A Hunter's Calling#144.dst: Es la única vez que el rey se ha dignado a reconocer que existimos, ¿y quiere echarnos a la calle?
A Hunter's Calling#144.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#145.src: We will not leave, simple as that. You'd better get out before someone lays you out for coming here.
A Hunter's Calling#145.dst: No nos iremos, así de simple. Mejor lárgate antes de que alguien te tumbe por venir aquí.
A Hunter's Calling#145.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#146.src: Return to the advisor for what to do next.
A Hunter's Calling#146.dst: Vuelve con el consejero para saber qué hacer.

A Hunter's Calling#147.src: As expected... Well, the King's orders are orders. They must be followed, but...
A Hunter's Calling#147.dst: Lo esperado... Bueno, las órdenes del rey son órdenes. Hay que cumplirlas, pero...
A Hunter's Calling#147.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#148.src: Good God, he wants to cave it in?! Explosives, dynamite? What's the meaning of all this?!
A Hunter's Calling#148.dst: ¡¿Santo cielo, quiere derrumbarlo?! ¿Explosivos, dinamita? ¡¿Qué significa todo esto?!
A Hunter's Calling#148.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#149.src: I... here. At least inform them before you set off the explosives that you're doing this, please...
A Hunter's Calling#149.dst: Yo... toma. Al menos avísales de lo que vas a hacer antes de detonar los explosivos, por favor...
A Hunter's Calling#149.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#150.src: Head deep inside the slums and blow it up.
A Hunter's Calling#150.dst: Adéntrate en los barrios bajos y vuélalos.

A Hunter's Calling#152.src: ...once again. You wonder. To what end?

A Hunter's Calling#153.src: The question taunts you. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#153.dst: La pregunta te acosa. ¿Con qué fin?

A Hunter's Calling#154.src: Your soul. We see your soul. Conflicted.
A Hunter's Calling#154.dst: Tu alma. Vemos tu alma. En conflicto.

A Hunter's Calling#155.src: You panic. We do not taint it. We do not darken it.
A Hunter's Calling#155.dst: Te alarmas. No la manchamos. No la oscurecemos.

A Hunter's Calling#156.src: But to what end, you ask. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#156.dst: Pero ¿con qué fin?, preguntas. Así que, ¿te ofrecemos un fin?

A Hunter's Calling#157.src: Metal. Life. A new place... One is not sacrificed for another. Always distrusting. Tension, as the clockworks chime.
A Hunter's Calling#157.dst: Metal. Vida. Un nuevo lugar... Ninguno se sacrifica por otro. Siempre desconfiando. Tensión, mientras suenan los engranajes.

A Hunter's Calling#158.src: Metal. Life. A new place... One is not sacrificed for another. Always distrusting. Tension, as the clockworks chime.
A Hunter's Calling#158.dst: Metal. Vida. Un nuevo lugar... Ninguno se sacrifica por otro. Siempre desconfiando. Tensión, mientras suenan los engranajes.

A Hunter's Calling#159.src: AH, GOOD. I LIKE THE LOOKS OF THIS ONE. I WILL HAVE TO THANK WHOEVER MADE THIS MECH.
A Hunter's Calling#159.dst: AH, BIEN. ME GUSTA EL ASPECTO DE ESTE. TENDRÉ QUE DARLE LAS GRACIAS A QUIEN HIZO ESTE MECH.
A Hunter's Calling#159.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#160.src: MECH PL-{~}Y. CAN YOU UNDERSTAND ME? ARE YOUR AUDIO RECEPTORS FUNCTIONAL? YES? GOOD.
A Hunter's Calling#160.dst: MECH PL-{~}Y. ¿ME ENTIENDES? ¿FUNCIONAN TUS RECEPTORES DE AUDIO? ¿SÍ? BIEN.
A Hunter's Calling#160.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#161.src: I WILL GIVE YOU YOUR PURPOSE. I CANNOT BELIEVE IT HAS COME TO THIS POINT. BUT AFTER THAT HUMAN DESTROYED OUR FACILITY...
A Hunter's Calling#161.dst: TE DARÉ TU PROPÓSITO. NO PUEDO CREER QUE HAYAMOS LLEGADO A ESTO. PERO TRAS DESTRUIR ESE HUMANO NUESTRAS INSTALACIONES...
A Hunter's Calling#161.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#162.src: IT WAS A GOOD THING I HAD BACKUP CORES PREPARED. MY SARCASTIC STATEMENTS MOST LIKELY TRICKED THE HUMAN INTO THINKING THEY DESTROYED ME FULLY.
A Hunter's Calling#162.dst: MENOS MAL QUE TENÍA NÚCLEOS DE RESPALDO. MIS COMENTARIOS SARCÁSTICOS SEGURAMENTE HICIERON CREER AL HUMANO QUE ME HABÍA DESTRUIDO DEL TODO.
A Hunter's Calling#162.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#163.src: AFTER SOME INVESTIGATION, IT CAME TO LIGHT THAT THE AVOS AIDED THE HUMANS. I HONESTLY COULD NOT UNDERSTAND WHY.
A Hunter's Calling#163.dst: TRAS INVESTIGAR, SALIÓ A LA LUZ QUE LOS AVOS AYUDARON A LOS HUMANOS. SINCERAMENTE, NO ENTIENDO POR QUÉ.
A Hunter's Calling#163.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#164.src: I CANNOT COMPUTE ANY OTHER POSSIBLE INTERPRETATION OF MY ORDER TO DESTROY THE HIGHEST THREATS AT THIS POINT.
A Hunter's Calling#164.dst: NO PUEDO CALCULAR OTRA INTERPRETACIÓN POSIBLE DE MI ORDEN DE DESTRUIR LAS MAYORES AMENAZAS A ESTAS ALTURAS.
A Hunter's Calling#164.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#165.src: BOTH THE AVOS AND HUMANS ARE INCREDIBLY DANGEROUS. I MEAN, HAVE YOU- WAIT. YOU WOULD NOT HAVE SEEN LEGENDARY ISLAND.
A Hunter's Calling#165.dst: TANTO LOS AVOS COMO LOS HUMANOS SON MUY PELIGROSOS. O SEA, ¿HAS- ESPERA. NO HABRÁS VISTO LEGENDARY ISLAND.
A Hunter's Calling#165.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#166.src: JUST KNOW THAT THEY'RE BOTH CRAZY. IF I AM TO FINISH MY PROGRAMMED ORDERS, BOTH OF THEM MUST BE DESTROYED, HOWEVER MUCH I HATE THE IDEA.
A Hunter's Calling#166.dst: BASTA CON QUE SEPAS QUE AMBOS ESTÁN LOCOS. SI HE DE CUMPLIR MIS ÓRDENES PROGRAMADAS, HAY QUE DESTRUIR A AMBOS, POR MUCHO QUE ME DISGUSTE.
A Hunter's Calling#166.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#167.src: IT IS YOUR JOB TO CREATE DISTRUST BETWEEN THEM, MAKE SURE YOU AREN'T SEEN. THE AVOS ARE ALREADY SKEPTICAL OF THE CORKIANS.
A Hunter's Calling#167.dst: TU TRABAJO ES SEMBRAR LA DESCONFIANZA ENTRE ELLOS. QUE NO TE VEAN. LOS AVOS YA RECELAN DE LOS CORKIANOS.
A Hunter's Calling#167.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#168.src: AND THE HUMANS WERE IDIOTIC ENOUGH TO KEEP A CATAPULT AIMED AT THE AVOS SETTLEMENT. TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THEIR STUPIDITY.
A Hunter's Calling#168.dst: Y LOS HUMANOS FUERON TAN IDIOTAS COMO PARA APUNTAR UNA CATAPULTA AL POBLADO AVOS. APROVECHA SU ESTUPIDEZ.
A Hunter's Calling#168.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#169.src: Find a rock to launch into the Avos territory and a battery to activate the catapult.
A Hunter's Calling#169.dst: Busca una roca para lanzarla al territorio Avos y una batería para activar la catapulta.

A Hunter's Calling#170.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: REALLY, WHO'S SO STUPID AS TO LEAVE A CATAPULT AIMED AT YOUR ALLIES?
A Hunter's Calling#170.dst: INICIO DE TRANSMISIÓN: EN SERIO, ¿QUIÉN APUNTA UNA CATAPULTA A SUS ALIADOS?
A Hunter's Calling#170.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#171.src: Bzzt... Hello World.NEW ENEMY REGISTERED: AVOS. Proceed with attack protocol- click.
A Hunter's Calling#171.dst: Bzzt... Hola, mundo. NUEVO ENEMIGO REGISTRADO: AVOS. Procediendo con protocolo de ataque- clic.

A Hunter's Calling#172.src: SURELY THE AVOS' NATURAL PREFERENCE FOR TREBUCHETS WILL SPARK CONFLICT. IN ADDITION TO THE STONE YOU WILL BE LOBBING THROUGH THEIR WALLS.
A Hunter's Calling#172.dst: SEGURO QUE LA PREFERENCIA NATURAL DE LOS AVOS POR LAS CATAPULTAS DE CONTRAPESO AVIVARÁ EL CONFLICTO. ADEMÁS DE LA PIEDRA QUE LANZARÁS CONTRA SUS MUROS.
A Hunter's Calling#172.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#175.src: RESUME TRANSMISSION: YOU WILL TAKE STONE FROM THIS AREA. IT IS LIKELY TO SHATTER AND INFLICT MORE COLLATERAL DAMAGE.
A Hunter's Calling#175.dst: REANUDAR TRANSMISIÓN: COGERÁS PIEDRA DE ESTA ZONA. ES PROBABLE QUE SE HAGA AÑICOS Y CAUSE MÁS DAÑOS COLATERALES.
A Hunter's Calling#175.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#176.src: AND SOMEHOW, THEY MADE A WOODEN CATAPULT ACTIVATE ONLY THROUGH ELECTROMAGIC. YOU SHOULD BE ABLE TO ACTIVATE IT OF YOUR OWN ACCORD.
A Hunter's Calling#176.dst: Y DE ALGÚN MODO, HICIERON QUE UNA CATAPULTA DE MADERA SOLO SE ACTIVE CON ELECTROMAGIA. DEBERÍAS PODER ACTIVARLA POR TU CUENTA.
A Hunter's Calling#176.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#177.src: END TRANSMISSION. Mech PL-{~}Y. When you have completed your objective I will return you to Factory base.
A Hunter's Calling#177.dst: FIN DE TRANSMISIÓN. Mech PL-{~}Y. Cuando completes tu objetivo, te devolveré a la base de la Fábrica.
A Hunter's Calling#177.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#178.src: I'm... in shock. We aid them in destroying their factory, and...
A Hunter's Calling#178.dst: Estoy... en shock. Les ayudamos a destruir su fábrica, y...
A Hunter's Calling#178.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#179.src: Round up our defenses and sharpen the spears. There is no excuse for this.
A Hunter's Calling#179.dst: Reúne nuestras defensas y afila las lanzas. Esto no tiene excusa.
A Hunter's Calling#179.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#181.src: Chieftain! We noticed the same thing as you did and I promise you, it was not us who did this.
A Hunter's Calling#181.dst: ¡Jefe! Vimos lo mismo que vosotros y os prometo que no fuimos nosotros.
A Hunter's Calling#181.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#182.src: Maxie! There is no more 'both sides' here! This is not your people tearing up the earth, this is your people making attempts on our lives!
A Hunter's Calling#182.dst: ¡Maxie! ¡Aquí ya no hay 'dos bandos'! ¡Tu gente ya no solo destroza la tierra, ahora atenta contra nuestras vidas!
A Hunter's Calling#182.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#183.src: No, I swear this wasn't planned! I'm on the city council now! There's got to be another explanation. There's still mechs around, it could have been one of them!
A Hunter's Calling#183.dst: ¡No, lo juro, esto no estaba planeado! ¡Ahora estoy en el consejo de la ciudad! Tiene que haber otra explicación. Aún quedan mechs, ¡pudo ser uno de ellos!
A Hunter's Calling#183.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#184.src: And what would those monstrosities be taking orders from now? Your factory is shut down, as it ought to be!
A Hunter's Calling#184.dst: ¿Y de quién recibirían órdenes esas monstruosidades? ¡Vuestra fábrica está cerrada, como debe ser!
A Hunter's Calling#184.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#185.src: I'll investigate this myself. There's got to be some other explanation! Please, hold off on the war preparations!
A Hunter's Calling#185.dst: Lo investigaré yo mismo. ¡Tiene que haber otra explicación! ¡Por favor, detened los preparativos de guerra!
A Hunter's Calling#185.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#186.src: Steal the Avos totem and activate it outside of {p}
A Hunter's Calling#186.dst: Roba el tótem de los Avos y actívalo a las afueras de {p}

A Hunter's Calling#187.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: THAT WOULD HAVE BEEN ALL WE NEEDED TO DO, IF NOT FOR SOMEONE INTERFERING. YOU DID YOUR JOB PERFECTLY, MECH PL-{~}Y.
A Hunter's Calling#187.dst: INICIO DE TRANSMISIÓN: ESO HABRÍA BASTADO, DE NO SER POR UN ENTROMETIDO. HICISTE TU TRABAJO A LA PERFECCIÓN, MECH PL-{~}Y.
A Hunter's Calling#187.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#188.src: BUT THERE WILL BE ANOTHER TASK FOR YOU. IT IS TIME TO MAKE THE AVOS LOOK AS THOUGH THEY ARE ATTACKING.
A Hunter's Calling#188.dst: PERO TENDRÁS OTRA TAREA. ES HORA DE HACER QUE PAREZCA QUE LOS AVOS ESTÁN ATACANDO.
A Hunter's Calling#188.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#189.src: THERE IS A TOTEM IN THE AVOS CHIEFTAIN'S TENT THAT CAN HARNESS DRUIDIC MAGIC. YOU WILL STEAL IT AND ATTACK CORKUS CITY.
A Hunter's Calling#189.dst: EN LA TIENDA DEL JEFE AVOS HAY UN TÓTEM QUE CANALIZA MAGIA DRUÍDICA. LO ROBARÁS Y ATACARÁS LA CIUDAD DE CORKUS.
A Hunter's Calling#189.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#190.src: Benefits can be new Beacons, increased chance for Vibrant Beacons, and more!
A Hunter's Calling#190.dst: ¡Ventajas como nuevas balizas, más opciones de balizas vibrantes y más!

A Hunter's Calling#191.src: YOU WILL BREAK IN, AIDED BY THE TELEPORTATION MECH THAT I AM SENDING THIS MESSAGE THROUGH. DO NOT GET CAUGHT.
A Hunter's Calling#191.dst: ENTRARÁS CON AYUDA DEL MECH DE TELETRANSPORTE A TRAVÉS DEL QUE ENVÍO ESTE MENSAJE. QUE NO TE ATRAPEN.
A Hunter's Calling#191.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#192.src: END TRANSMISSION. Mech PL-{~}Y. When you have completed your objective I will return you to Next objective location.
A Hunter's Calling#192.dst: FIN DE TRANSMISIÓN. Mech PL-{~}Y. Cuando completes tu objetivo, te llevaré al siguiente objetivo.
A Hunter's Calling#192.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#195.src: Sending Mech PL-{~}Y to Next objective location...
A Hunter's Calling#195.dst: Enviando Mech PL-{~}Y al siguiente objetivo...
A Hunter's Calling#195.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#196.src: WHAT IS THAT!? THE AVOS ARE ATTACKING?
A Hunter's Calling#196.speaker: Corkus Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#197.src: They listened to me... right? Why's this-
A Hunter's Calling#197.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#198.src: What in the world...? That's Avos magic!
A Hunter's Calling#198.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#199.src: Why're they attacking us? This is on a way bigger scale than finding grapevines in my laundry machine!
A Hunter's Calling#199.dst: ¿Por qué nos atacan? ¡Esto es mucho peor que encontrar parras en mi lavadora!
A Hunter's Calling#199.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#200.src: Don't panic! I'll talk to the Chieftain. There's been some kind of mistake here, I'm certain of it!
A Hunter's Calling#200.dst: ¡Que no cunda el pánico! Hablaré con el jefe. Ha habido algún error, ¡estoy seguro!
A Hunter's Calling#200.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#201.src: Chief! I thought I asked you to put away your war drums!
A Hunter's Calling#201.dst: ¡Jefe! ¡Creía haberte pedido que guardaras los tambores de guerra!
A Hunter's Calling#201.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#202.src: We HAVE, Maxie. Do not make accusations upon us, on our own land.
A Hunter's Calling#202.dst: Y LO HEMOS HECHO, Maxie. No nos acuses en nuestra propia tierra.
A Hunter's Calling#202.speaker: Avos Chieftain

A Hunter's Calling#203.src: {p} was attacked today! A magical root broke through our wall. This is nature magic, an Avos specialty!
A Hunter's Calling#203.dst: ¡Hoy han atacado {p}! Una raíz mágica atravesó el muro. Es magia de la naturaleza, ¡la especialidad Avos!
A Hunter's Calling#203.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#204.src: Hm. Convenient, that one of our prized ceremonial totems has gone missing. You may be right that someone is attempting to cause insurgence.
A Hunter's Calling#204.dst: Hm. Qué oportuno que haya desaparecido uno de nuestros preciados tótems ceremoniales. Quizá tengas razón y alguien intente provocar una revuelta.
A Hunter's Calling#204.speaker: Avos Chieftain

A Hunter's Calling#205.src: I knew this was some kind of mistake! I'll get to the bottom of this!
A Hunter's Calling#205.dst: ¡Sabía que era algún error! ¡Llegaré al fondo de esto!
A Hunter's Calling#205.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#206.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: THERE'S AN ANNOYING WRENCH IN THE WORKS. YOU'VE BEEN DOING YOUR WORK PERFECTLY, MECH PL-{~}Y.
A Hunter's Calling#206.dst: INICIO DE TRANSMISIÓN: HAY UN ESTORBO MOLESTO EN EL PLAN. HAS HECHO TU TRABAJO A LA PERFECCIÓN, MECH PL-{~}Y.
A Hunter's Calling#206.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#207.src: I'VE GOT ONE MORE ORDER FOR YOU THAT SHOULD TIP THINGS OVER THE EDGE. STAND BY FOR TELEPORTATION.
A Hunter's Calling#207.dst: TENGO UNA ÚLTIMA ORDEN PARA TI QUE DEBERÍA DESBORDAR EL VASO. PREPÁRATE PARA EL TELETRANSPORTE.
A Hunter's Calling#207.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#208.dst: Sube a la torre del reloj de Corkus.

A Hunter's Calling#209.src: THERE IS A SET OF STATISTICALLY INFERIOR MECHS BUILT BY THE CORKIANS IN THIS TOWER, I HAVE A SET OF SYSTEMS PROGRAMMED IN THIS DEVICE.
A Hunter's Calling#209.dst: EN ESTA TORRE HAY UNOS MECHS ESTADÍSTICAMENTE INFERIORES CONSTRUIDOS POR LOS CORKIANOS. TENGO UNOS SISTEMAS PROGRAMADOS EN ESTE DISPOSITIVO.
A Hunter's Calling#209.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#210.src: THIS WILL OVERRIDE THEIR CURRENT PROGRAMMING AND SEND THEM TO ATTACK THE AVOS SETTLEMENT. THEY'LL BE SO DISGUSTED BY THE CORKIAN'S RELENTLESS BRANDING...
A Hunter's Calling#210.dst: ESTO SOBRESCRIBIRÁ SU PROGRAMACIÓN Y LOS ENVIARÁ A ATACAR EL POBLADO AVOS. LES DARÁ TANTO ASCO LA INCESANTE PUBLICIDAD CORKIANA...
A Hunter's Calling#210.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#211.src: NO, I CAN'T EVEN KEEP UP THE SARCASTIC FACADE ANYMORE. THEY'LL ATTACK AND KILL AVOS PEOPLE AND SET THE CIVIL WAR BLAZING. DO YOUR JOB QUICKLY. END TRANSMISSION.
A Hunter's Calling#211.dst: NO, YA NI SIQUIERA PUEDO MANTENER LA FACHADA SARCÁSTICA. ATACARÁN Y MATARÁN AVOS Y AVIVARÁN LA GUERRA CIVIL. HAZ TU TRABAJO RÁPIDO. FIN DE TRANSMISIÓN.
A Hunter's Calling#211.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#212.src: Bzzt... Ḣ̸̺ë̴̩́l̷̼͕̄l̵̹̐ó̸̦̠ ̸̡̠͆ẇ̴̟̮o̵͙͗͂ṟ̵̢́̚l̴̤͕̈d̶̹̍ͅ.̷̛̤͋NEW ENEMY REGISTERED: AVOS. Proceed with attack protocol- click.
A Hunter's Calling#212.dst: Bzzt... H%l@, m#nd0.NUEVO ENEMIGO REGISTRADO: AVOS. Procediendo con protocolo de ataque- clic.
A Hunter's Calling#212.speaker: Corkus Guard

A Hunter's Calling#214.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: YOUR JOB IS OVER, MECH PL-{~}Y. I HESITATE TO SAY YOU DID A GOOD JOB, BECAUSE THE JOB WAS ANYTHING BUT GOOD. IT WAS NECESSARY THOUGH.
A Hunter's Calling#214.dst: INICIO DE TRANSMISIÓN: TU TRABAJO HA TERMINADO, MECH PL-{~}Y. DUDO EN DECIR QUE LO HICISTE BIEN, PORQUE EL TRABAJO FUE TODO MENOS BUENO. PERO ERA NECESARIO.
A Hunter's Calling#214.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#215.src: WE WILL BE ABLE TO LET THEM TEAR EACH OTHER TO SHREDS INSTEAD OF GETTING INVOLVED AND SPARKING SUSPICION.
A Hunter's Calling#215.dst: PODREMOS DEJAR QUE SE DESPEDACEN ENTRE ELLOS EN LUGAR DE INTERVENIR Y LEVANTAR SOSPECHAS.
A Hunter's Calling#215.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#216.src: I HAD WANTED TO FIND A SOLUTION THAT WOULD NOT REQUIRE A FRESH START. IF MY HAND WAS NOT FORCED, PERHAPS. BUT THAT IS IRRELEVANT NOW.
A Hunter's Calling#216.dst: QUERÍA ENCONTRAR UNA SOLUCIÓN QUE NO EXIGIERA EMPEZAR DE CERO. SI NO ME HUBIERAN FORZADO, QUIZÁ. PERO YA DA IGUAL.
A Hunter's Calling#216.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#217.src: YOU WILL RETURN TO THE FACTORY WITH THE TELEPORTATION MECH AND REMAIN UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE-
A Hunter's Calling#217.dst: VOLVERÁS A LA FÁBRICA CON EL MECH DE TELETRANSPORTE Y TE QUEDARÁS HASTA NUEVO AVISO-
A Hunter's Calling#217.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#218.src: I knew it! It was such a longshot, but I knew the Factory still had to be at large! And now I have evidence to prove it, too!
A Hunter's Calling#218.dst: ¡Lo sabía! Era muy improbable, ¡pero sabía que la Fábrica seguía suelta! ¡Y ahora también tengo pruebas!
A Hunter's Calling#218.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#219.src: This time we'll make sure you won't get another chance. I'll tell everyone what happened, and then we'll tear that factory down at the foundations!
A Hunter's Calling#219.dst: Esta vez nos aseguraremos de que no tengáis otra oportunidad. Contaré a todos lo que pasó, ¡y derribaremos esa fábrica desde los cimientos!
A Hunter's Calling#219.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#220.src: You should've picked a more private meeting place! I'm out!
A Hunter's Calling#220.dst: ¡Deberíais haber elegido un sitio más discreto! ¡Me largo!
A Hunter's Calling#220.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#223.src: Aah, you're fast! You caught up this quick?! I have no other choice...
A Hunter's Calling#223.dst: ¡Ah, qué rápido eres! ¡¿Ya me has alcanzado?! No me queda otra...
A Hunter's Calling#223.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#224.src: You aren't going to stop me from getting to the battleground! You look like you were scrounged up from rust and verdigris!
A Hunter's Calling#224.dst: ¡No me impedirás llegar al campo de batalla! ¡Pareces hecho de óxido y cardenillo!
A Hunter's Calling#224.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#225.src: Surrender, or I'll use my own mechs to smash you to scrap metal!
A Hunter's Calling#225.dst: ¡Ríndete, o mis propios mechs te harán chatarra!
A Hunter's Calling#225.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#226.src: You have defeated both of my most powerful creations...
A Hunter's Calling#226.dst: Has derrotado a mis dos creaciones más poderosas...
A Hunter's Calling#226.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#227.src: I usually don't do this... but I guess I have no other option. I need to get this information to the others.
A Hunter's Calling#227.dst: No suelo hacer esto... pero supongo que no tengo alternativa. Tengo que llevar esta información a los demás.
A Hunter's Calling#227.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#228.src: No... I... have to tell them.
A Hunter's Calling#228.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#230.src: ...you harden your heart. There is no end, you think.
A Hunter's Calling#230.dst: ...endureces tu corazón. No hay fin, piensas.

A Hunter's Calling#231.src: Wrong. The end is in sight.
A Hunter's Calling#231.dst: Error. El fin está a la vista.

A Hunter's Calling#232.src: Your soul. It awakens to something new.
A Hunter's Calling#232.dst: Tu alma. Despierta a algo nuevo.

A Hunter's Calling#233.src: Not dark. Not light. Not in-between. But separate.
A Hunter's Calling#233.dst: Ni oscura. Ni luminosa. Ni intermedia. Sino aparte.

A Hunter's Calling#234.src: Power. Gain. Risk. New beginnings, from an end.
A Hunter's Calling#234.dst: Poder. Ganancia. Riesgo. Nuevos comienzos, desde un fin.

A Hunter's Calling#235.src: So... may we offer you the end?

A Hunter's Calling#236.src: The very center... the place deemed closest to your home. There, in the center of Wynn... You shall find the end.
A Hunter's Calling#236.dst: El centro mismo... el lugar que se considera más cercano a tu hogar. Allí, en el centro de Wynn... Hallarás el fin.

A Hunter's Calling#237.src: The very center... the place deemed closest to your home. There, in the center of Wynn... You shall find the end.
A Hunter's Calling#237.dst: El centro mismo... el lugar que se considera más cercano a tu hogar. Allí, en el centro de Wynn... Hallarás el fin.

A Hunter's Calling#238.src: Halt! Who goes there? Stop, in the name of the {p} army!
A Hunter's Calling#238.dst: ¡Alto! ¿Quién va? ¡Deténte, en nombre del ejército de {p}!
A Hunter's Calling#238.speaker: Aegis

A Hunter's Calling#239.src: Should you continue, you shall face the strength and courage of Admiral Aegis!
A Hunter's Calling#239.dst: ¡Si sigues adelante, te enfrentarás a la fuerza y el valor del almirante Aegis!
A Hunter's Calling#239.speaker: Aegis

A Hunter's Calling#241.src: We cannot back down against any foe! Chaaaarge!!
A Hunter's Calling#241.dst: ¡No podemos retroceder ante ningún enemigo! ¡A la caaarga!
A Hunter's Calling#241.speaker: Aegis

A Hunter's Calling#243.src: Excuse me, I think you're forgetting someone.
A Hunter's Calling#243.dst: Perdona, creo que te olvidas de alguien.

A Hunter's Calling#244.src: {p} will not fall today. We'll be making sure of that!

A Hunter's Calling#246.src: TASIM! How the hell did you manage to kill him?!
A Hunter's Calling#246.speaker: Aledar

A Hunter's Calling#248.src: This isn't over! Once your little lackey's dead I'm coming after you!!
A Hunter's Calling#248.dst: ¡Esto no ha acabado! ¡En cuanto tu lacayo muera, iré a por ti!
A Hunter's Calling#248.speaker: Aledar

A Hunter's Calling#249.src: ...no sense screaming for the dead. But do you think I'm going to just give up like that?
A Hunter's Calling#249.dst: ...no sirve de nada gritar por los muertos. ¿Pero crees que me voy a rendir así como así?
A Hunter's Calling#249.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#250.src: Hah. Didn't know corrupteds had a sense of humor, twisted as it might be.
A Hunter's Calling#250.dst: Ja. No sabía que los corruptos tuvieran sentido del humor, por retorcido que sea.
A Hunter's Calling#250.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#251.src: I won't dare die while everything here is at stake.
A Hunter's Calling#251.dst: No pienso morir con todo esto en juego.
A Hunter's Calling#251.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#252.src: How's this then, hm? Think your PEON can handle me at my strongest?
A Hunter's Calling#252.dst: ¿Qué tal esto, eh? ¿Crees que tu PEÓN puede conmigo a plena fuerza?
A Hunter's Calling#252.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#254.src: And so, you have reached an end.
A Hunter's Calling#254.dst: Y así, has llegado a un fin.

A Hunter's Calling#255.src: You wonder. It is an end... But to what... purpose. What will you gain?
A Hunter's Calling#255.dst: Te preguntas. Es un fin... ¿Pero con qué... propósito? ¿Qué ganarás?

A Hunter's Calling#256.src: You have seen loss. Destruction. Betrayal. All ends, to some other than you. Ends that never came to pass...
A Hunter's Calling#256.dst: Has visto pérdida. Destrucción. Traición. Todos fines, para otros y no para ti. Fines que nunca llegaron...

A Hunter's Calling#257.src: To end is a powerful thing. To find your end... You may never stop searching. You may find your end in but a day's time.
A Hunter's Calling#257.dst: Acabar es algo poderoso. Para hallar tu fin... Quizá nunca dejes de buscar. Quizá lo halles en apenas un día.

A Hunter's Calling#258.src: But here... you will gain the power to bring an end. To be brought yours.
A Hunter's Calling#258.dst: Pero aquí... ganarás el poder de traer un fin. De recibir el tuyo.

A Hunter's Calling#259.src: My armies have been sent to the other cities. Their hero is inevitably busy.
A Hunter's Calling#259.dst: Mis ejércitos están en las otras ciudades. Su héroe estará ocupado.

A Hunter's Calling#260.src: Hm... Ah, hello there! Good to see you around, recruit. Is there anything you needed?
A Hunter's Calling#260.dst: Hm... ¡Ah, hola! Me alegro de verte por aquí, recluta. ¿Necesitabas algo?

A Hunter's Calling#261.src: After the King of {p} ordered the slums cave-in, another war broke out.
A Hunter's Calling#261.dst: Tras ordenar el rey de {p} derrumbar los barrios bajos, estalló otra guerra.

A Hunter's Calling#262.src: Yellow Beacons are pretty common, and they're great if you want to maximize your net loot throughout your run!
A Hunter's Calling#262.dst: Las balizas amarillas son bastante comunes, ¡y van genial si quieres maximizar tu botín total en la partida!

A Hunter's Calling#264.src: However. Though the change is irrevocable...
A Hunter's Calling#264.dst: Sin embargo. Aunque el cambio es irrevocable...

A Hunter's Calling#265.src: The power to bring an end. It is a choice. And that... Whether you will use that power, we cannot tell you.
A Hunter's Calling#265.dst: El poder de traer un fin. Es una elección. Y si... usarás ese poder, no podemos decírtelo.

A Hunter's Calling#266.src: You must deign to take that choice.
A Hunter's Calling#266.dst: Debes dignarte a tomar esa elección.

A Hunter's Calling#267.src: We may offer you not one more end.
A Hunter's Calling#267.dst: No podemos ofrecerte ni un fin más.

A Hunter's Calling#268.src: You must find your final end yourself. We will remain... And offer others the same. And so...
A Hunter's Calling#268.dst: Debes hallar tu fin último por ti mismo. Nosotros seguiremos... Y ofreceremos lo mismo a otros. Y así...

A Hunter's Calling#270.src: ???: But here...you will gain the power to bring an end. To be brought yours.
A Hunter's Calling#270.dst: ???: Pero aquí... ganarás el poder de traer un fin. De recibir el tuyo.

A Journey Beyond#000.src: Well... we are, but I'd like to brief {u} on the details first. This is a dangerous mission, so... I think it's best to fill them in.
A Journey Beyond#000.dst: Bueno... sí, pero antes quiero ponerle al día a {u}. Es una misión peligrosa, así que... mejor que esté al tanto de todo.

similar.text: Well... we are, but I'd like to brief on the details first. This is a dangerous mission, so... I think it's best to fill them in.

A Journey Beyond#001.src: Join Elphaba on a mission in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Journey Beyond#001.dst: Únete a Elphaba en una misión en {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Journey Beyond#002.src: ...Hm? Oh- uh, hello there. Sorry, we have this space reserved for...
A Journey Beyond#002.dst: ...¿Hm? Oh... eh, hola. Perdona, tenemos este sitio reservado para...
A Journey Beyond#002.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#003.src: Wait. You might be just what we're looking for. You look like you're capable in combat. How would you like to join a dangerous top secret mission?
A Journey Beyond#003.dst: Espera. Quizá seas justo lo que buscamos. Pareces capaz en combate. ¿Te apuntas a una misión peligrosa y secreta?
A Journey Beyond#003.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#004.src: ...I could have phrased that better. Look, the point is- we need a fourth. Let me give you the briefing, and if you don't want to join us... then we'll find someone else. How does that sound? Alright, here, follow me.
A Journey Beyond#004.dst: ...Podría haberlo dicho mejor. Mira, el caso es que nos falta un cuarto miembro. Deja que te informe, y si no quieres unirte... buscaremos a otra persona. ¿Qué te parece? Vale, ven, sígueme.
A Journey Beyond#004.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#005.src: And who's this? Did you really find a fourth? Come on, I told you we don't need one!
A Journey Beyond#005.dst: ¿Y quién es? ¿De verdad has encontrado a un cuarto? ¡Venga ya, te dije que no nos hace falta!
A Journey Beyond#005.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#006.src: And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is... sorry. I didn't catch your name. {u}? .
A Journey Beyond#006.dst: Y los dos seguimos explicándote por qué te equivocas. Te presento a... perdona, no he oído tu nombre. ¿{u}? .
A Journey Beyond#006.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#007.src: ... {u}, is that you? Wow, it's been a while. Sorry, I don't have time to chat right now. We're preparing for a dangerous mission, and...
A Journey Beyond#007.dst: ... ¿{u}, eres tú? Vaya, cuánto tiempo. Perdona, ahora no puedo charlar. Nos preparamos para una misión peligrosa, y...
A Journey Beyond#007.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#008.src: Well. Actually, we were looking for a fourth person to join us. And... you look like you fit the requirements for that position. If- if you'd like to join, that is.
A Journey Beyond#008.dst: Bueno. La verdad es que buscábamos a una cuarta persona. Y... pareces cumplir los requisitos. Si... si quieres unirte, claro.
A Journey Beyond#008.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#009.src: Tell you what. I'll give you the briefing, and if you don't want to join us... then we'll find someone else. How does that sound? Alright, here, follow me.
A Journey Beyond#009.dst: Hagamos una cosa. Te informo, y si no quieres unirte... buscaremos a otra persona. ¿Qué te parece? Vale, ven, sígueme.
A Journey Beyond#009.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#010.src: And who's this? Did you really find a fourth? Come on, I told you we don't need one!
A Journey Beyond#010.dst: ¿Y quién es? ¿De verdad has encontrado a un cuarto? ¡Venga ya, te dije que no nos hace falta!
A Journey Beyond#010.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#011.src: And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is {u}, we've worked together before.
A Journey Beyond#011.dst: Y los dos seguimos explicándote por qué te equivocas. Te presento a {u}, ya hemos trabajado juntos.
A Journey Beyond#011.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#012.src: Anyway, I want to give them the briefing before we head
A Journey Beyond#012.dst: En fin, quiero informarle antes de que nos vayamos
A Journey Beyond#012.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#013.src: Elphie, I'm back! I finally managed to catch Aegis, but he's not... happy. He thinks we should
A Journey Beyond#013.dst: ¡Elphie, ya estoy aquí! Por fin he pillado a Aegis, pero no está... contento. Cree que deberíamos
A Journey Beyond#013.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#014.src: Oh. {u}? What are you doing here? Gods, it's been a while, hasn't it?
A Journey Beyond#014.dst: Oh. ¿{u}? ¿Qué haces aquí? Dioses, cuánto tiempo, ¿no?
A Journey Beyond#014.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#015.src: They're our fourth. What were you saying about the Admiral?
A Journey Beyond#015.dst: Es nuestro cuarto miembro. ¿Qué decías del almirante?
A Journey Beyond#015.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#017.src: Nothing. If we have our fourth, we should be all set to go, shouldn't we?
A Journey Beyond#017.dst: Nada. Si ya tenemos cuarto miembro, estamos listos para irnos, ¿no?
A Journey Beyond#017.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#018.src: Well... we are, but I'd like to brief on the details first. This is a dangerous mission, so... I think it's best to fill them in.
A Journey Beyond#018.dst: Bueno... sí, pero antes quiero ponerle al día. Es una misión peligrosa, así que... mejor que esté al tanto de todo.
A Journey Beyond#018.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#019.src: So! You're aware of the {p}, yes? Hundreds of years ago, mining operations took place to extract emeralds from the earth. Until, for some unknown reason, they were halted.
A Journey Beyond#019.dst: ¡Bien! Conoces {p}, ¿verdad? Hace cientos de años se excavaba allí para extraer esmeraldas. Hasta que, por algún motivo, se detuvo.
A Journey Beyond#019.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#020.src: We don't know everything, but... evidence suggests they broke through to an undiscovered section of the Wynn province. There, they found... something.
A Journey Beyond#020.dst: No lo sabemos todo, pero... las pruebas indican que llegaron a una zona desconocida de la provincia de Wynn. Allí hallaron... algo.
A Journey Beyond#020.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#021.src: The land itself was said to be cursed. Not corrupted- they were very clear on that.
A Journey Beyond#021.dst: Se decía que la propia tierra estaba maldita. No corrupta: eso lo dejaron muy claro.
A Journey Beyond#021.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#022.src: Some other force makes its home in that place. The few reports we could find refer to it only as the Silent Expanse.
A Journey Beyond#022.dst: Otra fuerza habita en ese lugar. Los pocos informes que hallamos lo llaman solo Silent Expanse.
A Journey Beyond#022.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#023.src: The mines were sealed to prevent the spread of this new threat, but the cracks are beginning to show.
A Journey Beyond#023.dst: Sellaron las minas para frenar esta nueva amenaza, pero empiezan a verse las grietas.
A Journey Beyond#023.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#024.src: Strange and otherworldly creatures have begun to find their way through, threatening our province.
A Journey Beyond#024.dst: Criaturas extrañas de otro mundo han empezado a colarse y amenazan nuestra provincia.
A Journey Beyond#024.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#025.src: The existence of this place has been kept on a strict need-to-know basis.
A Journey Beyond#025.dst: La existencia de este lugar solo la conoce quien debe conocerla.
A Journey Beyond#025.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#026.src: That's where we come in! We're to battle our way through the mines, and scout out the potential danger level.
A Journey Beyond#026.dst: ¡Ahí entramos nosotros! Nos abriremos paso por las minas y evaluaremos el peligro.
A Journey Beyond#026.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#027.src: And we aren't going to be able to do it if we keep sitting around! The newbie's been briefed, let's get going already!
A Journey Beyond#027.dst: ¡Y no podremos hacerlo si seguimos aquí sentados! El novato ya está informado, ¡vámonos de una vez!
A Journey Beyond#027.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#028.src: H-hey! What're you doing to my fine establishment!
A Journey Beyond#028.dst: ¡E-eh! ¡¿Qué le estáis haciendo a mi local?!
A Journey Beyond#028.speaker: Rusty Bartender

A Journey Beyond#029.src: ...Shoot. Forgot he was still here. Sorry, barkeep! I'll fix it!
A Journey Beyond#029.dst: ...Vaya. Olvidé que seguía aquí. ¡Perdón, tabernero! ¡Lo arreglaré!
A Journey Beyond#029.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#030.src: Lucio, you can't keep... ugh, forget it. I'll gather our supplies... Aledar, can you get us to the mines?
A Journey Beyond#030.dst: Lucio, no puedes seguir... uf, olvídalo. Reuniré provisiones... Aledar, ¿nos llevas a las minas?
A Journey Beyond#030.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#031.src: Yes, ma'am! {u}, when you're ready, let's get going.
A Journey Beyond#031.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#032.src: Follow your team towards the Silent Expanse's entrance.
A Journey Beyond#032.dst: Sigue a tu equipo hasta la entrada del Silent Expanse.

A Journey Beyond#034.src: It's a twist of fate that our paths have converged here, {u}. We started our journey together and now...
A Journey Beyond#034.dst: Es cosa del destino que nuestros caminos se crucen aquí, {u}. Empezamos el viaje juntos y ahora...
A Journey Beyond#034.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#037.src: Ah, no problem. I'll take care of these.
A Journey Beyond#037.dst: Ah, no hay problema. Yo me encargo.
A Journey Beyond#037.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#038.src: No more running for us, huh ? Ah, we're here.
A Journey Beyond#038.dst: Se acabó huir, ¿eh ? Ah, ya llegamos.
A Journey Beyond#038.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#039.src: This is actually our second attempt. The first time, it didn't go too well.
A Journey Beyond#039.dst: En realidad es nuestro segundo intento. La primera vez no salió muy bien.
A Journey Beyond#039.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#040.src: We have more numbers now, Lucio and yourself should help us overpower it.
A Journey Beyond#040.dst: Ahora somos más; Lucio y tú deberíais ayudarnos a dominarlo.
A Journey Beyond#040.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#041.src: Can't be that strong, bet I can take it myself.
A Journey Beyond#041.dst: No será para tanto, apuesto a que puedo con él solo.
A Journey Beyond#041.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#042.src: We managed to seal it in but with the {~} of us I'm sure we ca-
A Journey Beyond#042.dst: Logramos encerrarlo, pero con los {~} seguro que pod-
A Journey Beyond#042.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#046.src: What's the big deal? You said yourself we can take it!
A Journey Beyond#046.dst: ¿Qué pasa? ¡Tú mismo dijiste que podíamos con él!
A Journey Beyond#046.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#056.src: Is it just me or are our attacks doing NOTHING?
A Journey Beyond#056.dst: ¿Soy yo o nuestros ataques no le hacen NADA?
A Journey Beyond#056.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#057.src: Lucio's right! Change of plan. Lucio, help me hold it in place.
A Journey Beyond#057.dst: ¡Lucio tiene razón! Cambio de plan. Lucio, ayúdame a retenerlo.
A Journey Beyond#057.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#058.src: Aledar, you know what to do.
A Journey Beyond#058.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#059.src: {u}, come with me! Cast a spell to block the cave's entrance so the monster can't leave.
A Journey Beyond#059.dst: ¡{u}, ven conmigo! Lanza un hechizo para bloquear la entrada de la cueva y que el monstruo no salga.
A Journey Beyond#059.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#060.src: I'll block it from attacking, you block it up with a spell.
A Journey Beyond#060.dst: Yo evito que ataque, tú bloquéalo con un hechizo.
A Journey Beyond#060.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#061.src: They won't be able to hold it for long.
A Journey Beyond#061.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#064.src: Plan a way of killing the beast.
A Journey Beyond#064.dst: Planea una forma de matar a la bestia.

A Journey Beyond#067.src: Phew, here. Let me get you out.
A Journey Beyond#067.dst: Uf, toma. Deja que te saque.
A Journey Beyond#067.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#068.src: I'm sorry, team. I've never seen a monster like that before.
A Journey Beyond#068.dst: Lo siento, equipo. Nunca había visto un monstruo así.
A Journey Beyond#068.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#069.src: It looks like our problem isn't firepower. It's something else. It's like our weapons just didn't affect it at all.
A Journey Beyond#069.dst: Parece que el problema no es la potencia de fuego. Es otra cosa. Es como si nuestras armas no le afectaran.
A Journey Beyond#069.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#070.src: I know someone who might be able to help us. A blacksmith on {p}.
A Journey Beyond#070.dst: Conozco a alguien que quizá pueda ayudarnos. Un herrero en {p}.
A Journey Beyond#070.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#071.src: {u}, I've written the house's coordinates on your book. Meet us there.
A Journey Beyond#071.dst: {u}, he anotado las coordenadas de la casa en tu libro. Nos vemos allí.
A Journey Beyond#071.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#072.dst: Reúnete con los demás soldados en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Journey Beyond#073.src: Just in time. We're all here.
A Journey Beyond#073.dst: Justo a tiempo. Ya estamos todos.
A Journey Beyond#073.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#074.src: It looks like the Blacksmith knows what's wrong...
A Journey Beyond#074.dst: Parece que el herrero sabe qué pasa...
A Journey Beyond#074.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#075.src: So, Dren. Do you know why we can't damage the beast?
A Journey Beyond#075.dst: Bueno, Dren. ¿Sabes por qué no podemos dañar a la bestia?
A Journey Beyond#075.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#076.src: Certainly! Your issue is elemental. As you know, there are {~} elements...
A Journey Beyond#076.dst: ¡Claro! Vuestro problema es elemental. Como sabéis, hay {~} elementos...
A Journey Beyond#076.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#082.src: But.. There is a hidden element, Darkness .
A Journey Beyond#082.dst: Pero... hay un elemento oculto, la Oscuridad .
A Journey Beyond#082.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#083.src: Thank grook for that. I was wondering if we'd ever be rid of this nightmare.
A Journey Beyond#083.dst: Gracias al grook. Ya pensaba que nunca nos libraríamos de esta pesadilla.

A Journey Beyond#084.src: And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is... sorry, I didn't catch your name. {u}? {u}.
A Journey Beyond#084.dst: Y los dos seguimos explicándote por qué te equivocas. Te presento a... perdona, ¿tu nombre? ¿{u}? {u}.

A Journey Beyond#085.src: In order to damage a creature of Darkness, you must remove that influence from your soul.
A Journey Beyond#085.dst: Para dañar a una criatura de la Oscuridad, debéis eliminar esa influencia de vuestra alma.
A Journey Beyond#085.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#086.src: Some Dark creatures use a sort of synchronous barrier that prevents them being harmed by other creatures influenced with Darkness.
A Journey Beyond#086.dst: Algunas criaturas oscuras usan una barrera sincrónica que impide que les dañen otras criaturas influidas por la Oscuridad.
A Journey Beyond#086.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#087.src: In order to purify you, I will need {~} powerful items.
A Journey Beyond#087.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#088.src: Firstly, a shard from a Dernic Beast. There is one living in the depths of the {p}.
A Journey Beyond#088.dst: Primero, un fragmento de una Dernic Beast. Hay una en las profundidades de {p}.
A Journey Beyond#088.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#089.src: I will use this to reveal the darkness element in you all.
A Journey Beyond#089.dst: Lo usaré para revelar el elemento oscuro en todos vosotros.
A Journey Beyond#089.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#090.src: And then, of course, a Light item, to purify all of you...
A Journey Beyond#090.dst: Y luego, claro, un objeto de Luz para purificaros...
A Journey Beyond#090.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#091.src: Wait... what do you mean a Light item?
A Journey Beyond#091.dst: Espera... ¿cómo que un objeto de Luz?
A Journey Beyond#091.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#092.src: Something from any Light creature would work, you could get some dust from Gavel fairies if you wanted.
A Journey Beyond#092.dst: Serviría algo de cualquier criatura de Luz; podríais conseguir polvo de las hadas de Gavel, por ejemplo.
A Journey Beyond#092.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#094.src: Alright. Aledar, you get the Darkness item with {u}, and I'll go get the Light item with Lucio.
A Journey Beyond#094.dst: Bien. Aledar, tú consigue el objeto de Oscuridad con {u}, y yo iré a por el de Luz con Lucio.
A Journey Beyond#094.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#097.src: Here we are, the roots of Corruption. Let's go, {u}!
A Journey Beyond#097.dst: Aquí estamos, las raíces de la Corrupción. ¡Vamos, {u}!
A Journey Beyond#097.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#098.src: We found that the caves around the roots are far more complex than we thought...
A Journey Beyond#098.dst: Descubrimos que las cuevas junto a las raíces son mucho más complejas de lo que creíamos...
A Journey Beyond#098.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#099.src: There's one with far more powerful creatures... Somewhere... Here!
A Journey Beyond#099.dst: Hay una con criaturas mucho más poderosas... En algún sitio... ¡Aquí!
A Journey Beyond#099.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#100.src: What are you waiting for? Let's go!
A Journey Beyond#100.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#101.src: I don't think we can spell our way across, {u}! We need something like... Wings!
A Journey Beyond#101.dst: ¡No creo que podamos cruzar con hechizos, {u}! Necesitamos algo como... ¡Alas!
A Journey Beyond#101.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#102.src: I've never used wings like this before...
A Journey Beyond#102.dst: Nunca he usado alas como estas...
A Journey Beyond#102.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#103.src: I think if we just hold them and walk normally, it should help us glide across.
A Journey Beyond#103.dst: Creo que si las sostenemos y caminamos normal, nos ayudarán a planear.
A Journey Beyond#103.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#104.src: Don't drop them and don't get hit by the lava geysers, obviously.
A Journey Beyond#104.dst: No las sueltes y que no te den los géiseres de lava, obviamente.
A Journey Beyond#104.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#105.src: Don't forget why we are here, we're looking for a creature of darkness. Shout for me if you find one.
A Journey Beyond#105.dst: No olvides a qué venimos: buscamos una criatura de oscuridad. Avísame si encuentras una.
A Journey Beyond#105.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#106.src: Go deeper into the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the Shard.
A Journey Beyond#106.dst: Adéntrate en la cueva en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para conseguir el fragmento.

A Journey Beyond#107.src: That's our target! Go after it!
A Journey Beyond#107.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#108.src: Wait, why isn't it fighting us here? Careful! It might be trapped!
A Journey Beyond#108.dst: Espera, ¿por qué no pelea aquí? ¡Cuidado! ¡Puede ser una trampa!
A Journey Beyond#108.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#109.src: Chase the beast for the Shard.
A Journey Beyond#109.dst: Persigue a la bestia para conseguir el fragmento.

A Journey Beyond#110.src: Kill the Progenitors to open up the entrance.
A Journey Beyond#110.dst: Mata a los Progenitors para abrir la entrada.

A Journey Beyond#111.src: Kill the Mangled Progeny for the [{~} Corrupted Pearl].
A Journey Beyond#111.dst: Mata a la Mangled Progeny para conseguir [{~} Corrupted Pearl].

A Journey Beyond#112.src: Wow, I'm impressed . I honestly thought you would need my help.
A Journey Beyond#112.dst: Vaya, estoy impresionado . Creía que necesitarías mi ayuda.
A Journey Beyond#112.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#113.src: Well, we got what we came for. Let's head back to Dren.
A Journey Beyond#113.dst: Bueno, tenemos lo que vinimos a buscar. Volvamos con Dren.
A Journey Beyond#113.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#114.src: Return to the Blacksmith with the Darkness Item.
A Journey Beyond#114.dst: Vuelve con el herrero con el objeto de Oscuridad.

A Journey Beyond#115.src: Looks like we lucked out on this one. Did you get an item of darkness?
A Journey Beyond#115.dst: Parece que esta vez tuvimos suerte. ¿Conseguiste un objeto de oscuridad?
A Journey Beyond#115.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#116.src: That should do it. Let's see if this will work. Come here !
A Journey Beyond#116.dst: Con eso bastará. A ver si funciona. ¡Ven aquí !
A Journey Beyond#116.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#117.src: It's done! You ought to be free of the dark influence. You ought to be able to break through that barrier that was giving you trouble.
A Journey Beyond#117.dst: ¡Hecho! Ya deberíais estar libres de la influencia oscura. Deberíais poder atravesar esa barrera que os daba problemas.
A Journey Beyond#117.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#118.src: Are you sure? I don't feel that different. Well... I guess there's only one way to find out.
A Journey Beyond#118.dst: ¿Seguro? No me siento muy distinta. Bueno... solo hay una forma de averiguarlo.
A Journey Beyond#118.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#119.src: Re-open the closed entrance with the other warriors.
A Journey Beyond#119.dst: Vuelve a abrir la entrada cerrada con los demás guerreros.

A Journey Beyond#120.src: Everyone here? Great! Time to finish what I started!
A Journey Beyond#120.dst: ¿Estamos todos? ¡Genial! ¡Hora de terminar lo que empecé!
A Journey Beyond#120.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#121.src: Lucio! No! When will you learn?
A Journey Beyond#121.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#122.src: Right, yes. Sorry, what's the plan?
A Journey Beyond#122.dst: Vale, sí. Perdón, ¿cuál es el plan?
A Journey Beyond#122.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#123.src: We don't want that thing to escape, it could cause widespread panic.
A Journey Beyond#123.dst: No queremos que esa cosa escape, podría sembrar el pánico.
A Journey Beyond#123.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#124.src: We'll open up a small entrance to get in, and fight it once inside.
A Journey Beyond#124.dst: Abriremos una pequeña entrada y lucharemos contra él dentro.
A Journey Beyond#124.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#129.src: We have an extremely old map of the mines to help us, but we have no idea what's waiting for us.
A Journey Beyond#129.dst: Tenemos un mapa antiquísimo de las minas, pero no sabemos qué nos espera.
A Journey Beyond#129.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#130.src: I want to warn you, this may well be a one way ticket for all of us.
A Journey Beyond#130.dst: Quiero advertiros: puede que esto sea un billete de ida para todos.
A Journey Beyond#130.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#132.src: Rocks are one thing, Lucio. The creatures we're about to face require more than brute strength. You need force of mind.
A Journey Beyond#132.dst: Las rocas son una cosa, Lucio. Las criaturas que nos esperan exigen más que fuerza bruta. Hace falta fuerza mental.
A Journey Beyond#132.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#133.src: Oh my. Maybe this isn't the best idea.
A Journey Beyond#133.dst: Madre mía. Quizá no sea buena idea.
A Journey Beyond#133.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#134.src: It's too late now. We've got to finish this mission.
A Journey Beyond#134.dst: Ya es tarde. Tenemos que acabar esta misión.
A Journey Beyond#134.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#136.src: Remember the goal Elphie, we must reach the end of the expanse.
A Journey Beyond#136.dst: Recuerda el objetivo, Elphie: debemos llegar al final del Expanse.
A Journey Beyond#136.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#137.src: It's still empty here. But it looks like they were here only yesterday.
A Journey Beyond#137.dst: Aquí sigue vacío. Pero parece que estuvieron aquí ayer mismo.
A Journey Beyond#137.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#138.src: I thought you said the miners were here hundreds of years ago?
A Journey Beyond#138.dst: ¿No dijiste que los mineros estuvieron aquí hace cientos de años?
A Journey Beyond#138.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#139.src: They were. I don't know why it would be so well presevered. It's as if nothing has touched it.
A Journey Beyond#139.dst: Así es. No sé por qué está tan bien conservado. Es como si nada lo hubiera tocado.
A Journey Beyond#139.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#140.src: According to the documents, we need to make our way to the end of the road.
A Journey Beyond#140.dst: Según los documentos, hay que llegar al final del camino.
A Journey Beyond#140.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#142.src: So much for nothing being here.
A Journey Beyond#142.dst: Y eso de que aquí no había nada...
A Journey Beyond#142.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#143.src: Why are they only going for me?
A Journey Beyond#143.dst: ¿Por qué solo van a por mí?
A Journey Beyond#143.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#144.src: Aledar, how far is it to the end?
A Journey Beyond#144.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#145.src: I read the same map as you. It didn't even have scale. There should be a bridge ahead, though.
A Journey Beyond#145.dst: Leí el mismo mapa que tú. Ni siquiera tenía escala. Pero debería haber un puente más adelante.
A Journey Beyond#145.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#146.src: Uhh... A destroyed one. And it wasn't cause I blew it up this time!
A Journey Beyond#146.dst: Ehh... Uno destruido. ¡Y esta vez no fui yo quien lo voló!
A Journey Beyond#146.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#147.src: Hmm, well we will have to go around.
A Journey Beyond#147.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#148.src: This doesn't really look like corruption, does it?
A Journey Beyond#148.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#149.src: Uhhh... I'm not feeling really wel-... Aahhh!
A Journey Beyond#149.dst: Ehhh... No me encuentro muy bi-... ¡Aahhh!
A Journey Beyond#149.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#150.src: Aaahhh! My liver! It took my liver!
A Journey Beyond#150.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#153.src: Aledar, maybe we should just double back now?
A Journey Beyond#153.dst: Aledar, ¿y si damos media vuelta ya?
A Journey Beyond#153.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#154.src: Elphaba is an extremely able warrior. We will fight on and find her.
A Journey Beyond#154.dst: Elphaba es una guerrera muy capaz. Seguiremos luchando y la encontraremos.
A Journey Beyond#154.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#155.src: Do you really think it was just an illusion?
A Journey Beyond#155.dst: ¿De verdad crees que era solo una ilusión?
A Journey Beyond#155.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#156.src: I'm not sure. I hope so.
A Journey Beyond#156.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#157.src: What if we're infected too? Shouldn't we just go back?
A Journey Beyond#157.dst: ¿Y si también estamos infectados? ¿No deberíamos volver?
A Journey Beyond#157.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#158.src: We can't, Lucio! We have a mission, as you very well know. We continue.
A Journey Beyond#158.dst: ¡No podemos, Lucio! Tenemos una misión, lo sabes muy bien. Seguimos.
A Journey Beyond#158.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#159.src: Besides, we might be carrying some of those things too. We can't risk them infesting Wynn.
A Journey Beyond#159.dst: Además, puede que llevemos algunas de esas cosas encima. No podemos arriesgarnos a que infesten Wynn.
A Journey Beyond#159.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#160.src: Looks like we need to go around to the right, here?
A Journey Beyond#160.dst: Parece que hay que rodear por la derecha, ¿no?
A Journey Beyond#160.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#161.src: It feels like something is watching us...
A Journey Beyond#161.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#162.src: Aledar, what is this place? You didn't tell me there was a city here.
A Journey Beyond#162.dst: Aledar, ¿qué es este lugar? No me dijiste que aquí hubiera una ciudad.
A Journey Beyond#162.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#163.src: There is. A big one, too; there's more ahead. But it doesn't look like anyone's home. The map doesn't have a name for it either.
A Journey Beyond#163.dst: La hay. Y grande; hay más adelante. Pero no parece que haya nadie en casa. El mapa tampoco le da nombre.
A Journey Beyond#163.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#164.src: Wait a sec, is that one of the miners? Is she hurt? HEEEEY! YOU OVER THERE!
A Journey Beyond#164.dst: Espera, ¿esa es una de las mineras? ¿Está herida? ¡EEEEH! ¡TÚ, LA DE AHÍ!
A Journey Beyond#164.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#167.src: Wait, what's going on? Why can't I move?
A Journey Beyond#167.dst: Espera, ¿qué pasa? ¿Por qué no puedo moverme?
A Journey Beyond#167.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#170.src: We can't live alone like this!
A Journey Beyond#170.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#173.src: You need to come with us!
A Journey Beyond#173.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#174.src: It's the only way to keep you safe!
A Journey Beyond#174.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#175.src: It's the only way to make you happy here!
A Journey Beyond#175.dst: ¡Es la única forma de que seas feliz aquí!
A Journey Beyond#175.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#176.src: It's the only way to make us feel whole!
A Journey Beyond#176.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#177.src: IT'S THE ONLY WAY, DO YOU UNDERSTAND?!
A Journey Beyond#177.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#178.src: AAAH! S-Stop screaming at me! I can't understand!!
A Journey Beyond#178.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#181.src: CAN'T YOU HEAR WHAT I'M SAYING?
A Journey Beyond#181.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#183.src: No! How did she disable my spell?!
A Journey Beyond#183.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#185.src: YOU'LL BE SO MUCH HAPPIER IF YOU COME ALONG!
A Journey Beyond#185.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#186.src: YOU'LL NEVER HAVE TO WORRY AGAIN!
A Journey Beyond#186.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#189.src: Just please, stand still a little longer!
A Journey Beyond#189.dst: ¡Por favor, quédate quieto un poco más!
A Journey Beyond#189.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#191.src: You won't be hunted! We promise! No one hunts us!
A Journey Beyond#191.dst: ¡Nadie te cazará! ¡Lo prometemos! ¡A nosotros nadie nos caza!
A Journey Beyond#191.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#193.src: THANK YOU! WE WILL GO TOGETHER!
A Journey Beyond#193.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#195.src: NO MORE FEAR! NO MORE CONCERN!
A Journey Beyond#195.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#197.src: No no no!! This is bad, really bad! We have to go ! Quick!
A Journey Beyond#197.dst: ¡¡No, no, no!! ¡Esto es malo, muy malo! ¡Hay que irse ! ¡Rápido!
A Journey Beyond#197.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#200.src: Wait, you're just one of the miners. This doesn't feel like an illusion...
A Journey Beyond#200.dst: Espera, solo eres uno de los mineros. Esto no parece una ilusión...
A Journey Beyond#200.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#201.src: Look, you need to get out of here. It's not safe- Wait, what's that noise...?
A Journey Beyond#201.dst: Mira, tienes que salir de aquí. No es seguro... Espera, ¿qué es ese ruido...?
A Journey Beyond#201.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#204.src: Find Aledar, Lucio and Elphaba in the Fallen City.
A Journey Beyond#204.dst: Encuentra a Aledar, Lucio y Elphaba en la Fallen City.

A Journey Beyond#205.src: {u}! She was completely right. You ought to come with us...
A Journey Beyond#205.dst: ¡{u}! Tenía toda la razón. Deberías venir con nosotros...
A Journey Beyond#205.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#206.src: Find Aledar and Elphaba in the Fallen City.
A Journey Beyond#206.dst: Encuentra a Aledar y Elphaba en la Fallen City.

A Journey Beyond#207.src: Find Aledar in the Fallen City.
A Journey Beyond#207.dst: Encuentra a Aledar en la Fallen City.

A Journey Beyond#209.src: I think my leg is broken. I have a potion to fix it, but I dropped it back up there.
A Journey Beyond#209.dst: Creo que tengo la pierna rota. Tengo una poción para curarla, pero se me cayó allí arriba.
A Journey Beyond#209.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#210.src: I feel a bit better.. But something's still wrong.
A Journey Beyond#210.dst: Me siento algo mejor... Pero algo sigue sin ir bien.
A Journey Beyond#210.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#211.src: Let's just get out of here, soldier on. There's only one way out.
A Journey Beyond#211.dst: Salgamos de aquí, hay que seguir. Solo hay una salida.
A Journey Beyond#211.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#214.src: Urrrgh. {u}, this hasn't gone to plan. According to my map we aren't even half way.
A Journey Beyond#214.dst: Uuurgh. {u}, esto no ha salido según el plan. Según mi mapa, ni vamos por la mitad.
A Journey Beyond#214.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#215.src: I can't walk. But equally we can't stay here.
A Journey Beyond#215.dst: No puedo caminar. Pero tampoco podemos quedarnos aquí.
A Journey Beyond#215.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#216.src: The mission must be carried out. The plan has changed, but it's imperative we get to the end of this expanse, together.
A Journey Beyond#216.dst: Hay que cumplir la misión. El plan ha cambiado, pero es vital que lleguemos juntos al final del Expanse.
A Journey Beyond#216.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#217.src: No more running for us, huh {u}? Ah, we're here.
A Journey Beyond#217.dst: Se acabó huir, ¿eh, {u}? Ah, ya llegamos.

A Journey Beyond#218.src: There has to be a way.. Even if you have to push me in this thing!
A Journey Beyond#218.dst: Tiene que haber una forma... ¡Aunque tengas que empujarme en este trasto!
A Journey Beyond#218.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#219.src: No, I'm not joking. You guard the cart, I'll lead the way.
A Journey Beyond#219.dst: No, no es broma. Tú protege la vagoneta, yo marco el camino.
A Journey Beyond#219.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#220.src: Escort Aledar through the {p} to {p} at ({~}, -{~}).
A Journey Beyond#220.dst: Escolta a Aledar por {p} hasta {p} en ({~}, -{~}).

A Journey Beyond#221.src: According to the map, the miners started a town a little ahead.
A Journey Beyond#221.dst: Según el mapa, los mineros fundaron un pueblo un poco más adelante.
A Journey Beyond#221.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#222.src: Who knows what's left, but it's got to be safer than here.
A Journey Beyond#222.dst: Quién sabe qué queda, pero será más seguro que esto.
A Journey Beyond#222.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#223.src: I think the Small Monsters will try to Kill me.
A Journey Beyond#223.dst: Creo que los monstruos pequeños intentarán matarme a mí.
A Journey Beyond#223.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#224.src: While the Big Monsters will try to Kill you.
A Journey Beyond#224.dst: Y los monstruos grandes intentarán matarte a ti.
A Journey Beyond#224.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#225.src: It's going to be on you to make sure we both get through this.
A Journey Beyond#225.dst: De ti depende que los dos salgamos de esta.
A Journey Beyond#225.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#226.src: The fate of the mission relies on the two of us working together.
A Journey Beyond#226.dst: El destino de la misión depende de que colaboremos.
A Journey Beyond#226.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#227.src: Are those... Eyes on the trees?
A Journey Beyond#227.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#229.src: Watch out, the small monsters are coming for me! I can't fight in this thing!
A Journey Beyond#229.dst: ¡Ojo, los monstruos pequeños vienen a por mí! ¡No puedo luchar aquí dentro!
A Journey Beyond#229.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#231.src: Great job! It looks like they've stopped coming. Let's keep going.
A Journey Beyond#231.dst: ¡Buen trabajo! Parece que ya no vienen. Sigamos.
A Journey Beyond#231.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#233.src: Let's keep going! Before they come back.
A Journey Beyond#233.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#234.src: A lot of those small ones are coming for me!
A Journey Beyond#234.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#235.src: This one was close! We're getting close to the town.
A Journey Beyond#235.dst: ¡Por poco! Ya estamos cerca del pueblo.
A Journey Beyond#235.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#236.src: We'll have to stop again! We can't go past so many monsters.
A Journey Beyond#236.dst: ¡Tendremos que parar otra vez! No podemos pasar con tantos monstruos.
A Journey Beyond#236.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#237.src: We're almost there! I can see the town from here!
A Journey Beyond#237.dst: ¡Ya casi estamos! ¡Veo el pueblo desde aquí!
A Journey Beyond#237.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#239.src: Great job! It looks like they've stopped coming. Let's keep going.
A Journey Beyond#239.dst: ¡Buen trabajo! Parece que ya no vienen. Sigamos.
A Journey Beyond#239.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#240.src: Ouch! I got hit! Be careful, {u}!
A Journey Beyond#240.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#241.src: Finally, we've arrived... It's not exactly the town on the map.
A Journey Beyond#241.dst: Por fin hemos llegado... No es justo el pueblo del mapa.
A Journey Beyond#241.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#242.src: The lost miners are here... How? they must be hundreds of years old!
A Journey Beyond#242.dst: Los mineros perdidos están aquí... ¿Cómo? ¡Deben de tener cientos de años!
A Journey Beyond#242.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#243.src: What is this obelisk? It's.. comforting. I recognise this feeling from my time in Gavel.
A Journey Beyond#243.dst: ¿Qué es este obelisco? Es... reconfortante. Reconozco esta sensación de mi época en Gavel.
A Journey Beyond#243.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#244.src: Maybe.. It's been touched by the light? If so.. It could heal me.
A Journey Beyond#244.dst: Quizá... ¿lo ha tocado la luz? Si es así... podría curarme.
A Journey Beyond#244.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#245.src: Let's see if it does anything to me...
A Journey Beyond#245.dst: A ver si me hace algo...
A Journey Beyond#245.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#246.src: It worked... Kind of. I feel at least {~}. We still have a ways to go.
A Journey Beyond#246.dst: Ha funcionado... Más o menos. Me siento al menos al {~}. Aún nos queda camino.
A Journey Beyond#246.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#247.src: Let's take some time to gather ourselves before we press on. I'll meet you on the other side of town.
A Journey Beyond#247.dst: Tomémonos un tiempo para recuperarnos antes de seguir. Nos vemos al otro lado del pueblo.
A Journey Beyond#247.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#003.src: {u}, good news. I'm basically as recovered as I think I'll get.
A Journey Further#003.dst: {u}, buenas noticias. Ya estoy casi todo lo recuperado que voy a estar.

A Journey Further#004.src: >and the hero shall blind the ancient seer. good luck.
A Journey Further#004.dst: >y el héroe cegará al antiguo vidente. buena suerte.

A Journey Further#006.src: Alright, let's go. I'll tell you more about our journey on the way.
A Journey Further#006.dst: Bien, vamos. Por el camino te cuento más sobre nuestro viaje.
A Journey Further#006.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#008.src: We should try to follow the path as closely as we can. You lead, I'll follow.
A Journey Further#008.dst: Deberíamos seguir el camino lo más fielmente posible. Tú guías, yo te sigo.
A Journey Further#008.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#013.src: Good work. Seems that killing the king made the other creatures run off. We’re lucky about that-
A Journey Further#013.dst: Buen trabajo. Parece que al matar al rey, las demás criaturas huyeron. Hemos tenido suerte-
A Journey Further#013.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#014.src: Wait, {u}, what's going on? Are you alright?
A Journey Further#014.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#015.src: Oh, no no! I have a potion for this, where is it, where is it, aha! Here, drink!
A Journey Further#015.dst: ¡Oh, no, no! Tengo una poción para esto, ¿dónde está, dónde está? ¡Ajá! ¡Toma, bebe!
A Journey Further#015.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#016.src: One of those things must have infected your wounds... Everything in this area looks completely hazardous and sickening.
A Journey Further#016.dst: Una de esas cosas te ha infectado las heridas... Todo en esta zona parece peligroso y repugnante.
A Journey Further#016.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#017.src: I expected the worst, so I tried to bring anything and everything that might help. Let's keep moving.
A Journey Further#017.dst: Me esperaba lo peor, así que traje todo lo que pudiera servir. Sigamos avanzando.
A Journey Further#017.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#018.src: Continue on the main path with Aledar.
A Journey Further#018.dst: Continúa por el camino principal con Aledar.

A Journey Further#021.src: I'm... I'm going to lead us for now. At least for a little...while... I can't have you g-getting-
A Journey Further#021.dst: Yo... yo iré delante por ahora. Al menos un... rato... No puedo dejar que te h-hagan-
A Journey Further#021.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#023.src: ...urgh... I...sorry. I just... I need a moment.
A Journey Further#023.dst: ...urgh... Yo... lo siento. Solo... necesito un momento.
A Journey Further#023.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#024.src: {u}, you just... you have to realize, I can't have you getting hurt.
A Journey Further#024.dst: {u}, tienes que... entenderlo: no puedo dejar que te hieran.
A Journey Further#024.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#025.src: I want to stress this... We NEED to get to the end of this path, together.
A Journey Further#025.dst: Quiero dejarlo claro... TENEMOS que llegar juntos al final de este camino.
A Journey Further#025.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#027.src: Okay. I'm as good as I can get right now. Let's move.
A Journey Further#027.dst: Vale. Ahora mismo no voy a estar mejor. Vámonos.
A Journey Further#027.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#028.src: Ah? What... What just... Why do I...
A Journey Further#028.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#029.src: I'll be fine, I just...why did I feel so empty all of the sudden...?
A Journey Further#029.dst: Estaré bien, es que... ¿por qué me he sentido tan vacío de repente...?
A Journey Further#029.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#030.src: A mysterious force pushes you back...

A Journey Further#031.src: Oh no, I think something is coming... {u}! Fight it off, I don't think I can defend myself right now!
A Journey Further#031.dst: Oh, no, algo se acerca... ¡{u}! ¡Detenlo, ahora mismo no creo que pueda defenderme!
A Journey Further#031.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#032.src: Defend Aledar from the Radiated Spiders.
A Journey Further#032.dst: Defiende a Aledar de las Radiated Spiders.

A Journey Further#033.src: Huff... Not feeling totally better, but... At least I can still defend myself.
A Journey Further#033.dst: Uf... No estoy del todo bien, pero... al menos puedo defenderme.
A Journey Further#033.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#034.src: My stomach is empty, I can't even vomit... Why so I still feel so dizzy? Maybe a potion will help...
A Journey Further#034.dst: Tengo el estómago vacío, ni puedo vomitar... ¿Por qué sigo tan mareado? Quizá una poción ayude...
A Journey Further#034.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#036.src: Urgh, pfft! My vomit tasted better than that coming up...
A Journey Further#036.dst: ¡Puaj! ¡Mi vómito sabía mejor que esto al subir...!
A Journey Further#036.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#037.src: Hah...that's the ticket. Which potion was this anyways... ... hair loss treatment? Why did THAT work?
A Journey Further#037.dst: Ah... esto es. ¿Qué poción era, por cierto...? ...¿contra la calvicie? ¿Por qué ha FUNCIONADO?
A Journey Further#037.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#038.src: Though, you saw what happened to that beast I attacked? Follow me.
A Journey Further#038.dst: Por cierto, ¿viste qué le pasó a la bestia que golpeé? Sígueme.
A Journey Further#038.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#039.src: This, from what I recall of the mission statements, is referred to as a "Void Hole." It's a sort of portal.
A Journey Further#039.dst: Según recuerdo del informe de la misión, esto se llama "agujero del Vacío". Es una especie de portal.
A Journey Further#039.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#040.src: They connect to each other in odd ways, but we saw the beast come out of that one when I knocked it in, so...
A Journey Further#040.dst: Se conectan entre sí de forma extraña, pero la bestia salió por ese cuando la metí de un golpe, así que...
A Journey Further#040.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#041.src: Watch. I'll come out the other side.
A Journey Further#041.dst: Mira. Saldré por el otro lado.
A Journey Further#041.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#042.src: Alright, good! It does connect up consistently, at least. You try now.
A Journey Further#042.dst: ¡Bien, perfecto! Al menos siempre conecta igual. Ahora prueba tú.
A Journey Further#042.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#044.src: Continue on the trail with Aledar.
A Journey Further#044.dst: Continúa por el sendero con Aledar.

A Journey Further#045.src: I bring this up because if we're seeing one, we'll be seeing more soon. You'll need to adjust yourself to the sight of them.
A Journey Further#045.dst: Lo menciono porque, si vemos uno, pronto veremos más. Tendrás que acostumbrarte a verlos.
A Journey Further#045.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#046.dst: Guía tú otra vez, por favor.
A Journey Further#046.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#047.src: We grossly underestimated the difficulties we would have here. And, by that, I mean myself, Elphie, and Lucio did...
A Journey Further#047.dst: Subestimamos muchísimo lo difícil que sería esto. Y con eso me refiero a mí, a Elphie y a Lucio...
A Journey Further#047.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#048.src: We were each unprepared and cocky. If it weren't for you, I'd be dead now, for what it's worth.
A Journey Further#048.dst: Íbamos poco preparados y muy creídos. Si no fuera por ti, ya estaría muerto, para que conste.
A Journey Further#048.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#049.src: I wasn't certain at first about you coming along, but you've more than shown you were the right one for the job.
A Journey Further#049.dst: Al principio no estaba seguro de que vinieras, pero has demostrado de sobra que eras la persona indicada.
A Journey Further#049.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#050.src: ...I had to figure this map was outdated. This wall of spikes isn't listed on it, and the path goes through here!
A Journey Further#050.dst: ...Debí suponer que el mapa estaba desfasado. Este muro de pinchos no sale, ¡y el camino pasa por aquí!
A Journey Further#050.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#051.src: I'll have to assume they're new...and if they're new, I might be able to bash through them.
A Journey Further#051.dst: Supondré que son nuevos... y si lo son, quizá pueda abrirme paso a golpes.
A Journey Further#051.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#052.src: {u}, try throwing a spell at the same time! Let's crack through these things!
A Journey Further#052.dst: {u}, ¡lanza un hechizo a la vez! ¡Rompamos estas cosas!
A Journey Further#052.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#054.src: ...aagh... I... H-how are these so resilient...?
A Journey Further#054.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#055.src: I'm an idiot... I nearly killed myself trying that. I nearly ruined the mission...
A Journey Further#055.dst: Soy idiota... Casi me mato intentándolo. Casi arruino la misión...
A Journey Further#055.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#056.src: I'm sorry, but you'll have to go without me. I can't move another step for now.
A Journey Further#056.dst: Lo siento, pero tendrás que seguir sin mí. Ahora mismo no puedo dar ni un paso.
A Journey Further#056.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#057.src: There's a lot of void holes around here, remember my warning... You can probably get past these spikes with one.
A Journey Further#057.dst: Hay muchos agujeros del Vacío por aquí, recuerda lo que te dije... Con uno podrías pasar los pinchos.
A Journey Further#057.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#058.src: If I'd been thinking I would have suggested it earlier... Once you're past, we'll...uh. We'll do something.
A Journey Further#058.dst: Si lo hubiera pensado, te lo habría dicho antes... Cuando pases, ya... eh. Ya haremos algo.
A Journey Further#058.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#059.src: Just...be careful where you go. The void holes could lead anywhere. They might lead you someplace very, very dangerous, too dangerous even for you. I pray they won't...
A Journey Further#059.dst: Solo... ten cuidado con adónde vas. Los agujeros del Vacío pueden llevar a cualquier sitio. Incluso a uno muy, muy peligroso, demasiado incluso para ti. Rezo para que no...
A Journey Further#059.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#060.src: There's a void hole right there to try out first. Get going, now. You have to do this.
A Journey Further#060.dst: Ahí mismo hay un agujero del Vacío para probar primero. Venga, ve. Tienes que hacerlo.
A Journey Further#060.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#061.src: Use Void Holes to try and get behind the spike barrier
A Journey Further#061.dst: Usa los agujeros del Vacío para intentar pasar detrás de la barrera de pinchos

A Journey Further#062.src: Find a way to help Aledar get to the other side of the spike barrier.
A Journey Further#062.dst: Busca la forma de ayudar a Aledar a cruzar al otro lado de la barrera de pinchos.

A Journey Further#063.src: ...wait, {u}? You got to the other side then...? Good...
A Journey Further#063.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#064.src: I don't know what you did, but whatever it was, it's made cracks in the spikes that I can see from this side.
A Journey Further#064.dst: No sé qué has hecho, pero sea lo que sea, ha agrietado los pinchos y lo veo desde este lado.
A Journey Further#064.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#065.src: I've got some of my energy back...let's try spellcasting again. If we do it at the same time, we might make some headway.
A Journey Further#065.dst: He recuperado algo de energía... probemos con hechizos otra vez. Si lanzamos a la vez, quizá avancemos algo.
A Journey Further#065.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#066.src: I won't crack my skull open on the spikes again though. Promise.
A Journey Further#066.dst: Pero no volveré a abrirme la cabeza con los pinchos. Prometido.
A Journey Further#066.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#067.src: You lead. I'll cast my spell as soon as I hear yours.
A Journey Further#067.dst: Tú primero. Lanzaré mi hechizo en cuanto oiga el tuyo.
A Journey Further#067.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#068.src: Thank god it worked... That's our destination there, the Eldritch Outlook.
A Journey Further#068.dst: Menos mal que ha funcionado... Ese es nuestro destino, el Mirador Sobrenatural.
A Journey Further#068.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#069.src: Now comes the hardest part... Come along. I'll need you there for it.
A Journey Further#069.dst: Ahora viene lo más difícil... Ven. Te necesitaré allí.
A Journey Further#069.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#070.src: That blade there...it's made for sacrifice. See how that gate is shut?
A Journey Further#070.dst: Esa hoja de ahí... está hecha para el sacrificio. ¿Ves la puerta cerrada?
A Journey Further#070.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#071.src: In order to open the doors to the Outlook, we need to sacrifice a powerful soul.
A Journey Further#071.dst: Para abrir las puertas del Mirador, hay que sacrificar un alma poderosa.
A Journey Further#071.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#072.src: We... we should have told you from the start. You and Lucio. Elphie and I, we knew. We knew this would be here.
A Journey Further#072.dst: Debimos... debimos decíroslo desde el principio. A ti y a Lucio. Elphie y yo lo sabíamos. Sabíamos que esto estaría aquí.
A Journey Further#072.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#073.src: We didn't have... we didn't have a sacrifice in mind. We decided that it would be best decided once we reached that point. And I think we both knew it would have to be one of us.
A Journey Further#073.dst: No teníamos... no teníamos pensado a quién sacrificar. Decidimos que era mejor decidirlo al llegar a este punto. Y creo que ambos sabíamos que tendría que ser uno de nosotros.
A Journey Further#073.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#074.src: ...I think she would have insisted it be her. Even though both of us had something we would be le-...
