A Journey Further#074.dst: ...Creo que ella habría insistido en ser la elegida. Aunque los dos teníamos algo que dej-...
A Journey Further#074.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#075.src: It doesn't matter now. It's just us left. And I've been mulling it over since we got to the town... you'll sacrifice me. I won't take no for an answer.
A Journey Further#075.dst: Ya no importa. Solo quedamos nosotros. Y llevo dándole vueltas desde que llegamos al pueblo... me sacrificarás a mí. No acepto un no por respuesta.
A Journey Further#075.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#076.src: I mean... look at the state I'm in, {u}! I'm on death's door already, and you've proven yourself far stronger than I am even at my best.
A Journey Further#076.dst: Quiero decir... ¡mira cómo estoy, {u}! Ya estoy a las puertas de la muerte, y has demostrado ser mucho más fuerte que yo en mi mejor momento.
A Journey Further#076.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#077.src: Here. You can take everything I had on me. My emeralds, and the key to the dungeon. I certainly won't be able to use them anymore.
A Journey Further#077.dst: Toma. Quédate con todo lo que llevo encima. Mis esmeraldas y la llave de la mazmorra. Yo ya no voy a poder usarlas.
A Journey Further#077.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#078.src: Upon the top of the tower is... Well, something. We don't know for certain what it is, but it will prevent you from passing through.
A Journey Further#078.dst: En lo alto de la torre hay... bueno, algo. No sabemos con certeza qué es, pero te impedirá el paso.
A Journey Further#078.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#079.src: You'll have to kill it to break the barrier. But... find other soldiers who can help you. It will be impossible to defeat alone.
A Journey Further#079.dst: Tendrás que matarlo para romper la barrera. Pero... busca otros soldados que te ayuden. Es imposible derrotarlo solo.
A Journey Further#079.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#080.src: ...no more putting it off, then. I'm bleeding out.
A Journey Further#080.dst: ...entonces no lo retrasemos más. Me estoy desangrando.
A Journey Further#080.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#082.src: Right click to grab the blade in the altar.
A Journey Further#082.dst: Haz clic derecho para coger la hoja del altar.

A Journey Further#083.src: Now...strike me down. My soul will unlock the gate...
A Journey Further#083.dst: Ahora... acaba conmigo. Mi alma abrirá la puerta...
A Journey Further#083.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#085.dst: Agh... No te preocupes... p-por mí...
A Journey Further#085.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#086.src: You...can do this. I know y-you can.
A Journey Further#086.dst: Tú... puedes hacerlo. Sé que p-puedes.
A Journey Further#086.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Home#000.src: What is this place? Such technology, you can hardly imagine how it was made.
A Journey Home#000.dst: ¿Qué es este lugar? Qué tecnología, cuesta imaginar cómo la fabricaron.

A Journey Home#001.src: The caravan driver seems to have disappeared... maybe you can find something if you look in some of mechanized carriages?
A Journey Home#001.dst: El conductor de la caravana parece haber desaparecido... ¿quizá encuentres algo si miras en los carruajes mecanizados?

A Journey Home#002.src: {p}'s relations with Fruma exclusively consist of the generous batches of recruits sent to fight the corruption here in Wynn.
A Journey Home#002.dst: La relación de {p} con Fruma consiste únicamente en los generosos lotes de reclutas enviados a luchar aquí contra la corrupción de Wynn.

A Journey Home#003.src: They've shut you out. There's no way in from here... But what if you went back the way
A Journey Home#003.dst: Te han dejado fuera. Desde aquí no hay forma de entrar... Pero ¿y si volvieras por donde

A Journey Home#004.src: ...Ah. I see. So I suppose...things must not have gone well. Have all the others returned?
A Journey Home#004.dst: ...Ah. Ya veo. Así que supongo que... las cosas no salieron bien. ¿Han vuelto todos los demás?

A Journey Home#006.src: Is there anything I can do for you today?

A Journey Home#007.src: ...something's prickling at the back of your mind. Weren't you asleep like this when you first arrived, too?
A Journey Home#007.dst: ...algo te ronda al fondo de la mente. ¿No estabas dormido así también cuando llegaste?

A Journey Home#009.src: Explore near where you originally arrived in Wynn.
A Journey Home#009.dst: Explora cerca de donde llegaste por primera vez a Wynn.

A Journey Home#010.dst: Sal de {p} por la puerta en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Journey Home#011.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.
A Journey Home#011.dst: Vuelve por el camino hacia Fruma.

A Journey Home#012.src: This job is impossible!! Why am I even here?!
A Journey Home#012.dst: ¡¡Este trabajo es imposible!! ¿¡Qué hago yo aquí!?
A Journey Home#012.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#013.src: Ah! You're a soldier, right? Look, I- It's, it's just a really difficult time right now.
A Journey Home#013.dst: ¡Ah! Eres soldado, ¿no? Mira, yo- Es que ahora mismo es un momento muy difícil.
A Journey Home#013.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#014.src: This, this whole situation is definitely above my paygrade! I don't know how I'm going to deal with this...
A Journey Home#014.dst: ¡Esta, esta situación está muy por encima de mi rango! No sé cómo voy a solucionar esto...
A Journey Home#014.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#015.src: Enough of that, I, ah, I suppose. What is it you need?
A Journey Home#015.dst: Basta ya, yo, eh, supongo. ¿Qué necesitas?
A Journey Home#015.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#016.src: Oh. Oh no. Ah, I, you see, that'll be a problem, I think. What do you even need to do at the border anyway?
A Journey Home#016.dst: Oh. Oh, no. Ah, yo, verás, creo que eso será un problema. ¿Qué tienes que hacer en la frontera, de todos modos?
A Journey Home#016.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#017.src: I can't really imagine what you could need there, but, whatever it is, it'll need to wait! This Corkian drill won't work, and Paxon's stuck, and
A Journey Home#017.dst: No me imagino qué necesitas allí, pero, sea lo que sea, ¡tendrá que esperar! La perforadora corkiana no funciona, Paxon está atrapado, y
A Journey Home#017.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#018.src: Look, I'm...I'm sorry for snapping at you. I'm trained for military operation, not for cave-in clearance, but no one else was available!
A Journey Home#018.dst: Mira, yo... siento haberte hablado mal. Me formaron para operaciones militares, no para despejar derrumbes, ¡pero no había nadie más!
A Journey Home#018.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#019.src: Even the demolitions expert I hired is stuck, so it's all just, it's all going wrong and I don't know what to do.
A Journey Home#019.dst: Hasta el experto en demoliciones que contraté está atascado, así que todo, todo sale mal y no sé qué hacer.
A Journey Home#019.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#020.src: You see that new entrance over there? The expert, Paxon, has been in there for almost as long as I was trying this dud machine.
A Journey Home#020.dst: ¿Ves esa nueva entrada de allí? El experto, Paxon, lleva ahí dentro casi tanto como yo con esta máquina inútil.
A Journey Home#020.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#021.src: If you think you can do a job better than an expert, go ahead and talk with them, but I'm pretty sure you'll have to cancel whatever plans you had.
A Journey Home#021.dst: Si crees que puedes hacerlo mejor que un experto, adelante, habla con él, pero seguro que tendrás que cancelar tus planes.
A Journey Home#021.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#022.src: Talk to the Demolition Mage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Journey Home#022.dst: Habla con el Demolition Mage en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Journey Home#023.src: If you really need to get to the border, your best bet is to talk to Paxon in the new cave entrance.
A Journey Home#023.dst: Si de verdad necesitas llegar a la frontera, lo mejor es hablar con Paxon en la nueva entrada de la cueva.
A Journey Home#023.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#024.src: But, they're an expert, so I think your business will have to wait. Really, really sorry about all this!
A Journey Home#024.dst: Pero es un experto, así que creo que tu asunto tendrá que esperar. ¡Lo siento muchísimo!
A Journey Home#024.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#025.src: Oh no, not another one I don't care what rank you are, what you're asking is impossible! Even for me, it
A Journey Home#025.dst: Oh, no, otro no me importa tu rango, ¡lo que pides es imposible! Incluso para mí, es
A Journey Home#025.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#026.src: Wait, you aren't part of the... You're just a regular soldier. You're just trying to get through here, aren't you?
A Journey Home#026.dst: Espera, no eres de los... Solo eres un soldado normal. Solo intentas pasar por aquí, ¿verdad?
A Journey Home#026.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#027.src: May as well give up now! Not happening. No way. You're wasting your time, and let me tell you exactly why.
A Journey Home#027.dst: ¡Ya puedes rendirte! No va a pasar. Ni hablar. Pierdes el tiempo, y te voy a decir exactamente por qué.
A Journey Home#027.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#028.src: You see that blue rock over there? It's a break point. If I could set off these explosives at it, it'd open a path.
A Journey Home#028.dst: ¿Ves esa roca azul de allí? Es un punto débil. Si detonara estos explosivos en ella, se abriría un paso.
A Journey Home#028.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#029.src: They're gone. Hurry down the path!
A Journey Home#029.dst: Se han ido. ¡Baja rápido por el camino!

A Journey Home#030.src: But apparently all these structures set up are so important that any of it being damaged, or MOVED, is unacceptable!
A Journey Home#030.dst: ¡Pero por lo visto estas estructuras son tan importantes que no se puede dañar ni MOVER ninguna!
A Journey Home#030.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#031.src: And to make sure I'm 'supervised' while the lieutenant is working on the drill, the detonator HAS to be here.
A Journey Home#031.dst: Y para que esté 'supervisado' mientras el teniente arregla la perforadora, el detonador TIENE que estar aquí.
A Journey Home#031.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#032.src: So I have to daisy-chain a limited amount of explosives all the way over to the stone, without blasting any structures!
A Journey Home#032.dst: ¡Así que tengo que encadenar pocos explosivos hasta la piedra sin volar ninguna estructura!
A Journey Home#032.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#033.src: I've been trying for hours and gotten absolutely nowhere! I'm one of the best in my field, even! It's ridiculous!!
A Journey Home#033.dst: ¡Llevo horas intentándolo y no he avanzado nada! ¡Y eso que soy de los mejores en lo mío! ¡¡Es ridículo!!
A Journey Home#033.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#034.src: If you feel like wasting your time, here's my stock of explosives. Feel free to try your hand at it, but you should really just go.
A Journey Home#034.dst: Si quieres perder el tiempo, aquí tienes mis explosivos. Puedes intentarlo, pero de verdad deberías irte.
A Journey Home#034.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#035.src: Use the TNT to open up a path through the cave.
A Journey Home#035.dst: Usa la TNT para abrir un camino a través de la cueva.

A Journey Home#036.src: Still at it? What, do you need a reminder? I've got nothing better to do.
A Journey Home#036.dst: ¿Sigues con eso? ¿Qué, quieres que te lo recuerde? No tengo nada mejor que hacer.
A Journey Home#036.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#037.src: So the blue rock is soft enough to crack with the explosives. But the detonator's stuck here.
A Journey Home#037.dst: La roca azul es lo bastante blanda para romperla con explosivos. Pero el detonador está aquí.
A Journey Home#037.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#038.src: So we need to use the TNT Placer to daisy-chain blasts from the detonator, without blasting any tents, crates, or walls.
A Journey Home#038.dst: Así que hay que usar el TNT Placer para encadenar explosiones desde el detonador sin volar tiendas, cajas ni muros.
A Journey Home#038.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#039.src: You can look at placed TNT to see its blast radius, as well.
A Journey Home#039.dst: También puedes mirar la TNT colocada para ver su radio de explosión.
A Journey Home#039.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#040.src: But given how tight the squeeze between some of those structures is, there's just no way it's happening.
A Journey Home#040.dst: Pero con lo estrecho que es el hueco entre algunas estructuras, es imposible que salga bien.
A Journey Home#040.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#041.src: Like I said, you really should just mosey on back to the castle. If I can't get anywhere, I don't think you'll fare better.
A Journey Home#041.dst: Como te dije, deberías volver tranquilamente al castillo. Si yo no lo consigo, dudo que a ti te vaya mejor.
A Journey Home#041.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#042.dst: Continúa a través de la cueva.

A Journey Home#044.src: Halt! Where did you come from? There was a cave-in past here, wasn't there?
A Journey Home#044.dst: ¡Alto! ¿De dónde sales? Hubo un derrumbe más allá, ¿no?
A Journey Home#044.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#045.src: A new path, huh? I didn't think you'd have things to be doing back here, though I won't say I'm ungrateful.
A Journey Home#045.dst: ¿Un camino nuevo, eh? No creía que tuvieras cosas que hacer por aquí atrás, aunque no diré que no lo agradezco.
A Journey Home#045.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#046.src: It even crushed the grook's nest there. I've been working off field rations for a few days. So where are you headed?
A Journey Home#046.dst: Hasta aplastó el nido de grook de ahí. Llevo días a raciones de campaña. ¿Y adónde vas?
A Journey Home#046.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#047.src: The border? I suppose if you're headed there, it must be important, official business. Although, it might have to wait.
A Journey Home#047.dst: ¿A la frontera? Si vas allí, supongo que será un asunto oficial importante. Aunque puede que tenga que esperar.
A Journey Home#047.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#048.src: The bridge repair was something of a hackjob. It may not bear up your weight. Now that the cave-in's clear, we might be able to get it fixed proper...
A Journey Home#048.dst: El puente se reparó de mala manera. Puede que no aguante tu peso. Ahora que se ha despejado el derrumbe, quizá podamos arreglarlo bien...
A Journey Home#048.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#049.src: But that'll take time. I'd just as soon turn back whatever business you have isn't worth your life, after all.
A Journey Home#049.dst: Pero eso llevará tiempo. Yo que tú me daría la vuelta; sea cual sea tu asunto, no vale tu vida.
A Journey Home#049.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#051.src: Say, I think I recognize you, actually. That's a rarity for this line of work.
A Journey Home#051.dst: Oye, creo que te reconozco. Eso es raro en este oficio.
A Journey Home#051.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#052.src: Are you sure that what you have to do is worth it? That bridge is awful rickety. Wouldn't want to lose you.
A Journey Home#052.dst: ¿Seguro que lo que tienes que hacer vale la pena? Ese puente se tambalea mucho. No quiero perderte.
A Journey Home#052.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#053.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.
A Journey Home#053.dst: Vuelve por el camino hacia Fruma.

A Journey Home#054.src: Hey, you there! Come talk to me before you pass through.
A Journey Home#054.dst: ¡Eh, tú! Ven a hablar conmigo antes de pasar.
A Journey Home#054.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#055.src: Hey, you! Come talk to me first, recruit!
A Journey Home#055.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#056.src: Coming or going, I'm under strict orders to intercept soldiers and make sure they're equipped before heading on.
A Journey Home#056.dst: Vengas o vayas, tengo órdenes estrictas de parar a los soldados y comprobar que van equipados antes de seguir.
A Journey Home#056.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#057.src: No exceptions, not for any reason. Especially not since the cave-in across the river!
A Journey Home#057.dst: Sin excepciones, por ningún motivo. ¡Y menos desde el derrumbe al otro lado del río!
A Journey Home#057.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#058.src: Nothing's more important than your life, and moving on without being suited up could cost you it!
A Journey Home#058.dst: Nada importa más que tu vida, ¡y seguir sin el equipo adecuado podría costártela!
A Journey Home#058.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#059.src: Well, let me take a look at it and see if this stuff is up to regulation.
A Journey Home#059.dst: Bueno, déjame echarle un vistazo y ver si esto cumple el reglamento.
A Journey Home#059.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#060.src: Well, let me take a look and see if this stuff is up to regulation.
A Journey Home#060.dst: Bueno, déjame echar un vistazo y ver si esto cumple el reglamento.
A Journey Home#060.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#061.src: Hmm... Ah, yep, signs of wear all over... Armor not polished... Weapon looks liable to fall apart any second...
A Journey Home#061.dst: Mmm... Ah, sí, desgaste por todas partes... Armadura sin pulir... El arma parece a punto de romperse...
A Journey Home#061.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#062.src: I'm surprised you made it ten feet out here with those rusty trinkets! This is no way to protect yourself!
A Journey Home#062.dst: ¡Me sorprende que llegaras hasta aquí con esas baratijas oxidadas! ¡Así no te puedes proteger!
A Journey Home#062.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#063.src: Look, there's a loot chest in the cave just there, so you need to head in and get yourself some proper equipment.
A Journey Home#063.dst: Mira, en esa cueva de ahí hay un cofre de botín, así que entra y consíguete un equipo como es debido.
A Journey Home#063.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#064.src: ...that so, huh? Well, I think you should take a second look up ahead.
A Journey Home#064.dst: ...¿ah, sí? Bueno, creo que deberías echar otro vistazo ahí delante.
A Journey Home#064.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#065.src: See? Now no more guff about levels you either gear up properly, or you don't pass! I won't have you risking your life.
A Journey Home#065.dst: ¿Ves? Se acabaron las excusas con los niveles o te equipas bien, ¡o no pasas! No dejaré que arriesgues la vida.
A Journey Home#065.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#066.src: You can find good stuff in caves, like the one just next to me, so hop to it.
A Journey Home#066.dst: En las cuevas hay cosas buenas, como la que tengo al lado, así que date prisa.
A Journey Home#066.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#067.src: Like I said, coming or going. No matter what, you should gear up by looting the cave here before heading onwards.
A Journey Home#067.dst: Como dije, vengas o vayas. Pase lo que pase, equípate saqueando esta cueva antes de seguir.
A Journey Home#067.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#068.src: Good stuff. There's a loot chest in that cave there, so you should find everything you need. Get to it!
A Journey Home#068.dst: Bien. En esa cueva hay un cofre de botín, así que encontrarás todo lo que necesitas. ¡Adelante!
A Journey Home#068.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#069.src: Explore the cave to find some loot.
A Journey Home#069.dst: Explora la cueva para encontrar botín.

A Journey Home#070.src: Enter the cave and open the loot chest.
A Journey Home#070.dst: Entra en la cueva y abre el cofre.
A Journey Home#070.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#071.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.
A Journey Home#071.dst: Vuelve por el camino hacia Fruma.

A Journey Home#072.src: That looks like the stuff. You can take that armor to an Item Identifier right there, and then you can wear it once identified.
A Journey Home#072.dst: Eso parece bueno. Lleva esa armadura al Identificador de objetos de ahí y podrás ponértela en cuanto esté identificada.
A Journey Home#072.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#073.src: Though... since you seem to be heading back to the border... I have to ask why. It's pretty unusual. Probably best you head back to {p}.
A Journey Home#073.dst: Aunque... como parece que vuelves a la frontera... tengo que preguntar por qué. Es muy raro. Mejor vuelve a {p}.
A Journey Home#073.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#074.src: If other recruits see you coming the other way, they might get confused, or discouraged. Wouldn't want to risk that, right?
A Journey Home#074.dst: Si otros reclutas te ven ir en sentido contrario, podrían confundirse o desanimarse. No querrás arriesgarte, ¿verdad?
A Journey Home#074.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#075.src: Are you sure whatever you're doing is worth it? Maybe you should just head back to town.
A Journey Home#075.dst: ¿Seguro que lo que haces vale la pena? Quizá deberías volver al pueblo.
A Journey Home#075.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#076.src: Avoid the Fruman recruits on the path.
A Journey Home#076.dst: Evita a los reclutas de Fruma del camino.

A Journey Home#077.src: ...been recruiting Fruman soldiers for the war effort. Apparently things are really bad over there. Makes me nervous...
A Journey Home#077.dst: ...reclutando soldados de Fruma para la guerra. Por lo visto allí la cosa está muy mal. Me pone nervioso...
A Journey Home#077.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#078.src: Walking corpses aren't anything I'm going to underestimate, but it can't be all doom and gloom, right?
A Journey Home#078.dst: No voy a subestimar a unos cadáveres andantes, pero no será todo tan negro, ¿verdad?
A Journey Home#078.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#079.src: I suppose we'll see once we pass this gate. It marks the border... Deep breaths, deep breaths...
A Journey Home#079.dst: Supongo que lo veremos al cruzar esta puerta. Marca la frontera... Respira hondo, respira hondo...
A Journey Home#079.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#080.src: ...know anything about Wynn? I didn't get any debriefing.
A Journey Home#080.dst: ...¿sabes algo de Wynn? A mí no me dieron ningún informe.
A Journey Home#080.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#081.src: I remember rumors... Something about a great hero. Name started with...and R?
A Journey Home#081.dst: Recuerdo rumores... Algo de un gran héroe. ¿Su nombre empezaba por... una R?
A Journey Home#081.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#082.src: We'll make it a point to ask as soon as we can. Information's key to fighting wars.
A Journey Home#082.dst: Preguntaremos en cuanto podamos. La información es clave en la guerra.
A Journey Home#082.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#083.src: ...rotten driver. I feel for the man, but he said he always hits that boulder. Sounds like his own fault to me.
A Journey Home#083.dst: ...conductor de pena. Lo siento por él, pero dijo que siempre choca con esa roca. Yo diría que es culpa suya.
A Journey Home#083.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#084.src: I'm thinking about meals more than wheels. I feel like I haven't eaten in days. Hope the walk's short...
A Journey Home#084.dst: Pienso más en comida que en ruedas. Siento que llevo días sin comer. Ojalá el paseo sea corto...
A Journey Home#084.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#085.src: Well, if he was a more competent driver you wouldn't have to walk so far on an empty stomach! Let's hurry so we can get you a feast, huh?
A Journey Home#085.dst: ¡Si fuera mejor conductor, no tendrías que andar tanto con el estómago vacío! Démonos prisa para que te den un festín, ¿eh?
A Journey Home#085.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#086.src: Wait, who's that? Why are they coming from the border??
A Journey Home#086.dst: Espera, ¿quién es ese? ¿¡Por qué viene de la frontera!?
A Journey Home#086.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#088.src: ...and that's the last of them for today.
A Journey Home#088.dst: ...y esos son los últimos por hoy.
A Journey Home#088.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#089.src: Lot of pairs today. Eight more in the wings... But that's for tomorrow.
A Journey Home#089.dst: Muchas parejas hoy. Quedan ocho más esperando... Pero eso es para mañana.
A Journey Home#089.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#090.src: Same darn boulder... Same darn line, too. Wonder if they'll let me shake it up one day. This is always a pain...
A Journey Home#090.dst: La misma dichosa roca... Y la misma dichosa frase. A ver si algún día me dejan cambiarla. Siempre es un fastidio...
A Journey Home#090.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#091.src: And that's that about that. And now, to be off...to the home I choose. And there's no troubles to follow me there.
A Journey Home#091.dst: Y asunto zanjado. Y ahora, a marcharme... al hogar que yo elija. Y allí no me seguirá ningún problema.
A Journey Home#091.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#092.dst: Explora más allá de la Fruma Gate.

A Journey Home#093.src: Just couldn't take the hint, huh?
A Journey Home#093.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#094.src: Bet you think you're slick. Didn't even notice me hang back to watch, huh? I wasn't born yesterday.
A Journey Home#094.dst: Te crees muy listo, ¿eh? Ni te diste cuenta de que me quedé atrás a mirar. No nací ayer.
A Journey Home#094.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#095.src: Listen, this isn't the first time something like this has happened- Y'know. Someone gets curious, retraces their steps.
A Journey Home#095.dst: Escucha, no es la primera vez que pasa algo así- Ya sabes. Alguien siente curiosidad y vuelve sobre sus pasos.
A Journey Home#095.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#096.src: ...I will make only one demand of you. Whatever happens...come back alive.
A Journey Home#096.dst: ...Solo te pediré una cosa. Pase lo que pase... vuelve con vida.

A Journey Home#097.src: If you couldn't tell, this whole thing's meant to be a one way trip. The bridge, the cave-in, everyone trying to discourage you.
A Journey Home#097.dst: Por si no te habías dado cuenta, todo esto es un viaje solo de ida. El puente, el derrumbe, todos intentando desanimarte.
A Journey Home#097.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#098.src: It's not wise to be here- After all, you weren't the one out of your group of three that got permission to stay. Yeah, I heard about the tournament results.
A Journey Home#098.dst: No es prudente estar aquí- Al fin y al cabo, de tu grupo de tres no fuiste tú quien obtuvo permiso para quedarse. Sí, me enteré del resultado del torneo.
A Journey Home#098.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#099.src: He's dead asleep. You could probably ring a church bell an inch above his head and he'd stay unconscious.
A Journey Home#099.dst: Está profundamente dormido. Podrías tocar una campana de iglesia a un palmo de su cabeza y no despertaría.

A Journey Home#100.src: That looks like the stuff. See? That wasn't so hard. Alright, now!
A Journey Home#100.dst: Eso parece bueno. ¿Ves? No era tan difícil. ¡Bien, ahora!

A Journey Home#101.src: So...you got two choices, buddy. We can let this slide between us. We can. You can go marching right back to {p} and my lips will be sealed.
A Journey Home#101.dst: Así que... tienes dos opciones, amigo. Podemos dejarlo pasar entre nosotros. Podemos. Vuelves derechito a {p} y yo no digo ni mu.
A Journey Home#101.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#102.src: Alas, I am afraid my hands are quite tied here. There is little I can do- you recall what I said in the meeting.
A Journey Home#102.dst: Por desgracia, me temo que aquí tengo las manos atadas. Poco puedo hacer- recuerda lo que dije en la reunión.

A Journey Home#103.src: Or, you can live life dangerously and follow me on the train to {p}. Better make your choice quick, though it's leaving soon.
A Journey Home#103.dst: O puedes vivir peligrosamente y seguirme en el tren a {p}. Pero decide rápido, que sale pronto.
A Journey Home#103.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#104.src: If I see you in the passenger cabin, well...that'll be that, and you'll just have to wait and see what comes of it.
A Journey Home#104.dst: Si te veo en el vagón de pasajeros, bueno... así será, y tendrás que esperar a ver qué pasa.
A Journey Home#104.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#105.src: Join the Caravan Driver in the passenger car at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Journey Home#105.dst: Reúnete con el Caravan Driver en el vagón de pasajeros en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Journey Home#106.src: Last chance to back out. This your choice?
A Journey Home#106.dst: Última oportunidad para echarte atrás. ¿Es tu decisión?
A Journey Home#106.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#107.src: Well, you better get headed on the long walk back to {p} then.
A Journey Home#107.dst: Pues más te vale emprender el largo camino de vuelta a {p}.
A Journey Home#107.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#111.src: You know what they say about curiosity, and how it killed the cat. You the type to believe satisfaction'll bring it back?
A Journey Home#111.dst: Ya sabes lo que dicen de la curiosidad y el gato. ¿Eres de los que creen que satisfacerla lo resucita?
A Journey Home#111.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#112.src: Well, 'kittycat,' you didn't find the cream- just the hound dogs.
A Journey Home#112.dst: Bueno, 'gatito', no has encontrado la nata- solo a los sabuesos.
A Journey Home#112.speaker: Fruman Guard

A Journey Home#113.src: Intruder to Fruma, you are under arrest! Now march!
A Journey Home#113.speaker: Fruman Guard

A Journey Home#114.src: You really thought the Driver was on your side, intruder? What a fool you are. We gave you every chance to quit this endeavor, but here you are. Let's go.
A Journey Home#114.dst: ¿De verdad creías que el conductor estaba de tu parte, intruso? Qué necio eres. Te dimos todas las oportunidades de abandonar, pero aquí estás. Vamos.
A Journey Home#114.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#116.src: I have urgent news to report from the gate.
A Journey Home#116.dst: Traigo noticias urgentes de la puerta.
A Journey Home#116.speaker: Guard Captain

A Journey Home#117.src: If it is truly so urgent, let's speak.
A Journey Home#117.dst: Si de verdad es tan urgente, hablemos.
A Journey Home#117.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#118.src: Soldiers! Keep the intruder still. I've every faith in you.
A Journey Home#118.dst: ¡Soldados! Vigilad al intruso. Confío plenamente en vosotros.
A Journey Home#118.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#119.dst: Derrota a los guardias y escapa.

A Journey Home#122.src: Anythin' I can help you with?
A Journey Home#122.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#123.src: Hm. Suppose there's no harm. But watch yourself, alright?
A Journey Home#123.dst: Mm. Supongo que no pasa nada. Pero ten cuidado, ¿vale?
A Journey Home#123.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#124.src: This here's our home. I wouldn't take too kindly to you messin' anything up, understand?
A Journey Home#124.dst: Este es nuestro hogar. No me haría gracia que me estropearas nada, ¿entendido?
A Journey Home#124.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#125.src: ...doin' alright, all things considered. Weather's nice, I suppose. Festival comin' up.
A Journey Home#125.dst: ...no nos va mal, dentro de lo que cabe. Hace buen tiempo, supongo. Se acerca el festival.
A Journey Home#125.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#126.src: But that ain't none of our business, really. If you didn't need anythin' else, I'll kindly ask you to take your leave.
A Journey Home#126.dst: Pero eso no es asunto nuestro, la verdad. Si no necesitas nada más, te pido amablemente que te marches.
A Journey Home#126.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#127.src: Hm. Good. Have a nice day, now.
A Journey Home#127.dst: Mm. Bien. Que tengas un buen día.
A Journey Home#127.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#128.src: Hmm? And who may you be?
A Journey Home#128.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#129.src: Hoh, oh well. Might I help you with something?
A Journey Home#129.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#130.src: Ah, completing some assorted metalworking projects. There always seems to be something to replace or maintain around here...
A Journey Home#130.dst: Ah, termino unos trabajos de metalistería variados. Aquí siempre parece haber algo que reponer o mantener...
A Journey Home#130.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#131.src: Though, I certainly am no expert! But I can handle the tools well enough, and that is all that is needed for the task.
A Journey Home#131.dst: ¡Aunque no soy ninguna experta! Pero manejo las herramientas bastante bien, y eso es todo lo que hace falta.
A Journey Home#131.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#132.src: Farewell, stranger! I hope that you will return home safely.
A Journey Home#132.dst: ¡Adiós, forastero! Espero que vuelva a casa sano y salvo.
A Journey Home#132.speaker: Mora

A Marauder's Dues#000.src: The very sight of you offends me! Let this gust of wind relieve me of your presence. Take it as a warning- you are not welcome here!
A Marauder's Dues#000.dst: ¡Tu sola presencia me ofende! Que esta ráfaga de viento me libre de ti. Tómalo como una advertencia- ¡aquí no eres bienvenido!

A Marauder's Dues#001.src: ...rrgh! The tunnels! Once again, humans try so hard to spoil my fun... But do you really think you've evaded me?
A Marauder's Dues#001.dst: ...¡rrgh! ¡Los túneles! Los humanos otra vez aguándome la fiesta... ¿Crees que me has esquivado?

A Marauder's Dues#002.src: A dullard to the end, walking to your obliteration. I'm going to savor this delectable moment...it's been decades since I've rendered a human to dust!
A Marauder's Dues#002.dst: Torpe hasta el final, caminando hacia tu aniquilación. Voy a saborear este delicioso momento... ¡hace décadas que no reduzco a un humano a polvo!

A Marauder's Dues#003.src: A shard of the crystal seems to have remained behind. Maybe you can use this to escape!
A Marauder's Dues#003.dst: Parece que ha quedado un fragmento del cristal. ¡Quizá puedas usarlo para escapar!

A Marauder's Dues#004.src: ...fine. The defenses of my tower were absolute enough that I never needed to defend myself inside. I should have taken you seriously from the start.
A Marauder's Dues#004.dst: ...Bien. Las defensas de mi torre eran tan absolutas que nunca tuve que defenderme dentro. Debí tomarte en serio desde el principio.

A Marauder's Dues#005.src: HA! I still get the last laugh! Even at my most vulnerable, I've gracefully outwitted you! As if I would really surrender to a human.
A Marauder's Dues#005.dst: ¡JA! ¡Aún me río el último! ¡Incluso en mi momento más vulnerable te he burlado con elegancia! Como si fuera a rendirme ante un humano.

A Marauder's Dues#006.src: I'll just drain Norsten's vitality to refill my own if you attack! There's nothing you can do- can't jump after the gem, can't defeat me! It's hopeless for you!
A Marauder's Dues#006.dst: ¡Si atacas, drenaré la vitalidad de Norsten para recuperar la mía! No puedes hacer nada- ni saltar tras la gema, ni derrotarme. ¡No tienes esperanza!

A Marauder's Dues#007.src: There's the strange gem that Dramele threw away... You should take it with you, he said it would save Norsten.
A Marauder's Dues#007.dst: Ahí está la extraña gema que Dramele tiró... Deberías llevártela, dijo que salvaría a Norsten.

A Marauder's Dues#008.src: Although the strange beings are now gone, some parts of them were left behind. They look very unstable.
A Marauder's Dues#008.dst: Aunque los extraños seres han desaparecido, dejaron atrás algunas partes. Parecen muy inestables.

A Marauder's Dues#009.src: Perhaps if you combine them in the right way you can cause an explosion and escape.
A Marauder's Dues#009.dst: Quizá, si las combinas de la forma correcta, puedas provocar una explosión y escapar.

A Marauder's Dues#010.src: Goal: Get {~} Explosive Power by combining the {~} different cores in the grid made of green particles.
A Marauder's Dues#010.dst: Objetivo: logra {~} de poder explosivo combinando los {~} núcleos en la cuadrícula de partículas verdes.

A Marauder's Dues#011.src: Right Click a core to select it, then Right Click one of the {~} green spots in the grid to place it there.
A Marauder's Dues#011.dst: Haz clic derecho en un núcleo para elegirlo y luego clic derecho en uno de los {~} puntos verdes para colocarlo.

A Marauder's Dues#012.src: Remember, you need to get {~} Explosive Power! If you need a hint, click on Hints and Rules and select "I want a hint."
A Marauder's Dues#012.dst: ¡Necesitas {~} de poder explosivo! Para una pista, pulsa Pistas y reglas y elige "Quiero una pista."

A Marauder's Dues#013.src: That terrible wizard must have captured you in his spell when you did. It was terrible, it was- Such a hard look you had in your eyes...
A Marauder's Dues#013.dst: Ese terrible mago debió de atraparte con su hechizo entonces. Fue terrible, fue- Tenías una mirada tan dura...

A Marauder's Dues#014.src: ...I barely remember anything. Just...feelings of anger, and...disgust, I suppose, but... You wouldn't lie to me, Grand-Peli.
A Marauder's Dues#014.dst: ...Apenas recuerdo nada. Solo... ira y... asco, supongo, pero... Tú no me mentirías, abuelo Peli.

A Marauder's Dues#016.src: ...ugh. Disgusting. Utterly disgusting. I've had just about enough of your kind here. Humans...
A Marauder's Dues#016.dst: ...puaj. Asqueroso. Absolutamente asqueroso. Ya estoy harto de los de tu especie. Humanos...
A Marauder's Dues#016.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#017.src: Dreadfully drab, always getting in the way, wriggling through our province like worms! You're no heroes, you're pretenders!!
A Marauder's Dues#017.dst: ¡Terriblemente sosos, siempre estorbando, retorciéndoos por nuestra provincia como gusanos! ¡No sois héroes, sois impostores!
A Marauder's Dues#017.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#018.src: Oh, you want through here? Well, I'm the gatekeeper. Let's call my toll...the abandonment of your ridiculous little heroics...and all your money besides. Sound fair?
A Marauder's Dues#018.dst: Oh, ¿quieres pasar? Pues yo soy el guardián de la puerta. Mi peaje será... que abandones tus ridículas heroicidades... y todo tu dinero, de paso. ¿Te parece justo?
A Marauder's Dues#018.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#019.src: Aha, Norsten my boy! We've been worried sick, it's been a week. What is it you're doing so far out into the canyon?
A Marauder's Dues#019.dst: ¡Ajá, Norsten, muchacho! Nos tenías muy preocupados, ha pasado una semana. ¿Qué haces tan lejos en el cañón?
A Marauder's Dues#019.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#020.src: Wha- Who are you, and who gave you permission to use my toll road?! And can't you see I'm busy?
A Marauder's Dues#020.dst: ¿Qu- Quién eres tú, y quién te ha dado permiso para usar mi camino de peaje? ¿¡No ves que estoy ocupado!?
A Marauder's Dues#020.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#021.src: Norsten?? Don't you recognize your own grandfather? What's that strange look in your eyes, and what's this about a toll road?
A Marauder's Dues#021.dst: ¿¿Norsten?? ¿No reconoces a tu propio abuelo? ¿Qué es esa mirada tan extraña, y qué es eso de un camino de peaje?
A Marauder's Dues#021.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#022.src: You're nothing to me at your age. I only care about what the young can do for me...and about the fee you're neglecting, you shriveled old fruit!
A Marauder's Dues#022.dst: A tu edad no vales nada para mí. Solo me importa lo que los jóvenes pueden hacer por mí... ¡y el peaje que no pagas, fruta vieja y arrugada!
A Marauder's Dues#022.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#023.src: What's gotten into you? Such a polite man, acting this way to your elders... Human, have you any idea what's-
A Marauder's Dues#023.dst: ¿Qué te ha pasado? Un joven tan educado, tratando así a sus mayores... Humano, ¿tienes idea de qué-
A Marauder's Dues#023.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#024.src: ...oh no. Oh, say it isn't so, is that what's happening? Is it HIS fault?
A Marauder's Dues#024.dst: ...oh, no. Oh, dime que no es eso lo que pasa. ¿Es culpa SUYA?
A Marauder's Dues#024.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#025.src: Up there, on the cliff- that tower! The scourge of the canyon...has he truly returned? Has he...taken my grandson?!
A Marauder's Dues#025.dst: Allí arriba, en el acantilado- ¡esa torre! El azote del cañón... ¿de verdad ha vuelto? ¿Se ha... llevado a mi nieto?
A Marauder's Dues#025.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#027.src: My reputation, even after all this time, still precedes me!! Indeed, old man, I have taken your grandson as my puppet!
A Marauder's Dues#027.dst: ¡¡Mi reputación, aun después de tanto tiempo, me precede!! ¡Así es, viejo, he tomado a tu nieto como marioneta!
A Marauder's Dues#027.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#028.src: What should I care about the facade? For a hundred and fifty years I've stolen the vitality of others to maintain my beauty, and your grandson will be no different.
A Marauder's Dues#028.dst: ¿Qué me importan las apariencias? Durante ciento cincuenta años he robado la vitalidad ajena para mantener mi belleza, y tu nieto no será distinto.
A Marauder's Dues#028.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#029.src: Miserable dastard!! Cold-water eel!! Human, you must help, you MUST! I beg you, please, seek the sorcerer and save my poor Norsten!!
A Marauder's Dues#029.dst: ¡¡Miserable canalla!! ¡¡Anguila de agua fría!! ¡Humano, tienes que ayudar, TIENES que hacerlo! Te lo ruego, ¡busca al hechicero y salva a mi pobre Norsten!
A Marauder's Dues#029.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#030.src: The southwest mountains have a shortcut past the bandits, time is of the essence!
A Marauder's Dues#030.dst: Al suroeste, las montañas tienen un atajo sin bandidos. ¡El tiempo apremia!
A Marauder's Dues#030.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#031.src: A veritable army fell before my magic! The bandits pay their tribute to my grace and obey my orders! You're as mad as I am called if you think one human can get through.
A Marauder's Dues#031.dst: ¡Un auténtico ejército cayó ante mi magia! ¡Los bandidos rinden tributo a mi gracia y obedecen mis órdenes! Estás tan loco como me llaman si crees que un humano puede pasar.
A Marauder's Dues#031.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#032.src: I'll leave you a corpse, a husk! A withered pile of dust- or perhaps I'll take YOU as a slave too, human! So what will it be? Run...or face me?
A Marauder's Dues#032.dst: ¡Te dejaré hecho un cadáver, una cáscara! Polvo marchito- ¡o quizá te haga a TI también mi esclavo, humano! ¿Qué eliges? ¿Huir... o enfrentarte a mí?
A Marauder's Dues#032.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#033.src: Go up the path to the wizard's tower, at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Marauder's Dues#033.dst: Sube por el camino hasta la torre del mago, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Marauder's Dues#034.src: Hoho... The worm comes wriggling in, it seems. What a horrid thing you are. Mismatched armor, courage of a fool all over your face... Inelegant and UGLY!!
A Marauder's Dues#034.dst: Jojo... Parece que el gusano entra retorciéndose. Qué cosa tan horrible eres. Armadura desparejada, coraje de necio por toda la cara... ¡¡Burdo y FEO!!

A Marauder's Dues#035.src: At least the last ones to face me had some coordination, and the sense to hide themselves. Come further and you'll share their fate!!
A Marauder's Dues#035.dst: Los últimos que me enfrentaron al menos tenían coordinación y el sentido de esconderse. ¡Si sigues avanzando, correrás su misma suerte!

A Marauder's Dues#036.src: ..rrgh! The tunnels! Once again, humans try so hard to spoil my fun... But do you really think you've evaded me?
A Marauder's Dues#036.dst: ..¡rrgh! ¡Los túneles! Los humanos otra vez aguándome la fiesta... ¿Crees que me has esquivado?

A Marauder's Dues#037.src: You can never understand. The beauty of one like myself cannot be transient, it must be everlasting! I will never succumb to my mortality!
A Marauder's Dues#037.dst: Nunca lo entenderás. La belleza de alguien como yo no puede ser pasajera, ¡debe ser eterna! ¡Jamás sucumbiré a mi mortalidad!

A Marauder's Dues#038.src: As a matter of fact...you humans ARE good for one thing. Drab as you are, you're lively. So consider this an honor!
A Marauder's Dues#038.dst: De hecho... los humanos SÍ servís para algo. Por sosos que seáis, tenéis vida. ¡Así que considéralo un honor!

A Marauder's Dues#039.src: HAAAAAhahahaha!! Instead of destruction, I'll leave you trapped in this illusion, and chip away at your ugly mind until nothing remains. You'll join the rest who've prolonged my life!
A Marauder's Dues#039.dst: ¡¡JAAAAAjajajaja!! En vez de destruirte, te dejaré atrapado en esta ilusión y roeré tu fea mente hasta que no quede nada. ¡Te unirás a los que han prolongado mi vida!

A Marauder's Dues#041.src: I'll take pleasure in peeling away your most formative memories first- W-wait, what's this giant blank spot? It's interfering with my spell...!!
A Marauder's Dues#041.dst: Disfrutaré arrancando primero tus recuerdos más formativos- E-espera, ¿qué es este enorme hueco en blanco? ¡¡Interfiere con mi hechizo...!!

A Marauder's Dues#042.src: Ugh, barely any memories to remove, hardly any personality... How much of a dull gray slate are you...and how is that making this more difficult?!
A Marauder's Dues#042.dst: Uf, apenas hay recuerdos que quitar, casi nada de personalidad... ¿Qué clase de pizarra gris y vacía eres... y por qué eso lo hace más difícil?

A Marauder's Dues#043.src: Run away and confront the wizard.

A Marauder's Dues#044.src: You escaped?! ...hmph. I suppose that trick works better for blinding a platoon than a person. When you only need to focus on what YOU see...rrgh.
A Marauder's Dues#044.dst: ¿¡Has escapado!? ...hmph. Supongo que ese truco ciega mejor a un pelotón que a una persona. Cuando solo tienes que fijarte en lo que ves TÚ... rrgh.

A Marauder's Dues#045.src: Fine...you've forced my hand. I must sweep you aside, you so-called hero! Never darken my door again! Cease to exist!!
A Marauder's Dues#045.dst: Muy bien... me has obligado. ¡Debo apartarte de mi camino, supuesto héroe! ¡No vuelvas a pisar mi puerta! ¡¡Deja de existir!!

A Marauder's Dues#047.src: Ugh, what was it that raisin of a man said- Miserable runt?! Cold-water eel?! More fitting names for you than me!!
A Marauder's Dues#047.dst: Uf, ¿qué dijo esa pasa de hombre? ¿¡Miserable enano!? ¿¡Anguila de agua fría!? ¡¡Te van mejor a ti que a mí!!
A Marauder's Dues#047.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#048.src: ...fine. The defenses of my tower were absolute enough that I never needed to defend myself inside. I should have taken you more seriously from the start.
A Marauder's Dues#048.dst: ...Bien. Las defensas de mi torre eran tan absolutas que nunca tuve que defenderme dentro. Debí tomarte más en serio desde el principio.
A Marauder's Dues#048.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#049.src: It's been so long since I've faced a threat, and now that you're here- RRGH! How could a HUMAN get the best of me?
A Marauder's Dues#049.dst: Hacía tanto que no me enfrentaba a una amenaza, y ahora que estás aquí- ¡RRGH! ¿Cómo puede vencerme un HUMANO?
A Marauder's Dues#049.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#050.src: Me, who holds control over every bandit in the canyon...! How dare you embarrass me so!
A Marauder's Dues#050.dst: ¡Yo, que controlo a todos los bandidos del cañón...! ¡Cómo te atreves a humillarme así!
A Marauder's Dues#050.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#051.src: Well, fine. You've got me dead to rights. I'll give up the blasted binding gem. Who knows if most of the bandits will return to normal, after so long...
A Marauder's Dues#051.dst: Bueno, está bien. Me has pillado. Entregaré la maldita gema de vinculación. Quién sabe si los bandidos volverán a la normalidad, después de tanto tiempo...
A Marauder's Dues#051.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#052.src: ...but Norsten? He'll barely be affected. Bring it to him and he'll be freed, loath as I am to let him go.
A Marauder's Dues#052.dst: ...¿pero Norsten? Apenas le afectará. Llévasela y quedará libre, por mucho que me pese soltarlo.
A Marauder's Dues#052.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#054.src: HA! I still get the last laugh! Even at my most vulnerable I have gracefully outwitted you! As if I would really surrender to a human.
A Marauder's Dues#054.dst: ¡JA! ¡Aún me río el último! ¡Incluso en mi momento más vulnerable te he burlado con elegancia! Como si fuera a rendirme ante un humano.
A Marauder's Dues#054.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#055.src: Those souls are mine to control, you hear me? Mine to bind!! Mine to drain dry of vitality!! Mine to OWN!! HehehaHAAAAA!!
A Marauder's Dues#055.dst: Esas almas son mías para controlarlas, ¿me oyes? ¡¡Mías para vincularlas!! ¡¡Mías para drenarlas!! ¡¡MÍAS!! ¡¡JejejaJAAAAA!!
A Marauder's Dues#055.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#056.src: And if you jump in after it? You'll be truly trapped- a dimension of my own making, filled with volatile magical waste! You'll never be seen again!
A Marauder's Dues#056.dst: ¿Y si saltas tras ella? Quedarás atrapado de verdad- ¡una dimensión creada por mí, llena de residuos mágicos inestables! ¡Nadie volverá a verte!
A Marauder's Dues#056.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#057.dst: En otras palabras... Has. Per. Dido.
A Marauder's Dues#057.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#058.src: Find a way out of the strange dimension.
A Marauder's Dues#058.dst: Busca una forma de salir de la extraña dimensión.

A Marauder's Dues#059.src: Find a way out of the strange dimension.
A Marauder's Dues#059.dst: Busca una forma de salir de la extraña dimensión.

A Marauder's Dues#061.src: H-how did you survive? How did you get OUT?! That pocket dimension has a one-way entrance!! I- You- I'LL DRAIN AWAY NORSTEN BEFORE YOUR VERY EYES!!
A Marauder's Dues#061.dst: ¿C-cómo has sobrevivido? ¿¡Cómo has SALIDO!? ¡¡Esa dimensión de bolsillo es de solo entrada!! Yo- Tú- ¡¡DRENARÉ A NORSTEN ANTE TUS OJOS!!
A Marauder's Dues#061.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#062.src: The scourge is angry!! Human, quickly, for him to be this upset you must have found something! Save my grandson, please!!
A Marauder's Dues#062.dst: ¡¡El azote está furioso!! Humano, rápido, si está tan alterado es que has encontrado algo. ¡¡Salva a mi nieto, por favor!!
A Marauder's Dues#062.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#063.src: I'LL FLING YOU TO THE ENDS OF THE CANYON!! FILTHY HUMAN, LOWLY WORM NOT FIT TO BE DUST-
A Marauder's Dues#063.dst: ¡¡TE LANZARÉ AL FIN DEL CAÑÓN!! HUMANO ASQUEROSO, GUSANO RASTRERO QUE NO VALE NI EL POLVO-
A Marauder's Dues#063.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#064.src: Aguh...w-where am I? My...my throat hurts...was I screaming?
A Marauder's Dues#064.dst: Agh... ¿d-dónde estoy? Me... me duele la garganta... ¿estaba gritando?
A Marauder's Dues#064.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#065.src: Oh, my poor grandson...my little Norsten is back to us! Oh, joyous day!!
A Marauder's Dues#065.dst: ¡Oh, mi pobre nieto... mi pequeño Norsten ha vuelto! ¡¡Oh, qué día tan feliz!!
A Marauder's Dues#065.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#066.src: Back to...did something happen? I remember coming this way after a thief...and then...
A Marauder's Dues#066.dst: ¿Vuelto...? ¿Ha pasado algo? Recuerdo venir por aquí tras un ladrón... y luego...
A Marauder's Dues#066.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#067.src: That terrible wizard captured you in his spell when you did. It was terrible, it was- Such a hard look you had in your eyes...
A Marauder's Dues#067.dst: Ese terrible mago te atrapó con su hechizo entonces. Fue terrible, fue- Tenías una mirada tan dura...
A Marauder's Dues#067.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#068.src: But this human, this hero... They have bested the scourge of the canyon! They managed to save you from such evil!
A Marauder's Dues#068.dst: Pero este humano, este héroe... ¡Ha vencido al azote del cañón! ¡Ha logrado salvarte de semejante mal!
A Marauder's Dues#068.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#069.src: ...I barely remember anything. Just...feelings of anger, and...disgust, I suppose, but... You wouldn't lie to me Grand-Peli.
A Marauder's Dues#069.dst: ...Apenas recuerdo nada. Solo... ira y... asco, supongo, pero... Tú no me mentirías, abuelo Peli.
A Marauder's Dues#069.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#070.src: Thank you, human- Hm? What's all this money doing in my pockets? I didn't bring my pouch out with me to chase the thief, but...! So much money!
A Marauder's Dues#070.dst: Gracias, humano- ¿Mm? ¿Qué hace todo este dinero en mis bolsillos? No saqué la bolsa para perseguir al ladrón, pero...! ¡Cuánto dinero!
A Marauder's Dues#070.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#071.src: Ill-gotten gains from the scourge's sham of a toll-road scheme, no doubt. I think that human could put that money to fine use, what say you, my boy?
A Marauder's Dues#071.dst: Ganancias ilícitas del falso peaje de ese azote, sin duda. Creo que este humano le daría un buen uso a ese dinero, ¿qué dices, muchacho?
A Marauder's Dues#071.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#072.src: Of course! Here. And don't worry about the gate. It's supposed to be open for anyone, so use it as you like.
A Marauder's Dues#072.dst: ¡Claro! Toma. Y no te preocupes por la puerta. Se supone que está abierta para todos, así que úsala cuando quieras.
A Marauder's Dues#072.speaker: Norsten

A New Beginning#003.src: To honor Her Majesty and to celebrate Her grace and blessings placed upon the land.
A New Beginning#003.dst: En honor a Su Majestad y para celebrar la gracia y las bendiciones que Ella ha concedido a la tierra.

A New Beginning#004.src: You've gotten about as much worthwhile information out of this conversation as you'll get.
A New Beginning#004.dst: Ya le has sacado a esta conversación toda la información útil que vas a sacar.

A New Beginning#005.src: E's real! Real I tells ya! Saw 'im with my own two eyes I did!
A New Beginning#005.dst: ¡Es real! ¡Real, te lo digo! ¡Lo vi con mis propios ojos, sí señor!

A New Beginning#006.src: But enough of that. You want to go to {p}, right?
A New Beginning#006.dst: Pero basta de eso. Quieres ir a {p}, ¿verdad?

A New Beginning#007.src: WRAHAHHEHGHHHHOROOOARRRRR!!!!!! 'E jumps out at me... And 'e... 'e...
A New Beginning#007.dst: WRAHAHHEHGHHHHOROOOARRRRR!!!!!! Se me echa encima... Y él... él...

A New Beginning#008.dst: Las botellas llevan la etiqueta "Auburn Amaretto".

A New Beginning#009.src: So, want me to take you over?

A New Beginning#010.src: What do you do for the resistance?

A New Beginning#011.src: You youngsters *hic* always poke fun... think it's make-believe... But I promises ya! 'e's real!
A New Beginning#011.dst: Los jóvenes *hic* siempre os burláis... creéis que me lo invento... ¡Pero te lo juro! ¡Es real!

A New Beginning#012.src: And I have to say: You look just like the kind of person that could take it on.
A New Beginning#012.dst: Y debo decirlo: pareces justo la clase de persona capaz de afrontarlo.

A New Beginning#013.src: Owners have been listed as unloyal to the crown. Have been disposed of.
A New Beginning#013.dst: Propietarios declarados desleales a la Corona. Ya han sido eliminados.

A New Beginning#014.src: Another region? What do you mean?

A New Beginning#015.src: Uh... one second. Let me find them...

A New Beginning#016.src: Understood. Now, back to- where did they go?!
A New Beginning#016.dst: Entendido. Bueno, volviendo a- ¡¿adónde han ido?!

A New Beginning#017.src: New Chapter Started: Leaves in the Wind

A New Beginning#018.src: Um. The thing at T-Torann... you w-wouldn't happen to-... n-n-nevermind. I don't need to know!
A New Beginning#018.dst: Eh. Lo de T-Torann... ¿no s-serías tú por casualidad-...? N-n-no importa. ¡No necesito saberlo!

A New Beginning#019.src: You'll need to search quickly, in case any guards return.
A New Beginning#019.dst: Tienes que buscar rápido, por si vuelve algún guardia.

A New Beginning#020.src: The door is locked from the other side.
A New Beginning#020.dst: La puerta está cerrada por el otro lado.

A New Beginning#021.src: Perhaps it's accessible from another location.
A New Beginning#021.dst: Quizá se pueda llegar desde otro sitio.

A New Beginning#022.src: This must be the records room... It's locked.
A New Beginning#022.dst: Esta debe de ser la sala de archivos... Está cerrada.

A New Beginning#023.src: "Only guards with appropriate clearance may access the records. If you believe a mistake has been made with your clearance level, inquire at the office."
A New Beginning#023.dst: "Solo los guardias con la autorización adecuada pueden consultar los archivos. Si crees que hay un error en tu nivel de autorización, pregunta en la oficina."

A New Beginning#024.src: Wait, a suspicious person in the region- is this the cursed one?! Get them!!
A New Beginning#024.dst: Espera, una persona sospechosa en la zona- ¡¿es el maldito?! ¡¡A por él!!

A New Beginning#025.src: The Sovereign must be in the office with the key- that'd be in the other tower. You need to hurry before you're discovered.
A New Beginning#025.dst: El Soberano debe de estar en la oficina con la llave- eso está en la otra torre. Date prisa antes de que te descubran.

A New Beginning#026.src: Sovereign, sir. It seems {p} was not prepared to directly face a cursed one. Dozens of soldiers are dead.
A New Beginning#026.dst: Soberano, señor. Parece que {p} no estaba preparada para enfrentarse a un maldito. Han muerto decenas de soldados.

A New Beginning#027.src: I have a dozen and a half other problems to solve that need to be pushed back- oh, would you put away the key already?
A New Beginning#027.dst: Tengo otra docena y media de problemas que aplazar- oh, ¿quiere guardar ya esa llave?

A New Beginning#029.src: This must be the key that unlocks the record storage.
A New Beginning#029.dst: Esta debe de ser la llave que abre el archivo.

A New Beginning#032.src: Subject brought to {p} by the Driver. (Note: Interrogate Driver for reasoning.)
A New Beginning#032.dst: Sujeto traído a {p} por el Conductor. (Nota: interrogarle sobre el motivo.)

A New Beginning#033.src: Seems to originate from Wynn Province. Matches description of one Queen's Tournament participant.
A New Beginning#033.dst: Parece proceder de la Provincia de Wynn. Coincide con la descripción de un participante del Torneo de la Reina.

A New Beginning#034.src: Do not engage without backup or blessed equipment. Subject is dangerous, and has shown no regard for military life.
A New Beginning#034.dst: No enfrentarse sin refuerzos o equipo bendecido. El sujeto es peligroso y no respeta la vida de los soldados.

A New Beginning#035.src: If sighted, report to superiors immediately. Keep an eye on subject, but do not engage. Keep them in sight until-
A New Beginning#035.dst: Si se le ve, avisar a los superiores. Vigilar al sujeto, sin atacarlo. No perderlo de vista hasta-

A New Beginning#036.src: You can't afford to be spotted. You need to take the records, and find a way out without alerting the guards.
A New Beginning#036.dst: No pueden verte. Tienes que llevarte los archivos y encontrar una salida sin alertar a los guardias.

A New Beginning#038.src: ...I th-thought you were m-making things up again.
A New Beginning#038.dst: ...Cr-creía que te lo estabas inv-ventando otra vez.

A New Beginning#039.src: Excuse you? I don't make things up! You can ask Mora, he saw it too.
A New Beginning#039.dst: ¿Perdona? ¡Yo no me invento nada! Pregúntale a Mora, él también lo vio.

A New Beginning#040.src: If you s-say so... I just- I-I-I thought there were no p-people left out there. The c-crown keeps a whole g-garrison stationed to f-fight off... um... m-m-monsters.
A New Beginning#040.dst: Si tú lo d-dices... Es que- y-y-yo creía que ahí fuera no quedaba n-nadie. La C-Corona tiene toda una g-guarnición para c-combatir a... eh... m-m-monstruos.

A New Beginning#041.src: Wh- I d-don't know! It s-s-sounded believable to me!
A New Beginning#041.dst: ¡Q- n-no lo sé! ¡A mí me p-p-pareció creíble!

A New Beginning#042.src: Ugh, whatever! I don't have time for this, Zeph, I have work to do. Just... stay on your guard. I don't trust whatever's going on with this stranger.
A New Beginning#042.dst: ¡Uf, lo que sea! No tengo tiempo para esto, Zeph, tengo trabajo. Tú... no bajes la guardia. No me fío de lo que pasa con este forastero.

A New Beginning#043.src: How'd you know I needed help?

A New Beginning#044.src: The breeze carries the sounds of windchimes...
A New Beginning#044.dst: La brisa trae el sonido de unos carillones...

A New Beginning#045.src: So let's get to the business at hand. I'll start with this - you're from the Wynn Province, aren't you?
A New Beginning#045.dst: Así que vayamos al grano. Empezaré por esto - vienes de la Provincia de Wynn, ¿verdad?

A New Beginning#046.src: You trust me enough to tell me that?
A New Beginning#046.dst: ¿Tanto confías en mí como para decirlo?

A New Beginning#047.src: Even if you chose to reveal my secrets - and if anyone even believed you - you'd have no guarantee of your own safety.
A New Beginning#047.dst: Aunque decidieras revelar mis secretos - y aunque alguien te creyera - nada garantizaría tu propia seguridad.

A New Beginning#048.src: Something strange is happening here. I can feel it.
A New Beginning#048.dst: Aquí está pasando algo raro. Lo noto.

A New Beginning#049.src: The power you carry - the curse you bear. I have seen such things before, yet always at a distance. Never up close.
A New Beginning#049.dst: El poder que llevas - la maldición que cargas. Ya he visto cosas así, pero siempre de lejos. Nunca de cerca.

A New Beginning#050.src: ...I have a different perspective on this story, you might imagine. The crown has wronged me, and many others. Yet, the stories hold truths to them, to some extent.
A New Beginning#050.dst: ...Como imaginarás, yo tengo otra visión de esta historia. La Corona me ha hecho daño a mí y a muchos otros. Aun así, las historias tienen algo de verdad.

A New Beginning#051.src: I've only ever known it as magic. Where I'm from, most people can wield it.
A New Beginning#051.dst: Siempre lo he llamado magia. De donde vengo, casi todos pueden usarla.

A New Beginning#052.src: Then that leads me to my final request. Would you join our cause, and offer your help to our resistance group? Your knowledge and strength will be greatly appreciated.
A New Beginning#052.dst: Eso me lleva a mi última petición. ¿Te unirías a nuestra causa y ofrecerías tu ayuda a nuestra resistencia? Tu conocimiento y tu fuerza serán muy valiosos.

A New Beginning#054.src: Um... wait, can I ask- actually... nevermind.
A New Beginning#054.dst: Eh... espera, ¿puedo preguntar- bueno... da igual.

A New Beginning#055.src: Well, welcome to the Leaves in the Wind! Pardon the hesitation earlier, the cursed are a... sensitive subject. If Syndra believes you to be safe, I will choose to believe her.
A New Beginning#055.dst: ¡Pues bienvenido a Hojas al Viento! Perdona la duda de antes, los malditos son un tema... delicado. Si Syndra cree que eres de fiar, yo decido creerla.

A New Beginning#056.src: It's always nice to have some fresh blood under our canopy! No matter how abnormal. We may wait for Syndra's return before getting you properly settled in.
A New Beginning#056.dst: ¡Siempre viene bien sangre nueva bajo nuestra copa! Por muy peculiar que sea. Quizá esperemos a que vuelva Syndra para instalarte como es debido.

A New Beginning#057.src: If you have any issues whatsoever, don't hesitate to inform me!
A New Beginning#057.dst: ¡Si tienes cualquier problema, no dudes en decírmelo!

A New Beginning#058.src: I am Syndra's right hand! I deal with many of the tasks involving our family here, to lighten the workload she places upon herself.
A New Beginning#058.dst: ¡Soy la mano derecha de Syndra! Me ocupo de muchas tareas de nuestra familia, para aligerar la carga que ella misma se impone.

A New Beginning#059.src: Such tasks could include onboarding new recruits, assigning members to various missions... handling disputes- that sort of thing.
A New Beginning#059.dst: Tareas como recibir a los nuevos reclutas, asignar miembros a distintas misiones... resolver disputas- ese tipo de cosas.

A New Beginning#060.src: Of course, my "official" occupation by the crown's terms is that of a lumberjack. Fighting for a better future isn't exactly a well paying job, hoho!
A New Beginning#060.dst: Claro que, según la Corona, mi oficio "oficial" es el de leñador. Luchar por un futuro mejor no es un trabajo muy bien pagado, ¡jojo!

A New Beginning#061.src: I'm a tactician, otherwise. Not the tactician- that'd be Syndra- but... y'know.
A New Beginning#061.dst: Aparte de eso, soy estratega. No la estratega- esa es Syndra- pero... ya sabes.

A New Beginning#062.src: No, you didn't- ugh! It's not you personally, it's just...
A New Beginning#062.dst: No, no has- ¡uf! No es por ti, es que...

A New Beginning#065.src: Yes... A toddler could calculate that by watching you. I'll solve that problem for you. Keep them out of trouble, and we won't have any issues- as usual.
A New Beginning#065.dst: Sí... Hasta un niño lo calcularía viéndote. Te resolveré ese problema. Tenlos lejos de líos y no habrá ningún inconveniente- como siempre.

A New Beginning#067.src: Simple - I don't. You don't need to worry about him. As I said, we have an agreement. He doesn't know about anything we do.
A New Beginning#067.dst: Fácil - no me fío. No tienes que preocuparte por él. Como he dicho, tenemos un acuerdo. No sabe nada de lo que hacemos.

A New Beginning#068.src: You shouldn't get near a running saw that big! Find a way to disable it first.
A New Beginning#068.dst: ¡No te acerques a una sierra tan grande en marcha! Busca antes cómo pararla.

A New Beginning#070.src: Halt! I'll need to see some form of identification.
A New Beginning#070.dst: ¡Alto! Necesito ver algún tipo de identificación.
A New Beginning#070.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#071.src: New policy, sorry for the inconvenience. We're heightening security around here.
A New Beginning#071.dst: Nueva normativa, disculpa las molestias. Estamos reforzando la seguridad por aquí.
A New Beginning#071.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#072.src: It shouldn't take too much of your time, don't worry! Just show us your citizen identification papers, and we'll let you on through.
A New Beginning#072.dst: No te llevará mucho tiempo, ¡tranquilo! Enséñanos tus papeles de ciudadano y te dejaremos pasar.
A New Beginning#072.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#075.src: What's taking so long? It can't be that hard to find those. You should have them on your person at all times.
A New Beginning#075.dst: ¿Por qué tardas tanto? No puede ser tan difícil encontrarlos. Deberías llevarlos siempre encima.
A New Beginning#075.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#076.src: It’s a very new restriction. There was some incident nearby. I’m not sure on the details, but-
A New Beginning#076.dst: Es una restricción muy reciente. Hubo un incidente cerca. No conozco los detalles, pero-
A New Beginning#076.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#077.src: Enough stalling. Where are your papers?
A New Beginning#077.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#078.src: If you don’t present identification, I’m going to need to take you in for questioning.
A New Beginning#078.dst: Si no presentas identificación, tendré que llevarte para interrogarte.
A New Beginning#078.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#079.src: O-oh, hey, th-there you are! Gosh, I was w-wondering where you'd gotten off to!
A New Beginning#079.dst: ¡O-oh, eh, a-aquí estás! ¡Vaya, me preguntaba a-adónde te habías ido!

A New Beginning#080.src: Ha... d-don't tell me you forgot your papers again! I k-keep telling you to keep th-them with you...
A New Beginning#080.dst: Ja... ¡n-no me digas que has vuelto a olvidar los papeles! Siempre te d-digo que los lleves e-encima...

A New Beginning#081.src: One of th-these days, you'll remember! F-for sure...

A New Beginning#082.src: You d-didn’t forget our conversation too, d-did you? S-s-sorry for my friend, sir!
A New Beginning#082.dst: ¿T-tampoco te habrás olvidado de nuestra charla, v-verdad? ¡P-p-perdone a mi amigo, señor!

A New Beginning#083.src: Ahem. I'll still need to see identification if you want to enter the city.
A New Beginning#083.dst: Ejem. Aun así necesito ver una identificación si queréis entrar en la ciudad.
A New Beginning#083.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#084.src: Oh! O-o-of course! L-let me just...

A New Beginning#085.src: ...They're a-around here s-s-somewhere, I'm s-sure... I think they m-might be
A New Beginning#085.dst: ...Están p-por aquí, en a-a-algún sitio, seguro... Creo que p-podrían estar

A New Beginning#086.src: Aha! Here! Identification p-papers, just for y-you!

A New Beginning#087.src: ...What even is this? I can barely read the handwriting... Is that Sovereign Selium's signature? The previous sovereign?
A New Beginning#087.dst: ...¿Qué es esto? Apenas entiendo la letra... ¿Es la firma del Soberano Selium? ¿El soberano anterior?
A New Beginning#087.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#088.src: I've had enough of these games. The two of you are under
A New Beginning#088.dst: Ya me he cansado de estos juegos. Los dos quedáis bajo
A New Beginning#088.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#091.src: We've received more information about the incident at {p}. There's a new cursed one to look out for. Dozens of soldiers were killed in an attempt to capture them.
A New Beginning#091.dst: Tenemos más información sobre el incidente de {p}. Hay un nuevo maldito al que vigilar. Decenas de soldados murieron intentando capturarlo.
A New Beginning#091.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#092.src: We're taking reinforcements to the fort, but I need you to remain at your posts. Keep a watchful eye on any suspicious individuals.
A New Beginning#092.dst: Llevamos refuerzos al fuerte, pero necesito que sigáis en vuestros puestos. Vigilad de cerca a cualquier sospechoso.
A New Beginning#092.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#093.src: ...Th-this might be a good time to run. While they're distracted! Quick, f-follow me!
A New Beginning#093.dst: ...E-este podría ser buen momento para huir. ¡Mientras están distraídos! ¡Rápido, s-sígueme!

A New Beginning#094.src: Understood. Now, back to where did they go?!
A New Beginning#094.dst: Entendido. Bueno, volviendo a ¡¿adónde han ido?!
A New Beginning#094.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#096.src: Phew... G-glad we got out of there...
A New Beginning#096.dst: Uf... M-menos mal que salimos de ahí...

A New Beginning#097.src: A-anyway. What were you th-thinking? Trying to enter the city without p-papers...
A New Beginning#097.dst: En f-fin. ¿En qué estabas p-pensando? Intentar entrar en la ciudad sin p-papeles...

A New Beginning#098.src: You're n-new around here, right? Transferred in f-from elsewhere. Y-you're interesting, though.
A New Beginning#098.dst: Eres n-nuevo por aquí, ¿no? Te han trasladado d-de otro sitio. Aunque e-eres interesante.

A New Beginning#099.src: Um. The thing at T-Torann... you w-wouldn't happen to... n-n-nevermind. I don't need to know!
A New Beginning#099.dst: Eh. Lo de T-Torann... ¿no s-serías tú por casualidad...? N-n-no importa. ¡No necesito saberlo!

A New Beginning#100.src: But, if y-you're interested... The military k-keeps records of these sorts of things! Th-they want a paper trail... or s-something.
A New Beginning#100.dst: Pero, si t-te interesa... ¡El ejército g-guarda registros de estas cosas! Q-quieren dejar constancia... o a-algo así.

A New Beginning#101.src: You d-didn't hear this from me... but the l-leaves have whispered something about th-the location of a record storage. Here, hand me that b-book of yours...
A New Beginning#101.dst: Esto n-no te lo he dicho yo... pero las h-hojas han susurrado dónde hay un archivo. Toma, dame ese l-libro tuyo...

A New Beginning#102.src: Well, good luck s-stranger! If anyone asks, we never m-met. But, um... y-you can call me Zeph.
A New Beginning#102.dst: ¡Bueno, suerte, f-forastero! Si alguien pregunta, nunca nos hemos v-visto. Pero, eh... p-puedes llamarme Zeph.
A New Beginning#102.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#103.src: Find your report in the storage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A New Beginning#103.dst: Encuentra tu informe en el archivo en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A New Beginning#105.src: HALT! Intruder! For trespassing on restricted property, you are under
A New Beginning#105.dst: ¡ALTO! ¡Intruso! Por entrar en una zona restringida, quedas bajo
A New Beginning#105.speaker: Nixeph Watchman

A New Beginning#106.src: Wait, a suspicious person in the region is this the cursed one?! Get them!!
A New Beginning#106.dst: Espera, una persona sospechosa en la zona ¡¿es el maldito?! ¡¡A por él!!
A New Beginning#106.speaker: Nixeph Watchman

A New Beginning#107.dst: Van a por... el Soberano Zhiraok... N-no...t...tú...
A New Beginning#107.speaker: Nixeph Watchman

A New Beginning#108.src: Well? You've crunched the numbers. Give me the report.
A New Beginning#108.dst: ¿Y bien? Ya has hecho los cálculos. Dame el informe.
A New Beginning#108.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#109.src: Sovereign, sir. It seems {p} was not directly prepared to face a cursed one. Dozens of soldiers are dead.
A New Beginning#109.dst: Soberano, señor. Parece que {p} no estaba realmente preparada para un maldito. Han muerto decenas de soldados.
A New Beginning#109.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#110.src: ...of all the possibilities. How could that have factored out...? Hm. Who was the commanding officer? Their take on the problem would help fill the gaps.
A New Beginning#110.dst: ...de todas las posibilidades. ¿Cómo ha podido salir ese resultado...? Hm. ¿Quién era el oficial al mando? Su versión ayudaría a completar la ecuación.
A New Beginning#110.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#111.src: Well... it seems it was Commander Lilles, sir. But he was one of the casualties of the incident, and a replacement has yet to be promoted.
A New Beginning#111.dst: Bueno... parece que era el comandante Lilles, señor. Pero fue una de las bajas del incidente, y aún no se ha ascendido a un sustituto.
A New Beginning#111.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#112.src: Naturally... I'll need to get hold of his family later and break the news. What else do you have on the Cursed One?
A New Beginning#112.dst: Cómo no... Luego tendré que contactar con su familia y darles la noticia. ¿Qué más tiene sobre el maldito?
A New Beginning#112.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#113.src: I've heard reports that they're... from outside. Possibly one of the ones who were invited into our province recently, though nobody seems certain on that.
A New Beginning#113.dst: He oído que es... de fuera. Quizá uno de los invitados hace poco a nuestra provincia, aunque nadie parece estar seguro.
A New Beginning#113.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#114.src: We've already raised security in {p}, and we have forces moving to Torann.
A New Beginning#114.dst: Ya hemos reforzado la seguridad en {p}, y hay tropas de camino a Torann.
A New Beginning#114.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#115.src: One positive in a sea of negatives, I suppose. Good work. File the report in the records room, and then we'll go view the damages for ourselves.
A New Beginning#115.dst: Un positivo en un mar de negativos, supongo. Buen trabajo. Archive el informe en la sala de archivos y luego iremos a ver los daños en persona.
A New Beginning#115.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#116.src: One more thing. Since Torann is compromised, we've taken the liberty of storing the cursed one's report here, so
A New Beginning#116.dst: Una cosa más. Como Torann ha caído, hemos guardado aquí el informe del maldito, así que
A New Beginning#116.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#117.src: Do we not have a higher priority right now?!
A New Beginning#117.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#118.src: ...N-n-no, sir. My- my apologies. I simply thought
A New Beginning#118.dst: ...N-n-no, señor. Mis- mis disculpas. Solo pensaba
A New Beginning#118.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#119.src: I have a dozen and a half other problems to solve that need to be pushed back oh, would you put away the key already?
A New Beginning#119.dst: Tengo otra docena y media de problemas que aplazar oh, ¿quiere guardar ya esa llave?
A New Beginning#119.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#120.src: We haven't got time to sit around like this when there's a tragedy of that value to look into! We need to get to {p}, yesterday!
A New Beginning#120.dst: ¡No tenemos tiempo de quedarnos aquí sentados con una tragedia de esa magnitud que investigar! ¡Tenemos que llegar a {p}, y para ayer!
A New Beginning#120.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#121.src: Locate the key inside the eastern tower and retrieve your report.
A New Beginning#121.dst: Encuentra la llave en la torre este y recupera tu informe.

A New Beginning#122.src: * Subject brought to {p} by the Driver. (Note: Interrogate Driver for reasoning.)
A New Beginning#122.dst: * Sujeto traído a {p} por el Conductor. (Nota: interrogar al Conductor sobre sus motivos.)
A New Beginning#122.speaker: "Unknown Cursed One"

A New Beginning#124.src: Someone's been here... search the outpost, quickly!
A New Beginning#124.dst: Alguien ha estado aquí... ¡registrad el puesto, rápido!

A New Beginning#125.src: Find a way out of Nexiph Outpost.
A New Beginning#125.dst: Encuentra una salida del Puesto de Nexiph.

A New Beginning#127.src: H-hey again, at the w-window! Tough s-situation, huh?
A New Beginning#127.dst: ¡H-hola otra vez, en la v-ventana! Mala s-situación, ¿eh?
A New Beginning#127.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#128.src: I f-figured you could use a hand... Stand back a m-moment.
A New Beginning#128.dst: Me i-imaginé que te vendría bien una mano... Apártate un m-momento.
A New Beginning#128.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#130.src: I-I'll be down in a bit. Just h-hold on tight to the rope, and you'll be f-fine!
A New Beginning#130.dst: B-bajo enseguida. ¡Tú agárrate bien a la cuerda y estarás b-bien!
A New Beginning#130.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#131.src: Talk to Rex and Zeph at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A New Beginning#131.dst: Habla con Rex y Zeph en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A New Beginning#132.src: Phew! W-we got you out. G-good work back there, though!
A New Beginning#132.dst: ¡Uf! T-te hemos sacado. ¡Aunque b-buen trabajo ahí dentro!
A New Beginning#132.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#134.src: D-don't mind her, she's just like that. Rex, this is
A New Beginning#134.dst: N-no le hagas caso, ella es así. Rex, este es
A New Beginning#134.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#135.src: The stranger you found trying to get into {p} without identification, I know. Do you really need me here still?
A New Beginning#135.dst: El forastero que pillaste intentando entrar en {p} sin identificación, ya lo sé. ¿De verdad hace falta que siga aquí?
A New Beginning#135.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#136.src: ...I-I-I'd like it if you s-stayed, yes.
A New Beginning#136.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#138.src: Um... I- I don't think I c-c-caught your name.
A New Beginning#138.dst: Eh... c-creo que no he o-oído tu nombre.
A New Beginning#138.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#139.src: {u}... so, wh-where are you from? Y-you must've transferred in from an-another region, right?
A New Beginning#139.dst: {u}... y, ¿d-de dónde eres? T-te habrán trasladado de o-otra región, ¿no?
A New Beginning#139.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#140.src: Another... um... wh-what do you-... you d-don't know?
A New Beginning#140.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#141.src: Obviously they're not from here, Zeph! Remember that thing I told you about? The big spectacle event they had with people from beyond the gates?
