A New Beginning#141.dst: ¡Está claro que no es de aquí, Zeph! ¿Recuerdas lo que te conté? ¿Ese gran espectáculo que montaron con gente de más allá de las puertas?
A New Beginning#141.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#142.src: You w-w-what?! But, there’s- th-that’s not possible...
A New Beginning#142.dst: ¡¿Q-q-qué?! Pero, eso- e-eso no es posible...
A New Beginning#142.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#143.src: Possible or not, they’re obviously from outside the province! They’re probably involved with that big spectacle event with people from beyond the gates that I was telling you about.
A New Beginning#143.dst: ¡Posible o no, está claro que viene de fuera de la provincia! Seguro que tiene que ver con ese gran espectáculo con gente de más allá de las puertas del que te hablé.
A New Beginning#143.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#144.src: …I th-thought you were m-making things up again.
A New Beginning#144.dst: …Cr-creía que te lo estabas inv-ventando otra vez.
A New Beginning#144.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#145.src: Excuse you? I don’t make things up! You can ask Mora, he saw it too.
A New Beginning#145.dst: ¿Perdona? ¡Yo no me invento nada! Pregúntale a Mora, él también lo vio.
A New Beginning#145.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#146.src: If you s-say so… I just- I-I-I thought there were no p-people left out there. The c-crown keeps a whole g-garrison stationed to f-fight off… um… m-m-monsters.
A New Beginning#146.dst: Si tú lo d-dices… Es que- y-y-yo creía que ahí fuera no quedaba n-nadie. La C-Corona tiene toda una g-guarnición para c-combatir a… eh… m-m-monstruos.
A New Beginning#146.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#148.src: Wh- I d-don’t know! It s-s-sounded believable to me!
A New Beginning#148.dst: ¡Q- n-no lo sé! ¡A mí me p-p-pareció creíble!
A New Beginning#148.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#149.src: Ugh, whatever! I don’t have time for this. Zeph, I have work to do. Just… stay on your guard. I don’t trust whatever’s going on with this stranger.
A New Beginning#149.dst: ¡Uf, lo que sea! No tengo tiempo para esto. Zeph, tengo trabajo. Tú… no bajes la guardia. No me fío de lo que pasa con este forastero.
A New Beginning#149.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#151.src: She's- um... she's n-not normally like this. S-sorry about that.
A New Beginning#151.dst: Ella es- eh... n-no suele ser así. P-perdona.
A New Beginning#151.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#152.src: O-Oh! I f-followed you, of course.
A New Beginning#152.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#153.src: A s-stranger comes to our region without p-papers and is supposedly a c-cursed one? I wasn't letting you go th-that easily!
A New Beginning#153.dst: ¿Un f-forastero llega a nuestra región sin p-papeles y dicen que es un m-maldito? ¡No iba a dejarte ir t-tan fácilmente!
A New Beginning#153.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#154.src: O-Oh! N-no problem! It was... it w-was nothing. Y-you did most of the work.
A New Beginning#154.dst: ¡O-oh! ¡N-no hay de qué! No fue... n-no fue nada. T-tú hiciste casi todo.
A New Beginning#154.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#155.src: N-Nixeph is... n-not an easy place to break into! I g-guess all the guards were gone.
A New Beginning#155.dst: ¡N-Nixeph no es... n-nada fácil de asaltar! S-supongo que los guardias se habían ido.
A New Beginning#155.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#156.src: But, um... y-you got what you needed, and I got what I- what I needed, s-so...
A New Beginning#156.dst: Pero, eh... t-tienes lo que querías, y yo lo que- lo que quería, a-así que...
A New Beginning#156.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#157.src: B-besides! I had s-something I needed to get from... f-from the outpost, anyway.
A New Beginning#157.dst: ¡A-además! Tenía que r-recoger algo del... d-del puesto, de todas formas.
A New Beginning#157.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#158.src: Um... th-there is someone you should meet. I was told to pass on a m-message...
A New Beginning#158.dst: Eh... h-hay alguien a quien deberías conocer. Me pidieron que te pasara un m-mensaje...
A New Beginning#158.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#159.src: And- and you'll be on y-your own this time. N-no help from me!
A New Beginning#159.dst: Y- y esta vez irás p-por tu cuenta. ¡N-nada de ayuda mía!
A New Beginning#159.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#160.src: The m-message is: w-westward, the giant lays its roots. As the wind blows, they s-sing along.
A New Beginning#160.dst: El m-mensaje es: al o-oeste, el gigante echa raíces. Cuando sopla el viento, ellas c-cantan con él.
A New Beginning#160.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#161.src: "Westward, the giant lays its roots. As the wind blows, they sing along."
A New Beginning#161.dst: "Al oeste, el gigante echa raíces. Cuando sopla el viento, ellas cantan con él."

A New Beginning#162.src: The m-message is: w-westward, the giant lays its roots. As the wind blows, they s-sing along.
A New Beginning#162.dst: El m-mensaje es: al o-oeste, el gigante echa raíces. Cuando sopla el viento, ellas c-cantan con él.
A New Beginning#162.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#163.src: Talk to the woman in the cave.
A New Beginning#163.dst: Habla con la mujer de la cueva.

A New Beginning#164.src: Well, well. If it isn't a fresh breeze dancing in the leaves...
A New Beginning#164.dst: Vaya, vaya. Si es una brisa fresca bailando entre las hojas...

A New Beginning#165.src: You must be the Cursed One who caused such a stir at Torann, yes? News has spread quickly of your actions.
A New Beginning#165.dst: Tú debes de ser el maldito que armó tanto revuelo en Torann, ¿verdad? Tus actos se han sabido enseguida.

A New Beginning#166.src: I'm impressed you found your way to me.
A New Beginning#166.dst: Me impresiona que hayas dado conmigo.

A New Beginning#167.src: So let's get to the business at hand. I'll start with this you're from the Wynn Province, aren't you?
A New Beginning#167.dst: Así que vayamos al grano. Empezaré por esto vienes de la Provincia de Wynn, ¿verdad?

A New Beginning#168.src: I thought so... You're certainly not from around here. Though, I would recommend you keep that information close to your chest.
A New Beginning#168.dst: Lo suponía... Desde luego no eres de por aquí. Aunque te recomendaría que guardes bien esa información.

A New Beginning#169.src: Very few people have knowledge of the outside world, and those that do... they're the ones who will be looking for you. Best to avoid drawing their attention.
A New Beginning#169.dst: Muy poca gente sabe del mundo exterior, y quienes saben... son los que te estarán buscando. Mejor no llamar su atención.

A New Beginning#170.src: But I should introduce myself. My name is Syndra, leader of the Leaves in the Wind resistance group.
A New Beginning#170.dst: Pero debería presentarme. Me llamo Syndra, líder del grupo de resistencia Hojas al Viento.
A New Beginning#170.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#171.src: Call it something of a gamble. Given your... shall we say, explosive entrance into the province, I find it unlikely you're with the crown.
A New Beginning#171.dst: Llámalo una apuesta. Dada tu... digamos, explosiva entrada en la provincia, dudo que estés con la Corona.
A New Beginning#171.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#172.src: Even if you chose to reveal my secrets and if anyone even believed you you'd have no guarantee of your own safety.
A New Beginning#172.dst: Aunque decidieras revelar mis secretos y aunque alguien te creyera nada garantizaría tu propia seguridad.
A New Beginning#172.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#173.src: Yes. You haven’t been here long, but you’ve felt it, haven’t you? The crown has its roots buried deep in this province, and it certainly isn’t kind to all.
A New Beginning#173.dst: Sí. No llevas mucho aquí, pero lo has notado, ¿verdad? La Corona tiene raíces hondas en esta provincia, y no es amable con todos.
A New Beginning#173.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#174.src: Those it sees as disposable… they don’t often make it far. That is why I have taken my role. I’d like to see a day where none are left behind.
A New Beginning#174.dst: A quienes considera prescindibles… no suelen llegar lejos. Por eso asumí este papel. Quiero ver un día en que nadie quede atrás.
A New Beginning#174.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#175.src: But that's enough about me. On to you. Why are you here, cursed one? For what purpose have you come to Fruma?
A New Beginning#175.dst: Pero basta de hablar de mí. Hablemos de ti. ¿Por qué estás aquí, maldito? ¿Con qué propósito has venido a Fruma?
A New Beginning#175.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#176.src: Interesting. A sense that something isn't right...
A New Beginning#176.dst: Interesante. La sensación de que algo no va bien...
A New Beginning#176.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#177.src: To tell you the truth, it's one I've had myself for quite some time. Though, likely for a different reason to you.
A New Beginning#177.dst: A decir verdad, yo también la tengo desde hace tiempo. Aunque seguramente por otro motivo que tú.
A New Beginning#177.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#178.src: A noble cause… It is one I can wholeheartedly support.
A New Beginning#178.dst: Una causa noble… Una que puedo apoyar de todo corazón.
A New Beginning#178.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#179.src: In a world like this, the most we can do sometimes is hold on to those we care for. Take care not to lose that drive.
A New Beginning#179.dst: En un mundo así, a veces lo único que podemos hacer es aferrarnos a quienes queremos. Procura no perder ese impulso.
A New Beginning#179.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#180.src: Then, I would ask of you one more thing. A test, in a way...
A New Beginning#180.dst: Entonces, te pediría una cosa más. Una prueba, en cierto modo...
A New Beginning#180.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#181.src: The power you carry the curse you bear. I have seen such things before, yet always at a distance. Never up close.
A New Beginning#181.dst: El poder que llevas la maldición que cargas. Ya he visto cosas así, pero siempre de lejos. Nunca de cerca.
A New Beginning#181.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#182.src: I would ask for a duel. Nothing dangerous, or lethal... I have safeguards in place for myself, so do not test my limits. When I call it, we stop.
A New Beginning#182.dst: Te pido un duelo. Nada peligroso ni letal... Tengo mis protecciones, así que no pongas a prueba mis límites. Cuando yo lo diga, paramos.
A New Beginning#182.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#183.src: I would simply like to see the strength of a cursed one in battle firsthand. So, then. Let us begin!
A New Beginning#183.dst: Solo quiero ver de primera mano la fuerza de un maldito en combate. Así que... ¡empecemos!
A New Beginning#183.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#186.src: Impressive. Very impressive. I have never seen a cursed one with such control and technique...
A New Beginning#186.dst: Impresionante. Muy impresionante. Nunca he visto a un maldito con tanto control y técnica...
A New Beginning#186.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#187.src: If I did not know better, I would believe you to have been blessed by the crown itself.
A New Beginning#187.dst: Si no supiera la verdad, creería que te ha bendecido la mismísima Corona.
A New Beginning#187.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#188.src: Your power, your spells. The ability to bend the world to your whim, to wield the elements for your own gain.
A New Beginning#188.dst: Tu poder, tus hechizos. La capacidad de doblegar el mundo a tu antojo, de usar los elementos en tu beneficio.
A New Beginning#188.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#189.src: Eons ago, so the stories say, the world was pure and balanced. Our people lived with the land, content with what we had.
A New Beginning#189.dst: Hace eones, según cuentan, el mundo era puro y equilibrado. Nuestro pueblo vivía con la tierra, contento con lo que tenía.
A New Beginning#189.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#190.src: And yet, an evil force lurked within us, a malice which despised our peace and happiness. One day, it burst forth, granting unimaginable power to those it deemed worthy...
A New Beginning#190.dst: Y aun así, una fuerza maligna acechaba en nuestro interior, una malicia que odiaba nuestra paz y felicidad. Un día estalló, y otorgó un poder inimaginable a quienes consideró dignos...
A New Beginning#190.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#191.src: Its power could not be controlled. Those cursed by its touch went on to tear apart the land, destroying cities and towns... fear overtook the land, none were safe.
A New Beginning#191.dst: Su poder no podía controlarse. Los malditos por su toque desgarraron la tierra, destruyendo ciudades y pueblos... el miedo se apoderó de todo, nadie estaba a salvo.
A New Beginning#191.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#192.src: Until she arrived, a force of good to counter the evil. She granted her own blessings to the people of Fruma, power which could be controlled and wielded to banish the cursed.
A New Beginning#192.dst: Hasta que llegó ella, una fuerza del bien para contrarrestar el mal. Concedió sus bendiciones al pueblo de Fruma, un poder controlable con el que desterrar a los malditos.
A New Beginning#192.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#193.src: She saved our province, and became our immortal Queen. Always looking out for the people, always alert for the presence of evil... for it could not be killed, only staved off.
A New Beginning#193.dst: Salvó nuestra provincia y se convirtió en nuestra Reina inmortal. Siempre velando por el pueblo, siempre alerta ante el mal... pues no podía matarse, solo contenerse.
A New Beginning#193.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#194.src: The cursed ones never left. They only grew smarter, more capable of hiding from the crown's watchful eye.
A New Beginning#194.dst: Los malditos nunca se fueron. Solo se volvieron más listos y hábiles para esconderse de la Corona.
A New Beginning#194.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#195.src: And so, it tells the people, always be aware. Always be looking for the cursed ones. It is only a matter of time before they hurt you.
A New Beginning#195.dst: Y por eso le dice al pueblo: estad siempre alerta. Buscad siempre a los malditos. Solo es cuestión de tiempo que os hagan daño.
A New Beginning#195.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#196.src: ...I have a different perspective on this story, you might imagine. The crown has wronged me, and many others. Yet, the stories hold truths to them, to an extent.
A New Beginning#196.dst: ...Como imaginarás, yo tengo otra visión de esta historia. La Corona me ha hecho daño a mí y a muchos otros. Aun así, las historias tienen algo de verdad, hasta cierto punto.
A New Beginning#196.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#197.src: That is why your control over your power has interested me. It bears more traits of the crown's blessings than of the evil's curses, and yet...
A New Beginning#197.dst: Por eso me interesa tu control sobre tu poder. Se parece más a las bendiciones de la Corona que a las maldiciones del mal, y aun así...
A New Beginning#197.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#198.src: Magic... yes, that term has been used in higher studies at the University.
A New Beginning#198.dst: Magia... sí, ese término se usa en los estudios superiores de la Universidad.
A New Beginning#198.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#199.src: But a land filled with cursed ones... and it isn't destroyed? I suppose I have had no reason to believe the crown's reports about it, but...
A New Beginning#199.dst: Pero una tierra llena de malditos... ¿y no está destruida? Supongo que nunca he tenido motivos para creer los informes de la Corona, pero...
A New Beginning#199.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#200.src: I need time to process this information. But I would like to discuss it with you further, at a later date, if you would be willing.
A New Beginning#200.dst: Necesito tiempo para asimilar todo esto. Pero me gustaría hablarlo más contigo en otro momento, si estás dispuesto.
A New Beginning#200.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#201.src: Then that leads me to my final request. Would you join our cause, and offer your help to our resistance group? Your knowledge and strength would be greatly appreciated.
A New Beginning#201.dst: Eso me lleva a mi última petición. ¿Te unirías a nuestra causa y ofrecerías tu ayuda a nuestra resistencia? Tu conocimiento y tu fuerza serían muy valiosos.
A New Beginning#201.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#202.src: Thank you. I will take you to meet with the others, then. Our home is directly to the south-west, it should be hard to miss. I'll meet you there.
A New Beginning#202.dst: Gracias. Entonces te llevaré a conocer a los demás. Nuestro hogar está justo al suroeste, es difícil no verlo. Nos vemos allí.
A New Beginning#202.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#203.src: Follow Syndra to the resistance base at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A New Beginning#203.dst: Sigue a Syndra hasta la base de la resistencia en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A New Beginning#204.src: There you are, {u}. I see you found your way here alright.
A New Beginning#204.dst: Ahí estás, {u}. Veo que has encontrado el camino sin problemas.
A New Beginning#204.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#205.src: If you're going to be joining us, I should introduce you to the others.
A New Beginning#205.dst: Si vas a unirte a nosotros, debería presentarte a los demás.
A New Beginning#205.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#206.src: Ahem... Children, come on out! We have a new member I'd like you to meet.
A New Beginning#206.dst: Ejem... ¡Niños, salid! Tenemos un nuevo miembro que quiero que conozcáis.
A New Beginning#206.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#207.src: We m-meet again! I knew you'd be a g-good fit!
A New Beginning#207.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#208.src: Yeah, Zeph, we know. You've been saying so for hours...
A New Beginning#208.dst: Sí, Zeph, ya lo sabemos. Llevas horas diciéndolo...
A New Beginning#208.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#209.src: Ah, lighten up Rex. Welcome to the Leaves, friend! No matter your origin, if Syndra believes you to be trustworthy, it must be so.
A New Beginning#209.dst: Ah, relájate, Rex. ¡Bienvenido a las Hojas, amigo! Venga de donde venga, si Syndra cree que es de fiar, así debe ser.
A New Beginning#209.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#210.src: On that subject, {u} here is from outside of our province. They'll be joining our resistance against the crown...
A New Beginning#210.dst: Hablando de eso, {u} viene de fuera de nuestra provincia. Se unirá a nuestra resistencia contra la Corona...
A New Beginning#210.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#211.src: ...and, hopefully, they'll be able to help me resolve some theories I have on the nature of curses and blessings.
A New Beginning#211.dst: ...y, con suerte, me ayudará a resolver unas teorías sobre la naturaleza de maldiciones y bendiciones.
A New Beginning#211.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#213.src: Yes. But they're no threat to us. We share the same enemies. And, having that power on our side could make a huge difference for our efforts.
A New Beginning#213.dst: Sí. Pero no es una amenaza para nosotros. Tenemos los mismos enemigos. Y tener ese poder de nuestro lado podría cambiarlo todo.
A New Beginning#213.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#214.src: Hm... are you certain, miss? I do trust your judgment, but perhaps it would be best to err on the side of caution when dealing with the cursed.
A New Beginning#214.dst: Hm... ¿está segura, señorita? Confío en su criterio, pero quizá sea mejor pecar de prudentes al tratar con malditos.
A New Beginning#214.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#215.src: The curse is the least of our problems! Are we really blindly trusting someone who says they're from Wynn? People don't just... just... come back from there!
A New Beginning#215.dst: ¡La maldición es lo de menos! ¿De verdad vamos a fiarnos a ciegas de alguien que dice venir de Wynn? La gente no... no... ¡no vuelve de allí!
A New Beginning#215.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#216.src: That's enough, Rex. I understand your misgivings, but I have reasons for my trust. I would ask you to have faith in me.
A New Beginning#216.dst: Basta, Rex. Entiendo tus recelos, pero tengo motivos para confiar. Te pido que tengas fe en mí.
A New Beginning#216.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#218.src: Now. I still need to acquire the proper papers for {u} to be able to access {p}. In the meantime, why don't you all get to know each other properly?
A New Beginning#218.dst: Bien. Aún tengo que conseguir los papeles adecuados para que {u} pueda entrar en {p}. Mientras tanto, ¿por qué no os conocéis como es debido?
A New Beginning#218.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#220.src: Introduce yourself to the Resistance Members are .
A New Beginning#220.dst: Preséntate a los miembros de la resistencia .

A New Beginning#221.src: ...What do you want? Do you need something?
A New Beginning#221.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#222.src: I... shoot things? With my bow?
A New Beginning#222.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#223.src: I'm a tactician, otherwise. Not the tactician that'd be Syndra but... y'know.
A New Beginning#223.dst: Aparte de eso, soy estratega. No la estratega esa es Syndra pero... ya sabes.
A New Beginning#223.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#224.src: ...You don't know. Because look, it doesn't matter what I do! Not to you, at least.
A New Beginning#224.dst: ...No lo sabes. Porque mira, ¡da igual lo que haga! Al menos para ti.
A New Beginning#224.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#225.src: What, are you looking for gossip?
A New Beginning#225.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#226.src: Well, you're not going to get any out of me.
A New Beginning#226.dst: Pues de mí no vas a sacar nada.
A New Beginning#226.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#227.src: No, you didn't ugh! It's not you personally, it's just...
A New Beginning#227.dst: No, no has ¡uf! No es por ti, es que...
A New Beginning#227.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#229.src: You're cursed, and you say you're from Wynn. Both of those are problems.
A New Beginning#229.dst: Estás maldito y dices que vienes de Wynn. Las dos cosas son un problema.
A New Beginning#229.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#230.src: I don't know what Syndra sees in you... but whatever it is, it'd better make up for both of those things.
A New Beginning#230.dst: No sé qué ve Syndra en ti... pero sea lo que sea, más vale que compense esas dos cosas.
A New Beginning#230.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#232.src: Well, welcome to the Leaves in the Wind! Pardon on the hesitation earlier, the cursed are a… sensitive subject. If Syndra believes you to be safe, I will choose to believe her.
A New Beginning#232.dst: ¡Pues bienvenido a Hojas al Viento! Perdona la duda de antes, los malditos son un tema… delicado. Si Syndra cree que eres de fiar, yo decido creerla.
A New Beginning#232.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#233.src: It’s always nice to have some fresh blood under our canopy! No matter how abnormal. We may wait for Syndra’s return before getting you properly settled in.
A New Beginning#233.dst: ¡Siempre viene bien sangre nueva bajo nuestra copa! Por muy peculiar que sea. Quizá esperemos a que vuelva Syndra para instalarte como es debido.
A New Beginning#233.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#234.src: If you have any issues whatsoever, don’t hesitate to inform me!
A New Beginning#234.dst: ¡Si tienes cualquier problema, no dudes en decírmelo!
A New Beginning#234.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#235.src: Now, what could I do for you?
A New Beginning#235.dst: Y bien, ¿qué puedo hacer por ti?
A New Beginning#235.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#236.src: I am Syndra’s right hand! I deal with many of the tasks involving our family here, to lighten the workload she places upon herself.
A New Beginning#236.dst: ¡Soy la mano derecha de Syndra! Me ocupo de muchas tareas de nuestra familia, para aligerar la carga que ella misma se impone.
A New Beginning#236.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#237.src: Such tasks could include onboarding new recruits, assigning members to various missions… handling disputes- that sort of thing.
A New Beginning#237.dst: Tareas como recibir a los nuevos reclutas, asignar miembros a distintas misiones… resolver disputas- ese tipo de cosas.
A New Beginning#237.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#238.src: Of course, my “official” occupation by the crown’s terms is that of a lumberjack. Fighting for a better future isn’t exactly a well paying job, hoho!
A New Beginning#238.dst: Claro que, según la Corona, mi oficio “oficial” es el de leñador. Luchar por un futuro mejor no es un trabajo muy bien pagado, ¡jojo!
A New Beginning#238.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#239.src: Ah! Yes, well, these are not our full numbers. The others live elsewhere, either in town or in various villages. They stop by every so often, so perhaps you’ll have the chance to meet them later!
A New Beginning#239.dst: ¡Ah! Sí, bueno, no estamos todos. Los demás viven en otros sitios, en la ciudad o en distintas aldeas. Pasan de vez en cuando, ¡así que quizá los conozcas más adelante!
A New Beginning#239.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#240.src: We all are the ones who live here full-time. Nowhere else in particular we can go, if you catch my meaning.
A New Beginning#240.dst: Nosotros somos los que vivimos aquí todo el tiempo. No tenemos otro sitio adonde ir, no sé si me entiendes.
A New Beginning#240.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#241.src: If you’re from beyond our province’s walls, I expect we’ll be wanting to set you up with a room of your own sometime… but we can discuss that later.
A New Beginning#241.dst: Si vienes de más allá de los muros de la provincia, supongo que querremos darte una habitación propia algún día… pero ya lo hablaremos.
A New Beginning#241.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#242.src: Indeed. I hope we can do some good work together, young leaf!
A New Beginning#242.dst: Así es. ¡Espero que hagamos un buen trabajo juntos, joven hoja!
A New Beginning#242.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#243.src: Um... nice to meet you, I guess?
A New Beginning#243.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#244.src: Oh... I take care of the injured. I also cook... sometimes.
A New Beginning#244.dst: Oh... yo cuido de los heridos. También cocino... a veces.
A New Beginning#244.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#245.src: I'm not really much of a fighter... not much of, um, anything, really.
A New Beginning#245.dst: No soy muy buena luchando... ni en, eh, nada, la verdad.
A New Beginning#245.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#246.src: I'm mostly just here because of Mora... he's, um, my brother.
A New Beginning#246.dst: Sobre todo estoy aquí por Mora... él es, eh, mi hermano.
A New Beginning#246.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#248.src: Um... wait, can I ask actually... nevermind.
A New Beginning#248.dst: Eh... espera, ¿puedo preguntar bueno... da igual.
A New Beginning#248.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#249.src: I'm g-glad you were able to c-convince Syndra to let you j-join! It'll be n-nice having someone new a-around.
A New Beginning#249.dst: ¡Me a-alegra que convencieras a Syndra para que te d-dejara unirte! Será b-bonito tener a alguien nuevo por a-aquí.
A New Beginning#249.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#251.src: I... d-don't know, actually. It looks like she's h-heading towards the F-Frog Tavern... but why...?
A New Beginning#251.dst: Pues... no lo s-sé, la verdad. Parece que va hacia la T-Taberna de la Rana... pero ¿por qué...?
A New Beginning#251.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#252.src: Hey... {u}. How'd you l-like to have your first of-official resistance mission with me?
A New Beginning#252.dst: Oye... {u}. ¿Qué te p-parece hacer tu primera misión o-oficial de la resistencia conmigo?
A New Beginning#252.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#253.src: I-I want to f-follow her and see what she g-gets up to at a r-random bar, of all places...
A New Beginning#253.dst: Q-quiero s-seguirla y ver qué hace en un b-bar cualquiera, precisamente...
A New Beginning#253.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#254.src: You know, I-I-I've always suspected that the t-tavern isn't what it a-appears to be!
A New Beginning#254.dst: ¿Sabes? ¡S-s-siempre he sospechado que la t-taberna no es lo que p-parece!
A New Beginning#254.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#257.src: Wh- I- n-no! I j-just want to m-m-make sure she's okay. Th-that's all.
A New Beginning#257.dst: ¡Q- y- n-no! Solo q-quiero a-a-asegurarme de que está bien. N-nada más.
A New Beginning#257.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#258.src: Let's m-meet up at the tavern. It's j-just to the north of here.
A New Beginning#258.dst: Veámonos en la taberna. Está j-justo al norte de aquí.
A New Beginning#258.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#259.src: I m-mainly gather intel for the resistance! Th-that usually involves needing to st-stay hidden.
A New Beginning#259.dst: ¡Sobre todo recojo información para la resistencia! Eso s-suele implicar tener que es-estar escondido.
A New Beginning#259.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#260.src: I've picked up a t-t-trick or two over the y-years.
A New Beginning#260.dst: He aprendido un t-t-truco o dos con los a-años.
A New Beginning#260.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#261.src: S-sometimes I sell stuff I f-find in the forest in town! B-but that's not really f-for the resistance. That's for m-me.
A New Beginning#261.dst: ¡A v-veces vendo en la ciudad cosas que e-encuentro en el bosque! P-pero eso no es para la resistencia. Es para m-mí.
A New Beginning#261.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#262.src: Huh? Oh, r-right! I was l-looking for guard rotations, for th-the upcoming festival.
A New Beginning#262.dst: ¿Eh? ¡Ah, c-claro! Buscaba los turnos de guardia, para el p-próximo festival.
A New Beginning#262.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#263.src: S-security is usually pretty high, so... it's g-good to know where and when is s-s-safe.
A New Beginning#263.dst: La s-seguridad suele ser muy alta, así que... viene bien saber dónde y cuándo es s-s-seguro.
A New Beginning#263.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#264.src: I-I've been wondering the s-same thing...
A New Beginning#264.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#265.src: She usually isn't l-like this! I wonder if s-something's wrong...
A New Beginning#265.dst: ¡Ella no suele ser a-así! Me pregunto si pasa a-algo...
A New Beginning#265.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#266.src: ...I can t-talk to her about it later.
A New Beginning#266.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#268.src: Meet up with Zeph outside the Frog Tavern at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A New Beginning#268.dst: Reúnete con Zeph frente a la Taberna de la Rana en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A New Beginning#269.src: W-wait. We can't j-just go through the f-front, she'll s-see us.
A New Beginning#269.dst: E-espera. No podemos entrar por d-delante, nos v-verá.
A New Beginning#269.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#271.src: You'll get s-spotted! Let's get in from above i-instead.
A New Beginning#271.dst: ¡Te van a v-ver! Mejor entremos por a-arriba.
A New Beginning#271.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#272.src: Sneak into the Frog Tavern at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A New Beginning#272.dst: Cuélate en la Taberna de la Rana en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A New Beginning#273.src: R-right behind you. D-don't get spotted!
A New Beginning#273.dst: J-justo detrás de ti. ¡Q-que no te vean!
A New Beginning#273.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#274.src: Th-there she is! I w-wonder what she's
A New Beginning#274.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#277.src: You interrupt my sequence like this and won't even say my name? Come on, now.
A New Beginning#277.dst: ¿Interrumpes así mi secuencia y ni siquiera dices mi nombre? Vamos, hombre.
A New Beginning#277.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#278.src: Bartender, my usual mix. I need a boost.
A New Beginning#278.dst: Camarero, lo de siempre. Me hace falta.
A New Beginning#278.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#280.src: Oh, thank you for noticing! It's because of the stress. Look, I know you're aware of the attack on Torann by now. You've always kept up with the details.
A New Beginning#280.dst: ¡Oh, gracias por notarlo! Es por el estrés. Mira, sé que ya estás al tanto del ataque a Torann. Siempre estás al día de los detalles.
A New Beginning#280.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#281.src: But how about we accelerate this. You know how little time I have and you didn't bring me here just for drinks.
A New Beginning#281.dst: Pero ¿y si aceleramos esto? Sabes el poco tiempo que tengo, y no me has traído aquí solo a tomar algo.
A New Beginning#281.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#282.src: Skipping the small talk, I see. Are my intentions really that transparent?
A New Beginning#282.dst: Nada de charla, ya veo. ¿Tan transparentes son mis intenciones?
A New Beginning#282.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#283.src: Predictable, more like, after all this time. You've always got an angle you're working towards when you call me here.
A New Beginning#283.dst: Predecibles, más bien, después de tanto tiempo. Siempre tienes algún ángulo en mente cuando me llamas.
A New Beginning#283.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#284.src: Maybe I just like the ambience.
A New Beginning#284.dst: Quizá solo me guste el ambiente.
A New Beginning#284.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#285.src: ...I need another passport. Same as the rest.
A New Beginning#285.dst: ...Necesito otro pasaporte. Igual que los demás.
A New Beginning#285.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#286.src: Naturally. You and your trend for collecting strays... Really you should just start a family by this point.
A New Beginning#286.dst: Cómo no. Tú y tu manía de recoger perros callejeros... La verdad, a estas alturas deberías formar una familia.
A New Beginning#286.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#287.src: You of all people should know that I can't just stand by and leave them to fend for themselves.
A New Beginning#287.dst: Tú, más que nadie, deberías saber que no puedo quedarme de brazos cruzados y dejar que se valgan solos.
A New Beginning#287.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#288.src: Yes... A toddler could calculate that by watching you. I'll solve that problem for you. Keep them out of trouble, and we won't have any issues as usual.
A New Beginning#288.dst: Sí... Hasta un niño lo calcularía viéndote. Te resolveré ese problema. Tenlos lejos de líos y no habrá ningún inconveniente como siempre.
A New Beginning#288.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#289.src: Of course. As I always do.
A New Beginning#289.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#290.src: Ha! "Always." If I were a gambling man I'd never bet on your odds.
A New Beginning#290.dst: ¡Ja! "Siempre". Si fuera apostador, jamás apostaría por tus probabilidades.
A New Beginning#290.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#291.src: I need to get moving. There's always something that needs me to crunch the numbers... and today's events have only added to the pile.
A New Beginning#291.dst: Tengo que irme. Siempre hay algo que necesita que haga cuentas... y lo de hoy solo ha engordado la pila.
A New Beginning#291.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#292.src: I certainly wouldn't want to delay you, Sovereign. I hope you manage to sort out all these problems.
A New Beginning#292.dst: No querría retrasarte, Soberano. Espero que logres resolver todos estos problemas.
A New Beginning#292.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#293.src: Oh, we will. It's only a matter of time. Take care, Syndra. Keep it constant.
A New Beginning#293.dst: Oh, lo haremos. Es cuestión de tiempo. Cuídate, Syndra. Sé constante.
A New Beginning#293.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#295.src: Sigh. You may as well come down now. Zeph, {u}.
A New Beginning#295.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#297.src: That was... risky. You're lucky he didn't look up.
A New Beginning#297.dst: Eso ha sido... arriesgado. Tenéis suerte de que no mirara arriba.
A New Beginning#297.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#298.src: S-sure, but- b-but what were you d-doing meeting up w-with him?!
A New Beginning#298.dst: C-claro, pero- p-pero ¡¿qué hacías r-reuniéndote c-con él?!
A New Beginning#298.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#299.src: Its... complicated we have something of an agreement. What matters is that everything is taken care of. Since you're here, {u}, take this. Your passport.
A New Beginning#299.dst: Es... complicado tenemos una especie de acuerdo. Lo que importa es que todo está resuelto. Ya que estás aquí, {u}, toma esto. Tu pasaporte.
A New Beginning#299.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#300.src: It's... complicated - we have something of an agreement. What matters is that everything is taken care of. Since you're here, {u}, take this. Your passport.
A New Beginning#300.dst: Es... complicado - tenemos una especie de acuerdo. Lo que importa es que todo está resuelto. Ya que estás aquí, {u}, toma esto. Tu pasaporte.
A New Beginning#300.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#301.src: He's... h-he's with the c-crown, though. H-how can you t-trust him?
A New Beginning#301.dst: Pero él... é-él está con la C-Corona. ¿C-cómo puedes f-fiarte de él?
A New Beginning#301.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#302.src: Simple I don't. You don't need to worry about him. As I said, we have an agreement. He doesn't know about anything we do.
A New Beginning#302.dst: Fácil no me fío. No tienes que preocuparte por él. Como he dicho, tenemos un acuerdo. No sabe nada de lo que hacemos.
A New Beginning#302.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#303.src: I had hoped to keep this a secret for a reason... but what's done is done. Just... don't do anything rash, would you?
A New Beginning#303.dst: Esperaba mantener esto en secreto por un motivo... pero lo hecho, hecho está. Solo... no hagáis ninguna tontería, ¿vale?
A New Beginning#303.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#304.src: {u}, your passport will let you enter the city. I'd suggest you take some time to visit and look around, to familiarize yourself with the place.
A New Beginning#304.dst: {u}, tu pasaporte te permitirá entrar en la ciudad. Te sugiero que te tomes tu tiempo para visitarla y conocer bien el lugar.
A New Beginning#304.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#305.src: And when you have time... I'd like to follow up on our discussion we had earlier. I think it's time we start taking steps forward.
A New Beginning#305.dst: Y cuando tengas tiempo... me gustaría retomar la conversación de antes. Creo que es hora de empezar a dar pasos.
A New Beginning#305.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#306.src: I'll be returning to our home. Zeph, you can come with me if you'd like.
A New Beginning#306.dst: Vuelvo a nuestro hogar. Zeph, puedes venir conmigo si quieres.
A New Beginning#306.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#309.src: Ugh. What do you want? I'm clearly busy.
A New Beginning#309.dst: Uf. ¿Qué quieres? Está claro que estoy ocupada.
A New Beginning#309.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#311.src: No, just... leave me alone, okay? I don't want to talk to you.
A New Beginning#311.dst: No, solo... déjame en paz, ¿vale? No quiero hablar contigo.
A New Beginning#311.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#314.src: Ah! You ca-caught- caught me off guard. How's your time in Auburn bee-been?
A New Beginning#314.dst: ¡Ah! Me has pi-pillado- pillado desprevenido. ¿Qué tal por Auburn?
A New Beginning#314.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#315.src: Yup! I've s-s-stayed here the longest so I've ma-managed to gather quite the assortment of useful stuff. Rex w-w-would call it junk but...
A New Beginning#315.dst: ¡Sí! Soy el que m-m-más lleva aquí, así que he re-reunido un buen surtido de cosas útiles. Rex lo l-l-llamaría basura, pero...
A New Beginning#315.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#316.src: An old friend a-actually helped me make this training dum-dummy.
A New Beginning#316.dst: Un viejo amigo me a-ayudó a hacer este muñeco de entre-entrenamiento.
A New Beginning#316.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#317.src: Gotta stay on t-top of my training! Especially with you here.
A New Beginning#317.dst: ¡Hay que seguir con el e-entrenamiento! Sobre todo contigo aquí.
A New Beginning#317.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#318.src: Besides, I wa-wa-want I want to be able to help when it matters.
A New Beginning#318.dst: Además, q-q-quiero quiero poder ayudar cuando importe.
A New Beginning#318.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#319.src: We should t-train together some day.
A New Beginning#319.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#321.src: Did you... need help with anything?
A New Beginning#321.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#322.src: Mhm! Me, Zeph, Rex, and Mora all, um, have rooms here. Oh, and Syndra, too. And Kaio lives nearby too...
A New Beginning#322.dst: ¡Ajá! Yo, Zeph, Rex y Mora, eh, tenemos habitación aquí. Ah, y Syndra también. Y Kaio vive cerca...
A New Beginning#322.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#323.src: I've... been meaning to decorate some more. You know... make it more, um, homely.
A New Beginning#323.dst: Llevo tiempo... queriendo decorar un poco más. Ya sabes... hacerlo más, eh, acogedor.
A New Beginning#323.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#324.src: ...but life's been getting in the way, I suppose.
A New Beginning#324.dst: ...pero la vida se ha ido interponiendo, supongo.
A New Beginning#324.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#325.src: Um! I d-don't, ha, judge me for this, but... I'm, um, writing in my diary.
A New Beginning#325.dst: ¡Eh! No- ja, no me juzgues, pero... estoy, eh, escribiendo en mi diario.
A New Beginning#325.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#326.src: ...a-and before you ask! No!! You're, um, not allowed to read it.
A New Beginning#326.dst: ...¡y-y antes de que preguntes! ¡¡No!! No, eh, puedes leerlo.
A New Beginning#326.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#327.src: ...thank you. I'll, um, see you later.
A New Beginning#327.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#328.src: Hmm... Delivering mail from river settlement to {p}... Kaio... Check... Hmmm.
A New Beginning#328.dst: Hmm... Entregar correo del asentamiento del río a {p}... Kaio... Hecho... Hmmm.
A New Beginning#328.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#329.src: Ah! {u}, do you require my assistance?
A New Beginning#329.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#330.src: Ah... You overheard me talking to myself, then. Hoh!
A New Beginning#330.dst: Ah... Así que me has oído hablar solo. ¡Jo!
A New Beginning#330.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#331.src: I am just writing and filing some reports I had forgotten about. We are trying to keep better track of our activities throughout the forest, you see.
A New Beginning#331.dst: Solo escribo y archivo unos informes que había olvidado. Queremos llevar mejor registro de lo que hacemos en el bosque, ¿sabes?
A New Beginning#331.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#333.src: Hm... I guess not, thinking on it now. A few years ago, had you asked, I'd've probably said yes. But I don't got the strength in me for it anymore.
A New Beginning#333.dst: Hm... Pensándolo ahora, supongo que no. Hace unos años, si me lo hubieras preguntado, habría dicho que sí. Pero ya no me quedan fuerzas pa' eso.
A New Beginning#333.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#334.src: It's good your arrival has given Syndra and the younguns some hope, for once. We've been a bit, eh... lacking in it lately.
A New Beginning#334.dst: Bien está que tu llegada les haya dado algo de esperanza a Syndra y los chavales, pa' variar. Últimamente andamos, eh... algo escasos.
A New Beginning#334.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#335.src: I've got no such delusions, unfortunately. I reckon this path only ends in tragedy. But it's not my place to say so, so I don't.
A New Beginning#335.dst: Por desgracia, yo no me hago ilusiones. Creo que este camino solo acaba en tragedia. Pero no me toca a mí decirlo, así que no lo digo.
A New Beginning#335.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#336.src: Would be good to be proven wrong... but I don't think I will be. I've seen this sorta thing before.
A New Beginning#336.dst: Ojalá me demuestren que me equivoco... pero no creo. Ya he visto cosas así antes.
A New Beginning#336.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#337.src: ...what? I got nothin' else to say.
A New Beginning#337.dst: ...¿qué? No tengo na' más que decir.
A New Beginning#337.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#338.src: Interesting that you're drawn to that grave in particular. S'our latest loss, that'n there.
A New Beginning#338.dst: Curioso que te atraiga justo esa tumba. Es nuestra última pérdida, esa de ahí.
A New Beginning#338.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#339.src: It's a damn shame. A tragedy each 'n every time, yet still happens often enough to feel routine. But that's life, I reckon.
A New Beginning#339.dst: Una puñetera lástima. Una tragedia cada vez, y aun así pasa tan a menudo que parece rutina. Pero así es la vida, digo yo.
A New Beginning#339.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#340.src: ...did you now? Funny thing to say about a dead man, considering I ain't ever seen you 'round these parts before.
A New Beginning#340.dst: ...¿ah, sí? Qué cosa más rara de decir de un muerto, cuando nunca te había visto por estos lares.
A New Beginning#340.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#341.src: Now, spill. 'Fore I go and tell Synny you ain't no good after all.
A New Beginning#341.dst: Venga, suéltalo. Antes de que le diga a Synny que no vales na'.
A New Beginning#341.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#342.src: Ah... caught Rex muttering something 'bout that once or twice before. Poor girl... it'd do her well to set it aside, for a time.
A New Beginning#342.dst: Ah... alguna vez pillé a Rex murmurando algo de eso. Pobre chica... le vendría bien dejarlo estar, por un tiempo.
A New Beginning#342.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#343.src: Didn't think much of it, but I suppose you're livin' proof, aren'tcha? Strange as can be...
A New Beginning#343.dst: No le di importancia, pero supongo que tú eres la prueba viviente, ¿no? Más raro imposible...
A New Beginning#343.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#344.src: Say, is the memory wipin' a real thing? Got no damn clue where that theory started, but... well, if one thing's true, why not the rest?
A New Beginning#344.dst: Oye, ¿lo de borrar la memoria es real? Ni puñetera idea de dónde salió esa teoría, pero... bueno, si una cosa es cierta, ¿por qué no el resto?
A New Beginning#344.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#345.src: Damn. Damn. That's rough. That real rough, ain't it. And you're tellin' me that's where he ended up?
A New Beginning#345.dst: Maldita sea. Maldita sea. Qué duro. Qué duro, ¿eh? ¿Y me dices que ahí es donde acabó?
A New Beginning#345.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#346.src: Hrm... y'know, it's funny. Big guy like him, you wouldn't take him for a thief. Hard to keep hidden, eh? And yet...
A New Beginning#346.dst: Hmm... ¿sabes? Tiene gracia. Un grandullón así no parece un ladrón. Difícil de esconder, ¿eh? Y aun así...
A New Beginning#346.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#347.src: He'd manage to turn blending into a crowd into an art. No matter where he was, who he spoke to, how he was actin', he'd always seem like he fit right in.
A New Beginning#347.dst: Conseguía convertir en un arte lo de fundirse entre la gente. Daba igual dónde estuviera, con quién hablara o cómo actuara, siempre parecía encajar.
A New Beginning#347.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#348.src: ...t'was a right stupid risk that did him in, in the end. I told him, I did it ain't worth breaking into the Sovereign's place, especially not during festival times...
A New Beginning#348.dst: ...al final lo mató un riesgo bien tonto. Se lo dije, vaya que sí no vale la pena colarse en casa del Soberano, y menos en pleno festival...
A New Beginning#348.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#349.src: But he was the kinda sort to dig in his heels. Said he'd be fine, said it'd be worth it, nabbin' all those documents. Something to help the cause... I hardly even remember now.
A New Beginning#349.dst: Pero era de los que no dan el brazo a torcer. Dijo que no le pasaría na', que valdría la pena, llevarse todos esos documentos. Algo pa' ayudar a la causa... ya casi ni me acuerdo.
A New Beginning#349.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#350.src: Can't save 'em all. Especially not from themselves. I've learned that many times over, over my years.
A New Beginning#350.dst: No se puede salvar a todos. Y menos de sí mismos. Lo he aprendido muchas veces a lo largo de los años.
A New Beginning#350.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#351.src: So he got caught. Heard a cursed one got involved... was a whole damn mess. Sovereign really wasn't happy with Synny when he heard, let me tell you. Ain't seen her that shellshocked in years.
A New Beginning#351.dst: Así que lo pillaron. Oí que había un maldito metido... fue un follón de mil demonios. Al Soberano no le hizo ni pizca de gracia lo de Synny cuando se enteró, te lo digo yo. Hacía años que no la veía tan conmocionada.
A New Beginning#351.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#352.src: ...but you're sayin' he lived? How's that all work out?
A New Beginning#352.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#354.src: Well... tell me this, then. Was he happy, you think? Out there in the wider world? Did he live a good life?
A New Beginning#354.dst: Bueno... dime una cosa, entonces. ¿Crees que era feliz? ¿Ahí fuera, en el mundo? ¿Vivió una buena vida?
A New Beginning#354.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#355.src: ...alright. Alrighty. Good. That that's good, y'hear. I... I'm glad for that much.
A New Beginning#355.dst: ...vale. Vale. Bien. Eso eso está bien, ¿oyes? Me alegro de eso, al menos.
A New Beginning#355.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#356.src: Thank you for... for tellin' me all that. S'not a tale that ends in happiness, but I reckon so long as he made the most of it... that's all you can really hope for.
A New Beginning#356.dst: Gracias por... por contarme todo eso. No es una historia con final feliz, pero digo yo que mientras le sacara todo el jugo... es lo único que se puede esperar.
A New Beginning#356.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#357.src: Y'may as well leave me be a while, now. Got some thinkin' to get through.
A New Beginning#357.dst: Mejor déjame solo un rato, anda. Tengo cosas en las que pensar.
A New Beginning#357.speaker: Kaio

A Sandy Scandal#000.src: You look like a hardy one! {p} army, is it? Would you be willing to help {p} a bit?

A Sandy Scandal#001.src: We're looking into some witness reports to try to gain information on the bandits' plan.

A Sandy Scandal#002.src: You read the report and visualize its words.

A Sandy Scandal#003.src: WITNESS REPORT I - TOLD BY ODIN GIBBS, SHOP OWNER - GIBBS' MINING SUPPLY STORE CO.

A Sandy Scandal#004.src: Business was slow that day, until two rugged, oddly-dressed men stormed into my shop, with a lot of nerve.

A Sandy Scandal#005.src: Before I could close any deal with them, the man with a dagger started threatening me!

A Sandy Scandal#006.src: I tried to make peace with the crooks.

A Sandy Scandal#007.src: The bandit put the knife closer to me and started demanding the code to the TNT vault downstairs!

A Sandy Scandal#008.src: The bandits grew agitated and resorted to violence to obtain the combination.

A Sandy Scandal#009.src: They swiped their knife at me, leaving a sizeable wound on my arm.

A Sandy Scandal#010.src: I had no choice but to give up the combination, which was {~}.

A Sandy Scandal#011.src: After I gave up the combination, they knocked me out!

A Sandy Scandal#012.src: I had no idea what the criminals did after that, I haven't been back to my shop since the incident.

A Sandy Scandal#013.src: The bandits must've taken the explosives! You should investigate.

A Sandy Scandal#014.src: Looks like the bandit's took almost all of the TNT from the shopkeeper's vault.

A Sandy Scandal#015.src: They seem to have dropped their knife during all the looting...

A Sandy Scandal#016.src: You should return to the {p} Bank Guard with your information.

A Sandy Scandal#017.src: WITNESS REPORT II - TOLD BY SCROLL MERCHANT, SHOP OWNER - ALMUJ SCROLL SHOP

A Sandy Scandal#018.src: I was having a fine time tending to my rooftop garden after a lengthy day of selling scrolls.

A Sandy Scandal#019.src: While looking down on the street, I saw two unsavory men, one with TNT in hand, marching down the path.

A Sandy Scandal#020.src: I was suspicious, so I tried to get their attention, but they ignored me.

A Sandy Scandal#021.src: I tried to yell for the attention of a guard or official, but nobody could hear me.

A Sandy Scandal#022.src: I wasn't sure what to do at this point... I didn't try to confront them, that'd have been way too risky!

A Sandy Scandal#023.src: I have no idea where they went off to afterwards.

A Sandy Scandal#024.src: You should check out the house that the explosion came from!

A Sandy Scandal#025.src: Two weapons are missing from the wealthy estate owner's weapon rack!

A Sandy Scandal#026.src: With such powerful weapons the bandits could easily break through the bank's defenses.

A Sandy Scandal#027.src: The whole thing'll go up in a few seconds, and any evidence will be buried in the sand. Good luck getting out of here!

A Sandy Scandal#028.src: Looks like the bandit's have started their heist! You should follow them into the bank and stop them.

A Sandy Scandal#029.src: It's too late to stop us now! We're about to bust out of here with the grand prize - the contents of the emerald vault!

A Sandy Scandal#030.src: We think the bandits might have made the first move in their heist, we're mobilising a troop to-

A Sandy Scandal#031.src: Before anybody could hear me, a large explosion occurred inside of the house the bandits intruded.
A Sandy Scandal#031.dst: Antes de que nadie pudiera oírme, hubo una gran explosión dentro de la casa donde entraron los bandidos.

A Sandy Scandal#032.src: Talk to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
A Sandy Scandal#032.dst: Habla con el guardia del banco de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Sandy Scandal#033.src: You look like a hardy one! {p} army is it? Would you be willing to help {p} a bit?
A Sandy Scandal#033.dst: ¡Pareces alguien duro! Del ejército de {p}, ¿eh? ¿Estarías dispuesto a echarle una mano a {p}?
A Sandy Scandal#033.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#034.src: {p} bank tends to be a prime target for bandits, and there's been a string of incidents that have made us suspicious.
A Sandy Scandal#034.dst: El banco de {p} suele ser un blanco predilecto de los bandidos, y una serie de incidentes nos ha hecho sospechar.
A Sandy Scandal#034.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#035.src: We're looking into some witness reports to try and gain information on the bandits' plan.
A Sandy Scandal#035.dst: Estamos revisando declaraciones de testigos para averiguar el plan de los bandidos.
A Sandy Scandal#035.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#036.src: If I give you some of the reports, will you help check them out for clues?
A Sandy Scandal#036.dst: Si te doy algunas declaraciones, ¿nos ayudarás a buscar pistas?
A Sandy Scandal#036.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#037.src: Great! The store from the first witness report is straight down the stairs, just past this building right behind me.
A Sandy Scandal#037.dst: ¡Genial! La tienda de la primera declaración está bajando las escaleras, justo pasando este edificio detrás de mí.
A Sandy Scandal#037.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#038.src: It's called "Gibbs' Mining Supply Store", and the owner reported a robbery a few days ago.
A Sandy Scandal#038.dst: Se llama "Gibbs' Mining Supply Store", y el dueño denunció un robo hace unos días.
A Sandy Scandal#038.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#039.src: Good luck! Report back to me if you find any information.
A Sandy Scandal#039.dst: ¡Suerte! Vuelve a informarme si encuentras algo.
A Sandy Scandal#039.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#040.src: Go to the witness report location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#040.dst: Ve al lugar de la declaración del testigo en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#041.src: Hello gentlemen! What can I interest you in today? Some industrial torches? Pickaxes?
A Sandy Scandal#041.dst: ¡Hola, caballeros! ¿Qué les puedo ofrecer hoy? ¿Antorchas industriales? ¿Picos?
A Sandy Scandal#041.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#042.src: Shut yer’ trap, old man. We came for a different kind of business.
A Sandy Scandal#042.dst: Cierra el pico, viejo. Venimos por otro tipo de negocio.
A Sandy Scandal#042.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#043.src: Wha-? Look, fellows. Just step out of my store, and nobody gets hurt. I don't want any trouble.
A Sandy Scandal#043.dst: ¿Qué-? Miren, amigos. Salgan de mi tienda y nadie saldrá herido. No quiero problemas.
A Sandy Scandal#043.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#044.src: Listen up old man, tell us the code to the TNT vault in the basement, or I decorate my necklace with your fingers!
A Sandy Scandal#044.dst: Escucha, viejo, dinos el código de la cámara de TNT del sótano, ¡o me hago un collar con tus dedos!
A Sandy Scandal#044.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#045.src: Certainly not! That TNT is for licensed mining companies only, not your average amateur miner.
A Sandy Scandal#045.dst: ¡Ni hablar! Esa TNT es solo para empresas mineras con licencia, no para cualquier minero aficionado.
A Sandy Scandal#045.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#046.src: Well then! I guess you'll still be able to grasp a pick with four fingers, eh?
A Sandy Scandal#046.dst: ¡Pues bueno! Supongo que con cuatro dedos aún podrás agarrar un pico, ¿eh?
A Sandy Scandal#046.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#047.src: Gaaah! Alright, alright! No more violence, please!
A Sandy Scandal#047.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#048.src: The code is {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... please don't hurt me!
A Sandy Scandal#048.dst: El código es {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... ¡no me hagan daño!
A Sandy Scandal#048.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#049.src: {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... thanks! We won't be needing you anymore... now go to sleep!
A Sandy Scandal#049.dst: {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... ¡gracias! Ya no te necesitamos... ¡ahora, a dormir!
A Sandy Scandal#049.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#050.src: Open the vault in the basement [Code: {~}].

A Sandy Scandal#053.src: Talk to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
A Sandy Scandal#053.dst: Habla con el guardia del banco de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Sandy Scandal#054.src: Ah, you're back! Did you find anything interesting in the report?
A Sandy Scandal#054.dst: ¡Ah, has vuelto! ¿Encontraste algo interesante en la declaración?
A Sandy Scandal#054.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#055.src: Missing TNT in the shop's vault? Looks like the shopkeeper was telling the truth.
A Sandy Scandal#055.dst: ¿Falta TNT en la cámara de la tienda? Parece que el tendero decía la verdad.
A Sandy Scandal#055.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#056.src: We need to catch these criminals quickly if they have access to that amount of TNT - they could blow a hole right into the bank's vault!
A Sandy Scandal#056.dst: Tenemos que atrapar rápido a estos criminales si tienen acceso a tanta TNT - ¡podrían volar un agujero directo a la cámara del banco!
A Sandy Scandal#056.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#057.src: You should check out another witness report, from after the attack on the shopkeeper.
A Sandy Scandal#057.dst: Deberías revisar otra declaración de testigo, de después del ataque al tendero.
A Sandy Scandal#057.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#058.src: It was taken from the rooftop garden of the Scroll Merchant's residence, you should take a look.
A Sandy Scandal#058.dst: Se tomó en la azotea ajardinada de la casa del Mercader de pergaminos, deberías echar un vistazo.
A Sandy Scandal#058.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#059.src: Be quick! We don't have much time if we want to stop these bandits.
A Sandy Scandal#059.dst: ¡Date prisa! No tenemos mucho tiempo si queremos detener a estos bandidos.
A Sandy Scandal#059.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#060.src: Go to the witness report location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#060.dst: Ve al lugar de la declaración del testigo en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#062.src: Ey', what do you two blighters think you're doing with those dangerous explosives in the city?
A Sandy Scandal#062.dst: Eh, ¿qué creéis que hacéis, granujas, con esos explosivos peligrosos en la ciudad?
A Sandy Scandal#062.speaker: Scroll Merchant

A Sandy Scandal#063.src: Guards! Guards! Robber! Come quick! Urgently!
A Sandy Scandal#063.speaker: Scroll Merchant

A Sandy Scandal#065.src: Find the source of the detonation at [{~}, {~}, {~}].
A Sandy Scandal#065.dst: Encuentra el origen de la detonación en [{~}, {~}, {~}].

A Sandy Scandal#067.src: Talk to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#067.dst: Habla con el guardia del banco de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#068.src: Were you able to uncover any new information regarding the status of the criminals?
A Sandy Scandal#068.dst: ¿Has podido descubrir algo nuevo sobre el paradero de los criminales?
A Sandy Scandal#068.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#069.src: Ah... that's troubling. The criminals plundered two very powerful weapons.
A Sandy Scandal#069.dst: Ah... eso es preocupante. Los criminales robaron dos armas muy poderosas.
A Sandy Scandal#069.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#070.src: It won't be easy facing those criminals if they decide to raid the bank with those weapons.
A Sandy Scandal#070.dst: No será fácil enfrentarse a esos criminales si deciden asaltar el banco con esas armas.
A Sandy Scandal#070.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#071.src: I'm not certain how to proceed from here, we didn't receive any more witness reports, and-
A Sandy Scandal#071.dst: No sé muy bien cómo seguir, no hemos recibido más declaraciones de testigos, y-
A Sandy Scandal#071.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#072.src: Boss, I just received urgent reports of a robbery underway in the left residential area of {p}!
A Sandy Scandal#072.dst: ¡Jefe, acabo de recibir avisos urgentes de un robo en curso en la zona residencial izquierda de {p}!
A Sandy Scandal#072.speaker: Almuj Sentry

A Sandy Scandal#073.src: Oh my… you! Soldier! Quick! The robbery is taking place across the bridge, next to the first house you visited today! It may be the bandits we're looking for.
A Sandy Scandal#073.dst: Madre mía… ¡tú! ¡Soldado! ¡Rápido! ¡El robo es al otro lado del puente, junto a la primera casa que visitaste hoy! Pueden ser los bandidos que buscamos.
A Sandy Scandal#073.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#074.src: There will be somebody waiting for you outside of the house once you get to the residential area!
A Sandy Scandal#074.dst: ¡Alguien te esperará fuera de la casa cuando llegues a la zona residencial!
A Sandy Scandal#074.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#075.src: If you still can't find it, I've written the coordinates in your content book. Now quickly, get to the house!
A Sandy Scandal#075.dst: Si aun así no la encuentras, he anotado las coordenadas en tu libro de contenido. ¡Rápido, ve a la casa!
A Sandy Scandal#075.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#076.src: Quickly! Go to the house at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#077.src: Hello? Are you with the guards? Good! Hurry! Some bandits just ransacked my house, and left with lots of emeralds!
A Sandy Scandal#077.dst: ¿Hola? ¿Eres de la guardia? ¡Bien! ¡Deprisa! Unos bandidos han saqueado mi casa, ¡y se llevaron muchas esmeraldas!
A Sandy Scandal#077.speaker: Almuj Citizen

A Sandy Scandal#078.src: Follow me to my house, hopefully you can find the bandits! They stole lots of my precious gems!
A Sandy Scandal#078.dst: Sígueme a mi casa, ¡ojalá encuentres a los bandidos! ¡Se llevaron muchas de mis preciadas gemas!
A Sandy Scandal#078.speaker: Almuj Citizen

A Sandy Scandal#079.src: Look for signs of the bandits' whereabouts.
A Sandy Scandal#079.dst: Busca pistas del paradero de los bandidos.

A Sandy Scandal#081.src: Ready, boys? We've got the TNT, weapons, and the fastest horses those emeralds could buy. Now we just-
A Sandy Scandal#081.dst: ¿Listos, chicos? Tenemos la TNT, las armas y los caballos más rápidos que dan esas esmeraldas. Ahora solo-
A Sandy Scandal#081.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#082.src: Ahah. I had a feeling we had a guard on our tail.
A Sandy Scandal#082.dst: Ajá. Ya me parecía que teníamos un guardia pisándonos los talones.
A Sandy Scandal#082.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#083.src: No point wasting these brand-new weapons on you... since we're blowing up this hideout anyway!
A Sandy Scandal#083.dst: No vale la pena gastar estas armas nuevecitas contigo... ¡total, vamos a volar este escondite igualmente!
A Sandy Scandal#083.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#084.src: This whole thing'll go up in a few seconds, and any evidence will be buried in the sand. Good luck getting out of here!
A Sandy Scandal#084.dst: Todo esto saltará por los aires en unos segundos, y cualquier prueba quedará enterrada en la arena. ¡Suerte saliendo de aquí!
A Sandy Scandal#084.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#086.src: Find where the bandits blasted a hole to get into the bank at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#086.dst: Encuentra dónde abrieron un agujero los bandidos para entrar en el banco en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#087.src: It’s too late to stop us now! We’re already about to bust out of here with the grand prize - the contents of the emerald vault!
A Sandy Scandal#087.dst: ¡Ya es tarde para detenernos! Estamos a punto de largarnos con el gran premio - ¡el contenido de la cámara de esmeraldas!
A Sandy Scandal#087.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#088.src: Follow the criminals into the other room.
A Sandy Scandal#088.dst: Sigue a los criminales a la otra sala.

A Sandy Scandal#089.src: Look here, the soldier decided they wanted to follow us. Dumb move.
A Sandy Scandal#089.dst: Mira, el soldado ha decidido seguirnos. Mala idea.
A Sandy Scandal#089.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#090.src: I guess we can kill two birds with one stone: escaping the bank, and killing this pest.
A Sandy Scandal#090.dst: Supongo que podemos matar dos pájaros de un tiro: escapar del banco y acabar con esta plaga.
A Sandy Scandal#090.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#093.src: Report back to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#093.dst: Vuelve a informar al guardia del banco de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#094.src: Soldier! Where did you disappear to? Did you hear those explosions, below the bank?
A Sandy Scandal#094.dst: ¡Soldado! ¿Dónde te habías metido? ¿Has oído esas explosiones bajo el banco?
A Sandy Scandal#094.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#095.src: We think those bandits might have made their first move in the heist, we're mobilising a troop to-
A Sandy Scandal#095.dst: Creemos que esos bandidos han dado su primer paso en el golpe, estamos movilizando una tropa para-
A Sandy Scandal#095.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#096.src: You've already stopped them? And reclaimed the stolen weapons and explosives..?
A Sandy Scandal#096.dst: ¿Ya los has detenido? ¿Y has recuperado las armas y los explosivos robados..?
A Sandy Scandal#096.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#097.src: Wow. Excellent work, soldier. {p} is in your debt. Please accept these from our vault, as a token of our thanks.
A Sandy Scandal#097.dst: Vaya. Excelente trabajo, soldado. {p} está en deuda contigo. Acepta esto de nuestra cámara como muestra de gratitud.
A Sandy Scandal#097.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

Acquiring Credentials#000.dst: Consigue un pasaporte de Gavel en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Acquiring Credentials#001.src: I'm sorry sir, but I can't just give you a new passport... You'd need approval from-...
Acquiring Credentials#001.dst: Lo siento, señor, pero no puedo darle un pasaporte nuevo sin más... Necesitaría la aprobación de-...
Acquiring Credentials#001.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#002.src: But sir, my passport was stolen! I have a flight to {p} in under {~} minutes. I really need one, quick...
Acquiring Credentials#002.dst: ¡Pero, señor, me han robado el pasaporte! Mi vuelo a {p} sale en menos de {~} minutos. Necesito uno ya...
Acquiring Credentials#002.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#003.src: I've already told you where you need to go to get a new one. Next in line, please!
Acquiring Credentials#003.dst: Ya le he dicho adónde tiene que ir para conseguir uno nuevo. ¡El siguiente, por favor!
Acquiring Credentials#003.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#004.src: Hmmm... {u}, is it? Unfortunately, humans are required to get their passports in Wynn.
Acquiring Credentials#004.dst: Mmm... {u}, ¿verdad? Por desgracia, los humanos deben tramitar su pasaporte en Wynn.
Acquiring Credentials#004.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#005.src: I'm afraid I can't help you. Next in line, please!
Acquiring Credentials#005.dst: Me temo que no puedo ayudarle. ¡El siguiente, por favor!
Acquiring Credentials#005.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#006.src: Hey, you! Yes, you! Come outside, would you? I think we can help each other.
Acquiring Credentials#006.dst: ¡Eh, tú! ¡Sí, tú! ¿Sales un momento? Creo que podemos ayudarnos.
Acquiring Credentials#006.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#007.src: So, I overheard your conversation with the Officer... You're also looking for a passport, right?
Acquiring Credentials#007.dst: He oído sin querer tu charla con el agente... También buscas un pasaporte, ¿verdad?
Acquiring Credentials#007.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#008.src: Well... so, I've heard rumours of a secret Black Market that hides in the airbase.
Acquiring Credentials#008.dst: Bueno... resulta que he oído rumores de un Mercado Negro secreto oculto en la base aérea.
Acquiring Credentials#008.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#009.src: Apparently they trade illegal products... There has to be a way of buying passports, I'm sure of it!
Acquiring Credentials#009.dst: Por lo visto trafican con productos ilegales... ¡Seguro que hay alguna forma de comprar pasaportes!
Acquiring Credentials#009.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#010.src: If we work together, we might be able to find a way in. What do you think?
Acquiring Credentials#010.dst: Si trabajamos juntos, quizá encontremos la entrada. ¿Qué te parece?
Acquiring Credentials#010.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#011.src: Explore the Airbase looking for clues about the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#011.dst: Explora la base aérea en busca de pistas sobre el Mercado Negro.

Acquiring Credentials#012.src: Oh, you brought us to the Inn! Hmmm, the Barman's been working here for a long time...
Acquiring Credentials#012.dst: ¡Oh, nos has traído a la posada! Mmm, el camarero lleva mucho tiempo trabajando aquí...
Acquiring Credentials#012.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#013.src: Maybe he knows something about the Black Market! I'll try and ask, y'know... all, uh... sneaky-like.
Acquiring Credentials#013.dst: ¡Quizá sepa algo del Mercado Negro! Intentaré preguntarle, ya sabes... con, eh... disimulo.
Acquiring Credentials#013.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#014.src: Excuse me, sir... You, uh...wouldn't happen to know any really cheap stores around here, would you?
Acquiring Credentials#014.dst: Disculpe, señor... ¿No sabrá usted, eh... de alguna tienda muy barata por aquí?
Acquiring Credentials#014.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#015.src: The table's been set for the great feast, have stout or beer, what will it be?
Acquiring Credentials#015.dst: La mesa está puesta para el gran festín. ¿Negra o rubia, qué va a ser?
Acquiring Credentials#015.speaker: Barman

Acquiring Credentials#016.src: Is that a secret code...? Beer?
Acquiring Credentials#016.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#017.src: Did that work? Is he gonna let us in?
Acquiring Credentials#017.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#018.src: I guess it wouldn't be that easy to find a way in... Where do you think we can go with that lead, {u}?
Acquiring Credentials#018.dst: Supongo que no iba a ser tan fácil entrar... ¿Adónde crees que nos lleva esa pista, {u}?
Acquiring Credentials#018.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#019.src: Let's just keep exploring. Lead the way.
Acquiring Credentials#019.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#020.src: Keep exploring the Airbase looking for clues about the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#020.dst: Sigue explorando la base aérea en busca de pistas sobre el Mercado Negro.

Acquiring Credentials#022.src: Hey, uh...do these people look suspicious to you, too?
Acquiring Credentials#022.dst: Oye, eh... ¿a ti también te parece sospechosa esta gente?
Acquiring Credentials#022.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#023.src: The airship commanders love what they hate.
Acquiring Credentials#023.dst: Los comandantes de aeronave aman lo que odian.
Acquiring Credentials#023.speaker: Waiter

Acquiring Credentials#024.src: I think we're getting onto something! Let's keep going.
Acquiring Credentials#024.dst: ¡Creo que vamos por buen camino! Sigamos.
Acquiring Credentials#024.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#025.src: Follow the clue: The airship commanders love what they hate.
Acquiring Credentials#025.dst: Sigue la pista: Los comandantes de aeronave aman lo que odian.

Acquiring Credentials#026.src: Hmmm... these crates are full of items. Maybe we could give some of them to the commanders?
Acquiring Credentials#026.dst: Mmm... estas cajas están llenas de objetos. ¿Y si les damos algunos a los comandantes?
Acquiring Credentials#026.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#027.src: Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
Acquiring Credentials#027.dst: Una vez rasgado, roto sin remedio.
Acquiring Credentials#027.speaker: Commander

Acquiring Credentials#028.src: Oh, let's keep going! Where can we go with that lead?
Acquiring Credentials#028.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#029.src: Follow the clue: Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
Acquiring Credentials#029.dst: Sigue la pista: Una vez rasgado, roto sin remedio.

Acquiring Credentials#030.src: Who's that on top of that platform?!
Acquiring Credentials#030.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#031.src: The two of you have come real far for this, huh?
Acquiring Credentials#031.dst: Habéis llegado muy lejos por esto, ¿eh?
Acquiring Credentials#031.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#032.src: Well, I can give you the answer to the stout and beer question! But you won't enter the Market with just that.
Acquiring Credentials#032.dst: ¡Puedo daros la respuesta a lo de la negra o la rubia! Pero con eso no entraréis al Mercado.
Acquiring Credentials#032.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#033.src: You see, to enter the Market you'll need something to sell! And it won't be something you can exactly buy around here, if you get what I mean.
Acquiring Credentials#033.dst: Veréis, para entrar al Mercado necesitáis algo que vender. Y no será algo que podáis comprar por aquí, ya me entendéis.
Acquiring Credentials#033.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#035.src: Exactly! Luckily for you, I'm in a good mood. There's an airship docked close by. We'll be able to take it and I can help you get an item.
Acquiring Credentials#035.dst: ¡Exacto! Por suerte, estoy de buen humor. Hay una aeronave atracada cerca. Podemos tomarla y os ayudaré a conseguir algo.
Acquiring Credentials#035.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#036.src: Uh... What do you think, {u}? I really need that passport, and well... you could get something out of this too, right?
Acquiring Credentials#036.dst: Eh... ¿Qué opinas, {u}? Necesito ese pasaporte de verdad, y bueno... tú también podrías sacar algo de esto, ¿no?
Acquiring Credentials#036.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#038.src: Great! Follow me, it's not far.
Acquiring Credentials#038.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#040.src: Wait! There are guards protecting the airship. Don't let them see you!
Acquiring Credentials#040.dst: ¡Esperad! Hay guardias vigilando la aeronave. ¡Que no os vean!
Acquiring Credentials#040.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#041.src: They're near the edge... Push them off.
Acquiring Credentials#041.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#042.src: Uhh... I'm sure they're fine, I'm sure that fall wasn't too big...
Acquiring Credentials#042.dst: Ehh... Seguro que están bien, seguro que la caída no era tan alta...
Acquiring Credentials#042.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#043.src: Well, that's your only way inside! There are more guards up ahead. Take care of them without being seen, and we'll be in the clear!
Acquiring Credentials#043.dst: ¡Bueno, es la única forma de entrar! Hay más guardias adelante. Encargaos de ellos sin que os vean y estaremos a salvo.
Acquiring Credentials#043.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#044.src: Well done! Let's get on the airship.
Acquiring Credentials#044.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#045.src: Did you just... Push them all...?
Acquiring Credentials#045.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#046.src: Buckle up! We're heading to the {p}, there we'll be able to collect some dragonling eggs for you to sell at the Black Market!
Acquiring Credentials#046.dst: ¡Agarraos! Vamos a {p}, donde podremos coger huevos de Dragonling para venderlos en el Mercado Negro.
Acquiring Credentials#046.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#047.src: Travel with the Mechanic and Doan to the {p} to get the Dragonling Egg.
Acquiring Credentials#047.dst: Viaja con el Mecánico y Doan a {p} para conseguir el huevo de Dragonling.

Acquiring Credentials#048.src: The island we're heading to is home to a Dragonling nest! They use it to lay their eggs, as it's quite a difficult place to access.
Acquiring Credentials#048.dst: ¡La isla adonde vamos alberga un nido de Dragonling! Ponen allí sus huevos, ya que es un lugar de difícil acceso.
Acquiring Credentials#048.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#049.src: And those'll be worth a lot in the Black Market, right...?
Acquiring Credentials#049.dst: Y valdrán mucho en el Mercado Negro, ¿verdad...?
Acquiring Credentials#049.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#050.src: They sure will! Dragonling eggs are rare, and this island can only be accessed by airship... They're worth a fortune back at Letvus.
Acquiring Credentials#050.dst: ¡Ya lo creo! Los huevos de Dragonling son raros, y a esta isla solo se llega en aeronave... En Letvus valen una fortuna.
Acquiring Credentials#050.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#051.src: Oh, there it is! I can see the island from here, buckle up. We've got some eggs to steal!
Acquiring Credentials#051.dst: ¡Oh, ahí está! Ya veo la isla desde aquí, agarraos. ¡Tenemos huevos que robar!
Acquiring Credentials#051.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#052.src: What's that?! Oh... It looks like we've got company...
Acquiring Credentials#052.dst: ¿¡Qué es eso!? Oh... Parece que tenemos compañía...
Acquiring Credentials#052.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#053.src: Drat, the skyraiders are here! We can't let them get away with those eggs...
Acquiring Credentials#053.dst: ¡Rayos, han venido los Skyraiders! No dejemos que se lleven los huevos...
Acquiring Credentials#053.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#054.src: Well, if that's the case, then there's only one thing to do! Come on, follow me!
Acquiring Credentials#054.dst: Bueno, si es así, ¡solo queda una cosa por hacer! ¡Vamos, seguidme!
Acquiring Credentials#054.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#055.src: We can't get to the nest with so many pirates on the way, kill them!
Acquiring Credentials#055.dst: ¡Con tantos piratas en medio no llegaremos al nido, matadlos!
Acquiring Credentials#055.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#056.src: Alright, follow me! Let's go harvest that egg!
Acquiring Credentials#056.dst: ¡Muy bien, seguidme! ¡Vamos a por ese huevo!
Acquiring Credentials#056.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#057.src: Protect me while I harvest the egg, human!
Acquiring Credentials#057.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#058.src: We're halfway there, just keep defending me!
