Acquiring Credentials#058.dst: ¡Ya vamos por la mitad, sigue defendiéndome!
Acquiring Credentials#058.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#059.src: There we go! Let's get back to the airship, run!
Acquiring Credentials#059.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#060.src: Don't let them get away! Fire the cannons!!
Acquiring Credentials#060.speaker: Skyraider

Acquiring Credentials#061.src: Human, don't let them hit us! Attack the cannonballs using your weapon before they hit our airship to deflect them!
Acquiring Credentials#061.dst: ¡Humano, que no nos den! ¡Golpea las balas de cañón con tu arma para desviarlas antes de que nos alcancen!
Acquiring Credentials#061.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#062.src: We can't take more cannon shots... We're wasting our time, let's get going! We got bigger fish to fry!
Acquiring Credentials#062.dst: No aguantaremos más cañonazos... ¡Estamos perdiendo el tiempo, vámonos! ¡Hay peces más gordos!
Acquiring Credentials#062.speaker: Skyraider

Acquiring Credentials#063.src: That was close... Well then, let's head back to the airbase!
Acquiring Credentials#063.dst: Por poco... ¡Bueno, volvamos a la base aérea!
Acquiring Credentials#063.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#064.src: Go back to the bar at the Blackbird Inn with Doan.
Acquiring Credentials#064.dst: Vuelve con Doan al bar de la Blackbird Inn.

Acquiring Credentials#065.src: The two of you have certainly proven yourselves today!
Acquiring Credentials#065.dst: ¡Desde luego, hoy habéis demostrado lo que valéis!
Acquiring Credentials#065.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#066.src: So, I'll give you the password to enter the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#066.dst: Así que os daré la contraseña para entrar al Mercado Negro.
Acquiring Credentials#066.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#067.src: Go back to the Barman at the Inn and tell him I'm not thirsty, I always carry a bottle.
Acquiring Credentials#067.dst: Volved con el camarero de la posada y decidle: no tengo sed, siempre llevo una botella.
Acquiring Credentials#067.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#068.src: That might just give you the chance you need to get in. Good luck!
Acquiring Credentials#068.dst: Eso podría daros la oportunidad de entrar. ¡Suerte!
Acquiring Credentials#068.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#069.src: Thank you for your help, sir... Let's go back to the bar, then.
Acquiring Credentials#069.dst: Gracias por su ayuda, señor... Volvamos al bar, entonces.
Acquiring Credentials#069.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#070.src: Here we are again. Let's talk to the Barman.
Acquiring Credentials#070.dst: Aquí estamos otra vez. Hablemos con el camarero.
Acquiring Credentials#070.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#071.src: Um, sir? I'm not thristy, I always carry a bottle.
Acquiring Credentials#071.dst: Eh, ¿señor? No tengo sed, siempre llevo una botella.
Acquiring Credentials#071.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#072.src: Talk only to the Black Market member in the end of the hallway and do not talk to anyone else.
Acquiring Credentials#072.dst: Hablad solo con el miembro del Mercado Negro al fondo del pasillo y con nadie más.
Acquiring Credentials#072.speaker: Barman

Acquiring Credentials#074.src: Enter the Black Market and talk to the Member at the end of the hallway.
Acquiring Credentials#074.dst: Entra en el Mercado Negro y habla con el miembro al fondo del pasillo.

Acquiring Credentials#075.src: I've heard you've stolen some eggs from the Skyraiders. That's a bold move!
Acquiring Credentials#075.dst: Me han dicho que robasteis huevos a los Skyraiders. ¡Qué atrevimiento!
Acquiring Credentials#075.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#077.src: Two passports? I'd say that's around {~} emeralds. You can get that selling this egg on the market.
Acquiring Credentials#077.dst: ¿Dos pasaportes? Yo diría que unas {~} esmeraldas. Puedes conseguirlas vendiendo este huevo en el mercado.
Acquiring Credentials#077.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#078.src: Let me fill you in how the market works. You'll get a low starting price for your egg, and then you'll have to go around the merchants asking for a higher bid.
Acquiring Credentials#078.dst: Te explico cómo funciona el mercado. Tu huevo tendrá un precio inicial bajo, y tendrás que ir de mercader en mercader pidiendo una oferta mayor.
Acquiring Credentials#078.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#079.src: Be careful, though, as you can only ask for {~} price increases.
Acquiring Credentials#079.dst: Pero cuidado: solo puedes pedir {~} subidas de precio.
Acquiring Credentials#079.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#080.src: You can try talking to different merchants, and see how much each increases the price of the egg.
Acquiring Credentials#080.dst: Puedes hablar con distintos mercaderes y ver cuánto sube cada uno el precio del huevo.
Acquiring Credentials#080.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#081.src: Good luck, and do try not to get killed.
Acquiring Credentials#081.dst: Suerte, y procura que no te maten.
Acquiring Credentials#081.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#082.src: Talk to the Merchants and try to get {~} emeralds to buy a passport.
Acquiring Credentials#082.dst: Habla con los mercaderes e intenta conseguir {~} esmeraldas para comprar un pasaporte.

Acquiring Credentials#083.src: That's what we need, {u}. Sold! The egg is yours.
Acquiring Credentials#083.dst: Es lo que necesitamos, {u}. ¡Vendido! El huevo es tuyo.
Acquiring Credentials#083.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#084.src: Here, you can have your emeralds.
Acquiring Credentials#084.speaker: Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#086.src: Talk to the Black Market Member again.
Acquiring Credentials#086.dst: Vuelve a hablar con el miembro del Mercado Negro.

Acquiring Credentials#087.src: So do you have the emeralds?
Acquiring Credentials#087.speaker: Black Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#088.src: Hmm... This will do it. Here, your passports.
Acquiring Credentials#088.dst: Mmm... Con esto bastará. Tomad, vuestros pasaportes.
Acquiring Credentials#088.speaker: Black Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#089.src: Uhh.. {u}, I think you dropped your passport. Let me get it for yo-...
Acquiring Credentials#089.dst: Ehh... {u}, se te ha caído el pasaporte. Deja que te lo recoj-...
Acquiring Credentials#089.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#090.src: Wait... That's MY passport?! It was in my pocket all along...
Acquiring Credentials#090.dst: Espera... ¿¡Es MI pasaporte!? Estuvo en mi bolsillo todo el tiempo...
Acquiring Credentials#090.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#091.src: Well, uhhh... I guess you can have some of these emeralds, then...
Acquiring Credentials#091.dst: Bueno, ehhh... Supongo que puedes quedarte algunas esmeraldas...
Acquiring Credentials#091.speaker: Doan

Aldorei's Secret Part I#000.src: Talk to the Elf Guard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part I#000.dst: Habla con el guardia elfo en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part I#001.src: Halt, traveler! Entry to {p} Town is forbidden at present.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#001.dst: ¡Alto, viajero! Ahora mismo está prohibido entrar al pueblo de {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#001.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.src: There is a dangerous criminal on the loose in this valley.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.dst: Hay un criminal peligroso suelto en este valle.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#003.src: These doors shall remain closed until the criminal is captured.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#003.dst: Estas puertas seguirán cerradas hasta que se capture al criminal.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#003.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#004.src: See if anyone in {p} Valley knows what happened
Aldorei's Secret Part I#004.dst: Averigua si alguien en el valle de {p} sabe qué ha pasado

Aldorei's Secret Part I#005.src: An outsider in our midst? Exciting to see. I have wished to share our magic with new people for a long while.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#005.dst: ¿Un forastero entre nosotros? Qué emoción. Hace mucho que deseo compartir nuestra magia con gente nueva.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#005.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#006.src: However, I am...well, rather hungry. And I must tend to my garden here for the time being.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#006.dst: Sin embargo, tengo... bueno, bastante hambre. Y por ahora debo ocuparme de mi jardín.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#006.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#007.src: Have you heard the saying “You scratch my ears, I scratch yours”? People must help one another.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#007.dst: ¿Conoces el dicho “Tú me rascas las orejas, yo te rasco las tuyas”? Hay que ayudarse unos a otros.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#007.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#008.src: If you would be so kind as to bring me a loaf of fresh bread you may take my enchanted bucket.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#008.dst: Si fueras tan amable de traerme una hogaza de pan recién hecho, podrás quedarte mi cubo encantado.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#008.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.src: I saw you toil to bake this yourself. Frankly, that is above and beyond what I expected, so here is your exchange.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.dst: Te vi hornearlo con esfuerzo tú mismo. Francamente, supera lo que esperaba, así que aquí tienes lo tuyo.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#010.src: If you require help in the future with anything, do not be afraid to ask. If you put such effort for me, I shall give you the same.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#010.dst: Si en el futuro necesitas ayuda con algo, no temas pedirla. Si pones tanto empeño por mí, yo haré lo mismo por ti.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#010.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#011.src: Find a use for Damys' Bucket
Aldorei's Secret Part I#011.dst: Encuentra un uso para el cubo de Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#012.src: This is utterly insane. A full lockdown, over a petty theft... Are we not to help one another? To thieve is unnecessary.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#012.dst: Esto es una locura. Todo cerrado por un simple hurto... ¿No debemos ayudarnos? Robar no hace falta.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#012.speaker: Vaenr

Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.src: The thieving is not the reason, from what I have heard. It is that the grove was jealously hidden due to the potency of the plants there.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.dst: Por lo que he oído, el robo no es el motivo. Es que la arboleda se ocultaba con celo por la potencia de sus plantas.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.speaker: Sylvar

Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.src: Tattytale, Iridesca, Subtraxerim... The Light only knows what else. It is impossible to reach without unusual means- And that is cause for grave concern.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.dst: Tattytale, Iridesca, Subtraxerim... Solo la Luz sabe qué más. Es imposible llegar sin medios insólitos- Y eso es motivo de grave preocupación.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.speaker: Sylvar

Aldorei's Secret Part I#015.src: Find a way to grow the plant by the waterfall
Aldorei's Secret Part I#015.dst: Encuentra la forma de hacer crecer la planta junto a la cascada

Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.src: Halt! This area is strictly off limits, especially for an outsider. Turn back now!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.dst: ¡Alto! Esta zona está terminantemente prohibida, sobre todo para un forastero. ¡Da media vuelta!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.speaker: Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#019.src: Aha, the outsider returns. Is there something troubling you?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#019.dst: Ajá, el forastero regresa. ¿Algo te preocupa?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#019.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.src: ...mmm. Unfortunate, that. I cannot help with this.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.dst: ...mmm. Qué lástima. En esto no puedo ayudarte.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.src: It is not a matter of secrecy or morals- I simply do not know what that leaf is from or what it may be capable of.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.dst: No es cuestión de secretos ni de moral- Sencillamente no sé de qué es esa hoja ni de qué es capaz.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.src: I am no botanist- Simply a gardener. The mistake is understandable, if regrettable.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.dst: No soy botánico- Solo jardinero. Error comprensible, aunque lamentable.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.src: However, I was taught under a much more storied botanist who may have the answers you seek.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.dst: Sin embargo, aprendí de una botánica mucho más ilustre que quizá tenga las respuestas que buscas.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.src: Her name is Fiona- Her home is across the valley from here. Take the bridge across. She often stays inside studying.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.dst: Se llama Fiona- Vive al otro lado del valle. Cruza el puente. Suele quedarse en casa estudiando.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.src: She has forgotten more than I will ever hope to know about plants. If she cannot help you, I fear none can.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.dst: Ha olvidado más de lo que yo jamás sabré sobre plantas. Si ella no puede ayudarte, me temo que nadie podrá.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#026.src: Go to the botanist's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Aldorei's Secret Part I#026.dst: Ve a la casa de la botánica en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.src: This is outrageous! To think one of our own would stoop to such thievery and destruction!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.dst: ¡Esto es indignante! ¡Pensar que uno de los nuestros caería tan bajo como para robar y destruir!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.src: Outsider, this is not the time to be asking me anything. My home has been ransacked!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.dst: Forastero, no es momento de preguntarme nada. ¡Han saqueado mi casa!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#029.src: Mm? Damys sent you... You have leaves of Iridesca? Hm... Then perhaps we may be able to help one another.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#029.dst: ¿Mm? Te envía Damys... ¿Tienes hojas de Iridesca? Mm... Entonces quizá podamos ayudarnos mutuamente.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#029.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#030.src: They tore through my shelves and furniture searching, and scanned the pages as fervently once they found it.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#030.dst: Revolvieron mis estantes y muebles buscando, y cuando lo encontraron, repasaron las páginas con avidez.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#030.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.src: Afterwards, they threw the book into the back garden, and forced a carnivorous plant to grow and consume my notes!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.dst: Después tiraron el libro al jardín trasero, ¡e hicieron crecer una planta carnívora que devoró mis notas!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#032.src: I assume when the desired information was found, they went into my garden, threw the book into the carnivorous plant and stormed off towards the lab.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#032.dst: Supongo que, al hallar lo que querían, fueron a mi jardín, echaron el libro a la planta carnívora y salieron furiosos hacia el laboratorio.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#032.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.src: I have researched the Iridesca bloom, and many other plants, for a long time. All my knowledge is stored in that book!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.dst: Llevo mucho tiempo estudiando la flor de Iridesca y muchas otras plantas. ¡Todo mi saber está en ese libro!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.src: Retrieve it for me, and I will share my knowledge with you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.dst: Recupéralo y compartiré contigo lo que sé.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#035.src: Kill the carnivorous plant and loot the book
Aldorei's Secret Part I#035.dst: Mata a la planta carnívora y recupera el libro

Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.src: ...disgusting. I will have to hang the pages to dry later, but first, our exchange.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.dst: ...qué asco. Luego tendré que tender las páginas a secar, pero primero, nuestro trato.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.src: Hmm... Herbstzeitlose... Death Whistle, no...where is Iridesca, again...?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.dst: Mmm... Herbstzeitlose... Death Whistle, no... ¿dónde estaba Iridesca...?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.src: Aha, there it is. The pages were sticking together. Iridesca leaves are potent in various ways and are very versatile in their use.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.dst: Ajá, aquí está. Las páginas estaban pegadas. Las hojas de Iridesca son potentes de muchas formas y muy versátiles en su uso.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.src: They have an incredibly broad range of usage, from soothing joint pain or curing sickness to emetic effect and lethal poison, depending on what it is brewed with.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.dst: Tienen usos increíblemente variados: desde aliviar el dolor de articulaciones o curar enfermedades hasta provocar el vómito o ser un veneno letal, según con qué se preparen.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#040.src: Mm? The book thief also possesses Iridesca...? This... This is very troubling. There are few notes aside from mine on how to heal Iridesca poisoning.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#040.dst: ¿Mm? ¿El ladrón también tiene Iridesca...? Esto... esto es muy preocupante. Aparte de las mías, apenas hay notas sobre cómo curar su veneno.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#040.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.src: They were headed in the direction of the potionmaker's guild. If they intend something wicked...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.dst: Iban en dirección al gremio de pocioneros. Si traman algo malvado...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#042.dst: Investiga la tienda del alquimista en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.src: ..you! You have been seeking me! I have seen you tracing my footsteps...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.dst: ...¡tú! ¡Me has estado buscando! Te he visto seguir mis pasos...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.src: I apologize for this... But what I do is a necessity!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.dst: Lo siento mucho... ¡Pero lo que hago es necesario!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.src: I beg you, do not pursue me any further!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.dst: ¡Te lo ruego, no me persigas más!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.src: Outsider, I realize the circumstances appear damning, but you must stop!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.dst: Forastero, sé que las apariencias me condenan, ¡pero debes parar!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.src: What I have done is needed, and if there were another path I would have taken it over this.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.dst: Lo que he hecho es necesario, y si hubiera otro camino, lo habría elegido.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#049.src: I must take my concoction to where it is needed!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#049.dst: ¡Debo llevar mi brebaje adonde se necesita!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#049.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.src: See me as I truly am- My name is Korben, and I musn’t be delayed further!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.dst: Mírame como soy de verdad- Me llamo Korben, ¡y no puedo retrasarme más!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.src: G R O W! (In High Gavellian)
Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.dst: ¡C R E C E! (En alto gavelliano)
Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.src: A damnable pace you have... I cannot let you stop me for a moment longer!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.dst: Menudo ritmo llevas... ¡No dejaré que me detengas ni un momento más!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.src: It will be done soon, but I must reach my destination first!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.dst: Pronto estará hecho, ¡pero antes debo llegar a mi destino!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.src: Finally... I apologize for the delay. I needed to take strong measures to get this to you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.dst: Por fin... Perdona la tardanza. Tuve que tomar medidas drásticas para traerte esto.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#055.src: Here, here... Drink, father. It will clear your throat.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#055.dst: Toma, toma... Bebe, padre. Te aliviará la garganta.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#055.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#056.src: ...there. It is done. Now... Outsider... Hear me, please.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#056.dst: ...listo. Ya está. Y ahora... forastero... escúchame, por favor.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#056.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#057.src: I am aware of exactly what I have done. Shredded Fiona’s research, disturbed the forbidden gardens, unsettled the hearts of many...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#057.dst: Sé perfectamente lo que he hecho. Destrocé la investigación de Fiona, perturbé los jardines prohibidos, inquieté muchos corazones...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#057.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#058.src: My father fell ill. A trek to {p}’s borders left him stricken with Kerasot poisoning. He was near death...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#058.dst: Mi padre enfermó. Un viaje a la frontera de {p} lo dejó envenenado por Kerasot. Estaba al borde de la muerte...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#058.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#059.src: {p}’s village is one of outcasts- to visit is, stupidly, forbidden. He would have been exiled, and that would have ensured his death with his affliction.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#059.dst: El pueblo de {p} es de desterrados- visitarlo está, absurdamente, prohibido. Lo habrían exiliado, y con su dolencia eso habría sido su muerte.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#059.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#060.src: Desperation causes one to do strange things. I thought only of his safety- I cared little about anything else.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#060.dst: La desesperación nos lleva a hacer cosas extrañas. Solo pensaba en su bienestar- Lo demás poco me importaba.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#060.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#061.src: Even now I am simply relieved for his safety. If you must turn me in, I understand- I have already done what I set out to do.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#061.dst: Aun ahora, solo siento alivio por que esté a salvo. Si debes entregarme, lo entiendo- Ya he hecho lo que me propuse.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#061.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#062.src: Though I wish to remain free, whether you choose to report my activities or not does not matter to me now.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#062.dst: Aunque deseo seguir libre, que denuncies lo que he hecho o no ya no me importa.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#062.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#064.src: Traveler, I must remind you- The doors shall remain shut until the criminal has been found.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#064.dst: Viajero, debo recordártelo- Las puertas seguirán cerradas hasta que se encuentre al criminal.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#064.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#065.src: ...ah. You have found him, then. The name is Korben... Understood. We shall interrogate him for his actions.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#065.dst: ...ah. Así que lo has encontrado. Se llama Korben... Entendido. Lo interrogaremos por sus actos.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#065.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#066.src: This being the case... You may come and go as you wish to {p} Town. We shall re-open the doors.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#066.dst: Siendo así... Puedes entrar y salir del pueblo de {p} cuando quieras. Reabriremos las puertas.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#066.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#067.src: ...you... You are... You would lie to the guards and say I perished in the chase? You will keep my identity secret?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#067.dst: ...tú... Tú... ¿Mentirías a los guardias diciendo que morí en la persecución? ¿Guardarás mi secreto?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#067.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#068.src: Outsider... You show generosity akin to my father. He passed his Sol Medallion onto me to continue his legacy...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#068.dst: Forastero... Tu generosidad es como la de mi padre. Me legó su Sol Medallion para continuar su legado...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#068.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#069.src: ...after what I have done, I do not deserve it. You take it, instead. It is in sufficiently worthy hands, I believe.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#069.dst: ...tras lo que he hecho, no lo merezco. Tómalo tú. Creo que está en manos lo bastante dignas.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#069.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#070.src: I shall beg the Light to shine upon you for the rest of your days. A thousand thanks to you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#070.dst: Rogaré a la Luz que brille sobre ti el resto de tus días. Mil gracias.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#070.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part II#000.dst: Entra en el pueblo de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#002.src: I know who you are, {u}. Do you know who I am?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#002.dst: Sé quién eres, {u}. ¿Sabes tú quién soy yo?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#002.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#004.src: Enough playing around, I need your assistance. You see... There is something fishy going on behind these doors.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#004.dst: Basta de bromas, necesito tu ayuda. Verás... Algo raro pasa tras estas puertas.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#004.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#005.src: Have you ever heard the saying "Elves never die", well it's true, or so at least I thought.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#005.dst: ¿Conoces el dicho "Los elfos nunca mueren"? Pues es cierto, o eso creía yo.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#005.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#007.dst: Sigue a Olon hasta el pueblo de {p}.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#008.src: You see, my family and a few other elves left {p} Town a long time ago to start a new life in {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#008.dst: Verás, mi familia y otros elfos dejaron el pueblo de {p} hace mucho para empezar de cero en {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#008.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#009.src: I've always heard since I was young that Elves cannot die from old age. Well... recently, my parents both died.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#009.dst: Desde niño oí que los elfos no mueren de viejos. Pues... hace poco murieron mis padres.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#009.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#010.src: More and more people around {p} have died! But none in {p}. I think something sketchy is going on in here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#010.dst: ¡Cada vez muere más gente en {p}! Pero nadie en {p}. Creo que aquí pasa algo turbio.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#010.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#011.src: Please, {u}. I really need your help. Us {p} elves aren't exactly welcomed with open arms in {p}. It's a surprise they even let us in at all.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#011.dst: Por favor, {u}. Necesito tu ayuda. A los elfos de {p} no nos reciben con los brazos abiertos en {p}. Ya es raro que nos dejen entrar.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#011.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#012.src: Could you try asking around, see if anyone knows about this.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#012.dst: ¿Podrías preguntar por ahí, a ver si alguien sabe algo?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#012.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#013.src: I will wait up here. Return to me if you find out any valuable information.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#013.dst: Esperaré aquí arriba. Vuelve si averiguas algo útil.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#013.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#014.src: Check with the elves around {p} Town for information.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#014.dst: Pregunta a los elfos del pueblo de {p}.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#015.src: Welcome to {p} Town. Home of the elves.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#015.dst: Bienvenido al pueblo de {p}. El hogar de los elfos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#015.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#017.src: I've heard of you and what happened in the valley.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#017.dst: He oído hablar de ti y de lo que pasó en el valle.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#017.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#020.src: How come you are so curious?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#020.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#021.dst: Mmm. La verdad es que estoy ocupada.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#021.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#022.src: I have a lot to do today.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#022.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#026.src: But why are you telling me that?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#026.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#028.src: Your attitude is really starting to annoy me, young traveler.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#028.dst: Tu actitud empieza a molestarme, joven viajero.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#028.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#029.src: I don't care if you have defeated all the monsters in the world, never ask a woman like me of her age.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#029.dst: Me da igual que hayas vencido a todos los monstruos del mundo: a una dama como yo no se le pregunta la edad.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#029.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#031.src: You seem like such a kind adventurer, you humans aren't all so bad.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#031.dst: Pareces un aventurero muy amable. Los humanos no sois tan malos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#031.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#033.src: How come you are so curious?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#033.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#034.src: Well... when I think about it. No.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#034.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#035.src: Actually. There is an old tale for children about a dying elf.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#035.dst: En realidad, hay un viejo cuento infantil sobre un elfo moribundo.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#035.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#036.src: I never thought much about it since I have never seen anyone in here die before.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#036.dst: Nunca le di muchas vueltas, porque nunca he visto morir a nadie aquí.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#036.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#037.src: I heard that there is some old graveyard somewhere in {p}. Probably just some weird story.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#037.dst: He oído que hay un viejo cementerio en algún lugar de {p}. Será una historia rara.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#037.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#038.src: I'm so sorry to hear that.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#038.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#039.src: I don't really see how that is connected to {p} though.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#039.dst: Pero no veo qué tiene que ver eso con {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#039.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#042.src: You never ask a woman her age. Did you not know that?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#042.dst: A una dama nunca se le pregunta la edad. ¿No lo sabías?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#042.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#043.src: All I can say is that I am old enough.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#043.dst: Solo diré que tengo edad suficiente.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#043.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#047.src: Worry not, the great Amber is here to help you find your way!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#047.dst: ¡Tranquilo, la gran Amber está aquí para guiarte!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#047.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#049.src: My name is Amber of the Sol Embassy Royal Task Force!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#049.dst: ¡Soy Amber, de la Fuerza Real de la Embajada de Sol!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#049.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#050.src: It is my duty to protect the city from wrongdoers!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#050.dst: ¡Mi deber es proteger la ciudad de los malhechores!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#050.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#051.src: You AREN'T A THIEF ARE YOU? OR A ROBBER? OR MURDERER!? ARSONIST!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#051.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#053.src: I let my imagination get the best of me!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#053.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#054.src: My main job is patrolling the grounds and making sure no one is doing anything they shouldn't.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#054.dst: Mi trabajo es patrullar y asegurarme de que nadie haga lo que no debe.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#054.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#055.src: I also report anything I hear people talk about that they shouldn't.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#055.dst: También informo de lo que oigo decir a la gente y no debería.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#055.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#056.src: Maybe I shouldn't have said all of that...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#056.dst: Quizá no debería haber dicho todo eso...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#056.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#057.src: Can I help you with anything else?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#057.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#059.src: I report who comes and leaves the town. Who sells what. Who buys what. Who talks with who.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#059.dst: Informo de quién entra y sale del pueblo. Quién vende qué. Quién compra qué. Quién habla con quién.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#059.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#060.src: The list goes on and on and on and on and on... and on... and on.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#060.dst: Y la lista sigue y sigue y sigue y sigue... y sigue... y sigue.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#060.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#061.src: They like keeping track of what happens inside the town!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#061.dst: ¡Les gusta saber todo lo que pasa en el pueblo!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#061.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#062.src: Can I help you with anything else?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#062.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#063.src: The Sol Embassy and its elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#063.dst: La Embajada de Sol y sus ancianos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#063.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#064.src: There are six elders who rule over {p} Town!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#064.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#065.src: They don't often show themselves to the public, they like to keep their privacy. I don't even know what all of them look like!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#065.dst: No suelen dejarse ver en público, les gusta su intimidad. ¡Ni siquiera sé qué cara tienen todos!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#065.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#067.src: Enjoy this wonderful town. Don't hesitate to ask me for help!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#067.dst: Disfruta de este pueblo maravilloso. ¡Pídeme ayuda cuando quieras!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#067.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#068.src: The Sol Embassy and its elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#068.dst: La Embajada de Sol y sus ancianos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#068.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#069.src: There are six elders who rule over {p} Town!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#069.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#070.src: They don't often show themselves to the public, they like to keep their privacy. I don't even know what all of them look like!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#070.dst: No suelen dejarse ver en público, les gusta su intimidad. ¡Ni siquiera sé qué cara tienen todos!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#070.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#072.src: Enjoy this wonderful town. Don't hesitate to ask me for help!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#072.dst: Disfruta de este pueblo maravilloso. ¡Pídeme ayuda cuando quieras!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#072.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#074.src: Every day I get to catch bad guys, I'm living the dream.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#074.dst: Atrapo malos todos los días, vivo un sueño.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#074.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#075.src: Well, more like every month or so, or... even one every year. There aren't many bad guys here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#075.dst: Bueno, más bien uno al mes, o... uno al año. Aquí no hay muchos malos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#075.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#078.src: I... I... No! Bullies don't affect me... *sniffles*
Aldorei's Secret Part II#078.dst: Yo... Yo... ¡No! Los abusones no me afectan... *snif*
Aldorei's Secret Part II#078.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#080.src: Enjoy this wonderful town. Don't hesitate to ask me for help!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#080.dst: Disfruta de este pueblo maravilloso. ¡Pídeme ayuda cuando quieras!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#080.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#081.src: Oh it's you. I can't believe we let a human into this place.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#081.dst: Ah, eres tú. No puedo creer que dejáramos entrar a un humano.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#081.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#084.src: You dare speak to me like that?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#084.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#085.src: I will get you deported if it's the last thing I do, mark my words!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#085.dst: ¡Haré que te expulsen aunque sea lo último que haga, te lo aseguro!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#085.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#086.src: That's me! Sol the Smart, Sol the Clever, Sol the Best. I go by many names.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#086.dst: ¡Ese soy yo! Sol el Sabio, Sol el Listo, Sol el Mejor. Tengo muchos nombres.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#086.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#087.src: So what is it you need?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#087.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#089.src: Hmm. I'm sorry but I can't talk about that too much.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#089.dst: Mmm. Lo siento, pero de eso no puedo hablar mucho.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#089.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#090.src: I would love to show you my knowledge but... the grass has ears here in {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#090.dst: Me encantaría lucir mis saberes, pero... en {p} la hierba tiene oídos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#090.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#091.src: I will tell you this, Elves used to die from old age around {~} years ago.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#091.dst: Te diré esto: hace unos {~} años, los elfos morían de viejos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#091.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#093.src: If you don't mind me asking... Is your friend from {p}?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#093.dst: Si no es indiscreción... ¿Tu amigo es de {p}?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#093.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#094.src: It seems like my theory is true. {p} elves are dying.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#094.dst: Parece que mi teoría es cierta. Los elfos de {p} están muriendo.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#094.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#096.src: Hmm. I'm sorry but I can't talk about that too much.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#096.dst: Mmm. Lo siento, pero de eso no puedo hablar mucho.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#096.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#097.src: I would love to show you my knowledge but... the grass has ears here in {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#097.dst: Me encantaría lucir mis saberes, pero... en {p} la hierba tiene oídos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#097.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#098.src: I will tell you this, Elves used to die from old age around {~} years ago.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#098.dst: Te diré esto: hace unos {~} años, los elfos morían de viejos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#098.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#099.src: Farewell. Make sure to let everyone know I'm the smartest!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#099.dst: Adiós. ¡Dile a todo el mundo que soy el más listo!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#099.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#100.src: Pfft. No way am I telling you any secret information about {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#100.dst: Bah. Ni loco te cuento secretos de {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#100.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#101.src: Elves may die, elves may not. I don't know.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#101.dst: Los elfos quizá mueran, quizá no. Yo qué sé.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#101.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#104.src: I was just taking a... little nap. No need to be so loud.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#104.dst: Solo echaba una... siestecita. No hace falta gritar.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#104.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#105.src: So why did you wake me up?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#105.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#108.src: You see, I'm a moon elf. I draw power from the moon.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#108.dst: Verás, soy un elfo lunar. Mi poder viene de la luna.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#108.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#109.src: You humans are really stupid I have to say... zzz......
Aldorei's Secret Part II#109.dst: Tengo que decirlo, los humanos sois muy tontos... zzz......
Aldorei's Secret Part II#109.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#110.src: It's the capital of the elves. It's a dream for all elves to live in here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#110.dst: Es la capital de los elfos. Todo elfo sueña con vivir aquí.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#110.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#112.src: {p} might look really pretty on the outside, but really, they are all hiding something in here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#112.dst: {p} parecerá muy bonito por fuera, pero en realidad aquí todos esconden algo.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#112.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#113.src: I'm younger than most here, you see. I'm just about a hundred years old.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#113.dst: Soy más joven que casi todos aquí. Tengo unos cien años.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#113.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#114.src: There's a few places we aren't allowed in. The more you think about it, the more controlled everything is here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#114.dst: Hay sitios donde no nos dejan entrar. Cuanto más lo piensas, más controlado está todo.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#114.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#116.src: No. Do you not know of the child regulations here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#116.dst: No. ¿No conoces las normas de natalidad de aquí?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#116.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#117.src: There are very strict restrictions on who or when someone can have children here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#117.dst: Aquí hay normas estrictas sobre quién y cuándo puede tener hijos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#117.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#118.src: I'm the only new elf this century. At least here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#118.dst: Soy el único elfo nacido este siglo. Al menos aquí.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#118.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#119.src: The main reason elves have moved to {p}, to start families.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#119.dst: Es el motivo principal por el que los elfos se van a {p}: formar familia.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#119.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#121.src: I can't really say... You really don't want to break the rules here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#121.dst: No puedo decirlo... Aquí no te conviene romper las normas.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#121.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#122.src: I would keep a low profile if I were you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#122.dst: Yo que tú no llamaría la atención.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#122.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#123.src: I can give you some information but you need to leave me alone after.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#123.dst: Te daré algo de información, pero luego déjame en paz.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#123.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#124.src: I heard about a hidden chamber under the town. And coincidentally, we aren't allowed to go down there.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#124.dst: He oído que hay una cámara oculta bajo el pueblo. Y qué casualidad: no nos dejan bajar.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#124.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#126.src: I can't really say... You really don't want to break the rules here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#126.dst: No puedo decirlo... Aquí no te conviene romper las normas.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#126.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#127.src: I would keep a low profile if I were you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#127.dst: Yo que tú no llamaría la atención.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#127.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#128.src: I can give you some information but you need to leave me alone after.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#128.dst: Te daré algo de información, pero luego déjame en paz.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#128.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#129.src: I heard about a hidden chamber under the town. And coincidentally, we aren't allowed to go down there.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#129.dst: He oído que hay una cámara oculta bajo el pueblo. Y qué casualidad: no nos dejan bajar.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#129.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#132.src: I'm not that much for... image and status.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#132.dst: No me importan mucho... la imagen y el estatus.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#132.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#133.src: That's all anyone ever talks about here... zzzz...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#133.dst: Aquí nadie habla de otra cosa... zzzz...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#133.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#135.src: Return to Olon with the information at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#135.dst: Vuelve con Olon con la información en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#136.src: Hmm... That is all very interesting, and the more I hear the more right I feel like I am.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#136.dst: Mmm... Todo eso es muy interesante, y cuanto más oigo, más creo que tengo razón.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#136.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#137.src: Even though the relationship between {p} and {p} isn't the best I would still not hope that {p} is doing something to kill us off.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#137.dst: Aunque la relación entre {p} y {p} no es la mejor, no quiero creer que {p} esté haciendo algo para acabar con nosotros.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#137.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#138.src: I think it's worth looking into the information you got ourselves.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#138.dst: Creo que vale la pena investigar lo que has averiguado.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#138.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#140.src: I don't know if that will help us, but sure.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#298.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#299.src: No! {u}, I am not letting this go! I will get justice for my parents.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#299.dst: ¡No! {u}, ¡no pienso dejarlo pasar! Haré justicia por mis padres.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#299.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#300.src: Pfft- it's merely a design flaw.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#300.dst: Bah, es un mero fallo de diseño.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#300.speaker: Elder Willow

Aldorei's Secret Part II#301.src: Don't try to trick us with your mind games.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#301.dst: No intentes engañarnos con tus juegos mentales.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#305.src: I'm sure you must realize by now we are the elders for a reason?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#305.dst: ¿Ya te habrás dado cuenta de que somos los ancianos por algo?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#305.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#306.src: Us elves are ten times more powerful than any human by nature.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#306.dst: Los elfos somos por naturaleza diez veces más poderosos que un humano.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#306.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#316.src: Escape the town hall with Olon.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#320.src: You know... I didn't really think that would work, and I was right.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#320.dst: ¿Sabes? No creía que eso fuera a funcionar, y tenía razón.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#320.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#321.src: But I think I figured it out...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#321.dst: Pero creo que ya lo he entendido...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#321.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#322.src: Exactly! You've got a keen eye for this kinda thing.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#322.dst: ¡Exacto! Tienes buen ojo para estas cosas.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#322.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#323.src: The question is if she lied, or if something else happened.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#323.dst: La cuestión es si ella mintió o si pasó otra cosa.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#323.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#324.src: One of the seats were empty but most importantly...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#324.dst: Uno de los asientos estaba vacío, pero lo más importante...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#324.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#325.src: I glanced over at the shelves behind them and saw papers signed by another name.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#325.dst: Eché un vistazo a los estantes de detrás y vi papeles firmados con otro nombre.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#325.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#326.src: So the question is... what happened to them?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#326.dst: Así que la pregunta es... ¿qué le pasó?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#326.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#328.src: No- but I noticed something that didn't add up with our previous information.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#328.dst: No, pero noté algo que no cuadra con lo que sabíamos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#328.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#329.src: One of the seats were empty and one of the elves mentioned six elders, did she not?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#329.dst: Uno de los asientos estaba vacío, y una elfa habló de seis ancianos, ¿no?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#329.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#330.src: I glanced over at the shelves behind them and saw papers signed by another name.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#330.dst: Eché un vistazo a los estantes de detrás y vi papeles firmados con otro nombre.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#330.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#331.src: So the question is... what happened to them?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#331.dst: Así que la pregunta es... ¿qué le pasó?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#331.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#332.src: I'm guessing the Elders got into a big disagreement and decided to rid of them.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#332.dst: Supongo que los ancianos discutieron y decidieron librarse de él.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#332.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#333.src: So I doubt they have any records of that occuring here...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#333.dst: Así que dudo que haya registros de eso aquí...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#333.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#334.src: Our best bet is to find somebody that may have seen what happened here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#334.dst: Lo mejor es encontrar a alguien que viera lo que pasó.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#334.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#335.src: Y'know I'm pretty good friends with the {p} Scouts.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#335.dst: ¿Sabes? Soy bastante amigo de los exploradores de {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#335.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#336.src: They are really observant of everything that goes on in and around the canyons.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#336.dst: Se fijan en todo lo que pasa dentro y alrededor de los cañones.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#336.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#337.src: Meet me outside the {p} {p}, speak with me if you'd like to travel there together.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#337.dst: Nos vemos fuera de {p} {p}. Háblame si quieres que vayamos juntos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#337.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#338.src: Meet up with Olon outside the {p} in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#338.dst: Reúnete con Olon fuera de {p}, en {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#339.src: Let's go then! Glad you want to travel with me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#339.dst: ¡Pues vamos! Me alegra que quieras venir conmigo.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#339.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#340.src: Here we are! The capital of Gavel, home of a lot of things I'm sure.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#340.dst: ¡Aquí estamos! La capital de Gavel, hogar de muchas cosas, seguro.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#340.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#341.src: Alright- so we have to come up with a plan on what to do next, I have a few suggestions myself.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#341.dst: Bien, tenemos que trazar un plan para lo siguiente. Yo tengo algunas ideas.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#341.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#342.src: I've done some work for the {p} staff in the past and happen to know a few of them.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#342.dst: Antes trabajé para el personal de {p} y conozco a algunos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#342.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#343.src: We are actually quite good friends, what do you think?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#343.dst: De hecho somos buenos amigos. ¿Qué te parece?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#343.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#344.src: Sounds like a good plan to me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#344.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#345.src: Head inside and look for someone who doesn't seem busy.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#345.dst: Entra y busca a alguien que no parezca ocupado.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#345.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#346.src: So you want us to sneak in?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#346.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#347.src: Do you even know where we need to go?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#347.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#348.src: Thought so... good thing I'm here then!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#348.dst: Lo suponía... ¡menos mal que estoy yo!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#348.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#349.src: As I previously mentioned, I've been helping out with keeping the gardens inside tidy.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#349.dst: Como te dije, he estado ayudando a cuidar los jardines de dentro.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#349.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#350.src: I've picked up a few things here and there, obviously! The conclusion I have is...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#350.dst: ¡Y claro, me he enterado de algunas cosas! Mi conclusión es...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#350.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#351.src: There's a room at the top of the guild hall that stores old military documents.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#351.dst: En lo alto del salón de gremios hay una sala con viejos documentos militares.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#351.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#352.src: It isn't really in use anymore, meaning the way up won't be easy... meet me under the bridge.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#352.dst: Ya casi no se usa, así que subir no será fácil... nos vemos bajo el puente.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#352.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#353.src: Find Olon's friend inside the {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#353.dst: Busca al amigo de Olon dentro de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#356.src: I haven't seen you in so long! I'm doing good, family too!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#356.dst: ¡Cuánto tiempo sin verte! Estoy bien, ¡y la familia también!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#356.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#357.src: Glad to hear! Listen- we're quite busy today, do you know where the old military documents are being kept?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#357.dst: ¡Me alegro! Oye, hoy vamos con prisa. ¿Sabes dónde guardan los viejos documentos militares?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#357.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#358.src: Is this about the theory you had going? Actually- I recently did some work there.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#358.dst: ¿Es por esa teoría tuya? Pues hace poco trabajé allí.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#358.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#359.src: There's an elevator up the stairs next to me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#359.dst: Subiendo las escaleras a mi lado hay un ascensor.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#359.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#360.src: Please come back and talk later! I miss our conversations.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#360.dst: ¡Vuelve luego a charlar! Echo de menos nuestras charlas.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#360.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#361.src: Perfect! lets take that elevator up stairs right away.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#361.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#362.src: Meet Olon under the bridge at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#362.dst: Reúnete con Olon bajo el puente en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#363.src: The archive should be at the top of one of the big towers of the {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#363.dst: El archivo debería estar en lo alto de una de las grandes torres de {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#363.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#364.src: I had a brilliant idea of blessing you with some of my magic that you can hopefully use to get in.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#364.dst: Se me ha ocurrido bendecirte con algo de mi magia, que espero te sirva para entrar.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#364.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#365.src: I want to go meet up with my old friend, I'll hopefully see you soon.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#365.dst: Quiero ir a ver a mi viejo amigo. Espero verte pronto.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#365.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#366.src: Do you see the pool of white magic next to us?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#366.dst: ¿Ves el charco de magia blanca a nuestro lado?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#366.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#367.src: Just hop in when you are ready to start.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#367.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#370.src: Use the pool of magic at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to start heading towards the archive.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#370.dst: Usa el charco de magia en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para empezar a ir hacia el archivo.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#374.src: Return to {p} Town by either using the Juggler merchant at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or walking to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Aldorei's Secret Part II#374.dst: Vuelve al pueblo de {p} con el mercader malabarista en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] o a pie hasta [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Aldorei's Secret Part II#375.src: You found it? Great, it's just as I thought.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#375.dst: ¿Lo has encontrado? Genial, justo lo que pensaba.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#375.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#376.src: Alright- this is the plan. I will stay behind and look for a map of the place mentioned, they almost always mark the reports properly.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#376.dst: Bien, este es el plan. Me quedaré a buscar un mapa del lugar mencionado; casi siempre marcan bien los informes.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#376.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#377.src: Meet me in {p} Town, at the eastern town exit. Let's try to avoid the elders for now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#377.dst: Nos vemos en el pueblo de {p}, en la salida este. De momento evitemos a los ancianos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#377.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#378.src: If you want to get back to {p} Town I heard that there's a so called "juggler" merchant in {p} that will bring you there for free.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#378.dst: Si quieres volver al pueblo de {p}, he oído que en {p} hay un mercader "malabarista" que te lleva gratis.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#378.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#379.src: You could always walk too, I suppose.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#379.dst: Aunque también puedes ir a pie, supongo.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#379.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#380.dst: Busca a Olon en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] en el pueblo de {p}.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#382.src: This road leads to the {p}, so we may have to look around for a while.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#382.dst: Este camino lleva a {p}, así que quizá tengamos que buscar un rato.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#382.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#383.src: The canyon moves on its own. Alright, let's get going.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#383.dst: El cañón se mueve solo. Bien, pongámonos en marcha.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#383.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#386.src: I'm not here to stop you. Actually, I wanted to help out.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#386.dst: No vengo a deteneros. De hecho, quería ayudar.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#386.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#387.src: There are a lot of things wrong with this town, this society. The judgements that we've made...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#387.dst: Este pueblo, esta sociedad, tiene muchos fallos. Los juicios que hemos hecho...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#387.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#388.src: Us elves aren't perfect. We like to say that- and frankly, many of us believe it too.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#388.dst: Los elfos no somos perfectos. Nos gusta decirlo y, sinceramente, muchos lo creen.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#388.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#389.src: I've always wanted to be the change in {p} but it's troublesome to convince those who are stuck in their crooked ways.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#389.dst: Siempre quise ser el cambio en {p}, pero cuesta convencer a quienes están anclados en sus torcidas costumbres.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#389.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#390.src: Please, bring back Elder Birch- for me. Follow the mountain road to the right until you come across a cave with mushrooms.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#390.dst: Por favor, traed de vuelta al anciano Birch, por mí. Seguid el camino de la montaña a la derecha hasta una cueva con setas.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#390.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#391.src: In the meantime, I have some things to ask the Elders- good luck, both of you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#391.dst: Mientras, tengo cosas que preguntar a los ancianos. Suerte a los dos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#391.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#392.src: Venture into the {p} and find the entrance to the sealed away Elder at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#392.dst: Adéntrate en {p} y encuentra la entrada al anciano sellado en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#393.src: Find your way through the canyon.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#393.dst: Abre camino a través del cañón.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#395.src: You have one minute to explain what you're doing here and who you are before I collapse the mountains around you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#395.dst: Tenéis un minuto para explicar qué hacéis aquí y quiénes sois antes de que os eche las montañas encima.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#395.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#396.src: An elf and a human- inside of my home!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#396.dst: Un elfo y un humano, ¡en mi casa!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#396.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#398.src: You can tell THEM I haven't left my home since my banishment. I haven't said a word, nor have I even considered doing anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#398.dst: Podéis decirles a ELLOS que no he salido de casa desde mi destierro. No he dicho ni una palabra, ni he pensado hacer nada.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#398.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#399.src: We aren't with the Elders. I'm from {p}! We are here for the truth.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#399.dst: No vamos con los ancianos. ¡Soy de {p}! Venimos por la verdad.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#399.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#401.src: So this is a test, huh?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#401.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#403.src: Do they... want... me back? Is this why you are here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#403.dst: ¿Acaso... quieren... que vuelva? ¿Por eso estáis aquí?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#403.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#404.src: We aren't connected to the Elders in any way! I'm here for personal reasons.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#404.dst: ¡No tenemos nada que ver con los ancianos! Vengo por motivos personales.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#404.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#407.src: This is some sort of test from the Elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#407.dst: Esto es una especie de prueba de los ancianos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#407.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#408.dst: Si no, convénceme de lo contrario.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#408.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#410.src: Prove it! I can't believe they would just forget about me so quickly.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#410.dst: ¡Demuéstralo! No creo que me olvidaran tan deprisa.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#410.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#412.src: So what? That doesn't prove anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#412.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#415.src: What... what did he say about me?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#415.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#417.src: Of course he did, he has always taken my side.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#417.dst: Claro que lo dijo, siempre se ha puesto de mi lado.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#417.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#418.src: You know what- I will come with you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#418.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#419.src: But I won't tell you anything. I'm only coming because of Alder.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#419.dst: Pero no os diré nada. Solo voy por Alder.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#419.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#420.src: Alder would never say that... especially not to the likes of you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#420.dst: Alder nunca diría eso... y menos a gente como vosotros.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#420.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#421.src: Although- I do miss him dearly...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#421.dst: Aunque... lo echo mucho de menos...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#421.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#423.src: Tough luck- I don't know how that would convince me you're not with the elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#423.dst: Mala suerte. No veo cómo eso prueba que no vais con los ancianos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#423.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#424.src: You'll have to try harder than that.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#424.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#425.src: If the Elders sent you, then you should already know the answer.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#425.dst: Si os enviaron los ancianos, ya deberíais saber la respuesta.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#425.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#426.src: I am not telling you anything...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#426.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#428.src: Where did that accusation come from?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#428.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#429.src: Are you two a bit slow or what? We are not killing anyone!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#429.dst: ¿Sois un poco lentos o qué? ¡No estamos matando a nadie!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#429.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#430.src: If anything, the {p} elves brought it upon themselves by leaving our city.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#430.dst: En todo caso, los elfos de {p} se lo buscaron al irse de nuestra ciudad.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#430.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#432.src: Let's just say the town is magical. That's all you need to know.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#432.dst: Digamos que el pueblo es mágico. Es todo lo que necesitáis saber.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#432.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#434.src: Really... it seems I can't escape the past.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#434.dst: Vaya... parece que no puedo huir del pasado.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#434.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#435.src: I don't know what it is... but I want you to tell me more...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#435.dst: No sé qué es... pero quiero que me contéis más...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#435.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#436.src: Maybe it's time- time to confront the elders again. We must go.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#436.dst: Quizá sea hora... hora de enfrentarme otra vez a los ancianos. Hay que irse.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#436.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#439.src: Of course things happened- things happen everywhere!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#439.dst: Claro que pasaron cosas, ¡pasan cosas en todas partes!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#439.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#440.src: Elves are magical, that's why the city is magical.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#440.dst: Los elfos son mágicos, por eso la ciudad es mágica.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#440.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#441.src: I'm not going to tell you anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#441.dst: No os voy a contar nada.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#441.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#443.src: {p} doesn't care about {p} elves, why would they kill them?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#443.dst: A {p} no le importan los elfos de {p}, ¿por qué iba a matarlos?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#443.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#444.src: Well, why are you here then?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#444.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#445.src: If you are so close, what do you need me for?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#445.dst: Si estáis tan cerca, ¿para qué me necesitáis?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#445.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#446.src: Even though I have been banished, I would never want something like that.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#446.dst: Aunque me desterraran, jamás desearía algo así.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#446.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#450.src: Go on ahead. This is not something I expected to happen...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#450.dst: Id delante. No esperaba que pasara esto...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#450.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#451.src: Return to the Elders with Elder Birch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#451.dst: Vuelve con los ancianos junto al anciano Birch en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#453.src: You've got guts coming back here after everyth-
Aldorei's Secret Part II#453.dst: Hace falta valor para volver después de todo lo-
Aldorei's Secret Part II#453.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#454.src: Actually- we have someone that you might be interested in meeting.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#454.dst: En realidad, traemos a alguien que quizá os interese ver.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#454.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#455.src: What is the meaning of this?!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#455.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#457.src: It's been so long, I didn't think you would come back.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#457.dst: Ha pasado tanto tiempo... No creía que fueras a volver.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#457.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#458.src: Alder- I am sorry but the only reason I have returned is to set things right once and for all.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#458.dst: Alder, lo siento, pero solo he vuelto para arreglar las cosas de una vez por todas.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#458.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#459.src: These two individuals have the right to know what's going on.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#459.dst: Estos dos tienen derecho a saber qué está pasando.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#459.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#460.src: Are you out of your MIND! We voted on this all those years ago!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#460.dst: ¡¿Has perdido el JUICIO?! ¡Lo votamos hace muchos años!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#460.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#461.src: If you tell them ANYTHING about the tree I will make sure your eternal life ends right here and now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#461.dst: Si les cuentas ALGO sobre el árbol, me aseguraré de que tu vida eterna acabe aquí y ahora.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#461.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#462.src: Oak- that is ENOUGH! Can't you see- this human is fighting the war we begun!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#462.dst: ¡Oak, BASTA YA! ¿No lo ves? ¡Este humano libra la guerra que empezamos!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#462.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#463.src: They've earned it- they should know. Salvation of our light, our redemption!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#463.dst: Se lo han ganado. ¡Salvación de nuestra luz, nuestra redención!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#463.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#464.src: I agree with Elder Birch, sir.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#464.dst: Coincido con el anciano Birch, señor.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#464.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#466.src: {u}, Olon- the war you are fighting...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#466.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#467.src: We- we are the ones to blame. Our kind, our people...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#467.dst: Nosotros... la culpa es nuestra. De nuestra raza, de nuestro pueblo...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#467.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#468.src: The elves are the reason the world is in calamity. All because of one, senseless, selfish mistake.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#468.dst: Los elfos son la causa de la calamidad del mundo. Todo por un error absurdo y egoísta.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#468.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#469.src: The worst fate that this world has seen, a fate beyond comprehension.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#469.dst: El peor destino que ha visto este mundo, un destino incomprensible.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#469.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#470.src: Your leading question, about our immortality. The answer is simple- but there is more to it.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#470.dst: Vuestra gran pregunta, sobre nuestra inmortalidad. La respuesta es sencilla, pero hay más.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#470.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#471.src: We... we revealed the first gate- giving way for the darkness...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#471.dst: Nosotros... abrimos la primera puerta, dejando paso a la oscuridad...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#471.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#473.src: I'd rather if we show you. Meet me under the Cherry Blossom tree.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#473.dst: Prefiero mostrároslo. Nos vemos bajo el cerezo en flor.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#473.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#474.src: I- I will join you as well.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#474.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#475.src: Head down to the Cherry Blossom tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#475.dst: Baja al cerezo en flor en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#476.src: This place- here is where it all began.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#476.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#477.src: The center of the Elven society, under the tree that protects our civilization.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#477.dst: El centro de la sociedad élfica, bajo el árbol que protege nuestra civilización.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#477.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#478.src: And, brings upon us our immortality...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#478.dst: Y que nos da la inmortalidad...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#478.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#479.src: The roots expand deep inside this cavern that we've used for storage over the years.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#479.dst: Las raíces se extienden por esta caverna que hemos usado de almacén durante años.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#479.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#480.src: At least two Elders are required to open the passage. We will open the way for you two now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#480.dst: Hacen falta al menos dos ancianos para abrir el paso. Os abriremos el camino ahora.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#480.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#481.src: Be careful, nobody was meant to return there so certain defense mechanisms were put in place.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#481.dst: Cuidado: nadie debía volver ahí, así que se pusieron ciertos mecanismos de defensa.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#481.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#482.src: Also, the information you will learn can harm all elves, unfortunately some things must be kept a secret.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#482.dst: Además, lo que sabréis puede dañar a todos los elfos; por desgracia, hay cosas que deben ser secretas.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#482.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#483.dst: Salta a la cueva del almacén.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#487.src: I've had a very bad feeling that we won't like what we see...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#487.dst: Tengo el mal presentimiento de que no nos gustará lo que veamos...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#487.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#488.src: Well... It's too late to back down now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#488.dst: Bueno... Ya es tarde para echarse atrás.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#488.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#490.src: Do you feel the magical energy, it's almost like I can touch it.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#490.dst: ¿Notas la energía mágica? Es como si pudiera tocarla.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#490.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#491.src: Is the water filled with logs?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#491.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#492.src: Have you noticed this... plant in the middle.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#492.dst: ¿Te has fijado en esta... planta del centro?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#492.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#493.src: It seems like this place is so alive, I mean just look at all of this coming from the logs!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#493.dst: Este lugar parece rebosar vida, ¡mira todo lo que sale de los troncos!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#493.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#494.src: If you are here to stop us, we won't hesitate to hurt you!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#494.dst: Si venís a detenernos, ¡no dudaremos en haceros daño!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#494.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#495.src: On the contrary. I... realize, that this is something we can no longer keep quiet about.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#495.dst: Al contrario. Me he... dado cuenta de que ya no podemos seguir callando esto.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#495.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#496.src: When you brought back Birch... it brought back memories, and I must admit. It made me realize I had lost myself along the way.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#496.dst: Cuando trajisteis a Birch... volvieron los recuerdos, y debo admitirlo. Me di cuenta de que me había perdido por el camino.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#496.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#497.src: We were ashamed of our actions- all of us. Scared for our people. If they knew the truth... there would be riots, wars, innocents would die!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#497.dst: Nos avergonzaban nuestros actos, a todos. Temíamos por nuestro pueblo. Si supieran la verdad... ¡habría disturbios, guerras, morirían inocentes!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#497.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#498.src: But because we locked up {p} from the outside, we grew a... god complex, so to speak.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#498.dst: Pero al aislar {p} del exterior, nos creímos... dioses, por así decirlo.
