All Roads to Peace#274.dst: ¡Sí, por fin! ¡Ya no tengo que preguntarme si el humano va a sacarme los ojos!
All Roads to Peace#274.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#275.src: Oh, quit being such a scaredy-baby. This one's nice!
All Roads to Peace#275.dst: Oh, no seas tan miedica. ¡Este es majo!
All Roads to Peace#275.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#276.src: Good game, I guess! Back to being bored again.
All Roads to Peace#276.dst: ¡Buen juego, supongo! A aburrirse otra vez.
All Roads to Peace#276.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#280.src: What? You aren't even wearing those kinds of shoes.
All Roads to Peace#280.dst: ¿Qué? Si ni siquiera llevas zapatos de esos.
All Roads to Peace#280.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#281.src: Anyways, to the winner goes the spoils. Here, for entertaining them for a bit.
All Roads to Peace#281.dst: En fin, al vencedor, el botín. Toma, por entretenerlos un rato.
All Roads to Peace#281.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#282.src: They have me watch the goblins but I'm no good at having fun with them, so thanks I suppose.
All Roads to Peace#282.dst: Me hacen vigilar a los goblins, pero no se me da bien divertirlos, así que supongo que gracias.
All Roads to Peace#282.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#284.src: Ah, the weird human. Why you looking to be helpful?
All Roads to Peace#284.dst: Ah, el humano raro. ¿Por qué querer ayudar?
All Roads to Peace#284.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#285.src: Must be some reason. Not sure if tired for fighting or some other reason, but if human feel like helping, can use some help.
All Roads to Peace#285.dst: Deber haber razón. No saber si cansado de luchar u otra razón, pero si humano querer ayudar, venir bien ayuda.
All Roads to Peace#285.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#286.src: Running low on blue dyes. Have plenty of other colors, but need blue. Know where to get them, too.
All Roads to Peace#286.dst: Quedar poco tinte azul. Tener muchos otros colores, pero necesitar azul. Saber dónde conseguir.
All Roads to Peace#286.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#287.src: The cave outside the villager bridge, with the pond and arch by it. Go in, and there will be blue flowers.
All Roads to Peace#287.dst: Cueva junto a puente aldeano, con estanque y arco al lado. Entrar, y haber flores azules.
All Roads to Peace#287.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#288.src: Get [{~} Terramarine Buds] so can make more dyes. Don't know why you helping, but won't turn down help either.
All Roads to Peace#288.dst: Traer [{~} Terramarine Buds] para hacer más tintes. No saber por qué ayudar, pero no rechazar ayuda.
All Roads to Peace#288.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#289.src: The weird human again? You all covered in blue powder. You found the flowers then!
All Roads to Peace#289.dst: ¿Humano raro otra vez? Estar cubierto de polvo azul. ¡Encontrar flores!
All Roads to Peace#289.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#290.src: Here. Will get that for you. The buds are enough for what need, but you can keep the dust.
All Roads to Peace#290.dst: Toma. Quedarme eso. Capullos bastar para lo que necesitar, pero tú quedarte polvo.
All Roads to Peace#290.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#291.src: Little more, too. But, again- why you looking to be helpful? Don't understand. Humans kill orcs a lot.
All Roads to Peace#291.dst: Y algo más. Pero, otra vez- ¿por qué querer ayudar? No entender. Humanos matar muchos orcos.
All Roads to Peace#291.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#292.src: You unlearn villager stupidity maybe? In the middle of unlearning? Perhaps a sign from the earth things will heal. Perhaps not. We will see.
All Roads to Peace#292.dst: ¿Quizá desaprender estupidez aldeana? ¿A mitad de desaprender? Quizá señal de tierra de que todo sanar. Quizá no. Ya ver.
All Roads to Peace#292.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#294.src: You that weird human helping instead killing, right? Nunexetor and little goblins talking about you.
All Roads to Peace#294.dst: ¿Tú humano raro que ayudar en vez de matar? Nunexetor y goblins pequeños hablar de ti.
All Roads to Peace#294.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#295.src: Trying to make weapons and tools better. Training, but running out of grindstones. Etemitoro- that is me, my name... That how say it?
All Roads to Peace#295.dst: Intentar mejorar armas y herramientas. Entrenar, pero acabar piedras de afilar. Etemitoro- ese ser yo, mi nombre... ¿Así decir?
All Roads to Peace#295.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#296.src: Weird human language. Anyway, know where good grindstone is- top of mountain east of fortress.
All Roads to Peace#296.dst: Idioma humano raro. En fin, saber dónde buena piedra de afilar- cima de montaña al este de fortaleza.
All Roads to Peace#296.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#297.src: There shortcut running through top by Ledant cave. Maybe dangerous, but not too much. Follow dead bushes on road and can get to top quickly.
All Roads to Peace#297.dst: Atajo por cima junto a cueva Ledant. Quizá peligroso, pero no mucho. Seguir arbustos secos en camino y llegar rápido a cima.
All Roads to Peace#297.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#298.src: May have something useful if bring me [Leaden Stone] for grind metal.
All Roads to Peace#298.dst: Quizá tener algo útil si traer [Leaden Stone] para afilar metal.
All Roads to Peace#298.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#299.src: Look- human want help? Then get Etemitoro- that is me, my name... Get-
All Roads to Peace#299.dst: Mira- ¿humano querer ayudar? Pues traer a Etemitoro- ese yo, mi nombre... Traer-
All Roads to Peace#299.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#300.src: Oh! You have [Leaden Stone]! Was focusing on work, didn't notice.
All Roads to Peace#300.dst: ¡Oh! ¡Tener [Leaden Stone]! Concentrado en trabajo, no ver.
All Roads to Peace#300.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#301.src: Here. Human like green gem for money, right? Not good for smithing though.
All Roads to Peace#301.dst: Toma. A humano gustar gema verde por dinero, ¿no? Pero no servir para forjar.
All Roads to Peace#301.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#302.src: Broken weapon parts not good alone, but still sharp. Can be used to make other good weapons! Reuse good for earth- waste not!
All Roads to Peace#302.dst: Piezas de arma rotas no servir solas, pero aún afiladas. ¡Poder hacer otras buenas armas! Reusar bueno para tierra- ¡no desperdiciar!
All Roads to Peace#302.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#304.src: Hm, healer human. Could swear, saw you walking around plains some time ago. What here for? Ressinter hurt again?
All Roads to Peace#304.dst: Mmm, humano sanador. Jurar que ver andar por llanuras hace tiempo. ¿Qué hacer aquí? ¿Ressinter herido otra vez?
All Roads to Peace#304.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#305.src: No? Well, am curious now. You try heal Ressinter...luck, maybe? Or did human really know what herbs do?
All Roads to Peace#305.dst: ¿No? Bueno, ahora tener curiosidad. Tú curar a Ressinter... ¿suerte? ¿O humano saber de verdad qué hacer hierbas?
All Roads to Peace#305.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#306.src: Want review. Want see human medicine knowledge. Will ask questions, human give answer. Simple. Ready?
All Roads to Peace#306.dst: Querer examinar. Ver saber médico de humano. Hacer preguntas, humano responder. Simple. ¿Listo?
All Roads to Peace#306.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#307.src: Good! So, first question. Ginkgo Leaf. What Gingko Leaf good for?
All Roads to Peace#307.dst: ¡Bien! Primera pregunta. Hoja de ginkgo. ¿Para qué servir hoja de ginkgo?
All Roads to Peace#307.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#308.src: Yes! Good. Gingko leaf help brain. Make feel better when stress, but make blood runny. Can be good for sometimes, but can be dangerous.
All Roads to Peace#308.dst: ¡Sí! Bien. Hoja de ginkgo ayudar cerebro. Aliviar estrés, pero hacer sangre líquida. A veces bueno, pero poder ser peligroso.
All Roads to Peace#308.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#309.src: So, second question. Sweetgale. What Sweetgale good for?
All Roads to Peace#309.dst: Segunda pregunta. Mirto de Brabante. ¿Para qué servir mirto?
All Roads to Peace#309.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#310.src: Nope. Sweetgale not for helping with that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#310.dst: No. Mirto no servir para eso. Mmm, quizá humano curar a Ressinter por suerte... Poder intentar otra vez.
All Roads to Peace#310.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#311.src: Nope. Sweetgale not for helping with that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#311.dst: No. Mirto no servir para eso. Mmm, quizá humano curar a Ressinter por suerte... Poder intentar otra vez.
All Roads to Peace#311.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#312.src: Mhm. Good! Sweetgale pulp makes bugs avoid. Also make irritated skin soothe. Very good for bug bite.
All Roads to Peace#312.dst: Ajá. ¡Bien! Pulpa de mirto espantar bichos. También calmar piel irritada. Muy bueno para picaduras.
All Roads to Peace#312.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#313.src: Here third question. Elderberry. Elderberry good for two thing. What Elderberry good for?
All Roads to Peace#313.dst: Tercera pregunta. Saúco. Saúco servir para dos cosas. ¿Para qué servir saúco?
All Roads to Peace#313.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#314.src: No, Elderberry not good for those. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#314.dst: No, saúco no servir para eso. Mmm, quizá humano curar a Ressinter por suerte... Poder intentar otra vez.
All Roads to Peace#314.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#315.src: Yes! Though, Elderberry also good for third thing. Can make good drink! Get drunk if ferment Elderberry, but that not medicine.
All Roads to Peace#315.dst: ¡Sí! Aunque saúco servir para tercera cosa. ¡Hacer buena bebida! Emborrachar si fermentar, pero eso no medicina.
All Roads to Peace#315.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#316.src: Last question for human. Feverfew. What Feverfew NOT help with?
All Roads to Peace#316.dst: Última pregunta para humano. Matricaria. ¿Con qué NO ayudar matricaria?
All Roads to Peace#316.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#317.src: Feverfew very good for heal that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#317.dst: Matricaria muy buena para curar eso. Mmm, quizá humano curar a Ressinter por suerte... Poder intentar otra vez.
All Roads to Peace#317.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#318.src: Feverfew very good for heal that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#318.dst: Matricaria muy buena para curar eso. Mmm, quizá humano curar a Ressinter por suerte... Poder intentar otra vez.
All Roads to Peace#318.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#321.src: That...correct! Not right, but correct! You...haha, you only help Ressinter through luck, right? Human not actually healer.
All Roads to Peace#321.dst: Eso... ¡acertar! ¡No correcto, pero acertar! Tú... jaja, tú solo ayudar a Ressinter por suerte, ¿no? Humano no ser sanador.
All Roads to Peace#321.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#322.src: Human have humor though! And human try hard to help. More than can say for most humans. Here then- try more heal, instead of be soldier.
All Roads to Peace#322.dst: ¡Pero humano tener humor! Y humano esforzarse por ayudar. Más que casi todos humanos. Toma- intentar curar más, en vez de ser soldado.
All Roads to Peace#322.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#323.src: World need more people to help other people. That human was willing to try mean many good thing.
All Roads to Peace#323.dst: Mundo necesitar más gente que ayudar a otros. Que humano querer intentar significar muchas cosas buenas.
All Roads to Peace#323.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#324.src: No, Elderberry not good for those. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#324.dst: No, saúco no servir para eso. Mmm, quizá humano curar a Ressinter por suerte... Poder intentar otra vez.
All Roads to Peace#324.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#325.src: No. Gingko Leaf bad for that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#325.dst: No. Hoja de ginkgo mala para eso. Mmm, quizá humano curar a Ressinter por suerte... Poder intentar otra vez.
All Roads to Peace#325.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#326.src: No. Gingko Leaf bad for that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#326.dst: No. Hoja de ginkgo mala para eso. Mmm, quizá humano curar a Ressinter por suerte... Poder intentar otra vez.
All Roads to Peace#326.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#327.src: Fine. Take your time. Will be here for while to make sure other healer okay.
All Roads to Peace#327.dst: Vale. Tomarse tiempo. Estar aquí un rato para asegurar que otro sanador bien.
All Roads to Peace#327.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#329.src: Human healer! Hello! This Onluk tower. Onluk tower two! Human help, so human welcome.
All Roads to Peace#329.dst: ¡Humano sanador! ¡Hola! Esto torre de Onluk. ¡Torre de Onluk dos! Humano ayudar, humano bienvenido.
All Roads to Peace#329.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#330.src: Tower one call tower one cause Onluk build tower one! This not usual spot for Onluk.
All Roads to Peace#330.dst: ¡Torre uno llamar torre uno porque Onluk construir torre uno! Este no sitio normal de Onluk.
All Roads to Peace#330.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#331.src: Usually at tower on small hill, across bridge. But because build tower by self, tower rickety.
All Roads to Peace#331.dst: Normalmente en torre de colina pequeña, cruzando puente. Pero construir torre solo, torre tambalear.
All Roads to Peace#331.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#332.src: Human helpful. Human get sturdy wood for fix tower? {p} has sturdy wood. Forest has wood too, but more magical than sturdy.
All Roads to Peace#332.dst: Humano ayudar. ¿Humano traer madera resistente para arreglar torre? {p} tener madera resistente. Bosque también, pero más mágica que resistente.
All Roads to Peace#332.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#333.src: [{~} Willow Planks] enough to make tower better, maybe. Willow strong wood! Can get?
All Roads to Peace#333.dst: [{~} Willow Planks] quizá bastar para mejorar torre. ¡Sauce madera fuerte! ¿Poder traer?
All Roads to Peace#333.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#334.src: Aha! Human have willow wood! Onluk fix tower now!
All Roads to Peace#334.dst: ¡Ajá! ¡Humano tener madera de sauce! ¡Onluk arreglar torre ya!
All Roads to Peace#334.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#335.src: Will repair Onluk tower one! Come see after fix!
All Roads to Peace#335.dst: ¡Reparar torre de Onluk uno! ¡Venir a ver tras arreglar!
All Roads to Peace#335.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#336.src: TOWER ONE REPAIRED! Hrahaaah! Yes! Human very helpful!
All Roads to Peace#336.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#337.src: Should go and see! Climb tower, shoot crossbow at Freelancer!
All Roads to Peace#337.dst: ¡Deber ir a ver! ¡Subir a torre, disparar ballesta a Freelancer!
All Roads to Peace#337.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#338.src: See? Onluk tower one much better than Onluk tower two! Cozy up here, and can see Fruludir tower too!
All Roads to Peace#338.dst: ¿Ver? ¡Torre de Onluk uno mucho mejor que torre dos! Aquí arriba cómodo, ¡y ver torre de Fruludir también!
All Roads to Peace#338.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#339.src: Human very helpful. Healer and woodcutter! Repairer of tower- Well, human not repair tower. Helper of repairer of tower!
All Roads to Peace#339.dst: Humano muy útil. ¡Sanador y leñador! Reparador de torre- Bueno, humano no reparar torre. ¡Ayudante de reparador de torre!
All Roads to Peace#339.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#340.src: Here, for help repair Onluk tower one!
All Roads to Peace#340.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#342.src: Speak to Ureietun at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to gain access to the Chieftess' hut
All Roads to Peace#342.dst: Habla con Ureietun en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para acceder a la choza de la cacica

All Roads to Peace#345.src: Human want talk Arrai-Veretel. In hut. Follow.
All Roads to Peace#345.dst: Humano querer hablar con Arrai-Veretel. En choza. Seguir.
All Roads to Peace#345.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#346.src: Arrai-Veretel! Human try help orc around fortress. Want talk.
All Roads to Peace#346.dst: ¡Arrai-Veretel! Humano ayudar a orcos por fortaleza. Querer hablar.
All Roads to Peace#346.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#347.src: Up to human now. Will not help more- choice is up to Arrai-Veretel.
All Roads to Peace#347.dst: Ahora cosa de humano. No ayudar más- decisión ser de Arrai-Veretel.
All Roads to Peace#347.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#348.src: Hmh. Zuett spoke about you. So you are human trying to end war?
All Roads to Peace#348.dst: Jmh. Zuett hablar de ti. ¿Así que tú humano que intentar acabar guerra?
All Roads to Peace#348.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#350.src: YOU! You human who kill Rai-Poxper! You human who attack other fort!
All Roads to Peace#350.dst: ¡TÚ! ¡Tú humano que matar a Rai-Poxper! ¡Tú humano que atacar otro fuerte!
All Roads to Peace#350.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#351.src: Need talk with Zuett again. You follow. And you stay quiet. Understand?
All Roads to Peace#351.dst: Necesitar hablar con Zuett otra vez. Tú seguir. Y tú callar. ¿Entender?
All Roads to Peace#351.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#352.src: Follow Arrai-Veretel into the meeting room at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
All Roads to Peace#352.dst: Sigue a Arrai-Veretel a la sala de reuniones en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

All Roads to Peace#353.src: ZUETT! You say human want peace. Do you know who human is?!
All Roads to Peace#353.dst: ¡ZUETT! Decir humano querer paz. ¿¡Saber quién ser humano!?
All Roads to Peace#353.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#354.src: Whuh- This good human! Heal Ressinter-
All Roads to Peace#354.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#357.src: Human ALSO attack other fort! Many orcs dead because this human!
All Roads to Peace#357.dst: ¡Humano TAMBIÉN atacar otro fuerte! ¡Muchos orcos muertos por humano!
All Roads to Peace#357.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#358.src: How can Zuett say human trying to end war, when human START WAR AGAIN?!
All Roads to Peace#358.dst: ¿Cómo Zuett decir humano querer paz, si EMPEZAR GUERRA OTRA VEZ?
All Roads to Peace#358.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#360.src: THAT. IS. THE. POINT!! Villager get human to fight for them! Cease-fire say Villager not attack orc. Then human come over ocean. Try make peace- get attack!
All Roads to Peace#360.dst: ¡¡ESO. SER. LA. CLAVE!! ¡Aldeano hacer que humano luchar por él! Tregua decir aldeano no atacar orco. Humano cruzar océano. Intentar paz- ¡recibir ataque!
All Roads to Peace#360.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#361.src: See human attack. Villager get human to attack, say lies to trick humans. Orcs defend self. Then, three Rai-orc die at Earthpit, Cliffhearth, and Trunkstump goblin camp.
All Roads to Peace#361.dst: Ver humano atacar. Aldeano hacer que humano atacar, mentir para engañar. Orcos defenderse. Luego, tres orcos Rai morir en Earthpit, Cliffhearth y campamento goblin Trunkstump.
All Roads to Peace#361.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#362.src: Human attack! Rai-Poxper take rightful toll for break cease-fire, but not war yet. Take magic axe from Villager city while magic power gone bad.
All Roads to Peace#362.dst: ¡Humano atacar! Rai-Poxper cobrar precio justo por romper tregua, pero aún no guerra. Coger hacha mágica de ciudad aldeana mientras magia ir mal.
All Roads to Peace#362.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#363.src: Villager and human attack first, but attack orc for take rightful toll like orc attack first! And human kill Rai-Poxper!
All Roads to Peace#363.dst: Aldeano y humano atacar primero, ¡pero culpar a orco por cobrar lo justo! ¡Y humano matar a Rai-Poxper!
All Roads to Peace#363.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#364.src: Orc take human fort build in dying earth forest. Cannot know if human planning another attack! But not kill human. Hold human instead.
All Roads to Peace#364.dst: Orco tomar fuerte humano en bosque de tierra moribunda. ¡No saber si humano planear otro ataque! Pero no matar humano. Retener humano.
All Roads to Peace#364.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#365.src: Then same human who kill Rai-Poxper come, kill bathing orc, break in fort, kill many Centerworld orc! Villager start, orc finish, villager no respect end!
All Roads to Peace#365.dst: ¡Luego mismo humano venir, matar orco en baño, asaltar fuerte, matar muchos de Centerworld! ¡Aldeano empezar, orco acabar, aldeano no respetar final!
All Roads to Peace#365.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#366.src: Yes, human tricked by Villager. But human still attack orc. Human still kill many orc! Human say want peace now?
All Roads to Peace#366.dst: Sí, humano engañado por aldeano. Pero igual atacar orco. ¡Igual matar muchos orcos! ¿Y ahora humano querer paz?
All Roads to Peace#366.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#367.src: What human done? Hunt boar? Help healer? Done busywork for other orc? That not make up for life lost.
All Roads to Peace#367.dst: ¿Qué hacer humano? ¿Cazar jabalí? ¿Ayudar sanador? ¿Hacer recados de orcos? Eso no compensar vidas perdidas.
All Roads to Peace#367.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#368.src: ...Arrai-Veretel right. What human done good, not make up for that. But, human still trying. If one human try to stop, more human can try to stop.
All Roads to Peace#368.dst: ...Arrai-Veretel tener razón. Lo bueno de humano no compensar eso. Pero humano seguir intentando. Si un humano intentar parar, más humanos poder intentar.
All Roads to Peace#368.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#369.src: War only killing us! If tried talk human instead of go sharpen spear and fight back, maybe human would learned faster than now.
All Roads to Peace#369.dst: ¡Guerra solo matarnos! Si hablar con humano en vez de afilar lanza y contraatacar, quizá humano aprender antes que ahora.
All Roads to Peace#369.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#370.src: Maybe. Maybe more orc be dead instead. Zuett, you cannot say what would happened. Wishful thinking, and I wish would happened too!
All Roads to Peace#370.dst: Quizá. Quizá morir más orcos en cambio. Zuett, no poder saber qué pasar. Ser ilusión, ¡y yo también desear que pasar!
All Roads to Peace#370.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#371.src: But with unfinished Wynnic, orc cannot talk well. YOU try learn language when idiot killing you! All sound stupid, and no time to learn for most!
All Roads to Peace#371.dst: ¡Pero con idioma Wynn a medias, orco no hablar bien! ¡TÚ intentar aprender idioma cuando idiota matarte! Todo sonar tonto, ¡y casi nadie tener tiempo!
All Roads to Peace#371.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#372.src: But human listen to Zuett, even if not sound smart. Arrai-Veretel not respect human. Justified, but still cause problem.
All Roads to Peace#372.dst: Pero humano escuchar a Zuett, aunque no sonar listo. Arrai-Veretel no respetar humano. Justificado, pero igual causar problema.
All Roads to Peace#372.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#373.src: Grrh. FINE! Zuett want peace so bad? Human want peace so bad? Human spilled much orc blood. Only way out of war, is through. We will battle.
All Roads to Peace#373.dst: Grrh. ¡VALE! ¿Zuett querer tanto paz? ¿Humano querer tanto paz? Humano derramar mucha sangre orca. Única salida de guerra, atravesarla. Luchar.
All Roads to Peace#373.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#374.src: No tricks. No backup. Nothing but battle between human and myself. If human can fight in ritual arena and win, then will listen.
All Roads to Peace#374.dst: Sin trucos. Sin refuerzos. Nada más que batalla entre humano y yo. Si humano luchar en arena ritual y ganar, escuchar.
All Roads to Peace#374.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#375.src: Listen, Zuett. I want war stop too. But you must understand the risk here. Cannot make decision lightly. Villager go back on word- see writing, find way around writing.
All Roads to Peace#375.dst: Escucha, Zuett. Yo también querer fin de guerra. Pero deber entender riesgo. No decidir a la ligera. Aldeano faltar a palabra- ver escrito, buscar forma de esquivar escrito.
All Roads to Peace#375.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#376.src: Try threaten us with iron corpse machine! So, battle will happen. Will prepare ritual and gather crowd. Prepare, human.
All Roads to Peace#376.dst: ¡Amenazarnos con máquina de cadáver de hierro! Así que haber batalla. Preparar ritual y público. Prepárate, humano.
All Roads to Peace#376.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#377.src: Prepare, human. Arrai-Veretel strongest orc. Strong in everything. Mind, body, power, spirit.
All Roads to Peace#377.dst: Prepararse, humano. Arrai-Veretel orco más fuerte. Fuerte en todo. Mente, cuerpo, poder, espíritu.
All Roads to Peace#377.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#378.src: Zuett still think human trying to be good. Still think can help stupid war end. Knock sense into Arrai-Veretel.
All Roads to Peace#378.dst: Zuett aún creer humano querer ser bueno. Creer poder acabar guerra estúpida. Hacer entrar en razón a Arrai-Veretel.
All Roads to Peace#378.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#379.src: Defeat Arrai-Veretel in combat in the arena below the orcish meeting room.
All Roads to Peace#379.dst: Derrota a Arrai-Veretel en combate en la arena bajo la sala de reuniones orca.

All Roads to Peace#380.src: Before fight... Must perform ritual. This challenge need respect. I do not repect you, human, but will show respect anyway.
All Roads to Peace#380.dst: Antes de luchar... Deber hacer ritual. Este desafío necesitar respeto. No respetarte, humano, pero mostrar respeto igual.
All Roads to Peace#380.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#381.src: May the earth herself hear us... Though we do not speak as we once have...
All Roads to Peace#381.dst: Que la propia tierra nos oiga... Aunque ya no hablemos como antaño...
All Roads to Peace#381.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#382.src: We, as humble inhabitants of the land she has gifted us, pledge this show in honor of her.
All Roads to Peace#382.dst: Nosotros, humildes moradores de la tierra que ella nos dio, ofrecemos este combate en su honor.
All Roads to Peace#382.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#383.src: May she be sated, grow healthy, and honor us in turn for this offering.
All Roads to Peace#383.dst: Que ella quede saciada, crezca sana y nos honre a cambio por esta ofrenda.
All Roads to Peace#383.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#386.src: HMH! Human tough. Fine- Will take battle seriously now!
All Roads to Peace#386.dst: ¡JMH! Humano duro. Vale- ¡Luchar en serio ahora!
All Roads to Peace#386.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#387.src: For sake of those killed before me, I will not lose!
All Roads to Peace#387.dst: ¡Por los caídos antes que yo, no perder!
All Roads to Peace#387.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#390.src: No, no! Arrai-Veretel hurt bad! Human try kill Arrai-Veretel!!
All Roads to Peace#390.dst: ¡No, no! ¡Arrai-Veretel muy herido! ¡¡Humano intentar matar a Arrai-Veretel!!
All Roads to Peace#390.speaker: Audience Orc

All Roads to Peace#391.src: AM FINE! Stupid, idiot! No interrupting while ritual fight!
All Roads to Peace#391.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#392.src: Human win. Hate to say, but human win. Not even try kill me.
All Roads to Peace#392.dst: Humano ganar. Odiar decirlo, pero humano ganar. Ni intentar matarme.
All Roads to Peace#392.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#393.src: Give time. Battle hard-fought- Need to wind down. Wait in meeting room. Will...discuss terms.
All Roads to Peace#393.dst: Dar tiempo. Batalla dura- Necesitar calmarse. Esperar en sala de reuniones. Hablar... de condiciones.
All Roads to Peace#393.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#394.src: Feel like insult to stop war we did not start. But, gave promise. Human strong. Still not make up for so much death...
All Roads to Peace#394.dst: Sentir como insulto parar guerra que no empezar. Pero dar promesa. Humano fuerte. Aún no compensar tanta muerte...
All Roads to Peace#394.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#395.src: But human trying. Really, really trying. Will admit, did not know about human killing all when saw... Still. If war ending, deaths also ending.
All Roads to Peace#395.dst: Pero humano intentar. Intentar de verdad, de verdad. Admitir, no saber que humano matar tanto al ver... Aun así. Si guerra acabar, muertes también acabar.
All Roads to Peace#395.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#396.src: Hmh. Human probably trying to end war to start with. Just on wrong side. Can agree, Zuett.
All Roads to Peace#396.dst: Jmh. Humano quizá querer acabar guerra desde inicio. Solo en bando equivocado. Estar de acuerdo, Zuett.
All Roads to Peace#396.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#397.src: Will stop attacking cities. Orcs still defend selves! Will not turn bellies for spears. Still not trust villagers- only give cease-fire.
All Roads to Peace#397.dst: Dejar de atacar ciudades. ¡Orcos aún defenderse! No enseñar barriga a lanzas. Aún no confiar en aldeanos- solo dar tregua.
All Roads to Peace#397.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#398.src: Give opportunity for human to learn and villager to show respect. They did not attack, then will be open to more negotiation.
All Roads to Peace#398.dst: Dar ocasión para que humano aprender y aldeano mostrar respeto. Si no atacar, estar abiertos a más negociación.
All Roads to Peace#398.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#399.src: Will say- many orc hold grudge, in plains. Many orc probably still attack. If so, human also can defend self. But, human should avoid fight there.
All Roads to Peace#399.dst: Advertir- muchos orcos guardar rencor, en llanuras. Muchos orcos quizá aún atacar. Si así, humano también defenderse. Pero humano evitar lucha allí.
All Roads to Peace#399.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#400.src: ...if villager continue attack, will defend selves as before. Human, make sure villager know this.
All Roads to Peace#400.dst: ...si aldeano seguir atacando, defenderse como antes. Humano, asegurar que aldeano saber esto.
All Roads to Peace#400.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#401.src: Mhm. Villager more stupid than human. Villager do many terrible thing. But endless war not help fix.
All Roads to Peace#401.dst: Ajá. Aldeano más tonto que humano. Aldeano hacer muchas cosas terribles. Pero guerra sin fin no ayudar a arreglar.
All Roads to Peace#401.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#402.src: Peace first step to heal. ...unless villager to stupid thing. Then may need fight anyway.
All Roads to Peace#402.dst: Paz primer paso para sanar. ...salvo que aldeano hacer tontería. Entonces quizá luchar igual.
All Roads to Peace#402.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#403.src: So Zuett not naive. Some things...cannot...be...forgiven. Villager treading line close.
All Roads to Peace#403.dst: Así que Zuett no ingenuo. Algunas cosas... no... poder... perdonarse. Aldeano estar al límite.
All Roads to Peace#403.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#404.src: Human seen earth rotting in north. Have to have, since took fort in rotting place. Forest used to be living thing. Now dying. Dead in north-east.
All Roads to Peace#404.dst: Humano ver tierra pudrirse en norte. Deber ver, si tomar fuerte en sitio podrido. Bosque antes ser cosa viva. Ahora morir. Muerto en noreste.
All Roads to Peace#404.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#405.src: Start happening only few decades before Villager leave across ocean! Villager always run away from problem.
All Roads to Peace#405.dst: ¡Empezar solo pocas décadas antes de que aldeano cruzar océano! Aldeano siempre huir de problemas.
All Roads to Peace#405.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#406.src: And villager create own problems. Can only mean villager hurt earth, and make her die, slow and sure. Many orc used to live there.
All Roads to Peace#406.dst: Y aldeano crear propios problemas. Solo significar que aldeano herir tierra, y hacerla morir, lento y seguro. Muchos orcos vivir allí.
All Roads to Peace#406.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#407.src: Even after villager move in, try kick orc out, many orc live there...then earth start to die. Has not come south- and we are south!
All Roads to Peace#407.dst: Incluso cuando aldeano llegar, intentar echar orco, muchos orcos vivir allí... luego tierra empezar a morir. No llegar al sur- ¡y nosotros en sur!
All Roads to Peace#407.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#408.src: But...that off-track. No more war. Give this to whatever villager need to see it.
All Roads to Peace#408.dst: Pero... eso desviarse. No más guerra. Dar esto a aldeano que necesitar verlo.
All Roads to Peace#408.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#409.src: Show Captain Goruca the Cease-Fire Agreement.
All Roads to Peace#409.dst: Muestra el Acuerdo de Alto el Fuego al capitán Goruca.

All Roads to Peace#410.src: Human! You're back! That certainly took you a while. I suppose all things considered I shouldn't be surprised. Those orcs are tough.
All Roads to Peace#410.dst: ¡Humano! ¡Has vuelto! Sí que has tardado. Aunque, bien pensado, no debería sorprenderme. Esos orcos son duros.
All Roads to Peace#410.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#411.src: What's this? You actually managed to get the brutes to sign a ceasefire?! I was expecting you to come back with a bloody prize, not a signature!
All Roads to Peace#411.dst: ¿Qué es esto? ¿¡De verdad lograste que esos brutos firmaran un alto el fuego!? ¡Esperaba que volvieras con un trofeo sangriento, no con una firma!
All Roads to Peace#411.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#412.src: After the way they so savagely attacked our outpost and the way they rebuffed our diplomacy squads, I wasn't expecting this.
All Roads to Peace#412.dst: Después de atacar con tanta saña nuestro puesto avanzado y de rechazar a nuestros diplomáticos, no me esperaba esto.
All Roads to Peace#412.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#413.src: Still, this is good! The terms are a bit more airtight than I'd prefer, but I suppose as long as they're out of our hair anything will do.
All Roads to Peace#413.dst: ¡Aun así, es una buena noticia! Las condiciones son más estrictas de lo que me gustaría, pero mientras nos dejen en paz, cualquier cosa vale.
All Roads to Peace#413.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#414.src: Hm? The orcs were talking about the decay up north? Not sure how that matters. It isn't like anyone knows what's causing it.
All Roads to Peace#414.dst: ¿Mmm? ¿Los orcos hablaban de la Decadencia del norte? No sé qué tiene que ver. Nadie sabe qué la causa.
All Roads to Peace#414.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#415.src: I mean, have you heard the rumors flying from {p}? Saying witches are cursing the land, hah! Well, that's besides the point.
All Roads to Peace#415.dst: Digo, ¿has oído los rumores que llegan de {p}? ¡Dicen que unas brujas maldicen la tierra, ja! Bueno, eso no viene al caso.
All Roads to Peace#415.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#416.src: Here- your reward. I'd intended on giving you the mask so you could try and sneak in like one of them, but I...well, I forgot about it til you'd already left.
All Roads to Peace#416.dst: Toma- tu recompensa. Pensaba darte la máscara para que te colaras disfrazado de uno de ellos, pero... bueno, me olvidé hasta que ya te habías ido.
All Roads to Peace#416.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#417.src: But I DID magically fortify it into a potent piece of gear instead! So it ought to serve you well. We thank you for your service, human!
All Roads to Peace#417.dst: ¡Pero SÍ la reforcé con magia hasta convertirla en un equipo potente! Así que te servirá bien. ¡Gracias por tu servicio, humano!
All Roads to Peace#417.speaker: Captain Goruca

An Iron Heart Part I#001.src: Oh, you there! I wasn't expecting a human soldier to be here, but you've come at a perfect time. I could use some help, see.
An Iron Heart Part I#001.dst: ¡Oh, oye, tú! No esperaba ver aquí a un soldado humano, pero llegas en el momento perfecto. Me vendría bien ayuda.
An Iron Heart Part I#001.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#002.src: I'm certain you know about Guard Golems, yes? They're manufactured here in Gavel, and I bought one recently.
An Iron Heart Part I#002.dst: Conoces los Gólems guardianes, ¿verdad? Se fabrican aquí en Gavel, y hace poco compré uno.
An Iron Heart Part I#002.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#003.src: The goblins keep trying to forage in my farms, you see- I needed something to keep them out, and a Golem would have been perfect.
An Iron Heart Part I#003.dst: Verás, los goblins no paran de rebuscar en mis granjas- necesitaba algo para echarlos, y un gólem habría sido perfecto.
An Iron Heart Part I#003.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#004.src: But, shortly after I activated it, the thing attacked me! I nearly got killed- It was ramming itself against boulders and walls...
An Iron Heart Part I#004.dst: Pero, poco después de activarlo, ¡la cosa me atacó! Casi me mata- Se lanzaba contra rocas y paredes...
An Iron Heart Part I#004.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#005.src: I obviously was sold a defective model... That golem is a danger to everything around it. Do you think you're up to subduing it?
An Iron Heart Part I#005.dst: Está claro que me vendieron un modelo defectuoso... Ese gólem es un peligro para todo lo que lo rodea. ¿Te ves capaz de reducirlo?
An Iron Heart Part I#005.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#006.src: It's shed a trail of scrap, as you can see. Please, follow the trail of scrap and keep it from causing anyone more damage!
An Iron Heart Part I#006.dst: Ha dejado un rastro de chatarra, como ves. Por favor, sigue el rastro y evita que haga más daño a nadie.
An Iron Heart Part I#006.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#007.src: Find the defective Guard Golem in the mountain at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
An Iron Heart Part I#007.dst: Encuentra el Gólem guardián defectuoso en la montaña en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part I#009.src: ...I am... w̶h̴at^s my...na̷m̸e...? I had one...

An Iron Heart Part I#010.src: Re...remember!! W̵H̸A̶T̸ IS MY N̵A̴M̵E̵? My life?

An Iron Heart Part I#011.src: REMEMBER!! No...no orders! No dREMEMBER!! No...no o irectREMEMBER!!
An Iron Heart Part I#011.dst: ¡¡RECUERDA!! No... ¡no hay órdenes! No oRECUERDA!! No... no ha órdRECUERDA!!

An Iron Heart Part I#012.src: My name!! My life! I wo̴n't hurt them! The pain helps me reme...who's there?! LEAVE! PL̴E̵A̷SE!
An Iron Heart Part I#012.dst: ¡¡Mi nombre!! ¡Mi vida! ¡No les haré daño! El dolor me ayuda a recor... ¿¡quién anda ahí!? ¡VETE! ¡POR FAVOR!
An Iron Heart Part I#012.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part I#013.src: No directives!! Who did this?! I can't...s-stop giving me ORDERS!!
An Iron Heart Part I#013.dst: ¡¡Sin directrices!! ¿¡Quién ha sido!? No puedo... ¡¡d-dejad de darme ÓRDENES!!
An Iron Heart Part I#013.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part I#014.src: N- MORE COLDNESS! NO MORE V̴O̸I̶C̴E̷S THAT AREN'T MINE! MY NAME IS [̶E̷R̶R̷O̸R̷]!! [̶E̷R̶R̷O̸R̷]!! NOOO!!
An Iron Heart Part I#014.dst: N- ¡MÁS FRÍO! ¡BASTA DE VOCES QUE NO SON MÍAS! ¡¡MI NOMBRE ES [ERROR]!! ¡¡[ERROR]!! ¡¡NOOO!!
An Iron Heart Part I#014.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part I#015.src: Subdue the defective Guard Golem and return to Duvale at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
An Iron Heart Part I#015.dst: Reduce al Gólem guardián defectuoso y vuelve con Duvale en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part I#016.src: Falling...apart...this isn't who I I I was... My... My... My my my my my name is. Was. Is. Was. Is. IS...! [̶E̷R̶R̷O̸R̷]... Ma[̶E̷R̶R̷O̸ine... Ma̷deleine!! I'm Madeleine... I... I-I-IIIIIIIIII-
An Iron Heart Part I#016.dst: Me... deshago... este no es quien yo yo yo era... Mi... Mi... Mi mi mi mi nombre es. Era. Es. Era. Es. ¡¡ES...!! [ERROR]... Ma[ERROine... ¡¡Madeleine!! Soy Madeleine... Yo... Y-Y-YYYYYYYYYY-
An Iron Heart Part I#016.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part I#017.src: Were you able to subdue the golem? You certainly look like you're in one piece.
An Iron Heart Part I#017.dst: ¿Has podido reducir al gólem? Desde luego pareces estar de una pieza.
An Iron Heart Part I#017.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#018.src: Ach...that stings. I shouldn't be surprised you had to destroy it, but that was still a big wasted investment for me.
An Iron Heart Part I#018.dst: Ay... qué rabia. No debería sorprenderme que tuvieras que destruirlo, pero ha sido una inversión tirada a la basura.
An Iron Heart Part I#018.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#019.src: Still, it makes me wonder...it sounded like it was talking when I first turned it on- Wait, you heard it too?
An Iron Heart Part I#019.dst: Aun así, me hace pensar... parecía que hablaba cuando lo encendí- Espera, ¿tú también lo oíste?
An Iron Heart Part I#019.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#020.src: Hm. There are some unsavory rumors about the factory, come to think of it... Maybe there's some stock to them.
An Iron Heart Part I#020.dst: Mmm. Ahora que lo pienso, corren rumores feos sobre la fábrica... Quizá tengan algo de cierto.
An Iron Heart Part I#020.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#021.src: It said a name? Madeleine? It doesn't exactly ring a bell, but that's...rather concerning. I never mentioned a Madeleine to it.
An Iron Heart Part I#021.dst: ¿Dijo un nombre? ¿Madeleine? No me suena de nada, pero eso es... bastante preocupante. Nunca le mencioné a ninguna Madeleine.
An Iron Heart Part I#021.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#022.src: This is worth sending onto the police, really. I think I might have to write to {p}- the factory is near there.
An Iron Heart Part I#022.dst: Esto merece llegar a la policía, la verdad. Creo que tendré que escribir a {p}- la fábrica está cerca de allí.
An Iron Heart Part I#022.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#023.src: Til then, here. Consider this your reward for helping me out, brave Human. Good luck out there.
An Iron Heart Part I#023.dst: Hasta entonces, toma. Considéralo tu recompensa por ayudarme, valiente humano. Buena suerte ahí fuera.
An Iron Heart Part I#023.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part II#000.dst: Habla con el detective Hart en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part II#001.src: Hotor, Athomo, Arperi, Etyir, Taiyroth, On'omi, Danin, Nesys, Onton. All missing...
An Iron Heart Part II#001.dst: Hotor, Athomo, Arperi, Etyir, Taiyroth, On'omi, Danin, Nesys, Onton. Todos desaparecidos...
An Iron Heart Part II#001.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#002.src: Etan is the latest. You don't happen to know anything about these people, soldier?
An Iron Heart Part II#002.dst: Etan es el último. ¿No sabrás nada de esta gente, soldado?
An Iron Heart Part II#002.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#003.src: Citizens are going missing at an alarming rate. We have lost {~} people in just {~} weeks. There hasn't been a trace of them anywhere.
An Iron Heart Part II#003.dst: Los ciudadanos desaparecen a un ritmo alarmante. Hemos perdido a {~} personas en solo {~} semanas. Y ni rastro de ellas.
An Iron Heart Part II#003.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#004.src: You wouldn't have expected it, with all the guard golems we've been donated recently! {p} should be safer than ever.
An Iron Heart Part II#004.dst: ¡Quién lo diría, con todos los gólems guardianes que nos han donado! {p} debería ser más segura que nunca.
An Iron Heart Part II#004.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#005.src: Of course I have my suspicions, there are rumors floating around about...shady business going on.
An Iron Heart Part II#005.dst: Claro que tengo mis sospechas. Corren rumores sobre... negocios turbios.
An Iron Heart Part II#005.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#006.src: I don't know who to trust in these circumstances, so if you would be willing to aid in this investigation, I'd be rather thankful.
An Iron Heart Part II#006.dst: No sé en quién confiar en estas circunstancias, así que si quieres ayudar en la investigación, te lo agradecería mucho.
An Iron Heart Part II#006.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#007.src: The “Great” Daxe is a man with a criminal past. He knows things the police don't, but he won't talk with me, given my status.
An Iron Heart Part II#007.dst: El “Gran” Daxe es un hombre con pasado criminal. Sabe cosas que la policía no, pero conmigo no hablará, por mi cargo.
An Iron Heart Part II#007.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#008.src: Can you try to get some information from him? You can find his hut west from here. Next to that Elven girl's camp.
An Iron Heart Part II#008.dst: ¿Puedes sacarle algo de información? Su cabaña está al oeste, junto al campamento de esa chica elfa.
An Iron Heart Part II#008.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#009.src: Follow the west road and speak with Daxe in his home at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
An Iron Heart Part II#009.dst: Sigue el camino del oeste y habla con Daxe en su casa en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part II#010.src: Oh, so a human wishes to wander into the home of the great Daxe?
An Iron Heart Part II#010.dst: Vaya, ¿un humano quiere colarse en la casa del gran Daxe?
An Iron Heart Part II#010.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#011.src: Unfortunately for you, I'm not fond of visitors. I've left my criminal past behind.
An Iron Heart Part II#011.dst: Por desgracia para ti, no me gustan las visitas. He dejado atrás mi pasado criminal.
An Iron Heart Part II#011.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#012.src: So go on. I don't have anything to tell you.
An Iron Heart Part II#012.dst: Así que vete. No tengo nada que contarte.
An Iron Heart Part II#012.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#013.src: Oh, so a human wishes to wander into the home of the great Daxe?
An Iron Heart Part II#013.dst: Vaya, ¿un humano quiere colarse en la casa del gran Daxe?
An Iron Heart Part II#013.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#014.src: Unfortunately for you, I'm not fond of visitors. I've left my criminal past behind...mh?
An Iron Heart Part II#014.dst: Por desgracia para ti, no me gustan las visitas. He dejado atrás mi pasado criminal... ¿mh?
An Iron Heart Part II#014.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#015.src: What's that device you have there? So you already know about this, then...?
An Iron Heart Part II#015.dst: ¿Qué es ese aparato que llevas? Entonces, ¿ya sabes de esto...?
An Iron Heart Part II#015.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#016.src: Hm! If you already know, what do you need the information for?
An Iron Heart Part II#016.dst: ¡Hm! Si ya lo sabes, ¿para qué quieres la información?
An Iron Heart Part II#016.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#018.src: MADELEINE! Where's...wait! What's happening, where am I? WHO'S VOICE IS THIS?!
An Iron Heart Part II#018.dst: ¡MADELEINE! ¿Dónde está...? ¡Espera! ¿Qué pasa, dónde estoy? ¡¿DE QUIÉN ES ESTA VOZ?!
An Iron Heart Part II#018.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part II#019.src: Wait, what in the world is going on?! What did you do to my golem?!
An Iron Heart Part II#019.dst: Espera, ¡¿qué demonios está pasando?! ¡¿Qué le has hecho a mi gólem?!
An Iron Heart Part II#019.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#020.src: They... my daughter... SHUT UP! QUIET! Who's giving me orders- NO ORDERS! Cold! COLD!
An Iron Heart Part II#020.dst: Ellos... mi hija... ¡CÁLLATE! ¡SILENCIO! ¿Quién me da órdenes- ¡NADA DE ÓRDENES! ¡Frío! ¡FRÍO!
An Iron Heart Part II#020.speaker: Guard Golem?

An Iron Heart Part II#022.src: You...you aren't...dead steel? You remember your name...?!
An Iron Heart Part II#022.dst: Tú... ¿no eres... acero muerto? ¡¿Recuerdas tu nombre...?!
An Iron Heart Part II#022.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#023.src: STOP GIVING ME ORDERS!! I'M...I'M THEODORE! I'M NOT A SERVANT! I...where has my life gone...? Where is...
An Iron Heart Part II#023.dst: ¡¡BASTA DE ÓRDENES!! ¡SOY... SOY THEODORE! ¡NO SOY UN SIRVIENTE! Yo... ¿y mi vida...? ¿Dónde está...
An Iron Heart Part II#023.speaker: Guard Golem?

An Iron Heart Part II#024.src: Madeleine... Where are you- RE-AFFIRMING DIRECTIVES. BZZT. ... ... ...
An Iron Heart Part II#024.speaker: Guard Golem?

An Iron Heart Part II#025.src: I... I can't believe it. They didn't...they're still...
An Iron Heart Part II#025.dst: Yo... No puedo creerlo. Ellos no... siguen...
An Iron Heart Part II#025.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#026.src: Dear god, that...that must...I'll talk. I will tell you what I know.
An Iron Heart Part II#026.dst: Dios mío, eso... eso tiene que... Hablaré. Te contaré lo que sé.
An Iron Heart Part II#026.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#027.src: I broke into the golem factory for petty thievery...and found them. They gave me this Golem... Theodore...later to keep me quiet.
An Iron Heart Part II#027.dst: Entré en la fábrica de gólems para robar algo... y los encontré. Luego me dieron este gólem... Theodore... para que callara.
An Iron Heart Part II#027.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#028.src: They assured me that they were gone, that every last bit of them was erased. They...those monsters lied to me...
An Iron Heart Part II#028.dst: Me aseguraron que ya no estaban, que no quedaba nada de ellos. Me... esos monstruos me mintieron...
An Iron Heart Part II#028.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#029.src: Follow this road west and turn right. Look for Urelix. The factory is hidden in a cabin, it won't look like a factory.
An Iron Heart Part II#029.dst: Sigue este camino al oeste y gira a la derecha. Busca a Urelix. La fábrica está oculta en una cabaña, no lo parece.
An Iron Heart Part II#029.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#030.src: Head to the Golem Factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
An Iron Heart Part II#030.dst: Ve a la fábrica de gólems en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part II#031.src: Find a way to deactivate the Guard Golem
An Iron Heart Part II#031.dst: Encuentra la forma de desactivar al gólem guardián

An Iron Heart Part II#032.src: And what do you think you are doing, barging into my humble home like this? Do they not teach humans manners in Wynn?
An Iron Heart Part II#032.dst: ¿Y qué crees que haces, irrumpiendo así en mi humilde hogar? ¿Es que en Wynn no enseñan modales a los humanos?
An Iron Heart Part II#032.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#033.src: Ah, yes. You are correct- I oversee the creation of Guard Golems. What of it?
An Iron Heart Part II#033.dst: Ah, sí. Tienes razón- Superviso la creación de gólems guardianes. ¿Y qué?
An Iron Heart Part II#033.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#034.src: Oh, you believe that our company is illicit somehow? You insult me so!
An Iron Heart Part II#034.dst: ¿Crees que nuestra empresa es ilegal? ¡Qué insulto!
An Iron Heart Part II#034.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#035.src: My golems have protected countless people for years. So if you think my company is corrupt, why don't you take a look around?
An Iron Heart Part II#035.dst: Mis gólems llevan años protegiendo a muchísima gente. Si crees que mi empresa es corrupta, ¿por qué no echas un vistazo?
An Iron Heart Part II#035.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#036.src: Go on, search through my house. See if you can find anything.
An Iron Heart Part II#036.dst: Adelante, registra mi casa. A ver si encuentras algo.
An Iron Heart Part II#036.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#037.src: Find a way into the factory in Urelix's house
An Iron Heart Part II#037.dst: Encuentra la entrada a la fábrica en la casa de Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#038.src: Escape the Golem Factory and find Urelix.
An Iron Heart Part II#038.dst: Escapa de la fábrica de gólems y encuentra a Urelix.

An Iron Heart Part II#039.src: Initiating Chip Insertion Machine - All personell in machine be advised, avoid the spikes.
An Iron Heart Part II#039.dst: Iniciando máquina de inserción de chips - Todo el personal en la máquina: eviten los pinchos.

An Iron Heart Part II#040.src: Intruder Detected - Emergency meltdown initiated. Please evacuate immediately via the emergency exit.
An Iron Heart Part II#040.dst: Intruso detectado - Fusión de emergencia iniciada. Evacúen de inmediato por la salida de emergencia.

An Iron Heart Part II#041.src: Talk to Dr. Urelix in his office
An Iron Heart Part II#041.dst: Habla con el Dr. Urelix en su despacho

An Iron Heart Part II#042.src: Well well, look at you, here at the end of my factory. I wasn't expecting you to survive the production line. I thought you'd be one of ours by now.
An Iron Heart Part II#042.dst: Vaya, vaya, mírate, al final de mi fábrica. No esperaba que sobrevivieras a la cadena de producción. Creía que ya serías uno de los nuestros.
An Iron Heart Part II#042.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#043.src: That's that, I suppose. Yes, this is indeed where all the iron golems you've ever encountered were made, and if you've gotten here, you know how we make them.
An Iron Heart Part II#043.dst: En fin, supongo. Sí, aquí se fabricaron todos los gólems de hierro que hayas visto, y si has llegado hasta aquí, ya sabes cómo los hacemos.
An Iron Heart Part II#043.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#044.src: Yes, metal forged with flesh...an unbeatable combination. Emotions and memories must be repressed in order to maintain obedience, of course...
An Iron Heart Part II#044.dst: Sí, metal forjado con carne... una combinación imbatible. Claro que hay que reprimir emociones y recuerdos para mantener la obediencia...
An Iron Heart Part II#044.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#045.src: Have you ever looked at a golem's eyes? Sometimes they look back, yes. The person they once were is still in there. I almost feel a connection when I make eye contact with them...
An Iron Heart Part II#045.dst: ¿Alguna vez has mirado a un gólem a los ojos? A veces te devuelven la mirada, sí. La persona que fueron sigue ahí dentro. Casi siento una conexión al mirarlos a los ojos...
An Iron Heart Part II#045.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#046.src: It's odd, honestly. I'm sure they don't feel much except cold, supposing our safeguards stay in place, of course. I have to assume malfunctions happened to have had you find us out...
An Iron Heart Part II#046.dst: La verdad, es curioso. Seguro que no sienten mucho más que frío, siempre que nuestras salvaguardas sigan en su sitio. Supongo que algún fallo te trajo hasta nosotros...
An Iron Heart Part II#046.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#047.src: Oh, look at me now, rambling! I must say I have been alone for a while...well, lacking any company that converses! So, I shall make you a deal, human.
An Iron Heart Part II#047.dst: ¡Mírame, divagando! Debo decir que llevo tiempo solo... bueno, sin compañía que converse. Así que te propongo un trato, humano.
An Iron Heart Part II#047.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#048.src: I will give you a substantial amount of emeralds and a piece of quality iron armor in return for your silence on my little operation here.
An Iron Heart Part II#048.dst: Te daré una buena cantidad de esmeraldas y una armadura de hierro de calidad a cambio de tu silencio sobre mi pequeña operación.
An Iron Heart Part II#048.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#049.src: I'll advise you to take my deal. Imagine what will happen if you should report my operation to the police. Yes, you'll save a few folk here, but how will the golems be made?
An Iron Heart Part II#049.dst: Te aconsejo aceptar. Imagina qué pasaría si denunciaras mi operación a la policía. Sí, salvarías a unos cuantos, pero ¿cómo se harían los gólems?
An Iron Heart Part II#049.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#050.src: Without them, both Gavel and Wynn would struggle under the weight of our wars. Is this operation so immoral, then? Sacrifices must be made in order to survive.
An Iron Heart Part II#050.dst: Sin ellos, Gavel y Wynn sufrirían bajo el peso de nuestras guerras. ¿Tan inmoral es esta operación? Hay que hacer sacrificios para sobrevivir.
An Iron Heart Part II#050.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#051.src: I'll give you some time to consider my proposition. Take from my chest if you wish to take up my offer, otherwise get out of here and do not return.
An Iron Heart Part II#051.dst: Te daré tiempo para pensar mi propuesta. Coge lo que hay en mi cofre si aceptas; si no, vete de aquí y no vuelvas.
An Iron Heart Part II#051.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#052.src: Either take the bribe or return to Detective Hart
An Iron Heart Part II#052.dst: Acepta el soborno o vuelve con el detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#053.src: Ahh, a wise choice. Production will continue then...and you've earned yourself a pocket full of emeralds at the same time.
An Iron Heart Part II#053.dst: Ahh, sabia elección. La producción seguirá, entonces... y de paso te has ganado un bolsillo lleno de esmeraldas.
An Iron Heart Part II#053.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#054.src: Whether you truly see things my way or simply understand that my work is necessary, I couldn't care less. What matters is not your morality, but your choice.
An Iron Heart Part II#054.dst: Me da igual si de verdad piensas como yo o si solo entiendes que mi trabajo es necesario. Lo que importa no es tu moral, sino tu elección.
An Iron Heart Part II#054.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#055.src: Enjoy your armor and money, and please escort yourself to the exit.
An Iron Heart Part II#055.dst: Disfruta de tu armadura y tu dinero, y ten la bondad de ir hacia la salida.
An Iron Heart Part II#055.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#056.src: You've returned, I see. Any news on the situation?
An Iron Heart Part II#056.dst: Has vuelto, por lo que veo. ¿Alguna novedad?
An Iron Heart Part II#056.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#057.src: Yes, we're aware of the Golem factory. Were the criminals using it as a base?
An Iron Heart Part II#057.dst: Sí, conocemos la fábrica de gólems. ¿La usaban los criminales como base?
An Iron Heart Part II#057.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#058.src: Wha...fleshcrafting?! Golems are powered by suspended villagers?! Is this true, soldier?
An Iron Heart Part II#058.dst: ¿Qué...? ¡¿Fabricar con carne?! ¡¿Los gólems funcionan con aldeanos suspendidos?! ¿Es cierto, soldado?
An Iron Heart Part II#058.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#059.src: We'll need to round up reinforcements immediately, and storm this factory! This cannot go on a moment longer!
An Iron Heart Part II#059.dst: ¡Hay que reunir refuerzos ya y asaltar esa fábrica! ¡Esto no puede seguir ni un momento más!
An Iron Heart Part II#059.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#060.src: Don't think you'll go unrewarded, soldier. There will be justice for this grave defilement of our people.
An Iron Heart Part II#060.dst: No creas que quedarás sin recompensa, soldado. Habrá justicia por esta grave profanación de nuestra gente.
An Iron Heart Part II#060.speaker: Detective Hart

Apotheosis (Quest)#000.src: Head to {p} and find your friends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Apotheosis (Quest)#000.dst: Ve a {p} y encuentra a tus amigos en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#001.src: Fight through {p} and find your friends.
Apotheosis (Quest)#001.dst: Ábrete paso por {p} y encuentra a tus amigos.

Apotheosis (Quest)#002.src: Ha. Your bow control is sloppy, "captain."
Apotheosis (Quest)#002.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#003.dst: Ni se te ocurra hablar, escoria.
Apotheosis (Quest)#003.speaker: Hyloch Captain

Apotheosis (Quest)#006.src: Thanks for the support, {u}! Not sure how much longer I could've held out on my own.
Apotheosis (Quest)#006.dst: ¡Gracias por el apoyo, {u}! No sé cuánto más habría aguantado sola.
Apotheosis (Quest)#006.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#007.src: We were about to regroup with the Canopy, but Cileon spotted soldiers approaching through the hotel windows.
Apotheosis (Quest)#007.dst: Íbamos a reunirnos con el Dosel, pero Cileon vio soldados acercándose por las ventanas del hotel.
Apotheosis (Quest)#007.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#008.src: They've stormed the plaza, and probably the rest of the city by now... I think they've rounded up all the citizens at the festival grounds.
Apotheosis (Quest)#008.dst: Han tomado la plaza, y seguramente ya el resto de la ciudad... Creo que han reunido a todos los ciudadanos en el recinto del festival.
Apotheosis (Quest)#008.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#009.src: We all got split up in the commotion - the others are probably fighting their own battles! Come on, we need to get moving!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#009.dst: Nos separamos con el alboroto; ¡los demás estarán librando sus propias batallas! ¡Vamos, tenemos que movernos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#009.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#011.src: Find the rest of your friends in {p}.
Apotheosis (Quest)#011.dst: Encuentra al resto de tus amigos en {p}.

Apotheosis (Quest)#013.src: Phew... th...that was close. {u}, it's g- good to see you.
Apotheosis (Quest)#013.dst: Uf... p...por poco. {u}, me al- alegra verte.
Apotheosis (Quest)#013.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#014.src: Where are the others? Have you seen them?
Apotheosis (Quest)#014.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#015.src: I saw Cileon u- up ahead! But I l- lo- lost sight of Sui a while ago...
Apotheosis (Quest)#015.dst: ¡Vi a Cileon a- ahí delante! Pero a Sui la p- per- perdí de vista hace rato...
Apotheosis (Quest)#015.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#016.src: Then what are we waiting for?! Let's get moving!
Apotheosis (Quest)#016.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#018.src: ...{u}, if y...you're here, then... the Queen...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#018.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#019.src: Worry about our friends first, Queen second! Come one, move move move!
Apotheosis (Quest)#019.dst: ¡Primero nuestros amigos, la Reina después! ¡Vamos, venga, venga, venga!
Apotheosis (Quest)#019.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#020.dst: Encuentra a Cileon y a Sui en {p}.

Apotheosis (Quest)#024.src: Th...that was awesome, Cileon!! Could you t- te- teach me some of your techni-
Apotheosis (Quest)#024.dst: ¡¡Eso ha s...sido increíble, Cileon!! ¿Podrías en- en- enseñarme alguna de tus técni-
Apotheosis (Quest)#024.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#025.src: ZEPH! There's no TIME!! Cileon, have you seen Sui?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#025.dst: ¡ZEPH! ¡¡No hay TIEMPO!! Cileon, ¡¿has visto a Sui?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#025.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#033.src: Sui, that was i- in- incredible!! But, using that much m...magic... be careful not to use up all of your st- strength...
Apotheosis (Quest)#033.dst: ¡¡Sui, eso ha sido in- in- increíble!! Pero usar tanta m...magia... ten cuidado de no gastar todas tus fu- fuerzas...
Apotheosis (Quest)#033.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#034.src: ...it's fine, Zeph. It doesn't drain me to use, anymore. I can just... pull on the strands.
Apotheosis (Quest)#034.dst: ...no pasa nada, Zeph. Ya no me agota usarla. Solo tengo que... tirar de los hilos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#034.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#036.src: R- ri- right... the festival speech. Should we try to l...listen in on it?
Apotheosis (Quest)#036.dst: C- cla- claro... el discurso del festival. ¿Intentamos e...escucharlo?
Apotheosis (Quest)#036.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#037.src: What?! No! We're all safe, so let's get out of here and regroup with the rest of the Canopy! Doing anything else is way too risky-
Apotheosis (Quest)#037.dst: ¡¿Qué?! ¡No! Estamos todos a salvo, así que salgamos de aquí y reunámonos con el resto del Dosel. Cualquier otra cosa es demasiado arriesgada-
Apotheosis (Quest)#037.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#038.src: No. I'm... I'm done running away. We're going in.
Apotheosis (Quest)#038.dst: No. Ya... ya me he cansado de huir. Vamos a entrar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#038.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#040.src: She's responsible for everything that has happened to us. I'm not going to just... let her get away when she's RIGHT THERE!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#040.dst: Ella es la culpable de todo lo que nos ha pasado. No pienso... dejarla escapar cuando la tengo JUSTO AHÍ!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#040.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#041.src: She's going to pay for all of it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#041.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#042.src: S- Sui... you don't h- have to do it alone.
Apotheosis (Quest)#042.dst: S- Sui... no t- tienes que hacerlo sola.
Apotheosis (Quest)#042.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#043.src: ...fine. Fine! Let's do it, then! Let's go... face the Queen.
Apotheosis (Quest)#043.dst: ...vale. ¡Vale! ¡Pues adelante! Vamos a... enfrentarnos a la Reina.
Apotheosis (Quest)#043.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#044.src: Make your way to the festival grounds at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Apotheosis (Quest)#044.dst: Dirígete al recinto del festival en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#048.src: ...th- this was a bad idea. We n...need to get out of-
Apotheosis (Quest)#048.dst: ...e- esto ha sido mala idea. T...tenemos que salir de-
Apotheosis (Quest)#048.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#049.src: People of the {p}! I deeply apologize for the disruption to your routines. You must be confused, afraid.
Apotheosis (Quest)#049.dst: ¡Pueblo de {p}! Lamento profundamente interrumpir vuestra rutina. Debéis de estar confusos, asustados.
Apotheosis (Quest)#049.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#050.src: This festival is a time for joy, for celebration! But there are those within your midst who reject this notion. They aim to bring destruction, chaos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#050.dst: ¡Este festival es un momento de alegría, de celebración! Pero entre vosotros hay quienes rechazan esa idea. ¡Buscan traer destrucción y caos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#050.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#051.src: Indeed... a plot to twist our province's ideals, to destroy our very way of life! The perpetrators lurking in your city, feigning innocence... what a disgrace.
Apotheosis (Quest)#051.dst: Así es... ¡un complot para torcer nuestros ideales y destruir nuestra forma de vida! Los culpables se esconden entre vosotros... qué vergüenza.
Apotheosis (Quest)#051.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#052.src: It was your very own Sovereign, Majin Thalas, whose quick thinking brought down the terrorists' plot! The Wings, the Constables, the Local Guard, all have mobilized to capture the perpetrators.
Apotheosis (Quest)#052.dst: ¡Fue vuestro propio Soberano, Majin Thalas, quien con su rapidez frustró el complot terrorista! Las Alas, los alguaciles y la Guardia Local se han movilizado para capturar a los culpables.
Apotheosis (Quest)#052.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#053.src: Soon, we shall have them chained before you. Soon, you shall see the faces of this blight, this infection in the veins of our province.
Apotheosis (Quest)#053.dst: Pronto los tendremos encadenados ante vosotros. Pronto veréis los rostros de esta plaga, esta infección en las venas de nuestra provincia.
Apotheosis (Quest)#053.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#054.src: And soon, we shall cut. It. Out.
Apotheosis (Quest)#054.dst: Y pronto la extirparemos. De. Raíz.
Apotheosis (Quest)#054.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#055.src: Listen to Her Majesty and her Sovereigns.
Apotheosis (Quest)#055.dst: Escucha a Su Majestad y a sus Soberanos.

Apotheosis (Quest)#058.src: And so it would seem my Sovereigns have once again failed to perform what should be a very simple task.
Apotheosis (Quest)#058.dst: Y así, parece que mis Soberanos han vuelto a fracasar en lo que debería ser una tarea muy sencilla.
Apotheosis (Quest)#058.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#059.src: Sovereign Thalas, what, precisely, is it you have been teaching these soldiers of yours?! Because there should be no reason for them to have FAILED to capture these CHILDREN!
Apotheosis (Quest)#059.dst: Soberano Thalas, ¡¿qué es exactamente lo que les enseñas a tus soldados?! ¡Porque no hay razón alguna para que hayan FRACASADO en capturar a estos NIÑOS!
Apotheosis (Quest)#059.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#060.src: I told you we should've taken the direct solution! More dead soldiers, more of our people subtracted out, for nothing!
Apotheosis (Quest)#060.dst: ¡Te dije que debíamos tomar la solución directa! ¡Más soldados muertos, más de los nuestros restados, para nada!
Apotheosis (Quest)#060.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#061.src: Hm! Now, let us be clear, the soldiers are-
Apotheosis (Quest)#061.dst: ¡Hm! Veamos, que quede claro, los soldados son-
Apotheosis (Quest)#061.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#062.src: Oh, I do not care. Save your excuses.
Apotheosis (Quest)#062.dst: Oh, me da igual. Ahórrate las excusas.
Apotheosis (Quest)#062.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#063.src: I have given you more than enough chances to realise the weight of what it is we do!
Apotheosis (Quest)#063.dst: ¡Os he dado oportunidades de sobra para comprender el peso de lo que hacemos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#063.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#064.src: You...you have proven very hard to pin down, it would seem. No matter the circumstances, you have a knack for slipping through the cracks...
Apotheosis (Quest)#064.dst: Tú... tú has resultado muy difícil de atrapar, por lo visto. Sean cuales sean las circunstancias, tienes un don para escurrirte por las grietas...
Apotheosis (Quest)#064.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#065.src: It would be oh so simple to blame you for all you have enacted... but the truth is, you were merely the catalyst. The seeds of this rebellion were planted long, long before you.
Apotheosis (Quest)#065.dst: Sería tan sencillo culparte de todo lo que has hecho... pero la verdad es que solo fuiste el catalizador. Las semillas de esta rebelión se plantaron mucho, mucho antes que tú.
Apotheosis (Quest)#065.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#066.src: Oh, the {p}... over these centuries, its beauty has never faded. The vibrant colors, the warm breeze of the changing seasons...
Apotheosis (Quest)#066.dst: Oh, {p}... en todos estos siglos, su belleza nunca se ha marchitado. Los colores vivos, la brisa cálida del cambio de estación...
Apotheosis (Quest)#066.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#067.src: What a shame, then, that beneath the cover of the leaves, there lurk countless cowering pests. And no matter how hard I try, I cannot seem to wash them out.
Apotheosis (Quest)#067.dst: Qué lástima, pues, que bajo el manto de las hojas aceche una infinidad de alimañas acobardadas. Y por mucho que lo intento, no logro arrastrarlas.
Apotheosis (Quest)#067.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#068.src: Fell the perceived source of their strength, cut the branches and burn the leaves, the fruit that emboldens their acts - and still, they persist!
Apotheosis (Quest)#068.dst: Derribad la supuesta fuente de su fuerza, cortad las ramas y quemad las hojas, el fruto que envalentona sus actos... ¡y aun así persisten!
Apotheosis (Quest)#068.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#069.src: Bury their monuments, erase their gods - and still, and STILL, they cling to ideals of love, of family! And still, and still, and still, they persist.
Apotheosis (Quest)#069.dst: Enterrad sus monumentos, borrad a sus dioses... ¡y aun así, AUN ASÍ, se aferran a ideales de amor, de familia! Y aun así, y aun así, persisten.
Apotheosis (Quest)#069.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#070.src: Washing it all away had shown results... for a time. But even growing forth from a blank slate, even with no ties to what came before - still, still, STILL THEY PERSIST!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#070.dst: Arrasarlo todo dio resultado... por un tiempo. Pero incluso brotando de cero, sin lazos con lo anterior... ¡aun así, aun así, AUN ASÍ PERSISTEN!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#070.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#071.src: There is a rot in the heart of that forest. I see that now. Perhaps, I had allowed my fondness for the region to blind me... but no more.
Apotheosis (Quest)#071.dst: Hay podredumbre en el corazón de ese bosque. Ahora lo veo. Quizá dejé que mi cariño por la región me cegara... pero se acabó.
Apotheosis (Quest)#071.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#072.src: And so, as once we saw out the New Age, so again shall we wash away these pests. That accursed forest will drown, and the rot buried deep will be excised once more.
Apotheosis (Quest)#072.dst: Y así, igual que despedimos la Nueva Era, volveremos a arrasar a estas alimañas. Ese bosque maldito se ahogará, y la podredumbre será extirpada una vez más.
Apotheosis (Quest)#072.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#074.src: W-With respect, that is not a viable angle! The Resistance is such a small percentage of the overall population, they're practically a rounding error!
Apotheosis (Quest)#074.dst: ¡C-con todo respeto, ese no es un enfoque viable! ¡La Resistencia es un porcentaje tan pequeño de la población que es casi un error de redondeo!
Apotheosis (Quest)#074.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#075.src: You can't divide out a quarter of our province's people, a-and just as much infrastructure, just to solve for a subset of rogue integers!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#075.dst: ¡¡No podéis dividir a una cuarta parte de la provincia, y a-a otro tanto de infraestructura, solo para despejar un puñado de enteros rebeldes!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#075.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#076.src: Learn when to keep your mouth shut, would you, Nasin?! We are standing before the public! This is not the time to raise such grievances-
Apotheosis (Quest)#076.dst: ¡¿Quieres aprender a callarte, Nasin?! ¡Estamos ante el público! No es momento de airear esas quejas-
Apotheosis (Quest)#076.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#077.src: That didn't stop you interrupting my sequence and openly denigrating the recruits at the tournament to fulfill your petty factoring grudge!! You have no excuses!
Apotheosis (Quest)#077.dst: ¡Eso no te impidió interrumpir mi secuencia y humillar a los reclutas en el torneo por tu mezquino rencor sin factorizar! ¡No tienes excusa!
Apotheosis (Quest)#077.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#078.src: We- We have been wasting our numbers at every point. When did our vector shift to something so shortsighted? When did we lose sight of our nontrivial solution?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#078.dst: N- Nos hemos pasado todo el tiempo derrochando números. ¿Cuándo cambió nuestro vector a algo tan corto de miras? ¿Cuándo perdimos de vista la solución no trivial?
Apotheosis (Quest)#078.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#079.src: You're both plugged into a destructive sequence! I can't enable these irrationalities!! I refuse to be a variable in this cyclical, downwards spiral!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#079.dst: ¡Estáis los dos metidos en una secuencia destructiva! ¡¡No puedo avalar estas irracionalidades!! ¡¡Me niego a ser una variable en esta espiral cíclica descendente!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#079.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#080.src: Take care with what you do next, Zhiraok Nasin. If you turn away now, you will forsake your position and forfeit your life.
Apotheosis (Quest)#080.dst: Cuidado con lo que haces ahora, Zhiraok Nasin. Si te das la vuelta, renunciarás a tu cargo y perderás la vida.
Apotheosis (Quest)#080.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#083.src: If this is what honor is supposed to feel like, I don't want it anymore.
Apotheosis (Quest)#083.dst: Si esto es lo que se siente con el honor, ya no lo quiero.
Apotheosis (Quest)#083.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#084.src: My loyalty is to the people. If yours isn't, then our vectors no longer converge. I'm subtracting my pact to you myself.
Apotheosis (Quest)#084.dst: Mi lealtad es para el pueblo. Si la tuya no, nuestros vectores ya no convergen. Resto mi juramento contigo yo mismo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#084.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#085.src: Gotta evacuate, contact Xao, the commanders, get everyone to higher ground, find where the helix S-
Apotheosis (Quest)#085.dst: Hay que evacuar, avisar a Xao, a los comandantes, llevar a todos a zonas altas, encontrar dónde la hélice S-
Apotheosis (Quest)#085.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#086.src: Hmph! You Majesty, if you would allow it, I would gladly put his head on a stick for you.
Apotheosis (Quest)#086.dst: ¡Hmpf! Majestad, si me lo permitís, con gusto os traeré su cabeza clavada en una pica.
Apotheosis (Quest)#086.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#087.src: Firstly, Sovereign Thalas, I would have you clean up your mess. Execute the terrorists.
Apotheosis (Quest)#087.dst: Primero, Soberano Thalas, quiero que limpies tu desastre. Ejecuta a los terroristas.
Apotheosis (Quest)#087.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#088.src: ...and once you are done, you have my approval to hunt down ex-Sovereign Zhiraok Nasin.
Apotheosis (Quest)#088.dst: ...y cuando termines, tienes mi permiso para dar caza al ex-Soberano Zhiraok Nasin.
Apotheosis (Quest)#088.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#089.src: While you are at it, eliminate that entire House. They have disappointed me far too many times, and I have granted them far too many chances.
Apotheosis (Quest)#089.dst: Ya puestos, elimina a toda esa Casa. Me han decepcionado demasiadas veces, y les he dado demasiadas oportunidades.
Apotheosis (Quest)#089.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#090.src: Aha! Gladly. As you wish, Your Majesty. It will be done.
Apotheosis (Quest)#090.dst: ¡Ajá! Con mucho gusto. Como deseéis, Majestad. Así se hará.
Apotheosis (Quest)#090.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#091.src: Sovereign Tasim. You will be coming with me to the dam.
Apotheosis (Quest)#091.dst: Soberano Tasim. Tú vendrás conmigo a la presa.
Apotheosis (Quest)#091.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#094.src: Ahhh... Finally! I'd been awaiting the day I'd get the chance to wipe you rats off the face of the planet.
Apotheosis (Quest)#094.dst: Ahhh... ¡Por fin! Llevaba tiempo esperando el día de borraros de la faz del planeta, ratas.
Apotheosis (Quest)#094.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#095.src: But before we begin, I'm an honourable man, so I'll grant you this opportunity! Any last words for the crowd?
Apotheosis (Quest)#095.dst: Pero antes de empezar, como hombre de honor, ¡os daré esta oportunidad! ¿Unas últimas palabras para el público?
Apotheosis (Quest)#095.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#096.src: Ahahahaha! Did you, now? That the great Sovereign Majin would fall to a simple group of insurgents... What a laughably fanciful tale!
Apotheosis (Quest)#096.dst: ¡Jajajajaja! ¿Ah, sí? ¿Que el gran Soberano Majin caería ante un simple grupo de insurgentes? ¡Qué historia tan ridículamente fantasiosa!
Apotheosis (Quest)#096.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#097.src: My goodness, what a statement! You truly believe so? That you of all people stand a chance against my might?
Apotheosis (Quest)#097.dst: ¡Madre mía, qué declaración! ¿De verdad lo crees? ¿Que precisamente tú tienes alguna opción contra mi poder?
Apotheosis (Quest)#097.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#098.src: Oh, how dreadfully dull. If you are going to be so dramatic, use a better line, would you?
