Apotheosis (Quest)#098.dst: Oh, qué terriblemente aburrido. Si vas a ponerte tan dramático, usa una frase mejor, ¿quieres?
Apotheosis (Quest)#098.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#099.src: Ha! As if. Half those tabloids are filled with naught but meaningless gossip! Though, I do have an appreciation for the Majin Monthly. It's quite the interesting read, you know!
Apotheosis (Quest)#099.dst: ¡Ja! Ni hablar. ¡La mitad de esos tabloides no son más que chismes sin sentido! Aunque reconozco que Majin Mensual me gusta. ¡Es una lectura muy interesante!
Apotheosis (Quest)#099.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#100.src: Hm... But I'm afraid only one of you is worthy of facing me in combat. As for the rest of you pitiful worms...
Apotheosis (Quest)#100.dst: Hm... Pero me temo que solo uno de vosotros es digno de luchar contra mí. En cuanto al resto, gusanos lamentables...
Apotheosis (Quest)#100.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#102.src: Ah ah ah! Keep your eyes on what's important, mmn?
Apotheosis (Quest)#102.dst: ¡Ah, ah, ah! No apartes la vista de lo importante, ¿mmn?
Apotheosis (Quest)#102.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#103.src: You should feel honoured! Very few are given the privilege of dying to my blade. I'd tell you to write about it in your memoirs, but...
Apotheosis (Quest)#103.dst: ¡Deberías sentirte honrado! Muy pocos tienen el privilegio de morir por mi espada. Te diría que lo escribieras en tus memorias, pero...
Apotheosis (Quest)#103.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#104.src: Well, I don't imagine you'll have the chance. NOW -
Apotheosis (Quest)#104.dst: En fin, no creo que tengas ocasión. AHORA -
Apotheosis (Quest)#104.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#105.src: Defeat Majin. To return to the fight, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Apotheosis (Quest)#105.dst: Derrota a Majin. Para volver al combate, ve a [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#106.src: Welcome to my domain of the starry night, dear guest! Quite the stunning view, is it not?
Apotheosis (Quest)#106.dst: ¡Bienvenido a mi dominio de la noche estrellada, querido invitado! Una vista impresionante, ¿no crees?
Apotheosis (Quest)#106.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#107.src: By all means - take your time, take it all in, every little detail! Allow that feeling to sink in - your sheer insignificance in the face of the vastness of the cosmos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#107.dst: ¡Adelante, tómate tu tiempo, empápate de todo, de cada detalle! Deja que cale esa sensación: ¡tu absoluta insignificancia ante la inmensidad del cosmos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#107.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#108.src: Ah... Her Majesty and the Spymaster, they held interest in you once. Looking upon you now, I simply cannot fathom why.
Apotheosis (Quest)#108.dst: Ah... Su Majestad y la Jefa de Espías se interesaron por ti una vez. Viéndote ahora, no logro entender por qué.
Apotheosis (Quest)#108.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#109.src: But I suppose it matters not! You have certainly cut that strand of interest with all your assorted antics, haven't you?
Apotheosis (Quest)#109.dst: ¡Pero supongo que da igual! Con todas tus travesuras ya has cortado ese hilo de interés, ¿verdad?
Apotheosis (Quest)#109.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#110.src: Well! If you must die, be glad it was to my blade! LET THE SHOW BEGIN!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#110.dst: ¡Bueno! Si has de morir, ¡alégrate de que sea por mi espada! ¡¡EMPIECE EL SHOW!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#110.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#111.src: Flooding the whole forest... There's- That can't be, th-there's no way...
Apotheosis (Quest)#111.dst: Inundar todo el bosque... No- No puede ser, n-no puede...
Apotheosis (Quest)#111.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#112.src: I certainly hope you've learned your lesson, Rose! This is what happens! Loose nails get hammered down!
Apotheosis (Quest)#112.dst: ¡Espero que hayas aprendido la lección, Rose! ¡Esto es lo que pasa! ¡El clavo que sobresale se lleva el martillazo!
Apotheosis (Quest)#112.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#114.src: This is all happening because a certain SOMEONE incited violence against the crown! In the papers no less, where we do our work!
Apotheosis (Quest)#114.dst: ¡Todo esto pasa porque CIERTA persona incitó a la violencia contra la Corona! ¡Y en el periódico, donde trabajamos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#114.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#115.src: Risky, dangerous, all of it- and now look where we are! Public executions! We might not even be allowed to publish after this!
Apotheosis (Quest)#115.dst: Arriesgado, peligroso, todo ello... ¡y mira dónde estamos! ¡Ejecuciones públicas! ¡Puede que ni nos dejen publicar después de esto!
Apotheosis (Quest)#115.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#116.src: ...there are...HOW many people in danger right now, a-and all you can think to do is-
Apotheosis (Quest)#116.dst: ...hay CUÁNTA gente en peligro ahora mismo, y-y lo único que se te ocurre es-
Apotheosis (Quest)#116.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#118.src: How can you be so monumentally stupid?! At least they TRIED! At least they SHOWED UP! They followed through!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#118.dst: ¡¿Cómo se puede ser tan estúpido?! ¡Al menos ELLOS LO INTENTARON! ¡Al menos DIERON LA CARA! ¡¡Llegaron al final!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#118.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#119.src: The first hope I've seen in years, and you throw petty insults at them?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#119.dst: La primera esperanza que veo en años, ¡¿y tú les lanzas insultos mezquinos?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#119.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#120.src: Ergh...where did you learn to hit?! Can you really only rely on that to make your point?
Apotheosis (Quest)#120.dst: Argh... ¡¿dónde has aprendido a pegar?! ¿Solo sabes defender tus ideas así?
Apotheosis (Quest)#120.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#121.src: Oh, grow UP already!! Think of something useful to do, instead of looking at the people who are doing anything more than sitting on their asses and going "how uncivilized!"
Apotheosis (Quest)#121.dst: ¡¡Oh, MADURA ya!! Piensa en algo útil que hacer, en vez de mirar a quienes hacen algo más que quedarse de brazos cruzados diciendo "¡qué incivilizado!"
Apotheosis (Quest)#121.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#122.src: Hey, language! And besides, it's not as if that insurgent has any chance against-
Apotheosis (Quest)#122.dst: ¡Eh, ese lenguaje! Además, no es que ese insurgente tenga ninguna opción contra-
Apotheosis (Quest)#122.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#126.src: ...The Sovereign...is dead!! The Resistance is triumphant!! Can't you see?! They were right!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#126.dst: ...¡¡El Soberano... ha muerto!! ¡¡La Resistencia ha triunfado!! ¡¿No lo ves?! ¡¡Tenían razón!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#126.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#127.src: We need to help them! This might be our only chance, we can't let it slip away from us!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#127.dst: ¡Tenemos que ayudarles! Puede que sea nuestra única oportunidad, ¡¡no podemos dejarla escapar!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#127.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#133.src: MAJIN'S DEAD, WHAT CAN THEY DO NOW?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#133.dst: MAJIN HA MUERTO, ¡¿QUÉ VAN A HACER AHORA?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#133.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Apotheosis (Quest)#134.src: You! You really did it!! People are...they're doing something!! It worked, I can't believe it worked!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#134.dst: ¡Tú! ¡¡De verdad lo has hecho!! La gente... ¡¡está haciendo algo!! Ha funcionado, ¡¡no me creo que haya funcionado!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#134.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#135.src: I'm going with them! We have to keep up the momentum, m-maybe I can direct them! You do whatever you have to- I trust you! We'll make it!
Apotheosis (Quest)#135.dst: ¡Me voy con ellos! Hay que mantener el impulso, ¡q-quizá pueda guiarlos! Tú haz lo que tengas que hacer, ¡confío en ti! ¡Lo lograremos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#135.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#139.src: Good. That's one less Sovereign to worry about...
Apotheosis (Quest)#139.dst: Bien. Un Soberano menos del que preocuparse...
Apotheosis (Quest)#139.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#141.src: She... she really threatened to flood the {p}... didn't she...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#141.dst: Ella... de verdad amenazó con inundar {p}... ¿verdad...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#141.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#142.src: I- I- I can't believe it... all be- because we won't b...back down?
Apotheosis (Quest)#142.dst: N- n- no me lo creo... ¿todo p- porque no queremos r...rendirnos?
Apotheosis (Quest)#142.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#143.src: Well, I can. Just like the New Age... ugh, was THAT her too?! We're unprepared, outmatched... how are we meant to-
Apotheosis (Quest)#143.dst: Pues yo sí. Igual que la Nueva Era... uf, ¡¿ESO también fue ella?! Sin preparación, superados... ¿cómo vamos a-
Apotheosis (Quest)#143.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#144.src: It doesn't matter! We- we have to stop her! We can't just... let her kill all those people!
Apotheosis (Quest)#144.dst: ¡Da igual! ¡T- tenemos que detenerla! No podemos... ¡dejar que mate a toda esa gente!
Apotheosis (Quest)#144.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#145.src: ...I hate it, but you're right. Come on, let's-
Apotheosis (Quest)#145.dst: ...lo odio, pero tienes razón. Vamos, hay que-
Apotheosis (Quest)#145.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#146.src: Phew- you're all still standing strong!! Good, good... I- phew- I was getting worried!
Apotheosis (Quest)#146.dst: ¡¡Uf- seguís todos en pie!! Bien, bien... ¡y- uf- ya empezaba a preocuparme!
Apotheosis (Quest)#146.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#147.src: R...Rurie? What are you doing h- here?
Apotheosis (Quest)#147.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#148.src: Ah! One moment, just, ha, allow me to catch my breath- let me tell you, those speed talismans are handy but they really leave you winded-
Apotheosis (Quest)#148.dst: ¡Ah! Un momento, ja, dejadme recuperar el aliento... os digo que esos talismanes de velocidad son útiles, pero te dejan sin aire-
Apotheosis (Quest)#148.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#149.src: ...ohohohoho, do my eyes decieve me?! I'd heard the townsfolk talking but I could hardly believe it- is it really true? Has the Sovereign Thalas truly been felled?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#149.dst: ...¡¿ojojojojo, me engañan los ojos?! Oí a la gente hablar, pero apenas podía creerlo... ¿es verdad? ¡¿De verdad ha caído el Soberano Thalas?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#149.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#152.src: Good! Great, even! Got what he deserved, in the end!
Apotheosis (Quest)#152.dst: ¡Bien! ¡Genial, incluso! ¡Al final tuvo lo que merecía!
Apotheosis (Quest)#152.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#153.src: Hm? No, it's perfectly normal. If you had the vendetta I had, then, well! You would react likewise, I'm certain.
Apotheosis (Quest)#153.dst: ¿Hm? No, es de lo más normal. Si tuvierais mi misma cuenta pendiente, ¡bueno! Reaccionaríais igual.
Apotheosis (Quest)#153.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#154.src: Hm? No, it's perfectly normal. If you had the vendetta I had, then, well! You would react likewise, I'm certain.
Apotheosis (Quest)#154.dst: ¿Hm? No, es de lo más normal. Si tuvierais mi misma cuenta pendiente, ¡bueno! Reaccionaríais igual.
Apotheosis (Quest)#154.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#155.src: Dead! Dead! He's dead, and I'm not, and I win! Hahahahaha!
Apotheosis (Quest)#155.dst: ¡Muerto! ¡Muerto! Él ha muerto, yo no, ¡y gano yo! ¡Jajajajaja!
Apotheosis (Quest)#155.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#157.src: Problems! Right! Right right right right right!! That's why I'm here, after all- haha, apologies, got distracted a moment...
Apotheosis (Quest)#157.dst: ¡Problemas! ¡Cierto! ¡¡Cierto, cierto, cierto!! Para eso he venido, al fin y al cabo... jaja, perdón, me he distraído...
Apotheosis (Quest)#157.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#158.src: It seems the crown's finally recovered from the shock, and attacks on the safe zone have increased in strength and frequency!
Apotheosis (Quest)#158.dst: Parece que la Corona por fin se ha recuperado del susto, ¡y los ataques a la zona segura son cada vez más fuertes y frecuentes!
Apotheosis (Quest)#158.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#159.src: She sent me to... well, to check and see if you're alive, firstly - but also to bring whoever I can back to support the defense effort!
Apotheosis (Quest)#159.dst: Ella me envió a... bueno, a ver si seguíais vivos, primero, ¡pero también a traer a quien pueda para reforzar la defensa!
Apotheosis (Quest)#159.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#160.src: We have issues here too, Rurie. The Queen has just publicly announced she's going to FLOOD the {p}!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#160.dst: Aquí también tenemos problemas, Rurie. ¡¡La Reina acaba de anunciar en público que va a INUNDAR {p}!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#160.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#161.src: Oh! Oh, dear! That isn't good at all! We've truly driven her far enough to warrant such an act?
Apotheosis (Quest)#161.dst: ¡Oh! ¡Oh, cielos! ¡Eso no es nada bueno! ¿De verdad la hemos llevado tan al límite?
Apotheosis (Quest)#161.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#162.src: Rurie, I'll g- go with you. I... I need to m...make sure Yuman's safe.
Apotheosis (Quest)#162.dst: Rurie, yo v- voy contigo. Ne... necesito asegurarme de que Yuman está bien.
Apotheosis (Quest)#162.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#164.src: Rex, Sui, {u}... I- I want to h...help you, but-
Apotheosis (Quest)#164.dst: Rex, Sui, {u}... qu- quiero a...ayudaros, pero-
Apotheosis (Quest)#164.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#165.src: Hey, Zeph, it's alright. Make sure there's a resistance still standing for us to rejoin when it's all over, alright?
Apotheosis (Quest)#165.dst: Eh, Zeph, tranquilo. Asegúrate de que quede una resistencia en pie para cuando volvamos, ¿vale?
Apotheosis (Quest)#165.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#167.src: Y- you guys too! Let's reunite wh...when this is all over, alright?
Apotheosis (Quest)#167.dst: ¡V- vosotros también! Nos reunimos cu...cuando acabe todo, ¿vale?
Apotheosis (Quest)#167.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#168.src: Then it's settled! Good luck, you three! Go show the Queen what you've got!
Apotheosis (Quest)#168.dst: ¡Decidido! ¡Suerte a los tres! ¡Demostradle a la Reina lo que valéis!
Apotheosis (Quest)#168.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#169.src: Head to the dam and stop the Queen at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Apotheosis (Quest)#169.dst: Ve a la presa y detén a la Reina en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#171.src: Necessary? Very little ever is. But it will prove a point.
Apotheosis (Quest)#171.dst: ¿Necesario? Pocas cosas lo son. Pero servirá para dejar algo claro.
Apotheosis (Quest)#171.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#172.src: Really. Thousands of lives... to prove a point.
Apotheosis (Quest)#172.dst: Ya. Miles de vidas... para dejar algo claro.
Apotheosis (Quest)#172.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#173.src: You understand the stakes of the greater task, yes? If that end is not averted, they die regardless. Them, and everyone else.
Apotheosis (Quest)#173.dst: Entiendes lo que está en juego en la tarea mayor, ¿sí? Si ese final no se evita, morirán igualmente. Ellos y todos los demás.
Apotheosis (Quest)#173.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#174.src: And without order here, we will lack the focus to see it through. So, see it as a necessary evil. Nothing more, nothing less.
Apotheosis (Quest)#174.dst: Y sin orden aquí, no podremos centrarnos en llevarla a cabo. Así que míralo como un mal necesario. Ni más, ni menos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#174.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#176.src: She will come around. She always does, in the end.
Apotheosis (Quest)#176.dst: Entrará en razón. Siempre lo hace, al final.
Apotheosis (Quest)#176.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#178.src: I don't like this. There are better opt-
Apotheosis (Quest)#178.dst: No me gusta esto. Hay mejores opc-
Apotheosis (Quest)#178.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#179.src: You do not have to like it, Sovereign. But if you wish to make change for the world, you will have to see it through.
Apotheosis (Quest)#179.dst: No tiene por qué gustarte, Soberano. Pero si quieres cambiar el mundo, tendrás que llegar hasta el final.
Apotheosis (Quest)#179.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#182.src: We won't let you go through with this!
Apotheosis (Quest)#182.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#184.src: Good grief, are my Sovereigns truly good for NOTHING?! Zhiraok, Soosu, Gikyo, Majin - each and every one a FAILURE!
Apotheosis (Quest)#184.dst: Por favor, ¡¿mis Soberanos NO sirven para NADA?! Zhiraok, Soosu, Gikyo, Majin... ¡todos y cada uno un FRACASO!
Apotheosis (Quest)#184.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#185.src: Oh, what does it matter?! All of this - everything you have done, everything you have caused, all will be swept away and once I am finished with you!
Apotheosis (Quest)#185.dst: Oh, ¡¿qué importa?! Todo esto, todo lo que habéis hecho, todo lo que habéis causado, ¡será barrido en cuanto acabe con vosotros!
Apotheosis (Quest)#185.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#187.src: Why are you doing this?! Why are you LETTING her kill all those people?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#187.dst: ¡¿Por qué haces esto?! ¡¿Por qué DEJAS que mate a toda esa gente?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#187.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#190.src: What?! You ALWAYS have a choice, du-
Apotheosis (Quest)#190.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#191.src: Stop trying to talk to him. We have to-...!
Apotheosis (Quest)#191.dst: Deja de hablar con él. ¡Tenemos que-...!
Apotheosis (Quest)#191.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#194.src: We have to stop her before she tears this whole thing down!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#194.dst: ¡¡Hay que detenerla antes de que lo eche todo abajo!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#194.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#195.src: I can't let you do that.
Apotheosis (Quest)#195.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#196.src: Ugh... we're getting nowhere! We NEED to find a way to stop the Queen!
Apotheosis (Quest)#196.dst: Uf... ¡no avanzamos! ¡TENEMOS que encontrar la forma de detener a la Reina!
Apotheosis (Quest)#196.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#198.src: Ha! Didn't expect that one, did you?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#198.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#201.src: {u}! Her spell's down, but- she'll get it back up if we don't keep her busy!
Apotheosis (Quest)#201.dst: ¡{u}! Su hechizo ha caído, pero... ¡lo volverá a lanzar si no la mantenemos ocupada!

Apotheosis (Quest)#355.dst: ...agotamiento. Creo que al final ha podido con él.
Apotheosis (Quest)#355.speaker: Soosu

Apotheosis (Quest)#360.src: No. No, I refuse to accept that.
Apotheosis (Quest)#360.dst: No. No, me niego a aceptarlo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#360.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#361.src: He's not the one who stood by and- and let this happen. He's not the one who was too- too cowardly to turn away when she- when she-
Apotheosis (Quest)#361.dst: Él no es quien se quedó mirando y- y dejó que esto pasara. Él no es quien fue demasiado- demasiado cobarde para apartarse cuando ella- cuando ella-
Apotheosis (Quest)#361.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#362.src: ...so why is he the one who has to die, and not...
Apotheosis (Quest)#362.dst: ...¿por qué tiene que morir él, y no...
Apotheosis (Quest)#362.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#364.src: "I couldn't just stand by when there was something I could do to help." How could I have forgotten...? Again, again, it's like he's lying there, on the cold wooden floor, and...
Apotheosis (Quest)#364.dst: "No podía quedarme quieto habiendo algo que yo pudiera hacer." ¿Cómo he podido olvidarlo...? Otra vez, otra vez, es como si estuviera ahí tirado, sobre el frío suelo de madera, y...
Apotheosis (Quest)#364.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#365.src: It won't work, Tasim. The charm's used up its charge already.
Apotheosis (Quest)#365.dst: No funcionará, Tasim. El amuleto ya ha gastado su carga.
Apotheosis (Quest)#365.speaker: Soosu

Apotheosis (Quest)#366.src: ...then I'll just have to recharge it myself. I have the power, I just need to...
Apotheosis (Quest)#366.dst: ...entonces tendré que recargarlo yo mismo. Tengo el poder, solo necesito...
Apotheosis (Quest)#366.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#367.src: Use it. Everything I have- my own magic - my curse, what I still have of her blessing, all of it... I just... need to...
Apotheosis (Quest)#367.dst: Usarlo. Todo lo que tengo- mi magia - mi maldición, lo que queda de su bendición, todo... Solo... necesito...
Apotheosis (Quest)#367.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#368.src: ...urgh. No, no, that can't be all I have- have I really used so much...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#368.dst: ...argh. No, no, no puede ser todo lo que queda- ¿tanto he usado...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#368.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#372.src: I SAID, I'll do it!!! If you think it'll work, then- then I'll help!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#372.dst: ¡¡¡HE DICHO que lo hago yo!!! Si crees que funcionará, pues- ¡¡pues ayudo!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#372.speaker: Soosu

Apotheosis (Quest)#373.src: Stupid, stupid Z... only person who ever cared...
Apotheosis (Quest)#373.dst: Idiota, idiota Z... el único que se preocupó por mí...
Apotheosis (Quest)#373.speaker: Soosu

Apotheosis (Quest)#374.src: ...that's all I've got. Stupid anti-magic cells... why'd I even make those in the first place?! Stupid, stupid...
Apotheosis (Quest)#374.dst: ...es todo lo que tengo. Malditas celdas antimagia... ¡¿por qué las hice siquiera?! Idiota, idiota...
Apotheosis (Quest)#374.speaker: Soosu

Apotheosis (Quest)#377.src: He... saved Rex. Even though he didn't have to. Even if it'd... kill him...
Apotheosis (Quest)#377.dst: Él... salvó a Rex. Aunque no tenía por qué. Aunque eso... lo matara...
Apotheosis (Quest)#377.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#378.src: So. S-so I can help... um, however I'm able to. Just- just this once.
Apotheosis (Quest)#378.dst: Así que. A-así que puedo ayudar... eh, en lo que pueda. Solo- solo esta vez.
Apotheosis (Quest)#378.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#379.src: ...urgh. The... the ocean here, it's... drained. I... used too much of it. It needs to... um, flow back and... fill back in...
Apotheosis (Quest)#379.dst: ...argh. El... el océano de aquí está... vacío. Yo... usé demasiado. Necesita... eh, volver a fluir y... llenarse otra vez...
Apotheosis (Quest)#379.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#382.src: I... have no right to ask this of you. Not- not now, not after everything I've...
Apotheosis (Quest)#382.dst: No... tengo derecho a pedirte esto. No- no ahora, no después de todo lo que he...
Apotheosis (Quest)#382.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#383.src: I... have no right to ask this of you. Not now... not after everything I've...
Apotheosis (Quest)#383.dst: No... tengo derecho a pedirte esto. Ahora no... no tras todo lo que he...
Apotheosis (Quest)#383.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#384.src: But... please. Just a little more. I can't... I can't let anyone else die for my mistakes.
Apotheosis (Quest)#384.dst: Pero... por favor. Solo un poco más. No puedo... no puedo dejar que muera nadie más por mis errores.
Apotheosis (Quest)#384.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#385.src: ...there you are, after all. I finally found who I came here looking for.
Apotheosis (Quest)#385.dst: ...así que estabas aquí. Por fin he encontrado a quien vine a buscar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#385.speaker: Player

Apotheosis (Quest)#389.src: Ah. Overloaded... used too many times, and charged with too unstable magic... and- kaboom.
Apotheosis (Quest)#389.dst: Ah. Sobrecargado... usado demasiadas veces y cargado con magia muy inestable... y- pum.
Apotheosis (Quest)#389.speaker: Soosu

Apotheosis (Quest)#391.src: Yeah, I think so. His breathing looks more... normal.
Apotheosis (Quest)#391.dst: Sí, eso creo. Respira de forma más... normal.
Apotheosis (Quest)#391.speaker: Soosu

Apotheosis (Quest)#392.src: ...good. Then... then it's done. It's all...
Apotheosis (Quest)#392.dst: ...bien. Entonces... entonces está hecho. Todo está...
Apotheosis (Quest)#392.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#394.src: Hm hm hm. Yeah, that's something. Any plans for dealing with that?
Apotheosis (Quest)#394.dst: Mm mm mm. Sí, menudo panorama. ¿Algún plan para ocuparse de eso?
Apotheosis (Quest)#394.speaker: Soosu

Apotheosis (Quest)#396.src: The Queen's still there, isn't she? We'll go in and kill her.
Apotheosis (Quest)#396.dst: La Reina sigue ahí, ¿verdad? Entraremos y la mataremos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#396.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#397.src: Hmph! Might work to stop new ones from opening up, sure. But wow, you wanna kill her? Good luck with that.
Apotheosis (Quest)#397.dst: ¡Mph! Puede que sirva para que no se abran más, claro. Pero vaya, ¿quieres matarla? Pues suerte con eso.
Apotheosis (Quest)#397.speaker: Soosu

Apotheosis (Quest)#398.src: ...s'your funeral! I've got a dam to fix... how long since I made the improvements...? Fifty years? Sixty? Eh, whatever, I'll just wing it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#398.dst: ...¡tú verás! Yo tengo una presa que arreglar... ¿cuánto hace que le hice las mejoras...? ¿Cincuenta años? ¿Sesenta? Bah, da igual, improvisaré.
Apotheosis (Quest)#398.speaker: Soosu

Apotheosis (Quest)#399.src: Hm. Hm hm. If you're going up into that whole ... you probably won't make it out. But if you do! We'll talk then.
Apotheosis (Quest)#399.dst: Mm. Mm mm. Si vais a meteros en todo ese ... seguramente no saldréis. ¡Pero si salís! Ya hablaremos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#399.speaker: Soosu

Apotheosis (Quest)#401.src: ...I, um, should... stay with Rex. Un-until the S-Sovereign is... up. {u}, go ahead to the safe zone. Make sure everyone's... everyone's okay, over there.
Apotheosis (Quest)#401.dst: ...yo, eh, debería... quedarme con Rex. Has-hasta que el S-Soberano se... despierte. {u}, ve tú a la zona segura. Asegúrate de que todos... de que todos están bien allí.
Apotheosis (Quest)#401.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#404.src: Sigh. And it all... just... breaks...
Apotheosis (Quest)#404.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#406.src: ...okay. I... I will. I'll see what I can do, if... if I can get any of the soldiers to stand down...
Apotheosis (Quest)#406.dst: ...vale. Lo... lo haré. Veré qué puedo hacer, si... si consigo que alguno de los soldados se retire...
Apotheosis (Quest)#406.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#407.src: I'll meet you by the palace. We'll fix this together.
Apotheosis (Quest)#407.dst: Nos vemos junto al palacio. Arreglaremos esto juntos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#407.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#408.src: Sigh. And it's all just... broken.
Apotheosis (Quest)#408.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#410.src: ...I will. I'll see what I can do, if... if I can get any of the soldiers to stand down...
Apotheosis (Quest)#410.dst: ...lo haré. Veré qué puedo hacer, si... si consigo que alguno de los soldados se retire...
Apotheosis (Quest)#410.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#411.src: I'll meet you by the palace. We'll fix this together.
Apotheosis (Quest)#411.dst: Nos vemos junto al palacio. Arreglaremos esto juntos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#411.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#412.src: Sigh. And it all... just... breaks... of course.
Apotheosis (Quest)#412.dst: Suspiro. Y todo... se... rompe... claro.
Apotheosis (Quest)#412.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#413.src: What will I... what can I do? It's all so... overwhelming.
Apotheosis (Quest)#413.dst: ¿Qué voy a... qué puedo hacer? Todo esto es... abrumador.
Apotheosis (Quest)#413.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#414.src: But... I have to try, don't I? I can't just... escape from the consequences.
Apotheosis (Quest)#414.dst: Pero... tengo que intentarlo, ¿no? No puedo... huir de las consecuencias.
Apotheosis (Quest)#414.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#415.src: I'll... meet you by the palace. I need to think first. Before we... go in.
Apotheosis (Quest)#415.dst: Nos... vemos junto al palacio. Antes necesito pensar. Antes de... entrar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#415.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#416.src: ...what. What do you want? Everything's broken. And it's my fault, right?
Apotheosis (Quest)#416.dst: ...qué. ¿Qué quieres? Todo está roto. Y es culpa mía, ¿no?
Apotheosis (Quest)#416.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#418.src: Right. Sure. If that's what you want from me.
Apotheosis (Quest)#418.dst: Ya. Claro. Si es lo que quieres de mí.
Apotheosis (Quest)#418.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#419.src: I'll be there when you go in after her.
Apotheosis (Quest)#419.dst: Estaré allí cuando vayáis a por ella.
Apotheosis (Quest)#419.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#420.src: Is that it... then? I guess we're... done.
Apotheosis (Quest)#420.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#421.src: The rift in the sky... it's all broken, havoc left in her wake, and... and it's my fault.
Apotheosis (Quest)#421.dst: La grieta del cielo... todo está roto, estragos a su paso, y... y es culpa mía.
Apotheosis (Quest)#421.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#422.src: But you won't kill me. So I guess I have to keep going... don't I?
Apotheosis (Quest)#422.dst: Pero no vas a matarme. Así que supongo que tengo que seguir... ¿no?
Apotheosis (Quest)#422.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#425.src: Head to the gates of Aelumia at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Apotheosis (Quest)#425.dst: Ve a las puertas de Aelumia en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#427.src: Make sure everyone is okay in the safe zone at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Apotheosis (Quest)#427.dst: Comprueba que todos están bien en la zona segura en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#428.src: ...and now all chaos has broken loose in the citadel, so some numbers truly would go a long way towards-
Apotheosis (Quest)#428.dst: ...y ahora se ha desatado el caos en la ciudadela, así que unos cuantos brazos más vendrían muy bien para-
Apotheosis (Quest)#428.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#429.src: Yes, Rurie, I know. Hold for just one minute, would you?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#429.dst: Sí, Rurie, lo sé. ¡¿Puedes esperar un minuto?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#429.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#430.src: Fine, fine. Yes, please, take your time! It's not as though the world is ending or anything!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#430.dst: Vale, vale. ¡Sí, tómate tu tiempo! ¡¡¡No es que se esté acabando el mundo ni nada!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#430.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#432.src: Hm? {u}!! You're alive, that's a relief - if you wouldn't mind answering, what the - and excuse the language - HELL is going on?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#432.dst: ¿Hm? ¡¡{u}!! Estás con vida, menos mal - si no te importa responder, ¡¿qué - y perdona el lenguaje - DEMONIOS está pasando?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#432.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#433.src: The SKY ITSELF has cracked open, there's RED LIGHTNING up there - and I have seen storms before, that is not normal - everything is a MESS! Explain.
Apotheosis (Quest)#433.dst: ¡El CIELO MISMO se ha abierto, ahí arriba hay RAYOS ROJOS - y he visto tormentas antes, eso no es normal - todo es un DESASTRE! Explícate.
Apotheosis (Quest)#433.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#436.src: And just when I thought we had reached the limit on fanciful tales... goodness. And you singlehandedly defeated her in combat?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#436.dst: Y justo cuando creía que ya no cabían más historias fantasiosas... madre mía. ¡¿Y la venciste en combate sin ayuda de nadie?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#436.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#438.src: Yes, Cileon, I suppose I shouldn't be surprised after that display... and yet.
Apotheosis (Quest)#438.dst: Sí, Cileon, supongo que no debería sorprenderme tras aquello... y aun así.
Apotheosis (Quest)#438.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#439.src: But back to the topic at hand - she is responsible for all of this?! This is... beyond my means to process.
Apotheosis (Quest)#439.dst: Pero volvamos al tema - ¡¿ella es la responsable de todo esto?! Esto... excede mi capacidad de asimilación.
Apotheosis (Quest)#439.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#440.src: A corrupt and oppressive governmental structure - that, I can plan around. For that, I at least have some inkling as to how to fight against it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#440.dst: Una estructura de gobierno corrupta y opresora - con eso puedo trabajar. Para eso al menos tengo alguna idea de cómo combatirla.
Apotheosis (Quest)#440.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#441.src: But this? For this, I have nothing. What is one even supposed to do about-
Apotheosis (Quest)#441.dst: ¿Pero esto? Para esto no tengo nada. ¿Qué se supone que hace uno con-
Apotheosis (Quest)#441.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#442.src: Ah! There we are! Twelve injured allies, five casualties, one bout of madness... talisman stockpiles mostly burned through - only two remaining, we'll have to produce more...
Apotheosis (Quest)#442.dst: ¡Ah! ¡Ya está! Doce aliados heridos, cinco bajas, un brote de locura... reservas de talismanes casi agotadas - solo quedan dos, tendremos que fabricar más...
Apotheosis (Quest)#442.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#443.src: Food rations will hold for another three and a half days, so we'll need to send a supply run tomorrow... at least armor and weapon supplies are still in surp-
Apotheosis (Quest)#443.dst: Las raciones aguantan tres días y medio más, así que mañana habrá que enviar suministros... al menos de armaduras y armas seguimos con exced-
Apotheosis (Quest)#443.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#444.src: Oh. {u}, you're here. Good to see you're still standing. What are we talking about?
Apotheosis (Quest)#444.dst: Ah. {u}, estás aquí. Me alegra verte en pie. ¿De qué hablamos?
Apotheosis (Quest)#444.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#447.src: Ah! So you defeated her, and she fled into the rifts. Very good work, deerling.
Apotheosis (Quest)#447.dst: ¡Ah! Así que la venciste y huyó a las grietas. Buen trabajo, cervatillo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#447.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#448.src: ...by most metrics, we've achieved our goal. Her Majesty has been dethroned, her Sovereigns either killed or turned - we have something to work with.
Apotheosis (Quest)#448.dst: ...en casi todo, hemos logrado el objetivo. Su Majestad destronada, sus Soberanos muertos o pasados a nuestro bando - tenemos con qué trabajar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#448.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#449.src: But this rift... there's very little we can do while it's there. The people are panicked, the soldiers scattered, defensive, lost - and that isn't to mention whatever adverse effects it may or may not have!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#449.dst: Pero esta grieta... poco podemos hacer mientras siga ahí. La gente está aterrada, los soldados dispersos, a la defensiva, perdidos - ¡¡y eso sin mencionar los efectos adversos que pueda tener o no!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#449.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#450.src: Perhaps if it can be cut off at its source...
Apotheosis (Quest)#450.dst: Quizá si se pudiera cortar en su origen...
Apotheosis (Quest)#450.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#451.src: What, you mean passing through it into whatever it is on the other side? All in the hopes of chasing down the Queen? Who would be insane enough to even consider-
Apotheosis (Quest)#451.dst: ¿Qué, te refieres a atravesarla hacia lo que sea que haya al otro lado? ¿Todo con la esperanza de dar caza a la Reina? ¿Quién estaría tan loco como para plantear-
Apotheosis (Quest)#451.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#452.src: Right! Of course, how could I forget! We have you. Well, I suppose that's all sorted then - not a problem I need concern myself with. What a relief.
Apotheosis (Quest)#452.dst: ¡Claro! ¡Cómo he podido olvidarlo! Te tenemos a ti. Bueno, pues asunto resuelto - no es un problema que deba preocuparme. Qué alivio.
Apotheosis (Quest)#452.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#453.src: Hm. Leaves us more time to finalize the stabilizing plan for the province, to deal with the chaos that comes after this chaos concludes. Joy.
Apotheosis (Quest)#453.dst: Hm. Nos deja más tiempo para cerrar el plan de estabilización de la provincia y afrontar el caos que llegará cuando acabe este caos. Qué bien.
Apotheosis (Quest)#453.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#454.src: Yes, yes... we can get to that. {u}, before you set off on yet another dangerous mission, you'd best go speak to everyone here. Alleviate some concerns, yes?
Apotheosis (Quest)#454.dst: Sí, sí... eso puede esperar. {u}, antes de partir a otra misión peligrosa, más vale que hables con todos los de aquí. Calmar algunas inquietudes, ¿sí?
Apotheosis (Quest)#454.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#455.dst: ...¿y tú estás bien? ¿Nada de heridas- nada?
Apotheosis (Quest)#455.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#456.src: Ughhhhh... yeah, bro, I'm fine! Quit hovering!
Apotheosis (Quest)#456.dst: Uffff... ¡que sí, tío, estoy bien! ¡Deja de rondarme!
Apotheosis (Quest)#456.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#457.src: Well, sorry for being worried under these circumstances! The SKY is broken, Yuman, so let me hover at least a little, okay?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#457.dst: ¡Perdona por preocuparme en estas circunstancias! El CIELO está roto, Yuman, déjame rondarte un poco, ¿vale?
Apotheosis (Quest)#457.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#458.src: Well, a...at least the soldiers have b- ba- backed off a little... so, that's s- something.
Apotheosis (Quest)#458.dst: Bueno, a...al menos los soldados se han re- re- retirado un poco... así que, algo es a- algo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#458.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#459.src: Sigh... yeah, that is something. I'm almost out of electrical charges...
Apotheosis (Quest)#459.dst: Suspiro... sí, algo es algo. Casi no me quedan cargas eléctricas...
Apotheosis (Quest)#459.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#462.src: S...so does that mean you... y- you stopped her?
Apotheosis (Quest)#462.dst: ¿E...entonces eso significa que... l- la detuviste?
Apotheosis (Quest)#462.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#465.src: ...I hear a "but" added on to the end. Where are Rex and Sui?
Apotheosis (Quest)#465.dst: ...noto un "pero" al final de eso. ¿Dónde están Rex y Sui?
Apotheosis (Quest)#465.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#469.src: B...but she's... sh- she's okay, now...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#469.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#470.src: ...man. Man. That... that really sucks, huh?
Apotheosis (Quest)#470.dst: ...tío. Tío. Eso... eso es una mierda, ¿eh?
Apotheosis (Quest)#470.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#471.src: Her... h- her bow... she's n- ne- never gonna be able to... use it ag- again...
Apotheosis (Quest)#471.dst: Su... s- su arco... ya n- no va a poder... volver a u- usarlo...
Apotheosis (Quest)#471.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#472.src: I didn't even consider that... man. So, then... Sui's with her still?
Apotheosis (Quest)#472.dst: Ni se me había ocurrido... tío. Entonces... ¿Sui sigue con ella?
Apotheosis (Quest)#472.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#473.src: She's... in good hands, at least. Multiple Sovereigns, turning to our side... it's a little hard to believe.
Apotheosis (Quest)#473.dst: Está... en buenas manos, al menos. Varios Soberanos pasándose a nuestro bando... cuesta un poco creerlo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#473.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#474.src: But this is good. If they've turned against the Queen... it'll make things easier for us once this is all over.
Apotheosis (Quest)#474.dst: Pero esto es bueno. Si se han vuelto contra la Reina... nos lo pondrá más fácil cuando todo esto acabe.
Apotheosis (Quest)#474.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#475.src: Guess so... WAIT! So Zhiraok broke Soosu out of prison?! Was that-
Apotheosis (Quest)#475.dst: Supongo... ¡ESPERA! ¡¿Zhiraok sacó a Soosu de la cárcel?! ¿Eso fue-
Apotheosis (Quest)#475.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#476.src: -wh- what we saw? It was a- a flash of s- so- something, going into and out of the p...palace! Just before the sk...sky broke.
Apotheosis (Quest)#476.dst: -¿l- lo que vimos? ¡Fue un- un destello de a- a- algo que entró y salió del p...palacio! Justo antes de que el c...cielo se rompiera.
Apotheosis (Quest)#476.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#477.src: It must've been! That explains some things! Hey, no wonder the soldiers were so confused!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#477.dst: ¡Tuvo que ser eso! ¡Explica algunas cosas! ¡¡Con razón los soldados estaban tan liados!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#477.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#479.src: ...{u}. The Queen isn't d...dead, is she?
Apotheosis (Quest)#479.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#480.src: Then... y...you're going after her. Right?
Apotheosis (Quest)#480.dst: Entonces... v...vas a ir a por ella. ¿Verdad?
Apotheosis (Quest)#480.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#481.src: Zeph... you're not thinking of going in there too, are you?
Apotheosis (Quest)#481.dst: Zeph... no estarás pensando en entrar ahí tú también, ¿no?
Apotheosis (Quest)#481.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#484.src: I- I have to... Rex won't be in any sh- shape to fight, a- and- and it's my turn to do my p...part anyway!
Apotheosis (Quest)#484.dst: T- tengo que ir... Rex no estará en c- condiciones de luchar, y- y- ¡y me toca a mí poner de mi p...parte!
Apotheosis (Quest)#484.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#485.src: ... Fine. But you have to come back, princess! We've got plans, remember? I still have to show you where I grew up, and-
Apotheosis (Quest)#485.dst: ...Vale. ¡Pero tienes que volver, princesa! Tenemos planes, ¿recuerdas? Aún tengo que enseñarte dónde me crie, y-
Apotheosis (Quest)#485.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#486.src: -and sh...show me your favourite food stand from when you were gr...growing up, I- I know. I'll be b- back.
Apotheosis (Quest)#486.dst: -y ens...enseñarme tu puesto de comida favorito de cuando eras p...pequeño, l- lo sé. V- volveré.
Apotheosis (Quest)#486.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#487.src: Okay, lovebirds, that's my signal to get out of here. There's schedules I have to organize...
Apotheosis (Quest)#487.dst: Vale, tortolitos, esa es mi señal para largarme. Tengo horarios que organizar...
Apotheosis (Quest)#487.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#488.src: ...but yeah. Zeph, {u}, I expect to see you two again. Understood?
Apotheosis (Quest)#488.dst: ...en serio. Zeph, {u}, espero volver a veros. ¿Entendido?
Apotheosis (Quest)#488.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#490.src: {u}, I'm glad to see you're back.
Apotheosis (Quest)#490.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#491.src: I heard from Zeph that you and the girls decided to challenge Her Majesty.
Apotheosis (Quest)#491.dst: Zeph me contó que tú y las chicas decidisteis desafiar a Su Majestad.
Apotheosis (Quest)#491.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#492.src: How... how did it go? I can't help notice the lack of companions by your side.
Apotheosis (Quest)#492.dst: ¿Cómo... cómo ha ido? No puedo evitar notar que vienes sin compañía.
Apotheosis (Quest)#492.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#493.src: Sui has grown into quite the powerful cursed one, huh?
Apotheosis (Quest)#493.dst: Sui se ha convertido en una maldita muy poderosa, ¿eh?
Apotheosis (Quest)#493.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#494.src: Did I hear that right... Soosu?
Apotheosis (Quest)#494.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#495.src: That... is an unexpected turn of events. However, you may accept their change of heart but for the rest of us...
Apotheosis (Quest)#495.dst: Eso... es un giro inesperado. Tú puedes aceptar su cambio de opinión, pero para el resto de nosotros...
Apotheosis (Quest)#495.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#496.src: They are an extension of her Majesty. All the pain and suffering they have caused is because of them.
Apotheosis (Quest)#496.dst: Son una extensión de Su Majestad. Todo el dolor y el sufrimiento que han causado es cosa suya.
Apotheosis (Quest)#496.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#498.src: We have been thinking about how to handle the aftermath; in case we were successful. The larger populous knows of us as only terrorists. They would never accept us to rebuild Fruma.
Apotheosis (Quest)#498.dst: Hemos estado pensando cómo manejar las secuelas, por si teníamos éxito. La mayoría de la gente solo nos conoce como terroristas. Nunca aceptarían que reconstruyéramos Fruma.
Apotheosis (Quest)#498.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#499.src: But. With the Sovereigns on our side, the people might, they just might, hear them out.
Apotheosis (Quest)#499.dst: Pero. Con los Soberanos de nuestro lado, puede, solo puede, que la gente los escuche.
Apotheosis (Quest)#499.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#500.src: Ugh. You're right. This is the best option we got.
Apotheosis (Quest)#500.dst: Uf. Tienes razón. Es la mejor opción que tenemos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#500.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#501.src: We will need to arrange a meeting with them to discuss moving forwards. I expect it to be tense, even hostile. But, but we can do this.
Apotheosis (Quest)#501.dst: Habrá que concertar una reunión con ellos para hablar del futuro. Será tensa, incluso hostil. Pero, pero podemos hacerlo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#501.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#502.src: I'll get Fuhue to draft up our plan, then.
Apotheosis (Quest)#502.dst: Entonces le diré a Fuhue que redacte el plan.
Apotheosis (Quest)#502.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#504.src: Went without a scratch, of course.
Apotheosis (Quest)#504.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#505.src: Well, we did have a lot of issues... I wasn't worried but I'm glad Zeph and Cileon returned with us.
Apotheosis (Quest)#505.dst: Bueno, problemas hubo muchos... No me preocupaba, pero me alegro de que Zeph y Cileon volvieran con nosotros.
Apotheosis (Quest)#505.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#506.src: Fuhue's talismans were doing a lot of the heavy listing in their absence.
Apotheosis (Quest)#506.dst: Sin ellos, los talismanes de Fuhue cargaron con casi todo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#506.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#507.src: The Canopy will be helping with the aftermath. I don't care for becoming a public figure after this is over. though.
Apotheosis (Quest)#507.dst: El Dosel ayudará con las secuelas. Aunque no me apetece convertirme en figura pública cuando esto acabe.
Apotheosis (Quest)#507.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#508.src: The trees are calling my name and the {p} is definitely not the place for me.
Apotheosis (Quest)#508.dst: Los árboles me llaman y {p} no es sitio para mí, desde luego.
Apotheosis (Quest)#508.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#509.src: Besides, could you ever see such a hunk like me become a politician... Pshh, at least I can't.
Apotheosis (Quest)#509.dst: Además, ¿te imaginas a un tipazo como yo metido a político...? Pff, yo desde luego no.
Apotheosis (Quest)#509.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#512.src: Foxes and I cleared them out.
Apotheosis (Quest)#512.dst: Los zorros y yo los limpiamos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#512.speaker: Cileon

Apotheosis (Quest)#513.src: I want to return to the forest.
Apotheosis (Quest)#513.speaker: Cileon

Apotheosis (Quest)#514.src: Need to hunt, run and stay away from... cities.
Apotheosis (Quest)#514.dst: Necesito cazar, correr y alejarme de... las ciudades.
Apotheosis (Quest)#514.speaker: Cileon

Apotheosis (Quest)#517.src: My talismans did the trick. Managed to keep up a temporary barrier for some time.
Apotheosis (Quest)#517.dst: Mis talismanes funcionaron. Logré mantener una barrera temporal un buen rato.
Apotheosis (Quest)#517.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#518.src: Unfortunately, they only last for some time and my schedule has not allowed me to create more. It was a miscalculation on my side.
Apotheosis (Quest)#518.dst: Por desgracia, solo duran un tiempo y mi agenda no me ha dejado fabricar más. Fue un error de cálculo por mi parte.
Apotheosis (Quest)#518.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#519.src: I have completely, utterly failed as the Deer's captain. I totally underestimated how many barrier talismans we needed!
Apotheosis (Quest)#519.dst: He fracasado del todo como capitana de los Ciervos. ¡Subestimé cuántos talismanes de barrera hacían falta!
Apotheosis (Quest)#519.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#520.src: The Canopy will remain. Master has asked me to document everything that has transpired in the past coupl of weeks. It will take me at least one week and three days to compile it all.
Apotheosis (Quest)#520.dst: El Dosel se quedará. El Maestro me ha pedido que documente todo lo ocurrido en las últimas semanas. Me llevará al menos una semana y tres días recopilarlo todo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#520.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#521.src: Besides, without the Queen a new government will have to be established. I am planning to be of assistance, there as well.
Apotheosis (Quest)#521.dst: Además, sin la Reina habrá que establecer un nuevo gobierno. Pienso prestar ayuda también en eso.
Apotheosis (Quest)#521.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#524.src: When we got- got back we had almost been c-completely overtaken.
Apotheosis (Quest)#524.dst: Cuando vol- volvimos ya casi nos habían t-tomado del todo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#524.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#525.src: I'd like t-to -to believe I helped but... to be honest Rurie did most of the w-work.
Apotheosis (Quest)#525.dst: Me gustaría c-cre- creer que ayudé, pero... la verdad es que Rurie hizo casi todo el t-trabajo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#525.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#526.src: I felt guilty that I- I left you guys.
Apotheosis (Quest)#526.dst: Me sentí culpable por- por dejaros.
Apotheosis (Quest)#526.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#527.src: But I will n-not back down for this final showdown!
Apotheosis (Quest)#527.dst: ¡Pero en este último combate no- no pienso echarme atrás!
Apotheosis (Quest)#527.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#529.src: It's, it's weird. After everything we've g-gone through, after everyone we- we- we lost. I have hope for the future.
Apotheosis (Quest)#529.dst: Es, es raro. Tras todo lo que hemos p-pasado, tras todos los que- que perdimos. Tengo esperanza en el futuro.
Apotheosis (Quest)#529.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#530.src: I promised myself when... when I was captured that if I- I made it out, I would not let my life fly by. I will l-live for Syndra and Mora. I will k-keep Syndra's legacy going.
Apotheosis (Quest)#530.dst: Me prometí cuando... cuando me capturaron que si s- salía de allí no dejaría que mi vida pasara de largo. V-viviré por Syndra y Mora. M-mantendré vivo el legado de Syndra.
Apotheosis (Quest)#530.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#531.src: And I made a p-promise to Yuman. I w-want to explore the world with- with him.
Apotheosis (Quest)#531.dst: Y le hice una p-promesa a Yuman. Q-quiero recorrer el mundo con- con él.
Apotheosis (Quest)#531.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#532.src: I don't think I- I will n-never be ready but, I want to do all that I c-can.
Apotheosis (Quest)#532.dst: Creo que n- nunca estaré lista, pero quiero hacer todo lo que p-pueda.
Apotheosis (Quest)#532.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#533.src: I won't be a hinderance to you. I k-know you and Sui are strong but... I'm not h-helpless.
Apotheosis (Quest)#533.dst: No voy a ser un estorbo. S-sé que Sui y tú sois fuertes, pero... no estoy i-indefensa.
Apotheosis (Quest)#533.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#534.src: I'll follow you whenever you're r-ready, friend.
Apotheosis (Quest)#534.dst: Te seguiré cuando t- tú quieras, amigo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#534.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#536.src: Things were looking veeery hairy for a bit. Luckily, Rurie brought back up just in time.
Apotheosis (Quest)#536.dst: Por un momento la cosa pintaba muuuy fea. Por suerte, Rurie trajo refuerzos justo a tiempo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#536.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#537.src: Those Canopy people can be quite scary, I must say.
Apotheosis (Quest)#537.dst: Los del Dosel dan bastante miedo, la verdad.
Apotheosis (Quest)#537.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#538.src: I know that chaos is sure to ensue with Her Majesty gone but, I don't think I'm the best at... cleaning up a province.
Apotheosis (Quest)#538.dst: Sé que sin Su Majestad va a haber caos seguro, pero no creo que lo mío sea... arreglar una provincia.
Apotheosis (Quest)#538.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#539.src: I would honestly love to see the world. Traveling the world with someone you like sounds... nice.
Apotheosis (Quest)#539.dst: La verdad es que me encantaría ver mundo. Viajar por ahí con alguien que te gusta suena... bien.
Apotheosis (Quest)#539.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#540.src: I also miss the Steel Feather. I don't know what will happen to that place, or what has happened for that matter, but that place will always be my home.
Apotheosis (Quest)#540.dst: También echo de menos la Pluma de Acero. No sé qué será de ese sitio, ni qué ha sido ya, pero siempre será mi hogar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#540.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#543.src: I'm just glad we managed to sort the situation.
Apotheosis (Quest)#543.dst: Me alegro de que hayamos podido enderezar la situación.
Apotheosis (Quest)#543.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#544.src: My electric charges almost ran out and I would have been useless without them.
Apotheosis (Quest)#544.dst: Casi me quedo sin cargas eléctricas, y sin ellas no valgo de nada.
Apotheosis (Quest)#544.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#545.src: Honestly, I'm ready to deal with the fall out of this revolution.
Apotheosis (Quest)#545.dst: La verdad, estoy listo para afrontar las secuelas de esta revolución.
Apotheosis (Quest)#545.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#546.src: I want to make a difference. I want to make sure the new Fruma is a good place. It will for sure take some time. But, I'm ready to spend the rest of my life bettering the province.
Apotheosis (Quest)#546.dst: Quiero marcar la diferencia. Quiero que la nueva Fruma sea un buen sitio. Seguro que llevará tiempo. Pero estoy dispuesto a pasar el resto de mi vida mejorando la provincia.
Apotheosis (Quest)#546.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#547.src: I better be seeing you later.
Apotheosis (Quest)#547.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#549.src: I intend to make up for my past mistakes. I don't think I told you this before but, the wall that separates the {p} from the Roughworks was designed by me during my university stay.
Apotheosis (Quest)#549.dst: Pretendo compensar mis errores del pasado. Creo que no te lo he contado, pero el muro que separa {p} de Roughworks lo diseñé yo en mis años de universidad.
Apotheosis (Quest)#549.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#550.src: I thought- I thought I was protecting the people of the Roughworks from the dangers of the {p}. But in reality, all I did was separate the people.
Apotheosis (Quest)#550.dst: Creía- creía que protegía a la gente de Roughworks de los peligros de {p}. Pero en realidad lo único que hice fue separar a la gente.
Apotheosis (Quest)#550.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#551.src: Fruma needs all the help it can get once this is all over. Everyone will need to cooperate to save the province from destroying itself without a ruler.
Apotheosis (Quest)#551.dst: Fruma necesitará toda la ayuda posible cuando esto acabe. Todos tendrán que cooperar para que la provincia no se destruya a sí misma sin gobernante.
Apotheosis (Quest)#551.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#554.src: I might hand the responsibilities for liberating Fruma to the young ones.
Apotheosis (Quest)#554.dst: Puede que deje la liberación de Fruma en manos de los jóvenes.
Apotheosis (Quest)#554.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#555.src: I've lived long enough and honestly, retirement sounds rather nice.
Apotheosis (Quest)#555.dst: Ya he vivido bastante y, la verdad, jubilarme suena bastante bien.
Apotheosis (Quest)#555.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#561.src: She, um... she is. S-Sovereign Zhiraok, he, um, took her to a medic. And... went to try to get control of the army.
Apotheosis (Quest)#561.dst: Ella, eh... sí. El S-Soberano Zhiraok, eh, la llevó a un médico. Y... fue a intentar controlar el ejército.
Apotheosis (Quest)#561.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#562.src: ...I don't want to think about him. Or- or Soosu. I don't... like that everything's just- j-just okay now. Because of a common enemy.
Apotheosis (Quest)#562.dst: ...no quiero pensar en él. Ni- ni en Soosu. No me... gusta que ahora todo esté- e-esté bien sin más. Por un enemigo común.
Apotheosis (Quest)#562.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#563.src: So... later. I'll think about it later. After we're d-
Apotheosis (Quest)#563.dst: Así que... luego. Ya lo pensaré luego. Cuando hayamos t-
Apotheosis (Quest)#563.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#564.src: Sui!!! I- I- I heard about what you g...guys did!! You st- st- stopped the Queen!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#564.dst: ¡¡¡Sui!!! ¡¡M- m- me he enterado de lo que h...hicisteis!! ¡¡¡De- de- detuvisteis a la Reina!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#564.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#565.dst: ...sí. Lo hicieron Rex y {u}. Yo... no.
Apotheosis (Quest)#565.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#566.src: What? Sui, you he- held back the lake's water from fl- fl- flooding the {p}!! If it wasn't for y...you, then-
Apotheosis (Quest)#566.dst: ¿Qué? Sui, ¡¡con- contuviste el agua del lago para que no in- inundara {p}!! Si no fuera por t...ti-
Apotheosis (Quest)#566.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#567.src: It doesn't MATTER! While I was stuck h-holding back the flood, I- I couldn't help fight!! Again - AGAIN!!! - someone got hurt because I COULDN'T BE THERE!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#567.dst: ¡NO IMPORTA! Mientras estaba atrapada c-conteniendo la riada, ¡¡no- no pude ayudar a luchar!! Otra vez - ¡¡¡OTRA VEZ!!! - alguien salió herido porque ¡¡¡YO NO ESTABA ALLÍ!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#567.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#568.src: Rex. She... she died, Zeph, I felt it. For a minute, I was holding her- her cold, LIFELESS BODY in my hands, and- a-and it was like I was there again. With... M-Mora.
Apotheosis (Quest)#568.dst: Rex. Ella... murió, Zeph, lo sentí. Durante un minuto tuve en las manos su- su CUERPO frío y SIN VIDA, y- y- y fue como estar allí otra vez. Con... M-Mora.
Apotheosis (Quest)#568.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#569.src: ...I failed again. I told myself, if I was STRONGER, if I was BETTER, it WOULDN'T HAPPEN AGAIN!! And it DID!!! Even if she got better, even if she's not dead, it's still MY FAULT!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#569.dst: ...fallé otra vez. Me dije que si fuera MÁS FUERTE, si fuera MEJOR, ¡¡NO VOLVERÍA A PASAR!! ¡¡¡Y PASÓ!!! Aunque se recupere, aunque no esté muerta, ¡¡¡sigue siendo CULPA MÍA!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#569.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#571.src: A- and if you were able to s...save Rex, but the dam broke... and all th- those people died instead... would that have been b- be- better?
Apotheosis (Quest)#571.dst: ¿Y- y si hubieras podido s...salvar a Rex, pero la presa cede... y mueren t- todas esas personas en su lugar... habría sido m- me- mejor?
Apotheosis (Quest)#571.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#573.src: I've b...been thinking about it, ever since {u} t- told me... if- if I had been th- there, a- and not here, could I have st...stopped it...? A- an extra pair of eyes...
Apotheosis (Quest)#573.dst: L-llevo pensándolo desde que {u} m- me lo contó... si- si yo hubiera estado a- allí, y- y no aquí, ¿habría podido im...impedirlo...? U- un par de ojos más...
Apotheosis (Quest)#573.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#574.src: B- but I was here, instead, a- a- and because of that, I was able to m...make sure Yuman survived! If it were the other way around... I'd feel the same!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#574.dst: P- pero estuve aquí, y- y- y gracias a eso pude a...asegurarme de que Yuman sobreviviera. Si fuera al revés... ¡¡sentiría lo mismo!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#574.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#576.src: She's still out there. Through that rift. We're going to kill her, Zeph.
Apotheosis (Quest)#576.dst: Sigue ahí fuera. Al otro lado de esa grieta. Vamos a matarla, Zeph.
Apotheosis (Quest)#576.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#577.src: ...right now? Sui, are you s...sure? Controlling that much water, it mu- must have drained your mana... can you st...still fight?
Apotheosis (Quest)#577.dst: ...¿ahora mismo? Sui, ¿es...estás segura? Controlar tanta agua te ha- habrá vaciado el maná... ¿puedes to...todavía luchar?
Apotheosis (Quest)#577.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#578.src: ...yes. I... it doesn't feel like I've used any magic at all. I, um, don't feel tired at all.
Apotheosis (Quest)#578.dst: ...sí. Yo... ni siquiera siento que haya usado magia. Yo, eh, no estoy nada cansada.
Apotheosis (Quest)#578.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#579.src: Ever since the {p}, the ocean's... grown. Or... no, that's wrong - it was always this big, I just... couldn't see it before.
Apotheosis (Quest)#579.dst: Desde lo de {p}, el océano ha... crecido. O... no, eso no es - siempre fue así de grande, solo que yo... no lo veía antes.
Apotheosis (Quest)#579.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#580.src: It's... mana, but it's not mine. It's... all the strands, the threads, tied up in everything. And I can, um, use as much as I want.
Apotheosis (Quest)#580.dst: Es... maná, pero no es mío. Son... todos los hilos, las hebras, enredados en todo. Y puedo, eh, usar todo el que quiera.
Apotheosis (Quest)#580.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#581.src: ...okay. So y- you- you're going now...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#581.dst: ...vale. ¿Así que t- te- te vas ya...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#581.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#583.src: Th- then let me join you! Things are c...calmer here, now, so- so they should be fine w- with- without me!
Apotheosis (Quest)#583.dst: ¡E- entonces dejadme ir! Aquí está todo más t...tranquilo, así- así que estarán bien s- sin- sin mí.
Apotheosis (Quest)#583.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#584.src: ...okay, Zeph. We could use the help.
Apotheosis (Quest)#584.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#586.src: I- I did it! I finally, finally, FINALLY did it!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#586.dst: ¡L- lo conseguí! ¡¡¡Por fin, por fin, POR FIN lo conseguí!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#586.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#588.src: The Resonance Weaver - I had theories before, workable theories, but I wasn't sure. But I am now!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#588.dst: El Tejedor de Resonancia - antes tenía teorías, teorías viables, pero no estaba seguro. ¡¡Ahora sí!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#588.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#589.src: It was in the glyphs! They don't just call upon the five elements, they ARE the five elements! Like Soosu's writings about matter - building blocks of reality!
Apotheosis (Quest)#589.dst: ¡Estaba en los glifos! No solo invocan los cinco elementos, ¡SON los cinco elementos! Como los escritos de Soosu sobre la materia - ¡los ladrillos de la realidad!
Apotheosis (Quest)#589.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#590.src: The Weaver pulls on these strands - the physical makeup of our reality - and uses them to... well... do mostly anything.
Apotheosis (Quest)#590.dst: El Tejedor tira de esos hilos - la composición física de nuestra realidad - y los usa para... bueno... casi cualquier cosa.
Apotheosis (Quest)#590.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#591.src: I used it before to make that... corruption visible. But with enough experimenting, you could do more than just visualizing it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#591.dst: Antes lo usé para hacer visible esa... corrupción. Pero con suficientes pruebas se podría hacer más que solo verla.
Apotheosis (Quest)#591.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#592.src: Thread it into something else, or change the course of its flow, or... or even bind it to something physical!
Apotheosis (Quest)#592.dst: ¡Tejerla en otra cosa, cambiar el curso de su flujo, o... o incluso atarla a algo físico!
Apotheosis (Quest)#592.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#593.src: ...I didn't see her transform. What did it look like?
Apotheosis (Quest)#593.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#594.src: S...so, what, that's how she b- became... human?
Apotheosis (Quest)#594.dst: ¿E...entonces así fue como se v- volvió... humana?
Apotheosis (Quest)#594.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#595.src: ...I don't really care. Yusanu, can it help with our... um, our rift problem?
Apotheosis (Quest)#595.dst: ...me da igual. Yusanu, ¿sirve para nuestro... eh, problema de la grieta?
Apotheosis (Quest)#595.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#596.src: Uh... maybe. To- to be clear, the Weaver is still... hard to use. If we had people more familiar with the glyphs... it could be very powerful. But we don't.
Apotheosis (Quest)#596.dst: Eh... quizá. Que- que quede claro, el Tejedor sigue siendo... difícil de usar. Con gente que conociera los glifos... sería muy potente. Pero no la hay.
Apotheosis (Quest)#596.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#597.src: In theory... it should be able to close the rifts. Would just- ha, need to weave reality shut again. But... I don't know how.
Apotheosis (Quest)#597.dst: En teoría... debería poder cerrar las grietas. Solo habría- ja, que volver a tejer la realidad. Pero... no sé cómo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#597.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#598.src: Um... S-Soveriegn Soosu might know. She and- a-and Zhiraok are... no longer against us. F-for now, at least.
Apotheosis (Quest)#598.dst: Eh... puede que la S-Soberana Soosu lo sepa. Ella y- y Zhiraok ya... no están contra nosotros. P-por ahora.
Apotheosis (Quest)#598.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#599.src: ...got it. I'll see what I can do..
Apotheosis (Quest)#599.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#600.src: You're... heading in to deal with the source, aren't you?
Apotheosis (Quest)#600.dst: Vais... a entrar a ocuparos del origen, ¿verdad?
Apotheosis (Quest)#600.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#602.src: Then... good luck. Don't die. Be careful. We'll hold the fort while you're gone, until everything stabilizes, at least.
Apotheosis (Quest)#602.dst: Entonces... suerte. No muráis. Con cuidado. Aguantaremos aquí mientras no estéis, hasta que todo se estabilice.
Apotheosis (Quest)#602.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#603.src: ...yeah. We should get going. See you when it's all over.
Apotheosis (Quest)#603.dst: ...sí. Deberíamos irnos. Nos vemos cuando todo acabe.
Apotheosis (Quest)#603.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#604.src: Head to the Royal Palace at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#606.src: It's fine. My mana has never been stronger. You don't have to worry about me.
Apotheosis (Quest)#606.dst: Estoy bien. Mi maná nunca ha sido tan fuerte. No tienes que preocuparte por mí.
Apotheosis (Quest)#606.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#608.src: Awful, empty, sad, enraged... Does that paint you a clear picture? But I can't afford that. Not, now.
Apotheosis (Quest)#608.dst: Fatal, vacía, triste, furiosa... ¿Te hace una idea clara? Pero no puedo permitírmelo. Ahora, no.
Apotheosis (Quest)#608.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#609.src: I... I still haven't given it much thought.
Apotheosis (Quest)#609.dst: Yo... aún no lo he pensado mucho.
Apotheosis (Quest)#609.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#610.src: I'll think about it if- when we kill her for good.
Apotheosis (Quest)#610.dst: Lo pensaré si- cuando la matemos del todo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#610.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#613.src: To be honest. If it weren't for your information about worlds beyond ours, I would never have figured it out. Besides, Sui taught me a lot about magic which helped...
Apotheosis (Quest)#613.dst: La verdad. Si no fuera por lo que contaste sobre mundos más allá del nuestro, nunca lo habría resuelto. Además, Sui me enseñó mucho sobre magia, y eso ayudó...
Apotheosis (Quest)#613.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#614.src: At the end of the day, Soosu has taught me to... think outside of the box and I have gotten quite used to how she builds her inventions.
Apotheosis (Quest)#614.dst: Al final, Soosu me ha enseñado a... pensar fuera de lo común, y ya me he acostumbrado bastante a cómo monta sus inventos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#614.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#615.src: I haven't been able to test my theory on the use but I'm {~} certain it will work.
Apotheosis (Quest)#615.dst: No he podido probar mi teoría de uso, pero estoy {~} seguro de que funciona.
Apotheosis (Quest)#615.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#616.src: I have a lot I want to do. I feel like a world of opportunity has opened for me. I want to travel the world, explore the other provinces and share research.
Apotheosis (Quest)#616.dst: Tengo mucho que hacer. Siento que se me ha abierto un mundo de oportunidades. Quiero viajar, explorar otras provincias y compartir investigaciones.
Apotheosis (Quest)#616.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#617.src: But more importantly, I heard from Quill that Soosu is alive. I think- I think she should join me on my travels. Once the aftermath has calmed down a bit.
Apotheosis (Quest)#617.dst: Pero, más importante, Quill me ha dicho que Soosu está viva. Creo- creo que debería acompañarme en mis viajes. Cuando esto se calme un poco.
Apotheosis (Quest)#617.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#620.src: I've.. done what I can. Reached as many people as I could, with the time I had. The rest...
Apotheosis (Quest)#620.dst: He.. hecho lo que he podido. He llegado a toda la gente que pude con el tiempo que tenía. El resto...
Apotheosis (Quest)#620.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#621.src: The gendarme won't listen to me... their commander's disappeared somewhere, and they won't tell me anything about it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#621.dst: Los gendarmes no me escuchan... su comandante ha desaparecido y no me quieren decir nada del asunto.
Apotheosis (Quest)#621.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#622.src: ...I thought she understood me. I still think she did, but... it doesn't make up for this. Any of this.
Apotheosis (Quest)#622.dst: ...creía que ella me entendía. Sigo creyéndolo, pero... eso no compensa esto. Nada de esto.
Apotheosis (Quest)#622.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#623.src: The cracks are finally showing... I always knew they were there, I just. Told myself they weren't the end of the world. Ha.
Apotheosis (Quest)#623.dst: Las grietas por fin se ven... Siempre supe que estaban ahí, solo que. Me decía que no eran el fin del mundo. Ja.
Apotheosis (Quest)#623.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#624.src: ...it's strange. For all that I thought she understood me... maybe she never really did. How much of what she said was real? How much of it wasn't?
Apotheosis (Quest)#624.dst: ...es extraño. Por mucho que creyera que me entendía... quizá nunca lo hizo de verdad. ¿Cuánto de lo que decía era real? ¿Cuánto no?
Apotheosis (Quest)#624.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#625.src: The cracks had been showing for a while, I just... chose to push them aside. I didn't think I would make it out of this, so... why push back on it?
Apotheosis (Quest)#625.dst: Las grietas llevaban tiempo a la vista, solo que... preferí apartarlas. No creía que fuera a salir de esta, así que... ¿para qué resistirme?
Apotheosis (Quest)#625.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#626.src: ...I still think her plan would have worked to stop the end of the world. She had the method and the means...
Apotheosis (Quest)#626.dst: ...sigo pensando que su plan habría evitado el fin del mundo. Tenía el método y los medios...
Apotheosis (Quest)#626.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#627.src: But it was never her priority. She was always focused on... this. Keeping Fruma perfect, and under her control.
Apotheosis (Quest)#627.dst: Pero nunca fue su prioridad. Siempre estuvo centrada en... esto. Mantener Fruma perfecta y bajo su control.
Apotheosis (Quest)#627.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#628.src: ...does any of this matter? I guess not. We've found ourselves here, either way. Nothing to do but... keep moving forward.
Apotheosis (Quest)#628.dst: ...¿importa algo de esto? Supongo que no. Hemos acabado aquí de todos modos. No queda más que... seguir adelante.
Apotheosis (Quest)#628.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#629.src: YOU!!! {u}, what is HE doing here?! After he- he- he KILLED Rex, so why is he HERE?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#629.dst: ¡¡¡TÚ!!! {u}, ¡¿qué hace ÉL aquí?! ¡¿MATÓ a Rex, así que por qué está AQUÍ?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#629.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#630.src: I should... I should kill you. You- you'd DESERVE it, for everything!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#630.dst: Debería... debería matarte. ¡¡¡Te- te lo MERECERÍAS, por todo!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#630.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#632.src: ...maybe. Maybe I do. But I can't just leave my mistakes for other people to deal with.
Apotheosis (Quest)#632.dst: ...quizá. Quizá sí. Pero no puedo dejar que otros arreglen mis errores.
Apotheosis (Quest)#632.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#633.src: I'm here to help with the Queen. I have to see it through, or... or I've made these mistakes for nothing.
Apotheosis (Quest)#633.dst: Estoy aquí para ayudar con la Reina. Tengo que llegar al final, o... o habré cometido estos errores para nada.
Apotheosis (Quest)#633.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#634.src: ...right. Of course you want to help, what else would you do? Sigh. Everyone who hurts me, always... out of reach.
Apotheosis (Quest)#634.dst: ...ya. Claro que quieres ayudar, ¿qué si no? Suspiro. Todo el que me hace daño, siempre... fuera de alcance.
Apotheosis (Quest)#634.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#635.src: Fine. Fine. Until this is done... I'll... ignore it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#635.dst: Vale. Vale. Hasta que esto acabe... lo... ignoraré.
Apotheosis (Quest)#635.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#636.src: I can't wait for this nightmare to be over...
Apotheosis (Quest)#636.dst: Estoy deseando que acabe esta pesadilla...
Apotheosis (Quest)#636.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#638.src: I don't want to hear it. I don't care what you have to say for yourself.
Apotheosis (Quest)#638.dst: No quiero oírlo. Me da igual lo que tengas que decir en tu defensa.
Apotheosis (Quest)#638.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#641.src: {u}. I'm here, aren't I? Sigh... Look at it all. What a mess. The sky itself is cracked and broken!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#641.dst: {u}. Aquí estoy, ¿no? Suspiro... Mira esto. Qué desastre. ¡¡El cielo mismo está agrietado y roto!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#641.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#642.src: Everything she said... it was true. She had a plan to stop the end of the world. She had the method and the means...
Apotheosis (Quest)#642.dst: Todo lo que dijo... era verdad. Tenía un plan para evitar el fin del mundo. Tenía el método y los medios...
Apotheosis (Quest)#642.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#643.src: But she was always focused on this, wasn't she? Fruma was her priority. Keeping it perfect and under her control...
Apotheosis (Quest)#643.dst: Pero siempre estuvo centrada en esto, ¿verdad? Fruma era su prioridad. Mantenerla perfecta y bajo su control...
Apotheosis (Quest)#643.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#644.src: Maybe I should have seen it. Maybe I did. But it doesn't matter, does it? We've found ourselves here and now either way.
Apotheosis (Quest)#644.dst: Quizá debería haberlo visto. Quizá lo vi. Pero da igual, ¿no? Hemos acabado aquí y ahora de todos modos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#644.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#645.src: YOU!!! {u}, what is HE doing here?! After he- he- he KILLED Rex, so why is he HERE?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#645.dst: ¡¡¡TÚ!!! {u}, ¡¿qué hace ÉL aquí?! ¡¿MATÓ a Rex, así que por qué está AQUÍ?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#645.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#646.src: I should... I should kill you. You- you'd DESERVE it, for everything!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#646.dst: Debería... debería matarte. ¡¡¡Te- te lo MERECERÍAS, por todo!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#646.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#648.src: ...I would, wouldn't I? But there are bigger things to worry about right now.
Apotheosis (Quest)#648.dst: ...me lo merecería, ¿verdad? Pero ahora hay cosas más importantes.
Apotheosis (Quest)#648.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#649.src: You're going after the Queen, right? I want to help.
Apotheosis (Quest)#649.dst: Vais a por la Reina, ¿verdad? Quiero ayudar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#649.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#650.src: Help. You want to... fine. Fine!! Of course you get to just... turn around and be good now. Of course...
Apotheosis (Quest)#650.dst: Ayudar. Quieres... vale. ¡¡Vale!! Claro, tú puedes... darte la vuelta y ser bueno ahora. Claro...
Apotheosis (Quest)#650.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#651.src: It's fine. It's fine! Until this is done... I'll... ignore it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#651.dst: Da igual. ¡Da igual! Hasta que esto acabe... lo... ignoraré.
Apotheosis (Quest)#651.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#652.src: I can't wait for this nightmare to be over...
Apotheosis (Quest)#652.dst: Estoy deseando que acabe esta pesadilla...
Apotheosis (Quest)#652.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#653.src: ...I just want to make things right.
Apotheosis (Quest)#653.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#654.src: Well... you CAN'T!! Her arm is gone, FOREVER, and it's YOUR fault. She would have been DEAD, if it weren't for- f-for Zhiraok!
Apotheosis (Quest)#654.dst: Pues... ¡¡NO PUEDES!! Su brazo ya no está, PARA SIEMPRE, y es culpa TUYA. ¡Estaría MUERTA si no fuera por- p-por Zhiraok!
Apotheosis (Quest)#654.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#655.src: So... so I don't care. If you're going to help with the Queen... fine. But I don't want to see you ever again after we're done.
Apotheosis (Quest)#655.dst: Así que... me da igual. Si vas a ayudar con la Reina... vale. Pero cuando esto acabe no quiero volver a verte nunca.
Apotheosis (Quest)#655.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#658.src: I've been thinking. About all of it. After everything that's happened, everything she's done - everything I've done - it wouldn't be right to turn away.
Apotheosis (Quest)#658.dst: He estado pensando. En todo ello. Después de todo lo que ha pasado, todo lo que ella ha hecho - todo lo que yo he hecho - no estaría bien apartarse.
Apotheosis (Quest)#658.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#659.src: It's all broken, breaking... and maybe it always was. And this is just the truth finally being visible.
Apotheosis (Quest)#659.dst: Todo está roto, rompiéndose... y quizá siempre lo estuvo. Y esta es solo la verdad haciéndose visible al fin.
Apotheosis (Quest)#659.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#660.src: ...I just wanted to do something about it all. About the realms... but also about Fruma. But... I was never going to make any real change, was I?
Apotheosis (Quest)#660.dst: ...solo quería hacer algo con todo esto. Con los reinos... pero también con Fruma. Pero... nunca iba a lograr un cambio real, ¿verdad?
Apotheosis (Quest)#660.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#661.src: I'll help you take her down. It's only right. After that... I don't know.
Apotheosis (Quest)#661.dst: Os ayudaré a derribarla. Es lo justo. Después de eso... no lo sé.
Apotheosis (Quest)#661.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#662.src: YOU!!! {u}, what is HE doing here?! After he- he- he KILLED Rex, so why is he HERE?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#662.dst: ¡¡¡TÚ!!! {u}, ¡¿qué hace ÉL aquí?! ¡¿MATÓ a Rex, así que por qué está AQUÍ?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#662.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#663.src: I should... I should kill you. You- you'd DESERVE it, for everything!!!
