Apotheosis (Quest)#663.dst: Debería... debería matarte. ¡¡¡Te- te lo MERECERÍAS, por todo!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#663.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#665.src: W-well? What do you have to say for yourself?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#665.dst: ¿Y- y bien? ¡¿Qué tienes que decir en tu defensa?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#665.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#670.src: ...I can't. I... I can't do it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#670.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#671.src: After everything... after EVERYTHING, I get a CHANCE to- to- to get back at s-someone who's hurt me, and- and- a-and I CAN'T DO IT?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#671.dst: Después de todo... de TODO, tengo la OCASIÓN de- de- de vengarme de al-alguien que me ha hecho daño, y- y- ¡¿y NO PUEDO HACERLO?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#671.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#672.src: ...whatever. WAHTEVER!! Let's just go deal with the STUPID Queen!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#672.dst: ...da igual. ¡¡DA IGUAL!! ¡¡Vamos a ocuparnos de la ESTÚPIDA Reina!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#672.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#673.src: I can't wait for this nightmare to be over...
Apotheosis (Quest)#673.dst: Estoy deseando que acabe esta pesadilla...
Apotheosis (Quest)#673.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#678.dst: Entra en el Palacio Real en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#681.src: How is- is this going to go?
Apotheosis (Quest)#681.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#683.src: And so, the cards fall. The shards collapse as decisions are made and paths are chosen. What a destructive end it has turned out to be.
Apotheosis (Quest)#683.dst: Y así caen las cartas. Los fragmentos se derrumban a medida que se toman decisiones y se eligen caminos. Qué final tan destructivo ha resultado ser.
Apotheosis (Quest)#683.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#684.src: In retrospect, it seems an inevitability... each decision branching out from the last. What was the weight that sent it over the edge? The tournament? The selection?
Apotheosis (Quest)#684.dst: En retrospectiva, parece inevitable... cada decisión ramificándose de la anterior. ¿Qué peso lo empujó al borde? ¿El torneo? ¿La selección?
Apotheosis (Quest)#684.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#685.src: Would you have been the better choice? No. Having seen now what I have, I am only more certain. But perhaps it could have saved us all this mess.
Apotheosis (Quest)#685.dst: ¿Habrías sido tú la mejor opción? No. Tras ver lo que he visto, tengo aún más certeza. Pero quizá nos habría ahorrado todo este desastre.
Apotheosis (Quest)#685.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#686.src: Oh, Anathema... what a mess you've left in your wake...
Apotheosis (Quest)#686.dst: Ay, Anathema... menudo desastre has dejado a tu paso...
Apotheosis (Quest)#686.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#687.src: You will face no resistance from me. I do not have a death wish.
Apotheosis (Quest)#687.dst: No encontraréis resistencia en mí. No tengo deseos de morir.
Apotheosis (Quest)#687.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#688.src: So go on, fellow Scion. Put an end to this.
Apotheosis (Quest)#688.dst: Así que adelante, compañero Vástago. Pon fin a esto.
Apotheosis (Quest)#688.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#690.src: Sovereign, then? Deny it all you like, but you chose to take on that role.
Apotheosis (Quest)#690.dst: ¿Soberano, entonces? Niégalo cuanto quieras, pero elegiste ese papel.
Apotheosis (Quest)#690.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#691.src: As with each of us, that mark remains. It cannot be so easily discarded. It cannot be forgotten.
Apotheosis (Quest)#691.dst: Como en cada uno de nosotros, esa marca permanece. No se descarta tan fácilmente. No se olvida.
Apotheosis (Quest)#691.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#692.src: Her power gifted, drawn through the mark... and she has given much away in pursuit of this freedom, hasn't she...
Apotheosis (Quest)#692.dst: Su poder concedido, canalizado por la marca... y ella ha entregado mucho persiguiendo esa libertad, ¿verdad...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#692.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#693.src: How much of it remains now, I wonder? Enough to guarantee her victory? Or, perhaps... little enough to grant you a chance of success...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#693.dst: ¿Cuánto le quedará ahora, me pregunto? ¿Bastante para garantizar su victoria? ¿O quizá... lo bastante poco para daros una oportunidad...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#693.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#694.src: Hm! I cannot say for certain. Of all things, this variable yet eludes me. The shards are inconclusive - equally favourable and not.
Apotheosis (Quest)#694.dst: ¡Hm! No puedo decirlo con certeza. De todo, esta variable aún se me escapa. Los fragmentos no son concluyentes - igual de favorables que no.
Apotheosis (Quest)#694.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#695.src: But you... an unexpected variable, though not unwelcome. A naturally-born manaweaver! I thought I'd never see the day.
Apotheosis (Quest)#695.dst: Pero tú... una variable inesperada, aunque no indeseada. ¡Una tejedora de maná de nacimiento! Creí que no vería el día.
Apotheosis (Quest)#695.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#697.src: ...naturally, you do not know the gift you possess. That knowledge was lost with the old world, after all. Will you grow into that power? Or will you allow it to consume you?
Apotheosis (Quest)#697.dst: ...naturalmente, no conoces el don que posees. Ese saber se perdió con el viejo mundo, al fin y al cabo. ¿Crecerás hasta ese poder? ¿O dejarás que te consuma?
Apotheosis (Quest)#697.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#699.src: And you. Do you remember what I asked you? If not Her, then who?
Apotheosis (Quest)#699.dst: Y tú. ¿Recuerdas lo que te pregunté? Si no es Ella, ¿entonces quién?
Apotheosis (Quest)#699.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#701.src: From here, there are no easy paths - your decisions have buried all of those. For Fruma, for the world... each step towards a better future will be a bitter, hard-fought victory.
Apotheosis (Quest)#701.dst: Desde aquí no hay caminos fáciles - vuestras decisiones los han enterrado todos. Por Fruma, por el mundo... cada paso hacia un futuro mejor será una victoria amarga y muy peleada.
Apotheosis (Quest)#701.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#702.src: But perhaps it will prove worthwhile, after all! You've surprised me once already - who's to say you won't do it again? An uncertain future... what an exciting prospect.
Apotheosis (Quest)#702.dst: ¡Pero quizá merezca la pena, después de todo! Ya me has sorprendido una vez - ¿quién dice que no lo harás otra? Un futuro incierto... qué perspectiva tan emocionante.
Apotheosis (Quest)#702.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#703.src: I hope to see you all once more, somewhere down this winding road of ours.
Apotheosis (Quest)#703.dst: Espero volver a veros a todos en algún punto de este camino sinuoso nuestro.
Apotheosis (Quest)#703.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#706.src: I'm... I don't know. Saying goodbye, I guess.
Apotheosis (Quest)#706.speaker: Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#708.src: I should... get going. I'll, uh... see you around.
Apotheosis (Quest)#708.dst: Debería... irme ya. Pues, eh... nos vemos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#708.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#000.src: Hm... ah, {u}! There you are. I was just about to send someone to fetch you.

Arachnids' Ascent#001.src: Our preparations are complete, and it's time for the assault on the spider den! With you here, we'll just need to wait for-...

Arachnids' Ascent#002.src: If {u} is here, I take it that means today's the day we strike at the spiders?

Arachnids' Ascent#003.src: 'course, the roots ain't an option. Lucky this ol' corrupted spring chose to pop up out here, eh? Scientific mystery, it is- but none o' that's our concern.

Arachnids' Ascent#005.src: Ah, good! You can see the pickle we're in, hmm? We've tried everything to get these poor souls out, but the damnned web is like glue!

Arachnids' Ascent#006.src: Cob filled you in on my reasoning, yes? We need to get through these webs somehow... and, well, this seemed simpler than the other option.

Arachnids' Ascent#008.src: So what do we do now? You mentioned another option- what was that about? What about it made it difficult?

Arachnids' Ascent#009.src: Then what's the catch? You would have tried this first if it were that simple.

Arachnids' Ascent#010.src: The mountain is infested with spiders, even more so than {p}. Our few attempts at scouting it out have been met with extreme hostility.

Arachnids' Ascent#011.src: You've been rocketed by the great web.

Arachnids' Ascent#012.src: Well, here we are! ...The heat's gotten more intense up here. Come on, let's find what we're looking for, before I over-

Arachnids' Ascent#016.src: You've returned! I trust you found something that can help us get through these webs?

Arachnids' Ascent#017.src: Talk to Admiral Aegis in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Arachnids' Ascent#017.dst: Habla con el almirante Aegis en los barracones de {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#018.src: Let's see... ah, {u}! There you are. I was just about to send someone to fetch you.
Arachnids' Ascent#018.dst: Veamos... ¡ah, {u}! Aquí estás. Iba a mandar a alguien a buscarte.
Arachnids' Ascent#018.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#019.src: Follow me- we have a conversation to have in my office. It's on the top floor of the barracks.
Arachnids' Ascent#019.dst: Sígueme, tenemos que hablar en mi despacho. Está en la última planta de los barracones.
Arachnids' Ascent#019.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#020.src: ...ahem. Now that we're here, we can discuss the matter of {p}.
Arachnids' Ascent#020.dst: ...ejem. Ya que estamos aquí, hablemos del asunto de {p}.
Arachnids' Ascent#020.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#021.src: Our preparations are complete, and it's time for the assault on Nivla's spider den! With you here, we'll just need to wait for-...
Arachnids' Ascent#021.dst: ¡Los preparativos están listos y es hora de asaltar la guarida de arañas de Nivla! Contigo aquí, solo falta esperar a...
Arachnids' Ascent#021.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#022.src: Admiral- we're here! Sorry we're late, we were sparring in the training room and lost track of time...
Arachnids' Ascent#022.dst: ¡Almirante, ya estamos! Perdón por el retraso, estábamos entrenando y se nos fue el tiempo...
Arachnids' Ascent#022.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#023.src: If {u} is here, I take it that means today is the day we strike at the spiders?
Arachnids' Ascent#023.dst: Si {u} está aquí, ¿significa que hoy atacamos a las arañas?
Arachnids' Ascent#023.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#024.src: Indeed it is. Now, you three are to be the force which will fight through their den and clear out as many of those spiders as you can. For that, you'll need support.
Arachnids' Ascent#024.dst: Así es. Vosotros tres seréis la fuerza que se abrirá paso por su guarida y eliminará todas las arañas que pueda. Para ello, necesitaréis apoyo.
Arachnids' Ascent#024.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#025.src: We've sent out several soldiers ahead of time to make preparations on site. You'll want to first speak to Private Cob on the {p}, who will have supplies for you.
Arachnids' Ascent#025.dst: Hemos enviado a varios soldados por delante para preparar el terreno. Primero hablad con el soldado Cob en {p}; tendrá suministros para vosotros.
Arachnids' Ascent#025.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#026.src: I expect this mission will hold some danger, but I trust the three of you will be able to deal with anything you come across. Good luck, soldiers!
Arachnids' Ascent#026.dst: Esta misión entrañará cierto peligro, pero confío en que los tres podréis con lo que os encontréis. ¡Suerte, soldados!
Arachnids' Ascent#026.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#027.src: Yes, sir. We'll do our best.
Arachnids' Ascent#027.dst: Sí, señor. Haremos lo que podamos.
Arachnids' Ascent#027.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#028.src: These spiders won't stand a chance! Let's get going.
Arachnids' Ascent#028.dst: ¡Esas arañas no tienen nada que hacer! Pongámonos en marcha.
Arachnids' Ascent#028.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#029.src: Speak to Private Cob in the Savannah at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to receive supplies.
Arachnids' Ascent#029.dst: Habla con el soldado Cob en la sabana, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}], para recibir suministros.

Arachnids' Ascent#030.src: 'ey there, chaps! You lot must be the spider killin' force, eh?
Arachnids' Ascent#030.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#031.src: That's us! The Admiral told us you had supplies to give us?
Arachnids' Ascent#031.dst: ¡Esos somos! El almirante dijo que tenías suministros para nosotros.
Arachnids' Ascent#031.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#032.src: That I do! Now, 'fore I send ya off, there's been sum news from the Cap'n!
Arachnids' Ascent#032.dst: ¡Y tanto! Pero antes de mandaros pa'llá, ¡hay noticias del capi!
Arachnids' Ascent#032.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#033.src: Buncha terrorised citizens been found right next to the bloomin' den! Trapped in a sticky old web, they were.
Arachnids' Ascent#033.dst: ¡Han encontrao un montón de vecinos aterraos al lao de la guarida! Atrapaos en una telaraña pegajosa, estaban.
Arachnids' Ascent#033.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#034.src: Priority number one is gettin' them out, before takin' on the den. But nothin' can get through the web!
Arachnids' Ascent#034.dst: Lo primero es sacarlos de ahí antes de atacar la guarida. ¡Pero no hay na' que atraviese la telaraña!
Arachnids' Ascent#034.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#035.src: No fire, no magic... nothin' has broken through. The cap'n decided- 'ey, why not try some lava? 's hotter than fire, anyway.
Arachnids' Ascent#035.dst: Ni fuego, ni magia... na' la ha roto. Y el capi va y dice: eh, ¿y si probamos con lava? Que quema más que el fuego, digo yo.
Arachnids' Ascent#035.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#036.src: Point is. Along with all your supplies 'n whatnot, ya've gotta bring along some lava for the cap'n. Magically contained, o' course!
Arachnids' Ascent#036.dst: A lo que iba. Además de los suministros y demás, tenéis que llevarle lava al capi. ¡Contenida con magia, claro!
Arachnids' Ascent#036.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#037.src: Sure, that sounds easy enough. A bit of extra work, but we were heading in that direction anyway.
Arachnids' Ascent#037.dst: Claro, parece bastante fácil. Es algo de trabajo extra, pero íbamos en esa dirección de todos modos.
Arachnids' Ascent#037.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#038.src: That's the spirit! If ya want the best route to the den, follow that road with the burn marks. It'll send ya straight to the cap'n!
Arachnids' Ascent#038.dst: ¡Así me gusta! Si queréis el mejor camino a la guarida, seguid la senda con marcas de quemaduras. ¡Os llevará derechitos al capi!
Arachnids' Ascent#038.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#039.src: Bring the supplies to Captain Enduyn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Arachnids' Ascent#039.dst: Lleva los suministros al capitán Enduyn en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#040.src: At ease, soldiers! You're the three Aegis told me to look out for, aren't you? Have you spoken to Cob yet?
Arachnids' Ascent#040.dst: ¡Descansen, soldados! Sois los tres que Aegis me pidió que esperara, ¿verdad? ¿Habéis hablado ya con Cob?
Arachnids' Ascent#040.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#041.src: We have, and we've brought supplies. As well as... lava, I think?
Arachnids' Ascent#041.dst: Sí, y traemos suministros. Y también... lava, creo.
Arachnids' Ascent#041.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#042.src: Ah, good! You can see the pickle we're in, hmm? We've tried everything to get those poor souls out, but the damned web is like glue!
Arachnids' Ascent#042.dst: ¡Ah, bien! Ya veis el lío en que estamos, ¿eh? Lo hemos probado todo para sacar a esas pobres almas, ¡pero la maldita telaraña es como pegamento!
Arachnids' Ascent#042.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#043.src: Now, let's see here... If I cast a spell on it like this, then...
Arachnids' Ascent#043.dst: A ver... Si le lanzo un hechizo así, entonces...
Arachnids' Ascent#043.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#045.src: So, what do we do now? You mentioned another option- what was that about? What about it made it difficult?
Arachnids' Ascent#045.dst: ¿Y ahora qué hacemos? Mencionó otra opción, ¿cuál era? ¿Qué la hacía tan difícil?
Arachnids' Ascent#045.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#046.src: Right. You may have noticed on your way here, but the nest is at the base of {p}, a dormant volcano.
Arachnids' Ascent#046.dst: Bien. Quizá lo notasteis de camino, pero el nido está al pie de {p}, un volcán dormido.
Arachnids' Ascent#046.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#047.src: Legends speak of incredible magic granted by the mountain- that of protection, incinerating any who dare go against it.
Arachnids' Ascent#047.dst: Las leyendas hablan de una magia asombrosa de la montaña: protección que calcina a quien ose desafiarla.
Arachnids' Ascent#047.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#048.src: These are only stories, of course. It's very unlikely the mountain actually could grant such magic. However... there may be some truth in the legend.
Arachnids' Ascent#048.dst: Solo son cuentos, claro. Es muy poco probable que la montaña pueda otorgar tal magia. Sin embargo... puede que la leyenda tenga algo de verdad.
Arachnids' Ascent#048.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#049.src: So what's the catch? You would have tried it first if it were that simple.
Arachnids' Ascent#049.dst: ¿Y cuál es la pega? Si fuera tan fácil, lo habría probado primero.
Arachnids' Ascent#049.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#050.src: The mountain is infested with spiders, even more so than {p}. Our few attempts at scouting it out have shown they're incredibly hostile towards intruders.
Arachnids' Ascent#050.dst: La montaña está infestada de arañas, aún más que {p}. En nuestros pocos intentos de explorarla, se han mostrado muy hostiles con los intrusos.
Arachnids' Ascent#050.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#051.src: As though they're protecting something, I assume?
Arachnids' Ascent#051.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#052.src: Indeed. So, here's the plan... If you enter the mountain, the spiders will quickly try to move inside to stop you. I'll need one of you to stay here with me to fight them off.
Arachnids' Ascent#052.dst: Exacto. Este es el plan... Si entráis en la montaña, las arañas correrán hacia dentro para deteneros. Necesito que uno de vosotros se quede aquí conmigo para contenerlas.
Arachnids' Ascent#052.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#053.src: So two of us take on the volcano, and two stay behind. Got it! {u}, you should be part of the Mount Wynn group. But then, Tasim, which of us should go with them?
Arachnids' Ascent#053.dst: O sea, dos vamos al volcán y dos se quedan. ¡Entendido! {u}, tú deberías ir al grupo de Mount Wynn. Pero entonces, Tasim, ¿cuál de los dos debería ir?
Arachnids' Ascent#053.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#054.src: Why don't we let {u} decide? Which of us do you want to join you in the volcano?
Arachnids' Ascent#054.dst: ¿Por qué no dejamos que decida {u}? ¿Con cuál de nosotros quieres entrar en el volcán?
Arachnids' Ascent#054.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#055.src: Alright! We'll handle the volcano then. Captain, Tasim, don't die out here!
Arachnids' Ascent#055.dst: ¡Muy bien! Nosotros nos encargamos del volcán. ¡Capitán, Tasim, no os muráis!
Arachnids' Ascent#055.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#056.src: Alright. We'll fight through the spiders in the mountain, then. Captain, Aledar, good luck!
Arachnids' Ascent#056.dst: De acuerdo. Nos abriremos paso entre las arañas de la montaña. ¡Capitán, Aledar, suerte!
Arachnids' Ascent#056.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#057.src: Then take more time. But don't take too long- we don't want the spiders to realize we're planning something.
Arachnids' Ascent#057.dst: Pues tómate más tiempo. Pero no tardes mucho: no queremos que las arañas noten que tramamos algo.
Arachnids' Ascent#057.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#058.src: Decide who to bring with you into Mount Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Arachnids' Ascent#058.dst: Decide a quién llevar contigo a Mount Wynn en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#059.src: So, who do you want to join you to fight through Mount Wynn?
Arachnids' Ascent#059.dst: Bueno, ¿a quién quieres a tu lado para abrirte paso por Mount Wynn?
Arachnids' Ascent#059.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#060.src: Alright! We'll handle the volcano then. Captain, Tasim, don't die out here!
Arachnids' Ascent#060.dst: ¡Muy bien! Nosotros nos encargamos del volcán. ¡Capitán, Tasim, no os muráis!
Arachnids' Ascent#060.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#061.src: Alright. We'll fight through the spiders in the mountain, then. Captain, Aledar, good luck!
Arachnids' Ascent#061.dst: De acuerdo. Nos abriremos paso entre las arañas de la montaña. ¡Capitán, Aledar, suerte!
Arachnids' Ascent#061.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#062.src: Then take more time. But don't take too long- we don't want the spiders to realize we're planning something.
Arachnids' Ascent#062.dst: Pues tómate más tiempo. Pero no tardes mucho: no queremos que las arañas noten que tramamos algo.
Arachnids' Ascent#062.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#063.src: Enter Mount Wynn and reach the summit through the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Arachnids' Ascent#063.dst: Entra en Mount Wynn y llega a la cima por la cueva de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#064.src: ...Wow, it's hot in here! That makes sense, I guess, given what we're here for. Let's reach the top as quickly as we can.
Arachnids' Ascent#064.dst: ...¡Vaya, qué calor hace aquí dentro! Tiene sentido, supongo, por lo que venimos a buscar. Lleguemos arriba lo antes posible.
Arachnids' Ascent#064.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#065.src: W-woah! You felt that too, right? What's going-
Arachnids' Ascent#065.dst: ¡Ho-hala! Lo has notado tú también, ¿no? ¿Qué está pasa-
Arachnids' Ascent#065.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#066.src: We've got to run for it! Come on, jump!
Arachnids' Ascent#066.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#067.src: That... that was a close one. Phew! Can't believe we made it out in one piece. I think we're near the top, too.
Arachnids' Ascent#067.dst: Eso... eso ha estado cerca. ¡Uf! No me creo que hayamos salido de una pieza. Y creo que ya estamos cerca de la cima.
Arachnids' Ascent#067.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#068.src: Well, here we are! ...The heat's gotten more intense up here. Come on, let's find out what we're looking for, before I over-
Arachnids' Ascent#068.dst: ¡Bueno, aquí estamos! ...Aquí arriba el calor es aún peor. Vamos, busquemos lo que hemos venido a buscar antes de que me desma-
Arachnids' Ascent#068.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#071.src: Ack! We should have known it wouldn't be that easy. Alright, let's take down this spider and get what we came for!
Arachnids' Ascent#071.dst: ¡Ay! Debimos saber que no sería fácil. ¡Venga, matemos a esta araña y llevémonos lo que vinimos a buscar!
Arachnids' Ascent#071.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#072.src: Well, there it is. We have what we need to burn through those webs!... I hope.
Arachnids' Ascent#072.dst: Bueno, ahí está. ¡Ya tenemos con qué quemar esas telarañas!... Eso espero.
Arachnids' Ascent#072.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#073.src: The spider mentioned a queen... I guess that's what we'll be facing in their nest, then.
Arachnids' Ascent#073.dst: La araña mencionó a una reina... Supongo que a eso nos enfrentaremos en su nido.
Arachnids' Ascent#073.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#074.src: Alright, let's get back to Tasim and the captain!
Arachnids' Ascent#074.dst: ¡Venga, volvamos con Tasim y el capitán!
Arachnids' Ascent#074.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#075.src: ...I can hear the spiders already. We'll need to fight through them if we want to reach the top. Let's get going, we don't want to take too long.
Arachnids' Ascent#075.dst: ...Ya oigo a las arañas. Tendremos que abrirnos paso entre ellas si queremos llegar arriba. Vamos, no hay que tardar demasiado.
Arachnids' Ascent#075.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#076.src: H-huh? That shaking, it's almost like-
Arachnids' Ascent#076.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#077.src: What are those spiders doing!? {u}, come on, we need to move!
Arachnids' Ascent#077.dst: ¡¿Qué están haciendo esas arañas?! ¡{u}, vamos, hay que moverse!
Arachnids' Ascent#077.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#078.src: ...That was closer than it should have been. The spiders must be real desperate to protect whatever it is they have up here, huh? Let's keep going.
Arachnids' Ascent#078.dst: ...Eso ha estado más cerca de lo debido. Las arañas deben de estar desesperadas por proteger lo que tengan aquí arriba, ¿eh? Sigamos.
Arachnids' Ascent#078.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#079.src: It was a tough climb, but we made it... It's, uh, very hot up here. So- what was it we were looking for-
Arachnids' Ascent#079.dst: Ha sido una subida dura, pero lo logramos... Aquí arriba hace, eh, muchísimo calor. Bueno, ¿qué era lo que buscába-
Arachnids' Ascent#079.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#082.src: Of course it wouldn't be that easy... Alright, {u}, let's do what we came here for. Let's claim that magic, and burn through the webs!
Arachnids' Ascent#082.dst: Claro, no iba a ser tan fácil... Venga, {u}, hagamos aquello a lo que hemos venido. ¡Reclamemos esa magia y quememos las telarañas!
Arachnids' Ascent#082.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#083.src: I guess that's that taken care of. We'll be able to burn through that web and save the villagers!
Arachnids' Ascent#083.dst: Supongo que eso ya está. ¡Podremos quemar esa telaraña y salvar a los aldeanos!
Arachnids' Ascent#083.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#084.src: You heard the spider mention a queen, right? We'll probably have to defeat it in it's nest to stop the spiders, once and for all.
Arachnids' Ascent#084.dst: Oíste a la araña mencionar a una reina, ¿verdad? Seguramente tendremos que vencerla en su nido para acabar con las arañas de una vez por todas.
Arachnids' Ascent#084.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#085.src: We should probably get going back down the mountain. We don't want to keep Aledar and the Captain waiting.
Arachnids' Ascent#085.dst: Deberíamos ir bajando la montaña. No hagamos esperar a Aledar y al capitán.
Arachnids' Ascent#085.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#086.src: Return to Captain Enduyn with the flame at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Arachnids' Ascent#086.dst: Vuelve con la llama junto al capitán Enduyn en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#087.src: You've returned! I trust you found something that can help us pass through these webs?
Arachnids' Ascent#087.dst: ¡Habéis vuelto! Supongo que habéis encontrado algo que nos ayude a atravesar estas telarañas.
Arachnids' Ascent#087.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#088.src: We did! We fought off a spider at the summit, and claimed a magical flame.
Arachnids' Ascent#088.dst: ¡Sí! Vencimos a una araña en la cima y conseguimos una llama mágica.
Arachnids' Ascent#088.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#089.src: Excellent! Now, give it here. Let's see if we can't get these villagers free... watch out, folks! It might get a little warm for a moment...
Arachnids' Ascent#089.dst: ¡Excelente! Venga, dádmela. A ver si logramos liberar a estos aldeanos... ¡cuidado, gente! Puede que haga un poco de calor un momento...
Arachnids' Ascent#089.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#090.src: Great work, soldiers. With these villagers out we can turn our focus to the main den.
Arachnids' Ascent#090.dst: Buen trabajo, soldados. Con los aldeanos fuera, podemos centrarnos en la guarida principal.
Arachnids' Ascent#090.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#091.src: If you're prepared, I don't see any reason to hold back. Good luck in there, soldiers! Let's stop this spider blight once and for all.
Arachnids' Ascent#091.dst: Si estáis preparados, no veo motivo para esperar. ¡Suerte ahí dentro, soldados! Acabemos con esta plaga de arañas de una vez por todas.
Arachnids' Ascent#091.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#092.src: We'll do our best, Captain. Aledar, {u}, let's head down to the den entrance.
Arachnids' Ascent#092.dst: Haremos lo que podamos, capitán. Aledar, {u}, bajemos a la entrada de la guarida.
Arachnids' Ascent#092.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#093.src: You've returned! I trust you found something that can help us pass through these webs?
Arachnids' Ascent#093.dst: ¡Habéis vuelto! Supongo que habéis encontrado algo que nos ayude a atravesar estas telarañas.
Arachnids' Ascent#093.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#094.src: We did, yes. There was a powerful spider at the peak, which was making use of this magical flame.
Arachnids' Ascent#094.dst: Sí, así es. En la cima había una araña poderosa que usaba esta llama mágica.
Arachnids' Ascent#094.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#095.src: Excellent! Now, give it here. Let's see if we can't get these villagers free... watch out, folks! It might get a little warm for a moment...
Arachnids' Ascent#095.dst: ¡Excelente! Venga, dádmela. A ver si logramos liberar a estos aldeanos... ¡cuidado, gente! Puede que haga un poco de calor un momento...
Arachnids' Ascent#095.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#096.src: Great work, soldiers. With these villagers out we can turn our focus to the main den.
Arachnids' Ascent#096.dst: Buen trabajo, soldados. Con los aldeanos fuera, podemos centrarnos en la guarida principal.
Arachnids' Ascent#096.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#097.src: If you're prepared, I don't see any reason to hold back. Good luck in there, soldiers! Let's stop this spider blight once and for all.
Arachnids' Ascent#097.dst: Si estáis preparados, no veo motivo para esperar. ¡Suerte ahí dentro, soldados! Acabemos con esta plaga de arañas de una vez por todas.
Arachnids' Ascent#097.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#098.src: We'll do our best, Captain. Aledar, {u}, let's head down to the den entrance.
Arachnids' Ascent#098.dst: Haremos lo que podamos, capitán. Aledar, {u}, bajemos a la entrada de la guarida.
Arachnids' Ascent#098.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#099.src: H-hah! F-freedom! No m-more c-creepy crawlies... Just me a-and my... mushrooms.
Arachnids' Ascent#099.dst: ¡J-ja! ¡L-libertad! Se acabaron los b-bichos... Solo yo y m-mis... setas.
Arachnids' Ascent#099.speaker: Yahya

Arachnids' Ascent#100.src: We did it! We killed the spider queen! {p} is safe from that threat now!
Arachnids' Ascent#100.dst: ¡Lo logramos! ¡La reina araña ha muerto! ¡{p} ya está libre de esa amenaza!
Arachnids' Ascent#100.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#101.src: We- we did! That was... intense. But we succeeded in the end!
Arachnids' Ascent#101.dst: ¡Lo... lo logramos! Ha sido... intenso. ¡Pero al final lo conseguimos!
Arachnids' Ascent#101.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#102.src: ...So, what now? We completed the mission, so we should report back to the Admiral, but... what's after that?
Arachnids' Ascent#102.dst: ...¿Y ahora qué? Hemos cumplido la misión, así que deberíamos informar al almirante, pero... ¿y después?
Arachnids' Ascent#102.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#103.src: I guess we'll have to figure that out. I know I still want to help defend the province, but beyond that... I don't know.
Arachnids' Ascent#103.dst: Supongo que tendremos que averiguarlo. Sé que aún quiero ayudar a defender la provincia, pero aparte de eso... no lo sé.
Arachnids' Ascent#103.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#104.src: ...Yeah, alright. Well, hey, let's all meet back at {p} and celebrate! We deserve it after that whole ordeal.
Arachnids' Ascent#104.dst: ...Sí, vale. Bueno, oye, ¡reunámonos todos en {p} y celebrémoslo! Nos lo merecemos después de este calvario.
Arachnids' Ascent#104.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#105.src: That sounds good, yeah. {u}, we'll rest up here a little, but we'll meet you back at the barracks soon.
Arachnids' Ascent#105.dst: Me parece bien, sí. {u}, descansaremos aquí un poco, pero nos vemos pronto en los barracones.
Arachnids' Ascent#105.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#106.src: Well, here we are! Back at the barracks, after a successful mission. It feels a little... unreal, you know?
Arachnids' Ascent#106.dst: ¡Bueno, aquí estamos! De vuelta en los barracones tras una misión cumplida. Parece un poco... irreal, ¿sabes?
Arachnids' Ascent#106.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#107.src: I know what you mean. But, well, we did good! We managed to make the woods safer for the people living there.
Arachnids' Ascent#107.dst: Sé lo que quieres decir. Pero, bueno, ¡lo hicimos bien! Conseguimos que el bosque sea más seguro para quienes viven allí.
Arachnids' Ascent#107.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#108.src: We did! And now, we celebrate! Here, let's all some {p} Whiskey for the occasion.
Arachnids' Ascent#108.dst: ¡Así es! ¡Y ahora, a celebrarlo! Tomad, bebamos todos un poco de whisky de {p} para la ocasión.
Arachnids' Ascent#108.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#109.src: So, what are you two planning to do next? I think I'll speak to the Admiral about finding an assignment somewhere.
Arachnids' Ascent#109.dst: ¿Y qué pensáis hacer ahora vosotros dos? Creo que hablaré con el almirante para que me asigne un destino.
Arachnids' Ascent#109.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#110.src: Hm. I've been thinking a little about... looking into more advanced powder techniques. Something about their magic sticks out to me.
Arachnids' Ascent#110.dst: Mmm. He estado pensando un poco en... estudiar técnicas de polvo más avanzadas. Hay algo en su magia que me llama la atención.
Arachnids' Ascent#110.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#111.src: Oh, really? I thought you would be more into basic fighting, what with our journey to {p}.
Arachnids' Ascent#111.dst: ¿Ah, sí? Pensaba que te iría más el combate sin más, después de nuestro viaje a {p}.
Arachnids' Ascent#111.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#112.src: Yeah... well, I guess I found something a little more interesting along the way. I'll let you know how it all goes.
Arachnids' Ascent#112.dst: Sí... bueno, supongo que por el camino encontré algo un poco más interesante. Ya os contaré qué tal va.
Arachnids' Ascent#112.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#113.src: Keep us updated, Aledar. So, {u}, what are you thinking of doing next?
Arachnids' Ascent#113.dst: Mantennos al tanto, Aledar. Y tú, {u}, ¿qué piensas hacer ahora?
Arachnids' Ascent#113.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#114.src: Not a bad idea! I might join you with that later, once I've decided on things more.
Arachnids' Ascent#114.dst: ¡No es mala idea! Puede que me una a ti más adelante, cuando tenga las cosas más claras.
Arachnids' Ascent#114.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#115.src: Helping people is a good goal. There's bound to be lots of people around who need it.
Arachnids' Ascent#115.dst: Ayudar a la gente es un buen objetivo. Seguro que por aquí hay mucha gente que lo necesita.
Arachnids' Ascent#115.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#116.src: Exploring, huh? That's a good idea. There's plenty to see around here!
Arachnids' Ascent#116.dst: Explorar, ¿eh? Buena idea. ¡Hay mucho que ver por aquí!
Arachnids' Ascent#116.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#117.src: ...And- well, we all came here for a reason. Might as well see the province while we're here, right?
Arachnids' Ascent#117.dst: ...Y, bueno, todos vinimos aquí por algo. Ya que estamos, podríamos conocer la provincia, ¿no?
Arachnids' Ascent#117.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#118.src: Well, if you're staying in the area, maybe we'll cross paths! I'll likely be defending {p} in the short-term.
Arachnids' Ascent#118.dst: Bueno, si te quedas por la zona, ¡quizá nos crucemos! Seguramente defenderé {p} a corto plazo.
Arachnids' Ascent#118.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#119.src: And, well, I'll probably be in the area as well! There's plenty of experts in the area.
Arachnids' Ascent#119.dst: Y yo, bueno, seguramente también andaré por aquí. ¡Hay muchos expertos en la zona!
Arachnids' Ascent#119.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#120.src: Well, hey, there's no shame in that. There's lots to do around here. I'm sure you'll figure it out!
Arachnids' Ascent#120.dst: Bueno, oye, no tiene nada de malo. Hay mucho que hacer por aquí. ¡Seguro que lo averiguas!
Arachnids' Ascent#120.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#121.src: If you need a goal, the next place you might want to visit is {p} {p}, to the north. Maybe pay it a visit when you reach level {~}.
Arachnids' Ascent#121.dst: Si necesitas un objetivo, el próximo lugar que podrías visitar es {p} {p}, al norte. Quizá cuando llegues al nivel {~}.
Arachnids' Ascent#121.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#122.src: ...Well, I'm glad we're all able to be here together. Here's to a long and fulfilling friendship!
Arachnids' Ascent#122.dst: ...Bueno, me alegro de que podamos estar aquí juntos. ¡Por una amistad larga y plena!
Arachnids' Ascent#122.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#123.src: I'll drink to that! To all our future adventures.
Arachnids' Ascent#123.dst: ¡Brindo por ello! Por todas nuestras aventuras futuras.
Arachnids' Ascent#123.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#124.src: ...Oh, {u}! Good to see you. Anything interesting going on with you?
Arachnids' Ascent#124.dst: ...¡Oh, {u}! Me alegro de verte. ¿Te ha pasado algo interesante?
Arachnids' Ascent#124.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#125.src: Me? Well, I've been making little progress... but, nothing too big yet. I'm keeping at it, though!
Arachnids' Ascent#125.dst: ¿Yo? Bueno, he avanzado un poquito... pero nada muy grande aún. ¡Aunque sigo en ello!
Arachnids' Ascent#125.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#126.src: Oh, hello {u}. I'm probably not going to be here for long- I've been assigned to help defend {p} to the south.
Arachnids' Ascent#126.dst: Oh, hola, {u}. Seguramente no estaré aquí mucho tiempo: me han destinado a ayudar a defender {p}, al sur.
Arachnids' Ascent#126.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#127.src: You should come visit, if you have the chance!
Arachnids' Ascent#127.dst: ¡Deberías venir a verme si tienes ocasión!
Arachnids' Ascent#127.speaker: Tasim

Beneath the Depths#000.src: Talk to Javier in the Pirate Cove at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Beneath the Depths#000.dst: Habla con Javier en Pirate Cove, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Beneath the Depths#001.src: Garh, you look like a mighty fine adventurer, lad. But perhaps your pockets are a little lighter than you want, eh?
Beneath the Depths#001.dst: Garh, tienes pinta de buen aventurero, muchacho. Pero quizá vas más corto de monedas de lo que quisieras, ¿eh?
Beneath the Depths#001.speaker: Javier

Beneath the Depths#002.src: Perhaps we be making a deal, lad, and it'll make us both rich!
Beneath the Depths#002.dst: Quizá podamos hacer un trato, muchacho, ¡y nos hacemos ricos los dos!
Beneath the Depths#002.speaker: Javier

Beneath the Depths#003.src: Ye see, lad, me treasure has been lost for quite some time, I kept it in a ocean village named Sarnfic, in a secret room.
Beneath the Depths#003.dst: Verás, muchacho, mi tesoro lleva perdío mucho tiempo. Lo guardaba en Sarnfic, un pueblo del mar, en un cuarto secreto.
Beneath the Depths#003.speaker: Javier

Beneath the Depths#004.src: Argh, but lad. The village vanished out of nowhere! Like some kind of dark magic! I swears to ye, I tell no lies!
Beneath the Depths#004.dst: ¡Argh, pero muchacho! ¡El pueblo se esfumó de la nada! ¡Como por magia negra! ¡Te lo juro, no miento!
Beneath the Depths#004.speaker: Javier

Beneath the Depths#005.src: So ye see, in me old age I could use a spot of me lawful gold to see me through me final years.
Beneath the Depths#005.dst: Así que ya ves, a mi edad me vendría bien algo de mi oro legítimo pa' llegar al final de mis días.
Beneath the Depths#005.speaker: Javier

Beneath the Depths#006.src: Don't fret though, chuck, old Javier always kept a back up plan.
Beneath the Depths#006.dst: No te apures, chaval, el viejo Javier siempre tuvo un plan de reserva.
Beneath the Depths#006.speaker: Javier

Beneath the Depths#007.src: I left me old sea fearin' map in me old hideout, it'll tell ye where we can find me old gold.
Beneath the Depths#007.dst: Dejé mi vieja carta de marear en mi antiguo escondite; te dirá dónde está mi oro.
Beneath the Depths#007.speaker: Javier

Beneath the Depths#008.src: So, lad. Are ya willin' to make ye'self mighty wealthy? Good.
Beneath the Depths#008.dst: Conque, muchacho. ¿Estás dispuesto a hacerte riquísimo? Bien.
Beneath the Depths#008.speaker: Javier

Beneath the Depths#009.src: Me old hideout's hidden inside that there skull at the entrance to our mighty fine establishment, Bring me that map, lad!
Beneath the Depths#009.dst: Mi escondite está en esa calavera de la entrada de nuestro fino local. ¡Tráeme ese mapa, muchacho!
Beneath the Depths#009.speaker: Javier

Beneath the Depths#010.src: Find Javier's map, hidden in the skull tomb at the entrance of the island
Beneath the Depths#010.dst: Encuentra el mapa de Javier, escondido en la tumba de la calavera a la entrada de la isla

Beneath the Depths#011.src: Halt it there, laddy! The wind has told us that yer looking for treasure map. Ah, ye'll not get it so easily.
Beneath the Depths#011.dst: ¡Alto ahí, muchacho! El viento nos ha dicho que buscas el mapa del tesoro. Ah, no lo conseguirás tan fácil.
Beneath the Depths#011.speaker: Deceased Buccaneer

Beneath the Depths#012.src: Ye see, us spirits are as greedy as our physical selves were. 'ere's no foolin' 'round there. We want yer money, and only then will we open the paths to the map.
Beneath the Depths#012.dst: Verás, los espíritus somos tan codiciosos como lo fuimos en carne y hueso. Ahí no hay tonterías que valgan. Queremos tu dinero, y solo entonces abriremos los caminos al mapa.
Beneath the Depths#012.speaker: Deceased Buccaneer

Beneath the Depths#013.src: One full stack of emeralds will satisfy our needs. Go to the front of this tomb if ye have what we want.
Beneath the Depths#013.dst: Una pila entera de esmeraldas nos bastará. Ve al frente de esta tumba si tienes lo que queremos.
Beneath the Depths#013.speaker: Deceased Buccaneer

Beneath the Depths#014.src: Good luck on that petty journey of yers. Just find the whole path, and yerself'll be just fine...
Beneath the Depths#014.dst: Suerte en ese viajecito tuyo. Recorre el camino entero y no te pasará nada...
Beneath the Depths#014.speaker: Deceased Buccaneer

Beneath the Depths#015.src: Argh, yer talented aren't you lad! Many thanks indeed, now we can see where me treasure be buried.
Beneath the Depths#015.dst: ¡Arre, qué talento tienes, muchacho! Mil gracias, ahora podemos ver dónde está enterrao mi tesoro.
Beneath the Depths#015.speaker: Javier

Beneath the Depths#016.src: Hrmm, well, garr, blast it all
Beneath the Depths#016.speaker: Javier

Beneath the Depths#017.src: I canne read me own darn map, lad! What'dya do with it? Scratch off the ink with yer pennies?
Beneath the Depths#017.dst: ¡No sé leer mi propio dichoso mapa, muchacho! ¿Qué le has hecho? ¿Rascar la tinta con tus monedas?
Beneath the Depths#017.speaker: Javier

Beneath the Depths#018.src: Gar, sorry lad. It be the test of time that failed old Javier, not you.
Beneath the Depths#018.dst: Gar, perdona, muchacho. Al viejo Javier lo ha vencido el tiempo, no tú.
Beneath the Depths#018.speaker: Javier

Beneath the Depths#019.src: Fear not, lad. There be an old friend of Javier's that can help decipher this old rag.
Beneath the Depths#019.dst: No temas, muchacho. Javier tiene un viejo amigo que puede descifrar este trapo.
Beneath the Depths#019.speaker: Javier

Beneath the Depths#020.src: Go to the old {p}, there be a man by the name of Dalben who can restore me map to its former glory. Get it done lad, and bring me treasure back!
Beneath the Depths#020.dst: Ve al viejo {p}; allí hay un hombre llamado Dalben que puede devolverle a mi mapa su antigua gloria. ¡Hazlo, muchacho, y tráeme mi tesoro!
Beneath the Depths#020.speaker: Javier

Beneath the Depths#021.src: Talk to Dalben on {p} about restoring the map
Beneath the Depths#021.dst: Habla con Dalben en {p} sobre la restauración del mapa

Beneath the Depths#022.src: What's this? A traveller? How might we assist you?
Beneath the Depths#022.dst: ¿Qué es esto? ¿Un viajero? ¿En qué podemos ayudarte?
Beneath the Depths#022.speaker: Dalben

Beneath the Depths#023.src: Ah, I see, you wish to explore the ocean depths? But for what possible reason?
Beneath the Depths#023.dst: Ah, ya veo, ¿quieres explorar las profundidades del océano? ¿Y por qué?
Beneath the Depths#023.speaker: Dalben

Beneath the Depths#024.src: This map... How did you acquire it? This is enchanted by our people.
Beneath the Depths#024.dst: Este mapa... ¿Cómo lo conseguiste? Lleva un encantamiento de los nuestros.
Beneath the Depths#024.speaker: Dalben

Beneath the Depths#025.src: You... You seek Sarnfic, don't you?
Beneath the Depths#025.speaker: Dalben

Beneath the Depths#026.src: Alas, that place has history. We, the Mage Council, banished that city long ago to hide the horrific power hidden within a treasure a pirate hid there.
Beneath the Depths#026.dst: Por desgracia, ese lugar tiene historia. El Consejo de Magos desterró esa ciudad hace mucho para ocultar el terrible poder de un tesoro que un pirata escondió allí.
Beneath the Depths#026.speaker: Dalben

Beneath the Depths#027.src: A pair of boots, made from a black material fashioned from the stone of an evil place, incredibly dark magic. But we do not believe the filthy idiotic pirate knew what he'd found.
Beneath the Depths#027.dst: Un par de botas, de un material negro forjado con la piedra de un lugar maligno, de magia oscurísima. Pero no creemos que aquel pirata asqueroso e idiota supiera lo que había encontrado.
Beneath the Depths#027.speaker: Dalben

Beneath the Depths#028.src: I must say, we, the council regret having to lay waste an entire village over a pair of boots. There was no other way.
Beneath the Depths#028.dst: He de decir que el Consejo lamenta haber tenido que arrasar un pueblo entero por un par de botas. No había otro modo.
Beneath the Depths#028.speaker: Dalben

Beneath the Depths#029.src: Who knows why he even kept the boots. If he had known about their power, I'm sure he would have used it for evil. But we sense no evil in you, so as such we will aid you in your quest.
Beneath the Depths#029.dst: Quién sabe por qué conservaba las botas. Si hubiera conocido su poder, seguro que lo habría usado para el mal. Pero en ti no percibimos maldad, así que te ayudaremos en tu misión.
Beneath the Depths#029.speaker: Dalben

Beneath the Depths#030.src: We hope that you will use the boots for good, despite the dark intentions. We will lift the enchantment once lain upon the charts, but it will cost you.
Beneath the Depths#030.dst: Esperamos que uses las botas para el bien, pese a sus oscuras intenciones. Levantaremos el encantamiento de las cartas, pero te costará.
Beneath the Depths#030.speaker: Dalben

Beneath the Depths#031.src: Give me [{~} Emerald Blocks], that should cover the cost.
Beneath the Depths#031.dst: Dame [{~} bloques de esmeralda], con eso se cubre el coste.
Beneath the Depths#031.speaker: Dalben

Beneath the Depths#032.src: Bring back [{~} Blocks of Emerald] to Dalben
Beneath the Depths#032.dst: Lleva [{~} bloques de esmeralda] de vuelta a Dalben

Beneath the Depths#033.src: Brilliant. That seems in order. Here you go.
Beneath the Depths#033.dst: Estupendo. Todo parece en orden. Aquí tienes.
Beneath the Depths#033.speaker: Dalben

Beneath the Depths#034.src: We only hope that the treasure will never fall into the hands of that pirate again, we'd much rather they fall into yours.
Beneath the Depths#034.dst: Solo esperamos que el tesoro no vuelva a caer nunca en manos de ese pirata; preferimos con mucho que caiga en las tuyas.
Beneath the Depths#034.speaker: Dalben

Beneath the Depths#035.src: Well? What does it say? Go to that location! Find the treasure!
Beneath the Depths#035.dst: ¿Y bien? ¿Qué dice? ¡Ve a ese lugar! ¡Encuentra el tesoro!
Beneath the Depths#035.speaker: Dalben

Beneath the Depths#036.src: Explore the cave in the ocean, located at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Beneath the Depths#036.dst: Explora la cueva del océano, situada en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Beneath the Depths#037.src: Find [{~} Ocean Treasure] and bring it back to Javier in Pirate Cove
Beneath the Depths#037.dst: Encuentra [{~} Tesoro Oceánico] y llévaselo a Javier en Pirate Cove

Beneath the Depths#038.src: Gnar, you did it lad! Ye brought back old Javiers gold! And as I promised, heres yer share of the loot.
Beneath the Depths#038.dst: ¡Gnar, lo lograste, muchacho! ¡Has traído el oro del viejo Javier! Y como prometí, aquí tienes tu parte del botín.
Beneath the Depths#038.speaker: Javier

Beneath the Depths#039.src: I threw in something extra for ye. It's an old key I salvaged a few years back, from the shipwreck of a legendary pirate.
Beneath the Depths#039.dst: Te he metido algo extra. Es una llave vieja que rescaté hace años del naufragio de un pirata legendario.
Beneath the Depths#039.speaker: Javier

Beneath the Depths#040.src: Who knows what it leads to? Maybe a treasure hoard, or maybe the ol' swashbuckler wanted to lead someone into a trap.
Beneath the Depths#040.dst: ¿Quién sabe adónde lleva? Quizá a un tesoro escondido, o quizá el viejo bucanero quería meter a alguien en una trampa.
Beneath the Depths#040.speaker: Javier

Beneath the Depths#041.src: Me bones are too old for a grand adventure like that, guess ye'll have to figure it out for yerself.
Beneath the Depths#041.dst: Mis huesos ya están muy viejos para una aventura así; supongo que tendrás que averiguarlo tú mismo.
Beneath the Depths#041.speaker: Javier

Beyond the Grave#000.src: Speak to Irlok in the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Beyond the Grave#001.src: Welcome to the Bantisu Temple, traveler. We guide lost souls onwards, be they wandering men to town or spirits unable to exit the canyon.
Beyond the Grave#001.dst: Bienvenido al Templo Bantisu, viajero. Guiamos a las almas perdidas: hombres extraviados camino del pueblo o espíritus que no logran salir del cañón.
Beyond the Grave#001.speaker: Irlok

Beyond the Grave#002.src: However, recently, our job has become much more difficult. The canyon shakes, and changes. Often, long-buried creatures are released as the walls shift.
Beyond the Grave#002.dst: Sin embargo, nuestra labor se ha vuelto mucho más difícil. El cañón tiembla y cambia. Al moverse las paredes, se liberan criaturas enterradas hace mucho.
Beyond the Grave#002.speaker: Irlok

Beyond the Grave#003.src: And unfortunately, the worst has come to pass, that one of these creatures is hostile. The Bantisu monks of old collapsed the entrance to its cave to seal it away...
Beyond the Grave#003.dst: Y por desgracia ha ocurrido lo peor: una de esas criaturas es hostil. Los antiguos monjes Bantisu derrumbaron la entrada de su cueva para sellarla...
Beyond the Grave#003.speaker: Irlok

Beyond the Grave#004.src: ...but the rubble has shifted, and the cave is open once more. We were not strong enough to defeat it then, and we are not strong enough to defeat it now.
Beyond the Grave#004.dst: ...pero los escombros se han movido y la cueva está abierta otra vez. Entonces no fuimos lo bastante fuertes para vencerla, y ahora tampoco lo somos.
Beyond the Grave#004.speaker: Irlok

Beyond the Grave#005.src: Even trying to collapse the cave again has ended in failure, for the beast, Krolton, slays our mages and demolitionists in but an instant.
Beyond the Grave#005.dst: Incluso intentar derrumbar la cueva de nuevo acabó en fracaso, pues la bestia, Krolton, mata a nuestros magos y demoledores en un instante.
Beyond the Grave#005.speaker: Irlok

Beyond the Grave#006.src: However, the word on the wind tells tales of humans doing the impossible as a matter of rote. Krolton must be dealt with before it leaves the cave- I beg your assistance!
Beyond the Grave#006.dst: Pero el viento trae relatos de humanos que hacen lo imposible por costumbre. Hay que acabar con Krolton antes de que salga de la cueva. ¡Te ruego tu ayuda!
Beyond the Grave#006.speaker: Irlok

Beyond the Grave#007.src: We've no time to spare. I will prepare a short spell to bring you to the cave- Please, wait outside, and prepare yourself.
Beyond the Grave#007.dst: No tenemos tiempo que perder. Prepararé un breve hechizo para llevarte a la cueva. Por favor, espera fuera y prepárate.
Beyond the Grave#007.speaker: Irlok

Beyond the Grave#008.src: Seek out the creature in the mines at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Beyond the Grave#008.dst: Busca a la criatura en las minas de [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Beyond the Grave#009.src: I apologize for the suddenness of this, but you must understand the urgency. We have no way of knowing when Krolton will emerge.
Beyond the Grave#009.dst: Disculpa lo repentino de todo esto, pero debes entender la urgencia. No hay modo de saber cuándo aparecerá Krolton.
Beyond the Grave#009.speaker: Irlok

Beyond the Grave#010.src: We will pray for your safety, and that your spirit will not become among those we must guide out of the canyon.
Beyond the Grave#010.dst: Rezaremos por tu seguridad, y por que tu espíritu no acabe entre los que debemos guiar fuera del cañón.
Beyond the Grave#010.speaker: Irlok

Beyond the Grave#012.src: Explore the strange realm and bargain with Death.
Beyond the Grave#012.dst: Explora el extraño reino y negocia con la Muerte.

Beyond the Grave#013.src: SO THAT IS YOUR FIRST INSTINCT? TO CLIMB THE VALLEY WALLS IN FRUITLESS SEARCH OF AN ESCAPE?
Beyond the Grave#013.dst: ¿ESE ES TU PRIMER INSTINTO? ¿TREPAR POR LAS PAREDES DEL VALLE EN BUSCA INÚTIL DE UNA SALIDA?
Beyond the Grave#013.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#014.src: AMUSING. BUT THIS IS WHERE YOU MUST BE. TAKE ALL THE TIME YOU LIKE, THOUGH. I WILL WAIT FOR YOU TO COME TO MY MANOR.
Beyond the Grave#014.dst: DIVERTIDO. PERO ESTE ES TU SITIO. TÓMATE EL TIEMPO QUE QUIERAS, ESO SÍ. ESPERARÉ A QUE VENGAS A MI MANSIÓN.
Beyond the Grave#014.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#015.src: SO MY MANSION IS DULL ENOUGH YOU'D RATHER GO ROCK CLIMBING?
Beyond the Grave#015.dst: ¿TAN ABURRIDA ES MI MANSIÓN QUE PREFIERES HACER ESCALADA?
Beyond the Grave#015.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#016.src: OR DID I SIMPLY SCARE YOU OFF SAYING SUCH SERIOUS THINGS?
Beyond the Grave#016.dst: ¿O SIMPLEMENTE TE ASUSTÉ AL DECIR COSAS TAN SERIAS?
Beyond the Grave#016.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#017.src: NEVERTHELESS, YOU WILL BE BACK EVENTUALLY. THERE IS NOTHING FOR ANYONE OUT THERE.
Beyond the Grave#017.dst: AUN ASÍ, ACABARÁS VOLVIENDO. AHÍ FUERA NO HAY NADA PARA NADIE.
Beyond the Grave#017.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#018.src: IT SEEMS I HAVE A NEW GUEST. WELCOME.
Beyond the Grave#018.dst: PARECE QUE TENGO UN NUEVO INVITADO. BIENVENIDO.
Beyond the Grave#018.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#019.src: MAKE YOURSELF COMFORTABLE. YOU'LL BE STAYING HERE FOR A WHILE.
Beyond the Grave#019.dst: PONTE CÓMODO. VAS A QUEDARTE AQUÍ UN BUEN RATO.
Beyond the Grave#019.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#020.src: NOTHING IS STOPPING YOU FROM TAKING A LOOK AROUND. DON'T TOUCH ANYTHING THOUGH. AND TAKE OFF YOUR SHOES AS YOU ENTER.
Beyond the Grave#020.dst: NADA TE IMPIDE ECHAR UN VISTAZO. PERO NO TOQUES NADA. Y DESCÁLZATE AL ENTRAR.
Beyond the Grave#020.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#021.src: WHEN YOU FEEL LIKE IT, COME TO MY OFFICE UPSTAIRS. WE HAVE A LENGTHY TALK TO HAVE.
Beyond the Grave#021.dst: CUANDO TE APETEZCA, SUBE A MI DESPACHO. TENEMOS UNA LARGA CONVERSACIÓN PENDIENTE.
Beyond the Grave#021.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#022.src: THIS IS WHERE I SERVE MEALS TO MY GUESTS. THEY GIVE SUCH GLOWING REVIEWS.
Beyond the Grave#022.dst: AQUÍ ES DONDE SIRVO LA COMIDA A MIS INVITADOS. SIEMPRE DEJAN CRÍTICAS ESPLÉNDIDAS.
Beyond the Grave#022.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#023.src: AFTER ALL, IT IS SAID ONE'S LAST MEAL IS THE SWEETEST, SO HAVING ANOTHER AFTER THAT IS SURELY TO DIE FOR. AH HA HA.
Beyond the Grave#023.dst: AL FIN Y AL CABO, DICEN QUE LA ÚLTIMA CENA ES LA MÁS DULCE, ASÍ QUE TOMAR OTRA DESPUÉS ES PARA MORIRSE. JA JA JA.
Beyond the Grave#023.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#024.src: IF I HAD BROUGHT ANY FLOUR THIS MORNING, I WOULD HAVE OFFERED A BISCUIT FOR DYING. I'M TOLD I MAKE THE BEST CHOCOLATE CHIP ONES.
Beyond the Grave#024.dst: SI HOY HUBIERA TRAÍDO HARINA, TE HARÍA UNA GALLETA POR TU ÓBITO. DICEN QUE LAS MÍAS DE PEPITAS DE CHOCOLATE SON LAS MEJORES.
Beyond the Grave#024.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#025.src: BUT ALAS. WE WILL HAVE TO CONTENT OURSELVES WITH A LAST DRINK FOR THE DEPARTED INSTEAD. I'LL PUT THE KETTLE ON.
Beyond the Grave#025.dst: PERO AY. TENDREMOS QUE CONFORMARNOS CON UN ÚLTIMO TRAGO POR EL DIFUNTO. PONDRÉ EL AGUA A HERVIR.
Beyond the Grave#025.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#026.dst: PIES FUERA DE LA MESA, POR FAVOR.
Beyond the Grave#026.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#027.src: THIS SECTION OF THE MANSION IS UNDERGOING RENOVATIONS. FOR THE TIME BEING, IT GOES EMPTY.
Beyond the Grave#027.dst: ESTA PARTE DE LA MANSIÓN ESTÁ EN OBRAS. POR AHORA SE QUEDA VACÍA.
Beyond the Grave#027.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#028.src: SOULS DO LINGER HERE. LINGERING EVER LONGER THAN BEFORE. AND WITH SO MANY ARRIVING...
Beyond the Grave#028.dst: LAS ALMAS SÍ SE DEMORAN AQUÍ. CADA VEZ MÁS QUE ANTES. Y CON TANTAS LLEGANDO...
Beyond the Grave#028.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#029.src: IT IS, PERHAPS, A POINTLESS COMFORT TO GIVE. BUT I FEEL A GUEST ROOM WOULD BE APPRECIATED, UNDER THE CIRCUMSTANCES.
Beyond the Grave#029.dst: QUIZÁ SEA UN CONSUELO INÚTIL. PERO CREO QUE UN CUARTO DE INVITADOS SE AGRADECERÁ, DADAS LAS CIRCUNSTANCIAS.
Beyond the Grave#029.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#030.src: PERHAPS GROWING THINGS IN A PLACE LIKE THIS IS A FOOL'S ERRAND.
Beyond the Grave#030.dst: QUIZÁ CULTIVAR COSAS EN UN LUGAR ASÍ SEA TAREA DE NECIOS.
Beyond the Grave#030.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#031.src: IF IT IS, THEN I WILL MERRILY JINGLE MY BELLS AS I WATER THEM. IT IS FLEETING JOY TO CARE FOR THEM, BUT A JOY NONETHELESS.
Beyond the Grave#031.dst: SI LO ES, HARÉ SONAR MIS CASCABELES ALEGREMENTE MIENTRAS LAS RIEGO. CUIDARLAS ES UNA ALEGRÍA FUGAZ, PERO ALEGRÍA AL FIN.
Beyond the Grave#031.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#032.src: THESE ARE BUSHES. NOTHING YOU DON'T ALREADY KNOW.
Beyond the Grave#032.dst: ESTO SON ARBUSTOS. NADA QUE NO SEPAS YA.
Beyond the Grave#032.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#033.src: WELCOME TO MY LIBRARY. I FIND MY GUESTS ARE DRAWN TO HERE. PERHAPS IT IS BECAUSE KNOWLEDGE IS POWER, AS I HAVE BEEN TOLD.
Beyond the Grave#033.dst: BIENVENIDO A MI BIBLIOTECA. MIS INVITADOS SE SIENTEN ATRAÍDOS HACIA AQUÍ. QUIZÁ PORQUE EL SABER ES PODER, SEGÚN ME HAN DICHO.
Beyond the Grave#033.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#034.src: ALTHOUGH, GIVEN SO MANY OF MY BOOKS ARE WRITTEN IN DEAD LANGUAGES, THERE IS LITTLE POWER TO BE FOUND HERE.
Beyond the Grave#034.dst: AUNQUE, DADO QUE MUCHOS DE MIS LIBROS ESTÁN ESCRITOS EN LENGUAS MUERTAS, POCO PODER SE ENCONTRARÁ AQUÍ.
Beyond the Grave#034.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#035.src: BUT I WILL NEVER BEGRUDGE A GUEST A REPRIEVE. HOWEVER MOMENTARY. MORTALITY CAN BE A HARSH LESSON.
Beyond the Grave#035.dst: PERO NUNCA LE NEGARÉ UN RESPIRO A UN INVITADO. POR BREVE QUE SEA. LA MORTALIDAD ES UNA LECCIÓN DURA.
Beyond the Grave#035.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#036.src: IT SEEMS YOU REALLY WANTED TO KNOW WHAT WAS BEHIND THIS DOOR.
Beyond the Grave#036.dst: PARECE QUE TENÍAS MUCHAS GANAS DE SABER QUÉ HABÍA TRAS ESTA PUERTA.
Beyond the Grave#036.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#037.src: I GUESS YOU WILL GET WHAT YOU WANTED...
Beyond the Grave#037.dst: SUPONGO QUE VAS A OBTENER LO QUE QUERÍAS...
Beyond the Grave#037.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#039.src: DO YOU REALLY THINK IT WAS WORTH YOUR TIME?
Beyond the Grave#039.dst: ¿DE VERDAD CREES QUE MERECIÓ LA PENA?
Beyond the Grave#039.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#040.src: AH, I SEE YOU HAVE DISCOVERED THE HOURGLASSES. I SUPPOSE IT IS ONLY NATURAL THEY WOULD DRAW YOUR ATTENTION.
Beyond the Grave#040.dst: AH, VEO QUE HAS DESCUBIERTO LOS RELOJES DE ARENA. SUPONGO QUE ES NATURAL QUE TE LLAMEN LA ATENCIÓN.
Beyond the Grave#040.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#041.src: EACH ONE MEASURES THE LIFE OF A BEING. WHEN ALL THE SAND REACHES THE BOTTOM, I RECEIVE A NEW GUEST.
Beyond the Grave#041.dst: CADA UNO MIDE LA VIDA DE UN SER. CUANDO TODA LA ARENA LLEGA ABAJO, RECIBO UN NUEVO INVITADO.
Beyond the Grave#041.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#042.src: BUT A MEASURED LIFESPAN IS NOT A GUARANTEE. IT IS ONLY AN ESTIMATE. THE RATE OF THE HOURGLASS WILL SHIFT IN RESPONSE TO ANY NUMBER OF FACTORS.
Beyond the Grave#042.dst: PERO UNA VIDA MEDIDA NO ES NINGUNA GARANTÍA. ES SOLO UNA ESTIMACIÓN. EL RITMO DEL RELOJ CAMBIA SEGÚN UN SINFÍN DE FACTORES.
Beyond the Grave#042.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#043.src: I AM SURE WE COULD FIND YOURS, IF WE SEARCHED HARD ENOUGH. BUT I FIND MOST VISITORS STRUGGLE TO GRAPPLE WITH SUCH A TANGIBLE DISPLAY.
Beyond the Grave#043.dst: SEGURO QUE PODRÍAMOS ENCONTRAR EL TUYO SI BUSCÁRAMOS LO BASTANTE. PERO A LA MAYORÍA DE VISITANTES LES CUESTA ASUMIR ALGO TAN TANGIBLE.
Beyond the Grave#043.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#044.src: THIS ONE... IT IS SPECIAL. IT DISPLAYS SOMETHING FAR MORE IMPORTANT THAN INDIVIDUAL LIFESPANS.
Beyond the Grave#044.dst: ESTE... ES ESPECIAL. MUESTRA ALGO MUCHO MÁS IMPORTANTE QUE LA VIDA DE UN INDIVIDUO.
Beyond the Grave#044.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#045.src: IT IS HERE TO MEASURE HOW MUCH TIME THE WORLD HAS LEFT.
Beyond the Grave#045.dst: ESTÁ AQUÍ PARA MEDIR CUÁNTO TIEMPO LE QUEDA AL MUNDO.
Beyond the Grave#045.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#046.src: AS WITH THE OTHERS, IT IS MERELY AN ESTIMATE. IT HAS BEEN SLOWED AND HALTED IN THE PAST.
Beyond the Grave#046.dst: COMO LOS DEMÁS, ES SOLO UNA ESTIMACIÓN. EN EL PASADO SE HA RALENTIZADO, Y HASTA DETENIDO.
Beyond the Grave#046.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#047.src: BUT I FEAR THE COMING END IS INEVITABLE. IT WAS SET IN MOTION LONG, LONG AGO, BY ACTORS BEYOND THE BOTH OF US.
Beyond the Grave#047.dst: PERO TEMO QUE EL FIN QUE SE ACERCA ES INEVITABLE. SE PUSO EN MARCHA HACE MUCHO, MUCHO TIEMPO, POR MANOS AJENAS A LOS DOS.
Beyond the Grave#047.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#048.src: I KEEP IT AS A REMINDER, TO CHERISH WHAT STILL IS LEFT. BEFORE IT, TOO, IS LOST.
Beyond the Grave#048.dst: LO CONSERVO COMO RECORDATORIO, PARA VALORAR LO QUE AÚN QUEDA. ANTES DE QUE ESO TAMBIÉN SE PIERDA.
Beyond the Grave#048.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#049.src: PLEASE REFRAIN FROM TOUCHING ANY OF MY JARS. I KEEP THINGS VERY DEAR TO ME IN THEM.
Beyond the Grave#049.dst: POR FAVOR, NO TOQUES NINGUNO DE MIS TARROS. GUARDO EN ELLOS COSAS MUY QUERIDAS.
Beyond the Grave#049.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#050.src: PARTICULARLY MY JAR OF SOIL. THAT IS A SOUVENIR FROM VERY, VERY LONG AGO.
Beyond the Grave#050.dst: SOBRE TODO MI TARRO DE TIERRA. ES UN RECUERDO DE HACE MUCHÍSIMO, MUCHÍSIMO TIEMPO.
Beyond the Grave#050.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#051.src: I HAVE NO NEED FOR SLEEP. SO, MY BEDROOM NOW SERVES MERELY A SYMBOLIC PURPOSE.
Beyond the Grave#051.dst: NO NECESITO DORMIR. ASÍ QUE MI DORMITORIO YA SOLO CUMPLE UNA FUNCIÓN SIMBÓLICA.
Beyond the Grave#051.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#052.src: SYMBOLIC OF WHAT, YOU ASK? MY LOVING MARRIAGE. JUST BECAUSE I DO NOT HAVE A HEART, IT DOES NOT MEAN I CANNOT LOVE.
Beyond the Grave#052.dst: ¿SÍMBOLO DE QUÉ, PREGUNTAS? DE MI MATRIMONIO FELIZ. QUE NO TENGA CORAZÓN NO SIGNIFICA QUE NO PUEDA AMAR.
Beyond the Grave#052.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#053.src: "TIL DEATH DO US PART" IS FOR QUITTERS, I SAY. I WILL LOVE HER BEYOND THE END OF TIME ITSELF.
Beyond the Grave#053.dst: LO DE "HASTA QUE LA MUERTE NOS SEPARE" ES PARA COBARDES. LA AMARÉ MÁS ALLÁ DEL FIN DEL TIEMPO.
Beyond the Grave#053.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#054.src: THESE DAYS, THE CATS LAY CLAIM TO THE BED FOR THE MOST PART. AT LEAST SOMEONE IS GETTING USE OUT OF IT, IN THE END.
Beyond the Grave#054.dst: ÚLTIMAMENTE, LOS GATOS RECLAMAN LA CAMA CASI SIEMPRE. AL MENOS ALGUIEN LE DA USO, AL FINAL.
Beyond the Grave#054.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#055.src: THIS IS THE DARK LORD, SNUGGLEBUNS. GREET HIM WITH RESPECT, WITH A PAT ON THE HEAD AND A SCRATCH UNDER THE CHIN.
Beyond the Grave#055.dst: ESTE ES EL SEÑOR OSCURO, SNUGGLEBUNS. SALÚDALO CON RESPETO: UNA CARICIA EN LA CABEZA Y UN RASCADO BAJO LA BARBILLA.
Beyond the Grave#055.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#056.src: HE IS A GUEST, MUCH LIKE YOURSELF. UNLIKE YOU, HOWEVER, HE HAS BEEN HERE A VERY LONG TIME.
Beyond the Grave#056.dst: ES UN INVITADO, COMO TÚ. AUNQUE, A DIFERENCIA DE TI, LLEVA AQUÍ MUCHÍSIMO TIEMPO.
Beyond the Grave#056.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#057.src: HE IS ONE OF THE MORE STUBBORN BEASTS I HAVE ENCOUNTERED ACROSS THESE EONS. YOU SEE, HE IS WAITING FOR SOMEONE TO CROSS OVER. MUCH LIKE MYSELF, HE CAN BE VERY PATIENT.
Beyond the Grave#057.dst: ES UNA DE LAS BESTIAS MÁS TESTARUDAS QUE HE CONOCIDO EN TODOS ESTOS EONES. VERÁS, ESPERA A QUE ALGUIEN CRUCE AL OTRO LADO. COMO YO, PUEDE SER MUY PACIENTE.
Beyond the Grave#057.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#058.src: TOO PATIENT FOR HIS OWN GOOD, PERHAPS.
Beyond the Grave#058.dst: DEMASIADO PACIENTE PARA SU PROPIO BIEN, QUIZÁ.
Beyond the Grave#058.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#059.src: ...I DO NOT HAVE THE HEART TO TELL HIM THE TRUTH. AND SO, AS THE YEARS PASS, HIS CLAIM ON MY HOME CONTINUES TO GROW.
Beyond the Grave#059.dst: ...NO TENGO CORAZÓN PARA DECIRLE LA VERDAD. Y ASÍ, CON LOS AÑOS, SU DOMINIO SOBRE MI CASA NO DEJA DE CRECER.
Beyond the Grave#059.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#060.src: AND I ALLOW IT. I FIND HIS COMPANIONSHIP WORTH THE HASSLE.
Beyond the Grave#060.dst: Y LO PERMITO. SU COMPAÑÍA BIEN VALE LA MOLESTIA.
Beyond the Grave#060.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#061.src: IT MAY NOT SEEM AS SUCH FROM YOUR PERSPECTIVE. BUT LIFE IS LIMITED. STILL, SOULS PASS THROUGH THE CYCLE, AND THE WORLD KEEPS ON SPINNING.
Beyond the Grave#061.dst: QUIZÁ NO TE LO PAREZCA. PERO LA VIDA ES LIMITADA. AUN ASÍ, LAS ALMAS PASAN POR EL CICLO Y EL MUNDO SIGUE GIRANDO.
Beyond the Grave#061.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#062.src: ...THEY WERE NOT MEANT TO BE LOST. TO PASS BEYOND MY REACH, TO REACH AN END SOMEWHERE I CANNOT FIND THEM.
Beyond the Grave#062.dst: ...NO DEBÍAN PERDERSE. NI PASAR MÁS ALLÁ DE MI ALCANCE, NI LLEGAR A UN FINAL DONDE NO PUEDA ENCONTRARLAS.
Beyond the Grave#062.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#063.src: AND YET, THROUGH MEANS BEYOND MY CONTROL, THEY DO. THEY HAVE. WITH EACH AND EVERY ONE, I LOSE A PIECE OF MYSELF. IRREVERSIBLY.
Beyond the Grave#063.dst: Y SIN EMBARGO, POR MEDIOS QUE NO CONTROLO, SE PIERDEN. SE HAN PERDIDO. CON CADA UNA PIERDO UN TROZO DE MÍ. SIN REMEDIO.
Beyond the Grave#063.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#064.src: AND THE CYCLE MUST KEEP SPINNING, LESSENED EVEN AS IT MAY BE. BUT I STILL REMEMBER THEM, EACH LIFE THAT THEY LIVED.
Beyond the Grave#064.dst: Y EL CICLO DEBE SEGUIR GIRANDO, POR MERMADO QUE ESTÉ. PERO YO LAS RECUERDO, CADA VIDA QUE VIVIERON.
Beyond the Grave#064.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#067.src: THIS ONE SHOULD BE FAMILIAR TO YOU.
Beyond the Grave#067.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#068.src: FEW EVER HAVE THE CHANCE TO COME FACE TO FACE WITH A LIFE THEY THEMSELVES HAVE BROUGHT TO AN END. I WONDER HOW YOU FEEL NOW.
Beyond the Grave#068.dst: POCOS TIENEN LA OCASIÓN DE ENCONTRARSE CARA A CARA CON UNA VIDA QUE ELLOS MISMOS SEGARON. ME PREGUNTO CÓMO TE SIENTES AHORA.
Beyond the Grave#068.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#069.src: HE WAS ONCE A GOOD MAN. BUT SUCH IS THE TRAVESTY OF THAT WAR-RAVAGED PROVINCE, THAT IT TWISTS THE MIND AND SPIRIT IN SUCH A WAY.
Beyond the Grave#069.dst: FUE UN BUEN HOMBRE. PERO ESA ES LA DESGRACIA DE AQUELLA PROVINCIA ASOLADA POR LA GUERRA: RETUERCE ASÍ LA MENTE Y EL ESPÍRITU.
Beyond the Grave#069.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#070.src: I WILL NOT PASS JUDGEMENT ON YOUR ACTIONS. BUT PERHAPS DEATH WAS A KINDER FATE THAN THE TURMOIL HE WAS DROWNING IN.
Beyond the Grave#070.dst: NO JUZGARÉ TUS ACTOS. PERO QUIZÁ LA MUERTE FUE UN DESTINO MÁS AMABLE QUE EL TORMENTO EN EL QUE SE AHOGABA.
Beyond the Grave#070.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#071.src: EVEN HERE, FREED OF ITS INFLUENCE, HE STRUGGLES TO RELEASE THAT ANGER THAT GRIPPED HIM SO TIGHTLY. HE REFUSES TO MOVE ON.
Beyond the Grave#071.dst: INCLUSO AQUÍ, LIBRE DE ESA INFLUENCIA, LE CUESTA SOLTAR LA IRA QUE LO ATENAZABA. SE NIEGA A SEGUIR ADELANTE.
Beyond the Grave#071.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#072.src: BUT HE WILL, EVENTUALLY. THEY ALL DO. IT IS ONLY A MATTER OF TIME.
Beyond the Grave#072.dst: PERO LO HARÁ, CON EL TIEMPO. TODOS LO HACEN. ES CUESTIÓN DE TIEMPO.
Beyond the Grave#072.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#074.src: HE IS NOT THE FIRST TO HAVE SUFFERED SUCH A FATE. THAT BLIGHT HAS TAKEN HOLD OF OH SO MANY OVER THE YEARS.
Beyond the Grave#074.dst: NO ES EL PRIMERO EN SUFRIR TAL DESTINO. ESA PLAGA SE HA APODERADO DE TANTÍSIMOS CON LOS AÑOS.
Beyond the Grave#074.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#075.src: A MILLENNIUM IS A RAINDROP IN THE SEA COMPARED TO MY EXISTENCE. SO WHY HAVE THESE YEARS FELT SO MUCH LONGER THAN EVER BEFORE?
Beyond the Grave#075.dst: UN MILENIO ES UNA GOTA DE LLUVIA EN EL MAR COMPARADO CON MI EXISTENCIA. ¿POR QUÉ, ENTONCES, ESTOS AÑOS SE ME HAN HECHO TAN LARGOS?
Beyond the Grave#075.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#076.src: IT IS FORTUNATE THAT IT ONLY TARGETS THE BODY, AND ONLY ONCE ITS SPARK FLICKERS OUT.
Beyond the Grave#076.dst: POR SUERTE SOLO ATACA AL CUERPO, Y SOLO CUANDO SU CHISPA SE HA APAGADO.
Beyond the Grave#076.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#077.src: WHAT IT DOES IS BAD ENOUGH ALREADY. IF IT WERE TO TAKE THE SOUL, AS WELL...
Beyond the Grave#077.dst: LO QUE HACE YA ES BASTANTE MALO. SI ADEMÁS SE LLEVARA EL ALMA...
Beyond the Grave#077.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#079.src: AH HA HA. I WOULD RATHER NOT DWELL ON THAT ANY LONGER. IT ISN'T AS IF I COULD DO SOMETHING ABOUT IT, ANYWAY.
Beyond the Grave#079.dst: JA JA JA. PREFIERO NO SEGUIR DÁNDOLE VUELTAS. TAMPOCO ES QUE PUDIERA HACER NADA AL RESPECTO.
Beyond the Grave#079.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#081.src: WELCOME TO MY OFFICE. GO ON, TAKE A GUESS AT WHAT I DO HERE.
Beyond the Grave#081.dst: BIENVENIDO A MI DESPACHO. VENGA, ADIVINA QUÉ HAGO AQUÍ.
Beyond the Grave#081.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#083.src: ...REALLY? NOTHING? PERHAPS I NEED SOME NEW MATERIAL.
Beyond the Grave#083.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#084.src: PLEASE TAKE A SEAT. LET US REVIEW YOUR OPTIONS.
Beyond the Grave#084.dst: SIÉNTATE, POR FAVOR. REPASEMOS TUS OPCIONES.
Beyond the Grave#084.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#085.src: PERHAPS SITTING IN FRONT OF DEATH MAY SEEM AN ODD PLACE TO BE. I APOLOGIZE FOR ANY DISCOMFORT.
Beyond the Grave#085.dst: QUIZÁ SENTARSE ANTE LA MUERTE PAREZCA UN SITIO EXTRAÑO. DISCULPA LA INCOMODIDAD.
Beyond the Grave#085.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#086.src: NOW, BEFORE WE BEGIN IN EARNEST. LIVING BEINGS ARE NOT SUBTLE ABOUT HAVING QUESTIONS. I AM SURE YOU HAVE THEM.
Beyond the Grave#086.dst: AHORA, ANTES DE EMPEZAR DE VERAS. LOS SERES VIVOS NO DISIMULAN CUANDO TIENEN PREGUNTAS. SEGURO QUE TÚ LAS TIENES.
Beyond the Grave#086.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#087.src: GO ON. ASK THEM NOW. I DO NOT WANT TO BE INTERRUPTED LATER.
Beyond the Grave#087.dst: ADELANTE. HAZLAS AHORA. NO QUIERO QUE ME INTERRUMPAN LUEGO.
Beyond the Grave#087.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#089.src: FEEL FREE TO TAKE A MOMENT TO COME TO TERMS WITH YOUR MORTALITY, IF YOU NEED IT. I HAVE TIME.
Beyond the Grave#089.dst: TÓMATE UN MOMENTO PARA ASUMIR TU MORTALIDAD, SI LO NECESITAS. TIEMPO ME SOBRA.
Beyond the Grave#089.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#091.src: MANY, MANY, MANY TIMES. AS HAS EVERY OTHER LIVING BEING.
Beyond the Grave#091.dst: MUCHAS, MUCHAS, MUCHAS VECES. COMO TODO SER VIVO.
Beyond the Grave#091.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#092.src: ONCE A LIFE REACHES AN END, THE SOUL PASSES THROUGH THE VEIL, CROSSING OVER INTO DEATH.
Beyond the Grave#092.dst: CUANDO UNA VIDA LLEGA A SU FIN, EL ALMA ATRAVIESA EL VELO Y CRUZA A LA MUERTE.
Beyond the Grave#092.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#093.src: HERE, THEY LINGER. MEMORIES FADE WITH TIME, AND THE SOUL IS REDUCED TO THE ESSENTIALS. PREPARED TO RETURN TO THE CYCLE.
Beyond the Grave#093.dst: AQUÍ SE DEMORAN. LOS RECUERDOS SE DESVANECEN CON EL TIEMPO Y EL ALMA QUEDA REDUCIDA A LO ESENCIAL. LISTA PARA VOLVER AL CICLO.
Beyond the Grave#093.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#094.src: LIFE AND DEATH ARE NOT IN OPPOSITION, AS YOU MORTALS OFTEN ASSUME. THEY ARE TWO PARTS OF THE SAME WHOLE.
Beyond the Grave#094.dst: LA VIDA Y LA MUERTE NO SE OPONEN, COMO SOLÉIS SUPONER LOS MORTALES. SON DOS PARTES DE UN MISMO TODO.
Beyond the Grave#094.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#095.src: YOU, THE ESSENCE AT THE CORE OF YOUR BEING, HAVE BEEN HERE MANY TIMES BEFORE. AND YOU WILL BE HERE MANY TIMES AGAIN.
Beyond the Grave#095.dst: TÚ, LA ESENCIA EN EL NÚCLEO DE TU SER, HAS ESTADO AQUÍ MUCHAS VECES. Y VOLVERÁS A ESTARLO MUCHAS MÁS.
Beyond the Grave#095.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#096.src: ...OR, SO I WOULD HOPE. BUT I DIGRESS.
Beyond the Grave#096.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#098.src: IT IS DEATH. IT MAY BE HARD TO BELIEVE, I KNOW. AH HA HA. BUT I HAVE BEEN EXCEEDINGLY CLEAR, HAVEN'T I?
Beyond the Grave#098.dst: ES LA MUERTE. SÉ QUE PUEDE COSTAR CREERLO. JA JA JA. PERO HE SIDO CLARÍSIMO, ¿VERDAD?
Beyond the Grave#098.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#099.src: BUT NOT EVERY SOUL WILL SEE IT THE SAME WAY. MOST LACK THE CAPACITY TO CONCEPTUALIZE IT AS ANYTHING MORE THAN A HAZE. A BLURRED STATE OF BEING.
Beyond the Grave#099.dst: PERO NO TODAS LAS ALMAS LO VEN IGUAL. LA MAYORÍA NO PUEDE CONCEBIRLO COMO ALGO MÁS QUE UNA BRUMA. UN ESTADO DE SER DIFUSO.
Beyond the Grave#099.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#100.src: IT IS RARE THAT I MAY HOST A GUEST WITH THE CLARITY OF MIND AND THE WILLPOWER REMAINING TO SEE THIS PLACE FOR WHAT IT TRULY IS.
Beyond the Grave#100.dst: ES RARO QUE PUEDA ALOJAR A UN INVITADO CON LA LUCIDEZ Y LA VOLUNTAD SUFICIENTES PARA VER ESTE LUGAR COMO REALMENTE ES.
Beyond the Grave#100.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#101.src: HOWEVER FLEETINGLY, I DO ENJOY WHEN IT HAPPENS. IT IS WORTH CELEBRATING. NOW IF ONLY I HAD SOME SPIRITS TO SHARE. AH HA HA.
Beyond the Grave#101.dst: POR FUGAZ QUE SEA, DISFRUTO CUANDO OCURRE. MERECE UNA CELEBRACIÓN. SI AL MENOS TUVIERA UNOS ESPÍRITUS CON QUE BRINDAR. JA JA JA.
Beyond the Grave#101.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#103.src: OH, IT CHANGES WITH THE TIMES. AND ACCORDING TO MY WHIMS.
Beyond the Grave#103.dst: OH, CAMBIA CON LOS TIEMPOS. Y SEGÚN MIS CAPRICHOS.
Beyond the Grave#103.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#104.src: IT HAS PREVIOUSLY BEEN A TOWER, A CASTLE, A FOREST, A CAVERN... I WAS IN A VERY UNDERGROUND PHASE OF MY EXISTENCE BACK THEN.
Beyond the Grave#104.dst: ANTES FUE UNA TORRE, UN CASTILLO, UN BOSQUE, UNA CAVERNA... POR ENTONCES ATRAVESABA UNA FASE MUY SUBTERRÁNEA DE MI EXISTENCIA.
Beyond the Grave#104.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#105.src: FOR NOW, A MANOR SERVES ME WELL. I DO ADMIRE THE ARCHITECTURAL STYLE OF ITS TIME. VERY GOTHIC.
Beyond the Grave#105.dst: POR AHORA, UNA MANSIÓN ME SIRVE BIEN. ADMIRO EL ESTILO DE SU ÉPOCA. MUY GÓTICO.
Beyond the Grave#105.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#107.src: CERTAINLY NOT. WHEREVER WOULD I FIND THE TIME?
Beyond the Grave#107.dst: DESDE LUEGO QUE NO. ¿DE DÓNDE IBA A SACAR EL TIEMPO?
Beyond the Grave#107.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#108.src: FOR MOST SOULS, THERE IS LITTLE NEED TO INTERVENE. THEY WILL LINGER, BUT GIVEN TIME, THEY WILL FIND THEIR WAY FORWARD.
Beyond the Grave#108.dst: CON LA MAYORÍA DE LAS ALMAS APENAS HACE FALTA INTERVENIR. SE DEMORARÁN, PERO CON TIEMPO ENCONTRARÁN SU CAMINO.
Beyond the Grave#108.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#109.src: BUT ON OCCASION, AN ARRIVAL WILL DRAW MY INTEREST. ONE WHICH DEMANDS A PROPER WELCOME.
Beyond the Grave#109.dst: PERO A VECES UNA LLEGADA DESPIERTA MI INTERÉS. UNA QUE EXIGE UNA BIENVENIDA COMO ES DEBIDO.
Beyond the Grave#109.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#110.src: THIS MEETING IN MY OFFICE IS NOT TRULY NECESSARY. THE PAPERWORK IS JUST FOR SHOW. BUT I LIKE TO INDULGE, ON OCCASION.
Beyond the Grave#110.dst: ESTA REUNIÓN EN MI DESPACHO NO ES REALMENTE NECESARIA. EL PAPELEO ES PURA FACHADA. PERO DE VEZ EN CUANDO ME GUSTA DARME EL GUSTO.
Beyond the Grave#110.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#112.src: THAT SHOULD BE EVERYTHING, THEN. PERHAPS IF I GAVE YOU MORE TIME, YOU COULD THINK OF MORE.
Beyond the Grave#112.dst: ESO SERÍA TODO, ENTONCES. QUIZÁ, CON MÁS TIEMPO, SE TE OCURRIRÍAN MÁS.
Beyond the Grave#112.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#113.src: BUT IT IS BEST WE GET ON WITH OUR DISCUSSION, I WOULD SAY.
Beyond the Grave#113.dst: PERO DIRÍA QUE CONVIENE SEGUIR CON NUESTRA CONVERSACIÓN.
Beyond the Grave#113.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#114.src: LET US BEGIN WITH THE BASICS.
Beyond the Grave#114.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#115.src: CAUSE OF DEATH: SLAIN BY THE HORROR KNOWN AS KROLTON. ANOTHER ADD TO THE TALLY.
Beyond the Grave#115.dst: CAUSA DE LA MUERTE: ABATIDO POR EL HORROR LLAMADO KROLTON. OTRO MÁS EN LA CUENTA.
Beyond the Grave#115.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#116.src: SWIFT AND UNAVOIDABLE. THERE IS NO SHAME IN LOSING TO SUCH A FORE. YOU ARE NOT THE FIRST, AND YOU WILL LIKELY NOT BE THE LAST.
Beyond the Grave#116.dst: RÁPIDO E INEVITABLE. NO HAY VERGÜENZA EN PERDER ANTE TAL ENEMIGO. NO ERES EL PRIMERO, Y SEGURAMENTE NO SERÁS EL ÚLTIMO.
Beyond the Grave#116.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#117.src: THOUGH PERHAPS I FIND MYSELF HOPING SOMEONE DOES MANAGE TO SUCCEED IN PUTTING AN END TO IT. IT HAS LIVED WELL BEYOND ITS MEAN, AND PROVES A NUISANCE EVERY TIME IT RE-EMERGES...
Beyond the Grave#117.dst: AUNQUE QUIZÁ ME DESCUBRO ESPERANDO QUE ALGUIEN LOGRE ACABAR CON ÉL. HA VIVIDO MUCHO MÁS DE LO QUE LE CORRESPONDÍA Y RESULTA UN FASTIDIO CADA VEZ QUE REAPARECE...
Beyond the Grave#117.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#118.src: BUT I DIGRESS. NEXT, LET US PERUSE YOUR LIFE'S RECORD. IT IS A FORMALITY, FOR THE MOST PART. ONLY APPLICABLE IF YOU WISH TO RETURN TO THE CYCLE.
Beyond the Grave#118.dst: PERO ME DESVÍO. AHORA, REVISEMOS EL REGISTRO DE TU VIDA. ES UN TRÁMITE, EN SU MAYOR PARTE. SOLO APLICABLE SI DESEAS VOLVER AL CICLO.
Beyond the Grave#118.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#119.src: SELFISHLY, HOWEVER, I WOULD URGE YOU TO LINGER A WHILE. IT HAS BEEN SOME TIME SINCE I HAVE HAD GUEST. YOUR COMPANY WOULD NOT BE UNAPPRECIATED.
Beyond the Grave#119.dst: AUNQUE, EGOÍSTAMENTE, TE ANIMARÍA A QUEDARTE UN RATO. HACE TIEMPO QUE NO TENGO INVITADOS. TU COMPAÑÍA NO SERÍA POCO APRECIADA.
Beyond the Grave#119.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#120.src: ...YOU HAVE TIME TO DECIDE. FOR NOW, WE MAY...
Beyond the Grave#120.dst: ...TIENES TIEMPO PARA DECIDIR. POR AHORA, PODEMOS...
Beyond the Grave#120.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#122.src: HM. HOW VERY INTERESTING. THAT WOULD EXPLAIN SOME THINGS.
Beyond the Grave#122.dst: HM. QUÉ INTERESANTE. ESO EXPLICARÍA ALGUNAS COSAS.
Beyond the Grave#122.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#123.src: SOMETHING HAS GONE WRONG. IT WOULD SEEM YOUR SPARK HAS PERSISTED EVEN THROUGH THE VEIL... EVEN THOUGH SUCH A THING SHOULD BE IMPOSSIBLE.
Beyond the Grave#123.dst: ALGO HA SALIDO MAL. PARECE QUE TU CHISPA HA PERSISTIDO INCLUSO A TRAVÉS DEL VELO... AUNQUE ESO DEBERÍA SER IMPOSIBLE.
Beyond the Grave#123.speaker: Death
