Beyond the Grave#124.src: IT HAS IMPRINTED ITSELF INTO YOUR VERY ESSENCE... HOW HAS THIS COME TO PASS? COULD IT HAVE BEEN...
Beyond the Grave#124.dst: SE HA GRABADO EN TU PROPIA ESENCIA... ¿CÓMO HA PODIDO OCURRIR? ¿ACASO HABRÁ SIDO...
Beyond the Grave#124.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#125.src: AH. I SEE... THIS COMPLICATES MATTERS.
Beyond the Grave#125.dst: AH. YA VEO... ESTO COMPLICA LAS COSAS.
Beyond the Grave#125.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#127.src: I WOULD NOT WISH TO KEEP YOU HERE. IT WOULD NOT BE RIGHT. AND YET, I LACK THE MEANS TO RETURN YOU TO THE LIVING. SUCH AN ACT IS BEYOND MY OWN CAPABILITY.
Beyond the Grave#127.dst: NO DESEARÍA RETENERTE AQUÍ. NO SERÍA JUSTO. Y SIN EMBARGO, ME FALTAN LOS MEDIOS PARA DEVOLVERTE A LOS VIVOS. ESO ESCAPA A MI CAPACIDAD.
Beyond the Grave#127.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#128.src: WHAT TO DO, WHAT TO DO...
Beyond the Grave#128.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#130.src: A THOUGHT OCCURS TO ME. THOUGH I LACK THE MEANS MYSELF, THERE IS AN OPTION YET OPEN TO US. A THREAD I MAY REACH OUT AND GRASP.
Beyond the Grave#130.dst: SE ME OCURRE ALGO. AUNQUE YO NO TENGA LOS MEDIOS, NOS QUEDA UNA OPCIÓN. UN HILO QUE PUEDO ALARGAR LA MANO Y AGARRAR.
Beyond the Grave#130.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#131.src: THE WRETCHED KROLTON. ITS SPARK IS STRONG, HAVING TAKEN SO MANY LIVES TO MAINTAIN IT. IF IT IS SLAIN, THAT STRENGTH WILL QUICKLY DISPERSE.
Beyond the Grave#131.dst: EL MISERABLE KROLTON. SU CHISPA ES FUERTE: HA SEGADO MUCHAS VIDAS PARA MANTENERLA. SI MUERE, ESA FUERZA SE DISPERSARÁ ENSEGUIDA.
Beyond the Grave#131.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#132.src: BUT FOR ONE SHORT MOMENT, IT WILL BE WITHIN MY REACH. AND WITH IT, WE MAY REIGNITE YOUR OWN CRADLED SPARK.
Beyond the Grave#132.dst: PERO DURANTE UN BREVE INSTANTE ESTARÁ A MI ALCANCE. Y CON ELLA PODREMOS REAVIVAR TU PROPIA CHISPA RESGUARDADA.
Beyond the Grave#132.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#133.src: ...THIS IS NOT AN ACT I TAKE LIGHTLY. TO TWIST THE CYCLE IN SUCH A WAY... IT IS AGAINST MY VERY NATURE.
Beyond the Grave#133.dst: ...NO ES UN ACTO QUE ME TOME A LA LIGERA. RETORCER ASÍ EL CICLO... VA CONTRA MI PROPIA NATURALEZA.
Beyond the Grave#133.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#134.src: BUT, SELFISHLY, I FIND MYSELF CARING LESS ABOUT SUCH THINGS AS OF LATE.
Beyond the Grave#134.dst: PERO, EGOÍSTAMENTE, ÚLTIMAMENTE ME IMPORTAN MENOS ESAS COSAS.
Beyond the Grave#134.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#135.src: SO IT IS DECIDED. I WILL GRANT YOU PASSAGE BACK BEYOND THE VEIL, WHERE YOU WILL RETURN TO THE BODY YOU HAD LEFT BEHIND.
Beyond the Grave#135.dst: ASÍ QUEDA DECIDIDO. TE CONCEDERÉ EL PASO DE VUELTA AL OTRO LADO DEL VELO, DONDE REGRESARÁS AL CUERPO QUE DEJASTE ATRÁS.
Beyond the Grave#135.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#136.src: THERE, WITH WHAT STRENGTH YOU HAVE, YOU WILL BRING AND END TO THAT HORROR. AND THROUGH THAT END, WE SHALL STAVE OFF YOUR OWN.
Beyond the Grave#136.dst: ALLÍ, CON LAS FUERZAS QUE TE QUEDEN, ACABARÁS CON ESE HORROR. Y CON SU FINAL, EVITAREMOS EL TUYO.
Beyond the Grave#136.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#137.src: IT WILL TAKE SOME TIME TO PREPARE. IN THE MEANTIME, YOU MAY EXPLORE THE MANSION FURTHER.
Beyond the Grave#137.dst: LLEVARÁ ALGO DE TIEMPO PREPARARLO. MIENTRAS TANTO, PUEDES SEGUIR EXPLORANDO LA MANSIÓN.
Beyond the Grave#137.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#138.src: THERE IS A GAME I HAD SET UP, IN THE OTHER UPSTAIRS ROOM. IT WAS MEANT TO BE A SURPRISE FOR YOU, BUT SINCE YOU WILL BE LEAVING, I SUPPOSE WE MAY PUSH IT FORWARD.
Beyond the Grave#138.dst: HAY UN JUEGO QUE PREPARÉ EN LA OTRA HABITACIÓN DE ARRIBA. IBA A SER UNA SORPRESA, PERO YA QUE TE MARCHAS, SUPONGO QUE PODEMOS ADELANTARLO.
Beyond the Grave#138.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#139.src: YES? WHAT ELSE DO YOU NEED?
Beyond the Grave#139.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#142.src: I SUPPOSE I HAVE GROWN TIRED OF STANDING BY.
Beyond the Grave#142.dst: SUPONGO QUE ME HE CANSADO DE QUEDARME AL MARGEN.
Beyond the Grave#142.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#143.src: IT IS DIFFICULT, WATCHING THE WORLD'S FATE UNFOLD, UNABLE TO LIFT EVEN A SINGLE SKELETAL FINGER TO MAKE A DIFFERENCE.
Beyond the Grave#143.dst: ES DURO VER CÓMO SE DESPLIEGA EL DESTINO DEL MUNDO SIN PODER LEVANTAR NI UN SOLO DEDO HUESUDO PARA CAMBIAR NADA.
Beyond the Grave#143.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#144.src: YOU DO NOT YET UNDERSTAND, I TAKE IT. FEW EVER WILL. IT IS SOMETHING FAR BEYOND ANY MORTAL'S CAPACITY TO COMPREHEND.
Beyond the Grave#144.dst: AÚN NO LO ENTIENDES, SUPONGO. POCOS LO HARÁN. ES ALGO MUY POR ENCIMA DE LA CAPACIDAD DE CUALQUIER MORTAL.
Beyond the Grave#144.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#145.src: I SUSPECT YOU WILL SOMEDAY. I DO NOT BELIEVE IN DESTINY. BUT PERHAPS THIS IS CLOSE ENOUGH.
Beyond the Grave#145.dst: SOSPECHO QUE ALGÚN DÍA LO HARÁS. NO CREO EN EL DESTINO. PERO QUIZÁ ESTO SE LE PAREZCA BASTANTE.
Beyond the Grave#145.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#146.src: IN TRUTH, YOU ARE RATHER FORTUNATE. YOU HAVE FOUND YOURSELF IN THE EXACT SET OF CIRCUMSTANCES TO ALLOW ME TO INTERVENE.
Beyond the Grave#146.dst: EN VERDAD, ERES AFORTUNADO. TE HAS VISTO EN EL CONJUNTO EXACTO DE CIRCUNSTANCIAS QUE ME PERMITE INTERVENIR.
Beyond the Grave#146.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#147.src: IT WOULD NOT BE RIGHT TO LET THE OPPORTUNITY PASS ME BY.
Beyond the Grave#147.dst: NO SERÍA CORRECTO DEJAR PASAR LA OPORTUNIDAD.
Beyond the Grave#147.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#148.src: IN ANY OTHER CIRCUMSTANCE, I WOULD BE HAPPY TO OBLIGE. A LONG-TERM GUEST IS ALWAYS APPRECIATED IN THESE LONESOME TIMES.
Beyond the Grave#148.dst: EN CUALQUIER OTRA CIRCUNSTANCIA, ACCEDERÍA ENCANTADO. UN INVITADO DE LARGA ESTANCIA SIEMPRE SE AGRADECE EN ESTOS TIEMPOS SOLITARIOS.
Beyond the Grave#148.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#149.src: BUT I CAN NOT. I WILL NOT.
Beyond the Grave#149.dst: PERO NO PUEDO. NO LO HARÉ.
Beyond the Grave#149.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#151.src: ...GO. DO NOT LINGER HERE ANY LONGER.
Beyond the Grave#151.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#152.src: THE GAME IS IN THE OTHER UPSTAIRS ROOM, ON THE OTHER END OF THE MANSION. I THINK YOU WILL ENJOY IT.
Beyond the Grave#152.dst: EL JUEGO ESTÁ EN LA OTRA HABITACIÓN DE ARRIBA, AL OTRO EXTREMO DE LA MANSIÓN. CREO QUE TE GUSTARÁ.
Beyond the Grave#152.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#153.src: I CANNOT HELP BUT NOTICE YOU ARE STILL HERE. ARE YOU LOST? THE GAME IS READY FOR YOU IN THE OTHER UPSTAIRS ROOM, ON THE OTHER END OF THE MANSION.
Beyond the Grave#153.dst: NO PUEDO EVITAR NOTAR QUE SIGUES AQUÍ. ¿TE HAS PERDIDO? EL JUEGO TE ESPERA EN LA OTRA HABITACIÓN DE ARRIBA, AL OTRO EXTREMO DE LA MANSIÓN.
Beyond the Grave#153.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#154.src: Find a way to exit the strange realm by looking around the mansion.
Beyond the Grave#154.dst: Busca por la mansión una forma de salir del extraño reino.

Beyond the Grave#155.src: WELL, I DID SAY YOU NEED TO BE SITTING ON THE COUCH. THE SCREEN TURNS OFF IF YOU MOVE TOO FAR AWAY. YOU'LL HAVE TO START OVER.
Beyond the Grave#155.dst: BUENO, YA DIJE QUE TENÍAS QUE ESTAR SENTADO EN EL SOFÁ. LA PANTALLA SE APAGA SI TE ALEJAS DEMASIADO. TENDRÁS QUE EMPEZAR DE NUEVO.
Beyond the Grave#155.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#156.src: IMPRESSIVE. HOWEVER, THAT WAS SIMPLY ROUND {~}, OUT OF {~}. EACH ONE WILL BE PROGRESSIVELY MORE DIFFICULT THAN THE LAST. READY?
Beyond the Grave#156.dst: IMPRESIONANTE. PERO ESA ERA SOLO LA RONDA {~} DE {~}. CADA UNA SERÁ MÁS DIFÍCIL QUE LA ANTERIOR. ¿LISTO?
Beyond the Grave#156.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#157.src: ...AH, THE LOOK ON YOUR FACE. PRICELESS. GIVEN HOW MY SKULL IS SOLID, MY GUESTS HAVE TO MEET MY FILL OF MAKING FACES FOR ME.
Beyond the Grave#157.dst: ...AH, ESA CARA QUE HAS PUESTO. NO TIENE PRECIO. COMO MI CRÁNEO ES MACIZO, MIS INVITADOS TIENEN QUE PONER LAS CARAS POR MÍ.
Beyond the Grave#157.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#158.src: SEEING AS YOU NEED TO LEAVE SOON, I HAVE ELECTED TO CUT THE QUIZ SHOW SHORT. FOR NOW, WE WILL PICK BACK UP WHERE WE LEFT OFF ONCE YOU INEVITABLY RETURN.
Beyond the Grave#158.dst: COMO TIENES QUE MARCHARTE PRONTO, HE DECIDIDO ACORTAR EL CONCURSO. YA LO RETOMAREMOS DONDE LO DEJAMOS CUANDO INEVITABLEMENTE REGRESES.
Beyond the Grave#158.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#159.src: ...WAS IT ENJOYABLE? I HAD PUT A GREAT DEAL OF WORK INTO IT.
Beyond the Grave#159.dst: ...¿TE HA GUSTADO? LE DEDIQUÉ MUCHÍSIMO TRABAJO.
Beyond the Grave#159.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#160.src: I AM GLAD. I PUT A LOT OF TIME INTO ENSURING MY GUESTS ARE ENTERTAINED HERE.
Beyond the Grave#160.dst: ME ALEGRO. DEDICO MUCHO TIEMPO A QUE MIS INVITADOS SE ENTRETENGAN AQUÍ.
Beyond the Grave#160.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#161.src: I SEE. VERY WELL. YOUR FEEDBACK IS APPRECIATED. I WILL HAVE TO MAKE SOME REVISIONS.
Beyond the Grave#161.dst: YA VEO. MUY BIEN. AGRADEZCO TU OPINIÓN. TENDRÉ QUE HACER ALGUNOS RETOQUES.
Beyond the Grave#161.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#162.src: THEN THAT IS ALL. IF ONLY YOU COULD STAY LONGER- I DO ENJOY ACTIVITIES WITH LUCID GUESTS. COOK CLUBS, LITTLE PARADES... BUT IT WILL HAVE TO WAIT.
Beyond the Grave#162.dst: PUES ESO ES TODO. OJALÁ PUDIERAS QUEDARTE MÁS: DISFRUTO DE LAS ACTIVIDADES CON INVITADOS LÚCIDOS. CLUBES DE COCINA, PEQUEÑOS DESFILES... PERO TENDRÁ QUE ESPERAR.
Beyond the Grave#162.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#163.src: NOW. THIS MANOR HASN'T GOT A BACK DOOR, SO I WILL NEED TO MAKE ONE FOR YOU TO EXIT. EXCUSE THE NOISE FOR MOMENT, AND TAKE THE NEW EXIT ANY TIME YOU LIKE.
Beyond the Grave#163.dst: AHORA. ESTA MANSIÓN NO TIENE PUERTA TRASERA, ASÍ QUE TENDRÉ QUE ABRIRTE UNA. DISCULPA EL RUIDO UN MOMENTO, Y USA LA NUEVA SALIDA CUANDO QUIERAS.
Beyond the Grave#163.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#164.src: WELL, I DID SAY YOU NEED TO BE SITTING ON THE COUCH. THE SCREEN TURNS OFF IF YOU MOVE TOO FAR AWAY. YOU'LL HAVE TO START OVER.
Beyond the Grave#164.dst: BUENO, YA DIJE QUE TENÍAS QUE ESTAR SENTADO EN EL SOFÁ. LA PANTALLA SE APAGA SI TE ALEJAS DEMASIADO. TENDRÁS QUE EMPEZAR DE NUEVO.
Beyond the Grave#164.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#165.src: SO, THERE YOU GO, WALKING BACK INTO THE LONG DREAM OF LIFE.
Beyond the Grave#165.dst: ASÍ QUE AHÍ VAS, DE VUELTA AL LARGO SUEÑO DE LA VIDA.
Beyond the Grave#165.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#166.src: IT WAS A SHORT STAY. BUT, I DID ENJOY HAVING YOU HERE. I ALWAYS DO LIKE THE GUESTS WHO CAN SEE ME FOR WHAT I AM.
Beyond the Grave#166.dst: HA SIDO UNA ESTANCIA BREVE. PERO DISFRUTÉ TENIÉNDOTE AQUÍ. SIEMPRE ME GUSTAN LOS INVITADOS QUE PUEDEN VERME COMO SOY.
Beyond the Grave#166.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#167.src: THE CIRCUMSTANCES HAVE NEVER ALIGNED FOR A GUEST TO LEAVE THIS WAY. TYPICALLY, THEY WILL MOVE ON AND EVENTUALLY RETURN TO THE CYCLE.
Beyond the Grave#167.dst: NUNCA SE HABÍAN DADO LAS CIRCUNSTANCIAS PARA QUE UN INVITADO SE FUERA ASÍ. LO NORMAL ES SEGUIR ADELANTE Y VOLVER AL CICLO.
Beyond the Grave#167.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#168.src: SO IN A WAY, THIS CANNOT BE CALLED A "GOODBYE." AH HA HA. NO, INSTEAD IT IS A "SEE YOU SOON."
Beyond the Grave#168.dst: ASÍ QUE, EN CIERTO MODO, ESTO NO ES UN "ADIÓS". JA JA JA. NO, ES UN "HASTA PRONTO".
Beyond the Grave#168.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#169.src: Defeat Krolton to earn your way back to the living.
Beyond the Grave#169.dst: Derrota a Krolton para ganarte el regreso al mundo de los vivos.

Beyond the Grave#170.src: ...ONE LAST THING. YOU HAVE NOT YET ENTIRELY REINTEGRATED INTO YOUR BODY.
Beyond the Grave#170.dst: ...UNA ÚLTIMA COSA. AÚN NO TE HAS REINTEGRADO DEL TODO EN TU CUERPO.
Beyond the Grave#170.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#171.src: AS SUCH, FOR THE TIME BEING, MORTALITY IS MERELY A SUGGESTION. SO BE AS RECKLESS AS YOU WANT.
Beyond the Grave#171.dst: POR ELLO, DE MOMENTO, LA MORTALIDAD ES UNA MERA SUGERENCIA. ASÍ QUE SÉ TODO LO TEMERARIO QUE QUIERAS.
Beyond the Grave#171.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#172.src: SO LONG AS THE HORROR DIES, NOT MATTER THE CAUSE, IT WILL BE ENOUGH FOR OUR NEEDS. REMEMBER THAT.
Beyond the Grave#172.dst: MIENTRAS EL HORROR MUERA, SEA CUAL SEA LA CAUSA, NOS BASTARÁ. RECUÉRDALO.
Beyond the Grave#172.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#173.src: AND THERE SHALL I DECLARE IT BE DONE. THE HORROR'S SPARK UNWOVEN.. AND YOU, BODY, SOUL, SPARK, KNITTED BACK TOGETHER. A NEW PATCH FOR THE TAPESTRY OF YOUR LIFE.
Beyond the Grave#173.dst: Y ENTONCES DECLARARÉ QUE ESTÁ HECHO. LA CHISPA DEL HORROR DESHILADA... Y TÚ, CUERPO, ALMA Y CHISPA, COSIDOS DE NUEVO. UN REMIENDO EN EL TAPIZ DE TU VIDA.
Beyond the Grave#173.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#174.src: IT WAS NICE TO SEE THIS PLACE IN PERSON AGAIN, EVEN IF I WAS ONLY VISITING FOR A MOMENT. BUT NOW I MUST RETURN TO MY OWN BUSINESS.
Beyond the Grave#174.dst: FUE AGRADABLE VOLVER A VER ESTE LUGAR EN PERSONA, AUNQUE SOLO FUERA UN INSTANTE. PERO AHORA DEBO VOLVER A MIS ASUNTOS.
Beyond the Grave#174.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#175.src: THIS MEANS FAREWELL, FOR THE TIME BEING. WHEN WE NEXT MEET, YOU WILL HAVE REACHED YOUR FINAL END.
Beyond the Grave#175.dst: ESTO ES UN ADIÓS, POR AHORA. LA PRÓXIMA VEZ QUE NOS VEAMOS, HABRÁS LLEGADO A TU FINAL DEFINITIVO.
Beyond the Grave#175.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#176.src: TIL THEN, TREASURE YOUR LIFE AS YOU LIVE IT TO THE FULLEST. I LOOK FORWARD TO SHARING STORIES OVER TEA, AH HA HA.
Beyond the Grave#176.dst: HASTA ENTONCES, ATESORA TU VIDA Y VÍVELA AL MÁXIMO. ME HACE ILUSIÓN COMPARTIR HISTORIAS ANTE UN TÉ. JA JA JA.
Beyond the Grave#176.speaker: Death

Beyond the Grave#177.src: Take proof of Krolton's demise to Irlok at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Beyond the Grave#177.dst: Lleva la prueba de la muerte de Krolton a Irlok, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Beyond the Grave#178.src: Oh, thank goodness. You've returned- not free of wear, but certainly alive. Did you need to flee from Krolton, or is he...?
Beyond the Grave#178.dst: Oh, gracias al cielo. Has vuelto; no sin desgaste, pero desde luego vivo. ¿Tuviste que huir de Krolton, o acaso él...?
Beyond the Grave#178.speaker: Irlok

Beyond the Grave#180.src: Gracious, I don't think I've ever been so relieved. Krolton was responsible for thousands of deaths long ago. You've prevented an oncoming massacre!
Beyond the Grave#180.dst: Cielos, creo que nunca había sentido tanto alivio. Krolton causó miles de muertes hace mucho tiempo. ¡Has evitado una masacre inminente!
Beyond the Grave#180.speaker: Irlok

Beyond the Grave#181.src: Bantisu Temple owes you a great deal. Here then- a suitable reward.
Beyond the Grave#181.dst: El Templo Bantisu te debe muchísimo. Toma, pues: una recompensa a la altura.
Beyond the Grave#181.speaker: Irlok

Beyond the Grave#182.src: A powerful Bantisu artifact, as a reward for defeating a beast that menaced in antiquated times.
Beyond the Grave#182.dst: Un poderoso artefacto Bantisu, como premio por derrotar a una bestia que asoló tiempos remotos.
Beyond the Grave#182.speaker: Irlok

Beyond the Grave#183.src: Safe travels, human. Whether it was luck or strength that had you prevail, I pray it will not fail you in the future.
Beyond the Grave#183.dst: Buen viaje, humano. Ya fuera suerte o fuerza lo que te hizo vencer, ruego que no te falle en el futuro.
Beyond the Grave#183.speaker: Irlok

Beyond the Grave#185.src: THIS BOOK IS SO BAD, EVEN THE LONG-WINDED AND PAINFUL DEATH OF SWEENEY S. GREENVILLE IS BETTER THAN THIS.
Beyond the Grave#185.dst: ESTE LIBRO ES TAN MALO QUE HASTA LA MUERTE LARGA Y DOLOROSA DE SWEENEY S. GREENVILLE ES MEJOR QUE ESTO.
Beyond the Grave#185.speaker: Death

Blazing Retribution#000.src: Speak to Piere in the {p} Plains at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Blazing Retribution#000.dst: Habla con Piere en las llanuras de {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Blazing Retribution#001.src: Oh sweet baby bovine, my house, what am I going to do? Wait, who are you?
Blazing Retribution#001.dst: Ay, por la sagrada vaquilla, mi casa, ¿qué voy a hacer? Espera, ¿quién eres?
Blazing Retribution#001.speaker: Piere

Blazing Retribution#002.src: Oh, a Human. Did the {p} authorities send you?
Blazing Retribution#002.dst: Oh, un humano. ¿Te envían las autoridades de {p}?
Blazing Retribution#002.speaker: Piere

Blazing Retribution#003.src: Detective Jackson has already been here. Not that he's doing anything useful.
Blazing Retribution#003.dst: El detective Jackson ya ha estado aquí. No es que esté haciendo nada útil.
Blazing Retribution#003.speaker: Piere

Blazing Retribution#004.src: An Orc managed to find some fire-imbued magical axe and burned down my house! Jackson didn't even call a firefighter!!
Blazing Retribution#004.dst: ¡Un orco consiguió un hacha mágica imbuida de fuego y quemó mi casa! ¡¡Jackson ni siquiera llamó a un bombero!!
Blazing Retribution#004.speaker: Piere

Blazing Retribution#005.src: I don't know what to do, but maybe if you find Detective Jackson, you can kick his sorry rear into gear...
Blazing Retribution#005.dst: No sé qué hacer, pero quizá si encuentras al detective Jackson puedas darle una patada para que espabile...
Blazing Retribution#005.speaker: Piere

Blazing Retribution#006.src: The Orcs are already savage brutes. If they really have their hands on magical weapons, we're all in trouble!
Blazing Retribution#006.dst: Los orcos ya son unos brutos salvajes. ¡Si de verdad tienen armas mágicas, estamos todos en peligro!
Blazing Retribution#006.speaker: Piere

Blazing Retribution#007.src: I believe Detective Jackson is by his cart "planning his next move." He's not far from here. Just continue past my farm!
Blazing Retribution#007.dst: Creo que el detective Jackson está junto a su carro "planeando su próximo paso". No está lejos de aquí. ¡Sigue más allá de mi granja!
Blazing Retribution#007.speaker: Piere

Blazing Retribution#008.src: Report the attack to Detective Jackson at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Blazing Retribution#008.dst: Informa del ataque al detective Jackson en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Blazing Retribution#009.src: How can I go about this...? I can't get involved myself, and they won't let me near... Wait, a human?
Blazing Retribution#009.dst: ¿Cómo lo hago...? Yo no puedo intervenir, y no me dejan acercarme... Espera, ¿un humano?
Blazing Retribution#009.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#010.src: ...what do you MEAN "what am I doing?" This is a delicate situation! I need to- wait...actually, you might just be the help I need.
Blazing Retribution#010.dst: ...¿cómo que QUÉ estoy haciendo? ¡Es una situación delicada! Necesito... espera... en realidad, puede que seas justo la ayuda que necesito.
Blazing Retribution#010.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#011.src: I'll give you the lowdown- we believe the orcs stole magical weaponry from within {p}, particularly a flaming axe.
Blazing Retribution#011.dst: Te pongo al día: creemos que los orcos robaron armas mágicas de dentro de {p}, en concreto un hacha llameante.
Blazing Retribution#011.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#012.src: However, that's a loophole in the ceasefire we had enacted with the Orcs. Theft isn't considered an act of aggression...
Blazing Retribution#012.dst: Pero eso es un vacío legal en el alto el fuego que pactamos con los orcos. El robo no cuenta como acto de agresión...
Blazing Retribution#012.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#013.src: And that means my hands are tied. Humans, however, were not mentioned in the notes, so you'll need to retrieve it.
Blazing Retribution#013.dst: Y eso me ata las manos. A los humanos, en cambio, no se los mencionaba, así que tendrás que recuperarla tú.
Blazing Retribution#013.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#014.src: Our only saving grace is that it'll be impossible for them to replicate its power- Orcs are hilariously inept at magic.
Blazing Retribution#014.dst: Lo único que nos salva es que les será imposible replicar su poder: los orcos son ridículamente ineptos con la magia.
Blazing Retribution#014.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#015.src: But, to the primary problem- You've probably seen how many orc camps are around here. Searching will take a long while...
Blazing Retribution#015.dst: Pero, al problema principal: habrás visto cuántos campamentos orcos hay por aquí. Buscar llevará muchísimo tiempo...
Blazing Retribution#015.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#016.src: My only leads are that the "Sablestone" and "Loamsprout" camps seem to be celebrating recently. Best to start there, yes?
Blazing Retribution#016.dst: Mis únicas pistas son que los campamentos Sablestone y Loamsprout parecen estar de celebración. Mejor empezar por ahí, ¿no?
Blazing Retribution#016.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#017.src: Just to review- You need to search those two camps for the Axe of {p}, and then return it to me if you find it.
Blazing Retribution#017.dst: Repasemos: tienes que buscar el hacha de {p} en esos dos campamentos y traérmela si la encuentras.
Blazing Retribution#017.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#018.src: Sablestone is to the north, and Loamsprout to the south. They will be guarded, so don't be afraid to knock some heads.
Blazing Retribution#018.dst: Sablestone está al norte y Loamsprout al sur. Estarán vigilados, así que no te cortes a la hora de repartir leña.
Blazing Retribution#018.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#019.src: Look for the stolen weapon at the Sablestone and Loamsprout Orc camps
Blazing Retribution#019.dst: Busca el arma robada en los campamentos orcos Sablestone y Loamsprout

Blazing Retribution#020.src: Return to Detective Jackson with the news
Blazing Retribution#020.dst: Vuelve con el detective Jackson con las noticias

Blazing Retribution#021.src: I see no axe in your hands, so I should assume neither Sablestone or Loamsprout had it.
Blazing Retribution#021.dst: No veo ningún hacha en tus manos, así que supongo que ni Sablestone ni Loamsprout la tenían.
Blazing Retribution#021.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#022.src: Wait, really? A stick was the most powerful weapon they had? And Loamsprout...threw their dinner at you...?
Blazing Retribution#022.dst: Espera, ¿en serio? ¿Un palo era el arma más potente que tenían? Y en Loamsprout... ¿te tiraron la cena...?
Blazing Retribution#022.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#023.src: I can't believe this! How are those...those THINGS outsmarting us?! Are they shuffling the axe between camps?
Blazing Retribution#023.dst: ¡No me lo puedo creer! ¿Cómo esas... esas COSAS son más listas que nosotros? ¿Se pasan el hacha entre campamentos?
Blazing Retribution#023.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#024.src: There are over a dozen camps between the Orcs and Goblins that they could be swapping it between!
Blazing Retribution#024.dst: ¡Hay más de una docena de campamentos entre orcos y goblins por los que podrían ir pasándola!
Blazing Retribution#024.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#025.src: What if the GOBLINS get a hold of it?! They're the cleverest by half of all of them, so that could actually be a threat!
Blazing Retribution#025.dst: ¿Y si la consiguen los GOBLINS? ¡Son los más listos con diferencia, así que eso sí sería una amenaza!
Blazing Retribution#025.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#026.src: Searching all the camps one by one will be far too slow, gah!! How am I going to fix this?!
Blazing Retribution#026.dst: Buscar campamento por campamento será demasiado lento, ¡¡agh!! ¿¡Cómo voy a arreglar esto!?
Blazing Retribution#026.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#027.src: There's Earthpit, and Cliffhearth, Shineridge and Stonecave, Sunspark, Mudspring, Holehold, I-
Blazing Retribution#027.dst: Están Earthpit, y Cliffhearth, Shineridge y Stonecave, Sunspark, Mudspring, Holehold, yo-
Blazing Retribution#027.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#028.src: Fire! Stop!! I hold magic cutter! LISTEN TO POXPER!!

Blazing Retribution#029.src: I- I can't believe it, that has to be the one! AFTER THAT ORC, NOW!!
Blazing Retribution#029.dst: N-no me lo puedo creer, ¡tiene que ser esa! ¡¡TRAS ESE ORCO, YA!!
Blazing Retribution#029.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#030.src: Find the hidden camp in the water near Piere's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Blazing Retribution#030.dst: Encuentra el campamento oculto en el agua cerca de la casa de Piere, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Blazing Retribution#033.src: Uthniiazek! Uthniiazek!! WHY NO LISTEN TO Poxper?
Blazing Retribution#033.speaker: Poxper

Blazing Retribution#034.src: Stupid Villager magic thing! Why fire no listen?
Blazing Retribution#034.dst: ¡Estúpida cosa mágica de aldeano! ¿Por qué fuego no escuchar?
Blazing Retribution#034.speaker: Poxper

Blazing Retribution#035.src: Poxper say thing and make fire...what else axe say? 'Azektoluth?'
Blazing Retribution#035.dst: Poxper decir cosa y hacer fuego... ¿qué más decir hacha? ¿'Azektoluth'?
Blazing Retribution#035.speaker: Poxper

Blazing Retribution#036.src: Hraahah! Poxper control fire! Fire- kill human with Poxper! Uthniiazek! Azektoluth!
Blazing Retribution#036.dst: ¡Hraahah! ¡Poxper controlar fuego! ¡Fuego, matar humano con Poxper! ¡Uthniiazek! ¡Azektoluth!
Blazing Retribution#036.speaker: Poxper

Blazing Retribution#037.src: Return the Magic Axe to the Detective
Blazing Retribution#037.dst: Devuelve el hacha mágica al detective

Blazing Retribution#038.src: That looks like the axe of {p} to me! Blue finish, hot to the touch- well done! What Orc boss had stolen it?
Blazing Retribution#038.dst: ¡A mí eso me parece el hacha de {p}! Acabado azul, caliente al tacto... ¡bien hecho! ¿Qué jefe orco la había robado?
Blazing Retribution#038.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#039.src: Poxper? That...hm. This could be bad. I've head that name, and he's a fairly prolific Orc chief. You killed him, right?
Blazing Retribution#039.dst: ¿Poxper? Eso... hm. Esto puede ser malo. He oído ese nombre; es un cacique orco bastante prolífico. Lo mataste, ¿verdad?
Blazing Retribution#039.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#040.src: Mmm... Hopefully that Veretel won't catch wind of it. Regardless, you've done a great service for Villager-kind!
Blazing Retribution#040.dst: Mmm... Ojalá ese Veretel no se entere. En cualquier caso, ¡has prestado un gran servicio a los aldeanos!
Blazing Retribution#040.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#041.src: Here's your compensation for that. Thank you for the aid!
Blazing Retribution#041.dst: Aquí tienes tu compensación. ¡Gracias por la ayuda!
Blazing Retribution#041.speaker: Detective Jackson

Bob's Lost Soul#000.src: Talk to Tarod in {p}'s Forest at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Bob's Lost Soul#000.dst: Habla con Tarod en el bosque de {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Bob's Lost Soul#001.src: You're one of those soldier types, right? My name is Tarod, and I could really use your assistance here.
Bob's Lost Soul#001.dst: Eres de los que van de soldado, ¿no? Me llamo Tarod y me vendría muy bien tu ayuda.
Bob's Lost Soul#001.speaker: Tarod

Bob's Lost Soul#002.src: Years ago, I met a very powerful and legendary warrior by the name of Bob. Yes, that Bob.
Bob's Lost Soul#002.dst: Hace años conocí a un guerrero legendario y muy poderoso llamado Bob. Sí, ese Bob.
Bob's Lost Soul#002.speaker: Tarod

Bob's Lost Soul#003.src: It's safe to say he was a very, well, admirable man. Him and I slowly became close friends over the years.
Bob's Lost Soul#003.dst: Era un hombre muy... bueno, admirable. Con los años nos hicimos muy amigos.
Bob's Lost Soul#003.speaker: Tarod

Bob's Lost Soul#004.src: That is, until one night, he vanished without a trace. The accepted story is that he was murdered by a pack of ravenous wolves...
Bob's Lost Soul#004.dst: Hasta que una noche desapareció sin dejar rastro. Dicen que lo mató una manada de lobos hambrientos...
Bob's Lost Soul#004.speaker: Tarod

Bob's Lost Soul#005.src: Now, I don't buy that story, but... look, the point here is that he's gone now, and I want to find out where the hell he ended up. That depressing zombie lumbering around {p} clearly isn't him.
Bob's Lost Soul#005.dst: Yo no me trago esa historia, pero... el caso es que ya no está y quiero saber dónde diablos acabó. Ese zombi deprimente que ronda por {p} no es él, desde luego.
Bob's Lost Soul#005.speaker: Tarod

Bob's Lost Soul#006.src: I believe he died in this area, and I have been looking for his body for quite a while now, with... less than success.
Bob's Lost Soul#006.dst: Creo que murió por aquí, y llevo bastante tiempo buscando su cuerpo, con... poco éxito.
Bob's Lost Soul#006.speaker: Tarod

Bob's Lost Soul#007.src: Rumors have spread that a tomb lies somewhere east of {p}, but I've never been able to find it. This is where I need you to help me out, yeah?
Bob's Lost Soul#007.dst: Se rumorea que hay una tumba al este de {p}, pero nunca he logrado encontrarla. Ahí es donde necesito tu ayuda, ¿vale?
Bob's Lost Soul#007.speaker: Tarod

Bob's Lost Soul#008.src: Do you think you could help me out here? Search around that area, and report back to me if you see anything noteworthy.
Bob's Lost Soul#008.dst: ¿Crees que podrías echarme una mano? Busca por esa zona y avísame si ves algo llamativo.
Bob's Lost Soul#008.speaker: Tarod

Bob's Lost Soul#009.src: I'd be eternally grateful if you could help me uncover my old friend's true story.
Bob's Lost Soul#009.dst: Te estaré eternamente agradecido si me ayudas a descubrir la verdad sobre mi viejo amigo.
Bob's Lost Soul#009.speaker: Tarod

Bob's Lost Soul#011.src: Report what you've found to Tarod at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Bob's Lost Soul#011.dst: Informa a Tarod de lo que has encontrado en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Bob's Lost Soul#012.src: Welcome back. Did you find anything worthwhile?
Bob's Lost Soul#012.dst: Bienvenido de vuelta. ¿Has encontrado algo útil?
Bob's Lost Soul#012.speaker: Tarod

Bob's Lost Soul#013.src: Oh? Yeah, that definitely sounds like the tomb! Were you able to see what's inside?
Bob's Lost Soul#013.dst: ¿Ah, sí? ¡Eso suena sin duda a la tumba! ¿Pudiste ver qué hay dentro?
Bob's Lost Soul#013.speaker: Tarod

Bob's Lost Soul#014.src: No? There's... a magical barrier? Great... just GREAT...
Bob's Lost Soul#014.speaker: Tarod

Bob's Lost Soul#015.src: I have a feeling whoever made that tomb didn't want anyone attempting to get to him, but... Forget it, we have no other options. This is the only way we can place Bob's soul to rest for good.
Bob's Lost Soul#015.dst: Algo me dice que quien hizo esa tumba no quería visitas, pero... da igual, no hay otra opción. Es el único modo de que el alma de Bob descanse de una vez.
Bob's Lost Soul#015.speaker: Tarod

Bob's Lost Soul#016.src: Listen, I have a guy who can help us out. His name is Wedyf, a sorcerer type. If anyone could get rid of that barrier, it would be him.
Bob's Lost Soul#016.dst: Escucha, conozco a alguien que puede ayudarnos. Se llama Wedyf, un hechicero. Si alguien puede quitar esa barrera, es él.
Bob's Lost Soul#016.speaker: Tarod

Bob's Lost Soul#017.src: He lives in {p}, a small town close to {p}. Go meet him, I'll wait for your return.
Bob's Lost Soul#017.dst: Vive en {p}, un pueblecito cerca de {p}. Ve a verlo, yo espero aquí.
Bob's Lost Soul#017.speaker: Tarod

Bob's Lost Soul#018.src: Talk to the sorcerer Wedyf in {p}.
Bob's Lost Soul#018.dst: Habla con el hechicero Wedyf en {p}.

Bob's Lost Soul#019.src: Welcome traveler. Are you looking for something?
Bob's Lost Soul#019.speaker: Wedyf

Bob's Lost Soul#020.src: Ooh, it has been a long time since I've released an undead...
Bob's Lost Soul#020.dst: Oh, hacía mucho que no liberaba a un no muerto...
Bob's Lost Soul#020.speaker: Wedyf

Bob's Lost Soul#021.src: The spirit of your dead friend must still be somewhere in this world. This is why we are unable to get close to his body. Soul magic works in mysterious ways.
Bob's Lost Soul#021.dst: El espíritu de tu amigo sigue en algún lugar de este mundo. Por eso no podemos acercarnos a su cuerpo. La magia de almas es caprichosa.
Bob's Lost Soul#021.speaker: Wedyf

Bob's Lost Soul#022.src: Don't worry, I can do it. I've heard a little bit of Bob's story before. What a tragedy. His own infallible protection used against him...
Bob's Lost Soul#022.dst: Tranquilo, puedo hacerlo. Algo sé de la historia de Bob. Qué tragedia. Su propia protección infalible usada contra él...
Bob's Lost Soul#022.speaker: Wedyf

Bob's Lost Soul#023.src: ...Anyways, there's no need to lament on the past. Now, we need two items. The first is something from Bob himself. The other is the last thing that made his blood drop.
Bob's Lost Soul#023.dst: ...En fin, no hay por qué lamentarse del pasado. Necesitamos dos cosas. La primera, algo del propio Bob. La otra, lo último que le hizo sangrar.
Bob's Lost Soul#023.speaker: Wedyf

Bob's Lost Soul#024.src: Out past the other side of {p} there are two farm houses with an old cave inbetween then. An old florist used to live there, she has a rose that Bob had once cut himself on.
Bob's Lost Soul#024.dst: Al otro lado de {p} hay dos granjas con una cueva vieja entre ellas. Allí vivía una florista que tiene una rosa con la que Bob se cortó una vez.
Bob's Lost Soul#024.speaker: Wedyf

Bob's Lost Soul#025.src: I will warn you, though; she was corrupted some time ago. It may not be that easy to take the rose, so do be prepared.
Bob's Lost Soul#025.dst: Te aviso, eso sí: ella fue corrompida hace tiempo. Puede que no sea fácil quitarle la rosa, así que ven preparado.
Bob's Lost Soul#025.speaker: Wedyf

Bob's Lost Soul#026.src: Secondly... something of Bob's. I've heard rumors of a visage of him wandering around {p}, perhaps you can find something of use from it? Killing enemies in the {p} region may be worth your time, as well.
Bob's Lost Soul#026.dst: Y lo segundo... algo de Bob. He oído rumores de una imagen suya vagando por {p}; quizá saques algo útil de ella. Matar enemigos por la región de {p} también puede valer la pena.
Bob's Lost Soul#026.speaker: Wedyf

Bob's Lost Soul#027.src: Bring me [{~} Rose] and [{~} Bob's Tear].
Bob's Lost Soul#027.speaker: Wedyf

Bob's Lost Soul#028.src: Bring [{~} Bob's Tear] from {p} and [{~} Rose] from the house in the {p} forest around [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to Wedyf
Bob's Lost Soul#028.dst: Lleva a Wedyf [{~} Bob's Tear] de {p} y [{~} Rose] de la casa del bosque de {p}, cerca de [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Bob's Lost Soul#030.src: Although... I might have forgot to tell you about something else too...
Bob's Lost Soul#030.dst: Aunque... puede que olvidara contarte otra cosita...
Bob's Lost Soul#030.speaker: Wedyf

Bob's Lost Soul#031.src: We also need a part of the soul of your dead friend.
Bob's Lost Soul#031.dst: También necesitamos una parte del alma de tu amigo muerto.
Bob's Lost Soul#031.speaker: Wedyf

Bob's Lost Soul#032.src: This is something I unfortunately cannot do myself. There is a blacksmith close to {p} who does this kind of stuff.
Bob's Lost Soul#032.dst: Eso, por desgracia, no puedo hacerlo yo. Cerca de {p} hay un herrero que se dedica a esto.
Bob's Lost Soul#032.speaker: Wedyf

Bob's Lost Soul#033.src: He can extract the soul from someone's weapon. Very useful in those situations. Go talk to him.
Bob's Lost Soul#033.dst: Sabe extraer el alma del arma de alguien. Muy útil en estos casos. Ve a hablar con él.
Bob's Lost Soul#033.speaker: Wedyf

Bob's Lost Soul#034.src: Bring me the soul, and I'll be able to remove the spell preventing you from entering the tomb.
Bob's Lost Soul#034.dst: Tráeme el alma y podré retirar el hechizo que te impide entrar en la tumba.
Bob's Lost Soul#034.speaker: Wedyf

Bob's Lost Soul#035.src: Talk to the blacksmith in the small settlement southwest of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] about Bob's lost soul
Bob's Lost Soul#035.dst: Habla con el herrero del pequeño asentamiento al suroeste de {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}], sobre el alma perdida de Bob

Bob's Lost Soul#036.src: What can I do for ya?
Bob's Lost Soul#036.speaker: The Blacksmith

Bob's Lost Soul#037.src: Oh yes! I can extract the soul from weapons!
Bob's Lost Soul#037.dst: ¡Ah, sí! ¡Sé extraer el alma de las armas!
Bob's Lost Soul#037.speaker: The Blacksmith

Bob's Lost Soul#038.src: Bring me the weapons of your friend, and I'll see if I can do something with it!
Bob's Lost Soul#038.dst: ¡Tráeme las armas de tu amigo y veré qué puedo hacer con ellas!
Bob's Lost Soul#038.speaker: The Blacksmith

Bob's Lost Soul#039.src: Oh it's... those weapons. Well, if you know what you're doing...
Bob's Lost Soul#039.dst: Ah, son... esas armas. Bueno, si sabes lo que haces...
Bob's Lost Soul#039.speaker: The Blacksmith

Bob's Lost Soul#040.src: [{~} Depressing Stick], [{~} Depressing Spear], [{~} Depressing Bow] and [{~} Depressing Shears] will do the trick.
Bob's Lost Soul#040.dst: Con [{~} Depressing Stick], [{~} Depressing Spear], [{~} Depressing Bow] y [{~} Depressing Shears] bastará.
Bob's Lost Soul#040.speaker: The Blacksmith

Bob's Lost Soul#041.src: Be careful with the weapons, you will only get [ONE] of each. If you lose one, you will have to ask around if anyone has a spare.
Bob's Lost Soul#041.dst: Cuidado con las armas: solo conseguirás [ONE] de cada. Si pierdes una, tendrás que preguntar por ahí si alguien tiene otra.
Bob's Lost Soul#041.speaker: The Blacksmith

Bob's Lost Soul#042.src: Maybe someone will be selling one on the Trade Market in {p}, who knows.
Bob's Lost Soul#042.dst: Igual alguien vende una en el Mercado de {p}, quién sabe.
Bob's Lost Soul#042.speaker: The Blacksmith

Bob's Lost Soul#043.src: My apprentice over there has traveled around a lot, they might know where the items are, but I warn you, they are a little bit quirky.
Bob's Lost Soul#043.dst: Mi aprendiz de ahí ha viajado mucho, quizá sepa dónde están, pero te aviso: es un poco peculiar.
Bob's Lost Soul#043.speaker: The Blacksmith

Bob's Lost Soul#044.src: Weapons of the depressed kind? Oh, of course, of course, I know of the set! Around {p}, I hear they are kept.
Bob's Lost Soul#044.dst: ¿Armas deprimentes? ¡Claro, claro, ese juego lo sé nombrar! Por {p}, dicen, se suelen guardar.
Bob's Lost Soul#044.speaker: Apprentice

Bob's Lost Soul#045.src: An army of Linx you must clear, in a cave you shall find this spear!
Bob's Lost Soul#045.dst: ¡Al ejército de Linx has de barrer, y esa lanza podrás tener!
Bob's Lost Soul#045.speaker: Apprentice

Bob's Lost Soul#046.src: To a skilled archer you must go, best her in a lumberyard and you will have her bow!
Bob's Lost Soul#046.dst: ¡A una arquera diestra debes buscar; véncela en el aserradero y su arco podrás portar!
Bob's Lost Soul#046.speaker: Apprentice

Bob's Lost Soul#047.src: On an altar, effervescence leers, complete the sacrifice and you will gain your shears...
Bob's Lost Soul#047.dst: En un altar la efervescencia acecha; culmina el sacrificio y las tijeras serán tu cosecha...
Bob's Lost Soul#047.speaker: Apprentice

Bob's Lost Soul#048.src: In the forest, a house frozen in spikes thick, outsmart the contraption and be gifted a stick!
Bob's Lost Soul#048.dst: En el bosque, una casa de gruesas púas cubierta; burla el artilugio y el palo será tu oferta.
Bob's Lost Soul#048.speaker: Apprentice

Bob's Lost Soul#049.src: But beware, beware! Danger lies ahead, and will try to halt you in your stead!
Bob's Lost Soul#049.dst: ¡Cuidado, cuidado! El peligro acecha y tu marcha querrá frenar.
Bob's Lost Soul#049.speaker: Apprentice

Bob's Lost Soul#050.src: Bring [{~} Depressing Stick], [{~} Depressing Spear], [{~} Depressing Bow] and [{~} Depressing Shear] to the Blacksmith.
Bob's Lost Soul#050.dst: Lleva [{~} Depressing Stick], [{~} Depressing Spear], [{~} Depressing Bow] y [{~} Depressing Shear] al herrero.

Bob's Lost Soul#052.src: I've just been hangin' down here working on my teleportation device. The teleporters got partially frozen over, but I'm pretty damn sure they still work.
Bob's Lost Soul#052.dst: Aquí ando, trasteando con mi aparato de teletransporte. Los teletransportadores se han congelado en parte, pero seguro que aún funcionan.
Bob's Lost Soul#052.speaker: Markque The Wizard

Bob's Lost Soul#053.src: Hey, if you want to test it out, be my guest! You can use the teleporter core next to me to start it.
Bob's Lost Soul#053.dst: ¡Oye, si quieres probarlo, adelante! Puedes usar el núcleo teletransportador de al lado para arrancarlo.
Bob's Lost Soul#053.speaker: Markque The Wizard

Bob's Lost Soul#054.src: Right click with it while on the center of the iced over teleporter chamber, and it will teleport you in a direction over to the next chamber.
Bob's Lost Soul#054.dst: Haz clic derecho con él en el centro de la sala helada y te llevará en una dirección hasta la sala siguiente.
Bob's Lost Soul#054.speaker: Markque The Wizard

Bob's Lost Soul#055.src: It will then teleport you again in a direction {~} degrees clockwise, and it will keep doin' that forever.
Bob's Lost Soul#055.dst: Luego te llevará otra vez en una dirección {~} grados en sentido horario, y así sin parar.
Bob's Lost Soul#055.speaker: Markque The Wizard

Bob's Lost Soul#056.src: Some of the ice walls have holes in them, and I believe if you use the teleporter core correctly you will be able to make it to the other side where the gold platform is.
Bob's Lost Soul#056.dst: Algunos muros de hielo tienen agujeros y creo que, si usas bien el núcleo, podrás llegar al otro lado, donde está la plataforma dorada.
Bob's Lost Soul#056.speaker: Markque The Wizard

Bob's Lost Soul#057.src: The core is unstable, though, and it will break if you run too far away. Keep that in mind, yeah?
Bob's Lost Soul#057.dst: Eso sí, el núcleo es inestable y se rompe si te alejas demasiado. No lo olvides, ¿vale?
Bob's Lost Soul#057.speaker: Markque The Wizard

Bob's Lost Soul#058.src: Oh, and I left an old wand of mine down at the gold platform. The thing was very depressing, though, so it ain't too much of an issue. But hey, if you can get to it, it's all yours, bud, free of cost!
Bob's Lost Soul#058.dst: Ah, y dejé una vieja varita mía en la plataforma dorada. Era deprimente de narices, así que tampoco es gran cosa. Pero oye, si llegas, ¡es tuya, tío, gratis!
Bob's Lost Soul#058.speaker: Markque The Wizard

Bob's Lost Soul#059.src: ... Hi again. I see you got the weapons.
Bob's Lost Soul#059.dst: ... Hola otra vez. Ya tienes las armas.
Bob's Lost Soul#059.speaker: The Blacksmith

Bob's Lost Soul#060.src: These weapons emanate so much sadness... I'm sure you heard about Bob's story...
Bob's Lost Soul#060.dst: Estas armas rezuman tristeza... Seguro que conoces la historia de Bob...
Bob's Lost Soul#060.speaker: The Blacksmith

Bob's Lost Soul#061.src: Here is the soul. It's a little bit crushed, but it can do the trick.
Bob's Lost Soul#061.dst: Aquí tienes el alma. Está algo machacada, pero servirá.
Bob's Lost Soul#061.speaker: The Blacksmith

Bob's Lost Soul#062.src: Good luck on your quest. Bob was a great hero, anything to help him is good in my book.
Bob's Lost Soul#062.dst: Suerte con tu misión. Bob fue un gran héroe; todo lo que le ayude me parece bien.
Bob's Lost Soul#062.speaker: The Blacksmith

Bob's Lost Soul#063.src: Bring back [{~} Bob's Crushed Soul] to Wedyf.
Bob's Lost Soul#063.dst: Lleva [{~} Bob's Crushed Soul] de vuelta a Wedyf.

Bob's Lost Soul#064.src: I'm glad to see you again.
Bob's Lost Soul#064.dst: Me alegro de volver a verte.
Bob's Lost Soul#064.speaker: Wedyf

Bob's Lost Soul#065.src: I only need a part of the soul, you can keep the rest.
Bob's Lost Soul#065.dst: Solo necesito una parte del alma; el resto puedes quedártelo.
Bob's Lost Soul#065.speaker: Wedyf

Bob's Lost Soul#066.src: Give me a minute, I need to concentrate...
Bob's Lost Soul#066.speaker: Wedyf

Bob's Lost Soul#069.src: It is done. You should be able to enter the tomb now. Be careful.
Bob's Lost Soul#069.dst: Está hecho. Ya deberías poder entrar en la tumba. Ten cuidado.
Bob's Lost Soul#069.speaker: Wedyf

Bob's Lost Soul#070.src: Find Bob's corpse in his tomb.
Bob's Lost Soul#070.dst: Encuentra el cuerpo de Bob en su tumba.

Bob's Lost Soul#071.src: Report back what you've seen to Tarod
Bob's Lost Soul#071.dst: Vuelve a informar a Tarod de lo que has visto

Bob's Lost Soul#072.src: You're back... Has he... has he finally been put to rest?
Bob's Lost Soul#072.dst: Has vuelto... ¿Ha... ha descansado por fin?
Bob's Lost Soul#072.speaker: Tarod

Bob's Lost Soul#073.src: It's... hard to hear, knowing that my old friend is really gone, this time, but... I'm happy he won't have to suffer on this war-torn world for another second.
Bob's Lost Soul#073.dst: Es... duro saber que mi viejo amigo se ha ido de verdad esta vez, pero... me alegra que no sufra ni un segundo más en este mundo roto por la guerra.
Bob's Lost Soul#073.speaker: Tarod

Bob's Lost Soul#074.src: ...I want you to have something. This is his old battle chesplate; he gave it to me a few days before he vanished. I think if he were still here, he'd want you to have this. Please, take good care of it for me...
Bob's Lost Soul#074.dst: ...Quiero darte algo. Es su vieja coraza de batalla; me la dio unos días antes de desaparecer. Creo que, si siguiera aquí, querría que fuese tuya. Por favor, cuídala bien por mí...
Bob's Lost Soul#074.speaker: Tarod

Brothers Return#000.src: Hey! Don't put that down there—

Brothers Return#001.src: If you could go to {p} and see if Drucksh has the will, I would be forever in your debt, pal.

Brothers Return#003.src: There must be something around here that could make him talk...

Brothers Return#004.src: You may have forgotten already, but I unfortunately must inform you that your brother is indeed dead.

Brothers Return#005.src: As I already told you, your brother is dead and buried. It's not like—

Brothers Return#006.src: They've what!? Holy Bovine! It's even worse than I feared!

Brothers Return#009.src: You find the will tucked into an inner pocket of Sayleros' brother's crumbling tunic.

Brothers Return#011.src: The exit seems to be opening...

Brothers Return#013.src: Please, take these as proof of my gratitude, pal. You really helped us out, in more ways than one.

Brothers Return#014.src: The obelisk does not react to your touch. [Req: {p} Trouble]

Brothers Return#016.src: Hey! Don't put that down there
Brothers Return#016.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#017.src: Oh, hello there, adventurer! I was just looking for someone like you! My name is Sayleros. I lived in {p} my whole life, but recently decided to move to {p}.
Brothers Return#017.dst: ¡Ah, hola, aventurero! ¡Justo buscaba a alguien como tú! Me llamo Sayleros. He vivido toda mi vida en {p}, pero hace poco decidí mudarme a {p}.
Brothers Return#017.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#018.src: You see, my older brother just passed. I would have taken care of it, if only I weren't so busy with the move!
Brothers Return#018.dst: Verás, mi hermano mayor acaba de morir. Yo me habría encargado de todo, ¡si no anduviera tan liado con la mudanza!
Brothers Return#018.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#019.src: I had to leave it all to my younger brother, Drucksh. He's still in {p}, but well, he's not the most reliable...
Brothers Return#019.dst: Tuve que dejárselo todo a mi hermano pequeño, Drucksh. Sigue en {p}, pero bueno, no es que sea muy de fiar...
Brothers Return#019.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#020.src: My older brother had amassed quite some wealth before he passed. He should have left us part of it in his will, only I don't exactly trust Drucksh to handle it...
Brothers Return#020.dst: Mi hermano mayor reunió bastante fortuna antes de morir. Debía dejarnos parte en su testamento, pero no me fío de que Drucksh lo gestione...
Brothers Return#020.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#021.src: If you could go to {p} and see if Drucksh has the will, I would forever be in your debt, pal.
Brothers Return#021.dst: Si pudieras ir a {p} y ver si Drucksh tiene el testamento, te lo debería de por vida, colega.
Brothers Return#021.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#022.src: Drucksh shouldn't be hard to find, he usually spends his time in the bar in {p}. Just follow this road out of {p} to get there.
Brothers Return#022.dst: Drucksh no será difícil de encontrar, suele pasar el rato en el bar de {p}. Sigue este camino para salir de {p} y llegarás.
Brothers Return#022.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#023.src: Find Drucksh at the bar in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Brothers Return#023.dst: Encuentra a Drucksh en el bar de {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Brothers Return#024.src: Thanks again for doing this, pal. Just follow this road out of {p} to get to {p}, Drucksh's usually at the bar there.
Brothers Return#024.dst: Gracias otra vez por esto, colega. Sigue este camino para salir de {p} y llegar a {p}; Drucksh suele estar en el bar de allí.
Brothers Return#024.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#027.src: Aauuughh... s-something... mmmmgh... to... drink... aaaughh...
Brothers Return#027.dst: Aauuughh... a-algo... mmmmgh... de... beber... aaaughh...
Brothers Return#027.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#028.src: Find a way to make Drucksh tell you about the will.
Brothers Return#028.dst: Encuentra la manera de que Drucksh te hable del testamento.

Brothers Return#029.src: Aauuughh... s-something... mmmmgh... to... drink... aaaughh...
Brothers Return#029.dst: Aauuughh... a-algo... mmmmgh... de... beber... aaaughh...
Brothers Return#029.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#031.src: Anythin' is possible. If ya have [{~} Emeralds] to spare, that is.
Brothers Return#031.dst: Todo es posible. Si te sobran [{~} esmeraldas], claro.
Brothers Return#031.speaker: Barkeep

Brothers Return#032.src: One {p} Whiskey, shipwrecked against the rocks, comin' right up.
Brothers Return#032.dst: Un whisky de {p}, estrellado contra las rocas, marchando.
Brothers Return#032.speaker: Barkeep

Brothers Return#033.src: Hey, Drucksh. Hey, can you hear me? Hey!
Brothers Return#033.speaker: Barkeep

Brothers Return#035.src: This nice fella got ya a drink. A {p} Whiskey, yer favourite.
Brothers Return#035.dst: Este buen hombre te ha invitado a una copa. Un whisky de {p}, tu favorito.
Brothers Return#035.speaker: Barkeep

Brothers Return#037.src: Hey! They paid for yer drink, ya know. Ya could at least try to be courteous.
Brothers Return#037.dst: ¡Eh! Te han pagado la copa, que lo sepas. Podrías ser un poco más cortés.
Brothers Return#037.speaker: Barkeep

Brothers Return#038.src: Oh, s-shut up. I c-can pay for my own drinks!
Brothers Return#038.dst: Ay, c-cállate. ¡Yo me p-puedo pagar mis copas!
Brothers Return#038.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#039.src: Well, call me if ya need anythin' else.
Brothers Return#039.dst: Bueno, llámame si necesitas algo más.
Brothers Return#039.speaker: Barkeep

Brothers Return#044.src: Yeah, there ain't no will, pal. After brother died, those Bovemists came and picked 'im up.
Brothers Return#044.dst: Ya, no hay ningún testamento, colega. Cuando mi hermano murió, vinieron esos Bovemist y se lo llevaron.
Brothers Return#044.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#045.src: Gave 'im a proper funeral and everything. Shame my dear, oh so dear brother couldn't attend. What kind of person can't be there for their own brother's funeral, y'know?
Brothers Return#045.dst: Le hicieron un funeral en condiciones y todo. Lástima que mi querido, ay, queridísimo hermano no pudiera asistir. ¿Qué clase de persona falta al funeral de su propio hermano?
Brothers Return#045.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#046.src: Well, I couldn't be there either, bein' here and all, but that's besides the point...
Brothers Return#046.dst: Bueno, yo tampoco pude ir, estando aquí y tal, pero eso es otra cosa...
Brothers Return#046.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#047.src: Anyway, the Bishop gave me a bit of money for my troubles and sent me on my merry way. Then, I ended up here, and haven't left since!
Brothers Return#047.dst: En fin, el obispo me dio algo de dinero por las molestias y me mandó a paseo. Acabé aquí y no me he movido desde entonces.
Brothers Return#047.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#048.src: So, as I already told you... There ain't no will, pal! Forget it.
Brothers Return#048.dst: Así que, como ya te he dicho... ¡No hay testamento, colega! Olvídalo.
Brothers Return#048.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#049.src: W-what? Sayleros told you about a will, a-and about money too, t-that brother left us?
Brothers Return#049.dst: ¿Q-qué? ¿Sayleros te habló de un testamento, y-y también de dinero que nos dejó mi hermano?
Brothers Return#049.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#050.src: So then why did the Bishop...
Brothers Return#050.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#052.src: S-stop! Hold your horses... That would mean...
Brothers Return#052.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#053.src: Hey, soldier! We're leaving, right now! W-we're gonna find that will!
Brothers Return#053.dst: ¡Eh, soldado! ¡Nos vamos, ahora mismo! ¡V-vamos a encontrar ese testamento!
Brothers Return#053.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#054.src: Speak to the Bishop Kaideus in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Brothers Return#054.dst: Habla con el obispo Kaideus en {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Brothers Return#055.src: Yes, yes. A little more to the right! Hurry!
Brothers Return#055.dst: Sí, sí. ¡Un poco más a la derecha! ¡Deprisa!
Brothers Return#055.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#056.src: Hey! Priest man, guy, whatever! Where's my brother!
Brothers Return#056.dst: ¡Eh! ¡Cura, tío, lo que seas! ¿¡Dónde está mi hermano!?
Brothers Return#056.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#057.src: Oh, it's you. For your information, the proper term of address is your excellency.
Brothers Return#057.dst: Ah, eres tú. Para tu información, el tratamiento correcto es su excelencia.
Brothers Return#057.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#058.src: You may have forgotten already, but I must inform you that your brother is indeed dead.
Brothers Return#058.dst: Puede que ya lo hayas olvidado, pero debo informarte de que tu hermano está, en efecto, muerto.
Brothers Return#058.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#059.src: Y-yes, I know all that, y-your priestliness. But where's my brother? I want to see 'im.
Brothers Return#059.dst: S-sí, todo eso ya lo sé, su reverendísima. ¿Pero dónde está mi hermano? Quiero verlo.
Brothers Return#059.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#060.src: You! Talk some sense into your, um, friend here. We buried his brother in the crypt here some time ago.
Brothers Return#060.dst: ¡Tú! Haz entrar en razón a tu, ejem, amigo. Enterramos a su hermano en la cripta hace ya tiempo.
Brothers Return#060.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#061.src: Now, please leave this peaceful house of worship, you're causing a ruckus. I have some quite important business to attend to, you see.
Brothers Return#061.dst: Ahora, haced el favor de salir de esta pacífica casa de oración, estáis armando alboroto. Tengo asuntos muy importantes que atender.
Brothers Return#061.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#062.src: Hey! I'm not leaving without my brother! No way, pal!
Brothers Return#062.dst: ¡Eh! ¡No me voy sin mi hermano! ¡Ni hablar, colega!
Brothers Return#062.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#063.src: As I already told you, your brother is dead and buried. It's not like
Brothers Return#063.dst: Como ya te he dicho, tu hermano está muerto y enterrado. No es que
Brothers Return#063.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#065.src: Holy Bovine! It's even worse than I feared!
Brothers Return#065.dst: ¡Santa Vaca! ¡Es aún peor de lo que temía!
Brothers Return#065.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#066.src: You, soldier! You better not stick your nose in this! It's not for the likes of you to mess with the affairs of the church!
Brothers Return#066.dst: ¡Tú, soldado! ¡Más te vale no meter las narices en esto! ¡Los de tu clase no tenéis nada que hacer en los asuntos de la iglesia!
Brothers Return#066.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#067.src: Now's our chance, pal! Go find my brother in the crypts! I-I'll stay behind, guarding the rear!
Brothers Return#067.dst: ¡Es nuestra oportunidad, colega! ¡Ve a buscar a mi hermano a las criptas! ¡Y-yo me quedo aquí, cubriendo la retaguardia!
Brothers Return#067.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#068.src: Enter the crypt at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find Sayleros' Brother.
Brothers Return#068.dst: Entra en la cripta en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] y encuentra al hermano de Sayleros.

Brothers Return#069.src: Now's our chance, pal! Go find my brother in the crypts! I-I'll stay behind, guarding the rear!
Brothers Return#069.dst: ¡Es nuestra oportunidad, colega! ¡Ve a buscar a mi hermano a las criptas! ¡Y-yo me quedo aquí, cubriendo la retaguardia!
Brothers Return#069.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#070.src: You better not stick your nose in this, soldier! It's not for the likes of you to mess with the affairs of the church!
Brothers Return#070.dst: ¡No metas las narices en esto, soldado! ¡Los asuntos de la iglesia no son para los de tu clase!
Brothers Return#070.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#071.src: Don't ask me about anything! I just work here!
Brothers Return#071.dst: ¡A mí no me preguntes nada! ¡Yo solo trabajo aquí!
Brothers Return#071.speaker: Worker

Brothers Return#073.dst: Encuentra la primera llave de la cripta.

Brothers Return#074.src: Open the door at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] using the Crypt Basement Key.
Brothers Return#074.dst: Abre la puerta en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] con la Crypt Basement Key.

Brothers Return#075.dst: Encuentra la segunda llave de la cripta.

Brothers Return#076.src: Open the door at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] using the Sealed Crypt Key.
Brothers Return#076.dst: Abre la puerta en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] con la Sealed Crypt Key.

Brothers Return#077.dst: Entra en la cripta sellada en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Brothers Return#079.dst: Sal de la cripta sellada en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Brothers Return#080.src: Bring back Sayleros' brother's will to [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Brothers Return#080.dst: Lleva el testamento del hermano de Sayleros a [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Brothers Return#081.src: As I've already told you a thousand times, I don't know what will you're talking about! Besides, I don't have the time for this!
Brothers Return#081.dst: ¡Como ya te he dicho mil veces, no sé de qué testamento hablas! ¡Además, no tengo tiempo para esto!
Brothers Return#081.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#083.src: I certainly hope you didn't use the usual methods of your sort...
Brothers Return#083.dst: Espero de veras que no hayas usado los métodos habituales de los tuyos...
Brothers Return#083.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#084.src: ... B-brother! What are y-you doing here?
Brothers Return#084.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#085.src: Drucksh! Likewise, what are you doing here?
Brothers Return#085.dst: ¡Drucksh! Lo mismo digo, ¿qué haces tú aquí?
Brothers Return#085.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#086.src: W-well... I-I thought I'd take responsibility for our family for once...
Brothers Return#086.dst: P-pues... S-se me ocurrió dar la cara por la familia por una vez...
Brothers Return#086.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#087.src: I thought I wouldn't live to see the day! Here I was, worried Drucksh wouldn't cooperate, but it seems like the two of you've got it all under control after all.
Brothers Return#087.dst: ¡Creí que no viviría para verlo! Y yo preocupado por si Drucksh no colaboraba, y resulta que lo teníais todo controlado.
Brothers Return#087.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#088.src: Under control!? This... This... renegade stormed into the crypts and k-k-killed your brother!
Brothers Return#088.dst: ¿¡Controlado!? Este... Este... ¡este renegado irrumpió en las criptas y m-m-mató a tu hermano!
Brothers Return#088.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#089.src: He's our brother, your priestliness! Let us w-worry about 'im and you can worry about your great cow in the sky, or whatever it is.
Brothers Return#089.dst: ¡Es NUESTRO hermano, su reverendísima! De él nos p-preocupamos nosotros, y tú preocúpate de tu vaca celestial o lo que sea.
Brothers Return#089.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#090.src: That's right, your priestliness! Here, I'll take the will.
Brothers Return#090.dst: ¡Eso es, su reverendísima! Venga, yo me quedo el testamento.
Brothers Return#090.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#091.src: Hey, brother, why don't we head to the ol' watering hole. For old brother's sake.
Brothers Return#091.dst: Oye, hermano, ¿nos pasamos por el garito de siempre? Por él.
Brothers Return#091.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#092.src: Well, i-if it's for his sake, then I c-can hardly refuse, can I?
Brothers Return#092.dst: B-bueno, s-si es por él, no me puedo negar, ¿verdad?
Brothers Return#092.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#093.src: Please, take this as proof of my gratitude, pal. You really helped us out, in more ways than one.
Brothers Return#093.dst: Toma esto como prueba de mi gratitud, colega. Nos has ayudado muchísimo, y de más de una forma.
Brothers Return#093.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#094.src: Hey soldier! That's quite the gear you're lugging around. Anything I can do for you?
Brothers Return#094.dst: ¡Eh, soldado! Menudo equipo llevas encima. ¿Puedo hacer algo por ti?
Brothers Return#094.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#095.src: Oh, really? I don't think I've seen you before, but I'm not so good with faces, especially armoured ones! I'm new to Wynn, just came through on the caravan. The name's Alfe, and yours?
Brothers Return#095.dst: ¿Ah, sí? No creo haberte visto antes, ¡aunque no se me dan bien las caras, menos aún las acorazadas! Soy nueva en Wynn, acabo de llegar en la caravana. Me llamo Alfe, ¿y tú?
Brothers Return#095.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#096.src: {u}, huh? I think I've heard of you somewhere... Laen was regaling stories at the {p} bar, you helped them find some old book, yeah? And I think the Bishop mentioned...
Brothers Return#096.dst: {u}, ¿eh? Creo que te he oído nombrar... Laen contaba historias en el bar de {p}: les ayudaste a encontrar un libro viejo, ¿no? Y creo que el obispo mencionó...
Brothers Return#096.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#097.src: You! Back again to cause more mayhem, are we?
Brothers Return#097.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#098.src: No need to be so hostile, your excellency! We were just discussing our time here in Wynn. {u} here even helped Laen find an old book of theirs, did you know that?
Brothers Return#098.dst: ¡No hace falta tanta hostilidad, su excelencia! Solo hablábamos de nuestro tiempo aquí en Wynn. {u} incluso ayudó a Laen a encontrar un libro viejo suyo, ¿lo sabía?
Brothers Return#098.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#099.src: Hm... Well, you certainly are not, my young apprentice. That much is true...
Brothers Return#099.dst: Hm... Bueno, tú desde luego no lo eres, mi joven aprendiz. Eso es cierto...
Brothers Return#099.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#100.src: Right, {u}! We could really use your help here, isn't that right Kaideus?
Brothers Return#100.dst: ¡Eso, {u}! Nos vendría muy bien tu ayuda aquí, ¿verdad, Kaideus?
Brothers Return#100.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#101.src: Another pair of hands on the task wouldn't hurt, you are right about that...
Brothers Return#101.dst: Un par de manos más no vendría mal, en eso tienes razón...
Brothers Return#101.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#102.src: Fine! You may inspect the texts, but only if you are very, very careful.
Brothers Return#102.dst: ¡Está bien! Puedes examinar los textos, pero solo si eres muy, muy cuidadoso.
Brothers Return#102.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#103.src: Well, you see {u}! I've been in {p} for the past little while helping to protect the city. But after Kaideus here stumbled across a shelf of old records I came here to help sort and clean them.
Brothers Return#103.dst: ¡Verás, {u}! He pasado una temporada en {p} ayudando a proteger la ciudad. Pero cuando Kaideus encontró por casualidad un estante de registros antiguos, vine a ayudar a ordenarlos y limpiarlos.
Brothers Return#103.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#104.src: They're positively ancient! It's all nonsense to me, but Laen says they must be over a thousand years old!
Brothers Return#104.dst: ¡Son antiquísimos! Para mí no son más que garabatos, ¡pero Laen dice que tienen más de mil años!
Brothers Return#104.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#105.src: You recruits are much to excitable, but she is right. Having dedicated my life to this cathedral, I have not been afforded the opportunity to see much of the world beyond these plains.
Brothers Return#105.dst: Los reclutas sois demasiado entusiastas, pero ella tiene razón. Habiendo dedicado mi vida a esta catedral, no he tenido ocasión de ver mucho mundo más allá de estas llanuras.
Brothers Return#105.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#106.src: So, {u}, why don't you take a look? You've traveled quite a bit, perhaps even to the lands described within. I may not like your methods, but perhaps, just this once, they may prove useful.
Brothers Return#106.dst: Así que, {u}, ¿por qué no les echas un vistazo? Has viajado bastante, quizá incluso a las tierras que ahí se describen. No me gustan tus métodos, pero tal vez, por esta vez, resulten útiles.
Brothers Return#106.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#107.src: Well then, what would you like to read?
Brothers Return#107.speaker: Alfe

Burning Bonds#000.src: There's only a razor-sharp rock here. Nothing particularly useful... yet.
Burning Bonds#000.dst: Aquí solo hay una roca afiladísima. Nada especialmente útil... por ahora.

Burning Bonds#001.src: Great work! Looks like you won't turn out like those rich old {p} folk after all!
Burning Bonds#001.dst: ¡Buen trabajo! ¡Parece que al final no acabarás como esos viejos ricachones de {p}!

Burning Bonds#002.src: Okay! That's step one complete. Now, the most important thing for any horse trainer - Feeding them of course.
Burning Bonds#002.dst: ¡Bien! Primer paso completado. Ahora, lo más importante para un domador de caballos: alimentarlos, claro.

Burning Bonds#003.src: Well! Enough of that. Come with me!

Burning Bonds#004.src: They will keep improving and getting stronger as you keep them in their enclosure. Just, just make sure they are well fed!
Burning Bonds#004.dst: Seguirán mejorando y haciéndose más fuertes mientras los tengas en su recinto. ¡Solo, solo asegúrate de que estén bien alimentados!

Burning Bonds#005.src: Let's get started then! Make sure to remember what I'm about to tell you.
Burning Bonds#005.dst: ¡Empecemos entonces! Recuerda bien lo que voy a contarte.

Burning Bonds#006.src: This here is a Feeder, which will be your best friend for raising these beauties.
Burning Bonds#006.dst: Esto es un comedero, tu mejor amigo para criar a estas preciosidades.

Burning Bonds#007.src: Ah! Ah! No entry without a medal-

Burning Bonds#008.src: Did you have any more questions before I take my leave?
Burning Bonds#008.dst: ¿Tenías alguna pregunta más antes de que me marche?

Burning Bonds#009.src: Then, let me tell you a story about losing your identity in the {p}. About burning your medallion.
Burning Bonds#009.dst: Entonces deja que te cuente una historia sobre perder la identidad en {p}. Sobre quemar tu medallón.

Burning Bonds#010.src: You pick up the medallion off the changeling's corpse.
Burning Bonds#010.dst: Recoges el medallón del cadáver del cambiaformas.

Burning Bonds#011.src: I'll be about! Just come find me if you need my assistance.
Burning Bonds#011.dst: ¡Andaré por aquí! Ven a buscarme si necesitas ayuda.

Burning Bonds#012.dst: Nueva misión iniciada: Lazos en llamas

Burning Bonds#013.src: The child might even become more powerful than the adults, who knows!
Burning Bonds#013.dst: ¡La cría podría llegar a ser más poderosa que los adultos, quién sabe!

Burning Bonds#015.src: Halt, stranger! If you value your life, do not take another step forward.
Burning Bonds#015.dst: ¡Alto, forastero! Si aprecias tu vida, no des un paso más.
Burning Bonds#015.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#016.src: I have nothing left to give you! Leave, you and your kindred!
Burning Bonds#016.dst: ¡No me queda nada que darte! ¡Marchaos, tú y los tuyos!
Burning Bonds#016.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#017.src: You're completely unscathed? You must be powerful indeed, no changeling could defeat you.
Burning Bonds#017.dst: ¿Estás completamente ileso? Debes de ser muy poderoso; ningún cambiaformas podría vencerte.
Burning Bonds#017.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#018.src: Still though, I have nothing for you. I even lack a medallion to prove my own identity...
Burning Bonds#018.dst: Aun así, no tengo nada para ti. Ni siquiera me queda un medallón con el que probar quién soy...
Burning Bonds#018.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#019.src: Ah, you have lost yours too? Kindred spirits we are, dead to our worlds!
Burning Bonds#019.dst: Ah, ¿tú también lo perdiste? ¡Almas gemelas, muertos para nuestros mundos!
Burning Bonds#019.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#020.src: Lost to my clan, dead to my family, assumed to be a brute beast of the worst sort... I am sure you can understand, being in the same state as myself?
Burning Bonds#020.dst: Perdido para mi clan, muerto para mi familia, tomado por una bestia de la peor calaña... Estando en mi misma situación, seguro que lo entiendes.
Burning Bonds#020.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#021.src: It is some small comfort to find one in the same situation as myself. I will not pry into you, I know the value of secrets as well as anyone. But please, will you allow me a measure of catharsis and lend me an empathetic ear so I may tell my tale?
Burning Bonds#021.dst: Es un pequeño consuelo encontrar a alguien en mi misma situación. No hurgaré en tu pasado; conozco el valor de los secretos tan bien como cualquiera. Pero, por favor, ¿me permitirías un desahogo y me prestarías un oído comprensivo para contarte mi historia?
Burning Bonds#021.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#022.src: You have returned! Now, are you willing to take a moment to listen to my tale?
Burning Bonds#022.dst: ¡Has vuelto! Y bien, ¿te tomarás un momento para escuchar mi historia?
Burning Bonds#022.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#023.src: The forest here is safe, I ought to return home.
Burning Bonds#023.dst: El bosque ya es seguro; debería volver a casa.
Burning Bonds#023.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#025.src: Abramod... I want to come home now.
Burning Bonds#025.dst: Abramod... Quiero volver a casa ya.
Burning Bonds#025.speaker: Lishvil

Burning Bonds#026.src: If you give me your medallion, I can be with you again.
Burning Bonds#026.dst: Si me das tu medallón, podré estar contigo otra vez.
Burning Bonds#026.speaker: Lishvil

Burning Bonds#027.src: If you can't show me your medallion, how could I know you are really you?
Burning Bonds#027.dst: Si no puedes mostrarme tu medallón, ¿cómo voy a saber que eres tú?
Burning Bonds#027.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#028.src: There are creatures that take the shape of any man, and they want to kill us! It would be ignorant to not take it with you!
Burning Bonds#028.dst: ¡Hay criaturas que adoptan la forma de cualquier hombre, y quieren matarnos! ¡Sería una necedad no llevarlo encima!
Burning Bonds#028.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#029.src: Give me your medallion. I can become one of you.
Burning Bonds#029.dst: Dame tu medallón. Puedo ser uno de los vuestros.
Burning Bonds#029.speaker: Lishvil

Burning Bonds#030.src: You are not Lishvil. And judging by that, he disposed of his before you could get to it.
Burning Bonds#030.dst: Tú no eres Lishvil. Y por lo que dices, él se deshizo del suyo antes de que llegaras a cogerlo.
Burning Bonds#030.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#031.src: If it means you won't deceive my clan, I'll burn my medallion, like Lishvil did! You can kill me, but you will never be me!
Burning Bonds#031.dst: ¡Si con eso no engañas a mi clan, quemaré mi medallón, como hizo Lishvil! ¡Puedes matarme, pero nunca serás yo!
Burning Bonds#031.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#033.src: Hyup! There, if you want it so bad, go get it!
Burning Bonds#033.dst: ¡Hyup! ¡Ahí lo tienes! ¡Si tanto lo quieres, ve a por él!
Burning Bonds#033.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#035.src: That is my story. It is unfortunate it cannot have a happier ending, unless...
Burning Bonds#035.dst: Esa es mi historia. Lástima que no pueda tener un final más feliz, a menos que...
Burning Bonds#035.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#036.src: I do know how to make a new medallion, but it is a difficult task. Collecting the materials required for it would be more dangerous for my frail body than fending for myself out here...
Burning Bonds#036.dst: Sé cómo fabricar un medallón nuevo, pero es una tarea difícil. Reunir los materiales sería más peligroso para mi frágil cuerpo que sobrevivir aquí fuera...
Burning Bonds#036.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#037.src: With you however, we might be able to gather them. If you prove yourself trustworthy, I could even help you make one as well. How does that sound?
Burning Bonds#037.dst: Contigo, en cambio, quizá podamos conseguirlos. Si demuestras ser de fiar, incluso podría ayudarte a hacer uno para ti. ¿Qué te parece?
Burning Bonds#037.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#039.src: First, we will need a wooden base for the medallion.
Burning Bonds#039.dst: Primero necesitaremos una base de madera para el medallón.
Burning Bonds#039.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#040.src: There's an old, lightning struck tree to the south that we traditionally go to.
Burning Bonds#040.dst: Al sur hay un viejo árbol alcanzado por un rayo al que solemos ir.
Burning Bonds#040.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#041.src: I will write the directions to it for you and meet you by it.
Burning Bonds#041.dst: Te escribiré las indicaciones y nos veremos allí.
Burning Bonds#041.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#042.src: Meet Abramod near the lightning struck tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Burning Bonds#042.dst: Reúnete con Abramod junto al árbol alcanzado por un rayo en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Burning Bonds#043.src: This tree was struck by lightning many generations ago. And yet it has remained standing, even after death.
Burning Bonds#043.dst: A este árbol lo alcanzó un rayo hace muchas generaciones. Y aun así sigue en pie, incluso después de muerto.
Burning Bonds#043.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#044.src: The bark from it has proven sturdy enough that it works well as a medallion's base.
Burning Bonds#044.dst: Su corteza ha demostrado ser lo bastante resistente para servir de base a un medallón.
Burning Bonds#044.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#045.src: However it might be a bit, ah, difficult to reach. It is in part why I need your help.
Burning Bonds#045.dst: Aunque puede que sea un poco, ah, difícil de alcanzar. En parte por eso necesito tu ayuda.
Burning Bonds#045.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#046.src: I will... assist you in climbing the tree. On your way down, you will need to hit {~} of healthier branches so we have enough bark.
Burning Bonds#046.dst: Yo... te ayudaré a subir al árbol. Al bajar tendrás que golpear {~} de las ramas más sanas para que tengamos corteza suficiente.
Burning Bonds#046.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#048.src: I'll need to stay down here so I can collect the bark as it hits the ground.
Burning Bonds#048.dst: Tendré que quedarme aquí abajo para recoger la corteza cuando caiga.
Burning Bonds#048.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#051.src: If you need time to get your bearings, I understand. Come back when you're ready!
Burning Bonds#051.dst: Si necesitas un momento para orientarte, lo entiendo. ¡Vuelve cuando estés listo!
Burning Bonds#051.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#052.src: Looks like you didn't quite hit enough branches...
Burning Bonds#052.dst: Parece que no golpeaste ramas suficientes...
Burning Bonds#052.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#054.src: Remember, you need to hit {~} healthy branches.
Burning Bonds#054.dst: Recuerda, tienes que golpear {~} ramas sanas.
Burning Bonds#054.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#056.src: I understand. Talk to me again when you've caught your breath.
Burning Bonds#056.dst: Lo entiendo. Habla conmigo cuando recuperes el aliento.
Burning Bonds#056.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#057.src: Good! This should be enough for the bases.
Burning Bonds#057.dst: ¡Bien! Con esto debería bastar para las bases.
Burning Bonds#057.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#058.src: Next we'll need to collect some resin to lacquer the medallion with.
Burning Bonds#058.dst: Ahora necesitamos recoger resina para lacar el medallón.
Burning Bonds#058.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#059.src: High in a mountain meadow to the east, a fern grows that excretes a resin that works well for the task.
Burning Bonds#059.dst: En lo alto de un prado de montaña, al este, crece un helecho que segrega una resina ideal para eso.
Burning Bonds#059.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#060.src: I'll write you some instructions on how to get there and see you once you arrive.
Burning Bonds#060.dst: Te escribiré las indicaciones para llegar y nos vemos allí.
Burning Bonds#060.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#061.src: Meet Abramod in the mountain grove at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Burning Bonds#061.dst: Reúnete con Abramod en la arboleda de la montaña en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Burning Bonds#062.src: This meadow is home to a rare fern that we collect resin from to make our medallions.
Burning Bonds#062.dst: En este prado crece un helecho raro del que sacamos la resina para nuestros medallones.
Burning Bonds#062.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#063.src: Do not go searching for it just yet though! It is also home to a poisonous fern that appears very similar to the one we need.
Burning Bonds#063.dst: ¡Pero no vayas a buscarlo todavía! Aquí también crece un helecho venenoso muy parecido al que necesitamos.
Burning Bonds#063.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#064.src: My eyes aren't so good anymore, so I'm going to need your help to tell them apart!
Burning Bonds#064.dst: Mi vista ya no es la que era, ¡así que necesitaré tu ayuda para distinguirlos!
Burning Bonds#064.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#065.src: I'm going to toss the plants for you. You can pick them up by right-clicking them - even while they're still in the air!
Burning Bonds#065.dst: Te iré lanzando las plantas. Puedes recogerlas haciendo clic derecho sobre ellas, ¡incluso en el aire!
Burning Bonds#065.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#066.src: Place the greener, healthier looking plants to the side where I am now. And you'll need to burn the poisonous, more sickly looking plants on the other side.
Burning Bonds#066.dst: Deja las plantas más verdes y sanas en el lado donde estoy yo. Y las venenosas, las de aspecto enfermizo, tendrás que quemarlas en el otro lado.
Burning Bonds#066.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#067.src: We'll need {~} of the good ferns to extract enough resin. But make sure the poisonous ferns don't build up too much or it could be dangerous for you!
Burning Bonds#067.dst: Necesitamos {~} helechos buenos para sacar resina suficiente. ¡Pero que no se acumulen demasiados venenosos o será peligroso para ti!
Burning Bonds#067.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#068.src: You'll only be able to pick up one at a time, so good luck!
Burning Bonds#068.dst: Solo podrás coger uno cada vez, ¡así que suerte!
Burning Bonds#068.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#071.src: I understand. I'll be here whenever you are.
Burning Bonds#071.dst: Lo entiendo. Estaré aquí cuando tú lo estés.
Burning Bonds#071.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#072.src: Looks like you didn't get enough!
Burning Bonds#072.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#077.src: There's only one final thing we need: knives to cut the bark with.
Burning Bonds#077.dst: Solo nos falta una cosa: cuchillos para cortar la corteza.
Burning Bonds#077.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#078.src: Put that away, we don't need just any knife!
Burning Bonds#078.dst: ¡Guarda eso, no nos vale cualquier cuchillo!
Burning Bonds#078.speaker: Abramod
