Dearly Departed#011.src: Good, good. Better safe than sorry... As I always say! Always, ha ha...
Dearly Departed#011.dst: Bien, bien. Más vale prevenir... ¡Como digo siempre! Siempre, ja ja...
Dearly Departed#011.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#012.src: Oh, no reason really! Just making sure, ha ha... Should be perfectly safe back there, perfectly safe.
Dearly Departed#012.dst: ¡Oh, por nada en concreto! Solo me aseguro, ja ja... Ahí detrás no hay peligro alguno, ninguno.
Dearly Departed#012.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#013.src: You've used your Skill Points too, right? They come in handy, should something happen.
Dearly Departed#013.dst: También has gastado tus puntos de atributo, ¿verdad? Vienen muy bien por si pasa algo.
Dearly Departed#013.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#014.src: Well, they're Skill Points! You gain them as you level up, then you can assign them to get bonuses in combat. Look, I'm no soldier, but even I know you really should be using them...
Dearly Departed#014.dst: ¡Pues son los puntos de atributo! Los ganas al subir de nivel y luego los asignas para obtener bonificaciones en combate. Mira, yo no soy soldado, pero hasta yo sé que deberías usarlos...
Dearly Departed#014.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#015.src: There's five of them. Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Defence, and Agility, each with different bonuses.
Dearly Departed#015.dst: Hay cinco. Fuerza, Destreza, Inteligencia, Defensa y Agilidad, cada uno con bonificaciones distintas.
Dearly Departed#015.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#016.src: You get it, or do you want me to tell you what they are?
Dearly Departed#016.dst: ¿Lo pillas o quieres que te explique cuáles son?
Dearly Departed#016.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#017.src: is handy if you're having a tough time taking down enemies. It makes your attacks hit harder, simple as.
Dearly Departed#017.dst: viene bien si te cuesta acabar con los enemigos. Hace que tus ataques peguen más fuerte, así de simple.
Dearly Departed#017.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#018.src: 's a bit of a tricky one. The more of it you've got, the higher the likelihood is that your attacks will deal double damage. Neat, right?
Dearly Departed#018.dst: es un poco peculiar. Cuanta más tengas, mayor es la probabilidad de que tus ataques hagan el doble de daño. Está bien, ¿eh?
Dearly Departed#018.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#019.src: is for the spellcasters, it lowers the cost to cast spells and increases your max amount of mana.
Dearly Departed#019.dst: es para los lanzadores de hechizos: reduce el coste de los hechizos y sube tu maná máximo.
Dearly Departed#019.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#020.src: is your best bet if you're struggling with staying alive. Decreases the damage you take, 's about all.
Dearly Departed#020.dst: es tu mejor opción si te cuesta seguir con vida. Reduce el daño que recibes, poco más.
Dearly Departed#020.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#021.src: Agility, now that one is for the risktakers. The more you have, the likelier you are to dodge incoming attacks, negating most of their damage.
Dearly Departed#021.dst: Agilidad, esa es para los que arriesgan. Cuanta más tengas, más probable es que esquives los ataques y anules casi todo su daño.
Dearly Departed#021.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#022.src: Best part is, you can combine them however you want, no matter your class or style of fighting.
Dearly Departed#022.dst: Lo mejor es que puedes combinarlos como quieras, sea cual sea tu clase o tu forma de luchar.
Dearly Departed#022.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#023.src: Just open your compass to assign your Skill Points. Then, when you're ready, head in there and get my ring.
Dearly Departed#023.dst: Abre tu brújula para asignar los puntos de atributo. Luego, cuando estés listo, entra ahí y tráeme el anillo.
Dearly Departed#023.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#025.src: Go on then, soldier! Show us the might of {p}'s army! Uh, I mean... get me that ring!
Dearly Departed#025.dst: ¡Venga, soldado! ¡Muéstranos el poder del ejército de {p}! Eh, quiero decir... ¡tráeme ese anillo!
Dearly Departed#025.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#026.src: What's going on in there, soldier? Have you found the ring yet?
Dearly Departed#026.dst: ¿Qué pasa ahí dentro, soldado? ¿Ya has encontrado el anillo?
Dearly Departed#026.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#027.src: You really should hurry, before... nevermind! Just find the ring and get out of there!
Dearly Departed#027.dst: Deberías darte prisa, antes de que... ¡da igual! ¡Encuentra el anillo y sal de ahí!
Dearly Departed#027.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#028.src: Holy Bovine! It's... it's... he's back! Kill it, quickly!
Dearly Departed#028.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#030.src: You did it! Come back here now, so I can finally get my ring back.
Dearly Departed#030.dst: ¡Lo has conseguido! Vuelve aquí ya, que por fin recupero mi anillo.
Dearly Departed#030.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#031.dst: Vuelve con el Granjero Cevalus a [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Dearly Departed#032.src: Goodness, that was a little more exciting than I anticipated, hmph. Still, good work! I'm glad we were able to get rid of that monster...
Dearly Departed#032.dst: Madre mía, eso fue algo más emocionante de lo que esperaba, hmpf. ¡Aun así, buen trabajo! Me alegra que nos hayamos librado de ese monstruo...
Dearly Departed#032.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#033.src: I mean... poor father-in-law! I don't know how I'll explain this to the wife...
Dearly Departed#033.dst: Digo... ¡pobre suegro! No sé cómo le voy a explicar esto a mi mujer...
Dearly Departed#033.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#034.src: I'll take the ring now, it's rather precious to me...
Dearly Departed#034.dst: Ya me quedo el anillo, es muy valioso para mí...
Dearly Departed#034.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#035.src: Anyhow, take this well-deserved reward for the, well, actions you took today. Perhaps, if you keep it up, you could even become a hero like Ragnar one day.
Dearly Departed#035.dst: En fin, toma esta merecida recompensa por, bueno, lo que has hecho hoy. Quizá, si sigues así, algún día llegues a ser un héroe como Ragnar.
Dearly Departed#035.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#036.src: Hello there, stranger. Was there something you wanted to speak to me about?
Dearly Departed#036.dst: Hola, forastero. ¿Querías hablar conmigo de algo?
Dearly Departed#036.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#037.src: I should be angry but... I can't pretend to be surprised. He's always been such a forgetful oaf.
Dearly Departed#037.dst: Debería enfadarme, pero... no puedo fingir sorpresa. Siempre ha sido un zoquete olvidadizo.
Dearly Departed#037.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#038.src: But, it explains a lot... He's been acting weird lately, ever since dad passed. That must've been what happened, so thank you for telling me.
Dearly Departed#038.dst: Pero explica muchas cosas... Lleva raro desde que murió papá. Tuvo que ser eso, así que gracias por contármelo.
Dearly Departed#038.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#039.src: That's right. The one and only, ha ha...
Dearly Departed#039.dst: Así es. La única, ja ja...
Dearly Departed#039.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#040.src: We're just simple farmers, trying to get by. We were taking care of my dad until... well... yeah...
Dearly Departed#040.dst: Solo somos granjeros sencillos que van tirando. Cuidábamos de mi padre hasta que... bueno... ya...
Dearly Departed#040.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#041.src: Thank you... It all happened so suddenly. On the day I left for {p}, dad was as healthy as ever, but when I came back he was already buried. The sickness must have come so fast...
Dearly Departed#041.dst: Gracias... Todo pasó muy de repente. El día que me fui a {p}, papá estaba más sano que nunca, pero al volver ya estaba enterrado. La enfermedad debió de llegar muy rápido...
Dearly Departed#041.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#042.src: But at his age, I'm not surprised... It's just regrettable that we couldn't get a priest out here in time, dad was such a pious man.
Dearly Departed#042.dst: Aunque a su edad, no me sorprende... Es una lástima que no llegara un sacerdote a tiempo, papá era muy devoto.
Dearly Departed#042.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#043.src: Dad... Above all, he was kind and always generous. He left us this entire farm. And very pious too, a true believer. Maybe that's why he lived so long...
Dearly Departed#043.dst: Papá... Ante todo era bondadoso y siempre generoso. Nos dejó la granja entera. Y muy devoto, un verdadero creyente. Quizá por eso vivió tanto...
Dearly Departed#043.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#044.src: Oh, dear... If I don't stop, I'm gonna start crying again.
Dearly Departed#044.dst: Ay, madre... Como no pare, me pondré a llorar otra vez.
Dearly Departed#044.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#045.src: You've used your Skill Points too, right? They could come in handy, should something happen.
Dearly Departed#045.dst: También has gastado tus puntos de atributo, ¿verdad? Podrían venirte bien por si pasa algo.

Dearly Departed#046.src: There's five of them.  Strength,  Dexterity,  Intelligence,  Defence, and  Agility, each with different bonuses.
Dearly Departed#046.dst: Hay cinco.  Fuerza,  Destreza,  Inteligencia,  Defensa y  Agilidad, cada uno con bonificaciones distintas.

Dearly Departed#047.src: Why are you asking me that?

Dearly Departed#056.src: Now to see if you can find that ring Cevalus mentioned...
Dearly Departed#056.dst: A ver si encuentras el anillo que mencionó Cevalus...

Dearly Departed#057.src: You manage to pry the ring off the monster's finger...
Dearly Departed#057.dst: Consigues arrancar el anillo del dedo del monstruo...

Dearly Departed#060.src: {#} Strength is handy if you're having a tough time taking down enemies. It makes your attacks hit harder, simple as.
Dearly Departed#060.dst: {#} La Fuerza viene bien si te cuesta acabar con los enemigos. Hace que tus ataques peguen más fuerte, así de simple.
Dearly Departed#060.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Death Whistle (Quest)#001.src: Hello! Hmm, armour, weapon, look of grim despair... You must be from the Wynn province!
Death Whistle (Quest)#001.dst: ¡Hola! Mmm, armadura, arma, cara de sombría desesperación... ¡Seguro que vienes de la provincia de Wynn!
Death Whistle (Quest)#001.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#002.src: My name is Voer, and I'm an exotic plant merchant. I sell all kinds of, uh, perfectly legal goods to the magicians of Gavel.
Death Whistle (Quest)#002.dst: Me llamo Voer y soy mercader de plantas exóticas. Vendo todo tipo de mercancías, eh, perfectamente legales a los magos de Gavel.
Death Whistle (Quest)#002.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#003.src: Lately, this Decay has been making business rather tough. The magical plants that used to grow here are dying.
Death Whistle (Quest)#003.dst: Últimamente la Decadencia ha puesto el negocio muy difícil. Las plantas mágicas que crecían aquí se están muriendo.
Death Whistle (Quest)#003.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#004.src: The need for magic has never been as big as it is now, and without supplies, the magicians of the swamp simply cannot operate!
Death Whistle (Quest)#004.dst: Nunca ha habido tanta necesidad de magia como ahora y, sin suministros, ¡los magos del pantano no pueden trabajar!
Death Whistle (Quest)#004.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#005.src: I need Death Whistle in particular. It's not as deadly as it sounds, I promise- the name's just archaic, if I recall that from that- er, my book.
Death Whistle (Quest)#005.dst: Necesito Death Whistle en concreto. No es tan mortal como suena, te lo prometo- el nombre es arcaico y ya, si no recuerdo mal de ese- eh, de mi libro.
Death Whistle (Quest)#005.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#006.src: It is a rather rare plant with all sorts of mystical properties, so much so that it can animate objects around it!
Death Whistle (Quest)#006.dst: Es una planta rara con toda clase de propiedades místicas, ¡tantas que anima los objetos que la rodean!
Death Whistle (Quest)#006.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#007.src: Look for the highest mountain in the swamp south-east from here. The Decay hasn't reached the peaks yet, you see!
Death Whistle (Quest)#007.dst: Busca la montaña más alta del pantano, al sureste de aquí. ¡La Decadencia aún no ha llegado a las cumbres!
Death Whistle (Quest)#007.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#008.src: Find the mountain at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and a way up on it.
Death Whistle (Quest)#008.dst: Encuentra la montaña en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y una forma de subir.

Death Whistle (Quest)#009.src: Go to the top of the mountain and get {~} Black Whistle Leaf.
Death Whistle (Quest)#009.dst: Sube a la cima de la montaña y consigue {~} Black Whistle Leaf.

Death Whistle (Quest)#010.src: Return to Voer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with [{~} Death Whistle Leaf].
Death Whistle (Quest)#010.dst: Vuelve con Voer a [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] con [{~} Death Whistle Leaf].

Death Whistle (Quest)#012.src: You've no idea what you even have done, do you? Your thoughtless actions will cost lives!
Death Whistle (Quest)#012.dst: No tienes ni idea de lo que has hecho, ¿verdad? ¡Tu imprudencia costará vidas!
Death Whistle (Quest)#012.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#013.src: Uhm... Excuse me? What do you want, elf girl? We're in the middle of a deal here?
Death Whistle (Quest)#013.dst: Eh... ¿Perdona? ¿Qué quieres, elfa? ¿No ves que estamos cerrando un trato?
Death Whistle (Quest)#013.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#014.src: You sold Pink Pelulite! Have you forgotten its enraging properties? Or shall I read from that herbology book you "found" in my camp?
Death Whistle (Quest)#014.dst: ¡Vendiste Pink Pelulite! ¿Olvidas que provoca furia? ¿O te leo el libro de herbología que "encontraste" en mi campamento?
Death Whistle (Quest)#014.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#015.src: Wait, wh-what? A Pink PELULITE!? I sold that woman a Pink PELUTE for her luck charms! How dare- wait... wait, Pink Pelute has rounder petals... Oh no.
Death Whistle (Quest)#015.dst: ¿Q-qué? ¿¡Una Pink PELULITE!? ¡Le vendí una Pink PELUTE para sus amuletos! Cómo te atre- espera... la Pelute tiene pétalos redondos... Ay, no.
Death Whistle (Quest)#015.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#016.src: You can't even say for certain. This kind of carelessness has no place! If you refuse to exercise the proper thought and caution, then those around you suffer.
Death Whistle (Quest)#016.dst: Ni siquiera estás seguro. ¡Este descuido es inaceptable! Si te niegas a pensar y a actuar con cautela, quienes te rodean lo pagan.
Death Whistle (Quest)#016.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#017.src: I must... make a difficult choice, and leave this job to you. I've other things to tend to, though it pains me to leave a life in another's hands. Remember this, villager!
Death Whistle (Quest)#017.dst: Debo... tomar una decisión difícil y dejarte a ti esta tarea. Tengo otros asuntos que atender, aunque me duele dejar una vida en manos ajenas. ¡Recuerda esto, aldeano!
Death Whistle (Quest)#017.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#018.src: Aaah, this is a disaster! Human, please, Pink Pelulite acts quickly and intensely... Follow the pink trail on the ground, the flowers shed their petals. Get it back before something bad happens!
Death Whistle (Quest)#018.dst: ¡Aaah, esto es un desastre! Humano, por favor, la Pink Pelulite actúa rápido y con fuerza... Sigue el rastro rosa del suelo, las flores van soltando pétalos. ¡Recupérala antes de que pase algo malo!
Death Whistle (Quest)#018.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#019.src: Follow the path of residue to the buyer’s cave.
Death Whistle (Quest)#019.dst: Sigue el rastro de residuos hasta la cueva de la compradora.

Death Whistle (Quest)#020.src: Ah, um, come back later please! Something strange is happening!
Death Whistle (Quest)#020.dst: Ah, eh, ¡vuelve luego, por favor! ¡Está pasando algo raro!
Death Whistle (Quest)#020.speaker: Witch

Death Whistle (Quest)#021.src: My body is a bit, um, not-in-my-control right now! I'd rather not hurt anyone!
Death Whistle (Quest)#021.dst: ¡Mi cuerpo está un poco, eh, fuera de control! ¡No quiero hacer daño a nadie!
Death Whistle (Quest)#021.speaker: Witch

Death Whistle (Quest)#022.src: Remove the flower from the woman in the cave.
Death Whistle (Quest)#022.dst: Quita la flor a la mujer de la cueva.

Death Whistle (Quest)#023.src: You're back, I see... and you're shedding petals! You got the Pink Pelulite back?
Death Whistle (Quest)#023.dst: Has vuelto, ya veo... ¡y vas soltando pétalos! ¿Recuperaste la Pink Pelulite?
Death Whistle (Quest)#023.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#024.src: And what of the woman who bought it? Was she...?
Death Whistle (Quest)#024.dst: ¿Y qué fue de la mujer que la compró? ¿Estaba...?
Death Whistle (Quest)#024.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#025.src: Oh, thank goodness! You got in there in time. She's a regular of mine- and a bit of a looker, too. That Lari was right, to some extent, at least...
Death Whistle (Quest)#025.dst: ¡Ay, menos mal! Llegaste a tiempo. Es clienta habitual mía- y bastante guapa, además. Esa tal Lari tenía razón, al menos en parte...
Death Whistle (Quest)#025.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#026.src: I did take her book, and I should be more careful in the future, regarding this... but I can't just quit selling the herbs.
Death Whistle (Quest)#026.dst: Sí que le cogí el libro, y debería tener más cuidado en el futuro con esto... pero no puedo dejar de vender hierbas.
Death Whistle (Quest)#026.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#027.src: I need an income, and the swamp isn't exactly the most resource-rich region here! Especially not any more.
Death Whistle (Quest)#027.dst: ¡Necesito ingresos, y el pantano no es precisamente la región más rica en recursos! Y menos ahora.
Death Whistle (Quest)#027.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#028.src: And how dare she just walk away like that! It's a good thing you were around, human, otherwise... well, I would not think about it.
Death Whistle (Quest)#028.dst: ¡Y encima se larga tan tranquila! Menos mal que estabas tú por aquí, humano, si no... bueno, mejor no pensarlo.
Death Whistle (Quest)#028.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#029.src: Regardless, you helped me greatly. Got me my supplies and saved the life of a regular of mine, so I've got a gift for you!
Death Whistle (Quest)#029.dst: En todo caso, me has ayudado muchísimo. Conseguiste mis suministros y salvaste la vida de una clienta, ¡así que tengo un regalo para ti!
Death Whistle (Quest)#029.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#030.src: I'll offer you a sampler of my stock. Everything here is pre-primed to be safe for brewing, so there won't be any mishaps like today!
Death Whistle (Quest)#030.dst: Te ofrezco una muestra de mi género. Todo esto viene ya tratado para poder usarlo sin riesgo, ¡así no habrá percances como el de hoy!
Death Whistle (Quest)#030.speaker: Voer

Deja Vu#000.src: Whatever that odd feeling was, it's over now. And there's Asher's shovel! Better return this to him.

Deja Vu#002.src: Whenever you're ready to save Asher, step through the rift.

Deja Vu#004.dst: Habla con Asher cerca de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Deja Vu#005.src: Well well well, look who decided to come back with their tail between their legs.
Deja Vu#005.dst: Vaya, vaya, vaya, mira quién vuelve con el rabo entre las piernas.
Deja Vu#005.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#006.src: Two weeks now and you still haven't found it? Ugh, I can't believe I ever trusted you with such a simple task.
Deja Vu#006.dst: ¿Dos semanas y aún no la has encontrado? Puf, no me creo que te confiara algo tan sencillo.
Deja Vu#006.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#007.src: Who am I? WHAT DO YOU MEAN WHO AM I? You offered to help find my shovel, and I've been waiting two weeks!
Deja Vu#007.dst: ¿Que quién soy? ¿¡CÓMO QUE QUIÉN SOY!? ¡Te ofreciste a buscar mi pala y llevo dos semanas esperando!
Deja Vu#007.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#008.src: Forget about your payment. Unless you either pay me back or get my shovel right now!
Deja Vu#008.dst: Olvídate de tu paga. ¡A menos que me compenses o me traigas la pala ahora mismo!
Deja Vu#008.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#009.src: My shovel? That's why I sent you out in the first place! It's somewhere in {p}. I lost it while following a trail of flowers.
Deja Vu#009.dst: ¿Mi pala? ¡Para eso te mandé, para empezar! Está en algún punto de {p}. La perdí siguiendo un rastro de flores.
Deja Vu#009.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#010.src: I think it was south west of the large ruined gate. Now go get it!
Deja Vu#010.dst: Creo que al suroeste de la gran puerta en ruinas. ¡Venga, a por ella!
Deja Vu#010.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#011.dst: Encuentra la pala de Asher cerca de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Deja Vu#013.src: Well hello there, stranger! Welcome to {p}! Always nice to see a new face around here.
Deja Vu#013.dst: ¡Hola, forastero! ¡Bienvenido a {p}! Siempre gusta ver una cara nueva por aquí.
Deja Vu#013.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#014.src: Mad at you? Why would I be mad at you? We've never met.
Deja Vu#014.dst: ¿Enfadado contigo? ¿Por qué iba a estarlo? No nos conocemos.
Deja Vu#014.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#015.src: I know this a bit forward, but I need to ask for your help with-
Deja Vu#015.dst: Sé que es un poco atrevido, pero necesito pedirte ayuda con-
Deja Vu#015.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#016.src: Wait, is that-? It is! You've found my shovel! I recognize those markings anywhere.
Deja Vu#016.dst: Espera, ¿eso es-? ¡Lo es! ¡Has encontrado mi pala! Reconocería esas marcas donde fuera.
Deja Vu#016.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#017.src: But why is it so rusty? Ah, no matter. Give that to me and I'll head inside to get you a nice reward.
Deja Vu#017.dst: ¿Y por qué está tan oxidada? Bah, da igual. Dámela y entro a buscarte una buena recompensa.
Deja Vu#017.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#018.src: Thank you. Now, about that reward-
Deja Vu#018.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#020.src: Oh dear, there he goes again. Poor fool ignored my warnings and touched that shovel.
Deja Vu#020.dst: Vaya por Dios, ya está otra vez. El pobre iluso ignoró mis avisos y tocó esa pala.
Deja Vu#020.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#021.src: He's gone and got himself stuck in a loop.
Deja Vu#021.dst: Ha ido y se ha quedado atrapado en un bucle.
Deja Vu#021.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#022.src: Head inside, soldier, and I'll explain what's happening here.
Deja Vu#022.dst: Entra, soldado, y te explicaré lo que pasa aquí.
Deja Vu#022.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#023.dst: Entra en la casa de Asher.

Deja Vu#024.src: Without Asher, his house has vanished from time.
Deja Vu#024.dst: Sin Asher, su casa ha desaparecido del tiempo.
Deja Vu#024.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#026.src: Let me explain why Asher disappeared...
Deja Vu#026.dst: Te explico por qué Asher desapareció...
Deja Vu#026.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#027.src: {p} was built many years ago by a long-lost civilization.
Deja Vu#027.dst: {p} lo construyó hace años una civilización perdida.
Deja Vu#027.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#028.src: They had odd powers. They ended up distorting time itself.
Deja Vu#028.dst: Tenían poderes extraños. Acabaron distorsionando el tiempo.
Deja Vu#028.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#029.src: The tools they used to make these structures are imbued with their power.
Deja Vu#029.dst: Las herramientas con que alzaron esto guardan su poder.
Deja Vu#029.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#030.src: Asher found one of these tools: the shovel.
Deja Vu#030.dst: Asher encontró una de esas herramientas: la pala.
Deja Vu#030.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#031.src: The shovel is tethering its time of influence to today. It keeps sending Asher back.
Deja Vu#031.dst: La pala ancla su tiempo de influencia al día de hoy. No para de enviar a Asher al pasado.
Deja Vu#031.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#032.src: The issue is, Asher died in the past. This creates a paradox.
Deja Vu#032.dst: El problema es que Asher murió en el pasado. Eso crea una paradoja.
Deja Vu#032.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#033.src: We can save him if I send you back to prevent his death. Go through this rift to join him in the past.
Deja Vu#033.dst: Podemos salvarlo si te envío a impedir su muerte. Cruza esta grieta para reunirte con él en el pasado.
Deja Vu#033.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#034.src: Find a way to save Asher from his death.
Deja Vu#034.dst: Encuentra la forma de salvar a Asher de su muerte.

Deja Vu#036.src: Usually this place is filled with workers.
Deja Vu#036.dst: Normalmente esto está lleno de obreros.
Deja Vu#036.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#037.src: But no one's here. And this place is clearly not done.
Deja Vu#037.dst: Pero no hay nadie. Y esto está claramente sin terminar.
Deja Vu#037.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#038.src: Whatever the case, I should probably find my shovel.
Deja Vu#038.dst: Sea como sea, será mejor que busque mi pala.
Deja Vu#038.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#039.src: If I were a shovel, where would I be?
Deja Vu#039.dst: Si yo fuera una pala, ¿dónde estaría?
Deja Vu#039.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#041.src: This place... There's so much going on but no one here.
Deja Vu#041.dst: Este sitio... Hay mucho en marcha, pero no hay nadie.
Deja Vu#041.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#042.src: What I don't understand, though, is why this place looks brand new.
Deja Vu#042.dst: Lo que no entiendo es por qué esto parece recién hecho.
Deja Vu#042.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#043.src: This place looks like it's just being built!
Deja Vu#043.dst: ¡Parece que lo están construyendo ahora mismo!
Deja Vu#043.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#044.src: This must be something to do with the valley's magic. Wouldn't be the first time.
Deja Vu#044.dst: Esto tendrá que ver con la magia del valle. No sería la primera vez.
Deja Vu#044.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#046.src: In fact, whenever I hold that shovel, this kind of stuff seems to happen.
Deja Vu#046.dst: De hecho, siempre que sostengo esa pala pasan estas cosas.
Deja Vu#046.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#047.src: Maybe it's sent me way back. Back to the construction of this place.
Deja Vu#047.dst: Quizá me ha mandado muy atrás. A cuando construían este lugar.
Deja Vu#047.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#048.src: Then why is no one here?
Deja Vu#048.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#049.src: Woah, that tree looks like it might fall over!
Deja Vu#049.dst: ¡Uy, parece que ese árbol se va a caer!
Deja Vu#049.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#051.src: Uhf! How do they have a cannon? These guys must be super advanced.
Deja Vu#051.dst: ¡Uf! ¿Cómo tienen un cañón? Esta gente va muy avanzada.
Deja Vu#051.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#052.src: I think I'm close now. I can just feel that shovel close by.
Deja Vu#052.dst: Creo que ya estoy cerca. Noto la pala aquí al lado.
Deja Vu#052.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#054.src: My my, a crushing defeat to be sure. You'll have to find a way to stop that.
Deja Vu#054.dst: Vaya, vaya, una derrota aplastante. Habrá que evitar eso.
Deja Vu#054.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#055.src: Go back through the rift and make sure Asher doesn't become a pancake this time.
Deja Vu#055.dst: Vuelve a cruzar la grieta y evita que Asher acabe hecho una tortita.
Deja Vu#055.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#057.src: Well that was quite the explosive end to our friend there. There must be a way to prevent that.
Deja Vu#057.dst: Pues vaya final más explosivo el de nuestro amigo. Tiene que haber forma de evitarlo.
Deja Vu#057.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#058.src: Head back in there. This time with less explosions.
Deja Vu#058.dst: Vuelve a entrar. Esta vez con menos explosiones.
Deja Vu#058.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#059.src: Oh, so close on that try. Who could've guessed that was how our friend met his end?
Deja Vu#059.dst: Ay, por poco esta vez. ¿Quién iba a imaginar semejante final para nuestro amigo?
Deja Vu#059.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#060.src: I'm sure you'll nail it this time. Not sure how you will stop a cosmic event, though.
Deja Vu#060.dst: Seguro que esta vez lo clavas. Aunque no sé cómo detendrás un suceso cósmico.
Deja Vu#060.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#061.src: Oh there it is! My shovel!
Deja Vu#061.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#062.src: I'm surprised it took me back this far this time.
Deja Vu#062.dst: Me sorprende que esta vez me llevara tan atrás.
Deja Vu#062.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#063.src: Well, time to head on back-
Deja Vu#063.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#066.src: Asher, you remember when I allowed you to live in the valley, I told you not to touch any odd objects.
Deja Vu#066.dst: Asher, cuando te dejé vivir en el valle te dije que no tocaras objetos raros.
Deja Vu#066.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#068.src: You got yourself stuck hundreds of years ago. If it wasn't for this guard, you'd be removed from existence.
Deja Vu#068.dst: Te quedaste atrapado hace siglos. De no ser por este guardia, habrías dejado de existir.
Deja Vu#068.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#069.src: Oh... So that's where I am. I am so sorry Martyn. Please don't kick me out of the valley.
Deja Vu#069.dst: Ah... Así que ahí estaba. Lo siento mucho, Martyn. No me eches del valle, por favor.
Deja Vu#069.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#070.src: I know time travel can be tempting. But it's far more dangerous than you can ever understand.
Deja Vu#070.dst: Sé que viajar en el tiempo es tentador. Pero es mucho más peligroso de lo que imaginas.
Deja Vu#070.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#071.src: The valley is banned for most citizens. I watch over this timeline because of poor souls like Asher.
Deja Vu#071.dst: El valle está vedado a casi todos. Vigilo esta línea temporal por pobres almas como Asher.
Deja Vu#071.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#075.src: How did you get these powers? Are you even human?
Deja Vu#075.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#076.src: Oh you know. I've read a book or two in my time.
Deja Vu#076.dst: Ya sabes. He leído algún que otro libro en mi vida.
Deja Vu#076.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#077.src: {u}, I'm sorry I got you dragged into this. I wish I could have done it myself.
Deja Vu#077.dst: {u}, siento haberte metido en esto. Ojalá hubiera podido hacerlo yo.
Deja Vu#077.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#078.src: I probably could have gotten myself out...
Deja Vu#078.dst: Seguro que yo solo habría salido...
Deja Vu#078.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#079.src: You died in the past. Multiple times.
Deja Vu#079.dst: Moriste en el pasado. Varias veces.
Deja Vu#079.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#081.src: Yes. In some surprising ways too.
Deja Vu#081.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#082.src: {u}, I'm sure we will meet again... in time.
Deja Vu#082.dst: {u}, seguro que volveremos a vernos... con el tiempo.
Deja Vu#082.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#086.src: I don't understand Martyn. He seems to know everything about the past. Here, come closer, I want to whisper something.
Deja Vu#086.dst: No entiendo a Martyn. Parece saberlo todo del pasado. Ven, acércate, quiero contarte algo.
Deja Vu#086.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#088.src: I think he might have known Bob. I saw some letters in his house.
Deja Vu#088.dst: Creo que pudo conocer a Bob. Vi unas cartas en su casa.
Deja Vu#088.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#089.src: Weird, right? Bob was a hard guy to know.
Deja Vu#089.dst: Raro, ¿no? A Bob no era fácil conocerlo.
Deja Vu#089.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#090.src: Anyway, take this. It's the least I can do to pay you for saving me.
Deja Vu#090.dst: En fin, toma esto. Es lo mínimo por haberme salvado.
Deja Vu#090.speaker: Asher

Desperate Metal#003.src: A bunch of stupid mechs came here and just started ransacking!
Desperate Metal#003.dst: ¡Vinieron unos mechs idiotas y se pusieron a saquearlo todo!
Desperate Metal#003.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#004.src: Looks like a bunch of despermechs. That's what we call junk mechs, trying to survive.
Desperate Metal#004.dst: Parecen despermechs. Así llamamos a los mechs de chatarra que intentan sobrevivir.
Desperate Metal#004.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#005.src: I count three different mech marks. Looks like they split up once they got their parts.
Desperate Metal#005.dst: Cuento tres marcas de mech distintas. Se separaron al conseguir sus piezas.
Desperate Metal#005.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#006.src: You got to help me here, I'm no warrior. Look they've dropped crates on their escape. Follow them and bring me back evidence that you destroyed them and I shall reward you.
Desperate Metal#006.dst: Tienes que ayudarme, yo no soy guerrero. Mira, se les cayeron cajas al huir. Síguelas, tráeme pruebas de que los destruiste y te recompensaré.
Desperate Metal#006.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#007.src: Three trails, three thieving despermechs. Be careful, they aren't to be underestimated.
Desperate Metal#007.dst: Tres rastros, tres despermechs ladrones. Cuidado, no hay que subestimarlos.
Desperate Metal#007.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#008.src: Locate the {~} mechs by following the trails of tools, return to Phinas with evidence that you destroyed the mechs.
Desperate Metal#008.dst: Localiza los {~} mechs siguiendo los rastros de herramientas y vuelve con Phinas con pruebas de que los destruiste.

Desperate Metal#009.src: You Wynn folk sure know your fights.
Desperate Metal#009.dst: En Wynn sabéis pelear, desde luego.
Desperate Metal#009.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#010.src: You found all three? Let's take a look. Hm....
Desperate Metal#010.dst: ¿Los encontraste los tres? Vamos a ver. Mmm....
Desperate Metal#010.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#011.src: Wait. These aren't Despermechs.. The factory fell over two years ago. These are brand new. Handmade.
Desperate Metal#011.dst: Espera. Estos no son despermechs.. La fábrica cayó hace más de dos años. Son nuevos. Hechos a mano.
Desperate Metal#011.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#013.src: Would you look at that! Their code!
Desperate Metal#013.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#014.src: Here, have them back. Take a close look at the names of these parts.
Desperate Metal#014.dst: Toma, quédatelos. Fíjate bien en los nombres de estas piezas.
Desperate Metal#014.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#015.src: Find out where to go by looking at the pieces of junk.
Desperate Metal#015.dst: Averigua adónde ir observando los trozos de chatarra.

Desperate Metal#016.src: What are these? I have nothing to do with them!
Desperate Metal#016.dst: ¿Y esto qué es? ¡No tengo nada que ver!
Desperate Metal#016.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#017.src: Ahh.. Well now that I think of it writing my location on these parts was a bit stupid.
Desperate Metal#017.dst: Ahh.. Bueno, ahora que lo pienso, grabar mi ubicación en las piezas fue algo estúpido.
Desperate Metal#017.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#018.src: Those mechs were my creation. Corkus can still live with machines.
Desperate Metal#018.dst: Esos mechs los creé yo. Corkus aún puede convivir con máquinas.
Desperate Metal#018.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#019.src: The factory was a disaster. That's what happens when a machine controls a machine.
Desperate Metal#019.dst: La fábrica fue un desastre. Eso pasa cuando una máquina controla a otra máquina.
Desperate Metal#019.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#020.src: I am living proof that humans can control them. Make use of them.
Desperate Metal#020.dst: Soy la prueba viviente de que los humanos podemos controlarlos y usarlos.
Desperate Metal#020.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#021.src: The metal shortage has made it difficult to make my machines... Not to mention the new laws..
Desperate Metal#021.dst: La escasez de metal me complica fabricar mis máquinas... Por no hablar de las nuevas leyes..
Desperate Metal#021.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#022.src: If you want to turn me in fine. You'll find all the evidence you need under my pillow.
Desperate Metal#022.dst: Si quieres delatarme, adelante. Tienes todas las pruebas bajo mi almohada.
Desperate Metal#022.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#024.dst: Intruso detectado... Sistemas de seguridad activados.

Desperate Metal#027.src: I'm sorry it ended up like this, you should've just ignored that old man.
Desperate Metal#027.dst: Siento que acabe así, deberías haber ignorado a ese viejo.
Desperate Metal#027.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#029.src: I was made to be angry. I can't stop myself...
Desperate Metal#029.dst: Me crearon para estar furioso. No puedo pararme...
Desperate Metal#029.speaker: Big Boss Mech-DM666

Desperate Metal#031.src: Did you find the source of those odd handmade mechs?
Desperate Metal#031.dst: ¿Diste con el origen de esos mechs hechos a mano?
Desperate Metal#031.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#032.src: Nettik? The Light House owner? It's not overly surprising.
Desperate Metal#032.dst: ¿Nettik? ¿La dueña del faro? No me sorprende demasiado.
Desperate Metal#032.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#033.src: She always did complain about the mech ban.
Desperate Metal#033.dst: Siempre se quejó de la prohibición de los mechs.
Desperate Metal#033.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#034.src: You see, many of the Corkian people rely on their machines. Have done for years.
Desperate Metal#034.dst: Verás, mucha gente corkiana depende de sus máquinas. Desde hace años.
Desperate Metal#034.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#035.src: So when the factory fell and the new laws were introduced, people's lives changed..
Desperate Metal#035.dst: Así que cuando cayó la fábrica y llegaron las nuevas leyes, la vida de la gente cambió..
Desperate Metal#035.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#036.src: People don't like change. Anyway, I can't thank you enough. Have this for your troubles.
Desperate Metal#036.dst: A la gente no le gustan los cambios. En fin, no sé cómo agradecértelo. Toma esto por las molestias.
Desperate Metal#036.speaker: Phinas

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002.src: The report suggests that the two species would compete for space.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002.dst: El informe indica que ambas especies competirían por el espacio.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#003.src: "Public opinion is firmly against removal of the natives..."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#003.dst: "La opinión pública se opone del todo a expulsar a los nativos..."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#005.src: Find out what's happening at the theatre.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#005.dst: Averigua qué pasa en el teatro.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.src: Interesting to see a Human wanting to see a Dwarven play!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.dst: ¡Curioso ver a un humano con ganas de teatro enano!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.src: The only play we're performing is the annual Victory Festival.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.dst: La única obra que representamos es el Festival de la Victoria anual.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#008.src: The entry cost is [{~} Emerald Block]
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#008.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.src: Just take a seat and enjoy the show.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.src: Wait, is that- Hey, {u}! It's so good to see you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#012.src: Hello, to the people of Gavel, glad to see so many here!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#012.dst: ¡Hola, gente de Gavel, me alegra ver a tantos aquí!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#012.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.src: I hope you'll enjoy the play and that it'll be very educational too. I will be tonight's narrator.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.dst: Espero que disfrutéis de la obra y que además sea muy instructiva. Yo seré el narrador de esta noche.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.src: I hope you'll enjoy the play, and that it'll be very educational too. I will be tonight's narrator.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.dst: Espero que disfrutéis de la obra y que además sea muy instructiva. Yo seré el narrador de esta noche.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#016.src: Pheeeew. I think we outran the villagers.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#016.dst: Uuuf. Hemos dejado atrás a los aldeanos.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#016.speaker: Babbi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.src: I think we are safe here in the mountains. Oh look. Shiny ores. This is like a gold mine.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.dst: Creo que aquí en las montañas estamos a salvo. Oh, mira. Minerales brillantes. Esto es una mina de oro.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.speaker: Dwarfi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.src: These nice minerals are very nice, let us start digging.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.dst: Estos bonitos minerales son muy bonitos, pongámonos a cavar.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.speaker: Dwarfi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.src: I am a dangerous monster and I will not let you mine these diamonds. We are the Doguns, and we will kill you!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.dst: Soy un monstruo peligroso y no os dejaré minar estos diamantes. ¡¡Somos los Doguns y os mataremos!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.src: Graoaoro. I will eat you all for my afternoon demon luncheon.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.dst: Graoaoro. Os comeré a todos en mi almuerzo demoníaco de la tarde.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#025.src: MOAHAHAHA. WE WILL KILL ALL OF YOU.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#025.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.src: We need to forge better weapons so we can fight back.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.dst: Hay que forjar mejores armas para poder contraatacar.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.speaker: Babbi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.src: Good idea! We will use our intelligence to slay the demons.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.dst: ¡Buena idea! Usaremos nuestra inteligencia para matar a los demonios.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#028.src: YOU CANNOT BEAT US, WE CAN SUMMON DRAGONS WITH OUR MAGIC.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#028.dst: NO PODÉIS VENCERNOS, INVOCAMOS DRAGONES CON NUESTRA MAGIA.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#028.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.src: Dragons are no match for us?? CHARGE!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.src: We have won. Hooray. And now we have established a great citadel, {p}!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.dst: Hemos ganado. Hurra. ¡Y ahora hemos fundado una gran ciudadela, {p}!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.src: The dwarven intellect beat the sheer power of the demons magic.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.dst: El intelecto enano venció a la pura fuerza de la magia demoníaca.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.src: I hope you enjoyed the show, and learned something new today!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.dst: ¡Espero que disfrutarais del espectáculo y aprendierais algo hoy!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.src: We are continuing the celebration at the old Demon City. Follow the red banners outside {p} to get there.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.dst: Seguimos la fiesta en la vieja Ciudad de los Demonios. Sigue los estandartes rojos fuera de {p} para llegar.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.src: Ugh, that was awful. Don't believe anything you see here, human. History is written by the victors.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.dst: Puf, qué horror. No te creas nada de lo que veas aquí, humano. La historia la escriben los vencedores.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#037.src: Make your way to the Dogun Festival by following the red banners outside {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#037.dst: Ve al Festival de los Doguns siguiendo los estandartes rojos fuera de {p}.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.src: Welcome one and all! Dwarven brothers and sisters, guests and visitors!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.dst: ¡Bienvenidos todos! ¡Hermanos y hermanas enanos, invitados y visitantes!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#039.src: Welcome, one and all! Dwarven brothers and sisters, guests and visitors!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#039.dst: ¡Bienvenidos todos! ¡Hermanos y hermanas enanos, invitados y visitantes!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#039.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#040.src: Axelus! You are under arrest for high treason!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#041.src: The cover crumbles a touch at your grip when you open it up. How old is this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#041.dst: La tapa se desmenuza un poco en tu mano al abrirlo. ¿Cuántos años tiene esto?

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.src: If I could draw your attention to the wooden stage in the north, we can begin.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.dst: Si me prestáis atención al escenario de madera del norte, podemos empezar.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.src: Welcome to the annual festival where we celebrate victory over the foul demons...The Doguns!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.dst: ¡Bienvenidos al festival anual en que celebramos la victoria sobre los viles demonios...los Doguns!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.src: Now, if I can get you to turn around to face the bonfire, we've prepared a lovely firecasting show for you all while we prepare!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.dst: Ahora, si os giráis hacia la hoguera, ¡os hemos preparado un precioso espectáculo de fuego mientras terminamos!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.src: Wow, I didn't know Dwarves could learn such magic! Beats the heck out of firecrackers!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.dst: ¡Vaya, no sabía que los enanos aprendieran esa magia! ¡Le da mil vueltas a los petardos!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.speaker: Mahou

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.src: Magnificent! Thank you very much to our fire casters. Now, ladies and gents, your attention to the main stage please!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.dst: ¡Magnífico! Gracias a nuestros lanzadores de fuego. Y ahora, damas y caballeros, ¡atención al escenario principal!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.src: For the last {~} years we have captured renegade Doguns that escaped the war, and this year is no exception!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.dst: Desde hace {~} años capturamos a los Doguns renegados que huyeron de la guerra, ¡y este año no es excepción!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.src: We shall now entomb the foul demon to join the ranks of the other Doguns on display.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.dst: Ahora sepultaremos a este vil demonio para que se una a los otros Doguns en exposición.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.src: Note its magical might, its aggressive nature, its intense heat, and its fierce appearance.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.dst: Fijaos en su poder mágico, su naturaleza agresiva, su calor intenso y su aspecto feroz.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.src: All no match for the ingenuity and comeradery of the Dwarven nations!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.dst: ¡Nada frente al ingenio y la camaradería de las naciones enanas!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#052.src: M-Monsters... You all...are the demons here...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#052.speaker: Dogun

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.src: Every year, every year, every single YEAR you do this. You all need to open your god-blessed eyes for once!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.dst: Cada año, cada año, todos los AÑOS hacéis esto. ¡Abrid los benditos ojos por una vez!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.src: Do you all really believe everything they tell you? Do you all just lap it up like dogs?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.dst: ¿De verdad os creéis todo lo que os cuentan? ¿¡Lo laméis todo como perros!?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.src: Our side won the war, but does that really mean we were in the right? I'll tell you right now, it doesn't!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.dst: Ganamos la guerra, ¿pero eso significa que teníamos razón? ¡Os lo digo ya, no la teníamos!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.src: We all see it- The Doguns have feelings, family and thoughts, just like anyone else here!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.dst: Todos lo vemos- ¡los Doguns tienen sentimientos, familia e ideas, como cualquiera de aquí!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.src: You are encasing live Doguns for entertainment. Public execution! This twisted display is more demonic than they ever could dream to be!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.dst: Encerráis Doguns vivos por diversión. ¡Una ejecución pública! ¡Este espectáculo retorcido es más demoníaco de lo que ellos podrían soñar!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.src: Guards! Get this propaganda spewing half pint to the Molten Core Prison, north side.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.dst: ¡Guardias! Llevad a este renacuajo propagandista a la Molten Core Prison, lado norte.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.src: Come along, sir. Let's not make more of a scene.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.dst: Acompáñenos, señor. No montemos más escándalo.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.speaker: Dwarven Guard

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.src: Why would Axelus say something so blatantly wrong?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.dst: ¿Por qué diría Axelus algo tan descaradamente falso?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#061.src: What was he talking about? That was all nonsense!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#061.dst: ¿De qué hablaba? ¡Todo eso era un disparate!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#061.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#062.src: Are they really taking him to the Molten Core? You've heard the horror stories about there, right?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#062.dst: ¿De verdad lo llevan al Molten Core? Habrás oído las historias de terror de ese sitio, ¿no?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#062.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.src: Well, the expression 'no hope blows from the north' came from there, since it's on the north side...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.dst: Pues el dicho 'del norte no sopla esperanza' viene de ahí, porque está en el lado norte...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.src: Apologies, all. I shall provide us all with a quick way back to {p} on the floor here. We hope you enjoyed the show, despite the interruption!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.dst: Disculpad todos. Abriré aquí en el suelo un atajo de vuelta a {p}. ¡Esperamos que disfrutarais del espectáculo, pese a la interrupción!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.src: Find out more about the hysterical dwarf in {p}'s prison.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.dst: Averigua más sobre el enano histérico en la prisión de {p}.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.src: I see I got your attention. Interested in the truth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.dst: Veo que capté tu atención. Te interesa la verdad.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.src: I'm no conspiracy nut. The Dwarves have been lied to for hundreds of years about the war.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.dst: No soy un conspiranoico. A los enanos les han mentido siglos sobre la guerra.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.src: I have seen the truth. But my word isn't enough, is it? Seeing is believing, after all.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.dst: Yo he visto la verdad. Pero mi palabra no basta, ¿no? Ver para creer, al fin y al cabo.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#069.src: Hopefully I will see you soon, {u}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#069.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#070.src: Pick up Axelus' note and head to the location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#070.dst: Recoge la nota de Axelus y ve al lugar en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.src: Well, now you have read what I read. The truth...or the lie.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.dst: Bien, ya has leído lo que leí yo. La verdad...o la mentira.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.src: My people are tyrants and conquerors...but they are also good. The people have been brainwashed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.dst: Mi pueblo son tiranos y conquistadores...pero también son buenos. Les han lavado el cerebro.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.src: Many things are about to happen. If you want to know more, come to house number {~} in {p}. I'll be waiting.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.dst: Muchas cosas están por pasar. Si quieres saber más, ven a la casa número {~} de {p}. Te esperaré.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#076.src: Search for house {~} in {p} like Axelus said.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#076.dst: Busca la casa {~} de {p} como dijo Axelus.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#077.src: Talk to Axelus in the Coalition Base.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#077.dst: Habla con Axelus en la base de la coalición.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#078.src: Ah, you made it. Come and meet Korzim
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#078.dst: Ah, has llegado. Ven a conocer a Korzim
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#078.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.src: We...are those who...want peace. I am son...of the Dogun Chief... I have...been banished.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.dst: Somos...los que...queremos paz. Soy hijo...del jefe Dogun... He sido...desterrado.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.src: The coalition is a small group of believers in the truth. The Doguns aren't demons, and the Dwarves aren't all brainwashed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.dst: La coalición es un grupito que cree en la verdad. Los Doguns no son demonios y no todos los enanos tienen el cerebro lavado.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#082.src: But of course, we have to live in hiding. The Doguns won’t tolerate Dwarves and the Dwarves hunt traitors and "Demons".
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#082.dst: Pero claro, vivimos escondidos. Los Doguns no toleran a los enanos y los enanos cazan traidores y "demonios".
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#082.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.src: But of course, we have to live in hiding. The Doguns won't tolerate Dwarves and the Dwarves hunt traitors and "Demons".
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.dst: Pero claro, vivimos escondidos. Los Doguns no toleran a los enanos y los enanos cazan traidores y "demonios".
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#084.src: We would...melt the beds...they sleep in... After all...we are...molten rock.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#084.dst: Derretiríamos...las camas...donde duermen... Al fin...somos...roca fundida.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.src: This hideout was created by the Doguns in minutes, when it would have taken us days!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.dst: ¡Este escondite lo hicieron los Doguns en minutos, y a nosotros nos habría llevado días!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.src: It's a control panel. It's futile to figure out how it works, perhaps brute force is necessary.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.dst: Es un panel de control. Es inútil entender cómo funciona, quizá haga falta la fuerza bruta.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.src: Right now, we're trying to convince the public. But it's proving difficult, if not impossible.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.dst: Ahora intentamos convencer al público. Pero está resultando difícil, si no imposible.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.src: It isn't {~} years ago. We have the technology and supply chains to live here peacefully, but they just won't listen!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.dst: Ya no estamos hace {~} años. Tenemos la tecnología y el suministro para vivir aquí en paz, ¡pero no escuchan!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.src: We have...a plan... To win over...my people...that is.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.dst: Tenemos...un plan... Para ganarnos...a mi pueblo...claro.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.src: Korzim has told us that dragon bone is sacred to his people. We had to make some connections, but we have a way to get it now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.dst: Korzim nos ha dicho que el hueso de dragón es sagrado para su pueblo. Nos costó mover hilos, pero ya podemos conseguirlo.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#091.src: If you want, you could come with us. We can explain more of the situation later. Exit's through the back.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#091.dst: Si quieres, puedes venir con nosotros. Ya te explicaremos más luego. La salida está por detrás.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#091.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#092.src: Follow the group on the mission.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#092.dst: Acompaña al grupo en la misión.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.src: The others...are just up ahead. I'll let you through...our tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.dst: Los demás...están ahí delante. Te dejaré pasar...por nuestro túnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.src: We use.. earth and.. fire.. elements. It is slow... like us.. but powerful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.dst: Usamos.. tierra y.. fuego. Es lento... como nosotros.. pero potente.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.src: We use...earth and...fire...elements. It is slow...like us...but powerful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.dst: Usamos...los elementos...tierra y...fuego. Es lento...como nosotros...pero potente.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#097.src: We don't forbid...you humans to be here, but please leave... We don't want any...unwanted dwarves here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#097.dst: No os prohibimos...estar aquí a los humanos, pero marchaos... No queremos...enanos indeseados aquí.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.src: We got this drill all the way from Corkus. Axelus had to pay a king's ransom to buy it, but this ought to work!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.dst: Trajimos esta perforadora desde Corkus. A Axelus le costó un dineral, ¡pero esto debería funcionar!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#101.src: AAAAGH! Idiot Corkus swindlers! Damn it all! How many emeralds did we waste?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#101.dst: ¡AAAAH! ¡Idiotas estafadores de Corkus! ¿¡Cuántas esmeraldas hemos tirado!?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#101.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.src: Ugh, do you have any experience with machines? You might have some idea of how in the hell to fix this hunk of junk.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.dst: Puf, ¿tienes experiencia con máquinas? Quizá se te ocurra cómo demonios arreglar este montón de chatarra.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.src: Fantastic, {u}! We got the bone! Couldn't have done it without you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.dst: ¡Fantástico, {u}! ¡Tenemos el hueso! Sin ti no habría sido posible.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.src: You can take it back to the coalition base. Barden and I will need to pack up before we join you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.dst: Puedes llevarlo a la base de la coalición. Barden y yo debemos recoger antes de seguirte.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.src: Just knock on the black block in front of the cave we arrived in.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.dst: Solo llama al bloque negro frente a la cueva por la que llegamos.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#106.src: Head back to the Coalition Base through the tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#106.dst: Vuelve a la base de la coalición por el túnel.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.src: Dragon bone is one of the hardest substances in all the provinces. It's extremely rare.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.dst: El hueso de dragón es de lo más duro de todas las provincias. Es rarísimo.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.src: We're going to present this to the Dogun chief as tribute. We need to tidy it up.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.dst: Se lo presentaremos al jefe Dogun como tributo. Hay que adecentarlo.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.src: Could you get [{~} Repair Kit] from the eastern part of the base?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.dst: ¿Puedes traer [{~} Repair Kit] de la parte este de la base?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#112.src: Retrieve the [Repair Kit] in the eastern part of the base.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#112.dst: Recupera el [Repair Kit] en la parte este de la base.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.src: There are voices behind this wall, and the trail ends here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.dst: Hay voces tras este muro, y el rastro acaba aquí.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#115.src: We have no vaults here. Must be traitors... The King really wants to see Axelus.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#115.dst: Aquí no hay cámaras. Serán traidores... El rey tiene muchas ganas de ver a Axelus.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#116.src: Stand back! I'll ready the charges...

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.src: No, no, ignore the repair kit! There's no time to worry about that!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.dst: ¡No, no, olvida el kit de reparación! ¡No hay tiempo para eso!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.src: Our position has been compromised, they blew our doors wide open! We have to evacuate immediately.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.dst: Nos han descubierto, ¡nos han volado las puertas! Hay que evacuar de inmediato.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.src: We've never been caught like this before, they never knew we really had Doguns on our side.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.dst: Nunca nos habían pillado así, jamás supieron que teníamos Doguns de nuestro lado.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.src: We need to get to safety right now! The least explored area is the Upper Heights.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.dst: ¡Hay que ponerse a salvo ya! La zona menos explorada es Upper Heights.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#122.src: Everyone, out! Now! They won't follow through the rough terrain!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#122.dst: ¡Todos fuera! ¡Ya! ¡No nos seguirán por ese terreno escarpado!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#122.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#123.src: Find your way up to the Dogun Village through the tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#123.dst: Sube hasta la aldea Dogun por el túnel.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#124.src: We'll stay around here, we aren't welcome in the village.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#124.dst: Nos quedamos por aquí, en la aldea no nos quieren.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#124.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#125.src: But... bring them... the dragon bone as a gift... If they accept it... they might accept us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#125.dst: Pero... llévales... el hueso de dragón de regalo... Si lo aceptan... quizá nos acepten.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#125.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#126.src: You are free to enter the village but we will stay back and wait until the coast is clear. Keep going.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#126.dst: Puedes entrar en la aldea, pero esperaremos atrás hasta que no haya peligro. Sigue.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#126.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#127.src: What is...that on the...cliff to the south?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#127.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#128.src: What is... that on the... cliff to the south?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#128.dst: ¿Qué es... eso del... acantilado del sur?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#128.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#129.src: Hey, aren't those...Doguns?! A whole settlement...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#129.dst: Eh, ¿¡esos no son... Doguns!? Todo un asentamiento...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#129.speaker: Dwarven Scout

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#130.src: They've been gathering forces! We must inform {p} immediately!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#130.dst: ¡Están reuniendo tropas! ¡Hay que avisar a {p} de inmediato!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#130.speaker: Dwarven Scout

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#131.src: Human. Come talk to me... Now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#131.dst: Humano. Ven a hablar conmigo... Ya.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#131.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#133.src: Human... That Dwarf, he saw us...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#133.dst: Humano... Ese enano nos ha visto...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#133.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#134.src: They will... destroy us... If he reports... back to {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#134.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#135.src: We need to...prepare our defenses. We need all the...help we can get.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#135.dst: Debemos...preparar las defensas. Necesitamos toda la...ayuda posible.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#135.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#136.src: If you want a ticket you'll have to pay me [{~} Emerald Block].
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#136.dst: Si quieres una entrada tendrás que pagarme [{~} bloque de esmeralda].

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#137.src: ...oh Lord, this must be why! D-Doguns?!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#138.src: Several rumours are suggested to be propagated amongst the population.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#138.dst: Se propone difundir varios rumores entre la población.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#139.src: He is consorting with the enemy! Axelus, they've tainted your soul!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#139.dst: ¡Está confraternizando con el enemigo! ¡Axelus, te han manchado el alma!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#140.src: They will...destroy us... If he reports...back to {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#140.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#141.src: "Any war could result in rioting in {p} and other established colonies."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#141.dst: "Cualquier guerra podría causar disturbios en {p} y otras colonias establecidas."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#144.src: We need to... prepare our defenses. We need all the... help we can get.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#144.dst: Debemos... preparar las defensas. Necesitamos toda la... ayuda posible.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#144.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#145.src: Wait... What are... you holding? Dragon bone...? Just what we need...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#145.dst: Espera... ¿Qué llevas... ahí? ¿Hueso de dragón...? Justo lo que necesitamos...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#145.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#146.src: Human... if you promise to help us... I will grant you access to... our secret elevators... You can get up and... down the heights with those.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#146.dst: Humano... si prometes ayudarnos... te daré acceso a... nuestros ascensores secretos... Con ellos podrás subir y... bajar por las Heights.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#146.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#147.src: Please return to... us when you reach level {~}. Take this... badge so the... others recognize you... as an ally. One of the elevators is... to the south.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#147.dst: Vuelve con nosotros... al llegar al nivel {~}. Toma esta... insignia para que los... demás te reconozcan... como aliado. Uno de los ascensores está... al sur.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#147.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#000.src: The Royal Guards escort you and Axelus out of the palace.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#000.dst: Los guardias reales os escoltan a ti y a Axelus fuera del palacio.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001.src: Aval...would have us...leave the Heights... But we...would not survive...in large numbers.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001.dst: Aval...quiere que...dejemos las Heights... Pero no...sobreviviríamos...siendo tantos.

similar.text: Aval... would have us... leave the Heights... But we... would not survive.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#002.src: Return to the Dogun village with a Dogun Badge of Trust and talk to the leader of the town
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#002.dst: Vuelve a la aldea Dogun con un Dogun Badge of Trust y habla con el líder del poblado

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.src: You are so young...to be fighting...a war so old. Still...it is appreciated.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.dst: Eres tan joven...para luchar...una guerra tan vieja. Aun así...lo agradecemos.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#004.src: Why...would we trust... Why...would we trust... you...of all Dwarves?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#004.dst: ¿Por qué...confiar... Por qué...confiar... en ti...entre tantos enanos?

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.src: The war...to you, it would be...ages ago. But...when one has lived for...{~} years...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.dst: La guerra...para ti sería...de hace siglos. Pero...cuando uno ha vivido...{~} años...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007.src: Are you lost? Why would anyone ever come down here?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007.dst: ¿Te has perdido? ¿Quién bajaría aquí por voluntad propia?

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#008.src: We have... few options. We need to discuss... the few we have... available.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#008.dst: Tenemos... pocas opciones. Debemos hablar... de las pocas que... nos quedan.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#008.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#010.src: I am sorry...to welcome you all...in such troubled times.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#010.dst: Lamento...recibiros a todos...en tiempos tan revueltos.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#010.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.src: We thought... we could hide in safety... But there is... no place left to hide.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.dst: Creímos... que podríamos escondernos... Pero ya no... queda dónde esconderse.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#012.src: Aval... would have us... leave the Heights... But we... would not survive.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#012.dst: Aval... quiere que... dejemos las Heights... Pero no... sobreviviríamos.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#012.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.src: We must...evacuate the settlement...immediately. They...are coming...again.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.dst: Debemos...evacuar el asentamiento...de inmediato. Vuelven...a venir...otra vez.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#014.src: [New Quest Started: Dwarves and Doguns Part II]
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#014.dst: [Nueva misión iniciada: Dwarves y Doguns, parte II]

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015.src: If you can get up there you can help yourself to it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015.dst: Si consigues subir ahí, puedes quedártelo.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.src: Please! You all know me, I'm not with the side of the government. Hear me out, we can fix this!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.dst: ¡Por favor! Me conocéis, no estoy del lado del gobierno. ¡Escuchadme, esto tiene arreglo!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.src: Stop! I have been hiding from the Dwarves just as much as anyone here, they've been after me too!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.dst: ¡Alto! Me escondo de los enanos tanto como cualquiera de aquí, ¡a mí también me buscan!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#021.src: Why... would we... trust you... of all Dwarves?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#021.dst: ¿Por qué... confiaríamos... en ti... entre todos los enanos?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#021.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.src: How...could you even help? They...won't listen to you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.src: I know all the war strategies and weapon cache locations.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.dst: Conozco todas las estrategias y los depósitos de armas.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.src: Treason... against your own kind...? How will you... manage this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.dst: ¿Traición... a los tuyos...? ¿Cómo lo... vas a lograr?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025.src: The human and I will sneak into the armoury and sabotage their equipment. Korzim will help you Doguns evacuate someplace safer.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025.dst: El humano y yo nos colaremos en la armería y sabotearemos su equipo. Korzim os ayudará a los Doguns a evacuar a un lugar más seguro.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.src: I am... yet wary of you... but we will... follow your plan... Dwarf. Korzim... lead us... to safety.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.dst: Aún... desconfío de ti... pero seguiremos... tu plan... enano. Korzim... llévanos... a un lugar seguro.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#027.src: {u}, follow the southern road from {p}, towards the {p} entrance. I'll be waiting there for you near the armoury.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#027.dst: {u}, sigue el camino del sur desde {p}, hacia la entrada de {p}. Te esperaré allí, cerca de la armería.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#027.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.src: Shh! Get behind here, and look towards the armoury doors.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.dst: ¡Shh! Ponte aquí detrás y mira hacia las puertas de la armería.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.src: We need to sneak in when they aren't looking, got it? But we need to be fast.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.dst: Hay que colarse cuando no miren, ¿vale? Pero hay que ser rápidos.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.src: If they close that door, we'll only have one option left, and it's a huge risk. Those Dwarven gates are almost unbreakable.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.dst: Si cierran esa puerta, solo nos quedará una opción, y es muy arriesgada. Esos portones enanos son casi irrompibles.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.src: Alright boys, let's close this up and head to base B.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.dst: Muy bien, chicos, cerremos esto y vamos a la base B.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.speaker: Rodoroc Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.src: Aaah! Charge them! HEY, STOP RIGHT THERE, SOLDIERS!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#034.src: Defeat the {p} Guards outside the armory.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#034.dst: Derrota a los guardias de {p} frente a la armería.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#035.src: It's the traitor! Capture them, now! There's only one reason they would be near the armoury!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#035.dst: ¡Es el traidor! ¡Capturadlos ya! ¡Solo hay un motivo para estar cerca de la armería!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#035.speaker: Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#036.src: Is that all of them? We're out of danger, at least, but they still shut the door, damn it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#036.dst: ¿Son todos? Al menos estamos a salvo, ¡pero cerraron la puerta, maldita sea!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#036.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.src: Gah, all that for nothing! You're not too banged up, are you?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.dst: ¡Bah, todo para nada! No estás muy magullado, ¿verdad?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.src: Well, I said there's another way, but it's not a guarantee. Hurry, follow me.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.dst: Dije que hay otra vía, pero no es segura. Deprisa, sígueme.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#039.src: Urgh, damn it. They almost never bother to close this door, and now of all times...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#039.dst: Uf, maldita sea. Casi nunca se molestan en cerrar esta puerta, y justo hoy...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#039.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#040.src: There's nothing for it. They'll be sending reinforcements soon, we need a way through here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#040.dst: No hay más remedio. Pronto enviarán refuerzos, necesitamos pasar por aquí.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#040.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.src: Those black bricks look breakable...but that won't solve the door, will it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.dst: Esos ladrillos negros parecen frágiles...pero no resuelven la puerta, ¿no?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#042.src: Find a way to break through the black bricks outside the wooden door.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#042.dst: Encuentra la forma de romper los ladrillos negros junto a la puerta de madera.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.src: Alright, let's destroy these machines! You see the two cannons?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.dst: ¡Bien, destruyamos estas máquinas! ¿Ves los dos cañones?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.src: If you use rocks as ammo, you'll destroy the machine it's aiming at, but if you use tnt, it'll selfdestruct. Good luck
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.dst: Con rocas de munición destruirás la máquina a la que apunte; con tnt, se autodestruirá. Suerte
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#046.src: Follow Axelus deeper into {p} and destroy the power source of the city, the {p} Power Core.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#046.dst: Sigue a Axelus al interior de {p} y destruye la fuente de energía de la ciudad, el {p} Power Core.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.src: Nice work! That will slow them down. We're not done yet, we need to pay the king a visit. Let's head further into {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.dst: ¡Buen trabajo! Eso los frenará. No hemos acabado, hay que visitar al rey. Vamos más adentro de {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#048.src: Hurry! Through here, to the power core!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#048.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#049.src: This is a geothermal power core. If we can disrupt it, it should slow them down.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#049.dst: Es un núcleo geotérmico. Si lo alteramos, debería frenarlos.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#049.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.src: The hypocrites used Dogun magic to make this... It's lucky, honestly. I know how to work it.
