Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.dst: Los hipócritas usaron magia Dogun para esto... Es una suerte, la verdad. Sé manejarlo.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.src: ...hell, they already rallied?! That's the army!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.dst: ...¿¡demonios, ya se han reunido!? ¡Es el ejército!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.src: That sounds like an entire battalion!! How did they know I was going after this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.dst: ¡¡Suena a un batallón entero!! ¿Cómo sabían que iba a por esto?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#053.src: Dogun magic is slow! Keep me defended, this'll take awhile!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#053.dst: ¡La magia Dogun es lenta! ¡Protégeme, esto llevará un rato!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#053.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.src: Grr, this is harder than I thought!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.dst: ¡Grr, es más difícil de lo que creía!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.src: Ah! Don't let them get too close!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.src: I hate that you're having to fight my people, but I wouldn't be asking for help if it weren't needed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.dst: Odio que tengas que luchar contra mi pueblo, pero no pediría ayuda si no hiciera falta.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#058.src: Hm...the slums should be behind this wall here. We'll lose them there.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#058.dst: Mmm...los barrios bajos están tras este muro. Allí los despistaremos.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#058.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.src: The power's down, but...that cannon should do to get us through. You know how to operate it, right?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.dst: No hay energía, pero...ese cañón debería abrirnos paso. Sabes usarlo, ¿verdad?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.src: Dwarvern society isn't as great as they make it out to be. The poorest are hidden away.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.dst: La sociedad enana no es tan maravillosa como la pintan. A los más pobres los esconden.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#062.src: The coalition has helped these people through some hard times, we can trust them.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#062.dst: La coalición ayudó a esta gente en tiempos duros, podemos confiar en ellos.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#062.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.src: There's a reason I brought us here. The sewer system is connected to the royal palace. All the way to the kings bathroom.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.dst: Os he traído aquí por algo. El alcantarillado conecta con el palacio real. Llega hasta el baño del rey.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#064.src: We need to find a way to ignite this explosive. Can you take a look around?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#064.dst: Hay que encontrar cómo encender este explosivo. ¿Echas un vistazo?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#064.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#065.src: Find a way to enter the sewer system.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#065.dst: Encuentra la forma de entrar en el alcantarillado.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#066.src: If we can convince the king that it’s not worth the fight, he may back down.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#066.dst: Si convencemos al rey de que no merece la pena, quizá ceda.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#066.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#067.src: I'm a little ashamed to admit I know my way round the sewers by now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#067.dst: Me da algo de vergüenza, pero ya me conozco las alcantarillas.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#067.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#068.src: You have to understand.. The people truly think the Doguns are evil incarnate. But the king knows better.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#068.dst: Tienes que entenderlo.. La gente cree de verdad que los Doguns son el mal. Pero el rey sabe la verdad.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#068.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#069.src: Enter the Royal Palace through the sewer pipe and find the king.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#069.dst: Entra en el Palacio Real por la tubería de las alcantarillas y encuentra al rey.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#070.src: Don't let the guards catch you. Stay out of sight, got it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#070.dst: No dejes que te pillen los guardias. No te dejes ver, ¿vale?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#070.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#071.src: Sneak past the guards and talk to the Dwarven King.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#071.dst: Esquiva a los guardias y habla con el rey enano.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#072.src: I can't say I'm surprised, Axelus. Guards, let them be.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#072.dst: No diré que me sorprende, Axelus. Guardias, dejadlos.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#072.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#073.src: You know why I'm here, father. We haven't got any more chances to stop this.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#073.dst: Sabes por qué estoy aquí, padre. No habrá más ocasiones de parar esto.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#073.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#074.src: Axelus, you know why we have to maintain the lie. Think about the people, how they would react.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#074.dst: Axelus, sabes por qué debemos mantener la mentira. Piensa en el pueblo, en cómo reaccionaría.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#074.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#075.src: We can not be responsible for the lies of our ancestors! This is ridiculous and you know it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#075.dst: ¡No podemos cargar con las mentiras de nuestros antepasados! ¡Es ridículo y lo sabes!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#075.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#076.src: Axelus, if the people found out, everything would descend to chaos. There would be riots, revolutions!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#076.dst: Axelus, si el pueblo lo supiera, todo caería en el caos. ¡Habría disturbios, revoluciones!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#076.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#077.src: If you hadn't turned traitor and gone gallivanting off with the Doguns, you would be in a better position to convince me.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#077.dst: Si no te hubieras vuelto un traidor ni te hubieras ido de correrías con los Doguns, estarías en mejor posición para convencerme.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#077.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#078.src: As it is now, you are too little and too late. The war has already begun.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#078.dst: Tal como están las cosas, llegas tarde y con poco. La guerra ya ha empezado.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#078.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#079.src: The armoury that a certain someone decided to sabotage won't make any difference.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#079.dst: La armería que cierta persona decidió sabotear no cambiará nada.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#079.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#080.src: You will commit genocide so you don't have to face the consequences of your lies?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#080.dst: ¿Cometerás un genocidio para no afrontar las consecuencias de tus mentiras?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#080.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#081.src: I will be the hero of our nation, and my name will forever be remembered as the King who brought peace.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#081.dst: Seré el héroe de nuestra nación y se me recordará por siempre como el rey que trajo la paz.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#081.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#082.src: I have nothing left to say to you. See yourselves out behind the throne. I'll let you use the trading tunnel to {p} in the southern caves, if you just step back and let me handle things.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#082.dst: No me queda nada que decirte. Salid vosotros mismos por detrás del trono. Os dejaré usar el túnel comercial a {p} de las cuevas del sur, si te apartas y me dejas ocuparme de esto.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#082.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#084.src: I'm not giving up on this. I'm going back in, I know he can be reasoned with!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#084.dst: No voy a rendirme. Voy a volver a entrar, ¡sé que se le puede convencer!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#084.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#085.src: Give this letter to Korzim in the Dogun village when you reach level {~}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#085.dst: Dale esta carta a Korzim en la aldea Dogun al llegar al nivel {~}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#085.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#086.src: I'm going to have one last talk with my father.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#086.dst: Voy a hablar por última vez con mi padre.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#086.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#000.src: {u}...I take back my statement. They have already begun... There cannot be reasoning.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#000.dst: {u}... Retiro lo dicho. Ya han empezado... No hay forma de razonar con ellos.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#001.src: A door slamming open is heard in the distance...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#001.dst: A lo lejos se oye una puerta abrirse de golpe...

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#002.src: Return to the Dogun Village with the letter and speak to Korzim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#002.dst: Vuelve al poblado Dogun con la carta y habla con Korzim.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#003.src: We...have an issue. A dire one... Where is...Axelus at a time...like this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#003.dst: Tenemos... un problema. Grave... ¿Dónde está Axelus... en un momento así?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#003.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#005.src: Oh... From Axelus, then...? He could not find...a stone? That...does not bode well.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#005.dst: Ah... ¿De Axelus, entonces...? ¿No pudo encontrar... una piedra? Eso... no augura nada bueno.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#005.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#006.src: He is trying to...reason with the Dwarven King? There is...no one else...then. You... You will have to...help.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#006.dst: ¿Pretende... razonar con el Rey de los Dwarves? Entonces... no hay nadie más. Tú... tendrás que... ayudar.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#006.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#007.src: The chieftain is...desperate. He has enacted a...terrible plan. They are planning on summoning Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#007.dst: El jefe está... desesperado. Ha puesto en marcha un... plan terrible. Van a invocar a Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#007.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#008.src: If they succeed...we all die. Dwarves... Doguns... Possibly even Villagers...and then... Humans as well.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#008.dst: Si lo logran... morimos todos. Dwarves... Doguns... Puede que hasta los aldeanos... y luego... los humanos.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#008.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#009.src: Garaheth is a...horrible demon. We used to worship him...thousands of years ago.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#009.dst: Garaheth es un... demonio atroz. Lo adorábamos... hace miles de años.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#009.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#010.src: I only overheard parts... But enough to be certain. They are preparing...to the south. At a disused...ritual site.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#010.dst: Solo oí fragmentos... Pero bastan para estar seguro. Se preparan... al sur. En un... sitio ritual abandonado.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#010.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#011.src: Meet me there... Do not just attack. We may be able to...resolve it peacefully. I will wait...by the staircase.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#011.dst: Nos vemos allí... No ataques sin más. Quizá podamos... resolverlo en paz. Te espero... junto a la escalera.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#011.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#012.src: Investigate the structure to the south.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#013.src: We shall take the east tower... Hide there...and watch.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#013.dst: Iremos a la torre este... Escóndete allí... y observa.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#013.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#014.src: Interrupting...at this point will have...disastrous consequences. We must let them continue...and pray they fail.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#014.dst: Interrumpir... ahora tendría... consecuencias desastrosas. Hay que dejarles seguir... y rezar por que fallen.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#014.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#015.src: Reach into the darkness...and grasp the hand of Garaheth to purge the intruders...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#015.dst: Adentraos en la oscuridad... y tomad la mano de Garaheth para purgar a los intrusos...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#015.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#016.src: This is a worst-case scenario... Meet me in {p}. We will talk more there...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#016.dst: Es el peor escenario posible... Nos vemos en {p}. Allí hablamos más...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#016.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#017.src: Travel to {p} and meet Korzim at the entrance. [{~},-{~}]
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#017.dst: Viaja a {p} y reúnete con Korzim en la entrada. [{~},-{~}]

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#018.src: Hoho...! Over here...fine traveler! Join me at the gates!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#018.dst: ¡Jojo...! ¡Por aquí... buen viajero! ¡Ven conmigo a las puertas!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#018.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#019.src: This dwarf voice is...horrible on my throat...but it is an effective disguise...is it not?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#019.dst: Esta voz de Dwarf es... horrible para mi garganta... pero el disfraz funciona... ¿no crees?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#019.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#020.src: We are headed to...a blacksmith in town. Follow me...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#020.dst: Vamos a ver... a un herrero del pueblo. Sígueme...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#020.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#021.src: Talk to the blacksmith in {p} at {~} {~} -{~}
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#021.dst: Habla con el herrero de {p} en {~} {~} -{~}

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#022.src: ...Korzim...what in the name of all that is holy is that disguise?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#022.dst: ...Korzim... ¿qué demonios es ese disfraz, por todos los santos?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#022.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#023.src: I'm flabbergasted you fooled anyone with that thing! How did you stop the beard from burning?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#023.dst: ¡No me puedo creer que hayas engañado a alguien con eso! ¿Cómo evitaste que la barba ardiera?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#023.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#024.src: But, erm...more importantly, who's the buck in the fancy armour there?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#024.dst: Pero, eh... lo importante: ¿quién viene con esa armadura tan elegante?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#024.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#025.src: An ally...of the coalition. No time...Edula. Doguns... summoning... Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#025.dst: Un aliado... de la coalición. Sin tiempo, Edula. Doguns... invocan... a Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#025.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#026.src: So...so it's really down to that low, then. Burning your own house down to kill the rats.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#026.dst: Así que... así que hemos caído tan bajo. Quemar tu propia casa para matar a las ratas.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#026.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#027.src: Good thing we've got this prepared. One fallout will prevent the next. Soldier, I've got a list of materials we need!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#027.dst: Menos mal que teníamos esto listo. Un desastre evitará el siguiente. ¡Soldado, tengo una lista de materiales!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#027.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#028.src: You will need [{~} Fire Webs]. The Heatscar Spiders under the town make them, there's a cave right by the entrance arch.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#028.dst: Necesitarás [{~} Fire Webs]. Las Heatscar Spiders de debajo del pueblo las tejen; hay una cueva junto al arco de entrada.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#028.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#029.src: Then, [{~} Magmatic Crystals] from the {p} mines. I'd get them myself, but...I'm banned from there since the rubber mallet incident.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#029.dst: Luego, [{~} Magmatic Crystals] de las minas de {p}. Iría yo, pero... tengo la entrada prohibida desde el incidente del mazo de goma.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#029.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#030.src: Lastly, [{~} Crystallized Lava]. The closest source is in the lava lake just outside {p}. There's a protruding crater in the lake.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#030.dst: Por último, [{~} Crystallized Lava]. Lo más cercano está en el lago de lava junto a {p}. Hay un cráter que sobresale en el lago.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#030.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#031.src: Bring back [{~} Fire Webs], [{~} Magmatic Crystals], and [{~} Crystallized lava].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#031.dst: Trae [{~} Fire Webs], [{~} Magmatic Crystals] y [{~} Crystallized lava].

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#032.src: The crystal formation... It is definitely here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#032.dst: La formación de cristal... Está aquí, sin duda.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#032.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#033.src: I will clear the lava... On my signal, move. And do not stop.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#033.dst: Yo despejaré la lava... A mi señal, corre. Y no pares.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#033.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#035.src: Mhm, looks like everything's in order. Now, for a short explanation.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#035.dst: Mmm, parece que está todo. Ahora, una breve explicación.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#035.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#036.src: These materials go into crafting a special charm. It will allow you to resist demon fire.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#036.dst: Con estos materiales se fabrica un amuleto especial. Te permitirá resistir el fuego demoníaco.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#036.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#037.src: We need to account for if they finish the summoning, so this'll help keep you safe if you end up having to square off with Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#037.dst: Hay que contar con que completen la invocación, así que esto te protegerá si acabas enfrentándote a Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#037.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#038.src: You will need to craft it yourself, so its magic will bond to you. I've got a station just for it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#038.dst: Tendrás que fabricarlo tú, para que su magia se ligue a ti. Tengo una mesa justo para eso.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#038.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#039.src: Right-click the crafting table in the back and put it together.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#039.dst: Haz clic derecho en la mesa de trabajo del fondo y móntalo.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#039.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#040.src: Craft the amulet in the crafting table.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#040.dst: Fabrica el amuleto en la mesa de trabajo.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#041.src: We must... visit... Sanba... the enchanter.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#041.dst: Debemos... visitar... a Sanba... la encantadora.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#041.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#042.src: Go to the enchanter and enchant the amulet.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#042.dst: Ve con la encantadora y encanta el amuleto.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#043.src: Erm...Korzim, what on earth are you doing here? It's not safe for you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#043.dst: Eh... Korzim, ¿qué diablos haces aquí? ¡No es seguro para ti!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#043.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#044.src: Wait, that amulet...oh no, really? Okay, I know what^s going on.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#044.dst: Espera, ese amuleto... ay no, ¿en serio? Vale, ya sé qué pasa.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#044.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#045.src: We're going to need to give this a little extra kick if you're going to use this for what I think you are.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#045.dst: Vamos a tener que darle un empujón extra si lo vas a usar para lo que creo.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#045.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#046.src: A pinch of fire scarab tail, splash of sulphur, exactly three ounces of old brimstone...!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#046.dst: ¡Una pizca de cola de escarabajo de fuego, un chorro de azufre y tres onzas justas de piedra sulfurosa añeja...!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#046.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#047.src: Infunde hoc monile, alta intra monte. Magia!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#047.dst: Infunde hoc monile, alta intra monte. Magia!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#047.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#048.src: Meet me in the back, we can't talk out here. You never know who's listening...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#048.dst: Ven a la trastienda, aquí no podemos hablar. Nunca sabes quién escucha...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#048.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#049.src: Enter the storage room in the enchanter's house.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#049.dst: Entra en el almacén de la casa de la encantadora.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#050.src: Supposing you're here to help, Soldier. Garaheth's being summoned if you're getting this...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#050.dst: Supongo que vienes a ayudar, soldado. Si tienes esto, es que están invocando a Garaheth...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#050.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#051.src: Axelus prepped a contingency plan for this, but having to put it in action is surreal. Let me fill you in.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#051.dst: Axelus preparó un plan de emergencia para esto, pero tener que usarlo es surrealista. Te pongo al día.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#051.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#052.src: That dragon skeleton lying in the Heights belonged to an Ice Drake. Centuries ago, it was used in the Dogun wars.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#052.dst: Ese esqueleto de dragón de las Heights era de un Ice Drake. Hace siglos lo usaron en las guerras Dogun.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#052.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#053.src: It had incredibly potent magic, particularly in its icy breath. The area it hit is still frozen to this day, and shows no signs of thaw.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#053.dst: Tenía una magia potentísima, sobre todo en su aliento helado. La zona que alcanzó sigue congelada hoy, sin señal de deshielo.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#053.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#054.src: According to Axelus' stories, its breath travelled through the tunnels and coalesced someplace deep within...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#054.dst: Según cuenta Axelus, su aliento recorrió los túneles y se condensó en algún punto de las profundidades...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#054.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#055.src: ...becoming True Ice, a potent mixture of sheer cold and magic energy. That's what we will need to combat Garaheth.'
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#055.dst: ...convirtiéndose en True Ice, una mezcla potente de frío puro y energía mágica. Eso necesitamos contra Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#055.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#056.src: If you bring me [{~} True Ice] I can make a staff capable of harnessing it...and we can freeze Garaheth in its tracks.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#056.dst: Si me traes [{~} True Ice], podré hacer un bastón capaz de canalizarlo... y congelaremos a Garaheth en el sitio.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#056.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#057.src: If you bring me [{~} True Ice] I can make a staff capable of harnessing it...and we can freeze Garahath in its tracks.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#057.dst: Si me traes [{~} True Ice], podré hacer un bastón capaz de canalizarlo... y congelaremos a Garaheth en el sitio.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#057.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#058.src: Me and my husband will support the coalition as long as we live.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#058.dst: Mi marido y yo apoyaremos a la coalición mientras vivamos.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#059.src: Head north to the Freezing Heights and make your way to the top, now! We've got no time at all!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#059.dst: ¡Ve al norte, a las Freezing Heights, y sube hasta arriba, ya! ¡No tenemos nada de tiempo!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#059.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#060.src: Travel to the frozen heights and find {~} True Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#060.dst: Viaja a las alturas heladas y consigue {~} True Ice.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#061.src: ... This... This used to be...a Dogun town. The Dwarves rendered it barren.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#061.dst: ... Esto... Esto era... un pueblo Dogun. Los Dwarves lo dejaron yermo.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#061.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#062.src: They used the Drake... They chained it up and...forced it to attack. We had to kill it...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#062.dst: Usaron al Drake... Lo encadenaron y... lo obligaron a atacar. Tuvimos que matarlo...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#062.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#063.src: It... froze my town... as it died. I was there... {~} years ago.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#063.dst: Al morir... congeló mi pueblo. Yo estaba allí... hace {~} años.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#063.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#064.src: I know the way... into the caves.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#064.dst: Conozco el camino... a las cuevas.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#064.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#065.src: The True Ice...is deep inside. I will struggle to...stay warm here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#065.dst: El True Ice... está al fondo. Me costará... mantener el calor aquí.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#065.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#066.src: I will try to run through...as quickly as possible. The ice is...painful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#066.dst: Intentaré cruzar... lo más rápido posible. El hielo... duele.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#066.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#067.src: We must... move fast... or... we will both.... freeze.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#067.dst: Debemos... ir rápido... o... los dos nos... congelaremos.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#067.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#068.src: Maybe... I am... hotter than... I thought... do you.. Hear that?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#068.dst: Quizá... esté... más caliente... de lo que creía... ¿oyes... eso?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#068.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#069.src: Oh no... I think... It's... COLLAPSING.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#069.dst: Ay no... Creo... que se... DERRUMBA.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#069.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#070.src: My... feet are... solid... Keep... running.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#070.dst: Mis... pies están... duros... Sigue... corriendo.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#070.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#071.src: This is it... The thing that... Killed my families... [{~} True Ice].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#071.dst: Es esto... Lo que... mató a los míos... [{~} True Ice].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#071.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#072.src: Return to the enchanter with the True Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#072.dst: Lleva el True Ice de vuelta a la encantadora.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#073.src: Impressive, you two. Must've been tough to get that...doubly so for Korzim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#073.dst: Impresionante, vosotros dos. No sería fácil... y para Korzim, el doble.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#073.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#074.src: Impressive, you two. Must have been tough to get that...doubly so for Korzim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#074.dst: Impresionante, vosotros dos. No sería fácil... y para Korzim, el doble.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#074.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#075.src: Here is the staff, {u}. Keep it safe, and don't you go dying on us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#075.dst: Aquí tienes el bastón, {u}. Cuídalo, y no se te ocurra morirte.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#075.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#076.src: My husband and I will round up the coalition and get them to act now. We need to get going before-
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#076.dst: Mi marido y yo reuniremos a la coalición para que actúen ya. Tenemos que salir antes de-
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#076.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#077.src: ...that's the barracks door. That's the barracks door!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#077.dst: ...es la puerta de los barracones. ¡¡Es la puerta de los barracones!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#077.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#078.src: Men! We have to meet for briefing on the surface, the war is due any hour now! Move faster!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#078.dst: ¡Soldados! ¡Reunión de instrucciones en la superficie, la guerra empieza en cualquier momento! ¡Más rápido!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#078.speaker: Maex Soldier

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#079.src: They're already going?! We're out of time! Korzim is waiting for you just upstairs when you reach level {~}. Go train! NOW!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#079.dst: ¿¡Ya salen!? ¡Se nos acaba el tiempo! Korzim te espera arriba cuando llegues al nivel {~}. ¡A entrenar! ¡YA!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#079.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#000.src: Quiet. Dwarven whelp...you have failed... We will not go quietly. AWAKEN.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#000.dst: Silencio. Mocoso Dwarf... fracasaste... No nos iremos callados. DESPIERTA.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#001.src: {u}... Do you have...the staff? And the amulet...?

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#003.src: Return to Korzim on the second floor of the enchanter in {p} with the Amulet of Fire Resistance and the Staff of True Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#003.dst: Vuelve con Korzim al segundo piso de la casa de la encantadora en {p} con el Amulet of Fire Resistance y el Staff of True Ice.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#004.src: ...Do you have...the staff? And the amulet...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#004.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#005.src: The war is starting... and Axelus... He has not returned.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#005.dst: La guerra empieza... y Axelus... no ha vuelto.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#005.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#006.src: We can not go... Not without him. Find him... And bring him to the... Dogun village.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#006.dst: No podemos ir... No sin él. Encuéntralo... y tráelo al... poblado Dogun.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#006.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#007.src: I can not leave. The guard...it is on high alert. He was last at {p}...yes?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#007.dst: Yo no puedo salir. La guardia... está en alerta. Estuvo en {p}... ¿verdad?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#007.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#008.src: Head to {p} and look for Axelus.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#008.dst: Ve a {p} y busca a Axelus.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#009.src: The first group has already started their climb, let's hurry.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#009.dst: El primer grupo ya ha empezado a subir, démonos prisa.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#009.speaker: Soldier

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#010.src: Hey! Everyone, the king has someone in the cage! It's been years since we used it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#010.dst: ¡Eh! ¡Mirad todos, el rey ha metido a alguien en la jaula! ¡Hacía años que no se usaba!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#010.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#011.src: Wait, that's Axelus up there!! The king locked up his son?! What in the world?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#011.dst: ¡¡Pero si es Axelus!! ¿¡El rey encierra a su hijo!? ¿Qué demonios pasa?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#011.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#012.src: I heard he was consorting with demons, but that can't possibly be true, can it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#012.dst: Oí que trataba con demonios, pero eso no puede ser verdad, ¿no?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#012.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#013.src: For the last time, they are not demons!! Gods, I've been telling you this whole time! Not even my father will listen to reason!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#013.dst: ¡¡Por última vez, no son demonios!! ¡Dioses, llevo todo este tiempo diciéndolo! ¡Ni siquiera mi padre atiende a razones!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#013.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#014.src: If I don't get freed we're doomed, you hear me?! We won't survive another war! As your prince I demand to be freed!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#014.dst: ¡Si no me soltáis, estamos perdidos! ¿Me oís? ¡No aguantaremos otra guerra! ¡Como vuestro príncipe, exijo salir!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#014.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#015.src: Listen, the statues are climbable and there's a control panel for the lava siphons near them! Now help me so we all don't die!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#015.dst: ¡Escucha, se puede trepar por las estatuas y al lado hay un panel de control de los sifones de lava! ¡Ayúdame o moriremos todos!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#015.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#016.src: Free Axelus and escape the city.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#016.dst: Libera a Axelus y huye de la ciudad.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#017.src: Wait, that human just defaced the hero's monument!! Are they working with the demons too?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#017.dst: ¡¡Espera, ese humano ha destrozado el monumento al héroe!! ¿También está con los demonios?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#017.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#018.src: {u}! I didn't think you'd be back, but we need to leave, now! Meet me outside!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#018.dst: ¡{u}! No creí que volvieras, ¡pero tenemos que irnos ya! ¡Nos vemos fuera!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#018.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#019.src: {u}! Over here, to the right! By the cannon! I'm commandeering this thing.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#019.dst: ¡{u}! ¡Aquí, a la derecha! ¡Junto al cañón! Requiso este trasto.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#019.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#020.src: We need to get up to the Doguns before the Dwarves begin their assault, or before the Doguns take their last resort.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#020.dst: Tenemos que llegar a los Doguns antes de que los Dwarves ataquen o de que los Doguns den su último paso.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#020.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#021.src: Get in the cannon, now! You've got your armour, you might end up charred and covered in soot but you'll be fine!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#021.dst: ¡Métete en el cañón, ya! Llevas armadura; acabarás hecho un tizón y lleno de hollín, pero sobrevivirás.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#021.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#022.src: Don't tell anyone we shot ourselves out of a cannon, I'll never live it down. Now come on, to the Dogun village, hurry!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#022.dst: No le cuentes a nadie que salimos disparados de un cañón, no lo superaría. ¡Vamos, al poblado Dogun, rápido!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#022.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#023.src: If the Doguns are taking their last resort and summoning Garaheth, then we've got two sides to stop at once...basically, the odds are astronomically against us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#023.dst: Si los Doguns dan su último paso e invocan a Garaheth, tendremos que frenar a dos bandos a la vez... vamos, que las probabilidades están astronómicamente en nuestra contra.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#023.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#024.src: That means you do what you need to do, no matter what. Understood? If we can stop this madness then the casualties won't have died for nothing! Now move!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#024.dst: Eso significa que harás lo que haga falta, pase lo que pase. ¿Entendido? ¡Si frenamos esta locura, los caídos no habrán muerto en vano! ¡Vamos!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#024.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#025.src: Reach the portal and stop Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#025.dst: Llega al portal y detén a Garaheth.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#027.src: Quiet. Dwarven whelp...we will not go quietly. AWAKEN.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#027.dst: Silencio, mocoso Dwarf... no nos iremos callados. DESPIERTA.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#027.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#028.src: I can't believe this... That bone was part of the ritual?! Agh, how could we have been so STUPID! You're all lucky we prepared for this!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#028.dst: No me lo puedo creer... ¿¡El hueso era parte del ritual!? ¡Agh, cómo pudimos ser tan ESTÚPIDOS! ¡¡Suerte tenéis de que nos preparásemos!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#028.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#029.src: You need to get inside him. He's still chained! The amulet will protect you from the heat! Freeze him from the inside out!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#029.dst: Tienes que meterte dentro de él. ¡Sigue encadenado! ¡El amuleto te protegerá del calor! ¡¡Congélalo desde dentro!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#029.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#030.dst: Entra en el cuerpo de Garaheth.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#031.src: Find all {~} organs and destroy them.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#032.src: Leave Garaheth and exit his realm.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#032.dst: Sal de Garaheth y abandona su reino.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#033.src: EVERYONE, STOP THIS! RIGHT NOW!! IT'S OVER!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#033.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#034.src: Open your eyes for once in your lives!! You see that?! Behind me! THAT was going to be the end result!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#034.dst: ¡¡Abrid los ojos por una vez en la vida!! ¿¡Veis eso!? ¡Detrás de mí! ¡ESE iba a ser el resultado final!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#034.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#035.src: Garaheth would have killed every one of us, damn it! Are you that short-sighted that you can't see this?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#035.dst: ¡Garaheth nos habría matado a todos, maldita sea! ¿Tan cortos de miras sois que no lo veis?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#035.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#036.src: Everyone here is to blame, except the human who helped stop this! The Doguns were already exiled, they wouldn't have hurt anyone!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#036.dst: ¡Aquí la culpa es de todos, menos del humano que ayudó a impedirlo! ¡Los Doguns ya estaban exiliados, no habrían hecho daño a nadie!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#036.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#037.src: But we couldn't just let ANYTHING be! You always need more glory, more, more, MORE! Don't you, Draani? I'm ashamed to be your lineage!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#037.dst: ¡Pero no podíamos dejar NADA en paz! ¡Siempre más gloria, más, más, MÁS! ¿Verdad, Draani? ¡Me avergüenza ser de tu linaje!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#037.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#038.src: And you, Doguns! I...I pitied you. You were wronged, but you resort to this? You'd doom the world over to spite the Dwarves? Is that it?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#038.dst: ¡Y vosotros, Doguns! Yo... os compadecía. Fuisteis agraviados, ¿y recurrís a esto? ¿Condenaríais al mundo por vengaros de los Dwarves? ¿Es eso?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#038.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#039.src: Whelp. You do not understand. To be persecuted...and see your people tortured...hunted.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#039.dst: Mocoso. No lo entiendes. Ser perseguidos... y ver a los tuyos torturados... cazados.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#039.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#040.src: You all deserve it! You attacked our ancestors for sport! Eye for an eye, have you heard of it? It's only fair!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#040.dst: ¡Os lo merecéis! ¡Atacasteis a nuestros ancestros por deporte! Ojo por ojo, ¿os suena? ¡Es lo justo!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#040.speaker: Dwarven Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#041.src: Imbeciles...your stories are not true. We... We lived through the war. You took everything...and suffered none.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#041.dst: Imbéciles... vuestras historias mienten. Nosotros... vivimos la guerra. Lo tomasteis todo... sin sufrir nada.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#041.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#042.src: I've been trying to tell BOTH of you that the monarchy has been spreading lies for centuries! One bad king doesn't mean the whole species is a loss!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#042.dst: ¡Llevo intentando deciros a AMBOS que la monarquía lleva siglos difundiendo mentiras! ¡Un mal rey no condena a toda una especie!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#042.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#043.src: Shut your mouth. Even now...you trample on the bones of our god... You have taken everything from us...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#043.dst: Cierra la boca. Incluso ahora... pisoteáis los huesos de nuestro dios... Nos lo habéis quitado todo...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#043.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#044.src: This earth is stained by you. We...we shall burn you...and scatter your ash to the wind.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#044.dst: Esta tierra está manchada por vosotros. Nosotros... os quemaremos... y esparciremos vuestras cenizas al viento.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#044.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#045.src: DON'T YOU DARE! STOP, RIGHT NOW!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#045.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#048.src: You would... You would kill a savior...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#048.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#049.src: No, no! No no no, this can't be happening! H-Hang on, we'll save you, I...I'll do something, I...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#049.dst: ¡No, no! ¡No no no, esto no puede estar pasando! A-aguanta, te salvaremos, yo... yo haré algo, yo...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#049.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#050.src: Y-You DEMONS! MONSTERS! I'll avenge you, Axelus, j-just give me time-
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#050.dst: ¡M-malditos DEMONIOS! ¡MONSTRUOS! Te vengaré, Axelus, s-solo dadme tiempo-
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#050.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#051.src: AGH, SHUT UP! SHUT...ack... Q-Quiet. Listen to one damn word from my mouth, Draani... For once in your miserable life
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#051.dst: ¡AGH, CÁLLATE! CÁLL... ack... S-silencio. Escucha una maldita palabra mía, Draani... Por una vez en tu miserable vida
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#051.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#052.src: Tell. The. TRUTH!! G-gaagh...you know that's th...the only way to stop this. Swallow your pride, you...old fool...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#052.dst: Di. La. ¡¡VERDAD!! G-gaagh... sabes que es la... la única forma de parar esto. Traga tu orgullo, viejo... necio...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#052.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#053.src: I...I... Axelus... He...he called me Draani...why did...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#053.dst: Yo... yo... Axelus... Me... me llamó Draani... ¿por qué...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#053.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#054.src: Men, stand down. This... This war is over! I will not have one more life lost! Touch the Doguns and I'll personally behead you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#054.dst: Soldados, deponed las armas. Esta... ¡esta guerra ha terminado! ¡No perderé ni una vida más! ¡Quien toque a los Doguns será decapitado por mí!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#054.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#055.src: Chief, I...I ask of you but an hour of your time. If you are willing to negotiate...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#055.dst: Jefe, yo... solo le pido una hora de su tiempo. Si está dispuesto a negociar...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#055.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#056.src: Speak with the King of {p} and the Dogun Chieftain.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#056.dst: Habla con el rey de {p} y con el jefe Dogun.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#057.src: Ah, you've arrived. I...actually remember you from earlier. So you and...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#057.dst: Ah, has llegado. La verdad... es que te recuerdo de antes. Así que tú y...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#057.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#059.src: ...you knew my son. Were helping him try to put an end to this, before everything was too far gone. Heh...apologies, for that.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#059.dst: ...conocías a mi hijo. Le ayudabas a intentar acabar con esto, antes de que todo fuera irreparable. Je... te pido disculpas por ello.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#059.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#060.src: Paku and I have had a long discussion about the wisdom of youth over the old. You all were right. I needed to swallow my pride.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#060.dst: Paku y yo hemos hablado largo y tendido sobre la sabiduría de los jóvenes frente a los viejos. Teníais razón. Debía tragarme el orgullo.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#060.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#061.src: We agreed upon a peace treaty... A new city... The Dwarves will aid us in building it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#061.dst: Hemos acordado un tratado de paz... Una ciudad nueva... Los Dwarves nos ayudarán a construirla.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#061.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#062.src: All hostilities...will end. My people will...be free to roam the caverns. It has been...too long.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#062.dst: Toda hostilidad... cesará. Los míos podrán... recorrer libres las cavernas. Ha pasado... demasiado tiempo.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#062.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#063.src: And the entombed Doguns at Courag will be reconstituted, as well, supposing that is a possibility.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#063.dst: Y los Doguns sepultados en Courag serán restituidos también, si es que eso es posible.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#063.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#064.src: Every king, since my so-far-great grandfather, Draani Thunderwill, has battled with their morality over the lies told to my people.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#064.dst: Todos los reyes, desde mi lejanísimo antepasado Draani Thunderwill, han luchado con su conciencia por las mentiras contadas a mi pueblo.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#064.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#065.src: It ends here, with the name Draani VIII. It will take time, but the bloodshed has proven things must begin to change now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#065.dst: Acaba aquí, con el nombre de Draani VIII. Llevará tiempo, pero tanta sangre demuestra que todo debe cambiar ya.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#065.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#066.src: You and the coalition have saved the Heights, and Gavel. In {p}, you will find a stall to trade valuable minerals. You will be granted special Dwarven privileges to purchase it now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#066.dst: Tú y la coalición habéis salvado las Heights y Gavel. En {p} hay un puesto donde comerciar con minerales valiosos. Desde ahora tendrás privilegios Dwarves especiales para comprar allí.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#066.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#067.src: Though that is...almost certainly not enough a reward for everything you have done...sincerely. Thank you, Wynn soldier.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#067.dst: Aunque eso... seguramente no sea recompensa suficiente por todo lo que has hecho... de corazón. Gracias, soldado de Wynn.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#067.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwelling Walls#000.src: I left a very precious journal inside of this mansion, a hell within walls. It was my great grandfather's!

Dwelling Walls#002.src: Let's see here... mother's old vase... check!
Dwelling Walls#002.dst: Veamos... el viejo jarrón de mamá... ¡listo!
Dwelling Walls#002.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#003.src: Dining room table... got it here, check!
Dwelling Walls#003.dst: La mesa del comedor... aquí está, ¡listo!
Dwelling Walls#003.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#004.src: Finally, the journal. It's out here somewhere, I assume. I'll look around.
Dwelling Walls#004.dst: Por último, el diario. Supongo que andará por aquí. Voy a echar un vistazo.
Dwelling Walls#004.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#006.src: Hold on, what? The journal! I must have forgotten it inside the mansion!
Dwelling Walls#006.dst: Un momento, ¿qué? ¡El diario! ¡Debí de olvidarlo dentro de la mansión!
Dwelling Walls#006.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#007.src: You there! Would you mind doing me a deed?
Dwelling Walls#007.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#008.src: I left a very precious journal inside this mansion, a hell within walls. It was my great grandfather's!
Dwelling Walls#008.dst: Dejé un diario muy valioso dentro de esta mansión, un infierno entre paredes. ¡Era de mi bisabuelo!
Dwelling Walls#008.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#009.src: The mansion was designed by a Corkian architect, and I was scammed into buying it.
Dwelling Walls#009.dst: La mansión la diseñó un arquitecto corkiano, y me estafaron para que la comprara.
Dwelling Walls#009.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#010.src: If you step inside the mansion just for a few moments, you'll understand why the sellers had to trick someone into investing in their god forsaken real estate!
Dwelling Walls#010.dst: Si entras en la mansión aunque sea un momento, entenderás por qué los vendedores tuvieron que engañar a alguien para que invirtiera en semejante propiedad maldita.
Dwelling Walls#010.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#011.src: Navigating from room to room is nearly impossible, the rooms move around. I've only been in the mansion for a week and I'm already packing my bags and moving to {p}.
Dwelling Walls#011.dst: Ir de una habitación a otra es casi imposible: las habitaciones se mueven. Llevo solo una semana en la mansión y ya estoy haciendo las maletas para mudarme a {p}.
Dwelling Walls#011.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#013.src: Navigate the mansion to the room holding the journal
Dwelling Walls#013.dst: Recorre la mansión hasta la habitación del diario

Dwelling Walls#015.src: The journal! You outsmarted the mansion!
Dwelling Walls#015.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#016.src: I must thank you, that journal was priceless to my family.
Dwelling Walls#016.dst: Te lo agradezco mucho, ese diario no tenía precio para mi familia.
Dwelling Walls#016.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#017.src: Let this be a life lesson to you. Never buy a house from a Corkian architect.
Dwelling Walls#017.dst: Que te sirva de lección: nunca compres una casa a un arquitecto corkiano.
Dwelling Walls#017.speaker: Leucsaa

Echoes of Change#000.src: Third Division - Guarding Sovereign Soosu's mansion.
Echoes of Change#000.dst: Tercera División - Guardia en la mansión de la Soberana Soosu.

Echoes of Change#003.src: The painting has a note attached to it.
Echoes of Change#003.dst: El cuadro tiene una nota pegada.

Echoes of Change#004.src: Attend the meeting to prepare for the plan in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#004.dst: Asiste a la reunión de preparación del plan en la Pluma de Acero en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#006.src: I trust everyone has taken the time to process last night's announcement? I will let Syndra take over shortly, but first, I would like to thank each and every one of you.
Echoes of Change#006.dst: Confío en que todos hayáis asimilado el anuncio de anoche. Enseguida le cedo la palabra a Syndra, pero antes quiero daros las gracias a todos y cada uno de vosotros.
Echoes of Change#006.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#007.src: I won't mince words. This is dangerous work. What we are planning puts us at great risk. But this is what it takes to change Fruma, to put an end to the crown's oppression!
Echoes of Change#007.dst: No me andaré con rodeos. Esto es peligroso. Lo que planeamos nos pone en grave riesgo. ¡Pero es el precio de cambiar Fruma, de acabar con la opresión de la Corona!
Echoes of Change#007.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#008.src: We will kill a God! And we will all be free. Now, Syndra?
Echoes of Change#008.dst: ¡Mataremos a un dios! Y todos seremos libres. Y ahora, ¿Syndra?
Echoes of Change#008.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#009.src: Thank you, Quill. To begin, allow me to give each group their assignment.
Echoes of Change#009.dst: Gracias, Quill. Para empezar, dejadme asignar su tarea a cada grupo.
Echoes of Change#009.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#010.src: Mora and Yuman, you will be infiltrating the guards' outpost in {p} to retrieve their schedules. Get in, note down the formations, and get out.
Echoes of Change#010.dst: Mora y Yuman, os infiltraréis en el puesto de guardia de {p} para conseguir sus turnos. Entrad, anotad las formaciones y salid.
Echoes of Change#010.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#011.src: Mora, you're familiar with military structure, and Yuman knows his way around {p}. I expect you two should be able to make it work.
Echoes of Change#011.dst: Mora, tú conoces la estructura militar, y Yuman se mueve bien por {p}. Confío en que entre los dos lo logréis.
Echoes of Change#011.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#013.src: Understood. However, I have a few concerns with the overall plans... I'll speak with you later.
Echoes of Change#013.dst: Entendido. Aunque tengo algunas dudas sobre el plan en conjunto... Hablaré contigo luego.
Echoes of Change#013.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#014.src: Yusanu and Sui, you'll be constructing explosives that we can use as distractions during the festival to draw guards away from the main stage.
Echoes of Change#014.dst: Yusanu y Sui, fabricaréis explosivos para usarlos como distracción en el festival y alejar a los guardias del escenario principal.
Echoes of Change#014.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#015.src: I trust Yusanu knows what he's doing, so Sui, you'll be acting as an assistant.
Echoes of Change#015.dst: Confío en que Yusanu sabe lo que hace, así que Sui, tú serás su ayudante.
Echoes of Change#015.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#017.src: Works for me. I might already have some blueprints lying around somewhere...
Echoes of Change#017.dst: Por mí bien. Puede que ya tenga algunos planos por ahí...
Echoes of Change#017.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#018.src: Zeph and Rex, I want you to scout the city rooftops for potential spots where Rex and Yulie can provide aerial support... in case it's necessary.
Echoes of Change#018.dst: Zeph y Rex, explorad los tejados de la ciudad buscando puntos desde donde Rex y Yulie puedan dar apoyo aéreo... por si acaso.
Echoes of Change#018.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#019.src: Yeah, I c- c- can do that.
Echoes of Change#019.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#021.src: Quill and Yulie, you two know your way around the city. I'll need you to scout out potential escape routes from the city... again, in case things go badly.
Echoes of Change#021.dst: Quill y Yulie, vosotros conocéis bien la ciudad. Necesito que busquéis posibles rutas de huida... otra vez, por si todo sale mal.
Echoes of Change#021.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#022.src: Ah, that should be a breeze.
Echoes of Change#022.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#023.src: ...yes. I think I have a few places in mind already.
Echoes of Change#023.dst: ...sí. Creo que ya tengo algunos sitios en mente.
Echoes of Change#023.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#024.src: Finally. {u}, I want you to be adaptable. Help out wherever it's needed - I'm sure your skills will come in handy.
Echoes of Change#024.dst: Por último. {u}, quiero que seas flexible. Ayuda donde haga falta; seguro que tus habilidades vendrán bien.
Echoes of Change#024.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#025.src: Hey, if you're helping out wherever, you should come with me and Mora! Guard positions would be handy to know before finding escape routes.
Echoes of Change#025.dst: ¡Oye, si vas a ayudar donde haga falta, vente con Mora y conmigo! Saber dónde están los guardias ayudará antes de buscar rutas de huida.
Echoes of Change#025.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#026.src: I was about to suggest the same thing. Then let us adjourn this meeting. Good luck, everyone.
Echoes of Change#026.dst: Justo iba a proponer lo mismo. Entonces demos por terminada la reunión. Suerte a todos.
Echoes of Change#026.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#027.src: Hum. {u} and Yuman, let us go our plans then.
Echoes of Change#027.dst: Hum. {u} y Yuman, hablemos entonces de nuestro plan.
Echoes of Change#027.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#028.src: Meet up with Mora and Yuman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#028.dst: Reúnete con Mora y Yuman en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#029.src: Alright, guys! So, any plans? What're we cooking with here?
Echoes of Change#029.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#031.src: Hey, man, everything good? I'm uh, not that horrible to work with, am I? Haha.
Echoes of Change#031.dst: Oye, tío, ¿todo bien? No soy tan horrible como compañero, ¿no? Ja, ja.
Echoes of Change#031.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#032.src: Ah! My apologies. No, it is not you... I simply do not like Syndra's plan.
Echoes of Change#032.dst: ¡Ah! Perdona. No, no eres tú... Es que no me gusta el plan de Syndra.
Echoes of Change#032.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#033.src: You must understand, I would trust her with my life... but that is precisely the issue. She will do anything to avoid putting us in danger.
Echoes of Change#033.dst: Has de entender que le confiaría mi vida... pero ese es justo el problema. Hará lo que sea para no ponernos en peligro.
Echoes of Change#033.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#034.src: She treats us as her own children, but she is only a decade older than I am! She would put herself through all the suffering in the world, if only to avoid letting us help where it is most needed!
Echoes of Change#034.dst: Nos trata como a sus propios hijos, ¡pero solo me lleva una década! ¡Cargaría con todo el sufrimiento del mundo con tal de no dejarnos ayudar donde más falta hace!
Echoes of Change#034.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#035.src: She is willing to take the fall if the plan goes awry. But, this time... this time, I will not back off. I am not allowing her to put herself through that danger alone.
Echoes of Change#035.dst: Está dispuesta a pagar el pato si el plan se tuerce. Pero esta vez... esta vez no pienso echarme atrás. No la dejaré afrontar ese peligro sola.
Echoes of Change#035.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#036.src: Yeesh. Didn't think you guys were that messy! I think I get it though.
Echoes of Change#036.dst: Vaya. ¡No sabía que estabais tan liados! Creo que lo entiendo.
Echoes of Change#036.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#037.src: My bros... they mean well, yeah, but they never ask for help. They're always trying to do everything themselves, and... and it drives me nuts!
Echoes of Change#037.dst: Mis hermanos... tienen buena intención, sí, pero nunca piden ayuda. Siempre quieren hacerlo todo solos y... ¡y me saca de quicio!
Echoes of Change#037.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#038.src: Like, man, just let me do something!! Anything!! It's so frustrating.
Echoes of Change#038.dst: ¡¡Tío, déjame hacer algo!! ¡¡Lo que sea!! Es muy frustrante.
Echoes of Change#038.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#039.src: Ha! I did not think we had this in common. Well then... perhaps we can both prove ourselves to our families, eh?
Echoes of Change#039.dst: ¡Ja! No imaginaba que tuviéramos eso en común. Pues quizá los dos podamos demostrar algo a nuestras familias, ¿eh?
Echoes of Change#039.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#040.src: Yeah!! I like the sound of that!!
Echoes of Change#040.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#041.src: Okay, well, I know where the guards' outpost is in {p}. Let's just go to it and take it from there!
Echoes of Change#041.dst: Vale, pues sé dónde está el puesto de guardia de {p}. ¡Vamos allí y ya veremos!
Echoes of Change#041.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#042.src: Ha, settle down a little. I think we need to be a bit more prepared than that. But, yes, time is of the essence, so let us head there first. I will attempt to think of a plan on the way.
Echoes of Change#042.dst: Ja, calma un poco. Creo que hace falta ir algo más preparados. Pero sí, el tiempo apremia, así que vayamos allí primero. Intentaré pensar un plan por el camino.
Echoes of Change#042.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#043.src: Whatever, man! Too much planning often spoils the results... but, sure! Let's meet outside the tallest building in {p}. First tunnel to the right leads there!
Echoes of Change#043.dst: ¡Lo que tú digas, tío! Planear demasiado suele estropearlo todo... ¡pero vale! Quedamos fuera del edificio más alto de {p}. ¡El primer túnel a la derecha lleva allí!
Echoes of Change#043.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#044.src: Meet up with Yuman and Mora in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#044.dst: Reúnete con Yuman y Mora en {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#046.src: Good grief, this town's a mess. How does anyone live here?
Echoes of Change#046.dst: Madre mía, qué desastre de ciudad. ¿Cómo vive aquí la gente?
Echoes of Change#046.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#047.src: Eh, ya get used to it. Here, follow me.
Echoes of Change#047.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#048.src: See, {p} utilizes all the space it has... stacking things atop each other. For example, this so-called "skyscraper" is mainly an apartment building!
Echoes of Change#048.dst: Mira, {p} aprovecha cada palmo... apilando unas cosas sobre otras. ¡Este llamado "rascacielos", por ejemplo, es sobre todo un bloque de pisos!
Echoes of Change#048.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#049.src: Then... what exactly are we doing here?
Echoes of Change#049.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#050.src: I said mainly, man. The top floors serve as the offices for the local commander and constables. That's also why we've got to climb this staircase!
Echoes of Change#050.dst: He dicho sobre todo, tío. Las plantas altas son las oficinas del comandante local y los alguaciles. ¡Por eso toca subir esta escalera!
Echoes of Change#050.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#051.src: Hope you guys are in shape!
Echoes of Change#051.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#053.src: Uh... we're on a mission, right? Trying to prove ourselves? Schedules are up there, so...
Echoes of Change#053.dst: Eh... estamos en una misión, ¿no? ¿Demostrando lo que valemos? Los turnos están arriba, así que...
Echoes of Change#053.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#054.src: We cannot just... walk in there and grab the schedules! You do realize that, right? {u} and I are wanted by the crown! Even showing ourselves here at all is a risk.
Echoes of Change#054.dst: ¡No podemos entrar ahí sin más y llevarnos los turnos! Te das cuenta, ¿verdad? ¡{u} y yo estamos en busca y captura! Dejarnos ver aquí ya es un riesgo.
Echoes of Change#054.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#055.src: Hey man, these soldiers see hundreds of people every day! If you don't give 'em a reason to pay attention, your faces won't stick out at all.
Echoes of Change#055.dst: Oye tío, ¡estos soldados ven a cientos de personas al día! Si no les das motivo para fijarse, vuestras caras no llamarán la atención.
Echoes of Change#055.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#056.src: Yuman, we were going to make a plan before rushing in. Did you forget about that?
Echoes of Change#056.dst: Yuman, íbamos a hacer un plan antes de entrar a lo loco. ¿Se te ha olvidado?
Echoes of Change#056.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#057.src: Riiight. Right. Sorry, I got excited. I am right, though - it wouldn't be hard for me to just talk us through this!
Echoes of Change#057.dst: Cieeerto. Cierto. Perdona, me he emocionado. Pero tengo razón: ¡no me costaría nada sacarnos de esta hablando!
Echoes of Change#057.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#058.src: This furnace seems to power the big crane...
Echoes of Change#058.dst: Este horno parece alimentar la gran grúa...

Echoes of Change#059.src: Riiight. Right. Sorry, I got excited. I am right though - it wouldn't be hard for me to just talk us through this!
Echoes of Change#059.dst: Cieeerto. Cierto. Perdona, me he emocionado. Pero tengo razón: ¡no me costaría nada sacarnos de esta hablando!
Echoes of Change#059.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#060.src: Sigh... here, I have a better plan. Let us take some guard uniforms and put them on, and reach the schedules that way. We'll stand out even less, then.
Echoes of Change#060.dst: Suspiro... mira, tengo un plan mejor. Cojamos unos uniformes de guardia y así llegamos a los turnos. Llamaremos mucho menos la atención.
Echoes of Change#060.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#061.src: Ohh. A sneak mission! That's good. They should definitely have some spare uniforms in the tower... *and*, it should be pretty empty this time of day. Everyone's out patrolling.
Echoes of Change#061.dst: Ohh. ¡Una misión sigilosa! Eso está bien. Seguro que tienen uniformes de repuesto en la torre... *y* a esta hora debería estar bastante vacía. Están todos patrullando.
Echoes of Change#061.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#062.src: So, good plan, man! I like it! Let's get to it!
Echoes of Change#062.dst: ¡Buen plan, tío! ¡Me gusta! ¡Manos a la obra!
Echoes of Change#062.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#063.src: Find guard uniforms inside of the guard tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#063.dst: Encuentra uniformes de guardia dentro de la torre de guardia en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#064.src: See? I told you, nobody's here!
Echoes of Change#064.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#065.src: Ha. I suppose I should have faith in your knowledge. My apologies.
Echoes of Change#065.dst: Ja. Supongo que debería fiarme de lo que sabes. Mis disculpas.
Echoes of Change#065.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#066.src: ...ah, is that really all? I thought they would be harder to find.
Echoes of Change#066.dst: ...ah, ¿eso es todo? Creía que costaría más encontrarlos.
Echoes of Change#066.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#067.src: With how many guards have to come through here every day for uniform exchanges, this is just the easiest way. More efficient having it out here.
Echoes of Change#067.dst: Con la de guardias que pasan por aquí cada día a cambiarse, así es lo más fácil. Es más eficiente tenerlos a mano.
Echoes of Change#067.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#070.src: Oh, you are just going for it... I see. {u}, let's wait outside until he's done.
Echoes of Change#070.dst: Ah, vas a cambiarte aquí mismo... Ya veo. {u}, esperemos fuera a que acabe.
Echoes of Change#070.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#071.src: Well? Thoughts? How do I look?
Echoes of Change#071.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#072.src: Like an average Roughworks soldier, I suppose.
Echoes of Change#072.dst: Como un soldado cualquiera de Roughworks, supongo.
Echoes of Change#072.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#075.src: Ah- haha, uh, n- nothin! Your turn!
Echoes of Change#075.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#076.src: This uniform is so... uncomfortable. And to think, I nearly signed up for this...
Echoes of Change#076.dst: Este uniforme es tan... incómodo. Y pensar que casi me alisté...
Echoes of Change#076.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#077.src: Yeah, you'd think they'd complain about it more! But nah, they're all... stoic.
Echoes of Change#077.dst: Ya, ¡pensarías que se quejarían más! Pues no, son todos... estoicos.
Echoes of Change#077.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#078.src: Yes... well, {u}, it's your turn. Hurry, please. Someone could come up here at any time.
Echoes of Change#078.dst: Sí... bueno, {u}, te toca. Date prisa, por favor. Podría subir alguien en cualquier momento.
Echoes of Change#078.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#079.src: Find guard schedules inside the guard tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#079.dst: Encuentra los turnos de guardia dentro de la torre de guardia en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#080.src: Very well. Let us get this over with.
Echoes of Change#080.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#081.src: From what I heard from Yulie, the commander usually keeps the schedules in the top office. Let's get looking!
Echoes of Change#081.dst: Por lo que me dijo Yulie, el comandante suele guardar los turnos en la oficina de arriba. ¡A buscar!
Echoes of Change#081.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#082.src: So, you? A soldier? What's the story there?
Echoes of Change#082.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#083.src: Sigh... the story is it was a choice between joining the military, and following in my parents' footsteps. And I did not especially want to do the latter.
Echoes of Change#083.dst: Suspiro... la historia es que tenía que elegir entre alistarme o seguir los pasos de mis padres. Y lo segundo no me apetecía nada.
Echoes of Change#083.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#085.src: They worked as woodcutters. A relatively common job in the {p}, but... I simply wanted to distance myself from them.
Echoes of Change#085.dst: Eran leñadores. Un oficio bastante común en {p}, pero... yo solo quería alejarme de ellos.
Echoes of Change#085.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#086.src: The military seemed my best option... until I met Syndra, that is. Still... I regret I could not do more for Sui. She did not take my departure well.
Echoes of Change#086.dst: El ejército parecía mi mejor opción... hasta que conocí a Syndra. Aun así... lamento no haber hecho más por Sui. No llevó bien mi marcha.
Echoes of Change#086.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#087.src: Hey, you were doing what was best for you, right? And it looks like you and Sui are all good now, so it turned out alright in the end.
Echoes of Change#087.dst: Oye, hacías lo mejor para ti, ¿no? Y parece que Sui y tú estáis bien ahora, así que al final salió todo bien.
Echoes of Change#087.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#089.src: Woah there! Eheh, sorry folks, didn't see-
Echoes of Change#089.dst: ¡Eh, cuidado! Ejem, perdonad, no os había-
Echoes of Change#089.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#090.src: Wait. You three - if you have your equipment, you should be out on the streets. State your business here.
Echoes of Change#090.dst: Un momento. Vosotros tres: si tenéis el equipo, deberíais estar en la calle. Explicad qué hacéis aquí.
Echoes of Change#090.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#091.src: ... Well? I'm not hearing an answer. State. Your. Business.
Echoes of Change#091.dst: ... ¿Y bien? No oigo respuesta. Explicad. Qué. Hacéis.
Echoes of Change#091.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#092.src: I- ah. We... we were looking for...
Echoes of Change#092.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#095.src: Ya know how the stress gets. Festival's coming up, lots to worry about! Not getting much sleep - all that.
Echoes of Change#095.dst: Ya sabéis cómo es el estrés. ¡Se acerca el festival, mil cosas de las que preocuparse! Dormimos poco, en fin.
Echoes of Change#095.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#096.src: Heck, I don't even remember what I last ate, hahaha!
Echoes of Change#096.dst: ¡Vamos, si ni me acuerdo de lo último que comí, jajaja!
Echoes of Change#096.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#097.src: Ha! Yeah, I've been feeling that. Commander's got us working overtime, it's a whole mess.
Echoes of Change#097.dst: ¡Ja! Sí, yo igual. El comandante nos tiene haciendo horas extra, es un desastre.
Echoes of Change#097.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#098.src: Oh, hey, why don't y'all join us for some drinks after the shift?
Echoes of Change#098.dst: Oye, ¿y si os venís a tomar algo con nosotros al acabar el turno?
Echoes of Change#098.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#099.src: Sounds great, man! Guess we'll meet you boys then! You got the night shift too, right?
Echoes of Change#099.dst: ¡Suena genial, tío! ¡Pues allí nos vemos! Vosotros también tenéis turno de noche, ¿no?
Echoes of Change#099.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#100.src: Yeah. Drew the short straw, unfortunately. The commander has us doing them the next few days...
Echoes of Change#100.dst: Sí. Nos tocó la china, por desgracia. El comandante nos los pone los próximos días...
Echoes of Change#100.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#101.src: At this rate, we'll be too damn tired to enjoy the festival! Like... give us a break, right?
Echoes of Change#101.dst: ¡A este paso estaremos demasiado cansados para disfrutar del festival! Vamos... que nos den un respiro, ¿no?
Echoes of Change#101.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#102.src: Yeah, yeah. Same sorta thing here! I got paired up with these newbies, and the commander's got us on festival shift.
Echoes of Change#102.dst: Ya, ya. ¡Aquí igual! Me han emparejado con estos novatos y el comandante nos pone turno de festival.
Echoes of Change#102.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#103.src: Ouch. That's rough. Good luck out there.
Echoes of Change#103.dst: Uf. Qué mal. Suerte ahí fuera.
Echoes of Change#103.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#104.src: Ey, thanks! But yeah, I'm still showin' them the ropes, and all that. We only got the news, like, an hour ago, so we're going to check the schedules.
Echoes of Change#104.dst: ¡Eh, gracias! Pero sí, aún les estoy enseñando el oficio y demás. Nos avisaron hace como una hora, así que vamos a mirar los turnos.
Echoes of Change#104.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#105.src: Ah, management... putting newbies on festival shift? I wonder what the commander's thinking? Well, good luck with that.
Echoes of Change#105.dst: Ah, los mandos... ¿novatos en el turno del festival? ¿En qué estará pensando el comandante? En fin, suerte con eso.
Echoes of Change#105.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#107.src: ...told ya I could talk us through it.
Echoes of Change#107.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#108.src: That was... impressive. I did not think it could be done.
Echoes of Change#108.dst: Eso ha sido... impresionante. No creí que se pudiera.
Echoes of Change#108.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#109.src: Ah, y'know... they're still people at the end of the day.
Echoes of Change#109.dst: Ah, ya sabes... al final del día también son personas.
Echoes of Change#109.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#110.src: I... suppose. I apologize, I do not know why I... froze up there. I should know what I'm doing...
Echoes of Change#110.dst: Yo... supongo. Perdona, no sé por qué me he... quedado en blanco. Debería saber lo que hago...
Echoes of Change#110.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#111.src: Hey, it happens. For the record, I'm sorry for bein' a bit rough with ya. Had to convince them somehow.
Echoes of Change#111.dst: Oye, pasa. Por cierto, siento haber sido un poco brusco contigo. Había que convencerlos de algún modo.
Echoes of Change#111.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#112.src: No worries, Yuman, I understand. Now, ah... let us find the schedules before someone else notices we are not supposed to be here.
Echoes of Change#112.dst: Tranquilo, Yuman, lo entiendo. Ahora, ah... busquemos los turnos antes de que alguien más note que no deberíamos estar aquí.
Echoes of Change#112.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#114.src: The schedules were further up, yes?
Echoes of Change#114.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#116.src: Start writing them down, would you?
Echoes of Change#116.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#117.src: It's more guards than we typically see in Auburn festivals, that's for certain... I hope Syndra anticipated this.
Echoes of Change#117.dst: Son más guardias de los que solemos ver en los festivales de Auburn, seguro... Espero que Syndra lo previera.
Echoes of Change#117.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#118.src: She seems like the kind of lady to have back-up plans for her back-up plans... I wouldn't worry too much.
Echoes of Change#118.dst: Parece de las que tienen planes de reserva para sus planes de reserva... Yo no me preocuparía mucho.
Echoes of Change#118.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#119.src: I suppose you're right. Now, we should make our way out of here before anyone else arrives.
Echoes of Change#119.dst: Supongo que tienes razón. Ahora deberíamos salir de aquí antes de que llegue alguien más.
Echoes of Change#119.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#120.src: Return to The Steel Feather using the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find Yusanu and Sui.
Echoes of Change#120.dst: Vuelve a la Pluma de Acero por el túnel en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y busca a Yusanu y Sui.

Echoes of Change#121.src: I could really use a nap after that.
Echoes of Change#121.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#122.src: Seems like our mission is done. Let's head back.
Echoes of Change#122.dst: Parece que nuestra misión ha terminado. Volvamos.
Echoes of Change#122.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#123.src: ...and we'll need to keep things calm back here while we're gone.
Echoes of Change#123.dst: ...y tendremos que mantener la calma aquí mientras no estamos.
Echoes of Change#123.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#124.src: Of course, of course. Wouldn't want anyone to panic.
Echoes of Change#124.dst: Por supuesto, por supuesto. No querríamos que cunda el pánico.
Echoes of Change#124.speaker: Jiro

Echoes of Change#125.src: I'm less concerned about panic, and more about stress. I know Quill will stay behind during the festival itself, but it'll be good to have additional help.
Echoes of Change#125.dst: Me preocupa menos el pánico que el estrés. Sé que Quill se quedará durante el festival, pero vendrá bien algo de ayuda extra.
Echoes of Change#125.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#126.src: Yes, ma'am. I can handle it.
Echoes of Change#126.speaker: Jiro

Echoes of Change#128.src: Ah, I should get going. I'll see if I can track down Quill.
Echoes of Change#128.dst: Ah, debería irme. Veré si consigo localizar a Quill.
Echoes of Change#128.speaker: Jiro

Echoes of Change#131.src: Oh, Jiro was asking if there was anything he could do to help. I told him he could help Quill keep the peace down here while we're... performing the plan.
Echoes of Change#131.dst: Ah, Jiro preguntaba en qué podía ayudar. Le dije que ayudara a Quill a mantener el orden aquí abajo mientras... ejecutamos el plan.
Echoes of Change#131.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#132.src: He's... been acting a little out of character, truth be told... though it might just be the stress of the upcoming festival causing it.
Echoes of Change#132.dst: La verdad es que ha estado... un poco raro últimamente... aunque quizá solo sea el estrés del festival que se acerca.
Echoes of Change#132.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#133.src: But either way - how are things going?
Echoes of Change#133.speaker: Syndra
