Fantastic Voyage#226.dst: Como ves, mi barco ha quedado hecho un despojo. ¡Ayúdame, por favor, estoy atrapado en la bodega, con enojo!
Fantastic Voyage#226.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#227.src: Amazing work, seems you got below deck rather quickly! You're going to have to get through this wreckage to free me!
Fantastic Voyage#227.dst: ¡Asombroso, has bajado a la bodega en un santiamén! ¡Ahora cruza estos escombros y libérame también!
Fantastic Voyage#227.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#228.src: Wow, so you managed to work your way through after all! Maybe to free me, you can use that cannonball?
Fantastic Voyage#228.dst: ¡Vaya, al final lograste abrirte paso, qué portento! ¿Y si usas esa bala de cañón para liberarme al momento?
Fantastic Voyage#228.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#229.src: Save Relend inside of the wreck of the Little Wing.
Fantastic Voyage#229.dst: Salva a Relend dentro de los restos del Little Wing.

Fantastic Voyage#230.src: Thank you for freeing me, now let's leave this mess! Although, I don't know how to do that, I have not even a guess.
Fantastic Voyage#230.dst: ¡Gracias por liberarme, salgamos de este desastre! Aunque no sé cómo hacerlo, ni una idea que me arrastre.
Fantastic Voyage#230.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#231.src: When the ship crashed, it was buried beneath the sand! But the good news is that we're finally back on land!
Fantastic Voyage#231.dst: Cuando el barco chocó, bajo la arena quedó sepultado. ¡Pero la buena noticia es que a tierra hemos llegado!
Fantastic Voyage#231.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#232.src: We should probably get of this place, it feels rather small. Perhaps you can try to break through that weak spot in the wall?
Fantastic Voyage#232.dst: Deberíamos salir de aquí, esto es un rincón muy pequeño. ¿Y si intentas romper ese punto débil del muro, con empeño?
Fantastic Voyage#232.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#234.src: It looks like we're going to be stuck here for a while. Come and speak to me so we can find a way off of this isle!
Fantastic Voyage#234.dst: Parece que aquí vamos a quedarnos un buen rato. ¡Ven a hablar conmigo y busquemos salir de este islote insensato!
Fantastic Voyage#234.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#235.src: Speak to Relend on the beach.
Fantastic Voyage#235.dst: Habla con Relend en la playa.

Fantastic Voyage#236.src: Gateway Island... we've finally arrived. I'm just thankful that we survived.
Fantastic Voyage#236.dst: Gateway Island... al fin hemos arribado. Doy gracias por no haber naufragado.
Fantastic Voyage#236.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#237.src: Well, all this adventuring has me hungry for stew. We'll need ingredients, whatever's on the island will have to do.
Fantastic Voyage#237.dst: Tanta aventura me ha dado hambre de un buen guiso. Harán falta ingredientes; lo que haya en la isla será preciso.
Fantastic Voyage#237.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#238.src: Meat is definitely something we need to reap, try and get [{~} Raw Mutton] from those sheep.
Fantastic Voyage#238.dst: Carne es algo que sin duda hay que obtener. Consigue [{~} Raw Mutton] de esas ovejas, a ver.
Fantastic Voyage#238.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#239.src: And perhaps you could get [{~} Edible Mushrooms] from the western cave, just make sure not to get the kind that will send me to my grave.
Fantastic Voyage#239.dst: Y quizá puedas traer [{~} Edible Mushrooms] de la cueva de poniente; asegúrate de no coger las que me manden a la tumba de repente.
Fantastic Voyage#239.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#240.src: I feel like something is missing from this medley. Oh, how about you get [{~} Coconut] from atop that tree?
Fantastic Voyage#240.dst: Siento que a esta mezcla aún le falta algo, quizá. ¿Y si coges [{~} Coconut] de lo alto de aquel árbol ya?
Fantastic Voyage#240.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#241.src: And if you could fetch [{~} Berries], that would just make me merry!
Fantastic Voyage#241.dst: ¡Y si pudieras traer [{~} Berries], qué alegría me darías!
Fantastic Voyage#241.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#242.src: Check your quest book if you ever need a recap. And to make sure you don't get lost, take this map.
Fantastic Voyage#242.dst: Consulta tu libro de misiones si necesitas un repaso. Y para que no te pierdas, toma este mapa, por si acaso.
Fantastic Voyage#242.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#243.src: Give the Odd Stew to Relend.
Fantastic Voyage#243.dst: Dale el guiso extraño a Relend.

Fantastic Voyage#244.src: Well, this stew has a rather odd flavor. But any food we can get here I shall savor.
Fantastic Voyage#244.dst: Vaya, este guiso tiene un sabor bastante extraño. Pero aquí saborearé cualquier comida, sin engaño.
Fantastic Voyage#244.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#245.src: What remains of my ship won't protect us very well. We'll need to find shelter, as you can clearly tell.
Fantastic Voyage#245.dst: Lo que queda de mi barco no nos dará protección. Habrá que buscar refugio, es clara la situación.
Fantastic Voyage#245.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#246.src: To the east, I can just barely make out a tent. Go and look for my friend there. I'm simply hellbent!
Fantastic Voyage#246.dst: Hacia el este apenas alcanzo a ver una tienda plantada. ¡Ve a buscar allí a mi amigo; mi voluntad no se apaga!
Fantastic Voyage#246.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#247.src: Check out the tent to the east.

Fantastic Voyage#249.src: So the tent was all empty and run-down? All of this bad news is making me frown.
Fantastic Voyage#249.dst: ¿La tienda estaba vacía y hecha ruinas? Tantas malas noticias me arruinan.
Fantastic Voyage#249.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#250.src: Allow me to borrow your map for a second. We'll have to find him somewhere else, I reckon.
Fantastic Voyage#250.dst: Déjame tu mapa un segundo, si no te importa. Habrá que buscarlo en otra parte, me consta.
Fantastic Voyage#250.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#251.src: I know we can come up with a solution using our wits. Perhaps we can use an explosive to blow that big rock to bits!
Fantastic Voyage#251.dst: Sé que con ingenio daremos con la solución. ¡Quizá un explosivo haga pedazos ese pedrusco de un tirón!
Fantastic Voyage#251.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#252.src: Let's think of some materials we can get here. There isn't much on this island, I fear...
Fantastic Voyage#252.dst: Pensemos qué materiales podemos conseguir aquí. En esta isla no hay mucho, me temo, ay de mí...
Fantastic Voyage#252.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#253.src: First we're going to need [{~} Gritty Sand]. Where to get it? Try the beach at the back of the island.
Fantastic Voyage#253.dst: Primero necesitaremos [{~} Gritty Sand], sin duda alguna. ¿Dónde hallarla? En la playa trasera de la isla, con fortuna.
Fantastic Voyage#253.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#254.src: Next up is [Sawdust], you'll need three. I think the best place to search would be the largest tree.
Fantastic Voyage#254.dst: Después va [Sawdust], y hacen falta tres. Creo que el mejor sitio es el árbol más grande, ya ves.
Fantastic Voyage#254.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#255.src: Finally, [{~} Black Powder], found in a place that is very unique. You'll have to brave your way to the volcano's peak.
Fantastic Voyage#255.dst: Por último, [{~} Black Powder], en un lugar muy singular. ¡Tendrás que armarte de valor y a la cima del volcán trepar!
Fantastic Voyage#255.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#256.src: You'll need those items you craft the bomb, I just told you where to look. If you forget what you need to find, check your quest book.
Fantastic Voyage#256.dst: Necesitarás esos objetos para fabricar la bomba; ya te dije dónde buscar. Si olvidas qué te hace falta, tu libro de misiones has de consultar.
Fantastic Voyage#256.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#257.src: Bring {~} Gritty Sand, {~} Saw Dust, and {~} Black Powder to the Crafting Table.
Fantastic Voyage#257.dst: Lleva {~} Gritty Sand, {~} Saw Dust y {~} Black Powder a la mesa de trabajo.

Fantastic Voyage#258.src: Use the explosive on the boulder.
Fantastic Voyage#258.dst: Usa el explosivo en la roca.

Fantastic Voyage#259.src: Incredible, The explosive blew right through the stone!
Fantastic Voyage#259.dst: ¡Increíble, el explosivo atravesó la piedra de un tirón!
Fantastic Voyage#259.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#260.src: Let us progress into this mysterious zone.
Fantastic Voyage#260.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#263.src: For adventurers like us, an incredible cave, perfect to explore.
Fantastic Voyage#263.dst: Para aventureros como nosotros, una cueva increíble que explorar.
Fantastic Voyage#263.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#264.src: Surely where my old friend ventured - just as I swore!
Fantastic Voyage#264.dst: ¡Aquí se aventuró mi viejo amigo, tal como juré sin dudar!
Fantastic Voyage#264.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#265.src: Long ago, a strong adventurer like yourself reached out to me for a wonderful sail. It truly is a gripping tale!
Fantastic Voyage#265.dst: Hace mucho, un aventurero fuerte como tú vino a pedirme una travesía genial. ¡Es un relato de verdad magistral!
Fantastic Voyage#265.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#266.src: We became best friends on our quest. But then he vanished, oh how he was the best.
Fantastic Voyage#266.dst: En aquel viaje nos hicimos los mejores amigos del lugar. Pero luego se esfumó; ay, cómo me hizo llorar.
Fantastic Voyage#266.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#267.src: And we've finally made it to where he'd been. I can't wait to see him again, I don't know where to begin!
Fantastic Voyage#267.dst: Y por fin llegamos adonde él estuvo, qué emoción. ¡Me muero por verlo, no sé ni cómo empezar la conversación!
Fantastic Voyage#267.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#268.src: A mystical portal! This must be where my old friend got lost!
Fantastic Voyage#268.dst: ¡Un portal místico! ¡Aquí debió de perderse mi amigo de antaño!
Fantastic Voyage#268.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#269.src: We must go through and find him, whatever the cost.
Fantastic Voyage#269.dst: Hemos de cruzarlo y hallarlo, cueste lo que cueste el daño.
Fantastic Voyage#269.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#270.src: I can't believe it! I simply can't speak!
Fantastic Voyage#270.dst: ¡No me lo creo! ¡No me sale ni hablar!
Fantastic Voyage#270.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#271.src: I always told the others I wasn't a freak. Old friend, I'll look for you until the bitter end!
Fantastic Voyage#271.dst: Siempre les dije a los demás que no era un chiflado vulgar. ¡Viejo amigo, te buscaré hasta el final, sin descansar!
Fantastic Voyage#271.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#272.src: Find Relend in the strange place
Fantastic Voyage#272.dst: Encuentra a Relend en el lugar extraño

Fantastic Voyage#273.src: A foreign land filled with danger, to the brim...
Fantastic Voyage#273.dst: Una tierra extraña colmada de peligro sin fin...
Fantastic Voyage#273.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#274.src: It must be where he vanished to, regardless of how grim.
Fantastic Voyage#274.dst: Aquí debió de desvanecerse, por sombrío que sea el confín.
Fantastic Voyage#274.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#275.src: My friend... Where do you think we are?
Fantastic Voyage#275.dst: Amigo mío... ¿dónde hemos ido a dar?
Fantastic Voyage#275.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#276.src: Whatever it is, I feel that we're being overseen from afar.
Fantastic Voyage#276.dst: Sea lo que sea, siento que nos vigilan desde algún lugar.
Fantastic Voyage#276.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#277.src: With all this danger, I still hope my good friend is still okay.
Fantastic Voyage#277.dst: Con tanto peligro, aún espero que mi buen amigo esté a salvo.
Fantastic Voyage#277.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#278.src: My goodness! Keep your wits about, we may be in for a fray!
Fantastic Voyage#278.dst: ¡Cielos! ¡Mantén la cabeza fría, quizá nos espere un asalto!
Fantastic Voyage#278.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#279.src: Aagh... New friend... are you there?
Fantastic Voyage#279.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#280.src: Don't...give up... we must find him, I swear...
Fantastic Voyage#280.dst: No... no te rindas... hemos de encontrarlo, lo juro...
Fantastic Voyage#280.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#281.src: I promise I'll find him, I'll do it, without a single scar!
Fantastic Voyage#281.dst: ¡Prometo que lo hallaré, lo lograré, sin un solo rasguño duro!
Fantastic Voyage#281.speaker: Relend

Fate of the Fallen#000.src: You can not return until your goal is fulfilled...
Fate of the Fallen#000.dst: No podrás volver hasta que cumplas tu objetivo...

Fate of the Fallen#001.src: Talk to Telvu the mage at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Fate of the Fallen#001.dst: Habla con el mago Telvu en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Fate of the Fallen#002.src: Ah, a member of the {p} army. We're trying to gain entry to this frozen barrow. We could use your aid.
Fate of the Fallen#002.dst: Ah, un soldado del ejército de {p}. Intentamos entrar en este túmulo helado. Nos vendría bien tu ayuda.
Fate of the Fallen#002.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#003.src: Are you familiar with the story of Theorick and {p}?
Fate of the Fallen#003.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#004.src: Probably not. Well, you see, {p} was not always frozen.
Fate of the Fallen#004.dst: Seguramente no. Verás, {p} no siempre estuvo helado.
Fate of the Fallen#004.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#005.src: During Theorick's time, this place was like the Wynn plains, warm and arable.
Fate of the Fallen#005.dst: En época de Theorick, esto era cálido y fértil, como las llanuras de Wynn.
Fate of the Fallen#005.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#006.src: For some reason, Theorick Twain used his immense power to freeze the land before exiling himself here.
Fate of the Fallen#006.dst: Por algún motivo, Theorick Twain usó su inmenso poder para congelar esta tierra y luego se exilió aquí.
Fate of the Fallen#006.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#007.src: We need to find out why so we can reverse this spell. Presumably, the source of that spell's magic would lie within the barrow... but we don't want to go in empty-handed.
Fate of the Fallen#007.dst: Debemos averiguar por qué para poder revertir el hechizo. Es de suponer que la fuente de su magia esté dentro del túmulo... pero no queremos entrar con las manos vacías.
Fate of the Fallen#007.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#008.src: As such...have you heard of a place called {p}? We could use it to go back in time, to try to learn more about Theorick's actions.
Fate of the Fallen#008.dst: Así pues... ¿has oído hablar de un lugar llamado {p}? Podríamos usarlo para volver al pasado y saber más de los actos de Theorick.
Fate of the Fallen#008.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#009.src: Well...in a way, at least. There are laws to this sort of magic. For one, you need an item from the specific time we want to see. Second, you can witness the past, not change it.
Fate of the Fallen#009.dst: Bueno... en cierto modo, al menos. Esta magia tiene sus leyes. Primero, hace falta un objeto de la época exacta que queremos ver. Segundo, puedes presenciar el pasado, no cambiarlo.
Fate of the Fallen#009.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#010.src: One of Theorick's staves is on display in the {p} bank. Presumably, it should work for what we need. Could you retrieve it somehow?
Fate of the Fallen#010.dst: Uno de los báculos de Theorick está expuesto en el banco de {p}. Debería servir para lo que necesitamos. ¿Podrías conseguirlo de algún modo?
Fate of the Fallen#010.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#011.dst: Encuentra el báculo de Theorick en el banco de {p}.

Fate of the Fallen#012.src: Aha, quick job. I see you've got the wand. Must've needed a sharp tongue to get the bankers to give it up.
Fate of the Fallen#012.dst: Ajá, qué rapidez. Veo que tienes el báculo. Habrás necesitado buena labia para que los banqueros lo soltaran.
Fate of the Fallen#012.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#013.src: Now, it is a long walk to {p}. Needn't take that walk, though, as I can teleport you there. Hopefully.
Fate of the Fallen#013.dst: Ahora bien, hasta {p} hay un buen paseo. Aunque no hará falta: puedo teletransportarte. Eso espero.
Fate of the Fallen#013.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#014.src: Once you're there, enter the Temple of Time. You should know what to do once you are there. Careful dealing with time travel, friend... No idea what you might find.
Fate of the Fallen#014.dst: Cuando llegues, entra en el Temple of Time. Allí sabrás qué hacer. Cuidado con los viajes en el tiempo, amigo... No hay modo de saber qué te encontrarás.
Fate of the Fallen#014.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#015.dst: Solo tienes que entrar en el portal.
Fate of the Fallen#015.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#016.src: Should anything go wrong, I'll stay here to teleport you back to the temple.
Fate of the Fallen#016.dst: Si algo sale mal, me quedaré aquí para traerte de vuelta al templo.
Fate of the Fallen#016.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#017.src: Enter the portal the mage made.
Fate of the Fallen#017.dst: Entra en el portal que ha creado el mago.

Fate of the Fallen#018.src: Enter the Gate of Time at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and travel back in time.
Fate of the Fallen#018.dst: Entra en la Gate of Time en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y viaja al pasado.

Fate of the Fallen#021.src: Woah, your weaponry and armour is so advanced!
Fate of the Fallen#021.dst: ¡Vaya, tus armas y tu armadura son avanzadísimas!
Fate of the Fallen#021.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#022.src: Are you another Twain? Only the Twains know magic like that.
Fate of the Fallen#022.dst: ¿Eres otro Twain? Solo los Twain conocen esa clase de magia.
Fate of the Fallen#022.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#024.src: He's busy fighting in the war, shouldn't you be doing the same?
Fate of the Fallen#024.dst: Está ocupado luchando en la guerra, ¿no deberías hacer tú lo mismo?
Fate of the Fallen#024.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#025.src: He went west. There was some kind of emergency.
Fate of the Fallen#025.dst: Se fue al oeste. Hubo algún tipo de emergencia.
Fate of the Fallen#025.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#026.src: We've been fighting the corruption for years, it seems like it might finally engulf {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#026.dst: Llevamos años luchando contra la Corrupción; parece que por fin va a engullir {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#026.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#027.src: Find Theorick in the forest west of {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].
Fate of the Fallen#027.dst: Encuentra a Theorick en el bosque al oeste de {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].

Fate of the Fallen#028.src: I could've sworn she had gone this way... Oh, what now, more imbeciles? This forest isn't safe to travel!
Fate of the Fallen#028.dst: Habría jurado que ella fue por aquí... Ay, ¿y ahora qué, más imbéciles? ¡Este bosque no es seguro!
Fate of the Fallen#028.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#029.src: If you need help, lodge a complaint with the guards. I'm busy and I can't exactly break away from saving this god-blessed province to chill your milk!!
Fate of the Fallen#029.dst: Si necesitas ayuda, presenta una queja a la guardia. ¡¡Estoy ocupado y no puedo dejar de salvar esta maldita provincia para enfriarte la leche!!
Fate of the Fallen#029.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#030.src: Are your ears full of wax?! I said-
Fate of the Fallen#030.dst: ¡¿Tienes cera en los oídos?! He dicho-
Fate of the Fallen#030.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#031.src: Urgh, the things followed you! See what happens?! STAND ASIDE.
Fate of the Fallen#031.dst: ¡Argh, esas cosas te han seguido! ¡¿Ves lo que pasa?! APÁRTATE.
Fate of the Fallen#031.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#032.src: As though I needed TWO people to save! Now get out of here, I have to find that woman who went missing!
Fate of the Fallen#032.dst: ¡Como si necesitara salvar a DOS personas! ¡Largo de aquí, tengo que encontrar a esa mujer desaparecida!
Fate of the Fallen#032.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#033.src: HEEEELP! I can't outrun them!!! Guards! Someone!!
Fate of the Fallen#033.dst: ¡SOCOOORRO! ¡¡¡No puedo escapar de ellos!!! ¡Guardias! ¡¡Que alguien venga!!

Fate of the Fallen#034.src: Whuh! That's her voice! Where is she?! I just cleared this area!
Fate of the Fallen#034.dst: ¡Eh! ¡Esa es su voz! ¡¿Dónde está?! ¡Si acabo de despejar esta zona!
Fate of the Fallen#034.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#036.src: Ugh, is she dragging them over from the west?! You there, If you don't want to end up frozen, GET BEHIND ME, NOW!!
Fate of the Fallen#036.dst: Ugh, ¿los está arrastrando desde el oeste? ¡Tú, si no quieres acabar congelado, PONTE DETRÁS DE MÍ, YA!
Fate of the Fallen#036.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#037.src: Phew... You're out of danger now. If you hadn't left town, though, you wouldn't have been IN any danger at all!
Fate of the Fallen#037.dst: Uf... Ya estás fuera de peligro. ¡Aunque si no hubieras salido del pueblo, no habrías corrido NINGÚN peligro!
Fate of the Fallen#037.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#038.src: Don't bother apologizing to me, just get back to town. Now.
Fate of the Fallen#038.dst: No te molestes en disculparte, vuelve al pueblo. Ahora.
Fate of the Fallen#038.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#039.src: Next time you feel like picking flowers in the forest or whatever you were doing, remember you have a life to live, hm?!
Fate of the Fallen#039.dst: La próxima vez que te dé por coger flores en el bosque o lo que fuera, recuerda que solo tienes una vida, ¿eh?
Fate of the Fallen#039.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#040.src: Every day, more corrupteds, more deaths... There is only one thing for it. I have to tackle it myself. Cut the roots...and kill this hellish weed.
Fate of the Fallen#040.dst: Cada día, más corruptos, más muertes... Solo queda una salida. Tengo que encargarme yo mismo. Cortar las raíces... y matar esta maleza infernal.
Fate of the Fallen#040.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#041.src: Still here? Well, listen up. Myself and a few others are planning something risky. Damned be it if our minds are lost, I need to go through that portal.
Fate of the Fallen#041.dst: ¿Sigues aquí? Pues escucha. Unos cuantos y yo estamos tramando algo arriesgado. Maldita sea si perdemos la cordura: tengo que cruzar ese portal.
Fate of the Fallen#041.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#042.src: You look heavily geared, so I'm conscripting you. Meet us at our base, immediately. Follow the river south and you'll see a house on the right side.
Fate of the Fallen#042.dst: Vas bien equipado, así que te recluto. Reúnete con nosotros en la base, de inmediato. Sigue el río hacia el sur y verás una casa a la derecha.
Fate of the Fallen#042.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#043.src: Head to the base of the operation south of {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].
Fate of the Fallen#043.dst: Dirígete a la base de la operación al sur de {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].

Fate of the Fallen#044.src: Well, I'll give you this. You're prompt to listen to orders, at least. We're headed to the {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#044.dst: Bueno, eso te lo concedo. Al menos obedeces las órdenes con rapidez. Vamos hacia {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#044.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#045.src: The last man that entered the portal and returned became Bak’al... But if there is even a fraction of a chance this could work, we must take it at this point.
Fate of the Fallen#045.dst: El último que entró en el portal y volvió se convirtió en Bak’al... Pero si hay la más mínima posibilidad, a estas alturas hay que aprovecharla.
Fate of the Fallen#045.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#046.src: Let's get moving. We'll be taking no breaks on the trip, so I hope you were prepared.
Fate of the Fallen#046.dst: En marcha. No habrá descansos en el camino, así que espero que vengas preparado.
Fate of the Fallen#046.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#047.src: Now. The sheer cold I command can stave off corruption itself. Somehow I doubt any of you can say the same. I'll go in alone.
Fate of the Fallen#047.dst: Bien. El frío absoluto que domino puede contener a la Corrupción misma. Dudo que ninguno de vosotros pueda decir lo mismo. Entraré solo.
Fate of the Fallen#047.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#048.src: When I enter... If I had to make an assumption, corrupteds will swarm the portal after me. Your job? Slay them. I can't have distractions in there.
Fate of the Fallen#048.dst: Cuando entre... Supongo que los corruptos se abalanzarán sobre el portal detrás de mí. ¿Vuestra tarea? Matarlos. No puedo permitirme distracciones ahí dentro.
Fate of the Fallen#048.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#049.src: You will not be leaving your post here until I exit that portal. Understood?
Fate of the Fallen#049.dst: No abandonarás tu puesto hasta que yo salga de ese portal. ¿Entendido?
Fate of the Fallen#049.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#052.src: ...no, no, no no no NO!! DAMN IT ALL!!
Fate of the Fallen#052.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#053.src: You know what happened?! I lost!! I will destroy the province if I turn completely! GET AWAY, NOW! DO YOU HEAR ME?! RUN!!
Fate of the Fallen#053.dst: ¡¿Sabes qué ha pasado?! ¡¡He perdido!! ¡Si me transformo del todo destruiré la provincia! ¡ALÉJATE, YA! ¡¿ME OYES?! ¡¡CORRE!!
Fate of the Fallen#053.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#054.src: I... C-calm yourself, Theorick...don't...don't lose yourself to it...there's...yet a solution...one way...
Fate of the Fallen#054.dst: Yo... C-cálmate, Theorick... no... no dejes que te devore... aún... hay una solución... un camino...
Fate of the Fallen#054.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#055.src: Oh...you again...the others...dead? Run off? Cowards...urgh...
Fate of the Fallen#055.dst: Ah... otra vez tú... los demás... ¿muertos? ¿Huyeron? Cobardes... urgh...
Fate of the Fallen#055.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#056.src: You live...so...eyes up. Listen to me. If I turn...w-when...when I turn...n-no, can't...gaaah, I'll destr- Nggh...
Fate of the Fallen#056.dst: Vives... pues... escúchame. Si me transformo... c-cuando me transforme... n-no, no puedo... gaaah, destrui- Nggh...
Fate of the Fallen#056.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#057.src: I won't last, you can tell... Right now...killing me is an impossibility, you idiotic weakl- Agh, GET OUT OF MY MIND!!
Fate of the Fallen#057.dst: No aguantaré, se nota... Ahora mismo... matarme es imposible, débil idio- Agh, ¡¡FUERA DE MI MENTE!!
Fate of the Fallen#057.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#058.src: Gaaah... Tell...everyone. I will freeze this place. I...t-too fargone. It needs time to heal...and my powers m-must be dampened...frozen...
Fate of the Fallen#058.dst: Gaaah... Díselo... a todos. Congelaré este lugar. Yo... e-estoy demasiado ido. La tierra necesita sanar... y mi poder d-debe ser sofocado... congelado...
Fate of the Fallen#058.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#059.src: All worthless... Urgh, no...they yet deserve life...and this spell...it will surely claim some. Please, let them know why...
Fate of the Fallen#059.dst: Todos inútiles... Urgh, no... aún merecen vivir... y este hechizo... seguro que se cobrará a algunos. Por favor, que sepan por qué...
Fate of the Fallen#059.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#060.src: If I have learned anything from that insufferable f- ...from Mael...deaths without reason lets spirits to linger. I would...prefer against giving him a harder time.
Fate of the Fallen#060.dst: Si algo aprendí de ese insufrible ca- ...de Mael... las muertes sin motivo hacen que los espíritus se queden. Preferiría... no complicarle más las cosas.
Fate of the Fallen#060.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#061.src: K-keep advancing. Your things, if everyone was as strong as you...we may stand a chance. This could end me, in time, once I am weaker.
Fate of the Fallen#061.dst: S-sigue avanzando. Si todos fueran tan fuertes como tú... quizá tendríamos opción. Con el tiempo, cuando esté más débil, esto podría acabar conmigo.
Fate of the Fallen#061.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#062.src: Let it be known...Theorick Twain is not dead. He cannot be killed...all will burn...until future days. Here, in this accursed place. Find me...and end it all.
Fate of the Fallen#062.dst: Que se sepa... Theorick Twain no ha muerto. No puede morir... todo arderá hasta días futuros. Aquí, en este lugar maldito. Encuéntrame... y acábalo todo.
Fate of the Fallen#062.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#063.src: Tell Telvu the mage what happened.
Fate of the Fallen#063.dst: Cuéntale al mago Telvu lo ocurrido.

Fate of the Fallen#064.src: You must have succeeded, or you would be yet in the memory of the past. I can feel some potent magic on you.
Fate of the Fallen#064.dst: Debes de haberlo logrado, o seguirías en el recuerdo del pasado. Percibo una magia potente en ti.
Fate of the Fallen#064.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#065.src: So, you met Theorick? He was always said to have fallen from heroism after the great freezing.
Fate of the Fallen#065.dst: Así que conociste a Theorick. Siempre se dijo que cayó del heroísmo tras la gran congelación.
Fate of the Fallen#065.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#066.src: Were you able to figure out why it was he froze this place, at least?
Fate of the Fallen#066.dst: ¿Al menos pudiste averiguar por qué congeló este lugar?
Fate of the Fallen#066.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#067.src: What... so many revelations... ice magic staves off corruption...? It is true this palce has seen less corrupted threats than other places in the province...
Fate of the Fallen#067.dst: Qué... cuántas revelaciones... ¿la magia de hielo frena la Corrupción...? Cierto, aquí ha habido menos amenazas corruptas que en la provincia...
Fate of the Fallen#067.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#068.src: Dear gods... We've had it all wrong this whole time... This was to protect everyone...but surely he would have told someone his intentions if he was of that sound a mind!
Fate of the Fallen#068.dst: Dioses... Todo este tiempo lo hemos entendido al revés... Era para proteger a todos... ¡pero si hubiera estado tan cuerdo, seguro que le habría contado a alguien sus intenciones!
Fate of the Fallen#068.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#069.src: All this time, spent buried alive, wrestling with the corruption. The thought horrifies you, as well, judging by your face. Killing him would be a mercy.
Fate of the Fallen#069.dst: Todo este tiempo enterrado vivo, forcejeando con la Corrupción. A juzgar por tu cara, a ti también te horroriza la idea. Matarlo sería un acto de misericordia.
Fate of the Fallen#069.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#070.src: Here. Use this. It may help protect you within the Ice Barrows... Please, soldier. Be Theorick's guardian angel. Free him from this torment.
Fate of the Fallen#070.dst: Toma. Usa esto. Puede protegerte dentro de los Túmulos de Hielo... Por favor, soldado. Sé el ángel guardián de Theorick. Libéralo de este tormento.
Fate of the Fallen#070.speaker: Telvu

Finding the Light#000.src: Enter the portal, {u}. I shall show you the Gateway to Light... And I shall wish you luck.
Finding the Light#000.dst: Entra en el portal, {u}. Te mostraré la Puerta de la Luz... Y te deseo suerte.

Finding the Light#001.src: What you have done may not have been the right thing, by anyone's account. However, it was necessary. You have thrown off your bonds, in a sense.
Finding the Light#001.dst: Puede que lo que has hecho no fuera lo correcto para nadie. Pero era necesario. En cierto modo, te has librado de tus ataduras.

Finding the Light#002.src: New Quest Started: Realm of Light IV - Finding the Light
Finding the Light#002.dst: Nueva misión iniciada: Reino de la Luz IV - En busca de la luz

Finding the Light#003.src: That should have cracked open the foundation! You should check to see if you can reach the archive mentioned by the note card.
Finding the Light#003.dst: ¡Eso debería haber resquebrajado los cimientos! Comprueba si ya puedes llegar al archivo que mencionaba la nota.

Finding the Light#004.src: The door down below should open, now that you've activated the mechanisms.
Finding the Light#004.dst: La puerta de abajo debería abrirse ahora que has activado los mecanismos.

Finding the Light#005.src: Some of the few pages are ripped out. It seems to be describing an event occurring with the Guardian of the Forest until the first missing page.
Finding the Light#005.dst: Faltan algunas páginas, arrancadas. Hasta la primera que falta, parece describir algo que le ocurrió al Guardián del Bosque.

Finding the Light#006.src: The rest of the book is in perfect condition- Who could've done this if the archives were locked away? Did someone enter before you?
Finding the Light#006.dst: El resto del libro está intacto- ¿Quién pudo hacer esto si el archivo estaba cerrado? ¿Entró alguien antes que tú?

Finding the Light#007.src: ...so it returned, asleep and unwakeable. The light has spoken of a time when the Guardian shall grace us with its presence once more...
Finding the Light#007.dst: ...así volvió, dormido y sin poder despertar. La luz habló de un tiempo en que el Guardián nos honrará de nuevo con su presencia...

Finding the Light#008.src: ...but such a time is centuries off, and will require great effort. The spell included is vital to the process.
Finding the Light#008.dst: ...pero ese tiempo queda a siglos de distancia y exigirá un gran esfuerzo. El hechizo adjunto es vital para el proceso.

Finding the Light#009.src: The light also warns- If the darkness should encroach and reach the Guardian's roots, it shall never wake... But it seems we will not have to worry of that.
Finding the Light#009.dst: La luz también advierte- Si la oscuridad avanza hasta las raíces del Guardián, jamás despertará... Pero parece que eso no nos preocupará.

Finding the Light#010.src: There's another loose page here, with more High Gavellian text on it. Lari should be able to translate this.
Finding the Light#010.dst: Aquí hay otra hoja suelta, con más texto en alto gavelliano. Lari debería poder traducirla.

Finding the Light#011.src: ...go on, then, do it. I'm just needed here to be a translator for you thus far, it seems.
Finding the Light#011.dst: ...venga, hazlo. Por ahora parece que aquí solo hago falta como tu traductora.

Finding the Light#013.src: The voice of the Light told you to pursue her. You shouldn't stop now, should you?
Finding the Light#013.dst: La voz de la Luz te dijo que la siguieras. No irás a parar ahora, ¿verdad?

Finding the Light#014.src: The building looks climbable... You can probably eavesdrop on the conversation if you climb up the walls.
Finding the Light#014.dst: El edificio parece escalable... Si trepas por los muros, seguramente puedas escuchar la conversación.

Finding the Light#016.src: You got the plant! You should return by the Guardian of the Forest to proceed.
Finding the Light#016.dst: ¡Tienes la planta! Vuelve junto al Guardián del Bosque para continuar.

Finding the Light#017.src: I DON'T CARE ANYMORE! STOP STEALING MY LIFE LIKE THIS!!!
Finding the Light#017.dst: ¡YA NO ME IMPORTA! ¡¡¡DEJA DE ROBARME LA VIDA ASÍ!!!

Finding the Light#019.src: ...GRAAAAAUGH!! TELL ME HOW THIS IS "ENOUGH!" TELL ME, NOW!

Finding the Light#020.src: To do something "dark," you are about to say, and to that I say you have not.
Finding the Light#020.dst: Hacer algo "oscuro", ibas a decir, y a eso respondo que no lo has hecho.

Finding the Light#021.src: For a thousand years or more of your own thoughts, I understand that you are conflicted.
Finding the Light#021.dst: Tras mil años o más a solas con tus pensamientos, comprendo que estés en conflicto.

Finding the Light#022.src: However... You have, in that time, made a grave error. You have grown to realize an incorrect assumption.
Finding the Light#022.dst: Sin embargo... en ese tiempo has cometido un grave error. Has llegado a tomar por cierta una premisa falsa.

Finding the Light#023.src: Dark and Light... They oppose. They clash. They create a cloying pox. But, allow me to ask.
Finding the Light#023.dst: Oscuridad y Luz... Se oponen. Chocan. Engendran una plaga asfixiante. Pero permíteme preguntar.

Finding the Light#024.src: Is the axe evil for chopping the tree? Is the wood evil for resisting the metal?
Finding the Light#024.dst: ¿Es malvada el hacha por talar el árbol? ¿Y la madera por resistirse al metal?

Finding the Light#025.src: Are the flames evil for burning up the leaves? Is the water evil for dousing the fire?
Finding the Light#025.dst: ¿Son malvadas las llamas por quemar las hojas? ¿Y el agua por apagar el fuego?

Finding the Light#026.src: Is a victim evil for striking back against those that have struck them?
Finding the Light#026.dst: ¿Es malvada una víctima por devolver el golpe a quien la golpeó?

Finding the Light#027.src: And most importantly... Are any of these things light, or dark?
Finding the Light#027.dst: Y lo más importante... ¿Alguna de esas cosas es luz, u oscuridad?

Finding the Light#028.src: I will not ask you to. You must understand that Orphion has no moral bearings- He simply needs action.
Finding the Light#028.dst: No te lo pediré. Debes entender que Orphion no tiene brújula moral- Solo necesita que se actúe.

Finding the Light#029.src: I admit, such a thing is a conundrum. I agree that it is a tragedy to kill, in many instances.
Finding the Light#029.dst: Lo admito, es un dilema. Coincido en que matar es, en muchos casos, una tragedia.

Finding the Light#030.src: Yet when such an action could save the lives of others, it becomes a conundrum with no answer. An impossible value to weigh.
Finding the Light#030.dst: Pero cuando ese acto podría salvar otras vidas, se vuelve un dilema sin respuesta. Un peso imposible de medir.

Finding the Light#031.src: Despite the circumstances, you have done the best you could. I cannot fault you for your thoughts and morals.
Finding the Light#031.dst: Pese a las circunstancias, has hecho lo mejor que podías. No puedo reprocharte tus ideas ni tu moral.

Finding the Light#032.src: And so... As you are now proven, as I am awoken, the gateway to the Light shall reveal itself to you. Lari... You must prepare for your journey to the Realm of Light.
Finding the Light#032.dst: Así pues... Ahora que estás probado y que yo he despertado, la puerta a la Luz se te revelará. Lari... debes prepararte para tu viaje al Reino de la Luz.

Finding the Light#033.src: I do not blame you for it. By the time you have composed yourself, your ally will be ready. Understand that they are as necessary as you are.
Finding the Light#033.dst: No te culpo por ello. Cuando te hayas serenado, tu aliado estará listo. Entiende que es tan necesario como tú.

Finding the Light#034.src: I must ask you to pay close attention. I shall present it simply- though the enormity of this cannot be understated.
Finding the Light#034.dst: Debo pedirte que prestes mucha atención. Lo expondré de forma sencilla- aunque su magnitud es inmensa.

Finding the Light#035.src: This is our world, the world we stand in right now. The physical plane of existence.
Finding the Light#035.dst: Este es nuestro mundo, el mundo en que estamos ahora. El plano físico de la existencia.

Finding the Light#036.src: Only a select few are aware that there is more of the world than this. Even the astronomers and those who view the enormity of the sky cannot understand.
Finding the Light#036.dst: Solo unos pocos saben que el mundo es más que esto. Ni los astrónomos ni quienes contemplan la inmensidad del cielo llegan a comprenderlo.

Finding the Light#037.src: For, you see, this realm, this plane- It is mirrored upon a second plane, as the embodiments of Realms clash.
Finding the Light#037.dst: Verás, este reino, este plano- se refleja en un segundo plano, donde chocan las encarnaciones de los Reinos.

Finding the Light#038.src: This is the Plane of Influence, comprised of many realms. There are three you must know- But only one you must pay attention to.
Finding the Light#038.dst: Es el Plano de Influencia, formado por muchos reinos. Hay tres que debes conocer- pero solo uno al que debes atender.

Finding the Light#039.src: The Realms of Influence are connected to the physical plane, tied inexorably so to it. This is why even those gazing at the cosmos cannot grasp the enormity of it.
Finding the Light#039.dst: Los Reinos de Influencia están unidos al plano físico, atados a él de forma inexorable. Por eso ni quienes miran al cosmos abarcan su magnitud.

Finding the Light#040.src: These realms are in a constant push and pull- Battles that could not be seen by those of this world, waged constantly.
Finding the Light#040.dst: Esos reinos viven en un tira y afloja constante- batallas invisibles para este mundo, libradas sin descanso.

Finding the Light#041.src: However, they can be felt. Wide-scale changes to the balance of one realm or another are reflected on the physical plane.
Finding the Light#041.dst: Pero sí pueden sentirse. Los grandes cambios en el equilibrio de uno u otro reino se reflejan en el plano físico.

Finding the Light#042.src: The Realms of Influence are, themselves, reflections of a Beast- They themselves, a physical manifestation of their realm, as their realm is a manifestation of them.
Finding the Light#042.dst: Los Reinos de Influencia son, en sí mismos, reflejos de una Bestia- son la manifestación física de su reino, igual que su reino es manifestación de ellas.

Finding the Light#043.src: So surely, you must know- As Gavel has decayed, it must mean that the Realm of Light is in peril, and thus that Orphion is, as well.
Finding the Light#043.dst: Así que ya lo sabrás- si Gavel se ha marchitado, significa que el Reino de la Luz corre peligro, y por tanto Orphion también.

Finding the Light#044.src: The Light is infected- That abominable parasite has breached the Realm of Light, and sought Orphion to leech away his light.
Finding the Light#044.dst: La Luz está infectada- ese parásito abominable ha invadido el Reino de la Luz y ha buscado a Orphion para drenarle su luz.

Finding the Light#045.src: And so, as the sun is forced to set, the land of Gavel grows dark. As the dark parasites spread and devour the minds of those here, so too is Orphion subject to this torture.
Finding the Light#045.dst: Y así, forzado el sol a ponerse, la tierra de Gavel se oscurece. Mientras los parásitos oscuros se extienden y devoran las mentes de los de aquí, Orphion sufre esa misma tortura.

Finding the Light#046.src: Now, you must enter the Realm of Light, and aid Lari in purging the parasite, before its work is finished and Orphion's mind is consumed.
Finding the Light#046.dst: Ahora debes entrar en el Reino de la Luz y ayudar a Lari a purgar al parásito, antes de que termine su obra y consuma la mente de Orphion.

Finding the Light#047.src: You must ready yourself before this, of course. To venture to another realm is a lofty task.
Finding the Light#047.dst: Antes debes prepararte, por supuesto. Aventurarse a otro reino es una empresa mayúscula.

Finding the Light#048.src: I will bestow upon you two things that will surely aid you in this, however. First, I shall provide you the way to the Gateway to Light.
Finding the Light#048.dst: Aun así te concederé dos cosas que sin duda te ayudarán. Primero, te mostraré el camino hasta la Puerta de la Luz.

Finding the Light#049.src: Once you have reached it, I shall bestow upon you a personal blessing of mine, in the hopes that your path will become clear.
Finding the Light#049.dst: Cuando llegues a ella, te otorgaré una bendición mía, con la esperanza de que tu camino se despeje.

Finding the Light#052.src: ...ah. {u}. So you are needed here too, then?
Finding the Light#052.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#053.src: I am... TRYING... To awaken the Guardian of the Forest to receive its guidance, but it refuses to budge! Even the voice of Orphion provides no reaction.
Finding the Light#053.dst: Estoy... INTENTANDO... despertar al Guardián del Bosque para recibir su guía, ¡pero no se inmuta! Ni la voz de Orphion logra reacción alguna.
Finding the Light#053.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#054.src: I beg once more of you, awaken! Us two... Us two seek your wisdom!
Finding the Light#054.dst: ¡Te lo ruego una vez más, despierta! ¡Los dos... los dos buscamos tu sabiduría!
Finding the Light#054.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#055.src: I present you Orphion's barest light- Please, respond!
Finding the Light#055.dst: Te ofrezco la luz más tenue de Orphion- ¡Por favor, responde!
Finding the Light#055.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#056.src: Urgh... See? Nothing is happening. I'm at a loss of what to do. Maybe you can effect some change, considering what you've done before.
Finding the Light#056.dst: Urgh... ¿Ves? No pasa nada. No sé qué más hacer. Quizá tú puedas cambiar algo, con todo lo que has hecho antes.
Finding the Light#056.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#057.src: Urgh... See? Nothing is happening. I'm at a loss of what to do. Maybe you can affect some change, considering what you've done before.
Finding the Light#057.dst: Urgh... ¿Ves? No pasa nada. No sé qué más hacer. Quizá tú puedas cambiar algo, con todo lo que has hecho antes.
Finding the Light#057.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#058.src: My pulse, it is time. I shall shine my light upon the roots of the Guardian. You and she must learn now.
Finding the Light#058.dst: Mi pulso, ha llegado la hora. Haré brillar mi luz sobre las raíces del Guardián. Tú y ella debéis aprender ahora.

Finding the Light#059.src: Read the inscription at the bottom of the big tree.
Finding the Light#059.dst: Lee la inscripción al pie del gran árbol.

Finding the Light#060.src: An inscription! That wasn't there before! It was... That was completely instant. How did you even...?
Finding the Light#060.dst: ¡Una inscripción! ¡Antes no estaba ahí! Fue... fue completamente instantáneo. ¿Cómo has...?
Finding the Light#060.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#061.src: But, still! I knew I could be useful, let me translate this for you! As a stranger to Gavel you wouldn't know High Gavellian...
Finding the Light#061.dst: ¡Pero bueno! ¡Sabía que podía servir de algo, deja que te lo traduzca! Como no eres de Gavel, no sabrás alto gavelliano...
Finding the Light#061.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#062.src: It says... Secrets uncovered in the oldest of libraries in {p}.
Finding the Light#062.dst: Dice... Los secretos se descubren en la más antigua biblioteca de {p}.
Finding the Light#062.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#063.src: ...of course. A place that Elves aren't allowed, but humans are. {u}, you'll have to find this library on your own, it seems.
Finding the Light#063.dst: ...cómo no. Un lugar vedado a los elfos, pero no a los humanos. {u}, parece que tendrás que encontrar esa biblioteca por tu cuenta.
Finding the Light#063.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#064.src: Find the Church Library in the city of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Finding the Light#064.dst: Encuentra la Biblioteca de la Iglesia en la ciudad de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Finding the Light#065.src: Find a way up to the church bell at the top of the church.
Finding the Light#065.dst: Encuentra la forma de subir hasta la campana en lo alto de la iglesia.

Finding the Light#066.src: Explore the secret library and find a way to wake up the tree.
Finding the Light#066.dst: Explora la biblioteca secreta y halla la forma de despertar al árbol.

Finding the Light#068.src: Do you reject the light of Orphion? Waken, please!
Finding the Light#068.dst: ¿Rechazas la luz de Orphion? ¡Despierta, por favor!
Finding the Light#068.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#069.src: Urgh... {u}, please tell me you were able to make some progress. The Guardian still refuses... To... WAKE!
Finding the Light#069.dst: Urgh... {u}, dime que has avanzado algo, por favor. El Guardián sigue negándose a... ¡DESPERTAR!
Finding the Light#069.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#070.src: What is this? A spell scroll- Of the Waking Forest?! In {p}, of all places? Where it would have been... Impossible for me to go...
Finding the Light#070.dst: ¿Qué es esto? Un pergamino de hechizo- ¡¿del Bosque que Despierta?! ¿Y en {p}, precisamente? Donde me habría sido... imposible entrar...
Finding the Light#070.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#071.src: So I am Orphion's chosen, yet I would not have been able to do what was asked of me. That... No, I can't dwell on that, let me see the scroll.
Finding the Light#071.dst: Soy la elegida de Orphion y aun así no habría podido hacer lo que se me pedía. Eso... No, no puedo darle vueltas, déjame ver el pergamino.
Finding the Light#071.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#072.src: ...hm. It says, The seeker must rest these words upon those of the Guardian.
Finding the Light#072.dst: ...hm. Dice: el buscador debe posar estas palabras sobre las del Guardián.
Finding the Light#072.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#073.src: I suppose that means you need to place it by the inscription. So yet another task that you must finish...
Finding the Light#073.dst: Supongo que eso significa que has de ponerlo junto a la inscripción. Otra tarea más que debes terminar tú...
Finding the Light#073.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#074.src: ...go on, then, do it. I'm just needed here to be a translator for you thusfar, it seems.
Finding the Light#074.dst: ...venga, hazlo. Por ahora parece que aquí solo hago falta como tu traductora.
Finding the Light#074.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#075.src: Use the spell on the inscription under the tree.
Finding the Light#075.dst: Usa el hechizo sobre la inscripción bajo el árbol.

Finding the Light#076.src: Let me go ahead and read this, too. This will be tedious, I fear...
Finding the Light#076.dst: Deja que lea esto también. Me temo que será tedioso...
Finding the Light#076.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#077.src: It says... Awakening the Guardian of the Forest requires more than just magic. The home of the elves will house the answers and revelations...?
Finding the Light#077.dst: Dice... Despertar al Guardián del Bosque requiere algo más que magia. ¿El hogar de los elfos guardará las respuestas y revelaciones...?
Finding the Light#077.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#078.src: That... This is finally my time! I still have a hand in this!! Finally, I can do something more than just holding stasis here!
Finding the Light#078.dst: Eso... ¡Por fin me toca a mí! ¡¡Aún pinto algo en todo esto!! ¡Por fin puedo hacer algo más que sostener el equilibrio aquí!
Finding the Light#078.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#079.src: Listen, {u}. Achara... This is my time. I can finally help you more directly. I know the elders of {p}- They're sure to have answers!
Finding the Light#079.dst: Escucha, {u}. Achara... Es mi momento. Por fin puedo ayudarte más directamente. ¡Conozco a los ancianos de {p}- seguro que tienen respuestas!
Finding the Light#079.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#080.src: You truly have been helpful, even through my own worries. I must thank you, but you can relax now! I will be the one this time!
Finding the Light#080.dst: De verdad has sido de ayuda, pese a todas mis inquietudes. Debo darte las gracias, ¡pero ya puedes relajarte! ¡Esta vez seré yo!
Finding the Light#080.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#081.src: You can continue doing...whatever else it is you need doing. I have seen you helping in various places- Concern yourself with those for now. I can handle this.
Finding the Light#081.dst: Puedes seguir con... lo que sea que tengas que hacer. Te he visto ayudar en varios sitios- ocúpate de eso por ahora. Yo me encargo de esto.
Finding the Light#081.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#082.src: Pursue her, my pulse. She must take dire action- Alone, her light shall illuminate nothing. You must provide her direction.
Finding the Light#082.dst: Síguela, mi pulso. Debe tomar medidas extremas- sola, su luz no alumbrará nada. Tú has de darle rumbo.

Finding the Light#083.src: Enter the portal Lari left behind
Finding the Light#083.dst: Entra en el portal que dejó Lari

Finding the Light#084.src: Go to the hut Lari entered.
Finding the Light#084.dst: Ve a la cabaña en la que entró Lari.

Finding the Light#085.src: W-What? You- Why did you follow me? I can handle this! I can finally be useful again! Do you...not trust me?
Finding the Light#085.dst: ¿Q-Qué? Tú- ¿Por qué me has seguido? ¡Yo me encargo! ¡Por fin puedo volver a ser útil! ¿Es que... no confías en mí?
Finding the Light#085.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#086.src: Please, just respect my wishes! If I need your help, I'll go find you- For now, just leave! You don't need to worry about this!
Finding the Light#086.dst: ¡Por favor, respeta mis deseos! Si necesito tu ayuda, iré a buscarte- ¡por ahora, vete! ¡No tienes que preocuparte por esto!
Finding the Light#086.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#087.src: Find a way to sneak into the hut.
Finding the Light#087.dst: Encuentra la forma de colarte en la cabaña.

Finding the Light#088.src: ...if this human has truly done what you have said, then why do you spurn their aid? It is unlike you.
Finding the Light#088.dst: ...si este humano ha hecho de verdad lo que dices, ¿por qué rechazas su ayuda? No es propio de ti.
Finding the Light#088.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#089.src: I know, I know. I just am in disbelief. They've been contacted by Orphion himself, allowed into the Taproot, they have a symbol of Orphion's blessing!!
Finding the Light#089.dst: Lo sé, lo sé. Es que no me lo creo. ¡¡Orphion en persona lo ha contactado, le han dejado entrar en el Taproot, lleva un símbolo de la bendición de Orphion!!
Finding the Light#089.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#090.src: They just...walked up, after a thousand years of my putting my entire life into trying to save this province, and do everything I couldn't, in the span of weeks at most!
Finding the Light#090.dst: Simplemente... apareció, tras mil años volcando mi vida entera en salvar esta provincia, ¡y ha hecho todo lo que yo no pude en unas semanas a lo sumo!
Finding the Light#090.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#091.src: Do you understand how infuriating this is? Can you comprehend such a thing, not having been in my position yourself?
Finding the Light#091.dst: ¿Entiendes lo exasperante que es esto? ¿Puedes comprenderlo sin haber estado nunca en mi lugar?
Finding the Light#091.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#092.src: No. I cannot understand. But I also cannot understand how you are not grateful for this aid.
Finding the Light#092.dst: No. No puedo entenderlo. Pero tampoco entiendo cómo no agradeces esta ayuda.
Finding the Light#092.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#093.src: I know I should be! It's all I've been able to think about. I should be ecstatic! The light will be saved, it should be everything I've dreamed of...
Finding the Light#093.dst: ¡Sé que debería! Es en lo único que he podido pensar. ¡Debería estar eufórica! La luz se salvará, debería ser todo lo que he soñado...
Finding the Light#093.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#094.src: But it makes me feel like a complete failure. Like everything I have done has been for naught, that I have somehow been doing everything wrong!
Finding the Light#094.dst: Pero me hace sentir un fracaso absoluto. Como si todo lo que he hecho hubiera sido en vano, ¡como si lo hubiera hecho todo mal!
Finding the Light#094.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#095.src: I know I have made mistakes. Dullahan would still be... Still be himself, if I had taken faster action, but I can't have done nothing right. I can't accept that.
Finding the Light#095.dst: Sé que cometí errores. Dullahan seguiría siendo... él mismo si yo hubiera actuado antes, pero algo habré hecho bien. No acepto lo contrario.
Finding the Light#095.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#096.src: This is my chance to prove I can still be useful- that Orphion choosing me wasn't a fluke! Please, the inscription said you would know where to go!
Finding the Light#096.dst: Es mi oportunidad de demostrar que aún sirvo- ¡que Orphion no me eligió por casualidad! Por favor, ¡la inscripción decía que tú sabrías adónde ir!
Finding the Light#096.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#098.src: ...even after a millennium, there is so very much for us all to learn. Fine then.
Finding the Light#098.dst: ...incluso tras un milenio, a todos nos queda muchísimo por aprender. Está bien.
Finding the Light#098.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#099.src: But promise me to accept the aid you receive. This opportunity cannot be wasted, Lari.
Finding the Light#099.dst: Pero prométeme que aceptarás la ayuda que recibas. Esta oportunidad no puede desperdiciarse, Lari.
Finding the Light#099.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#100.src: ...I have to do at least one thing right. I can't just keep up this holding pattern. I'll do whatever is necessary!
Finding the Light#100.dst: ...Tengo que hacer al menos una cosa bien. No puedo seguir dando vueltas sin avanzar. ¡Haré lo que haga falta!
Finding the Light#100.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#101.src: You must seek the Canned Abis plant, then. It rests within a cavern shaded by giant fern leaves.
Finding the Light#101.dst: Entonces debes buscar la planta Canned Abis. Reposa en una caverna cubierta por hojas de helecho gigantes.
Finding the Light#101.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#102.src: Thank you. I can finally do what I was meant to do! I won't let anything stop me this time!!
Finding the Light#102.dst: Gracias. ¡Por fin puedo hacer aquello para lo que nací! ¡¡Esta vez no dejaré que nada me detenga!!
Finding the Light#102.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#103.src: ...Human, I can see you. Consider yourself lucky that she did not. Come talk to me.
Finding the Light#103.dst: ...Humano, te veo. Tienes suerte de que ella no. Ven a hablar conmigo.
Finding the Light#103.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#105.src: So you are Orphion's new chosen, then. It is both surprising and not- Humans have an interesting reputation.
Finding the Light#105.dst: Así que Orphion te ha elegido a ti. Sorprende y no sorprende- los humanos tenéis una reputación curiosa.
Finding the Light#105.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#106.src: Often said as being able to get anything done, without limits, be it completing impossible tasks or breaking moral tenets.
Finding the Light#106.dst: Se dice que sois capaces de lograr cualquier cosa, sin límites, ya sea completar tareas imposibles o quebrantar preceptos morales.
Finding the Light#106.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#107.src: In this instance, however, you've both to do. Orphion has commanded it, has he not? And so you must, and for that I apologize.
Finding the Light#107.dst: En este caso, sin embargo, tendrás que hacer ambas cosas. Orphion lo ha ordenado, ¿no es así? Así que debes hacerlo, y por ello te pido perdón.
Finding the Light#107.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#108.src: I have seen Lari's work- And she has done this land a priceless service. Alone, she has kept the Decay from creeping south, and thus the Guardian remains with us.
Finding the Light#108.dst: He visto la obra de Lari- y ha prestado a esta tierra un servicio impagable. Ella sola ha impedido que la Decadencia avance al sur, y por eso el Guardián sigue con nosotros.
Finding the Light#108.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#109.src: However, her own morals prevent the situation from progressing. She cannot kill- And the source must be exterminated for light to once again fill the land.
Finding the Light#109.dst: Sin embargo, su propia moral impide que la situación avance. No es capaz de matar- y hay que exterminar la fuente para que la luz vuelva a llenar la tierra.
Finding the Light#109.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#110.src: Orphion's circumstances are dire- And so you must come to understand something. He is above us, in terms of morals. Such concepts do not apply to him.
Finding the Light#110.dst: La situación de Orphion es crítica- y por eso debes comprender algo. Él está por encima de nosotros en cuanto a moral. Esos conceptos no se le aplican.
Finding the Light#110.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#111.src: As the embodiment of Light itself, he has no sense of morals- Merely survival and stasis. What he asks of us, many will balk at.
Finding the Light#111.dst: Como encarnación de la Luz misma, carece de moral- solo hay supervivencia y equilibrio. Lo que nos pide, muchos lo rechazarán.
Finding the Light#111.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#112.src: It is a matter where morals must be set aside... And such a thing is one that Lari cannot abide by, for she has stubbornly clung to them for a thousand years.
Finding the Light#112.dst: Es un asunto en el que la moral debe dejarse a un lado... Y eso es algo que Lari no puede tolerar, pues lleva mil años aferrada a ella con terquedad.
Finding the Light#112.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#113.src: To break them... I will admit, I believe there to be some other way to solve these problems, but the fact of the matter is there simply is no time left.
Finding the Light#113.dst: Romperla... Reconozco que creo que hay otra forma de resolver estos problemas, pero lo cierto es que ya no queda tiempo.
Finding the Light#113.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#114.src: She must use the extent of her powers, and while she retains her pacifism that will not happen. I must ask you to follow her, as Orphion would wish.
Finding the Light#114.dst: Debe usar todo su poder, y mientras conserve su pacifismo eso no ocurrirá. He de pedirte que la sigas, como Orphion querría.
Finding the Light#114.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#115.src: There is, unfortunately, no right to this. There is simply necessity- And there, you must push her to her limits. Seek the cave of the Canned Abis.
Finding the Light#115.dst: Por desgracia, aquí no hay nada correcto. Solo hay necesidad- y allí deberás llevarla al límite. Busca la cueva de la Canned Abis.
Finding the Light#115.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#116.src: It is north-east from here. The entrance is shaded by giant fern leaves. I only pray that this will be enough.
Finding the Light#116.dst: Está al noreste de aquí. La entrada queda cubierta por hojas de helecho gigantes. Solo ruego que esto baste.
Finding the Light#116.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#117.src: Find the Canned Abis cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Finding the Light#117.dst: Encuentra la cueva de la Canned Abis en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Finding the Light#118.src: Find the plant inside the cave.
Finding the Light#118.dst: Encuentra la planta dentro de la cueva.

Finding the Light#120.src: ...I can't believe this. What am I doing wrong? What is it? There has to be some reason, what IS it?!
Finding the Light#120.dst: ...No me lo puedo creer. ¿Qué estoy haciendo mal? ¿Qué es? Tiene que haber una razón, ¡¿cuál ES?!
Finding the Light#120.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#121.src: There's not another inscription...it's just the same words! What does it mean by "dire actions?!" I've done everything I can think of!
Finding the Light#121.dst: No hay otra inscripción... ¡son las mismas palabras! ¡¿Qué quiere decir con "medidas extremas"?! ¡He hecho todo lo que se me ocurre!
Finding the Light#121.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#122.src: ...{u}. I. I have to know. What did Orphion tell you, exactly? I can't stand not knowing any longer. Did he really replace me?
Finding the Light#122.dst: ...{u}. Yo. Tengo que saberlo. ¿Qué te dijo Orphion exactamente? No soporto seguir sin saberlo. ¿De verdad me ha sustituido?

Finding the Light#123.src: Is- Is this not dire enough? Is poring over you and putting aside my role and pride to someone else not EXTREME enough?!
Finding the Light#123.dst: ¿No- no es esto bastante extremo? ¡¿Escudriñarte y ceder mi papel y mi orgullo a otro no es lo bastante EXTREMO?!
Finding the Light#123.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#124.src: .... I. I have to know. What did Orphion tell you, exactly? I can't stand not knowing any longer. Did he really replace me?
Finding the Light#124.dst: .... Yo. Tengo que saberlo. ¿Qué te dijo Orphion exactamente? No soporto seguir a oscuras. ¿De verdad me ha reemplazado?
Finding the Light#124.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#125.src: I can't think of any other reason why everything for me has just...stopped working. Did he? Please, tell me-
Finding the Light#125.dst: No se me ocurre otra razón por la que todo lo mío haya... dejado de funcionar. ¿Lo hizo? Por favor, dímelo-
Finding the Light#125.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#126.src: ...wait... You... You have Canned Abis on you!! Where did you get that?!
Finding the Light#126.dst: ...espera... Tú... ¡¡Llevas Canned Abis encima!! ¡¿De dónde lo has sacado?!
Finding the Light#126.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#127.src: You... There's no way you would've known that unless you... YOU! You eavesdropped on me!!
Finding the Light#127.dst: Tú... No podrías saber eso a menos que... ¡TÚ! ¡¡Me estuviste espiando!!
Finding the Light#127.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#128.src: You FOLLOWED ME into the cave even after I asked not to! You... After everything I said!! After you heard all those private thoughts!
Finding the Light#128.dst: ¡ME SEGUISTE hasta la cueva aunque te pedí que no! Tú... ¡¡Después de todo lo que dije!! ¡Después de oír todos esos pensamientos íntimos!
Finding the Light#128.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#129.src: You STILL decided it was a good idea to come after me! What are you planning to accomplish like this?!
Finding the Light#129.dst: ¡Y AUN ASÍ te pareció buena idea venir tras de mí! ¡¿Qué pretendes conseguir así?!
Finding the Light#129.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#130.src: What, are you thinking ‘’oh, let's follow the funny elf girl and see her FAIL, OVER and OVER AGAIN!?‘’ IS THAT IT?!
Finding the Light#130.dst: ¿Qué, estás pensando ‘’ah, sigamos a la elfa graciosa y veámosla FRACASAR, UNA y OTRA VEZ!?‘’ ¡¿ES ESO?!
Finding the Light#130.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#131.src: You heard me then!! It's ALL out in the open! I can't succeed! You're there! You're doing everything I couldn't!
Finding the Light#131.dst: ¡¡Me oíste!! ¡Está TODO al descubierto! ¡No puedo lograrlo! ¡Tú sí! ¡Haces todo lo que yo no pude!
Finding the Light#131.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#132.src: I'm NOT a failure! I'm not! I won't be! I refuse to be! You don't GET to watch me flounder and flail!!
Finding the Light#132.dst: ¡NO soy un fracaso! ¡No lo soy! ¡No lo seré! ¡Me niego a serlo! ¡¡No TIENES derecho a verme tropezar y manotear!!
Finding the Light#132.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#135.src: Wha- I... What just... What did I...?
Finding the Light#135.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#138.src: ...GRAAAAAUGH!! TELL ME HOW THIS IS ‘’ENOUGH!‘’ TELL ME, NOW!
Finding the Light#138.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#139.src: I-I NEARLY KILLED THEM! I JUST BROKE AND DEFILED EVERYTHING I'VE EVER STOOD FOR!!
Finding the Light#139.dst: ¡C-CASI LO MATO! ¡¡ACABO DE ROMPER Y PROFANAR TODO LO QUE HE DEFENDIDO SIEMPRE!!
Finding the Light#139.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#140.src: TELL ME!! HOW COULD THIS POSSIBLY BE THE ANSWER?! HOW COULD THIS BE WHAT NEEDED TO HAPPEN?!
Finding the Light#140.dst: ¡¡DÍMELO!! ¡¿CÓMO PUEDE SER ESTA LA RESPUESTA?! ¡¿CÓMO PUEDE SER ESTO LO QUE TENÍA QUE PASAR?!
Finding the Light#140.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#141.src: WHY WOULD I BE NEEDED TO... To...
Finding the Light#141.dst: ¿POR QUÉ HARÍA FALTA QUE YO... Que...
Finding the Light#141.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#142.src: T-Trying to murder them because they did what I couldn't isn't dark? How can you possibly think that?!
Finding the Light#142.dst: ¿I-intentar matarlo porque hizo lo que yo no pude no es oscuridad? ¡¿Cómo puedes pensar eso?!
Finding the Light#142.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#143.src: What kind of guardian are you, permissing this kind of violence? How is anything I just did alright?
Finding the Light#143.dst: ¿Qué clase de guardián eres, permitiendo semejante violencia? ¿Cómo va a estar bien nada de lo que acabo de hacer?
Finding the Light#143.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#144.src: ...you. You can't possibly be saying that what I did was the right thing to do. I refuse to accept that.
Finding the Light#144.dst: ...tú. No puedes estar diciendo que lo que hice estuvo bien. Me niego a aceptarlo.
Finding the Light#144.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#146.src: ...then... Shouldn't I feel... I don't know. Shouldn't I feel less restrained? Less afraid? More... More free?
Finding the Light#146.dst: ...entonces... ¿No debería sentirme...? No sé. ¿No debería sentirme menos atada? ¿Menos asustada? ¿Más... más libre?
Finding the Light#146.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#147.src: If what I've done was what needed to happen, why do I feel like the scum of the earth? Why do I feel so terrible?!
Finding the Light#147.dst: Si lo que he hecho era lo que tenía que pasar, ¿por qué me siento la peor escoria? ¡¿Por qué me siento tan mal?!
Finding the Light#147.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#148.src: ...I... I need time to process this. I... Do you understand how difficult this is to hear? To bear?
Finding the Light#148.dst: ...Yo... Necesito tiempo para asimilarlo. Yo... ¿Entiendes lo difícil que es oír esto? ¿Soportarlo?
Finding the Light#148.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#149.src: My pulse, your light is brilliant... It has shone upon Lari, and soon her light will shine my way...
Finding the Light#149.dst: Mi pulso, tu luz es deslumbrante... Ha brillado sobre Lari, y pronto la suya brillará hacia mí...

Finding the Light#150.src: Enter the roots, and witness the path to my realm. And then, prepare yourself. Muster your most blinding light...
Finding the Light#150.dst: Entra en las raíces y contempla el camino a mi reino. Y luego, prepárate. Reúne tu luz más cegadora...

Flight in Distress#000.src: Bring your Gavellian Passport to the Airship Clerk at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Flight in Distress#000.dst: Lleva tu pasaporte de Gavel al encargado de la aeronave en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Flight in Distress#001.src: Good day, soldier! Will you be flying with us today?
Flight in Distress#001.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#002.src: May I see your passport please?
Flight in Distress#002.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#003.src: It's a bit dusty! It looks very old, but the picture looks like you.
Flight in Distress#003.dst: ¡Está algo polvoriento! Parece muy antiguo, pero la foto es usted.
Flight in Distress#003.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#004.src: Well everything seems to be in order, climb aboard and I hope you have a pleasant journey.
Flight in Distress#004.dst: Bien, todo parece estar en orden. Suba a bordo y que tenga un viaje agradable.
Flight in Distress#004.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#006.src: Please remain seated, passengers. We'll be taking off in a moment!
Flight in Distress#006.dst: Pasajeros, permanezcan sentados. ¡Despegaremos en un momento!
Flight in Distress#006.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#007.src: Speak to Captain Ackbar regarding the missing child.
Flight in Distress#007.dst: Habla con el capitán Ackbar sobre el niño desaparecido.

Flight in Distress#008.src: Attention passengers. There has been a missing person reported aboard. If there are any volunteers to help search for them, please report to the bridge and speak to the captain.
Flight in Distress#008.dst: Atención, pasajeros. Se ha denunciado la desaparición de una persona a bordo. Si hay voluntarios para ayudar en la búsqueda, preséntense en el puente y hablen con el capitán.
Flight in Distress#008.speaker: Broadcast

Flight in Distress#009.src: This area is off limits to passengers during take off. Climb up to the passenger decks, there will be an attendee waiting at your cabin.
Flight in Distress#009.dst: Esta zona está prohibida a los pasajeros durante el despegue. Suba a las cubiertas de pasajeros; habrá un auxiliar esperando en su camarote.
Flight in Distress#009.speaker: Ship Crew

Flight in Distress#010.src: I hope I do not get nauseous...
Flight in Distress#010.speaker: Passenger Jeremy

Flight in Distress#011.src: Greetings, young adventurer. You haven't seen my glasses, have you?
Flight in Distress#011.dst: Saludos, joven aventurero. ¿No habrás visto mis gafas?
Flight in Distress#011.speaker: Baron Axol

Flight in Distress#012.src: The interior of this ship is beautiful!
Flight in Distress#012.dst: ¡El interior de esta nave es precioso!
Flight in Distress#012.speaker: Passenger John

Flight in Distress#013.src: Good day to you, soldier! This will be your quarters for the flight. I wish you a pleasant trip with us!
Flight in Distress#013.dst: ¡Buenos días, soldado! Este será su camarote durante el vuelo. ¡Le deseo un feliz viaje con nosotros!
Flight in Distress#013.speaker: Attendant

Flight in Distress#014.src: You can sleep through your journey here if you have nothing else to do!
Flight in Distress#014.dst: ¡Si no tiene nada más que hacer, puede dormir aquí todo el viaje!
Flight in Distress#014.speaker: Attendant

Flight in Distress#015.src: The food they serve here is dreadful! As if it were meant for beasts they transport below deck.
Flight in Distress#015.dst: ¡La comida que sirven aquí es espantosa! Como si fuera para las bestias que llevan bajo cubierta.
Flight in Distress#015.speaker: Passenger Casula

Flight in Distress#016.src: *Sniff*... Have you seen my child? We were in our cabin, and then he just disappeared!
Flight in Distress#016.dst: *Snif*... ¿Has visto a mi hijo? ¡Estábamos en el camarote y de pronto desapareció!
Flight in Distress#016.speaker: Passenger Nancy

Flight in Distress#017.src: I heard that a big ship was approaching from north. I saw it from the entrance deck. I wonder what they are doing.
Flight in Distress#017.dst: Oí que un barco grande se acercaba por el norte. Lo vi desde la cubierta de entrada. Me pregunto qué querrán.
Flight in Distress#017.speaker: Sub-engineer Akot

Flight in Distress#018.src: Are you here to volunteer to search for the missing child?
Flight in Distress#018.dst: ¿Vienes a ofrecerte voluntario para buscar al niño desaparecido?
Flight in Distress#018.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#019.src: We only just to set off and there is already an incident.
Flight in Distress#019.dst: Apenas hemos zarpado y ya tenemos un incidente.
Flight in Distress#019.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#020.src: His mother informed us that her son disappeared soon after boarding.
Flight in Distress#020.dst: Su madre nos ha dicho que su hijo desapareció poco después de embarcar.
Flight in Distress#020.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#021.src: Poor parenting, if you ask me. Alas, we must find the lad.
Flight in Distress#021.dst: Mala crianza, si me lo preguntas. En fin, hay que encontrar al chaval.
Flight in Distress#021.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#022.src: Since we don't have any leads, it might be best to ask some of the passengers for information.
Flight in Distress#022.dst: Como no tenemos ninguna pista, lo mejor será preguntar a algunos pasajeros.
Flight in Distress#022.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#023.src: Most of them will be in the dining area or in the lounge.
Flight in Distress#023.dst: La mayoría estarán en el comedor o en el salón.
Flight in Distress#023.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#024.src: Thank you so much for your help; I hope you find the lad soon.
Flight in Distress#024.dst: Muchísimas gracias por tu ayuda; espero que encuentres pronto al chaval.
Flight in Distress#024.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#025.src: Try and find out where the missing child is located by speaking to the passengers.
Flight in Distress#025.dst: Habla con los pasajeros para averiguar dónde está el niño desaparecido.

Flight in Distress#026.src: Hey! Look at that ship over in the distance. It has been following the ship almost since we left off.
Flight in Distress#026.dst: ¡Eh! Mira ese barco a lo lejos. Lleva siguiéndonos casi desde que salimos.
Flight in Distress#026.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#027.src: I know I shouldn't be down here but...
Flight in Distress#027.dst: Ya sé que no debo estar aquí, pero...
Flight in Distress#027.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#028.src: I love airships, and I have never seen one like that.
Flight in Distress#028.dst: Me encantan las aeronaves, y nunca había visto una así.
Flight in Distress#028.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#030.src: Okay then, I will head back right now!
Flight in Distress#030.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#032.src: Thank you so much for finding my child! He will not be leaving my side for the rest of the trip.
Flight in Distress#032.dst: ¡Muchísimas gracias por encontrar a mi hijo! No se separará de mí en lo que queda de viaje.
Flight in Distress#032.speaker: Passenger Nancy

Flight in Distress#033.src: I'm sorry I caused such a worry earlier...
Flight in Distress#033.dst: Siento haber preocupado tanto a todos...
Flight in Distress#033.speaker: Found Child

Flight in Distress#034.src: Hello again, did you find him?
Flight in Distress#034.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#035.src: How did he get down there?! There is supposed to be someone on duty!
Flight in Distress#035.dst: ¡¿Cómo llegó ahí abajo?! ¡Se supone que hay alguien de guardia!
Flight in Distress#035.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#036.src: Thank you so much for finding him. You were the only volunteer.
Flight in Distress#036.dst: Muchísimas gracias por encontrarlo. Fuiste la única persona que se ofreció.
Flight in Distress#036.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#037.src: Hopefully that is the only hiccup in the journey.
Flight in Distress#037.dst: Ojalá ese sea el único contratiempo del viaje.
Flight in Distress#037.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#038.src: What in good heavens was that? Crew, report!
Flight in Distress#038.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#039.src: Sir! One of our engines blew out! We've lost all thrust on that side.
Flight in Distress#039.dst: ¡Señor! ¡Un motor ha reventado! Sin empuje en ese lado.
Flight in Distress#039.speaker: Airship Crewmember

Flight in Distress#040.src: Blast it all! We are sitting dead in the water without both engines.
Flight in Distress#040.dst: ¡Maldita sea! Sin los dos motores nos quedamos parados en seco.
Flight in Distress#040.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#041.src: Go check on the condition of the passengers.
Flight in Distress#041.dst: Ve a ver cómo están los pasajeros.
Flight in Distress#041.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#042.src: Soldier, go report to the Engineer in the engine room and see if there is anything you can do to help us get moving once again.
Flight in Distress#042.dst: Soldado, preséntate al ingeniero en la sala de máquinas y mira si puedes hacer algo para que volvamos a movernos.
Flight in Distress#042.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#043.src: Look if the engineer has something for you to do in order to help.
Flight in Distress#043.dst: Mira si el ingeniero tiene algo en lo que puedas ayudar.

Flight in Distress#044.src: You must be the 'uman the captain done told me.
Flight in Distress#044.dst: Tú debes de ser el humano que m'ha dicho el capitán.
Flight in Distress#044.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#045.src: We sure are havin' quite the situation down 'ere.
Flight in Distress#045.dst: Vaya papeleta que tenemos aquí abajo, ya te digo.
Flight in Distress#045.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#046.src: I hafta stay here and man the 'ngines, else she might damage 'erself.
Flight in Distress#046.dst: Yo tengo que quedarme al pie de los motores, no vaya a estropearse la pobre.
Flight in Distress#046.speaker: Engineer Eric
