Flight in Distress#047.src: If ye wanna help 'uman, go on up the riggin' and take a gander at the props.
Flight in Distress#047.dst: Si quieres ayudar, humano, sube por la jarcia y échale un ojo a las hélices.
Flight in Distress#047.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#048.src: Ye can get to 'em through the access 'atches in the bridge.
Flight in Distress#048.dst: Se llega a ellas por las escotillas de acceso del puente.
Flight in Distress#048.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#049.src: If'n they're stopped, just hit the breakers that are off.
Flight in Distress#049.dst: Si están paradas, sube los interruptores que estén bajados y ya está.
Flight in Distress#049.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#050.src: Come back here when ye done. I need ta stay here and keep her cool.
Flight in Distress#050.dst: Vuelve p'acá cuando acabes. Yo tengo que quedarme aquí refrescándola.
Flight in Distress#050.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#051.src: Go find and fix the issue with the airship's engines. They are located on top of the balloon through the bridge.
Flight in Distress#051.dst: Encuentra y arregla el problema de los motores de la aeronave. Están sobre el globo, se llega por el puente.

Flight in Distress#052.src: In event of shut-down, maitenence must be performed.
Flight in Distress#052.dst: En caso de parada, debe realizarse el mantenimiento.
Flight in Distress#052.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#053.src: Worker must restart all wooden switches before engine overheats.
Flight in Distress#053.dst: El operario debe reactivar los interruptores antes del recalentamiento.
Flight in Distress#053.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#054.src: DO NOT PRESS THE STONE SWITCHES
Flight in Distress#054.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#055.src: Report to Engineer Eric that you fixed the engines.
Flight in Distress#055.dst: Informa al ingeniero Eric de que has arreglado los motores.

Flight in Distress#056.src: Thank ye! The 'ngines are back up and running!
Flight in Distress#056.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#057.src: I couldn't have dun this without ye.
Flight in Distress#057.dst: Sin ti no lo habría sacao.
Flight in Distress#057.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#058.src: You go back to yer quarters and get some rest. A passen'er like yerself shouldn' have to help the crew.
Flight in Distress#058.dst: Vuelve a tu camarote y descansa. Un pasajero como tú no tendría que andar ayudando a la tripulación.
Flight in Distress#058.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#059.src: I hope the rest of yer journey is good. I'll let the cap'n know so he can turn her up ta max and get us movin' again.
Flight in Distress#059.dst: Que te vaya bien el resto del viaje. Le aviso al capitán pa' que la ponga al máximo y sigamos camino.
Flight in Distress#059.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#063.src: All staff report to stations! This is not a drill! All staff report to stations!
Flight in Distress#063.dst: ¡Personal a sus puestos! ¡No es un simulacro! ¡Personal a sus puestos!
Flight in Distress#063.speaker: Broadcast

Flight in Distress#064.src: Explore the lower deck and find out what caused the explosion.
Flight in Distress#064.dst: Explora la cubierta inferior y averigua qué causó la explosión.

Flight in Distress#065.src: Hol' togetha old girl, ye got this!
Flight in Distress#065.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#066.src: Men, hold her steady. We can still survive this! We just need to stop them following us.
Flight in Distress#066.dst: Muchachos, mantenedla firme. ¡Aún podemos salir de esta! Solo hay que impedir que nos sigan.
Flight in Distress#066.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#068.src: Look here girls, the meat has come to us!
Flight in Distress#068.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#069.src: Send more in! They can't get all of us!
Flight in Distress#069.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#070.src: The rest of you all, get in here!
Flight in Distress#070.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#072.src: I heard fighting? Is someone there? I am in the jail cell!
Flight in Distress#072.dst: ¿He oído pelea? ¿Hay alguien ahí? ¡Estoy en la celda!
Flight in Distress#072.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#074.src: I heard fighting above, well done! Any chance to see those raiders get what's coming warms my old heart.
Flight in Distress#074.dst: Oí la pelea de arriba, ¡bien hecho! Ver a esos saqueadores recibir su merecido me calienta el viejo corazón.
Flight in Distress#074.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#075.src: I used to be the greatest locksmith in all of Gavel! I was known all over, unfortunately.
Flight in Distress#075.dst: ¡Fui el mejor cerrajero de todo Gavel! Me conocían en todas partes, por desgracia.
Flight in Distress#075.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#076.src: These fiends captured me, years ago, and made me create hundreds of keys for their raids.
Flight in Distress#076.dst: Estos desalmados me capturaron hace años y me hicieron fabricar cientos de llaves para sus asaltos.
Flight in Distress#076.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#077.src: I am much too old now, but I would love to see them taken down before I leave this world.
Flight in Distress#077.dst: Ya soy demasiado viejo, pero me encantaría verlos caer antes de dejar este mundo.
Flight in Distress#077.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#078.src: My key making gear is stored down the hall, behind the staircase. You can use them to craft a way inside the Queen's quarters.
Flight in Distress#078.dst: Mis herramientas de cerrajería están al fondo del pasillo, tras la escalera. Con ellas puedes fabricar la entrada al camarote de la Reina.
Flight in Distress#078.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#079.src: Just look into the keyhole to see how to make them. Good luck!
Flight in Distress#079.dst: Mira por la cerradura para ver cómo hacerla. ¡Buena suerte!
Flight in Distress#079.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#080.src: Make the key to reach the Skyraider Queen.
Flight in Distress#080.dst: Fabrica la llave para llegar hasta la reina de los Skyraiders.

Flight in Distress#081.src: So you think you can just come on my ship, huh?
Flight in Distress#081.dst: ¿Así que crees que puedes subir a mi nave sin más?
Flight in Distress#081.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#082.src: Kill my crew? Interrupt my plunder?
Flight in Distress#082.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#083.src: I know how to deal with 'problems' like you!
Flight in Distress#083.dst: ¡Sé muy bien cómo tratar los 'problemas' como tú!
Flight in Distress#083.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#084.src: Fight the Skyraider Queen and take one of her personal treasures with you.
Flight in Distress#084.dst: Lucha contra la reina de los Skyraiders y llévate uno de sus tesoros personales.

Flight in Distress#085.src: Escape the ship and speak to Captain Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#085.dst: Escapa de la nave y habla con el capitán Ackbar.

Flight in Distress#086.src: Wow, You single handedly took out a skyraider invasion.
Flight in Distress#086.dst: Vaya, has frenado una invasión de skyraiders sin ayuda de nadie.
Flight in Distress#086.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#087.src: And you're a passenger! It's a good job you did...
Flight in Distress#087.dst: ¡Y eres pasajero! Menudo trabajo has hecho...
Flight in Distress#087.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#088.src: We have no defense on this ship. We are a civilian carrier.
Flight in Distress#088.dst: No tenemos defensas en esta nave. Somos un transporte civil.
Flight in Distress#088.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#089.src: What is this? A ring from the queen? It looks valuable. You should keep it.
Flight in Distress#089.dst: ¿Y esto? ¿Un anillo de la reina? Parece valioso. Deberías quedártelo.
Flight in Distress#089.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#090.src: I still do not know how to thank you... We owe you so much.
Flight in Distress#090.dst: Sigo sin saber cómo agradecértelo... Te debemos muchísimo.
Flight in Distress#090.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#091.src: Wait! I know! You can have free travel from {p} to {p}!
Flight in Distress#091.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#092.src: A private airship owner called Calo owes me big.
Flight in Distress#092.dst: Un dueño de aeronave privada llamado Calo me debe una grande.
Flight in Distress#092.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#093.src: I will tell him the deal. All you have to do is enter his ship and he'll take you back and forth!
Flight in Distress#093.dst: Yo le cuento el trato. ¡Solo tienes que subir a su nave y te llevará de ida y vuelta!
Flight in Distress#093.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#094.src: Oh, and you will also be rewarded kindly monetarily. I will also personally send him the ring, so that it doesn't get damaged on the way, and you will receive it there.
Flight in Distress#094.dst: Ah, y también recibirás una buena recompensa en dinero. Además le enviaré el anillo en persona, para que no se estropee por el camino, y lo recogerás allí.
Flight in Distress#094.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#095.src: Just head down to the entrance deck, and we are about to arrive at {p} Airbase now.
Flight in Distress#095.dst: Baja a la cubierta de entrada; estamos a punto de llegar a la base aérea de {p}.
Flight in Distress#095.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#097.src: Head down to the entrance deck, and get off.
Flight in Distress#097.dst: Baja a la cubierta de entrada y desembarca.

Flight in Distress#098.src: Speak to Calo next to the little ship at the {p} docks.
Flight in Distress#098.dst: Habla con Calo junto a la nave pequeña en los muelles de {p}.

Flight in Distress#099.src: Hey there. You must be the Human Ackbar told me about.
Flight in Distress#099.dst: Hola. Debes de ser el humano del que me habló Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#099.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#100.src: I heard what you did on the ship, very admirable. Fortunately for you, I owe Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#100.dst: Me he enterado de lo que hiciste en la nave, muy admirable. Por suerte para ti, le debo una a Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#100.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#101.src: I'll take you from {p} to {p} or vice versa whenever you want.
Flight in Distress#101.dst: Te llevaré de {p} a {p} o al revés cuando quieras.
Flight in Distress#101.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#102.src: All you have to do is board my ship. Oh, this was also from Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#102.dst: Solo tienes que subir a mi nave. Ah, esto también es de parte de Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#102.speaker: Calo

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#001.src: Hey, hey, humie! Yeah, I'm talkin' to ya here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#001.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.src: Y'see, I got a few things here... look around for a bit, they're all very rare...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.dst: Mira, tengo unas cosillas aquí... míralas, son todas rarísimas...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.src: I see that look in yer eyes... Ya interested in something here? It's all 'fa sale...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.dst: Veo ese brillo en tus ojos... ¿Te interesa algo de aquí? Todo está en venta...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#004.src: ..Say, humie... I ain't mean to alarm ya, but do ya know who that guy sneakin' up behind 'ye is?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#004.dst: ...Oye, humanito... No quiero asustarte, pero ¿sabes quién es ese tipo que se te acerca por detrás?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#004.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#005.src: OI! Wake up, you damned miscreant!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#006.src: Took ya long enough.. Alright, listen up, maggot!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#006.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.src: We found ya outside of {p}, passed out near some dead body, and... Well, we had to arrest someone for that merchant's death!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.dst: Te encontramos fuera de {p}, desmayado junto a un cadáver, y... ¡bueno, por la muerte de ese mercader había que detener a alguien!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#008.src: So, welcome to the {p} Federal Prison. You're in here for the rest of your life, short-nose, so no use complaining about it.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#008.dst: Así que bienvenido a la Prisión Federal de {p}. Te quedas aquí de por vida, narizcorta, así que no te quejes.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#008.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#009.src: And don't think you get to just lounge around all day in your cell. You gotta do work here, or you're getting thrown in the hole.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#009.dst: Y no creas que vas a pasarte el día tumbado en la celda. Aquí se trabaja, o acabas en el agujero.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#009.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.src: But for now, you’re stayin’ in your cell, understood? Now, stay here, and take a look around your cell. You'll know when it's time to work..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.dst: Pero por ahora te quedas en tu celda, ¿entendido? Venga, quédate aquí y echa un vistazo a la celda. Ya sabrás cuándo toca trabajar...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#012.src: GWAH! Who the hell are you?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#012.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.src: Oh, thank grook, you're just another prisoner... So young, too...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.dst: Ay, gracias al grook, solo eres otro preso... Y tan joven...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.src: You just got here, right? Well... I can tell you're innocent... Just like almost everyone else in this forsaken prison...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.dst: Acabas de llegar, ¿verdad? Bueno... se nota que eres inocente... Como casi todos en esta prisión maldita...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.src: Listen, human... This prison... You couldn't have come to a more horrific prison in the entire world! This place is hellish!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.dst: Escucha, humano... Esta prisión... ¡No hay otra más espantosa en todo el mundo! ¡¡Esto es un infierno!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.src: The guards here, they're sadistic! They'll pluck random prisoners out of their cells, and nobody ever sees them again! They're trying to kill us all in here!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.dst: ¡Los guardias de aquí son unos sádicos! ¡Sacan presos al azar de sus celdas y nadie los vuelve a ver! ¡Quieren matarnos a todos aquí dentro!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.src: I'm being serious, human! If you stay here, they'll kill you, too! You HAVE to escape this place, whatever it t-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.dst: ¡Hablo en serio, humano! ¡Si te quedas, a ti también te matarán! TIENES que escapar de aquí, cueste lo que c-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.src: Oi, filth! You're comin' with us. Get out of your cell, NOW!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.dst: ¡Eh, basura! Te vienes con nosotros. ¡Fuera de la celda, YA!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.src: Are you sure, uh, sir? I don't think I'm supposed to be anywhere today...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.dst: ¿Está seguro, eh, señor? Creo que hoy no me toca ir a ningún sitio...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.src: Oh, ya think you're smart, trying to resist?? Oi, Jon, block the entrance!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.dst: Ah, ¿te crees listo resistiéndote?? ¡Eh, Jon, bloquea la entrada!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#021.src: H-HEY! WHAT ARE YOU- GET OFF- AAAAAHH!! SOMEONE!! HELP ME!!! PLEASE!!!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#021.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.src: OI! Quit starin’ off into space, maggot! Come over to your cell's bars.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.dst: ¡EH! ¡Deja de mirar al vacío, gusano! Ven a los barrotes de tu celda.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#023.src: It’s work time, filth. I'll escort you to the hallways. Once you're there, someone will tell you what to do. Do as they say, and you might come back tonight.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#023.dst: Hora de trabajar, basura. Te escolto a los pasillos. Allí alguien te dirá qué hacer. Obedece y puede que esta noche vuelvas.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#023.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.src: You got that, wretch? Alright, now get out of your cell!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.dst: ¿Te queda claro, desgraciado? ¡Venga, fuera de la celda!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#025.src: Get your instructions from the guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.src: Guess you're the one on cleanin' duty, huh? Alright. Listen up, scum!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.dst: Así que a ti te toca limpiar, ¿eh? Bien. ¡Escucha, escoria!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#027.src: Take this sponge, and look around the hallways. If you see a mess, use the sponge to clean it up. Someone will escort you back to the cells once you're done.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#027.dst: Coge esta esponja y recorre los pasillos. Si ves suciedad, límpiala con la esponja. Cuando acabes, alguien te escoltará de vuelta a las celdas.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#027.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#028.src: Got it? Alright. Now, get to work!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#028.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#029.src: Search the hallways for messes to clean up
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#029.dst: Busca suciedad que limpiar por los pasillos

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#030.src: Report to the prison guard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.src: You're done cleaning? Alright, it's time for rollcall. You're being escorted back to the cell block. Follow me, and don't move.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.dst: ¿Ya has terminado de limpiar? Bien, toca pasar lista. Te escoltamos de vuelta al bloque de celdas. Sígueme y no te muevas.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#032.src: Well, well, well... Looks like the dross of society is here on time!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#032.dst: Vaya, vaya, vaya... ¡Parece que la escoria de la sociedad llega puntual!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#032.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.src: Alright. Stay in line, and don't move, maggots! It's time for roll call...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.dst: Bien. ¡En fila y quietos, gusanos! Hora de pasar lista...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.src: You’re all here… Ha! That’s a surprise, you outcasts can actually follow orders!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.dst: Estáis todos… ¡Ja! Qué sorpresa, ¡los marginados sabéis obedecer!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#036.src: ...Hm… Looks like we’ve got a new arrival too.. Don’t worry, peon... your soul will be well secure here for the rest of eternity.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#036.dst: ...Mmm… Parece que también tenemos un recién llegado... Tranquilo, siervo... tu alma estará bien guardada aquí por toda la eternidad.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#036.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.src: Alright. That’s it for now, you worthless menaces. It’s meal time. Head to the cafeteria, and pray that we’re not giving you your last meal.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.dst: Bien. Por ahora es todo, inútiles. Hora de comer. Id al comedor y rezad para que no sea vuestra última comida.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#038.src: Find a place to sit in the cafeteria
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#038.dst: Busca un sitio donde sentarte en el comedor

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#039.src: Hi... Say, could you... do something for me...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#039.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#040.src: I'm... starving to death here... those blasted guards won't... let me get any food...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#040.dst: Me estoy... muriendo de hambre... esos malditos guardias no... me dejan coger comida...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#040.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#041.src: Please... to my right... There's some food sitting there, if you could get it for me, I'd be... eternally grateful...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#041.dst: Por favor... a mi derecha... hay comida ahí puesta; si me la trajeras, te estaría... eternamente agradecido...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#041.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#043.src: I... I can't thank you enough, human... I should be able to keep going with this...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#043.dst: No... no sé cómo agradecértelo, humano... Con esto podré aguantar...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#043.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#044.src: Say... if you ever get out of this slaughterhouse... could you go to {p}... and try and talk with my family, there? Let them know that I'm still alive...? I'd appreciate that....
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#044.dst: Oye... si algún día sales de este matadero... ¿podrías ir a {p}... y hablar con mi familia? ¿Decirles que sigo vivo...? Te lo agradecería....
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#044.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#045.src: Hey.. It's alright, you can sit here, don't worry.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#045.dst: Eh... Tranquilo, puedes sentarte aquí, no pasa nada.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#045.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#046.src: So... you're new here, right? Hah… Guessing you're innocent, just like the rest of us… and I mean that...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#046.dst: Así que... eres nuevo, ¿no? Je… Supongo que eres inocente, como el resto de nosotros… y lo digo en serio...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#046.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#047.src: He's tellin' the truth, new guy. Most of us here are just average civilians. I worked at a transportation company in {p}, and was delivering some crates to {p} when they snatched me just out of town.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#047.dst: Dice la verdad, novato. Casi todos aquí somos civiles corrientes. Yo trabajaba en una empresa de transportes de {p} y llevaba unas cajas a {p} cuando me trincaron nada más salir de la ciudad.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#047.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.src: Me too! I don't even know why I was put here at all! I wasn't even given a trial in court, or anything! They just plucked me off the streets and threw me in here!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.dst: ¡Yo igual! ¡Ni siquiera sé por qué me metieron aquí! ¡No hubo juicio ni nada! ¡Me sacaron de la calle y me tiraron aquí dentro!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.src: They wanna kill you, that's why. Did ya hear about Revan? He got taken away a couple of days ago, after he accidentally stumbled during roll call. Nobody's heard or seen 'em since.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.dst: Porque quieren matarte, por eso. ¿Te has enterado de lo de Revan? Se lo llevaron hace un par de días por tropezar sin querer al pasar lista. Nadie ha vuelto a saber de él.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.src: I… you're probably right... I just dont understand any of this anymore... I just want to escape this damn place for good...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.dst: Yo… seguramente tengas razón... Ya no entiendo nada de esto... Solo quiero largarme de este maldito sitio para siempre...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.src: ...Good luck with that.. Only way out is through that exit door, and even then you gotta get into the Control Room, as well. It's...just impossible, y'know?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.dst: ...Suerte con eso... La única salida es esa puerta, y aun así antes tienes que entrar en la sala de control. Es... simplemente imposible, ¿sabes?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.src: Alright, meal time's over! Get to your cells, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.dst: ¡Venga, se acabó la comida! ¡A vuestras celdas, basura!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.src: ...Well… That's this place in a nutshell for you, human. Just try not to get in anyone's way or step out of line, and you should be alright until they end up taking you.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.dst: ...Bueno… Así es este sitio en pocas palabras, humano. Procura no estorbar a nadie ni salirte de la fila y estarás bien hasta que acaben llevándote a ti.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#054.src: Oi, who’s this guy right ‘ere? We don’t know ya. Move it!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#054.dst: Eh, ¿y este quién es? No te conocemos. ¡Circula!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#054.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.src: ‘Ey, ‘ey, let it rest, Don. They're not hurtin’ nobody.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.dst: Eh, eh, déjalo estar, Don. No le hace daño a nadie.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.src: Don’t worry about it. So... You know who we are, novello?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.dst: No le des importancia. Y bien... ¿Sabes quiénes somos, novello?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.src: We’re part of the Placido Crime Family. We do business across the entire world; all parts of it, you know what I’m saying?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.dst: Somos de la Placido Crime Family. Hacemos negocios por todo el mundo; en todos los rincones, ¿me entiendes?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.src: Almost all of us at this table got caught for running with the family-... Ah, bet you’re surprised to hear that there are some guilty people up in this slaughterhouse, yeah?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.dst: Casi todos los de esta mesa caímos por andar con la familia-... Ah, te sorprende oír que en este matadero hay alguno culpable de verdad, ¿eh?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.src: It’s alright, you don’t have to worry about us getting plucked and killed like those other piacevole here. Guards keep on sayin’ something about “our souls are too tainted”, whatever they mean.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.dst: Tranquilo, no temas que a nosotros nos saquen y nos maten como a los demás piacevole de aquí. Los guardias repiten algo de que "nuestras almas están demasiado manchadas", vete a saber.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.src: Hah! Maybe you’ll get the same treatment too, novello. I saw it the minute I laid eyes on ya. You’re a killer too, ain't ya? Hey, gotta be one to know you're dealin' with one..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.dst: ¡Ja! Puede que a ti te traten igual, novello. Lo vi en cuanto te eché la vista encima. Tú también matas, ¿a que sí? Eh, hay que serlo para reconocer a otro...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.src: ..Anyways... You thinkin’ about staying in this prison, fratello? Word of advice: Don’t. If you can, you gotta escape. You might think it’s impossible for someone to escape here, or whatnot...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.dst: ...En fin... ¿Piensas quedarte en esta prisión, fratello? Un consejo: no. Si puedes, tienes que escapar. Quizá creas que es imposible salir de aquí, o lo que sea...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#063.src: Alright, meal time’s over! Get to your cells, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#063.dst: ¡Venga, se acabó la comida! ¡A vuestras celdas, basura!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#063.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.src: But no, you're different. I can see it in those eyes. You just gotta find a way into that Control Room, somehow. And hey, if you do get outta here, go and raise some hell in the Levtus Black Market for us, yeah?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.dst: Pero no, tú eres distinto. Lo veo en esos ojos. Solo tienes que encontrar cómo entrar en esa sala de control. Y oye, si sales de aquí, ve a montar el follón en el Mercado Negro de Letvus por nosotros, ¿vale?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#065.dst: Acude al pase de lista de la mañana

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#066.src: Alright! Everyone, get up! Out of your cells, NOW! It's time for rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#066.dst: ¡Venga! ¡Todos en pie! ¡Fuera de las celdas, YA! ¡Hora de pasar lista!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#067.src: Alright, look straight, scum! Morning rollcall is about to start.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#067.dst: ¡Venga, la vista al frente, escoria! El pase de lista va a empezar.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#067.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.src: ...you’re all here...? Hm... Disappointing, honestly. Rollcall is over. All of you, head to wherever your job is, and get to work!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.dst: ...¿estáis todos...? Mmm... Decepcionante, la verdad. Se acabó la lista. ¡Todos a vuestro puesto de trabajo, y a currar!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#070.src: Search the hallways for possible escape routes, and find a guard outfit
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#070.dst: Busca posibles rutas de huida por los pasillos y consigue un uniforme de guardia

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#071.src: Report to the Prison Guard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#071.dst: Preséntate ante el guardia de la prisión en [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.src: You're done? Alright, now follow me. Rollcall is about to start.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.dst: ¿Ya has acabado? Bien, sígueme. El pase de lista va a empezar.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.src: What with you all, showing up late like this?? It's time for rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.dst: ¿Pero qué os pasa, llegando tarde así?? ¡Hora de pasar lista!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.src: You're all here, huh? Alright then, head on to dinn-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.dst: Estáis todos, ¿eh? Muy bien, pues id a ce-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#076.src: Oi! Quit steppin' on my shoes, cretino!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#076.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.src: Hey! What the hell are you talkin' about, making up something like that! I didn't do anythin'!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.dst: ¡Eh! ¿De qué demonios hablas, inventándote algo así? ¡Yo no he hecho nada!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.src: Shut it, fat-nose! You know what you were doin'! Now stay out of my way!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.dst: ¡Cállate, narizgorda! ¡Sabes muy bien lo que hacías! ¡Y ahora apártate!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.src: OI! Are you blind, or something?!? Get those lowlifes under control, guards!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.dst: ¡EH! ¿¡Estáis ciegos o qué!? ¡Guardias, controlad a esos indeseables!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.src: You two got some damn nerve, fightin' during rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.dst: ¡Vaya morro tenéis los dos, peleando mientras se pasa lista!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#081.src: W-Woah, HEY! This maggot has a shank! Back up!!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#081.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#082.src: LOCKDOWN! LOCKDOWN! ALL OF YOU, IN YOUR CELLS, NOW!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#082.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.src: You two really are stupid, huh? Fighting in the midst of all of these guards? And you got a shank, too...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.dst: Sois idiotas de verdad, ¿eh? ¿Pelearos rodeados de guardias? Y encima con un pincho...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.src: Well, looks like it's game over for you two outcasts. You're heading straight to the hole!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.dst: Bueno, se acabó la partida para vosotros dos, marginados. ¡Directos al agujero!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.src: You, take these two cretins to the hole, and you, go to my office and get one of the spare control room keys. Now, LIGHTS OUT!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.dst: Tú, lleva a estos dos cretinos al agujero; y tú, ve a mi despacho y coge una llave de repuesto de la sala de control. Y ahora, ¡LUCES FUERA!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#086.dst: Acude al pase de lista de la mañana

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#087.src: Alright! Everyone, get up! Out of your cells, NOW! It's time for rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#087.dst: ¡Venga! ¡Todos en pie! ¡Fuera de las celdas, YA! ¡Hora de pasar lista!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.src: Alright, everyone get in line, and stand straight! Don't move, or it's game over for you!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.dst: ¡Venga, todos en fila y bien rectos! ¡No os mováis, o se acabó para vosotros!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#090.src: H-hey! Stop pushing me, mate! Seriou-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#090.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.src: Well, well, well... Another peon thought it was wise to step off course..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.dst: Vaya, vaya, vaya... Otro siervo que se cree listo saliéndose de la fila...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#092.src: W-wait a minute, miss! Someone pushed me out of line! I swear!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#092.dst: ¡E-espere un momento, señora! ¡Alguien me empujó fuera de la fila! ¡Se lo juro!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#092.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.src: BE QUIET! I didn't say you could speak, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.dst: ¡SILENCIO! ¡No te he dado permiso para hablar, basura!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.src: Get back in line! Once this is over, you're out, slime!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.dst: ¡Vuelve a la fila! ¡Cuando esto acabe, estás acabado, sabandija!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#095.src: Alright, now, the rest of you, get to work! Rollcall is over for you all!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#095.dst: ¡Venga, los demás, a trabajar! ¡Para vosotros se acabó la lista!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#095.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#096.src: Steal the key from the warden's office, and head to the control room
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#096.dst: Roba la llave del despacho de la alcaidesa y ve a la sala de control

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#097.src: Find a way to open the exit door
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#097.dst: Encuentra la forma de abrir la puerta de salida

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#098.src: Head through the exit door at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#098.dst: Cruza la puerta de salida en [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#099.src: Sneak past the guards and find a way to the Records Room
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#099.dst: Esquiva a los guardias y encuentra el camino a la sala de archivos

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.src: Oh, thank the bovine! There's a friendly face around here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.dst: ¡Ay, gracias a la santa vaca! Por fin una cara amiga por aquí...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#102.src: Listen, human, you gotta get me out of here! They've been killin' people in here all day! If you don't help me out, I'll be next!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#102.dst: ¡Escucha, humano, tienes que sacarme de aquí! ¡Llevan todo el día matando gente ahí dentro! ¡Si no me ayudas, el siguiente soy yo!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#102.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.src: Look, next to my cell, on that desk! There's a key! Grab it and hand it to me!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.dst: ¡Mira, al lado de mi celda, en esa mesa! ¡Hay una llave! ¡Cógela y dámela!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.src: Yes, perfect, PERFECT! That's the key, hand it to me!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.src: I can't explain the debt I owe you, human... You have no idea how grateful I am..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.dst: No sé cómo explicarte lo que te debo, humano... No te imaginas lo agradecido que estoy...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.src: Say, what's your name, human? {u}? Alright, my name's Kaetan. Go on ahead and get out of here, I'll catch up. If you do get out of this chop-shop, meet me in {p}, I want to give you something there.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.dst: Oye, ¿cómo te llamas, humano? ¿{u}? Bien, yo soy Kaetan. Tú sal de aquí, que yo te alcanzo. Si logras salir de este desguace, búscame en {p}, quiero darte algo allí.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.src: Huh...? Oh- HEY! The table caught on fire, someone get over 'ere and help me put it out!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.dst: ¿Eh...? ¡Oh- EH! ¡La mesa se ha prendido, que venga alguien a ayudarme a apagarla!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#109.src: Find and destroy your criminal records
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#109.dst: Encuentra y destruye tu expediente criminal

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#111.src: Who are you? Can I help you, human?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#111.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.src: WHAT?? Taron, he-he's alive?? And you... made sure he didn't starve in that prison...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.dst: ¿¿QUÉ?? Taron, ¿¿e-está vivo?? Y tú... ¿evitaste que muriera de hambre en esa prisión...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.src: I... human, I can't thank you enough. Even if he doesn't get out of there, just knowing he's alive is... please, I know it's not a lot, but take this.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.dst: Yo... humano, no sé cómo agradecértelo. Aunque no salga de ahí, solo saber que vive ya es... por favor, sé que no es mucho, pero toma esto.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#114.src: Good evening. Can I help you with anything?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#114.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#115.src: M-my son? He's alive?!? Oh, sweet baby bovine, that's...! Where is he??
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#115.dst: ¿M-mi hijo? ¡¿Vivo?! Ay, por la sagrada vaquilla... ¿¿Dónde está??
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#115.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.src: ...the prison, huh? Well... It's good to know that he'll be able to hold on a little longer... Thank you so much, human. Here, take this!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.dst: ...en la prisión, ¿eh? Bueno... Me alegra saber que podrá aguantar un poco más... Muchísimas gracias, humano. ¡Toma, quédate esto!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#117.src: The only way to escape is by heading through the exit door. You'll need to access the control room in order to open it...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#117.dst: La única forma de escapar es cruzar la puerta de salida. Para abrirla tendrás que acceder a la sala de control...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#118.src: The Prison appears to be lying about almost everything they do to the government, and they appear to buy into it, despite all the rumors about this place.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#118.dst: Parece que la prisión miente al gobierno sobre casi todo lo que hace, y el gobierno se lo traga, pese a todos los rumores sobre este lugar.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#119.src: It looks like the only way to get out of here is through the exit door..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#119.dst: Parece que la única forma de salir de aquí es esa puerta...

From the Bottom#000.src: An'! The best part! The idiot came back with a crumpled wrist and this HORRIFIED look- Musta gotten on the Hive witch's bad side!
From the Bottom#000.dst: ¡Y! ¡Lo mejor! ¡El idiota volvió con la muñeca destrozada y una cara de HORROR- Seguro que se ganó a pulso a la bruja de la Colmena!

From the Bottom#001.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy [{~} Troll Hair]. Nakoba is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#001.dst: Encuentra en {p} a alguien que quiera comprar [{~} Troll Hair]. Nakoba está en {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#002.src: Ah, hey there, human! I'm certain you've noticed the bazaar down here. It's a point of pride for the Dwarves- biggest marketplace of all the Dwarf cities!
From the Bottom#002.dst: ¡Ah, hola, humano! Seguro que has visto el bazar de aquí abajo. Es el orgullo de los enanos- ¡el mercado más grande de todas las ciudades enanas!
From the Bottom#002.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#003.src: Specialty items you can't find anywhere else- All sorts of strange, wonderful, unique things. I've been looking for a few sundry items myself here.
From the Bottom#003.dst: Artículos que no hallarás en ningún otro sitio- Toda clase de cosas raras, maravillosas y únicas. Yo mismo busco aquí unas menudencias.
From the Bottom#003.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#004.src: It's almost all barter, unlike the merchants above that deal in that shiny stuff. Which is...a little unfortunate for me, in a way.
From the Bottom#004.dst: Aquí casi todo es trueque, no como los mercaderes de arriba y su metal brillante. Lo cual es... algo desafortunado para mí, en cierto modo.
From the Bottom#004.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#005.src: You see, I'm a historian by trade, but what I'm really after now is some Troll Hair. See, I really like the sme- er. It's good and sturdy for binding books- wait a second!
From the Bottom#005.dst: Verás, soy historiador de oficio, pero lo que busco de verdad es Troll Hair. Es que me encanta el olo- ejem. Es fuerte y resistente para encuadernar- ¡un momento!
From the Bottom#005.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#006.src: YOU have some? Phenomenal! I can never get it myself- was never much of a fighter. Um, here! Let me trade you that, for...this!
From the Bottom#006.dst: ¿TÚ tienes? ¡Fenomenal! Yo nunca logro conseguirlo- nunca fui muy luchador. ¡Eh, toma! Déjame cambiártelo por... ¡esto!
From the Bottom#006.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#007.src: A Decorative Bottlecap Set! These were hard to come by, but I've got two sets of them anyways. Check them out! You'll learn a lot. Thank you very much, by the way!
From the Bottom#007.dst: ¡Un Decorative Bottlecap Set! Costaba encontrarlos, pero tengo dos juegos igualmente. ¡Échales un vistazo! Aprenderás mucho. ¡Y muchísimas gracias, por cierto!
From the Bottom#007.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#008.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy a [Decorative Bottlecap Collection]. Dobile is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#008.dst: Encuentra en {p} a alguien que quiera comprar una [Decorative Bottlecap Collection]. Dobile está en {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#009.src: Minerals for sale! Minerals for sale! Come get your rare metals! We've got Kanderstone, Wynnic Copper, genuine {p} Sandstone, real Voidstone from the {p}!
From the Bottom#009.dst: ¡Minerales en venta! ¡Minerales en venta! ¡Venid por metales raros! ¡Tenemos Kanderstone, Wynnic Copper, auténtica Sandstone de {p}, Voidstone real de {p}!
From the Bottom#009.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#010.src: Human, you there! If you're interested in smithing, you've found the right place! ...so long as you like drinking Dwarven drinks. I'm looking for bottlecap sets in exchange for these.
From the Bottom#010.dst: ¡Humano, tú! Si te interesa la herrería, ¡has dado con el sitio! ...siempre que te gusten las bebidas enanas. Busco juegos de chapas a cambio de esto.
From the Bottom#010.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#011.src: What's that look for? Are you new here or something? Never seen a bottlecap collector before? Or is that just your face?
From the Bottom#011.dst: ¿A qué viene esa cara? ¿Acabas de llegar o qué? ¿Nunca habías visto a un coleccionista de chapas? ¿O es que tu cara es así?
From the Bottom#011.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#012.src: Wh- That! That's! I! How did you! It...It's in pristine condition! There's not a single cap missing! There's not even any dents from the bottle openers!!!
From the Bottom#012.dst: ¿Qu- ¡Eso! ¡Eso es! ¡Yo! ¿¡Cómo has...!? ¡Está... está en perfecto estado! ¡No falta ni una chapa! ¡¡¡Ni una marca de abridor!!!
From the Bottom#012.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#013.src: There's no way you got those in person! You can't possibly understand the significance of what you're holding!! I! NEED! THEM!
From the Bottom#013.dst: ¡No es posible que las consiguieras tú! ¡¡No puedes entender lo que significa lo que tienes en las manos!! ¡YO! ¡LAS! ¡NECESITO!
From the Bottom#013.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#014.src: Here! My rarest metal! Take them! Take them and give me those bottlecaps! I've got to complete my collection!! Give it! Give it! Give it give it give it give it NOW!
From the Bottom#014.dst: ¡Toma! ¡Mi metal más raro! ¡Cógelo! ¡Cógelo y dame esas chapas! ¡¡Tengo que completar mi colección!! ¡Dámelas! ¡Dámelas! ¡Dámelas dámelas dámelas AHORA!
From the Bottom#014.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#015.src: ...er. Ahem. I got carried away there. But...those bottlecaps are from the very first Dogun Festival. It wasn't even held in Courag at the time these were made!
From the Bottom#015.dst: ...ejem. Perdón, me he dejado llevar. Pero... esas chapas son del primerísimo Dogun Festival. ¡Ni siquiera se celebraba en Courag cuando las hicieron!
From the Bottom#015.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#016.src: I'd love to talk about them more, but I can't spend too long on the sale, or other customers might go away. But you got a good deal with that Jasplite I gave you!
From the Bottom#016.dst: Me encantaría hablar más de ellas, pero no puedo alargar una venta o se me irán otros clientes. ¡Pero has salido ganando con esa Jasplite que te he dado!
From the Bottom#016.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#017.src: Come to think of it, some guy wanted that stuff, but he didn't even have a plain ol' sodapop cap on him! I think he's right close by. Maybe you'd have some interest in what you're selling instead.
From the Bottom#017.dst: Ahora que lo pienso, un tipo quería eso, ¡pero no llevaba encima ni una triste chapa de refresco! Creo que anda muy cerca. Quizá le interese lo que vendes.
From the Bottom#017.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#018.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy some [Molten Jasplite Ingots]. Dorroc is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#018.dst: Encuentra en {p} a alguien que quiera comprar unos [Molten Jasplite Ingots]. Dorroc está en {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#019.src: Hm...a human trader? Well, I've heard of you, but I hope it isn't just the standard fare from you.
From the Bottom#019.dst: Hm... ¿un comerciante humano? Bueno, he oído hablar de vosotros, pero espero que no traigas lo de siempre.
From the Bottom#019.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#020.src: Yes, I've seen quite a few of your type to this bazaar- Using the community forges and smithing tables in all. You seem to have metals in bulk...
From the Bottom#020.dst: Sí, he visto a unos cuantos de los tuyos en este bazar- usando las fraguas y las mesas de herrería comunes. Parece que tenéis metales a montones...
From the Bottom#020.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#021.src: ...but probably ninety-eight out of a hundred of the metal ingots I've seen humans use have been trash quality! Worthless only for practice! I seek only the finest metals, you see.
From the Bottom#021.dst: ...¡pero de cada cien lingotes que he visto usar a los humanos, noventa y ocho eran basura! ¡Solo valen para practicar! Yo solo busco los mejores metales.
From the Bottom#021.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#022.src: ...so, of course, you have to prove me wrong by having MOLTEN JASPLITE?! Oh, you must have gotten that from Dobile. Wouldn't have taken you as a bottlecap collector!
From the Bottom#022.dst: ...así que, cómo no, tienes que quitarme la razón con ¿¡MOLTEN JASPLITE!? Ah, eso te lo ha dado Dobile. ¡No te tenía por coleccionista de chapas!
From the Bottom#022.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#023.src: I've been pestering him for a while about his stock. The metal of the Unseen Blade is very valuable, you see. It's fragile, yes...
From the Bottom#023.dst: Llevo tiempo dándole la lata con sus existencias. El metal de la Unseen Blade es muy valioso, verás. Es frágil, sí...
From the Bottom#023.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#024.src: ...but to wield it is to channel the power of Ockar the Unseen Blade himself! The wartime taskmaster who cowed a hundred demons with a mere dagger!
From the Bottom#024.dst: ...¡pero blandirlo es canalizar el poder del propio Ockar the Unseen Blade! ¡El capataz de guerra que acobardó a cien demonios con una simple daga!
From the Bottom#024.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#025.src: Sneaking behind the lines of the enemy, braving blistering heat! Remaining as a shadow, and cutting through sheer earth and magma without flinching!!
From the Bottom#025.dst: ¡Colarse tras las líneas enemigas, desafiando un calor abrasador! ¡¡Ser una sombra y cortar roca pura y magma sin pestañear!!
From the Bottom#025.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#026.src: ...erm, yes. Anyways! For that, I can give you nothing less than my rarest stock. A Golemlus Power Core. If Qira found out I had this, I'd be worse off than a dead man.
From the Bottom#026.dst: ...ejem, sí. ¡En fin! Por eso no puedo darte menos que mi mercancía más rara. Un Golemlus Power Core. Si Qira supiera que lo tengo, estaría peor que muerto.
From the Bottom#026.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#027.src: She keeps the secrets of those creatures under lock and key- and it must be the ticket to unlocking that particular mystery. Treasure this, human! It is no mere Corkian battery.
From the Bottom#027.dst: Ella guarda bajo llave los secretos de esas criaturas- y esto debe de ser la clave de ese misterio. ¡Atesóralo, humano! No es una simple batería corkiana.
From the Bottom#027.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#028.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy a [Golemlus Power Cell]. Lodog is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#028.dst: Encuentra en {p} a alguien que quiera comprar una [Golemlus Power Cell]. Lodog está en {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#029.src: Right chief, what can I do ya for? I got all kinds'a machines here. One of 'em's gotta catch your eye, y'hear?
From the Bottom#029.dst: A ver, jefe, ¿en qué te sirvo? Tengo máquinas de todo tipo. Alguna te tiene que gustar, ¿oyes?
From the Bottom#029.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#030.src: I jury-rigged this juicer! Put a lemon inside, give it some, heheh, juice, and you'll get yourself lemon juice in a jiff!
From the Bottom#030.dst: ¡Este exprimidor lo apañé yo! Metes un limón, le das, je je, jugo, ¡y en un pis pas tienes zumo!
From the Bottom#030.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#031.src: Or how 'bout this coin-shooter? Turn the crank and this'll spit out any coin-sized object like nobody's business. Just, uh, don't aim it at any windows, unless you really hate that window.
From the Bottom#031.dst: ¿O qué tal este lanzamonedas? Giras la manivela y escupe cualquier cosa del tamaño de una moneda que da gusto. Eso sí, no apuntes a ventanas, salvo que odies esa ventana.
From the Bottom#031.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#032.src: ...what? Oh, I see. You think you got somethin' that'll interest ME instead of the other way round. I gotcha. Well, lemme see it a sec.
From the Bottom#032.dst: ...¿qué? Ah, ya veo. Crees que tienes algo que me interesa a MÍ y no al revés. Te pillo. Bueno, déjame verlo un segundo.
From the Bottom#032.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#033.src: ...okay. I can't make heads or tails a' this thing. What'd you say it was again? Don't tell me this is some Corkus gadget from that not-so-{p}!
From the Bottom#033.dst: ...vale. No le encuentro ni pies ni cabeza a esto. ¿Qué has dicho que era? ¡No me digas que es un chisme de Corkus de ese no-tan-{p}!
From the Bottom#033.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#034.src: ...a... A Golemlus Power Core...? This... hot DOG! Yahaaah, I'd heard about these wacko golem thingies ages ago, I always wanted to take 'em apart! Aw hell, but this is an opportunity!
From the Bottom#034.dst: ...un... ¿Un Golemlus Power Core...? Esto... ¡ANDA YA! ¡Yajaaa, oí hablar de esos golems chiflados hace siglos, siempre quise desmontarlos! ¡Diablos, qué oportunidad!
From the Bottom#034.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#035.src: Gotta say, for something that came from that Hive it's a lot less purple and black and spidery-all-over than I expected. The complexity...this has gotta be the real deal, but...
From the Bottom#035.dst: Oye, para venir de esa Colmena tiene mucho menos morado, negro y arácnido de lo que esperaba. La complejidad... esto tiene que ser auténtico, pero...
From the Bottom#035.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#036.src: Feels like someone else made this. That Qira lady doesn't seem like the handsy type, and this is something like {~} mechanics, {~} magic. Just seems out of character.
From the Bottom#036.dst: Parece hecho por otra persona. Esa tal Qira no parece de las que se manchan las manos, y esto es como {~} de mecánica y {~} de magia. No pega con ella.
From the Bottom#036.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#037.src: Ah, but I'm gettin' away from myself. Tell ya what- prob'ly went through a lotta trouble ta get this, and that means you got guts. You got bravery. You got STONES, human!
From the Bottom#037.dst: Ah, pero me estoy yendo por las ramas. Mira- seguro que te costó lo tuyo conseguir esto, y eso significa que tienes agallas. Tienes valor. ¡Tienes un PAR, humano!
From the Bottom#037.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#038.src: So, how 'bout these Ice Drake Scales then? It fits a brave soul like you, it does! Take 'em with pride, there!
From the Bottom#038.dst: ¿Y qué tal estas Ice Drake Scales? ¡Le pegan a un alma valiente como tú! ¡Cógelas con orgullo!
From the Bottom#038.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#039.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy the Ice Drake Scales. Mastro is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#039.dst: Encuentra en {p} a alguien que quiera comprar las Ice Drake Scales. Mastro está en {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#040.src: Ardent Magma Crystals for sale! Pure, {~}! Accept no substitutes, unless you're paying in emeralds, in which case kindly substitute...a lot of them!!
From the Bottom#040.dst: ¡Ardent Magma Crystals en venta! ¡Puros, {~}! ¡No aceptes sustitutos, salvo que pagues en esmeraldas, en cuyo caso sustituye... por muchas!!
From the Bottom#040.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#041.src: Human! You have a keen eye for prices and values! I can tell by that glint in your eye- a real MAN's spirit! Even if you aren't a man, your spirit shines all the same as a man...!
From the Bottom#041.dst: ¡Humano! ¡Qué ojo para precios y valores! ¡Lo veo en ese brillo- el espíritu de un verdadero HOMBRE! Aunque no seas un hombre, ¡tu espíritu brilla igual...!
From the Bottom#041.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#042.src: A SALES MAN! YES! Macho and brave! Chiseled and strong! Strong enough to carry {~} Liquid Emeralds to trade for this brilliant Ardent Magma Crystal!
From the Bottom#042.dst: ¡UN HOMBRE DE VENTAS! ¡SÍ! ¡Macho y valiente! ¡Recio y fuerte! ¡Tan fuerte como para cargar {~} esmeraldas líquidas por este Ardent Magma Crystal!
From the Bottom#042.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#043.src: ...but hold on a moment. Hold on just one moment. Do I detect...a vein of ICE in that manly aura? A chill, pushing against that spirit of market machismo?
From the Bottom#043.dst: ...pero espera un momento. Espera solo un momento. ¿Detecto... una veta de HIELO en esa aura viril? ¿Un frío contra ese machismo de mercado?
From the Bottom#043.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#044.src: YES, I DO! Human, you have Ice Drake Scales! I needn't see them to be sure! I was right about you from the start- Such burning passion!!
From the Bottom#044.dst: ¡SÍ! ¡Humano, tienes Ice Drake Scales! ¡No necesito verlas para saberlo! Acerté contigo desde el principio- ¡¡qué pasión tan ardiente!!
From the Bottom#044.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#045.src: AND SUCH NAIVETE! Let me strengthen your MIND! Ice Drake Scales are indicative of a great challenge having been overcome! A truly macho trophy of accomplishment!
From the Bottom#045.dst: ¡Y QUÉ INGENUIDAD! ¡Déjame fortalecer tu MENTE! ¡Las Ice Drake Scales señalan un gran desafío superado! ¡Un trofeo de logro verdaderamente macho!
From the Bottom#045.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#046.src: To tame Ice Drakes required UNBREAKABLE will! To overcome the sheerest cold with MACHO HEAT! And to outshine demons of lava and flame with that same determination! Those scales represent such resilience!
From the Bottom#046.dst: ¡Domar a los Ice Drake exigía una voluntad INQUEBRANTABLE! ¡Vencer el frío más puro con CALOR MACHO! ¡Y eclipsar con esa misma determinación a los demonios de lava y llama! ¡Esas escamas representan tal temple!
From the Bottom#046.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#047.src: And yet...I must wonder. Such a fiery spirit you have- THOSE SCALES HOLD YOU BACK! Your spirit cannot be contained in such a manner!
From the Bottom#047.dst: Y aun así... me pregunto. Tienes un espíritu tan ardiente- ¡ESAS ESCAMAS TE FRENAN! ¡Tu espíritu no puede contenerse de ese modo!
From the Bottom#047.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#048.src: DISRESPECT YOURSELF NO LONGER! I DEMAND YOU HAND OVER THOSE SCALES! But you will not leave empty-handed, no no, friend!
From the Bottom#048.dst: ¡NO TE FALTES MÁS AL RESPETO! ¡EXIJO QUE ME ENTREGUES ESAS ESCAMAS! ¡Pero no te irás con las manos vacías, no, no, amigo!
From the Bottom#048.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#049.src: You have ignited my passion as a salesman, so I shall present you with one of my own greatest accomplishments! For a spirit so WHITE HOT, only an ARDENT MAGMA CRYSTAL is fitting!
From the Bottom#049.dst: ¡Has encendido mi pasión de vendedor, así que te ofreceré uno de mis mayores logros! ¡Para un espíritu tan CANDENTE, solo un ARDENT MAGMA CRYSTAL está a la altura!
From the Bottom#049.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#050.src: YES! Your soul shines brighter than the shimmer of EIGHT-HUNDRED-MILLION EMERALDS! Forever may your spirit BURN, human!
From the Bottom#050.dst: ¡SÍ! ¡Tu alma brilla más que el destello de OCHOCIENTOS MILLONES DE ESMERALDAS! ¡Que tu espíritu ARDA por siempre, humano!
From the Bottom#050.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#051.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy an [Ardent Magma Crystal]. Dohstaj is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#051.dst: Encuentra en {p} a alguien que quiera comprar un [Ardent Magma Crystal]. Dohstaj está en {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#053.dst: ...he oído gritar a Mastro. Es... tan apasionado.
From the Bottom#053.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#054.src: ...he's married to his work. Would I were his.
From the Bottom#054.dst: ...está casado con su trabajo. Ojalá yo fuera ese trabajo.
From the Bottom#054.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#055.src: ...but business first. Wartime artifacts for sale.
From the Bottom#055.dst: ...pero primero el negocio. Vendo reliquias de guerra.
From the Bottom#055.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#056.src: ...priciest thing is a Dogun Flameshooter. Practically invaluable. You want it?
From the Bottom#056.dst: ...lo más caro es un Dogun Flameshooter. Casi sin precio. ¿Lo quieres?
From the Bottom#056.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#059.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy the [Dogun Flameshooter]. Syni is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#059.dst: Encuentra en {p} a alguien que quiera comprar el [Dogun Flameshooter]. Syni está en {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#060.src: I can't stand this. I can't stand this! SHUT UP, MASTRO! NO ONE CARES ABOUT YOUR SWEATY SPIRIT OR WHATEVER!
From the Bottom#060.dst: No lo soporto. ¡No lo soporto! ¡CÁLLATE, MASTRO! ¡A NADIE LE IMPORTA TU ESPÍRITU SUDOROSO NI NADA DE ESO!
From the Bottom#060.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#061.src: MY MACHISMO CANNOT BE CONTAINED! Your aversion only inspires my salesman's spirit! Ardent Magma Crystals! Pure, {~} gold! {~} Liquid Emeralds, {~} off! STRONG bargains!
From the Bottom#061.dst: ¡MI MACHISMO NO SE CONTIENE! ¡Tu rechazo solo aviva mi espíritu de vendedor! ¡Ardent Magma Crystals! ¡Oro puro, {~}! ¡{~} esmeraldas líquidas, {~} menos! ¡Ofertas FUERTES!
From the Bottom#061.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#062.src: AAAGH! Stupid, stupid, stupid Dohstaj! I just need him to fork over that stupid Flameshooter and then I can get away from this tripe but he just! Won't! DO IT!
From the Bottom#062.dst: ¡AAAGH! ¡Estúpido, estúpido, estúpido Dohstaj! ¡Solo necesito que suelte ese estúpido Flameshooter para largarme de esta cutrez, pero es que no! ¡Quiere! ¡HACERLO!
From the Bottom#062.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#063.src: No, look, human! Can't you see the kind of stress I'm under?! I don't care about your Flameshooter, I need to get my hands on Dohstaj's Flameshooter!
From the Bottom#063.dst: ¡No, mira, humano! ¿¡No ves el estrés que llevo encima!? ¡Tu Flameshooter me da igual, necesito hacerme con el Flameshooter de Dohstaj!
From the Bottom#063.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#065.src: ...wait. Wait wait wait that's Dohstaj's Flameshooter how in the world did you get it what what WHAT! How did you snap him out of his...emotions?!
From the Bottom#065.dst: ...espera. Espera espera espera, ese es el Flameshooter de Dohstaj, ¿cómo lo has conseguido, qué qué QUÉ? ¿¡Cómo lo sacaste de sus... emociones!?
From the Bottom#065.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#066.src: I've been trying to get a hold of that for a week straight! I already have the perfect trade lined up! Please, hear me out!
From the Bottom#066.dst: ¡Llevo una semana entera intentando hacerme con eso! ¡Ya tengo preparado el trueque perfecto! ¡Por favor, escúchame!
From the Bottom#066.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#067.src: I have here the Scepter of Draani Thunderwill I! Dohstaj only WISHES he could salvage something this juicy! The real, honest-to-goodness staff of the Wartime King!
From the Bottom#067.dst: ¡Tengo aquí el Cetro de Draani Thunderwill I! ¡Dohstaj solo SUEÑA con rescatar algo tan jugoso! ¡El auténtico y genuino báculo del Rey de la Guerra!
From the Bottom#067.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#068.src: A war relic for a war relic. It's only a fair trade! Just be real careful- a theif's been skulking in the yellow stall by the bank trying to steal it from me.
From the Bottom#068.dst: Una reliquia de guerra por otra. ¡Trato justo! Pero mucho cuidado- un ladrón anda rondando el puesto amarillo junto al banco para robármelo.
From the Bottom#068.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#069.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy [Draani Thunderwill's Scepter]. Yobon is behind the stone walls at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#069.dst: Encuentra en {p} a alguien que quiera comprar [Draani Thunderwill's Scepter]. Yobon está detrás de los muros de piedra en {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#070.src: ...so. I saw you talking with Syni.
From the Bottom#070.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#071.src: Pfft. Thief? I'm an honest man. Just following the old footsteps.
From the Bottom#071.dst: Pfff. ¿Ladrón? Soy un hombre honrado. Solo sigo los pasos de antaño.
From the Bottom#071.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#072.src: I know you have the Scepter. I'd have thumped you and taken you if you were a Dwarf.
From the Bottom#072.dst: Sé que tienes el Cetro. Si fueras enano, ya te habría zurrado y te lo habría quitado.
From the Bottom#072.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#073.src: But how 'bout we work out a deal, instead? Take this tablet.
From the Bottom#073.dst: ¿Y si mejor hacemos un trato? Toma esta tablilla.
From the Bottom#073.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#074.src: It'll explain everything. Dwarven History...if you can read it. I can. Won't let loose my secrets for free though.
From the Bottom#074.dst: Te lo explicará todo. Historia enana... si sabes leerla. Yo sí. Pero mis secretos no los suelto gratis.
From the Bottom#074.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#075.src: Hand over the Scepter, and I'll hand over the tablet.
From the Bottom#075.dst: Dame el Cetro y yo te doy la tablilla.
From the Bottom#075.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#076.src: I won't translate it for you, but I'm sure there's some egghead who'll get back to you on what it means in...ten years or so.
From the Bottom#076.dst: No te la voy a traducir, pero seguro que algún sabelotodo te dirá qué significa dentro de... unos diez años.
From the Bottom#076.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#077.src: Good things come to those who wait for others to do the work for 'em, as they say.
From the Bottom#077.dst: Las cosas buenas llegan a quien espera a que otros hagan el trabajo, como dicen.
From the Bottom#077.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#078.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy your [Eons-Lost Dwarven History Tablet]. Nakoba is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#078.dst: Encuentra en {p} a alguien que quiera comprar tu [Eons-Lost Dwarven History Tablet]. Nakoba está en {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#079.src: Well, you've been busy, I see! You've been working this bazaar like a champion!
From the Bottom#079.dst: ¡Vaya, veo que no has parado! ¡Te has movido por este bazar de maravilla!
From the Bottom#079.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#080.src: I ought to tell my friends up at the topside shops- they really respect traders who know their way around a deal. You should be able to buy and use more items from the armories!
From the Bottom#080.dst: Debería contárselo a mis amigos de las tiendas de arriba- respetan mucho a los comerciantes que saben cerrar un trato. ¡Deberías poder comprar y usar más objetos de las armerías!
From the Bottom#080.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#081.src: I... haven't had such luck unfortunately. I think you might've picked the place clean, eheh. Don't suppose you've got one last deal up your sleeve, huh?
From the Bottom#081.dst: Yo... por desgracia no he tenido tanta suerte. Creo que has dejado el sitio limpio, je je. ¿No tendrás un último trato en la manga, eh?
From the Bottom#081.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#082.src: Oh, really? Hah, I was just joking about that, but if you really do have an offer, go ahead and lay it on me!
From the Bottom#082.dst: ¿Ah, sí? Ja, lo decía en broma, pero si de verdad tienes una oferta, ¡venga, suéltala!
From the Bottom#082.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#087.src: THAT'S ANCIENT HISTORY! FORMATIVE ANCIENT HISTORY!
From the Bottom#087.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#088.src: I recognize those runes, they're ancient Dwarven glyphs! This is slab number three! We already have the first, second, and fourth tablets, my team and I- this would finish the collection!
From the Bottom#088.dst: ¡Reconozco esas runas, son glifos enanos antiguos! ¡Esta es la losa número tres! ¡Mi equipo y yo ya tenemos la primera, la segunda y la cuarta- esta completaría la colección!
From the Bottom#088.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#089.src: I! I! I! Take! TAKE EVERYTHING I HAVE! TAKE IT ALL, I NEED THAT! I NEED TO DISCOVER THOSE ANCIENT SECRETS!
From the Bottom#089.dst: ¡Yo! ¡Yo! ¡Yo! ¡Toma! ¡TOMA TODO LO QUE TENGO! ¡TODO, LO NECESITO! ¡DEBO DESCUBRIR ESOS SECRETOS ANTIGUOS!
From the Bottom#089.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#090.src: AH! AHAHAHAHA! THE HISTORY! THE STORIES! THE EVERYTHING! IT'S BETTER THAN THE SMELL OF TROLL HAIR! AHAHAHAAAHAHHAHHAHAAAAAH!
From the Bottom#090.dst: ¡AH! ¡AJAJAJAJA! ¡LA HISTORIA! ¡LAS HISTORIAS! ¡TODO! ¡ES MEJOR QUE EL OLOR DEL TROLL HAIR! ¡AJAJAJAAAJAJJAJJAJAAAAAH!
From the Bottom#090.speaker: Nakoba

From the Mountains#000.src: Find out what's going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

From the Mountains#001.src: Mmph! Humnym! Mah houfhs fhs on fifhre! Gft hfrelp, tiff brafze womd strfp!
From the Mountains#001.dst: ¡Mmf! ¡Humfano! ¡Mi cafsa arfde! ¡Busfca ayufda, el fuefgo no pafra!
From the Mountains#001.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#002.src: Ouh hff do hflp! I hff nho glue wfhtsh doon fifs!
From the Mountains#002.dst: ¡Te pfido ayufda! ¡No tenfgo ni idfea de qué pafsa!
From the Mountains#002.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#003.src: Find what Arnod wants inside of the house.
From the Mountains#003.dst: Encuentra dentro de la casa lo que Arnod quiere.

From the Mountains#004.src: ...well, that explains why you didn't help. But, uh, did the RAGING FIRE escape your notice somehow?!
From the Mountains#004.dst: ...bueno, eso explica que no ayudaras. Pero, eh, ¿¡el FUEGO ENORME se te pasó por alto!?
From the Mountains#004.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#005.src: I don't care who it is, get me help!! I don't care if you do it, I don't care if you get someone to do it, but someone's got to help with this crazy re-igniting fire!
From the Mountains#005.dst: ¡¡Me da igual quién sea, tráeme ayuda!! Me da igual si lo haces tú o si buscas a alguien, ¡pero alguien tiene que ocuparse de este fuego loco que se vuelve a encender!
From the Mountains#005.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#006.src: Check around {p} if you need to, but hurry up already! My house is going to burn to ashes if you don't hurry!
From the Mountains#006.dst: Pregunta por {p} si hace falta, ¡pero date prisa ya! ¡Mi casa arderá hasta las cenizas si no te apuras!
From the Mountains#006.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#007.src: Find someone in {p} who can help you with the fires.
From the Mountains#007.dst: Encuentra a alguien en {p} que pueda ayudarte con el fuego.

From the Mountains#008.src: Hm... where am I going to get help now- Mh? You're one of those human types, right? Do you have-
From the Mountains#008.dst: Hm... ¿dónde encuentro ayuda ahora- Mh? Eres de esos tipos humanos, ¿no? ¿No tendrás-
From the Mountains#008.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#009.src: Huh? Someone's house is on fire? Guess that's a little more pressing than what I was going to ask. Where is it?
From the Mountains#009.dst: ¿Eh? ¿Se le quema la casa a alguien? Supongo que eso es más urgente que lo mío. ¿Dónde es?
From the Mountains#009.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#010.src: Oh, that valley by the gate? I think I know where you mean. Let's walk together. So, tell me what exactly happened?
From the Mountains#010.dst: ¿Ah, ese valle junto a la puerta? Creo que sé cuál dices. Vamos andando. ¿Y qué pasó exactamente?
From the Mountains#010.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#011.src: Ah, so you're like a mercenary then, and you found this man's house on fire. He said... what? It re-ignited itself? Well, that doesn't make any sense.
From the Mountains#011.dst: Ah, así que eres mercenario y hallaste la casa de este hombre en llamas. Dijo... ¿qué? ¿Que se reenciende sola? Eso no tiene ningún sentido.
From the Mountains#011.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#012.src: Eh, I'll see when we get there. Oh, what am I doing over here? Yeah, I suppose I do look different from the fare you'd have seen. Well, I'm a dwarf.
From the Mountains#012.dst: Bah, ya lo veré al llegar. Ah, ¿qué hago yo por aquí? Sí, supongo que no me parezco a lo que sueles ver. Bueno, soy un enano.
From the Mountains#012.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#013.src: Normally I live in the {p}, past the canyons to the east. Guess for yourself what the land is like, considering the name.
From the Mountains#013.dst: Normalmente vivo en {p}, pasados los cañones del este. Adivina cómo es esa tierra por el nombre.
From the Mountains#013.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#014.src: Without getting into too much detail, there's... A few problems, with how it's being governed, and I was trying to drum up support over in {p}.
From the Mountains#014.dst: Sin entrar en detalles, hay... algunos problemas con cómo se gobierna aquello, y yo intentaba reunir apoyos en {p}.
From the Mountains#014.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#015.src: It, uh. Well, I'm used to getting laughed out of the room back home, but I wasn't expecting to see the same thing over there, just with quartz wallpaper.
From the Mountains#015.dst: Pues, eh. Bueno, en casa ya me acostumbré a que me echaran a risas, pero no esperaba lo mismo allí, solo que con paredes de cuarzo.
From the Mountains#015.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#016.src: I was going to ask if you had any way that you might've been able to help, but...well, I can smell the smoke from here. One thing at a time.
From the Mountains#016.dst: Iba a preguntarte si podías ayudarme de algún modo, pero... bueno, el humo se huele desde aquí. Una cosa a la vez.
From the Mountains#016.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#017.src: ...and where there's smoke, there's fire. This is, uh... that's looking a little more like home, and I'm fairly certain that it isn't supposed to be.
From the Mountains#017.dst: ...y donde hay humo, hay fuego. Esto, eh... esto se parece bastante a mi tierra, y estoy casi seguro de que no debería.
From the Mountains#017.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#018.src: Yep, this fire isn't natural at all... Hell, this almost looks like arson to me!
From the Mountains#018.dst: Sí, este fuego no es natural... ¡Diablos, casi parece provocado!
From the Mountains#018.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#019.src: So that's the house, hm? Alright, I'll see what I can do. Might not be able to put it out, but if it's re-igniting, then maybe...
From the Mountains#019.dst: ¿Esa es la casa? Bien, veré qué puedo hacer. Quizá no logre apagarlo, pero si se vuelve a encender, entonces quizá...
From the Mountains#019.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#020.src: Hm... didn't think they'd be this far out, but it'd make sense if...
From the Mountains#020.dst: Hm... no creía que llegaran tan lejos, pero tendría sentido si...
From the Mountains#020.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#021.src: Aha! Here's the problem. It's just a little Fleris. Ehm, to explain, they normally live in the Heights.
From the Mountains#021.dst: ¡Ajá! Aquí está el problema. Es solo un pequeño Fleris. Eh, te explico: suelen vivir en las Heights.
From the Mountains#021.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#022.src: Pretty affectionate, good if you can stand the heat, but if you take them away from their mounds they get spooked.
From the Mountains#022.dst: Bastante cariñosos, buenos si aguantas el calor, pero si los alejas de sus montículos se asustan.
From the Mountains#022.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#023.src: One fleris could have kept setting this man's house on fire, but all the other fallout... there's certainly more where this one came from.
From the Mountains#023.dst: Un fleris pudo incendiar esta casa una y otra vez, pero con todos los demás destrozos... seguro que hay más de donde vino este.
From the Mountains#023.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#024.src: Let's go talk to the villager outside. He might've seen where the others got off to, or where they came from.
From the Mountains#024.dst: Vamos a hablar con el aldeano de fuera. Quizá vio adónde fueron los otros, o de dónde vinieron.
From the Mountains#024.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#025.src: Sir, I figured out why your house kept re-igniting and solved that issue, but tell me, have you seen any moving sludgy things around here?
From the Mountains#025.dst: Señor, descubrí por qué su casa se reencendía y lo resolví, pero dígame, ¿ha visto por aquí alguna cosa viscosa que se moviera?
From the Mountains#025.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#026.src: Uhm, I don't really know. I've been trying to douse my house so many times over that I haven't really paid attention!
From the Mountains#026.dst: Ehm, no lo sé muy bien. ¡He intentado apagar mi casa tantas veces que no me he fijado en nada!
From the Mountains#026.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#027.src: I remember seeing some tar-looking stuff dripping from the mountains behind my house, but that's it!
From the Mountains#027.dst: ¡Recuerdo haber visto algo parecido a alquitrán goteando desde las montañas detrás de mi casa, y ya está!
From the Mountains#027.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#028.src: Sounds concrete enough to me. Let's check out what's going on on top of the mountain ridge. Check that book of yours if you need directions.
From the Mountains#028.dst: Me parece una pista bastante sólida. Veamos qué ocurre en lo alto de la cresta. Consulta tu libro si necesitas indicaciones.
From the Mountains#028.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#029.src: Go to the path at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and follow it up to the top of the mountain.
From the Mountains#029.dst: Ve al sendero en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y súbelo hasta la cima de la montaña.

From the Mountains#030.src: Hm, you're a pretty quick climber. I thought I'd get ahead of you. Well, this looks like the scorched area down in the valley... Hm! I thought so.
From the Mountains#030.dst: Hm, escalas bastante rápido. Creía que te adelantaría. Bueno, esto se parece a la zona quemada del valle... ¡Hm! Lo suponía.
From the Mountains#030.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#031.src: There's only one reason I can think of that there would be so many Flerisi around here... If that wagon's reinforced, then...
From the Mountains#031.dst: Solo se me ocurre una razón para que haya tantos Flerisi por aquí... Si esa carreta está reforzada, entonces...
From the Mountains#031.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#032.src: Gah, I knew it. Traffickers! And incompetent ones, too, considering they couldn't hold the things.
From the Mountains#032.dst: Bah, lo sabía. ¡Traficantes! Y además incompetentes, ya que no supieron retener a los bichos.
From the Mountains#032.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#033.src: There's a black market issue in the {p}. Things that you can't find anywhere else is harvested in the Heights for their high value.
From the Mountains#033.dst: Hay un problema de mercado negro en {p}. Lo que no se encuentra en ningún otro sitio se recolecta en las Heights por su alto valor.
From the Mountains#033.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#034.src: Flerisi are one of them. In the Heights, they're kept as pets. They're relatively friendly, keep your house warm, and don't need much care...
From the Mountains#034.dst: Los Flerisi son una de esas cosas. En las Heights los tienen como mascotas. Son bastante amistosos, calientan la casa y no dan mucho trabajo...
From the Mountains#034.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#035.src: ...But if you take them away from a warm place, they burn everything. To think- Some people use the things as weapons. Can't leave well enough alone...
From the Mountains#035.dst: ...Pero si los sacas de un sitio cálido, lo queman todo. Y pensar- Algunos los usan como armas. No saben dejar las cosas en paz...
From the Mountains#035.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#036.src: We'll need to catch these Flerisi. Here, take this net. While you catch them, I'll repair the cart so we can put them in there later.
From the Mountains#036.dst: Tendremos que atrapar a estos Flerisi. Toma, coge esta red. Mientras los cazas, repararé la carreta para meterlos luego.
From the Mountains#036.speaker: Axelus
