Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.src: But those dumb over fed town folk did not catch us when we dug our cave road right under their watch house.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.dst: Pero esa gente del pueblo, tonta y gorda, no nos pilló cuando cavamos el camino justo bajo su casa de guardia.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.src: With our new way to get to Gylia land we have more stuff than ever!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.dst: ¡Con el nuevo camino a tierra Gylia tenemos más cosas que nunca!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#032.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.src: Human! You're back... and haven't been eaten by a Gert!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.dst: ¡Humano! Has vuelto... ¡y no te ha comido un Gert!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.src: What did you discover in the camp?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.src: A tunnel?! Past Gerten borders? That must be how they're managing to get in and steal my livestock.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.dst: ¿¡Un túnel!? ¿Más allá de las fronteras gerten? Así deben de colarse para robarme el ganado.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.src: Look, human. The Watch aren't gonna do anything about this. Please... maybe you can help me.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.dst: Mira, humano. La Guardia no va a hacer nada con esto. Por favor... quizá tú puedas ayudarme.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.src: If you can disguise yourself as a Gert maybe you could sneak into their main camp and check out this tunnel?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.dst: Si logras disfrazarte de Gert, ¿quizá puedas colarte en su campamento principal y ver ese túnel?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.src: Okay! As you can see, all Gerts wear a carved pumpkin on their head - something to do with their culture.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.dst: ¡Vale! Como ves, todos los Gerts llevan una calabaza tallada en la cabeza - cosa de su cultura.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.src: There's a pumpkin farm near here at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]... maybe you could get one from there?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.dst: Hay un huerto de calabazas cerca, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]... ¿quizá puedas conseguir una allí?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.src: Go to the gerten pumpkin farm at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.dst: Ve al huerto de calabazas gerten en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.dst: Qué bien, ¿te mandaron aquí para ser mi comida?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.src: Are you here to be my lunch?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#045.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#045.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.dst: Oh. Entonces, ¿qué eres, una especie de aperitivo?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.src: ... Is that a joke? What are you, some kind of snack?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.dst: ... ¿Eso es broma? ¿Qué eres, una especie de aperitivo?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.dst: ¿Un hu.. mano? ¡Ah, dices gente nueva! ¿Tan lejos, en tierras gerten? Aquí no he visto a ninguno de vosotros.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.src: I do want to know how you taste...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.dst: Sí quiero saber a qué sabes...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.src: Doing? I am here to guard the orange gourd farm, of course!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.dst: ¿Haciendo? ¡Guardo el huerto de calabacinos naranjas, claro!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.src: This farm right here is where all the gerts get their day mask from!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.dst: ¡De este huerto sacan todos los gerts su máscara de día!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.src: No, new folk. Gerts only in this farm.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.dst: No, gente nueva. Huerto solo de gerts.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.src: That is why I am put here. To make sure no one gets in.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.dst: Por eso me ponen aquí. Para que nadie entre.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.src: But but I get so bored... and I really want to eat...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.dst: Pero pero me aburro mucho... y quiero comer mucho...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.src: Like, with the clear green rocks?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.src: No new folk, gerts do not have any need for green rocks. But...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.dst: No, gente nueva, los gerts no necesitan piedras verdes. Pero...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.src: How about this - I will just eat you!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#058.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#058.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#059.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#059.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.src: Well, I think I will still eat you. Just how it is!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.dst: Bueno, creo que te como igual. ¡Así son las cosas!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.src: Oh, it is a thing gerts have been doing for as long as we know.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.dst: Oh, los gerts hacen eso desde que tenemos memoria.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.src: At wake time each day a gert takes an orange gourd and eats into it a shape that shows their mood!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.dst: ¡Cada día al despertar, un gert coge un calabacino naranja y le muerde una forma que enseña su humor!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#063.src: It is really nice, is it not?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#063.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#063.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#064.src: We all want to eat all the time!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#064.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#064.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#067.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#068.dst: ¡Oh, un fruto rojo de árbol! No debo dejar el puesto... pero quiero comer...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#068.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#068.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#069.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#070.dst: Son solo unos pasos hacia allá...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#070.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#070.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#071.src: That tastes so good! What a good red tree fruit.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#071.dst: ¡Qué rico está! Qué buen fruto rojo de árbol.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#071.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#071.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#072.src: ... If I wait here, more might fall from the sky!

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#075.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#075.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#077.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#078.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#079.dst: ¡Tú no eres gert! ¡Eres humano! ¡Un gert nunca deja de tener hambre!

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#080.dst: Perdona, humano, esto es tierra gerten privada. Y... ¡un gert tiene que comer!

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#082.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#070.src: Good job on emptying the tower. I explained the situation to the {p} Military and they followed me here.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#070.dst: Buen trabajo vaciando la torre. Expliqué la situación a los militares de {p} y han venido conmigo.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#070.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#070.speaker: Winie

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#071.src: Good thing you came to us. There is something wrong with this place because I swear... everyone seems to go coockoo.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#071.dst: Menos mal que acudiste a nosotros. Algo va mal en este sitio, porque te juro... que todos parecen chiflados.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#071.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#071.speaker: Cinfras Military

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#072.src: Either way. Due to the workers breaking the treaty we have no choice but to charge them for their crimes and fire them on the spot.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#072.dst: En cualquier caso. Como los trabajadores han roto el tratado, no nos queda otra que acusarlos de sus delitos y despedirlos en el acto.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#072.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#072.speaker: Cinfras Military

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#073.src: Us three have been put in place as a replacement until further notice.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#073.dst: A nosotros tres nos han puesto de relevo hasta nuevo aviso.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#073.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#073.speaker: Winie

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#074.src: We will also return the stolen food to the Gerts, and hopefully calm them down.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#074.dst: También devolveremos la comida robada a los Gerts, a ver si así se calman.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#074.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#074.speaker: Winie

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#075.src: Your job is finished here, Wynnian. Thank you on behalf of {p}.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#075.dst: Tu trabajo aquí ha terminado, wynniano. Gracias en nombre de {p}.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#075.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#075.speaker: Winie

Ice Nations#000.src: Talk to Adigard on the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Ice Nations#001.src: Welcome traveler, to our humble island...
Ice Nations#001.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#002.src: My people and I landed here many years ago. Unfortunately, our ship didn't make it...
Ice Nations#002.dst: Mi pueblo y yo llegamos aquí hace muchos años. Por desgracia, nuestro barco no lo logró...
Ice Nations#002.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#003.src: We tried to build a nation on these islands but became divided through the years.
Ice Nations#003.dst: Quisimos fundar una nación en estas islas, pero con los años acabamos divididos.
Ice Nations#003.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#004.src: Because of this, we are fighting a useless war with our neighbours.
Ice Nations#004.dst: Por eso libramos una guerra inútil contra nuestros vecinos.
Ice Nations#004.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#005.src: I believe we should try to pass a peace treaty, but I am afraid of getting killed if I leave the island...
Ice Nations#005.dst: Creo que deberíamos firmar un tratado de paz, pero temo que me maten si salgo de la isla...
Ice Nations#005.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#006.src: Would you mind helping us? Talk to Hallfred about this treaty. He lives on another ice island nearby.
Ice Nations#006.dst: ¿Nos ayudarías? Habla con Hallfred sobre el tratado. Vive en otra isla de hielo cercana.
Ice Nations#006.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#007.src: Talk to Hallfred about the peace treaty
Ice Nations#007.dst: Habla con Hallfred sobre el tratado de paz

Ice Nations#008.src: Welcome traveler! What brings you to our island?
Ice Nations#008.dst: ¡Bienvenido, viajero! ¿Qué te trae a nuestra isla?
Ice Nations#008.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#009.src: Oh, I see that Adigard now sends strangers through his cowardice! Worried he'll get killed?
Ice Nations#009.dst: ¡Ah, ya veo que Adigard manda a extraños por cobardía! ¿Teme que lo maten?
Ice Nations#009.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#010.src: This is the last time I'll repeat it: We will sign the peace treaty the day Adigard and his nation will return to us... the treasure.
Ice Nations#010.dst: Lo repito por última vez: firmaremos la paz el día que Adigard y su nación nos devuelvan... el tesoro.
Ice Nations#010.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#011.src: The one that they kept and hid from us after the shipwreck.
Ice Nations#011.dst: El que se quedaron y nos ocultaron tras el naufragio.
Ice Nations#011.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#012.src: Pure gold, very valuable and rare! Tell him I'll be waiting for it. And none of that silly story again.
Ice Nations#012.dst: ¡Oro puro, valiosísimo y rarísimo! Dile que lo espero. Y nada de esa historia absurda otra vez.
Ice Nations#012.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#013.src: Talk back to Adigard about Hallfred's response
Ice Nations#013.dst: Vuelve con Adigard y cuéntale la respuesta de Hallfred

Ice Nations#014.src: I should have expected that. Hallfred was always very greedy...
Ice Nations#014.dst: Debí imaginarlo. Hallfred siempre fue muy codicioso...
Ice Nations#014.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#015.src: We tried to make him understand that we do not have the treasure, without much success.
Ice Nations#015.dst: Intentamos hacerle entender que no tenemos el tesoro, sin mucho éxito.
Ice Nations#015.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#016.src: ... You see, the reason why we became shipwrecked wasn't natural cause. We were attacked...
Ice Nations#016.dst: ... Verás, nuestro naufragio no fue por causas naturales. Nos atacaron...
Ice Nations#016.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#017.src: By whom? The undead. Ghosts and demons navigating a monstrous ship. They got us by surprise.
Ice Nations#017.dst: ¿Por quién? Los no muertos. Fantasmas y demonios en un barco monstruoso. Nos pillaron por sorpresa.
Ice Nations#017.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#018.src: I believe they also stole our treasure during the attack.
Ice Nations#018.dst: Creo que también robaron nuestro tesoro durante el ataque.
Ice Nations#018.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#019.src: Would you help our nation come back together? Find this ship, and bring the treasure back to Hallfred so we can finally live in peace.
Ice Nations#019.dst: ¿Ayudarías a reunir de nuevo a nuestra nación? Encuentra ese barco y lleva el tesoro a Hallfred para que por fin vivamos en paz.
Ice Nations#019.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#020.src: Sail north. That is where they attacked us many years ago. It should be easy to find, I'm sure they are anchored there in glory... Thank you.
Ice Nations#020.dst: Navega al norte. Allí nos atacaron hace años. Será fácil de encontrar; seguro que siguen anclados allí, orgullosos... Gracias.
Ice Nations#020.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#021.src: Find the ghost ship and bring back [Ancient Treasure] to Hallfred
Ice Nations#021.dst: Encuentra el barco fantasma y lleva el [Ancient Treasure] a Hallfred

Ice Nations#022.src: Incredible! He actually delivered the treasure!
Ice Nations#022.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#023.src: I suppose that means the end of the war between our nations!
Ice Nations#023.dst: ¡Supongo que eso pone fin a la guerra entre nuestras naciones!
Ice Nations#023.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#024.src: This is a great day! Here, take this as a reward for helping our nation.
Ice Nations#024.dst: ¡Es un gran día! Toma, por ayudar a nuestra nación.
Ice Nations#024.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#025.src: I'm sure you'll find a use for this helmet one day!
Ice Nations#025.dst: ¡Seguro que algún día le darás uso a este casco!
Ice Nations#025.speaker: Hallfred

Infested Plants#003.src: Meet up with Tasim at the entrance to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#003.dst: Reúnete con Tasim en la entrada de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#004.src: Oh, {u}! There you are. It's good to see you. Are you ready to continue on towards {p}?
Infested Plants#004.dst: ¡Ah, {u}! Ahí estás. Me alegro de verte. ¿Listo para seguir hacia {p}?
Infested Plants#004.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#006.src: H-hey! You two! You're soldiers, right? I can tell from your weird fashion sense. You folk are supposed to help people! So. Help!
Infested Plants#006.dst: ¡E-eh! ¡Vosotros dos! Sois soldados, ¿no? Se nota por vuestro raro gusto para vestir. ¡Los vuestros ayudan a la gente! Pues eso. ¡Ayudadme!

Infested Plants#007.src: Huh? Oh- yes, of course! What's your name? What do you need help with?
Infested Plants#007.dst: ¿Eh? Ah... ¡sí, claro! ¿Cómo te llamas? ¿Con qué necesitas ayuda?
Infested Plants#007.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#008.src: I'm Ope! I was recently... uh... bit by a spider! And now I need your help to get a rare medicinal herb to heal me!
Infested Plants#008.dst: ¡Soy Ope! Hace poco... eh... ¡me mordió una araña! ¡Necesito una hierba medicinal rara para curarme!
Infested Plants#008.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#009.src: It only grows in an infested cave filled with creepy crawlies. And I'm clearly in no condition to go get it myself!
Infested Plants#009.dst: Solo crece en una cueva infestada de bichos rastreros. ¡Y está claro que no estoy para ir yo mismo!
Infested Plants#009.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#010.src: Well, alright! We're here to help, after all, so... We'll get you that herb!
Infested Plants#010.dst: ¡Vale, de acuerdo! Para eso hemos venido... ¡te traeremos esa hierba!
Infested Plants#010.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#012.src: Follow Ope to the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#012.dst: Sigue a Ope hasta la cueva en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#014.src: Hm... There's two of you. Good! One of your can climb up into that cave, and the other can protect me from the crawly spiders down here!
Infested Plants#014.dst: Hm... Sois dos. ¡Bien! Uno puede subir a esa cueva y el otro puede protegerme aquí abajo de las arañas rastreras.
Infested Plants#014.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#015.src: Alright! {u}, you can go into the cave, and I can defend Ope here while you do that.
Infested Plants#015.dst: ¡Vale! {u}, tú entra en la cueva y yo protejo a Ope aquí mientras tanto.
Infested Plants#015.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#017.src: Locate the medicine in the spider cave behind Ope at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#017.dst: Localiza la medicina en la cueva de arañas detrás de Ope en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#018.src: Exit the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with the medicinal herb.
Infested Plants#018.dst: Sal de la cueva en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] con la hierba medicinal.

Infested Plants#019.src: There you are! It feels like we've been waiting for hours.
Infested Plants#019.dst: ¡Ya estás aquí! Parece que llevamos horas esperando.
Infested Plants#019.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#020.src: It... really hasn't been that long. Maybe ten minutes at most.
Infested Plants#020.dst: En realidad... no ha sido tanto. Diez minutos como mucho.
Infested Plants#020.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#021.src: Well-... Anyway! Do you have the herb? It's very- uh, important! To cure me. Yep.
Infested Plants#021.dst: Bueno... ¡En fin! ¿Tenéis la hierba? Es muy... eh, ¡importante! Para curarme. Sí.
Infested Plants#021.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#023.src: Oh. I seem to be out of emeralds. Well- I can, uh, offer some advice! There's lots to find in this forest. Plenty of caves with valuables to explore! Might be worth your time.
Infested Plants#023.dst: Oh. Parece que me he quedado sin esmeraldas. Pero... ¡puedo daros un consejo! En este bosque hay mucho que encontrar. ¡Cuevas con tesoros de sobra! Quizá os merezca la pena.
Infested Plants#023.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#025.src: It has been a time, soldiers, but I truly must be going! We're near {p}, you should stop on by! Just keep going east down the main road! Go and speak to the mayor! He can cover my expenses!
Infested Plants#025.dst: ¡Ha sido un placer, soldados, pero debo irme! ¡Estamos cerca de {p}, pasaos por allí! ¡Seguid al este por el camino principal! ¡Hablad con el alcalde, él cubrirá mis gastos!
Infested Plants#025.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#028.src: That's... frustrating. He seemed shady from the start, I should have-... Well. What's done is done. Let's go speak to that mayor.
Infested Plants#028.dst: Es... frustrante. Parecía turbio desde el principio, debería haber-... En fin. Lo hecho, hecho está. Vamos a hablar con ese alcalde.
Infested Plants#028.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#029.src: Speak to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#029.dst: Habla con el alcalde Alvin en {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#030.src: Ah, travelers... welcome to our humble forest town. Have you come to stay, or are you simply passing through?
Infested Plants#030.dst: Ah, viajeros... bienvenidos a nuestro humilde pueblo del bosque. ¿Venís a quedaros o solo estáis de paso?
Infested Plants#030.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#031.src: Probably the latter. Though, we ran into a man named Ope, who directed us to speak with you.
Infested Plants#031.dst: Seguramente lo segundo. Aunque nos encontramos con un hombre llamado Ope que nos dijo que habláramos con usted.
Infested Plants#031.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#032.src: Oh, Ope... I take it your meeting with him went poorly? I must apologize for him, he is... a tough man to deal with.
Infested Plants#032.dst: Ah, Ope... Supongo que el encuentro no fue bien. Debo disculparme por él, es... un hombre difícil de tratar.
Infested Plants#032.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#033.src: Here, I may offer you a small sum of emeralds as an apology. I hope he has not soured your opinion of our small town, here...
Infested Plants#033.dst: Tomad, permitidme ofreceros una pequeña suma de esmeraldas como disculpa. Espero que no os haya amargado la opinión de nuestro pueblecito...
Infested Plants#033.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#034.src: Oh... Thank you. That's very kind of you. We'll probably stay for a while, before we continue towards {p}.
Infested Plants#034.dst: Oh... Gracias. Es muy amable de su parte. Seguramente nos quedemos un tiempo antes de seguir hacia {p}.
Infested Plants#034.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#035.src: Then feel free to make yourselves at home! We welcome all travelers here, no matter how long their stay is.
Infested Plants#035.dst: ¡Pues sentíos como en casa! Damos la bienvenida a todos los viajeros, dure lo que dure su estancia.
Infested Plants#035.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#036.src: Oh, {u}! There you are. It's good to see you. I'd say we should keep heading towards {p}, but...
Infested Plants#036.dst: ¡Ah, {u}! Ahí estás. Me alegro de verte. Deberíamos seguir hacia {p}, pero...

Infested Plants#037.src: It looks like we'll need to pass through the {p} first. I've heard the forest is crawling with spiders... and the undead are a danger, as always... but between you and me, we should be-
Infested Plants#037.dst: Parece que primero habrá que cruzar el {p}. He oído que el bosque está plagado de arañas... y los no muertos son un peligro, como siempre... pero entre tú y yo, deberíamos-

Infested Plants#038.src: H-hey! You two! You're soldiers, right?

Infested Plants#040.src: Yep, I could tell from your weird fashion sense! You folk are supposed to help people, right? So. Help!
Infested Plants#040.dst: ¡Sí, se nota por vuestro raro gusto para vestir! Los vuestros ayudan a la gente, ¿no? Pues eso. ¡Ayudadme!

Infested Plants#041.src: Well, sure- but who are you? Why are you out on your own, isn't it dangerous? Aren't the undead...
Infested Plants#041.dst: Bueno, claro... pero ¿quién eres? ¿Por qué andas solo por aquí, no es peligroso? ¿No están los no muertos...

Infested Plants#042.src: I'm Ope! And the undead... eh, there's not as many of them around here. The spiders aren't picky 'bout who they go for.
Infested Plants#042.dst: ¡Soy Ope! Y los no muertos... bah, por aquí no hay tantos. A las arañas no les importa a quién atacan.

Infested Plants#043.src: Right... okay. That makes sense. What did you need help with?
Infested Plants#043.dst: Ya... vale. Tiene sentido. ¿Con qué necesitabas ayuda?

Infested Plants#044.src: I... uh... so, there's this rare medicinal herb that grows in these woods, right? And it's important. But the only place I know to find it is an infested cave, filled with creepy crawly spiders.
Infested Plants#044.dst: Yo... eh... veréis, en estos bosques crece una hierba medicinal rara, ¿vale? Y es importante. Pero el único sitio donde sé que hay es una cueva infestada de arañas asquerosas.

Infested Plants#045.src: And, y'know, I- I'm no soldier! Can't just go in there and get it myself! So, I was hoping you could help me out.
Infested Plants#045.dst: Y, ya sabéis, ¡yo-yo no soy soldado! ¡No puedo entrar ahí a por ella! Así que esperaba que me echarais una mano.

Infested Plants#046.src: Well... we came to Wynn to help out, after all. So... we can get you that herb!
Infested Plants#046.dst: Bueno... al fin y al cabo vinimos a Wynn para ayudar. Así que... ¡te conseguiremos esa hierba!

Infested Plants#047.src: Great. Great! I'll bring you to the cave, and you can do the rest from there. Follow me!
Infested Plants#047.dst: Genial. ¡Genial! Os llevo a la cueva y allí os encargáis del resto. ¡Seguidme!

Infested Plants#048.src: Well, here we are! That's the cave right over there- just climb up the rocks and jump into it. It's safe! Uh, probably.
Infested Plants#048.dst: ¡Bueno, aquí estamos! La cueva es esa de ahí: subid por las rocas y saltad dentro. ¡Es segura! Eh, seguramente.

Infested Plants#049.src: ...eek. There's a lot of spiders even up here... hey, since there's two of you- one of you can go get the herb, and the other can, uh... protect me from the crawly spiders?
Infested Plants#049.dst: ...iep. Aquí arriba también hay un montón de arañas... oye, ya que sois dos: uno va a por la hierba y el otro, eh... ¿me protege de las arañas rastreras?

Infested Plants#050.src: That works for me. {u}, you go into the cave, and I'll defend Ope up here while you do that.
Infested Plants#050.dst: Por mí bien. {u}, tú entra en la cueva y yo protejo a Ope aquí arriba mientras tanto.

Infested Plants#051.src: Yep... good! Good, good! Good, uh, luck up there! Try not to get bitten too much by the spiders!
Infested Plants#051.dst: Sí... ¡bien! ¡Bien, bien! ¡Eh, mucha... suerte ahí arriba! ¡Intenta que no te muerdan mucho las arañas!

Infested Plants#052.src: ...ah- there you are!! What took you so long, it feels like we've been waiting for hours!
Infested Plants#052.dst: ...ah, ¡ya estás aquí! ¿Por qué has tardado tanto? ¡Parece que llevamos horas esperando!

Infested Plants#053.src: It-... mm. A-anyway! Do you have the herb? It's very important, yep.
Infested Plants#053.dst: Es-... mm. ¡E-en fin! ¿Tienes la hierba? Es muy importante, sí.

Infested Plants#054.src: Come to think of it... I don't think you ever mentioned what you needed it for.
Infested Plants#054.dst: Ahora que lo pienso... creo que nunca dijiste para qué la necesitabas.

Infested Plants#055.src: Oh, I- eheh, it... I... uh, it's n-none of your business, actually.
Infested Plants#055.dst: Ah, yo... ejeje, es... yo... eh, en realidad n-no es asunto tuyo.

Infested Plants#056.src: I- I thank you kindly for your work, soldiers! Now, about your payment... let's see, what do I have...
Infested Plants#056.dst: ¡O-os agradezco mucho el trabajo, soldados! Ahora, vuestro pago... veamos, qué tengo por aquí...

Infested Plants#057.src: Oh. I seem to be out of emeralds. Well- then, I- I can offer some advice! There's lots to find in this forest. Plenty of other caves with valuables to explore! Might be worth your time!
Infested Plants#057.dst: Oh. Parece que me he quedado sin esmeraldas. Pues... ¡e-entonces os doy un consejo! En este bosque hay mucho que encontrar. ¡Hay más cuevas con tesoros! ¡Quizá os merezca la pena!

Infested Plants#058.src: Wait, what? Hey, are you seriously not going to-
Infested Plants#058.dst: Espera, ¿qué? Oye, ¿en serio no vas a-

Infested Plants#059.src: It has been a time soldiers, but I- I truly must be going! Important things to get to! We're near {p}, you should stop on by! Just keep going east down the main road!
Infested Plants#059.dst: Ha sido un placer, soldados, pero de-de verdad tengo que irme. ¡Tengo cosas importantes que hacer! ¡Estamos cerca de {p}, pasaos por allí! ¡Seguid al este por el camino principal!

Infested Plants#060.src: You can, uh, go speak to the mayor! He can cover my expenses!
Infested Plants#060.dst: Podéis, eh, ¡hablar con el alcalde! ¡Él cubrirá mis gastos!

Infested Plants#062.src: That's... frustrating. I really did just want to know... well. What's done is done. Let's just go talk to that mayor he mentioned.
Infested Plants#062.dst: Es... frustrante. Solo quería saberlo... en fin. Lo hecho, hecho está. Vamos a hablar con ese alcalde que ha mencionado.

Infested Plants#063.src: I'm going to go on ahead. I'll meet you in {p}, it's just down the main road to the east.
Infested Plants#063.dst: Me adelanto. Nos vemos en {p}, está camino abajo hacia el este.

Infested Plants#064.src: Ah, recruits... welcome to our humble forest town. Have you come to stay, or are you simply passing through?
Infested Plants#064.dst: Ah, reclutas... bienvenidos a nuestro humilde pueblo del bosque. ¿Venís a quedaros o solo estáis de paso?

Infested Plants#065.src: Just passing through, our destination is {p}. Though... we ran into a man named Ope, who directed us to speak with you.
Infested Plants#065.dst: Solo de paso, vamos a {p}. Aunque... nos topamos con un tal Ope que nos dijo que habláramos con usted.

Infested Plants#066.src: Oh, Ope... I take it your meeting with him went poorly? I must apologize for him, he is... a tough man to deal with sometimes.
Infested Plants#066.dst: Ah, Ope... Supongo que el encuentro no fue bien. Debo disculparme por él, es... un hombre difícil de tratar a veces.

Infested Plants#067.src: Oh... thank you. That's very kind of you. We'll probably stay a while, before we continue towards {p}.
Infested Plants#067.dst: Oh... gracias. Es muy amable de su parte. Seguramente nos quedemos un tiempo antes de seguir hacia {p}.

Infested Plants#068.src: Then feel free to make yourselves at home! We welcome all travelers here, no matter how long their stay.
Infested Plants#068.dst: ¡Pues sentíos como en casa! Damos la bienvenida a todos los viajeros, dure lo que dure su estancia.

Jungle Fever#000.src: Talk to Worid in the jungle village at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Jungle Fever#000.dst: Habla con Worid en la aldea de la jungla en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Jungle Fever#001.src: Oh, I am so happy to see you! *cough*, I caught a very bad fever, and I really need help! *cough*
Jungle Fever#001.dst: ¡Oh, cuánto me alegro de verte! *tos*, he pillado una fiebre horrible y necesito ayuda de verdad. *tos*
Jungle Fever#001.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#002.src: The only cure against this fever is to drink Liquid Emeralds! Yes, exactly! *cough*
Jungle Fever#002.dst: ¡El único remedio contra esta fiebre es beber esmeraldas líquidas! ¡Sí, exacto! *tos*
Jungle Fever#002.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#003.src: Do you think you could ask the Banker at {p} if he could give me, oh I don't know, [{~} Liquified Emeralds]?
Jungle Fever#003.dst: ¿Podrías preguntarle al Banquero de {p} si me puede dar, yo qué sé, [{~} esmeraldas líquidas]?
Jungle Fever#003.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#004.src: If he has the audacity to *cough* say no... you will have to use brute force...
Jungle Fever#004.dst: Si tiene el descaro de *tos* negarse... tendrás que usar la fuerza...
Jungle Fever#004.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#005.src: Break into *cough* to the emerald storage, but don't take anything... come back to me immediately after, if you make it out alive, heheh...
Jungle Fever#005.dst: Cuélate *tos* en el almacén de esmeraldas, pero no te lleves nada... y vuelve enseguida conmigo, si sales con vida, je je...
Jungle Fever#005.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#007.src: Talk to {p}'s Banker about the cure for Worid at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Jungle Fever#007.dst: Habla con el Banquero de {p} sobre el remedio para Worid en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Jungle Fever#008.src: [{~} Liquified Emeralds]? He is crazy! Liquified Emeralds cannot cure anyone from anything, except being poor!
Jungle Fever#008.dst: ¿[{~} esmeraldas líquidas]? ¡Está loco! ¡Las esmeraldas líquidas no curan nada, salvo la pobreza!
Jungle Fever#008.speaker: The Banker

Jungle Fever#009.src: I will not participate in this pathetic fraud attempt!
Jungle Fever#009.dst: ¡No pienso participar en este patético intento de estafa!
Jungle Fever#009.speaker: The Banker

Jungle Fever#010.dst: Entra en el almacén de esmeraldas de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Jungle Fever#011.src: Oh no! How will I ever cure my sickness without any Liquified Emeralds?... *cough*
Jungle Fever#011.dst: ¡Oh, no! ¿Cómo voy a curar mi enfermedad sin esmeraldas líquidas?... *tos*
Jungle Fever#011.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#012.src: We'll have to change our strategy, we won't ask for permission. It's to help me after all.
Jungle Fever#012.dst: Tendremos que cambiar de estrategia: no pediremos permiso. Total, es para ayudarme a mí.
Jungle Fever#012.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#013.src: First, I need to make sure you can easily break into a bank. Try to enter {p}' Secret Stash.
Jungle Fever#013.dst: Primero necesito asegurarme de que puedes colarte en un banco. Intenta entrar en el Almacén Secreto de {p}.
Jungle Fever#013.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#014.src: When you're done, talk to me again. Be careful too, they might have some Guards.
Jungle Fever#014.dst: Cuando termines, habla conmigo otra vez. Y ten cuidado, puede que tengan guardias.
Jungle Fever#014.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#016.src: What? You're here already. I thought you would take too long so I just went myself.
Jungle Fever#016.dst: ¿Qué? Ya estás aquí. Pensé que tardarías demasiado, así que fui yo mismo.
Jungle Fever#016.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#017.src: My sickness? RIGHT. *cough* You should feel bad for forcing a sick man to do your job.
Jungle Fever#017.dst: ¿Mi enfermedad? CLARO. *tos* Deberías avergonzarte por obligar a un enfermo a hacer tu trabajo.
Jungle Fever#017.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#018.src: Anyway I see you proved yourself, we can start the real thing now.
Jungle Fever#018.dst: En fin, ya has demostrado lo que vales; podemos empezar con lo de verdad.
Jungle Fever#018.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#019.src: You see, {p} has a very well guarded emerald vault named "The Emerald Labyrinth".
Jungle Fever#019.dst: Verás, {p} tiene una cámara de esmeraldas muy bien vigilada llamada "El Laberinto de Esmeraldas".
Jungle Fever#019.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#020.src: It is guarded with tons of well trained Guard Golem, who can easily kill any adventurer.
Jungle Fever#020.dst: La custodian montones de Gólems guardianes bien entrenados, capaces de matar a cualquier aventurero.
Jungle Fever#020.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#021.src: The Banker in the secret vault must be completely bored out of his mind, and won't mind if you find him.
Jungle Fever#021.dst: El Banquero de la cámara secreta debe de estar muerto de aburrimiento, no le importará que lo encuentres.
Jungle Fever#021.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#022.src: Good luck with that. Haha.. I mean, *cough*.
Jungle Fever#022.dst: Buena suerte con eso. Jaja... quiero decir, *tos*.
Jungle Fever#022.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#023.src: Infiltrate {p}'s Secret Emerald Labyrinth at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] underground and find the Banker in the Emerald Room
Jungle Fever#023.dst: Infíltrate en el Laberinto Secreto de Esmeraldas de {p}, bajo tierra, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] y encuentra al Banquero en la Sala de las Esmeraldas

Jungle Fever#024.src: Oh, uh! Somebody! It has been so long since I've seen someone!
Jungle Fever#024.dst: ¡Oh, vaya! ¡Alguien! ¡Hacía tantísimo que no veía a nadie!
Jungle Fever#024.speaker: Almuj Banker

Jungle Fever#025.src: Liquified Emeralds? Of course, of course! I've got tons! Here, take them.
Jungle Fever#025.dst: ¿Esmeraldas líquidas? ¡Claro, claro! ¡Tengo un montón! Toma, llévatelas.
Jungle Fever#025.speaker: Almuj Banker

Jungle Fever#028.src: That is a lot of money, thank you very much, I will finally be able to... *cough* to cure myself!
Jungle Fever#028.dst: Es mucho dinero, muchísimas gracias, por fin podré... *tos* ¡curarme!
Jungle Fever#028.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#029.src: Here, take this part, you deserve it. I have to use most of the... *cough* money so I can heal, so I've instead paid you with a key.
Jungle Fever#029.dst: Toma, esta parte es tuya, te la mereces. Casi todo el... *tos* dinero se me irá en la cura, así que te pago con una llave.
Jungle Fever#029.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#030.src: I stole- *cough* I mean, borrowed it, from our tribe's leader. Apparently it was used to lock up a great evil.
Jungle Fever#030.dst: La robé- *tos* quiero decir, se la pedí prestada al jefe de nuestra tribu. Por lo visto sirvió para encerrar un gran mal.
Jungle Fever#030.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#031.src: Good ridda- *cough* Er... luck. Yes, good luck, adventurer!
Jungle Fever#031.dst: Hasta nunc- *tos* Eh... suerte. Sí, ¡buena suerte, aventurero!
Jungle Fever#031.speaker: Worid

King's Recruit#002.src: Hey, {u}! You alright in there? Looks like we hit something.
King's Recruit#002.dst: ¡Eh, {u}! ¿Estás bien ahí dentro? Parece que hemos chocado con algo.

King's Recruit#003.src: Exit the caravan and talk to the Caravan Driver at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#003.dst: Sal de la caravana y habla con el conductor de la caravana en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#004.src: Hm... I swear I hit this same darn boulder every time I make this trip. Sorry folks.
King's Recruit#004.dst: Mmm... Juro que choco con este maldito pedrusco cada vez que hago este viaje. Lo siento, gente.
King's Recruit#004.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#005.src: Ah. Does this mean we have to walk all the way to {p} from here?
King's Recruit#005.dst: Ah. ¿Eso significa que tenemos que ir andando desde aquí hasta {p}?
King's Recruit#005.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#006.src: Unfortunately so. Luckily, it's not that far from here. Just a straight path forward.
King's Recruit#006.dst: Me temo que sí. Por suerte no queda lejos. Todo recto por el camino.
King's Recruit#006.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#007.src: Well, nothing to do but keep moving! Tasim, {u}, I'll race you to the gate!
King's Recruit#007.dst: ¡Bueno, no queda otra que seguir! Tasim, {u}, ¡os echo una carrera hasta la puerta!
King's Recruit#007.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#009.src: ... He's already gone. We'll have to catch up to him. {u}, lead the way.
King's Recruit#009.dst: ... Ya se ha ido. Tendremos que alcanzarlo. {u}, abre camino.
King's Recruit#009.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#010.src: Walk down the path towards the gate to the Wynn Province at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#010.dst: Recorre el camino hacia la puerta de la Provincia de Wynn en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#011.src: I don't suppose you know much about Wynn either, do you?
King's Recruit#011.dst: Supongo que tú tampoco sabes mucho sobre Wynn, ¿verdad?
King's Recruit#011.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#012.src: Of course, the King of {p}'s been recruiting Fruma soldiers, but...
King's Recruit#012.dst: Claro, el Rey de {p} lleva tiempo reclutando soldados de Fruma, pero...
King's Recruit#012.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#013.src: That war of theirs must be getting pretty bad if they need this much support.
King's Recruit#013.dst: Esa guerra suya debe de ir bastante mal si necesitan tanto apoyo.
King's Recruit#013.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#014.src: Oh, there's Aledar! And the gate, by the looks of it.
King's Recruit#014.dst: ¡Ah, ahí está Aledar! Y la puerta, por lo que parece.
King's Recruit#014.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#015.src: There you two are! You'll have to be faster than that if you want to stand a chance against the undead.
King's Recruit#015.dst: ¡Por fin llegáis! Tendréis que ser más rápidos si queréis plantar cara a los no muertos.
King's Recruit#015.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#016.src: Yes, yes, we'll be faster next time. So, is this the gate marking the border between Wynn and Fruma?
King's Recruit#016.dst: Sí, sí, la próxima vez iremos más rápido. Entonces, ¿esta es la puerta que marca la frontera entre Wynn y Fruma?
King's Recruit#016.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#017.src: It looks like it, yep! Are you two ready for the start of our new lives?
King's Recruit#017.dst: ¡Eso parece, sí! ¿Listos para empezar nuestra nueva vida?
King's Recruit#017.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#018.src: {u}, why don't you do the honours? Go ahead and open that gate.
King's Recruit#018.dst: {u}, ¿por qué no haces tú los honores? Anda, abre esa puerta.
King's Recruit#018.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#019.src: Enter the Province of Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#019.dst: Entra en la Provincia de Wynn en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#020.src: Well, what are we waiting for? Let's go ahead and explore this province.
King's Recruit#020.dst: Bueno, ¿a qué esperamos? Vamos a explorar esta provincia.
King's Recruit#020.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#021.src: Continue through the Wynn Province to the castle
King's Recruit#021.dst: Continúa por la Provincia de Wynn hasta el castillo

King's Recruit#022.src: So this is Wynn we've all been hearing about... It's beautiful.
King's Recruit#022.dst: Así que este es el Wynn del que tanto hemos oído hablar... Es precioso.
King's Recruit#022.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#023.src: I guess the war hasn't made it this far. This is what we'll be fighting to protect.
King's Recruit#023.dst: Supongo que la guerra no ha llegado hasta aquí. Esto es lo que vamos a luchar por proteger.
King's Recruit#023.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#024.src: Hey, recruits! Come over here, I have something to tell you.
King's Recruit#024.dst: ¡Eh, reclutas! Venid aquí, tengo algo que deciros.
King's Recruit#024.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#026.src: A soldier? What are you doing all the way out here?
King's Recruit#026.dst: ¿Un soldado? ¿Qué hace usted tan lejos de todo?
King's Recruit#026.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#027.src: There's a bit of trouble up ahead. They sent me out here to intercept new recruits.
King's Recruit#027.dst: Hay algo de jaleo más adelante. Me han enviado aquí a interceptar a los nuevos reclutas.
King's Recruit#027.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#028.src: If you want to survive out here, you're going to need this.
King's Recruit#028.dst: Si queréis sobrevivir aquí fuera, vais a necesitar esto.
King's Recruit#028.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#031.src: Hopefully we won't have to use these just yet.
King's Recruit#031.dst: Espero que aún no tengamos que usarlas.
King's Recruit#031.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#032.src: Good luck out there, recruits! Just follow this path, and there will be a bridge up ahead.
King's Recruit#032.dst: ¡Suerte ahí fuera, reclutas! Seguid este camino y más adelante habrá un puente.
King's Recruit#032.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#034.src: Ah, this must be the bridge the soldier was talking about. But it certainly looks very...
King's Recruit#034.dst: Ah, este debe de ser el puente del que hablaba el soldado. Aunque desde luego tiene una pinta muy...
King's Recruit#034.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#035.src: Well, let's not keep the King of {p} waiting!
King's Recruit#035.dst: ¡Bueno, no hagamos esperar al Rey de {p}!
King's Recruit#035.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#039.src: That's what I was trying to warn you about! Let's just get off this bridge before the rest of it collapses...
King's Recruit#039.dst: ¡De eso intentaba avisarte! Salgamos de este puente antes de que se derrumbe el resto...
King's Recruit#039.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#040.src: Well, how are we meant to get to the other side of this ravine now? Ugh. Another thing gone wrong, just like-...
King's Recruit#040.dst: ¿Y cómo se supone que cruzamos ahora este barranco? Uf. Otra cosa que sale mal, igual que-...
King's Recruit#040.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#042.src: That's... weird. I was just thinking about something from before Wynn, but... it's gone. I can't remember.
King's Recruit#042.dst: Qué... raro. Estaba pensando en algo de antes de Wynn, pero... ha desaparecido. No lo recuerdo.
King's Recruit#042.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#043.src: Hm. I can't remember anything from Fruma either... {u}, how about you?
King's Recruit#043.dst: Hm. Yo tampoco recuerdo nada de Fruma... {u}, ¿y tú?
King's Recruit#043.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#044.src: Nothing. It can't be a coincidence we all lost our memories at the same time, right?
King's Recruit#044.dst: Nada. No puede ser casualidad que los tres hayamos perdido la memoria a la vez, ¿no?
King's Recruit#044.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#045.src: No, but... We can worry about that later. For now, we need to find a way past this ravine. Aledar, {u}, you should look around for a way across. I'll keep looking here.
King's Recruit#045.dst: No, pero... Ya nos preocuparemos de eso luego. Ahora hay que encontrar la forma de cruzar el barranco. Aledar, {u}, buscad un paso por ahí. Yo seguiré mirando aquí.
King's Recruit#045.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#047.src: Search for another way across the ravine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#047.dst: Busca otra forma de cruzar el barranco en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#048.src: Woah! That sure did the trick, {u}. Good thinking!
King's Recruit#048.dst: ¡Hala! Eso ha funcionado de maravilla, {u}. ¡Bien pensado!
King's Recruit#048.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#049.src: Hey, Tasim! Come over here, {u} found a way over!
King's Recruit#049.dst: ¡Eh, Tasim! ¡Ven aquí, {u} ha encontrado un paso!
King's Recruit#049.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#051.src: Phew! We made it over safely this time at least.
King's Recruit#051.dst: ¡Uf! Al menos esta vez hemos cruzado sanos y salvos.
King's Recruit#051.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#052.src: If we just continue forward, we should make it to {p} in no time!
King's Recruit#052.dst: ¡Si seguimos recto, llegaremos a {p} en un momento!
King's Recruit#052.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#053.src: Hmm? What's that guard doing here? We should probably talk to them if we want to pass through.
King's Recruit#053.dst: ¿Mmm? ¿Qué hace ahí ese guardia? Si queremos pasar, será mejor que hablemos con él.
King's Recruit#053.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#057.src: A group of corrupted have sieged this underpass. I can't let you enter without any armour.
King's Recruit#057.dst: Un grupo de corruptos ha tomado este paso subterráneo. No puedo dejaros entrar sin armadura.
King's Recruit#057.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#058.src: Then what do we do? We have to get to {p}!
King's Recruit#058.dst: ¿Y entonces qué hacemos? ¡Tenemos que llegar a {p}!
King's Recruit#058.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#059.src: Do you see that cave over there? Caves such as those often contain useful loot that can help keep you alive.
King's Recruit#059.dst: ¿Veis esa cueva de ahí? En cuevas así suele haber botín útil que os ayudará a seguir con vida.
King's Recruit#059.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#060.src: If you enter the cave, you should be able to find some armour to protect you. After that return to me.
King's Recruit#060.dst: Si entráis en la cueva, deberíais encontrar alguna armadura que os proteja. Después, volved a verme.
King's Recruit#060.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#061.src: What do you say {u}? Let's go see what's in that cave.
King's Recruit#061.dst: ¿Qué me dices, {u}? Vamos a ver qué hay en esa cueva.
King's Recruit#061.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#062.src: Enter the cave and find some armour at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#062.dst: Entra en la cueva y encuentra una armadura en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#063.src: We should return to the guard to see if he'll let us through now!
King's Recruit#063.dst: ¡Deberíamos volver con el guardia a ver si ahora nos deja pasar!
King's Recruit#063.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#065.src: So you found some armor, huh?
King's Recruit#065.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#066.src: Yes, a helmet! Will you let us pass now?
King's Recruit#066.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#067.src: Hold on there, recruit. Before you can equip a piece of armor you first have to identify it.
King's Recruit#067.dst: No tan deprisa, recluta. Antes de equiparte una pieza de armadura tienes que identificarla.
King's Recruit#067.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#068.src: And how do we do that?
King's Recruit#068.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#069.src: You can identify items at Item Identifiers. They exist in every city across the whole world, and we keep one here for convenience.
King's Recruit#069.dst: Los objetos se identifican en los Identificadores de objetos. Los hay en todas las ciudades del mundo, y aquí tenemos uno por comodidad.
King's Recruit#069.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#070.src: Identify your helmet at the Item Identifier and then return to me with it equipped. After you've done that I'll let you pass.
King's Recruit#070.dst: Identifica tu casco en el Identificador de objetos y vuelve a verme con él equipado. Cuando lo hayas hecho, te dejaré pasar.
King's Recruit#070.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#072.src: I see you have your helmet on. Fantastic, you may now pass. Let me open this door for you.
King's Recruit#072.dst: Veo que llevas el casco puesto. Fantástico, ya podéis pasar. Os abro la puerta.
King's Recruit#072.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#073.src: Good luck in there recruits! Even with your armour it won't be so easy!
King's Recruit#073.dst: ¡Suerte ahí dentro, reclutas! ¡Ni con armadura será fácil!
King's Recruit#073.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#074.dst: Entra en el paso subterráneo en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#075.dst: Sigue por el paso subterráneo hasta [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#076.src: Wow, that guard wasn't joking. This place is crawling with the corrupt.
King's Recruit#076.dst: Vaya, el guardia no bromeaba. Esto está plagado de corruptos.
King's Recruit#076.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#077.src: Well, we've got no choice but to make it through! Finally time for us to use these weapons we got. Let's go, {u}.
King's Recruit#077.dst: ¡Pues no queda otra que abrirse paso! Por fin toca usar estas armas que nos han dado. Vamos, {u}.
King's Recruit#077.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#078.src: {u}, you take the skeleton in the front. We'll handle the two zombies in the back!
King's Recruit#078.dst: {u}, encárgate del Skeleton de delante. ¡Nosotros nos ocupamos de los dos zombis de atrás!
King's Recruit#078.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#081.src: This path opened up, let's continue through the underpass.
King's Recruit#081.dst: Se ha abierto este camino, sigamos por el paso subterráneo.
King's Recruit#081.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#082.dst: Sigue por el paso subterráneo hasta [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#083.src: Over here! You're just what I needed!
King's Recruit#083.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#085.src: Finally, some backup! Wait a second... you're straight from Fruma aren't you?
King's Recruit#085.dst: ¡Por fin, refuerzos! Un momento... venís directos de Fruma, ¿verdad?
King's Recruit#085.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#086.src: Oh well, this area should be clear by now. {p} is just up ahead, after all.
King's Recruit#086.dst: En fin, esta zona ya debería estar despejada. {p} está justo ahí delante.
King's Recruit#086.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#088.src: Quick, you have to use an ability!
King's Recruit#088.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#090.src: Wait, it's running away! We have to save the Lieutenant!
King's Recruit#090.dst: ¡Esperad, se escapa! ¡Tenemos que salvar al teniente!
King's Recruit#090.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#092.src: Defeat the Goliath and free the Lieutenant.
King's Recruit#092.dst: Derrota al Goliath y libera al teniente.

King's Recruit#093.src: That sure was close... Thanks for the save, {u}!
King's Recruit#093.dst: Eso ha estado cerca... ¡Gracias por salvarme, {u}!
King's Recruit#093.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#094.src: I think you three are going to make good soldiers - not many can handle themselves like you just did.
King's Recruit#094.dst: Creo que los tres vais a ser buenos soldados; no muchos se defienden como acabáis de hacer.
King's Recruit#094.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#095.src: It seems that beast dropped something, you should check it out before heading to {p}.
King's Recruit#095.dst: Parece que esa bestia ha soltado algo; deberíais echarle un vistazo antes de ir a {p}.
King's Recruit#095.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#096.src: Pick up the loot dropped by the Goliath.
King's Recruit#096.dst: Recoge el botín que ha soltado el Goliath.

King's Recruit#097.src: That item looks rare! Maybe there's an identifier around here.
King's Recruit#097.dst: ¡Ese objeto parece raro! Quizá haya un identificador por aquí.
King's Recruit#097.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#100.src: We... we made it! We really made it! Sure was a close call at the end.
King's Recruit#100.dst: ¡Lo... lo hemos conseguido! ¡De verdad! Al final ha estado muy justo.
King's Recruit#100.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#101.src: ... Still think those corrupted don't stand a chance against you?
King's Recruit#101.dst: ... ¿Sigues pensando que esos corruptos no tienen nada que hacer contra ti?
King's Recruit#101.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#102.src: Ha ha. Very funny. Ah, {u}, there seems to be an identifier here for you to identify that rare helmet.
King's Recruit#102.dst: Ja, ja. Muy gracioso. Ah, {u}, parece que aquí hay un identificador para ese casco raro tuyo.
King's Recruit#102.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#103.src: And a blacksmith too, you can sell your old helmet there for some emeralds.
King's Recruit#103.dst: Y también un herrero; ahí puedes vender tu casco viejo por unas esmeraldas.
King's Recruit#103.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#104.src: Here it is, the end of our journey.
King's Recruit#104.dst: Aquí está, el final de nuestro viaje.
King's Recruit#104.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#105.src: The end of one adventure, but the beginning of another! Let's go inside and talk to the King!
King's Recruit#105.dst: ¡El final de una aventura y el principio de otra! ¡Entremos a hablar con el Rey!
King's Recruit#105.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#106.dst: Habla con el Rey de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#107.src: Welcome to the Province of Wynn! By your ragged appearance, I gather your journey here must have been quite the adventure.
King's Recruit#107.dst: ¡Bienvenidos a la Provincia de Wynn! Por vuestro aspecto andrajoso, deduzco que el viaje hasta aquí ha sido toda una aventura.
King's Recruit#107.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#108.src: This, recruits, is the noble fort of {p}, one of the great cities of our province!
King's Recruit#108.dst: Este, reclutas, es el noble fuerte de {p}, ¡una de las grandes ciudades de nuestra provincia!
King's Recruit#108.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#109.src: As soldiers of Wynn, it is your duty to stem the tide of corrupted monsters ravaging this land.
King's Recruit#109.dst: Como soldados de Wynn, vuestro deber es frenar la marea de monstruos corruptos que asola esta tierra.
King's Recruit#109.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#110.src: Although, you may want to gain some experience beforehand. Many lives are tragically lost every day...
King's Recruit#110.dst: Aunque quizá convenga que antes ganéis algo de experiencia. Cada día se pierden muchas vidas...
King's Recruit#110.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#111.src: Take this [{p} Teleportation Scroll] to aid you in your journey. Upon use, it will instantly bring you back to this city, wherever you may be.
King's Recruit#111.dst: Llévate este [{p} Teleportation Scroll] para ayudarte en tu viaje. Al usarlo, te traerá al instante de vuelta a esta ciudad, estés donde estés.
King's Recruit#111.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#112.src: With that, I must bid you farewell, more recruits may arrive at any time. Good luck out there, soldiers of Wynn!
King's Recruit#112.dst: Dicho esto, debo despedirme; pueden llegar más reclutas en cualquier momento. ¡Suerte ahí fuera, soldados de Wynn!
King's Recruit#112.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#113.src: So! Wynn, huh? It's pretty exciting to finally be here.
King's Recruit#113.dst: ¡Bueno! Wynn, ¿eh? Es emocionante estar por fin aquí.
King's Recruit#113.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#114.src: I can't wait to discover what it looks like for myself!
King's Recruit#114.dst: ¡Estoy deseando descubrir cómo es con mis propios ojos!
King's Recruit#114.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#115.src: Ha, well, I think I'm going to head in the direction of {p} soon, although there seems to be something called {p} on the way...
King's Recruit#115.dst: Ja, bueno, creo que pronto pondré rumbo a {p}, aunque parece que por el camino hay algo llamado {p}...
King's Recruit#115.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#116.src: Enough talking already! Let's get out there and help some people!
King's Recruit#116.dst: ¡Basta de charla! ¡Salgamos ahí fuera a ayudar a la gente!
King's Recruit#116.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#117.src: And he's gone again... Well, I'm sure we'll be seeing him soon enough. For now, let's just see what Wynn really is like.
King's Recruit#117.dst: Y se ha vuelto a ir... En fin, seguro que lo vemos pronto. Por ahora, veamos cómo es Wynn de verdad.
King's Recruit#117.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#118.src: It's beautiful... Oh! I almost forgot to tell you, {u}.
King's Recruit#118.dst: Es precioso... ¡Ah! Casi se me olvida contarte algo, {u}.
King's Recruit#118.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#119.src: There's this handy item we were all given on our way here, the Content Book. It displays most things you can do in this world; Quests, Caves, and much, much more.
King's Recruit#119.dst: Nos dieron a todos un objeto muy útil de camino aquí: el libro de contenido. Muestra casi todo lo que puedes hacer en este mundo: misiones, cuevas y mucho, mucho más.
King's Recruit#119.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#120.src: It also lets you track any content you want, which will create beacons for you to follow.
King's Recruit#120.dst: También te permite seguir el contenido que quieras, y te crea balizas que puedes seguir.
King's Recruit#120.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#121.src: Here, why don't you try it out? Use your Content Book, and click on the highlighted quest.
King's Recruit#121.dst: Anda, ¿por qué no lo pruebas? Usa tu libro de contenido y haz clic en la misión resaltada.
King's Recruit#121.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#122.src: There you go! I'm going to head towards {p}, at the end of the {p}.
King's Recruit#122.dst: ¡Eso es! Yo me voy hacia {p}, al final del {p}.
King's Recruit#122.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#123.src: You should meet me there once you've gotten a little stronger. Well, see you around, {u}.
King's Recruit#123.dst: Ven a verme allí cuando te hayas hecho un poco más fuerte. Bueno, ¡hasta pronto, {u}!
King's Recruit#123.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#124.src: What are you waiting for recruits? Go identify your helmet at the  Item Identifier and then equip it in your helmet slot!
King's Recruit#124.dst: ¿A qué esperáis, reclutas? ¡Id a identificar el casco al Identificador de objetos y equipadlo en la ranura del casco!

King's Recruit#125.src: Unless you'd rather stand around here all day, that's fine by me too.
King's Recruit#125.dst: A menos que prefiráis quedaros aquí plantados todo el día; por mí, bien.

King's Recruit#126.src: Well, what are you waiting for?

King's Recruit#127.src: Good luck in there, recruits! You're gonna need it...
King's Recruit#127.dst: ¡Suerte ahí dentro, reclutas! La vais a necesitar...
King's Recruit#127.speaker: Guard

Kingdom of Sand#000.src: ... Until now. I believe I've managed to trace its possession to a nearby group of bandits. They probably have no idea what they're sitting on.

Kingdom of Sand#001.src: Oi! Remember, yer need to nab that journal from the big mansion in {p}, if yer want to get in with us.

Kingdom of Sand#003.src: Looks like this is the room the journal is kept in...

Kingdom of Sand#004.src: What yer waiting for, get in here!

Kingdom of Sand#005.src: Seems like there's a meeting going on...

Kingdom of Sand#006.src: Seems like that broken cart by the river might be worth checking out...

Kingdom of Sand#008.src: Seems like that note might give you a clue...

Kingdom of Sand#009.src: The sceptre hums with unmeasurable power, filled with a thousand years of Desert history.

Kingdom of Sand#010.src: You should get this back to Junes as soon as possible.

Kingdom of Sand#012.src: I should get it to {p} right away. Thank you, {u}. You have my eternal gratitude.

Kingdom of Sand#013.src: Are you thinking of exploring the tomb? I'm sure you could learn so much about the Empire... but you best be careful.

Kingdom of Sand#014.src: I have little to offer you for your help, but please accept these emeralds, and this lesser treasure I found nearby.

Kingdom of Sand#016.src: A {p} soldier! I imagine you're here to investigate the tomb up the hill?
Kingdom of Sand#016.dst: ¡Un soldado de {p}! Supongo que vienes a investigar la tumba de la colina, ¿no?
Kingdom of Sand#016.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#017.src: It's believed to house the remains of Prince Hashr, the son of the old Desert Emperor, but it's far too dangerous for me to explore personally.
Kingdom of Sand#017.dst: Se cree que alberga los restos del príncipe Hashr, hijo del viejo Emperador del Desierto, pero es demasiado peligrosa para explorarla yo misma.
Kingdom of Sand#017.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#018.src: Instead I've been looking into a related legend - the Emperor's Sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#018.dst: Así que me he dedicado a una leyenda relacionada: el Emperor's Sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#018.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#019.src: It was the source of his power, and potentially one of the most important artifacts in history.
Kingdom of Sand#019.dst: Era la fuente de su poder y quizá uno de los artefactos más importantes de la historia.
Kingdom of Sand#019.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#020.src: When the Emperor was slain by his son, Hashr, it is said that the sceptre was lost amongst the raging sandstorm that followed.
Kingdom of Sand#020.dst: Cuando el Emperador cayó a manos de su hijo, Hashr, se dice que el cetro se perdió en la tormenta de arena que vino después.
Kingdom of Sand#020.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#021.src: ... Until now. I believe I have been able to trace its possession to a nearby group of bandits. They probably have no idea what they're sitting on.
Kingdom of Sand#021.dst: ... Hasta ahora. Creo que he seguido su rastro hasta un grupo de bandidos cercano. Seguramente no tienen ni idea de lo que poseen.
Kingdom of Sand#021.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#022.src: I'm not prepared to confront them myself, but... this artifact belongs in a museum, in the hands of careful and respectful researchers.
Kingdom of Sand#022.dst: No estoy preparada para enfrentarme a ellos, pero... este artefacto pertenece a un museo, en manos de investigadores cuidadosos y respetuosos.
Kingdom of Sand#022.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#023.src: I would be in your debt if you could try to retrieve it, for the sake of history.
Kingdom of Sand#023.dst: Te estaría en deuda si intentaras recuperarlo, por el bien de la historia.
Kingdom of Sand#023.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#024.src: Attempt to enter the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#024.dst: Intenta entrar en el escondite de los bandidos en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#026.src: Even if yer a crooked soldier, we can't jus let yer in.
Kingdom of Sand#026.dst: Aunque seas un soldao corrupto, no podemos dejarte pasar así como así.
Kingdom of Sand#026.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#027.src: That is, unless yer got the password?
Kingdom of Sand#027.dst: A no ser que sepas la contraseña, claro.
Kingdom of Sand#027.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#028.src: Didn’t think so. Now get lost, wasted enough of my t-
Kingdom of Sand#028.dst: Ya me lo imaginaba. Largo de aquí, bastante tiempo me has hecho perd-
Kingdom of Sand#028.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#029.src: Now would you look at that... Even soldiers think they can waltz in ere.
Kingdom of Sand#029.dst: Vaya, vaya... Hasta los soldaos se creen que pueden entrar aquí.
Kingdom of Sand#029.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#030.src: Having fun thinking of a password? Sorry to spoil your lunch, but there isn’t one!
Kingdom of Sand#030.dst: ¿Te diviertes pensando una contraseña? Siento aguarte la fiesta, ¡pero no hay ninguna!
Kingdom of Sand#030.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#031.src: We could use a few more officials on the roster.
Kingdom of Sand#031.dst: No nos vendrían mal un par de funcionarios más en la lista.
Kingdom of Sand#031.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#032.src: If yer are on the liberal side of the law, talk to us outside.
Kingdom of Sand#032.dst: Si estás del lado flojo de la ley, hablamos fuera.
Kingdom of Sand#032.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#033.dst: Reúnete con Geo y Tarek en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#034.src: Looks like yer in. Look, there ain't a password cause we're meant to be the best thieves in the land, right?
Kingdom of Sand#034.dst: Parece que te apuntas. Mira, no hay contraseña porque se supone que somos los mejores ladrones del país, ¿no?
Kingdom of Sand#034.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#035.src: So what good are words? Yer gotta give the guard somethin' stolen, aintcha!
Kingdom of Sand#035.dst: ¿De qué sirven las palabras? ¡Al guardia hay que darle algo robao!
Kingdom of Sand#035.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#036.src: And we just so happen to have the opportunity of a lifetime for you. {p} has gone soft see, a new Mayor is cleaning things up.
Kingdom of Sand#036.dst: Y da la casualidad de que tenemos la oportunidad de tu vida. {p} se ha ablandao, ¿ves?, hay un alcalde nuevo poniendo orden.
Kingdom of Sand#036.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#037.src: Well, we can't have government not under our control. {p} will always be bandit capital.
Kingdom of Sand#037.dst: No podemos dejar que el gobierno se nos escape. {p} siempre será la capital de los bandidos.
Kingdom of Sand#037.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#038.src: So how about we give him a taste of his own medicine, and get hold of that journal he keeps? I'm sure that’ll dig up some dirt on him.
Kingdom of Sand#038.dst: ¿Y si le damos de su propia medicina y nos hacemos con ese diario suyo? Seguro que saca a la luz sus trapos sucios.
Kingdom of Sand#038.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#039.src: And by "we", we mean you. You'll have to sneak through the mansion and avoid guards.
Kingdom of Sand#039.dst: Y cuando decimos "nosotros", decimos tú. Tendrás que colarte en la mansión esquivando a los guardias.
Kingdom of Sand#039.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#040.src: He keeps his journal in the highest room. Might need to distract some guards too. It's the biggest mansion in {p}, can't miss it.
Kingdom of Sand#040.dst: Guarda el diario en la habitación más alta. Quizá tengas que distraer a algún guardia. Es la mansión más grande de {p}, no tiene pérdida.
Kingdom of Sand#040.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#041.src: Sneak into the highest room of the {p} Mansion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#041.dst: Cuélate en la habitación más alta de la {p} Mansion en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#042.src: Arh, there's the thief I saw a-sneakin' round the Mansion! Get them!
Kingdom of Sand#042.dst: ¡Ajá, ahí está el ladrón que vi merodeando por la mansión! ¡A por él!
Kingdom of Sand#042.speaker: Mansion Guard

Kingdom of Sand#043.src: Yer know you could get kicked out of the army fer this.
Kingdom of Sand#043.dst: Que sepas que por esto te pueden echar del ejército.
Kingdom of Sand#043.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#044.src: Heh, guess yer the real thing. Hop in, lets get out of ‘ere.
Kingdom of Sand#044.dst: Je, parece que vas en serio. Sube, vámonos de aquí.
Kingdom of Sand#044.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#045.src: That journal is more valuable than any gem, you'll be able to get in fer sure.
Kingdom of Sand#045.dst: Ese diario vale más que cualquier gema, seguro que ahora te dejan entrar.
Kingdom of Sand#045.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#046.src: Bring the journal from the {p} Mansion to the Vault Guard to enter the hideout.
Kingdom of Sand#046.dst: Lleva el diario de la {p} Mansion al Vault Guard para entrar en el escondite.

Kingdom of Sand#049.src: Oh, this is quite the password, "soldier". I think this will do nicely, on you go.
Kingdom of Sand#049.dst: Oh, menuda contraseña, "soldado". Con esto vale, pasa.
Kingdom of Sand#049.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#050.src: Look for the sceptre within the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#050.dst: Busca el cetro en el escondite de los bandidos en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#051.src: Right, then, you lot. Give me your reports.
Kingdom of Sand#051.dst: Muy bien, vosotros. Dadme vuestros informes.
Kingdom of Sand#051.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#052.src: Gold relieved from Mesa travellers last week counted just over {~} bars.
Kingdom of Sand#052.dst: El oro de los viajeros de Mesa de la semana pasada pasa de {~} lingotes.
Kingdom of Sand#052.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#054.src: We're working on exposing that blasted {p} Mayor with a stolen journal. {p} should be back under Creden Tibus control within the week.
Kingdom of Sand#054.dst: Estamos desacreditando al maldito alcalde de {p} con un diario robado. {p} volverá a estar bajo control de Creden Tibus en una semana.
Kingdom of Sand#054.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#056.src: Well... someone's been hanging around the old tomb. An archaeologist, looks like. I reckon she's lookin' for the sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#056.dst: Pues... alguien anda rondando la vieja tumba. Parece una arqueóloga. Yo diría que busca el cetro.
Kingdom of Sand#056.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#057.src: Ah... that sceptre's too valuable for us to lose. Maybe we pay 'er a visit, persuade her to... stop lookin'.
Kingdom of Sand#057.dst: Ah... ese cetro vale demasiado para perderlo. Igual le hacemos una visita y la convencemos de que... deje de buscar.
Kingdom of Sand#057.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#058.src: Right you are, boss. Good thing no one will think to look for it in that broken cart by the river, ey?!
Kingdom of Sand#058.dst: ¡Eso es, jefe! Menos mal que a nadie se le ocurrirá buscarlo en el carro roto que hay junto al río, ¿eh?
Kingdom of Sand#058.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#059.src: Shut it, you fool! What did I just say? Anyway, I'll decide what to do with this archaeologist. Dismissed!
Kingdom of Sand#059.dst: ¡Cierra el pico, idiota! ¿Qué acabo de decir? En fin, yo decidiré qué hacemos con esa arqueóloga. ¡Retiraos!
Kingdom of Sand#059.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#062.src: We might be bandits, but we’re not stupid. That sceptre is left better off alone.
Kingdom of Sand#062.dst: Seremos bandidos, pero no somos tontos. A ese cetro más vale no tocarlo.
Kingdom of Sand#062.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#065.src: Return to the tomb and give Junes the sceptre at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#065.dst: Vuelve a la tumba y dale el cetro a Junes en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#066.src: Ah, {u}. I couldn't help myself - I simply had to see the tomb up close.
Kingdom of Sand#066.dst: Ah, {u}. No he podido resistirme: tenía que ver la tumba de cerca.
Kingdom of Sand#066.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#067.src: You have no idea how tempted I am to go inside, but I doubt I'd make it out alive.
Kingdom of Sand#067.dst: No te imaginas las ganas que tengo de entrar, pero dudo que saliera con vida.
Kingdom of Sand#067.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#068.src: You... you found the sceptre? Oh! This is incredible! I can't believe it!
Kingdom of Sand#068.dst: ¿Has... has encontrado el cetro? ¡Oh! ¡Es increíble! ¡No me lo puedo creer!
Kingdom of Sand#068.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#069.src: This artifact, it witnessed the rise and fall of the Empire, thousands of years ago. And you've just been... holding it, without gloves...
Kingdom of Sand#069.dst: Este artefacto presenció el auge y la caída del Imperio hace miles de años. Y tú lo has estado... sosteniendo, sin guantes...
Kingdom of Sand#069.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#070.src: Under the circumstances, I think I can let that slide. But the things I could learn from studying it...
Kingdom of Sand#070.dst: Dadas las circunstancias, creo que puedo pasarlo por alto. Pero lo que podría aprender estudiándolo...
Kingdom of Sand#070.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#071.src: I should get to {p} right away. Thank you, {u}. You have my eternal gratitude.
Kingdom of Sand#071.dst: Debo ir a {p} de inmediato. Gracias, {u}. Te estaré eternamente agradecida.
Kingdom of Sand#071.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#072.src: Are you thinking of exploring the tomb? I'm sure you can learn so much about the Empire... but you best be careful.
Kingdom of Sand#072.dst: ¿Piensas explorar la tumba? Seguro que aprendes muchísimo sobre el Imperio... pero ten mucho cuidado.
Kingdom of Sand#072.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#073.src: There are nasty legends of what it holds. Silverfish, skeletons... even Prince Hashr himself. Make sure to gear up!
Kingdom of Sand#073.dst: Hay leyendas desagradables sobre lo que guarda. Lepismas, esqueletos... hasta el propio príncipe Hashr. ¡Equípate bien!
Kingdom of Sand#073.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#074.src: I have little to offer you for your help, but please accept these emeralds, and a fossil bone I found around here.
Kingdom of Sand#074.dst: Poco puedo ofrecerte por tu ayuda, pero acepta estas esmeraldas y un hueso fósil que encontré por aquí.
Kingdom of Sand#074.speaker: Junes

Lava Springs#002.src: This should be enough evidence. You should report back to Colonel Gailard.

Lava Springs#003.src: Wait... I've got an idea... Alright, listen up soldier! There's a lil' town North of here named {p}, yeah? There's a healer person there that can help us out.

Lava Springs#004.src: They're holed up inside of some important well in the center of the town. There's a password ya need to hop into that place, though...

Lava Springs#005.src: ...Corrupted... lava springs...? You realize how stupid that sounds, yeah? Well, I completely believe you.

Lava Springs#006.src: Now, you have somewhere to be, right? Right. Go and report back to the Colonel, soldier. Tell him I said hi, by the way.

Lava Springs#007.src: You can feel your body heat adjusting as the potion courses through your body...

Lava Springs#008.src: Ye're a good ally, soldier! And a great help to the army, at that!

Lava Springs#009.dst: Habla con el coronel Gailard en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#010.src: Oh, good, good! I bet'cha you're a {p} soldier, aren't ya? Listen up, soldier! I've got a task here that 'ye can help out with.
Lava Springs#010.dst: ¡Ah, bien, bien! Seguro que eres un soldado de {p}, ¿a que sí? ¡Escucha, soldado! Tengo una tarea con la que puedes echar una mano.
Lava Springs#010.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#011.src: Ya see that lava spring right there? It just went and popped up out of nowhere! The brass is real concerned about it, mhm?
Lava Springs#011.dst: ¿Ves ese manantial de lava de ahí? ¡Ha brotado de la nada! Los de arriba están muy preocupados, ¿eh?
Lava Springs#011.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#012.src: They've been yappin' about it bein' related to the Corruption, and 'ye can bet that that means trouble. BAD trouble.
Lava Springs#012.dst: Andan diciendo que tiene que ver con la Corrupción, y eso, tenlo por seguro, significa problemas. Problemas GORDOS.
Lava Springs#012.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#013.src: Now, this here Savannah has always had some Corruption lurkin' about, but not to the point where it can do this! It won't be safe around here if we don't do somethin' about it!
Lava Springs#013.dst: Mira, en esta sabana siempre ha rondado algo de Corrupción, ¡pero nunca tanto como para hacer esto! ¡Si no hacemos algo, esta zona dejará de ser segura!
Lava Springs#013.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#014.src: Anyways, high command ain't gonna provide support for this until they know there's actual Corruption, so we've gotta find some evidence around the springs, understand?
Lava Springs#014.dst: En fin, el alto mando no va a mandar apoyo hasta que sepa que hay Corrupción de verdad, así que tenemos que encontrar pruebas cerca de los manantiales, ¿entendido?
Lava Springs#014.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#015.src: Take a look around the springs, soldier! Find me some damn evidence around here! [{~} Pieces of Evidence] should be enough! Now, get movin'!
Lava Springs#015.dst: ¡Echa un vistazo por los manantiales, soldado! ¡Tráeme alguna maldita prueba! ¡Con [{~} pruebas] debería bastar! ¡Venga, en marcha!
Lava Springs#015.speaker: Colonel Gailard
