Lava Springs#016.src: Look for three pieces of corrupted evidence around the Lava Spring at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lava Springs#016.dst: Busca tres pruebas de corrupción alrededor del manantial de lava en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#017.src: Go back to Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lava Springs#017.dst: Vuelve con el coronel Gailard en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#018.src: Alright, good! Ya found some evidence, let me take a look at that!
Lava Springs#018.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#019.src: Oh... This is bad... very, VERY bad...
Lava Springs#019.dst: Oh... Esto es malo... muy, MUY malo...
Lava Springs#019.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#020.src: This here is some physical corruption. If it's gettin' onto the surface, then 'ye can bet one of those weeds is spreadin' underground, right beneath the springs...
Lava Springs#020.dst: Esto es corrupción física. Si está saliendo a la superficie, seguro que una de esas raíces se extiende bajo tierra, justo debajo de los manantiales...
Lava Springs#020.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#021.src: If ya could get underneath the spring, 'ye could probably sever whatever damn root is causing this, but... the heat would be sure to fry your skin off...
Lava Springs#021.dst: Si pudieras llegar debajo del manantial, seguramente podrías cortar la maldita raíz que lo causa, pero... el calor te arrancaría la piel...
Lava Springs#021.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#022.src: Wait... I've got an idea... Alright, listen up soldier! There's a lil' town North of here called {p}, yeah? There's a healer person there that can help us out.
Lava Springs#022.dst: Espera... Tengo una idea... ¡Escucha bien, soldado! Al norte hay un pueblecito llamado {p}, ¿sí? Allí hay un sanador que puede ayudarnos.
Lava Springs#022.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#023.src: They're holed up inside of some important well in the center of town. There's a password ya need to hop into that place, though...
Lava Springs#023.dst: Se ha encerrado dentro de un pozo importante en el centro del pueblo. Aunque para entrar ahí hace falta una contraseña...
Lava Springs#023.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#024.src: Don't have much to go on, but I'm pretty damn sure the password is Bob, or something. After the hero himself.
Lava Springs#024.dst: No tengo mucho a lo que agarrarme, pero estoy casi seguro de que la contraseña es Bob o algo así. Por el héroe.
Lava Springs#024.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#025.src: Right, ye're headin' there to find a potion that can keep ya weak little hide safe from the heat, understand? Here, let me write down the location in that book of yours.
Lava Springs#025.dst: Bueno, vas para allá a buscar una poción que proteja tu pellejo enclenque del calor, ¿entendido? Toma, te apunto el sitio en ese libro tuyo.
Lava Springs#025.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#026.src: Talk to Gregor outside the {p} well at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lava Springs#026.dst: Habla con Gregor fuera del pozo de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#027.src: Hey, hey hey hey! Darling, what do you think you're doing? You can't just waltz in here without telling me the password!
Lava Springs#027.dst: ¡Eh, eh, eh, eh! Cielo, ¿qué te crees que haces? ¡No puedes entrar aquí tan tranquilo sin decirme la contraseña!
Lava Springs#027.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#028.src: Hmm... Your face... confidence... it gleans with confidence... yet... you still haven't spoken to me since you arrived...
Lava Springs#028.dst: Mmm... Tu cara... confianza... rezuma confianza... y aun así... no me has dicho nada desde que llegaste...
Lava Springs#028.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#029.src: Could it be... you know that the password is penguin eggs, but you're just too shy to talk? Yeah... yeah, that's gotta be it!
Lava Springs#029.dst: ¿Será que... sabes que la contraseña es huevos de pingüino, pero te da demasiada vergüenza hablar? Sí... ¡sí, tiene que ser eso!
Lava Springs#029.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#030.src: You've convinced me, little mute darling... You can enter the well. Go on, now!
Lava Springs#030.dst: Me has convencido, mudito encanto... Puedes entrar. ¡Venga, adentro!
Lava Springs#030.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#031.src: Enter the {p} well and talk to the healer at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lava Springs#031.dst: Entra en el pozo de {p} y habla con el sanador en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#032.src: G'day to you, friend. How can I help you?
Lava Springs#032.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#033.src: Hm? The Colonel sent you? what for?
Lava Springs#033.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#034.src: ...Corrupted... lava springs...? You realize how ridiculous that sounds, yeah? Well, I completely believe you.
Lava Springs#034.dst: ...¿Manantiales... de lava... corruptos...? Sabes lo ridículo que suena, ¿no? Pues te creo del todo.
Lava Springs#034.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#035.src: Right, you said lava, sooo... You need a heat resistance potion, yes?
Lava Springs#035.dst: Vale, has dicho lava, así queee... ¿necesitas una poción contra el calor?
Lava Springs#035.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#036.src: Welp, you're in luck, kinda... I have a potion that can resist the heat of lava, but the brew will not let you swim in lava.
Lava Springs#036.dst: Bueno, estás de suerte, más o menos... Tengo una poción que resiste el calor de la lava, pero el brebaje no te dejará nadar en ella.
Lava Springs#036.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#037.src: Oh that works, you just need to enter a borehole that goes through the lava? Perfect
Lava Springs#037.dst: Ah, entonces vale, ¿solo tienes que entrar por un pozo que atraviesa la lava? Perfecto
Lava Springs#037.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#038.src: Anyways, if you ever need any more special brews, my assistant will be happy to sell some at a very affordable price.
Lava Springs#038.dst: Por cierto, si alguna vez necesitas más brebajes especiales, mi ayudante estará encantado de vendértelos a muy buen precio.
Lava Springs#038.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#039.src: Now, you have somewhere to be, right? Right. Go and report to the Colonel, soldier. Tell him I said hi, by the way.
Lava Springs#039.dst: Bueno, tienes sitios a los que ir, ¿no? Eso. Ve a informar al coronel, soldado. Y dale recuerdos de mi parte.
Lava Springs#039.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#040.src: Report back to Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#041.src: Report! Ya got the potion yet, soldier? Good, drink it if ya haven't already!
Lava Springs#041.dst: ¡Informe! ¿Tienes ya la poción, soldado? ¡Bien, bébetela si no lo has hecho!
Lava Springs#041.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#042.src: Right, that's what I like to hear! Now, LOOK TO THE LEFT SOLDIER! There is a borehole out there we dug to try and hit the source of this weed.
Lava Springs#042.dst: ¡Eso es lo que quería oír! Ahora, ¡MIRA A LA IZQUIERDA, SOLDADO! Ahí hay un pozo de sondeo que cavamos para llegar al origen de esta mala hierba.
Lava Springs#042.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#043.src: We found a pretty damn hot cave lying underneath the surface! If ya jumped into the borehole, 'ye could probably find the source of the Corruption and stop it.
Lava Springs#043.dst: ¡Bajo la superficie encontramos una cueva endiabladamente caliente! Si saltas por el pozo, seguro que das con el origen de la Corrupción y lo detienes.
Lava Springs#043.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#044.src: Now, the roots and spikes of Corruption are very sturdy, but we ain't never seen something like lava burstin' out of the ground.
Lava Springs#044.dst: Las raíces y las púas de la Corrupción son muy resistentes, pero nunca habíamos visto lava saliendo a chorros del suelo.
Lava Springs#044.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#045.src: Had a small chat with the brass, earlier. They got a hunch that there's a heart to the Corruption that's pumpin' out all the lava!
Lava Springs#045.dst: Antes he hablado un rato con los de arriba. Se huelen que la Corrupción tiene un corazón que bombea toda esa lava.
Lava Springs#045.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#046.src: That's gotta be our ticket, yeah? If 'ye destroy that, ya should be able to stop the spread of the lava! Now, get movin'! Head into the borehole, soldier!
Lava Springs#046.dst: Esa tiene que ser nuestra baza, ¿no? ¡Si lo destruyes, podrás frenar la lava! ¡Venga, en marcha! ¡Métete en el pozo, soldado!
Lava Springs#046.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#047.src: Drink the Potion of Obsidian Skin, then enter the lava spring through the borehole at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and look for a corrupted heart
Lava Springs#047.dst: Bébete la Poción de piel de obsidiana, entra en el manantial de lava por el pozo de sondeo en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] y busca un corazón corrupto

Lava Springs#048.src: Tell Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] that you destroyed the heart
Lava Springs#048.dst: Dile al coronel Gailard en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] que has destruido el corazón

Lava Springs#049.src: Hah! I knew ya'd give me results! Ye're pretty damn reliable, soldier! Here, take this for your trouble!
Lava Springs#049.dst: ¡Ja! ¡Sabía que me darías resultados! ¡Eres de lo más fiable, soldado! ¡Toma, por las molestias!
Lava Springs#049.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#001.src: Ah, one of you adventurin' types, huh? We see a lot of you around here... Going in and out as you please. Must be a nice life.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#001.dst: Ah, otro de esos aventureros, ¿eh? Por aquí vemos a muchos... Entráis y salís cuando os apetece. Menuda vida, ¿no?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#001.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#002.src: Though, if you could spare some time, the town could use you-
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#002.dst: Aunque, si te sobra un rato, al pueblo le vendría bien tu ay-
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#002.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#003.src: Wait, already?! It's only been a day since last! How insatiable are they...?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#003.dst: Espera, ¡¿ya?! ¡Si solo ha pasado un día! ¿Tan insaciables son...?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#003.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#004.src: THE UNDEAD HAVE OVERWHELMED THE GOLEMS! EVERY CITIZEN FOR THEMSELVES!!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#004.dst: ¡LOS NO MUERTOS HAN ARRASADO A LOS GÓLEMS! ¡¡QUE CADA CIUDADANO SE SALVE COMO PUEDA!!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#004.speaker: Gelibord Guard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#005.src: This is what I was talking about! We need your help with this! You Wynn folk are good at killing zombies, right?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#005.dst: ¡De esto te hablaba! ¡Necesitamos tu ayuda! Los de Wynn sois buenos matando zombis, ¿verdad?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#005.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#006.src: We need help with this! Defend the town with us!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#006.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#007.src: The horde's retreating, but we have one citizen dead! Regroup at the square and prepare the pyres!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#007.dst: ¡La horda se retira, pero ha muerto un ciudadano! ¡Reagrupaos en la plaza y preparad las piras!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#007.speaker: Gelibord Guard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#008.src: Hey! Over here, you alright? Come talk to me, I can explain what just happened.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#008.dst: ¡Eh! Aquí, ¿estás bien? Ven, que te explico lo que ha pasado.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#008.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#009.src: Check in with Burtur about the attack at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#009.dst: Pregunta a Burtur por el ataque en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#010.src: Phew. That was a smaller horde, thankfully... Still, good thing you were there. That could have been worse.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#010.dst: Uf. Por suerte era una horda pequeña... Aun así, menos mal que estabas aquí. Podría haber sido peor.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#010.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#011.src: Still, c'mon now... We have to burn the bodies. Can't leave the job half-done.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#011.dst: Aun así, vamos... Hay que quemar los cuerpos. No podemos dejarlo a medias.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#011.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#012.src: It's a bit sacrilegious, but necessary to do right now- otherwise they just keep coming back, like they do across the ridge in Kander.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#012.dst: Es un poco sacrílego, pero ahora mismo hace falta; si no, vuelven una y otra vez, como al otro lado del risco, en Kander.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#012.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#013.src: The ones around here all come up from the river, though, and since it runs right through the town, well... You can see the problem.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#013.dst: Aunque los de por aquí salen todos del río, y como el río cruza el pueblo, pues... ya ves el problema.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#013.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#014.src: Since we don't live in a reeking, pockmarked plain, we have to burn the bodies so any dead don't turn right around against us.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#014.dst: No vivimos en una llanura apestosa y llena de socavones, así que tenemos que quemar los cuerpos para que los muertos no se vuelvan contra nosotros.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#014.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#015.src: Say your goodbyes, all. Irahe will be missed. Step away from the pyre!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#015.dst: Despedíos todos. Echaremos de menos a Irahe. ¡Apartaos de la pira!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#015.speaker: Gelibord Guard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#016.src: Some conspiracy theorists think that the Lazarus Pit is the issue. It's an urban legend, a well of water that can revive the dead.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#016.dst: Algunos conspiranoicos creen que el problema es el Pozo de Lazarus. Es una leyenda urbana: un pozo de agua que revive a los muertos.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#016.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#017.src: Supposing that it's real, it would make some sense, at least- If it started feeding into the river or water tables, then we'd get the current goings-on.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#017.dst: Suponiendo que sea real, al menos tendría cierto sentido: si empezara a filtrarse al río o a las aguas subterráneas, pasaría justo lo que pasa ahora.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#017.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#018.src: Of course, no one knows where it is, since it's just rumors, but there's supposedly an "Order" of pit-keepers. Conveniently long dead, and buried in that small graveyard just north of here.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#018.dst: Claro que nadie sabe dónde está, son solo rumores, pero dicen que hay una "Orden" de guardianes del pozo. Convenientemente muertos hace siglos y enterrados en el cementerio al norte de aquí.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#018.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#019.src: It's... probably just Referick having made the rounds to any drunk who would listen a while back, but it's also our only shot. If you could give it a search, and a yay or nay?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#019.dst: Seguramente... solo sea que Referick anduvo contándoselo a todo borracho que le escuchara, pero es nuestra única baza. ¿Podrías echar un vistazo y decirme si sí o si no?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#019.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#020.src: I'll stay back at the town square, in case the undead attack again. Give me a shout if you find something you aren't sure about.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#020.dst: Yo me quedaré en la plaza del pueblo, por si los no muertos vuelven a atacar. Dame un grito si encuentras algo que no tengas claro.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#020.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#021.src: Have you checked out that small graveyard north of here yet? Remember, you're looking for any clues about that Lazarus Pit "Order."
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#021.dst: ¿Ya has mirado ese cementerio pequeño del norte? Recuerda, buscas cualquier pista sobre esa "Orden" del Pozo de Lazarus.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#021.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#022.src: Find the body of the Order's mage in {p}'s graveyard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#022.dst: Encuentra el cuerpo del mago de la Orden en el cementerio de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#023.src: Locate the chapel mentioned by the talisman, or return to Burtur for assistance.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#023.dst: Localiza la capilla que menciona el talismán, o vuelve con Burtur en busca de ayuda.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#024.src: Oh, you found something? Well color me shocked that there was any stock to Referick's ranting...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#024.dst: Oh, ¿has encontrado algo? Pues me dejas de piedra; resulta que los desvaríos de Referick tenían algo de fundamento...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#024.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#025.src: Chapel of an ancient order? There's a chapel just northwest of here. I'd say investigate that! I have to stick around here in case of another attack, but...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#025.dst: ¿La capilla de una orden antigua? Hay una capilla justo al noroeste de aquí. ¡Yo diría que la investigues! Yo tengo que quedarme por si hay otro ataque, pero...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#025.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#026.src: Any luck searching out that chapel yet? The coordinates ought to be in your content book, right?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#026.dst: ¿Has tenido suerte buscando esa capilla? Las coordenadas deberían estar en tu libro de contenido, ¿no?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#026.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#027.src: Investigate the Order's chapel northwest of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#027.dst: Investiga la capilla de la Orden al noroeste de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#028.src: Solve the crypt's riddle to 'bring the water of life anew' to the graves.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#028.dst: Resuelve el acertijo de la cripta para "traer de nuevo el agua de la vida" a las tumbas.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#029.src: Revive the people in the tombs with the Lazarus Water and complete their tasks.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#029.dst: Revive con el Agua de Lazarus a la gente de las tumbas y cumple sus encargos.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#030.src: Ugh. And who put YOU in charge of waking me up? Where's Gwendolyn, my maid? Incompetents- she was supposed to be buried with me too!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#030.dst: Uf. ¿Y quién TE ha puesto a ti a despertarme? ¿Dónde está Gwendolyn, mi doncella? Incompetentes... ¡a ella también debían enterrarla conmigo!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#030.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#031.src: What, you want to enter the crypt? Well, prove you're better than the funeral directors and do something right! The Ghastly Ghouls around here won't stop SCREAMING!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#031.dst: ¿Qué, quieres entrar en la cripta? ¡Pues demuestra que eres mejor que los de la funeraria y haz algo bien! ¡Los Ghastly Ghouls de por aquí no paran de CHILLAR!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#031.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#032.src: I want them gone! Get rid of, say, {~} Ghastly Ghouls. Then perhaps I'll give you the time of day, you strange, small-nosed lookyloo!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#032.dst: ¡Quiero que desaparezcan! Acaba con, digamos, {~} Ghastly Ghouls. Entonces quizá te haga caso, curiosa personita de nariz pequeña.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#032.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#033.src: Agh! Stop sneaking up on me! Have you killed those {~} Ghastly Ghouls I asked you to, yet?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#033.dst: ¡Agh! ¡Deja de acercarte a hurtadillas! ¿Ya has matado a esos {~} Ghastly Ghouls que te pedí?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#033.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#035.src: Ah, my favorite little weird-small-nosed-person! The graveyard is so lovely when it's quiet- you really did do a good job!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#035.dst: ¡Ah, mi personita rara de nariz pequeña favorita! El cementerio es encantador cuando hay silencio. ¡Buen trabajo!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#035.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#036.src: As important as I am, you must still check with the other graves, though you certainly have my blessing to enter.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#036.dst: Por importante que yo sea, aún debes consultar a las otras tumbas, aunque mi bendición ya la tienes.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#036.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#037.src: My goodness! Ah, it feels good to stretch these old bones. It's not easy being cooped up in a coffin, you know.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#037.dst: ¡Madre mía! Ah, qué gusto estirar estos viejos huesos. Estar encerrada en un ataúd no es fácil, ¿sabes?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#037.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#038.src: You want to get into the crypt? I suppose I could give you a hand... figuratively, I mean. Still, need to see if you can be trusted and all...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#038.dst: ¿Quieres entrar en la cripta? Supongo que podría echarte una mano... en sentido figurado, claro. Aun así, habrá que ver si eres de fiar...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#038.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#039.src: Oh, right! My dear husband gave me the most beautiful wedding band, but it became lost when I carked it. Some rude shadowy thing- See if anyone ever marries THEM!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#039.dst: ¡Ah, sí! Mi querido esposo me regaló la alianza más preciosa, pero se perdió cuando estiré la pata. Una sombra muy maleducada... ¡A ver quién se casa con ESA!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#039.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#040.src: Bring it back, could you? I died around that old lich's tower to the east. Do that, and I'll be happy to give you my blessing!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#040.dst: ¿Me la traes, por favor? Morí cerca de la vieja torre del liche, al este. Hazlo y te daré mi bendición encantada.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#040.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#041.src: Bring my wedding band back, could you? I died around that old lich's tower to the east. Do that, and I'll be happy to give you my blessing!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#041.dst: ¿Me traes mi alianza, por favor? Morí cerca de la vieja torre del liche, al este. Hazlo y te daré mi bendición encantada.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#041.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#042.dst: Encuentra la alianza de Sir Pigglesworth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#043.src: Oh, you found it! Wonderful! Just pop it on that fingerbone right there... Ah, it fits even better on the other hand!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#043.dst: ¡Oh, la has encontrado! ¡Maravilloso! Póntela en ese huesecillo de ahí... ¡Ay, en la otra mano queda aún mejor!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#043.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#044.src: The crypt, you say? I can offer my blessing to enter, but you'll need to check with the other tombs as well. Farewell!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#044.dst: ¿La cripta, dices? Puedo darte mi bendición para entrar, pero también tendrás que consultar a las otras tumbas. ¡Adiós!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#044.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#045.src: I oughta deck you for waking me up!! Don't you realize it's RUDE to re-animate the long-dead corpse of a murderer when he's trying to get his beauty death?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#045.dst: ¡¡Un tortazo te daba por despertarme!! ¿No sabes que es DE MALA EDUCACIÓN reanimar a un asesino muerto hace siglos durante su sueño de belleza?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#045.speaker: Uggword Pollywaggon the Murderous

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#047.src: Greetings! Thank goodness, that dreary old tomb was simply awful. No furniture, no natural light, not even a lick of paint! So drab, the whole thing.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#047.dst: ¡Saludos! Menos mal, esa vieja tumba lúgubre era sencillamente horrible. Ni muebles, ni luz natural, ¡ni una mano de pintura! Todo tan soso.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#047.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#048.src: What's that? You want to get into the crypt? Well, of course I can help, if you just do one teensy little thing for me?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#048.dst: ¿Cómo dices? ¿Quieres entrar en la cripta? Pues claro que puedo ayudarte, ¿si me haces una cosita de nada?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#048.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#049.src: Could you feed my cat for me? I know Mrs. Fluffles must be so lonely after all these years. My old house is just south of here, over at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], just pop some food down for her? Thank you!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#049.dst: ¿Podrías darle de comer a mi gata? Seguro que Mrs. Fluffles se siente sola después de tantos años. Mi vieja casa está justo al sur, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]; ¿le dejas algo de comida? ¡Gracias!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#049.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#050.src: Please, kind adventurer! Feed Mrs. Fluffles for me. I'm sure she's just so lonely, in that big old house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#050.dst: ¡Por favor, amable aventurero! Dale de comer a Mrs. Fluffles. Seguro que se siente sola en ese caserón de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#050.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#051.dst: Da de comer a la gata de Poclo

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#053.src: So, is Mrs. Fluffles doing alright without me? Oh, I bet she was so affectionate, always such a softie!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#053.dst: Y bien, ¿está bien Mrs. Fluffles sin mí? ¡Ay, seguro que estaba cariñosísima, siempre tan mimosa!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#053.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#054.src: Oh, thank you so much! I was so worried that after my death she wouldn't be okay... What a relief!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#054.dst: ¡Oh, muchísimas gracias! Tenía mucho miedo de que no estuviera bien tras mi muerte... ¡Qué alivio!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#054.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#055.src: You have my blessing to enter the crypt! Make sure to check with the other graves as well though.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#055.dst: ¡Tienes mi bendición para entrar en la cripta! Pero asegúrate de consultar también a las otras tumbas.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#055.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#056.src: W-wait, Mrs. Fluffles... She was...d-dead? No... It can't be! I left her a lifetime supply of food!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#056.dst: E-espera, Mrs. Fluffles... ¿Estaba... m-muerta? No... ¡No puede ser! ¡Le dejé comida para toda la vida!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#056.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#057.src: You! You killed Mrs. Fluffles, it's the only explanation!! HOW COULD YOU DO SUCH A THING?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#057.dst: ¡Tú! ¡Tú mataste a Mrs. Fluffles, no hay otra explicación! ¡¿CÓMO HAS PODIDO HACER ALGO ASÍ?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#057.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#058.dst: Abre la puerta de la cripta en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#059.src: Investigate the crypt's inner chamber at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#059.dst: Investiga la cámara interior de la cripta en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#060.src: ... the Lazarus Pi... said to bring back the dead.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#060.dst: ... el Pozo de Lazar... dicen que devuelve a los muertos.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#060.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#061.src: Be warned, traveller, th... not truly alive agai... were before.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#061.dst: Ten cuidado, viajero, n... vuelven de verdad a la vid... eran antes.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#061.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#062.src: ... In times of great need, one can find... at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#062.dst: ... En tiempos de gran necesidad, se puede hallar... en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#062.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#063.src: But know this... use for greed or self-ga... result in... worse than death.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#063.dst: Pero sabe esto... usarlo por codicia... traerá... algo peor que la muerte.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#063.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#064.src: Find the entrance to the Lazarus Pit at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#064.dst: Encuentra la entrada del Pozo de Lazarus en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#065.src: Follow the path to the Lazarus pit at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and enter the Pit.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#065.dst: Sigue el camino hasta el Pozo de Lazarus en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y entra en él.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#066.src: Follow the cave to find the Lazarus Pit.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#066.dst: Recorre la cueva para encontrar el Pozo de Lazarus.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#067.src: Find a way to block off the water pillar in the Lazarus Pit.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#067.dst: Encuentra la forma de cortar la columna de agua del Pozo de Lazarus.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#068.src: Tell Burtur that you have blocked off the Lazarus Pit at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#068.dst: Dile a Burtur en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] que has bloqueado el Pozo de Lazarus

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#069.src: Ah, you're back! We were getting a tad worried about you. Were you able to figure anything out in the chapel there?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#069.dst: ¡Ah, has vuelto! Ya empezábamos a preocuparnos por ti. ¿Has podido averiguar algo en la capilla?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#069.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#070.src: Wait, you found the Lazarus Pit? AND blocked the flow into the river? Grook feathers you humans work quick! It's only been a few hours!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#070.dst: Espera, ¿has encontrado el Pozo de Lazarus? ¿Y cortado el flujo al río? ¡Plumas de Grook, qué rápidos sois los humanos! ¡Si solo han pasado unas horas!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#070.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#071.src: Heck, I gotta pitch in and compensate you for that hard work! I know we're not the richest, but I hope you'll accept this...other way of paying, too!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#071.dst: ¡Caray, tengo que compensarte por semejante trabajazo! Sé que no somos los más ricos, pero espero que aceptes también esta... otra forma de pago.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#071.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#072.src: ...loss, but those pure of heart found... untouched by the curse, and formed this Order.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#072.dst: ...pérdida, pero los puros de corazón hallaron... sin tocar por la maldición, y fundaron esta Orden.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#072.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#073.src: For worry of the misuse... waters, malicious or not, our... shall be taken to the grave.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#073.dst: Por temor al mal uso de las... aguas, con malicia o sin ella, nuestros... se llevarán a la tumba.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#073.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#074.src: Only one apart from our... of it, and they have... secrecy, even... immmortality.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#074.dst: Solo uno ajeno a nuestra... de ello, y ha... el secreto, incluso... la inmortalidad.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#074.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#075.src: The lich, Espera... keeper of the Order. We ...an outside influence will not...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#075.dst: El liche, Espera... guardián de la Orden. Nosotros ...una influencia externa no...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#075.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#076.src: Looks like there's some debris blocking the path, but perhaps you could blast it away with a spell up close?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#076.dst: Parece que hay escombros bloqueando el camino, pero ¿quizá puedas volarlos con un hechizo desde cerca?

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#077.src: There's some kind of door over on the east side, with a hole shaped like an amulet, but I can't seem to find anything that would fit in it...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#077.dst: Hay una especie de puerta en el lado este, con un hueco en forma de amuleto, pero no encuentro nada que encaje...

Lexdale Witch Trials#000.src: You should follow the creature before it gets away!
Lexdale Witch Trials#000.dst: ¡Deberías seguir a esa criatura antes de que escape!

Lexdale Witch Trials#001.src: See what's going on in the center of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#001.dst: Averigua qué pasa en el centro de {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lexdale Witch Trials#002.src: We have an enemy amongst our own in {p}! This witch's illegal practice of magic threatens us!
Lexdale Witch Trials#002.dst: ¡Tenemos un enemigo entre los nuestros en {p}! ¡La magia ilegal de esta bruja nos amenaza!
Lexdale Witch Trials#002.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#003.src: Ms. Amira's home was found to be plagued by spreading Decay! We must kill the witch to protect our sanctity!
Lexdale Witch Trials#003.dst: ¡La casa de la señora Amira está plagada de Decadencia! ¡Hay que matar a la bruja para proteger nuestra santidad!
Lexdale Witch Trials#003.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#004.src: WAIT! Let me GO already! I told you what was happening!
Lexdale Witch Trials#004.dst: ¡ESPERAD! ¡SOLTADME de una vez! ¡Ya os dije lo que pasaba!
Lexdale Witch Trials#004.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#005.src: The deceit of your dark magic won't work, Ms. Amira. Go quietly- leave us in peace!
Lexdale Witch Trials#005.dst: Sus engaños de magia oscura no funcionarán, señora Amira. Váyase en silencio- ¡déjenos en paz!
Lexdale Witch Trials#005.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#006.src: SHUT UP ALREADY! You can't just single people out like this!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#006.dst: ¡CÁLLATE YA! ¡No puedes señalar así a la gente!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#006.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#007.src: Just hear me out for a second! It's not me, something infected my home! That's the reason it was so dark!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#007.dst: ¡Escúchame un segundo! ¡No soy yo, algo infectó mi casa! ¡¡Por eso estaba tan oscura!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#007.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#008.src: My basement, some outlandish thing dug into it! Wherever it went, the area withered and decayed!
Lexdale Witch Trials#008.dst: ¡Mi sótano, algo extrañísimo se abrió paso hasta él! ¡Por donde pasaba, todo se marchitaba y se pudría!
Lexdale Witch Trials#008.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#009.src: There's proof in my house that it wasn't me! It's the one that's decayed and barren! You'll see if you LOOK, you gorehound!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#009.dst: ¡En mi casa está la prueba de que no fui yo! ¡Es esa la que está podrida y yerma! ¡¡Lo verás si MIRAS, sanguinario!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#009.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#010.src: Quit with the insults! We'll delay for now- If there's no proof of the witch's innocence she will be executed!
Lexdale Witch Trials#010.dst: ¡Basta de insultos! Lo aplazaremos por ahora- ¡Si no hay prueba de su inocencia, la bruja será ejecutada!
Lexdale Witch Trials#010.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#011.src: Explore the basement of the decayed and barren house.
Lexdale Witch Trials#011.dst: Explora el sótano de la casa podrida y yerma.

Lexdale Witch Trials#012.src: Follow the creature down the tunnels.
Lexdale Witch Trials#012.dst: Sigue a la criatura por los túneles.

Lexdale Witch Trials#013.src: Continue to follow the creature from the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#013.dst: Sigue a la criatura desde el túnel en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lexdale Witch Trials#014.src: Continue to follow the creature from the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#014.dst: Sigue a la criatura desde el túnel en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lexdale Witch Trials#015.src: ...Further... intruders...? You are not of the worms... the parasites?
Lexdale Witch Trials#015.dst: ...¿Más... intrusos...? ¿No eres de los gusanos... los parásitos?
Lexdale Witch Trials#015.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#016.src: Another stranger... You must have witnessed the tunnels. They blight the stone, wither the roots, make lifeless the land...
Lexdale Witch Trials#016.dst: Otro forastero... Habrás visto los túneles. Agostan la piedra, marchitan las raíces, dejan la tierra sin vida...
Lexdale Witch Trials#016.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#017.src: And here, we starve in isolation. My people are lost, as the very earth itself warps and shifts.
Lexdale Witch Trials#017.dst: Y aquí pasamos hambre, aislados. Mi pueblo está perdido, pues la tierra misma se retuerce y se mueve.
Lexdale Witch Trials#017.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#018.src: The water, stagnant and gray. Nothing but those horrid magic scourges, and the worms themselves to sustain ourselves.
Lexdale Witch Trials#018.dst: El agua, estancada y gris. Nada con que sustentarnos salvo esas horribles plagas mágicas y los propios gusanos.
Lexdale Witch Trials#018.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#019.src: We cannot escape, for the sun scourges us. There is no place to go, no place to burrow that they do not wait.
Lexdale Witch Trials#019.dst: No podemos huir, el sol nos abrasa. No hay lugar al que ir, ni galería que cavar donde no aguarden.
Lexdale Witch Trials#019.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#020.src: You... You... You have life. You have a heart, and muscle, and meat... To survive till this torture ends...
Lexdale Witch Trials#020.dst: Tú... Tú... Tú tienes vida. Corazón, y músculo, y carne... Para aguantar hasta que acabe este tormento...
Lexdale Witch Trials#020.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#022.dst: Derrota al Jefe de los Moradores del Túnel.

Lexdale Witch Trials#023.src: Wait... These earthquakes! IT'S THEM! AGHHHHHHHHHHH!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#023.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#024.src: Dig yourself out of the dirt. Then go after the creature.
Lexdale Witch Trials#024.dst: Cava para salir de la tierra. Luego ve tras la criatura.

Lexdale Witch Trials#025.src: Return to {p} and try to show the mayor the creature at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#025.dst: Vuelve a {p} e intenta enseñarle la criatura al alcalde en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lexdale Witch Trials#026.src: You're back. Did- Wait, what in the nine hells is THAT?!
Lexdale Witch Trials#026.dst: Has vuelto. ¿Has-? Espera, ¿qué diablos es ESO?!
Lexdale Witch Trials#026.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#027.src: That! That was the thing in my basement!! I knew that human could find it! Thank you!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#027.dst: ¡Eso! ¡¡Eso era lo que había en mi sótano!! ¡Sabía que ese humano lo encontraría! ¡¡Gracias!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#027.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#028.src: That thing was spreading the decay through my house! It's NOT witches or magic like you suddenly DECIDED one day!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#028.dst: ¡Esa cosa extendía la decadencia por mi casa! ¡¡NO son brujas ni magia, como DECIDISTE de golpe un buen día!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#028.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#029.src: ...Fine then. This... creature... bug... leach? This whatever- it- is... I'll accept your explanation.
Lexdale Witch Trials#029.dst: ...Está bien. Esta... criatura... bicho... ¿sanguijuela? Esta cosa- sea- lo que sea... Acepto su explicación.
Lexdale Witch Trials#029.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#030.src: Step off the podium, Ms. Amira. You're innocent.
Lexdale Witch Trials#030.dst: Baje del estrado, señora Amira. Es inocente.
Lexdale Witch Trials#030.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#031.src: Gah, finally! You're seeing sense! It's almost like something just... took you over one day and never left 'til now!
Lexdale Witch Trials#031.dst: ¡Bah, por fin! ¡Entras en razón! Es casi como si algo... se apoderara de ti un día y no se fuera hasta ahora.
Lexdale Witch Trials#031.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#032.src: ...hm. That... Mmh. Regardless. Human, you've proven yourself to be trustworthy. We'll keep our doors open for you.
Lexdale Witch Trials#032.dst: ...hum. Eso... Mmh. En fin. Humano, has demostrado ser de fiar. Nuestras puertas seguirán abiertas para ti.
Lexdale Witch Trials#032.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#033.src: As for the... THING... Well... I'll be sure to inform the Gavel government.
Lexdale Witch Trials#033.dst: En cuanto a esa... COSA... En fin... Informaré al gobierno de Gavel.
Lexdale Witch Trials#033.speaker: The Mayor

Lost in the Jungle#001.src: Excuse me, traveller... I am dreadfully sorry to ask this of you, but I need your help.
Lost in the Jungle#001.dst: Disculpa, viajero... Siento muchísimo pedirte esto, pero necesito tu ayuda.
Lost in the Jungle#001.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#002.src: You see, my son, Aryn. Very recently, he underwent a traditional coming-of-age ceremony from our tribe.
Lost in the Jungle#002.dst: Verás, mi hijo, Aryn. Hace muy poco pasó la ceremonia tradicional de mayoría de edad de nuestra tribu.
Lost in the Jungle#002.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#003.src: He was tasked to enter the dangerous {p}, just south of here, and brave the wilderness for three days. He returned a true man, successful.
Lost in the Jungle#003.dst: Debía entrar en la peligrosa {p}, al sur de aquí, y resistir tres días en la espesura. Volvió con éxito, hecho todo un hombre.
Lost in the Jungle#003.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#004.src: However, he also brought with him an odd purple gemstone. Our shaman saw it as a bad omen, but I was so caught up in the celebrations, I brushed it off.
Lost in the Jungle#004.dst: Pero también trajo una extraña gema morada. Nuestro chamán lo vio como mal augurio, pero yo estaba tan metido en la fiesta que no le hice caso.
Lost in the Jungle#004.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#005.src: Strange happenings began around the village. Aryn walked about at night, talking to someone, but no one else was there with him.
Lost in the Jungle#005.dst: Empezaron cosas raras en la aldea. Aryn paseaba de noche hablando con alguien, pero no había nadie más con él.
Lost in the Jungle#005.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#006.src: Just last sunrise, he vanished entirely. We sent out a search for him, but even our hardiest warriors could not venture deep into the jungle.
Lost in the Jungle#006.dst: Al amanecer de ayer desapareció por completo. Lo buscamos, pero ni nuestros guerreros más recios pudieron adentrarse en la jungla.
Lost in the Jungle#006.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#007.src: We returned empty-handed, having lost our newest tribesman. The village is in terrible spirits, and I feel as though I am responsible.
Lost in the Jungle#007.dst: Volvimos con las manos vacías, tras perder al miembro más joven de la tribu. La aldea está hundida, y siento que soy el responsable.
Lost in the Jungle#007.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#008.src: You Wynn warriors, however... great stories are told of your exploits. Surely, you will be able to brave the jungle, yes?
Lost in the Jungle#008.dst: Pero de vosotros, los guerreros de Wynn... se cuentan grandes hazañas. Seguro que tú sí puedes con la jungla, ¿verdad?
Lost in the Jungle#008.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#009.src: I beg of you, please, find my son. I do not know quite where he is, but undoubtedly he has been taken quite a ways in...
Lost in the Jungle#009.dst: Te lo ruego, por favor, encuentra a mi hijo. No sé bien dónde está, pero sin duda lo han llevado muy adentro...
Lost in the Jungle#009.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#010.src: Hm... I just now am seeing a strange trail on the ground... it matches the color of the gemstone! It may take you to him, please, follow it!
Lost in the Jungle#010.dst: Hm... Ahora mismo veo un rastro extraño en el suelo... ¡es del color de la gema! Puede que te lleve hasta él, ¡por favor, síguelo!
Lost in the Jungle#010.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#012.src: P-please, I beg of you spirit, let me go free! The tribesmen must be so worried-
Lost in the Jungle#012.dst: P-por favor, espíritu, ¡suéltame! La tribu estará preocupadísima-
Lost in the Jungle#012.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#013.src: DO NOT RESIST, BOY! YOUR BODY IS MINE. I WAS TRAPPED IN THAT STONE FOR MILLENIA, AND NOW I AM FREE.
Lost in the Jungle#013.dst: ¡NO TE RESISTAS, CHICO! TU CUERPO ES MÍO. ESTUVE ATRAPADO EN ESA PIEDRA MILENIOS, Y AHORA SOY LIBRE.
Lost in the Jungle#013.speaker: Aryn?

Lost in the Jungle#014.src: Aha, I hear someone coming! Surely a tribesman here to rescue me!
Lost in the Jungle#014.dst: ¡Ajá, oigo a alguien venir! ¡Seguro que es alguien de la tribu!
Lost in the Jungle#014.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#015.src: Oh! If so, the body of this warrior will be far better suited to my needs! Grant me your power, boy! I need to thrash them first to possess them!
Lost in the Jungle#015.dst: ¡Oh! ¡Entonces el cuerpo de este guerrero me servirá mucho mejor! ¡Dame tu poder, chico! ¡Debo vencerlo antes de poseerlo!
Lost in the Jungle#015.speaker: Aryn?

Lost in the Jungle#016.dst: Derrota al espíritu que posee a Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#017.src: Make sure Aryn is safe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lost in the Jungle#017.dst: Asegúrate de que Aryn está a salvo en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lost in the Jungle#018.src: Hahah, take that, evil wraith! You'll never match the power of our tribe-
Lost in the Jungle#018.dst: ¡Jajá, toma ya, espectro maligno! ¡Jamás igualarás a nuestra tribu-
Lost in the Jungle#018.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#019.src: W-wait, you aren't part of our tribe! Who are you, why did you come here?
Lost in the Jungle#019.dst: E-espera, ¡tú no eres de nuestra tribu! ¿Quién eres, a qué has venido?
Lost in the Jungle#019.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#020.src: Oh... my father sent you? Well, I am very impressed, Wynn warrior. You fight with ferocity of our own!
Lost in the Jungle#020.dst: Oh... ¿te envió mi padre? Pues me impresionas, guerrero de Wynn. ¡Luchas con la ferocidad de los nuestros!
Lost in the Jungle#020.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#021.src: I...can't say the same for myself. That spirit completely overtook me, I still can't move right now...
Lost in the Jungle#021.dst: Yo... no puedo decir lo mismo. Ese espíritu me dominó por completo; aún no puedo moverme...
Lost in the Jungle#021.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#022.src: For now, please. Take away this gemstone. It caused all this, I don't want to be near such a bad luck charm.
Lost in the Jungle#022.dst: Por ahora, por favor, llévate esta gema. Ella causó todo esto; no quiero cerca un amuleto de mala suerte.
Lost in the Jungle#022.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#023.src: Tell the tribe that I will return on my own. I made it back once, I can do it again once I am prepared.
Lost in the Jungle#023.dst: Dile a la tribu que volveré por mi cuenta. Ya lo logré una vez; lo lograré otra vez cuando esté listo.
Lost in the Jungle#023.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#024.src: Bring the Mysterious Gemstone to Gracen at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lost in the Jungle#024.dst: Lleva la Gema Misteriosa a Gracen en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lost in the Jungle#025.src: Oh my... Aryn was possessed by a spirit residing within the gemstone?
Lost in the Jungle#025.dst: Cielos... ¿Un espíritu de la gema poseyó a Aryn?
Lost in the Jungle#025.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#026.src: How shameful... Our shaman has never been wrong before, why did I disregard his warning...
Lost in the Jungle#026.dst: Qué vergüenza... Nuestro chamán nunca se ha equivocado, ¿por qué ignoré su advertencia...?
Lost in the Jungle#026.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#027.src: But that is beside the point. You say you have destroyed the spirit and it does not feel tainted any longer, so I will trust you.
Lost in the Jungle#027.dst: Pero eso da igual ahora. Dices que destruiste al espíritu y que ya no se siente corrompida, así que confiaré en ti.
Lost in the Jungle#027.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#028.src: Looking at it now, this is actually quite a valuable stone. If crushed to dust, it can be used in special charms we make.
Lost in the Jungle#028.dst: Ahora que la miro, es una piedra bastante valiosa. Molida, sirve para los amuletos especiales que hacemos.
Lost in the Jungle#028.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#029.src: Here, allow me to grind this down for you. You can keep the shards for whatever purposes you may find for them in the future.
Lost in the Jungle#029.dst: Ven, deja que te la muela. Quédate los fragmentos para lo que quieras darles uso en el futuro.
Lost in the Jungle#029.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#030.src: Our tribe, and especially myself... We thank you for your service. We shall consider you one of our own, from this day forward.
Lost in the Jungle#030.dst: Nuestra tribu, y yo en especial... te agradecemos tu ayuda. Desde hoy te consideraremos uno de los nuestros.
Lost in the Jungle#030.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#031.src: In fact, if you'd like, you may even enter my house here whenever you'd like.
Lost in the Jungle#031.dst: De hecho, si quieres, puedes entrar en mi casa cuando gustes.
Lost in the Jungle#031.speaker: Gracen

Lost Royalty#001.src: Oh, hello there! I had hoped not to bother you, adventurer, but this is urgent.
Lost Royalty#001.dst: ¡Ah, hola! No quería molestarle, aventurero, pero es urgente.
Lost Royalty#001.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#002.src: You see, the king is very... erm, distracted, and you are just the kind of willing, able-bodied person I need.
Lost Royalty#002.dst: Verá, el rey está muy... ejem, distraído, y usted es justo la persona dispuesta y capaz que necesito.
Lost Royalty#002.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#003.src: You see, the king's son has gone missing, and with him worrying so much, the problems of the city have festered unsolved.
Lost Royalty#003.dst: Resulta que el hijo del rey ha desaparecido, y con él tan preocupado, los problemas de la ciudad se pudren sin resolver.
Lost Royalty#003.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#004.src: We believe he was kidnapped by the splinter cell mercenaries in the jungle... Unfortunate, too. They used to be quite honourable.
Lost Royalty#004.dst: Creemos que lo secuestraron los mercenarios escindidos de la jungla... Una pena, además. Antes eran bastante honorables.
Lost Royalty#004.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#005.src: Well, anyway, they're usually spotted outside the run-down farm outside of town. Go there and see what they want in return for the young prince.
Lost Royalty#005.dst: En fin, suelen verse junto a la granja ruinosa de las afueras. Vaya allí y averigüe qué piden a cambio del joven príncipe.
Lost Royalty#005.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#006.src: Talk to the Mercenary Leader in their hideout outside {p}
Lost Royalty#006.dst: Habla con el Líder Mercenario en su escondite a las afueras de {p}

Lost Royalty#007.src: Excuse me?! What are you doing here, how did you find our secret hideout?
Lost Royalty#007.dst: ¿¡Perdona!? ¿Qué haces aquí, cómo encontraste nuestro escondite secreto?
Lost Royalty#007.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#008.src: Oh, you're here for the boy? A mighty fine steal, that one! The boy won't be leaving this establishment for free. I'll need some nice loot for him.
Lost Royalty#008.dst: Ah, ¿vienes por el chaval? ¡Vaya golpe, ese! No saldrá de aquí gratis. Voy a necesitar un buen botín a cambio.
Lost Royalty#008.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#009.src: Ah, but what to have you fetch...oh, haha! This would be a perfect opportunity to obtain that... Alright, ears open!
Lost Royalty#009.dst: Ah, pero qué te mando a buscar... ¡oh, jaja! Sería la ocasión perfecta para conseguir aquello... ¡Venga, oídos abiertos!
Lost Royalty#009.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#010.src: There's a certain talisman that we aren't able to get to in the temple not far from here. It has special abilities that allow my men to be strengthened, see.
Lost Royalty#010.dst: Hay cierto talismán en el templo de aquí cerca al que no logramos llegar. Tiene poderes especiales que refuerzan a mis hombres, ¿ves?
Lost Royalty#010.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#011.src: The guardians there pack quite the punch, and there's some nasty mechanism in the way that we just can't crack.
Lost Royalty#011.dst: Los guardianes de allí pegan fuerte, y hay un mecanismo endiablado de por medio que no logramos resolver.
Lost Royalty#011.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#012.src: The temple is found just across the waterway, in a crevice in the mountain. It used to be blocked until those WynnExcavation fellows tried digging there.
Lost Royalty#012.dst: El templo está justo al otro lado del canal, en una grieta de la montaña. Estaba tapiado hasta que los de WynnExcavation se pusieron a excavar allí.
Lost Royalty#012.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#013.src: You get that talisman in my hands, and the king's boy is yours. Now off you pip! I'm a very busy man.
Lost Royalty#013.dst: Pon ese talismán en mis manos y el hijo del rey es tuyo. ¡Venga, largo! Soy un hombre muy ocupado.
Lost Royalty#013.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#014.src: Go to the jungle temple and retrieve the talisman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lost Royalty#014.dst: Ve al templo de la jungla y recupera el talismán en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lost Royalty#015.src: Bring the talisman back to the Mercenary Leader.
Lost Royalty#015.dst: Lleva el talismán de vuelta al Líder Mercenario.

Lost Royalty#016.src: You've gotten the talisman! I can't believe you actually got through that puzzle!
Lost Royalty#016.dst: ¡Has conseguido el talismán! ¡No me creo que superaras ese rompecabezas!
Lost Royalty#016.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#017.src: At this point I would usually keep the kid and throw you out of here, but since you've done what I've asked in such a timely fashion, he's all yours.
Lost Royalty#017.dst: Normalmente me quedaría con el crío y te echaría de aquí, pero como has hecho lo que te pedí tan rápido, es todo tuyo.
Lost Royalty#017.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#018.src: When you get back to whoever asked you to do this, tell him to leave my men and I alone! We guildsmen lay down our lives every day, we don't need any more hostile onlookers!
Lost Royalty#018.dst: Cuando vuelvas con quien te mandó, ¡dile que nos deje en paz a mis hombres y a mí! Los del gremio nos jugamos la vida a diario, ¡no necesitamos más miradas hostiles!
Lost Royalty#018.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#019.src: Talk to the Prince of {p} in the jail cell
Lost Royalty#019.dst: Habla con el Príncipe de {p} en la celda

Lost Royalty#020.src: Report back to Yavlis with the news
Lost Royalty#020.dst: Informa a Yavlis de las novedades

Lost Royalty#021.src: Ah, finally! You're back. Did they let you bring him back? Those mercenaries have an awful habit of failing to honour their deals.
Lost Royalty#021.dst: ¡Ah, por fin! Ha vuelto. ¿Le dejaron traerlo? Esos mercenarios tienen la pésima costumbre de no cumplir sus tratos.
Lost Royalty#021.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#022.src: Wait, the prince said what? He truly wants to be a mercenary? Oh my... then he must have escaped on his own.
Lost Royalty#022.dst: Espere, ¿el príncipe dijo qué? ¿De verdad quiere ser mercenario? Cielos... entonces escapó por su cuenta.
Lost Royalty#022.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#023.src: Alright then, if that's the path the king's son chooses to walk, then there's nothing we can do.
Lost Royalty#023.dst: Está bien; si ese es el camino que elige el hijo del rey, nada podemos hacer.
Lost Royalty#023.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#024.src: I can only hope that he chose to join them out of a will to protect the people, rather than simply brutishness or money.
Lost Royalty#024.dst: Solo cabe esperar que se uniera a ellos por voluntad de proteger al pueblo, y no por mera brutalidad o dinero.
Lost Royalty#024.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#025.src: Such a shame that old guild has stooped to such a level. Well, we must thank you for your help. You can have the emerald ransom we had intended to pay.
Lost Royalty#025.dst: Qué lástima que ese viejo gremio haya caído tan bajo. En fin, gracias por su ayuda. Quédese con las esmeraldas del rescate que íbamos a pagar.
Lost Royalty#025.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Soles#000.src: Talk to Ferndor at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], make sure to bring Abysso Galoshes with you.
Lost Soles#000.dst: Habla con Ferndor en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]; asegúrate de llevar contigo las Abysso Galoshes.

Lost Soles#001.src: Have you seen boots called Abysso Galoshes on your journey, a pirate stole them from us years ago! I could reward you if you could bring me the Abysso Galoshes and help us!
Lost Soles#001.dst: ¿Has visto en tu viaje unas botas llamadas Abysso Galoshes? ¡Un pirata nos las robó hace años! ¡Si me traes las Abysso Galoshes y nos ayudas, podría recompensarte!
Lost Soles#001.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#002.src: Bring back Abysso Galoshes, received during the quest Beneath the Depths.
Lost Soles#002.dst: Devuelve las Abysso Galoshes, obtenidas en la misión Bajo las profundidades.

Lost Soles#003.src: I see you have the infamous galoshes with you. But do you know even half of the story of them?
Lost Soles#003.dst: Veo que llevas encima las famosas botas. Pero ¿conoces siquiera la mitad de su historia?
Lost Soles#003.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#004.src: The boots were once owned by my ancestors, who decided to lock it away in this manor years ago.
Lost Soles#004.dst: Las botas fueron de mis antepasados, que hace años decidieron encerrarlas en esta mansión.
Lost Soles#004.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#005.src: Nobody knows why they decided to hide the boots just after they got into my family's hands. I was told they were acquired from a strange man with pale grey skin.
Lost Soles#005.dst: Nadie sabe por qué las escondieron nada más llegar a manos de mi familia. Me contaron que se las compraron a un tipo extraño de piel gris pálida.
Lost Soles#005.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#006.src: We think they hid the boots in some kind of basement in the manor. You can get to it by following the river to the waterfall, but you will need some kind of code to open it...
Lost Soles#006.dst: Creemos que las escondieron en algún sótano de la mansión. Se llega siguiendo el río hasta la cascada, pero necesitarás algún código para abrirlo...
Lost Soles#006.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#007.src: I remember Grandon saying that he found a book which is apparently a diary from one of my ancestors. Ever since that filthy pirate raided our home and stole our treasures, weird things have been happening.
Lost Soles#007.dst: Recuerdo que Grandon dijo haber encontrado un libro que al parecer es el diario de uno de mis antepasados. Desde que aquel pirata asqueroso asaltó nuestra casa y robó nuestros tesoros, pasan cosas raras.
Lost Soles#007.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#008.src: Grandon should already have finished reading it. If I allow you to enter my home, would you talk to him?
Lost Soles#008.dst: Grandon ya debería haberlo terminado. Si te dejo entrar en mi casa, ¿hablarías con él?
Lost Soles#008.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#009.src: There are strange things going on in this mansion and I hope that book reveals everything we need to know...
Lost Soles#009.dst: En esta mansión pasan cosas extrañas, y espero que ese libro revele todo lo que necesitamos saber...
Lost Soles#009.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#010.src: I almost forgot to give you your boots back, I am not sure if I want to have them near me. Remember, it is imperative you find the {~} digit code to the basement.
Lost Soles#010.dst: Casi olvido devolverte tus botas; no sé si quiero tenerlas cerca. Recuerda: es imprescindible que halles el código de {~} dígitos del sótano.
Lost Soles#010.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#011.src: Visit the mansion dining room and ask Grandon about the book
Lost Soles#011.dst: Visita el comedor de la mansión y pregúntale a Grandon por el libro

Lost Soles#012.src: Ferndor sent you here, correct? That must mean you’re here to help find the hidden {~} digit code in the manor.
Lost Soles#012.dst: Te envía Ferndor, ¿verdad? Entonces vienes a buscar el código oculto de {~} dígitos de la mansión.
Lost Soles#012.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#013.src: The book is actually a diary written by our ancestors decades ago. It is actually very interesting, how they remodeled almost the whole house.
Lost Soles#013.dst: El libro es en realidad un diario que escribieron nuestros antepasados hace décadas. Es muy interesante cómo reformaron casi toda la casa.
Lost Soles#013.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#014.src: Ferndor probably told you about the boots, right? The diary has some information about them...ah, here, on this page.
Lost Soles#014.dst: Ferndor te habrá hablado de las botas, ¿no? El diario cuenta algunas cosas sobre ellas... ah, aquí, en esta página.
Lost Soles#014.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#015.src: Here...our family bought them from "a dark and mysterious humanoid creature" a long time ago.
Lost Soles#015.dst: Aquí... nuestra familia se las compró hace mucho a "una criatura humanoide oscura y misteriosa".
Lost Soles#015.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#016.src: The boots were apparently so valuable that the creature as part of the deal, said they put some kind of spell on them, but that was a lie.
Lost Soles#016.dst: Al parecer las botas eran tan valiosas que la criatura dijo, como parte del trato, haberles puesto una especie de hechizo; pero era mentira.
Lost Soles#016.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#017.src: It was found that the boots themselves were horrendously powerful, imbued with dark magic that will deteriorate and decay everything around it over time.
Lost Soles#017.dst: Se descubrió que las botas mismas eran de un poder horrendo, imbuidas de magia oscura que con el tiempo deteriora y pudre todo a su alrededor.
Lost Soles#017.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#018.src: They were given a special boot container with similar effects, but when the Galoshes are within the Container, they cancel each others' effects out.
Lost Soles#018.dst: Les dieron un contenedor especial con efectos similares, pero cuando las Galoshes están dentro del Contenedor, sus efectos se anulan.
Lost Soles#018.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#019.src: They hid the boots in the mansion, along with the case. The writer of this diary wrote down some hints as to how to get them, maybe you can find out what they mean. Here, try this one:
Lost Soles#019.dst: Escondieron las botas en la mansión junto con el estuche. Quien escribió el diario dejó pistas para conseguirlas; quizá tú averigües qué significan. Toma, prueba con esta:
Lost Soles#019.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#020.src: "The face above the hall owns the nose that needs to be heavier to open the way".
Lost Soles#020.dst: "La cara sobre el salón posee la nariz que debe pesar más para abrir el camino".
Lost Soles#020.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#021.src: Hmm, all the hints appear in a chapter about this room, the dining hall. Any idea what this meant? It feels like it should be obvious, but I can't for the life of me figure this out.
Lost Soles#021.dst: Hmm, todas las pistas salen en un capítulo sobre esta sala, el comedor. ¿Se te ocurre qué significa? Parece que debería ser obvio, pero no hay manera de que lo saque.
Lost Soles#021.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#022.src: "The face above the hall owns the nose that needs to be heavier to open the way"
Lost Soles#022.dst: "La cara sobre el salón posee la nariz que debe pesar más para abrir el camino"

Lost Soles#023.src: Talk to Grandon and tell him about your findings
Lost Soles#023.dst: Habla con Grandon y cuéntale lo que has descubierto

Lost Soles#024.src: A room hidden underneath the big head? Why didn't I think of that!? I always wondered how self-centered they had to be to put that in, but who knew it actually had a valid purpose!
Lost Soles#024.dst: ¿Una sala escondida bajo la cabezota? ¡¿Cómo no se me ocurrió?! Siempre me pregunté qué ego había que tener para ponerla ahí, ¡y resulta que tenía una función!
Lost Soles#024.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#025.src: So, there was a sign telling you to look for stone in the corner? Hm...intriguing!
Lost Soles#025.dst: ¿Un cartel te decía que buscaras piedra en la esquina? Hm... ¡intrigante!
Lost Soles#025.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#026.src: Whoever placed down that sign might have a secret way up to the second floor. It hasn't been accessible for a fairly long while, not since the stairs collapsed. Except for Leacen, but she's a bit crazy...
Lost Soles#026.dst: Quien puso ese cartel quizá tenga un paso secreto a la segunda planta. Hace bastante que no se puede subir, desde que se derrumbó la escalera. Salvo Leacen, pero está un poco loca...
Lost Soles#026.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#027.src: Anyway, seems they guessed that we would have to search for a way to return the boots, and made preparations. Good thing, that.
Lost Soles#027.dst: En fin, parece que supusieron que tendríamos que buscar cómo devolver las botas, y lo prepararon todo. Menos mal.
Lost Soles#027.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#028.src: As I said, the stairs are all broken. I mean, I certainly couldn't climb up those rotten scraps of wood. Suppose it might be best to look for that stone, hm?
Lost Soles#028.dst: Como decía, la escalera está destrozada. Vamos, yo desde luego no treparía por esas maderas podridas. Igual es mejor buscar esa piedra, ¿hm?
Lost Soles#028.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#029.src: But where could it be...oh? Is this a hint? I just noticed this on the next page.
Lost Soles#029.dst: Pero ¿dónde estará...? ¿Oh? ¿Esto es una pista? Acabo de verlo en la página siguiente.
Lost Soles#029.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#030.src: "The carpet of different colour will show you the stone to reveal the tables secret".
Lost Soles#030.dst: "La alfombra de otro color te mostrará la piedra que revela el secreto de la mesa".
Lost Soles#030.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#031.src: "The carpet of different colour will show you the stone to reveal the tables secret"
Lost Soles#031.dst: "La alfombra de otro color te mostrará la piedra que revela el secreto de la mesa"

Lost Soles#032.src: Talk to Grandon and tell him about your findings
Lost Soles#032.dst: Habla con Grandon y cuéntale lo que has descubierto

Lost Soles#033.src: Sheesh! Quite the engineers, these old fellows! Never would've imagined any of this in the house. Anyway, was there a message? What did it say?
Lost Soles#033.dst: ¡Caray! ¡Vaya ingenieros estaban hechos los viejos! Jamás habría imaginado nada de esto en la casa. En fin, ¿había un mensaje? ¿Qué decía?
Lost Soles#033.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#034.src: The hole nobody wanted? He can only mean the little rat hole in the back part of this hall. Though, it's more just a hole anymore, all the rats are gone.
Lost Soles#034.dst: ¿El agujero que nadie quería? Solo puede referirse a la ratonera del fondo de esta sala. Aunque ya no es más que un agujero, las ratas se fueron.
Lost Soles#034.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#035.src: Well, details, details. We never checked it any more than just laying mouse traps, so I suppose there could be something in there given how complex these contraptions have been.
Lost Soles#035.dst: Bueno, detalles, detalles. Nunca lo revisamos más allá de poner trampas, así que puede que haya algo dentro, viendo lo complejos que son estos artilugios.
Lost Soles#035.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#036.src: I would say, you look into the hole and then search on top of the blue flags!
Lost Soles#036.dst: ¡Yo miraría en el agujero y luego encima de las banderas azules!
Lost Soles#036.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#037.src: But if that's the way up to the second floor, what does the diary mean by this?
Lost Soles#037.dst: Pero si ese es el paso a la planta de arriba, ¿qué significa esto del diario?
Lost Soles#037.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#038.src: "Throw something behind the map on the wall to uncover a piece of the code"? Wait, that probably means the code to the basement! Come back to me at once when you've done that, I have more to tell you!
Lost Soles#038.dst: ¿"Lanza algo detrás del mapa de la pared para descubrir una parte del código"? ¡Espera, eso será el código del sótano! ¡Vuelve enseguida cuando lo hayas hecho, tengo más que contarte!
Lost Soles#038.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#039.src: "Throw something behind the map on the wall to uncover a piece of the code"
Lost Soles#039.dst: "Lanza algo detrás del mapa de la pared para descubrir una parte del código"

Lost Soles#040.src: You found a piece of the code!? Hahah, excellent! I must say, you've made more progress in a few minutes than I have in a few years! You humans really are something!
Lost Soles#040.dst: ¿¡Has encontrado una parte del código!? ¡Jajá, excelente! ¡Debo decir que has avanzado más en unos minutos que yo en unos años! ¡Los humanos sois algo serio!
Lost Soles#040.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#041.src: Now, the diary now says you must make your way to the second floor to find the other {~} digits of the code.
Lost Soles#041.dst: Ahora el diario dice que debes subir a la segunda planta para hallar los otros {~} dígitos del código.
Lost Soles#041.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#042.src: Remember, to get up to the second floor you need to use the button in the rat hole to open the passage above the blue flags hanging from the ceiling.
Lost Soles#042.dst: Recuerda: para subir a la segunda planta hay que usar el botón de la ratonera y abrir el paso sobre las banderas azules del techo.
Lost Soles#042.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#043.src: It doesn't say where they are, just that they're well hidden and that there are additional clues around the house. The other {~} digits should all be up there on the second floor! Maybe Leacen has seen something about them while she's been up there, as well.
Lost Soles#043.dst: No dice dónde están, solo que están bien escondidos y que hay más pistas por la casa. ¡Los otros {~} dígitos deberían estar todos en la segunda planta! Quizá Leacen haya visto algo de ellos mientras estaba arriba.
Lost Soles#043.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#044.src: Once you've found the whole code, head to the basement. Just follow the path and signs outside the manor once you have it.
Lost Soles#044.dst: Cuando tengas el código entero, ve al sótano. Basta con seguir el camino y los carteles de fuera de la mansión.
Lost Soles#044.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#045.src: Open the secret passage above the flags by reaching into the unwanted hole
Lost Soles#045.dst: Abre el paso secreto sobre las banderas metiendo la mano en el agujero que nadie quería

Lost Soles#046.src: Bring back [{~} Boot Container] and [Abysso Galoshes] to Ferndor
Lost Soles#046.dst: Lleva [{~} Boot Container] y [Abysso Galoshes] de vuelta a Ferndor

Lost Soles#047.src: Darn, I thought for sure one of these books would open a secret shelf...oh, heya Humie. Did you manage to climb up the stairs too?
Lost Soles#047.dst: Jolín, estaba segura de que uno de estos libros abriría un estante secreto... ah, hola, humanito. ¿Tú también lograste subir la escalera?
Lost Soles#047.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#048.src: Oh wow, a secret passage! Not as impressive as gettin' to climb the way up, but still nice job! I'm guessing that you're looking for the code hints?
Lost Soles#048.dst: ¡Hala, un pasadizo secreto! No mola tanto como subir trepando, ¡pero buen trabajo igual! Supongo que buscas las pistas del código, ¿no?
Lost Soles#048.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#049.src: Yeah, I've been trying for a while too. I thought I was on to somethin' a couple of times, too! Like in here. Not one of these books opens a secret passage, can you believe it?
Lost Soles#049.dst: Sí, yo también llevo un rato intentándolo. ¡Un par de veces creí que iba por buen camino! Como aquí. Ni uno de estos libros abre un pasadizo, ¿te lo puedes creer?
Lost Soles#049.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#050.src: Plus, I lost my notebook, so I can't even write down my notes. I just put it on the pillow for two seconds, and then it disappeared!
Lost Soles#050.dst: Y encima perdí mi cuaderno, así que ni puedo apuntar nada. ¡Lo dejé en la almohada dos segundos y desapareció!
Lost Soles#050.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#051.src: Tell you what, Humie. You help us out, and I'll give you some information you might be interested in hearing. Sound good to you?
Lost Soles#051.dst: Mira lo que te digo, humanito. Nos echas una mano y yo te cuento algo que te va a interesar. ¿Te parece bien?
Lost Soles#051.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#052.src: On the upper floor are some bedrooms, and a spiral staircase that starts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Head to the top of the staircase, which will take you to the roof of the manor. The sign can be found at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], at the edge of the roof, and says "{~} is the first".
Lost Soles#052.dst: En la planta de arriba hay dormitorios y una escalera de caracol que arranca en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Sube hasta lo más alto y saldrás al tejado de la mansión. El cartel está en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], al borde del tejado, y dice "{~} is the first".
Lost Soles#052.speaker: First Digit

Lost Soles#053.src: The second digit's sign is the one you find in stage {~}, revealing that the second digit is {~} when you throw any item into the map near Grandon.
Lost Soles#053.dst: El cartel del segundo dígito es el de la etapa {~}: lanza cualquier objeto al mapa junto a Grandon y verás que el segundo dígito es {~}.
Lost Soles#053.speaker: Second Digit

Lost Soles#054.src: On the second floor, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], there is an iron door with a button next to it. Press the button to open the door and enter the small room; you should find a sign which reads "He told us that the blue flowers are special...". Back in the area outside the iron door, there is one blue flower on a high shelf next to a button at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The button opens up a ladder leading to a bedroom in the corner of the room, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The third sign is on the wall of the room the ladder leads to, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and says "{~} is the third".
Lost Soles#054.dst: En la segunda planta, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], hay una puerta de hierro con un botón al lado. Púlsalo para abrirla y entra en la salita; deberías encontrar un cartel que dice "He told us that the blue flowers are special...". De vuelta a la zona de fuera de la puerta de hierro, hay una flor azul en un estante alto junto a un botón en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. El botón abre una escalera que lleva a un dormitorio en la esquina de la sala, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. El tercer cartel está en la pared de la habitación a la que lleva la escalera, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], y dice "{~} is the third".
Lost Soles#054.speaker: Third Digit

Lost Soles#055.src: On the third floor is a staircase that starts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and leads to a walkway crossing over a hallway. Jumping off the walkway through a gap in the railings on the north side, you can get into a small hole with a sign saying "He always hid something underneath his pillow...". Drop back down to the Master Bedroom at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and, as the clue suggests, throw an emerald on the pillow. This opens up a small room behind a high shelf, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], leading to the final sign, which says "{~} is the fourth". Note that if you aren't quick enough to get into the room, you can throw an emerald over to the pillow while standing on top of the shelf.
Lost Soles#055.dst: En la tercera planta hay una escalera que arranca en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y lleva a una pasarela que cruza un pasillo. Saltando de la pasarela por un hueco de la barandilla del lado norte, puedes meterte en un pequeño hueco con un cartel que dice "He always hid something underneath his pillow...". Baja de nuevo al Dormitorio Principal en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y, como sugiere la pista, lanza una esmeralda sobre la almohada. Esto abre una salita detrás de un estante alto, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], que lleva al cartel final, que dice "{~} is the fourth". Ten en cuenta que, si no eres lo bastante rápido para entrar en la sala, puedes lanzar la esmeralda hasta la almohada desde encima del estante.
Lost Soles#055.speaker: Fourth Digit

Lost Soles#056.src: You found the container? I wish I would have gone with you...
Lost Soles#056.dst: ¿Encontraste el contenedor? Ojalá hubiera ido contigo...
Lost Soles#056.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#057.src: At least we can stop the manor's slow decay! Let me just put the boots into the container...
Lost Soles#057.dst: ¡Al menos podemos detener la lenta decadencia de la mansión! Deja que meta las botas en el contenedor...
Lost Soles#057.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#058.src: That was easy. I still can not believe that such a small thing can cause so much trouble.
Lost Soles#058.dst: Qué fácil. Sigo sin creer que algo tan pequeño cause tantos problemas.
Lost Soles#058.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#059.src: Well, I can not just let you stand there without a reward, right?
Lost Soles#059.dst: Bueno, no puedo dejarte ahí de pie sin recompensa, ¿verdad?
Lost Soles#059.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#060.src: Here, how about some emeralds, and these boots? They're heirlooms given to my family by the Sodeta Guild who once owned this mansion. I promise they aren’t evil! Feel free to visit us at any time!
Lost Soles#060.dst: Toma, ¿qué tal unas esmeraldas y estas botas? Son reliquias que le dio a mi familia el gremio Sodeta, que antaño poseyó esta mansión. ¡Prometo que no son malignas! ¡Visítanos cuando quieras!
Lost Soles#060.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Tower#000.src: Hey, adventurer! Would you mind helping me for a second? I have a bit of a problem on my hands.

Lost Tower#001.src: A long time ago, before {p} was destroyed, my family used to own quite an interesting book, that held knowledge of places and beings of great power.

Lost Tower#003.src: Hey adventurer! Would you mind helping me for a second? I have a bit of a problem on my hands.
Lost Tower#003.dst: ¡Eh, aventurero! ¿Te importaría ayudarme un momento? Tengo un problemilla entre manos.
Lost Tower#003.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#004.src: A while ago, before {p} was destroyed, my family used to own quite an interesting book, that held knowledge of places and beings of great power.
Lost Tower#004.dst: Hace tiempo, antes de que {p} fuera destruida, mi familia tenía un libro muy curioso, con saber sobre lugares y seres de gran poder.
Lost Tower#004.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#005.src: Unfortunately, a creature stole it from them during the attack that led to the destruction of {p}, and no one has seen it since.
Lost Tower#005.dst: Por desgracia, una criatura se lo robó durante el ataque que acabó destruyendo {p}, y nadie lo ha vuelto a ver.
Lost Tower#005.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#006.src: If you are willing to help, bring me [{~} Book of the Bones], I believe this book is now between the hands of skeletons, in an old tower in {p}.
Lost Tower#006.dst: Si quieres ayudar, tráeme [{~} Book of the Bones]; creo que el libro está ahora en manos de esqueletos, en una vieja torre de {p}.
Lost Tower#006.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#007.src: See if you can find this tower, one of the skeletons probably has the book somewhere in there.
Lost Tower#007.dst: A ver si encuentras esa torre; seguramente uno de los esqueletos de dentro tenga el libro.
Lost Tower#007.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#008.src: Find the lost tower in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lost Tower#008.dst: Encuentra la torre perdida en {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lost Tower#009.src: Find the book in the tower, and bring it back to Laen.
Lost Tower#009.dst: Encuentra el libro en la torre y llévaselo a Laen.

Lost Tower#010.src: Bring back the book to Laen.

Lost Tower#011.src: Great! This will be very interesting to read, thank you!
Lost Tower#011.speaker: Laen

Maltic's Well#000.src: Talk to Rynend located in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Maltic's Well#001.src: Please help us! We called for a {p} guard days ago, but Humans tend to forget this little village.
Maltic's Well#001.dst: ¡Ayúdanos, por favor! Pedimos un guardia de {p} hace días, pero los humanos suelen olvidar esta aldea.
Maltic's Well#001.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#002.src: Last week, an evil witch found refuge in our old well. Normally this wouldn't be a problem...
Maltic's Well#002.dst: La semana pasada, una bruja malvada se refugió en nuestro viejo pozo. Normalmente no sería un problema...
Maltic's Well#002.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#003.src: But she's lured my child into the well! My only child! He was born in Wynn, that makes him a Wynn citizen!
