Maltic's Well#003.dst: ¡Pero ha atraído a mi hijo al pozo! ¡Mi único hijo! ¡Nació en Wynn, así que es ciudadano de Wynn!
Maltic's Well#003.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#004.src: Please do something! I know {p} isn't of importance to you humans, being a Villager settlement, but...my son!
Maltic's Well#004.dst: ¡Haz algo, por favor! Sé que {p} no os importa a los humanos por ser un pueblo de aldeanos, pero... ¡mi hijo!
Maltic's Well#004.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#005.src: Investigate the old {p} well at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring [{~} Witch's Empty Bottle] to Rynend
Maltic's Well#005.dst: Investiga el viejo pozo de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y lleva [{~} Witch's Empty Bottle] a Rynend

Maltic's Well#006.src: Help me! Someone! The witch is being mean!!
Maltic's Well#006.dst: ¡Socorro! ¡Que alguien me ayude! ¡¡La bruja es mala!!
Maltic's Well#006.speaker: Child

Maltic's Well#007.src: I wondered when they'd send the famous {p} guards. You'll never get me!
Maltic's Well#007.dst: Sabía que mandarían a la famosa guardia de {p}. ¡No me atraparás!
Maltic's Well#007.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#008.src: I don't know why they call me a witch. Magic is everywhere, you know. This one's father made fun of my looks, so I'll turn his son into a Grook!
Maltic's Well#008.dst: No sé por qué me llaman bruja. La magia está por todas partes. Su padre se burló de mi aspecto, ¡así que convertiré a su hijo en un Grook!
Maltic's Well#008.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#009.src: Treat me like a witch, I'll act like one, darn it! You'll have to pass through my dastardly magical defenses to find me!
Maltic's Well#009.dst: ¡Me tratan como a una bruja, pues bruja seré, caramba! ¡Supera mis pérfidas defensas mágicas si quieres hallarme!
Maltic's Well#009.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#010.src: Oh...drat. I never could get that spell right. Well, now you'll have to guess the way, um, you fool! Turn back now, for, uh...
Maltic's Well#010.dst: Oh... rayos. Nunca me salió bien ese hechizo. Bueno, pues adivina el camino, eh, ¡insensato! Da media vuelta, porque, eh...
Maltic's Well#010.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#011.src: ...for if you choose the wrong door, you'll be sent to a beast, a beast most foul! The, um...the Beast-What-Eats-{p}-Guards-For-Brunch!! Totally!
Maltic's Well#011.dst: ...porque si eliges mal la puerta, ¡irás a dar con una bestia vilísima! La, eh... ¡¡la Bestia-Que-Almuerza-Guardias-de-{p}!! ¡En serio!
Maltic's Well#011.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#012.src: Oh...didn't think that'd fool you. You know, I'm really not all that good at magic. I just like wearing pointy hats, and have warts.
Maltic's Well#012.dst: Oh... ya imaginaba que no colaría. ¿Sabes? La magia no se me da nada bien. Solo me gustan los sombreros puntiagudos, y tengo verrugas.
Maltic's Well#012.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#013.src: Maybe if the people of this village weren't so mean to me, I wouldn't have been forced to live here.
Maltic's Well#013.dst: Si la gente de esta aldea no fuera tan cruel conmigo, no me habría visto obligada a vivir aquí.
Maltic's Well#013.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#014.src: I know it's a crime, but his father and the rest of the villagers here hunt me like I'm a rabid dog!
Maltic's Well#014.dst: Sé que es un delito, ¡pero su padre y el resto de aldeanos me cazan como a una perra rabiosa!
Maltic's Well#014.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#015.src: I wasn't really going to turn this boy into a Grook. I doubt I could even make him grow one feather. I mean, watch...
Maltic's Well#015.dst: No iba a convertir al niño en un Grook de verdad. Dudo que le saliera ni una pluma. Mira, fíjate...
Maltic's Well#015.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#017.src: ...oh my gosh it worked???? It worked, I did a spell for once in my miserable life!!
Maltic's Well#017.dst: ...ay madre, ¿¿¿¿funcionó???? ¡¡Funcionó, por una vez en mi mísera vida hice un hechizo!!
Maltic's Well#017.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#018.src: W-Wait, that's not good at all, you're gonna... No! You won't take me out of here alive!
Maltic's Well#018.dst: E-espera, esto es malísimo, vas a... ¡No! ¡No me sacarás de aquí con vida!
Maltic's Well#018.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#019.src: Thank you for saving me from the witch... She was nice at first and made me cookies, but I want to go home now.
Maltic's Well#019.dst: Gracias por salvarme de la bruja... Al principio era amable y me hacía galletas, pero ahora quiero irme a casa.
Maltic's Well#019.speaker: Child

Maltic's Well#020.src: Oh my son! What happened down there? Erh, not a witch, you say?
Maltic's Well#020.dst: ¡Hijo mío! ¿Qué pasó ahí abajo? Eh, ¿que no era una bruja?
Maltic's Well#020.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#021.src: Preposterous! She wore a hat and had warts! I guess it's too late now... Thank you so much for your help.
Maltic's Well#021.dst: ¡Absurdo! ¡Llevaba sombrero y tenía verrugas! Supongo que ya es tarde... Muchísimas gracias por tu ayuda.
Maltic's Well#021.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#022.src: I have very little to offer you as reward... I hope my appreciation will be more than enough!
Maltic's Well#022.dst: Tengo muy poco que ofrecerte como recompensa... ¡Espero que mi gratitud te baste de sobra!
Maltic's Well#022.speaker: Rynend

Master Piece#000.src: Talk to Caissop the artist, in his tent at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Master Piece#000.dst: Habla con Caissop, el artista, en su tienda en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Master Piece#002.src: Oh sorry, I didn't notice you. Did you want an autograph?
Master Piece#002.dst: Oh, perdona, no te había visto. ¿Querías un autógrafo?
Master Piece#002.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#003.src: Wait, no? Don't you know who I am?! It seems like you have no taste in art... I am Caissop, the legendary artist!
Master Piece#003.dst: ¿Cómo que no? ¡¿No sabes quién soy?! Parece que no tienes gusto artístico... ¡Soy Caissop, el artista legendario!
Master Piece#003.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#004.src: Though, since you are not a fan... Perhaps you can help me? I am looking for a new assistant.
Master Piece#004.dst: Aunque, ya que no eres admirador... ¿Quizá puedas ayudarme? Busco un nuevo ayudante.
Master Piece#004.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#005.src: Excellent... I need your help to find three legendary creatures that are hiding in caves around the swamp.
Master Piece#005.dst: Excelente... Necesito que me ayudes a hallar tres criaturas legendarias escondidas en cuevas del pantano.
Master Piece#005.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#006.src: I actually know their location, but unfortunately, I am...blind.
Master Piece#006.dst: Sé dónde están, pero, por desgracia, soy... ciego.
Master Piece#006.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#007.src: For me to do my work I need to imagine them! That's where you come in. I need you to find them and describe them to me!
Master Piece#007.dst: ¡Para trabajar necesito imaginármelas! Ahí entras tú. ¡Necesito que las encuentres y me las describas!
Master Piece#007.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#008.src: Would you turn your back on a blind man?! I need you to give me an accurate description of them! Once you have found one, come back and describe it to me exactly!
Master Piece#008.dst: ¡¿Le darías la espalda a un ciego?! ¡Necesito una descripción exacta de ellas! ¡Cuando encuentres una, vuelve y descríbemela con todo detalle!
Master Piece#008.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#009.src: The first cave is up a hill with tall, thin-leafed flowers. They smell pink to me, and of this I am certain.
Master Piece#009.dst: La primera cueva está en un cerro con flores altas de hojas finas. Me huelen a rosa, de eso estoy seguro.
Master Piece#009.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#010.src: Search for the first mythical creature in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Master Piece#010.dst: Busca la primera criatura mítica en la cueva de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Master Piece#011.src: Report back with the description of the brown, large-snouted creature to Caissop
Master Piece#011.dst: Vuelve y descríbele a Caissop la criatura marrón de gran hocico

Master Piece#012.src: Quick! Describe it to me! Go on!
Master Piece#012.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#013.src: Brown...big-nosed... A Villager Cow, you say!?
Master Piece#013.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#015.src: ...MH, NO, A LITTLE MORE RED!..... YES!
Master Piece#015.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#016.src: Haha! This is WONDERFUL! I'm not going to show it to you before it is finished!
Master Piece#016.dst: ¡Jaja! ¡Esto es MARAVILLOSO! ¡No te lo enseñaré hasta que esté acabado!
Master Piece#016.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#017.src: Savor the ideas! So now, I need you to go to the second cave...
Master Piece#017.dst: ¡Saborea las ideas! Y ahora, ve a la segunda cueva...
Master Piece#017.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#018.src: It is down a road, with short, round-cupped flowers. Those ones smell orange to me!
Master Piece#018.dst: Está junto a un camino, con flores bajas de cáliz redondo. ¡Esas me huelen a naranja!
Master Piece#018.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#019.src: Hurry! I'll finish this animal while you are gone. OH, YES. MUY MACHO.
Master Piece#019.dst: ¡Corre! Acabaré este animal mientras no estás. OH, SÍ. MUY MACHO.
Master Piece#019.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#020.src: Search for the second mythical beast in the cave at [-{~},-{~}]
Master Piece#020.dst: Busca la segunda bestia mítica en la cueva de [-{~},-{~}]

Master Piece#021.src: Report back with the description of the white, big-horned creature to Caissop
Master Piece#021.dst: Vuelve y descríbele a Caissop la criatura blanca de gran cuerno

Master Piece#022.src: You're here! Quick! Don't look at me, describe it!
Master Piece#022.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#023.src: Snow white, a large horn... A Unicorn Sheep, you say?!
Master Piece#023.dst: Blanca como la nieve, un gran cuerno... ¿¡Una Oveja Unicornio!?
Master Piece#023.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#024.src: ...OH YES, THE WOOL IS REAL... MORE SWIPING... OH YES, BIEN!
Master Piece#024.dst: ...OH SÍ, LA LANA ES REAL... MÁS TRAZOS... ¡OH SÍ, BIEN!
Master Piece#024.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#025.src: ... THIS IS UNIQUE, REMARKABLE, YES. SUPERNATURAL!
Master Piece#025.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#026.src: The last creature! Red-smelling flowers, prickly thorns, hurry, mucho inspired!
Master Piece#026.dst: ¡La última! Flores con olor a rojo, espinas, corre, ¡muy inspirado!
Master Piece#026.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#027.src: ... OH, NO, NO. YES! MORE COLOUR, MORE PAINT! I'M OUT OF RED!
Master Piece#027.dst: ... OH, NO, NO. ¡SÍ! ¡MÁS COLOR, MÁS PINTURA! ¡SE ME ACABÓ EL ROJO!
Master Piece#027.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#028.src: I'LL JUST USE MY BLOOD! OH! YES! ...INSPIRED! REMARKABLE! Huh? Why are you still here? Go! I need that last description!
Master Piece#028.dst: ¡USARÉ MI PROPIA SANGRE! ¡OH! ¡SÍ! ...¡INSPIRADO! ¡EXTRAORDINARIO! ¿Eh? ¿Sigues aquí? ¡Ve! ¡Necesito esa última descripción!
Master Piece#028.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#029.src: Search for the third and last mythical animal in the cave at [-{~},-{~}]
Master Piece#029.dst: Busca el tercer y último animal mítico en la cueva de [-{~},-{~}]

Master Piece#030.src: Report back with the description of the pink, flying creature to Caissop
Master Piece#030.dst: Vuelve y descríbele a Caissop la criatura rosa voladora

Master Piece#031.src: You're finally back! I just finished the last one. Go! Describe it!
Master Piece#031.dst: ¡Por fin vuelves! Acabo de terminar el último. ¡Venga! ¡Descríbela!
Master Piece#031.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#034.src: ...OH YES, WINGS! EYES FROM HEAVEN! OH, YES.
Master Piece#034.dst: ...¡OH SÍ, ALAS! ¡OJOS DEL CIELO! OH, SÍ.
Master Piece#034.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#035.src: Och, Perfect. The final touch and, done! You were so inspiring that I made two! One for you, and one for me!
Master Piece#035.dst: Oh, perfecto. El último toque y, ¡listo! ¡Me inspiraste tanto que hice dos! ¡Uno para ti y otro para mí!
Master Piece#035.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#036.src: You might want to hold onto that, big-town upper class Villagers pay through the roof for Caissop's work!
Master Piece#036.dst: Más te vale guardarlo: ¡los aldeanos ricos de las grandes ciudades pagan un dineral por la obra de Caissop!
Master Piece#036.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#037.src: Thank you for your assistance, what a rush! Good luck on your Gavel adventure!
Master Piece#037.dst: ¡Gracias por tu ayuda, qué subidón! ¡Suerte en tu aventura por Gavel!
Master Piece#037.speaker: Caissop

Meaningful Holiday#000.src: If you want to help someone else this year, our boss Nick is already out in the thick of it.

Meaningful Holiday#002.src: I'm sorry but everyfin is sold out, everyone is preparing for Craftmas.

Meaningful Holiday#003.src: I might have something on the attic, if you find anyfin, you can 'ave it. I know how difficult it gets.

Meaningful Holiday#004.src: Did ye find anyfin in the attic?

Meaningful Holiday#005.src: Looks like I'm fresh outta food. Barely got enough to feed meself.

Meaningful Holiday#006.src: Oh, also, can you give this blanket to Margaret while you're down in the tunnel? Just follow the road behind me.

Meaningful Holiday#008.src: Oh, please don't move me along. I have no where else to go!

Meaningful Holiday#009.src: Heya! I just finished decorating this craftmas tree!

Meaningful Holiday#011.src: I've been wrapping presents all week long.

Meaningful Holiday#012.src: My hands are starting to hurt!

Meaningful Holiday#013.src: Get out before I call the guards!

Meaningful Holiday#014.src: Stealing is not in the Craftmas spirit... But I think I can make this work.

Meaningful Holiday#015.src: My siblings and I take care of people at Craftmas. My area is the {p} desert. I guess you could call me Sanda Claus, heh.

Meaningful Holiday#017.src: Hello, dear. My name is Haily. Nice to meet you.
Meaningful Holiday#017.dst: Hola, cariño. Me llamo Haily. Encantada de conocerte.
Meaningful Holiday#017.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#018.src: This is the {p} Charity center. We're looking for volunteers to help the homeless this year.
Meaningful Holiday#018.dst: Este es el centro benéfico de {p}. Buscamos voluntarios para ayudar a los sin techo este año.
Meaningful Holiday#018.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#019.src: If you want to help someone else this year, our boss Nick is already in the thick of it.
Meaningful Holiday#019.dst: Si quieres ayudar a alguien este año, nuestro jefe Nick ya está metido de lleno.
Meaningful Holiday#019.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#020.src: He's a really special man. I'll write his location down for you in your book. Oh, remember this is charity work, so hopefully gratitude is a good enough reward for you.
Meaningful Holiday#020.dst: Es un hombre muy especial. Te apuntaré dónde está en tu libro. Ah, recuerda que esto es trabajo benéfico, así que espero que la gratitud te baste como recompensa.
Meaningful Holiday#020.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#021.src: Go talk to Haily's friend Nick at the poor area.
Meaningful Holiday#021.dst: Ve a hablar con Nick, el amigo de Haily, en el barrio pobre.

Meaningful Holiday#022.src: Oh. Oh... Oh dear. There's more people here than ever.
Meaningful Holiday#022.dst: Oh. Oh... Ay, madre. Hay más gente aquí que nunca.
Meaningful Holiday#022.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#023.src: Hm, are you just passing through? Oh! A volunteer!
Meaningful Holiday#023.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#024.src: You're the only one this year. Things have really changed. We used to have hundreds of volunteers this time of year.
Meaningful Holiday#024.dst: Eres el único este año. Las cosas han cambiado mucho. Antes teníamos cientos de voluntarios por estas fechas.
Meaningful Holiday#024.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#025.src: The people here are starving. There's no two ways about it.
Meaningful Holiday#025.dst: La gente de aquí se muere de hambre. No hay otra forma de decirlo.
Meaningful Holiday#025.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#026.src: I don't know how we're going to feed everyone this year.
Meaningful Holiday#026.dst: No sé cómo vamos a dar de comer a todos este año.
Meaningful Holiday#026.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#027.src: The man who runs the budget store used to be homeless... He knows the struggles they face.
Meaningful Holiday#027.dst: El hombre de la tienda barata también fue un sin techo... Sabe por lo que pasan.
Meaningful Holiday#027.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#028.src: I'll look after things here. Can you go to the budget store? It's really close. Any food is gratefully received.
Meaningful Holiday#028.dst: Yo me ocupo de todo aquí. ¿Puedes ir a la tienda barata? Está muy cerca. Cualquier comida se agradece.
Meaningful Holiday#028.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#029.src: Go to the budget store and ask for food.
Meaningful Holiday#029.dst: Ve a la tienda barata y pide comida.

Meaningful Holiday#031.src: What can I do fer ye?
Meaningful Holiday#031.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#033.src: I'm sorry but everyfin is sold out, everyone is preparing for Craftmas lad.
Meaningful Holiday#033.dst: Lo siento, pero to' está vendido; toos andan preparando Craftmas, chaval.
Meaningful Holiday#033.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#034.src: I might have something in the attic, if you find anyfin, you can 'ave it. I know how difficult it gets.
Meaningful Holiday#034.dst: Igual queda algo en el desván; si encuentras algo, es tuyo. Sé lo duro que se pone.
Meaningful Holiday#034.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#035.src: Look for food on the second floor.
Meaningful Holiday#035.dst: Busca comida en la segunda planta.

Meaningful Holiday#036.src: Hm... This apple has seen betta days...
Meaningful Holiday#036.dst: Hm... Esta manzana ya está pasada...
Meaningful Holiday#036.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#037.src: Looks like i'm fresh outta food. Barely got enough to feed myself.
Meaningful Holiday#037.dst: Parece que me he quedado sin comida. Apenas tengo pa' mí.
Meaningful Holiday#037.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#038.src: I wish I had something to give this year. I guess people are having a feast in the city.
Meaningful Holiday#038.dst: Ojalá tuviera algo que dar este año. Supongo que en la ciudad andan de banquete.
Meaningful Holiday#038.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#039.src: Return to Nick and tell him the bad news.
Meaningful Holiday#039.dst: Vuelve con Nick y dale las malas noticias.

Meaningful Holiday#041.src: I see. I was counting on him.
Meaningful Holiday#041.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#042.src: I can't be too upset. He donates so much the rest of the year.
Meaningful Holiday#042.dst: No puedo enfadarme. Dona muchísimo el resto del año.
Meaningful Holiday#042.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#043.src: We may have to ask the farmers directly...
Meaningful Holiday#043.dst: Puede que tengamos que pedírselo a los granjeros...
Meaningful Holiday#043.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#044.src: I know someone in {p} with a kind heart.
Meaningful Holiday#044.dst: Conozco a alguien en {p} de buen corazón.
Meaningful Holiday#044.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#045.src: We've fallen out before, seems he didn't understand what a donation was.
Meaningful Holiday#045.dst: Ya nos peleamos una vez; parece que no entendía qué era una donación.
Meaningful Holiday#045.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#046.src: There is a shortcut south from here, in a cave. Go through there.
Meaningful Holiday#046.dst: Al sur de aquí hay un atajo, en una cueva. Pasa por ahí.
Meaningful Holiday#046.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#047.src: Oh, also, could you give this blanket to Margaret while you're down in the tunnel? Just follow the road behind me.
Meaningful Holiday#047.dst: Ah, y ¿podrías darle esta manta a Margaret cuando pases por el túnel? Sigue el camino que hay detrás de mí.
Meaningful Holiday#047.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#048.src: Bring the blanket to the woman in the tunnel south of Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#048.dst: Lleva la manta a la mujer del túnel al sur de Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#049.src: Oh, please don't move me along. I have nowhere else to go!
Meaningful Holiday#049.dst: Ay, por favor, no me eches de aquí. ¡No tengo adónde ir!
Meaningful Holiday#049.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#050.src: Oh, a blanket for me? How sweet... From Nick, you say? He's always so kind... Thank you, as well.
Meaningful Holiday#050.dst: Oh, ¿una manta para mí? Qué detalle... ¿De parte de Nick, dices? Siempre tan amable... Gracias a ti también.
Meaningful Holiday#050.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#051.src: If you want to get to {p} quickly, just keep going through this tunnel. Some unfriendly homeless folks live around here too, so be careful. It's so sad, their state.
Meaningful Holiday#051.dst: Si quieres llegar rápido a {p}, sigue por este túnel. Por aquí también viven algunos sin techo poco amistosos, así que ten cuidado. Da mucha pena verlos así.
Meaningful Holiday#051.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#052.src: Continue the tunnel and find Nick's friend.
Meaningful Holiday#052.dst: Sigue por el túnel y encuentra al amigo de Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#053.src: Welcome to my farm! Looking to buy some of my fresh crops?
Meaningful Holiday#053.dst: ¡Bienvenido a mi granja! ¿Buscas comprar mis cultivos frescos?
Meaningful Holiday#053.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#054.src: Well, it seems you're out of luck. I've just sold the last of them from this harvest.
Meaningful Holiday#054.dst: Vaya, parece que no hay suerte. Acabo de vender lo último de esta cosecha.
Meaningful Holiday#054.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#055.src: It was all for that big Craftmas feast happening in {p}. Wish I could help you out, but I'm fresh out of food to sell you.
Meaningful Holiday#055.dst: Todo fue para ese gran banquete de Craftmas que hay en {p}. Ojalá pudiera ayudarte, pero no me queda comida que venderte.
Meaningful Holiday#055.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#056.src: Wait, I bet Nick sent you, didn't he? Well, he's coming up on your left. Remind him that this isn't a charity.
Meaningful Holiday#056.dst: Espera, te envía Nick, ¿no? Mira, viene por tu izquierda. Recuérdale que esto no es una beneficencia.
Meaningful Holiday#056.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#058.src: We can't get any food? We're running out of options here...
Meaningful Holiday#058.dst: ¿No conseguimos nada de comida? Se nos acaban las opciones...
Meaningful Holiday#058.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#059.src: Well, there's only one person left that we can appeal to at this time of year.
Meaningful Holiday#059.dst: Bueno, en esta época solo queda una persona a la que recurrir.
Meaningful Holiday#059.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#061.src: Explore the area and look for Santa.
Meaningful Holiday#061.dst: Explora la zona y busca a Santa.

Meaningful Holiday#062.src: Heya! I just finished decorating this christmas tree!
Meaningful Holiday#062.dst: ¡Hola! ¡Acabo de terminar de decorar este árbol de Craftmas!
Meaningful Holiday#062.speaker: Elvura

Meaningful Holiday#064.src: He is right down the stairs to the right.
Meaningful Holiday#064.dst: Está escaleras abajo, a la derecha.
Meaningful Holiday#064.speaker: Elvura

Meaningful Holiday#065.src: Enter Santa's home and speak to him.
Meaningful Holiday#065.dst: Entra en la casa de Santa y habla con él.

Meaningful Holiday#067.src: The council all have their areas to care for. Yours is {p}. How you care for it is your responsibility.
Meaningful Holiday#067.dst: Cada miembro del consejo tiene su zona que cuidar. La tuya es {p}. Cómo la cuides es tu responsabilidad.
Meaningful Holiday#067.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#068.src: There's five times more homeless and hungry than last year!
Meaningful Holiday#068.dst: ¡Hay cinco veces más sin techo y hambrientos que el año pasado!
Meaningful Holiday#068.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#069.src: Nick, I know times are tough there, but-
Meaningful Holiday#069.dst: Nick, sé que allí es duro, pero-
Meaningful Holiday#069.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#070.src: Tough?! It's impossible! What happened to people's good will? I had one volunteer this year! ONE!
Meaningful Holiday#070.dst: ¡¿Duro?! ¡Es imposible! ¿Qué fue de la buena voluntad de la gente? ¡Este año tuve un voluntario! ¡UNO!
Meaningful Holiday#070.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#071.src: I'm sorry Nick. You could go to {p} and ask there, they have a feast big enough to feed an army!
Meaningful Holiday#071.dst: Lo siento, Nick. Podrías ir a {p} y preguntar allí; ¡tienen un banquete capaz de alimentar a un ejército!
Meaningful Holiday#071.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#072.src: Hmmm... Oh, sorry. I miscalculated your journey here. Good to see you.
Meaningful Holiday#072.dst: Mmm... Ah, perdona. Calculé mal tu viaje hasta aquí. Me alegro de verte.
Meaningful Holiday#072.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#073.src: I suppose you heard Santa and I. Our next location is {p}.
Meaningful Holiday#073.dst: Supongo que nos has oído a Santa y a mí. Nuestra próxima parada es {p}.
Meaningful Holiday#073.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#074.src: Alright, that's settled then. Leave through the fireplace behind me, it will bring you directly to {p}. Good luck, Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#074.dst: Muy bien, asunto resuelto. Sal por la chimenea que hay detrás de mí; te llevará directo a {p}. Buena suerte, Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#074.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#075.src: Leave through the portal behind Santa.
Meaningful Holiday#075.dst: Sal por el portal que hay detrás de Santa.

Meaningful Holiday#076.dst: Entra en el salón de baile.

Meaningful Holiday#077.src: Wow. The people here live in such grandure. I wonder if they know people are starving to the east.
Meaningful Holiday#077.dst: Vaya. Qué lujo el de esta gente. Me pregunto si saben que al este hay gente pasando hambre.
Meaningful Holiday#077.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#078.src: Let's ask around for some donations.
Meaningful Holiday#078.dst: Vamos a pedir donaciones por ahí.
Meaningful Holiday#078.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#079.src: More importantly, let's hope they'll share a trifle of food.
Meaningful Holiday#079.dst: Y lo más importante: ojalá compartan una pizca de comida.
Meaningful Holiday#079.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#082.dst: Este evento es solo por invitación.
Meaningful Holiday#082.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#083.src: You aren't even in a formal dress.
Meaningful Holiday#083.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#085.src: Food? You want food? Does this look like a charity to you?
Meaningful Holiday#085.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#086.src: Of course not! We have an obligation to feed our partygoers, not some poor scraps of men in the desert!
Meaningful Holiday#086.dst: ¡Claro que no! Debemos alimentar a nuestros invitados, no a unos pobres desgraciados del desierto.
Meaningful Holiday#086.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#087.src: Now get out of here before I call the security golems. And don't even think of stealing from the kitchen!
Meaningful Holiday#087.dst: Ahora largaos de aquí antes de que llame a los gólems de seguridad. ¡Y ni se os ocurra robar en la cocina!
Meaningful Holiday#087.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#088.src: Steal the food from the kitchen and talk to Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#088.dst: Roba la comida de la cocina y habla con Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#089.src: Were you able to get any food?
Meaningful Holiday#089.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#090.src: You do?! I didn't expect them to be so generous, a whole crate?
Meaningful Holiday#090.dst: ¡¿Sí?! No esperaba tanta generosidad, ¿una caja entera?
Meaningful Holiday#090.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#093.src: Stealing is not in the christmas spirit... But I think I can make this work.
Meaningful Holiday#093.dst: Robar no va con el espíritu de Craftmas... Pero creo que puedo sacarle partido.
Meaningful Holiday#093.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#094.src: Go on ahead. I have a plan. Don't worry, I'll return all this food.
Meaningful Holiday#094.dst: Adelántate. Tengo un plan. Tranquilo, devolveré toda esta comida.
Meaningful Holiday#094.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#097.src: I know you are hungry. Because I am too.
Meaningful Holiday#097.dst: Sé que tenéis hambre. Yo también.
Meaningful Holiday#097.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#098.src: But your dinner will not be served tonight.
Meaningful Holiday#098.dst: Pero esta noche no se servirá vuestra cena.
Meaningful Holiday#098.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#099.src: There will be no Craftmas feast this year!
Meaningful Holiday#099.dst: ¡Este año no habrá banquete de Craftmas!
Meaningful Holiday#099.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#101.src: The food on the table isn't enough to feed everyone here!
Meaningful Holiday#101.dst: ¡La comida de la mesa no basta para todos los que estamos aquí!
Meaningful Holiday#101.speaker: Guest

Meaningful Holiday#102.src: This one night, this one missed meal.
Meaningful Holiday#102.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#103.src: This is how thousands of people live every day.
Meaningful Holiday#103.dst: Así viven miles de personas cada día.
Meaningful Holiday#103.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#104.src: Hungry, wondering when the food will be available.
Meaningful Holiday#104.dst: Con hambre, sin saber cuándo habrá comida.
Meaningful Holiday#104.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#105.src: And while you sit there with empty stomachs be thankful for what you have. Spare a thought for those who have not.
Meaningful Holiday#105.dst: Y mientras estáis ahí sentados con el estómago vacío, agradeced lo que tenéis. Pensad en los que no tienen nada.
Meaningful Holiday#105.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#106.src: Hundreds of men, women and children, just like you, will not eat tonight, at all.
Meaningful Holiday#106.dst: Cientos de hombres, mujeres y niños, igual que vosotros, no comerán nada esta noche.
Meaningful Holiday#106.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#107.src: All because this enormous feast was not enough. {p} bought all the food, cheap or expensive.
Meaningful Holiday#107.dst: Y todo porque este enorme banquete no era suficiente. {p} compró toda la comida, barata o cara.
Meaningful Holiday#107.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#108.src: I'm here to remind you the real meaning of this day. To think of others..
Meaningful Holiday#108.dst: Vengo a recordaros el verdadero sentido de este día. Pensar en los demás..
Meaningful Holiday#108.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#109.src: I will return your meal tonight, but while you eat it... I want you to remember every empty mouth it could have fed.
Meaningful Holiday#109.dst: Os devolveré vuestra cena esta noche, pero mientras la coméis... quiero que recordéis cada boca vacía que podría haber alimentado.
Meaningful Holiday#109.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#110.src: Share what you have, be thankful for what you are given.
Meaningful Holiday#110.dst: Compartid lo que tenéis, agradeced lo que se os da.
Meaningful Holiday#110.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#112.src: Well, looks like you came through yet again Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#112.dst: Vaya, parece que lo has vuelto a conseguir, Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#113.src: I came to see if I could help out. But it looks like you've done it.
Meaningful Holiday#113.dst: Vine a ver si podía echar una mano. Pero parece que ya lo has hecho.
Meaningful Holiday#113.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#114.src: Well, I guess there is only one thing left to do to complete this scene.
Meaningful Holiday#114.dst: Bueno, supongo que solo queda una cosa para completar esta escena.
Meaningful Holiday#114.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#115.src: Hope you all have a merry craftmas. Ho-ho!
Meaningful Holiday#115.dst: Espero que paséis un feliz Craftmas. ¡Jo, jo!
Meaningful Holiday#115.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#117.src: It looks like my little speech brought the rich back down to earth.
Meaningful Holiday#117.dst: Parece que mi pequeño discurso bajó a los ricos a la tierra.
Meaningful Holiday#117.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#118.src: They gave us half of their feast. Can you believe they still had leftovers?
Meaningful Holiday#118.dst: Nos dieron la mitad de su banquete. ¿Te crees que aún les sobró?
Meaningful Holiday#118.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#119.src: All of that food, going straight to waste.
Meaningful Holiday#119.dst: Toda esa comida, directa a la basura.
Meaningful Holiday#119.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#120.src: They have no idea what they have, compared to these poor folks.
Meaningful Holiday#120.dst: No tienen ni idea de lo que tienen, comparados con esta pobre gente.
Meaningful Holiday#120.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#121.src: You might be wondering why I know Santa. Well, he's my brother.
Meaningful Holiday#121.dst: Quizá te preguntes por qué conozco a Santa. Pues es mi hermano.
Meaningful Holiday#121.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#122.src: Me and my siblings take care of people at Craftmas. My area is the {p} desert. I guess you could call me Sanda Claus, heh.
Meaningful Holiday#122.dst: Mis hermanos y yo cuidamos de la gente en Craftmas. Mi zona es el desierto de {p}. Supongo que puedes llamarme Santa Arena, je.
Meaningful Holiday#122.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#123.src: It's people like you that keep the real meaning of this holiday alive. It gets harder every year as the meaning is distorted. Here is a personal gift from me. Thank you.
Meaningful Holiday#123.dst: Es gente como tú la que mantiene vivo el verdadero sentido de estas fiestas. Cada año cuesta más, porque el sentido se distorsiona. Aquí tienes un regalo personal de mi parte. Gracias.
Meaningful Holiday#123.speaker: Nick

Memory Paranoia#001.src: Oh, a human? If I could beg your pardon a moment...could I talk to you about the mansion here?
Memory Paranoia#001.dst: ¿Oh, un humano? Si me permites un momento... ¿podría hablarte de la mansión de aquí?
Memory Paranoia#001.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#002.src: It was not always so dilapidated. It once stood tall, a monument to the family of Caritat, who constructed it from the ground up.
Memory Paranoia#002.dst: No siempre estuvo tan ruinosa. Antaño se alzaba imponente, un monumento a la familia Caritat, que la levantó desde los cimientos.
Memory Paranoia#002.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#003.src: The Caritats were unlike any other. Uncharacteristically selfless and helpful. Their wealth was everyone’s wealth as far as they were concerned.
Memory Paranoia#003.dst: Los Caritat no eran como los demás. Generosos y serviciales, algo insólito en su clase. Para ellos, su riqueza era la riqueza de todos.
Memory Paranoia#003.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#004.src: But... Eventually... Erm, we’re not entirely sure what happened, only rumours have surfaced over the years, but...things took a turn, shall we say.
Memory Paranoia#004.dst: Pero... con el tiempo... Ejem, no sabemos bien qué pasó, con los años solo han corrido rumores, pero... la cosa cambió, por decirlo así.
Memory Paranoia#004.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#005.src: Because, aah...how shall I put this... One day they were all...discovered dead. Murdered. By each other.
Memory Paranoia#005.dst: Porque, aah... cómo lo diría... Un día aparecieron todos... muertos. Asesinados. Entre ellos.
Memory Paranoia#005.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#006.src: I am the last remaining descendant, Atisun Caritat. I was the only survivor of the... incident. I was only an infant when I was found by a passerby.
Memory Paranoia#006.dst: Soy el último descendiente, Atisun Caritat. Fui el único superviviente de aquel... incidente. Era un bebé cuando me encontró un transeúnte.
Memory Paranoia#006.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#007.src: Since, erm...since there was no one alive to report the incident, it wasn't discovered until days later when a traveller passing by took notice of the mansion.
Memory Paranoia#007.dst: Como, ejem... como no quedaba nadie vivo para dar aviso, no se descubrió hasta días después, cuando un viajero de paso se fijó en la mansión.
Memory Paranoia#007.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#008.src: I do not believe that my family simply went mad, but I do not know what happened. I want to know the truth. I think this mansion still holds the answers I'm looking for.
Memory Paranoia#008.dst: No creo que mi familia enloqueciera sin más, pero no sé qué ocurrió. Quiero saber la verdad. Creo que esta mansión aún guarda las respuestas que busco.
Memory Paranoia#008.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#009.src: Yet, I am...scared of this place. It is the ruins of the life I should have had. The spirits of the dead are still there...cursed. I need someone else to uncover my heritage.
Memory Paranoia#009.dst: Y aun así... este lugar me da miedo. Son las ruinas de la vida que debí tener. Los espíritus de los muertos siguen ahí... malditos. Necesito que otro descubra mi origen.
Memory Paranoia#009.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#010.src: Don't you worry, like my ancestors, I'm a generous man. If you help me, I will reward you handsomely. All you have to do, is go in there and find answers. I'm sure the past won't haunt us both.
Memory Paranoia#010.dst: No te preocupes: como mis antepasados, soy generoso. Si me ayudas, te pagaré bien. Solo tienes que entrar y buscar respuestas. Seguro que el pasado no nos perseguirá a ambos.
Memory Paranoia#010.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#012.src: Learn the story of the Caritat Family.
Memory Paranoia#012.dst: Descubre la historia de la familia Caritat.

Memory Paranoia#013.src: This check is made out to a charity for a lot of emeralds.
Memory Paranoia#013.dst: Este cheque es para una obra benéfica, por muchas esmeraldas.
Memory Paranoia#013.speaker: Check

Memory Paranoia#014.src: It's so nice that the Caritats are donating all of these supplies to the struggling people in the forest.
Memory Paranoia#014.dst: Qué bonito que los Caritat donen todos estos suministros a la gente que lo pasa mal en el bosque.
Memory Paranoia#014.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#015.src: He seems to be very engrossed in his writing.
Memory Paranoia#015.dst: Parece muy absorto en lo que escribe.
Memory Paranoia#015.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#016.src: I've heard about weird things happening around the house. People are saying the mansion might be haunted!
Memory Paranoia#016.dst: He oído que pasan cosas raras por la casa. ¡Dicen que la mansión podría estar encantada!
Memory Paranoia#016.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#017.src: Ghosts? Preposterous! This mansion isn't haunted, don't believe those silly rumors!
Memory Paranoia#017.dst: ¿Fantasmas? ¡Qué disparate! Esta mansión no está encantada, ¡no te creas esos rumores tontos!
Memory Paranoia#017.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#019.src: Mister Caritat is always writing in that book, always so intensely. I wonder what he is writing.
Memory Paranoia#019.dst: El señor Caritat siempre está escribiendo en ese libro, y con qué intensidad. ¿Qué escribirá?
Memory Paranoia#019.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#020.src: He won't even tell me what he's writing.
Memory Paranoia#020.dst: Ni a mí me dice qué escribe.
Memory Paranoia#020.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#021.src: I'll bet he's writing insults about us. He can't be as nice as he appears.
Memory Paranoia#021.dst: Seguro que escribe pestes de nosotros. No será tan bueno como parece.
Memory Paranoia#021.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#022.src: I accidentally dropped my Library Key down the drain, do you think my dad will be angry?
Memory Paranoia#022.dst: Se me cayó sin querer la Library Key por el desagüe, ¿crees que mi padre se enfadará?
Memory Paranoia#022.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#023.src: No, Mister Caritat is very forgiving. I doubt he'd be upset, especially if it was an accident.
Memory Paranoia#023.dst: No, el señor Caritat es muy indulgente. Dudo que se enfade, y menos si fue un accidente.
Memory Paranoia#023.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#024.src: I still want to find the key though, do you know where I should look?
Memory Paranoia#024.dst: Aun así quiero recuperar la llave, ¿dónde busco?
Memory Paranoia#024.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#025.src: Well, the drainage pipes have probably taken the key to the basement in the southeast corner of the mansion by now, that's most likely where it is.
Memory Paranoia#025.dst: Bueno, a estas alturas las cañerías habrán llevado la llave al sótano del rincón sureste de la mansión; lo más probable es que esté ahí.
Memory Paranoia#025.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#026.src: Enter the basement and recover the Library Key.
Memory Paranoia#026.dst: Entra en el sótano y recupera la Library Key.

Memory Paranoia#028.src: Enter the hole in the wall.
Memory Paranoia#028.dst: Entra por el agujero de la pared.

Memory Paranoia#029.src: Timmy, is something bothering you? You have been acting so weird lately.
Memory Paranoia#029.dst: Timmy, ¿te preocupa algo? Últimamente estás rarísimo.
Memory Paranoia#029.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#030.src: You cannot command me, mortal! You and all of your inferior species will bow to the darkness!
Memory Paranoia#030.dst: ¡No puedes darme órdenes, mortal! ¡Tú y toda tu especie inferior os postraréis ante la oscuridad!
Memory Paranoia#030.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#031.src: I don't know what game you are playing, Timmy. But I will not stand for it any longer, snap out of it!
Memory Paranoia#031.dst: No sé a qué juegas, Timmy. Pero no pienso tolerarlo más, ¡vuelve en ti de una vez!
Memory Paranoia#031.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#032.src: You shall pay for your insolence, mortal!
Memory Paranoia#032.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#033.src: Dark magic? What foul books have you been reading? And what's that in your hand?
Memory Paranoia#033.dst: ¿Magia oscura? ¿Qué libros inmundos has estado leyendo? ¿Y qué llevas en la mano?
Memory Paranoia#033.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#034.src: Casting spells with a black spoon? I'm going to get rid of this foul thing!
Memory Paranoia#034.dst: ¿Hechizos con una cuchara negra? ¡Me deshago de esa inmundicia!
Memory Paranoia#034.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#035.src: That is an item beyond you, mortal. Give it back to me this instant!
Memory Paranoia#035.dst: Ese objeto te supera, mortal. ¡Devuélvemelo ahora mismo!
Memory Paranoia#035.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#036.src: Return the spoon to the Kitchen.
Memory Paranoia#036.dst: Devuelve la cuchara a la cocina.

Memory Paranoia#037.dst: Escucha el anuncio del señor Caritat.

Memory Paranoia#038.src: Attention, attention everyone! I have an announcement I'd like to make!
Memory Paranoia#038.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#039.src: My son, Timothy, has just turned eighteen today.
Memory Paranoia#039.dst: Mi hijo Timothy cumple hoy dieciocho años.
Memory Paranoia#039.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#040.src: Now, there have been a few slight hiccups over the years, but we've made it through mostly in one piece.
Memory Paranoia#040.dst: Ha habido algún que otro tropiezo con los años, pero hemos salido casi ilesos.
Memory Paranoia#040.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#041.src: And I'd like to say, I'm very proud of him. To Timothy, a new man!
Memory Paranoia#041.dst: Y quiero decirlo: estoy muy orgulloso. ¡Por Timothy, todo un hombre!
Memory Paranoia#041.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#042.src: Thank you very much, Dad, and everyone here. Here's to more years of health-
Memory Paranoia#042.dst: Gracias, papá, y a todos. Brindo por muchos años de salud-
Memory Paranoia#042.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#043.src: Please, everyone stay calm. I'm sure it's just the cooks spilling something...
Memory Paranoia#043.dst: Calma todos, por favor. Seguro que los cocineros han tirado algo...
Memory Paranoia#043.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#045.src: Oh my god... what is that thing?!
Memory Paranoia#045.speaker: Baker

Memory Paranoia#046.src: Everyone out, now! We can't fight these things!
Memory Paranoia#046.dst: ¡Todos fuera, ya! ¡No podemos con esas cosas!
Memory Paranoia#046.speaker: Chef

Memory Paranoia#048.src: Speak to people who haven't fled from the disaster.
Memory Paranoia#048.dst: Habla con quienes no han huido del desastre.

Memory Paranoia#049.src: My god...what is wrong with this place? No matter what I do, what I try...
Memory Paranoia#049.dst: Dios mío... ¿qué pasa aquí? Haga lo que haga, pruebe lo que pruebe...
Memory Paranoia#049.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#050.src: How was any of that even possible? What are we going to tell their families?
Memory Paranoia#050.dst: ¿Cómo ha podido pasar algo así? ¿Qué les decimos a sus familias?
Memory Paranoia#050.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#051.src: ...Timothy, I'm going to ask you something, and I need you to answer me honestly. Were you...were you responsible for this?
Memory Paranoia#051.dst: ...Timothy, voy a preguntarte algo y necesito que me respondas con sinceridad. ¿Fuiste tú...? ¿Fuiste tú el responsable de esto?
Memory Paranoia#051.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#052.src: No, of course not! I overcame that years ago, you know that, I can't believe you still suspect me of-
Memory Paranoia#052.dst: ¡No, claro que no! Superé eso hace años, lo sabes, no me creo que aún sospeches de-
Memory Paranoia#052.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#053.src: Ah, sir, we did find something rather unusual in the kitchen that might interest you? Maybe?
Memory Paranoia#053.dst: Ah, señor, sí que hallamos algo bastante insólito en la cocina, ¿quizá le interese? ¿Tal vez?
Memory Paranoia#053.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#054.src: What- Out with it! What did you find?! Please, please tell me I'm wrong!!
Memory Paranoia#054.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#055.src: We found this charred-looking black spoon. I've worked here for years, and I've never seen any spoons of this style in the mansion.
Memory Paranoia#055.dst: Hallamos esta cuchara negra, como chamuscada. Llevo años trabajando aquí y nunca he visto cucharas así en la mansión.
Memory Paranoia#055.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#056.src: Wait, that spoon? I remember sneaking into your study that one time to get it, but how did it survive the fire?
Memory Paranoia#056.dst: Espera, ¿esa cuchara? Recuerdo haberme colado en tu despacho para cogerla, pero ¿cómo sobrevivió al fuego?
Memory Paranoia#056.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#057.src: Wait, you got it from my STUDY?! You...you idiot! Do you have any idea what you stupidly, yet inadvertently have done?! You must NEVER go in my study!!
Memory Paranoia#057.dst: Espera, ¿¡la sacaste de mi DESPACHO!? ¡Serás idiota! ¿¡Tienes idea de la estupidez que has cometido sin querer!? ¡¡JAMÁS entres en mi despacho!!
Memory Paranoia#057.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#061.src: Speak with the Possessed Mr. Caritat.
Memory Paranoia#061.dst: Habla con el señor Caritat poseído.

Memory Paranoia#062.src: IT WHICH STARTED THE WAR SHALL RISE ONCE MORE. FROM THE REALM OF SHADOWS, DECEIT AND PAIN.
Memory Paranoia#062.dst: LO QUE INICIÓ LA GUERRA SE ALZARÁ DE NUEVO. DESDE EL REINO DE SOMBRAS, ENGAÑO Y DOLOR.
Memory Paranoia#062.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#063.src: FOREVER TRAPPED, FROM WHENCE IT CAME. THROUGH THE WEAK POINT BETWEEN REALMS IT. WILL. RISE. AGAIN!
Memory Paranoia#063.dst: ATRAPADO PARA SIEMPRE ALLÍ DE DONDE VINO. POR EL PUNTO DÉBIL ENTRE REINOS ¡SE. ALZARÁ. DE. NUEVO!
Memory Paranoia#063.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#065.src: Bring the key to Timmy's bedroom.
Memory Paranoia#065.dst: Lleva la llave al dormitorio de Timmy.

Memory Paranoia#066.dst: Entra en el dormitorio de Timmy.

Memory Paranoia#068.src: Bring the key to the Master Bedroom.
Memory Paranoia#068.dst: Lleva la llave al dormitorio principal.

Memory Paranoia#073.src: FROM THE SOILS OF DOOM THE SERVANT LAID
Memory Paranoia#073.dst: DE LAS TIERRAS DE PERDICIÓN QUE EL SIERVO SEMBRÓ
Memory Paranoia#073.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#074.src: BREAK THROUGH THE REALMS TO THE LAND OF TRADE.
Memory Paranoia#074.dst: IRRUMPE POR LOS REINOS HASTA LA TIERRA DEL COMERCIO.
Memory Paranoia#074.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#075.src: CORRUPT THE WORLD WITH SEEDS OF PAIN
Memory Paranoia#075.dst: CORROMPE EL MUNDO CON SEMILLAS DE DOLOR
Memory Paranoia#075.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#078.src: Escape the flaming mansion through the back door.
Memory Paranoia#078.dst: Escapa de la mansión en llamas por la puerta trasera.

Memory Paranoia#079.dst: Recorre el sótano de los Caritat.

Memory Paranoia#081.src: No, no! I said three feet left, you absolute...
Memory Paranoia#081.dst: ¡No, no! ¡Dije un metro a la izquierda, pedazo de...!
Memory Paranoia#081.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#082.src: Mr. Caritat! What are you doing?!
Memory Paranoia#082.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#083.src: What are you doing here, Elf? You need proper equipment to be on this site-
Memory Paranoia#083.dst: ¿Qué haces aquí, elfa? Hace falta equipo adecuado para estar en esta obra-
Memory Paranoia#083.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#084.src: Mr Caritat, you can't build a house here!
Memory Paranoia#084.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#085.src: I can do whatever I like here, I bought the land.
Memory Paranoia#085.dst: Aquí hago lo que me da la gana, la tierra la compré yo.
Memory Paranoia#085.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#086.src: You don't understand! This is where it came... this is where the darkness invaded!
Memory Paranoia#086.dst: ¡No lo entiende! Por aquí vino... ¡por aquí invadió la oscuridad!
Memory Paranoia#086.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#087.src: Don't be preposterous. I'm building here to show the people that there's simply nothing to worry about!
Memory Paranoia#087.dst: No diga disparates. ¡Construyo aquí para demostrar a la gente que no hay nada de qué preocuparse!
Memory Paranoia#087.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#088.src: Besides, even if there was something, now that Dullahan's gone, it'll go too.
Memory Paranoia#088.dst: Además, aunque hubiera algo, ahora que Dullahan no está, también se irá.
Memory Paranoia#088.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#089.src: What?! He wasn't the one causing all this, it was-
Memory Paranoia#089.dst: ¿¡Qué!? ¡Él no causaba nada de esto, fue-
Memory Paranoia#089.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#090.src: Well of course you would think that. You and him had some... history, didn't you?
Memory Paranoia#090.dst: Claro que pensaría eso. Usted y él tuvieron cierta... historia, ¿verdad?
Memory Paranoia#090.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#091.src: I... Please, Mr Caritat. You don't understand what you're doing...
Memory Paranoia#091.dst: Yo... Por favor, señor Caritat. No entiende lo que hace...
Memory Paranoia#091.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#092.src: I am securing some prime real-estate right here. Oh... Perhaps that is why you're here?
Memory Paranoia#092.dst: Estoy asegurándome un terreno de primera aquí mismo. Ah... ¿Quizá sea por eso que ha venido?
Memory Paranoia#092.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#094.src: Trying to expand elven territories, are you?! Well, I'll be having none of that! Leave, before I have my men escort you!
Memory Paranoia#094.dst: ¿¡Quiere expandir los territorios élficos!? ¡Pues conmigo no! ¡Váyase, antes de que mis hombres la echen!
Memory Paranoia#094.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#095.src: Hey! Human! Are you alright?! Please, calm down, quit flailing around, you're safe!
Memory Paranoia#095.dst: ¡Eh! ¡Humano! ¿¡Estás bien!? ¡Cálmate, por favor, deja de agitarte, estás a salvo!
Memory Paranoia#095.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#097.src: Oh thank goodness, you're back to us. I was so worried... er, you might not recall. Let me explain...
Memory Paranoia#097.dst: Ay, gracias al cielo, has vuelto. Estaba muy preocupado... eh, quizá no lo recuerdes. Deja que te explique...
Memory Paranoia#097.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#098.src: It... it seemed like you were possessed. You stood in the hall for... I don't know how long. I couldn't snap you out of it, no matter what I tried.
Memory Paranoia#098.dst: Parecía... parecía que estabas poseído. Te quedaste en el vestíbulo... no sé cuánto tiempo. No lograba sacarte de ahí, hiciera lo que hiciera.
Memory Paranoia#098.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#099.src: Voices that weren't yours, you spoke out their moments and thoughts. The maids, my father... everyone. I... you said what I needed to hear.
Memory Paranoia#099.dst: Con voces que no eran tuyas, recitabas sus momentos y sus pensamientos. Las criadas, mi padre... todos. Yo... dijiste lo que necesitaba oír.
Memory Paranoia#099.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#100.src: My great grandfather, wanting to prove to everyone that the forest was still good, built his mansion atop the very spot that was acclaimed to be the cause of the Decay.
Memory Paranoia#100.dst: Mi bisabuelo, queriendo demostrar a todos que el bosque seguía siendo bueno, construyó su mansión justo encima del lugar señalado como origen de la Decadencia.
Memory Paranoia#100.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#101.src: My father tried to continue the traditions... but all of it was burned to ashes. I must consider myself lucky that I did not fall with them.
Memory Paranoia#101.dst: Mi padre intentó continuar las tradiciones... pero todo ardió hasta las cenizas. Debo considerarme afortunado por no haber caído con ellos.
Memory Paranoia#101.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#102.src: And what emerged from that spot? Who knows... but, whatever it was... the darkness must have lingered, and drove them all to madness.
Memory Paranoia#102.dst: ¿Y qué salió de aquel lugar? Quién sabe... pero, fuera lo que fuese... la oscuridad debió de quedarse, y los llevó a todos a la locura.
Memory Paranoia#102.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#103.src: I'm sorry you went through that ordeal... I would suggest seeing a healer as soon as possible.
Memory Paranoia#103.dst: Siento que hayas pasado por ese calvario... Te sugiero ver a un sanador cuanto antes.
Memory Paranoia#103.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#104.src: I will make sure no one enters this house again. It is cursed. Thank you for helping me.
Memory Paranoia#104.dst: Me aseguraré de que nadie vuelva a entrar en esta casa. Está maldita. Gracias por ayudarme.
Memory Paranoia#104.speaker: Atisun

Misadventure on the Sea#000.src: Sitting on this stool will start Misadventure on the Sea.

Misadventure on the Sea#001.src: I'll take two {p} Whiskeys. One for me, one for this chap.

Misadventure on the Sea#003.src: I'll wait for ya at the docks. Don't worry, ya can't miss the boat!

Misadventure on the Sea#005.src: They're a bit too head on, don't you think?

Misadventure on the Sea#006.src: I'm tryin' to steer the ship but it's not budging...

Misadventure on the Sea#007.src: Sounds like you're being dragged around...

Misadventure on the Sea#008.src: You pick up a small sign...

Misadventure on the Sea#010.src: So, there's quite a few bodies in there, and we never bothered throwin' em out!

Misadventure on the Sea#011.src: Go ahead, here's a sponge for the dried blood as well. Just wack the bodies with it!

Misadventure on the Sea#013.src: You take a look inside the furnaces...

Misadventure on the Sea#015.src: An absurd amount of wood shavings, for some reason.

Misadventure on the Sea#016.src: Looks like the door that leads to the hold...

Misadventure on the Sea#017.src: It's locked. Probably because of the rat issue. Honip must have the key.

Misadventure on the Sea#018.src: You find some notes on the table.

Misadventure on the Sea#019.src: There's mentions of... A human cannon? How does that make sense?

Misadventure on the Sea#020.src: Apparently, only gunpowder is needed, as well as a fuse.

Misadventure on the Sea#021.src: This cannon is aiming slightly upwards, and it seems less powerful than the others.

Misadventure on the Sea#022.src: According to the notes you saw, it's probably the "human" cannon. This must be your escape route!

Misadventure on the Sea#024.src: There are mentions of a hidden key in the hold...

Misadventure on the Sea#025.src: You should probably search the hold later, when possible.

Misadventure on the Sea#026.src: You cleaned the bodies! You should talk to Honip on the deck.

Misadventure on the Sea#027.src: 'ey! How's the cleaning? Don't forget to check everywhere, ya never know what you might find!

Misadventure on the Sea#028.src: You're done? Well good job! Honip's next to the helm if you're lookin' for him.

Misadventure on the Sea#029.src: You've been running around the boat for a while now!

Misadventure on the Sea#031.src: Honip's probably waitin' for ya by now! Take these ladders next to me, he's up there.

Misadventure on the Sea#032.src: If you lose your sponge, Honip can give you a new one on the deck.

Misadventure on the Sea#034.src: Hello there soldier! What can I get you?
Misadventure on the Sea#034.speaker: Barman

Misadventure on the Sea#035.src: I'll take {~} {p} Whiskeys. One for me, one for this chap.
Misadventure on the Sea#035.dst: Ponme {~} whiskys de {p}. Uno para mí y otro para este amigo.
Misadventure on the Sea#035.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#037.src: So... I've seen ya around town. I saw how happy that guy was when you brought him some journal.
Misadventure on the Sea#037.dst: Oye... te he visto por el pueblo. Vi lo contento que se puso aquel tipo cuando le llevaste un diario.
Misadventure on the Sea#037.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#039.src: So... Soldier. Are ya up for sailin' the ocean with me? I got a fancier boat than that seaskipper!
Misadventure on the Sea#039.dst: Bueno... soldado. ¿Te animas a surcar el mar conmigo? ¡Tengo un barco mucho más fino que ese Seaskipper!
Misadventure on the Sea#039.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#040.src: I figured you'd be interested in explorin' the waters!
Misadventure on the Sea#040.dst: ¡Me imaginé que te interesaría explorar las aguas!
Misadventure on the Sea#040.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#041.src: I'll wait for ya on the docks. Don't worry, ya can't miss the boat!
Misadventure on the Sea#041.dst: Te espero en el muelle. ¡Tranquilo, no tiene pérdida!
Misadventure on the Sea#041.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#043.src: There you are! Ready? Follow me, the boat's over here!
Misadventure on the Sea#043.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#044.src: Look at this.. Magnificent! Much better than whatever the Seaskipper is using!
Misadventure on the Sea#044.dst: Mira esto... ¡Magnífico! ¡Mucho mejor que lo que usa el Seaskipper!
Misadventure on the Sea#044.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#045.src: Well, what are you waiting for? Hop aboard!
Misadventure on the Sea#045.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#046.src: Then it's settled, we're goin' on an adventure!
Misadventure on the Sea#046.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#047.src: Buckle up, we got waves to catch.
Misadventure on the Sea#047.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#048.src: So... I should warn ya', this is actually my first time sailing...
Misadventure on the Sea#048.dst: Oye... debo avisarte, esta es mi primera vez al timón...
Misadventure on the Sea#048.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#049.src: It doesn't seem too difficult though, a little to the left...
Misadventure on the Sea#049.dst: Aunque no parece muy difícil, un poco a la izquierda...
Misadventure on the Sea#049.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#050.src: Hmm, looks like we're not the only ones out on the water today.
Misadventure on the Sea#050.dst: Mmm, parece que hoy no somos los únicos en el agua.
Misadventure on the Sea#050.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#051.src: They are a bit too head on, don't you think?
Misadventure on the Sea#051.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#052.src: I'm trying to steer the ship but it's not budging...
Misadventure on the Sea#052.dst: Intento virar el barco pero no se mueve...
Misadventure on the Sea#052.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#056.src: I honestly, truly can't believe you fell for that. Let me sum it up for you...
Misadventure on the Sea#056.dst: De verdad que no me creo que picaras. Te lo resumo...
Misadventure on the Sea#056.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#057.src: Some extremely suspicious pirate comes up, offers you a drink, and leads you to his suspicious boat.
Misadventure on the Sea#057.dst: Se te acerca un pirata sospechosísimo, te invita a una copa y te lleva a su barco sospechoso.
Misadventure on the Sea#057.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#058.src: Any normal person would've turned back by then. But what do you do? You hop on! Well, now you're stuck with us.
Misadventure on the Sea#058.dst: Cualquier persona normal se habría dado la vuelta. ¿Y tú? ¡Tú subes! Pues nada, ahora te quedas con nosotros.
Misadventure on the Sea#058.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#059.src: Let me make this quick. This boat needs renovation, and we want you to do it.
Misadventure on the Sea#059.dst: Voy al grano: este barco necesita arreglos, y los harás tú.
Misadventure on the Sea#059.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#060.src: Why? You're a soldier! All you do is take orders! Anyway, we'll need you to clean our stuff. Here, get out.
Misadventure on the Sea#060.dst: ¿Por qué? ¡Eres soldado! ¡Si solo sabes obedecer órdenes! En fin, nos limpiarás las cosas. Venga, fuera.
Misadventure on the Sea#060.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#062.src: I told you to stay back!
Misadventure on the Sea#062.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#064.src: So, there's quite a few skeletons in there, and we never bothered throwin' them out!
Misadventure on the Sea#064.dst: Ahí dentro hay unos cuantos esqueletos, ¡y nunca nos molestamos en sacarlos!
Misadventure on the Sea#064.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#065.src: Go ahead, here's a sponge for the dried blood as well. Just wack the skeletons with it!
Misadventure on the Sea#065.dst: Adelante, toma también una esponja para la sangre seca. ¡A los esqueletos, dales con ella!
Misadventure on the Sea#065.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#066.src: If you need me, I'll be on the deck. And, uh, don't go in the hold. We've got a BIG rat problem.
Misadventure on the Sea#066.dst: Si me necesitas, estaré en cubierta. Y, eh, no entres en la bodega. Tenemos un GRAN problema de ratas.
Misadventure on the Sea#066.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#067.src: Also, for the sake of my crew, could you be more cooperative? I don't have an unlimited amount of these potions.
Misadventure on the Sea#067.dst: Ah, y por el bien de mi tripulación, ¿podrías colaborar más? No tengo pociones de estas para siempre.
Misadventure on the Sea#067.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#068.src: Clean the bodies in the boat. Look for clues on how to escape at the same time. -Bodies cleaned: #/{~}
Misadventure on the Sea#068.dst: Limpia los cuerpos del barco. Busca al mismo tiempo pistas para escapar. -Cuerpos limpiados: #/{~}

Misadventure on the Sea#069.src: Hey, so you're our personal guard, huh?
Misadventure on the Sea#069.dst: Eh, ¿o sea que eres nuestro guardia?
Misadventure on the Sea#069.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#071.src: That ladder leads to the hold, but right now it's locked... We've got a severe case of rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#071.dst: Esa escalera baja a la bodega, pero ahora está cerrada... Tenemos un caso grave de ratas.
Misadventure on the Sea#071.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#072.src: Pep is just a treasure, ain't I right? I'm glad you're taking care of him too!
Misadventure on the Sea#072.dst: Pep es un tesoro, ¿a que sí? ¡Me alegra que tú también lo cuides!
Misadventure on the Sea#072.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#073.src: Honip has a pet chicken, weird right?
Misadventure on the Sea#073.dst: Honip tiene un pollo por mascota, ¿no?
Misadventure on the Sea#073.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#074.src: I bet he got inspiration from that weird guy on his island...
Misadventure on the Sea#074.dst: Seguro que se inspiró en aquel tipo raro de su isla...
Misadventure on the Sea#074.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#075.src: What? You murdered that guy's most prized chicken? You're an odd one, soldier.
Misadventure on the Sea#075.dst: ¿Qué? ¿Mataste el pollo más preciado de aquel tipo? Qué raro eres, soldado.
Misadventure on the Sea#075.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#076.src: Oh, uh... Don't worry about that, 'ay?
Misadventure on the Sea#076.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#078.src: Oh, that's my cannon! Pretty cool, right? I made it using a bunch of arm- Nevermind...
Misadventure on the Sea#078.dst: ¡Ah, ese es mi cañón! Mola, ¿eh? Lo hice con un montón de braz- Nada, olvídalo...
Misadventure on the Sea#078.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#080.src: He's a strong chicken alright, trust me on that one.
Misadventure on the Sea#080.dst: Es un pollo fuerte, eso te lo aseguro.
Misadventure on the Sea#080.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#082.src: I'm just goin' to... Wait here... With my cannons...
Misadventure on the Sea#082.dst: Yo me voy a... quedar aquí... con mis cañones...
Misadventure on the Sea#082.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#083.src: Talk to Honip on the deck to get your next task
Misadventure on the Sea#083.dst: Habla con Honip en cubierta para recibir tu próxima tarea

Misadventure on the Sea#084.src: Hey! The boat's lookin' real nice now!
Misadventure on the Sea#084.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#085.src: I'll probably let you rest so- hold on.
Misadventure on the Sea#085.dst: Igual te dejo descansar as- espera.
Misadventure on the Sea#085.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#086.src: Ho-Honip! One of the guys said he saw something really weird coming right for us!
Misadventure on the Sea#086.dst: ¡Ho-Honip! ¡Uno de los chicos dice que ha visto algo rarísimo viniendo hacia nosotros!
Misadventure on the Sea#086.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#089.src: We-we don't know! We can't exactly see it, but it seems huge!
Misadventure on the Sea#089.dst: ¡N-no lo sabemos! No se ve bien, ¡pero parece enorme!
Misadventure on the Sea#089.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#091.src: Uh... Where am I supposed to be looking at, exactly?
Misadventure on the Sea#091.dst: Eh... ¿Y dónde se supone que tengo que mirar?
Misadventure on the Sea#091.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#092.src: I swear, it felt like the whole ocean was getting crazy a second ago!
Misadventure on the Sea#092.dst: ¡Te lo juro, hace nada parecía que el mar entero enloquecía!
Misadventure on the Sea#092.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#093.src: If this is another one of your jokes...
Misadventure on the Sea#093.dst: Como sea otra de vuestras bromas...
Misadventure on the Sea#093.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#096.src: I don't know, this wasn't planned!
Misadventure on the Sea#096.dst: ¡No lo sé, esto no estaba planeado!
Misadventure on the Sea#096.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#097.src: Soldier, now's your time to shine! Scare it off with one of your spells or something!
Misadventure on the Sea#097.dst: ¡Soldado, ha llegado tu momento! ¡Espántalo con uno de tus hechizos o algo!
Misadventure on the Sea#097.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#102.src: I knew you had it in ya, haha!
Misadventure on the Sea#102.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#103.src: What a show! Come, I've got some things to tell ya!
Misadventure on the Sea#103.dst: ¡Menudo espectáculo! Ven, tengo cosas que contarte.
Misadventure on the Sea#103.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#104.src: I don't know where that creature came from, but thanks to you it's gone.
Misadventure on the Sea#104.dst: No sé de dónde salió esa criatura, pero gracias a ti se ha ido.
Misadventure on the Sea#104.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#105.src: I've got something else for you to tackle. It's about... the rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#105.dst: Tengo otro asunto para ti. Es sobre... las ratas.
Misadventure on the Sea#105.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#106.src: Come to the hold, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#106.dst: Ven a la bodega, te explico por el camino.
Misadventure on the Sea#106.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#107.src: I think we have quite a hellish problem on our hands.
Misadventure on the Sea#107.dst: Creo que tenemos entre manos un problema infernal.
Misadventure on the Sea#107.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#108.src: I'm not sure what y'all find there, but these are NOT normal rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#108.dst: No sé qué te encontrarás ahí, pero esas NO son ratas normales.
Misadventure on the Sea#108.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#109.src: So please, get in there... and kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#109.dst: Así que entra, por favor... y mátalo todo, ¿vale?
Misadventure on the Sea#109.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#110.src: I've got faith in ya. Here goes nothin'!
Misadventure on the Sea#110.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#111.src: Soldier, now's your time to shine! Scare it off with one of your spells or something!
Misadventure on the Sea#111.dst: ¡Soldado, ha llegado tu momento! ¡Espántalo con uno de tus hechizos o algo!
Misadventure on the Sea#111.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#112.src: Just cast one of your fancy spells!
Misadventure on the Sea#112.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#113.src: That was... Phew... That was something.
Misadventure on the Sea#113.dst: Eso ha sido... Uf... Menudo asunto.
Misadventure on the Sea#113.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#114.src: Now, for an even bigger surprise...
Misadventure on the Sea#114.dst: Y ahora, una sorpresa aún mayor...
Misadventure on the Sea#114.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#115.src: What the hell soldier?? What don't you get in the "soldier" part of your job?
Misadventure on the Sea#115.dst: ¿¡Qué demonios, soldado!? ¿Qué parte de "soldado" no entiendes?
Misadventure on the Sea#115.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#116.src: Come, let's figure some things out.
Misadventure on the Sea#116.dst: Ven, vamos a aclarar unas cosas.
Misadventure on the Sea#116.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#117.src: You've been a massive disappointment, y'know?
Misadventure on the Sea#117.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#118.src: But you can still redeem yourself.
Misadventure on the Sea#118.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#119.src: Follow me, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#119.dst: Sígueme, te explico por el camino.
Misadventure on the Sea#119.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#120.src: I mentioned a rat problem earlier... It's, uh, not a small one.
Misadventure on the Sea#120.dst: Antes mencioné un problema de ratas... No es, eh, pequeño.
Misadventure on the Sea#120.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#121.src: We've got gunpowder to retrieve, so you're the one who's gonna clear the hold.
Misadventure on the Sea#121.dst: Hay que recuperar pólvora, así que tú vas a limpiar la bodega.
Misadventure on the Sea#121.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#122.src: So get in there... and try to kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#122.dst: Así que entra... e intenta matarlo todo, ¿vale?
Misadventure on the Sea#122.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#123.src: Don't be as bad as earlier. You're a soldier.
Misadventure on the Sea#123.dst: No lo hagas tan mal como antes. Eres soldado.
Misadventure on the Sea#123.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#126.src: I expected you to do somethin', soldier, not him!
Misadventure on the Sea#126.dst: ¡Esperaba que hicieras algo TÚ, soldado, no él!
Misadventure on the Sea#126.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#127.dst: En fin, ven a hablar conmigo.
Misadventure on the Sea#127.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#128.src: I have another task for you. It's about... the rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#128.dst: Tengo otra tarea para ti. Es sobre... las ratas.
Misadventure on the Sea#128.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#129.src: See, I really don't think we have your usual type of problem.
Misadventure on the Sea#129.dst: Verás, no creo que sea un problema de los normales.
Misadventure on the Sea#129.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#130.src: Come to the hold, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#130.dst: Ven a la bodega, te explico por el camino.
Misadventure on the Sea#130.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#131.src: We sometimes hear unusually load footsteps, along with some really eerie squeaking...
Misadventure on the Sea#131.dst: A veces oímos pasos de lo más sonoros, y unos chillidos muy siniestros...
Misadventure on the Sea#131.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#132.src: That's why we're not too fond of goin' in... But our gunpowder there! We need it, as pirates!
Misadventure on the Sea#132.dst: Por eso no nos hace gracia entrar... ¡Pero la pólvora está ahí! ¡La necesitamos, somos piratas!
Misadventure on the Sea#132.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#133.src: So, I need you to get in... and kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#133.dst: Así que entra... y mátalo todo, ¿vale?
Misadventure on the Sea#133.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#134.src: Here goes nothing. Snoo, ya stay there!
Misadventure on the Sea#134.dst: A por todas. ¡Snoo, tú te quedas!
Misadventure on the Sea#134.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#135.src: Explore the hold and kill the rats
Misadventure on the Sea#135.dst: Explora la bodega y mata a las ratas

Misadventure on the Sea#136.src: Defeat the Colossal Rat in the hold
Misadventure on the Sea#136.dst: Derrota al Colossal Rat en la bodega

Misadventure on the Sea#137.src: Use the gunpowder and the fuse to activate the cannon and escape
Misadventure on the Sea#137.dst: Usa la pólvora y la mecha para activar el cañón y escapar

Misadventure on the Sea#138.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#138.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#139.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#139.dst: ¿Te cargaste a esos malditos roedores? ¿Una... Colossal Rat, dices?
Misadventure on the Sea#139.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#140.src: Nicely done, I knew I could count on ya! C'mere, take these!
Misadventure on the Sea#140.dst: ¡Bien hecho, sabía que podía contar contigo! ¡Ven, toma esto!
Misadventure on the Sea#140.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#141.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#141.dst: En fin, por ahora puedes descansar y hacer lo que quieras.
Misadventure on the Sea#141.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#142.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#142.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#143.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#143.dst: ¿Te cargaste a esos malditos roedores? ¿Una... Colossal Rat, dices?
Misadventure on the Sea#143.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#144.src: Well, shiver me timbers! You did redeem yourself soldier!
Misadventure on the Sea#144.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#145.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#145.dst: En fin, por ahora puedes descansar y hacer lo que quieras.
Misadventure on the Sea#145.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#146.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#146.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#147.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#147.dst: ¿Te cargaste a esos malditos roedores? ¿Una... Colossal Rat, dices?
Misadventure on the Sea#147.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#148.src: That sounds absolutely terrifying! And ya did that alone! You know what, her', take these.
Misadventure on the Sea#148.dst: ¡Eso suena aterrador! ¡Y lo hiciste tú solo! ¿Sabes qué? Toma, quédate esto.
Misadventure on the Sea#148.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#149.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#149.dst: En fin, por ahora puedes descansar y hacer lo que quieras.
Misadventure on the Sea#149.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#150.src: Hey! What do you think you're doin'?!
Misadventure on the Sea#150.speaker: Pirate Guard

Misadventure on the Sea#152.src: No, but they did a great job in the hold! Some gunpowder went missing though.
Misadventure on the Sea#152.dst: No, ¡pero hizo un gran trabajo en la bodega! Aunque falta algo de pólvora.
Misadventure on the Sea#152.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#156.src: Find out where you are and a way to flee the island
Misadventure on the Sea#156.dst: Averigua dónde estás y cómo huir de la isla

Misadventure on the Sea#157.src: 'ey there soldier! Looks like ya're in a bit of a pickle! How 'bout ya hop on?'
Misadventure on the Sea#157.dst: ¡Eh, soldado! ¡Parece que estás en un apuro! ¿Qué tal si subes?
Misadventure on the Sea#157.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#158.src: Well... We're headed for {p}, the heart of the ocean! Which is safer than wherever you were, heh!
Misadventure on the Sea#158.dst: Bueno... ¡Vamos a {p}, el corazón del océano! Más seguro que donde estabas, ¡je!
Misadventure on the Sea#158.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#159.src: I was casually takin' a scenic detour when I saw you and your shiny equipment on that island.
Misadventure on the Sea#159.dst: Iba dando un rodeo turístico cuando te vi a ti y a tu equipo reluciente en esa isla.
Misadventure on the Sea#159.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#160.src: So, ya gotta tell me what happened!
Misadventure on the Sea#160.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#161.src: Oh, kidnapped by pirates I see! How unfortunate...
Misadventure on the Sea#161.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#162.src: I guess that'll show ya, tryin' to avoid using good ol' seaskipper! I'm the only trustworthy one 'round here.
Misadventure on the Sea#162.dst: ¡Eso te pasa por evitar al viejo Seaskipper! Soy el único de fiar por aquí.
Misadventure on the Sea#162.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#163.src: Well, I hope they weren't too bad with ya! Here, I'll make you travel to {p} for free as compensation.
Misadventure on the Sea#163.dst: ¡Espero que no te trataran muy mal! Mira, te llevo a {p} gratis como compensación.
Misadventure on the Sea#163.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#164.src: Anyway, I can see the shore off in the distance! Hang tight, we're almost there!
Misadventure on the Sea#164.dst: ¡Ya veo la costa a lo lejos! ¡Agárrate, casi hemos llegado!
Misadventure on the Sea#164.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Mixed Feelings#000.src: Speak to Javen at the Corkus Docks.
Mixed Feelings#000.dst: Habla con Javen en los muelles de Corkus.

Mixed Feelings#001.src: Mo’in lad! We don’t get many Wynn folks round ‘ere.
Mixed Feelings#001.dst: ¡Buenas, chaval! Por aquí no vemos mucha gente de Wynn.
Mixed Feelings#001.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#002.src: Welcome to old Javen’s tavern, what can I do yer for?
Mixed Feelings#002.dst: Bienvenido a la taberna del viejo Javen, ¿qué te pongo?
Mixed Feelings#002.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#003.src: Let’s see... I can give ya some of the islands “Old Cork” Brew..
Mixed Feelings#003.dst: A ver... puedo ponerte del brebaje "Old Cork" de la isla...
Mixed Feelings#003.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#004.src: Seems like you are in luck today, adventurer.
Mixed Feelings#004.dst: Parece que hoy estás de suerte, aventurero.
