Mixed Feelings#005.src: My day's been long, and you also look like you could do with a drink or two.
Mixed Feelings#005.dst: He tenido un día largo, y tú también pareces necesitar un trago.

Mixed Feelings#006.src: There's no need to pay by yourself. Javen, we'll have two cups of the seasonal brew.
Mixed Feelings#006.dst: No hace falta que pagues tú. Javen, dos jarras de la cerveza de temporada.

Mixed Feelings#008.src: Everything alright, lad? Looking a bit pale...
Mixed Feelings#008.dst: ¿Todo bien, chaval? Se te ve pálido...
Mixed Feelings#008.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#010.src: Oh by the mighty founders, everything is ruined!
Mixed Feelings#010.dst: ¡Por los poderosos fundadores, está todo destrozado!
Mixed Feelings#010.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#012.src: You did this! Yer mad in the head! Possessed or summet!
Mixed Feelings#012.dst: ¡Esto lo hiciste tú! ¡Estás mal de la cabeza! ¡Poseído o algo!
Mixed Feelings#012.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#013.src: Yer seem fine now though. What got inter ye lad? You went berserk like!
Mixed Feelings#013.dst: Aunque ahora pareces normal. ¿Qué te dio, chaval? ¡Te volviste loco!
Mixed Feelings#013.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#014.src: It weren’t just here neither. You ran outta here and wrecked all sorts! You better go find the people you affected and apologise
Mixed Feelings#014.dst: Y no fue solo aquí. ¡Saliste corriendo y destrozaste de todo! Más te vale ir a buscar a los afectados y disculparte
Mixed Feelings#014.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#015.src: Talk to the citizens around the docks.
Mixed Feelings#015.dst: Habla con los ciudadanos de los muelles.

Mixed Feelings#016.src: The whole aqueduct is ruined! The cities fresh water is just draining into the ocean...
Mixed Feelings#016.dst: ¡El acueducto entero está destrozado! El agua limpia de la ciudad se va al océano...
Mixed Feelings#016.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#017.src: Ah! It's you! Back to wreck the rest of the city's infrastructure?! You're meant to be a tourist!
Mixed Feelings#017.dst: ¡Ah! ¡Eres tú! ¿¡Vuelves a destrozar el resto de la ciudad!? ¡Se supone que eres turista!
Mixed Feelings#017.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#018.src: Wait... Weren't your eyes red before? Were you ill? It was a bit scary.
Mixed Feelings#018.dst: Espera... ¿No tenías los ojos rojos? ¿Estabas enfermo? Daba miedo.
Mixed Feelings#018.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#019.src: Oh.. You don't even remember? Well.. If you want to help, I need it right now.
Mixed Feelings#019.dst: Ah... ¿Ni te acuerdas? Bueno... Si quieres ayudar, me hace falta ya.
Mixed Feelings#019.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#020.src: The system needs to be rebooted, which can only be done down in the sewers.
Mixed Feelings#020.dst: Hay que reiniciar el sistema, y eso solo se hace en las alcantarillas.
Mixed Feelings#020.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#021.src: Kind of a design flaw if you ask me.. But if you go down that trap door, you will find it in the sewers!
Mixed Feelings#021.dst: Un fallo de diseño, vamos... ¡Pero baja por esa trampilla y lo verás en las alcantarillas!
Mixed Feelings#021.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#022.src: You fixed it? Everything you broke? That's one hell of a twisted personality.
Mixed Feelings#022.dst: ¿Lo arreglaste? ¿Todo lo que rompiste? Menuda personalidad retorcida.
Mixed Feelings#022.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#023.src: Corkus has been urging tourists and envoys from the other provinces to gain recognition.
Mixed Feelings#023.dst: Corkus lleva tiempo atrayendo turistas y enviados de otras provincias para ganar reconocimiento.
Mixed Feelings#023.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#024.src: There are others that blame any outsiders for the problems of the islands.. They say they are patriots.. but honestly...
Mixed Feelings#024.dst: Hay quienes culpan a cualquier forastero de los problemas de las islas... Dicen que son patriotas... pero, sinceramente...
Mixed Feelings#024.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#025.src: They are just awful people. They want to do anything to make non Corkians look bad.
Mixed Feelings#025.dst: Son simplemente gente horrible. Harían lo que fuera por dejar mal a los no corkianos.
Mixed Feelings#025.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#026.src: If I were you, I'd better start asking around to find out more about that!
Mixed Feelings#026.dst: ¡Yo que tú empezaría a preguntar por ahí para saber más!
Mixed Feelings#026.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#027.src: Speak to the other citizens around the docks.
Mixed Feelings#027.dst: Habla con los demás ciudadanos de los muelles.

Mixed Feelings#028.src: It’s THEM! Someone call the authorities! It’s the one who set my house on fire.
Mixed Feelings#028.dst: ¡Es ESA persona! ¡Que alguien llame a las autoridades! ¡Le prendió fuego a mi casa!
Mixed Feelings#028.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#029.src: How could you do this and just come back all calm like? You were screaming your head off!
Mixed Feelings#029.dst: ¿Cómo puedes hacer esto y volver tan tranquilo? ¡Estabas gritando como un poseso!
Mixed Feelings#029.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#030.src: My house is still burning! Wait… You say you don’t have any memory of any of this?
Mixed Feelings#030.dst: ¡Mi casa sigue ardiendo! Espera... ¿Dices que no recuerdas nada de esto?
Mixed Feelings#030.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#031.src: Look, if you’re serious, you have a chance to help make it better.
Mixed Feelings#031.dst: Mira, si vas en serio, tienes ocasión de arreglarlo.
Mixed Feelings#031.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#032.src: There are valuables in a chest in there you must save before the whole place burns to the ground, get going!
Mixed Feelings#032.dst: Ahí dentro hay un cofre con objetos de valor; sálvalo antes de que todo arda, ¡venga, corre!
Mixed Feelings#032.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#033.src: You did it! So you weren't lying? Ugh, I guess you might just be trustworthy.
Mixed Feelings#033.dst: ¡Lo lograste! ¿O sea que no mentías? Uf, puede que seas de fiar.
Mixed Feelings#033.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#034.src: You know about the 'patriots' of Corkus?
Mixed Feelings#034.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#035.src: Well this kind of maneuver is right up their alley.. It certainly made you look bad!
Mixed Feelings#035.dst: Pues esta clase de maniobra es muy suya... ¡Desde luego te dejó fatal!
Mixed Feelings#035.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#036.src: Now that you bring it up, I did hear a group of Corkians quietly discussing something about framing tourists.
Mixed Feelings#036.dst: Ahora que lo dices, sí oí a un grupo de corkianos hablando bajito de inculpar a turistas.
Mixed Feelings#036.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#037.src: I have no idea how they would make you do something against your will though...
Mixed Feelings#037.dst: Aunque no sé cómo te obligarían a actuar contra tu voluntad...
Mixed Feelings#037.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#038.src: Talk to the final victim of your rampage.
Mixed Feelings#038.dst: Habla con la última víctima de tu arrebato.

Mixed Feelings#039.src: Came back to wreck the rest of my work have you? Why aren't you all insane looking?
Mixed Feelings#039.dst: ¿Vienes a destrozar el resto de mi trabajo? ¿Cómo es que ya no pareces un demente?
Mixed Feelings#039.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#040.src: So now your story is you were not in control? It's easy to believe. You were mad!
Mixed Feelings#040.dst: ¿Y ahora dices que no te controlabas? Es fácil de creer. ¡Estabas como una cabra!
Mixed Feelings#040.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#041.src: I don't know if you have some kind of condition.. but if you want to help, I need it to clean up the mess you made.
Mixed Feelings#041.dst: No sé si tienes alguna dolencia... pero si quieres ayudar, necesito que limpies el estropicio que montaste.
Mixed Feelings#041.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#042.src: I need to replace all the cargo you destroyed.
Mixed Feelings#042.dst: Tengo que reponer toda la carga que destrozaste.
Mixed Feelings#042.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#043.src: All you gotta do is get those crates here and put them back on the boats. The limit is {~} for each boat, not more not less!
Mixed Feelings#043.dst: Solo tienes que traer esas cajas y volver a subirlas a los barcos. El límite es {~} por barco, ¡ni más ni menos!
Mixed Feelings#043.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#044.src: Some weights might not be needed, but be careful, I don't wanna go diving after you.
Mixed Feelings#044.dst: Puede que algunos lastres sobren, pero ten cuidado, no quiero tener que bucear a por ti.
Mixed Feelings#044.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#045.src: You did it? ... -I mean, at last. Eh... I guess I was too fast with my judgement for once.
Mixed Feelings#045.dst: ¿Lo has hecho? ... -Digo, por fin. Eh... Supongo que esta vez juzgué demasiado rápido.
Mixed Feelings#045.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#046.src: Hmm… As it happens I have seen some strange things around here.
Mixed Feelings#046.dst: Mmm... Pues mira, sí que he visto cosas raras por aquí.
Mixed Feelings#046.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#047.src: During the night I saw something moving across the cliffs.. Looked like a personal balloon.
Mixed Feelings#047.dst: De noche vi algo moviéndose por los acantilados... Parecía un globo individual.
Mixed Feelings#047.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#048.src: It wouldn't have been out of the ordinary except there are occasional blood trails leading from the balloon...
Mixed Feelings#048.dst: No tendría nada de raro, salvo que a veces del globo salen rastros de sangre...
Mixed Feelings#048.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#049.src: If you really want to approach these people… I guess all you would need to do is follow the trail of blood.
Mixed Feelings#049.dst: Si de verdad quieres acercarte a esa gente... supongo que basta con seguir el rastro de sangre.
Mixed Feelings#049.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#050.src: Can't say I recommend it but the trail starts near the aqueduct.
Mixed Feelings#050.dst: No te lo recomiendo, pero el rastro empieza junto al acueducto.
Mixed Feelings#050.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#051.src: Follow the trail of blood and board the airship.
Mixed Feelings#051.dst: Sigue el rastro de sangre y sube a la aeronave.

Mixed Feelings#053.src: Why are you here? I don't mean here and now, I mean why are you on our island?
Mixed Feelings#053.dst: ¿Por qué estás aquí? No aquí y ahora: ¿por qué estás en nuestra isla?
Mixed Feelings#053.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#054.src: You have of course found yourself in front of me because you were a pawn in our attempts to save this nation.
Mixed Feelings#054.dst: Estás ante mí, claro está, porque fuiste un peón en nuestro intento de salvar esta nación.
Mixed Feelings#054.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#055.src: I suppose I should apologize, but truth is you are the reason for this movement. Not you personally... but your people.
Mixed Feelings#055.dst: Supongo que debería disculparme, pero tú eres la razón de este movimiento. No tú en persona... sino los tuyos.
Mixed Feelings#055.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#056.src: You... Look at yourself. You fight in a war you did not cause. You come from a land you don't even remember.
Mixed Feelings#056.dst: Tú... Mírate. Luchas en una guerra que no provocaste. Vienes de una tierra que ni recuerdas.
Mixed Feelings#056.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#057.src: We ask ourselves why would we invite people from two lands of sin. Invite a nation of warring travellers and a nation of greedy merchants to our doors?
Mixed Feelings#057.dst: Nos preguntamos por qué invitar a gente de dos tierras de pecado. ¿Abrir la puerta a un pueblo de viajeros belicosos y otro de mercaderes codiciosos?
Mixed Feelings#057.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#058.src: The Corkian people are above such mundane capitalism and brutality. We work as a nation to better all.
Mixed Feelings#058.dst: El pueblo corkiano está por encima de ese capitalismo vulgar y esa brutalidad. Como nación, trabajamos por todos.
Mixed Feelings#058.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#059.src: You have been a pawn your entire existence on this world. The worst part is you don't even know it.
Mixed Feelings#059.dst: Has sido un peón toda tu existencia en este mundo. Lo peor es que ni lo sabes.
Mixed Feelings#059.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#060.src: Do you, for example - Know the name of your ultimate enemy? The reason for the war on your land?
Mixed Feelings#060.dst: ¿Sabes, por ejemplo, el nombre de tu enemigo final? ¿La razón de la guerra en tu tierra?
Mixed Feelings#060.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#061.src: No? Didn't think so. I have no time for this. You served your purpose, even if you did try and redeem your barbaric behaviour... Kill them!
Mixed Feelings#061.dst: ¿No? Ya me lo imaginaba. No tengo tiempo para esto. Cumpliste tu función, aunque intentaras redimir tu conducta bárbara... ¡Matadlos!
Mixed Feelings#061.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#062.src: Fight and evade the waves of mobs until the timer runs out.
Mixed Feelings#062.dst: Lucha y esquiva las oleadas de enemigos hasta que se acabe el tiempo.

Mixed Feelings#063.src: Tougher than I expected. You don’t mind if I interfere a bit, do you?
Mixed Feelings#063.dst: Más duro de lo que esperaba. No te importa que intervenga un poco, ¿no?
Mixed Feelings#063.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#065.src: You may have won this fight, but you are still the loser in this situation.
Mixed Feelings#065.dst: Habrás ganado el combate, pero sigues siendo el perdedor aquí.
Mixed Feelings#065.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#066.src: Your eyes are still closed to the greater picture of it all. Corkus is the only place safe from it. I will make sure of it!
Mixed Feelings#066.dst: Sigues con los ojos cerrados al cuadro completo. Corkus es el único lugar a salvo de ello. ¡Yo me encargaré de que así sea!
Mixed Feelings#066.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#067.src: There are still greater things in motion as we speak. Plans that will secure this island's safety.
Mixed Feelings#067.dst: Mientras hablamos hay cosas mayores en marcha. Planes que asegurarán esta isla.
Mixed Feelings#067.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#068.src: Fruma.. Gavel.. Wynn… It’s all a joke. We all sit on the cusp of this reality, fighting only the prelude to the real war.
Mixed Feelings#068.dst: Fruma... Gavel... Wynn... Todo es una broma. Estamos al borde de esta realidad, librando solo el preludio de la guerra de verdad.
Mixed Feelings#068.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#069.src: This is our farewell. I must depart before the short sighted government arrive. Good Luck with your struggle.
Mixed Feelings#069.dst: Aquí nos despedimos. Debo irme antes de que llegue ese gobierno cegato. Suerte con tu lucha.
Mixed Feelings#069.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#071.src: Now look who we got over ‘ere! We were all wondering if you'd ever wake up.
Mixed Feelings#071.dst: ¡Mira quién anda por aquí! Nos preguntábamos si despertarías.
Mixed Feelings#071.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#072.src: Sorry we ever doubted ye. Weren't fair of us. What you drank was a rare brew designed to enrage and berserk someone.
Mixed Feelings#072.dst: Perdona que dudáramos de ti. No fue justo. Lo que bebiste era un brebaje raro hecho para enfurecer y enloquecer.
Mixed Feelings#072.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#073.src: Basically, it weren't yer fault lad. We never knew some Corkians were so closed minded.
Mixed Feelings#073.dst: En resumen, no fue culpa tuya, chaval. No sabíamos que algunos corkianos fueran tan cerrados.
Mixed Feelings#073.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#074.src: Anyways! Look at what we got, thanks to you I acquired this little place!
Mixed Feelings#074.dst: ¡En fin! Mira lo que tenemos: ¡gracias a ti me hice con este local!
Mixed Feelings#074.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#075.src: By means of reparations have this on me. Yer always welcome round here.
Mixed Feelings#075.dst: Como reparación, esta corre de mi cuenta. Aquí siempre eres bienvenido.
Mixed Feelings#075.speaker: Javen

Murder Mystery#000.src: Looks like the symbol has something carved in on the back...
Murder Mystery#000.dst: Parece que el símbolo tiene algo grabado por detrás...

Murder Mystery#001.dst: Habla con el detective Lorias en [-{~}, -{~}].

Murder Mystery#002.src: Stand back, human! This is a crime scene, under my authority. I cannot let you inside.
Murder Mystery#002.dst: ¡Atrás, humano! Esto es la escena de un crimen, bajo mi autoridad. No puedo dejarte entrar.
Murder Mystery#002.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#003.src: Although we are in need of some... assistance... and you are fairly experienced, are you not?
Murder Mystery#003.dst: Aunque nos vendría bien algo de... ayuda... y tú tienes bastante experiencia, ¿verdad?
Murder Mystery#003.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#004.src: Well, straight to the point... do you think I might be able to hire you as a private investigator?
Murder Mystery#004.dst: Bien, al grano... ¿crees que podría contratarte como investigador privado?
Murder Mystery#004.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#005.src: To put it bluntly, the owner of this house, Eminar, was murdered a few days ago, and what few leads we had have all gone cold.
Murder Mystery#005.dst: Sin rodeos: al dueño de esta casa, Eminar, lo asesinaron hace unos días, y las pocas pistas que teníamos se han enfriado.
Murder Mystery#005.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#006.src: This is acting outside protocol, of course... but if you manage to catch the killer, I'm sure I could pull some strings and pay you for your work!
Murder Mystery#006.dst: Esto va contra el protocolo, por supuesto... pero si logras atrapar al asesino, ¡seguro que puedo mover hilos y pagarte por tu trabajo!
Murder Mystery#006.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#007.src: I'll make sure no one stops you inside the crime scene. Head inside the house and see if you can find anything helpful.
Murder Mystery#007.dst: Me aseguraré de que nadie te detenga en la escena. Entra en la casa y mira si encuentras algo útil.
Murder Mystery#007.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#008.src: My soldiers and I will keep watch outside the house, and make sure you're not disturbed. Be careful in there!
Murder Mystery#008.dst: Mis soldados y yo vigilaremos fuera para que nadie te moleste. ¡Ten cuidado ahí dentro!
Murder Mystery#008.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#009.src: Investigate the crime scene at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for clues.
Murder Mystery#009.dst: Investiga la escena del crimen en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] en busca de pistas.

Murder Mystery#010.src: Ah, a human! A refreshing sight these days. You've come to see me, I presume? What brings you here?
Murder Mystery#010.dst: ¡Ah, un humano! Qué refrescante hoy en día. Viene a verme, supongo. ¿Qué le trae por aquí?
Murder Mystery#010.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#011.src: An investigation!? Eminar? That's... that's absurd. I've done nothing wrong.
Murder Mystery#011.dst: ¿¡Una investigación!? ¿Eminar? Es... es absurdo. Yo no he hecho nada.
Murder Mystery#011.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#012.src: Still, the poor man. Eminar and I were good friends, you know. If it could help find his killer, I may have some information for you... strictly off-record, of course...
Murder Mystery#012.dst: Aun así, pobre hombre. Eminar y yo éramos buenos amigos, ¿sabe? Si sirve para hallar a su asesino, quizá tenga información para usted... extraoficial, por supuesto...
Murder Mystery#012.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#013.src: Well. You see, there's an underground gambling den hidden in the city's sewers. Only the elite can get in, and Eminar happened to be a frequent visitor.
Murder Mystery#013.dst: Verá. Hay un garito clandestino escondido en las alcantarillas de la ciudad. Solo entra la élite, y Eminar resultaba ser un cliente asiduo.
Murder Mystery#013.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#014.src: Once, he even brought me along with him.
Murder Mystery#014.dst: Una vez incluso me llevó con él.
Murder Mystery#014.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#015.src: Eminar, though, he often tried to cheat the other gamblers. I suppose it was only a matter of time before they had enough; most do not take cheating lightly.
Murder Mystery#015.dst: Solo que Eminar solía intentar engañar a los otros jugadores. Supongo que era cuestión de tiempo que se hartaran; pocos se toman bien las trampas.
Murder Mystery#015.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#016.src: Back to the point, many of them, including poor Eminar, had a symbol built into the sides of their homes, shaped like a snake. A proof of membership, you could say.
Murder Mystery#016.dst: Al grano: muchos de ellos, y el pobre Eminar también, tenían un símbolo empotrado en la pared de casa, con forma de serpiente. Una prueba de pertenencia, digamos.
Murder Mystery#016.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#017.src: If you can find it, it will show you the way to get into the sewers. I'm sorry, I would tell you more if I knew more. But good luck with your investigation, sir.
Murder Mystery#017.dst: Si lo encuentra, le indicará cómo entrar en las alcantarillas. Lo siento, le diría más si supiera más. Pero suerte con su investigación, señor.
Murder Mystery#017.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#018.src: Return to the victim's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find a snake symbol.
Murder Mystery#018.dst: Vuelve a la casa de la víctima en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para buscar un símbolo de serpiente.

Murder Mystery#019.src: Find the gamblers in the {p} sewers.
Murder Mystery#019.dst: Encuentra a los jugadores en las alcantarillas de {p}.

Murder Mystery#020.src: How did ya find us down 'ere? I don't remember you... you're with the police, aren't ya? Here after Eminar, I suppose?
Murder Mystery#020.dst: ¿Cómo nos has encontrado aquí abajo? No te recuerdo... eres de la policía, ¿no? Vienes por Eminar, supongo.
Murder Mystery#020.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#021.src: Yeah, we've 'eard about what happened to him. Murders don't happen every day up there, ya know. And as it happened, I saw Eminar down here, not too long ago...
Murder Mystery#021.dst: Sí, ya oímos lo que le pasó. Ahí arriba no matan a nadie todos los días, ¿sabes? Y mira por dónde, vi a Eminar aquí abajo no hace mucho...
Murder Mystery#021.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#022.src: Well... as long as I get a guarantee I won't be shut down, I'll help ya. This is a very profitable place, as I'm sure ya might've guessed.
Murder Mystery#022.dst: Bueno... mientras me garantices que no me cierran, te ayudo. Esto da mucho dinero, como ya habrás supuesto.
Murder Mystery#022.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#023.src: He was brought down here by his friend one day. Rohem, it was. A fine customer, you understand. Never failed to pay his dues...
Murder Mystery#023.dst: Un día lo trajo aquí abajo su amigo. Rohem, se llamaba. Un cliente estupendo, ya me entiendes. Siempre pagaba sus deudas...
Murder Mystery#023.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#024.src: But the day he brought Eminar 'round, though, it got ugly fast. Kept borrowing Rohem's emeralds and losing, till neither of em had anythin' left.
Murder Mystery#024.dst: Pero el día que trajo a Eminar, la cosa se torció rápido. No paraba de pedirle esmeraldas a Rohem y perder, hasta que ninguno tuvo nada.
Murder Mystery#024.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#025.src: It was a good day for me, for obvious reasons, don'cha see! But Rohem was furious. Dead drunk, too, but what else is new!
Murder Mystery#025.dst: ¡Para mí fue un buen día, por motivos obvios, ya ves! Pero Rohem estaba furioso. Y borracho perdido, ¡como siempre!
Murder Mystery#025.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#026.src: Neither of 'em has been back since, though in Eminar's case, I can see why! And I hope that's enough for ya, 'cause that's all I got.
Murder Mystery#026.dst: Ninguno ha vuelto desde entonces, ¡aunque lo de Eminar se entiende! Espero que te baste, porque no tengo más.
Murder Mystery#026.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#027.src: Now get out of 'ere; there's a back exit in the wall over there. Though, if ya ever fancy a game of 'jack, come back'n we'll be happy to serve ya!
Murder Mystery#027.dst: Ahora largo de aquí; hay una salida trasera en esa pared. Aunque si algún día te apetece una partida de blackjack, ¡vuelve y te atenderemos encantados!
Murder Mystery#027.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#028.src: Confront Rohem about the murder at house #{~} in {p}.
Murder Mystery#028.dst: Encara a Rohem por el asesinato en la casa #{~} de {p}.

Murder Mystery#029.src: Ah... you again! You're back. I see that. I must admit, I did not expect you to return... so soon...
Murder Mystery#029.dst: Ah... ¡usted otra vez! Ha vuelto. Ya lo veo. Confieso que no esperaba que volviera... tan pronto...
Murder Mystery#029.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#030.src: You really did find your way down there? Oh, that's... excellent... I hope the investigation is going well. Now if you'll just leave me be-
Murder Mystery#030.dst: ¿De verdad encontró el camino? Ah, eso es... excelente... Espero que la investigación vaya bien. Y ahora, si me deja en paz-
Murder Mystery#030.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#031.src: Valimare? Bah! Why would you trust anything he says? He's a criminal! A scam artist! I mean, I did direct you to him, but...
Murder Mystery#031.dst: ¿Valimare? ¡Bah! ¿Por qué iba a creerle nada? ¡Es un criminal! ¡Un estafador! Bueno, sí, yo le mandé con él, pero...
Murder Mystery#031.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#032.src: He- He's the one you should be arresting. Eminar was a danger to society, got what he deserved, the fool-
Murder Mystery#032.dst: A él... a él debería detener. Eminar era un peligro público, se llevó su merecido, el muy necio-
Murder Mystery#032.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#033.src: Wait! No! Don't turn me in! Can't you let me finish my drink in peace? Get out, get out, you can't prove anything!
Murder Mystery#033.dst: ¡Espere! ¡No! ¡No me entregue! ¿No puede dejarme acabar la copa? ¡Fuera, fuera, no puede probar nada!
Murder Mystery#033.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#034.src: Besides, have you ever heard of a little thing called evidence? You don't have any proof!
Murder Mystery#034.dst: Además, ¿ha oído hablar de algo llamado pruebas? ¡No tiene ninguna!
Murder Mystery#034.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#035.src: Now, officer, if you don't have a proper warrant, I expect you to vacate my property immediately!
Murder Mystery#035.dst: Y ahora, agente, si no tiene una orden en regla, ¡espero que abandone mi propiedad de inmediato!
Murder Mystery#035.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#036.src: Find the murder weapon around Rohem's house at house #{~} in {p}.
Murder Mystery#036.dst: Busca el arma homicida alrededor de la casa #{~} de Rohem en {p}.

Murder Mystery#037.src: Hi! I'm digging a hole in my garden, just like Mr. Rohem did last night!
Murder Mystery#037.dst: ¡Hola! ¡Cavo un hoyo en el jardín, como el señor Rohem anoche!
Murder Mystery#037.speaker: Child

Murder Mystery#038.src: For the last time officer, would you either show me a warrant or get out of my- what are you doing in my garden?!
Murder Mystery#038.dst: Por última vez, agente, o me enseña una orden o sale de mi- ¿¡qué hace en mi jardín!?
Murder Mystery#038.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#039.src: A... a hatchet? I don't know what you mean, I- I've never seen that before in my life!
Murder Mystery#039.dst: ¿Un... un hacha? No sé de qué me habla, ¡yo- jamás he visto eso en mi vida!
Murder Mystery#039.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#040.src: Gah! Curse you, human! I might be headed to jail, but I can send you straight to hell!
Murder Mystery#040.dst: ¡Agh! ¡Maldito humano! ¡Puede que yo vaya a la cárcel, pero a usted lo mando al infierno!
Murder Mystery#040.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#041.src: That's enough, Rohem! Stand down, or the guards will attack.
Murder Mystery#041.dst: ¡Basta, Rohem! Ríndete, o la guardia atacará.
Murder Mystery#041.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#042.src: Augh! Fine, you've got me. But mark my words, this won't be the last you hear of me, human!
Murder Mystery#042.dst: ¡Augh! Está bien, me ha cogido. Pero recuerde mis palabras: ¡no será la última vez que oiga de mí, humano!
Murder Mystery#042.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#043.src: Whatever you pale-faced walking cowlick. You're headed to {p} Penitentiary with a charge of first-class murder. Guards, take him away.
Murder Mystery#043.dst: Lo que tú digas, remolino andante de cara pálida. Te vas a la Penitenciaría de {p} acusado de asesinato en primer grado. Guardias, lleváoslo.
Murder Mystery#043.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#044.src: As for you, human, please accept my immense gratitude. We probably wouldn't have caught that rat without you.
Murder Mystery#044.dst: En cuanto a ti, humano, acepta mi inmensa gratitud. Sin ti no habríamos cazado a esa rata.
Murder Mystery#044.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#045.src: On behalf of the city of {p}, please accept these emeralds as compensation for your services. You were a fine detective today!
Murder Mystery#045.dst: En nombre de la ciudad de {p}, acepta estas esmeraldas como pago por tus servicios. ¡Hoy has sido un gran detective!
Murder Mystery#045.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#046.src: Heya there! Fancy a quick game of blackjack?
Murder Mystery#046.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#048.src: Good stuff! Put ya money in the pot and I'll start the deal.
Murder Mystery#048.dst: ¡Estupendo! Pon tu dinero en el bote y reparto.
Murder Mystery#048.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#049.src: Not feelin' up to playin' right now? No worries, just drop by later!
Murder Mystery#049.dst: ¿Ahora no te apetece jugar? Tranquilo, ¡pásate luego!
Murder Mystery#049.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#050.src: Not right now? No worries - come back another time!
Murder Mystery#050.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#051.src: Ah, new to the game huh? No worries, lemme tell ya all about it!
Murder Mystery#051.dst: Ah, ¿nuevo en el juego? Tranquilo, ¡te lo explico todo!
Murder Mystery#051.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#052.src: The rules are simple! I deal two cards face up to ya both face down, and two cards to me, one face up and one face down.
Murder Mystery#052.dst: ¡Las reglas son simples! Te doy dos cartas boca abajo, y a mí otras dos: una boca arriba y otra boca abajo.
Murder Mystery#052.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#053.src: Ya can hit and get another card as many times as ya want, or stand and end ya turn. The aim is to get the value of your hand as close to {~} as possible!
Murder Mystery#053.dst: Puedes pedir carta tantas veces como quieras, o plantarte y acabar tu turno. ¡El objetivo es acercar tu mano lo más posible a {~}!
Murder Mystery#053.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#054.src: Number cards are worth what they say, all picture cards are worth {~}, and an ace can be worth either {~} or {~}, whichever works best for ya hand.
Murder Mystery#054.dst: Las cartas numeradas valen su número, las figuras valen {~}, y un as vale {~} u {~}, lo que mejor le venga a tu mano.
Murder Mystery#054.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#055.src: Go over {~} and that's it - you're bust! Stand with your current hand and it's my turn to hit or stand to try and beat your hand.
Murder Mystery#055.dst: Pasa de {~} y se acabó: ¡te pasas! Plántate con tu mano y me toca a mí pedir o plantarme para intentar ganarte.
Murder Mystery#055.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#056.src: And if ya get a blackjack - that's an ace and a picture card or a ten - ya automatically get double ya money back!
Murder Mystery#056.dst: Y si sacas un blackjack, o sea un as y una figura o un diez, ¡recuperas automáticamente el doble!
Murder Mystery#056.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#057.src: Sound fair enough? Alrighty, just right-click me again to play!
Murder Mystery#057.dst: ¿Te parece justo? ¡Venga, haz clic derecho otra vez para jugar!
Murder Mystery#057.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Mushroom Man#001.src: O-oh! No, t-there's nothing going on. Not a th-thing. My m-m-mushrooms are... they're fine. Why are you a-asking? Ev-... everything is g-great. W-why wouldn't it b-be?
Mushroom Man#001.dst: ¡O-oh! No, n-no pasa nada. Nada de n-nada. Mis s-s-setas están... están bien. ¿P-por qué lo preguntas? T-todo va g-genial. ¿P-por qué no iba a ir?

Mushroom Man#002.src: Soon... s-soon I will have my m-mushrooms again...
Mushroom Man#002.dst: Pronto... p-pronto tendré otra vez mis s-setas...

Mushroom Man#003.src: G-gah! D-don't you know it's rude to-... to e-eavesdrop?
Mushroom Man#003.dst: ¡G-gah! ¿N-no sabes que espiar es de... de mala educación?

Mushroom Man#004.src: I-... this is bad. This is really bad. We need to tell the Mayor, now.
Mushroom Man#004.dst: Yo... Esto es malo, muy malo. Hay que avisar al alcalde, ya.

Mushroom Man#005.src: Right! Right. We've arrived from {p}, with bad news and a request for aid. The spiders of the forest have grown hostile, and threaten the town.
Mushroom Man#005.dst: ¡Sí! Sí. Venimos de {p} con malas noticias y una petición de ayuda. Las arañas del bosque se han vuelto hostiles y amenazan al pueblo.

Mushroom Man#006.src: And Lieutenant Van is planning a raid on a corrupt stronghold! I'm sure he'd be glad to have more forces with him.
Mushroom Man#006.dst: ¡Y el teniente Van prepara un asalto a una fortaleza corrupta! Seguro que agradecería más efectivos.

Mushroom Man#008.src: {u}, hello! This place is really nice, isn't it? I'd like to stay a while longer before moving on towards {p}, but I'll be ready soon.
Mushroom Man#008.dst: ¡Hola, {u}! Este sitio está muy bien, ¿verdad? Me gustaría quedarme un poco más antes de seguir hacia {p}, pero pronto estaré listo.
Mushroom Man#008.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#009.src: In the meantime, I've been thinking about what we could do to help this place... I've maybe got something.
Mushroom Man#009.dst: Mientras tanto, he estado pensando en qué podríamos hacer por este lugar... Creo que tengo algo.
Mushroom Man#009.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#010.src: Take a look at that villager over there. He's acting a little off, like he's got something going on. I wonder...
Mushroom Man#010.dst: Mira a ese aldeano de ahí. Actúa un poco raro, como si le pasara algo. Me pregunto...
Mushroom Man#010.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#011.src: Alright, I've decided. I'm feeling a little restless, so let's go over there and see if there's anything we can help with!
Mushroom Man#011.dst: ¡Vale, decidido! Estoy algo inquieto, así que vamos allí a ver si podemos echar una mano.
Mushroom Man#011.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#012.src: Maybe we can leave this place better off than it was when we got here!
Mushroom Man#012.dst: ¡Quizá dejemos este sitio mejor de como lo encontramos!
Mushroom Man#012.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#013.src: Speak to the strange man at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Mushroom Man#013.dst: Habla con el hombre extraño en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Mushroom Man#014.src: G-... Hi! H-how can I help you on this... this p-perfectly fine and n-n-normal day!
Mushroom Man#014.dst: G-... ¡Hola! ¿E-en qué puedo ayudarte en este... este día t-tan normal y c-corriente?
Mushroom Man#014.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#015.src: Sorry to interrupt- we're soldiers traveling through this town, and you looked like the sort of person who might need the kind of help soldiers can provide. Anything we can help with?
Mushroom Man#015.dst: Perdona que te moleste: somos soldados de paso por el pueblo, y parecías de esos que necesitan la ayuda que damos los soldados. ¿Podemos ayudarte en algo?
Mushroom Man#015.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#016.src: O-oh! No, t-there's nothing going on. Not a th-thing. My m-m-mushroms are... they're fine. Why are you a-asking? Ev-... everything is g-great. W-Why wouldn't it b-be?
Mushroom Man#016.dst: ¡O-oh! No, n-no pasa nada. Nada de n-nada. Mis s-s-setas están... están bien. ¿P-por qué lo preguntas? T-todo va g-genial. ¿P-por qué no iba a ir?
Mushroom Man#016.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#017.src: ...O-okay, fine, y-you caught me! My mushrooms... my m-mushrooms aren't fine! T-they're bad, even! A-are you hap-... happy now?
Mushroom Man#017.dst: ...V-vale, ¡m-me has pillado! Mis setas... ¡mis s-setas no están bien! ¡E-están mal, incluso! ¿C-contento ahora?
Mushroom Man#017.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#018.src: Ehm- no, but that's why we're here! Is there anything we can do to help your... uh. Your mushrooms?
Mushroom Man#018.dst: Eh, no, ¡pero para eso estamos aquí! ¿Podemos hacer algo por tus... eh. Tus setas?
Mushroom Man#018.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#019.src: Hm. One soldier, two s-soldier... Y-you look weak. I've s-seen str-... stronger. B-But- eheh, the- the s-stronger soldiers are... not here. Y-you'll be good enough. Maybe.
Mushroom Man#019.dst: Hm. Un soldado, dos s-soldados... P-pareces débil. He v-visto más f-fuertes. P-pero, ejem, los s-soldados más fuertes... no están aquí. S-servirás. Puede.
Mushroom Man#019.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#020.src: I- my favorite mushroom spot. I c-can't use it any-... anymore. Spiders. L-lots of spiders. They've t-t-taken over it... I can't get... mushrooms. Can y-you kill the s-s-spiders? Mushrooms.
Mushroom Man#020.dst: M-mi sitio favorito de setas. Y-ya no puedo... usarlo. Arañas. M-muchas arañas. L-lo han t-tomado... No puedo coger... setas. ¿P-puedes matar a las a-arañas? Setas.
Mushroom Man#020.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#021.src: We can kill spiders! Right, {u}? Come on, this is what we're here to do! We became soldiers to help the people of Wynn, didn't we? We'll help you get your mushrooms back sir.
Mushroom Man#021.dst: ¡Arañas sabemos matar! ¿Verdad, {u}? ¡Venga, a esto hemos venido! Nos hicimos soldados para ayudar a la gente de Wynn, ¿no? Recuperaremos tus setas, señor.
Mushroom Man#021.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#022.src: H-hm. Good. I can't m-make soup without... mushrooms. F-follow me, I'll take you to the-... the spiders. B-bad spiders.
Mushroom Man#022.dst: H-hm. Bien. Sin setas no puedo... hacer sopa. S-sígueme, te llevo a las... las arañas. A-arañas malas.
Mushroom Man#022.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#023.src: Follow Yahya to his infested mushroom patch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Mushroom Man#023.dst: Sigue a Yahya hasta su campo de setas infestado, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Mushroom Man#024.src: H-here we are. I- I can f-feel the m-m-mushrooms... from here. And the s-spiders! No-... no good.
Mushroom Man#024.dst: Y-ya estamos. D-desde aquí noto las s-s-setas. ¡Y las a-arañas! N-nada bueno.
Mushroom Man#024.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#025.src: S-so! Mushrooms. Those-... those bad c-creepy c-crawly s-s-spiders... Kill them. P-please?
Mushroom Man#025.dst: ¡A-así que! Setas. Esas... esas a-arañas asquerosas y r-rastreras... Mátalas. ¿P-porfa?
Mushroom Man#025.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#026.src: We wouldn't have come here if we weren't planning to. Alright, {u}, let's clear out some spiders!
Mushroom Man#026.dst: No habríamos venido si no pensáramos hacerlo. ¡Venga, {u}, a limpiar arañas!
Mushroom Man#026.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#027.src: Clear out the spiders from Yahya's favorite mushroom patch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], then return and talk to Yahya.
Mushroom Man#027.dst: Limpia de arañas el campo de setas favorito de Yahya, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], y vuelve a hablar con Yahya.

Mushroom Man#028.src: I-is it done? S-s-spiders... No m-more spiders? Is my m-m-mushroom patch cl-... cleared?
Mushroom Man#028.dst: ¿E-está hecho? A-arañas... ¿N-no hay más arañas? ¿Mi campo de s-setas está l-limpio?
Mushroom Man#028.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#029.src: Looks cleared to me. These are... uh... some fine mushrooms!
Mushroom Man#029.dst: A mí me parece limpio. Estas son... eh... ¡unas setas estupendas!
Mushroom Man#029.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#030.src: Th-thank you soldiers! Th-that was-... I mean. I-it was f-fine, I g-... guess.
Mushroom Man#030.dst: ¡G-gracias, soldados! E-eso ha sido... Digo. E-estuvo b-bien, supongo.
Mushroom Man#030.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#031.src: ...O-oh. Do I n-need to pay you... now? Heh. Is- is [{~} Emeralds] fine with y-you..?
Mushroom Man#031.dst: ...O-oh. ¿T-tengo que pagaros... ahora? Je. ¿O-os vale con [{~} esmeraldas]..?
Mushroom Man#031.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#033.src: Oho okay, ok-... okay! It was a joke, don't get all ex-... ex-... excited. Here, just take-
Mushroom Man#033.dst: Jo, v-vale, ¡v-vale! Era broma, no os p-p-pongáis así. Toma, coge-
Mushroom Man#033.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#037.src: I-... This is bad. This is really bad. We need to tell the Mayor, now.
Mushroom Man#037.dst: Yo... Esto es malo, muy malo. Hay que avisar al alcalde, ya.
Mushroom Man#037.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#038.src: Return to Mayor Alvin at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with news about the spiders.
Mushroom Man#038.dst: Vuelve con el alcalde Alvin, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], con noticias sobre las arañas.

Mushroom Man#039.src: Ah, hello travelers. You seem to be in a rush- has something happened?
Mushroom Man#039.dst: Ah, hola, viajeros. Parecéis tener prisa, ¿ha pasado algo?
Mushroom Man#039.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Mushroom Man#040.src: Yes! Yes, something- something has happened. We went with Yahya to help him with a problem he was having with spiders-
Mushroom Man#040.dst: ¡Sí! Sí, ha... ha pasado algo. Fuimos con Yahya a ayudarle con un problema que tenía con unas arañas-
Mushroom Man#040.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#041.src: Yes, yes, I know of Yahya's antics... He doesn't seem to be with you. Has he ran off on you, just as Ope did?
Mushroom Man#041.dst: Sí, sí, conozco las andanzas de Yahya... No viene con vosotros. ¿Se os ha escapado, igual que Ope?
Mushroom Man#041.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Mushroom Man#042.src: No- no. When we finished clearing out the spiders, we were swarmed- and they took him!
Mushroom Man#042.dst: No... no. Cuando acabamos con las arañas, nos rodearon en masa... ¡y se lo llevaron!
Mushroom Man#042.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#043.src: ...Oh. Oh, dear. That isn't good at all. If they're making moves such as this, unprovoked...
Mushroom Man#043.dst: ...Oh. Ay, madre. Eso no es nada bueno. Si actúan así, sin provocación...
Mushroom Man#043.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Mushroom Man#044.src: You two are soldiers, yes? I would ask you to continue your travels to {p}. Find an Admiral Aegis- tell him our little village needs aid.
Mushroom Man#044.dst: Sois soldados, ¿verdad? Os pediría que sigáis viaje hacia {p}. Buscad a un tal almirante Aegis y decidle que nuestra aldea necesita ayuda.
Mushroom Man#044.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Mushroom Man#045.src: I-... of course. We'll set out immediately. Come on, {u}.
Mushroom Man#045.dst: Yo... claro. Salimos ahora mismo. Vamos, {u}.
Mushroom Man#045.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#046.src: Travel to {p} to request the help of their military at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Mushroom Man#046.dst: Viaja a {p} para pedir ayuda a su ejército, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Mushroom Man#049.src: Another one of these? We've fought one of them before, we can do it again!
Mushroom Man#049.dst: ¿Otro de estos? ¡Ya luchamos contra uno, podemos repetir!
Mushroom Man#049.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#050.src: Phew. I think that went about as well as it could have!
Mushroom Man#050.dst: Uf. ¡Creo que ha salido todo lo bien que podía salir!
Mushroom Man#050.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#051.src: We're both in one piece, the corrupted is dead... Good. That's good!
Mushroom Man#051.dst: Estamos los dos de una pieza, el corrupto ha muerto... Bien. ¡Eso está bien!
Mushroom Man#051.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#052.src: Let's keep moving towards {p}. I don't think it's too much further, if we keep heading east from here.
Mushroom Man#052.dst: Sigamos hacia {p}. No creo que quede mucho si seguimos al este desde aquí.
Mushroom Man#052.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#054.src: Why'd you just leave me there? If we couldn't fight that thing off together, what made you think I could do it alone?
Mushroom Man#054.dst: ¿Por qué me dejaste allí? Si juntos no podíamos con esa cosa, ¿qué te hizo pensar que yo solo sí?
Mushroom Man#054.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#055.src: I managed to get away, but... still. What if I couldn't? Would you have just left me for dead?
Mushroom Man#055.dst: Logré escapar, pero... aun así. ¿Y si no hubiera podido? ¿Me habrías dejado morir sin más?
Mushroom Man#055.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#056.src: ...Whatever. I'm alive, you're alive... that's probably good enough. Let's go find Admiral Aegis
Mushroom Man#056.dst: ...Da igual. Yo estoy vivo, tú estás vivo... con eso basta, supongo. Vamos a buscar al almirante Aegis.
Mushroom Man#056.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#057.src: ...Oh, {u}, you're awake! I was really worried there for a bit...
Mushroom Man#057.dst: ...Oh, {u}, ¡estás despierto! Por un momento me preocupé mucho...
Mushroom Man#057.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#058.src: After you went down, I managed to hold my own long enough for some nearby soldiers to arrive and help. I can't thank Lieutenant Van enough.
Mushroom Man#058.dst: Cuando caíste, aguanté lo justo para que llegaran unos soldados cercanos a ayudar. Nunca podré agradecérselo bastante al teniente Van.
Mushroom Man#058.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#059.src: We, uh... brought you back here to rest up. Aledar's around here somewhere, I think.
Mushroom Man#059.dst: Nosotros, eh... te trajimos aquí a descansar. Aledar anda por aquí, creo.
Mushroom Man#059.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#060.src: Oh, I spoke to Admiral Aegis about the spider problem already. He said he wants to speak to you about it, too. He should be downstairs
Mushroom Man#060.dst: Ah, ya le hablé al almirante Aegis del problema de las arañas. Dice que quiere hablarlo contigo también. Debe de estar abajo.
Mushroom Man#060.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#061.src: ...and that's how we managed to defeat that undead swarm, sir!
Mushroom Man#061.dst: ...¡y así logramos acabar con esa horda de no muertos, señor!
Mushroom Man#061.speaker: Aledar

Mushroom Man#062.src: That's good to hear. Thank you for your work, Aledar. I'll speak to Lieutenant Van and see if he'd be willing to take you into his squad.
Mushroom Man#062.dst: Me alegra oírlo. Gracias por tu trabajo, Aledar. Hablaré con el teniente Van a ver si quiere incorporarte a su escuadrón.
Mushroom Man#062.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#063.src: Thank you for the opportunity, sir. I won't let you down-... Wait, is that- Tasim and {u}?
Mushroom Man#063.dst: Gracias por la oportunidad, señor. No le defrauda-... Espera, ¿esos son Tasim y {u}?
Mushroom Man#063.speaker: Aledar

Mushroom Man#064.src: Aledar! We've finally made it to {p}. We've had... something of an adventure, getting here.
Mushroom Man#064.dst: ¡Aledar! Por fin hemos llegado a {p}. Ha sido... toda una aventura llegar hasta aquí.
Mushroom Man#064.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#065.src: Ah, you two must be the recruits Aledar has been telling us all about. It's good to finally meet you, though I can't help but notice you seem to have arrived in a rush.
Mushroom Man#065.dst: Ah, vosotros dos debéis de ser los reclutas de los que tanto nos habla Aledar. Me alegra conoceros por fin, aunque no puedo evitar notar que habéis llegado con prisa.
Mushroom Man#065.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#066.src: Right! Right. We've arrived from Nivla Town, with bad news and a request for aid. The spiders of the forest have grown hostile, and threaten the town.
Mushroom Man#066.dst: ¡Sí! Sí. Venimos del pueblo de Nivla con malas noticias y una petición de ayuda. Las arañas del bosque se han vuelto hostiles y amenazan al pueblo.
Mushroom Man#066.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#067.src: One of their townsfolk was captured and taken away in front of our eyes. Mayor Alvin sent us here to request the aid of {p}' army.
Mushroom Man#067.dst: A uno de sus vecinos se lo llevaron ante nuestros ojos. El alcalde Alvin nos envió a pedir la ayuda del ejército de {p}.
Mushroom Man#067.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#068.src: Bad news, indeed. Very well, we will make preparations. For the time being, the two of you should rest and hone your skills. Captain Ragon here in the barracks would gladly offer some training.
Mushroom Man#068.dst: Malas noticias, desde luego. Muy bien, haremos los preparativos. Por ahora, deberíais descansar y pulir vuestras aptitudes. El capitán Ragon, aquí en los barracones, os dará gustoso algo de entrenamiento.
Mushroom Man#068.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#069.src: Thank you, sir. But is there anything we could do to actually help?
Mushroom Man#069.dst: Gracias, señor. ¿Pero hay algo que podamos hacer para ayudar de verdad?
Mushroom Man#069.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#070.src: Enthusiastic, aren't you! Let me think... I believe Captain Fenor out by the west gate was looking for aid. If you're willing, I'd suggest you speak with him.
Mushroom Man#070.dst: ¡Qué entusiasmo! Déjame pensar... Creo que el capitán Fenor, junto a la puerta oeste, buscaba ayuda. Si queréis, hablad con él.
Mushroom Man#070.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#071.src: And Lieutenant Van is planning a raid on a corrupt stronghold! I'm sure he'd be glad to have more forces with them.
Mushroom Man#071.dst: ¡Y el teniente Van prepara un asalto a una fortaleza corrupta! Seguro que agradecería más efectivos.
Mushroom Man#071.speaker: Aledar

Mushroom Man#072.src: Yes, yes. Well, I must be off. If the threat of Nivla's spiders is growing... we must prepare accordingly. I hope to hear of your future endeavors, all three of you.
Mushroom Man#072.dst: Sí, sí. Bueno, debo irme. Si la amenaza de las arañas de Nivla va a más... tendremos que prepararnos en consecuencia. Espero saber de vuestras hazañas, los tres.
Mushroom Man#072.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#073.src: ...so, Captain, what do you think? We'll need to start training soldiers more quickly, but I hope that won't be a problem.
Mushroom Man#073.dst: ...Entonces, capitán, ¿qué opinas? Tendremos que entrenar soldados más deprisa, pero espero que eso no sea problema.
Mushroom Man#073.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#074.src: Of course, Admiral, I'll see what I can do.
Mushroom Man#074.dst: Por supuesto, almirante, veré qué puedo hacer.
Mushroom Man#074.speaker: Captain Ragon

Mushroom Man#075.src: Excellent. Now- ah, {u}. Good to see you're up and about again. You gave us quite a shock!
Mushroom Man#075.dst: Excelente. Y ahora... ah, {u}. Me alegra verte en pie otra vez. ¡Nos diste un buen susto!
Mushroom Man#075.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#076.src: Van tells me that goliath the two of you faced was a dangerous foe. He was impressed you managed to damage it as much as you did, even if you ended up needing rescue.
Mushroom Man#076.dst: Van me dice que ese Goliath al que os enfrentasteis era un enemigo peligroso. Le impresionó lo mucho que lograsteis dañarlo, aunque al final hiciera falta rescataros.
Mushroom Man#076.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#077.src: Now, to business. We've already begun planning for our assault on the spiders, but we'll need more well-trained soldiers. Captain Ragon here should be able to help you hone your skills.
Mushroom Man#077.dst: Vayamos al grano. Ya hemos empezado a planear el asalto a las arañas, pero necesitaremos más soldados bien entrenados. El capitán Ragon puede ayudarte a pulir tus aptitudes.
Mushroom Man#077.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#078.src: And if we wanted to help out, sir? I'm getting a little stir-crazy in here.
Mushroom Man#078.dst: ¿Y si quisiéramos ayudar, señor? Aquí encerrado me subo por las paredes.
Mushroom Man#078.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#079.src: Enthusiastic, aren't you! Let me think... I believe Captain Fenor out by the west gate was looking for aid. If you're willing, I suggest you speak with him.
Mushroom Man#079.dst: ¡Qué entusiasmo! Déjame pensar... Creo que el capitán Fenor, junto a la puerta oeste, buscaba ayuda. Si queréis, hablad con él.
Mushroom Man#079.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#080.src: In addition, Lieutenant Van was highly impressed by your fight with the goliath! He told me to pass on that he'd appreciate your help in a raid he's planning on a nearby corrupted stronghold. I believe your friend Aledar was involved.
Mushroom Man#080.dst: Además, ¡al teniente Van le impresionó mucho vuestra pelea con el Goliath! Me pidió que te dijera que agradecería tu ayuda en un asalto que prepara contra una fortaleza corrupta cercana. Creo que tu amigo Aledar participa en él.
Mushroom Man#080.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#081.src: With that, I must be off. We have many preparations to make, and the enemy never rests. I hope to hear of your future endeavors, both of you.
Mushroom Man#081.dst: Dicho esto, debo irme. Tenemos muchos preparativos que hacer y el enemigo no descansa. Espero saber de vuestras hazañas, los dos.
Mushroom Man#081.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Off the Rails#001.src: Tch... Another filthy poor... No, I won't give you any money.
Off the Rails#001.dst: Bah... Otro pobre asqueroso... No, no te voy a dar dinero.
Off the Rails#001.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#002.src: I don't care if you're struggling to get by. In this world, you've gotta put in some work to make it through.
Off the Rails#002.dst: No me importa que te cueste salir adelante. En este mundo hay que currar para poder seguir.
Off the Rails#002.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#003.src: Besides, I've talked to enough of you hobos for one day. I'll be glad to take the Subway out of here.
Off the Rails#003.dst: Además, ya he hablado hoy con bastantes vagabundos como tú. Me alegrará coger el Metro y largarme de aquí.
Off the Rails#003.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#004.src: ...Heh... That look on your face... You don't know about the Subway?
Off the Rails#004.dst: ...Je... Esa cara que pones... ¿No sabes qué es el Metro?
Off the Rails#004.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#005.src: Wow, I thought taking a ride on that thing was the dream of every peasant around here, what with the way my proles are always going on about it.
Off the Rails#005.dst: Vaya, y yo que creía que montar en eso era el sueño de todo campesino de por aquí, con lo que insisten mis peones.
Off the Rails#005.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#006.src: Well, it's an underground transport system that goes all over the province... Not that that matters for a beggar like you, of course. You'll never be able to afford a trip! Ha!
Off the Rails#006.dst: Bueno, es una red de transporte subterráneo que recorre toda la provincia... No es que eso le importe a un mendigo como tú, claro. ¡Nunca podrás pagarte un viaje! ¡Ja!
Off the Rails#006.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#007.src: Now, if you'll excuse me, my train to Auburn arrives in a few minutes. I have important business there. Nothing for you to worry about. Toodles!
Off the Rails#007.dst: Y ahora, si me disculpas, mi tren a Auburn llega en unos minutos. Tengo negocios importantes allí. Nada que te incumba. ¡Adiosito!
Off the Rails#007.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#008.src: Turn in your subway pass at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Off the Rails#008.dst: Entrega tu pase del metro en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Off the Rails#009.src: Hey! What are you doing? The rails aren't safe! If you want to get to the other side, take the overpass!
Off the Rails#009.dst: ¡Eh! ¿Qué haces? ¡Las vías no son seguras! Si quieres cruzar al otro lado, ¡usa la pasarela!
Off the Rails#009.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#010.src: Sigh... Welcome to the {p} subway station. Got a ticket?
Off the Rails#010.dst: Suspiro... Bienvenido a la estación de metro de {p}. ¿Billete?
Off the Rails#010.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#011.src: Alright... I'll stamp your hand to mark that you're allowed on the train. Give me a moment.
Off the Rails#011.dst: Muy bien... Te sellaré la mano para indicar que puedes subir al tren. Dame un momento.
Off the Rails#011.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#012.src: There. You should be good to go now.
Off the Rails#012.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#013.src: The train gets here in about fifteen minutes. Happy travels...
Off the Rails#013.dst: El tren llega en unos quince minutos. Buen viaje...
Off the Rails#013.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#014.src: Wait for the train to arrive.
Off the Rails#014.dst: Espera a que llegue el tren.

Off the Rails#017.src: Eheh... I must have had you all wrong. Let's, er, put aside our past grievances.
Off the Rails#017.dst: Ejem... Te había juzgado mal. Dejemos, eh, atrás viejas rencillas.
Off the Rails#017.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#018.src: Say, buddy, could you do your friend a favor? I've got a meeting in Auburn soon, I need to get on this train.
Off the Rails#018.dst: Oye, colega, ¿le harías un favor a tu amigo? Tengo una reunión en Auburn, necesito subir a este tren.
Off the Rails#018.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#019.src: What do you say you... Give me your space? Just tell the clerk over there that you'll sacrifice your spot for me.
Off the Rails#019.dst: ¿Qué tal si... me cedes tu plaza? Solo dile al empleado de allí que sacrificas tu sitio por mí.
Off the Rails#019.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#023.src: (By the Queen... Must I really say this to every customer?)
Off the Rails#023.dst: (Por la Reina... ¿De verdad tengo que decírselo a cada cliente?)
Off the Rails#023.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#024.src: Oh, hey, stranger. Looking for a chat? Sure, it'll help kill some time, I guess.
Off the Rails#024.dst: Ah, hola. ¿Quieres charlar? Claro, así mato el rato, supongo.

Off the Rails#025.src: The name's Malic, nice to meet you. I'm guessing you'll be taking the train to the same place as me? To {p}?
Off the Rails#025.dst: Me llamo Malic, encantado. ¿Supongo que coges el tren al mismo sitio que yo? ¿A {p}?
Off the Rails#025.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#026.src: I'm pretty excited about it. Around these parts, people never really get the opportunity to travel the Queen's Line. Too expensive for us, typically.
Off the Rails#026.dst: Estoy bastante emocionado. Por aquí la gente casi nunca tiene ocasión de viajar en la Línea de la Reina. Suele salirnos muy cara.
Off the Rails#026.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#027.src: It's always been a dream of mine to see what other parts of Fruma are like, though, so I... well, I saved up for a long time.
Off the Rails#027.dst: Pero siempre he soñado con ver cómo son otras partes de Fruma, así que... bueno, ahorré durante mucho tiempo.
Off the Rails#027.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#028.src: Don't really know what the {p}'ll be like... I can't wait to find out. If it's anything like its Sovereign, it should be pretty great.
Off the Rails#028.dst: No sé muy bien cómo será {p}... Me muero por descubrirlo. Si se parece algo a su Soberano, debería ser genial.
Off the Rails#028.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#029.src: Heh. Enough yammering from me, though. You probably have your own stuff you wanna talk about, right? (After Malic's introduction)
Off the Rails#029.dst: Je. Bueno, ya he hablado bastante. Seguro que tú tienes tus propios temas, ¿no? (Tras la presentación de Malic)
Off the Rails#029.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#030.src: Anything else you wanna talk about? (When the dialogue options reappear)
Off the Rails#030.dst: ¿Algo más de lo que quieras hablar? (Cuando reaparecen las opciones)
Off the Rails#030.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#031.src: Hey again! Anything to say? (Subsequent conversations with Malic)
Off the Rails#031.dst: ¡Hola otra vez! ¿Algo que decir? (Conversaciones posteriores con Malic)
Off the Rails#031.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#032.src: Enough of this, though, or I'll get too excited. Anything else you wanna talk about? (After asking about the {p})
Off the Rails#032.dst: Mejor lo dejo o me emocionaré demasiado. ¿Algo más de lo que hablar? (Tras preguntar por {p})
Off the Rails#032.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#033.src: Sigh. Anything else you wanna talk about? (After asking about Soda)
Off the Rails#033.dst: Ay. ¿Algo más de lo que hablar? (Tras preguntar por Soda)
Off the Rails#033.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#034.src: Oh, shoot. The train's here. I'll catch you later, I guess?
Off the Rails#034.dst: Oh, vaya. Ya está el tren. ¿Nos vemos luego?
Off the Rails#034.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#035.src: ...Wow... Fascinating... I wonder what the cat symbolizes...

Off the Rails#036.src: Oh, hi! Are you from around here? My name's Maddison, I'm a tourist from Aelumia.
Off the Rails#036.dst: ¡Oh, hola! ¿Eres de por aquí? Me llamo Maddison, soy turista de Aelumia.
Off the Rails#036.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#037.src: I've been travelling the Queen's Line all around Fruma to see what the rest of the province is like! It's been a fun time so far! ...Well, mostly...
Off the Rails#037.dst: ¡He recorrido Fruma en la Línea de la Reina para ver cómo es el resto de la provincia! ¡Hasta ahora me lo he pasado genial! ...Bueno, casi siempre...
Off the Rails#037.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#038.src: This region has been... It's not quite what I expected. There's quite a unique culture here, though! Check out the cool wall art! You never see that back home!
Off the Rails#038.dst: Esta región ha sido... No es lo que esperaba. ¡Aunque tiene una cultura muy suya! ¡Mira qué chulos los murales! ¡En casa no ves eso!
Off the Rails#038.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#039.src: I'm really looking forward to seeing what makes {p} different- that's where I'm headed next. So far, everywhere has been really unique!
Off the Rails#039.dst: Tengo muchas ganas de ver qué hace distinta a {p}, que es mi próxima parada. ¡Hasta ahora todos los sitios han sido únicos!
Off the Rails#039.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#040.src: I'm just sad I'll miss their festival... The one here went... bad.
Off the Rails#040.dst: Me da pena perderme su festival... El de aquí salió... mal.
Off the Rails#040.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#041.src: ...Anyway, is there anything you'd like to talk about? (After Maddison's introduction)
Off the Rails#041.dst: ...En fin, ¿hay algo de lo que quieras hablar? (Tras la presentación de Maddison)
Off the Rails#041.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#042.src: ...Anything else you'd like to discuss? (When the dialogue options reappear)
Off the Rails#042.dst: ...¿Algo más que quieras comentar? (Cuando reaparecen las opciones)
Off the Rails#042.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#043.src: Hi again! Want to talk? (Subsequent conversations with Maddison)
Off the Rails#043.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#044.src: Oh, well... Anything else you'd like to discuss?(After asking about Maddison's trip)
Off the Rails#044.dst: Oh, bueno... ¿Algo más que quieras comentar? (Tras preguntar por el viaje de Maddison)
Off the Rails#044.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#045.src: Roughworks? Oh, right, that's what the people here call it. To me, it's the {p}.
Off the Rails#045.dst: ¿Roughworks? Ah, claro, así lo llaman aquí. Para mí es {p}.
Off the Rails#045.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#046.src: I always imagined this place being a bit... cleaner. Maybe the people here are just used to it being messy, though?
Off the Rails#046.dst: Siempre imaginé este sitio un poco más... limpio. ¿O será que la gente de aquí ya está acostumbrada al desorden?
Off the Rails#046.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#047.src: A lot of the people I tried talking to were, well, not very nice. They didn't seem to like tourists all that much...
Off the Rails#047.dst: Mucha de la gente con la que intenté hablar era, bueno, poco amable. No parece que les gusten mucho los turistas...
Off the Rails#047.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#048.src: Overall, this... has probably been the low point of my trip. I think it's just not for me, really. But there were some parts I liked!
Off the Rails#048.dst: En general, esto... quizá haya sido lo peor de mi viaje. Creo que sencillamente no es para mí. ¡Pero hubo cosas que me gustaron!
Off the Rails#048.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#049.src: I already mentioned the pretty murals, but there was a bunch of other cool stuff, too. Did you know the people here fight to resolve disputes?
Off the Rails#049.dst: Ya mencioné los murales bonitos, pero también había un montón de cosas chulas. ¿Sabías que aquí la gente pelea para resolver disputas?
Off the Rails#049.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#050.src: ...Or, wait. You would, since you're from here, right? Or... no, you're dressed pretty different. Where are you from?
Off the Rails#050.dst: ...O, espera. Lo sabrás, porque eres de aquí, ¿no? O... no, vistes muy distinto. ¿De dónde eres?
Off the Rails#050.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#052.src: {p}'s beautiful. I've lived there my whole life, it's my home, it's precious to me.
Off the Rails#052.dst: {p} es un lugar precioso. He vivido allí toda mi vida, es mi hogar, es valioso para mí.
Off the Rails#052.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#053.src: It's just... When you've lived somewhere for that long, it starts to feel... small. Samey. Especially when you're boxed in by those towering city walls.
Off the Rails#053.dst: Es solo que... cuando llevas tanto en un sitio, empieza a parecerte... pequeño. Repetitivo. Más aún encerrada entre esas murallas enormes.
Off the Rails#053.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#054.src: Don't get me wrong, I'm proud to live in the Queen's royal city, but... I needed something new. A change of pace. That's why I decided to go on this trip!
Off the Rails#054.dst: No me malinterpretes, me enorgullece vivir en la ciudad real de la Reina, pero... necesitaba algo nuevo. Un cambio de aires. ¡Por eso viajo!
Off the Rails#054.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#055.src: I'm lucky enough to be the daughter of one of the University's best-paid professors, so I was able to afford such a privilege. Those tickets aren't cheap...
Off the Rails#055.dst: Tengo la suerte de ser hija de uno de los profesores mejor pagados de la Universidad, así que pude permitírmelo. Esos billetes no son baratos...
Off the Rails#055.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#056.src: ...Anyway, sorry, that was a bit of a tangent. Overall, Aelumia's great if you enjoy the city life, it just... gets boring, eventually.
Off the Rails#056.dst: ...En fin, perdona, me he ido por las ramas. En general, Aelumia es genial si te gusta la vida urbana, solo que... acaba aburriendo.
Off the Rails#056.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#057.src: So far, the trip's been pretty great! It's been really refreshing to see how different each region of Fruma is!
Off the Rails#057.dst: ¡Hasta ahora el viaje ha ido genial! ¡Ver lo distinta que es cada región de Fruma es muy refrescante!
Off the Rails#057.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#058.src: I've only been to the {p} and here, though. Both have been enlightening, in their own ways.
Off the Rails#058.dst: Aunque solo he estado en {p} y aquí. Los dos me han enseñado mucho, cada uno a su manera.
Off the Rails#058.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#059.src: The {p} may be the most beautiful place I've ever seen... Not that that's saying much. The landscapes were incredible, and oh, the flowers!
Off the Rails#059.dst: {p} quizá sea el lugar más bonito que he visto... aunque eso no diga mucho. Los paisajes eran increíbles, ¡y ay, las flores!
Off the Rails#059.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#060.src: This place? It's... I guess I've come to learn that some people live by different standards to me, which is... interesting.
Off the Rails#060.dst: ¿Aquí? Pues... supongo que he aprendido que hay gente que vive con otros criterios, y eso es... interesante.
Off the Rails#060.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#061.src: I'm a little sad the trip's coming to an end after the next stop... Fruma is so big, yet so small, isn't it?
Off the Rails#061.dst: Me da un poco de pena que el viaje acabe tras la próxima parada... Fruma es enorme y a la vez diminuta, ¿verdad?
Off the Rails#061.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#062.src: I hear people used to live in the {p} and the Penitence District, but they were moved out. I wish I could go back in time and experience their culture, too.
Off the Rails#062.dst: He oído que antes vivía gente en {p} y en el Distrito de la Penitencia, pero los desalojaron. Ojalá pudiera viajar al pasado y vivir su cultura.
Off the Rails#062.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#063.src: I think this might be the stop I'm most excited for!
Off the Rails#063.dst: ¡Creo que esta puede ser la parada que más ilusión me hace!
Off the Rails#063.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#064.src: My dad teaches biology, and he's been all over the place studying the province's wildlife. His travels honestly inspired me to go on this journey.
Off the Rails#064.dst: Mi padre enseña biología y ha recorrido medio mundo estudiando la fauna de la provincia. La verdad, sus viajes me inspiraron a hacer este.
Off the Rails#064.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#065.src: Growing up, he told me stories of his trips... {p} was always the place that stood out the most, of the ones he described.
Off the Rails#065.dst: De pequeña me contaba historias de sus viajes... De todos los que describía, {p} era siempre el que más destacaba.
Off the Rails#065.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#066.src: It sounds like nothing you'd ever see anywhere else. Golden leaves, beautiful traditional architecture, and the kindest people...
Off the Rails#066.dst: Suena a algo que no verías en ningún otro sitio. Hojas doradas, preciosa arquitectura tradicional y la gente más amable...
Off the Rails#066.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#067.src: Needless to say, I've dreamed of going there my whole life. Of course, I also dreamed of going everywhere else, too. But Auburn most of all.
Off the Rails#067.dst: Ni que decir tiene que he soñado toda la vida con ir. Claro que también soñaba con ir a todas partes. Pero sobre todo a Auburn.
Off the Rails#067.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#068.src: Ah, them. I've not really spoken to either.
Off the Rails#068.dst: Ah, ellos. No he hablado mucho con ninguno.
Off the Rails#068.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#069.src: I tried talking to the one with the funny shirt, but they didn't seem much for conversation.
Off the Rails#069.dst: Intenté hablar con el de la camisa graciosa, pero no parecía tener ganas de conversación.
Off the Rails#069.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#070.src: The other guy? He seems to be from around here, and, well...
Off the Rails#070.dst: ¿El otro? Parece que es de por aquí, y, bueno...
Off the Rails#070.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#071.src: ...I don't have anything against the people of this District, but their attitudes differ from mine, and...
Off the Rails#071.dst: ...No tengo nada contra la gente de este Distrito, pero su actitud es distinta de la mía, y...
Off the Rails#071.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#072.src: ...I'm just a little tired of being berated by them for coming here, okay?
Off the Rails#072.dst: ...Es solo que me cansa que me echen la bronca por venir aquí, ¿vale?
Off the Rails#072.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#073.src: Oh! The train's here! ...Uh, Guess I should catch you later?
Off the Rails#073.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#076.src: You want to talk? Sigh, fine. Fine, I guess.

Off the Rails#078.src: Ugh. Well, see, I'm from {p}. I... don't like it there. So I wanted to see what the {p} was like.
Off the Rails#078.dst: Uf. Mira, soy de {p}. Allí... no me gusta. Así que quise ver cómo era {p}.
Off the Rails#078.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#079.src: Having been here yourself, I'm sure you understand well how that turned out. Now, I'm heading home.
Off the Rails#079.dst: Como has estado aquí, seguro que entiendes bien cómo salió. Ahora me vuelvo a casa.
Off the Rails#079.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#080.src: Really, at this point, I don't know if anywhere in this province is worth seeing. It must all be like this.
Off the Rails#080.dst: La verdad, a estas alturas no sé si algún sitio de esta provincia merece la pena. Debe de ser todo así.
Off the Rails#080.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#081.src: ...But enough about me. What do you want to say? (After Flinn's introduction)
Off the Rails#081.dst: ...Pero basta de mí. ¿Qué querías decir? (Tras la presentación de Flinn)
Off the Rails#081.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#082.src: Anything else? (When the dialogue options reappear)
Off the Rails#082.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#084.src: Sorry about that, I got... Madder, than expected... Anything else you'd like to discuss? (After asking about the {p})
Off the Rails#084.dst: Perdona, me he... cabreado más de lo previsto... ¿Algo más que quieras comentar? (Tras preguntar por {p})
Off the Rails#084.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#085.src: I chose this place because it was the cheapest ticket... I had to exchange so many materials for those weird emeralds they use here.
Off the Rails#085.dst: Elegí este sitio porque era el billete más barato... Tuve que cambiar un montón de materiales por esas esmeraldas raras que usan aquí.
Off the Rails#085.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#086.src: I had high expectations, thought seeing another part of the province might restore my hopes... It didn't.
Off the Rails#086.dst: Tenía muchas expectativas, creía que ver otra parte de la provincia me devolvería la esperanza... No fue así.
Off the Rails#086.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#087.src: I hoped, at least, that the Festival here would be cool, and instead, it was a complete disaster. On top of that, I missed the one back home...
Off the Rails#087.dst: Al menos esperaba que el Festival de aquí molara, y en vez de eso fue un desastre total. Encima me perdí el de mi casa...
Off the Rails#087.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#088.src: I'm just heading home. I guess I'll have to just... learn to like Auburn. Ugh...
Off the Rails#088.dst: Me voy a casa. Supongo que tendré que... aprender a querer Auburn. Uf...
Off the Rails#088.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#089.src: This shirt? Ugh... I forgot about this stupid shirt.
Off the Rails#089.dst: ¿Esta camisa? Uf... Me había olvidado de esta camisa estúpida.
Off the Rails#089.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#090.src: On the way here, some guy came up to me and begged on his knees for me to buy his shirt. It was hard to refuse... I felt bad...
Off the Rails#090.dst: De camino aquí, un tío se me acercó y me suplicó de rodillas que le comprara su camisa. Costaba decir que no... Me dio pena...
Off the Rails#090.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#091.src: I guess "TC" stands for {p} City. For the record, I do NOT love {p} City.
Off the Rails#091.dst: Supongo que "TC" es por {p} City. Que conste que NO me encanta {p} City.
Off the Rails#091.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#092.src: In fact, this shirt doesn't even hold any value to me as a souvenier. I don't want to remember this trip.
Off the Rails#092.dst: De hecho, esta camisa ni siquiera vale como recuerdo. No quiero acordarme de este viaje.
Off the Rails#092.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#093.src: I'm going to have to destroy it, or perhaps trade it for something. I never want to see it again.
Off the Rails#093.dst: Voy a tener que destruirla, o quizá cambiarla por algo. No quiero volver a verla.
Off the Rails#093.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#095.src: It feels like we're living in squalor for no reason! You always hear these wonderful stories about other regions, like that the {p} have beautiful, huge lakes.
Off the Rails#095.dst: ¡Parece que vivimos en la miseria sin motivo! Siempre oyes historias maravillosas de otras regiones, como que {p} tiene lagos enormes y preciosos.
Off the Rails#095.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#096.src: If that's even true, why can't we get some of that water? Why must we put up with the pathetic trickle we get from the dam?
Off the Rails#096.dst: Si es que es verdad, ¿por qué no nos llega algo de esa agua? ¿Por qué aguantamos el chorrito penoso que baja de la presa?
Off the Rails#096.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#097.src: And yet, everyone back home is just so... Okay??? With it??? They think the government couldn't wrong them. They build shrines to the Queen in their homes!
Off the Rails#097.dst: Y aun así, ¡en casa todo el mundo está tan...! ¿¿¿Conforme??? Creen que el gobierno no podría hacerles daño. ¡Levantan altares a la Reina en sus casas!
Off the Rails#097.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#098.src: It's just so... Frustrating!!! Why can't they see things the way I do??? The region itself is mostly fine, it's the people I can't stand!
Off the Rails#098.dst: ¡¡¡Es tan... frustrante!!! ¿¿¿Por qué no pueden ver las cosas como yo??? La región en sí está bien, ¡lo que no soporto es a la gente!
Off the Rails#098.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#099.src: I don't even believe those stories anymore though... I think everywhere is just awful in its own way.
Off the Rails#099.dst: Aunque ya ni me creo esas historias... Creo que todos los sitios son horribles a su manera.
Off the Rails#099.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#100.src: We were always sold this idea of the {p} as this beautiful place where proud workers labored for the Queen amidst beautiful crop fields... You've seen it, haven't you?
Off the Rails#100.dst: Siempre nos vendieron {p} como un lugar precioso donde obreros orgullosos trabajaban para la Reina entre bonitos campos de cultivo... Lo has visto, ¿no?
Off the Rails#100.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#101.src: I bet everywhere is just as bad. I just don't know what to think of anything anymore. It all feels like a lie. But maybe I'm just asking for too much, I don't know...
Off the Rails#101.dst: Apuesto a que en todas partes es igual de malo. Ya no sé qué pensar de nada. Todo parece una mentira. Pero quizá solo pido demasiado, no sé...
Off the Rails#101.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#102.src: Other people? The girl tried talking to me, but she left me alone when she realized I didn't want to talk.
Off the Rails#102.dst: ¿Los demás? La chica intentó hablarme, pero me dejó en paz cuando vio que no quería hablar.
Off the Rails#102.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#103.src: And that other guy? I didn't notice him until just now.
Off the Rails#103.dst: ¿Y el otro tipo? No me había fijado en él hasta ahora.
Off the Rails#103.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#104.src: ...Train's here. Stop talking to me, please...
Off the Rails#104.dst: ...Ya está el tren. Deja de hablarme, por favor...
Off the Rails#104.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#105.src: Hey... Didn't I just ask you to not cause trouble? Could you stop that, please?
Off the Rails#105.dst: Oye... ¿No acabo de pedirte que no causes problemas? ¿Puedes parar, por favor?
Off the Rails#105.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#107.src: Listen. I don't feel like calling the guards over, okay? I'm asking you to please stop.
Off the Rails#107.dst: Escucha. No me apetece llamar a los guardias, ¿vale? Te estoy pidiendo que pares, por favor.
Off the Rails#107.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#108.src: You're really annoying everyone here, including me. Thanks.
Off the Rails#108.dst: Estás molestando a todo el mundo, a mí incluido. Gracias.
Off the Rails#108.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#109.src: Sigh... Whatever, it's not like they're paying me enough to care...
Off the Rails#109.dst: Suspiro... Da igual, tampoco me pagan tanto como para que me importe...
Off the Rails#109.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#111.src: Step aside, citizens. We're here on important business.
Off the Rails#111.dst: Apartaos, ciudadanos. Estamos aquí por un asunto importante.
