Overture to Despair#212.dst: Como todos nosotros: de leche y amor, según dicen. Pero si nos ponemos con el origen del universo, aquí pasamos la noche. Entonces, ¿de dónde son de verdad?
Overture to Despair#212.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#213.src: Ahaaa, I see! So you're looking for the people who seek the truth. A noble endeavour, certainly.
Overture to Despair#213.dst: ¡Ahaaa, ya veo! Así que buscan a quienes buscan la verdad. Un empeño noble, desde luego.
Overture to Despair#213.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#214.src: We'd, um, love to meet some more of these... truth... seekers...?
Overture to Despair#214.dst: Nos, eh, encantaría conocer a más de esos... buscadores... de verdad...?
Overture to Despair#214.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#215.src: There's many a like-minded individual if you know where to look. So allow me to catch your eye with the Aelumia Times! It's the best way to keep up with current events.
Overture to Despair#215.dst: Hay mucha gente afín si uno sabe dónde mirar. ¡Así que permítanme llamar su atención con el Aelumia Times! Es la mejor forma de seguir la actualidad.
Overture to Despair#215.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#216.src: Column {~} will often print the phrase of the day. Read up, and pay close attention! Things will kick off here at midnight.
Overture to Despair#216.dst: En la columna {~} suele imprimirse la frase del día. ¡Léanla y presten mucha atención! Aquí la cosa arranca a medianoche.
Overture to Despair#216.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#217.src: I wish you two good luck on your endeavours. May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change.
Overture to Despair#217.dst: Les deseo suerte en sus empeños. Que desenterremos la verdad sepultada y traigamos el cambio.
Overture to Despair#217.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#218.src: Th-thank you. Um... may we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change!
Overture to Despair#218.dst: G-gracias. Eh... ¡que desenterremos la verdad sepultada y traigamos el cambio!
Overture to Despair#218.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#219.src: Leave the shop and discuss the next steps.
Overture to Despair#219.dst: Sal de la tienda y habla de los siguientes pasos.

Overture to Despair#220.src: May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change. Never forget that.
Overture to Despair#220.dst: Que desenterremos la verdad sepultada y traigamos el cambio. No lo olviden.
Overture to Despair#220.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#221.src: Finally! Finally, finally, something good is happening!
Overture to Despair#221.dst: ¡Por fin! ¡Por fin, por fin pasa algo bueno!
Overture to Despair#221.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#222.src: I didn't even think there'd be a resistance in {p}... it just seems so... idyllic, here. Like... um, like they don't really have... issues.
Overture to Despair#222.dst: Ni se me ocurrió que hubiera resistencia en {p}... es que esto parece tan... idílico. Como si... eh, como si aquí no tuvieran... problemas.
Overture to Despair#222.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#223.src: But... I guess we don't know what life is like here... um, either way, if they're a resistance, they have to have intel.
Overture to Despair#223.dst: Pero... supongo que no sabemos cómo es la vida aquí... eh, en cualquier caso, si son una resistencia, tendrán información.
Overture to Despair#223.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#224.src: Here, hand me that newspaper. Okay... Column {~}... looks like today's phrase of the day is... "No such thing as a green Squirmle Pot?"
Overture to Despair#224.dst: Toma, dame ese periódico. Vale... Columna {~}... parece que la frase de hoy es... "¿No existen las Squirmle Pot verdes?"
Overture to Despair#224.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#225.src: Weird. But... I guess nobody's going to guess it!
Overture to Despair#225.dst: Qué raro. Pero... ¡supongo que nadie va a adivinarlo!
Overture to Despair#225.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#226.src: Okay. Okay... th-this is happening! Majin Thalas, "number one" Sovereign, we're coming for you...
Overture to Despair#226.dst: Vale. Vale... ¡e-esto está pasando! Majin Thalas, Soberano "número uno", vamos a por ti...
Overture to Despair#226.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#227.src: I'm... feeling a lot better now. Um... what should we do now, then? While we... wait for midnight.
Overture to Despair#227.dst: Me... me siento mucho mejor ya. Eh... ¿y ahora qué hacemos? Mientras... esperamos a medianoche.
Overture to Despair#227.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#228.src: I long for a worthy opponent, someone I can fully explore the depths of the endless cosmos with. Maybe then my hunger will be satiated.
Overture to Despair#228.dst: Anhelo un rival digno, alguien con quien explorar a fondo las profundidades del cosmos infinito. Quizá entonces se sacie mi hambre.

Overture to Despair#229.src: I'm feeling a lot better now. Um... what should we do now, then? While we... wait for midnight.
Overture to Despair#229.dst: Me siento mucho mejor ya. Eh... ¿y ahora qué hacemos? Mientras... esperamos a medianoche.
Overture to Despair#229.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#230.src: Yes... um, thinking about it now, I guess I am kind of starving...
Overture to Despair#230.dst: Sí... eh, ahora que lo pienso, sí que estoy muerta de hambre...
Overture to Despair#230.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#231.src: I remember seeing a restaurant earlier! Follow me.
Overture to Despair#231.dst: ¡Me acuerdo de haber visto un restaurante antes! Sígueme.
Overture to Despair#231.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#232.src: I... I guess I could use a nap...
Overture to Despair#232.dst: Creo... que me vendría bien una siesta...
Overture to Despair#232.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#233.src: Okay. I'll meet you in our room.
Overture to Despair#233.dst: Vale. Te veo en la habitación.
Overture to Despair#233.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#234.src: Head to the restaurant and wait at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#234.dst: Ve al restaurante y espera en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#235.src: Oh... this is quite cozy, actually. It... it, ha, doesn't really... compare to the Red Fox... but it works.
Overture to Despair#235.dst: Oh... la verdad es que esto es acogedor. No se puede, ja, comparar con el Zorro Rojo... pero sirve.
Overture to Despair#235.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#236.src: Maybe it's... better that it, isn't the same. I'm not sure I could...
Overture to Despair#236.dst: Quizá... sea mejor que no sea igual. No sé si podría...
Overture to Despair#236.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#237.src: Hello, hello! Welcome to the Peacock Inn! What can I get started for you this evening?
Overture to Despair#237.dst: ¡Hola, hola! ¡Bienvenidas a la Posada del Pavo Real! ¿Qué les pongo para empezar esta noche?
Overture to Despair#237.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#238.src: Today's special dishes are fish tacos, fish miso soup, and yak curry! All locally sourced from our lovely {p}, naturally.
Overture to Despair#238.dst: ¡Los platos especiales de hoy son tacos de pescado, sopa de miso con pescado y curry de yak! Todo de nuestro querido {p}, claro.
Overture to Despair#238.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#239.src: Um... I'll take the tacos, please.
Overture to Despair#239.dst: Eh... yo tomaré los tacos, por favor.
Overture to Despair#239.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#240.src: Coming right up! It'll just be a few minutes.
Overture to Despair#240.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#241.src: ...it's nice here, isn't it? I hadn't... really let myself notice that before. I can see why people talk about the {p} so much...
Overture to Despair#241.dst: ...se está bien aquí, ¿verdad? Antes no... no me dejaba notarlo. Entiendo por qué se habla tanto de {p}...
Overture to Despair#241.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#242.src: I'm... ugh. I'm still so angry. At... everything! The crown, the sovereigns, the... the people of {p}, too!! For... for still living their lives, even... even when it feels like the world's ended.
Overture to Despair#242.dst: Estoy... agh. Sigo con tanta rabia. ¡Con... todo! ¡¡Con la corona, con los soberanos, con... la gente de {p} también!! Por... por seguir viviendo, aun... aun cuando el mundo parece acabado.
Overture to Despair#242.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#244.src: I'm... ugh. I'm still so angry. At... everything! The crown, the sovereigns, the... the people of {p}, too!! For... for still living their lives, even, even when it feels like the world's ended.
Overture to Despair#244.dst: Estoy... agh. Sigo con tanta rabia. ¡Con... todo! ¡¡Con la corona, con los soberanos, con... la gente de {p} también!! Por... por seguir con su vida, aun, aun cuando el mundo parece acabado.
Overture to Despair#244.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#245.src: ...but we have some hope. F-finally. Rex and Zeph... there's still a chance we'll get to see them again.
Overture to Despair#245.dst: ...pero tenemos algo de esperanza. P-por fin. Rex y Zeph... aún hay una posibilidad de volver a verlos.
Overture to Despair#245.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#246.src: And... is it weird that I kind of miss the Canopy, too? Even though they were... annoying, and overbearing, and- and kind of... scary?
Overture to Despair#246.dst: Y... ¿es raro que también eche de menos al Dosel? ¿Aunque fueran... pesados, y mandones, y- y un poco... inquietantes?
Overture to Despair#246.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#247.src: ...and Yusanu. I hope he's alright. I- I, ha, I really hope he can free his family too. I... I, um, don't want him to lose anyone either.
Overture to Despair#247.dst: ...y Yusanu. Espero que esté bien. Ja, ojalá pueda liberar también a su familia. No... eh, no quiero que él pierda a nadie tampoco.
Overture to Despair#247.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#248.src: ...I hope he doesn't hate me. After what I said to him.
Overture to Despair#248.dst: ...espero que no me odie. Después de lo que le dije.
Overture to Despair#248.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#250.src: Um... while we wait. Is there anything you want to talk about?
Overture to Despair#250.dst: Eh... mientras esperamos. ¿Hay algo de lo que quieras hablar?
Overture to Despair#250.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#251.src: ...it's weird. It feels like the ocean is... raging. Thundering storms and crashing waves, and... and still, it doesn't feel like it's at risk of drowning me?
Overture to Despair#251.dst: ...es raro. Siento el océano como... enfurecido. Tormentas atronando y olas rompiendo, y... y aun así, ¿no parece que vaya a ahogarme?
Overture to Despair#251.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#252.src: Like... like I could take as much as I want and it wouldn't change a thing. And, ha, it scares me, a little. It's so... different, to how it was before, but...
Overture to Despair#252.dst: Como... como si pudiera tomar todo lo que quisiera y no cambiara nada. Y, ja, me asusta un poco. Es tan... distinto a antes, pero...
Overture to Despair#252.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#253.src: ...it feels right. Like this is how it always was supposed to be, and I just... didn't realize.
Overture to Despair#253.dst: ...se siente bien. Como si siempre hubiera tenido que ser así y yo... no me diera cuenta.
Overture to Despair#253.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#254.src: Once it's... over...? I... I hadn't... let myself think about that...
Overture to Despair#254.dst: ¿Cuando... acabe...? No... no me había dejado pensar en eso...
Overture to Despair#254.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#255.src: I, um. I actually... had a dream last night. But, ha, it was- it was just that. Just a dream.
Overture to Despair#255.dst: Eh. La verdad es que... anoche tuve un sueño. Pero, ja, era- era solo eso. Un sueño.
Overture to Despair#255.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#257.src: All of us... Rex, Zeph, the- the Roughworks boys... um, Mora, a-and Syndra... we were all laughing and, and having a good time at the Auburn Festival.
Overture to Despair#257.dst: Todos nosotros... Rex, Zeph, los- los chicos de Roughworks... eh, Mora, y- y Syndra... nos reíamos y, y lo pasábamos bien en el Festival de Auburn.
Overture to Despair#257.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#258.src: We ate good food... Yuman played music, while Rex and Zeph were b-bickering... Yusanu and Mora were t-talking about his latest invention, and...
Overture to Despair#258.dst: Comíamos bien... Yuman tocaba música, mientras Rex y Zeph d-discutían... Yusanu y Mora h-hablaban de su último invento, y...
Overture to Despair#258.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#260.src: When I... when I woke up, I- ha, I was c-crying. I- I know, I know! It's... stupid. It's stupid.
Overture to Despair#260.dst: Cuando... cuando me desperté, ja, estaba l-llorando. ¡Ya, ya lo sé! Es... una tontería. Es una tontería.
Overture to Despair#260.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#261.src: ...it's, um, hard to pick out one moment. She's been like a mother to me ever since I was... {~} years old.
Overture to Despair#261.dst: ...es, eh, difícil elegir un solo momento. Ha sido como una madre para mí desde que tenía... {~} años.
Overture to Despair#261.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#262.src: M-maybe the first time I really met her. After I discovered my... my gift, I thought my life was over.
Overture to Despair#262.dst: Q-quizá la primera vez que la conocí de verdad. Cuando descubrí mi... mi don, pensé que mi vida se había acabado.
Overture to Despair#262.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#263.src: I- I was cursed! And I knew what h-happened to the cursed. Taken away, never to be seen again... or, or killed outright. I had nowhere to go.
Overture to Despair#263.dst: ¡E-estaba maldita! Y sabía lo que les p-pasaba a los malditos. Se los llevan y nunca vuelven a verse... o, o los matan sin más. No tenía adónde ir.
Overture to Despair#263.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#264.src: I, um... I'd seen Syndra around before. I... I knew she talked to Mora, before he... l-left our family. So... I, ha, I guess I thought... maybe she'd help me too.
Overture to Despair#264.dst: Eh... yo ya había visto a Syndra. Sabía que hablaba con Mora antes de que él... se f-fuera de casa. Así que... ja, pensé... que quizá me ayudaría a mí también.
Overture to Despair#264.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#265.src: A-and she did! She wasn't scared, she didn't report me. She just... embraced me in a hug and welcome me to her home.
Overture to Despair#265.dst: ¡Y- y lo hizo! No se asustó, no me denunció. Solo... me dio un abrazo y me acogió en su casa.
Overture to Despair#265.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#266.src: She, um, reunited me with Mora again. After... f-five long years alone. She... she saved me, and now... and now she's...
Overture to Despair#266.dst: Eh, me reunió otra vez con Mora. Tras... c-cinco largos años sola. Ella... me salvó, y ahora... ahora está...
Overture to Despair#266.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#267.src: ...I never got to tell her how much she meant to me.
Overture to Despair#267.dst: ...nunca pude decirle lo mucho que significaba para mí.
Overture to Despair#267.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#271.src: And here we are with your orders! You fish tacos, young lady - sturgeon head packed with tangy cabbage, tossed in rice vinegar, crispy seaweed, and punchy umami sauce.
Overture to Despair#271.dst: ¡Y aquí están sus pedidos! Sus tacos de pescado, señorita: cabeza de esturión con col avinagrada en vinagre de arroz, alga crujiente y salsa umami con carácter.
Overture to Despair#271.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#272.src: And another order of fish tacos for you! Please, enjoy!
Overture to Despair#272.dst: ¡Y otra ración de tacos de pescado para usted! ¡Que aproveche!
Overture to Despair#272.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#273.src: And for you, the Bubble Heckel Miso Soup! A hearty broth simmered with today's catch and miso paste that ties all the flavours together! Enjoy!
Overture to Despair#273.dst: ¡Y para usted, la sopa de miso de Bubble Heckel! ¡Un caldo contundente con la pesca del día y miso que une todos los sabores! ¡Disfrute!
Overture to Despair#273.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#274.src: And for you, the Yak Potato Curry! A rich, aromatic dish seasoned with wild heather. Tender yak meat and new potatoes! You're in for a treat!
Overture to Despair#274.dst: ¡Y para usted, el curry de yak con patata! Rico y aromático, sazonado con brezo silvestre. ¡Yak tierno y patata nueva! ¡Va a disfrutar!
Overture to Despair#274.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#275.src: Um... so this is a taco...?
Overture to Despair#275.dst: Eh... ¿así que esto es un taco...?
Overture to Despair#275.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#276.src: I, I guess I don't know what I expected, but... um. Not this.
Overture to Despair#276.dst: No sé qué me esperaba, pero... eh. Esto no.
Overture to Despair#276.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#278.src: Head back to your hotel room at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and get some rest before the meeting later.
Overture to Despair#278.dst: Vuelve a tu habitación del hotel en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y descansa antes de la reunión.

Overture to Despair#279.src: Um... before we go to sleep... Is there anything you want to talk about?
Overture to Despair#279.dst: Eh... antes de dormir... ¿Hay algo de lo que quieras hablar?
Overture to Despair#279.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#280.src: ...it's weird. It feels like the ocean is... raging. Thundering storms and crashing waves, and... and still, it doesn't feel like it's at risk of drowning me?
Overture to Despair#280.dst: ...es raro. Siento el océano como... enfurecido. Tormentas atronando y olas rompiendo, y... y aun así, ¿no parece que vaya a ahogarme?
Overture to Despair#280.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#281.src: Like... like I could take as much as I want and it wouldn't change a thing. And, ha, it scares me, a little. It's so... different, to how it was before, but...
Overture to Despair#281.dst: Como... como si pudiera tomar todo lo que quisiera y no cambiara nada. Y, ja, me asusta un poco. Es tan... distinto a antes, pero...
Overture to Despair#281.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#282.src: ...it feels right. Like this is how it always was supposed to be, and I just... didn't realize.
Overture to Despair#282.dst: ...se siente bien. Como si siempre hubiera tenido que ser así y yo... no me diera cuenta.
Overture to Despair#282.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#283.src: Once it's... over...? I... I hadn't... let myself think about that...
Overture to Despair#283.dst: ¿Cuando... acabe...? No... no me había dejado pensar en eso...
Overture to Despair#283.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#284.src: I, um. I actually... had a dream last night. But, ha, it was- it was just that. Just a dream.
Overture to Despair#284.dst: Eh. La verdad es que... anoche tuve un sueño. Pero, ja, era- era solo eso. Un sueño.
Overture to Despair#284.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#286.dst: Todos nosotros... Rex, Zeph, los- los chicos de Roughworks... eh, Mora, y- y Syndra... nos reíamos y, y lo pasábamos bien en el Festival de Auburn.
Overture to Despair#286.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#287.dst: Comíamos bien... Yuman tocaba música, mientras Rex y Zeph d-discutían... Yusanu y Mora h-hablaban de su último invento, y...
Overture to Despair#287.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#289.dst: Cuando... cuando me desperté, ja, estaba l-llorando. ¡Ya, ya lo sé! Es... una tontería. Es una tontería.
Overture to Despair#289.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#290.dst: ...es, eh, difícil elegir un solo momento. Ha sido como una madre para mí desde que tenía... {~} años.
Overture to Despair#290.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#291.dst: Q-quizá la primera vez que la conocí de verdad. Cuando descubrí mi... mi don, pensé que mi vida se había acabado.
Overture to Despair#291.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#293.dst: Eh... yo ya había visto a Syndra. Sabía que hablaba con Mora antes de que él... se f-fuera de casa. Así que... ja, pensé... que quizá me ayudaría a mí también.

Overture to Despair#300.src: Return to the newspaper shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Overture to Despair#300.dst: Vuelve a la tienda de periódicos en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Overture to Despair#302.src: Oh, is it night time already...? We should get back to the newspaper merchant then.
Overture to Despair#302.dst: Oh, ¿ya es de noche...? Entonces deberíamos volver con el vendedor de periódicos.
Overture to Despair#302.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#303.src: {u}, before we head in. Let's just... observe, a-and not ask too many questions.
Overture to Despair#303.dst: {u}, antes de entrar. Vamos a... observar, y- y no preguntar demasiado.
Overture to Despair#303.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#304.src: Ah, terribly sorry! We're just closing out for the day was on my way out the door. Oh did you find the paper to be enlightening?
Overture to Despair#304.dst: ¡Ah, lo siento muchísimo! Estamos cerrando por hoy, ya iba de salida. Oh, ¿les resultó reveladora la lectura?
Overture to Despair#304.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#305.src: No such thing as a green Squirmle Pot.
Overture to Despair#305.dst: No existen las Squirmle Pot verdes.
Overture to Despair#305.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#306.src: Good, good! Glad to hear you're interested in cutting through the weeds, hearing the stories that matter.
Overture to Despair#306.dst: ¡Bien, bien! Me alegra que quieran apartar la maleza y oír las historias que importan.
Overture to Despair#306.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#307.src: The meeting will be shortly starting- take the stairs behind me, and head downwards.
Overture to Despair#307.dst: La reunión empieza enseguida: tomen las escaleras de detrás y bajen.
Overture to Despair#307.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#308.src: The meeting will be shortly starting- take the stairs behind me, and head downwards.
Overture to Despair#308.dst: La reunión empieza enseguida: tomen las escaleras de detrás y bajen.
Overture to Despair#308.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#309.src: That ought to be all of us. Let's begin, everyone!
Overture to Despair#309.speaker: Resistance Member

Overture to Despair#310.src: We have some new members joining us today. Please welcome them to our society, The Blossom of Blades.
Overture to Despair#310.dst: Hoy se nos unen algunos miembros nuevos. Dadles la bienvenida a nuestra sociedad, La Flor de Cuchillas.
Overture to Despair#310.speaker: Resistance Member

Overture to Despair#311.src: Now, Bleeding Rose. You were so excited to start us off earlier. You've been so quiet normally- how about you share first today?
Overture to Despair#311.dst: Bien, Rosa Sangrante. Antes tenías muchas ganas de abrir la sesión. Normalmente estás muy callada... ¿y si hoy hablas tú primero?
Overture to Despair#311.speaker: Resistance Member

Overture to Despair#312.src: ...thank you, Dusk Garden. I...I think this is pretty alarming, actually... Comparing the prices day to day, bread suddenly spiked. {~} more than just a week ago, with no word of warning.
Overture to Despair#312.dst: ...gracias, Jardín del Ocaso. Yo... creo que esto es bastante alarmante, la verdad... Comparando los precios día a día, el pan se ha disparado. {~} más que hace solo una semana, sin previo aviso.
Overture to Despair#312.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#313.src: I'm not sure what we can...really do about that, but shouldn't we...y-y'know... ... ...do... ...something...?
Overture to Despair#313.dst: No sé qué podemos... hacer de verdad al respecto, pero ¿no deberíamos... y-ya sabéis... ... ...hacer... ...algo...?
Overture to Despair#313.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#314.src: Ugh, again? It isn't an unlivable increase yet, but the poorer among us will definitely be feeling that. Thank you for speaking up, now it's someone else's turn.
Overture to Despair#314.dst: Uf, ¿otra vez? Aún no es una subida imposible, pero los más pobres la van a notar seguro. Gracias por hablar, ahora le toca a otro.
Overture to Despair#314.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#316.src: Psst. What the hell is going on here?
Overture to Despair#316.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#318.src: Oh, oh! The news from {p}!! It's- well, I don't know if it's a disaster, or a good thing, really!
Overture to Despair#318.dst: ¡Oh, oh! ¡¡La noticia de {p}!! Es- bueno, ¡no sé si es un desastre o algo bueno, la verdad!
Overture to Despair#318.speaker: Thorn Blade

Overture to Despair#319.src: Well, I barely had time to read the Aelumia Times to get the passcode. Fill me in, would you?
Overture to Despair#319.dst: Bueno, apenas tuve tiempo de leer el Aelumia Times para la contraseña. ¿Me ponéis al día?
Overture to Despair#319.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Overture to Despair#320.src: This wasn't in the Aelumia Times... Anonymous sources have stated that Sovereign Soosu defied Her Majesty, openly!!
Overture to Despair#320.dst: Esto no venía en el Aelumia Times... ¡¡Fuentes anónimas afirman que la Soberana Soosu desafió a Su Majestad, y en público!!
Overture to Despair#320.speaker: Thorn Blade

Overture to Despair#322.src: What- What do you mean?! Defied, like...went off-script during a speech, or-
Overture to Despair#322.dst: ¿Qué- qué quieres decir? Desafiar, ¿como... salirse del guion en un discurso, o-
Overture to Despair#322.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Overture to Despair#323.src: She allowed terrorists to escape! At least three of them, according to my sources! Word is, too, that... That she was... Executed!!
Overture to Despair#323.dst: ¡Dejó escapar a unos terroristas! ¡Al menos a tres, según mis fuentes! Y también se dice que... ¡¡que la han... ejecutado!!
Overture to Despair#323.speaker: Thorn Blade

Overture to Despair#324.src: I- You guys! A Sovereign went against the Queen! What...what do you think that means, for us? what do you think we should do? If she can do something that big-
Overture to Despair#324.dst: Yo- ¡chicos! ¡Una Soberana se ha opuesto a la Reina! ¿Qué... qué creéis que significa eso para nosotros? ¿Qué creéis que deberíamos hacer? Si ella pudo hacer algo tan grande-
Overture to Despair#324.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#325.src: And get executed for it?! Then who would do the work we do? Soosu has always been a bit of a loose cannon anyways. It isn't that surprising.
Overture to Despair#325.dst: ¡¿Y que la ejecuten por ello?! ¿Y entonces quién haría lo que hacemos? Además, Soosu siempre fue un poco imprevisible. No es tan sorprendente.
Overture to Despair#325.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#327.src: In other news! Sovereign Majin was supposedly seen with an unknown man this Saturday. They were out on a walk, but we all know what that really means.
Overture to Despair#327.dst: ¡Y en otras noticias! Dicen que vieron al Soberano Majin con un hombre desconocido este sábado. Paseando, pero todos sabemos qué significa eso.
Overture to Despair#327.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#328.src: -up for you next time, Rose- Ah. That- I heard that was just a new servant. Nothing too important.
Overture to Despair#328.dst: -te escuchamos la próxima vez, Rose- Ah. Eso- he oído que era solo un criado nuevo. Nada importante.
Overture to Despair#328.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Overture to Despair#329.src: Well, I'll be publishing it in the Majin Monthly anyways. Maybe I could spin a scandal out of this one! ...probably not, but you never know.
Overture to Despair#329.dst: Bueno, de todas formas lo publicaré en el Mensual de Majin. ¡Quizá pueda sacar un escándalo de esto! ...seguramente no, pero nunca se sabe.
Overture to Despair#329.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#330.src: Um... I actually had a question about Sovereign Majin.
Overture to Despair#330.dst: Eh... en realidad tenía una pregunta sobre el Soberano Majin.
Overture to Despair#330.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#331.src: Oh, absolutely! I keep tabs on him, so you could consider me an expert on all things Majin, uh...miss...what was your code name again?
Overture to Despair#331.dst: ¡Oh, por supuesto! Le sigo la pista, así que puedes considerarme experta en todo lo relativo a Majin, eh... señorita... ¿cuál era tu nombre en clave?
Overture to Despair#331.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#332.src: Oh, my... code... name... um. Right. It's- Water Grass. That's my name.
Overture to Despair#332.dst: Ah, mi... nombre... en clave... eh. Sí. Es- Hierba de Agua. Ese es mi nombre.
Overture to Despair#332.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#333.src: ...alright. That... That doesn't follow our naming scheme perfectly but- You know, whatever. What's your question?
Overture to Despair#333.dst: ...vale. Eso... eso no encaja del todo con nuestro criterio de nombres, pero- Bah, da igual. ¿Cuál es tu pregunta?
Overture to Despair#333.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#334.src: I... um, I heard a rumor that he'd picked up some prisoners from the {p}.
Overture to Despair#334.dst: Eh... he oído el rumor de que se llevó a unos presos de {p}.
Overture to Despair#334.speaker: "Water Grass"

Overture to Despair#335.src: Ah! You spoiled my juicy scoop for tomorrow's edition! Yes, the rumour is true.
Overture to Despair#335.dst: ¡Ah! ¡Me has destripado la exclusiva jugosa de mañana! Sí, el rumor es cierto.
Overture to Despair#335.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#336.src: Supposedly, he took these prisoners to his castle in the east. There is, according to other rumour, a dungeon underneath it. It'd make sense- why wouldn't a dictator have a dungeon for dissidents?
Overture to Despair#336.dst: Al parecer llevó a esos presos a su castillo del este. Y según otro rumor, debajo hay una mazmorra. Tendría sentido: ¿qué dictador no tiene una mazmorra para los disidentes?
Overture to Despair#336.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#337.src: R-really? What else do you know?
Overture to Despair#337.speaker: "Water Grass"

Overture to Despair#338.src: That there were specifically two prisoners, and, to bring it back around to Thorn Blade's news, that they're part of the {p} Terrorists! Because of that, the guard around House Thalas is particularly tight recently.
Overture to Despair#338.dst: Que los presos eran exactamente dos y, volviendo a la noticia de Filo de Espinas, ¡que son parte de los Terroristas de {p}! Por eso la guardia alrededor de la Casa Thalas es últimamente muy estricta.
Overture to Despair#338.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#339.src: Incidentally, I was planning on selling this piece to the Aelumia Times. So, don't any of you go writing in before me.
Overture to Despair#339.dst: Por cierto, pensaba venderle esta pieza al Aelumia Times. Así que que nadie escriba antes que yo.
Overture to Despair#339.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#340.src: Well, ah, I heard one of them was that runaway House Athassa girl! Remember the tabloids a few years ago? It was a whole scandal.
Overture to Despair#340.dst: Bueno, eh, ¡yo he oído que una de ellos era esa chica fugada de la Casa Athassa! ¿Os acordáis de la prensa rosa de hace unos años? Fue todo un escándalo.
Overture to Despair#340.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Overture to Despair#341.src: Goodness, Boundless Cherry's sister? I hadn't realized she was involved! Tsk, what a shame that reason doesn't run in the family.
Overture to Despair#341.dst: Vaya, ¿la hermana de Cereza Infinita? ¡No sabía que estaba metida en esto! Tsk, qué lástima que la sensatez no sea de familia.
Overture to Despair#341.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#342.src: What does it matter?! You never shut up about the "one that got away," and- and there's so much more important to b-
Overture to Despair#342.dst: ¡¿Y eso qué más da?! No paráis de hablar de "la que se escapó", y- y hay cosas mucho más importa-
Overture to Despair#342.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#343.src: I do not! Crimson Dagger, please, back me up-
Overture to Despair#343.dst: ¡Yo no! Daga Carmesí, por favor, apóyame-
Overture to Despair#343.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#344.src: What are we going to DO?! We just- I came here because I thought together we-
Overture to Despair#344.dst: ¡¿Qué vamos a HACER?! Es que- vine aquí porque pensé que juntos podría-
Overture to Despair#344.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#345.src: Ah! Ah ah!! Did you guys hear that we aren't getting any freebies this festival? This is absolutely appalling.
Overture to Despair#345.dst: ¡Ah! ¡¡Ah, ah!! ¿Os habéis enterado de que este festival no habrá regalos gratis? Es absolutamente indignante.
Overture to Despair#345.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Overture to Despair#348.src: ...shoot! Me and... um, Shadow Bush... forgot to turn off the stove! We'll, um, see you guys at the next meeting! May we reveal secrets buried and bring change!
Overture to Despair#348.dst: ...¡mecachis! ¡Yo y... eh, Arbusto de Sombra... nos hemos dejado el fuego encendido! ¡Nos, eh, vemos en la próxima reunión! ¡Que revelemos los secretos sepultados y traigamos cambio!
Overture to Despair#348.speaker: "Water Grass"

Overture to Despair#349.src: Uhm- it's "May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change..." People never get it right-
Overture to Despair#349.dst: Em- es "que desenterremos la verdad sepultada y traigamos el cambio..." La gente nunca lo dice bien-
Overture to Despair#349.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#350.src: She's going to do something! I, I know she's going to- I have to- Guys, can't you see th-
Overture to Despair#350.dst: ¡Va a hacer algo! Y-yo lo sé, sé que va a- tengo que- Chicos, ¿no veis q-
Overture to Despair#350.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#351.src: You don't know that! And if you try and convince her to, we won't be having you here anymore! Enough about this, do you have any kind of plan?
Overture to Despair#351.dst: ¡Eso no lo sabes! ¡Y si intentas convencerla, aquí ya no te queremos! Basta de esto, ¿tienes algún plan?
Overture to Despair#351.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Overture to Despair#352.src: Every time I try and think of one, I get shut down! I know I don't have much, but...but, if we work toge-
Overture to Despair#352.dst: ¡Cada vez que intento pensar uno, me cortáis! Sé que no tengo mucho, pero... pero si trabajamos jun-
Overture to Despair#352.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#353.src: Enough of that already, Bleeding Rose! We can't reveal the secrets of the monarchy if we're imprisoned! And don't even try to say "what secrets?" This is big news!!
Overture to Despair#353.dst: ¡Ya está bien, Rosa Sangrante! ¡No podremos revelar los secretos de la monarquía si estamos en prisión! Y ni se te ocurra decir "¿qué secretos?" ¡¡Esto es una noticia enorme!!
Overture to Despair#353.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#354.src: Speak with Sui outside the Newspaper Shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#354.dst: Habla con Sui fuera de la tienda de periódicos en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#356.src: I... wanted to stay for the whole meeting. But after that, I... I couldn't.
Overture to Despair#356.dst: Quería... quedarme toda la reunión. Pero después de eso, yo... no pude.
Overture to Despair#356.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#357.src: We know where they are. We know where to find them!
Overture to Despair#357.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#358.src: I didn't realize all their names would be so... weird and edgy. I had to come up with something! Just be glad it wasn't something worse, okay?
Overture to Despair#358.dst: No imaginaba que todos sus nombres fueran tan... raros y siniestros. ¡Tuve que inventarme algo! Alégrate de que no fuera algo peor, ¿vale?
Overture to Despair#358.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#359.src: Look. I had to think on the spot, okay! I just needed a way out.
Overture to Despair#359.dst: Mira. ¡Tuve que improvisar, ¿vale?! Solo necesitaba una excusa para salir.
Overture to Despair#359.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#360.src: ...was that really it? That's the resistance group around here...?
Overture to Despair#360.dst: ...¿de verdad era eso? ¿Ese es el grupo de resistencia de aquí...?
Overture to Despair#360.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#361.src: All they're doing is... is... is sitting around, gossiping about trivial problems! Like... like it's the end of the world!
Overture to Despair#361.dst: Lo único que hacen es... es... ¡sentarse a cotillear sobre problemas triviales! ¡Como... como si fuera el fin del mundo!
Overture to Despair#361.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#362.src: An increase in bread prices...? No freebies from the festival...? Who cares?! People are... p-people are dying!!
Overture to Despair#362.dst: ¿Sube el pan...? ¿Sin regalos en el festival...? ¡¿A quién le importa?! ¡¡Hay gente... g-gente muriéndose!!
Overture to Despair#362.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#363.src: And... and the one person who was trying to do something kept... k-kept getting shut down... ugh! Why did I think something could f-finally go right...
Overture to Despair#363.dst: Y... y a la única que intentaba hacer algo la... la c-callaban una y otra vez... ¡agh! ¿Por qué pensé que algo p-podría salir bien por fin...?
Overture to Despair#363.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#364.src: Whatever. At least their gossip got us some useful leads... we- we know for sure where Rex and Zeph are!
Overture to Despair#364.dst: Da igual. Al menos sus cotilleos nos dieron alguna pista útil... ¡s-sabemos seguro dónde están Rex y Zeph!
Overture to Despair#364.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#365.src: So... let's head to the castle, and- and take back our friends.
Overture to Despair#365.dst: Así que... vamos al castillo y- y recuperemos a nuestros amigos.
Overture to Despair#365.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#366.src: Violent Heather mentioned, um, a dungeon. That's probably where they're being kept... I- I can get them.
Overture to Despair#366.dst: Brezo Violento mencionó, eh, una mazmorra. Seguramente los tengan ahí... Y-yo puedo sacarlos.
Overture to Despair#366.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#367.src: But... if we just go in, then... there'll probably be too many guards to take out. We need a distraction.
Overture to Despair#367.dst: Pero... si entramos sin más... seguramente haya demasiados guardias. Necesitamos una distracción.
Overture to Despair#367.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#368.src: Could you... draw their attention at the front gates? I, um, I know you're strong enough for it, so... could you do that?
Overture to Despair#368.dst: ¿Podrías... llamar su atención en la puerta principal? Eh, sé que tienes fuerza de sobra, así que... ¿lo harías?
Overture to Despair#368.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#369.src: A-alright. Good. Good, good, good. Come on, let's save our friends!
Overture to Despair#369.dst: M-muy bien. Bien. Bien, bien, bien. ¡Vamos, salvemos a nuestros amigos!
Overture to Despair#369.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#370.src: Well... well, too bad. I need you to do it anyway. Come on.
Overture to Despair#370.dst: Bueno... qué pena. Necesito que lo hagas igualmente. Vamos.
Overture to Despair#370.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#371.src: Head the Majin's castle to the east at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#371.dst: Dirígete al castillo de Majin, al este, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#372.src: Come on, let's save our friends!
Overture to Despair#372.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#373.dst: ...así que es aquí. La Casa Thalas.
Overture to Despair#373.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#374.src: Oh, what I'd give to just... just... stick him full of spikes... ugh, but I can't.
Overture to Despair#374.dst: Ay, lo que daría por... por... llenarlo de púas... agh, pero no puedo.
Overture to Despair#374.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#375.src: I'll... search for them in the dungeons while you, um, cause a distraction.
Overture to Despair#375.dst: Yo... los buscaré en las mazmorras mientras tú, eh, montas la distracción.
Overture to Despair#375.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#376.src: However you... um, do that. Storm the castle, or... or whatever. Just... stay safe.
Overture to Despair#376.dst: Como tú, eh, quieras hacerlo. Asalta el castillo, o... o lo que sea. Solo... ten cuidado.
Overture to Despair#376.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#377.src: We'll meet back at the Crown Jewel once we're done. If... if either of us don't make it, then...
Overture to Despair#377.dst: Nos vemos en La Joya de la Corona cuando terminemos. Si... si alguna de las dos no vuelve, entonces...
Overture to Despair#377.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#380.src: Okay... okay. L-let's get them back!
Overture to Despair#380.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#381.src: Okay. Y-yeah. Just... um, hurry back here once you are.
Overture to Despair#381.dst: Vale. S-sí. Solo... eh, vuelve rápido en cuanto puedas.
Overture to Despair#381.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#382.src: Head the Majin's castle to the east at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#382.dst: Dirígete al castillo de Majin, al este, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#383.src: Oh my, but if it isn't the province's most wanted criminal, striding forth into my House entirely of your own volition! Her predictions are as accurate as ever, it would seem.
Overture to Despair#383.dst: Vaya, pero si es el criminal más buscado de la provincia, ¡entrando en mi Casa por su propia voluntad! Parece que sus predicciones son tan certeras como siempre.
Overture to Despair#383.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#384.src: Quite a foolish thing to do, if you ask me... though I do suppose you have proven yourself something of a wild card these past weeks!
Overture to Despair#384.dst: Una tontería, si me lo preguntas... ¡aunque reconozco que estas últimas semanas has demostrado ser un comodín impredecible!
Overture to Despair#384.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#385.src: But of course! We do hold the leverage here... you must have come in search of your dear imprisoned friends, haven't you?
Overture to Despair#385.dst: ¡Pues claro! La ventaja la tenemos nosotros... has venido en busca de tus queridos amigos presos, ¿verdad?
Overture to Despair#385.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#386.src: What a simple lure... but effective, evidently! It has drawn you in, right where we want you.
Overture to Despair#386.dst: Qué señuelo tan simple... ¡pero eficaz, está claro! Te ha atraído justo adonde queríamos.
Overture to Despair#386.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#387.src: Oh, really! My my, I would have never guessed - to think, holding them captive might draw you in! What an astonishing revelation.
Overture to Despair#387.dst: ¡Oh, vaya! Madre mía, jamás lo habría imaginado: ¡pensar que tenerlos cautivos podría atraerte! Qué revelación tan asombrosa.
Overture to Despair#387.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#388.src: They are here, certainly. But you will not be seeing them. There are greater plans in motion, it would seem!
Overture to Despair#388.dst: Están aquí, desde luego. Pero no los vas a ver. ¡Parece que hay planes mayores en marcha!
Overture to Despair#388.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#389.src: Fight you?! and ruin my decor? Ha! Ahahahaha! Goodness, no, of course not. If I were, you would already be dead.
Overture to Despair#389.dst: ¡¿Luchar contigo?! ¿Y estropear mi decoración? ¡Ja! ¡Ajajajaja! No, claro que no. Si quisiera, ya estarías bajo tierra.
Overture to Despair#389.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#390.src: Perhaps at some later date I might be more amenable to wiping the floor with you! But I'm afraid we have business to attend to.
Overture to Despair#390.dst: ¡Quizá otro día esté más dispuesto a barrer el suelo contigo! Pero me temo que tenemos asuntos que atender.
Overture to Despair#390.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#391.src: Oh, take that dour look off your face. Perhaps if all goes well, we might be willing to discuss returning those friends of yours! I certainly have no need to keep them.
Overture to Despair#391.dst: Vamos, quita esa cara de amargura. ¡Quizá, si todo va bien, estemos dispuestos a hablar de devolverte a esos amigos tuyos! Desde luego, no me hacen ninguna falta.
Overture to Despair#391.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#392.src: I mean, really, what use could I actually have had for those two? Waste my efforts pulling information out of them that I already know?
Overture to Despair#392.dst: Es decir, en serio, ¿de qué me iban a servir esos dos? ¿Malgastar esfuerzos sacándoles información que ya conozco?
Overture to Despair#392.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#393.src: You tell her how you finally killed it. How it fought, and fought, and fought, but could not take you down. How the Light was freed from the Shadows.
Overture to Despair#393.dst: Le cuentas cómo por fin lo mataste. Cómo luchó, y luchó, y luchó, pero no pudo derribarte. Cómo la Luz se liberó de las Sombras.

Overture to Despair#394.src: I mean, really, what use could I actually have had for those two? Waster my efforts pulling information out of them that I already know?
Overture to Despair#394.dst: Es decir, en serio, ¿de qué me iban a servir esos dos? ¿Malgastar mis esfuerzos sacándoles información que ya conozco?
Overture to Despair#394.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#395.src: It was pathetic, honestly. The two of them, sitting in front of me, sniveling like little babies...
Overture to Despair#395.dst: Fue patético, sinceramente. Los dos, sentados frente a mí, lloriqueando como bebés...
Overture to Despair#395.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#396.src: "Spare me, great Sovereign! Spare me, great Sovereign!"
Overture to Despair#396.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#397.src: As if that would save them! Ha! Hahahahahaha!
Overture to Despair#397.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#398.src: Oh, but what does it matter? They are not important, but you... it would seem Her Majesty has taken interest in you, heavens know why.
Overture to Despair#398.dst: Oh, ¿pero qué más da? Ellos no importan, pero tú... parece que Su Majestad se ha interesado por ti, sabrá el cielo por qué.
Overture to Despair#398.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#399.src: But before that, seeing as you are a guest of honour here in House Thalas... allow me to lead you on a tour of the castle!
Overture to Despair#399.dst: Pero antes, ya que eres huésped de honor aquí en la Casa Thalas... ¡permíteme guiarte en una visita por el castillo!
Overture to Despair#399.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#400.src: You should feel honoured. Receiving such a personalized tour is quite an uncommon occurrence around here! Do feel free to write about it in your memoirs... if you ever get the chance.
Overture to Despair#400.dst: Es todo un honor, deberías saberlo. ¡Recibir una visita tan personal no es nada habitual por aquí! Escríbelo en tus memorias... si alguna vez tienes ocasión.
Overture to Despair#400.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#401.src: Oh no, dear guest, I'm afraid you are not. You do not have a choice in the matter, in fact!
Overture to Despair#401.dst: Oh, no, querido huésped, me temo que no. ¡De hecho, en esto no tienes elección!
Overture to Despair#401.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#402.src: Oh, but I rather do insist! You've come this far, haven't you? And you're a guest of the House- it would be quite rude for you to decline.
Overture to Despair#402.dst: ¡Oh, pero insisto de veras! Has llegado hasta aquí, ¿no? Y eres huésped de la Casa: negarte sería bastante grosero.
Overture to Despair#402.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#403.src: So come along, now. There's much to see, much to do! And we wouldn't want to keep her waiting, would we?
Overture to Despair#403.dst: Así que ven. ¡Hay mucho que ver, mucho que hacer! Y no querríamos hacerla esperar, ¿verdad?
Overture to Despair#403.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#404.src: Oh, did I forget to mention? There's someone who would like to meet you! Our Spymaster has finally returned from abroad, and she has much to say to you.
Overture to Despair#404.dst: Oh, ¿olvidé mencionarlo? ¡Hay alguien que quiere conocerte! Nuestra Jefa de Espías ha vuelto por fin del extranjero y tiene mucho que decirte.
Overture to Despair#404.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#405.src: Follow Majin on the tour of his castle at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#405.dst: Sigue a Majin en la visita por su castillo en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#406.src: Now. To begin with, to your left you'll see my personal library!
Overture to Despair#406.dst: Bien. Para empezar, a tu izquierda verás mi biblioteca personal.
Overture to Despair#406.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#407.src: I've amassed quite a large collection, you see. Numerous books written by famous writers from all over the province! Some of my personal work is also featured here.
Overture to Despair#407.dst: He reunido una colección considerable, como ves. ¡Innumerables libros de escritores famosos de toda la provincia! También hay aquí alguna obra mía.
Overture to Despair#407.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#408.src: And straight ahead, we'll reach my secret, not-so-secret, tower of magical tomes and scrolls.
Overture to Despair#408.dst: Y justo enfrente llegaremos a mi secreta, no tan secreta, torre de tomos y pergaminos mágicos.
Overture to Despair#408.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#409.src: Over the years, I've acquired much... hm, shall we say, "forbidden" literature of that variety. The Cursed simply will not stop trying, no matter how foolish the act!
Overture to Despair#409.dst: Con los años he adquirido bastante... hm, digamos, literatura "prohibida" de ese tipo. ¡Los Malditos no dejan de intentarlo, por muy necio que sea!
Overture to Despair#409.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#410.src: I'd say I have mastered... ah, about half of the spells and rituals featured here? It depends on your definitions- goodness knows the psionics have it rough.
Overture to Despair#410.dst: Diría que domino... ah, ¿la mitad de los hechizos y rituales que hay aquí? Depende de tu definición: sabe el cielo que lo psiónico es complicado.
Overture to Despair#410.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#411.src: Oh, good grief, don't play dumb. I know full well that you understand the term. You all out there in Wynn make great use of it, or so I've been told.
Overture to Despair#411.dst: Oh, por favor, no te hagas el tonto. Sé de sobra que conoces el término. Vosotros, allá en Wynn, le sacáis buen partido, o eso me han dicho.
Overture to Despair#411.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#412.src: It truly is a wonder you manage to get anything done out there! Where is the control, the coordination?! No, I much prefer how we handle things here in Fruma, thank you.
Overture to Despair#412.dst: ¡Es un milagro que consigáis hacer algo allí fuera! ¡¿Dónde está el control, la coordinación?! No, prefiero mucho más cómo hacemos las cosas aquí, en Fruma, gracias.
Overture to Despair#412.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#413.src: Yes, the Psionics... old history, that is. Sometime during the RA years, I believe? They had been mistaken for the cursed, and were exterminated by the crown for it.
Overture to Despair#413.dst: Sí, los psiónicos... vieja historia. Durante los años RA, creo. Los confundieron con los malditos y por ello la corona los exterminó.
Overture to Despair#413.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#414.src: A mistake, if you ask me! Psionic abilities certainly should not be considered the same as magic, they're quite different in how they manifest... but alas, it is what it is.
Overture to Despair#414.dst: ¡Un error, si me lo preguntas! Lo psiónico no debería equipararse a la magia, se manifiesta de forma muy distinta... pero, ay, es lo que hay.
Overture to Despair#414.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#415.src: Cursed?! Ha! Oh, no no no, I was not "cursed". I believe you and I both understand the meaninglessness of that terminology, hm?
Overture to Despair#415.dst: ¿Maldito? ¡Ja! Oh, no, no, no, yo no estaba "maldito". Creo que tú y yo entendemos lo vacía que es esa palabra, ¿hm?
Overture to Despair#415.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#416.src: Curses, blessings... a means of controlling the public. A rather useful one, at that - though I never did follow the rules.
Overture to Despair#416.dst: Maldiciones, bendiciones... un modo de controlar al pueblo. Y bastante útil, además; aunque yo nunca seguí las reglas.
Overture to Despair#416.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#417.src: In the end, magic is but another way to obtain power over the weak... is it not natural to seek it out oneself, in order to achieve greatness?
Overture to Despair#417.dst: Al final, la magia no es más que otra forma de obtener poder sobre los débiles... ¿no es natural buscarlo uno mismo para alcanzar la grandeza?
Overture to Despair#417.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#418.src: I don't suppose you would understand. You don't seem the type to have ever reached such heights. Regardless, let us press onward!
Overture to Despair#418.dst: Supongo que no lo entenderás. No pareces de los que han llegado a tales alturas. En fin, ¡sigamos adelante!
Overture to Despair#418.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#419.src: Hm... I shall leave you to peruse my collections for the time being. The tour shall continue at the top of these stairs! Don't take too long, would you?
Overture to Despair#419.dst: Hm... te dejaré examinar mis colecciones un rato. ¡La visita continúa en lo alto de estas escaleras! No tardes mucho, ¿quieres?
Overture to Despair#419.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#420.src: Ah... this before you is my planetarium. Quite the marvel, don't you think? On my journey in developing my magical prowess, I developed quite the interest in the cosmos.
Overture to Despair#420.dst: Ah... esto que tienes delante es mi planetario. Toda una maravilla, ¿no crees? Mientras desarrollaba mi destreza mágica, me nació un gran interés por el cosmos.
Overture to Despair#420.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#421.src: It was this very room in which I discovered the comet which would be named after me! Majin's Comet... this year will be the third time I see its purple shine fly through the night sky.
Overture to Despair#421.dst: ¡Fue en esta misma sala donde descubrí el cometa que llevaría mi nombre! El Cometa de Majin... este año será la tercera vez que vea su brillo púrpura cruzar el cielo nocturno.
Overture to Despair#421.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#422.src: In truth, it fascinates me... the power and mystery lying dormant behind each and every star, just waiting to be tapped into!
Overture to Despair#422.dst: En verdad me fascina... ¡el poder y el misterio que duermen tras cada estrella, esperando a que alguien los aproveche!
Overture to Despair#422.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#423.src: Well, I suppose it wasn't much of a surprise when that was the shape Her Majesty's blessing took on, once I received it on ascension.
Overture to Despair#423.dst: Bueno, supongo que no fue gran sorpresa que la bendición de Su Majestad tomara esa forma cuando la recibí al ascender.
Overture to Despair#423.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#424.src: As I said before, it's quite uncommon for me to personally give a tour of the castle. I take the opportunity to speak on my many accomplishments whenever I can!
Overture to Despair#424.dst: Como decía, es poco habitual que yo mismo guíe una visita por el castillo. ¡Aprovecho para hablar de mis muchos logros siempre que puedo!
Overture to Despair#424.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#425.src: Oh, and you mean to tell me that if you had a voice like mine, you wouldn't do the very same? Ha! Perhaps someday, you'll understand.
Overture to Despair#425.dst: Oh, ¿y pretendes decirme que si tuvieras una voz como la mía no harías lo mismo? ¡Ja! Quizá algún día lo entiendas.
Overture to Despair#425.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#426.src: Ah, the Sovereigns' blessings... they truly are an assorted bunch. Each taking on a distinct shape based on the person receiving it.
Overture to Despair#426.dst: Ah, las bendiciones de los Soberanos... son un grupo de lo más variado. Cada una toma una forma distinta según quien la recibe.
Overture to Despair#426.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#427.src: I wonder, what could yours have looked like? Anything would be more interesting than that of your friend's... oh yes, "Intention." How passive, how boring.
Overture to Despair#427.dst: Me pregunto qué aspecto habría tenido la tuya. Cualquier cosa sería más interesante que la de tu amigo... ah, sí, "Intención". Qué pasiva, qué aburrida.
Overture to Despair#427.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#428.src: But I suppose it's just as well, given his... shall we say, transience. Quite the mission he's signed himself up for! What a relief that I have no need to concern myself with it.
Overture to Despair#428.dst: Pero supongo que da igual, dada su... digamos, fugacidad. ¡Vaya misión se ha buscado! Qué alivio no tener que preocuparme por ella.
Overture to Despair#428.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#429.src: ...oh, yes, this here is my hobby tower! I had it constructed - what was it, {~} years ago? - in order to store all my various projects. I'm a man of many interests, you see.
Overture to Despair#429.dst: ...oh, sí, ¡esta es mi torre de aficiones! La mandé construir, ¿cuándo fue, hace {~} años?, para guardar todos mis proyectos. Soy hombre de muchos intereses.
Overture to Despair#429.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#430.src: As of late, I've been experimenting with gardening, of all things. Incredibly boring, mind you - a word of advice? Don't bother. It is not worth your time.
Overture to Despair#430.dst: Últimamente experimento con la jardinería, nada menos. Increíblemente aburrida, te lo digo. ¿Un consejo? Ni lo intentes. No merece tu tiempo.
Overture to Despair#430.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#431.src: Ah... a better view than this is hard to come by. The {p}, in all their glory! Who needs the {p} when you have this!
Overture to Despair#431.dst: Ah... difícil encontrar una vista mejor. ¡{p}, en todo su esplendor! ¡Quién necesita {p} teniendo esto!
Overture to Despair#431.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#432.dst: Hemos llegado. Saludos, Jefa de Espías.
Overture to Despair#432.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#433.src: Sovereign Majin. And {u}. I've been expecting you.
Overture to Despair#433.dst: Soberano Majin. Y {u}. Te estaba esperando.

Overture to Despair#434.src: Talk to Sovereign Majin and the Spymaster at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#434.dst: Habla con el Soberano Majin y la Jefa de Espías en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#435.src: It's been a while since we've met face to face, hasn't it? And you've been busy.
Overture to Despair#435.dst: Hacía tiempo que no nos veíamos cara a cara, ¿verdad? Y has tenido mucho trabajo.

Overture to Despair#436.src: So in the end you made the choice to search for your answers... bold, I'll admit. You've caused quite the disruption thus far.
Overture to Despair#436.dst: Así que al final elegiste buscar tus respuestas... audaz, lo admito. Hasta ahora has causado bastante revuelo.

Overture to Despair#437.src: I am the Second, the Spymaster. You may call me Two.
Overture to Despair#437.dst: Soy la Segunda, la Jefa de Espías. Puedes llamarme Two.

Overture to Despair#438.src: You've quite the set of accomplishments, it turns out. Careless work by our inquisitors, perhaps, that we did not know beforehand... with some exceptions, granted.
Overture to Despair#438.dst: Resulta que tienes un buen puñado de logros. Quizá fue descuido de nuestros inquisidores que no lo supiéramos antes... con alguna excepción, eso sí.
Overture to Despair#438.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#439.src: To think, the Shade was struck blind by your hand! At no small cost, of course... but a shattered soul means little in the wider stage.
Overture to Despair#439.dst: ¡Pensar que la Sombra fue cegada por tu mano! No sin coste, claro... pero un alma rota importa poco en el escenario mayor.
Overture to Despair#439.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#440.src: Had we known, would you have been given greater consideration? Perhaps. Or perhaps not. Each flaw remains as damning as before.
Overture to Despair#440.dst: De haberlo sabido, ¿se te habría considerado más? Quizá. O quizá no. Cada defecto sigue siendo tan condenatorio como antes.
Overture to Despair#440.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#441.src: Oh, get to the point, would you? I have more important things to attend to then this frivolous attempt at information gathering.
Overture to Despair#441.dst: Oh, ve al grano, ¿quieres? Tengo asuntos más importantes que este frívolo intento de recabar información.
Overture to Despair#441.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#443.src: Of all your accomplishments, of all your history, of each point along your storied trail, there is but one we cannot see. A place we cannot go.
Overture to Despair#443.dst: De todos tus logros, de toda tu historia, de cada punto de tu legendario camino, solo hay uno que no podemos ver. Un lugar al que no podemos ir.
Overture to Despair#443.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#444.src: You and the Light's Scion entered the Realm of Light. At a time pinpointed to have transpired during your stay within, the spread of Gavel's Decay abruptly ceased.
Overture to Despair#444.dst: Tú y el Vástago de la Luz entrasteis en el Reino de la Luz. En un momento situado justo durante tu estancia allí, la expansión de la Decadencia de Gavel cesó de golpe.
Overture to Despair#444.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#445.src: You would later return to your numerous adventures, not a sign of ever having traversed the realms at all. She has not been seen since.
Overture to Despair#445.dst: Después volviste a tus muchas aventuras, sin señal alguna de haber cruzado jamás los reinos. A ella no se la ha vuelto a ver.
Overture to Despair#445.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#446.src: I do not expect you to share this information freely. That is why we are here. To make an... exchange, of sorts.
Overture to Despair#446.dst: No espero que compartas esta información sin más. Por eso estamos aquí. Para hacer un... intercambio, digamos.
Overture to Despair#446.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#447.src: I should rather like to know the same thing myself! The way I see it, it hardly impacts the wider scope of your schemes.
Overture to Despair#447.dst: ¡A mí también me gustaría saberlo! Tal como yo lo veo, apenas afecta al alcance mayor de tus planes.
Overture to Despair#447.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#448.src: I do like to be meticulous. Each additional defined variable helps with the accuracy of my predictions.
Overture to Despair#448.dst: Me gusta ser meticulosa. Cada variable definida de más mejora la precisión de mis predicciones.
Overture to Despair#448.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#449.src: Regardless - the request comes directly from Her Majesty. It appears she is just as interested in the answer as I am.
Overture to Despair#449.dst: En todo caso, la petición viene directamente de Su Majestad. Parece que la respuesta le interesa tanto como a mí.
Overture to Despair#449.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#450.src: My goodness, what a question! How does the Spymaster know these things? What a conundrum - perhaps the title should clue you in?
Overture to Despair#450.dst: ¡Madre mía, qué pregunta! ¿Cómo sabe la Jefa de Espías estas cosas? Vaya enigma... ¿quizá el título te dé una pista?
Overture to Despair#450.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#451.src: There is little I do not keep track of in this world. Mostly, my inquisitors work to collect information beyond our gates...
Overture to Despair#451.dst: Poco hay en este mundo que no siga de cerca. Sobre todo, mis inquisidores recogen información más allá de nuestras puertas...
Overture to Despair#451.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#452.src: Though, in special circumstances, I have been known to do so myself. Such as the one we find ourselves in now.
Overture to Despair#452.dst: Aunque, en circunstancias especiales, se sabe que lo hago yo misma. Como la que nos ocupa ahora.
Overture to Despair#452.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#453.src: Entry to their Claims is not such an easy task if uninvited. You've seen the portal that lies at the end of the Expanse, haven't you? Still active, yet... sealed shut.
Overture to Despair#453.dst: Entrar en sus Dominios sin invitación no es tarea fácil. Has visto el portal del final del Expanse, ¿verdad? Sigue activo, pero... sellado.
Overture to Despair#453.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#454.src: It seems the Shade did not take well to losing its Sight. An act of caution, blocking your access to its domain. The Light is much the same.
Overture to Despair#454.dst: Parece que a la Sombra no le sentó bien perder su Vista. Cerrarte el paso a su dominio es un acto de cautela. Con la Luz ocurre lo mismo.
Overture to Despair#454.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#455.src: Awestruck, are we? I do suppose such is the natural consequence of being in the vicinity of the crown's two strongest Sovereigns!
Overture to Despair#455.dst: ¿Te ha dejado sin habla? Supongo que es la consecuencia natural de estar cerca de los dos Soberanos más fuertes de la corona.
Overture to Despair#455.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#456.src: But I'm afraid we do need you to speak up, so do get over yourself, would you?
Overture to Despair#456.dst: Pero me temo que necesitamos que hables, así que déjate de tonterías, ¿quieres?
Overture to Despair#456.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#457.src: And so, we return to the exchange. If you tell us what we wish to know, I will offer some valuable information in return. I trust it will be of interest to you.
Overture to Despair#457.dst: Y así volvemos al intercambio. Si nos dices lo que deseamos saber, te ofreceré a cambio información valiosa. Confío en que te interese.
Overture to Despair#457.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#458.src: Well, do we have a deal?
Overture to Despair#458.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#459.src: You always have a choice. But sometimes, there is a right and a wrong choice to make. The decision is yours.
Overture to Despair#459.dst: Siempre hay elección. Pero a veces hay una elección correcta y otra equivocada. La decisión es tuya.
Overture to Despair#459.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#460.src: So tell me. What happened in the Realm of Light? What could we not see?
Overture to Despair#460.dst: Así que dime. ¿Qué pasó en el Reino de la Luz? ¿Qué no pudimos ver?
Overture to Despair#460.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#462.src: How very interesting. To think, the Shade has enough trust in War's lost Scion to send him to defend its trump card...
Overture to Despair#462.dst: Qué interesante. Pensar que la Sombra confía tanto en el Vástago perdido de la Guerra como para enviarlo a defender su as en la manga...
Overture to Despair#462.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#463.src: I had wondered when he might finally show his ugly face again. Heavens know we'd had enough of him already.
Overture to Despair#463.dst: Me preguntaba cuándo volvería a asomar su fea cara. Sabe el cielo que ya habíamos tenido bastante de él.
Overture to Despair#463.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#464.src: And the Dawn is freed from the Dusk's assault... but its Scion is lost to the Dark's Claim... a step forward, and a step back alike.
Overture to Despair#464.dst: Y el Alba se libra del asalto del Ocaso... pero su Vástago se pierde en el Dominio de la Oscuridad... un paso adelante y otro atrás.
Overture to Despair#464.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#465.src: A step back, perhaps, but it could also be a boon in disguise. She could serve as a potential ally for your... whatever, if you could only locate her.
Overture to Despair#465.dst: Un paso atrás, quizá, pero también podría ser una bendición disfrazada. Podría servirte de aliada para tu... lo que sea, si lograras localizarla.
Overture to Despair#465.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#466.src: Certainly, she could. This will shift the trajectory of certain shards of possibility... I'll have to dive deeper into the consequences.
Overture to Despair#466.dst: Sin duda podría. Esto desviará la trayectoria de ciertos fragmentos de posibilidad... tendré que ahondar en las consecuencias.
Overture to Despair#466.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#467.src: Regardless, this has been enlightening. Her Majesty will certainly be interested in these developments.
Overture to Despair#467.dst: En cualquier caso, ha sido revelador. A Su Majestad le interesarán sin duda estos acontecimientos.
Overture to Despair#467.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#468.src: You refer to the War of the Realms, I presume?
Overture to Despair#468.dst: Te refieres a la Guerra de los Reinos, supongo.
Overture to Despair#468.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#469.src: I suppose it must. Beyond the wider scope, why do we care? Wynn's corruption is at a safe distance, and both Light and Dark are far, far away.
Overture to Despair#469.dst: Supongo que sí. Más allá del alcance mayor, ¿qué nos importa? La corrupción de Wynn queda lejos, y la Luz y la Oscuridad, muchísimo más.
Overture to Despair#469.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#470.src: I can answer your question. But first, a tale.
Overture to Despair#470.dst: Puedo responder a tu pregunta. Pero primero, un relato.
Overture to Despair#470.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#471.src: Once, there were two twins orbiting one another, each laying claim to their own piece of the void they were given.
Overture to Despair#471.dst: Hubo una vez dos gemelos que se orbitaban, cada cual reclamando su trozo del vacío que les fue dado.
Overture to Despair#471.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#472.src: The first was bright, radiant, overwhelming. The other was dark, shadowed, suffocating. Gazing through the abyss, they saw one another - each a mirror image of the other.
Overture to Despair#472.dst: El primero era brillante, radiante, abrumador. El otro era oscuro, sombrío, asfixiante. Al mirar a través del abismo, se vieron el uno al otro: cada cual, imagen especular del otro.
Overture to Despair#472.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#473.src: The twins grew to hate each other. They built forms all their own, denying the truth of their reflections. They tried, and tried, and tried to break their bonds...
Overture to Despair#473.dst: Los gemelos llegaron a odiarse. Se construyeron formas propias, negando la verdad de sus reflejos. Lo intentaron, y lo intentaron, y lo intentaron, por romper sus lazos...
Overture to Despair#473.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#474.src: ...but in the end, they could do naught but orbit - holding influence in their own right, but possessing nothing to exert it on.
Overture to Despair#474.dst: ...pero al final no pudieron sino orbitar: con influencia propia, pero sin nada sobre lo que ejercerla.
Overture to Despair#474.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#475.src: Until... they found it. A miraculous world, of magic and life, and all of a sudden, nothing became something.
Overture to Despair#475.dst: Hasta que... lo encontraron. Un mundo milagroso, de magia y vida, y de pronto la nada se volvió algo.
Overture to Despair#475.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#477.src: And in so doing, they came to shatter the mirror which once held their reflections. A building pressure of light and dark and hate, until finally enough was enough...
Overture to Despair#477.dst: Y al hacerlo, rompieron el espejo que antaño sostenía sus reflejos. Una presión creciente de luz y oscuridad y odio, hasta que por fin fue demasiado...
Overture to Despair#477.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#478.src: And from those uncountable shattered pieces of their battleground, War came to be.
Overture to Despair#478.dst: Y de aquellos incontables pedazos rotos de su campo de batalla, nació la Guerra.
Overture to Despair#478.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#479.src: War, Chaos, Hate... call it what you will. It was lesser, holding less control over itself than the twins from which it was birthed.
Overture to Despair#479.dst: Guerra, Caos, Odio... llámalo como quieras. Era menor, con menos dominio de sí misma que los gemelos que la engendraron.
Overture to Despair#479.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#480.src: All it knew was the hatred of the twins, directed towards one another, never acknowledging the battlefield they had made. All it knew was the pain of being.
Overture to Despair#480.dst: Solo conocía el odio de los gemelos, dirigido el uno al otro, sin reconocer nunca el campo de batalla que habían creado. Solo conocía el dolor de existir.
Overture to Despair#480.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#481.src: Until, one day... it all stopped. The twins had lost their connection to their world of influence, and could no longer sustain their endless War.
Overture to Despair#481.dst: Hasta que, un día... todo se detuvo. Los gemelos perdieron su conexión con el mundo donde influían y ya no pudieron sostener su Guerra sin fin.
Overture to Despair#481.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#482.src: It was in that silence that War could finally sense beyond itself, could feel the world the twins had taken for granted, the beauty they had discarded in their race for victory.
Overture to Despair#482.dst: Fue en ese silencio cuando la Guerra pudo por fin percibir más allá de sí misma, sentir el mundo que los gemelos daban por hecho, la belleza que habían desechado en su carrera por vencer.
Overture to Despair#482.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#483.src: And so, when the connections emerged once more, it took its chance.
Overture to Despair#483.dst: Y así, cuando las conexiones volvieron a surgir, aprovechó su oportunidad.
Overture to Despair#483.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#484.src: It broke through the endless void, forcing its own connection unto the world, following in the twins' example.
Overture to Despair#484.dst: Atravesó el vacío infinito e impuso su propia conexión al mundo, siguiendo el ejemplo de los gemelos.
Overture to Despair#484.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#485.src: Finally, it saw the world beyond... sprawling plains, forests, seas. Saw towns, cities, farmlands- war, destruction, tainted by the human desperation to live.
Overture to Despair#485.dst: Por fin vio el mundo de fuera... llanuras extensas, bosques, mares. Vio pueblos, ciudades, campos; guerra, destrucción, manchados por la desesperación humana por vivir.
Overture to Despair#485.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#486.src: And it began to dream of that desperation itself.
Overture to Despair#486.dst: Y empezó a soñar con esa desesperación misma.
Overture to Despair#486.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#488.src: Her Majesty is War - was War. But it is no longer hers - instead, she has chosen to lay claim to this world's protection.
Overture to Despair#488.dst: Su Majestad es la Guerra. Lo era. Pero ya no le pertenece: ha elegido reclamar la protección de este mundo.
Overture to Despair#488.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#489.src: And in the meanwhile, the twins continue to take and take and take. If left unchecked, they will take until there is nothing left to fight over.
Overture to Despair#489.dst: Y mientras tanto, los gemelos siguen tomando y tomando y tomando. Si nadie los frena, tomarán hasta que no quede nada por lo que luchar.
Overture to Despair#489.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#490.src: ... Will that do for your answer?
Overture to Despair#490.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#491.src: You've a streak for the dramatic, don't you... Was that truly all necessary? We could have always laid it out simply- on that note, why even answer at all?
Overture to Despair#491.dst: Tienes una vena dramática, ¿eh...? ¿De verdad hacía falta todo eso? Podríamos haberlo dicho sin más... y, ya puestos, ¿para qué responder?
Overture to Despair#491.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#492.src: I believe the context to be important.
Overture to Despair#492.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#493.src: Of course you would... well then, are we finished here?
Overture to Despair#493.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#494.src: I suppose we are. We may consider this interrogation adjourned.
Overture to Despair#494.dst: Supongo que sí. Demos este interrogatorio por concluido.
Overture to Despair#494.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#495.src: Ah ah ah! Not so fast. Certainly, neither of us will deign to stop your escape... but the troops lying in wait will have no such reservations.
Overture to Despair#495.dst: ¡Ah, ah, ah! No tan rápido. Desde luego, ninguno de los dos se dignará a impedir tu huida... pero las tropas apostadas no tendrán tantos reparos.
Overture to Despair#495.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#496.src: Now, see yourself out, would you? You are dismissed.
Overture to Despair#496.dst: Y ahora ya sabes dónde está la puerta, ¿verdad? Puedes retirarte.
Overture to Despair#496.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#498.src: ...oh, would you take your leave already? You're ruining the view.
Overture to Despair#498.dst: ...oh, ¿te vas a marchar ya? Me estás estropeando la vista.
Overture to Despair#498.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#499.src: I believe we'll meet once again very soon.
Overture to Despair#499.dst: Creo que volveremos a vernos muy pronto.
Overture to Despair#499.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#500.src: Regroup at the Crown Jewel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#500.dst: Reagrúpate en La Joya de la Corona en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#504.src: We're alive, so... better than nothing, huh?
Overture to Despair#504.dst: Estamos vivos, así que... mejor que nada, ¿no?
Overture to Despair#504.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#506.dst: Seguimos en pie. A pesar de todo.
Overture to Despair#506.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#508.src: ...yeah. Gods, I... I can't believe they're gone.
Overture to Despair#508.dst: ...sí. Dioses, no... no me creo que ya no estén.
Overture to Despair#508.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#509.src: S...Syndra, a- and Mora... and we, we c...couldn't do an- any- anything!
Overture to Despair#509.dst: S...Syndra, y- y Mora... ¡y nosotros n...no pudimos hacer n- na- nada!
Overture to Despair#509.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#510.src: Ugh, how stupid could we have been...? Of course they knew what we were planning. A group that big...
Overture to Despair#510.dst: Agh, ¿cómo pudimos ser tan tontos...? Claro que sabían lo que planeábamos. Un grupo tan grande...
Overture to Despair#510.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#511.src: What was Syndra thinking? We should've called it off the minute we knew there would be another Sovereign...
