Recipe For Disaster#069.dst: ¿Investigar para ayudar? ¡Cuántas convenientes! ¡Humynos requerir ayudación! ¡Tú observador, humynos volfallar dentro de gran roca-cráter!
Recipe For Disaster#069.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#070.src: Burnmilk run out and one direction to retrieve it is moonsalt! We strike lucknugget and discover moonsalt on crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#070.dst: ¡Quemaleche acabarse y una dirección para recuperar ser moonsalt! ¡Nosotros golpear pepitasuerte y descubrir moonsalt en roca-cráter!
Recipe For Disaster#070.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#071.src: Refined moonsalt gives burnmilk for spacezoom! Inconveniencing, spacezoom destroyed. Humyns create miniscule Spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#071.dst: ¡Moonsalt refinado dar quemaleche para espaciozum! Inconvenienciar, espaciozum destruido. ¡Humynos crear Espaciozum minúsculo!
Recipe For Disaster#071.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#072.src: Only singular humyn can fit in current spacezoom. If strangeling helps humyns will let strangeling in spacezoom. Humyns can create new spacezoom in given time!
Recipe For Disaster#072.dst: Solo humyno singular caber en espaciozum actual. Si forastín ayudar, humynos dejar forastín entrar. ¡Humynos poder crear espaciozum nuevo en tiempo dado!
Recipe For Disaster#072.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#073.src: Humyns currently residing on crater-rock, meaning waiting is not result of death!
Recipe For Disaster#073.dst: ¡Humynos residir ahora en roca-cráter, esperar no ser resultado de muerte!
Recipe For Disaster#073.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#074.src: Moonsalt discovered in saltcave in north, strangeling follow path!
Recipe For Disaster#074.dst: ¡Moonsalt descubierto en cuevasal del norte, forastín seguir sendero!
Recipe For Disaster#074.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#075.src: Just [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] need for burnmilk, strangeling can grab any left over!
Recipe For Disaster#075.dst: ¡Solo [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] necesitar para quemaleche, forastín poder coger lo sobrante!
Recipe For Disaster#075.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#076.src: When strangeling has moonsalt, refine at device beside humyn and go zoom in spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#076.dst: ¡Cuando forastín tener moonsalt, refinar en aparato junto a humyno y zumbar en espaciozum!
Recipe For Disaster#076.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#077.src: Hello aaand welcome to the Racetrack of the Century!
Recipe For Disaster#077.dst: ¡Hola y bieeenvenidos al Circuito del Siglo!
Recipe For Disaster#077.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#078.src: One winner, one loser. And Usnail Bolt eats losers for breakfast.
Recipe For Disaster#078.dst: Un ganador, un perdedor. Y Usnail Bolt desayuna perdedores.
Recipe For Disaster#078.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#079.src: Breakfast? Wait, did I have breakfast? A little breckkie could be good fo-
Recipe For Disaster#079.dst: ¿Desayuno? Espera, ¿he desayunado? Un desayunillo no vendría ma-
Recipe For Disaster#079.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#080.src: Well, no matter. What do you say, adventurer? Enter the race against Usnail Bolt. The grand prize is some Snail Slime!
Recipe For Disaster#080.dst: Bueno, da igual. ¿Qué me dices, aventurero? Compite en la carrera contra Usnail Bolt. ¡El gran premio es un poco de Snail Slime!
Recipe For Disaster#080.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#082.src: Shame, could've been a great race. See you around, adventurer!
Recipe For Disaster#082.dst: Lástima, habría sido una gran carrera. ¡Nos vemos, aventurero!
Recipe For Disaster#082.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#083.src: Well well well... looks like Usnail Bolt has won this one. Again.
Recipe For Disaster#083.dst: Vaya, vaya... parece que Usnail Bolt ha ganado esta. Otra vez.
Recipe For Disaster#083.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#084.src: Not your lucky day, human. Oh well, you know the price for losing. Guards!
Recipe For Disaster#084.dst: No es tu día, humano. En fin, ya sabes el precio de perder. ¡Guardias!
Recipe For Disaster#084.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#085.src: Wowee! In what turned out to be an amazing race, the human has managed to steal the lead right out from Usnail Bolt's nose!
Recipe For Disaster#085.dst: ¡Guau! ¡En una carrera que ha resultado increíble, el humano le ha robado la delantera a Usnail Bolt en sus propias narices!
Recipe For Disaster#085.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#086.src: Here, human. Take this slime as your prize.
Recipe For Disaster#086.dst: Toma, humano. Llévate esta baba como premio.
Recipe For Disaster#086.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#087.src: ISN'T THIS JUST ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC. A HUMAN?! WHO WOULD HAVE GUESSED.
Recipe For Disaster#087.dst: ¿NO ES ESTO SENCILLAMENTE FANTÁSTICO? ¿¡UN HUMANO!? QUIÉN LO HABRÍA IMAGINADO.
Recipe For Disaster#087.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#088.src: YOU'RE THE SEVENTH ONE PASSING ME TODAY AND YOU'RE NO DIFFERENT FROM THE OTHERS.
Recipe For Disaster#088.dst: ERES EL SÉPTIMO QUE PASA POR AQUÍ HOY Y NO TE DIFERENCIAS EN NADA DE LOS DEMÁS.
Recipe For Disaster#088.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#089.src: EVERY SINGLE ONE WITH THAT DOPEY SHEEPISH LOOK ON THEIR FACE, AS IF A TALKING MUSHROOM IS OUT OF THE BLUE.
Recipe For Disaster#089.dst: TODOS CON ESA CARA DE BOBO ASUSTADIZO, COMO SI UNA SETA PARLANTE FUERA ALGO CAÍDO DEL CIELO.
Recipe For Disaster#089.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#090.src: GIVE ME A BREAK, I'VE HAD ENOUGH OF JERKS PICKING ME UP AND DISRESPECTING ME LIKE THAT. PRIVATE SPACE, EVER HEARD OF IT?
Recipe For Disaster#090.dst: DADME UN RESPIRO, ESTOY HARTO DE IMBÉCILES QUE ME ARRANCAN Y ME FALTAN AL RESPETO. ESPACIO PERSONAL, ¿TE SUENA?
Recipe For Disaster#090.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#091.src: WHY DO I EVEN TRY. JUST LOOK AT YOU! THE EPITOME OF CLUELESS. WHAT NOW, GONNA TAKE ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS?
Recipe For Disaster#091.dst: PARA QUÉ LO INTENTO. ¡MÍRATE! LA VIVA IMAGEN DEL DESPISTE. ¿Y AHORA QUÉ, ME LLEVAS DE AVENTURA CHIFLADA POR LAS ISLAS DEL CIELO?
Recipe For Disaster#091.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#092.src: I HOPE NOT, IF YOU WERE THINKING THAT. I'VE ALREADY LOST A STEM TODAY BECAUSE SOME DIMWIT TRIED TAKING A BITE OUT OF ME... LIVE!
Recipe For Disaster#092.dst: ESPERO QUE NO, SI ES LO QUE PENSABAS. YA HE PERDIDO UN PIE HOY PORQUE ALGÚN MEMO INTENTÓ DARME UN BOCADO... ¡EN VIVO!
Recipe For Disaster#092.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#093.src: DON'T TELL ME, ARE YOU TAKING ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS? HOW LOVELY.
Recipe For Disaster#093.dst: NO ME DIGAS, ¿ME LLEVAS DE AVENTURA CHIFLADA POR LAS ISLAS DEL CIELO? QUÉ ENCANTO.
Recipe For Disaster#093.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#094.src: A KITCHEN YOU SAY, WELL, IF IT'LL PUT ME OUT OF MY MISERY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, THEN WHY NOT.
Recipe For Disaster#094.dst: A UNA COCINA, DICES. BUENO, SI ASÍ ACABA ANTES MI SUFRIMIENTO, POR QUÉ NO.
Recipe For Disaster#094.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#095.src: WAIT, WHY ARE YOU STUFFING ME INTO YOUR BAG? HOW DO YOU EXPECT ME TO BREATHE IN HERE?!
Recipe For Disaster#095.dst: ESPERA, ¿POR QUÉ ME METES EN TU BOLSA? ¿¡CÓMO PRETENDES QUE RESPIRE AQUÍ DENTRO!?
Recipe For Disaster#095.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#096.src: Hello there! I can see you knead you some sunrise flour, don't you?
Recipe For Disaster#096.dst: ¡Hola! Veo que necesitas Sunrise Flour, ¿o me estoy pasando de la masa?
Recipe For Disaster#096.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#097.src: It's needed rye away? Well no worries, friend!
Recipe For Disaster#097.dst: ¿La necesitas ya de ya? ¡Sin problema, amigo, pan comido!
Recipe For Disaster#097.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#098.src: Well butter me up and call me toast, it seems I ran out of the stuff, there's none left.
Recipe For Disaster#098.dst: Que me unten con mantequilla y me llamen tostada: se me ha acabado, no queda ni una pizca.
Recipe For Disaster#098.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#099.src: I'm sorry if I see to just be loafing around, but at yeast I know how to make some more.
Recipe For Disaster#099.dst: Perdona si parece que me estoy dejando leudar, pero al menos sé cómo hacer más.
Recipe For Disaster#099.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#100.src: Can you see that wheat field over there, next to the bakery? You can farm up some wheat and pop it on the mill.
Recipe For Disaster#100.dst: ¿Ves ese trigal de ahí, al lado de la panadería? Puedes cosechar trigo y meterlo en el molino.
Recipe For Disaster#100.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#101.src: Grab a scythe from the tool merchant next dough and get to work!
Recipe For Disaster#101.dst: ¡Coge una guadaña en la tienda de al 'pan'... de al lado, y a trabajar!
Recipe For Disaster#101.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#102.src: Make as much as you want, I've made all the bread I need for today already.
Recipe For Disaster#102.dst: Haz toda la que quieras, el pan de hoy ya lo tengo horneado.
Recipe For Disaster#102.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#103.src: Howdy, pal! Looking for some Skyhigh Raspberries? They work great in a pie!
Recipe For Disaster#103.dst: ¡Hola, amigo! ¿Buscas Skyhigh Raspberries? ¡Van genial en una tarta!
Recipe For Disaster#103.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#104.src: If you're interested, it's just a small fee of {~} Emeralds to get access to the island.
Recipe For Disaster#104.dst: Si te interesa, acceder a la isla cuesta solo {~} esmeraldas.
Recipe For Disaster#104.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#105.src: A man's gotta make a living somehow, so I've set up a system of cannons to take you right up to the island they grow on!
Recipe For Disaster#105.dst: Uno tiene que ganarse la vida, así que he montado un sistema de cañones que te lleva directo a la isla donde crecen.
Recipe For Disaster#105.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#106.src: So, whaddya say? Small price for a little adventure, and as many raspberries as you can eat!
Recipe For Disaster#106.dst: ¿Qué me dices? Poco precio por una pequeña aventura, ¡y todas las frambuesas que puedas comer!
Recipe For Disaster#106.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#107.src: Alrighty! Just head on over to that island beside me and jump in the cannon - it's perfectly safe, I promise!
Recipe For Disaster#107.dst: ¡Muy bien! Ve a esa isla de al lado y métete en el cañón - es totalmente seguro, ¡te lo prometo!
Recipe For Disaster#107.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#108.src: Find your way up the island and grab as many raspberries as you want! When you're done just jump in the big cannon and come back to shore!
Recipe For Disaster#108.dst: ¡Busca el camino hasta lo alto de la isla y coge todas las frambuesas que quieras! Cuando termines, métete en el cañón grande y vuelve a la orilla.
Recipe For Disaster#108.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#109.src: Alrighty, no worries. Feel free to come back if you're ever in the mood for some!
Recipe For Disaster#109.dst: Muy bien, no pasa nada. ¡Vuelve cuando te apetezcan!
Recipe For Disaster#109.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#110.src: Present the ingredients to your chosen chef.
Recipe For Disaster#110.dst: Presenta los ingredientes al cocinero elegido.

Recipe For Disaster#111.src: Have you got all the ingredients? Amazing!
Recipe For Disaster#111.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#112.src: Okay you set back and let me work on the cooking, just pass over the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#112.dst: Vale, échate atrás y déjame a mí la cocina, ¡tú solo pásame los ingredientes!
Recipe For Disaster#112.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#113.src: Aha! That should do it! Hopefully I've done everything correctly... but wow, would you look at the color of that soup!
Recipe For Disaster#113.dst: ¡Ajá! ¡Con esto debería bastar! Espero haberlo hecho todo bien... pero, hala, ¡mira qué color tiene esta sopa!
Recipe For Disaster#113.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#114.src: You should bring it over to Hamsey to see what he thinks!
Recipe For Disaster#114.dst: ¡Deberías llevárselo a Hamsey a ver qué opina!
Recipe For Disaster#114.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#115.src: You got everything? Took you long enough.
Recipe For Disaster#115.dst: ¿Lo tienes todo? Ya te ha costado.
Recipe For Disaster#115.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#116.src: Let's get started. Everyone else already finished. Stay back while I work my magic.
Recipe For Disaster#116.dst: Empecemos. Los demás terminaron hace rato. Apártate mientras hago mi magia.
Recipe For Disaster#116.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#117.src: Mwah! My masterdish is finished. Present this to the chef, I'm sure he'll love it!
Recipe For Disaster#117.dst: ¡Mua! Mi obra maestra está lista. Preséntasela al chef, ¡seguro que le encanta!
Recipe For Disaster#117.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#118.src: And be CAREFUL taking it over. That food could be worth HUNDREDS once I'm famous!
Recipe For Disaster#118.dst: Y llévalo con CUIDADO. ¡Cuando yo sea famoso, esa comida valdrá CIENTOS!
Recipe For Disaster#118.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#119.src: You got everything? Awesome stuff, dude.
Recipe For Disaster#119.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#120.src: I'll just take a smallll bit of this raspberry - chef's commission, eh? And let's get started!
Recipe For Disaster#120.dst: Voy a coger un trocito de esta frambuesa - comisión del cocinero, ¿eh? ¡Y empezamos!
Recipe For Disaster#120.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#121.src: And we're all done. Hamsey's gonna love this.
Recipe For Disaster#121.dst: Y listo. A Hamsey le va a encantar.
Recipe For Disaster#121.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#122.src: Here you go, dawg. Pleasure working with you - show this to Hamsey and we'll see what he thinks. Make sure you don't "lose" any of it on the way over - you know what they say about your own supply!
Recipe For Disaster#122.dst: Aquí tienes, colega. Un placer trabajar contigo - enséñaselo a Hamsey y a ver qué opina. Que no se te 'pierda' nada por el camino, ¡ya sabes lo que dicen de catar tu propio género!
Recipe For Disaster#122.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#123.src: Talk to Hamsey with your finished dish.
Recipe For Disaster#123.dst: Habla con Hamsey con tu plato terminado.

Recipe For Disaster#124.src: Ah, you have finished your dish? Well, then, il est temps de goûter!
Recipe For Disaster#124.dst: Ah, ¿has terminado tu plato? Pues bien, il est temps de goûter!
Recipe For Disaster#124.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#125.src: Let us retreat to my private dining room... this way!
Recipe For Disaster#125.dst: Retirémonos a mi comedor privado... ¡por aquí!
Recipe For Disaster#125.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#126.src: Meet Hamsey in the dining room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recipe For Disaster#126.dst: Reúnete con Hamsey en el comedor, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recipe For Disaster#127.src: Welcome back, mon ami! I see you've return with a dish in hand!
Recipe For Disaster#127.dst: ¡Bienvenido de vuelta, mon ami! ¡Veo que regresas con un plato en la mano!
Recipe For Disaster#127.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#128.src: A stew? Seems simple, but even the simplest things in life can be le meilleur!
Recipe For Disaster#128.dst: ¿Un estofado? Parece sencillo, ¡pero hasta lo más sencillo puede ser le meilleur!
Recipe For Disaster#128.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#129.src: Adventurer, are you sure you made this dish? It is so good I might as well close the restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#129.dst: Aventurero, ¿seguro que has hecho tú este plato? ¡Está tan bueno que podría cerrar el restaurante!
Recipe For Disaster#129.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#130.src: You never fail to surprise me, friend. Here, take this apron, an essential of any true chef.
Recipe For Disaster#130.dst: No dejas de sorprenderme, amigo. Toma, quédate este delantal, esencial para todo buen cocinero.
Recipe For Disaster#130.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#131.src: I cannot help but notice that your dish is ready!
Recipe For Disaster#131.dst: ¡No puedo evitar fijarme en que tu plato está listo!
Recipe For Disaster#131.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#132.src: Let me taste your dish and I will present you mine! Mon dieu, une omelette?
Recipe For Disaster#132.dst: ¡Déjame probar el tuyo y te presento el mío! Mon dieu, une omelette?
Recipe For Disaster#132.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#133.src: Je suis déçu, ami. I would prefer biting into a mule derrière! This thing... a Gert wouldn't touch it!
Recipe For Disaster#133.dst: Je suis déçu, ami. ¡Prefiero morder el derrière de una mula! Esto... ¡ni un Gert lo tocaría!
Recipe For Disaster#133.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#134.src: I see you haven't improved in the art of cuisine. Leave me be, and come back when you have learned what good food is!
Recipe For Disaster#134.dst: Veo que no has mejorado en el arte de la cocina. ¡Déjame en paz y vuelve cuando sepas qué es la buena comida!
Recipe For Disaster#134.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#135.src: I see you've returned, and not empty handed. Please, show me what you've created!
Recipe For Disaster#135.dst: Veo que has vuelto, y no con las manos vacías. ¡Por favor, enséñame lo que has creado!
Recipe For Disaster#135.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#136.src: A pie? Why, you must have been helped by Frank. He always has a thing for making pie!
Recipe For Disaster#136.dst: ¿Una tarta? Vaya, te habrá ayudado Frank. ¡Siempre ha tenido debilidad por las tartas!
Recipe For Disaster#136.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#137.src: I can see that your compétences culinaires are very well developed!
Recipe For Disaster#137.dst: ¡Veo que tus compétences culinaires están muy desarrolladas!
Recipe For Disaster#137.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#138.src: Though I will not truly call you a chef quite yet, you are très bien! Have this reward as congratulations!
Recipe For Disaster#138.dst: Aún no puedo llamarte cocinero de verdad, pero ¡eres très bien! ¡Toma esta recompensa como felicitación!
Recipe For Disaster#138.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Reclaiming the House#000.src: Join Elphaba on a mission in the Temporary Camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Reclaiming the House#000.dst: Únete a Elphaba en una misión en el Temporary Camp, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Reclaiming the House#001.src: Oh, a Wynnic soldier out here in the boondocks? Honestly, you're just what we need- I could use your help, if you're able?
Reclaiming the House#001.dst: ¿Un soldado de Wynn por estos andurriales? La verdad, eres justo lo que necesitamos- Me vendría bien tu ayuda, ¿te ves capaz?
Reclaiming the House#001.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#002.src: Good, thank you. Let me lock down the camp before I give you the briefing, though.
Reclaiming the House#002.dst: Bien, gracias. Aunque déjame cerrar el campamento antes de darte las instrucciones.
Reclaiming the House#002.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#003.src: My name is Elphaba. I've been working with the Gavellian army for a good few years now.
Reclaiming the House#003.dst: Me llamo Elphaba. Llevo ya unos cuantos años trabajando con el ejército de Gavel.
Reclaiming the House#003.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#004.src: I'm the commander of the {p} Outpost down ahead. It's a strategic fortress, placed to monitor the Orcish capital.
Reclaiming the House#004.dst: Mando el puesto avanzado de {p}, ahí delante. Es una fortaleza estratégica para vigilar la capital orca.
Reclaiming the House#004.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#005.src: It was safe for a long while, but especially in the past while the Orcs have gotten far bolder, more aggressive.
Reclaiming the House#005.dst: Estuvo seguro mucho tiempo, pero sobre todo últimamente los orcos se han vuelto mucho más audaces y agresivos.
Reclaiming the House#005.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#006.src: They overwhelmed the outpost- we had to retreat and set up this camp to watch over the place we used to watch over them with!
Reclaiming the House#006.dst: Arrasaron el puesto- tuvimos que retirarnos y montar este campamento para vigilar el lugar desde el que los vigilábamos a ellos.
Reclaiming the House#006.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#007.src: I need more firepower if I'm going... to get...
Reclaiming the House#007.dst: Necesito más potencia de fuego si quiero... recuperar...
Reclaiming the House#007.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#008.src: ...oh no. See, this is what I mean! The orcs are coming!
Reclaiming the House#008.dst: ...ay, no. ¿Ves? ¡A esto me refiero! ¡Los orcos vienen!
Reclaiming the House#008.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#009.src: Brace yourself, soldier! Protect the camp!
Reclaiming the House#009.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#010.src: Kill the mobs raiding the Camp.
Reclaiming the House#010.dst: Mata a los monstruos que asaltan el campamento.

Reclaiming the House#011.src: This is the third attack in three days! How many reinforcements have they got?!
Reclaiming the House#011.dst: ¡Es el tercer ataque en tres días! ¡¿Cuántos refuerzos tienen?!
Reclaiming the House#011.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#012.src: Gah! Their casters are strong, careful!
Reclaiming the House#012.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#013.src: Talk to Elphaba for information on the upcoming attack.
Reclaiming the House#013.dst: Habla con Elphaba para saber más sobre el ataque que se avecina.

Reclaiming the House#014.src: Ugh, I think that was all of them... Come here now, I'll start up where we left off.
Reclaiming the House#014.dst: Uf, creo que ya están todos... Ven aquí, retomo donde lo dejamos.
Reclaiming the House#014.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#015.src: Not sure I could have done that myself. I'm lucky you came around when you did, soldier.
Reclaiming the House#015.dst: No sé si habría podido hacerlo yo sola. Suerte que has aparecido justo ahora, soldado.
Reclaiming the House#015.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#016.src: Anyway, it's clear I'm going to need more firepower if I'm going to have a shot at reclaiming that outpost.
Reclaiming the House#016.dst: En fin, está claro que necesitaré más potencia de fuego si quiero tener alguna opción de recuperar ese puesto.
Reclaiming the House#016.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#017.src: You've certainly got the fighting chops, so I'd appreciate the aid, but we've got to come up with a plan, fast.
Reclaiming the House#017.dst: Desde luego sabes pelear, así que te agradezco la ayuda, pero tenemos que idear un plan, rápido.
Reclaiming the House#017.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#018.src: There's an old tower near the outpost- some old storage silo. It was built taller than the fort, so we might be able to spy on them from there.
Reclaiming the House#018.dst: Cerca del puesto hay una torre vieja- un antiguo silo de almacenaje. La construyeron más alta que el fuerte, así que quizá podamos espiarlos desde allí.
Reclaiming the House#018.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#019.src: It's a risk though, since it's so close by, but we have no other options. Meet me at the tower southeast of here so we can survey the situation.
Reclaiming the House#019.dst: Es un riesgo, porque está muy cerca, pero no tenemos otra opción. Reúnete conmigo en la torre al sureste de aquí y estudiamos la situación.
Reclaiming the House#019.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#020.src: Go to the watch tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to plan the attack.
Reclaiming the House#020.dst: Ve a la torre de vigilancia en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para planear el ataque.

Reclaiming the House#021.src: Soldier! I'm right behind you. You can see our outpost- and the tower I mentioned.
Reclaiming the House#021.dst: ¡Soldado! Estoy justo detrás de ti. Ya ves nuestro puesto- y la torre de la que te hablé.
Reclaiming the House#021.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#022.src: We need to find a way in. A lot of soldiers were caught unaware during the Orcs' assault, too.
Reclaiming the House#022.dst: Tenemos que encontrar una forma de entrar. Además, el asalto de los orcos pilló desprevenidos a muchos soldados.
Reclaiming the House#022.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#023.src: If there's any survivors in there, we should make rescuing them a priority.
Reclaiming the House#023.dst: Si queda algún superviviente ahí dentro, rescatarlo debería ser lo primero.
Reclaiming the House#023.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#024.src: After all, it means more manpower for us. We can't count on that being the case, though...
Reclaiming the House#024.dst: Al fin y al cabo, eso significa más efectivos para nosotros. Aunque no podemos contar con ello...
Reclaiming the House#024.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#025.src: Come on, hurry inside before one of the orcs spots us!
Reclaiming the House#025.dst: ¡Vamos, entra rápido antes de que nos vea algún orco!
Reclaiming the House#025.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#026.src: Enter to the watch tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to plan the attack.
Reclaiming the House#026.dst: Entra en la torre de vigilancia en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para planear el ataque.

Reclaiming the House#027.src: Alright, this is a pretty clear view. Let's see what's going on in there...
Reclaiming the House#027.dst: Bien, desde aquí se ve bastante claro. Veamos qué pasa ahí dentro...
Reclaiming the House#027.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#028.src: Wh- I'm shocked! In the middle there- they just caged the soldiers instead of killing them? That's... kind of a relief.
Reclaiming the House#028.dst: Pe- ¡No me lo creo! Ahí en el centro- ¿los han enjaulado en vez de matarlos? Eso es... casi un alivio.
Reclaiming the House#028.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#029.src: There's definitely too many orcs in the plaza for us to take down on our own...
Reclaiming the House#029.dst: Hay demasiados orcos en la plaza para que podamos con ellos solos...
Reclaiming the House#029.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#030.src: ...but that cage is held up by those ropes. If we can cut them, the other soldiers should be able to help!
Reclaiming the House#030.dst: ...pero esa jaula cuelga de esas cuerdas. ¡Si las cortamos, los demás soldados podrán ayudar!
Reclaiming the House#030.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#031.src: Alright, now I just need to figure out how we can both get in... There's sentries on the perimeter, so going over may no be an option...
Reclaiming the House#031.dst: Bien, ahora solo me falta pensar cómo entramos los dos... Hay centinelas en el perímetro, así que saltar por encima quizá no sea opción...
Reclaiming the House#031.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#032.src: Maybe we can keep an eye out on their sentry patterns and look for an opening-
Reclaiming the House#032.dst: Quizá podamos vigilar las rondas de los centinelas y buscar un hueco-
Reclaiming the House#032.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#033.src: Humans on old tower! Junhur will shoot! This our place now, get out!!
Reclaiming the House#033.dst: ¡Humanos en torre vieja! ¡Junhur disparar! ¡¡Este sitio ahora nuestro, fuera!!
Reclaiming the House#033.speaker: Orc

Reclaiming the House#034.src: Aw, not now! I knew this was a risk, no time to get out... Brace for impact!!
Reclaiming the House#034.dst: ¡Ahora no! Sabía que era un riesgo, no da tiempo a salir... ¡¡Al suelo!!
Reclaiming the House#034.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#035.src: Old tower fall! Junhur is best cannon shooter!!
Reclaiming the House#035.dst: ¡Torre vieja caer! ¡¡Junhur ser mejor tirador de cañón!!
Reclaiming the House#035.speaker: Orc

Reclaiming the House#036.src: Agh, soldier!! Are you alright, where'd you fall?!
Reclaiming the House#036.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#037.src: Ah... Wow. You barely look scratched, you must've gotten really lucky.
Reclaiming the House#037.dst: Ah... Vaya. Casi ni tienes un rasguño, has debido de tener mucha suerte.
Reclaiming the House#037.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#038.src: Not so much here... I'm pretty battered after that. At least one of us is in good condition...
Reclaiming the House#038.dst: Aquí no tanto... Me he llevado una buena. Al menos uno de los dos está en condiciones...
Reclaiming the House#038.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#039.src: Unfortunately, that means figuring a way in is up to you. We can't examine their sentry patterns from down here.
Reclaiming the House#039.dst: Por desgracia, eso significa que buscar la manera de entrar te toca a ti. Desde aquí abajo no vemos sus rondas.
Reclaiming the House#039.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#040.src: I'll survive, sure, but I won't be able to walk around and defend myself for a while.
Reclaiming the House#040.dst: Sobreviviré, claro, pero durante un tiempo no podré moverme ni defenderme.
Reclaiming the House#040.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#041.src: I hate leaving you on your own like this, but if it's any consolation, you should be tough enough, or lucky enough, to get through.
Reclaiming the House#041.dst: Odio dejarte solo así, pero si te sirve de consuelo, deberías ser lo bastante duro, o lo bastante afortunado, para salir adelante.
Reclaiming the House#041.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#042.src: Explore the perimeter of the outpost. Try to find a way in, but be careful, okay?
Reclaiming the House#042.dst: Explora el perímetro del puesto. Intenta encontrar una forma de entrar, pero ten cuidado, ¿vale?
Reclaiming the House#042.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#043.src: Explore the outpost's surroundings to find another way in.
Reclaiming the House#043.dst: Explora los alrededores del puesto para encontrar otra forma de entrar.

Reclaiming the House#044.src: Follow the trail of mud left by the orc. It leads to the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Reclaiming the House#044.dst: Sigue el rastro de barro que dejó el orco. Lleva a la cueva en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Reclaiming the House#045.src: Enter the outpost while covered in mud.
Reclaiming the House#045.dst: Entra en el puesto cubierto de barro.

Reclaiming the House#047.src: Cut the ropes to free the guards from the cage.
Reclaiming the House#047.dst: Corta las cuerdas para liberar a los guardias de la jaula.

Reclaiming the House#049.src: Good thinking with the mud disguise, soldier! They never suspected a thing, now come help us out over here!
Reclaiming the House#049.dst: ¡Buena idea la del disfraz de barro, soldado! No sospecharon nada, ¡ahora ven a echarnos una mano aquí!
Reclaiming the House#049.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#050.src: Kill the Orcish Overtakers, we'll help keep the other ones off you!
Reclaiming the House#050.dst: ¡Mata a los Orcish Overtaker, nosotros te quitamos a los demás de encima!
Reclaiming the House#050.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#051.src: Open the gate with a spell
Reclaiming the House#051.dst: Abre la puerta con un hechizo

Reclaiming the House#052.src: The Overtakers are down, the other Orcs are flailing! Open the outpost's entrance with a spell now, we've got this under control!
Reclaiming the House#052.dst: ¡Los Overtaker han caído, los demás orcos están desbordados! Abre ahora la entrada del puesto con un hechizo, ¡esto lo tenemos controlado!
Reclaiming the House#052.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#054.src: Phew... That's some fine work there, soldier! The outpost is back under our control!
Reclaiming the House#054.dst: Uf... ¡Menudo trabajo, soldado! ¡El puesto vuelve a estar bajo nuestro control!
Reclaiming the House#054.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#055.src: Glad to see some more capable Wynnic hands over here. Though, I didn't catch your name. Would you mind?
Reclaiming the House#055.dst: Me alegra tener aquí más manos capaces de Wynn. Aunque no he oído tu nombre. ¿Te importa?
Reclaiming the House#055.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#056.src: {u}, huh? I'll remember that. You barely even needed my help, heh... Wish I hadn't been such a burden, but at least it worked out.
Reclaiming the House#056.dst: {u}, ¿eh? Lo recordaré. Casi no has necesitado mi ayuda, je... Ojalá no hubiera sido una carga, pero al menos ha salido bien.
Reclaiming the House#056.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#057.src: Here- it's some of my own personal spending money, as a thank-you gift.
Reclaiming the House#057.dst: Toma- son unos ahorrillos míos, como regalo de agradecimiento.
Reclaiming the House#057.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#058.src: Alright everyone, let's get this place ship-shape! Everything needs to be repaired in case of another attack!!
Reclaiming the House#058.dst: ¡Muy bien, todos, dejemos esto como los chorros del oro! ¡¡Hay que repararlo todo por si hay otro ataque!!
Reclaiming the House#058.speaker: Elphaba

Recover the Past#000.src: Thanks again for your help. Now we can truly say creepers exist here in the ravines.

Recover the Past#001.src: But with this device... we can change that! Restore what has been lost! Recover the- you get the point.

Recover the Past#002.src: Now, I'm in great need of test subjects... You would do well as one, yes, but I need more to be certain this thing works.

Recover the Past#003.src: In the meantime, I'll be making adjustments here... It's not perfect just yet. I'm still missing large portions of my memory... Hm? You're still here? Get going!

Recover the Past#004.src: Huh? Oh! I- ah, nothing to see here! Just... just having a look at my ship! That's all.

Recover the Past#005.src: Picard sent you? The guy cooped up in that tower of his? Huh, good to know he's finally finished his work. But what could he want me for?

Recover the Past#006.src: ... Look at my memories from Fruma, huh? I'm not so sure 'bout that. If they're missing, they must be missing for a reason. And I'm-I'm happy here! Don't need to know nothin' about-...

Recover the Past#007.src: Get me the part from that blacksmith's and I'll come with you to Picard's tower. I could hardly leave my baby alone unfinished like this now, could I?

Recover the Past#008.src: Move the box out of the door to complete the puzzle!

Recover the Past#010.src: You take a package out of the wreckage.

Recover the Past#011.src: You should return to Caid with the package before the blacksmith notices...

Recover the Past#013.src: Sure thing. Say- Caid. How do you keep getting ahold of these things? There's expensive parts in these, and that seems a bit out of your price range.

Recover the Past#014.src: Wait- what? Caid, please tell me you haven't been stealing from the guards. You know they won't-

Recover the Past#015.src: Take him to the prison for further questioning, and to decide what shall be done with him.

Recover the Past#016.src: Hm. Hm hm hm. The memory cut off there... I wonder what we'd see if we could-

Recover the Past#017.src: Yes, so it would appear! But surely there's more beyond this point... perhaps, if I-

Recover the Past#018.src: But that's of no importance now. What is important is what we've just seen! Memories relived in vivid detail! Truly, this device will revolutionize the world!

Recover the Past#019.src: I saw him heading into the temple not very long ago. Perhaps he's had a change of heart. You lead the way to Caid, I'll be right behind you.

Recover the Past#020.src: I wouldn't dream of doing anything else!

Recover the Past#021.src: But- consider, Reynauld. Maybe the past is forgotten for a reason.

Recover the Past#023.src: I salvaged some parts from... uh, one of the nearby factories. I hope it's-... it's probably what you need.

Recover the Past#024.src: N-no. I wasn't spotted. I, uh... I took precautions. Went in at night. You know.

Recover the Past#025.src: I- hmph. Okay, okay, fine, I'll- I'll add in some emeralds. To sweeten the deal.

Recover the Past#027.src: Your accomplice, the supplier, was caught the other day. I'm told he spent very little time grappling with the thought before choosing to spill your secrets.

Recover the Past#028.src: Assistant! Assistant! Snap out of it!

Recover the Past#029.src: {u}!? What're you doing... here...? No, actually, better question- what is happening up here?

Recover the Past#031.src: Science! Highly experimental and important science! That is what is taking place up here- and who are you, interrupting-

Recover the Past#032.src: Doctor. Stop. Talking. Tasim, why are you here? Where's Caid?

Recover the Past#033.src: Right... the Admiral sent me to bolster {p}'s defences. I was expecting to meet you at the bridge, but all I found was Caid.

Recover the Past#034.src: Urgh... that damned thief! I knew I shouldn't have left... This was all a mistake... Damn.

Recover the Past#035.src: There's no time to waste now. Let's go. Tasim, {u}. We need to save {p}.

Recover the Past#036.src: ...hmph. Rather rude, the both of them. But fine, the circumstances warrant it, I suppose.

Recover the Past#037.src: That Tasim, he must be from Fruma as well? If he's a companion of yours, you should recruit him to this little experiment of ours. I'll need to think through our next steps...

Recover the Past#038.src: ... Well? What are you waiting for?! Go on, get out there! {p} needs saving!

Recover the Past#039.src: I'm trying to think, but... I've never...

Recover the Past#040.src: Reynauld, it's not working! They just keep coming- we... have to do something... else, or we won't last!

Recover the Past#041.src: You're right. We'll have to retreat, call for aid from {p}. The three of us alone can't defeat this!

Recover the Past#042.src: Caid! You made it! That was incredible- you're a hero!

Recover the Past#043.src: That's all well and good, but... what about your boat?

Recover the Past#044.src: Well, Caid seems to be fine enough... considering the circumstances. I'll take him to get checked out, just in case.

Recover the Past#045.src: Do you remember? We'd just barely entered Wynn and... Aledar was with us, and he almost went and died on his first day! I hope he's being more careful, out there...

Recover the Past#046.src: ... Oh, {u}, you've returned, and with a brand new subject! I take it {p} is now safe and sound? Excellent, excellent. Please, step up to the orb, and-

Recover the Past#047.src: Hold on. I didn't get the chance to ask questions, when I walked in on this earlier. How safe is this procedure, exactly? Because from what I saw of Reynauld-

Recover the Past#048.src: Now, now, settle down. Just because I didn't do any proper tests before this doesn't mean it isn't safe! I've done the calculations! They all work out fine!

Recover the Past#050.src: You want to put more magic into this, when it's already unstable?!

Recover the Past#051.src: ... Fine. We can look at my memories. I don't know that I necessarily agree... but alright.

Recover the Past#053.src: My... magic is struggling to keep hold... but it's clear there's more to see! Increasing power...

Recover the Past#054.src: ... It was the right thing to do. I couldn't just stand by when there was something I could do to help.

Recover the Past#055.src: You feel a faint tug as something tries to pull you out of the memory.

Recover the Past#056.src: But there's more to see. You can't leave just yet.

Recover the Past#057.src: The- the what? What are you going to do to-

Recover the Past#058.src: You are a new recruit, being sent to the Wynn Province to fight in their war. You enlisted because you thought your unique... talents... would be useful.

Recover the Past#059.src: Wonderful. Take this one away. It looks like we'll be able to fit two more for today's batch.

Recover the Past#060.src: ... Fine, fine. It did give us more information. Don't do it again, though! We have much to discuss.

Recover the Past#061.src: ... Hmph. I'll admit, I'm-... I'm not sure what to do with this information.

Recover the Past#062.src: And the Inquisitor... I don't know what to think. All of us- what we thought we knew when we arrived in Wynn... None of it was true.

Recover the Past#063.src: I- I need some space to think. To... reflect. Can you-... please don't tell Aledar about any of this.

Recover the Past#064.src: When you get stronger, you should go there too. Maybe we'll even run into each other, eventually.

Recover the Past#065.src: I guess this is goodbye for now, then. Not forever- but for now. I'll see you around, {u}.

Recover the Past#068.src: Well. Bystander-turned-assis- you know what, I'll just call you my assistant- not quite the response I was looking for... a shame, too- I truly believe we were on to something.
Recover the Past#068.dst: Bien. Transeúnte-convertido-en-ayuda- ¿sabes qué? Te llamaré mi ayudante- no es la reacción que esperaba... una lástima, además- de verdad creía que íbamos por buen camino.

Recover the Past#069.src: ...he doesn't know. You have to break the news to him.
Recover the Past#069.dst: ...él no lo sabe. Tendrás que darle la noticia.

Recover the Past#070.src: Hmph. Maybe it just needs more power... If I increase the amount of mana I'm able to put into the spell, then-
Recover the Past#070.dst: Hmpf. Quizá solo necesite más potencia... Si aumento el maná que puedo verter en el hechizo, entonces-

Recover the Past#071.src: In the meantime, with our subject gone, we'll have to make do with another. There is a Scout Reynauld on duty today, also from Fruma originally, just like yourself.
Recover the Past#071.dst: Mientras tanto, sin nuestro sujeto, habrá que apañarse con otro. Hoy está de guardia el explorador Reynauld, también originario de Fruma, igual que tú.

Recover the Past#073.src: It's puzzling, to be sure... if only we could see further. I'll get to work immediately- we must know more!
Recover the Past#073.dst: Desconcertante, sin duda... ojalá pudiéramos ver más allá. Me pongo a trabajar ya- ¡debemos saber más!

Recover the Past#074.src: Use your Movement Keys to Preview your move, then press Jump to Confirm.
Recover the Past#074.dst: Teclas de movimiento para ver la jugada; Saltar para confirmar.

Recover the Past#075.dst: Habla con el Dr. Picard en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#076.src: Success! Success, success, SUCCESS! I'm a genius, the smartest man alive!
Recover the Past#076.dst: ¡Éxito! ¡Éxito, éxito, ÉXITO! ¡Soy un genio, el hombre más listo del mundo!
Recover the Past#076.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#077.src: You there, random bystander! You have witnessed a magical marvel! I have just successfully restored my memories from years ago!
Recover the Past#077.dst: ¡Eh, tú, transeúnte cualquiera! ¡Has presenciado un prodigio mágico! ¡Acabo de restaurar mis recuerdos de hace años!
Recover the Past#077.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#078.src: You look to be from Fruma, yes? So you know just as well as I that your memories of your life before have vanished. Poof. Gone!
Recover the Past#078.dst: Pareces de Fruma, ¿verdad? Entonces sabes tan bien como yo que tus recuerdos de tu vida anterior se han esfumado. Puf. ¡Ya no están!
Recover the Past#078.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#079.src: But with this device... we can change that! Restore what has been lost! Recover the you get the point.
Recover the Past#079.dst: ¡Pero con este aparato... podemos cambiarlo! ¡Recuperar lo perdido! Recuperar el... ya me entiendes.
Recover the Past#079.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#080.src: Now, I'm in great need of test subjects... You would do well as one, yes, but I need to be more certain this thing works.
Recover the Past#080.dst: Ahora bien, necesito sujetos de prueba... Tú servirías, sí, pero debo asegurarme de que esto funciona.
Recover the Past#080.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#081.src: Listen here! I have a proposition to make. You'd like your memories back, yes? Bring me enough test subjects, and I can show you what you've lost!
Recover the Past#081.dst: ¡Escucha! Tengo una propuesta. Quieres recuperar tus recuerdos, ¿no? ¡Tráeme suficientes sujetos y te enseñaré lo que has perdido!
Recover the Past#081.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#082.src: Let's see, let's see... We need individuals originally from Fruma. There are a few of those around here.
Recover the Past#082.dst: Veamos, veamos... Necesitamos gente originaria de Fruma. Por aquí hay unos cuantos.
Recover the Past#082.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#083.src: You can start with the would-be sailor, Caid. You'll find him just past {p}- follow the path until you reach the river.
Recover the Past#083.dst: Puedes empezar por Caid, el aspirante a marinero. Lo encontrarás pasado {p}- sigue el camino hasta llegar al río.
Recover the Past#083.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#084.src: In the meantime, I'll be making adjustments here... It's not perfect just yet. I'm still missing large portions of my memory... Hm? You're still in here? Get going!
Recover the Past#084.dst: Mientras, yo seguiré haciendo ajustes aquí... Aún no es perfecto. Todavía me faltan grandes trozos de memoria... ¿Hm? ¿Sigues aquí? ¡En marcha!
Recover the Past#084.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#085.src: Recover the sailor Caid near his boat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#085.dst: Encuentra al marinero Caid junto a su barca en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#086.src: Well? I've given you an assignment, what are you still doing here? Go find the sailor Caid. You'll find him just past {p} follow the path until you reach the river.
Recover the Past#086.dst: ¿Y bien? Te he dado una tarea, ¿qué haces aquí todavía? Ve a buscar al marinero Caid. Lo encontrarás pasado {p}, sigue el camino hasta el río.
Recover the Past#086.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#087.src: Huh? Oh! I ah, nothing to see here! Just... just taking a look at my good old ship!
Recover the Past#087.dst: ¿Eh? ¡Oh! Yo, eh, ¡aquí no hay nada que ver! Solo... ¡solo le echaba un vistazo a mi viejo barco!
Recover the Past#087.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#088.src: Picard sent you? The guy cooped up in the tower? Huh. Good to know he's finally finished his work. But what could he want me for?
Recover the Past#088.dst: ¿Te envía Picard? ¿El tipo encerrado en la torre? Vaya. Me alegra saber que por fin ha terminado. ¿Pero para qué me quiere a mí?
Recover the Past#088.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#089.src: ... Look at my memories from Fruma, huh? I'm not so sure 'bout that. If they're missing, they must be missing for a reason. I'm-I'm happy here! Don't need to know nothin' about...
Recover the Past#089.dst: ... ¿Mirar mis recuerdos de Fruma, eh? No lo tengo tan claro. Si no están, por algo será. ¡Yo-yo estoy bien aquí! No necesito saber nada de...
Recover the Past#089.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#090.src: ... Yeah, alright. I'll come with you to get my memory checked out. Just, do me a solid first, alright?
Recover the Past#090.dst: ... Sí, vale. Iré contigo a que me revisen la memoria. Pero hazme un favor antes, ¿vale?
Recover the Past#090.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#091.src: I'm something of a builder. Figured I'd try my hand at making a ship, and, here it is! Pretty good, right?
Recover the Past#091.dst: Se me da bien construir. Pensé en probar a hacer un barco y, ¡aquí está! Está bien, ¿eh?
Recover the Past#091.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#092.src: That's what I'm talkin' about, take that Reynauld! I knew someone would like it!
Recover the Past#092.dst: ¡De eso hablo, toma esa, Reynauld! ¡Sabía que le gustaría a alguien!
Recover the Past#092.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#094.src: Hey! Heh, well you're not wrong. I cobbled it together using mostly junk I found laying around. Still, it's pretty impressive for a scrap heap, don't you think?
Recover the Past#094.dst: ¡Eh! Je, bueno, no te falta razón. Lo monté sobre todo con chatarra que encontré por ahí. Aun así, para ser un montón de desechos impresiona, ¿no?
Recover the Past#094.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#095.src: You'll have to promise me you won't tell Reynauld but... Some of the more exotic components have been comin' from the guard's quarters. Nothing big! Just some stuff skimmed off the top...
Recover the Past#095.dst: Tienes que prometerme que no se lo dirás a Reynauld pero... Algunas piezas más exóticas salieron del cuartel de los guardias. ¡Nada gordo! Solo cosillas de la superficie...
Recover the Past#095.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#096.src: I only need one more part to finish it off, and well, you see... A shipment just arrived at the blacksmith's... You see where I'm going with this?
Recover the Past#096.dst: Solo me falta una pieza para terminarlo y, verás... Acaba de llegar un cargamento a la herrería... ¿Ves por dónde voy?
Recover the Past#096.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#097.src: Get me the part from the blacksmith's and I'll come with you to Picard's tower. I could hardly leave my baby alone unfinished like this now, could I?
Recover the Past#097.dst: Consígueme la pieza de la herrería y me iré contigo a la torre de Picard. No puedo dejar a mi criatura sin terminar así, ¿no?
Recover the Past#097.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#098.src: Steal the box from the Blacksmith's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#098.dst: Roba la caja de la casa del herrero en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#099.src: Have you gotten the box yet? It's at the blacksmith's, a short walk away from here in {p}. Just, don't get spotted!
Recover the Past#099.dst: ¿Ya tienes la caja? Está en la herrería, a un paso de aquí, en {p}. ¡Eso sí, que no te vean!
Recover the Past#099.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#100.src: Bring the package to Caid at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#100.dst: Lleva el paquete a Caid en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#101.src: ... You're back! How did it go? Here, I'll take the goods.
Recover the Past#101.dst: ... ¡Has vuelto! ¿Qué tal ha ido? Venga, dame el botín.
Recover the Past#101.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#102.src: The blacksmith didn't see anything right? I'm a bit worried Reynauld is on my trail...
Recover the Past#102.dst: El herrero no vio nada, ¿verdad? Me preocupa un poco que Reynauld me esté siguiendo la pista...
Recover the Past#102.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#103.src: Ah, whatever! Finally, time to finish this ol' boat of mine!
Recover the Past#103.dst: ¡Ah, qué más da! ¡Por fin voy a terminar mi vieja barca!
Recover the Past#103.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#104.src: There we go! Ta da! How's it look?
Recover the Past#104.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#105.src: That's right! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell. Wouldn't be the same without one.
Recover the Past#105.dst: ¡Exacto! Todo barco que se precie tiene que llevar campana. Sin ella no sería lo mismo.
Recover the Past#105.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#106.src: What's with the attitude! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell, you know? Do you think the Seaskipper'd be caught dead without one? Didn't think so!
Recover the Past#106.dst: ¡Vaya humos! Todo barco que se precie lleva campana, ¿sabes? ¿Crees que el Seaskipper se dejaría ver sin una? ¡Ya me parecía!
Recover the Past#106.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#107.src: Anyway... I guess you've fulfilled your end of the bargain, so I've got no choice but to fulfil mine!
Recover the Past#107.dst: En fin... Supongo que has cumplido tu parte del trato, ¡así que no me queda otra que cumplir la mía!
Recover the Past#107.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#108.src: Lead the way to Picard's tower! Let's see what's hiding in this big head o' mine.
Recover the Past#108.dst: ¡Guíame a la torre de Picard! A ver qué se esconde en este cabezón mío.
Recover the Past#108.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#109.src: Bring Caid to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#109.dst: Lleva a Caid ante el Dr. Picard en su torre, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#111.src: Aha! You've returned! Good, good, this'll be a good test of my changes...
Recover the Past#111.dst: ¡Ajá! ¡Habéis vuelto! Bien, bien, buena prueba para mis ajustes...
Recover the Past#111.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#112.src: ... Right. And this is the doctor we're trusting with my memories?
Recover the Past#112.dst: ... Ya. ¿Y a este doctor le confiamos mis recuerdos?
Recover the Past#112.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#113.src: Now, now, don't underestimate my genius. You'll be fine! Probably. I'd give it a ninety-five, well, ninety percent chance. Now, step up here.
Recover the Past#113.dst: Vamos, vamos, no subestimes mi genio. ¡Estarás bien! Seguramente. Yo diría un noventa y cinco, bueno, noventa por ciento. Venga, súbete aquí.
Recover the Past#113.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#114.src: Alright... I trust you know what you're doing, doctor...
Recover the Past#114.dst: Vale... Confío en que sepa lo que hace, doctor...
Recover the Past#114.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#115.src: And now, all I need to do is... Activate the spell here, hit the switch there, and...
Recover the Past#115.dst: Y ahora, solo tengo que... Activar el hechizo aquí, accionar la palanca allí, y...
Recover the Past#115.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#117.src: Right, let's see what we've got here... Edwin, can you check that other crate over there?
Recover the Past#117.dst: Bien, veamos qué tenemos aquí... Edwin, ¿puedes mirar esa otra caja de ahí?
Recover the Past#117.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#118.src: Sure thing. Say Caid. How do you keep getting ahold of these things? There's expensive parts in these, and that seems a bit out of your price range.
Recover the Past#118.dst: Claro. Oye, Caid. ¿Cómo consigues siempre estas cosas? Ahí dentro hay piezas caras, y no parecen de tu presupuesto.
Recover the Past#118.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#119.src: Well... Let's just say the latest resupply package for the guards is slightly lighter than it might otherwise be.
Recover the Past#119.dst: Bueno... Digamos que el último paquete de suministros de los guardias pesa un poco menos de lo que debería.
Recover the Past#119.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#120.src: Wait what? Caid, please tell me you haven't been stealing from the guards. You know they won't
Recover the Past#120.dst: ¿Qué? Caid, dime que no has estado robando a los guardias. Sabes que no van a
Recover the Past#120.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#121.src: Edwin, relax. I'm barely skimming off the top of their supplies. They won't notice one or two missing packages out of thirty.
Recover the Past#121.dst: Edwin, relájate. Solo les quito un poquito de la superficie. No van a notar uno o dos paquetes de treinta.
Recover the Past#121.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#122.src: 'sides, I'm not scared of them. They're here to protect us, aren't they? I figure they'll just let me off with a warning, like they have all those other times.
Recover the Past#122.dst: Además, no les tengo miedo. Están aquí para protegernos, ¿no? Supongo que me soltarán con un aviso, como todas las otras veces.
Recover the Past#122.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#123.src: If... if you say so. I guess you're right. They don't need all those supplies, really. And we can make much better use of these than they would!
Recover the Past#123.dst: Si... si tú lo dices. Supongo que tienes razón. Tampoco necesitan tantos suministros. ¡Y nosotros les damos mejor uso que ellos!
Recover the Past#123.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#124.src: Exactly! I'm glad you agree. So, have you found anything goo
Recover the Past#124.dst: ¡Exacto! Me alegra que estés de acuerdo. Entonces, ¿has encontrado algo bue
Recover the Past#124.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#125.src: You two! Hold still, you're under arrest!
Recover the Past#125.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#127.src: E-Edwin! Get back here, you cowa
Recover the Past#127.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#128.src: That's enough out of you. You two, track down the accomplice.
Recover the Past#128.dst: Ya basta de ti. Vosotros dos, dad caza al cómplice.
Recover the Past#128.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#131.src: Caid, you are being placed under arrest for repeated counts of theft of imperial property.
Recover the Past#131.dst: Caid, quedas detenido por reiterados robos de propiedad imperial.
Recover the Past#131.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#132.src: Your record shows you have received multiple warnings for previous acts. This was your final chance, and you have thoroughly wasted it.
Recover the Past#132.dst: Tu expediente muestra que recibiste varios avisos por actos anteriores. Esta era tu última oportunidad y la has desperdiciado por completo.
Recover the Past#132.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#133.src: Take him to the prison for further questioning, and decide what shall be done with him.
Recover the Past#133.dst: Llevadlo a prisión para seguir interrogándolo y decidid qué se hará con él.
Recover the Past#133.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#134.src: Hey! Hello? Bystander-turned-assistant! Get yourself out of that trance, we need to talk.
Recover the Past#134.dst: ¡Eh! ¿Hola? ¡Transeúnte-convertido-en-ayudante! Sal de ese trance, tenemos que hablar.
Recover the Past#134.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#135.src: Hm. Hm hm hm. The memory cut off there...I wonder what we'd see if we could
Recover the Past#135.dst: Hm. Hm hm hm. El recuerdo se ha cortado ahí... Me pregunto qué veríamos si
Recover the Past#135.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#137.src: Yes, it appears so... But perhaps, if I can increase the power, then... Yes! I'm a geniu
Recover the Past#137.dst: Sí, eso parece... Pero quizá, si logro aumentar la potencia, entonces... ¡Sí! Soy un geni
Recover the Past#137.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#138.src: That's all I am?! Just some thief... Is that all I'm good for?
Recover the Past#138.dst: ¿Eso es todo lo que soy? Un ladrón... ¿Solo sirvo para eso?
Recover the Past#138.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#141.src: Ah! Bystander-turned-assis you know what, I'll just call you my assistant. Finally out of your trance, I see.
Recover the Past#141.dst: ¡Ah! Transeúnte-convertido-en-ayuda- ¿sabes qué? Te llamaré mi ayudante. Veo que por fin has salido del trance.
Recover the Past#141.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#142.src: But that's of no importance now! What, however, is important is what we've just seen! Memories relived in vivid detail! Truly, this device will change the world!
Recover the Past#142.dst: ¡Pero eso ahora no importa! ¡Lo que sí importa es lo que acabamos de ver! ¡Recuerdos revividos con todo detalle! ¡Este aparato cambiará el mundo!
Recover the Past#142.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#143.src: ... Though, I will say. I am a little lost as to the timeline of events. Caid was arrested- so how did he find himself here in Wynn, as a soldier?
Recover the Past#143.dst: ... Aunque debo decirlo. Me pierdo un poco con la cronología. A Caid lo detuvieron- ¿cómo acabó entonces aquí, en Wynn, como soldado?
Recover the Past#143.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#144.src: We are in need of more subjects if we are to find out the truth of it! There is a Scout Reynauld on duty today, he is also from Fruma originally, just like yourself.
Recover the Past#144.dst: ¡Necesitamos más sujetos si queremos averiguar la verdad! Hoy está de guardia el explorador Reynauld, también originario de Fruma, igual que tú.
Recover the Past#144.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#145.src: Yes, hm. You'll find him near the bridge to the {p}. I'm counting on you to convince him to join our experiment. In the name of science!
Recover the Past#145.dst: Sí, hm. Lo encontrarás cerca del puente hacia {p}. Cuento contigo para convencerlo de unirse a nuestro experimento. ¡En nombre de la ciencia!
Recover the Past#145.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#146.src: Find Scout Reynauld near the bridge to the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#146.dst: Encuentra al explorador Reynauld cerca del puente hacia {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#147.src: Hm... Where does this barrier lie? Is this magic not strong enough to break through it? Maybe if I increase the power, then...
Recover the Past#147.dst: Hm... ¿Dónde está esa barrera? ¿Esta magia no basta para atravesarla? Quizá si aumento la potencia, entonces...
Recover the Past#147.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#148.src: Gah! Assistant! What are you doing here? Have you spoken to Scout Reynauld yet? You'll find him near the bridge to the {p}.
Recover the Past#148.dst: ¡Ah! ¡Ayudante! ¿Qué haces aquí? ¿Ya has hablado con el explorador Reynauld? Lo encontrarás cerca del puente hacia {p}.
Recover the Past#148.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#150.src: Ah, hello. What seems to be the matter? You look like you want something from me.
Recover the Past#150.dst: Ah, hola. ¿Qué ocurre? Parece que quieres algo de mí.
Recover the Past#150.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#151.src: Hm? The strange doctor wants to see me? To restore my memories? I can't say I really trust the man... but I am curious to see if it'll really work.
Recover the Past#151.dst: ¿Hm? ¿El doctor raro quiere verme? ¿Para restaurar mis recuerdos? No diría que me fío mucho de ese hombre... pero me pica la curiosidad.
Recover the Past#151.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#152.src: Unfortunately, however, I must decline. I couldn't leave my station unattended. What if a corrupted assault were to appear? {p} would be left defenseless.
Recover the Past#152.dst: Por desgracia, debo declinar. No puedo dejar mi puesto sin vigilancia. ¿Y si llegara un ataque corrupto? {p} se quedaría sin defensa.
Recover the Past#152.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#153.src: Hm, well. If it's only for a little while, that might work. As long as you promise to help out if an attack does occur.
Recover the Past#153.dst: Hm, bueno. Si es solo un rato, quizá pueda funcionar. Siempre que prometas ayudar si de verdad hay un ataque.
Recover the Past#153.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#154.src: Then it's settled. I'll go with you to meet the doctor. However, first we'll need someone to keep the watch. Did you have someone in mind?
Recover the Past#154.dst: Entonces decidido. Iré contigo a ver al doctor. Pero primero necesitamos a alguien que vigile. ¿Tienes a alguien en mente?
Recover the Past#154.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#155.src: Caid? That... crook. He's been stealing supplies, I know it. I just can't prove it. But, if you think he'll do, I'm sure it will be fine.
Recover the Past#155.dst: ¿Caid? Ese... granuja. Ha estado robando suministros, lo sé. Solo que no puedo probarlo. Pero si crees que servirá, seguro que va bien.
Recover the Past#155.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#156.src: Yes, fine, I understand you've taken issue with my methodology. But it works! This has worked thrice now!
Recover the Past#156.dst: Sí, sí, entiendo que te moleste mi metodología. ¡Pero funciona! ¡Ya ha funcionado tres veces!

Recover the Past#157.src: Sigh... all of that, and we still weren't able to see what comes next! I swear, I was able to see more when I looked at my own memories! It's ridicu-
Recover the Past#157.dst: Ay... ¡tanto lío y seguimos sin ver lo que viene después! ¡Te juro que vi más cuando miré mis propios recuerdos! Es ridícu-

Recover the Past#158.src: I saw him heading to the temple not very long ago. Perhaps he's had a change of heart. You lead the way to Caid, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#158.dst: Lo vi hace poco yendo hacia el templo. Quizá haya cambiado de idea. Guíame hasta Caid, voy justo detrás de ti.
Recover the Past#158.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#160.src: Perhaps Caid's had a change of heart. You lead the way to him, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#160.dst: Quizá Caid haya cambiado de idea. Guíame hasta él, voy justo detrás de ti.
Recover the Past#160.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#161.src: Convince Caid to keep watch over the bridge at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#161.dst: Convence a Caid de vigilar el puente en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#162.src: Oh, it's you again. What do you want?
Recover the Past#162.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#163.src: It's us, and we'd like to ask something of you. Our mutual friend here is attempting to recruit me for some sort of experiment.
Recover the Past#163.dst: Somos nosotros, y queremos pedirte algo. Nuestro amigo común intenta reclutarme para una especie de experimento.
Recover the Past#163.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#164.src: Only, my participation would leave {p} undefended. So we're asking if you'd be willing to keep a watch over things while I'm otherwise preoccupied.
Recover the Past#164.dst: Solo que, si participo, {p} quedaría sin defensa. Así que te preguntamos si estarías dispuesto a vigilar mientras yo estoy ocupado.
Recover the Past#164.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#165.src: Really? You're asking me to guard {p}?
Recover the Past#165.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#166.src: Don't get me wrong, I'd rather not leave the security of {p} in the hands of a thie... someone like you. You weren't my first choice to say the least, or second, or third
Recover the Past#166.dst: No me malinterpretes, preferiría no dejar la seguridad de {p} en manos de un ladró... de alguien como tú. No eras mi primera opción, ni la segunda, ni la tercera
Recover the Past#166.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#169.src: You will? Well, that was easier than I expected. Remember if you see any signs of an imminent attack, run to that doctor's tower and alert us immediately. Leave the fighting to the professionals.
Recover the Past#169.dst: ¿Sí? Vaya, más fácil de lo que esperaba. Recuerda: si ves cualquier señal de ataque inminente, corre a la torre del doctor y avísanos al momento. La pelea, para los profesionales.
Recover the Past#169.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#170.src: I wouldn't dream of anything else! But, consider Reynauld, that maybe the past is forgotten for a reason.
Recover the Past#170.dst: ¡Ni se me ocurriría otra cosa! Pero piensa, Reynauld, que quizá el pasado se olvide por algo.
Recover the Past#170.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#171.src: Well, I suppose that settles that. Let's hurry to the doctor. I don't want to leave {p}'s safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Recover the Past#171.dst: Bueno, supongo que asunto resuelto. Corramos a ver al doctor. No quiero dejar la seguridad de {p} en los dedos pegajosos de ese hombre más tiempo del necesario.
Recover the Past#171.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#172.src: Thank you for your help, Tasim and {u}. And Caid too...
Recover the Past#172.dst: Gracias por vuestra ayuda, Tasim y {u}. Y a Caid también...

Recover the Past#173.src: Bring Reynauld to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#173.dst: Lleva a Reynauld ante el Dr. Picard en su torre, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#174.src: Let's hurry to the doctor, I don't want to leave {p}'s safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Recover the Past#174.dst: Corramos a ver al doctor, no quiero dejar la seguridad de {p} en los dedos pegajosos de ese hombre más tiempo del necesario.
Recover the Past#174.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#176.src: Ah, assistant! Welcome back, and I see you've brought our next subject! Wonderful!
Recover the Past#176.dst: ¡Ah, ayudante! ¡Bienvenido de vuelta, y veo que traes a nuestro próximo sujeto! ¡Maravilloso!
Recover the Past#176.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#178.src: Now, now, step forward. Don't be shy! Just step right up over here! Look directly into the orb, and concentrate on remembering.
Recover the Past#178.dst: Vamos, vamos, da un paso al frente. ¡No seas tímido! ¡Ponte justo aquí! Mira directamente a la esfera y concéntrate en recordar.
Recover the Past#178.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#180.src: Yes, yes! Not to worry, the device has been extensively tested on Caid. Very quickly, I just need to activate this... cast a spell here... and...
Recover the Past#180.dst: ¡Sí, sí! Tranquilo, el aparato se ha probado a fondo con Caid. Rapidito, solo tengo que activar esto... lanzar un hechizo aquí... y...
Recover the Past#180.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#182.src: H-huh? Hey, who's there? Why are you knocking at this hour
Recover the Past#182.dst: ¿E-eh? Oye, ¿quién anda ahí? ¿Por qué llamas a estas hora
Recover the Past#182.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#184.src: Yes, it's me. Mind if I step inside?
Recover the Past#184.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#185.src: N-no, of course not- Uh. It would have been nice if, you know, you warned me you would be coming!
Recover the Past#185.dst: N-no, claro que no- Eh. ¡Habría estado bien que, ya sabes, me avisaras de que venías!
Recover the Past#185.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#186.src: You know that isn't how this works. Now, where are the goods?
Recover the Past#186.dst: Sabes que esto no funciona así. Bueno, ¿dónde está la mercancía?
Recover the Past#186.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#187.src: Right... always straight to business with you. Never oh, how was your week? Always just-...
Recover the Past#187.dst: Ya... siempre directo al grano contigo. Nunca un oh, ¿qué tal la semana? Siempre solo-...
Recover the Past#187.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#188.src: Fine. It's up and over here.
Recover the Past#188.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#189.src: I salvaged some parts from... uh, one of the nearby factories. I hope it's... it's probably what you need.
Recover the Past#189.dst: Rescaté unas piezas de... eh, una de las fábricas cercanas. Espero que sea... seguramente sea lo que necesitas.
Recover the Past#189.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#190.src: ... Hm. One of the factories, you say? And you're sure you weren't spotted doing it? If I were caught speaking to a known criminal, you know the consequences for both of us.
Recover the Past#190.dst: ... Hm. ¿De una de las fábricas, dices? ¿Y seguro que no te vieron hacerlo? Si me pillaran hablando con un criminal conocido, ya sabes las consecuencias para los dos.
Recover the Past#190.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#191.src: N-no. I wasn't spotted. I, uh... took precautions. Went in at night. You know.
Recover the Past#191.dst: N-no. No me vieron. Yo, eh... tomé precauciones. Entré de noche. Ya sabes.
Recover the Past#191.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#193.src: S-so... is that enough? I've gotten you what you asked for.
Recover the Past#193.dst: A-así que... ¿es suficiente? Te he traído lo que pediste.
Recover the Past#193.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#194.src: Well... it is that, yes. But, Caid, you know the risk I take every time I come out here to speak with you. I'll need more than just the bare minimum to guarantee your safety.
Recover the Past#194.dst: Bueno... eso sí, sí. Pero, Caid, sabes el riesgo que corro cada vez que vengo hasta aquí a hablar contigo. Necesitaré más que el mínimo para garantizar tu seguridad.
Recover the Past#194.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#195.src: I hmph. Okay, okay, fine, I'll- I'll add in some emeralds. To sweeten the deal.
Recover the Past#195.dst: Yo hmpf. Vale, vale, te- te añado unas esmeraldas. Para endulzar el trato.
Recover the Past#195.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#196.src: Excellent. A pleasure doing business, as always. I'll be back in a few weeks.
Recover the Past#196.dst: Excelente. Un placer hacer negocios, como siempre. Volveré en unas semanas.
Recover the Past#196.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#198.src: Ah, Reynauld. Good to see you. Come in, come in.
Recover the Past#198.dst: Ah, Reynauld. Me alegra verte. Pasa, pasa.
Recover the Past#198.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#199.src: Might I ask what this meeting is for, sir?
Recover the Past#199.dst: ¿Puedo preguntar a qué se debe esta reunión, señor?
Recover the Past#199.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#200.src: Oh, nothing too special. I just wanted to have a quick chat about your performance.
Recover the Past#200.dst: Oh, nada especial. Solo quería charlar un momento sobre tu desempeño.
Recover the Past#200.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#201.src: You understand that those of us who serve Her Majesty in such well regarded positions have a certain... strict code of honor we must follow, yes?
Recover the Past#201.dst: Entiendes que quienes servimos a Su Majestad en puestos tan respetados debemos seguir un... estricto código de honor, ¿verdad?
Recover the Past#201.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#202.src: Otherwise, how could we be certain our ranks are pure of any misdeeds? We must set an example for the people of our great province.
Recover the Past#202.dst: Si no, ¿cómo estaríamos seguros de que nuestras filas están limpias de faltas? Debemos dar ejemplo al pueblo de nuestra gran provincia.
Recover the Past#202.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#203.src: Now, what do you think might happen if one of our own happened to... bend, or break that code of honour? What sort of a precedent would that set?
Recover the Past#203.dst: Y bien, ¿qué crees que pasaría si uno de los nuestros llegara a... doblar o romper ese código de honor? ¿Qué precedente sentaría eso?
Recover the Past#203.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#205.src: It is with no great pleasure that I inform you that you, Reynauld, are to be stripped of your rank and arrested under charges of dishonour and conspiracy against Her Majesty.
Recover the Past#205.dst: No es con placer que te informo de que tú, Reynauld, serás despojado de tu rango y detenido bajo cargos de deshonra y conspiración contra Su Majestad.
Recover the Past#205.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#206.src: Your accomplice, the supplier, was caught the other day. I'm told he spent very little time grappling with the thought before choosing to spill your own secrets.
Recover the Past#206.dst: A tu cómplice, el proveedor, lo atraparon el otro día. Me dicen que apenas dudó antes de decidirse a contar todos tus secretos.
Recover the Past#206.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#207.src: There is no place for your sort in our ranks, Reynauld. A shame it had to come to this.
Recover the Past#207.dst: No hay lugar para los de tu clase en nuestras filas, Reynauld. Una lástima que se llegara a esto.
Recover the Past#207.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#208.src: There is no place for your spot in our ranks, Reynauld. A shame it had to come to this.
Recover the Past#208.dst: No tienes lugar en nuestras filas, Reynauld. Una lástima que se llegara a esto.
Recover the Past#208.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#209.src: Assistant! Snap out of it! There's more to discuss.
Recover the Past#209.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#211.src: Marvelous! Assistant, you've done very well so far! We're closer than ever to uncovering the mystery of Fruma!
Recover the Past#211.dst: ¡Maravilloso! ¡Ayudante, vas muy bien! ¡Estamos más cerca que nunca de desvelar el misterio de Fruma!
Recover the Past#211.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#213.src: {u}!? Didn't think I'd stumble upon you all the way out here!
Recover the Past#213.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#214.src: There's time for pleasantries later. Tasim? Why are you here? Where's Caid?
Recover the Past#214.dst: Los saludos, para luego. ¿Tasim? ¿Qué haces aquí? ¿Dónde está Caid?
Recover the Past#214.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#215.src: The Admiral sent me to bolster {p}'s defenses. I was expecting to meet you at the bridge, but all I found was Caid.
Recover the Past#215.dst: El almirante me envió a reforzar las defensas de {p}. Esperaba verte en el puente, pero solo encontré a Caid.
Recover the Past#215.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#216.src: He said there was an assault on {p} gathering and that you were here, then he ran away.
Recover the Past#216.dst: Dijo que se reunía un ataque contra {p} y que tú estabas aquí, y luego salió corriendo.
Recover the Past#216.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#217.src: That damned thief! I knew I shouldn't have left... This was all a mistake... Damn.
Recover the Past#217.dst: ¡Maldito ladrón! Sabía que no debía marcharme... Todo esto ha sido un error... Maldita sea.
Recover the Past#217.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#218.src: There's no time to waste now. Let's go, Tasim and {u}. We need to save {p}.
Recover the Past#218.dst: No hay tiempo que perder. Vamos, Tasim y {u}. Tenemos que salvar {p}.
Recover the Past#218.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#219.src: That Tasim, he must be from Fruma as well? If he's a companion of yours, you should recruit him to this little experiment of ours. For science of course! Now, now, be off. {p} needs saving!
Recover the Past#219.dst: Ese Tasim, ¿será también de Fruma? Si es compañero tuyo, deberías reclutarlo para nuestro pequeño experimento. ¡Por la ciencia, claro! Venga, venga, largo. ¡{p} necesita ayuda!
Recover the Past#219.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#220.src: Rush to defend {p} from the incursion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#220.dst: Corre a defender {p} de la incursión en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#221.src: Assistant! What are you still doing here? Your friends seem to be in need of your assistance!
Recover the Past#221.dst: ¡Ayudante! ¿Qué haces aquí todavía? ¡Parece que tus amigos necesitan tu ayuda!
Recover the Past#221.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#222.src: Besides, this might be an opportunity to recruit that Tasim to our experiment! Hm, yes, he would certainly be an interesting specimen to examine!
Recover the Past#222.dst: ¡Además, quizá sea la ocasión de reclutar a ese Tasim para nuestro experimento! Hm, sí, ¡sería sin duda un espécimen interesante!
Recover the Past#222.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#223.src: They'll be coming for this bridge any minute now. We will need to stand ready.
Recover the Past#223.dst: Vendrán a por este puente en cualquier momento. Habrá que estar listos.
Recover the Past#223.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#225.src: Good answer, soldier. We'll take them down, no matter how many they throw at us!
Recover the Past#225.dst: Buena respuesta, soldado. ¡Los derribaremos, por muchos que nos lancen!
Recover the Past#225.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#226.src: Do whatever you have to first, but be quick. The enemy might arrive at any moment.
Recover the Past#226.dst: Haz antes lo que tengas que hacer, pero rápido. El enemigo puede llegar en cualquier momento.
Recover the Past#226.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#228.src: Tasim, you take the front, I'll provide cover from behind.
Recover the Past#228.dst: Tasim, ponte delante, yo cubro desde atrás.
Recover the Past#228.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#229.src: It would be my pleasure, Reynauld!
Recover the Past#229.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#230.src: Shouldn't be much longer now... If only Aledar was here, it'd be like old times again. Don't you think?
Recover the Past#230.dst: Ya no debería faltar mucho... Si Aledar estuviera aquí, sería como en los viejos tiempos. ¿No crees?
Recover the Past#230.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#231.src: I have eyes on the target! Corrupted forces incoming!
Recover the Past#231.dst: ¡Tengo el objetivo a la vista! ¡Fuerzas corruptas acercándose!
Recover the Past#231.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#233.src: Damn it. That leader looks shielded! How do we take it down?
Recover the Past#233.dst: Maldita sea. ¡El líder parece escudado! ¿Cómo lo derribamos?
Recover the Past#233.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#234.src: The spikes must be its weak point!
Recover the Past#234.dst: ¡Los pinchos deben ser su punto débil!
Recover the Past#234.speaker: Tasim
