Recover the Past#235.src: You're right! Tasim, {u}. As long as you can keep the enemy away from me, I can line up a good shot at the spikes. That's our only chance at taking this thing down.
Recover the Past#235.dst: ¡Tienes razón! Tasim, {u}. Mientras mantengáis al enemigo lejos de mí, podré apuntar bien a los pinchos. Es nuestra única oportunidad de derribar a esta cosa.
Recover the Past#235.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#236.src: ... Ah. Turns out this might be a little tougher than expected. But, let's give it our all!
Recover the Past#236.dst: ... Ah. Resulta que esto va a ser algo más duro de lo esperado. ¡Pero demos todo lo que tenemos!
Recover the Past#236.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#237.src: Just... a little more... to the right...
Recover the Past#237.dst: Solo... un poco más... a la derecha...
Recover the Past#237.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#238.src: That's it! It's got to be...
Recover the Past#238.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#239.src: Reynauld! What do we do now? We can't beat it like this...
Recover the Past#239.dst: ¡Reynauld! ¿Y ahora qué? Así no podemos vencerlo...
Recover the Past#239.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#240.src: I'm trying to think but... I've never...
Recover the Past#240.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#241.src: Tasim, {u}, you continue to hold them off. I'll think of something, anything...
Recover the Past#241.dst: Tasim, {u}, seguid conteniéndolos. Ya se me ocurrirá algo, lo que sea...
Recover the Past#241.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#242.src: We can't give up now, not while {p} is still in danger!
Recover the Past#242.dst: ¡No podemos rendirnos ahora, no mientras {p} siga en peligro!
Recover the Past#242.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#243.src: Reynauld, it's not working! They just keep coming we... have to do something... else, or we won't last!
Recover the Past#243.dst: ¡Reynauld, no funciona! No dejan de venir... tenemos que hacer otra cosa, ¡o no aguantaremos!
Recover the Past#243.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#244.src: You're right. We'll have to retreat, call for aid from {p}. Three men alone can't defeat this!
Recover the Past#244.dst: Tienes razón. Tendremos que retirarnos y pedir ayuda a {p}. ¡Tres hombres solos no pueden con esto!
Recover the Past#244.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#247.src: Caid, what are you doing here!? It's too dangerous, leave this one to the professionals!
Recover the Past#247.dst: ¡¿Caid, qué haces aquí?! ¡Es demasiado peligroso, deja esto a los profesionales!
Recover the Past#247.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#248.src: I'm done, I'm done letting my future slip out of my fingers!
Recover the Past#248.dst: ¡Se acabó, se acabó dejar que mi futuro se me escape de las manos!
Recover the Past#248.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#249.dst: ¡Caid, no! No... no puedes, te vas a
Recover the Past#249.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#252.src: Now, Reynauld! Shoot! For goodness' sake, shoot! While it's distracted!
Recover the Past#252.dst: ¡Ahora, Reynauld! ¡Dispara! ¡Por el amor de Dios, dispara! ¡Está distraído!
Recover the Past#252.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#253.src: It-It's coming down! Now's our chance!
Recover the Past#253.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#254.src: We did it... We really did it!
Recover the Past#254.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#258.src: Caid! You made it! You're a hero!
Recover the Past#258.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#259.src: That's all well and good but, what about your boat?
Recover the Past#259.dst: Todo eso está muy bien pero, ¿y tu barca?
Recover the Past#259.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#260.src: I can always build another one, can't I?
Recover the Past#260.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#261.src: Ha. But not using my belongings this time.
Recover the Past#261.dst: Ja. Pero esta vez no con mis cosas.
Recover the Past#261.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#262.src: Well, Caid seems to be fine enough, considering the circumstances. I'll take him to get checked out, just in case. Thank you for your help, Tasim and {u}. And Caid too...
Recover the Past#262.dst: Bueno, Caid parece bastante entero, dadas las circunstancias. Lo llevaré a que lo revisen, por si acaso. Gracias por vuestra ayuda, Tasim y {u}. Y a Caid también...
Recover the Past#262.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#263.src: You must be wanting to take Tasim with you for your experiment. After all you've done today, I can hardly object. But, Tasim...
Recover the Past#263.dst: Supongo que querrás llevarte a Tasim para tu experimento. Después de todo lo que has hecho hoy, poco puedo objetar. Pero, Tasim...
Recover the Past#263.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#264.src: Think carefully before looking into that crystal. For some, the past is filled with things they'd rather forget.
Recover the Past#264.dst: Piénsalo bien antes de mirar ese cristal. Para algunos, el pasado está lleno de cosas que preferirían olvidar.
Recover the Past#264.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#265.src: Recovering memories from Fruma, huh... I guess that's something I'd be interested in. I've had a strange feeling about it, ever since we first realized we lost them.
Recover the Past#265.dst: Recuperar recuerdos de Fruma, eh... Supongo que es algo que me interesaría. He tenido una sensación extraña desde que nos dimos cuenta de que los habíamos perdido.
Recover the Past#265.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#266.src: You were there, remember? We'd just barely entered Wynn and... Aledar was with us, and he almost went and died on his first day! I hope he's being more careful, out there...
Recover the Past#266.dst: Tú estabas allí, ¿recuerdas? Acabábamos de entrar en Wynn y... Aledar venía con nosotros, ¡y casi se muere el primer día! Espero que ahí fuera tenga más cuidado...
Recover the Past#266.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#267.src: Well, anyway. Please, lead the way to the doctor. I'm intrigued to see what it's all about.
Recover the Past#267.dst: Bueno, en fin. Por favor, guíame hasta el doctor. Me intriga saber de qué va todo esto.
Recover the Past#267.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#268.src: Bring Tasim to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#268.dst: Lleva a Tasim ante el Dr. Picard en su torre, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#270.src: ... Oh, {u}, you're back with yet another subject I see! Excellent, excellent. Please, step up to the orb.
Recover the Past#270.dst: ... Oh, {u}, ¡veo que traes otro sujeto! Excelente, excelente. Acércate a la esfera.
Recover the Past#270.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#271.src: So, doctor. You're certain this is safe? Reynauld warned me that
Recover the Past#271.dst: Bueno, doctor. ¿Seguro que esto es seguro? Reynauld me advirtió de que
Recover the Past#271.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#272.src: Oh, yes, yes. We've tested it with two subjects before, haven't we, {u}? Besides, I've done the calculations! They all work out fine!
Recover the Past#272.dst: Oh, sí, sí. Ya lo hemos probado con dos sujetos, ¿verdad, {u}? ¡Además, he hecho los cálculos! ¡Todos salen bien!
Recover the Past#272.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#273.src: There's only the tiniest bit of instability. Hmph. Maybe it just needs more power... If I increase the amount of mana I'm able to put into the spell, then
Recover the Past#273.dst: Solo hay una minúscula inestabilidad. Hmpf. Quizá solo necesite más potencia... Si aumento el maná que puedo verter en el hechizo, entonces
Recover the Past#273.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#274.src: Hold on. You want to put more magic into this, when it's already unstable?
Recover the Past#274.dst: Un momento. ¿Quiere meterle más magia, si ya es inestable?
Recover the Past#274.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#275.src: Don't you want to know what your life was like before? Even if it's not what you want to see, isn't it better to know?
Recover the Past#275.dst: ¿No quieres saber cómo era tu vida antes? Aunque no sea lo que quieres ver, ¿no es mejor saberlo?
Recover the Past#275.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#276.src: Fine. We can look at my memories. I don't know that I necessarily agree... but I'll do it.
Recover the Past#276.dst: Está bien. Podemos mirar mis recuerdos. No sé si estoy del todo de acuerdo... pero lo haré.
Recover the Past#276.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#277.src: Excellent, I'm glad to hear that! Now. Activating in three... two... one... go!
Recover the Past#277.dst: ¡Excelente, me alegra oírlo! Y ahora. Activando en tres... dos... uno... ¡ya!
Recover the Past#277.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#278.src: All hands on deck! Arrest that insurgent!
Recover the Past#278.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#280.src: Grr... He couldn't have gotten far. All of you, search the city! Leave no corner unturned! Don't let him get away!
Recover the Past#280.dst: Grr... No puede haber ido lejos. ¡Registrad la ciudad entera! ¡Que no quede un rincón! ¡Que no escape!
Recover the Past#280.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#281.src: I- oh, this is bad... What can I...
Recover the Past#281.dst: Yo- oh, esto va mal... ¿Qué puedo...
Recover the Past#281.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#282.src: ... Damn it. Damn it all. I can't just let the man bleed out, even if he's-...
Recover the Past#282.dst: ... Maldita sea. Maldito todo. No puedo dejar que se desangre, aunque sea-...
Recover the Past#282.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#283.src: ... You really shouldn't have gotten involved, you know.
Recover the Past#283.dst: ... No deberías haberte metido en esto, ¿sabes?

Recover the Past#284.src: Besides, we have used the spell on two subjects already, and it has gone perfectly fine for both of them... eh, for the most part. There's only the slightest bit of instability.
Recover the Past#284.dst: Además, ya hemos usado el hechizo en dos sujetos, y a los dos les fue perfectamente... eh, en su mayor parte. Solo hay una levísima inestabilidad.

Recover the Past#285.src: ...Damn it. Damn it all. I can't just let the man bleed out, even if he's...
Recover the Past#285.dst: ...Maldita sea. Maldito todo. No dejaré que se desangre, aunque sea...
Recover the Past#285.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#287.src: It's fine, you'll be fine... I know what to do, even if I really shouldn't...
Recover the Past#287.dst: Tranquilo, te pondrás bien... Sé qué hacer, aunque no debería...
Recover the Past#287.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#288.src: G-gah! Wh-where am I? Who are you? I need to get

Recover the Past#290.src: He's in here! And he has an accomplice! Arrest them both!
Recover the Past#290.dst: ¡Está aquí dentro! ¡Y tiene un cómplice! ¡Detenedlos a los dos!
Recover the Past#290.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#291.src: My magic is struggling to keep hold... but it's clear there's more to see! Increasing power...
Recover the Past#291.dst: A mi magia le cuesta mantener el agarre... ¡pero está claro que queda más por ver! Aumentando la potencia...
Recover the Past#291.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#292.src: So, what? I should have just let you bleed out in my home? Don't be ridiculous.
Recover the Past#292.dst: ¿Y qué? ¿Debía haber dejado que te desangraras en mi casa? No seas ridículo.
Recover the Past#292.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#293.src: Yes! You should have! Because now, not only have I been arrested for crimes against the crown, but you've also been outed as one of the cursed. Wouldn't have happened if you had just... stood by.
Recover the Past#293.dst: ¡Sí! ¡Deberías! Porque ahora no solo me han detenido por crímenes contra la Corona, sino que a ti te han señalado como uno de los malditos. Nada de esto habría pasado si te hubieras... quedado al margen.
Recover the Past#293.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#294.src: ...It was the right thing to do. I couldn't just stand by when there was something I could do to help.
Recover the Past#294.dst: ...Era lo correcto. No podía quedarme al margen cuando podía hacer algo por ayudar.
Recover the Past#294.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#295.src: Well, a lot of good that's done us. You know no one gets out of here, right? When they take you, you're never heard from again! So, that's where we're at.
Recover the Past#295.dst: Ya, y mira de cuánto nos ha servido. Sabes que de aquí no sale nadie, ¿verdad? ¡Cuando te llevan, nunca se vuelve a saber de ti! Así estamos.
Recover the Past#295.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#297.src: Tasim. It's your time. Follow me.
Recover the Past#297.speaker: Royal Guard

Recover the Past#298.src: Good luck out there, Tasim. You'll need it.
Recover the Past#298.dst: Suerte ahí fuera, Tasim. La vas a necesitar.
Recover the Past#298.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#299.src: See you on the other side, Aledar.
Recover the Past#299.dst: Nos vemos al otro lado, Aledar.
Recover the Past#299.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#300.src: Ahem. We're ready for the process. Prepare the Adjustor.
Recover the Past#300.dst: Ejem. Estamos listos para el proceso. Preparad el Ajustador.
Recover the Past#300.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#301.src: The- the what? What are you going to do to
Recover the Past#301.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#302.src: Silence. Before we begin, I want to make one thing clear. We do not need your ilk in Fruma. We do not want your ilk in Fruma.
Recover the Past#302.dst: Silencio. Antes de empezar, quiero dejar una cosa clara. No necesitamos a los de tu clase en Fruma. No queremos a los de tu clase en Fruma.
Recover the Past#302.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#303.src: What we will do with you today is a kindness, a mercy. If the world were to have its way, you would be far worse off. Remember that as we continue.
Recover the Past#303.dst: Lo que haremos hoy contigo es una bondad, una misericordia. Si el mundo se saliera con la suya, estarías mucho peor. Recuérdalo mientras seguimos.
Recover the Past#303.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#305.src: You are a new recruit, being sent to the Wynn Province to fight in their war. You enlisted because you thought your unique... talents would be useful.
Recover the Past#305.dst: Eres un recluta nuevo, enviado a la Provincia de Wynn a luchar en su guerra. Te alistaste porque creías que tus... talentos únicos serían útiles.
Recover the Past#305.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#306.src: Fruma is nothing but a speck in your history. A fact set in stone, with details lost to the hypothetical past. You think of it fondly, but remember nothing.
Recover the Past#306.dst: Fruma no es más que una mota en tu historia. Un hecho grabado en piedra, con los detalles perdidos en un pasado hipotético. La recuerdas con cariño, pero no recuerdas nada.
Recover the Past#306.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#307.src: You will fight in their war. You will live for it, you will die for it. You will be of Wynn forever, and Fruma will be glad to be rid of you.
Recover the Past#307.dst: Lucharás en su guerra. Vivirás por ella, morirás por ella. Serás de Wynn para siempre, y Fruma se alegrará de deshacerse de ti.
Recover the Past#307.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#310.src: Must I repeat myself? Do you understand?
Recover the Past#310.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#311.src: I will ask once more. Is your directive understood?
Recover the Past#311.dst: Preguntaré una vez más. ¿Has entendido tu directriz?
Recover the Past#311.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#313.src: Wonderful. Take this one to the caravan. It looks like we'll be able to fit in two more for today's batch.
Recover the Past#313.dst: Maravilloso. Llevad a este a la caravana. Parece que aún caben dos más en la tanda de hoy.
Recover the Past#313.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#318.src: Assistant! Snap out of it! You've gone in too deep, the memory is sucking you in!
Recover the Past#318.dst: ¡Ayudante! ¡Espabila! ¡Has entrado demasiado hondo, el recuerdo te está absorbiendo!
Recover the Past#318.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#319.src: Good grief- there you are! Do you understand how dangerous that was?!
Recover the Past#319.dst: Madre mía- ¡ahí estás! ¡¿Entiendes lo peligroso que ha sido eso?!
Recover the Past#319.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#320.src: What do you think happens to me if one of my assistants gets trapped in their memories forever! Nothing good!
Recover the Past#320.dst: ¡¿Qué me pasa a mí si un ayudante se queda atrapado en sus recuerdos para siempre?! ¡Nada bueno!
Recover the Past#320.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#321.src: ... Fine, fine. It did give us more information. Don't do it again, though! Come on, come over here, we have much to discuss.
Recover the Past#321.dst: ... Vale, vale. Nos ha dado más información. ¡Pero no vuelvas a hacerlo! Venga, ven aquí, tenemos mucho de que hablar.
Recover the Past#321.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#322.src: ... Hmph. I'll admit, I'm... I'm not sure what to do with this information.
Recover the Past#322.dst: ... Hmpf. Lo admito, no... no sé muy bien qué hacer con esta información.
Recover the Past#322.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#323.src: The memory restorification orb worked as well as I could expect for a single use... but, good grief, that was upsetting to watch.
Recover the Past#323.dst: La esfera de restaurificación de memoria funcionó todo lo bien que cabía esperar de un solo uso... pero, madre mía, qué duro fue de ver.
Recover the Past#323.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#324.src: It stands to reason both Caid and Reynauld also experienced this... and my magic couldn't break through that wall...
Recover the Past#324.dst: Es lógico pensar que Caid y Reynauld pasaron por lo mismo... y mi magia no pudo atravesar ese muro...
Recover the Past#324.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#325.src: Is this what they're doing to their criminals out there, in Fruma? Casting them out to fight in Wynn's war?
Recover the Past#325.dst: ¿Es esto lo que hacen allí, en Fruma, con sus criminales? ¿Expulsarlos a luchar en la guerra de Wynn?
Recover the Past#325.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#326.src: ... I'll have to think on how much I want to delve into memories. In any case! At the very start of this, I promised you we could view your memories.
Recover the Past#326.dst: ... Tendré que pensar cuánto quiero ahondar en los recuerdos. ¡En todo caso! Al principio de todo te prometí que podríamos ver los tuyos.
Recover the Past#326.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#327.src: The offer still stands, if you'd like to take it. Just step up to the orb, like the others did.
Recover the Past#327.dst: La oferta sigue en pie, si quieres aceptarla. Solo tienes que acercarte a la esfera, como los demás.
Recover the Past#327.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#328.src: Well? The offer still stands, if you'd like to take it. Simply step up to the orb, just like the others did.
Recover the Past#328.dst: ¿Y bien? La oferta sigue en pie, si quieres aceptarla. Simplemente acércate a la esfera, igual que los demás.
Recover the Past#328.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#329.src: H-huh?! The orb! My beautiful memory restorification orb! It's ruined!
Recover the Past#329.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#330.src: ... Oh, whatever. I have the blueprints stored somewhere around here. I can always make another... but still.
Recover the Past#330.dst: ... Ah, qué más da. Tengo los planos guardados por aquí. Siempre puedo hacer otra... pero aun así.
Recover the Past#330.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#332.src: Oh! Oh, right! My apologies, I completely forgot to check in with you! Are you alright?
Recover the Past#332.dst: ¡Oh! ¡Ah, sí! ¡Perdona, se me olvidó por completo preguntarte! ¿Estás bien?
Recover the Past#332.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#333.src: None of the other test subjects experienced this powerful a reaction... strange. It's almost like we're accessing memories that didn't exist.
Recover the Past#333.dst: Ninguno de los otros sujetos tuvo una reacción tan fuerte... qué raro. Es casi como si accediéramos a recuerdos que no existían.
Recover the Past#333.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#334.src: ... Well. Ehem. In any case, I'll need to continue my research. There's more to learn, I'm sure...
Recover the Past#334.dst: ... Bueno. Ejem. En cualquier caso, tendré que seguir investigando. Seguro que queda mucho por aprender...
Recover the Past#334.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#335.src: As thanks for your help. Here, a reward. Ah, also... I believe your friend is just outside the tower. You might want to check in on him.
Recover the Past#335.dst: En agradecimiento por tu ayuda. Toma, una recompensa. Ah, además... creo que tu amigo está justo fuera de la torre. Quizá quieras ver cómo está.
Recover the Past#335.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#336.src: Find Tasim outside Dr. Picard's tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#336.dst: Encuentra a Tasim fuera de la torre del Dr. Picard, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#338.src: Cursed. He called me cursed. What does that mean for me...?
Recover the Past#338.dst: Maldito. Me ha llamado maldito. ¿Qué significa eso para mí...?
Recover the Past#338.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#339.src: And the Inquisitor... I don't know what to think. All of us what we thought we knew when we arrived in Wynn... None of it was true.
Recover the Past#339.dst: Y el Inquisidor... No sé qué pensar. Todos nosotros lo que creíamos saber al llegar a Wynn... Nada de ello era cierto.
Recover the Past#339.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#340.src: ... Did the two of us really meet through sheer random luck? He was running from something, and... fell straight into my life.
Recover the Past#340.dst: ... ¿De verdad nos conocimos por pura casualidad? Él huía de algo y... cayó de lleno en mi vida.
Recover the Past#340.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#341.src: I- I need some space to think. To... reflect. Can you... please don't tell Aledar about any of this.
Recover the Past#341.dst: Yo- necesito espacio para pensar. Para... reflexionar. ¿Puedes... por favor, no le cuentes nada de esto a Aledar.
Recover the Past#341.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#342.src: He doesn't need to know about all of this. He's- he's better off not knowing.
Recover the Past#342.dst: No necesita saber todo esto. Es- es mejor que no lo sepa.
Recover the Past#342.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#343.src: ... I'm going to head for the Gavel Province, I think. It's across the ocean, far enough from... From all of this.
Recover the Past#343.dst: ... Creo que me iré a la Provincia de Gavel. Está al otro lado del océano, lo bastante lejos de... De todo esto.
Recover the Past#343.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#344.src: When you get stronger, you should go there too. Maybe we'll run into each other, eventually.
Recover the Past#344.dst: Cuando te hagas más fuerte, deberías ir tú también. Quizá acabemos encontrándonos.
Recover the Past#344.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#345.src: I guess this is goodbye for now, then. Not forever but for now. I'll see you around, {u}.
Recover the Past#345.dst: Supongo que esto es un adiós, por ahora. No para siempre, solo por ahora. Nos vemos, {u}.
Recover the Past#345.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#346.src: ... I'm just resting here, a little. I'll be on my way soon.
Recover the Past#346.dst: ... Solo estoy descansando un poco aquí. Pronto me pondré en camino.
Recover the Past#346.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#347.src: It's the box Caid was talking about...
Recover the Past#347.dst: Es la caja de la que hablaba Caid...

Redbeard's Booty#000.src: Talk with Marston in the ocean at [-{~} {~} -{~}]
Redbeard's Booty#000.dst: Habla con Marston en el océano en [-{~} {~} -{~}]

Redbeard's Booty#001.src: Ah, ahoy matey! Are ye here to get a glimpse of ol' Redbeard's sunken galleon as well?
Redbeard's Booty#001.dst: ¡Ah, ah del barco, compañero! ¿Vienes tú también a echarle un ojo al galeón hundido del viejo Redbeard?
Redbeard's Booty#001.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#002.src: A fine ship it once was, aye? Accordin' to the stories, it sank in one o' the greatest sea battles in history! The cap'n sank beneath the waves, ne'er to be seen again!
Redbeard's Booty#002.dst: Buen barco fue en su día, ¿eh? ¡Según cuentan, se hundió en una de las mayores batallas navales de la historia! ¡El capitán se fue bajo las olas y nunca más se le vio!
Redbeard's Booty#002.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#003.src: ...Say. Have ye ever wanted to go on a real treasure hunt? Ye look like someone with an eye for treasure, aye?
Redbeard's Booty#003.dst: ...Oye. ¿Nunca has querido ir a una caza del tesoro de verdad? Tienes pinta de tener buen ojo para el botín, ¿eh?
Redbeard's Booty#003.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#004.src: Good for ye then! I bought meself a real treasure map on Pirate Cove, a fine deal if ye ask me. And, if the jack wasn't fibbing, it leads to the feared Redbeard's real treasure!
Redbeard's Booty#004.dst: ¡Pues estupendo! Me compré un mapa del tesoro auténtico en Pirate Cove, un buen trato, donde va a parar. ¡Y si el mozo no mentía, lleva al tesoro de verdad del temido Redbeard!
Redbeard's Booty#004.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#005.src: I ventured 'round, spied some fine jacks at the island, and I collected a crew to join me on me grand, fantastic voyage!
Redbeard's Booty#005.dst: Anduve por ahí, vi a unos buenos mozos en la isla, ¡y reuní tripulación para mi gran viaje!
Redbeard's Booty#005.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#006.src: O' course, there always be room for another! Ye joinin'? We could use another hand.
Redbeard's Booty#006.dst: ¡Claro que siempre hay sitio pa' uno más! ¿Te apuntas? Nos vendría bien otro par de manos.
Redbeard's Booty#006.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#007.src: Aye! Let's find the booty and bring back some doubloons! Here be that map I snagged. Swim or whatever you landlubbers do to get to Pirate Cove. It'll be the first house to the right when ye arrive.
Redbeard's Booty#007.dst: ¡Eso es! ¡Vamos a por el botín y a traernos unos doblones! Aquí tienes el mapa que pillé. Nada o haz lo que hagáis los de tierra firme para llegar a Pirate Cove. Será la primera casa a la derecha al llegar.
Redbeard's Booty#007.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#008.src: Find Marston's crew on Pirate Cove at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Redbeard's Booty#008.dst: Encuentra a la tripulación de Marston en Pirate Cove, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Redbeard's Booty#009.src: And that be when ye will...
Redbeard's Booty#009.dst: Y es entonces cuando vas a...
Redbeard's Booty#009.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#010.src: Cor lad...ye don' look like a pirate ta me, and I be but a young lass!
Redbeard's Booty#010.dst: Anda, muchacho... tú no me pareces un pirata, ¡y yo no soy más que una moza!
Redbeard's Booty#010.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#011.src: 's right, bucko. Who be ye, bargin' into our home in yer fancy armour 'n whatnot?
Redbeard's Booty#011.dst: Eso es, colega. ¿Quién eres tú, pa' colarte en nuestra casa con esas galas?
Redbeard's Booty#011.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#012.src: Ah, ye be accompanyin' Marston, eh? Well if ye insist on that, where be the man 'himself?
Redbeard's Booty#012.dst: Ah, ¿que vienes con Marston, eh? Pues si tanto insistes, ¿dónde está el hombre en persona?
Redbeard's Booty#012.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#013.src: Comin' later? Hm. Well, more hands always be helpful. Let us go down to me ship, the Black Ring.
Redbeard's Booty#013.dst: ¿Que viene luego? Hm. En fin, más manos siempre vienen bien. Bajemos a mi barco, el Black Ring.
Redbeard's Booty#013.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#014.src: So he told ye about the plan? We'll bathe in doubloons when we get back! Ah, me fair lass will be so happy.
Redbeard's Booty#014.dst: ¿Así que te contó el plan? ¡Nos bañaremos en doblones al volver! Ah, mi moza se pondrá contentísima.
Redbeard's Booty#014.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#015.src: Hop aboard the Black Ring down at the dock of Pirate Cove.
Redbeard's Booty#015.dst: Sube a bordo del Black Ring en el muelle de Pirate Cove.

Redbeard's Booty#017.src: Aha, quick on yer feet, lad! Ye got 'ere before us!
Redbeard's Booty#017.dst: ¡Ajá, qué pies más rápidos, muchacho! ¡Has llegado antes que nosotros!
Redbeard's Booty#017.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#019.src: How's about we wait up fer him? He's the one who's givin us the opportunity fer this hunt, anyways.
Redbeard's Booty#019.dst: ¿Qué tal si lo esperamos? Al fin y al cabo, es él quien nos da la ocasión de esta caza.
Redbeard's Booty#019.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#020.src: I be getting impatient... The whole crew is 'ere, 'cept fer him!
Redbeard's Booty#020.dst: Se me acaba la paciencia... ¡Toda la tripulación está aquí menos él!
Redbeard's Booty#020.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#021.src: Argh! Where be our mate? It be getting dark out! We will have to leave Marston at land.
Redbeard's Booty#021.dst: ¡Argh! ¿Dónde está nuestro compañero? ¡Se está haciendo de noche! Tendremos que dejar a Marston en tierra.
Redbeard's Booty#021.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#022.src: Do ya have the map Marston bought?
Redbeard's Booty#022.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#023.src: Let us take a looksie at the map and see where to go.
Redbeard's Booty#023.dst: Echémosle un vistazo al mapa a ver adónde hay que ir.
Redbeard's Booty#023.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#024.src: It seems like one of these islands have the treasure... A'ight, yer in charge, landlubber! Set us on a course fer an island!
Redbeard's Booty#024.dst: Parece que el tesoro está en una de estas islas... ¡Vale, tú mandas, marinero de agua dulce! ¡Ponnos rumbo a una isla!
Redbeard's Booty#024.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#025.src: Ahoy, this must be the booty. Fret not, Argus is keepin' the ship prepared so we can leave.
Redbeard's Booty#025.dst: Ah del barco, este debe de ser el botín. No te apures, Argus mantiene el barco listo para zarpar.
Redbeard's Booty#025.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#026.src: A'ight, let's us dig it up, jacks!
Redbeard's Booty#026.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#027.src: Aha, I see somethin' gleaming in there! Methinks we hit gold, lads.
Redbeard's Booty#027.dst: ¡Ajá, algo brilla ahí dentro! Me parece que hemos dado con oro, mozos.
Redbeard's Booty#027.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#028.src: Now Martim, knock the lubber out.
Redbeard's Booty#028.dst: Ahora, Martim, tumba al de tierra.
Redbeard's Booty#028.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#029.src: What? Another clue! The be just a wild grook hunt, where be the real booty?! No one ever got rich off a heap o' keys!! Maybe this 'ere jewel attached will sell...
Redbeard's Booty#029.dst: ¿Qué? ¡Otra pista! Esto es una caza de fantasmas. ¡¿Dónde está el botín de verdad?! ¡¡Nadie se hizo rico con un montón de llaves!! Igual la joya que lleva se vende...
Redbeard's Booty#029.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#030.src: Wait, there be a clue on the key! Presented to the ruined Galleon, a true path forward will arise.
Redbeard's Booty#030.dst: ¡Espera, la llave tiene una pista! Presentada ante el galeón en ruinas, surgirá el verdadero camino.
Redbeard's Booty#030.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#031.src: Garh...I be losin' my patience. Argus arrived, let's ditch the lubber before they awake, hm? This island be hidden by magic, ain't no way they're gettin' found.
Redbeard's Booty#031.dst: Garh... se me acaba la paciencia. Argus ya está aquí, dejemos tirado al de tierra antes de que despierte, ¿hm? Esta isla la esconde la magia, no hay forma de que lo encuentren.
Redbeard's Booty#031.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#032.src: Arright! This key... We might be able to bring Redbeard 'imself back to life... He'll strike terror in the seas again, and we will be 'is crew!
Redbeard's Booty#032.dst: ¡Muy bien! Esta llave... Puede que devolvamos la vida al mismísimo Redbeard... ¡Sembrará el terror en los mares otra vez, y seremos su tripulación!
Redbeard's Booty#032.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#033.src: Leave the hidden island and stop the pirates from stealing Redbeard's Booty.
Redbeard's Booty#033.dst: Abandona la isla oculta e impide que los piratas roben el botín de Redbeard.

Redbeard's Booty#034.src: Talk to Marston about his crew at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Redbeard's Booty#034.dst: Habla con Marston sobre su tripulación en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Redbeard's Booty#035.src: Can't say I expected all that... Those dogs are quick, eh?
Redbeard's Booty#035.dst: No diré que me esperaba todo eso... Qué rápidos son esos perros, ¿eh?
Redbeard's Booty#035.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#036.src: Fer a landlubber, ye sure are quick. When I got ta Pirate Cove, ye were already but a speck on the horizon.
Redbeard's Booty#036.dst: Para ser de tierra firme, bien rápido eres. Cuando llegué a Pirate Cove ya eras un punto en el horizonte.
Redbeard's Booty#036.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#037.src: Speakin' of, what'n the name o' Davy Jones' Locket happened out there?!
Redbeard's Booty#037.dst: Y hablando de eso, ¡¿qué demonios ha pasado ahí fuera?!
Redbeard's Booty#037.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#038.src: Ye look a bit bruised! Reckon ye ran aground o' trouble with 'em too, eh?
Redbeard's Booty#038.dst: ¡Vienes magullado! Supongo que tú también tuviste líos con ellos, ¿eh?
Redbeard's Booty#038.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#039.src: Well, lad! Methinks ye oughta go in after 'em! We may be a rowdy lot, but a mutiny's somethin' ye don't tolerate.
Redbeard's Booty#039.dst: ¡Pues, muchacho! ¡Me parece que deberías ir tras ellos! Seremos gente pendenciera, pero un motín no se tolera.
Redbeard's Booty#039.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#040.src: They don't deserve that treasure, lad! It ain't be mine either, since I missed ye. That gold be yours fer the takin...so take it!
Redbeard's Booty#040.dst: ¡No se merecen ese tesoro, muchacho! Y mío tampoco es, que te perdí de vista. Ese oro es tuyo si lo tomas... ¡así que tómalo!
Redbeard's Booty#040.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#041.src: Speakin' of...I ain't got much a penny ta my name, but I found this fish while ye were gone. I hear it sells for a decent haul, so here.
Redbeard's Booty#041.dst: Y hablando de eso... no me queda ni un mísero real, pero encontré este pez mientras no estabas. Dicen que se vende por un buen puñado, así que toma.
Redbeard's Booty#041.speaker: Marston

Reincarnation#000.src: Talk to Batelu in Bob's Tomb.
Reincarnation#000.dst: Habla con Batelu en la tumba de Bob.

Reincarnation#001.src: Hello adventurer! I see you want to solve the mystery of Bob's tomb also? Glad to meet you.
Reincarnation#001.dst: ¡Hola, aventurero! Veo que tú también quieres resolver el misterio de la tumba de Bob, ¿no? Encantado de conocerte.
Reincarnation#001.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#002.src: My name is Batelu. Lately, I've been studying these strange symbols on the walls.
Reincarnation#002.dst: Me llamo Batelu. Últimamente he estado estudiando estos extraños símbolos de las paredes.
Reincarnation#002.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#003.src: It's about Bob. Hopefully you do not believe the stories of his death, right? Bob couldn't have died so easily. Not to something so mundane as a wolf.
Reincarnation#003.dst: Se trata de Bob. Espero que no te creas las historias de su muerte, ¿no? Bob no pudo morir tan fácilmente. Y menos por algo tan vulgar como un lobo.
Reincarnation#003.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#004.src: He wasn't only strong, he was absolutely un-killable, a master in almost every skill.
Reincarnation#004.dst: No solo era fuerte: era absolutamente imposible de matar, un maestro en casi cualquier arte.
Reincarnation#004.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#005.src: I believe he knew he was about to die. How? What of? Nobody knows, but he left this world prepared.
Reincarnation#005.dst: Creo que sabía que iba a morir. ¿Cómo? ¿De qué? Nadie lo sabe, pero dejó este mundo preparado.
Reincarnation#005.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#006.src: You see, it says here Bob had three loyal animals. Before dying, he scattered them across the ocean.
Reincarnation#006.dst: Verás, aquí dice que Bob tenía tres animales fieles. Antes de morir, los repartió por todo el océano.
Reincarnation#006.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#007.src: I think those animals are the key to accessing his real tomb...
Reincarnation#007.dst: Creo que esos animales son la llave para acceder a su verdadera tumba...
Reincarnation#007.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#008.src: You see that little gap right there? It's the entrance...
Reincarnation#008.dst: ¿Ves esa pequeña grieta de ahí? Es la entrada...
Reincarnation#008.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#009.src: Unfortunately, nobody was able to remove the spell blocking it.
Reincarnation#009.dst: Por desgracia, nadie ha podido retirar el hechizo que la bloquea.
Reincarnation#009.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#010.src: But I do. I know how to open the passage to Bob. This is where the animals come in useful...
Reincarnation#010.dst: Pero yo sí. Sé cómo abrir el paso hacia Bob. Ahí es donde los animales resultan útiles...
Reincarnation#010.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#011.src: I believe Bob did something to those animals. I think if we could reunite them in some way, we could open the passage.
Reincarnation#011.dst: Creo que Bob les hizo algo a esos animales. Si pudiéramos reunirlos de algún modo, podríamos abrir el paso.
Reincarnation#011.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#012.src: Bring me {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, {~} Baab's Wool & {~} Mooington's Skin if you can find them.
Reincarnation#012.dst: Tráeme {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, {~} Baab's Wool y {~} Mooington's Skin si logras encontrarlos.
Reincarnation#012.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#013.src: I am sure that together, we can open the passage. Good luck.
Reincarnation#013.dst: Estoy seguro de que juntos podremos abrir el paso. Buena suerte.
Reincarnation#013.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#014.src: Bring back {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, Baab's Wool, and Mooington's Skin to Batelu.
Reincarnation#014.dst: Lleva de vuelta a Batelu {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, Baab's Wool y Mooington's Skin.

Reincarnation#015.src: Wonderful! We can now open the passage to the true tomb of Bob...
Reincarnation#015.dst: ¡Maravilloso! Ya podemos abrir el paso a la verdadera tumba de Bob...
Reincarnation#015.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#016.src: I am not worthy enough to enter it. I did not complete the task of the animals, merely read it. You shall go alone, be careful.
Reincarnation#016.dst: Yo no soy digno de entrar. No completé la prueba de los animales, solo la leí. Tendrás que ir solo, ten cuidado.
Reincarnation#016.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#017.dst: Mata a la Reencarnación de Bob.

Reincarnation#018.src: I am Bob, master of the arts of Wynn.
Reincarnation#018.dst: Soy Bob, maestro de las artes de Wynn.
Reincarnation#018.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#019.src: Let me explain why you are here.
Reincarnation#019.dst: Te explicaré por qué estás aquí.
Reincarnation#019.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#020.src: My animals, were my greatest allies in my travels through the world.
Reincarnation#020.dst: Mis animales fueron mis mayores aliados en mis viajes por el mundo.
Reincarnation#020.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#021.src: I travelled too far, mined too deep, and of course challenged what should not be challenged. My time in Wynn was coming to an end.
Reincarnation#021.dst: Viajé demasiado lejos, excavé demasiado hondo y, por supuesto, desafié lo que no debía desafiarse. Mi tiempo en Wynn llegaba a su fin.
Reincarnation#021.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#022.src: I knew so, too. But I refused to leave without giving the power i had attained to those worthy of it.
Reincarnation#022.dst: Yo también lo sabía. Pero no quise partir sin legar el poder que había alcanzado a quienes fueran dignos de él.
Reincarnation#022.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#023.src: Using what ability I had left to me, I transferred my power to my animals, in three pieces. In the hope that those worthy to harness it will seek them out.
Reincarnation#023.dst: Con la poca capacidad que me quedaba, repartí mi poder entre mis animales, en tres partes. Con la esperanza de que los dignos de manejarlo los busquen.
Reincarnation#023.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#024.src: The spell I placed on the door to this realm will only break to the one who collects my power. But it cannot have escaped your notice, you do not have my power.
Reincarnation#024.dst: El hechizo que puse en la puerta de este reino solo se romperá ante quien reúna mi poder. Pero no se te habrá escapado: tú no tienes mi poder.
Reincarnation#024.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#025.src: The truth is, you must pass a test, the ultimate test. Hone your skills you have learnt throughout your travels, and face me. Face me, and earn your place amongst soldiers of Wynn.
Reincarnation#025.dst: La verdad es que debes superar una prueba, la definitiva. Afila lo aprendido en tus viajes y enfréntate a mí. Enfréntate a mí y gánate tu lugar entre los soldados de Wynn.
Reincarnation#025.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#026.src: Bring back {~} Bob's Seal of Approval to Batelu.
Reincarnation#026.dst: Lleva de vuelta a Batelu {~} Bob's Seal of Approval.

Reincarnation#027.src: Ah! You have returned! Tell me, what did you find within?
Reincarnation#027.dst: ¡Ah! ¡Has vuelto! Dime, ¿qué has encontrado ahí dentro?
Reincarnation#027.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#028.src: ...You faced Bob himself in combat? And you triumphed? That's quite remarkable!
Reincarnation#028.dst: ...¿Te enfrentaste al propio Bob? ¿Y venciste? ¡Es de lo más notable!
Reincarnation#028.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#029.src: And he gave you his Seal of Approval... Hm. If that is the case, then there is something I may do for you.
Reincarnation#029.dst: Y te dio su sello de aprobación... Hm. Si es así, entonces hay algo que puedo hacer por ti.
Reincarnation#029.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#030.src: Before Bob passed, he left his mythical weapons with a trusted friend. They were, so he said, to be kept for one who would be worthy to wield them...
Reincarnation#030.dst: Antes de morir, Bob dejó sus armas míticas a un amigo de confianza. Debían guardarse, según dijo, para quien fuera digno de empuñarlas...
Reincarnation#030.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#031.src: Yes... Yes, I am certain. You have proven yourself worthy. Take this relic, the Stone of Myths, and bring it to the Temple of the Legends.
Reincarnation#031.dst: Sí... Sí, estoy seguro. Has demostrado ser digno. Toma esta reliquia, la Piedra de los Mitos, y llévala al Templo de las leyendas.
Reincarnation#031.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#032.src: Within, you will find a merchant who will offer you a weapon in exchange for it. I wish you luck with your future travels.
Reincarnation#032.dst: Dentro encontrarás a un mercader que te ofrecerá un arma a cambio de ella. Te deseo suerte en tus futuros viajes.
Reincarnation#032.speaker: Batelu

Revelations in Fall#000.src: They had the potential to be dangerous. Sometimes, they were. But more often than not, they were heroes. They used their power to protect people in need.
Revelations in Fall#000.dst: Podían ser peligrosos. A veces lo eran. Pero casi siempre eran héroes. Usaban su poder para proteger a quien lo necesitaba.

Revelations in Fall#002.src: Attend the meeting in the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#002.dst: Asiste a la reunión en el campamento de la resistencia en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#003.src: Hello, everyone. Thank you for being here today.
Revelations in Fall#003.dst: Hola a todos. Gracias por estar hoy aquí.
Revelations in Fall#003.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#004.src: It has been growing increasingly clear that there is very little we can do here to make a larger impact on Fruma.
Revelations in Fall#004.dst: Cada vez está más claro que desde aquí podemos hacer muy poco para influir de verdad en Fruma.
Revelations in Fall#004.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#005.src: We have been doing good for the people of Auburn! But our resources are limited, and our opportunities to take action are even more so.
Revelations in Fall#005.dst: ¡Hemos hecho el bien por la gente de Auburn! Pero nuestros recursos son limitados, y nuestras ocasiones de actuar aún más.
Revelations in Fall#005.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#006.src: Additionally, our risks of operation grow by the day. I do not regret taking in {u} as a member, but it's no secret that we risk more scrutiny by having them here.
Revelations in Fall#006.dst: Además, el riesgo de operar crece cada día. No me arrepiento de aceptar a {u} como miembro, pero no es ningún secreto que tenerlo aquí atrae más vigilancia.
Revelations in Fall#006.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#007.src: Zeph and {u} learned yesterday that an Inquisitor is arriving in the area. We don't know what for exactly, but their presence further endangers our cause.
Revelations in Fall#007.dst: Zeph y {u} supieron ayer que un Inquisidor viene a la zona. No sabemos a qué exactamente, pero su presencia pone nuestra causa en más peligro.
Revelations in Fall#007.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#008.src: At the festival, I received word from a contact in the Roughworks. There's a group similar to ours there, run by an old friend of mine they're called the Steel Feather.
Revelations in Fall#008.dst: En el festival recibí noticias de un contacto en Roughworks. Allí hay un grupo parecido al nuestro, dirigido por un viejo amigo mío. Se llaman la Pluma de Acero.
Revelations in Fall#008.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#009.src: They have resources we don't, and are situated in a much more favorable position. If we're able to cross through to the Roughworks, they've agreed to host us and help plan our next moves.
Revelations in Fall#009.dst: Tienen recursos que nosotros no, y están en una posición mucho más favorable. Si logramos cruzar a Roughworks, han accedido a acogernos y a ayudarnos a planear los siguientes pasos.
Revelations in Fall#009.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#010.src: So, what are our next moves? I don't know what you expect us to do there that we're not already able to do here.
Revelations in Fall#010.dst: ¿Y cuáles son esos pasos? No sé qué esperas que hagamos allí que no podamos hacer ya aquí.
Revelations in Fall#010.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#011.src: I'm still workshopping ideas, but they involve the Crown Festival. If we move quickly, we'll be able to catch it in the Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#011.dst: Aún estoy puliendo ideas, pero tienen que ver con el Festival de la Corona. Si nos damos prisa, lo alcanzaremos en Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#011.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#012.src: Of course, traveling to a different district presents its own risks and dangers... if any of you wish to stay here, I will respect that decision.
Revelations in Fall#012.dst: Claro que viajar a otro distrito trae sus propios riesgos y peligros... si alguno quiere quedarse aquí, respetaré esa decisión.
Revelations in Fall#012.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#013.src: Ha! And leave you to strategize all on your own? I had foreseen something along these lines, so I have already made arrangements with my work. I will join you, miss.
Revelations in Fall#013.dst: ¡Ja! ¿Y dejar que trace usted los planes sola? Ya preveía algo así, de modo que lo he arreglado en el trabajo. La acompaño, señorita.
Revelations in Fall#013.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#014.src: An I'm definitely not sitting this one out, are you kidding? I'll follow you wherever you go, Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#014.dst: Y yo desde luego no me quedo fuera, ¿bromeas? Te sigo adonde vayas, Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#014.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#015.src: I- I'll go too! Wh- what's the point of hav- having magic if I don't use it for our c- c- cause?
Revelations in Fall#015.dst: ¡Y- yo también voy! ¿De qué sirve te- tener magia si no la uso por nuestra c- c- causa?
Revelations in Fall#015.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#016.src: Eh. Don't see myself bein' much use out there, to tell you the truth, Synny. And I figure you need someone to hold down the fort while you're gone, anyhow. So I'll stay.
Revelations in Fall#016.dst: Eh. La verdad, Synny, no me veo sirviendo de mucho ahí fuera. Y digo yo que alguien tendrá que guardar la casa mientras no estáis. Así que me quedo.
Revelations in Fall#016.speaker: Kaio

Revelations in Fall#017.src: That would be appreciated, Kaio. I'll feel more comfortable leaving, knowing the LEaves in the Wind is safe in your care.
Revelations in Fall#017.dst: Te lo agradecería, Kaio. Me iré más tranquila sabiendo que Hojas al Viento queda a tu cuidado.
Revelations in Fall#017.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#020.src: You'll... need my medicine. So I'll go...
Revelations in Fall#020.dst: Necesitaréis mi medicina. Así que voy...
Revelations in Fall#020.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#021.src: Sui... you can stay, if you want. I don't want to force you
Revelations in Fall#021.dst: Sui... puedes quedarte, si quieres. No quiero obligarte
Revelations in Fall#021.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#022.src: N-no! I want to go with you! I just... I need to say goodbye to some people. Before we leave.
Revelations in Fall#022.dst: ¡N-no! ¡Quiero ir con vosotros! Es solo... que tengo que despedirme de algunas personas. Antes de irnos.
Revelations in Fall#022.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#025.src: I'm forever in your debt. Thank you, again, for offering your help.
Revelations in Fall#025.dst: Estaré siempre en deuda contigo. Gracias otra vez por ofrecer tu ayuda.
Revelations in Fall#025.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#026.src: In Wynn, we have stories of people who could use magic like you. It came naturally to them, and they didn't need a focus for it.
Revelations in Fall#026.dst: En Wynn contamos historias de gente que usaba la magia como tú. Les salía de forma natural, y no necesitaban ningún catalizador.

Revelations in Fall#027.src: Sigh... I wish I could disagree. But you're right, I need you to join us.
Revelations in Fall#027.dst: Suspiro... Ojalá pudiera negarlo. Pero tienes razón, necesito que vengas.
Revelations in Fall#027.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#028.src: I still need to make preparations before we leave- namely, arranging passage across the border. I have a contact that I can... hopefully convince to help.
Revelations in Fall#028.dst: Aún tengo que prepararlo todo antes de partir- sobre todo, conseguir el paso por la frontera. Tengo un contacto al que... espero poder convencer.
Revelations in Fall#028.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#029.src: You- you can't pos- possibly mean
Revelations in Fall#029.dst: N- no estarás ha- hablando de
Revelations in Fall#029.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#030.src: Yes, Zeph, I do. It will be fine.
Revelations in Fall#030.dst: Sí, Zeph, de eso hablo. Irá bien.
Revelations in Fall#030.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#031.src: As for the rest of you, you should make your own preparations. I don't know how long the window of opportunity will be, so make the most of the time left.
Revelations in Fall#031.dst: Los demás, preparaos también. No sé cuánto durará la ventana de oportunidad, así que aprovechad el tiempo que queda.
Revelations in Fall#031.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#032.src: Hmn... Zeph, why the concern? We all know miss Syndra knows what she's doing! If she claims to have the situation covered, then I see no reason to doubt her!
Revelations in Fall#032.dst: Hmn... Zeph, ¿a qué viene esa inquietud? ¡Todos sabemos que la señorita Syndra sabe lo que hace! Si dice que lo tiene controlado, no veo razón para dudar de ella.
Revelations in Fall#032.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#034.src: Ah, no matter! Come now, other children... and {u}, of course! Let us all take some time to say our goodbyes. We don't know when we'll be back, after all!
Revelations in Fall#034.dst: ¡Ah, no importa! Venid, muchachos... ¡y {u}, por supuesto! Tomémonos un rato para despedirnos. ¡Al fin y al cabo, no sabemos cuándo volveremos!
Revelations in Fall#034.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#035.src: If we'll be back at all...
Revelations in Fall#035.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#036.src: Sui... we will be back. I'll make sure of it! And you know I always keep my word for matters such as these.
Revelations in Fall#036.dst: Sui... volveremos. ¡Yo me encargo! Y sabes que en estas cosas siempre cumplo mi palabra.
Revelations in Fall#036.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#037.src: We'll be fine, Sui. We always are.
Revelations in Fall#037.dst: Nos irá bien, Sui. Como siempre.
Revelations in Fall#037.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#039.src: Talk with Zeph outside the base at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#039.dst: Habla con Zeph fuera de la base en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#041.src: I don't know if I- I'm ready for this.
Revelations in Fall#041.dst: No sé si e- estoy lista para esto.
Revelations in Fall#041.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#042.src: But I have to be! I... I have to.
Revelations in Fall#042.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#044.src: So... I r- really don't trust the Sovereign, and I- I- I'm afraid he might do s- so- something to Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#044.dst: Es que... no me f- fío nada del Soberano, y m- m- me da miedo que le haga a- al- algo a Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#044.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#045.src: It- it's silly, but... if y- you and I can fi- find a way over the wall without having to ask him d- directly, we could avoid a- a potential con- conflict.
Revelations in Fall#045.dst: Es- es una tontería, pero... si t- tú y yo en- encontramos un modo de pasar el muro sin pedírselo d- directamente, evitaríamos un p- posible con- conflicto.
Revelations in Fall#045.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#046.src: And besides, it's not like I have a- any- anything better to do...
Revelations in Fall#046.dst: Y además, tampoco tengo n- na- nada mejor que hacer...
Revelations in Fall#046.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#047.src: So! L- let's head into town, and s- s- see if we can
Revelations in Fall#047.dst: ¡Así que! V- vamos a la ciudad y v- v- vemos si podemos
Revelations in Fall#047.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#048.src: Um... excuse me, s-sorry to interrupt I overheard you were... going into town?
Revelations in Fall#048.dst: Eh... perdonad, s-siento interrumpir. Os oí decir que... ¿vais a la ciudad?
Revelations in Fall#048.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#049.src: Sui! Y- yeah, we were pl- planning on it.
Revelations in Fall#049.dst: ¡Sui! S- sí, esa era la i- idea.
Revelations in Fall#049.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#050.src: If... if it wouldn't be too much trouble... could I maybe go with you? I, ah... have some people I want to... say goodbye to.
Revelations in Fall#050.dst: Si... si no es mucha molestia... ¿podría ir con vosotros? Yo, ah... tengo gente de la que quiero... despedirme.
Revelations in Fall#050.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#051.src: Oh... the people at the R- Re- the Red Fox?
Revelations in Fall#051.dst: Ah... ¿los del Z- Zo- el Zorro Rojo?
Revelations in Fall#051.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#052.src: It's... a restaurant I, um, frequent. The owners are... nice. I wanted to thank them, for, ha, everything.
Revelations in Fall#052.dst: Es... un restaurante al que, eh, voy mucho. Los dueños son... amables. Quería darles las gracias por, ja, todo.
Revelations in Fall#052.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#053.src: It's built atop one of th- the tallest tr- trees in {p}, too... so it'll w- wo- work for my idea too. It's jus- just outside {p}'s gates.
Revelations in Fall#053.dst: Y está construido sobre uno de l- los árboles más al- altos de {p}... así que t- ta- también me vale para mi idea. Está jus- justo a las puertas de {p}.
Revelations in Fall#053.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#054.src: Head to the Red Fox treetop café at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#054.dst: Ve al Zorro Rojo, el café de las copas, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#055.src: L- let's all meet up at the Re- Red Fox café. It's just ou- out- outside the {p} Gates.
Revelations in Fall#055.dst: Q- quedemos todos en el café el Zo- Zorro Rojo. Está jus- jus- justo fuera de las puertas de {p}.
Revelations in Fall#055.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#057.src: So, wh- what do you think? It's a n- nice view from up here, is- isn't it?
Revelations in Fall#057.dst: ¿Y qu- qué te parece? Bo- bonitas vistas desde aquí, ¿v- verdad?
Revelations in Fall#057.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#058.src: I... bring the others here quite often. They, um, serve the best food in {p}...
Revelations in Fall#058.dst: Yo... traigo aquí a los demás muy a menudo. Sirven, eh, la mejor comida de {p}...
Revelations in Fall#058.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#059.src: Yeah... I'll m- mi- miss our late-night snack runs. Heh.
Revelations in Fall#059.dst: Sí... e- ech- echaré de menos nuestras cenas de madrugada. Je.
Revelations in Fall#059.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#061.src: S- Sui, do you... want us t- to stay? We can
Revelations in Fall#061.dst: S- Sui, ¿quieres... que nos qu- quedemos? Podemos
Revelations in Fall#061.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#062.src: N-no! No, no, it's... fine. I'll go find Chen on my own. You two, um, hand something you were going to do, right?
Revelations in Fall#062.dst: ¡N-no! No, no, está... bien. Iré a ver a Chen yo sola. Vosotros dos, eh, teníais algo que hacer, ¿no?
Revelations in Fall#062.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#063.src: We did... uh, if y- you're sure, Sui. We'll see you l- la- later?
Revelations in Fall#063.dst: Sí... eh, si e- estás segura, Sui. ¿Nos vemos lu- lu- luego?
Revelations in Fall#063.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#064.src: Y... yes. Um, good... good luck!
Revelations in Fall#064.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#065.src: ...okay. Well, {u}, the re- reason we came here... from up h- he- from up here, we have good access to the r- roof- rooftops.
Revelations in Fall#065.dst: ...vale. Bueno, {u}, el mo- motivo de venir aquí... desde a- arr- desde aquí arriba llegamos bien a los te- tej- tejados.
Revelations in Fall#065.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#066.src: I w- w- I want to see if we can ge- get over the wall. If we st- stick to the roofs, we should be able to av- avoid suspicion...
Revelations in Fall#066.dst: Qu- qu- quiero ver si podemos pa- pasar el muro. Si no nos sa- salimos de los tejados, deberíamos ev- evitar sospechas...
Revelations in Fall#066.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#068.src: Follow Zeph to the tree branch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#068.dst: Sigue a Zeph hasta la rama del árbol en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#069.src: Ah, Sui! What a pleasure to see you as always!
Revelations in Fall#069.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#070.src: Hi, Chen... is, um, business going well?
Revelations in Fall#070.dst: Hola, Chen... ¿va bien, eh, el negocio?
Revelations in Fall#070.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#071.src: Hum, as well as one can hope, I would say! The Festival does always bring a rush of customers. So, should I prepare the usual for you?
Revelations in Fall#071.dst: ¡Hum, todo lo bien que cabe esperar, diría yo! El festival siempre trae una avalancha de clientes. ¿Te preparo lo de siempre?
Revelations in Fall#071.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#072.src: Oh. Um... that's very kind of you, but, no, not today. Thank you.
Revelations in Fall#072.dst: Ah. Eh... es muy amable de tu parte, pero no, hoy no. Gracias.
Revelations in Fall#072.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#073.src: Very well, very well. Well, since you're here, might I ask if you've had a thought about my job offer?
Revelations in Fall#073.dst: Muy bien, muy bien. Ya que estás aquí, ¿puedo preguntarte si has pensado en mi oferta de trabajo?
Revelations in Fall#073.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#074.src: You basically know our menu inside and out by this point, so I do truly think you'd be a great fit.
Revelations in Fall#074.dst: A estas alturas te sabes nuestra carta de memoria, así que de verdad creo que encajarías de maravilla.
Revelations in Fall#074.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#076.src: Okay, so... just f- fo- follow the green trails !
Revelations in Fall#076.dst: Vale, pues... ¡tú s- si- sigue los rastros verdes!
Revelations in Fall#076.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#077.src: If you g- get lost, meet me back here.
Revelations in Fall#077.dst: Si te p- pierdes, vuelve aquí.
Revelations in Fall#077.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#078.src: Travel across the roof tops of {p} starting from .
Revelations in Fall#078.dst: Cruza los tejados de {p} empezando desde .

Revelations in Fall#080.src: Do you, uh, w- want to take a break?
Revelations in Fall#080.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#081.src: Alright, g- good luck! Just re- remember to follow the green trail.
Revelations in Fall#081.dst: Vale, ¡s- suerte! Re- recuerda seguir el rastro verde.
Revelations in Fall#081.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#082.src: I- I'll follow you soon, I'm just w- war- warming up a bit first.
Revelations in Fall#082.dst: Y- yo te sigo enseguida, primero ca- cal- caliento un poco.
Revelations in Fall#082.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#084.src: Just re- return here when you're ready to st- start again.
Revelations in Fall#084.dst: V- vuelve aquí cuando quieras em- empezar otra vez.
Revelations in Fall#084.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#085.src: Ha, I- I guess you got here b- be- before me this time!
Revelations in Fall#085.dst: Ja, ¡e- esta vez has llegado a- an- antes que yo!
Revelations in Fall#085.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#087.dst: Vale... s- saltemos al otro lado.
Revelations in Fall#087.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#088.src: Aah! I... I... th- that was... c- cl- close.
Revelations in Fall#088.dst: ¡Aah! Yo... yo... ha- ha estado... c- ce- cerca.
Revelations in Fall#088.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#089.src: That was... th- that was m- magic, wasn't it...? It was l- li- it was like my whole body was... w- was en- engulfed by a, a g- ge- gentle breeze...
Revelations in Fall#089.dst: Eso ha sido... ha- ha sido m- magia, ¿no...? Era c- co- era como si todo mi cuerpo... q- qued- quedara envuelto en una b- br- brisa suave...
Revelations in Fall#089.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#090.src: I... ha. Th- that was- e- e- exhilarating, but... b- but... Th- there- there's no way we c- ca- we can get across these r- ro- rooftops... one c- cl- one close call is enough f- for me.
Revelations in Fall#090.dst: Yo... ja. Ha- ha sido- e- e- emocionante, pero... p- pero... N- no- no hay forma de que c- cr- de que crucemos estos te- tej- tejados... con un s- su- con un susto me basta.
Revelations in Fall#090.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#091.src: Ugh... l- let's just... get back to the R- Red Fox...
Revelations in Fall#091.dst: Uf... m- mejor... volvamos al Z- Zorro Rojo...
Revelations in Fall#091.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#092.src: Return to The Red Fox and talk to Zeph at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#092.dst: Vuelve al Zorro Rojo y habla con Zeph en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#093.src: I just... I- I- I don't like it. I don't like that S- Syn- Syndra's putting herself in- in danger like that!
Revelations in Fall#093.dst: Es que... n- n- no me gusta. ¡No me gusta que S- Syn- Syndra se ponga en p- peligro así!
Revelations in Fall#093.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#094.src: I... I owe her a lot. If it weren't for her, I- I- I'd still be st- stuck on the... the st- str- streets. It's thanks to her that I'm still... here.
Revelations in Fall#094.dst: Yo... le debo mucho. Si no fuera por ella, s- s- seguiría at- atrapado en... en la c- ca- calle. Gracias a ella sigo... aquí.
Revelations in Fall#094.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#095.src: Yeah... I, uh, grew up in a- a small village. S- someone was accused of being c- cursed, and... my people refused to h- ha- hand them over without a- a- wi- without a fight.
Revelations in Fall#095.dst: Sí... yo, eh, crecí en u- una aldea pequeña. A- acusaron a alguien de estar m- maldito, y... mi gente se negó a en- en- entregarlo sin p- p- pe- sin pelear.
Revelations in Fall#095.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#096.src: ...actually, wh- where is she? I th- thought she'd wait for us before...
Revelations in Fall#096.dst: ...por cierto, ¿d- dónde está? C- creía que nos esperaría antes de...
Revelations in Fall#096.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#097.src: Ah, Zeph, is that you I hear?
Revelations in Fall#097.dst: Ah, Zeph, ¿eres tú lo que oigo?
Revelations in Fall#097.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#098.src: Oh, h- hey Chen. I need to get going, but have you seen Sui? We were g- go- going to meet up here.
Revelations in Fall#098.dst: Ah, h- hola, Chen. Tengo que irme, pero ¿has visto a Sui? Ha- ha- habíamos quedado aquí.
Revelations in Fall#098.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#099.src: Yes, Sui... she left not long ago. The poor girl, clearly something is weighing on her...
Revelations in Fall#099.dst: Sí, Sui... se fue hace poco. Pobre niña, está claro que algo le pesa...
Revelations in Fall#099.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#100.src: I believe she would have gone to the pond to the southeast... that is where she usually goes when she needs some air.
Revelations in Fall#100.dst: Me parece que habrá ido al estanque del sureste... ahí es donde suele ir cuando necesita aire.
Revelations in Fall#100.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#101.src: Oh, I s- see. Th- thank you for the help!
Revelations in Fall#101.dst: Ah, y- ya veo. ¡G- gracias por la ayuda!
Revelations in Fall#101.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#102.src: Of course, anything for you children. Stop by again soon, would you? I'll make you all the family platter, on the house.
Revelations in Fall#102.dst: Claro, lo que sea por vosotros, chicos. Pasaos pronto otra vez, ¿vale? Os haré la bandeja familiar, invita la casa.
Revelations in Fall#102.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#103.src: I... y- yeah, we... we will! Thanks for the off- offer.
Revelations in Fall#103.dst: Yo... s- sí, ¡lo... lo haremos! Gracias por la in- invitación.
Revelations in Fall#103.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#105.src: {u}, can I ask you a f- fa- favour?
Revelations in Fall#105.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#106.src: Could you ch- check on Sui for me, p- please? I... I don't know h- how to help her, right now...
Revelations in Fall#106.dst: ¿Podrías ir a v- ver cómo está Sui, p- por favor? Yo... no sé c- cómo ayudarla ahora mismo...
Revelations in Fall#106.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#107.src: S- some- something's on her mind, but... b- but she won't tell me about it. I've tr- tried asking, but...
Revelations in Fall#107.dst: A- al- algo le ronda la cabeza, pero... p- pero no me lo cuenta. He in- intentado preguntarle, pero...
Revelations in Fall#107.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#108.src: ...but if you ask, ma- maybe she'll tell you? I- I don't know. It's worth a try, at- at least, r- r- right?
Revelations in Fall#108.dst: ...pero si preguntas tú, qu- quizá te lo diga. N- no lo sé. Al- al menos merece la pena probar, ¿v- v- verdad?
Revelations in Fall#108.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#109.src: Th- thanks, {u}. Chen said she w- was at the pond to the southeast.
Revelations in Fall#109.dst: G- gracias, {u}. Chen dice que e- estaba en el estanque del sureste.
Revelations in Fall#109.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#110.src: Meet up with Sui near the pond at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#110.dst: Reúnete con Sui junto al estanque en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#112.src: O-oh, {u}! I didn't... um, expect to see you here.
Revelations in Fall#112.dst: A-ah, ¡{u}! No... eh, no esperaba verte aquí.
Revelations in Fall#112.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#113.src: Oh... right. I just... needed some air. It's, hah, kind of a lot. L-leaving Auburn, I mean! I've never... known anywhere else.
Revelations in Fall#113.dst: Ah... ya. Solo... necesitaba aire. Es, ja, algo abrumador. ¡D-dejar Auburn, digo! Nunca he... conocido otro sitio.
Revelations in Fall#113.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#115.src: Can I... tell you something? I was... I wanted to talk to you, earlier, but, um, I... I couldn't build up the courage.
Revelations in Fall#115.dst: ¿Puedo... contarte una cosa? Yo... quería hablar contigo antes, pero, eh, no... no reuní el valor.
Revelations in Fall#115.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#117.src: S-sorry, I should just... go for it. It- it might be easier if I just, show you, hah...
Revelations in Fall#117.dst: P-perdona, debería... lanzarme y ya. Q- quizá sea más fácil si te lo enseño, ja...
Revelations in Fall#117.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#118.src: You're the first, um, cursed one I've ever... seen. And- and everyone being so kind, about, all of it...
Revelations in Fall#118.dst: Eres el primer, eh, maldito que he... visto. Y- y que todos sean tan amables con, con todo esto...
Revelations in Fall#118.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#119.src: And, I thought, maybe... maybe you could... help. Me. W-with figuring it all out.
Revelations in Fall#119.dst: Y he pensado que quizá... quizá podrías... ayudarme. A mí. A e-entenderlo todo.
Revelations in Fall#119.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#121.src: But... I don't use, um, a focus. To... to control water. S-so, that means I'm, one of the... d-dangerous ones. That's... th-that's what Mora said, um, earlier.
Revelations in Fall#121.dst: Pero... yo no uso, eh, catalizador. Para... para controlar el agua. A-así que soy una de las... p-peligrosas. Eso... e-eso dijo Mora, eh, antes.
Revelations in Fall#121.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#125.src: Oh... g-good. That's- that's good. I'm glad.
Revelations in Fall#125.dst: Ah... m-menos mal. Eso- eso está bien. Me alegro.
Revelations in Fall#125.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#126.src: Oh... that's, ha, a big thing to do for someone. B-breaking into a province? I can't imagine, um, doing something like that...
Revelations in Fall#126.dst: Ah... eso es, ja, mucho hacer por alguien. ¿C-colarse en una provincia? No me imagino, eh, haciendo algo así...
Revelations in Fall#126.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#128.src: I'm just... scared. I'm scared that- that if I try to use it, then, I'll, h-hurt someone...
Revelations in Fall#128.dst: Solo... tengo miedo. Miedo de que- de que si intento usarla, acabe, h-hiriendo a alguien...
Revelations in Fall#128.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#129.src: I'm... not very brave, haha. I didn't, really, join the resistance because... because I wanted to stand up against the crown!
Revelations in Fall#129.dst: No soy... muy valiente, jaja. En realidad no me uní a la resistencia porque... ¡porque quisiera plantar cara a la Corona!
Revelations in Fall#129.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#130.src: Something like that, it feels... impossible.
Revelations in Fall#130.dst: Algo así se me hace... imposible.
Revelations in Fall#130.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#131.src: ... I'm only here because I followed Mora. He's the brave one! N-not- not me. I just, ha, had nowhere else to go.
Revelations in Fall#131.dst: ... Estoy aquí solo porque seguí a Mora. ¡El valiente es él! N-no- no yo. Es que, ja, no tenía adónde ir.
Revelations in Fall#131.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#132.src: And- and everyone else is so, excited about m-ma-magic! Even, um, Mora. And here I am, too afraid to- to even try!
Revelations in Fall#132.dst: ¡Y- y los demás están tan ilusionados con la m-ma-magia! Hasta, eh, Mora. ¡Y yo con miedo de- de probar!
Revelations in Fall#132.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#134.src: Yeah, but... it- it wouldn't feel, um, right. If the rest of my family is going, then, ha, how could I not go with them?
Revelations in Fall#134.dst: Ya, pero... no- no me parecería, eh, bien. Si el resto de mi familia se va, ja, ¿cómo no iba a ir con ellos?
Revelations in Fall#134.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#135.src: What if... something happened to them- to you - and, and, and- and I wasn't, there? I'd... I'd never f-forgive myself!
Revelations in Fall#135.dst: ¿Y si... les pasara algo- o a ti - y, y, y- y yo no estuviera, allí? Nunca... ¡nunca me lo p-perdonaría!
Revelations in Fall#135.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#136.src: So... s-so, even if I'm scared... I can't stay behind.
Revelations in Fall#136.dst: Así que... a-así que, aunque tenga miedo... no puedo quedarme.
Revelations in Fall#136.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#137.src: ...I'm, um, not much of a fighter. But I'm still good with m-medicine, and healing. So... I can help.
Revelations in Fall#137.dst: ...no soy, eh, muy luchadora. Pero sigo siendo buena con las m-medicinas y la curación. Así que... puedo ayudar.
Revelations in Fall#137.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#138.src: Let's... get back home. I should tell Zeph I'm alright.
Revelations in Fall#138.dst: Vamos... a casa. Debería decirle a Zeph que estoy bien.
Revelations in Fall#138.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#139.src: Return to the Leaves in the Wind at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#139.dst: Vuelve a Hojas al Viento en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#140.src: Thank you for listening to me.
Revelations in Fall#140.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#141.src: I... I want to help. I'm just... scared.
Revelations in Fall#141.dst: Yo... quiero ayudar. Solo tengo miedo.
Revelations in Fall#141.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#142.src: Hrmm... ah, {u}, just the leaf I was looking to find!
Revelations in Fall#142.dst: Hrmm... ah, {u}, ¡justo la hoja que buscaba!
Revelations in Fall#142.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#143.src: I am nearly finished with preparations for our expedition. Supplies packed, goodbyes said, and so on and so forth.
Revelations in Fall#143.dst: Casi he terminado los preparativos de la expedición. Provisiones empacadas, despedidas dichas, y demás.
Revelations in Fall#143.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#144.src: There is... one last thing, however. If I may ask you for a favor?
Revelations in Fall#144.dst: Aunque queda... una última cosa. ¿Me permites pedirte un favor?
Revelations in Fall#144.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#145.src: Excellent! I thank you for your time.
Revelations in Fall#145.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#146.src: ...ah, a busy day, I take it? I promise it will be quick, if you would hear me out.
Revelations in Fall#146.dst: ...ah, día ajetreado, ¿me equivoco? Prometo que será rápido, si me escuchas.
Revelations in Fall#146.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#147.src: I had mentioned previously, your words on magic had resonated with me! I have been taking some time to practice, with the aid of cursory knowledge of military blessings.
Revelations in Fall#147.dst: Ya te lo dije antes: ¡tus palabras sobre la magia calaron en mí! He sacado tiempo para practicar, con la ayuda de unas nociones superficiales sobre las bendiciones militares.
Revelations in Fall#147.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#148.src: But such training will do me little good in a true combat scenario. So, in the interest of improvement, I would ask for a sparring match against you!
Revelations in Fall#148.dst: Pero ese entrenamiento me servirá de poco en un combate real. Así que, por mejorar, ¡te pido un combate de entrenamiento contra ti!
Revelations in Fall#148.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#149.src: It will help me to spot and shore up my weaknesses. Perhaps it will do the same for you!
Revelations in Fall#149.dst: Me ayudará a detectar y reforzar mis puntos débiles. ¡Quizá a ti te sirva igual!
Revelations in Fall#149.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#150.src: Come, follow me to our sparring arena!
Revelations in Fall#150.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#153.src: Oof... you are very talented, I must say!
Revelations in Fall#153.dst: Uf... ¡debo decir que tienes mucho talento!
Revelations in Fall#153.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#154.src: No wonder miss Syndra is so invested in you, having battled you herself!
Revelations in Fall#154.dst: ¡Con razón la señorita Syndra confía en ti, tras luchar contigo!
Revelations in Fall#154.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#155.src: Now, tell me, how did I perform?
Revelations in Fall#155.dst: Y bien, dime, ¿qué tal lo he hecho?
Revelations in Fall#155.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#156.src: Really! In the moment, it did not feel like I stood much of a chance, but I suppose I am still learning to wield it!
Revelations in Fall#156.dst: ¡De veras! En el momento no sentí que tuviera muchas opciones, pero ¡supongo que aún estoy aprendiendo a manejarla!
Revelations in Fall#156.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#157.src: It is odd, though. I have only learned of it recently, yet it fels as though the magic has been with me all along! It is like... muscle memory, I suppose? Much to think about.
Revelations in Fall#157.dst: Aunque es extraño. Lo supe hace nada y, sin embargo, ¡siento que la magia ha estado conmigo desde siempre! Es como... memoria muscular, ¿no? Hay mucho en lo que pensar.
Revelations in Fall#157.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#158.src: Ha! No need to sugarcoat it. I have always specialized in heavy attacks, so I struggle against swift opponents. Rarely have I managed to best Zeph in a spar!
Revelations in Fall#158.dst: ¡Ja! No hace falta que lo endulces. Siempre me he especializado en golpes pesados, así que sufro contra rivales veloces. ¡Rara vez he ganado a Zeph en un entrenamiento!
Revelations in Fall#158.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#159.src: Perhaps therein lies the value of this magic... finding methods to raise area of effect, or slow targets down? Much to think about.
Revelations in Fall#159.dst: Quizá ahí esté el valor de esta magia... ¿hallar métodos para ampliar el área de efecto o ralentizar a los rivales? Hay mucho en lo que pensar.
Revelations in Fall#159.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#160.src: An excellent question, though I have no true answers. Perhaps some of what I had learned from military sources has stuck with me?
Revelations in Fall#160.dst: Excelente pregunta, aunque no tengo respuestas ciertas. ¿Quizá se me haya quedado algo de lo aprendido en fuentes militares?
Revelations in Fall#160.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#161.src: I do trust it will come to Zeph with time. He is persistent! That trait will serve him well for these purposes.
Revelations in Fall#161.dst: Confío en que a Zeph le llegará con el tiempo. ¡Es tenaz! Ese rasgo le vendrá muy bien para esto.
Revelations in Fall#161.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#162.src: Hey, Mora! Have you seen- oh, there you are. I've been looking for you.
Revelations in Fall#162.dst: ¡Eh, Mora! ¿Has visto- ah, ahí estás. Te estaba buscando.
Revelations in Fall#162.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#163.src: I had a friend... he was also from Fruma, and he was "cursed." And he was also struggling with that label, like you.
Revelations in Fall#163.dst: Tenía un amigo... también era de Fruma, y estaba "maldito". Y también le pesaba esa etiqueta, como a ti.

Revelations in Fall#164.src: But he found ways to make peace with it. He used his abilities to strengthen himself and his allies. He made a difference.
Revelations in Fall#164.dst: Pero encontró la forma de hacer las paces con ello. Usó sus poderes para fortalecerse a sí mismo y a sus aliados. Cambió las cosas.

Revelations in Fall#165.src: Alright, {u}, come with me. We are SORTING through our problems before we leave.
Revelations in Fall#165.dst: Vale, {u}, ven conmigo. Vamos a ACLARAR nuestros problemas antes de irnos.
Revelations in Fall#165.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#166.src: Come on, come on! To the giant tree stump, I don't have all day!
