Revelations in Fall#166.dst: ¡Vamos, vamos! Al tocón gigante, ¡no tengo todo el día!
Revelations in Fall#166.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#167.src: ... Ah. Oh dear. She appears to be in a mood today! I suppose that would make sense, given...
Revelations in Fall#167.dst: ... Ah. Vaya. ¡Parece que hoy está de malas! Aunque tiene sentido, dado que...
Revelations in Fall#167.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#168.src: Hmm, how should I put it...? Ah, nevermind. You'd best follow her to the tree, see what she wants.
Revelations in Fall#168.dst: Hmm, ¿cómo lo diría...? Ah, déjalo. Mejor síguela hasta el árbol y mira qué quiere.
Revelations in Fall#168.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#169.src: Keep an eye on her for me, would you? Make sure she gets home safely.
Revelations in Fall#169.dst: Échale un ojo por mí, ¿quieres? Que vuelva a casa sana y salva.
Revelations in Fall#169.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#170.src: Find Rex at the old tree stump at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#170.dst: Busca a Rex en el viejo tocón en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#171.src: Keep an eye on Rex, would you? I haven't seen her this worked up in a while...
Revelations in Fall#171.dst: Échale un ojo a Rex, ¿quieres? Hacía tiempo que no la veía tan alterada...
Revelations in Fall#171.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#172.src: Good, you came. Took you long enough!
Revelations in Fall#172.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#173.src: So, here's the deal! You are a problem.
Revelations in Fall#173.dst: Mira, la cosa es así: eres un problema.
Revelations in Fall#173.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#174.src: Sure, you've proven yourself a hundred times over! Over and over and over again, you've shown you're on our side.
Revelations in Fall#174.dst: ¡Claro, lo has demostrado cien veces! Una y otra y otra vez has dejado claro que estás de nuestro lado.
Revelations in Fall#174.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#175.src: And that's great! That's great and all! But. But but but but but! You're still. From. Wynn.
Revelations in Fall#175.dst: ¡Y eso es genial! ¡Genial y todo lo que quieras! Pero. ¡Pero pero pero pero pero! Sigues siendo. De. Wynn.
Revelations in Fall#175.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#176.src: Or... originally from Fruma, whatever. That's actually the problem! If you were just from Wynn, maybe it wouldn't be so bad!
Revelations in Fall#176.dst: O... de Fruma en origen, lo que sea. ¡Ese es el problema, en realidad! Si solo fueras de Wynn, ¡quizá no sería tan grave!
Revelations in Fall#176.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#177.src: There's oh so many people from Fruma who were shipped off to Wynn! They really like sending off the problem children whenever they can't deal with them anymore.
Revelations in Fall#177.dst: ¡Hay muchísima gente de Fruma a la que embarcaron rumbo a Wynn! Les encanta mandar lejos a los niños problemáticos en cuanto no pueden con ellos.
Revelations in Fall#177.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#178.src: So I get it! I do! It makes sense! But still... still, why, why... why does it get to be YOU here, and not- not...!
Revelations in Fall#178.dst: ¡Lo entiendo! ¡De verdad! ¡Tiene sentido! Pero aun así... por qué... ¡¿por qué estás TÚ aquí y no- no...?!
Revelations in Fall#178.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#181.src: Oh, don't look at me like that.
Revelations in Fall#181.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#182.src: So I had a brother, right? And sure, he was an idiot sometimes, but- but he was the only one there who really understood me.
Revelations in Fall#182.dst: Pues yo tenía un hermano, ¿vale? Y sí, a veces era un idiota, pero- pero era el único de allí que me entendía de verdad.
Revelations in Fall#182.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#183.src: He's the one who carved my bow for me. He heard I was interested in archery, so he... when everyone else told me to just focus on schoolwork, he helped me learn.
Revelations in Fall#183.dst: Él me talló el arco. Se enteró de que me interesaba el tiro con arco, así que... cuando los demás me decían que me centrara en los estudios, él me enseñó.
Revelations in Fall#183.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#184.src: He really hated all the rules we had up there. So he liked to break them. A lot. And eventually, the crown got sick of it. Packed him up, sent him to the Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#184.dst: Odiaba con toda su alma las reglas que teníamos allí arriba. Así que le gustaba romperlas. Mucho. Y al final la Corona se hartó. Lo empaquetó y lo mandó a Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#184.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#185.src: The worst part was, our parents agreed to it! Said it'd be good for him, to get some real hard work!
Revelations in Fall#185.dst: ¡Y lo peor es que nuestros padres estuvieron de acuerdo! ¡Decían que le vendría bien currar de verdad!
Revelations in Fall#185.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#186.src: I never liked it there anyway. It took me a while to build up the courage, but eventually I stole some of our money and bought a ticket to take me there.
Revelations in Fall#186.dst: A mí tampoco me gustaba aquello. Tardé en reunir el valor, pero al final robé algo de nuestro dinero y compré un billete para ir allí.
Revelations in Fall#186.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#187.src: I didn't pack a whole lot. I guess I expected to find him and live with him! Stupid. Should've thought ahead more.
Revelations in Fall#187.dst: No hice mucho equipaje. ¡Supongo que esperaba encontrarlo y vivir con él! Qué tonta. Debí pensarlo mejor.
Revelations in Fall#187.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#188.src: He wasn't there, obviously. Heard from some of his friends that he kept being stupid over there. Got caught by the crown, and they decided to stop giving him second chances.
Revelations in Fall#188.dst: No estaba allí, claro. Unos amigos suyos me contaron que allí siguió haciendo tonterías. La Corona lo pilló y decidió dejar de darle segundas oportunidades.
Revelations in Fall#188.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#189.src: So, he's gone! He promised he'd see me again someday, and and of course he didn't follow through. I guess I wasn't important enough to remember.
Revelations in Fall#189.dst: ¡Así que ya no está! Prometió que algún día volvería a verme, y y por supuesto no cumplió. Supongo que no era lo bastante importante como para acordarse.
Revelations in Fall#189.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#190.src: Yes, I know. I just... I guess I just hoped I'd be an exception.
Revelations in Fall#190.dst: Sí, ya lo sé. Es solo... supongo que esperaba ser la excepción.
Revelations in Fall#190.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#192.src: I haven't been very fair to you, have I? It's not your fault you're here and he isn't.
Revelations in Fall#192.dst: No he sido muy justa contigo, ¿verdad? No es culpa tuya que tú estés aquí y él no.
Revelations in Fall#192.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#194.src: So... sorry. For all of that.
Revelations in Fall#194.dst: Así que... perdona. Por todo eso.
Revelations in Fall#194.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#196.src: Give me some time, would you? I need to... I don't know. I just need some space.
Revelations in Fall#196.dst: Dame algo de tiempo, ¿vale? Necesito... no sé. Necesito espacio.
Revelations in Fall#196.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#198.src: Okay. I... won't take too long. Nobody ever comes here, anyway.
Revelations in Fall#198.dst: Vale. No... tardaré mucho. Total, aquí nunca viene nadie.
Revelations in Fall#198.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#199.src: Return to the camp and finish packing up at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#199.dst: Vuelve al campamento y acaba de hacer el equipaje en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#201.src: I just hope he's still out there, somewhere...
Revelations in Fall#201.dst: Solo espero que siga ahí fuera, en algún sitio...
Revelations in Fall#201.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#202.src: Th- there you are! We, uh, got worried s- some- something bad might've happened.
Revelations in Fall#202.dst: ¡A- ahí estás! Nos, eh, preocupamos por si p- pa- pasaba algo malo.
Revelations in Fall#202.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#203.src: I... I mean... th- they got worried.
Revelations in Fall#203.dst: Yo... digo... e- ellos se preocuparon.
Revelations in Fall#203.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#205.src: We were just talking. Gods, you guys and your overeager imaginations...
Revelations in Fall#205.dst: Solo estábamos hablando. Dioses, qué imaginación tenéis...
Revelations in Fall#205.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#207.src: I am afraid not. We have heard nothing since the meeting this morning.
Revelations in Fall#207.dst: Me temo que no. No sabemos nada desde la reunión de esta mañana.
Revelations in Fall#207.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#209.src: Let us just continue to place our trust in Syndra, as we have done many times before! She can handle herself.
Revelations in Fall#209.dst: ¡Sigamos confiando en Syndra, como tantas otras veces! Sabe cuidarse sola.
Revelations in Fall#209.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#210.src: Ugh! I knew t- tr- trusting the Sovereign w- was a mistake! We n- n- need to go
Revelations in Fall#210.dst: ¡Uf! ¡Sabía que f- fi- fiarse del Soberano e- era un error! T- t- tenemos que ir
Revelations in Fall#210.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#211.src: Excuse me- the Sovereign? What do you mean the S-
Revelations in Fall#211.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#213.src: Sigh... I'm just a little too late, I see.
Revelations in Fall#213.dst: Suspiro... Llego un poco tarde, ya veo.
Revelations in Fall#213.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#214.src: Well, since it's out in the open, I might as well explain myself. Firstly, I owe you all an apology for this.
Revelations in Fall#214.dst: Bueno, ya que ha salido a la luz, me explicaré. Primero, os debo a todos una disculpa por esto.
Revelations in Fall#214.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#216.src: Mora, it's alright. I was going to reveal this secret anyway.
Revelations in Fall#216.dst: Mora, no pasa nada. Iba a revelar este secreto de todos modos.
Revelations in Fall#216.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#217.src: The contact I mentioned earlier today - it's the Sovereign Zhiraok.
Revelations in Fall#217.dst: El contacto que mencioné esta mañana - es el Soberano Zhiraok.
Revelations in Fall#217.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#219.src: What?! How long have you been- wait, Mora, you knew?
Revelations in Fall#219.dst: ¡¿Qué?! ¿Desde cuándo llevas- espera, Mora, ¿tú lo sabías?
Revelations in Fall#219.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#220.src: It was a secret kept out of necessity. As for how long... let's say a while, and leave it at that. But we're leaving the {p}, so I see no need to keep it hidden anymore.
Revelations in Fall#220.dst: Fue un secreto guardado por necesidad. En cuanto a cuánto tiempo... digamos que bastante, y dejémoslo ahí. Pero nos vamos de {p}, así que ya no veo motivo para ocultarlo.
Revelations in Fall#220.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#221.src: I know you all worry about me... and I did not want to add another variable to stress over today. I apologize.
Revelations in Fall#221.dst: Sé que todos os preocupáis por mí... y hoy no quería añadir otra variable de la que inquietarse. Lo siento.
Revelations in Fall#221.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#223.src: Yes, I have them. Zhiraok provided me with enough for all of us. We'll need to move fast, though I want to cross into the Roughworks before he suspects what's going on.
Revelations in Fall#223.dst: Sí, los tengo. Zhiraok me dio suficientes para todos. Aunque habrá que darse prisa: quiero cruzar a Roughworks antes de que sospeche lo que pasa.
Revelations in Fall#223.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#224.src: ...s- so you're safe? It all w- went fine?
Revelations in Fall#224.dst: ...¿e- estás a salvo entonces? ¿Fue t- todo bien?
Revelations in Fall#224.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#225.src: Yes, Zeph, I am safe. Are you all packed? Crossing the border will take some time, so we need to start going to {p} now.
Revelations in Fall#225.dst: Sí, Zeph, estoy a salvo. ¿Tenéis todo recogido? Cruzar la frontera llevará un rato, así que hay que salir hacia {p} ya.
Revelations in Fall#225.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#226.src: Come on, let's hurry. Let us leave this chapter behind.
Revelations in Fall#226.dst: Vamos, deprisa. Dejemos atrás este capítulo.
Revelations in Fall#226.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#227.src: Walk through the gate to the Roughworks at in {p}.
Revelations in Fall#227.dst: Atraviesa la puerta hacia Roughworks en  en {p}.

Revelations in Fall#229.src: I-I a-am ready for this. I have to be.
Revelations in Fall#229.dst: E-estoy l-listo para esto. Debo estarlo.
Revelations in Fall#229.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#230.src: I guess this is really happening...
Revelations in Fall#230.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#232.src: Let's meet up at the gate to the Roughworks and walk through together!
Revelations in Fall#232.dst: ¡Quedemos en la puerta a Roughworks y crucemos juntos!
Revelations in Fall#232.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#233.src: Oh... there you are. The, um, line was really long when we got here, so, we... started queuing.
Revelations in Fall#233.dst: Ah... ahí estás. La, eh, cola era larguísima al llegar, así que... nos pusimos ya.
Revelations in Fall#233.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#234.src: Everything's... fine, so far. I think. I... hope.
Revelations in Fall#234.dst: Todo va... bien, de momento. Creo. Eso... espero.
Revelations in Fall#234.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#239.src: All good. Keep it moving. NEXT!
Revelations in Fall#239.speaker: Passport Officer

Revelations in Fall#244.src: We're through. That went... smoothly enough.
Revelations in Fall#244.dst: Hemos pasado. Ha ido... bastante bien.
Revelations in Fall#244.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#245.dst: E- eso ha sido... e- estresante.
Revelations in Fall#245.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#248.src: Enough of that, children. Miss Syndra, we've reached the Roughworks, yes?
Revelations in Fall#248.dst: Ya basta, niños. Señorita Syndra, hemos llegado a Roughworks, ¿verdad?
Revelations in Fall#248.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#249.src: We have. We'll follow the plan regroup outside {p}, the city in the region. We need to move quickly, I don't know how much time we have before
Revelations in Fall#249.dst: Así es. Seguiremos el plan: reagruparnos a las afueras de {p}, la ciudad de la región. Hay que darse prisa, no sé de cuánto tiempo disponemos antes de que
Revelations in Fall#249.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#250.src: Zero, Syndra. You've got zero time.
Revelations in Fall#250.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#251.src: ... Sovereign. Fast and efficient as always, I see.
Revelations in Fall#251.dst: ... Soberano. Rápido y eficiente, como siempre.
Revelations in Fall#251.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#252.src: Naturally, you completely miscalculated, thinking you could sneak by like this. An unwanted variable isn't an unexpected one.
Revelations in Fall#252.dst: Cómo no, calculaste fatal al creer que podrías colarte así. Una variable no deseada no es una variable inesperada.
Revelations in Fall#252.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#253.src: It was worth a shot, even if unlikely.
Revelations in Fall#253.dst: Valía la pena, aunque fuera improbable.
Revelations in Fall#253.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#254.src: What garbage. Translating yourself into the Roughworks completely nulls the crown's pact... As if you wouldn't be spotted.
Revelations in Fall#254.dst: Qué basura. Trasladarte a Roughworks anula por completo el pacto de la Corona... Como si no fueran a verte.
Revelations in Fall#254.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#255.src: I'm the one who really miscalculated though! Your angle was so obvious, but I just kept overlooking it. Kept trusting you. Kept hoping you'd settle, you'd terminate this sequence.
Revelations in Fall#255.dst: ¡Aunque el que calculó mal de verdad fui yo! Tu ángulo era clarísimo, y aun así lo pasaba por alto. Seguía confiando en ti. Seguía esperando que te asentaras, que terminaras esta secuencia.
Revelations in Fall#255.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#256.src: And here you are...associating with a mass murderer! The cursed that caused the Torann massacre!! What kind of lowest-order logic is this?! What were you THINKING?!
Revelations in Fall#256.dst: Y aquí estás... ¡juntándote con un asesino en masa! ¡¡El maldito que causó la masacre de Torann!! ¡¿Qué lógica de orden ínfimo es esta?! ¡¿En qué estabas PENSANDO?!
Revelations in Fall#256.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#258.src: Isn't it obvious, Sovereign? I want Her Majesty dethroned. I want her empire to crumble.
Revelations in Fall#258.dst: ¿No es obvio, Soberano? Quiero a Su Majestad destronada. Quiero que su imperio se desmorone.
Revelations in Fall#258.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#259.src: Your job was to infiltrate, not sum to the resistance!! Since when did you switch to the other side of the equation?! You're subtracting your only chance, you're You're wasting everything I've done for you!
Revelations in Fall#259.dst: ¡¡Tu trabajo era infiltrarte, no sumarte a la resistencia!! ¡¿Desde cuándo te pasaste al otro lado de la ecuación?! Estás restando tu única oportunidad, estás ¡Estás tirando por la borda todo lo que he hecho por ti!
Revelations in Fall#259.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#260.src: So after everything She did to me, you expected me to just go along with it?! To accept the scraps I was left with, to forgive and forget?!
Revelations in Fall#260.dst: Así que después de todo lo que Ella me hizo, ¡¿esperabas que lo aceptara sin más?! ¡¿Que me conformara con las sobras, que perdonara y olvidara?!
Revelations in Fall#260.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#261.src: Maybe you were the fool all along, Zhiraok, for believing it.
Revelations in Fall#261.dst: Quizá el necio fuiste tú desde el principio, Zhiraok, por creértelo.
Revelations in Fall#261.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#263.src: ...so it was all imaginary? Nothing real? I cared about you, as a friend. A confidant. Did you? Or...was I just a convenient tool for you?
Revelations in Fall#263.dst: ...¿entonces todo era imaginario? ¿Nada real? Yo te apreciaba, como amiga. Como confidente. ¿Y tú? ¿O... solo era una herramienta cómoda para ti?
Revelations in Fall#263.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#265.src: Does it...matter. ...ha. Does it matter!! Do you know how much weight you carried in my day to day operations? I wonder how much I carried in yours!!
Revelations in Fall#265.dst: Acaso... importa. ...ja. ¡¡Acaso importa!! ¿Sabes cuánto peso tenías en mis operaciones diarias? ¡¡Me pregunto cuánto tenía yo en las tuyas!!
Revelations in Fall#265.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#266.src: It doesn't make me happy to do this. Your resistance is under arrest for the crime of conspiracy against the crown and your cursed, slated for execution.
Revelations in Fall#266.dst: No me alegra hacer esto. Tu resistencia queda detenida por el delito de conspiración contra la Corona, y tu maldito, condenado a ejecución.
Revelations in Fall#266.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#267.src: I can still pull some strings, Syndra. Round this all out. I might be able to keep you as part of the remainder if you turn yourself in. We can still
Revelations in Fall#267.dst: Aún puedo mover algunos hilos, Syndra. Redondear todo esto. Quizá pueda dejarte dentro del resto si te entregas. Todavía podemos
Revelations in Fall#267.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#268.src: We won't give in without a fight!
Revelations in Fall#268.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#269.src: ...why...do I even bother. A cursed compared to me...absolute trash. Let's get this over with.
Revelations in Fall#269.dst: ...por qué... me molesto siquiera. Un maldito comparado conmigo... pura basura. Acabemos con esto.
Revelations in Fall#269.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#272.src: S- Syndra, are- are y- you
Revelations in Fall#272.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#278.src: Let's move. Everyone, remember the meeting point, just
Revelations in Fall#278.dst: En marcha. Recordad el punto de encuentro, solo
Revelations in Fall#278.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#279.src: Are we really glossing over you killing a Sovereign????
Revelations in Fall#279.dst: ¿En serio vamos a pasar por alto que has matado a un Soberano????
Revelations in Fall#279.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#280.src: Yes, Rex, because he won't stay down for long- that's why we need to move, now!
Revelations in Fall#280.dst: Sí, Rex, porque no seguirá caído mucho tiempo- ¡por eso hay que moverse, ya!
Revelations in Fall#280.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#281.src: Split up, stay safe, don't get caught. We meet in three days now, GO!
Revelations in Fall#281.dst: Separaos, cuidaos, que no os pillen. Nos vemos en tres días, ¡VAMOS!
Revelations in Fall#281.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#282.src: Sovereign Zhiraok, sir! You have a visitor here!
Revelations in Fall#282.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#283.src: Send them in, and if you could process these files, please-and-thank-you? I need the inquisitor to weigh in on the problem.
Revelations in Fall#283.dst: Que pase, y si pudieras tramitar estos expedientes, por-favor-y-gracias. Necesito que el inquisidor opine sobre el problema.
Revelations in Fall#283.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#284.src: I have a finite value of time for this, so let's keep this short
Revelations in Fall#284.dst: Tengo un valor finito de tiempo para esto, así que seamos breves
Revelations in Fall#284.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#286.src: Hello, Sovereign. Sorry to interrupt you during your working hours once again.
Revelations in Fall#286.dst: Hola, Soberano. Perdón por interrumpirte otra vez en horario de trabajo.
Revelations in Fall#286.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#287.src: I'll add it to the tally! Bringing the trouble straight to my office, too You've got me nervous with the number of times it's happened recently.
Revelations in Fall#287.dst: ¡Lo añadiré al recuento! Y encima traes el problema directo a mi despacho. Me pone nervioso la cantidad de veces que ha pasado últimamente.
Revelations in Fall#287.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#288.src: Let's cut to the chase, then. Tell me what your angle Ugh. What your request is.
Revelations in Fall#288.dst: Vayamos al grano, entonces. Dime cuál es tu ángulo Uf. Cuál es tu petición.
Revelations in Fall#288.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#289.src: Don't hold it in, you'll get an ulcer. I'll make this quick- I need passage to the Roughworks. For myself and five others.
Revelations in Fall#289.dst: No te lo guardes, te saldrá una úlcera. Seré breve- necesito paso a Roughworks. Para mí y para otras cinco personas.
Revelations in Fall#289.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#290.src: ...you're really asking me to square the circle here. Why do you need to do this, go there? And so suddenly? Why?
Revelations in Fall#290.dst: ...me estás pidiendo la cuadratura del círculo. ¿Por qué necesitas hacer esto, ir allí? ¿Y tan de repente? ¿Por qué?
Revelations in Fall#290.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#291.src: I... I need to find her. I don't know how much more time I'll have to try.
Revelations in Fall#291.dst: Yo... tengo que encontrarla. No sé cuánto tiempo más tendré para intentarlo.
Revelations in Fall#291.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#292.src: I know, I know!! Quit being obtuse, you know the consequences if you break the mandate, for both of us!!
Revelations in Fall#292.dst: ¡¡Lo sé, lo sé!! ¡¡Deja de hacerte la obtusa, sabes las consecuencias de romper el mandato, para los dos!!
Revelations in Fall#292.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#294.src: ...Is that all I get? What about the other five?
Revelations in Fall#294.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#296.src: Of course. You and your strays. Why can't you just... There has to be another solution, if we If you I
Revelations in Fall#296.dst: Cómo no. Tú y tus perros callejeros. ¿Por qué no puedes...? Tiene que haber otra solución, si nosotros Si tú Yo
Revelations in Fall#296.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#298.src: ...why do I even bother. Fine. You want it so badly, fine!! You know what this will take. Just... Remember. Remember what I've done for you.
Revelations in Fall#298.dst: ...por qué me molesto siquiera. Está bien. Si tanto lo quieres, ¡¡está bien!! Ya sabes lo que costará. Solo... Recuerda. Recuerda lo que he hecho por ti.
Revelations in Fall#298.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#299.src: Thank you, Zhiraok. I won't let your kindness go to waste.
Revelations in Fall#299.dst: Gracias, Zhiraok. No dejaré que tu bondad se desperdicie.
Revelations in Fall#299.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#300.src: Sovereign Zhiraok! Inquisitor Renn has some concerns
Revelations in Fall#300.dst: ¡Soberano Zhiraok! El Inquisidor Renn tiene algunas dudas
Revelations in Fall#300.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#301.src: Xao, I need you to clear my schedule. There's a higher priority now, he can wait.
Revelations in Fall#301.dst: Xao, necesito que me despejes la agenda. Ahora hay una prioridad mayor, puede esperar.
Revelations in Fall#301.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#302.src: Oh! Um, of course! If you insist, sir!! Inquisitor Renn won't be happy, but your orders are top
Revelations in Fall#302.dst: ¡Ah! Eh, ¡por supuesto! ¡¡Si usted insiste, señor!! Al Inquisidor Renn no le gustará, pero sus órdenes son lo primer
Revelations in Fall#302.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#303.src: No, you're right, I'm being irrational. You're always right. Clear everything but that, it's fine. I'll get back to it later. Unexpected variables, extenuating circumstances...
Revelations in Fall#303.dst: No, tienes razón, estoy siendo irracional. Siempre tienes razón. Despeja todo menos eso, no pasa nada. Ya lo retomaré luego. Variables inesperadas, circunstancias atenuantes...
Revelations in Fall#303.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#304.src: Sov ...Zhi-Zhi? Is everything okay? You...you look rattled, was it something she said? Should I have not brought her
Revelations in Fall#304.dst: Sobe ...¿Zhi-Zhi? ¿Va todo bien? Se... se le ve alterado, ¿dijo ella algo? ¿No debí hacerla pasa
Revelations in Fall#304.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#305.src: You didn't do anything wrong. She gave me a prime opportunity anyway. A warning before throwing my sequence out of line.
Revelations in Fall#305.dst: No has hecho nada malo. Al fin y al cabo, me dio una oportunidad prima. Un aviso antes de descuadrar mi secuencia.
Revelations in Fall#305.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#306.src: Xao, I trust you. I need to leave Auburn in your care for a bit while I solve this. Please. Can you handle that?
Revelations in Fall#306.dst: Xao, confío en ti. Necesito dejar Auburn a tu cargo un tiempo mientras resuelvo esto. Por favor. ¿Podrás con ello?
Revelations in Fall#306.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#307.src: ...oh my, I... It's an honor! I won't let you down, sir!! I'll keep things ship-shape! But, why do you need me for this?
Revelations in Fall#307.dst: ...vaya, yo... ¡Es un honor! ¡¡No le fallaré, señor!! ¡Lo tendré todo como los chorros del oro! Pero ¿por qué me necesita a mí para esto?
Revelations in Fall#307.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#308.src: ...I need to converge at the Roughworks, handle her work for a while. That, and the next Crown Festival is soon. I feel like...it'd be a disservice to miss it.
Revelations in Fall#308.dst: ...Necesito converger en Roughworks y cubrir su trabajo un tiempo. Y el Festival de la Corona está cerca. Siento que perdérmelo sería un error.
Revelations in Fall#308.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Rise of the Quartron#001.src: Shipment {~}A and {~}B, fully accounted for... shipments {~}C and {~}A...missing {~} of quartz content?!
Rise of the Quartron#001.dst: Envío {~}A y {~}B, todo cuadra... envíos {~}C y {~}A... ¡¿faltan {~} de cuarzo?!
Rise of the Quartron#001.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#002.src: Agh, this is getting worse! There's never been so much loss...whoever this is, thy're getting bold...
Rise of the Quartron#002.dst: ¡Agh, esto va a peor! Nunca se había perdido tanto... quienquiera que sea, se está envalentonando...
Rise of the Quartron#002.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#003.src: Ugh, go AWAY! Quit hovering over my shoulder like that- wait, a Human? Since when did you get here?
Rise of the Quartron#003.dst: ¡Uf, LARGO! Deja de rondarme por encima del hombro- espera, ¿un humano? ¿Desde cuándo estás aquí?
Rise of the Quartron#003.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#004.src: What, you like listening to the melodious sound of my voice or something? Or do you intend to help out?
Rise of the Quartron#004.dst: ¿Qué pasa, te gusta escuchar el melodioso sonido de mi voz o qué? ¿O es que piensas ayudar?
Rise of the Quartron#004.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#005.src: Well, I'm flattered either way, and I could certainly use the help. Quartz is going missing from my shipments.
Rise of the Quartron#005.dst: Bueno, en cualquier caso me halaga, y desde luego me vendría bien la ayuda. De mis envíos desaparece cuarzo.
Rise of the Quartron#005.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#006.src: Obviously one of the laborers is siphoning it to someplace, and I can't have that happening. So, be a private eye, humie.
Rise of the Quartron#006.dst: Está claro que alguno de los obreros lo desvía a alguna parte, y eso no lo puedo consentir. Así que hazte el detective, humanito.
Rise of the Quartron#006.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#007.src: This is actually pretty dire- quartz has some magicality to it, see. It likes to soak up magic power, which means it can be weaponized.
Rise of the Quartron#007.dst: La cosa es bastante grave- el cuarzo tiene algo de mágico, ¿sabes? Le gusta absorber poder mágico, así que se puede convertir en arma.
Rise of the Quartron#007.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#008.src: We tend not to use it for weapons since it can overcharge, but that's neither here nor there, is it?
Rise of the Quartron#008.dst: No solemos usarlo para armas porque puede sobrecargarse, pero eso ahora da igual, ¿no?
Rise of the Quartron#008.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#009.src: Every siphoned shipment has gone through Dado. Interrogate him! He hangs out past the big red tent, near the house with red flags.
Rise of the Quartron#009.dst: Todos los envíos desviados han pasado por Dado. ¡Interrógalo! Anda por detrás de la carpa roja grande, cerca de la casa de las banderas rojas.
Rise of the Quartron#009.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#010.src: Talk to Dado and see if he is the culprit.
Rise of the Quartron#010.dst: Habla con Dado y averigua si es el culpable.

Rise of the Quartron#011.src: Okay, these go to division P, and...look, I'm busy allocating these deliveries to {p}. Go pester someone else, okay?
Rise of the Quartron#011.dst: Vale, esto va a la división P, y... mira, estoy ocupado repartiendo estos envíos a {p}. Vete a dar la lata a otro, ¿vale?
Rise of the Quartron#011.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#012.src: ...what. You...think I... Pfff... Pffhahaaaah! Ohhh, that's RICH coming from a human of all things!
Rise of the Quartron#012.dst: ...qué. ¿Crees... que yo...? Pfff... ¡Pfjajajaaa! ¡Ohhh, qué GRACIA viniendo justo de un humano!
Rise of the Quartron#012.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#013.src: "Oh, me, the hired gun species that kills for money, will accuse you, a storied worker of seven years, of illegal activity!" Wow, you HYPOCRITE!
Rise of the Quartron#013.dst: "Oh, yo, de la especie mercenaria que mata por dinero, ¡te acuso a ti, con siete años de trabajo a las espaldas, de actividad ilegal!" ¡Vaya, qué HIPÓCRITA!
Rise of the Quartron#013.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#014.src: I'm hardly even angry about this! But, yeah, you freak. You got the wrong guy, surprise! Your brain workin' right in there?
Rise of the Quartron#014.dst: ¡Si es que ni me enfado! Pero sí, pirado. Te has equivocado de tío, ¡sorpresa! ¿Te funciona bien el coco ahí dentro?
Rise of the Quartron#014.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#015.src: I bet you got some wires crossed in there, huh? Go scuttle on back to town and kill someone's Wybel for pocket change or something.
Rise of the Quartron#015.dst: Seguro que tienes los cables cruzados, ¿eh? Vuelve corriendo al pueblo y mata el Wybel de alguien por cuatro monedas o lo que sea.
Rise of the Quartron#015.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#016.src: Go back to Nasea and tell her about Dado’s response.
Rise of the Quartron#016.dst: Vuelve con Nasea y cuéntale la respuesta de Dado.

Rise of the Quartron#017.src: I'm just going to take a wild guess and say that asking him nicely whether he committed theft didn't bring up any answers.
Rise of the Quartron#017.dst: Me arriesgo a adivinar: preguntarle por las buenas si había robado no dio ninguna respuesta.
Rise of the Quartron#017.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#018.src: What, he brushed you off like THAT? Jeez, I knew he was a jerk, but really? That's just uncalled for.
Rise of the Quartron#018.dst: ¿Qué, te despachó ASÍ? Jolín, sabía que era un capullo, pero ¿en serio? Eso ya es pasarse.
Rise of the Quartron#018.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#019.src: We have to make him talk...if shipments keep going missing, my contractors are going to look elsewhere!
Rise of the Quartron#019.dst: Hay que hacerlo hablar... ¡si los envíos siguen desapareciendo, mis clientes se irán a otra parte!
Rise of the Quartron#019.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#020.src: We need to prove that he's guilty...wait, you came to ME for ideas? This is why I asked you for help! Am I really back to square one?
Rise of the Quartron#020.dst: Tenemos que demostrar que es culpable... espera, ¿has venido a pedirme ideas a MÍ? ¡Para eso te pedí ayuda! ¿En serio vuelvo a la casilla de salida?
Rise of the Quartron#020.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#022.src: I...what are you doing here, uh...Larry? Were you missing quartz too??
Rise of the Quartron#022.dst: Yo... ¿qué haces aquí, eh... Larry? ¿A ti también te falta cuarzo??
Rise of the Quartron#022.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#023.src: Ah, it's...Lari. No, the quartz shipment found its way fine...
Rise of the Quartron#023.dst: Ah, es... Lari. No, el envío de cuarzo llegó bien...
Rise of the Quartron#023.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#024.src: But, there was hardly an effect. Your idea was, unfortunately, a dead end.
Rise of the Quartron#024.dst: Pero apenas tuvo efecto. Su idea, por desgracia, no llevó a nada.
Rise of the Quartron#024.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#025.src: Well, I did warn you that it was only an idea. I manage the mine, I don't practice purification magic. Don't pin anything on me for that.
Rise of the Quartron#025.dst: Oye, ya te avisé de que era solo una idea. Yo dirijo la mina, no practico magia de purificación. No me eches nada en cara por eso.
Rise of the Quartron#025.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#026.src: I did not intend to imply that. Your help was appreciated, fate simply had opposing plans...
Rise of the Quartron#026.dst: No pretendía insinuar eso. Agradezco su ayuda; el destino sencillamente tenía otros planes...
Rise of the Quartron#026.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#027.src: ...is this human a part of your operations, miss?
Rise of the Quartron#027.dst: ...¿este humano forma parte de sus operaciones, señorita?
Rise of the Quartron#027.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#028.src: Well, in a sense. Someone's siphoning quartz, but our suspect wasn't intimidated by the ten tons of armor, so we're at a loss. Any ideas?
Rise of the Quartron#028.dst: Bueno, en cierto sentido. Alguien desvía cuarzo, pero al sospechoso no lo intimidaron diez toneladas de armadura, así que estamos atascados. ¿Alguna idea?
Rise of the Quartron#028.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#029.src: ...as a matter of fact, I do have a solution. Elven botany describes a flower that grows decently close by, the "Tattytale" flower.
Rise of the Quartron#029.dst: ...de hecho, sí tengo una solución. La botánica élfica describe una flor que crece bastante cerca: la flor "Tattytale".
Rise of the Quartron#029.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#030.src: It weakens the will of those who catch a whiff of its petals, making them pliable to questions. It's...unpleasant, but if it is needed, I suppose.
Rise of the Quartron#030.dst: Debilita la voluntad de quien huele sus pétalos y lo vuelve dócil a las preguntas. Es... desagradable, pero si hace falta, en fin.
Rise of the Quartron#030.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#031.src: There is a cave infested with spiders, and covered with webs in the western mountain. It is the only place it grows outside of {p}, unfortunately.
Rise of the Quartron#031.dst: En la montaña occidental hay una cueva infestada de arañas y cubierta de telarañas. Por desgracia, es el único sitio donde crece fuera de {p}.
Rise of the Quartron#031.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#032.src: Nasea, since it didn't help, I've returned the quartz. I thank you for your help...and I shall bid you both adieu.
Rise of the Quartron#032.dst: Nasea, como no sirvió, he devuelto el cuarzo. Le agradezco su ayuda... y me despido de ambos.
Rise of the Quartron#032.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#034.src: Make Dado confess by using the Tattytale Flower.
Rise of the Quartron#034.dst: Haz confesar a Dado usando la flor Tattytale.

Rise of the Quartron#035.src: Hey, everyone's least-favorite attack dog! Here boy! You want the emerald? Go kill all the flies in my house! Come on boy!
Rise of the Quartron#035.dst: ¡Eh, el perro de presa que menos gusta a todos! ¡Ven aquí, chico! ¿Quieres la esmeralda? ¡Ve a matar todas las moscas de mi casa! ¡Venga, chico!
Rise of the Quartron#035.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#036.src: Aw, flowers. How sweet of you! Sorry, but I don't cave to psychopaths or flattery, hehehee!
Rise of the Quartron#036.dst: Ay, flores. ¡Qué detalle! Lo siento, pero yo no me rindo ante psicópatas ni halagos, ¡jejejé!
Rise of the Quartron#036.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#037.src: I...huff... What was THAT for?! Are you offended that I don't like your flo- What? What am I doing with the quartz?
Rise of the Quartron#037.dst: Yo... uf... ¡¿A qué ha venido ESO?! ¿Te ofende que no me gusten tus flo- ¿Qué? ¿Que qué hago con el cuarzo?
Rise of the Quartron#037.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#038.src: Uh, isn't it obvious? I'm working overtime and sending it up to Popo, duh. Where else would I be sending it?
Rise of the Quartron#038.dst: Eh, ¿no es obvio? Hago horas extra y se lo mando arriba a Popo, obvio. ¿Adónde si no?
Rise of the Quartron#038.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#039.src: What- Where's Popo sending it? Um...no clue. Whoever it is, they're super rich though. They pay me more than my house is worth every shipment!
Rise of the Quartron#039.dst: Qué- ¿Adónde lo manda Popo? Eh... ni idea. Pero quienquiera que sea, es rico de narices. ¡Me paga más de lo que vale mi casa por cada envío!
Rise of the Quartron#039.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#040.src: Not sure why you need to- What? Where's Popo? Uh, he said he'd meet me at the cart track overpass, near the teal flags.
Rise of the Quartron#040.dst: No sé para qué- ¿Qué? ¿Popo? Dijo que me vería en el paso elevado de las vías, junto a las banderas turquesa.
Rise of the Quartron#040.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#041.src: This was going to be our first meeting, so I don't know what he looks like, and likewise he's never seen me.
Rise of the Quartron#041.dst: Iba a ser nuestro primer encuentro, así que no sé qué pinta tiene, y él tampoco me ha visto nunca.
Rise of the Quartron#041.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#042.src: ...uh. Okay, I haave no clue why I told you all of that...um, have you got any more of those flowers though? It was actually really good...
Rise of the Quartron#042.dst: ...eh. Vale, no tengoo ni idea de por qué te he contado todo eso... oye, ¿te quedan más de esas flores? La verdad es que estaba muy bien...
Rise of the Quartron#042.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#043.src: Go up the minecart hill and find Popo.
Rise of the Quartron#043.dst: Sube la cuesta de las vagonetas y encuentra a Popo.

Rise of the Quartron#044.src: Ah, you must- Wait, never mind. I was expecting a visit from someone else.
Rise of the Quartron#044.dst: Ah, tú debes de- Espera, déjalo. Esperaba la visita de otro.
Rise of the Quartron#044.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#045.src: Wait, you're Dado? I guess humans have more brain capacity than orcs after all, hehah!
Rise of the Quartron#045.dst: Espera, ¿tú eres Dado? Parece que los humanos tienen más cerebro que los orcos, ¡jejá!
Rise of the Quartron#045.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#046.src: Okay, down to business. I'm gonna look busy to cover for you while you get to the base for briefing. You'll get the details there.
Rise of the Quartron#046.dst: Vale, al lío. Yo haré como que estoy ocupado para cubrirte mientras llegas a la base a por las instrucciones. Allí te darán los detalles.
Rise of the Quartron#046.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#047.src: You stick out like a sore thumb, but thankfully humans like to get into lots of weird spots, so it won't look too out of place.
Rise of the Quartron#047.dst: Cantas más que un pollo, pero por suerte a los humanos les gusta meterse en sitios raros, así que no desentonará demasiado.
Rise of the Quartron#047.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#048.src: Use the small rail here, flick the lever. It'll look like you're just...doing what humans do, instead of drawing suspicion.
Rise of the Quartron#048.dst: Usa la vía pequeña y acciona la palanca. Parecerá que solo... haces cosas de humanos, sin levantar sospechas.
Rise of the Quartron#048.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#049.src: Ride the minecart to the bandit mansion.
Rise of the Quartron#049.dst: Viaja en la vagoneta hasta la mansión de los bandidos.

Rise of the Quartron#050.src: Hop on the minecart, it's leaving! But act natural!
Rise of the Quartron#050.dst: ¡Sube a la vagoneta, que se va! ¡Pero disimula!
Rise of the Quartron#050.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#051.src: Interesting, a human's been swept up in our plans. Hadn't expected the work force to diversify so fast.
Rise of the Quartron#051.dst: Interesante, un humano metido en nuestros planes. No esperaba que la plantilla se diversificara tan rápido.
Rise of the Quartron#051.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#052.src: Time for the rundown, oh I love explaining this! I think you'll find what I have to say quite interesting, yes yes!
Rise of the Quartron#052.dst: Hora del resumen, ¡ay, cómo me gusta explicar esto! Creo que lo que voy a contarte te parecerá bastante interesante, ¡sí, sí!
Rise of the Quartron#052.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#053.src: You see, quartz is a powerful magical material- moreso than many know! It can absorb and harness magical energy, but what more? I had to find out!
Rise of the Quartron#053.dst: Verás, el cuarzo es un material mágico poderoso- ¡más de lo que muchos saben! Puede absorber y canalizar energía mágica, pero ¿qué más? ¡Tenía que averiguarlo!
Rise of the Quartron#053.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#054.src: The rubes in my research department got me kicked out for suggesting we further our research. What kind of scientist is scared to make advancements?!
Rise of the Quartron#054.dst: Los zoquetes de mi departamento hicieron que me echaran por proponer que lleváramos más lejos la investigación. ¡¿Qué clase de científico teme avanzar?!
Rise of the Quartron#054.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#055.src: But without a board of directors breathing down my neck, my research has led me exactly where I'd hoped, and even more, yes yes!
Rise of the Quartron#055.dst: Pero sin un consejo de administración respirándome en la nuca, mi investigación me ha llevado justo adonde esperaba, y aún más allá, ¡sí, sí!
Rise of the Quartron#055.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#056.src: Oi. Got a guest taking the secret passage.
Rise of the Quartron#056.dst: Eh. Tenemos un invitado por el pasadizo secreto.
Rise of the Quartron#056.speaker: Guard

Rise of the Quartron#058.src: Harnort! I'M Dado! This sicko mugged me for info! They're gonna ruin us both!
Rise of the Quartron#058.dst: ¡Harnort! ¡Dado soy YO! ¡Este pirado me sacó la info! ¡Nos hundirá a los dos!
Rise of the Quartron#058.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#059.src: Guards!! GUARDS!! Capture them! Stop them! Tie them up, do something!! Our research can't go to waste, not at this vital point!!
Rise of the Quartron#059.dst: ¡¡Guardias!! ¡¡GUARDIAS!! ¡Atrapadlos! ¡Detenedlos! ¡¡Atadlos, haced algo!! Nuestra investigación no puede echarse a perder, ¡¡no en un punto tan crucial!!
Rise of the Quartron#059.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#060.src: HA! That's what you get for showing me that amazi- HORRIBLE flower! Outta here!
Rise of the Quartron#060.dst: ¡JA! ¡Por enseñarme esa flor tan increí- HORRIBLE! ¡Yo me piro!
Rise of the Quartron#060.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#061.src: Break into the laboratory and stop Harnort.
Rise of the Quartron#061.dst: Irrumpe en el laboratorio y detén a Harnort.

Rise of the Quartron#062.src: ...so, it's come to this then. I knew the names of all those guards. I didn't hurt anyone to meet my goal.
Rise of the Quartron#062.dst: ...así que hemos llegado a esto. Me sabía los nombres de todos esos guardias. No hice daño a nadie para lograr mi meta.
Rise of the Quartron#062.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#063.src: You...I won't let their sacrifices be in vain! {p} needs to see what quartz is truly capable of! I MUST show them.
Rise of the Quartron#063.dst: Tú... ¡No dejaré que su sacrificio sea en vano! ¡{p} tiene que ver de lo que es capaz el cuarzo! DEBO enseñárselo.
Rise of the Quartron#063.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#064.src: My Quartrons are the future! They need to see it! It will have been worth the scheming, and the thieving, and the burnt bridges!
Rise of the Quartron#064.dst: ¡Mis Quartron son el futuro! ¡Tienen que verlo! ¡Habrán valido la pena las intrigas, los robos y los puentes quemados!
Rise of the Quartron#064.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#065.src: But you- you couldn't leave well enough alone. You stepped in, and callously threw away a hundred lives to stop the inevitable!
Rise of the Quartron#065.dst: Pero tú- tú no podías dejarlo estar. ¡Te metiste y tiraste sin piedad cien vidas por la borda para frenar lo inevitable!
Rise of the Quartron#065.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#066.src: One live for a hundred is a fair trade!!
Rise of the Quartron#066.dst: ¡¡Una vida por cien es un trato justo!!
Rise of the Quartron#066.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#067.src: Take down the Quartron and return to nasea with the news.
Rise of the Quartron#067.dst: Derriba al Quartron y vuelve con Nasea con la noticia.

Rise of the Quartron#068.src: Aaah! Not responding?! You- You... YOU! You've destroyed the future! MY future! GAVEL'S future!!!
Rise of the Quartron#068.dst: ¡Aaah! ¡¿No responde?! Tú- Tú... ¡TÚ! ¡Has destruido el futuro! ¡MI futuro! ¡¡¡El futuro de GAVEL!!!
Rise of the Quartron#068.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#069.src: The futures of a hundred men or more!! You humans deserve to burn in hell for your careless destruction!
Rise of the Quartron#069.dst: ¡¡El futuro de cien hombres o más!! ¡Los humanos merecéis arder en el infierno por vuestra destrucción insensata!
Rise of the Quartron#069.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#070.src: The energy output by the detonations is overcharging the quartz in the walls... This entire lab is a deathtrap now! Do us all a favor- SIT STILL AND DIE ALREADY!!
Rise of the Quartron#070.dst: La energía de las detonaciones sobrecarga el cuarzo de los muros... ¡Este laboratorio es ya una trampa mortal! Haznos un favor- ¡¡ESTATE QUIETO Y MUÉRETE YA!!
Rise of the Quartron#070.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#071.src: ...you've got some serious explaining to do. First you disappear to get that Tattle flower, or whatever it was.
Rise of the Quartron#071.dst: ...tienes muchísimo que explicar. Primero desapareces a por esa flor Tattle, o como se llamara.
Rise of the Quartron#071.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#072.src: Then Dado ran through here screaming that he was drugged or nugged, and ran off to the east ridge.
Rise of the Quartron#072.dst: Luego Dado pasó por aquí gritando que lo habían drogado o drugado, y salió corriendo hacia la loma del este.
Rise of the Quartron#072.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#073.src: Then, he came back, asking me if I'd found any more of those flowers, and while he was blabbering the ENTIRE MOUNTAIN SHOOK.
Rise of the Quartron#073.dst: Después volvió a preguntarme si había encontrado más de esas flores, y mientras farfullaba TODA LA MONTAÑA TEMBLÓ.
Rise of the Quartron#073.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#074.src: So, spill it. I wanted you to figure out where my quartz was going, and you made one of my workers an addict and caused a freaking landslide!!
Rise of the Quartron#074.dst: Así que suéltalo. Te pedí que averiguaras adónde iba mi cuarzo, ¡¡y has vuelto adicto a uno de mis obreros y provocado un dichoso desprendimiento!!
Rise of the Quartron#074.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#075.src: ...uh huh. Mhm. ... ...yeah, go on. Uh, okay, I can buy that... I'd never believe you if you hadn't given me the proof.
Rise of the Quartron#075.dst: ...ajá. Mmm. ... ...sí, sigue. Eh, vale, me lo puedo creer... Nunca te creería si no me hubieras dado la prueba.
Rise of the Quartron#075.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#076.src: A militarized quartz mech...yeesh. That guy sounds like a piece of work. Guess that wasn't really your fault after all.
Rise of the Quartron#076.dst: Un mecha de cuarzo militarizado... uf. Vaya elemento ese tipo. Supongo que al final no fue culpa tuya.
Rise of the Quartron#076.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#077.src: I'll round up the police to get all those guards and them. ...what's with that look? Almost looks like you don't think anyone'll be there. Anyways...
Rise of the Quartron#077.dst: Reuniré a la policía para que detengan a esos guardias y a él. ...¿a qué viene esa cara? Casi parece que crees que no habrá nadie. En fin...
Rise of the Quartron#077.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#078.src: Okay, so I'll out you a quick deal. I'll pay you now for figuring this out, and if you do justt one more thing for me then you'll get something extra.
Rise of the Quartron#078.dst: Vale, te propongo un trato rápido. Te pago ya por haberlo resuelto, y si haces una cosita más por mí, te llevas algo extra.
Rise of the Quartron#078.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#079.src: Take the elevator past the yellow flags and go into the private site, you have my permission. I'll meet you up there.
Rise of the Quartron#079.dst: Coge el ascensor tras las banderas amarillas y entra en la zona privada. Tienes mi permiso. Nos vemos arriba.
Rise of the Quartron#079.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#080.src: Join Nasea at the end of the minecart track.
Rise of the Quartron#080.dst: Reúnete con Nasea al final de las vías de las vagonetas.

Rise of the Quartron#082.src: This is the newest mining annex, but we've hit a bit of a brick wall. Well...a gravel wall.
Rise of the Quartron#082.dst: Este es el anexo minero más nuevo, pero nos hemos topado con un muro. Bueno... con un muro de grava.
Rise of the Quartron#082.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#083.src: So, if you can open up this area, you'll get access to the mine and whatever you find in it.
Rise of the Quartron#083.dst: Así que, si puedes abrir esta zona, tendrás acceso a la mina y a lo que encuentres en ella.
Rise of the Quartron#083.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#084.src: I have to be off though, lots of work to get to. Hm. It looks like the core you showed me folded up into a ring. Really high-tech stuff, but I can't use it, so you can take it.
Rise of the Quartron#084.dst: Pero yo tengo que irme, me espera mucho trabajo. Hm. Parece que el núcleo que me enseñaste se ha plegado en forma de anillo. Pura alta tecnología, pero no puedo usarlo, así que quédatelo.
Rise of the Quartron#084.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#085.src: Suppose that's all, then! Here's your payment. I'll see you around.
Rise of the Quartron#085.dst: ¡Pues supongo que esto es todo! Aquí tienes tu paga. Nos vemos.
Rise of the Quartron#085.speaker: Nasea

Rogue Wyrmling#000.dst: No vuelvas a hablar de esto... forastero.

Royal Trials#001.src: Back off! No'ne enters 'til the pirate queen is chosen. What's a landwalker like you doin' here?
Royal Trials#001.dst: ¡Atrás! Nadie entra hasta que se elija a la reina pirata. ¿Qué hace aquí una rata de tierra como tú?
Royal Trials#001.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#002.src: Participate? Are ye crazy? Ain't no way a landlubber is wearing the crown.
Royal Trials#002.dst: ¿Participar? ¿Has perdido la cabeza? Ninguna rata de tierra llevará la corona.
Royal Trials#002.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#003.src: Off with ya now! Before I call the gals to gut you. And dun' go wandering around chatting to any skyraiders!
Royal Trials#003.dst: ¡Largo de aquí! Antes de que llame a las chicas y te destripen. ¡Y no andes charlando con los Skyraiders!
Royal Trials#003.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#005.src: Yer wantin' to be pirate queen, ye? Don' worry, I can help ye.
Royal Trials#005.dst: ¿Quieres ser reina pirata, eh? No te preocupes, yo puedo ayudarte.
Royal Trials#005.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#006.src: Y'see, the other pirates ain't fit for the role. They're dumb 'n weak. All they've got is looks.
Royal Trials#006.dst: Verás, las otras piratas no dan la talla. Son tontas y débiles. Solo tienen la cara bonita.
Royal Trials#006.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#007.src: Yer got the lot! Looks and talent.
Royal Trials#007.dst: ¡Tú lo tienes todo! Cara y talento.
Royal Trials#007.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#008.src: Y'know, the guard, she's dumb too. A simple disguise will fool 'er. Issue is, ye dun' look like a skyraider at all!
Royal Trials#008.dst: La guardia también es tonta. Un disfraz simple la engañará. ¡Lo malo es que no pareces una Skyraider!
Royal Trials#008.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#009.src: Yer in luck, though. A skyraider will sell anything for a price - just look around the town and see if ye can persuade anyone to part with their outfit.
Royal Trials#009.dst: Pero estás de suerte. Una Skyraider vende lo que sea por el precio justo - date una vuelta por el pueblo a ver si convences a alguien de soltar su ropa.
Royal Trials#009.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#010.src: Look around the skyraider town at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find a pirate outfit.
Royal Trials#010.dst: Busca por el pueblo Skyraider en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] y consigue un atuendo pirata.

Royal Trials#011.src: Aye? A landwalker, wanderin' around our base? Whatcha' want?
Royal Trials#011.dst: ¿Eh? ¿Una rata de tierra rondando nuestra base? ¿Qué quieres?
Royal Trials#011.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#013.src: ... aye, I suppose I could be tempted to pass it on to ye... for a price.
Royal Trials#013.dst: ... sí, supongo que podría cedértela... por un precio.
Royal Trials#013.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#014.src: Here, these are what I'd trade it to ye for.
Royal Trials#014.dst: Toma, esto es lo que aceptaría a cambio.
Royal Trials#014.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#015.src: If yer thinkin' emeralds... [{~} Emerald Blocks] seems like a fair price, heh.
Royal Trials#015.dst: Si piensas en esmeraldas... [{~} Emerald Blocks] me parece un precio justo, je.
Royal Trials#015.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#016.src: Of course, if you're running low on funds, how about ye grab me [{~} Dragonling Eggs] instead? Y'know, the ingredient. I'm 'oping to raise some 'o the lil critters!
Royal Trials#016.dst: Claro que, si no te sobra el dinero, ¿por qué no me traes [{~} Dragonling Eggs]? El ingrediente, ya sabes. ¡Quiero criar unos cuantos de esos bichillos!
Royal Trials#016.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#017.src: But if neither of them tickle ye fancy... I've always wanted [{~} Shiny Shell] - they're just so sparkly! Ye can find them in the cave south-east of here, beside the ladders.
Royal Trials#017.dst: Pero si ninguna de las dos te convence... siempre he querido [{~} Shiny Shell] - ¡brillan muchísimo! Los hallarás en la cueva al sureste de aquí, junto a las escaleras.
Royal Trials#017.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#018.src: Ye can get me one o' those three, landwalker, and ye can have my outfit!
Royal Trials#018.dst: Tráeme una de esas tres cosas, rata de tierra, ¡y la ropa es tuya!
Royal Trials#018.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#019.src: Give an item to Egpla at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Royal Trials#019.dst: Dale un objeto a Egpla en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Royal Trials#020.src: So, landwalker, are ye ready to pay up? I can see emeralds in ye pocket, hand 'em over.
Royal Trials#020.dst: Entonces, rata de tierra, ¿vas a pagar ya? Veo esmeraldas en tu bolsillo, dámelas.
Royal Trials#020.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#021.src: Alrigh'! Those're exactly what I've been lookin' for. Give it here, lemme have a look...
Royal Trials#021.dst: ¡Muy bien! Es justo lo que andaba buscando. Trae aquí, déjame verlo...
Royal Trials#021.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#022.src: Aye, landwalker! Is that the sparkle of a shiny shell I spot in ye pocket?! Lemme have a look...
Royal Trials#022.dst: ¡Eh, rata de tierra! ¡¿Es el brillo de un shiny shell eso de tu bolsillo?! Déjame ver...
Royal Trials#022.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#023.src: Alright, landwalker. Ye can have me outfit. 'ere, lemme just get changed inside.
Royal Trials#023.dst: Está bien, rata de tierra. La ropa es tuya. Espera, voy a cambiarme dentro.
Royal Trials#023.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#024.src: Here ye go, landlubber. I hope ye get some kinda use out of it, whatever ye want it for.
Royal Trials#024.dst: Ahí tienes, rata de tierra. Espero que te sirva de algo, para lo que sea que la quieras.
Royal Trials#024.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#026.src: Another contestant, eh? That outfit looks a bit funny on ye, but I'll let yer in. Hurry up!
Royal Trials#026.dst: ¿Otra concursante, eh? Esa ropa te queda un poco rara, pero te dejo pasar. ¡Date prisa!
Royal Trials#026.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#028.src: Ugh! Ye can't be the queen, ye can barely fly an airship!
Royal Trials#028.dst: ¡Bah! ¡Tú no puedes ser reina, si apenas sabes pilotar una aeronave!
Royal Trials#028.speaker: Angry Contestant

Royal Trials#029.src: No! I'll be the queen! I'm much more qualified than any of you sky rats!
Royal Trials#029.dst: ¡No! ¡La reina seré yo! ¡Valgo más que cualquiera de vosotras, ratas del cielo!
Royal Trials#029.speaker: Angry Contestant

Royal Trials#030.src: Listen to the Trials Overseer's speech.
Royal Trials#030.dst: Escucha el discurso de la Supervisora de las Pruebas.

Royal Trials#031.src: Gather round, ladies. The next Queen is about to be selected!
Royal Trials#031.dst: Reuníos, chicas. ¡Se va a elegir a la próxima reina!
Royal Trials#031.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#032.src: As ye know, our previous queen suffered a... nasty fate, murdered on her very own airship by a Wynn soldier.
Royal Trials#032.dst: Como sabéis, nuestra anterior reina tuvo un... final feo: la mató un soldado de Wynn en su propia aeronave.
Royal Trials#032.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#033.src: But in the ashes of her honor, a new queen shall rise! Three trials. That's what ye all face now.
Royal Trials#033.dst: ¡Pero de las cenizas de su honor se alzará una nueva reina! Tres pruebas. Eso es lo que os espera ahora.
Royal Trials#033.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#034.src: Only one, who passes all trials laid before her, will pass and gain the title of Skyraider Queen.
Royal Trials#034.dst: Solo una superará todas las pruebas y obtendrá el título de reina de los Skyraiders.
Royal Trials#034.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#035.src: Now, I introduce ye all to the first trial, to test yer capability at a vital skill for queenship - combat!
Royal Trials#035.dst: Ahora os presento la primera prueba, que medirá una destreza vital para reinar - ¡el combate!
Royal Trials#035.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#037.src: Defeat the armory room of the combat challenge.
Royal Trials#037.dst: Supera la sala de la armería del desafío de combate.

Royal Trials#038.src: Defeat the brig room of the combat challenge.
Royal Trials#038.dst: Supera la sala del calabozo del desafío de combate.

Royal Trials#039.src: Defeat the cockpit room of the combat challenge.
Royal Trials#039.dst: Supera la cabina de mando del desafío de combate.

Royal Trials#040.src: Listen to the trials overseer's speech.
Royal Trials#040.dst: Escucha el discurso de la supervisora de las pruebas.

Royal Trials#041.src: Arr, that weeded out the weak. A queen must be strong to lead.
Royal Trials#041.dst: Arr, las débiles ya han caído. Una reina debe ser fuerte para mandar.
Royal Trials#041.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#042.src: Now, to the second challenge - the task of flight! Ye can't be a queen if ye can't fly yer airship!
Royal Trials#042.dst: ¡Y ahora, el segundo desafío - la prueba de vuelo! ¡No puedes ser reina si no sabes pilotar tu aeronave!
Royal Trials#042.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#043.src: Make sure ye bring yer eyes, girls, one false move and death awaits.
Royal Trials#043.dst: Abrid bien los ojos, chicas: un paso en falso y os espera la muerte.
Royal Trials#043.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#044.src: This task should get rid of the rest of ye unworthy.
Royal Trials#044.dst: Esta prueba se llevará por delante al resto de las indignas.
Royal Trials#044.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#046.src: Listen to the trials overseer's speech.
Royal Trials#046.dst: Escucha el discurso de la supervisora de las pruebas.

Royal Trials#047.src: Well lookie here, an amateur made it through her flight.
Royal Trials#047.dst: Vaya, vaya, una novata ha superado su vuelo.
Royal Trials#047.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#048.src: Well let’s see how you hold up in the final task ladies.
Royal Trials#048.dst: Pues veamos cómo aguantáis la última prueba, chicas.
Royal Trials#048.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#049.src: Yer ain’ a pirate at all if ye can't steal, but this is different.
Royal Trials#049.dst: No eres pirata si no sabes robar, pero esto es distinto.
Royal Trials#049.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#050.src: This is the real deal. Stealin’ from a highly secure mansion.
Royal Trials#050.dst: Esto va en serio. Robar en una mansión muy bien vigilada.
Royal Trials#050.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#051.src: Yer job is to steal a priceless treasure from the richest family in the sky.
Royal Trials#051.dst: Vuestra tarea es robar un tesoro sin precio a la familia más rica del cielo.
Royal Trials#051.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#052.src: We'll be waiting with a getaway airship at the extraction point, everyone else'll left behind.
Royal Trials#052.dst: Esperaremos con una aeronave de huida en el punto de salida; las demás se quedarán atrás.
Royal Trials#052.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#053.src: Remember, this be the real thing, and the consequences of failure will be severe. Good luck, ladies.
Royal Trials#053.dst: Recordad: esto va en serio, y fallar tendrá consecuencias graves. Suerte, chicas.
Royal Trials#053.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#054.src: This here is the garden you we'll tunnel into, and yer'll 'ave to find a way into the Mansion, maybe yer can just ask nicely, heh.
Royal Trials#054.dst: Este es el jardín hasta el que cavaremos el túnel, y tendréis que buscaros la manera de entrar en la mansión; quizá baste con pedirlo con educación, je.
Royal Trials#054.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#055.src: Then yer'll have to sneak through these corridors to reach the treasure - and don't let the guards find yer, or they'll lock yer up and throw away the key.
Royal Trials#055.dst: Luego tendréis que colaros por estos pasillos hasta el tesoro - y que no os vean los guardias, o os encerrarán y tirarán la llave.
Royal Trials#055.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#056.src: This, o' course, is the mythical treasure that yer gonna want to grab and get outta here, stat. I'm sure there'll be some extra defenses, though.
Royal Trials#056.dst: Y este, cómo no, es el tesoro legendario que hay que agarrar para salir pitando de allí. Aunque seguro que habrá defensas de sobra.
Royal Trials#056.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#057.src: And finally yer'll have to escape outta this window right 'ere - I'll be waitin' with an airship to carry all of ye out.
Royal Trials#057.dst: Y por último saldréis por esta ventana de aquí - yo estaré esperando con una aeronave para sacaros a todas.
Royal Trials#057.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#059.src: Aye', think ye ready to try grabbin' that treasure, eh? Just 'ead outta this hole and try to find yer way into the mansion.
Royal Trials#059.dst: Eh, ¿te ves ya con ganas de ir a por el tesoro? Sal por este agujero y busca cómo entrar en la mansión.
Royal Trials#059.speaker: Skyraider

Royal Trials#060.src: Sneak past the guards and steal the treasure.
Royal Trials#060.dst: Esquiva a los guardias y roba el tesoro.

Royal Trials#061.src: Oi', you! Whatcha' think yer' doin' sneakin' around these parts? This be a restricted area! Yer' headed to the jail cell!
Royal Trials#061.dst: ¡Eh, tú! ¿Qué crees que haces merodeando por aquí? ¡Esta es zona restringida! ¡Te vas derecho al calabozo!
Royal Trials#061.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#062.src: Get the treasure to the trials overseer outside of the mansion's window.
Royal Trials#062.dst: Lleva el tesoro a la supervisora de las pruebas, fuera de la ventana de la mansión.

Royal Trials#063.src: Aye', men! Tha' treasure has been stolen! Prepare the defenses!
Royal Trials#063.dst: ¡Eh, hombres! ¡Han robado el tesoro! ¡Preparad las defensas!
Royal Trials#063.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#064.src: Aye, we caught the nasty thief! We'll be lockin' him up till' he rots!
Royal Trials#064.dst: ¡Hemos atrapado al ladrón asqueroso! ¡Lo encerraremos hasta que se pudra!
Royal Trials#064.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#065.src: Ah, I thought yer might be the first one back. Yer got a queenly look about ye...
Royal Trials#065.dst: Ah, ya suponía que serías la primera en volver. Tienes aire de reina...
Royal Trials#065.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#066.src: Head to the airship behind me, lassie. We'll wait a second before the others.
Royal Trials#066.dst: Sube a la aeronave de detrás, muchacha. Esperaremos un poco a las demás.
Royal Trials#066.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#067.src: Exit the Mansion onto the airship outside.
Royal Trials#067.dst: Sal de la mansión a la aeronave de fuera.

Royal Trials#068.src: Listen to the trials overseer's speech.
Royal Trials#068.dst: Escucha el discurso de la supervisora de las pruebas.

Royal Trials#069.src: Aha! I figured it'd be ye to win o'er the rest of that lot… Ye've earned the proper sovereignty of bein' our ruler, our queen of the Skyraiders.
Royal Trials#069.dst: ¡Ajá! Ya imaginaba que ganarías al resto de esa panda... Te has ganado por derecho el mando sobre nosotras, reina de los Skyraiders.
Royal Trials#069.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#070.src: Don't be worryin', we got this airship armoured somethin' heavy, and we’re miles away from their cannons… Nothin' to be afraid of, we're safe in this ship.
Royal Trials#070.dst: No te preocupes, esta aeronave lleva un blindaje bien grueso y estamos a millas de sus cañones... No hay nada que temer, aquí estamos a salvo.
Royal Trials#070.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#071.src: But, first things first, let’s take a look inside that fancy box ye got, see what mythical treasures lay guarded behind those grubby guardsmen, shall we?
Royal Trials#071.dst: Pero lo primero es lo primero: veamos qué hay en esa caja tan elegante que traes, a ver qué tesoro legendario guardaban esos guardias mugrientos, ¿eh?
Royal Trials#071.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#072.dst: Por los cielos y los mares...
Royal Trials#072.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#073.src: I hafta wonder now if this weren't bein' guarded for a bit of a nefarious reason. This be... Quite the weapon. It'd be deadly if this got used.
Royal Trials#073.dst: Ahora me pregunto si no lo guardaban por algún motivo turbio. Esto es... todo un arma. Si llegara a usarse, sería mortífera.
Royal Trials#073.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#074.src: Well, thanks to ye, us Skyraiders might have it now, but using this weapon against civilization would be beyond terrible. We might be pirates but we ain't heartless!
Royal Trials#074.dst: Bueno, gracias a ti puede que ahora sea de las Skyraiders, pero usar esta arma contra la civilización sería algo atroz. ¡Seremos piratas, pero no desalmadas!
Royal Trials#074.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#075.src: I think we'll just have to keep this locked up nice n' tight once we get back. We'll be sure to tie this little cataclysm-in-a-box down much safer th'n those idiot men did.
Royal Trials#075.dst: Creo que, en cuanto volvamos, tendremos que guardarlo bajo mil llaves. Ataremos este cataclismo en caja mucho mejor que esos hombres idiotas.
Royal Trials#075.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#076.src: Aha! Just gettin' back now. Let's head down and start the ceremony, shall we?
Royal Trials#076.dst: ¡Ajá! Ya hemos llegado. Bajemos y empecemos la ceremonia, ¿te parece?
Royal Trials#076.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#077.src: I am pleased to introduce our {~}th Skyraider Queen. Fer the sake of our people, let her reign last more than two weeks.
Royal Trials#077.dst: Me complace presentar a nuestra {~}.ª reina de los Skyraiders. Por el bien de nuestro pueblo, que su reinado dure más de dos semanas.
Royal Trials#077.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#078.src: I, on behalf on the rest of the Skyraider people, have the honor of decoratin' you with the highest decoration of the Skyraiders, The Queen's Headpiece.
Royal Trials#078.dst: En nombre del pueblo Skyraider, tengo el honor de condecorarte con la más alta distinción de los Skyraiders: The Queen's Headpiece.
Royal Trials#078.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#079.src: Please use your sovereignty to lead us to the riches we deserve.
Royal Trials#079.dst: Usa tu poder para llevarnos a las riquezas que merecemos.
Royal Trials#079.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#080.dst: Habla con la supervisora de las pruebas.

Royal Trials#081.src: Yer Majesty. What an honour to have such a beautiful queen.
Royal Trials#081.dst: Majestad. Qué honor tener una reina tan hermosa.
Royal Trials#081.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#082.src: Now, we must crown ye, and give you yer reward.
Royal Trials#082.dst: Ahora debemos coronarte y entregarte tu recompensa.
Royal Trials#082.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#083.src: Benefits of being a queen I 'spose.
Royal Trials#083.speaker: Trials Overseer

Shattered Minds#001.src: Aha, perfect! You'll be perfect! Lucky a human decided to come here!
Shattered Minds#001.dst: ¡Ajá, perfecto! ¡Me vienes de perlas! ¡Qué suerte que haya venido un humano!
Shattered Minds#001.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#002.src: I'll get to the point- I want you to go get something for me, and then bring it back here. Simple, right?
Shattered Minds#002.dst: Iré al grano: quiero que vayas a buscarme una cosa y la traigas aquí. Sencillo, ¿no?
Shattered Minds#002.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#003.src: When you do that, I'm going to fix it up and try something out on you. Something magically enlightening!
Shattered Minds#003.dst: Cuando lo hagas, la prepararé y probaré algo contigo. ¡Algo mágicamente iluminador!
Shattered Minds#003.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#004.src: Oh, don't give me that look, it should be perfectly safe! Unless you've been mired in darkness for the past however many years...
Shattered Minds#004.dst: Ay, no me mires así, ¡debería ser totalmente seguro! A menos que la oscuridad te haya envuelto durante no sé cuántos años...
Shattered Minds#004.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#005.src: Anyway, what I need is a specific kind of mushroom that grows close by, the Bluecap Mushroom.
Shattered Minds#005.dst: En fin, necesito una seta concreta que crece aquí cerca: la Bluecap Mushroom.
Shattered Minds#005.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#006.src: They grow underground- in a cave out the gate northwest of here. I'll even pay you if you bring it back, so what have you got to lose?
Shattered Minds#006.dst: Crecen bajo tierra, en una cueva pasada la puerta al noroeste de aquí. Encima te pagaré si me la traes, así que ¿qué pierdes?
Shattered Minds#006.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#007.src: Bring Likeru the mushrooms from the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shattered Minds#007.dst: Llévale a Likeru las setas de la cueva en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shattered Minds#008.src: Figure out how to get out of the cave, and return to Likeru.
Shattered Minds#008.dst: Encuentra la salida de la cueva y vuelve con Likeru.

Shattered Minds#009.src: Looks like someone rolled about the air fuzz too much, so indeed hello! A light hello to yourself, {u}, and a greetings to Professor Eih, which is me!
Shattered Minds#009.dst: ¡Parece que alguien rodó demasiado por la pelusa del aire, así que hola, sí! Un ligero hola para ti, {u}, ¡y un saludo para el profesor Eih, que soy yo!

Shattered Minds#010.src: I don't rhyme all the instances, I feel the need to say. But what do you say? Very little! But I bet you're wondering where you are.
Shattered Minds#010.dst: No rimo en todas las ocasiones, siento la necesidad de decirlo. Pero ¿tú qué dices? ¡Muy poco! Pero apuesto a que te preguntas dónde estás.
Shattered Minds#010.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#011.src: I am no gambling man, but the chips are down and it is time to play {~}-Pickup with the puzzle pieces, and I'll eat my bowtie if you aren't ready.
Shattered Minds#011.dst: No soy hombre de apuestas, pero las fichas están echadas y toca jugar al recoge-{~} con las piezas del puzle, y me comeré la pajarita si no lo estás.
Shattered Minds#011.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#012.src: The betting pool says the way to go is the opposite of in front, so that leaves someplace we can't talk about in front of the kids as your path!
Shattered Minds#012.dst: La quiniela dice que el camino es lo contrario de delante, ¡así que tu senda es ese sitio del que no se habla delante de los niños!
Shattered Minds#012.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#013.src: I will be around! Or asquare, as it were. Technically amultiplesquares, replete with alines! And abevels! And other some such things like-
Shattered Minds#013.dst: ¡Estaré alrededor! O alcuadrado, por así decirlo. Técnicamente almultiplescuadrados, ¡repleto de allíneas! ¡Y albiseles! Y otras cosas así como-
Shattered Minds#013.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#014.src: The punks scramble like eggs, and your skillet is sizzling! Certainly the heat in the kitchen is too much- so where is the fire extinguisher?
Shattered Minds#014.dst: ¡Los matones se revuelven como huevos y tu sartén chisporrotea! Desde luego, en la cocina hace demasiado calor- ¿dónde está el extintor?
Shattered Minds#014.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#015.src: It won't rocket you! The hole in the shape of a door looms out of your transparent grasp- frogs can't skip leg day, so be froggy! Bounce and jump!
Shattered Minds#015.dst: ¡No te lanzará por los aires! El hueco con forma de puerta asoma fuera de tu alcance transparente- las ranas no faltan al día de pierna, ¡sé rana! ¡Bota y salta!
Shattered Minds#015.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#016.src: Swoosh and sprint! Speed and non-slip shoes! With a CLICK upon me I give you all but one, as much as you need!
Shattered Minds#016.dst: ¡Zas y esprinta! ¡Velocidad y zapatos antideslizantes! ¡Con un CLIC sobre mí te doy todo menos uno, cuanto necesites!
Shattered Minds#016.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#017.src: The colors! Shimmering as a prism- oh, no one likes those things. The writing is on the wall, but the window mugs it for pocket change! The inhumanity!
Shattered Minds#017.dst: ¡Los colores! Brillan como un prisma- ay, eso no le gusta a nadie. La escritura está en la pared, ¡pero la ventana la atraca por calderilla! ¡Qué inhumano!
Shattered Minds#017.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#018.src: Use your eyes as ears and hear what I shall write! The cockpit is missing ground control and the cornfields all look the same in endless rows!
Shattered Minds#018.dst: ¡Usa los ojos como orejas y oye lo que voy a escribir! ¡A la cabina le falta el control de tierra y los maizales son iguales en hileras sin fin!
Shattered Minds#018.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#019.src: So Eih, esquire professor PhD, will provide the coordinates in helpfully non-literal fashion, and one's joystick shall lead the holder to bliss!
Shattered Minds#019.dst: Así que Eih, profesor doctor y caballero, dará las coordenadas de forma amablemente no literal, ¡y la palanca llevará a quien la empuñe a la dicha!
Shattered Minds#019.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#020.src: At one's boots, the colors paint themselves towards an orientation. Above one's head, the lights match and fling you the same!
Shattered Minds#020.dst: A los pies de uno, los colores se pintan hacia una orientación. Sobre la cabeza, ¡las luces coinciden y te lanzan en la misma dirección!
Shattered Minds#020.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#021.src: I'm all out of airplane food, but the goal is more than peanuts- it's progress, just opposite our position. Fly well!
Shattered Minds#021.dst: Se acabó la comida de avión, pero la meta es más que cacahuetes- es avanzar, justo enfrente de nosotros. ¡Buen vuelo!
Shattered Minds#021.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#022.src: WOW. Just, WOW! Your brain being frazzled doesn't excuse this failure! Time is money and we're swimming in a river called DEBT!
Shattered Minds#022.dst: GUAU. ¡Simplemente, GUAU! ¡Tener el cerebro frito no excusa este fracaso! ¡El tiempo es oro y nadamos en un río llamado DEUDA!
Shattered Minds#022.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#023.src: I'm just going to stand here and you're gonna go into the teleporters I'm NOT in, and you're gonna like it!
Shattered Minds#023.dst: Yo me quedo aquí parado y tú te metes en los teletransportadores donde NO estoy, ¡y te va a encantar!
Shattered Minds#023.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#024.src: Explore the strange forest to find Likeru.
Shattered Minds#024.dst: Explora el extraño bosque para encontrar a Likeru.

Shattered Minds#025.src: Hey, look to your left for a moment.
Shattered Minds#025.dst: Oye, mira un momento a tu izquierda.

Shattered Minds#026.src: I hope you've got a note pad with you, if you want me to teach you the ways of a master you'll need to write a lot down!
Shattered Minds#026.dst: Espero que lleves una libreta encima; si quieres que te enseñe el camino del maestro, ¡tendrás que apuntar mucho!
Shattered Minds#026.speaker: Steve
