Shattered Minds#027.src: It doesn't matter that we're on a {~}-match losing streak, we'll never give up!
Shattered Minds#027.dst: Da igual que llevemos {~} derrotas seguidas, ¡nunca nos rendiremos!
Shattered Minds#027.speaker: Erd

Shattered Minds#028.src: C'mon Beakmeister, we've ventured together for years now! Why won't you listen to me?
Shattered Minds#028.dst: ¡Vamos, Beakmeister, llevamos años aventurándonos juntos! ¿Por qué no me haces caso?
Shattered Minds#028.speaker: Flamingo Rider

Shattered Minds#029.src: I don't think she's even listening to me anymore. She's a free spirit!
Shattered Minds#029.dst: Creo que ya ni me escucha. ¡Es un espíritu libre!
Shattered Minds#029.speaker: Flamingo Rider

Shattered Minds#030.src: Familiar to the nursing home, with no IV in sight! Phenomenal, and now my gambling metaphors will be apropos!
Shattered Minds#030.dst: ¡Familiar para el asilo, y sin un gotero a la vista! Fenomenal, ¡ahora mis metáforas de apuestas vendrán al caso!
Shattered Minds#030.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#031.src: A solid, {~} pure, statue-made-out-of-tons-of-things what looks like me! I call it, “Ill Of The Ooze, Young!” And it begets your path amongst the lilypads.
Shattered Minds#031.dst: ¡Una estatua maciza, {~} pura, hecha-de-toneladas-de-cosas y con mi cara! La llamo “¡Mal de la Baba, Joven!”. Y engendra tu camino entre los nenúfares.
Shattered Minds#031.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#032.src: Likeru? No, no, she can’t find you here- her eyes deceive her. But I won't! Not any more than the film reel degrades, and the theater is ahead!
Shattered Minds#032.dst: ¿Likeru? No, no, aquí no te encuentra- sus ojos la engañan. ¡Pero yo no! No más de lo que se gasta el rollo de cine, ¡y el teatro está delante!
Shattered Minds#032.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#033.src: Now, don't tell the kids about this one either! The way forward is through my masterpiece- but I can't imagine a gullet glorious!
Shattered Minds#033.dst: ¡Y de esto tampoco les cuentes nada a los niños! El camino pasa por mi obra maestra- ¡pero no imagino un gaznate glorioso!
Shattered Minds#033.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#034.src: Enter the giant frog and escape.
Shattered Minds#034.dst: Entra en la rana gigante y escapa.

Shattered Minds#035.src: Don't come any closer... I don't want to have to fight...
Shattered Minds#035.dst: No te acerques más... No quiero tener que pelear...

Shattered Minds#036.src: I-I'm warning you. You'll stand no match against me...
Shattered Minds#036.dst: T-te lo advierto. No tienes nada que hacer contra mí...

Shattered Minds#038.src: There we are! Snapped out of it! Though perhaps writing in the mud was better- Soon it will dry.
Shattered Minds#038.dst: ¡Ya está! ¡De vuelta en el mundo! Aunque quizá escribir en el barro era mejor- Pronto se secará.
Shattered Minds#038.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#039.src: Without the static of the fungal caps, the radio station will be off-air- and the device unplugged!
Shattered Minds#039.dst: Sin la estática de los sombreros fúngicos, la emisora saldrá del aire- ¡y el aparato se desenchufará!
Shattered Minds#039.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#040.src: Scratch it in your eyelids- the lightbulb screwed between the arches, and the feather-duster's sunset shades will reveal my deepest compatriot. Quick now, wake!
Shattered Minds#040.dst: Grábatelo en los párpados- la bombilla enroscada entre los arcos y los tonos de atardecer del plumero revelarán a mi más hondo compatriota. ¡Rápido, despierta!
Shattered Minds#040.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#041.src: Ugh. Rats chewing the roots. They've their place, it simply isn't here. Neither is your place in the koi pond, stranger.
Shattered Minds#041.dst: Uf. Ratas royendo las raíces. Tienen su sitio, y no es este. Ni el tuyo está en el estanque koi, forastero.
Shattered Minds#041.speaker: Elder Berusia

Shattered Minds#042.src: I believe Likeru tossed you into the deep end without meaning, so to speak. I understand your being overwhelmed, but still...
Shattered Minds#042.dst: Creo que Likeru te arrojó a lo hondo sin mala intención, por así decirlo. Entiendo que te abrume todo esto, pero aun así...
Shattered Minds#042.speaker: Elder Berusia

Shattered Minds#043.src: Speaking of which, it might behoove you to let her know you've recovered. Though, should you need rest, you may take it here.
Shattered Minds#043.dst: Y ya que hablamos de ello, convendría que le hicieras saber que te has recuperado. Aunque, si necesitas descansar, puedes hacerlo aquí.
Shattered Minds#043.speaker: Elder Berusia

Shattered Minds#045.src: Ehm. Okay, that was...a bad idea. Should NOT have done that with a human. Uh, noted for the futu- oh, you're actually alright?!
Shattered Minds#045.dst: Ehm. Vale, eso fue...una mala idea. NO debí hacerlo con un humano. Eh, anotado para el futu- ¡¿en serio estás bien?!
Shattered Minds#045.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#046.src: You came back and just leapt into the koi pond! I thought you'd drowned down there!
Shattered Minds#046.dst: ¡Volviste y te lanzaste de cabeza al estanque koi! ¡Pensé que te habías ahogado ahí abajo!
Shattered Minds#046.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#047.src: I guess the spores from the Bluecaps got to you before you could bring them back. I wonder what you saw?
Shattered Minds#047.dst: Supongo que las esporas de los Bluecap te alcanzaron antes de que pudieras traerlas. ¿Qué habrás visto?
Shattered Minds#047.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#048.src: You reacted like you were crazy when I tried to talk with you... You were supposed to get visions of the light! A deep connection!
Shattered Minds#048.dst: Reaccionaste como si hubieras perdido la cabeza cuando intenté hablar contigo... ¡Deberías haber tenido visiones de la luz! ¡Una conexión profunda!
Shattered Minds#048.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#049.src: Wait, maybe it's cause of that portal...the signals got mixed? I'll have to look into this more...but hey, I got the Bluecap, anyways, so...
Shattered Minds#049.dst: Espera, ¿quizá sea por ese portal...y las señales se mezclaron? Tendré que investigarlo más...pero bueno, el Bluecap ya lo tengo, así que...
Shattered Minds#049.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#050.src: Here, your payment- and a little extra I whipped up too. Um, really sorry about all that!
Shattered Minds#050.dst: Toma, tu pago- y un extra que te he preparado. Eh, ¡siento muchísimo todo eso!
Shattered Minds#050.speaker: Likeru

Shrouded in Mist#004.src: Would you like to challenge Sovereign Zhiraok again?
Shrouded in Mist#004.dst: ¿Quieres volver a desafiar al Soberano Zhiraok?

Shrouded in Mist#005.src: New Chapter Started: Amongst the Canopy

Shrouded in Mist#006.src: There's a thin layer of dust on top of the bed.
Shrouded in Mist#006.dst: Hay una fina capa de polvo sobre la cama.

Shrouded in Mist#007.src: The monitor is keeping the machine running.
Shrouded in Mist#007.dst: El monitor mantiene la máquina en marcha.

Shrouded in Mist#008.src: Maybe something sharp can break it...

Shrouded in Mist#009.src: - Entry {~}: Stayed in and slept all day. Was very tired.
Shrouded in Mist#009.dst: - Entrada {~}: Me quedé en casa durmiendo todo el día. Estaba agotado.

Shrouded in Mist#010.src: - Entry {~}: Slept in. Boss wasn't happy with me, has me working extra shifts next week.
Shrouded in Mist#010.dst: - Entrada {~}: Me dormí. Al jefe no le hizo gracia; la semana que viene me toca turnos extra.

Shrouded in Mist#013.src: The entries stop after this point...

Shrouded in Mist#014.src: This must be where Nisen lives...

Shrouded in Mist#015.src: Group up with the remaining members at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#015.dst: Reúnete con los miembros restantes en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#020.src: About what? What could you possibly be thinking about right-
Shrouded in Mist#020.dst: ¿En qué? ¿En qué puedes estar pensando ahora mis-
Shrouded in Mist#020.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#021.src: I don't know, Yusanu! Maybe about what to do next? How we can- h-how we-
Shrouded in Mist#021.dst: ¡No lo sé, Yusanu! ¿Quizá en qué hacer ahora? Cómo podemos- c-cómo-
Shrouded in Mist#021.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#022.src: There's nothing we can do! We're stuck in unfamiliar territory, all lone, our family and friends all captured, or- or worse-
Shrouded in Mist#022.dst: ¡No hay nada que podamos hacer! Estamos atrapados en tierra desconocida, solos, con la familia y los amigos capturados, o- o peor-
Shrouded in Mist#022.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#024.src: Urgh! I can't believe I let her convince me stealing this... this thing was worth it! If I hadn't, then... then our agreement wouldn't have fallen through, and none of this would have-
Shrouded in Mist#024.dst: ¡Agh! ¡No me creo que dejara que me convenciera de que robar esta... esta cosa merecía la pena! Si no lo hubiera hecho... nuestro acuerdo no se habría roto, y nada de esto habría-
Shrouded in Mist#024.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#025.src: Don't you dare pin this on Rex. You heard what that Sovereign said, they- th-they knew what we were planning for ages!
Shrouded in Mist#025.dst: No te atrevas a echarle la culpa a Rex. Ya oíste a ese Soberano: ellos- e-ellos llevaban siglos sabiendo lo que planeábamos.
Shrouded in Mist#025.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#026.src: ...then maybe it'd have been best if you left us out of it.
Shrouded in Mist#026.dst: ...pues quizá habría sido mejor que no nos metieras en esto.
Shrouded in Mist#026.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#031.src: Woah woah woah woah woah! Alright, let's all take a step back, shall we?
Shrouded in Mist#031.dst: ¡Eo eo eo eo eo! Bien, demos todos un paso atrás, ¿de acuerdo?

Shrouded in Mist#032.src: Owls! Step down! Bit of a leap, jumping straight to violence- we reserve that for the obviously crown-aligned, eheheh.
Shrouded in Mist#032.dst: ¡Búhos! ¡Atrás! Ir directos a la violencia es pasarse- eso lo reservamos para los afines a la Corona, ejejeje.

Shrouded in Mist#033.src: Allow me to introduce myself! The name's Rurie, member of the Canopy, captain of the Owls division! Apologies for the roughhousing, seems everyone's a little enthusiastic today, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#033.dst: ¡Permitidme presentarme! Me llamo Rurie, miembro del Dosel y capitán de la división de los Búhos. Perdón por la brusquedad; parece que hoy todos están un poco entusiastas, ¿eh?
Shrouded in Mist#033.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#035.src: Questions, questions! I'm afraid it's our turn first- I've called the owls off for a time, but don't think you're off the hook just yet, young lady!
Shrouded in Mist#035.dst: ¡Preguntas, preguntas! Me temo que primero nos toca a nosotros- he apartado a los búhos un rato, ¡pero no creas que estás libre, jovencita!
Shrouded in Mist#035.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#036.src: ...captain, are you certain about this? For all we know, they could be spies-
Shrouded in Mist#036.dst: ...capitán, ¿está seguro de esto? Por lo que sabemos, podrían ser espías-
Shrouded in Mist#036.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#037.src: Ah ah ah! Trust in the process, my friend. Spies or not, information is valuable.
Shrouded in Mist#037.dst: ¡Ah, ah, ah! Confía en el proceso, amigo mío. Espías o no, la información es valiosa.
Shrouded in Mist#037.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#038.src: Besides! We know how to... ah, deal with spies, as it were. Risk factor is minimal!
Shrouded in Mist#038.dst: ¡Además! Sabemos cómo... ah, ocuparnos de los espías, por así decirlo. ¡El riesgo es mínimo!
Shrouded in Mist#038.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#039.src: So... what, are you also resisting-
Shrouded in Mist#039.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#040.src: Hold it there, mister! Didn't you hear me? We'll be asking the questions here first.
Shrouded in Mist#040.dst: ¡Alto ahí, caballero! ¿No me has oído? Aquí las preguntas las hacemos primero nosotros.
Shrouded in Mist#040.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#041.src: Seems you're the only one who hasn't spoken yet! Well now, don't be shy. Tell me - where are you lot from?
Shrouded in Mist#041.dst: ¡Parece que tú eres quien aún no ha hablado! Venga, no te cortes. Dime - ¿de dónde sois?
Shrouded in Mist#041.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#042.src: Really? Quite far afield, aren't you? Finding your way from there to here is quite an endeavor.
Shrouded in Mist#042.dst: ¿En serio? Venís de muy lejos, ¿eh? Llegar desde allí hasta aquí es toda una hazaña.
Shrouded in Mist#042.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#043.src: Ahhh! Now the pieces are clicking together! I think I get it now.
Shrouded in Mist#043.dst: ¡Ahhh! ¡Ahora las piezas encajan! Creo que ya lo entiendo.
Shrouded in Mist#043.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#044.src: Ohoho? Really now? How very, very curious. You're either a verrrry clever spy, or...
Shrouded in Mist#044.dst: ¿Ojojó? ¿De verdad? Qué curioso, qué curioso. O eres un espía muuuy listo, o...
Shrouded in Mist#044.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#045.src: H... hey! Listen! I don't know who, or, or what you guys are, but--
Shrouded in Mist#045.dst: ¡E... eh! ¡Escuchad! No sé quiénes, ni, ni qué sois, pero--
Shrouded in Mist#045.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#046.src: How many times must I repeat myself? I said no que-
Shrouded in Mist#046.dst: ¿Cuántas veces he de repetirlo? He dicho que nada de pregun-
Shrouded in Mist#046.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#047.src: Shut UP! We just BARELY escaped {p} after we- after we tried to KILL the Queen! The rest of our friends are... captured, or d- dead!
Shrouded in Mist#047.dst: ¡CÁLLATE! ¡Escapamos de {p} por los PELOS después de- después de intentar MATAR a la Reina! El resto de nuestros amigos están... capturados, o m- muertos.
Shrouded in Mist#047.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#048.src: So- so either leave us alone, or I'll- I'll make sure you never see your loved ones a- again!
Shrouded in Mist#048.dst: Así que- o nos dejáis en paz, o haré- haré que no volváis a ver a vuestros seres queridos.
Shrouded in Mist#048.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#051.src: Ohoho, she's sure got some temper, huh?
Shrouded in Mist#051.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#052.src: Rurie... her story could explain what-
Shrouded in Mist#052.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#053.src: Yes, my friend, I was just thinking the very same thing. Well well, new folk, if what you're saying is true, the Canopy might just be able to assist!
Shrouded in Mist#053.dst: Sí, amigo mío, estaba pensando exactamente lo mismo. Vaya, vaya, recién llegados, si lo que decís es cierto, ¡puede que el Dosel os pueda ayudar!
Shrouded in Mist#053.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#054.src: I may have information regarding your allies.
Shrouded in Mist#054.dst: Puede que tenga información sobre vuestros aliados.
Shrouded in Mist#054.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#056.src: Ah- but! But but but, see- trust is a currency here in the {p}. I can't just spill all my secrets at once, can I?
Shrouded in Mist#056.dst: Ah- ¡pero! Pero pero pero- aquí en {p} la confianza es moneda. No puedo soltar todos mis secretos de golpe, ¿no?
Shrouded in Mist#056.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#057.src: And if you'd like to earn our trust... I'll need you to, ah, deal with some things for me.
Shrouded in Mist#057.dst: Y si queréis ganaros nuestra confianza... necesitaré que, ah, os ocupéis de un par de cosas por mí.
Shrouded in Mist#057.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#059.src: Oh, nothing too difficult... I'll tell you on one condition! I'll be taking one of you with me as leverage! Eenie, meenie, money... you, little man!
Shrouded in Mist#059.dst: Oh, nada demasiado difícil... ¡Os lo diré con una condición! ¡Me llevaré a uno de vosotros como garantía! Pito, pito, gorgorito... ¡tú, hombrecillo!
Shrouded in Mist#059.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#061.src: You, indeed! Worry not, for I'll be sure to keep you safe, but... well, you understand the need, yes?
Shrouded in Mist#061.dst: ¡Tú mismo! No temas, me aseguraré de que estés a salvo, pero... bueno, entendéis la necesidad, ¿sí?
Shrouded in Mist#061.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#062.src: We can't! We can't lose... we can't lose anyone else. Please, there has to be something-
Shrouded in Mist#062.dst: ¡No podemos! No podemos perder... no podemos perder a nadie más. Por favor, tiene que haber algo-
Shrouded in Mist#062.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#063.src: Sui... it's... fine. I don't think we have a choice. Just... do what they ask of you.
Shrouded in Mist#063.dst: Sui... no... pasa nada. No creo que tengamos elección. Solo... haced lo que os pidan.
Shrouded in Mist#063.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#065.src: Goodness, so melodramatic! Come on, I'm a trustworthy fella! You've got nothing to worry about from me.
Shrouded in Mist#065.dst: ¡Cielos, qué melodrama! ¡Vamos, soy un tipo de fiar! No tenéis nada que temer de mí.
Shrouded in Mist#065.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#067.src: Ah-mazing! I'm glad you chose to be reasonable. In that case - I'll need the remaining two of you to go and sabotage three military structures.
Shrouded in Mist#067.dst: ¡Mara-villoso! Me alegra que seáis razonables. En tal caso - los dos que quedáis iréis a sabotear tres instalaciones militares.
Shrouded in Mist#067.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#068.src: Now, go and say your goodbyes, then come grab the list from me!
Shrouded in Mist#068.dst: ¡Venga, despedíos y luego venid a por la lista!
Shrouded in Mist#068.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#069.src: Talk to Rurie before heading out at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#069.dst: Habla con Rurie antes de salir, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#070.src: Hey. You'll be fine. I'll be fine.
Shrouded in Mist#070.dst: Oye. Estarás bien. Yo estaré bien.
Shrouded in Mist#070.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#071.src: I think we can trust them for now, at least. Not like we have an alternative...
Shrouded in Mist#071.dst: Creo que por ahora podemos fiarnos. Tampoco tenemos otra opción...
Shrouded in Mist#071.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#073.src: We really... don't have a choice, do we? We, we need their support.
Shrouded in Mist#073.dst: De verdad... no tenemos elección, ¿no? Necesitamos, necesitamos su apoyo.
Shrouded in Mist#073.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#074.src: I just... hope Yusanu will be safe.
Shrouded in Mist#074.dst: Solo... espero que Yusanu esté a salvo.
Shrouded in Mist#074.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#075.src: Ugh... Captain's being reckless as usual...
Shrouded in Mist#075.dst: Uf... El capitán es imprudente, como siempre...
Shrouded in Mist#075.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#076.src: Have we finished with the heartfelt goodbyes? Excellent. Truly, I am glad you took me up on this generous offer.
Shrouded in Mist#076.dst: ¿Hemos terminado con las despedidas emotivas? Excelente. De veras, me alegra que aceptarais mi generosa oferta.
Shrouded in Mist#076.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#077.src: Don't worry about your little friend over there! He'll be safe and sound amongst our Canopy.
Shrouded in Mist#077.dst: ¡No os preocupéis por vuestro amiguito de ahí! Estará sano y salvo entre los nuestros, en el Dosel.
Shrouded in Mist#077.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#078.src: ...and how can we trust you? To not... hurt him?
Shrouded in Mist#078.dst: ...¿y cómo podemos fiarnos de ti? ¿De que no... le harás daño?
Shrouded in Mist#078.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#079.src: Ah, isn't that the issue at the heart of it all? You can't. But as I said, trust is valuable in these woods. That must go both ways!
Shrouded in Mist#079.dst: Ah, ¿no es ese el meollo de todo el asunto? No podéis. Pero, como dije, la confianza vale mucho en estos bosques. ¡Y debe ir en ambos sentidos!
Shrouded in Mist#079.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#080.src: Well, newbies! You've a list of the structures I need you to sabotage, so it really should be a simple task.
Shrouded in Mist#080.dst: ¡Bien, novatos! Tenéis la lista de las instalaciones que quiero que saboteéis, así que debería ser sencillo.
Shrouded in Mist#080.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#081.src: Just find a way to... disable them! However you manage it, I can't say I really care - so long as it gets done!
Shrouded in Mist#081.dst: ¡Buscad la forma de... inutilizarlas! Cómo lo hagáis me da bastante igual - ¡mientras quede hecho!
Shrouded in Mist#081.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#083.src: Why, because it's a golden opportunity! The work needs doing, and you need a way to prove yourselves...
Shrouded in Mist#083.dst: ¡Pues porque es una ocasión de oro! Hay trabajo que hacer y vosotros necesitáis demostrar vuestra valía...
Shrouded in Mist#083.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#084.src: So why not? It's less work for me to do, so I'm not complaining!
Shrouded in Mist#084.dst: ¿Por qué no, entonces? Es menos trabajo para mí, ¡no me quejo!
Shrouded in Mist#084.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#085.src: Newbies! That's what you are, isn't it? New to the woods, new to the world...
Shrouded in Mist#085.dst: ¡Novatos! Eso sois, ¿no? Nuevos en el bosque, nuevos en el mundo...
Shrouded in Mist#085.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#086.src: ...maybe new to Fruma, even? Ah ah, wipe that expression of shock off your face! I won't tell if you don't either.
Shrouded in Mist#086.dst: ...¿quizá nuevos incluso en Fruma? Ah ah, ¡quita esa cara de espanto! Yo no lo cuento si tú tampoco.
Shrouded in Mist#086.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#088.src: Once you're done, find me back here! Just don't take too long, eh? Wouldn't want to get bored!
Shrouded in Mist#088.dst: ¡Cuando acabéis, buscadme aquí de nuevo! Eso sí, no tardéis mucho, ¿eh? ¡No querría aburrirme!
Shrouded in Mist#088.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#089.src: Ta ta, newbies! Good luck out there! And just a word of advice - stay on your guard. You never know what the mists may be hiding.
Shrouded in Mist#089.dst: ¡Adiosito, novatos! ¡Suerte ahí fuera! Y un consejo - estad alerta. Nunca se sabe qué esconde la niebla.
Shrouded in Mist#089.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#090.src: Select the structure to sabotage using the checklist.
Shrouded in Mist#090.dst: Elige con la lista la instalación que vas a sabotear.

Shrouded in Mist#091.src: Still a bit lost? Just use your taskbook to find the things I need broken!
Shrouded in Mist#091.dst: ¿Aún perdidos? ¡Usad el libro de misiones para ver qué hay que romper!
Shrouded in Mist#091.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#092.src: Head to the watchtower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and sabotage it using a spell.
Shrouded in Mist#092.dst: Ve a la torre de vigilancia en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y sabotéala con un hechizo.

Shrouded in Mist#093.src: So is this... the place? "Military... Watchtower..." I guess so.
Shrouded in Mist#093.dst: ¿Es este... el sitio? "Torre de vigilancia... militar..." Supongo que sí.
Shrouded in Mist#093.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#094.src: Those supports look rather unstable, don't they? I wonder...
Shrouded in Mist#094.dst: Esos soportes se ven bastante inestables, ¿verdad? Me pregunto...
Shrouded in Mist#094.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#095.src: C-can you deal with them, please?
Shrouded in Mist#095.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#096.src: Huh?! We're under attack - it must be the Canopy!
Shrouded in Mist#096.dst: ¡¿Eh?! Nos atacan - ¡tiene que ser el Dosel!
Shrouded in Mist#096.speaker: Watchtower Guard

Shrouded in Mist#098.src: Let's just get this over with.
Shrouded in Mist#098.dst: Acabemos con esto de una vez.
Shrouded in Mist#098.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#100.src: Check the book, where should we go next?
Shrouded in Mist#100.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#102.src: Head to the water pump at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and sabotage it.
Shrouded in Mist#102.dst: Ve a la bomba de agua en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y sabotéala.

Shrouded in Mist#103.dst: Vale, la bomba de agua entonces...
Shrouded in Mist#103.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#104.src: I think we can work together for this one. Go, um, blast some weak spots on the structure, and I'll... see if I can reverse the water flow.
Shrouded in Mist#104.dst: Creo que en esta podemos trabajar juntos. Ve y, em, revienta algunos puntos débiles de la estructura, y yo... veré si puedo invertir el flujo del agua.
Shrouded in Mist#104.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#105.src: Let's just... get rid of this hunk of junk.
Shrouded in Mist#105.dst: Vamos a... deshacernos de este trasto.
Shrouded in Mist#105.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#106.src: You, um, should try to blast some of the weak points with your magic.
Shrouded in Mist#106.dst: Tú, em, deberías reventar algunos puntos débiles con tu magia.
Shrouded in Mist#106.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#107.src: Did you manage to apply some pressure on the pipes?
Shrouded in Mist#107.dst: ¿Has conseguido meterle presión a las tuberías?
Shrouded in Mist#107.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#108.src: Good, then it's... time for my part, I guess. Um, come talk to me when you're ready.
Shrouded in Mist#108.dst: Bien, entonces... me toca a mí, supongo. Em, ven a hablar conmigo cuando puedas.
Shrouded in Mist#108.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#110.src: Okay... okay. Breathe. I need to... focus.
Shrouded in Mist#110.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#111.src: After... after, um, everything that- that's happened, I've been... struggling with my cur-... ugh. You get what I mean.
Shrouded in Mist#111.dst: Después... después de, em, todo lo que- lo que ha pasado, me cuesta... controlar mi mald-... uf. Ya me entiendes.
Shrouded in Mist#111.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#112.src: It all feels so... so... hopeless! We've lost everyone, and now- now we've lost Yusanu too, and I... I couldn't do anything!
Shrouded in Mist#112.dst: ¡Todo parece tan... tan... desesperado! Hemos perdido a todos, y ahora- ahora también a Yusanu, y yo... ¡no pude hacer nada!
Shrouded in Mist#112.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#113.src: And the last thing we did before was... argue! And now, he's... he's safe, probably, but... I don't know. I wish we hadn't.
Shrouded in Mist#113.dst: Y lo último que hicimos fue... ¡discutir! Y ahora él está... a salvo, seguramente, pero... no sé. Ojalá no lo hubiéramos hecho.
Shrouded in Mist#113.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#114.src: Every time I think about- about any of it, I get so... angry! And the swirling ocean around me starts raging more and more and more, and... and...
Shrouded in Mist#114.dst: Cada vez que pienso en- en cualquier parte de esto, me pongo tan... ¡furiosa! Y el océano que me rodea se embravece más y más y más, y... y...
Shrouded in Mist#114.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#115.src: I'm scared, {u}. I'm scared for Mora... Syndra... Rex, Zeph, the whole Steel Feather- for all of them! And I... there's nothing I can do...
Shrouded in Mist#115.dst: Tengo miedo, {u}. Miedo por Mora... Syndra... Rex, Zeph, toda la Pluma de Acero- ¡por todos ellos! Y yo... no puedo hacer nada...
Shrouded in Mist#115.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#116.src: What if... what if they're all gone? And, and, and it's just us, forever...?
Shrouded in Mist#116.dst: ¿Y si... y si ya no queda nadie? ¿Y solo quedamos nosotros, para siempre...?
Shrouded in Mist#116.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#117.src: I... I know, {u}, I know! I'm... I'm trying, okay?!
Shrouded in Mist#117.dst: Lo... lo sé, {u}, ¡lo sé! Estoy... estoy intentándolo, ¡¿vale?!
Shrouded in Mist#117.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#120.src: I don't know if I, ha, have any left. Everything's... moving so fast...
Shrouded in Mist#120.dst: No sé si me, ja, me queda algo. Todo va... tan deprisa...
Shrouded in Mist#120.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#121.src: I... I never wanted any of this. I just... I just wanted to live...
Shrouded in Mist#121.dst: Yo... yo nunca quise nada de esto. Solo... solo quería vivir...
Shrouded in Mist#121.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#122.src: Sigh... okay. Sui, focus. You can do this.
Shrouded in Mist#122.dst: Suspiro... vale. Sui, concéntrate. Tú puedes.
Shrouded in Mist#122.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#124.src: That's... I don't... how did I...
Shrouded in Mist#124.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#125.src: It... the ocean, it... stopped. I pulled at it, and it... it stopped moving, and...
Shrouded in Mist#125.dst: El... el océano se... detuvo. Tiré de él y... y dejó de moverse, y...
Shrouded in Mist#125.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#126.src: There's... there's no time to, to think about it. It worked, so... so that's good.
Shrouded in Mist#126.dst: No hay... no hay tiempo de pensarlo. Funcionó, así que... bien.
Shrouded in Mist#126.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#127.src: Just... check the book, what's our next stop?
Shrouded in Mist#127.dst: Solo... mira el libro, ¿cuál es la siguiente parada?
Shrouded in Mist#127.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#128.src: I... I think that was the last one. Let's go tell Rurie that it's, um, done.
Shrouded in Mist#128.dst: Creo... creo que ese era el último. Vamos a decirle a Rurie que, em, ya está.
Shrouded in Mist#128.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#129.src: Head to the mining drill at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#129.dst: Ve a la perforadora minera en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#130.dst: Esa es... sin duda la perforadora.
Shrouded in Mist#130.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#131.src: It looks... durable. Like, um, it'll be hard to just... break. We need to find another way...
Shrouded in Mist#131.dst: Parece... resistente. O sea, em, no será fácil... romperla. Hay que buscar otra forma...
Shrouded in Mist#131.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#132.src: There- there isn't any water nearby. So, so if any soldiers show up... please, can you deal with them?
Shrouded in Mist#132.dst: A- aquí cerca no hay agua. Así que, así que si aparecen soldados... por favor, ¿te ocupas tú?
Shrouded in Mist#132.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#133.src: Aha, saboteurs! You won't get away with damaging the crown's property, not on my watch!
Shrouded in Mist#133.dst: ¡Ajá, saboteadores! No dañaréis los bienes de la Corona y os iréis de rositas, ¡no en mi guardia!
Shrouded in Mist#133.speaker: Mistwoods Captain

Shrouded in Mist#134.src: Um... good job, {u}. I didn't think about breaking the controls...
Shrouded in Mist#134.dst: Em... buen trabajo, {u}. No se me ocurrió romper los mandos...
Shrouded in Mist#134.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#135.src: We should check the book, and find our next stop.
Shrouded in Mist#135.dst: Deberíamos mirar el libro y buscar la siguiente parada.
Shrouded in Mist#135.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#136.src: Was that the last one? Let's head back to Rurie and... and tell him it's done.
Shrouded in Mist#136.dst: ¿Era ese el último? Volvamos con Rurie y... y digámosle que está hecho.
Shrouded in Mist#136.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#137.src: Return to Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and discuss the next step.
Shrouded in Mist#137.dst: Vuelve con Rurie en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y habla del siguiente paso.

Shrouded in Mist#138.src: Well well! So the newbies return! Tell me, how did you find your trial?
Shrouded in Mist#138.dst: ¡Vaya, vaya! ¡Los novatos han vuelto! Decidme, ¿qué tal la prueba?
Shrouded in Mist#138.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#139.src: We did what you asked, so... so tell us about our friends, already!
Shrouded in Mist#139.dst: Hicimos lo que pediste, así que... ¡así que habla ya de nuestros amigos!
Shrouded in Mist#139.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#140.src: Ah ah ah! Not so fast! I'm afraid you're not done quite yet!
Shrouded in Mist#140.dst: ¡Ah, ah, ah! ¡No tan deprisa! ¡Me temo que aún no habéis terminado!
Shrouded in Mist#140.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#142.src: Deadly serious, I fear! That, dear friends, was but the first part of your task.
Shrouded in Mist#142.dst: ¡Mortalmente en serio, me temo! Eso, queridos amigos, era solo la primera parte.
Shrouded in Mist#142.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#143.src: Oh, but on the contrary! I received word immediately once you had done the deed.
Shrouded in Mist#143.dst: ¡Oh, al contrario! Me llegó aviso en cuanto lo hicisteis.
Shrouded in Mist#143.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#144.src: Ugh... we had an agreement! You can't just-
Shrouded in Mist#144.dst: Uf... ¡teníamos un trato! No puedes sin más-
Shrouded in Mist#144.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#145.src: But I can. If you want our support, you'll do what we ask. If it is any consolation, this is the last I will ask of you before our deal is concluded.
Shrouded in Mist#145.dst: Pues sí puedo. Si queréis nuestro apoyo, haréis lo que pidamos. Si os sirve de consuelo, es lo último que os pediré antes de cerrar el trato.
Shrouded in Mist#145.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#147.src: I would ask of you to kindly... ehm, transport an {p} citizen here. Do make sure you aren't spotted by anyone else! That could cause... issues.
Shrouded in Mist#147.dst: Os pediría que amablemente... ejem, trajerais aquí a un ciudadano de {p}. ¡Aseguraos de que nadie os vea! Eso podría causar... problemas.
Shrouded in Mist#147.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#149.src: Ah! Allow me to rephrase. You need to kidnap them.
Shrouded in Mist#149.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#151.src: Yes, indeed! Kidnap them, bring them here, and we will deal with the rest.
Shrouded in Mist#151.dst: ¡Sí, exacto! Secuestradlo, traedlo aquí y del resto nos encargamos nosotros.
Shrouded in Mist#151.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#152.src: You want us to just... just snatch a random citizen from their home? And, and what do you mean "deal with the rest?"
Shrouded in Mist#152.dst: ¿Quieres que... que saquemos a un ciudadano de su casa? Y, ¿y qué significa "del resto nos encargamos"?
Shrouded in Mist#152.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#153.src: No questions, young lady! Not if you'd like to ensure the safety of your friend, that is.
Shrouded in Mist#153.dst: ¡Nada de preguntas, jovencita! No si quieres asegurar la seguridad de tu amigo, claro.
Shrouded in Mist#153.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#155.src: You didn't even tell us who we're looking for!
Shrouded in Mist#155.dst: ¡Ni siquiera nos has dicho a quién buscamos!
Shrouded in Mist#155.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#156.src: Ahaha, apologies, my mistake! You'll be looking for the man named Nisen. Bring him here, but don't take too long!
Shrouded in Mist#156.dst: ¡Ajajá, disculpad, culpa mía! Buscaréis a un hombre llamado Nisen. Traedlo aquí, ¡pero no tardéis mucho!
Shrouded in Mist#156.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#157.src: Nisen. Fine. {u}, let's... talk about this outside the cave.
Shrouded in Mist#157.dst: Nisen. Bien. {u}, vamos a... hablar de esto fuera de la cueva.
Shrouded in Mist#157.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#158.src: Leave the cave and discuss the plan with Sui at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#158.dst: Sal de la cueva y habla del plan con Sui en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#160.src: This... this is just getting ridiculous.
Shrouded in Mist#160.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#161.src: We, we need to find a way to get Yusanu back, and... and get out of here.
Shrouded in Mist#161.dst: Tenemos, tenemos que recuperar a Yusanu y... y salir de aquí.
Shrouded in Mist#161.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#162.src: I know, I know, I know! And if we start looking, they'll, they'll notice.
Shrouded in Mist#162.dst: ¡Lo sé, lo sé, lo sé! Y si empezamos a buscar, se, se darán cuenta.
Shrouded in Mist#162.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#163.src: I'm... sick and tired of following that clown's orders. But you're right...
Shrouded in Mist#163.dst: Estoy... harta de obedecer a ese payaso. Pero tienes razón...
Shrouded in Mist#163.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#164.src: It's just... weird. This last task. I don't get it.
Shrouded in Mist#164.dst: Es solo... raro. Esta última tarea. No lo entiendo.
Shrouded in Mist#164.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#165.src: Even if Rurie's out of his mind... I don't see him just- just killing an innocent person. Especially if they're, um, a resistance group.
Shrouded in Mist#165.dst: Aunque Rurie esté como una cabra... no le veo matando- matando sin más a un inocente. Sobre todo si son, em, un grupo de resistencia.
Shrouded in Mist#165.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#166.src: Ugh. I don't know. Maybe if we investigate this Nisen person, we'll... figure out Rurie's reasoning.
Shrouded in Mist#166.dst: Uf. No sé. Quizá si investigamos a ese tal Nisen... entendamos los motivos de Rurie.
Shrouded in Mist#166.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#168.src: Head to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and locate Nisen.
Shrouded in Mist#168.dst: Ve a {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y localiza a Nisen.

Shrouded in Mist#170.src: Phew. Getting up here really wasn't the easiest... the Red Fox back in Auburn really, ha, pales in comparison.
Shrouded in Mist#170.dst: Uf. Subir hasta aquí no ha sido nada fácil... el Red Fox de Auburn, ja, no le llega ni a la suela.
Shrouded in Mist#170.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#171.src: I've been trying to get information on Nisen, but... people don't seem to like me much.
Shrouded in Mist#171.dst: He intentado sacar información sobre Nisen, pero... parece que aquí no les caigo muy bien.
Shrouded in Mist#171.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#172.src: Maybe you'll have some better luck?
Shrouded in Mist#172.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#175.dst: Tengo mucho que hacer, así que...
Shrouded in Mist#175.speaker: Shu

Shrouded in Mist#187.src: ...I don't...see it. You haven't got one- Er. I. I mean. Nothing. No. Definitely, uh...definitely not.
Shrouded in Mist#187.dst: ...no...lo veo. Tú no tienes uno- Eh. Yo. Digo. Nada. No. Desde luego, eh...desde luego que no.
Shrouded in Mist#187.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#188.src: I can't look, I'm really not supposed to be talking to you at all, and Wait, that counts as urgh!
Shrouded in Mist#188.dst: No puedo mirar, en realidad no debería hablar contigo para nada, y Espera, eso también cuenta ¡agh!
Shrouded in Mist#188.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#189.src: ...I'm. I. You. ...ugh, I'm no good at this.
Shrouded in Mist#189.dst: ...yo. Yo. Tú. ...uf, no se me da bien esto.
Shrouded in Mist#189.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#190.src: ...well. ...sorry. Nisen... I. I do know. I shouldn't be telling you, but I do know. Please don't hurt me.
Shrouded in Mist#190.dst: ...bueno. ...perdón. Nisen... yo. Yo sí lo sé. No debería decírtelo, pero lo sé. Por favor, no me hagas daño.
Shrouded in Mist#190.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#191.src: You need to take the zipline north-west. Not the one that goes upwards, though.
Shrouded in Mist#191.dst: Tienes que tomar la tirolina del noroeste. Pero no la que sube.
Shrouded in Mist#191.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#195.src: Search Nisen's house for any [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] clues regarding him.
Shrouded in Mist#195.dst: Registra la casa de Nisen en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] en busca de pistas sobre él.

Shrouded in Mist#196.src: Um, let's hope he's not home...
Shrouded in Mist#196.dst: Em, esperemos que no esté en casa...
Shrouded in Mist#196.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#197.src: That's odd... the latest entry's dated from weeks ago.
Shrouded in Mist#197.dst: Qué raro... la última entrada es de hace semanas.
Shrouded in Mist#197.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#198.src: It's like they stopped writing them abruptly...
Shrouded in Mist#198.dst: Es como si dejara de escribirlas de golpe...
Shrouded in Mist#198.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#199.dst: Sal rápido de la casa de Nisen en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#201.src: Eep! That must be Nisen! We need to think of an excuse...
Shrouded in Mist#201.dst: ¡Ay! ¡Ese debe de ser Nisen! Hay que inventar una excusa...
Shrouded in Mist#201.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#202.src: Excuse me? What are you doing in my abode?
Shrouded in Mist#202.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#203.src: If I am not mistaken, stumbling into other people's abodes is not a custom.
Shrouded in Mist#203.dst: Si no me equivoco, entrar por error en la morada ajena no es costumbre.
Shrouded in Mist#203.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#204.src: Oh... I- I'm so sorry! I- I- we- we thought this was the... bakery.
Shrouded in Mist#204.dst: Ay... ¡l- lo siento! Cre- creíamos que esto era la... panadería.
Shrouded in Mist#204.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#206.src: Oh. Yes, wrong building. The bakery is down at ground level.
Shrouded in Mist#206.dst: Ah. Sí, edificio equivocado. La panadería está abajo, a nivel del suelo.
Shrouded in Mist#206.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#207.src: Oh! Thank you for the directions. We are... so sorry for the misunderstanding.
Shrouded in Mist#207.dst: ¡Ah! Gracias por indicarnos. Sentimos... mucho el malentendido.
Shrouded in Mist#207.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#208.src: Regroup with Sui at the main square at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#208.dst: Reúnete con Sui en la plaza principal en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#210.src: That was close... I'm, um, surprised he believed us.
Shrouded in Mist#210.dst: Por poco... Me, em, sorprende que nos creyera.
Shrouded in Mist#210.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#211.src: I- I panicked, okay! But it worked, didn't it?
Shrouded in Mist#211.dst: ¡M- me entró el pánico, vale! Pero funcionó, ¿no?
Shrouded in Mist#211.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#212.src: He was... surprisingly chatty. That's a nice change compared to everyone else.
Shrouded in Mist#212.dst: Fue... sorprendentemente hablador. Un buen cambio comparado con los demás.
Shrouded in Mist#212.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#213.src: Though, um, he was a bit... odd. He didn't seem too certain about his answers...
Shrouded in Mist#213.dst: Aunque, em, era un poco... raro. No parecía muy seguro de sus respuestas...
Shrouded in Mist#213.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#214.src: I don't know. What are you thinking? Any theories?
Shrouded in Mist#214.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#215.src: I... was thinking the same thing. It'd explain the diary entries stopping abruptly...
Shrouded in Mist#215.dst: Yo... pensaba lo mismo. Explicaría que las entradas del diario se corten de golpe...
Shrouded in Mist#215.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#216.src: Maybe... I guess he could be. I might just be jumping to conclusions.
Shrouded in Mist#216.dst: Quizá... supongo que podría serlo. Igual me precipito al concluir.
Shrouded in Mist#216.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#217.src: Uh... let's workshop that one a little.
Shrouded in Mist#217.dst: Eh... démosle unas vueltas más a esa.
Shrouded in Mist#217.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#218.src: Look, I managed to snag a schedule off his bedside table.
Shrouded in Mist#218.dst: Mira, le birlé un horario de la mesilla de noche.
Shrouded in Mist#218.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#219.src: Listen to this. "Deliver hunting tools from weaponsmith through southern exit at noon."
Shrouded in Mist#219.dst: Escucha esto. "Entregar herramientas de caza del armero por la salida sur al mediodía."
Shrouded in Mist#219.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#220.src: It's weird, right? Something's definitely off with him... but still, kidnapping him and handing him off to some... some random bird-man! I don't like it.
Shrouded in Mist#220.dst: Es raro, ¿verdad? Algo le pasa, seguro... pero aun así, ¡secuestrarlo y entregárselo a un... a un hombre-pájaro cualquiera! No me gusta.
Shrouded in Mist#220.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#221.src: But... we don't have much of a choice. Let's camp outside the southern gate and wait...
Shrouded in Mist#221.dst: Pero... no tenemos mucha opción. Apostémonos fuera de la puerta sur y esperemos...
Shrouded in Mist#221.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#222.dst: Prepárate para secuestrar a Nisen en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#224.src: Guess we'll just have to wait...
Shrouded in Mist#224.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#226.src: I... ha, I've been feeling really out of my depth, here. I've never had to do this much without... um, without their support.
Shrouded in Mist#226.dst: Yo... ja, aquí me siento totalmente superada. Nunca había tenido que hacer tanto sin... em, sin su apoyo.
Shrouded in Mist#226.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#227.src: But... you're here to help, so. Um. Thanks for- for sticking with me. I... I don't think I'd have made it this far without you.
Shrouded in Mist#227.dst: Pero... tú estás aquí ayudando, así que. Em. Gracias por- por quedarte conmigo. Yo... creo que sin ti no habría llegado tan lejos.
Shrouded in Mist#227.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#231.src: Um... I think it worked, though. Can you help me?
Shrouded in Mist#231.dst: Em... pero creo que funcionó. ¿Me echas una mano?
Shrouded in Mist#231.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#233.src: That was... easier than I expected it to be.
Shrouded in Mist#233.dst: Eso fue... más fácil de lo que esperaba.
Shrouded in Mist#233.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#234.src: I kind of just, um, landed on top of him? And... and here we are.
Shrouded in Mist#234.dst: Más o menos, em, ¿le caí encima? Y... y aquí estamos.
Shrouded in Mist#234.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#235.src: We should... probably get moving. I don't want anyone to- to see us!
Shrouded in Mist#235.dst: Deberíamos... movernos ya. ¡No quiero que nadie- que nadie nos vea!
Shrouded in Mist#235.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#236.src: Um! Control is... maybe not the right word. I... ha, I tried to freeze him. So... still working on it. I guess.
Shrouded in Mist#236.dst: ¡Em! Controlar... quizá no sea la palabra. Yo... ja, intenté congelarlo. Así que... sigo practicando. Supongo.
Shrouded in Mist#236.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#237.src: ......how are we going to move him?
Shrouded in Mist#237.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#238.src: Um! I... didn't think about that.
Shrouded in Mist#238.dst: ¡Em! No... no había pensado en eso.
Shrouded in Mist#238.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#239.src: Well well, newbies! Looks like you could use a hand!
Shrouded in Mist#239.dst: ¡Vaya, vaya, novatos! ¡Parece que os vendría bien una mano!
Shrouded in Mist#239.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#240.src: Aah! Wh- where did you come from?!
Shrouded in Mist#240.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#241.src: Why, from the trees, of course! I see you've managed to subdue the good mister Nisen over here, well done, well done.
Shrouded in Mist#241.dst: ¡De los árboles, por supuesto! Veo que habéis reducido al buen señor Nisen, bien hecho, bien hecho.
Shrouded in Mist#241.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#242.src: ...we've done everything you've asked for. Now- now tell us what you know!!
Shrouded in Mist#242.dst: ...hemos hecho todo lo que pediste. ¡¡Ahora- ahora dinos lo que sabes!!
Shrouded in Mist#242.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#243.src: Oh, dear, you thought you two were done? Ha! Ahahaha!
Shrouded in Mist#243.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#245.src: Kidding! Kidding, kidding- goodness, the looks on your faces! What's a little practical joke between friends, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#245.dst: ¡Es broma! Broma, broma- ¡cielos, qué caras! ¿Qué es una bromita entre amigos, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#245.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#246.src: Fine! Fine, fine, I get it! Jeez, lady...
Shrouded in Mist#246.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#247.src: I'll cut it with the jokes... for now. Good news! You've passed the test!
Shrouded in Mist#247.dst: Dejo las bromas... por ahora. ¡Buenas noticias! ¡Habéis pasado la prueba!
Shrouded in Mist#247.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#249.src: Yes, yes, settle down, I will tell you. Give me a moment! Goodness. You're an impatient one, aren't you?
Shrouded in Mist#249.dst: Sí, sí, calma, os lo contaré. ¡Dadme un momento! Cielos. Qué impaciente eres, ¿eh?
Shrouded in Mist#249.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#250.src: I'll be bringing you two to the Canopy! But, ah, one little precaution- I'll have to blindfold you till we arrive, Just a security measure!
Shrouded in Mist#250.dst: ¡Os llevaré a los dos al Dosel! Pero, ah, una pequeña precaución- tendré que vendaros los ojos hasta llegar, ¡solo por seguridad!
Shrouded in Mist#250.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#251.src: Ugh... you know what, I don't even care anymore. Just... bring us to Yusanu.
Shrouded in Mist#251.dst: Uf... ¿sabes qué? Ya me da igual. Solo... llévanos con Yusanu.
Shrouded in Mist#251.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#253.src: Ugh! Fine fine fine! But hurry up.
Shrouded in Mist#253.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#254.src: Rurie, care to explain yourself? Why did you bring these outsiders here?
Shrouded in Mist#254.dst: Rurie, ¿te importaría explicarte? ¿Por qué has traído aquí a estos forasteros?
Shrouded in Mist#254.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#256.src: Ah, you know how it is, Fuhue! I was oh so bored on patrol this morning! You lot aren't exactly the life of the party..
Shrouded in Mist#256.dst: ¡Ah, ya sabes cómo va, Fuhue! ¡La patrulla de esta mañana fue un tostón! Vosotros no sois el alma de la fiesta..
Shrouded in Mist#256.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#257.src: You know Azael has clear rules on recruiting. Did you file the necessary paperwork? Because I didn't see anything on my desk regarding this.
Shrouded in Mist#257.dst: Sabes que Azael tiene reglas claras sobre el reclutamiento. ¿Presentaste el papeleo necesario? Porque no vi nada al respecto en mi mesa.
Shrouded in Mist#257.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#258.src: The... ah, the paperwork was real? I always thought it was something you were making up for the fun of it.
Shrouded in Mist#258.dst: El... ah, ¿el papeleo era real? Siempre pensé que te lo inventabas por diversión.
Shrouded in Mist#258.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#259.src: No. We have the protocols in place for a reason, Captain Rurie. Will you find the time to review them yourself, or must I have Captain Cileon run you through them?
Shrouded in Mist#259.dst: No. Los protocolos existen por algo, capitán Rurie. ¿Sacarás tú mismo el tiempo para repasarlos, o tendré que pedirle al capitán Cileon que te los explique?
Shrouded in Mist#259.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#260.src: Yes, yes, I understand the importance- though, I believe Cileon shares my views on the protocols. Isn't that right, Cileon?
Shrouded in Mist#260.dst: Sí, sí, entiendo su importancia- aunque creo que Cileon comparte mi opinión sobre los protocolos. ¿Verdad, Cileon?
Shrouded in Mist#260.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#262.src: H- hey! Don't just act like, like we aren't right here!
Shrouded in Mist#262.dst: ¡E- eh! ¡No actuéis como si, como si no estuviéramos aquí!
Shrouded in Mist#262.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#263.src: Cileon! That is also against our protocols. We wouldn't want to leave a body for the crown to find, we have far simpler forms of disposal.
Shrouded in Mist#263.dst: ¡Cileon! Eso también va contra los protocolos. No conviene dejar un cadáver para la Corona; tenemos métodos mucho más simples.
Shrouded in Mist#263.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#264.src: And of course, we need to torture any necessary information out of them first - I have heard this a dozen times over.
Shrouded in Mist#264.dst: Y claro, primero hay que sacarles la información a base de tortura - lo he oído ya una docena de veces.
Shrouded in Mist#264.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#265.src: Ah! You were listening! Good, Captain Rurie. We'll knock some sense into you yet.
Shrouded in Mist#265.dst: ¡Ah! ¡Estabas escuchando! Bien, capitán Rurie. Aún te meteremos algo de juicio.
Shrouded in Mist#265.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#266.src: I did have some deerlings bring Nisen into our processing room earlier. Thank you for your service, Captain.
Shrouded in Mist#266.dst: Ya hice que unos cervatillos llevaran a Nisen a la sala de procesado. Gracias por tu servicio, capitán.
Shrouded in Mist#266.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#267.src: Ah, no problem! Hardly even broke a sweat!
Shrouded in Mist#267.dst: ¡Ah, no hay de qué! ¡Casi ni sudé!
Shrouded in Mist#267.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#268.src: Well, I'll be catching up with you later! I suppose if we're following protocols, I'll need to hand these kids off to Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#268.dst: ¡Bueno, ya nos veremos luego! Supongo que, si seguimos los protocolos, tendré que entregarle estos chicos a Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#268.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#269.src: Hey hey, friends! I'm a bit thirsty, so I'll be leaving you now! Think you'll manage to find Azael yourselves?
Shrouded in Mist#269.dst: ¡Eh, eh, amigos! Tengo algo de sed, ¡así que os dejo aquí! ¿Creéis que sabréis encontrar a Azael solos?
Shrouded in Mist#269.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#270.src: Find the leader inside the Canopy at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#270.dst: Encuentra al líder dentro del Dosel en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#271.src: Hm. Rurie told you to find Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#271.dst: Hm. Rurie os mandó buscar a Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#271.speaker: Cileon

Shrouded in Mist#280.src: The schedule's always so busy... and now I have even more to deal with.
Shrouded in Mist#280.dst: La agenda siempre tan llena... y ahora tengo aún más entre manos.
Shrouded in Mist#280.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#281.src: But I suppose I can squeeze you in for questions.
Shrouded in Mist#281.dst: Pero supongo que puedo haceros hueco para preguntas.
Shrouded in Mist#281.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#282.src: I am Fuhue, Team Captain of the Deer clan.
Shrouded in Mist#282.dst: Soy Fuhue, capitana del clan de los Ciervos.
Shrouded in Mist#282.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#283.src: I also function as the overall manager of the Canopy, not just the Deer operations.
Shrouded in Mist#283.dst: También ejerzo de administradora general del Dosel, no solo de las operaciones de los Ciervos.
Shrouded in Mist#283.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#284.src: Master Azael can be found in his hut... it's just to the south-west of here.
Shrouded in Mist#284.dst: Al maestro Azael lo hallaréis en su cabaña... está justo al suroeste de aquí.
Shrouded in Mist#284.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#285.src: From what I've heard, your friend is over there as well.
Shrouded in Mist#285.dst: Por lo que he oído, vuestro amigo también está allí.
Shrouded in Mist#285.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#286.src: I'm afraid so. Insufferable as always...
Shrouded in Mist#286.dst: Eso me temo. Insufrible como siempre...
Shrouded in Mist#286.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#287.src: But he's incredibly talented at what he does. No one else could run the Owls like he does.
Shrouded in Mist#287.dst: Pero es de un talento increíble en lo suyo. Nadie más sabría dirigir a los Búhos como él.
Shrouded in Mist#287.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#289.src: Or not! It's Master Azael's decision as to whether you stay or not. Just hope you manage to impress him.
Shrouded in Mist#289.dst: ¡O no! Que os quedéis o no lo decide el maestro Azael. Esperad lograr impresionarlo.
Shrouded in Mist#289.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#290.src: I have heard about your adventures in the {p} thus far. Very impressive work.
Shrouded in Mist#290.dst: He oído hablar de vuestras andanzas en {p} hasta ahora. Un trabajo muy notable.
Shrouded in Mist#290.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#291.src: Not to interrupt you, but we've been running around all day, and I'm tired. Where's Yusanu?
Shrouded in Mist#291.dst: No quiero interrumpir, pero llevamos todo el día corriendo y estoy cansada. ¿Dónde está Yusanu?
Shrouded in Mist#291.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#294.src: Oh, you're okay... I'm so glad.
Shrouded in Mist#294.dst: Ay, estás bien... Cuánto me alegro.
Shrouded in Mist#294.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#295.src: Yes, reunited at last. But now that you are here, it is time for business.
Shrouded in Mist#295.dst: Sí, reunidos al fin. Pero ya que estáis aquí, es hora de hablar de negocios.
Shrouded in Mist#295.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#296.src: I had Yusanu inform me of your adventures in the {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#296.dst: Hice que Yusanu me informara de vuestras andanzas en {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#296.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#297.src: And it would appear our causes are in alignment... to dismantle the crown. We here in the Canopy have taken a very active approach to this end.
Shrouded in Mist#297.dst: Y parece que nuestras causas coinciden... desmantelar a la Corona. Aquí en el Dosel hemos tomado un camino muy activo a tal fin.
Shrouded in Mist#297.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#298.src: We had established three teams, each with their own responsibility. Each team attacks the crown on different fronts.
Shrouded in Mist#298.dst: Establecimos tres equipos, cada uno con su cometido. Cada equipo ataca a la Corona en un frente distinto.
Shrouded in Mist#298.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#299.src: The Owls are our eyes and ears. They are also our most efficient assassins. Captain Rurie, who you have already had the pleasure of meeting, is one of our most lethal members.
Shrouded in Mist#299.dst: Los Búhos son nuestros ojos y oídos. También son nuestros asesinos más eficaces. El capitán Rurie, a quien ya habéis tenido el placer de conocer, es uno de nuestros miembros más letales.
Shrouded in Mist#299.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#300.src: The Foxes are our assault team. They are skilled swordsmen utilizing techniques native to the {p}. They are trained to never lose a duel.
Shrouded in Mist#300.dst: Los Zorros son nuestro equipo de asalto. Son espadachines diestros que usan técnicas propias de {p}. Están entrenados para no perder jamás un duelo.
Shrouded in Mist#300.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#301.src: The Deers are our command team, the brains behind the operation. They are also responsible for... taking care of spies within {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#301.dst: Los Ciervos son nuestro equipo de mando, el cerebro de la operación. También se encargan de... ocuparse de los espías dentro de {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#301.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#303.src: Spies. That man you brought in, Nisen... I fear that is no longer Nisen. Weeks ago, he had been replaced by one of the crown's elite spies. We know them as Changelings.
Shrouded in Mist#303.dst: Espías. Ese hombre que trajisteis, Nisen... me temo que ya no es Nisen. Hace semanas lo sustituyó uno de los espías de élite de la Corona. Los llamamos cambiaformas.
Shrouded in Mist#303.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#304.src: The {p} have been plagued for years by these masterful creatures of disguise. Whenever one is recognized, we capture them and hold them for questioning.
Shrouded in Mist#304.dst: {p} lleva años plagada de estas criaturas maestras del disfraz. Cuando se reconoce a una, la capturamos y la retenemos para interrogarla.
Shrouded in Mist#304.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#305.src: The people of our region have developed a form of identification, the medallions. If you do not possess one, many will refuse to speak with you.
Shrouded in Mist#305.dst: La gente de nuestra región ha creado una forma de identificarse: los medallones. Si no tenéis uno, muchos se negarán a hablaros.
Shrouded in Mist#305.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#306.src: Um... Azael, sir, I don't mean to come off as rude, but... Rurie told us there were news on our friends from the Roughworks.
Shrouded in Mist#306.dst: Em... señor Azael, no quiero parecer grosera, pero... Rurie nos dijo que había noticias de nuestros amigos de Roughworks.
Shrouded in Mist#306.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#307.src: In a sense, there are. However, we still are processing the information the Owls have returned with from the festival. I cannot offer anything just yet.
Shrouded in Mist#307.dst: En cierto sentido, las hay. Pero aún estamos procesando la información que los Búhos trajeron del festival. Todavía no puedo ofreceros nada.
Shrouded in Mist#307.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#308.src: Rest assured, we will not withhold anything once we have gone through everything.
Shrouded in Mist#308.dst: Estad tranquilos: no ocultaremos nada cuando lo hayamos revisado todo.
Shrouded in Mist#308.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#309.src: I give you my word that we will continue searching for any word of your friends.
Shrouded in Mist#309.dst: Os doy mi palabra de que seguiremos buscando noticias de vuestros amigos.
Shrouded in Mist#309.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#310.src: It... it finally feels like we have a second to breath.
Shrouded in Mist#310.dst: Por fin... por fin parece que podemos respirar un poco.
Shrouded in Mist#310.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#311.src: I'll stay with Yusanu and wait for them to sort through the information.
Shrouded in Mist#311.dst: Me quedaré con Yusanu y esperaré a que revisen la información.
Shrouded in Mist#311.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#312.src: I'm going to focus on figuring out what this device is used for.
Shrouded in Mist#312.dst: Voy a centrarme en averiguar para qué sirve este aparato.
Shrouded in Mist#312.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#313.src: It must have be worth stealing it... somehow.
Shrouded in Mist#313.dst: Por algo merecía la pena robarlo... digo yo.
Shrouded in Mist#313.speaker: Sui

Skittering Spiders#000.src: You should report back to Yahya and tell him the spiders have been cleared out.
Skittering Spiders#000.dst: Deberías volver con Yahya y decirle que las arañas ya no están.

Skittering Spiders#001.src: I-is it done? S-s-spiders... No more spiders? Is my m-mushroom patch cl-... cleared?
Skittering Spiders#001.dst: ¿Y-ya está? A-a-arañas... ¿Ya no hay arañas? ¿Mi h-huerto de setas está l-... limpio?

Skittering Spiders#003.src: Well, it looks cleared to me. These are... uh... some fine mushrooms!
Skittering Spiders#003.dst: Bueno, a mí me parece limpio. Estas son... eh... ¡unas setas estupendas!

Skittering Spiders#004.src: Th-thank you soldiers! That was-... I mean. It was f-fine, I g-... guess.
Skittering Spiders#004.dst: ¡G-gracias, soldados! Eso fue-... digo. E-estuvo bien, s-... supongo.

Skittering Spiders#006.src: I am everywhere. M-mushroom soup, stew, soup m-makes me fast!
Skittering Spiders#006.dst: Estoy en todas partes. S-sopa de setas, guiso, ¡la sopa me hace r-rápido!

Solidarity of Steel#000.src: I hope the brothers weren't too much of a nuisance. Yuman, especially... he's a good lad, but his enthusiasm gets the best of him sometimes.
Solidarity of Steel#000.dst: Espero que los hermanos no hayan dado mucha guerra. Yuman, sobre todo... es buen chico, pero a veces se le va la emoción.

Solidarity of Steel#001.src: My water's been out for two days now. Last bloke I tried to get on the job refused.
Solidarity of Steel#001.dst: Llevo ya dos días sin agua. El último tipo al que llamé para el trabajo se negó.

Solidarity of Steel#002.src: These boards can last generations, you're sure of it. And this one is covered in notes of all kinds! Even graffiti carvings mean something. There's a carving in one corner that catches your eye...
Solidarity of Steel#002.dst: Estos tablones duran generaciones, estás seguro. ¡Y este está cubierto de notas de todo tipo! Hasta los grabados de los grafitis significan algo. Hay uno en una esquina que te llama la atención...

Solidarity of Steel#003.src: You made it back to Torann.

Solidarity of Steel#004.src: That's what we call the {p} sewers and waterworks. Maze of pipes and brickwork, some of it old old. Vagrants and criminals been settling there for years.
Solidarity of Steel#004.dst: Así llamamos a las cloacas y canalizaciones de {p}. Un laberinto de tuberías y ladrillo, parte muy antiguo. Vagabundos y criminales llevan años ahí.

Solidarity of Steel#006.src: You need to pack something that will help Aihan sleep, something to remind her of home, and something to entertain her at the station.
Solidarity of Steel#006.dst: Tienes que llevarle a Aihan algo que la ayude a dormir, algo que le recuerde a casa y algo con lo que entretenerse en la estación.

Solidarity of Steel#007.src: Wh-what?! H-how did you fit my whole m-mattress in here? Was... was there not anything smaller?
Solidarity of Steel#007.dst: ¡¿Q-qué?! ¿C-cómo has metido aquí mi c-colchón entero? ¿No... no había nada más pequeño?

Solidarity of Steel#008.src: Regroup with your friends outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#008.dst: Reúnete con tus amigos fuera de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#009.src: ...that's everyone, then. Good. Good, you're all safe. I wasn't certain, after...
Solidarity of Steel#009.dst: ...así que estamos todos. Bien. Bien, estáis a salvo. No lo tenía claro, tras...
Solidarity of Steel#009.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#010.src: Are you just going to ignore what happened back there?
Solidarity of Steel#010.dst: ¿Vas a ignorar sin más lo que pasó allí?
Solidarity of Steel#010.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#012.src: Zhiraok's blessing... it gives him the power to revive himself. It takes some time, though.
Solidarity of Steel#012.dst: La bendición de Zhiraok... le da el poder de revivirse a sí mismo. Aunque tarda un poco.
Solidarity of Steel#012.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#013.src: If we wanted any chance to get away, I had to- I had to kill him.
Solidarity of Steel#013.dst: Si queríamos alguna opción de escapar, tenía que- tenía que matarlo.
Solidarity of Steel#013.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#014.src: Well, in any case, we're all here! We'll be meeting with my contact soon, after which we'll certainly be safe, but...
Solidarity of Steel#014.dst: Bueno, en cualquier caso, ¡estamos todos! Pronto veremos a mi contacto y entonces sí estaremos a salvo, pero...
Solidarity of Steel#014.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#016.src: We have some time to spare. You've had a few days to acclimate to the Roughworks - any thoughts?
Solidarity of Steel#016.dst: Nos sobra algo de tiempo. Habéis tenido unos días para aclimataros a Roughworks, ¿qué os parece?
Solidarity of Steel#016.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#017.src: It is, isn't it? It's much busier, less open, and yet... it carries a certain nostalgia for me.
Solidarity of Steel#017.dst: Lo es, ¿verdad? Hay más bullicio, menos espacio abierto y aun así... me despierta cierta nostalgia.
Solidarity of Steel#017.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#018.src: Nostalgic? This place, really? What's so nostalgic about loud factories and urban sprawl?
Solidarity of Steel#018.dst: ¿Nostalgia? ¿De este sitio, en serio? ¿Qué tiene de nostálgico tanta fábrica ruidosa y tanto bloque?
Solidarity of Steel#018.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#020.src: Well, I'm with Rex on th- this- this one! I wouldn't want to s- st- stay here for long, it's s- so... smoggy.
Solidarity of Steel#020.dst: ¡Pues en e- esto- esto estoy con Rex! No querría q- que- quedarme mucho aquí, hay t- tanto... humo.
Solidarity of Steel#020.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#021.src: Certainly, it is not as... clean, I suppose, as the {p}. The smell of the morning dew shall be sorely missed!
Solidarity of Steel#021.dst: Desde luego, no es tan... limpio, supongo, como {p}. ¡Cómo se echará de menos el olor del rocío matinal!
Solidarity of Steel#021.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#022.src: Alright, children, get it out of your system. Please refrain from speaking poorly of the Roughworks once we meet with my contact... I'd like to make a good first impression.
Solidarity of Steel#022.dst: Muy bien, niños, desahogaos ahora. Por favor, absteneos de hablar mal de Roughworks cuando veamos a mi contacto... Me gustaría causar buena impresión.
Solidarity of Steel#022.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#023.src: Oh, you wouldn't think so if you actually had to live here.
Solidarity of Steel#023.dst: Ya no pensarías eso si tuvieras que vivir aquí de verdad.
Solidarity of Steel#023.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#025.src: What?! Most of them would agree with me!
Solidarity of Steel#025.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#026.src: I think I'm with Rex on this- this one! I can't im-imagine- imagine living here, it's s- so... smoggy.
Solidarity of Steel#026.dst: ¡Creo que en e- esto estoy con Rex! No me im-imagino- imagino viviendo aquí, hay t- tanto... humo.
Solidarity of Steel#026.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#027.src: Certainly, it is not as... clean, I suppose, as the {p}. The smell of the morning dew shall be sorely missed!
Solidarity of Steel#027.dst: Desde luego, no es tan... limpio, supongo, como {p}. ¡Cómo se echará de menos el olor del rocío matinal!
Solidarity of Steel#027.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#028.src: Alright, children, get it out of your system. Please refrain from speaking poorly of the Roughworks once we meet with my contact... no matter how much they may or may not agree.
Solidarity of Steel#028.dst: Muy bien, niños, desahogaos ahora. Por favor, absteneos de hablar mal de Roughworks cuando veamos a mi contacto... estén o no de acuerdo.
Solidarity of Steel#028.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#029.src: In any case, I was told to meet them in the city at noon - {p} is usually empty during the daytime.
Solidarity of Steel#029.dst: En cualquier caso, me dijeron que los viera en la ciudad al mediodía; {p} suele estar vacía de día.
Solidarity of Steel#029.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#030.src: What? It's empty during the day? Th- that doesn't make a lot of sense.
Solidarity of Steel#030.dst: ¿Qué? ¿Vacía de día? E- eso no tiene mucho sentido.
Solidarity of Steel#030.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#031.src: I'm afraid the lives of the citizens of the Roughworks revolve entirely around their work. The work day starts at sunrise, and ends with sunset. So, let's just wait...
Solidarity of Steel#031.dst: Me temo que la vida de los habitantes de Roughworks gira por completo en torno al trabajo. La jornada empieza al amanecer y acaba al anochecer. Así que esperemos...
Solidarity of Steel#031.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#033.src: Maybe they, um, just read time differently, here...? Or maybe we-
Solidarity of Steel#033.dst: ¿Puede que aquí, eh, midan la hora de otro modo...? O puede que nosotros-
Solidarity of Steel#033.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#035.src: Hello, Quill. It's been a while since we've met face to face, hasn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#035.dst: Hola, Quill. Hacía tiempo que no nos veíamos en persona, ¿verdad?
Solidarity of Steel#035.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#036.src: Indeed, indeed... I hope your journey to cross to the Roughworks wasn't too difficult.
Solidarity of Steel#036.dst: Cierto, cierto... Espero que el viaje hasta Roughworks no fuera demasiado duro.
Solidarity of Steel#036.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#037.src: Could have been better, could have been worse. We expected difficulties going in.
Solidarity of Steel#037.dst: Pudo ir mejor y pudo ir peor. Ya contábamos con dificultades.
Solidarity of Steel#037.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#038.src: I see... You'll have to tell me more later. Now, which of you is the cursed one? I'd like a look at you.
Solidarity of Steel#038.dst: Ya veo... Luego me contarás más. Y bien, ¿quién de vosotros es el maldito? Me gustaría verte.
Solidarity of Steel#038.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#039.src: Mmhm! So you're the one, eh? What I'd heard in correspondence had me thinking you'd be different than us. Seems like I was right!
Solidarity of Steel#039.dst: ¡Ajá! Así que eres tú, ¿eh? Por lo que leí en las cartas, pensaba que serías distinto a nosotros. ¡Parece que acerté!
Solidarity of Steel#039.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#040.src: There's a look in your eyes, something to your gait. In all my years I've seen quite a lot, and everything that shouts "promise" is there in you.
Solidarity of Steel#040.dst: Hay algo en tu mirada, algo en tu forma de andar. He visto mucho en todos mis años, y todo lo que grita "promesa" está en ti.
Solidarity of Steel#040.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#041.src: Ha! Yes, yes, I suppose that would be the correct response to that question. You'd do well to stick to that script.
Solidarity of Steel#041.dst: ¡Ja! Sí, sí, supongo que esa es la respuesta correcta a esa pregunta. Harías bien en seguir ese guion.
Solidarity of Steel#041.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#042.src: But Syndra has already written much about you in our correspondence. No need to be shy.
Solidarity of Steel#042.dst: Pero Syndra ya me ha escrito mucho sobre ti en nuestras cartas. No hace falta que te cortes.
Solidarity of Steel#042.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#043.src: Blessed, cursed... They're two sides of the same coin, in my eyes. I've seen my fair share of both in my time leading this group, heh heh...
Solidarity of Steel#043.dst: Benditos, malditos... Para mí son dos caras de la misma moneda. He visto de sobra de ambos en mis años al frente de este grupo, je, je...
Solidarity of Steel#043.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#044.src: I see no reason not to celebrate differences, and what better difference could there be?
Solidarity of Steel#044.dst: No veo motivo para no celebrar las diferencias, ¿y qué diferencia podría ser mejor?
Solidarity of Steel#044.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#045.src: ... Ah, we'll have more time to speak later. We'd best make our way down to the station, we can sort out arrangements there-
Solidarity of Steel#045.dst: ... Ah, ya habrá tiempo de hablar luego. Mejor bajamos a la estación, allí podemos organizarlo todo-
Solidarity of Steel#045.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#046.src: Hey, hey! We're leaving before we even get our introductions in? Why'd we even come here then, man?
Solidarity of Steel#046.dst: ¡Eh, eh! ¿Nos vamos sin ni siquiera presentarnos? ¿Entonces para qué hemos venido, tío?
Solidarity of Steel#046.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#047.src: Yes, Yuman, why did we come here? You're the one who dragged us all along.
Solidarity of Steel#047.dst: Sí, Yuman, ¿para qué hemos venido? Tú nos arrastraste a todos.
Solidarity of Steel#047.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#048.src: Well, hey, I just thought this old man could use some help, that's all! Six people's a lot for one guy to greet, you know?
Solidarity of Steel#048.dst: ¡Eh, oye, solo pensé que al viejo le vendría bien una mano! Seis personas son muchas para recibirlas uno solo, ¿sabes?
Solidarity of Steel#048.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#049.src: Yes, yes... Well, alright, since you all are here, we may as well handle introductions now.
Solidarity of Steel#049.dst: Sí, sí... Bueno, está bien, ya que estáis todos aquí, hagamos las presentaciones ahora.
Solidarity of Steel#049.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#050.src: I'm Yuman! I'm the greatest musician of our age, man! And I'm super muscular and cool, and-
Solidarity of Steel#050.dst: ¡Soy Yuman! ¡El mejor músico de nuestra era, tío! Y soy superfuerte y molón, y-
Solidarity of Steel#050.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#051.src: Alright, Yuman, that's enough. I'm Yulie, oldest of three. I work as a detective in {p}.
Solidarity of Steel#051.dst: Vale, Yuman, ya basta. Soy Yulie, el mayor de tres hermanos. Trabajo de detective en {p}.
Solidarity of Steel#051.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#052.src: Booooring! Come on, bro, have some-
Solidarity of Steel#052.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#053.src: And I'm Yusanu! I'm a mechanic. Quill's told us a lot about you, it's a pleasure to finally meet you.
Solidarity of Steel#053.dst: ¡Y yo soy Yusanu! Soy mecánico. Quill nos ha hablado mucho de vosotros, encantado de conoceros por fin.
Solidarity of Steel#053.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#054.src: Uh... S- same, I guess. This is all s- st- still a bit new.
Solidarity of Steel#054.dst: Eh... L- lo mismo digo. Todo esto t- to- todavía es nuevo.
Solidarity of Steel#054.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#055.src: Eh, you'll get used to it. This place has a way of growing on you.
Solidarity of Steel#055.dst: Bah, ya te acostumbrarás. Este sitio acaba gustándote.
Solidarity of Steel#055.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#056.src: Ah, if I may - I don't suppose you'd have anything prepared for us to be able to blend in better? I'd imagine we stick out a fair bit right now.
Solidarity of Steel#056.dst: Ah, si se me permite: ¿no tendríais algo preparado para que pasemos más desapercibidos? Imagino que ahora mismo llamamos bastante la atención.
Solidarity of Steel#056.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#057.src: Hm... I hadn't quite considered that. Boys, why don't you handle that while Syndra and I go ahead to sort out living arrangements?
Solidarity of Steel#057.dst: Hm... No había caído en eso. Chicos, ¿os encargáis vosotros mientras Syndra y yo vamos a organizar el alojamiento?
Solidarity of Steel#057.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#059.src: Leaves, why don't you join them? It'll be a good opportunity to get to know each other.
Solidarity of Steel#059.dst: Hojas, ¿por qué no vais con ellos? Será buena ocasión para conoceros.
Solidarity of Steel#059.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#060.src: Um... I think I'd rather go with you. I'd like to rest a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#060.dst: Eh... Creo que prefiero ir contigo. Me gustaría descansar un poco.
Solidarity of Steel#060.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#061.src: ... Then I'll tag along as well. Perhaps I could be of use at the station!
Solidarity of Steel#061.dst: ... Entonces yo también os acompaño. ¡Quizá sea de utilidad en la estación!
Solidarity of Steel#061.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#062.src: Very well. Follow me, we have an access point this way.
Solidarity of Steel#062.dst: Muy bien. Seguidme, tenemos un acceso por aquí.
Solidarity of Steel#062.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#063.src: Well. I'm afraid I can't stay either... the station doesn't exactly run by itself. We'll have to catch up later!
Solidarity of Steel#063.dst: Bueno. Me temo que yo tampoco puedo quedarme... la estación no funciona sola. ¡Ya nos pondremos al día!
Solidarity of Steel#063.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#064.src: Ugh, boring as usual... Oh well! Yulie and I can show you around just fine by ourselves.
Solidarity of Steel#064.dst: Uf, aburrido como siempre... ¡Da igual! Yulie y yo os enseñamos esto de sobra nosotros solos.
Solidarity of Steel#064.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#065.src: We should start with getting you all some new clothes.
Solidarity of Steel#065.dst: Deberíamos empezar por conseguiros ropa nueva.
Solidarity of Steel#065.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#066.src: Hey! Wh- what's wrong with our cur- current ones!
Solidarity of Steel#066.dst: ¡Eh! ¡Q- qué tiene de malo la que lle- llevamos!
Solidarity of Steel#066.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#067.src: They make you look like poor forest people, man!
Solidarity of Steel#067.dst: ¡Os hace parecer pobres gentes del bosque, tío!
Solidarity of Steel#067.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#068.src: Yuman! Don't be rude to our guests.
Solidarity of Steel#068.dst: ¡Yuman! No seas grosero con las visitas.
Solidarity of Steel#068.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#069.src: What, I'm just saying! Am I wrong?
Solidarity of Steel#069.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#070.src: Well! At l- lea- at least we don't smell bad!
Solidarity of Steel#070.dst: ¡Bueno! ¡Al m- me- al menos no olemos mal!
Solidarity of Steel#070.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#071.src: Alright, boys, settle down, play nice. You're both pretty. So, Yulie, what's the plan?
Solidarity of Steel#071.dst: Vale, chicos, calmaos y portaos bien. Los dos sois guapísimos. Y bien, Yulie, ¿cuál es el plan?
Solidarity of Steel#071.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#072.src: I'll have to swing by some shops... Yuman, in the meantime, why don't you see if you can find any clothes around here?
Solidarity of Steel#072.dst: Tendré que pasarme por unas tiendas... Yuman, mientras tanto, ¿por qué no miras si encuentras ropa por aquí?
Solidarity of Steel#072.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#073.src: Great, I'll join you. I need to get re-acquainted with things around here.
Solidarity of Steel#073.dst: Genial, te acompaño. Necesito volver a familiarizarme con esto.
Solidarity of Steel#073.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#074.src: Sure, that works. Any complaints, Yuman?
