Solidarity of Steel#074.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#075.src: If I had 'em, you'd hear it loud and clear. The plan's good, bro.
Solidarity of Steel#075.dst: Si las tuviera, las oirías alto y claro. El plan está bien, tío.
Solidarity of Steel#075.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#076.src: Okay, we'll meet back at the Steel Feather once we're done. See you then!
Solidarity of Steel#076.dst: Vale, nos vemos en la Pluma de Acero al terminar. ¡Hasta luego!
Solidarity of Steel#076.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#077.src: ...Well! I've got a plan of my own in mind. Not exactly what Yulie had in mind, but... heh, what he doesn't know won't hurt him. Follow me, leaf people!
Solidarity of Steel#077.dst: ...¡Bueno! Yo tengo mi propio plan. No es justo lo que Yulie pensaba, pero... je, lo que no sepa no le hará daño. ¡Seguidme, gente de las hojas!
Solidarity of Steel#077.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#078.src: Find clothes in the city by following Yuman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#078.dst: Busca ropa en la ciudad siguiendo a Yuman en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#079.src: Hey! Hold- h- hold up! What's your p- p- plan?
Solidarity of Steel#079.dst: ¡Eh! ¡Es- e- espera! ¿Cuál es tu p- p- plan?
Solidarity of Steel#079.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#080.src: Oh! Right. We're going to steal from the clotheslines, of course.
Solidarity of Steel#080.dst: ¡Ah! Cierto. Vamos a robar de los tendederos, claro.
Solidarity of Steel#080.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#081.src: ... I'm no stranger to st- stealing, but... isn't it a bit r- r-... a bit risky to do that in the m- middle of the city?
Solidarity of Steel#081.dst: ... No me es ajeno el ro- robar, pero... ¿no es un poco a- a-... un poco arriesgado hacerlo en m- mitad de la ciudad?
Solidarity of Steel#081.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#082.src: Man, haven't you noticed how empty {p} is?
Solidarity of Steel#082.dst: Tío, ¿no has visto lo vacía que está {p}?
Solidarity of Steel#082.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#083.src: Figures you wouldn't know, since you're not from around here! It's pretty simple.
Solidarity of Steel#083.dst: ¡Normal que no lo sepas, si no eres de aquí! Es muy sencillo.
Solidarity of Steel#083.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#084.src: It's the middle of the workday! People are out at their jobs, they don't have time to stroll around the city! Got to make a living somehow, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#084.dst: ¡Estamos en plena jornada laboral! La gente está trabajando, ¡no tiene tiempo de pasear por la ciudad! Hay que ganarse la vida, ¿no?
Solidarity of Steel#084.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#085.src: A- and since they're out at their jobs, they're n- n- not home... you want us to just walk th- through someone's apartment, then?
Solidarity of Steel#085.dst: Y- y si están trabajando, n- n- no están en casa... ¿entonces quieres que crucemos s- sin más el piso de alguien?
Solidarity of Steel#085.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#086.src: Yep, yep, exaaaactly! You get it. I think you and I are gonna get along great.
Solidarity of Steel#086.dst: ¡Sí, sí, exaaaacto! Lo pillas. Creo que tú y yo nos vamos a llevar genial.
Solidarity of Steel#086.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#087.src: Yeah... sure. L- let- let's get going! I think we can rea- reach the rooftops from this house. We'll find some clothes up there.
Solidarity of Steel#087.dst: Ya... claro. ¡V- va- vamos! Creo que desde esta casa lle- llegamos a los tejados. Allí arriba encontraremos ropa.
Solidarity of Steel#087.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#088.src: Ha! Really? You should... you should pay more attention, man. The moment you stop keeping an eye on things is the moment things go wrong, y'know? Jeez.
Solidarity of Steel#088.dst: ¡Ja! ¿En serio? Deberías... deberías fijarte más, tío. En cuanto dejas de vigilar es cuando todo se tuerce, ¿sabes? Madre mía.
Solidarity of Steel#088.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#089.src: What I was gonna say is that it's the middle of the workday. People are out at their jobs! No time to stroll around the city, or anything.
Solidarity of Steel#089.dst: Lo que iba a decir es que estamos en plena jornada laboral. ¡La gente está trabajando! No hay tiempo de pasear por la ciudad ni nada.
Solidarity of Steel#089.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#090.src: A- and since they're out at their jobs, they're n- not home... you want us to just walk th- through someone's apartment, then?
Solidarity of Steel#090.dst: Y- y si están trabajando, n- no están en casa... ¿entonces quieres que crucemos s- sin más el piso de alguien?
Solidarity of Steel#090.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#091.src: Mhm, yep, you get it. They won't mind! Cause they won' know we were there, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#091.dst: Ajá, sí, lo pillas. ¡No les importará! Porque ni sabrán que estuvimos allí, ¿no?
Solidarity of Steel#091.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#092.src: I- I- I guess. Okay, let's get going! I think we can rea- reach the rooftops from this house. We'll find some clothes up there.
Solidarity of Steel#092.dst: S- s- supongo. ¡Vale, vamos! Creo que desde esta casa lle- llegamos a los tejados. Allí arriba encontraremos ropa.
Solidarity of Steel#092.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#093.src: Climb up the apartment at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and jump across the roofs.
Solidarity of Steel#093.dst: Sube al edificio en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y salta por los tejados.

Solidarity of Steel#094.src: Try n-not to fall off the roof...
Solidarity of Steel#094.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#095.src: Jump across the roofs to the first spot at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Solidarity of Steel#095.dst: Salta por los tejados hasta el primer punto en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Solidarity of Steel#096.src: I'll be right be- behind you! Let's get up to the rooftops. I think we can rea- reach them through this building.
Solidarity of Steel#096.dst: ¡Voy justo de- detrás de ti! Subamos a los tejados. Creo que lle- llegamos por este edificio.
Solidarity of Steel#096.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#097.src: ...what the hell are you doin' jumpin' around?
Solidarity of Steel#097.dst: ...¿qué demonios haces dando saltos por ahí?
Solidarity of Steel#097.speaker: Timaca Mason

Solidarity of Steel#098.src: Buzz off, some've us got jobs.
Solidarity of Steel#098.speaker: Timaca Mason

Solidarity of Steel#099.src: Here we are! Best clothes in the entire province, man! Take your pick!
Solidarity of Steel#099.dst: ¡Ya estamos! ¡La mejor ropa de toda la provincia, tío! ¡Elegid!
Solidarity of Steel#099.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#100.src: ... Wait a mi- min- minute. There are only dr- dresses here?
Solidarity of Steel#100.dst: ... Un m- mo- momento. ¿Aquí solo hay v- vestidos?
Solidarity of Steel#100.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#101.src: Oh, yeah. My bad, man! Bet you could pull it off though, eh?
Solidarity of Steel#101.dst: Ah, ya. ¡Culpa mía, tío! Aunque seguro que te quedaría bien, ¿eh?
Solidarity of Steel#101.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#102.src: I- y- you- wh- wh- what- h- huh? Ev- even- even if I could, Rex and Mora would- w- would never wear- wear these. A- and- and they're n- n- not-
Solidarity of Steel#102.dst: Y- t- tú- q- q- qué- e- ¿eh? A- aun- aun si pudiera, Rex y Mora n- nunca- nunca se pon- pondrían esto. Y- y- y además n- n- no-
Solidarity of Steel#102.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#103.src: Relax, I'm just messing with you, man! We'll find some more. But, hey, grab one if you want, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#103.dst: ¡Relájate, solo te estoy vacilando, tío! Ya encontraremos más. Pero oye, coge uno si quieres, ¿no?
Solidarity of Steel#103.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#105.src: I'll take one for Sui, just in c- cas- just in case. And let's hurry after him. I'm getting sick a- and-... s- sick and tired of this place already.
Solidarity of Steel#105.dst: Cogeré uno para Sui, por si a- aca- por si acaso. Y vamos tras él, rápido. Ya estoy h- har-... h- harto de este sitio.
Solidarity of Steel#105.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#106.src: Continue looking for clothes on the rooftops at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#106.dst: Sigue buscando ropa en los tejados en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#107.src: It's g-going to be a long c- couple of days, huh?
Solidarity of Steel#107.dst: V-van a ser unos d- días muy largos, ¿eh?
Solidarity of Steel#107.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#108.src: Careful there, princess! Wouldn't want to fall, eh?
Solidarity of Steel#108.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#110.src: Anyway, these clothes should work, yeah? Looks like enough for all of you!
Solidarity of Steel#110.dst: En fin, esta ropa servirá, ¿no? ¡Parece que hay para todos!
Solidarity of Steel#110.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#111.src: ...yes, this sh- sh- should be fine. Thank you f- for showing us. Let's just grab them a- and go.
Solidarity of Steel#111.dst: ...sí, esto s- se- servirá. Gracias p- por enseñárnoslo. Cojámoslas y- y vámonos.
Solidarity of Steel#111.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#112.src: Sounds good! You saw the big statue in the river when you were entering the city, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#112.dst: ¡Perfecto! Visteis la estatua grande del río al entrar en la ciudad, ¿no?
Solidarity of Steel#112.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#113.src: The one to the s- south- {u}, yes.
Solidarity of Steel#113.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#114.src: That's the one! I'll wait for you there, then we can head to the station. And hurry up, would ya?
Solidarity of Steel#114.dst: ¡Esa misma! Os espero allí y luego vamos a la estación. Y daos prisa, ¿queréis?
Solidarity of Steel#114.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#115.src: Find the statue in the water at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#115.dst: Encuentra la estatua en el agua en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#116.src: Ugh... How can one guy be s- s- so annoying?
Solidarity of Steel#116.dst: Uf... ¿Cómo puede ser alguien t- t- tan pesado?
Solidarity of Steel#116.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#117.src: Whatever... Let's just go to that s- st- statue. It's in the river t- to the southwest.
Solidarity of Steel#117.dst: Da igual... Vamos a esa e- es- estatua. Está en el río a- al suroeste.
Solidarity of Steel#117.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#118.src: Ey, there you are! What's with the holdup?
Solidarity of Steel#118.dst: ¡Eh, ahí estáis! ¿A qué viene el retraso?
Solidarity of Steel#118.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#119.src: I was just telling Zeph all about our base of operations! Here, I can start over if you-
Solidarity of Steel#119.dst: ¡Le estaba contando a Zeph todo sobre nuestra base de operaciones! Mira, puedo empezar de nuevo si-
Solidarity of Steel#119.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#120.src: Let's just h- head in! Even if the city's empty, the longer we stay out here, the more we ri- risk getting seen.
Solidarity of Steel#120.dst: ¡E- entremos ya! Aunque la ciudad esté vacía, cuanto más estemos fuera, más ri- riesgo de que nos vean.
Solidarity of Steel#120.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#121.src: Yeah, yeah, you're right. Okay, follow me! It's just down here.
Solidarity of Steel#121.dst: Sí, sí, tienes razón. ¡Vale, seguidme! Es aquí abajo.
Solidarity of Steel#121.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#123.src: Sorry if our secret base isn't up to your high standards, princess! We've got to stay hidden somehow, eh?
Solidarity of Steel#123.dst: ¡Perdona si nuestra base secreta no está a tu altura, princesa! De algún modo hay que esconderse, ¿eh?
Solidarity of Steel#123.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#125.src: Follow Yuman and Zeph into the sewer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#125.dst: Sigue a Yuman y Zeph hasta la cloaca en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#127.src: Catch up with Zeph and Rex.

Solidarity of Steel#129.src: Welcome to the station, man! There's a bunch of abandoned train lines down here. Dunno how we first found it, but it's where the Steel Feather operates.
Solidarity of Steel#129.dst: ¡Bienvenido a la estación, tío! Aquí abajo hay un montón de vías abandonadas. Ni idea de cómo la encontramos, pero es donde opera la Pluma de Acero.
Solidarity of Steel#129.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#131.src: Good to see you've made it down here too. Yuman, you weren't rude to our guests, were you?
Solidarity of Steel#131.dst: Me alegra que hayáis bajado vosotros también. Yuman, no habrás sido grosero con los invitados, ¿verdad?
Solidarity of Steel#131.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#132.src: What? Screw you, man, of course I was nice! When have I ever not been nice and kind and awesome?
Solidarity of Steel#132.dst: ¿Qué? ¡Anda ya, tío, claro que fui majo! ¿Cuándo no he sido majo, amable y genial?
Solidarity of Steel#132.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#133.src: Well, either way, I'm sure you've tired them out by now. Let's go on ahead and give them time to catch up, alright?
Solidarity of Steel#133.dst: Bueno, en todo caso seguro que ya los has agotado. Vayamos delante y démosles tiempo para alcanzarnos, ¿vale?
Solidarity of Steel#133.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#135.src: So... how've you been finding Yuman so far?
Solidarity of Steel#135.dst: Bueno... ¿qué te ha parecido Yuman hasta ahora?
Solidarity of Steel#135.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#136.src: Ugh. He's f- fi- fine. We got the clothes, at least.
Solidarity of Steel#136.dst: Uf. Es... p- pa- pasable. Al menos tenemos la ropa.
Solidarity of Steel#136.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#137.src: Hm. You don't sound fine. Spill.
Solidarity of Steel#137.dst: Hm. No suenas nada bien. Suéltalo.
Solidarity of Steel#137.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#138.src: Oh, that's it? He's just like that.
Solidarity of Steel#138.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#139.src: He's just... very p- per- persistent.
Solidarity of Steel#139.dst: Es solo que... es muy p- per- pesado.
Solidarity of Steel#139.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#140.src: Well, that says more about you than it does about him. Have you tried making it less easy for him?
Solidarity of Steel#140.dst: Bueno, eso dice más de ti que de él. ¿Has probado a ponérselo un poco más difícil?
Solidarity of Steel#140.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#141.src: Ha ha. Very hel- hel- helpful, Rex.
Solidarity of Steel#141.dst: Ja, ja. Qué a- ay- ayuda, Rex.
Solidarity of Steel#141.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#142.src: Makes sense, I guess. It's been a few days since we've been able to relax, hasn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#142.dst: Tiene sentido, supongo. Hace unos días que no podemos relajarnos, ¿verdad?
Solidarity of Steel#142.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#143.src: Yeah... it'll be n- n- nice to slow down, for a while.
Solidarity of Steel#143.dst: Sí... estará b- b- bien bajar el ritmo un tiempo.
Solidarity of Steel#143.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#144.src: Not sure how long we'll be slowed down... but sure. I think Syndra's got some plans in the works, but she hasn't shared them yet.
Solidarity of Steel#144.dst: No sé cuánto durará esa calma... pero vale. Creo que Syndra tiene planes en marcha, pero aún no los ha contado.
Solidarity of Steel#144.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#145.src: She's been getting... more ambitious lately. {u}, I think having you around has had something to do with that.
Solidarity of Steel#145.dst: Últimamente está... más ambiciosa. {u}, creo que tenerte cerca tiene algo que ver con eso.
Solidarity of Steel#145.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#146.src: We- we- well, how about you? Is the Roughworks just how you r- remember it?
Solidarity of Steel#146.dst: Y- y- ¿y tú qué? ¿Roughworks es como lo r- recuerdas?
Solidarity of Steel#146.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#147.src: Yeah... pretty much. Things don't tend to change a lot around here, so... it's just like slotting back into place.
Solidarity of Steel#147.dst: Sí... más o menos. Aquí las cosas no suelen cambiar mucho, así que... es como volver a encajar en tu hueco.
Solidarity of Steel#147.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#149.src: Ha. No, it really isn't. The few months I spent here before Quill sent me off to Syndra were... rough.
Solidarity of Steel#149.dst: Ja. No, para nada. Los pocos meses que pasé aquí antes de que Quill me mandara con Syndra fueron... duros.
Solidarity of Steel#149.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#150.src: Oh... h- how come? You've never really talked about the R- R- Rough-... about the R- Roughworks.
Solidarity of Steel#150.dst: Ah... ¿p- por qué? Nunca has hablado mucho de R- R- Rough-... de R- Roughworks.
Solidarity of Steel#150.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#151.src: Uh... Hey, so about those clothes- let's take a look at what you got!
Solidarity of Steel#151.dst: Eh... Oye, sobre esa ropa- ¡a ver qué habéis traído!
Solidarity of Steel#151.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#152.src: R- right... right! Well, here are th- the- the, uh, workers' clothes we got f- for me, Mora, and {u}... And this is a dr- dress for Sui...
Solidarity of Steel#152.dst: C- cierto... ¡cierto! Bueno, esta es l- la- la, eh, ropa de obrero que cogimos p- para mí, Mora y {u}... Y este es un v- vestido para Sui...
Solidarity of Steel#152.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#153.src: And, of- of- of course, a simple dress for you!
Solidarity of Steel#153.dst: Y, c- cla- claro, ¡un vestido sencillo para ti!
Solidarity of Steel#153.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#154.src: Oh... that's funny, I don't think I've ever worn one of those! Hey, maybe I'll just take your set and you can wear the dress?
Solidarity of Steel#154.dst: Ah... qué gracia, ¡creo que nunca me he puesto uno de esos! Oye, ¿y si me quedo tu conjunto y tú te pones el vestido?
Solidarity of Steel#154.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#155.src: Woah, ha, we- well, let's not g- g- get too hasty, haha- oh, l- look here, an extra set of re- reg- regular workers' clothes! What a c- co- coincidence!
Solidarity of Steel#155.dst: Uau, ja, b- bueno, no nos p- pre- precipitemos, jaja- ah, m- mira, ¡un conjunto de sobra de ropa de obrero n- no- normal! ¡Qué c- ca- casualidad!
Solidarity of Steel#155.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#156.src: ...don't, uh, m- m- make me wear the dress, please?
Solidarity of Steel#156.dst: ...no, eh, m- m- me hagas ponerme el vestido, ¿vale?
Solidarity of Steel#156.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#157.src: Yeah, yeah. Well, that's enough fooling around - we should find Mora and Sui, see what they've figured out. I'll race you there!
Solidarity of Steel#157.dst: Sí, sí. Bueno, basta de tonterías; hay que buscar a Mora y Sui y ver qué han averiguado. ¡Te echo una carrera!
Solidarity of Steel#157.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#158.src: Hey! Oh, you're going d- down!
Solidarity of Steel#158.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#159.dst: Encuentra a Sui y Mora en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#162.src: Indeed! Tell us, friends, how go the escapades? Has anything of interest transpired up in the city?
Solidarity of Steel#162.dst: ¡Desde luego! Contadnos, amigos, ¿qué tal las andanzas? ¿Ha ocurrido algo de interés allá arriba?
Solidarity of Steel#162.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#163.src: No, Mora, nothing very exciting. Yulie and I did a quick supply run in {p} while we were there.
Solidarity of Steel#163.dst: No, Mora, nada emocionante. Yulie y yo aprovechamos para reponer suministros en {p}.
Solidarity of Steel#163.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#164.src: And {u} and I found some cl- cl- clothes! They might not fit perfectly, but...
Solidarity of Steel#164.dst: ¡Y {u} y yo encontramos r- r- ropa! Puede que no siente perfecta, pero...
Solidarity of Steel#164.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#165.src: Ah, well, we'll take what we can get. Besides, I have to imagine they have someone around here who knows their way around modifying clothes!
Solidarity of Steel#165.dst: Ah, bueno, nos conformamos con lo que haya. ¡Además, imagino que aquí habrá alguien que sepa arreglar ropa!
Solidarity of Steel#165.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#166.src: Speaking of, have you had time to explore this place yet? It's far larger than I could have anticipated! So many people with so many skillsets; Syndra wasn't lying when she said they had resources here, hoho!
Solidarity of Steel#166.dst: Y hablando de eso, ¿habéis tenido tiempo de explorar esto? ¡Es mucho más grande de lo que habría imaginado! Tanta gente con tantas habilidades; Syndra no mentía al decir que aquí tenían recursos, ¡jojo!
Solidarity of Steel#166.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#167.src: Yes... everyone chips in, too. I got put to work quite fast. Had an opportunity to chat with some of the people here.
Solidarity of Steel#167.dst: Sí... y todo el mundo arrima el hombro. A mí me pusieron a trabajar enseguida. Pude charlar con algunos de aquí.
Solidarity of Steel#167.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#168.src: They, um... a lot of them don't have anywhere else to go... so they work hard to keep this place running.
Solidarity of Steel#168.dst: Ellos, eh... muchos no tienen otro sitio adonde ir... así que se esfuerzan para que esto siga en marcha.
Solidarity of Steel#168.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#170.src: Hey, do you know where Yusanu is? I haven't had the chance to catch up with him yet.
Solidarity of Steel#170.dst: Oye, ¿sabes dónde está Yusanu? Aún no he tenido ocasión de ponerme al día con él.
Solidarity of Steel#170.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#171.src: Oh, he seemed to have disappeared into his study some time ago, though not before I could have a chat with him! Did you know he singlehandedly repaired much of the abandoned infrastructure here?
Solidarity of Steel#171.dst: Ah, parece que hace rato desapareció en su taller, ¡aunque no sin que antes pudiera charlar con él! ¿Sabíais que él solo reparó gran parte de la infraestructura abandonada de aquí?
Solidarity of Steel#171.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#173.src: Apparently, um, the crown was working on building this, central station, but they... abandoned the project, for, some reason. Nobody... really knows why.
Solidarity of Steel#173.dst: Por lo visto, eh, la Corona estaba construyendo esta, estación central, pero... abandonaron el proyecto, por, alguna razón. Nadie... sabe bien por qué.
Solidarity of Steel#173.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#174.src: Hm... so what are Syndra and Quill ta- talk- talking about over there?
Solidarity of Steel#174.dst: Hm... ¿y de qué ha- hab- hablan Syndra y Quill allí?
Solidarity of Steel#174.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#175.src: An excellent question! Nobody knows! Attempting to interject has only resulted in failure thus far.
Solidarity of Steel#175.dst: ¡Excelente pregunta! ¡Nadie lo sabe! Los intentos de intervenir solo han terminado en fracaso.
Solidarity of Steel#175.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#176.src: I mean... should we even interrupt? I haven't seen her this... happy... in a long time.
Solidarity of Steel#176.dst: O sea... ¿deberíamos interrumpir siquiera? Hacía mucho que no la veía tan... contenta...
Solidarity of Steel#176.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#177.src: It is a sweet moment, isn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#177.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#179.src: Well, I nominate {u} to go interrupt them. It needs to be done eventually.
Solidarity of Steel#179.dst: Pues yo propongo a {u} para ir a interrumpirlos. Alguien tendrá que hacerlo.
Solidarity of Steel#179.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#180.src: Oh, yes, I second that notion. If it must be anyone, {u} is the one to sacrifice for the cause.
Solidarity of Steel#180.dst: Ah, sí, secundo la moción. Si ha de ser alguien, {u} es quien debe sacrificarse por la causa.
Solidarity of Steel#180.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#181.src: Oh! Uh... sure, I'll... th- third it? That sounds right.
Solidarity of Steel#181.dst: ¡Ah! Eh... vale, yo... ¿la t- terceo? Suena bien.
Solidarity of Steel#181.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#183.src: Well! Three for, one against. It seems the decision has been made!
Solidarity of Steel#183.dst: ¡Bien! Tres a favor, uno en contra. ¡Parece que está decidido!
Solidarity of Steel#183.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#184.src: Yeah, yeah! Come on, what are you waiting for? Go {u}, and find out what they're talking about.
Solidarity of Steel#184.dst: ¡Sí, sí! Venga, ¿a qué esperas? Ve, {u}, y averigua de qué están hablando.
Solidarity of Steel#184.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#185.src: Good luck, my friend! You'll certainly need it.
Solidarity of Steel#185.dst: ¡Buena suerte, amigo mío! Sin duda la vas a necesitar.
Solidarity of Steel#185.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#186.src: Your sacrifice will not be in vain.
Solidarity of Steel#186.dst: Tu sacrificio no será en vano.
Solidarity of Steel#186.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#187.src: I had no p- pa- part in this!
Solidarity of Steel#187.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#188.src: Don't try to get out of this, Zeph. You're just as complicit in this as the rest of us.
Solidarity of Steel#188.dst: No intentes escaquearte, Zeph. Eres tan cómplice como el resto de nosotros.
Solidarity of Steel#188.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#189.src: Wh- I- fine... {u}, just get it o- over with. Go {u}, and find out what th- they- wh- what they're talking about.
Solidarity of Steel#189.dst: Q- y- vale... {u}, acaba con esto d- de una vez. Ve, {u}, y averigua de qué e- ellos- d- de qué están hablando.
Solidarity of Steel#189.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#190.src: I will remember you fondly, my friend.
Solidarity of Steel#190.dst: Te recordaré con cariño, amigo mío.
Solidarity of Steel#190.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#194.src: H-hey! Don't you have a m-mission to do?
Solidarity of Steel#194.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#195.src: Ah, {u}! I see you have all returned. Welcome to our home.
Solidarity of Steel#195.dst: ¡Ah, {u}! Veo que habéis vuelto todos. Bienvenidos a nuestra casa.
Solidarity of Steel#195.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#196.src: I hope the brothers weren't too much of a nuisance. Yuman, especially... he's a good lad, but he tends towards
Solidarity of Steel#196.dst: Espero que los hermanos no hayan dado mucha guerra. Yuman, sobre todo... es buen chico, pero tiende a
Solidarity of Steel#196.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#197.src: Speaking of nuisances... I can't help but notice the rest of our group looking onwards at our conversation with excitement.
Solidarity of Steel#197.dst: Y hablando de molestias... no puedo evitar notar que el resto del grupo observa nuestra conversación con entusiasmo.
Solidarity of Steel#197.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#198.src: Ah! Understood. A noble one, at that.
Solidarity of Steel#198.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#199.src: In any case, Quill and I have been trying to plan out our next moves... but, if I'm being honest, most of that time has been spent catching up.
Solidarity of Steel#199.dst: En todo caso, Quill y yo hemos intentado planear los próximos pasos... pero, si soy sincera, hemos pasado casi todo el rato poniéndonos al día.
Solidarity of Steel#199.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#200.src: Don't be fooled. All of these people here are resisting to some extent, but very few are ready to go up against a God.
Solidarity of Steel#200.dst: No te engañes. Toda esta gente resiste en cierta medida, pero muy pocos están listos para enfrentarse a un dios.
Solidarity of Steel#200.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#201.src: Hah! Goodness, how long has it been since we met face to face? It must have been... {~} years? Not since before you-
Solidarity of Steel#201.dst: ¡Ja! Madre mía, ¿cuánto hace que no nos vemos en persona? Debe de hacer... ¿{~} años? No desde antes de que tú-
Solidarity of Steel#201.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#203.src: ...Ahem. Yes, of course. As Syndra said, we haven't truly started planning yet... You must be surprised by our numbers, yes? More members in the Steel Feather than you'd have expected.
Solidarity of Steel#203.dst: ...Ejem. Sí, claro. Como dijo Syndra, aún no hemos empezado a planear de verdad... Te sorprende cuántos somos, ¿no? Más miembros en la Pluma de Acero de los que esperabas.
Solidarity of Steel#203.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#204.src: In truth, looks may be deceiving. Everyone here is resisting in whatever ways they can manage, but few are willing to put as much of themselves into it as your group.
Solidarity of Steel#204.dst: En verdad, las apariencias engañan. Todos aquí resisten como pueden, pero pocos están dispuestos a entregarse tanto como vuestro grupo.
Solidarity of Steel#204.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#205.src: Most of them are simply trying to live without the watchful eye of the monarchy. Our safe haven takes in people who are at risk. People who can't work, who have been thrown out of their homes...
Solidarity of Steel#205.dst: La mayoría solo intenta vivir lejos del ojo vigilante de la monarquía. Nuestro refugio acoge a quienes están en peligro. Gente que no puede trabajar, a la que han echado de su casa...
Solidarity of Steel#205.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#206.src: But we are not helpless. The brothers and I are all ready to help, however we can. And the rest of the Steel Feather will still offer support from the sidelines. We have infrastructure, and we have resources.
Solidarity of Steel#206.dst: Pero no estamos indefensos. Los hermanos y yo estamos listos para ayudar en lo que sea. Y el resto de la Pluma de Acero apoyará desde la retaguardia. Tenemos infraestructura y tenemos recursos.
Solidarity of Steel#206.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#207.src: I've also suggested that you might offer to teach the basics of magic to those who are interested-
Solidarity of Steel#207.dst: También he sugerido que podrías enseñar lo básico de la magia a quien tenga interés-
Solidarity of Steel#207.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#208.src: Yes, yes, but I do not believe we need curses or blessings to resist. As I've told you several times before in our correspondences, Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#208.dst: Sí, sí, pero no creo que hagan falta maldiciones ni bendiciones para resistir. ¡Como ya te he dicho varias veces en nuestras cartas, Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#208.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#209.src: And as I've told you in response, I see no reason not to make use of all the tools available!
Solidarity of Steel#209.dst: ¡Y como te he respondido, no veo motivo para no usar todas las herramientas disponibles!
Solidarity of Steel#209.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#210.src: Syndra, I have been firm on this point for a reason. We have done well for ourselves thus far.
Solidarity of Steel#210.dst: Syndra, si me mantengo firme en esto es por algo. Hasta ahora nos ha ido bien solos.
Solidarity of Steel#210.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#211.src: As an example- Yusanu has grown quite proficient with machinery. He has constructed weaponry, tools- even my leg is his creation!
Solidarity of Steel#211.dst: Por ejemplo- Yusanu se ha vuelto muy hábil con la maquinaria. Ha construido armas, herramientas- ¡hasta mi pierna es obra suya!
Solidarity of Steel#211.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#212.src: ... I simply think that-... Sigh. Fine. Quill, we should get to discussing the reason we came here.
Solidarity of Steel#212.dst: ... Yo solo creo que-... Suspiro. Está bien. Quill, deberíamos hablar del motivo por el que vinimos.
Solidarity of Steel#212.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#213.src: Yes, I rather think we should. {u}, in the meantime, why don't you take a look around the station? Familiarize yourself with the area and the people.
Solidarity of Steel#213.dst: Sí, creo que deberíamos. {u}, mientras tanto, ¿por qué no echas un vistazo a la estación? Familiarízate con el sitio y con la gente.
Solidarity of Steel#213.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#214.src: Explore the Steel Feather train station at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#214.dst: Explora la estación de la Pluma de Acero en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#215.src: Take a look around the station! Familiarize yourself with the area and the people.
Solidarity of Steel#215.dst: ¡Echa un vistazo a la estación! Familiarízate con el sitio y con la gente.
Solidarity of Steel#215.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#216.src: Hoho! So they return! Tell us, how did it go?
Solidarity of Steel#216.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#218.src: Ah, we all knew the stakes going in! Worry not, friend, your sacrifice will not be forgotten any time soon!
Solidarity of Steel#218.dst: ¡Ah, todos sabíamos lo que había en juego! ¡No temas, amigo, tu sacrificio no se olvidará pronto!
Solidarity of Steel#218.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#219.src: Hey! E- e- enough with the theatrics!
Solidarity of Steel#219.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#220.src: Excellent! You have successfully defied the odds, friend!
Solidarity of Steel#220.dst: ¡Excelente! ¡Has desafiado a la suerte con éxito, amigo!
Solidarity of Steel#220.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#221.src: Zeph didn't believe you'd make it, you know.
Solidarity of Steel#221.dst: Zeph no creía que lo lograras, ¿sabes?
Solidarity of Steel#221.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#222.src: Wh- what, n- no I- I didn't- Sui!! D- don't- don't believe a word- a word she says, o- okay?
Solidarity of Steel#222.dst: Q- qué, n- no, y- yo no- ¡¡Sui!! N- no- no creas ni una palabra- una palabra de lo que dice, ¿v- vale?
Solidarity of Steel#222.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#223.src: Wh- what were they talking about, anyway?
Solidarity of Steel#223.dst: ¿D- de qué estaban hablando, por cierto?
Solidarity of Steel#223.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#224.src: Oh, so it was as boring as I predicted.
Solidarity of Steel#224.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#225.src: Don't call that boring, Rex! It's... nice for her to relax for a little, isn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#225.dst: ¡No digas que es aburrido, Rex! Está... bien que se relaje un poco, ¿no?
Solidarity of Steel#225.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#226.src: It can be both boring and a nice thing, can it not? The nice things often tend towards the boring end of the spectrum, in any case.
Solidarity of Steel#226.dst: Puede ser aburrido y agradable a la vez, ¿no es así? De todos modos, lo agradable suele tirar hacia el extremo aburrido.
Solidarity of Steel#226.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#227.src: So, still n- nothing about the plans... when is she go- go- going to tell us anything?
Solidarity of Steel#227.dst: Entonces, s- sigue sin haber nada de los planes... ¿cuándo v- va- va a contarnos algo?
Solidarity of Steel#227.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#228.src: Have patience, young Leaf. She will tell us when it is time! Now, Sui and I have had the opportunity to explore, but you three have not! So, go on! Look around, talk to people.
Solidarity of Steel#228.dst: Paciencia, joven Hoja. ¡Nos lo dirá cuando sea el momento! Ahora bien, Sui y yo hemos podido explorar, ¡pero vosotros tres no! ¡Venga, id! Mirad por ahí, hablad con la gente.
Solidarity of Steel#228.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#230.src: Ah. You're all back already? Man, I totally lost track of time there... there's so much to do.
Solidarity of Steel#230.dst: Ah. ¿Ya habéis vuelto todos? Tío, he perdido del todo la noción del tiempo... hay tantísimo que hacer.
Solidarity of Steel#230.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#231.src: So, what's up? Sorry I couldn't talk to you more earlier- I'm the one who makes sure everything runs smoothly here.
Solidarity of Steel#231.dst: Bueno, ¿qué tal? Perdona que antes no pudiera hablar más- soy quien se encarga de que aquí todo funcione.
Solidarity of Steel#231.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#232.src: Most of the infrastructure was here already, but I basically fixed it all up myself... with some help, of course. But now I'm in charge of maintaining all of it!
Solidarity of Steel#232.dst: Casi toda la infraestructura ya estaba aquí, pero prácticamente la arreglé yo solo... con algo de ayuda, claro. ¡Pero ahora el mantenimiento es todo cosa mía!
Solidarity of Steel#232.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#233.src: It's not usually this... hectic. We had some stuff break down recently, and I'm the oooonly one who can deal with it!
Solidarity of Steel#233.dst: No suele haber tanto... ajetreo. Se han roto varias cosas hace poco, ¡y soy el úuuunico que puede arreglarlas!
Solidarity of Steel#233.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#235.src: ... Still don't have time to chat, sorry! I'm nearly done, though, I'll be out in a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#235.dst: ... ¡Sigo sin tiempo para charlar, perdona! Pero casi he terminado, salgo en nada.
Solidarity of Steel#235.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#238.src: Hah! Yeah, yeah, maybe. I was hoping to tease him some more.
Solidarity of Steel#238.dst: ¡Ja! Sí, sí, puede. Esperaba picarle un poco más.
Solidarity of Steel#238.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#239.src: He's a fun guy! But the boy's gotta learn how to tease back... it's no fun if it's one-side, y'know?
Solidarity of Steel#239.dst: ¡Es un tío majo! Pero el chaval tiene que aprender a picar de vuelta... si va en un solo sentido no mola, ¿sabes?
Solidarity of Steel#239.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#240.src: ...what? Ey, don't look at me like that! It's all for fun at the end of the day. If he tells me to quit it, I'll quit it.
Solidarity of Steel#240.dst: ...¿qué? ¡Eh, no me mires así! Al final es todo por diversión. Si me dice que pare, paro.
Solidarity of Steel#240.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#242.src: I'll... go over there later. Eventually! ... Maybe.
Solidarity of Steel#242.dst: Ya... me acercaré luego. ¡Algún día! ... Quizá.
Solidarity of Steel#242.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#243.src: Eheh. Wouldn't want to overstay my welcome, y'know? I've got things to do, anyway...
Solidarity of Steel#243.dst: Je, je. No quiero abusar de su paciencia, ¿sabes? Además, tengo cosas que hacer...
Solidarity of Steel#243.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#244.src: ...so, you exploring? That's good! I'd show you around, but... eheh, I'm uh, working on a little something right now.
Solidarity of Steel#244.dst: ...¿así que explorando? ¡Eso está bien! Te enseñaría esto, pero... je, ahora mismo estoy, eh, con una cosilla.
Solidarity of Steel#244.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#245.src: Yo, quit trying to sneak a peak at it! No spoilers! You'll see it tonight, if I get it done.
Solidarity of Steel#245.dst: ¡Eh, deja de intentar espiarla! ¡Sin spoilers! La verás esta noche, si la termino.
Solidarity of Steel#245.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#247.src: Hm. I suppose you're used to invading personal space?
Solidarity of Steel#247.dst: Hm. ¿Supongo que estás acostumbrado a invadir el espacio ajeno?
Solidarity of Steel#247.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#248.src: Don't worry, I'm not upset. I appreciate the effort in familiarizing yourself with this place.
Solidarity of Steel#248.dst: Tranquilo, no estoy molesto. Agradezco el esfuerzo por familiarizarte con este sitio.
Solidarity of Steel#248.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#249.src: Did you have a question, or are you just looking around?
Solidarity of Steel#249.dst: ¿Tenías alguna pregunta o solo estás mirando?
Solidarity of Steel#249.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#250.src: Oh, has he done something again? Of course he has... I apologize for my brother's actions.
Solidarity of Steel#250.dst: Ah, ¿ha vuelto a hacer algo? Cómo no... Te pido disculpas por lo que haya hecho mi hermano.
Solidarity of Steel#250.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#251.src: He's... hard to keep a handle on. Energetic, impulsive... I do love him, but do I ever wish he would cause less trouble.
Solidarity of Steel#251.dst: Es... difícil de controlar. Enérgico, impulsivo... Lo quiero, pero ojalá diera menos problemas.
Solidarity of Steel#251.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#253.src: Ah. Then I apologize for my assumption.
Solidarity of Steel#253.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#254.src: He's... I might be too hard on him sometimes. He does help out a lot around here, he does- just... like I said. Energetic and impulsive.
Solidarity of Steel#254.dst: Es... quizá a veces soy demasiado duro con él. La verdad es que ayuda mucho por aquí, de verdad- solo... como he dicho. Enérgico e impulsivo.
Solidarity of Steel#254.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#255.src: You'll get used to his personality, with time. Everyone does.
Solidarity of Steel#255.dst: Con el tiempo te acostumbrarás a su carácter. Todos lo hacen.
Solidarity of Steel#255.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#256.src: But in any case, I'll speak with him about it. He should know better than to bother our guests.
Solidarity of Steel#256.dst: En cualquier caso, hablaré con él del tema. Debería saber que no se molesta a los invitados.
Solidarity of Steel#256.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#257.src: I have to get back to work. I'll see you around.
Solidarity of Steel#257.dst: Tengo que volver al trabajo. Nos vemos por ahí.
Solidarity of Steel#257.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#258.src: Hm? My role? That's a bit of a complex question, actually. In the Steel Feather... I don't do much.
Solidarity of Steel#258.dst: ¿Hm? ¿Mi papel? La verdad es que es una pregunta algo compleja. En la Pluma de Acero... no hago gran cosa.
Solidarity of Steel#258.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#259.src: But I work as a consulting detective for the crown, in the city. I perform investigations for them, but I also gather information for us - keeping tabs on the military, and such.
Solidarity of Steel#259.dst: Pero trabajo como detective consultor para la Corona, en la ciudad. Hago investigaciones para ellos, pero también reúno información para nosotros: vigilo al ejército y cosas así.
Solidarity of Steel#259.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#260.src: Besides, the pay's... decent enough. A few emeralds in my pocket helps all of us down here. Unfortunately, we can't produce everything ourselves.
Solidarity of Steel#260.dst: Además, la paga es... bastante decente. Unas esmeraldas en mi bolsillo nos ayudan a todos aquí abajo. Por desgracia, no podemos producirlo todo nosotros.
Solidarity of Steel#260.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#261.src: But speaking of my work, I... am actually busy preparing for a meeting right now. {p}'s Commander wants us on the lookout for... something, he hasn't told us yet.
Solidarity of Steel#261.dst: Y hablando de mi trabajo, ahora mismo... estoy ocupado preparando una reunión. El Comandante de {p} quiere que estemos atentos a... algo, aún no nos lo ha dicho.
Solidarity of Steel#261.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#262.src: But it's my duty to find out, so into the city I will go. If you'll excuse me, I'll get back to preparing now.
Solidarity of Steel#262.dst: Pero averiguarlo es mi deber, así que a la ciudad iré. Si me disculpas, vuelvo a los preparativos.
Solidarity of Steel#262.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#263.src: Return to the main room at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#263.dst: Vuelve a la sala principal en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#265.src: Nothing beyond what I'd written in our letters.
Solidarity of Steel#265.dst: Nada más allá de lo que escribí en las cartas.
Solidarity of Steel#265.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#266.src: Alright... thank you, Quill. Just a little longer, then I-
Solidarity of Steel#266.dst: Está bien... gracias, Quill. Solo un poco más y entonces-
Solidarity of Steel#266.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#267.src: Ah, {u}! What do you think of our home? It took a great deal of planning to get the station up and running, but I feel we've done a good-
Solidarity of Steel#267.dst: ¡Ah, {u}! ¿Qué te parece nuestra casa? Costó mucha planificación poner la estación en marcha, pero creo que hemos hecho un buen-
Solidarity of Steel#267.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#270.src: I overheard... an altercation... between a woma-... and a- ...dier...
Solidarity of Steel#270.dst: He oído... un altercado... entre una muje-... y un- ...dado...
Solidarity of Steel#270.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#271.src: Calm yourself, Jiro. Take a breath, and repeat
Solidarity of Steel#271.dst: Cálmate, Jiro. Respira hondo y repite
Solidarity of Steel#271.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#272.src: A woman is being kicked out... again! I don't know the details, but I think she didn't reach her quota for the month.
Solidarity of Steel#272.dst: ¡Están echando a una mujer... otra vez! No sé los detalles, pero creo que no llegó a su cuota del mes.
Solidarity of Steel#272.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#274.src: Living Block {~} - through the southwestern tunnel.
Solidarity of Steel#274.dst: Bloque Residencial {~} - por el túnel del suroeste.
Solidarity of Steel#274.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#278.src: We're heading out. Rescue mission. Yuman, where's Yulie?
Solidarity of Steel#278.dst: Salimos. Misión de rescate. Yuman, ¿dónde está Yulie?
Solidarity of Steel#278.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#279.src: He has a meeting in the city today, remember? He told all of us this morning.
Solidarity of Steel#279.dst: Hoy tiene una reunión en la ciudad, ¿recuerdas? Nos lo dijo esta mañana.
Solidarity of Steel#279.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#280.src: ...Right. Right, he did say- alright. We'll have to go in blind, then. Not ideal, but it can't be helped-
Solidarity of Steel#280.dst: ...Cierto. Cierto, lo dijo- vale. Entonces iremos a ciegas. No es lo ideal, pero no hay remedio-
Solidarity of Steel#280.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#281.src: Damn it! Not now, of all times to-
Solidarity of Steel#281.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#282.src: What's going on? Is something wrong?
Solidarity of Steel#282.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#283.src: No, no, nothing's- it's nothing bad... I hope. I just need to... check what triggered the alarm. Ugh, can anything go right today...
Solidarity of Steel#283.dst: No, no, no es nada- no es nada malo... espero. Solo tengo que... ver qué ha disparado la alarma. Uf, hoy no hay nada que salga bien...
Solidarity of Steel#283.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#284.src: Hey, bro, don't worry about it. I'll handle it! You take care of whatever you need to, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#284.dst: Eh, tío, no te preocupes por eso. ¡Yo me encargo! Tú ocúpate de lo tuyo, ¿vale?
Solidarity of Steel#284.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#285.src: ...Okay. Okay, thanks, Yuman. I owe you one.
Solidarity of Steel#285.dst: ...Vale. Vale, gracias, Yuman. Te debo una.
Solidarity of Steel#285.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#286.src: Hey, one of these days I'll collect on all those ones you owe me! Don't think you can dodge that just cause you're my bro!
Solidarity of Steel#286.dst: ¡Eh, un día de estos te cobraré todas las que me debes! ¡No creas que te libras solo por ser mi hermano!
Solidarity of Steel#286.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#287.src: Will you n- ne- need help? {u} and I can join if y- if you need us.
Solidarity of Steel#287.dst: ¿Ne- nec- necesitáis ayuda? {u} y yo vamos si hace falta.
Solidarity of Steel#287.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#288.src: Was just about to ask the same thing! Jiro, Zeph, {u}, you all listen to my orders 'till this is sorted! Got it?
Solidarity of Steel#288.dst: ¡Justo iba a preguntar lo mismo! Jiro, Zeph, {u}, ¡obedecéis mis órdenes hasta que esto se arregle! ¿Entendido?
Solidarity of Steel#288.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#290.src: You forgot the "sir" at the end, there! Anyway, let me grab my guitar, and let's head out!
Solidarity of Steel#290.dst: ¡Se te ha olvidado el "señor" al final! En fin, cojo mi guitarra y ¡en marcha!
Solidarity of Steel#290.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#292.src: Don't ask, you'll find out later. We need to get moving now.
Solidarity of Steel#292.dst: No preguntes, ya lo verás luego. Ahora hay que moverse.
Solidarity of Steel#292.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#294.src: Follow Yuman to the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#294.dst: Sigue a Yuman hasta el túnel en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#296.src: I hope Yuman doesn't annoy them to death...
Solidarity of Steel#296.dst: Espero que Yuman no los saque de quicio...
Solidarity of Steel#296.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#297.src: Th- through here! Yuman and Jiro are s- sc- scouting up ahead.
Solidarity of Steel#297.dst: ¡P- por aquí! Yuman y Jiro están e- ex- explorando delante.
Solidarity of Steel#297.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#298.src: Find the woman in trouble at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#298.dst: Encuentra a la mujer en apuros en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#299.src: I see them up a- a- ahead... Let's join up with them. Fo- follow me!
Solidarity of Steel#299.dst: Los veo d- d- delante... Vamos con ellos. ¡S- sígueme!
Solidarity of Steel#299.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#301.src: Alright, lady! Time's up! It's time to get going.
Solidarity of Steel#301.dst: ¡Muy bien, señora! ¡Se acabó el tiempo! Hay que irse.
Solidarity of Steel#301.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#302.src: We need to clean up this filthy apartment of yours for whoever's next in line. We've got a tight schedule, so don't make this harder than it needs to be, alright?
Solidarity of Steel#302.dst: Tenemos que limpiar este piso asqueroso tuyo para el siguiente de la lista. Vamos justos de horario, así que no lo compliques más de lo necesario, ¿vale?
Solidarity of Steel#302.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#303.src: W-w-wait! I still need to pack! You haven't given me enough time!
Solidarity of Steel#303.dst: ¡E-e-esperad! ¡Aún tengo que recoger! ¡No me habéis dado tiempo!
Solidarity of Steel#303.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#304.src: You received an eviction notice last night, detailing the protocol, didn't you? You've had plenty of time already, lady.
Solidarity of Steel#304.dst: Anoche recibiste un aviso de desalojo con el procedimiento detallado, ¿no? Has tenido tiempo de sobra, señora.
Solidarity of Steel#304.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#305.src: Unless what you mean to say is you take issue with the system? We've got a formal complaints department, lady, but I don't think you'd enjoy paying them a visit.
Solidarity of Steel#305.dst: ¿A menos que lo que quieras decir sea que tienes un problema con el sistema? Hay un departamento de reclamaciones, señora, pero dudo que te gustara visitarlo.
Solidarity of Steel#305.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#306.src: N-n-no! No, it- it's fine! I-I-I just- I'm just saying th-that- I just need a couple of minutes... Please!
Solidarity of Steel#306.dst: ¡N-n-no! ¡No, e- está bien! Y-y-yo solo- solo digo q-que- solo necesito un par de minutos... ¡Por favor!
Solidarity of Steel#306.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#307.src: Sigh. I did warn you, lady. Guess we're doing things the hard way, then.
Solidarity of Steel#307.dst: Suspiro. Te avisé, señora. Pues lo haremos por las malas.
Solidarity of Steel#307.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#309.src: I'm sorry! I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm-
Solidarity of Steel#309.dst: ¡Lo siento! Lo siento, lo siento, lo-
Solidarity of Steel#309.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#310.src: Disrespecting the crown is a serious crime, y'know. Alright, boys, you know what to do.
Solidarity of Steel#310.dst: Faltar al respeto a la Corona es un delito grave, ¿sabes? Venga, chicos, ya sabéis qué hacer.
Solidarity of Steel#310.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#311.src: Hey! We n- ne- need to hel- help her!
Solidarity of Steel#311.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#312.src: Quiet! It's not protocol, we need to wait until the coast's clear, or else-
Solidarity of Steel#312.dst: ¡Silencio! No es el protocolo, hay que esperar a que no haya nadie, o si no-
Solidarity of Steel#312.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#313.src: But th- they're going to beat her! We c- can- we c- can't just let that-
Solidarity of Steel#313.dst: ¡P- pero van a pegarle! N- no- n- no podemos dejar que-
Solidarity of Steel#313.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#314.src: You're new here, so you get a pass for not knowing, but we cannot draw attention towards us.
Solidarity of Steel#314.dst: Eres nuevo aquí, así que se te perdona no saberlo, pero no podemos llamar la atención.
Solidarity of Steel#314.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#315.src: Yeah, man! If the guards get a whiff of what we're doing, we're toast! The only reason we have the station is 'cause they don't know about it!
Solidarity of Steel#315.dst: ¡Eso, tío! ¡Si los guardias huelen lo que hacemos, estamos fritos! ¡Si aún tenemos la estación es porque no saben de ella!
Solidarity of Steel#315.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#317.src: M- m- maybe hiding is enough f- f- for you, but I c- ca- can't just let someone get h- hur- hurt!
Solidarity of Steel#317.dst: Q- q- quizá a vosotros os baste e- es- esconderos, ¡pero yo n- no- no puedo dejar que hagan d- da- daño a alguien!
Solidarity of Steel#317.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#318.src: S- so-... so sc- screw your cover! She n- n- needs help, so I- I'm going to h- he- help!
Solidarity of Steel#318.dst: A- así-... ¡así que a la p- porra vuestra tapadera! Ella n- n- necesita ayuda, ¡y yo voy a a- ay- ayudar!
Solidarity of Steel#318.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#319.src: Hey, don't!-... Damn it. Man, how am I gonna explain this to...
Solidarity of Steel#319.dst: ¡Eh, no!-... Maldita sea. Tío, cómo voy a explicarle esto a...
Solidarity of Steel#319.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#320.src: Defeat the soldiers attacking the woman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#320.dst: Derrota a los soldados que atacan a la mujer en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#321.src: Fine, man! Can't just let you fight alone, can we? Let's just get this over with...
Solidarity of Steel#321.dst: ¡Está bien, tío! No vamos a dejarte pelear solo, ¿no? Acabemos con esto de una vez...
Solidarity of Steel#321.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#323.src: ..Okay. I th- th- I think the coast is clear. She sh- sh- should be-
Solidarity of Steel#323.dst: ..Vale. C- c- creo que no hay nadie. Ella d- d- debería-
Solidarity of Steel#323.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#324.src: What the hell was that? What were you thinking?!
Solidarity of Steel#324.dst: ¿Qué demonios ha sido eso? ¡¿En qué pensabas?!
Solidarity of Steel#324.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#326.src: No, I really think I should-
Solidarity of Steel#326.dst: No, de verdad creo que debería-
Solidarity of Steel#326.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#327.src: Jiro. We've got other things to worry about, man. Cool it till we're back at the station, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#327.dst: Jiro. Tenemos cosas más urgentes, tío. Cálmate hasta que volvamos a la estación, ¿vale?
Solidarity of Steel#327.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#330.src: Wh-who are you people? What are- what are you doing here?
Solidarity of Steel#330.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#331.src: One can learn so much of the community's spirit by surveying the boards. See what they're worried of, see the way they support each other, see their culture...
Solidarity of Steel#331.dst: Se aprende muchísimo del espíritu de una comunidad mirando sus tablones. Ves qué les preocupa, cómo se apoyan entre ellos, cómo es su cultura...

Solidarity of Steel#332.src: Donated {~} IA by Sovereign Zhiraok after vandalization of previous noticeboard.
Solidarity of Steel#332.dst: Donado en {~} IA por el Soberano Zhiraok tras el vandalismo del tablón anterior.

Solidarity of Steel#333.src: Said it was the Sovereign's problem, but I know the real reason. He just didn't want to go into The Flush.
Solidarity of Steel#333.dst: Dijo que era problema del Soberano, pero sé la razón de verdad. Simplemente no quería meterse en el Desagüe.

Solidarity of Steel#334.src: You don't know us, and we don't know you. But we're here to help. I'm Yuman, and these are-
Solidarity of Steel#334.dst: Tú no nos conoces y nosotros no te conocemos. Pero venimos a ayudar. Soy Yuman, y estos son-
Solidarity of Steel#334.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#335.src: Why... why would you... help me...?
Solidarity of Steel#335.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#336.src: 'Cause... that's what people like us should do.
Solidarity of Steel#336.dst: Porque... es lo que la gente como nosotros debería hacer.
Solidarity of Steel#336.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#337.src: No! N-n-no... people like us should just do as we're told and not get involved in things that aren't ours!
Solidarity of Steel#337.dst: ¡No! N-n-no... ¡la gente como nosotros solo debe obedecer y no meterse en lo que no es suyo!
Solidarity of Steel#337.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#339.src: If I just follow orders, at least I'll survive! I might lose my apartment, and maybe everything I've built for myself, and all the things I've managed to keep for myself, but- but- but at least I'll be alive!
Solidarity of Steel#339.dst: ¡Si me limito a obedecer, al menos sobreviviré! Puede que pierda mi piso, y quizá todo lo que me he construido, y todo lo que he logrado conservar, pero- pero- ¡pero al menos estaré viva!
Solidarity of Steel#339.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#340.src: ...I hear you. Trust me, Aihan, I really do.
Solidarity of Steel#340.dst: ...Te entiendo. Créeme, Aihan, de verdad que sí.
Solidarity of Steel#340.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#341.src: Can I tell you a story?
Solidarity of Steel#341.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#343.src: Long, long ago, when I was just a little kid, I lost my ma. Dad's out of the picture, so... my bros had to put in the work to take care of me, even though they were just kids too.
Solidarity of Steel#343.dst: Hace mucho, mucho tiempo, cuando era solo un crío, perdí a mi madre. Mi padre no estaba, así que... mis hermanos tuvieron que cuidar de mí, aunque también eran unos críos.
Solidarity of Steel#343.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#344.src: But, y'know, being kids... they couldn't do enough. Failed to meet their quotas, just like you. Got kicked out, had to live on the streets.
Solidarity of Steel#344.dst: Pero, ya sabes, siendo críos... no daban abasto. No llegaron a sus cuotas, igual que tú. Los echaron y tuvieron que vivir en la calle.
Solidarity of Steel#344.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#345.src: You want to know the reason we made it through that? It was 'cause someone reached out a helping hand. Gave us a place to stay, to work without the threat of not meeting expectations. To live, man.
Solidarity of Steel#345.dst: ¿Quieres saber por qué salimos de aquello? Porque alguien nos tendió la mano. Nos dio un sitio donde quedarnos, donde trabajar sin la amenaza de no cumplir expectativas. Donde vivir, tía.
Solidarity of Steel#345.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#346.src: So... please. Accept the hand that's offered to you, 'kay? You can come with us and talk to the boss, and if what we have isn't enough for you... no one will force you to stay. But give it a try, please?
Solidarity of Steel#346.dst: Así que... por favor. Acepta la mano que se te tiende, ¿vale? Puedes venir con nosotros y hablar con el jefe, y si lo que tenemos no te basta... nadie te obligará a quedarte. Pero inténtalo, ¿vale?
Solidarity of Steel#346.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#348.src: Not to ruin the moment, Yuman, but we've got more soldiers coming our way! We've got to get moving soon!
Solidarity of Steel#348.dst: No quiero arruinar el momento, Yuman, ¡pero vienen más soldados hacia aquí! ¡Hay que irse ya!
Solidarity of Steel#348.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#349.src: Damn... alright. Aihan, will you trust me?
Solidarity of Steel#349.dst: Maldita sea... vale. Aihan, ¿confiarás en mí?
Solidarity of Steel#349.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#351.src: Okay... okay. Thank you. {u}, could you help her pack her stuff? Zeph, Jiro, help me prepare an escape route.
Solidarity of Steel#351.dst: Vale... vale. Gracias. {u}, ¿puedes ayudarla a recoger? Zeph, Jiro, preparadme una vía de escape.
Solidarity of Steel#351.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#352.src: W-wait! I... I don't know what I'm packing!
Solidarity of Steel#352.dst: ¡E-espera! ¡Yo... no sé qué tengo que llevarme!
Solidarity of Steel#352.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#353.src: Right. Uh... don't bring anything heavy. We have food and cookware where we're going...
Solidarity of Steel#353.dst: Cierto. Eh... no te lleves nada pesado. Adonde vamos hay comida y utensilios de cocina...
Solidarity of Steel#353.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#354.src: Bring something to with, something that ... and maybe some form of {u}, if you've got any.
Solidarity of Steel#354.dst: Llévate algo para, algo que ... y quizá algún tipo de {u}, si tienes.
Solidarity of Steel#354.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#356.src: I... I can't think straight... this is all moving so fast... please- please, can you help me?
Solidarity of Steel#356.dst: Yo... no puedo pensar con claridad... todo va tan rápido... por favor- por favor, ¿puedes ayudarme?
Solidarity of Steel#356.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#357.dst: Ayuda a Aihan a recoger en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#358.src: Grab that backpack and... pick whatever you think works...
Solidarity of Steel#358.dst: Coge esa mochila y... elige lo que creas que sirva...
Solidarity of Steel#358.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#359.src: You've probably seen most of the station by now. Time to head back.
Solidarity of Steel#359.dst: Ya habrás visto casi toda la estación. Hora de volver.

Solidarity of Steel#360.src: Grab that and... pick whatever you think works...
Solidarity of Steel#360.dst: Coge eso y... elige lo que creas que sirva...
Solidarity of Steel#360.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#361.src: We have to hurry but I just can't think!
Solidarity of Steel#361.dst: ¡Hay que darse prisa y no puedo pensar!
Solidarity of Steel#361.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#362.src: Pack something to help Aihan some form of a piece of and something to
Solidarity of Steel#362.dst: Guarda algo para ayudar a Aihan algún tipo de un trozo de y algo para

Solidarity of Steel#363.src: {u}, h- h- hurry! We don't have m- mu- much time!
Solidarity of Steel#363.dst: {u}, ¡d- d- date prisa! ¡No tenemos m- mu- mucho tiempo!
Solidarity of Steel#363.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#365.src: Where- where are you going? D-d-don't leave me here!
Solidarity of Steel#365.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#366.src: Did you get everything? Can we go?
Solidarity of Steel#366.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#367.src: Okay... No one's here yet. Let's go!
Solidarity of Steel#367.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#369.src: We're out of time, we have to get moving! Come on, come on!
Solidarity of Steel#369.dst: ¡Se acabó el tiempo, hay que moverse! ¡Vamos, vamos!
Solidarity of Steel#369.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#370.src: Up the ladder, into the tunnel! Go, go, go!
Solidarity of Steel#370.dst: ¡Por la escalera, al túnel! ¡Vamos, vamos, vamos!
Solidarity of Steel#370.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#371.src: Yuman... c- co- come on. Let's go.
Solidarity of Steel#371.dst: Yuman... v- va- vamos. Nos vamos.
Solidarity of Steel#371.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#374.src: Man... that was a really stupid thing for you to do. Like, astronomically stupid, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#374.dst: Tío... lo que has hecho ha sido una estupidez enorme. Vamos, astronómicamente estúpido, ¿sabes?
Solidarity of Steel#374.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#376.src: But I get it. I get it, y'know? If I didn't have to be a leader there, I'd've probably done the same thing!
Solidarity of Steel#376.dst: Pero lo entiendo. Lo entiendo, ¿sabes? ¡Si allí no hubiera tenido que mandar, seguramente habría hecho lo mismo!
Solidarity of Steel#376.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#377.src: Difference is, my bros can hold me back from that impulse. Guess I wasn't able to do that, here...
Solidarity of Steel#377.dst: La diferencia es que mis hermanos me frenan ese impulso. Parece que yo no pude hacer eso contigo...
Solidarity of Steel#377.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#378.src: Hate to disappoint 'em, y'know? Bit late now, though. What's done is done, can't take it back.
Solidarity of Steel#378.dst: Odio decepcionarlos, ¿sabes? Aunque ya es tarde. Lo hecho, hecho está, no hay vuelta atrás.
Solidarity of Steel#378.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#379.src: It'll be alright. Worse things've happened. Aihan's safe, that's all that matters! We'll deal with the rest as it comes.
Solidarity of Steel#379.dst: Saldrá bien. Han pasado cosas peores. ¡Aihan está a salvo, eso es lo que importa! Lo demás lo iremos viendo.
Solidarity of Steel#379.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#380.src: I- I should've... I should've l-lis- listened to you. But, s- s- seeing the way they- they were treating her... I was j- j- just so... angry. How dare th- they look down on p- p- people like that?!
Solidarity of Steel#380.dst: Y- yo debería... debería haberte h-he- hecho caso. Pero, a- a- al ver cómo la- la trataban... me puse t- t- tan... furioso. ¡¿Cómo se a- atreven a despreciar así a la g- g- gente?!
Solidarity of Steel#380.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#381.src: Yeah... I hear you. Hear you loud and clear. It's not right, is it? But that's what we're working to fix down here, man. Gotta do what little you can, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#381.dst: Ya... te entiendo. Alto y claro. No está bien, ¿verdad? Pero eso es lo que intentamos arreglar aquí abajo, tío. Hay que hacer lo poco que puedas, ¿no?
Solidarity of Steel#381.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#382.src: Let's get going. They'll be expecting us. Wouldn't want to keep 'em waiting.
Solidarity of Steel#382.dst: Vámonos. Nos estarán esperando. No los hagamos esperar.
Solidarity of Steel#382.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#383.src: ...We should f- f- follow them in.
Solidarity of Steel#383.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#384.src: Head back to the Steel Feather through the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#384.dst: Vuelve a la Pluma de Acero por el túnel en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#385.src: Report what happened to The Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#385.dst: Informa de lo ocurrido a la Pluma de Acero en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#387.src: Would- w- would it be weird to say it's a r- r- relief to find out he has a ser- a- a serious side to him?
Solidarity of Steel#387.dst: ¿S- se- sería raro decir que es un a- a- alivio saber que tiene un lado s- se- serio?
Solidarity of Steel#387.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#388.src: Not- n- not that this is how I'd have w- w- wanted to find out...
Solidarity of Steel#388.dst: N- n- no es que quisiera e- en- enterarme así...
Solidarity of Steel#388.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#390.src: Jiro and I got her settled. Quill's giving her the rundown as we speak.
Solidarity of Steel#390.dst: Jiro y yo la hemos instalado. Quill le está explicando todo ahora mismo.
Solidarity of Steel#390.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#391.src: You should... probably avoid Jiro for now, yeah? He's not exactly... happy.
Solidarity of Steel#391.dst: Deberías... evitar a Jiro por ahora, ¿vale? No está precisamente... contento.
Solidarity of Steel#391.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#392.src: Right... Got it. So- s- so... how does it wor- work now? Should we re- record this mission s- somewhere?
Solidarity of Steel#392.dst: Vale... Entendido. E- en- entonces... ¿cómo fun- funciona ahora? ¿Hay que a- anotar esta misión en a- algún sitio?
Solidarity of Steel#392.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#393.src: Yep, yep! Normally I'd go to Quill, but he's busy. Let's see if we can find Yusanu first- he'll... understand. Probably. More than Yulie, at least. I trust him to keep it quiet for now, at least... y'know?
Solidarity of Steel#393.dst: ¡Sí, sí! Normalmente iría a Quill, pero está ocupado. Busquemos antes a Yusanu- él... lo entenderá. Seguramente. Al menos más que Yulie. Me fío de que se lo calle por ahora, al menos... ¿sabes?
Solidarity of Steel#393.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#395.src: Yuman, I swear. Yusanu should know better than to let you take the lead on these sorts of things! What were you thinking?
Solidarity of Steel#395.dst: Yuman, te lo juro. ¡Yusanu debería saber que no hay que dejarte al mando en estas cosas! ¿En qué pensabas?
Solidarity of Steel#395.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#396.src: Woah, woah, woah! That's a lot of accusations out of nowhere, bro! What gives?
Solidarity of Steel#396.dst: ¡Eh, eh, eh! ¡Cuántas acusaciones de la nada, tío! ¿Qué pasa?
Solidarity of Steel#396.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#397.src: What gives? You know what gives- a whole squadron of housing enforcers turns up dead on the job, and you expect that to go over quietly?
Solidarity of Steel#397.dst: ¿Que qué pasa? Sabes muy bien qué pasa- todo un escuadrón de agentes de vivienda aparece muerto en servicio, ¿y esperas que eso pase desapercibido?
Solidarity of Steel#397.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#398.src: Ahhh. That. Well, you know how it is. Things happen, right?
Solidarity of Steel#398.dst: Ahhh. Eso. Bueno, ya sabes cómo va. Pasan cosas, ¿no?
Solidarity of Steel#398.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#399.src: You-... at least pretend to take this seriously, would you? Of all people, you should know what this is going to lead to.
Solidarity of Steel#399.dst: Tú-... al menos finge que te lo tomas en serio, ¿quieres? Precisamente tú deberías saber adónde lleva esto.
Solidarity of Steel#399.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#400.src: It- it was- was- it wasn't his f- f- fault, I-
Solidarity of Steel#400.dst: N- no fue- fue- no fue c- c- culpa suya, yo-
Solidarity of Steel#400.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#401.src: Hey, princess, it's alright. Don't need you to cover for me, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#401.dst: Eh, princesa, tranquilo. No hace falta que me cubras, ¿vale?
Solidarity of Steel#401.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#402.src: So what's the plan then, Yulie? Meeting to talk about it, as always?
Solidarity of Steel#402.dst: ¿Y cuál es el plan, Yulie? ¿Reunión para hablarlo, como siempre?
Solidarity of Steel#402.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#403.src: Sigh... as soon as Quill gets Aihan sorted, yes. It shouldn't take long, so everyone's gathered in advance.
Solidarity of Steel#403.dst: Suspiro... sí, en cuanto Quill acabe con Aihan. No debería tardar, así que todos se han reunido ya.
Solidarity of Steel#403.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#405.src: Hey! What happened out there? Everyone's acting weird about it.
Solidarity of Steel#405.dst: ¡Eh! ¿Qué pasó ahí fuera? Todos están raros con el tema.
Solidarity of Steel#405.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#406.src: We ended up f- fight- fighting some soldiers to save the w- w- the woman we went there for...
Solidarity of Steel#406.dst: Acabamos pe- pele- peleando con unos soldados para salvar a la m- m- a la mujer a la que íbamos...
Solidarity of Steel#406.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#407.src: Huh. Is that all? I thought it'd be way worse.
Solidarity of Steel#407.dst: Vaya. ¿Solo eso? Pensaba que sería mucho peor.
Solidarity of Steel#407.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#408.src: Yeah... they- th- they're worried about it dr- draw- drawing attention...
Solidarity of Steel#408.dst: Ya... es- e- están preocupados por si lla- llama- llama la atención...
Solidarity of Steel#408.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#410.src: Still helping out in the kitchen, preparing for dinner! Worry not, I will catch her up once the meeting concludes.
Solidarity of Steel#410.dst: ¡Sigue echando una mano en la cocina con la cena! No temáis, la pondré al día cuando acabe la reunión.
Solidarity of Steel#410.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#411.src: Ah, hello everybody. Apologies for the delay.
Solidarity of Steel#411.dst: Ah, hola a todos. Disculpad la tardanza.
Solidarity of Steel#411.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#413.src: She hasn't quite decided yet, but she has agreed to stay the night. She's in a bad state of mind, the poor woman. Some rest will do her good.
Solidarity of Steel#413.dst: Aún no lo ha decidido del todo, pero ha aceptado pasar la noche. Está en muy mal estado de ánimo, la pobre. Descansar le vendrá bien.
Solidarity of Steel#413.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#414.src: But that leads us well to the reason this meeting was called. The retrieval process went... poorly, I take it?
Solidarity of Steel#414.dst: Pero eso nos lleva al motivo de esta reunión. El rescate salió... mal, ¿me equivoco?
Solidarity of Steel#414.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#415.src: Poorly is an understatement. The military is on high alert now! Everyone entering or leaving {p} this evening was questioned- if I hadn't used our tunnel, I'd still be stuck in line there!
Solidarity of Steel#415.dst: Mal se queda corto. ¡El ejército está en alerta máxima! Esta tarde han interrogado a todo el que entraba o salía de {p}- ¡si no llego a usar nuestro túnel, seguiría en la cola!
Solidarity of Steel#415.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#416.src: This is an unmitigated disaster. Yuman, what do you have to say for yourself? You should know better by now, we need to-
Solidarity of Steel#416.dst: Esto es un desastre absoluto. Yuman, ¿qué tienes que decir en tu defensa? A estas alturas deberías saberlo, necesitamos-
Solidarity of Steel#416.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#417.src: H- hey! It- it- it's not- it's n- not his f- f- fault! I'm the- the one who-
Solidarity of Steel#417.dst: ¡E- eh! N- n- no es- ¡n- no es c- c- culpa suya! Fui y- yo quien-
Solidarity of Steel#417.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#418.src: Nah, the blame falls on me. I was the leader, so anything that happened is my responsibility. I should've... been more firm about it.
Solidarity of Steel#418.dst: No, la culpa es mía. Yo era el líder, así que todo lo que pasó es responsabilidad mía. Debería haber... sido más firme.
Solidarity of Steel#418.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#419.src: None of this would have happened if I'd been there... damn it. The timing couldn't have been worse. This is all my-
Solidarity of Steel#419.dst: Nada de esto habría pasado si yo hubiera estado allí... maldita sea. Peor momento imposible. Todo esto es culpa-
Solidarity of Steel#419.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#420.src: Okay, that's enough. You're all acting stupid! Who cares whose fault it was? Either way, it already happened, so let's figure out what we're going to do about it.
Solidarity of Steel#420.dst: Vale, ya basta. ¡Os estáis comportando como tontos! ¿A quién le importa de quién fue la culpa? Ya ha pasado, así que pensemos qué vamos a hacer.
Solidarity of Steel#420.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#422.src: And I'm not done! You're all acting like it's the end of the world that some soldiers are dead. So what? Soldiers die all the time.
Solidarity of Steel#422.dst: ¡Y no he terminado! Actuáis como si fuera el fin del mundo que hayan muerto unos soldados. ¿Y qué? Los soldados mueren a todas horas.
Solidarity of Steel#422.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#423.src: They don't die like this, though. We don't have the luxury of being able to wave off the crown's attention! If they find out what we're doing down here, we're done for.
Solidarity of Steel#423.dst: Pero no mueren así. ¡No podemos permitirnos espantar la atención de la Corona como si nada! Si descubren lo que hacemos aquí abajo, estamos acabados.
Solidarity of Steel#423.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#424.src: But they haven't found out yet, have they? You have options still. For example- you're on the detective force! If suspicions arise, couldn't you just lead them elsewhere?
Solidarity of Steel#424.dst: Pero aún no lo han descubierto, ¿no? Todavía tenéis opciones. Por ejemplo- ¡tú estás en el cuerpo de detectives! Si surgen sospechas, ¿no podrías desviarlas?
Solidarity of Steel#424.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#425.src: Besides. If staying hidden means having to look away as innocent people get harmed- what kind of a resistance does that make you? What's the point of any of it?
Solidarity of Steel#425.dst: Además. Si esconderse significa mirar hacia otro lado mientras hacen daño a inocentes- ¿qué clase de resistencia sois? ¿Qué sentido tiene todo esto?
Solidarity of Steel#425.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#426.src: Rex... take care with your words. Don't say anything you'll-
Solidarity of Steel#426.dst: Rex... mide tus palabras. No digas nada de lo que vayas a-
Solidarity of Steel#426.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#427.src: What's the POINT?! The POINT is all the people we ALREADY have down here who we need to protect! Quill, please, back me up here.
Solidarity of Steel#427.dst: ¡¿Qué SENTIDO?! ¡El SENTIDO es toda la gente que YA tenemos aquí abajo y a la que hay que proteger! Quill, por favor, apóyame.
Solidarity of Steel#427.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#428.src: ... No, Yulie, Rex has a point. Even if it was phrased harshly... we have been rather passive in our battle thus far. We've let people get hurt, even if only for the sake of our safety.
Solidarity of Steel#428.dst: ... No, Yulie, Rex tiene razón. Aunque lo diga con dureza... hasta ahora hemos sido pasivos en esta lucha. Hemos dejado que hirieran a otros, aunque fuera por nuestra seguridad.
Solidarity of Steel#428.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#429.src: We have had our reasons... and we have done good work, to the best of our ability. But if we are afraid to act, how will anything ever change for the better?
Solidarity of Steel#429.dst: Hemos tenido nuestras razones... y hemos hecho un buen trabajo, dentro de nuestras posibilidades. Pero si tenemos miedo de actuar, ¿cómo va a mejorar algo?
Solidarity of Steel#429.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#431.src: You are not wrong to feel frustration, Yulie. I, too, wish this had been handled with more care... but something like this was bound to happen eventually. We will survive this, as we have survived other hardships before.
Solidarity of Steel#431.dst: No te falta razón al sentir frustración, Yulie. Yo también desearía que se hubiera llevado con más cuidado... pero algo así tenía que pasar tarde o temprano. Sobreviviremos a esto, como hemos sobrevivido a otras penurias.
Solidarity of Steel#431.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#433.src: ...But let's lighten the mood a little! Dinner should almost be ready. Yuman, you told me earlier today you were working on a new song. Would you still like to perform it tonight?
Solidarity of Steel#433.dst: ...¡Pero animemos un poco el ambiente! La cena estará casi lista. Yuman, hoy me has dicho que estabas con una canción nueva. ¿Sigues queriendo tocarla esta noche?
Solidarity of Steel#433.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#434.src: Huh? Oh, yeah, yeah man! I can do that, for sure.
Solidarity of Steel#434.dst: ¿Eh? ¡Ah, sí, sí, tío! Claro que puedo.
Solidarity of Steel#434.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#435.src: Ahem. Before we depart, if I may- while we are all gathered here, I believe it could be beneficial to lay out some relevant information.
Solidarity of Steel#435.dst: Ejem. Antes de irnos, si se me permite- ya que estamos todos reunidos, creo que sería útil exponer cierta información relevante.
Solidarity of Steel#435.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#436.src: Most of us are new to the Roughworks, so getting to know the lay of the land could help.
Solidarity of Steel#436.dst: La mayoría somos nuevos en Roughworks, así que conocer el terreno podría ayudar.
Solidarity of Steel#436.speaker: Mora
