Solidarity of Steel#437.src: Right, of course. I'd been meaning to suggest something similar earlier, before... this situation came up.
Solidarity of Steel#437.dst: Sí, claro. Pensaba proponer algo parecido antes, hasta que... surgió esta situación.
Solidarity of Steel#437.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#438.src: Certainly, we could do that! What would you like to know?
Solidarity of Steel#438.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#439.src: Ah, yes. Her name is Soosu. It's hard to say much about her... she's rather reclusive, staying cooped up in her mansion, working away.
Solidarity of Steel#439.dst: Ah, sí. Se llama Soosu. Poco se puede decir de ella... es bastante solitaria, encerrada en su mansión, trabajando sin parar.
Solidarity of Steel#439.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#440.src: She's the opposite of Zhiraok, in that way. Ideally, we'll avoid drawing her attention. We'll have plenty to worry about already without adding her to the list.
Solidarity of Steel#440.dst: En eso es lo contrario de Zhiraok. Lo ideal sería no llamar su atención. Ya tendremos bastantes preocupaciones sin añadirla a la lista.
Solidarity of Steel#440.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#441.src: That'd be for the best, yeah. She's... kind of a genius. She singlehandedly brought forth the Industrial Age, over a century ago! Most of the machinery you see in Fruma probably traces its origin back to her in some way.
Solidarity of Steel#441.dst: Sí, sería lo mejor. Es... una especie de genio. ¡Ella sola trajo la Era Industrial hace más de un siglo! Casi toda la maquinaria que veis en Fruma seguramente tenga su origen en ella de algún modo.
Solidarity of Steel#441.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#442.src: Ha! Yeah, yeah, figures you'd know all that, bro. Nerd.
Solidarity of Steel#442.dst: ¡Ja! Sí, sí, cómo no ibas a saber todo eso, tío. Empollón.
Solidarity of Steel#442.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#443.src: Wh- that's just written history, Yuman. If you're going to make fun of me, at least do it right.
Solidarity of Steel#443.dst: Q- eso es historia escrita, Yuman. Si vas a burlarte de mí, hazlo bien al menos.
Solidarity of Steel#443.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#444.src: How about her blessing? If we do run into her, we'll want to know what to watch out for.
Solidarity of Steel#444.dst: ¿Y su bendición? Si nos topamos con ella, querremos saber de qué cuidarnos.
Solidarity of Steel#444.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#445.src: I don't know the specifics... but what I do know is that it allows her to mold matter at will. To what extent, or with what limits... hard to say. Still, that uncertainty is dangerous. Be careful.
Solidarity of Steel#445.dst: No sé los detalles... pero sí sé que le permite moldear la materia a voluntad. Hasta qué punto, o con qué límites... difícil decirlo. Aun así, esa duda es peligrosa. Cuidado.
Solidarity of Steel#445.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#446.src: Very well! Then let us adjourn for dinner.
Solidarity of Steel#446.dst: ¡Muy bien! Entonces levantamos la sesión para cenar.
Solidarity of Steel#446.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#447.src: Speak to Sui at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and watch Yuman's performance.
Solidarity of Steel#447.dst: Habla con Sui en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y mira la actuación de Yuman.

Solidarity of Steel#448.src: Yuman's performance is about to start. You should grab a bite from Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#448.dst: La actuación de Yuman está a punto de empezar. ¡Pilla algo de comer con Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#448.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#449.src: Oh, {u}! I feel like I've barely seen you around here...
Solidarity of Steel#449.dst: ¡Ah, {u}! Siento que apenas te he visto por aquí...
Solidarity of Steel#449.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#450.src: I, um... Mora told me about what happened. On your mission. I'm... glad you were able to help that woman.
Solidarity of Steel#450.dst: Yo, eh... Mora me contó lo que pasó. En vuestra misión. Me... alegra que pudierais ayudar a esa mujer.
Solidarity of Steel#450.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#451.src: I, ha, kind of wish I could've been there, to help. Though, I don't... really know what I could have done, there.
Solidarity of Steel#451.dst: Yo, ja, ojalá hubiera podido estar allí, para ayudar. Aunque no... sé muy bien qué habría podido hacer.
Solidarity of Steel#451.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#452.src: S-so maybe it's a good thing! That I've been, um, busy, cooking. For the Steel Feather. There's, ha, a lot of people here!
Solidarity of Steel#452.dst: A-así que quizá sea bueno. Que haya estado, eh, ocupada, cocinando. Para la Pluma de Acero. ¡Hay, ja, muchísima gente aquí!
Solidarity of Steel#452.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#453.src: But I've been learning new recipes, and getting to know new people! Oh, right, you're probably here for, um, the food. Here! Please have some.
Solidarity of Steel#453.dst: ¡Pero estoy aprendiendo recetas nuevas y conociendo gente nueva! Ah, claro, habrás venido por, eh, la comida. ¡Toma! Sírvete.
Solidarity of Steel#453.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#454.src: ...oh, hi! Are you here for some food?
Solidarity of Steel#454.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#455.src: Ah, n-no, I- well, yes, I'd love some food, but I'm here to- to thank {u}.
Solidarity of Steel#455.dst: Ah, n-no, yo- bueno, sí, me encantaría comer algo, pero vengo a- a dar las gracias a {u}.
Solidarity of Steel#455.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#456.src: Don't- don't sell yourself short! I don't... f-fully understand yet, but, fighting the guards like... like that is dangerous, and- and I know why some people wouldn't want to...
Solidarity of Steel#456.dst: ¡No- no te quites mérito! Aún no... lo e-entiendo del todo, pero pelear con los guardias así... así es peligroso, y- y sé por qué algunos no querrían...
Solidarity of Steel#456.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#458.src: We- no, no, no, this- this won't work, I can't- you need to pack different things, I can't go with- with this, pleas
Solidarity of Steel#458.dst: No- no, no, no, esto- esto no vale, no puedo- tienes que llevar otras cosas, no puedo ir con- con esto, por fav

Solidarity of Steel#459.src: There's an inscription, but it's written in a language you can't understand.
Solidarity of Steel#459.dst: Hay una inscripción, pero está escrita en un idioma que no entiendes.

Solidarity of Steel#460.src: It's the poster you stuck on advertising the Pishlas Hot Springs.
Solidarity of Steel#460.dst: Es el cartel que pegaste anunciando las Termas de Pishlas.

Solidarity of Steel#461.src: But you did anyway, and- and- and it means a lot.
Solidarity of Steel#461.dst: Pero lo hicisteis igualmente, y- y- y significa mucho.
Solidarity of Steel#461.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#462.src: It, um, sounds like it was a really bad situation. So I'm glad you got out alright.
Solidarity of Steel#462.dst: Suena, eh, a que fue una situación muy fea. Así que me alegro de que salierais bien.
Solidarity of Steel#462.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#463.src: H-ha... yes. They've been... p-pushy before, but they've never been this- this- this, ah, violent.
Solidarity of Steel#463.dst: J-ja... sí. Antes ya se p-ponían pesados, pero nunca habían sido tan- tan- tan, ah, violentos.
Solidarity of Steel#463.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#464.src: Y-yes, I am. It's... new, and- and different, but everyone here has been so kind, and...
Solidarity of Steel#464.dst: S-sí, lo estoy. Es... nuevo, y- y distinto, pero aquí todo el mundo ha sido amabilísimo, y...
Solidarity of Steel#464.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#465.src: It's a little- a little strange... It almost feels like- like- like I don't deserve it! Because, I- I- I haven't... w-worked for it.
Solidarity of Steel#465.dst: Es un poco- un poco raro... ¡Casi siento que- que- que no me lo merezco! Porque, y-y-yo no... me lo he g-ganado.
Solidarity of Steel#465.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#466.src: Um... I don't really, know, what it's like to live here... but where I'm from, people help each other. You shouldn't have to earn the right to live.
Solidarity of Steel#466.dst: Eh... No sé muy, bien, cómo es vivir aquí... pero de donde vengo, la gente se ayuda. No deberías tener que ganarte el derecho a vivir.
Solidarity of Steel#466.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#467.src: Y-you must be from a much n-nicer place than- than here.
Solidarity of Steel#467.dst: T-tú debes de venir de un sitio mucho m-mejor que- que este.
Solidarity of Steel#467.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#468.src: Ha... it's k-kind of ridiculous, looking back. Stupid- s-stupid quotas... ouch...
Solidarity of Steel#468.dst: Ja... v-visto ahora, es hasta ridículo. Malditas- m-malditas cuotas... ay...
Solidarity of Steel#468.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#469.src: You want to know my story?

Solidarity of Steel#471.src: Oh, it- it's nothing. Just, heavy m-machinery. Hurt my shoulder when- when I went in. It- it's r-really my fault, I, I, I sh-should have been m-more careful...
Solidarity of Steel#471.dst: Ah, no- no es nada. Solo, m-maquinaria pesada. Me hice daño en el hombro al- al entrar. Es- es c-culpa mía, yo, yo, yo d-debía haber tenido m-más cuidado...
Solidarity of Steel#471.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#472.src: Um... I- I can, ha, I can help you.
Solidarity of Steel#472.dst: Eh... Yo- yo puedo, ja, puedo ayudarte.
Solidarity of Steel#472.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#474.src: Just... sigh. Follow me, and- and trust me.
Solidarity of Steel#474.dst: Solo... suspiro. Sígueme y- y confía en mí.
Solidarity of Steel#474.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#477.src: H-hey! I- I only have this shirt, I c- I can't- I-
Solidarity of Steel#477.dst: ¡E-eh! S- solo tengo esta camisa, n- no puedo- yo-
Solidarity of Steel#477.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#480.src: How did- how did you do that?
Solidarity of Steel#480.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#483.src: I-... th-thank you. I didn't... I didn't know cursed ones could be- could be nice.
Solidarity of Steel#483.dst: Yo-... g-gracias. No sabía... no sabía que los malditos pudieran ser- ser amables.
Solidarity of Steel#483.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#484.src: Um... I sh-should go. Thank you for- for the food, and- and- and for... healing my shoulder. I- I really appreciate it.
Solidarity of Steel#484.dst: Eh... D-debería irme. Gracias por- por la comida, y- y- y por... curarme el hombro. Te- te lo agradezco de verdad.
Solidarity of Steel#484.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#487.src: It's fine. It's what I expected. I'm... glad I could help.
Solidarity of Steel#487.dst: No pasa nada. Me lo esperaba. Me... alegra haber podido ayudar.
Solidarity of Steel#487.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#488.src: I- I guess so! Ha... at least she, um, wasn't scared. Just... nervous.
Solidarity of Steel#488.dst: ¡S- supongo que sí! Ja... al menos no, eh, se asustó. Solo... estaba nerviosa.
Solidarity of Steel#488.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#489.src: I'll, um, catch up with the rest of you, later.
Solidarity of Steel#489.dst: Yo, eh, me reúno con vosotros, luego.
Solidarity of Steel#489.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#490.src: Go join the others. Uh, I'll join you in a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#490.dst: Ve con los demás. Eh, yo voy en un rato.
Solidarity of Steel#490.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#491.src: {u}, it's nice of you to join us. Have you had dinner yet?
Solidarity of Steel#491.dst: {u}, qué bien que te unas. ¿Ya has cenado?
Solidarity of Steel#491.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#492.src: It's good, isn't it? Quill tells me she's managed to fit right in with the other cooks here.
Solidarity of Steel#492.dst: Está buena, ¿verdad? Quill me dice que ha encajado perfectamente con los demás cocineros.
Solidarity of Steel#492.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#493.src: So, {u}, are you also w- wait- waiting for Yuman's performance?
Solidarity of Steel#493.dst: Y bien, {u}, ¿tú también es- esp- esperas la actuación de Yuman?
Solidarity of Steel#493.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#494.src: I have heard great things about his musical talents! Though, ah, I have also heard this his variety, ah, leaves something to be desired.
Solidarity of Steel#494.dst: ¡He oído maravillas de su talento musical! Aunque, ah, también he oído que su variedad, ah, deja algo que desear.
Solidarity of Steel#494.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#495.src: Then worry not, for you have been reminded just now, hoho!
Solidarity of Steel#495.dst: Pues no te preocupes, que acaban de recordártelo, ¡jojo!
Solidarity of Steel#495.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#496.src: Hey, maybe he's written a song about you, Zeph!
Solidarity of Steel#496.dst: ¡Oye, quizá haya escrito una canción sobre ti, Zeph!
Solidarity of Steel#496.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#497.src: Wh- wh- what?! R- Rex, no h- he-... that's n- not-... wh- why would he ev- even-
Solidarity of Steel#497.dst: ¡¿Q- q- qué?! R- Rex, no, é- él-... eso n- no-... p- por qué iba s- siquiera-
Solidarity of Steel#497.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#498.src: Ha! Relax, relax, I'm just teasing ya.
Solidarity of Steel#498.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#499.src: Ahem... Attention, attention! Everyone, gather around!
Solidarity of Steel#499.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#500.src: I am heartened to see so many of you joining us for dinner today. It feels as though it has been a while since we've had such a large attendance!
Solidarity of Steel#500.dst: Me reconforta ver a tantos de vosotros en la cena de hoy. ¡Parece que hacía tiempo que no teníamos tanta asistencia!
Solidarity of Steel#500.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#501.src: There is of course news to deliver... but first! We begin by thanking our cooks for the meal.
Solidarity of Steel#501.dst: Por supuesto hay noticias que dar... ¡pero antes! Empecemos dando las gracias a nuestros cocineros por la comida.
Solidarity of Steel#501.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#502.src: We're all familiar with Fletch's talents, but dinner wouldn't have been possible without the help of one of our new arrivals: Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#502.dst: Todos conocemos el talento de Fletch, pero la cena no habría sido posible sin la ayuda de una recién llegada: ¡Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#502.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#503.src: Oh...! It, ha, it- um. It was nothing. T'was my pleasure! To- to help.
Solidarity of Steel#503.dst: ¡Ah...! Es, ja, es- eh. No fue nada. ¡Fue un placer! A- ayudar.
Solidarity of Steel#503.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#504.src: No need to be shy, my dear!
Solidarity of Steel#504.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#505.src: Dinner aside, let's get to the announcements!
Solidarity of Steel#505.dst: Dejando la cena, ¡vamos con los anuncios!
Solidarity of Steel#505.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#506.src: Today, we have had not one, but seven new arrivals! In addition to Sui, please welcome Aihan, Mora, Rex, Zeph, {u}, and Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#506.dst: ¡Hoy no ha llegado uno, sino siete recién llegados! ¡Además de Sui, dad la bienvenida a Aihan, Mora, Rex, Zeph, {u} y Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#506.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#507.src: Now, I'm certain news has spread of our... altercation, shall we say, with the crown's military. I assure you, all is under control! The Steel Feather remains secure and hidden.
Solidarity of Steel#507.dst: Sin duda ya habrá corrido la voz de nuestro... altercado, digamos, con el ejército de la Corona. ¡Os aseguro que todo está bajo control! La Pluma de Acero sigue segura y oculta.
Solidarity of Steel#507.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#508.src: It does mean expeditions out of the station will be at higher risk for a time. We will have updated guidelines available in the morning for those of you who volunteer.
Solidarity of Steel#508.dst: Eso sí, durante un tiempo las salidas de la estación serán más arriesgadas. Mañana por la mañana habrá instrucciones actualizadas para quienes se ofrezcan voluntarios.
Solidarity of Steel#508.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#509.src: But in lighter news, we have restocked candy bars and sodas at the ticket shops! Make sure to trade for some before they run out - remember the rules, one of each per person.
Solidarity of Steel#509.dst: Pero en noticias más alegres, ¡hemos repuesto chocolatinas y refrescos en las taquillas! Cambiadlas antes de que se acaben - recordad la norma: una de cada por persona.
Solidarity of Steel#509.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#510.src: Well then! Barring any surprises at this very moment, that is all for today's report. As he has volunteered himself today, I will hand over the stage to Yuman.
Solidarity of Steel#510.dst: ¡Pues bien! Salvo sorpresas de última hora, eso es todo por el informe de hoy. Como hoy se ha ofrecido voluntario, le cedo el escenario a Yuman.
Solidarity of Steel#510.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#511.src: Heeeeeelllllooooo people of the Steel Feather!
Solidarity of Steel#511.dst: ¡Hoooolaaaaa, gente de la Pluma de Acero!
Solidarity of Steel#511.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#512.src: Good to see you all as always- ey, Taio, lookin' good! Mei, love what you've done with the hair! Jin, my man!
Solidarity of Steel#512.dst: Un placer veros como siempre- ¡ey, Taio, qué buen aspecto! Mei, ¡me encanta tu pelo nuevo! ¡Jin, tío!
Solidarity of Steel#512.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#513.src: Ah... I guess I can introduce my song. It's a new one! You guys won't be able to tease me for being an artist with only one song anymore, haha!
Solidarity of Steel#513.dst: Ah... Supongo que puedo presentar mi canción. ¡Es nueva! ¡Ya no podréis picarme por ser un artista de una sola canción, jaja!
Solidarity of Steel#513.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#514.src: I've been working on this one for a while. Never could find a way to end it, though... 'till now, that is. Finally managed to find some inspiration.
Solidarity of Steel#514.dst: Llevo un tiempo trabajando en ella. Aunque nunca daba con el final... hasta ahora. Por fin he encontrado algo de inspiración.
Solidarity of Steel#514.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#515.src: Well, enough talking from me. Here it goes!
Solidarity of Steel#515.dst: Bueno, ya he hablado bastante. ¡Allá va!
Solidarity of Steel#515.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#517.src: Hm hm hm! Look who it is!
Solidarity of Steel#517.speaker: ??? (Sovereign Soosu)

Solidarity of Steel#520.src: Happy to see you again, Flowers.
Solidarity of Steel#520.dst: Me alegra volver a verte, Flowers.
Solidarity of Steel#520.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#522.src: You need to subtract some of this security. It shouldn't need to take twenty minutes to get through just the gate. We need to talk, an hour ago.
Solidarity of Steel#522.dst: Tienes que restar algo de esta seguridad. No debería costar veinte minutos pasar solo la verja. Tenemos que hablar, hace una hora.
Solidarity of Steel#522.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#523.src: Wow, mister loudmouth, big words for someone who wasn't supposed to be here for a few more weeks! What gives?! You're interrupting my flow!
Solidarity of Steel#523.dst: Vaya, señor bocazas, ¡qué palabras más grandes para alguien que no debía llegar hasta dentro de unas semanas! ¡¿Qué pasa?! ¡Me estás cortando el rollo!
Solidarity of Steel#523.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Solidarity of Steel#524.src: Your sche- Are you taking lessons from Oru? This provincial emergency has a much greater value than your charter, Sovereign, so I'm summing to the equatio- nnh.
Solidarity of Steel#524.dst: Tu hora- ¿Estás tomando clases de Oru? Esta emergencia provincial tiene un valor mucho mayor que tu estatuto, Soberana, así que me sumo a la ecuació- nnh.
Solidarity of Steel#524.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#525.src: I've changed my schedule to come here early and track down a defector- Syndra, and her set of insurgents. You've heard the name, right?
Solidarity of Steel#525.dst: He cambiado mi horario para venir antes y dar caza a una desertora- Syndra, y su grupo de insurgentes. Has oído ese nombre, ¿verdad?
Solidarity of Steel#525.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Stable Story#000.src: Howdy! Lookin' to hitch a ride off to {p}? Well, lucky you! The wagon's been fixed up all nice and new!

Stable Story#001.src: Just hop on aboard, and I'll get you to {p} in a jiffy!

Stable Story#002.src: Ain't far to {p} from here! We'll be there in a jiffy, just you wait.

Stable Story#003.src: Usually, I'd be charging a high price for these horses- Not to be rude, but one you couldn't afford.

Stable Story#004.src: So, let's cut a deal- They stole my stable key. If you can go to my barn in {p}...

Stable Story#005.src: And return that key to me, I'll so charitably bestow upon you one of my horses. This deal is sweeter than you realize, too...

Stable Story#006.src: Hm. Cows, huh? Ah- who knows!? Life is full of mysteries, huh?

Stable Story#007.src: Either way. As the great bovine above is my witness if I see the smallest bruise on Betty I will-

Stable Story#008.src: Ah! I can't just hand you a horse without telling you how to care for that beautiful creature, can I?

Stable Story#009.src: Those rich {p} folk have no respect for horses, let me tell you!

Stable Story#010.src: Now! Right Click the Feeder and place your [Horse Saddle] in there.

Stable Story#011.src: Use the [{~} Wheat Grains] I gave you earlier to feed your new friend.

Stable Story#012.src: Just Right Click the Feeder again.

Stable Story#013.src: Horses are sensitive creatures, you see. They don't grow strong over night, they require patience and a good stable diet.

Stable Story#014.src: However, you also need to take them out on walks so they get some well needed exercise, otherwise they will never reach their full potential.

Stable Story#015.src: I almost forgot! If you really want to master the art of a horse trainer you can breed two horses using the Feeder.

Stable Story#016.src: Anyway! I wish you luck on your horse training career!

Stable Story#017.dst: Habla con Enkser fuera de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Stable Story#018.src: Looking for able-bodied adventurers! Preferably with no friends or family, but I'm not picky!
Stable Story#018.dst: ¡Busco aventureros fuertes! Preferiblemente sin amigos ni familia, ¡pero no soy exigente!
Stable Story#018.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#019.src: You see, I'm a horse merchant. Make my living selling these beauties to adventurers like you.
Stable Story#019.dst: Verás, soy tratante de caballos. Me gano la vida vendiendo estas preciosidades a aventureros como tú.
Stable Story#019.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#020.src: I work at this barn, selling the horses I raise in {p} out here to rich {p} folk.
Stable Story#020.dst: Trabajo en este establo: vendo aquí los caballos que crío en {p} a los ricos de {p}.
Stable Story#020.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#021.src: Until these rabble-rousing troublemakers blew a tunnel through my barn and smuggled MY horses out.
Stable Story#021.dst: Hasta que esos alborotadores volaron un túnel bajo mi establo y se llevaron MIS caballos.
Stable Story#021.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#022.src: Usually, I'd be charging a high price for these horses Not to be rude, but one you couldn't afford.
Stable Story#022.dst: Normalmente pediría un buen precio por estos caballos. Sin ánimo de ofender, uno que tú no podrías pagar.
Stable Story#022.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#023.src: So, let's cut a deal They stole my stable key. If you can go to my barn in {p}...
Stable Story#023.dst: Así que hagamos un trato. Me robaron la llave del establo. Si puedes acercarte al mío en {p}...
Stable Story#023.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#024.src: And return the key to me, I'll so charitably bestow upon you one of my horses. This deal is sweeter than you realize, too...
Stable Story#024.dst: Y me devuelves la llave, te concederé caritativamente uno de mis caballos. Además, el trato es mejor de lo que crees...
Stable Story#024.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#025.src: Betty'll be there to help! Strong as she is, don't you DARE let them touch her!
Stable Story#025.dst: ¡Betty te ayudará! Es fuerte, ¡pero NI SE TE OCURRA dejar que la toquen!
Stable Story#025.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#026.src: I'll be making my way to {p} myself to ensure Betty's safety.
Stable Story#026.dst: Yo mismo iré a {p} para asegurarme de que Betty esté a salvo.
Stable Story#026.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#027.src: Now, best be on your way. {p} is a fair bit down the {p} from here, off to the east.
Stable Story#027.dst: Venga, ponte en marcha. {p} está bastante más abajo por {p}, hacia el este.
Stable Story#027.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#028.src: Bring back [{~} Stable Key] to Enkser from the tunnel at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Stable Story#028.dst: Lleva [{~} Stable Key] de vuelta a Enkser desde el túnel en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Stable Story#029.src: Hey, have you found my [{~} Stable Key] yet? It should be somewhere in {p} to the east.
Stable Story#029.dst: Oye, ¿ya has encontrado mi [{~} Stable Key]? Debería estar por {p}, al este.
Stable Story#029.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#030.src: Looking for able-bodied adventurers, preferably with no friends or
Stable Story#030.dst: Busco aventureros fuertes, preferiblemente sin amigos ni
Stable Story#030.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#031.src: Hey, it's you! Got my barn key yet?
Stable Story#031.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#032.src: Ah, god bless. And I presume Betty did all the work while you just lounged around.
Stable Story#032.dst: Ah, bendito sea. Y supongo que Betty hizo todo el trabajo mientras tú holgazaneabas.
Stable Story#032.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#033.src: Hm. Cows, huh? Ah who knows!? Life is full of mysterious, huh?
Stable Story#033.dst: Hm. ¿Vacas, eh? ¡¿Quién sabe?! La vida está llena de misterios, ¿no?
Stable Story#033.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#034.src: Either way. As the great bovine above is my witness if I see the smallest bruise I will
Stable Story#034.dst: En fin. Pongo por testigo al gran bovino de las alturas: si veo el menor moratón, yo
Stable Story#034.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#035.src: Nevermind all that. A horse I promised, and a horse you shall have. Much thanks to you.
Stable Story#035.dst: Olvida todo eso. Un caballo te prometí y un caballo tendrás. Muchísimas gracias.
Stable Story#035.speaker: Enkser

Star Thief#000.src: Look into the rumors of strange weather near the Imal Inn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Star Thief#000.dst: Investiga los rumores de clima extraño cerca del Imal Inn en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Star Thief#001.src: Find the meteor's crash site at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Star Thief#001.dst: Encuentra el lugar del impacto del meteorito en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Star Thief#002.src: Hey you! Human. What are you doing here?
Star Thief#002.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#003.src: Under Villager law any extra terrestrial or extra voidal entities are prohibited and owned by the state.
Star Thief#003.dst: Según la ley de los aldeanos, toda entidad extraterrestre o del Vacío está prohibida y pertenece al estado.
Star Thief#003.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#004.src: Seeing as you are new to the land, I can't see you being prosecuted, especially a {p} Guard.
Star Thief#004.dst: Como eres nuevo en estas tierras, dudo que te procesen, y menos a un guardia de {p}.
Star Thief#004.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#005.src: This meteor is different to what we've seen before. We suspect that direct contact with the meteor is dangerous.
Star Thief#005.dst: Este meteorito es distinto a los que hemos visto. Sospechamos que el contacto directo con él es peligroso.
Star Thief#005.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#006.src: The magical radiation doesn't seem to be affecting you at all though. Do you not feel anything? Perhaps you could help me locate it.
Star Thief#006.dst: Aunque la radiación mágica no parece afectarte en absoluto. ¿No notas nada? Quizá puedas ayudarme a localizarlo.
Star Thief#006.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#007.src: Explore the cave that the meteor crashed into.
Star Thief#007.dst: Explora la cueva en la que se estrelló el meteorito.

Star Thief#009.dst: Escapa de la cueva que se derrumba.

Star Thief#010.src: Follow the trail leading off to the east from the cave.
Star Thief#010.dst: Sigue el rastro que sale de la cueva hacia el este.

Star Thief#011.src: Explore the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and defeat the insane thief.
Star Thief#011.dst: Explora la cueva en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y derrota al ladrón enloquecido.

Star Thief#012.src: .̸.̴.̵.̴ I can't control myself...f̸j̷f̴j̵f̵j̴ This rock...
Star Thief#012.speaker: Thief

Star Thief#013.src: What is... this feeling... No I won't listen..
Star Thief#013.dst: ¿Qué es... esta sensación...? No, no pienso escuchar..
Star Thief#013.speaker: Thief

Star Thief#014.src: I can't... control... my mind... e̴n̴d̴ ̷m̶e̷.̷
Star Thief#014.dst: No puedo... controlar... mi mente... end me.
Star Thief#014.speaker: Thief

Star Thief#015.src: Bring back the piece of meteor to the secret agent at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Star Thief#015.dst: Lleva el fragmento de meteorito al agente secreto en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Star Thief#016.src: Hello again. Did you find the meteor down there? Why on earth are you holding some?!
Star Thief#016.dst: Hola de nuevo. ¿Encontraste el meteorito ahí abajo? ¡¿Por qué diablos llevas un trozo?!
Star Thief#016.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#017.src: I see. This material is incredibly rare and magically powerful. Meteors fall all over Gavel and come in a variety of colours and potency.
Star Thief#017.dst: Ya veo. Este material es rarísimo y de gran poder mágico. Los meteoritos caen por todo Gavel, con colores y potencias muy variados.
Star Thief#017.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#018.src: We don't fully understand them, but we know they are dangerous. Every scientist who has studied them has lost their minds.
Star Thief#018.dst: No los entendemos del todo, pero sabemos que son peligrosos. Todos los científicos que los han estudiado han perdido la cabeza.
Star Thief#018.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#019.src: The meteors hold many secrets and powers, maybe the ones we need to end your war. Thank you, here's a small reward for helping us.
Star Thief#019.dst: Los meteoritos guardan muchos secretos y poderes; quizá los que necesitamos para acabar con vuestra guerra. Gracias, aquí tienes una pequeña recompensa.
Star Thief#019.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#020.src: Hello again. Did you find the meteor down there? No? Maybe go back and try to find it?
Star Thief#020.dst: Hola de nuevo. ¿Encontraste el meteorito ahí abajo? ¿No? ¿Y si vuelves a intentar encontrarlo?
Star Thief#020.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#021.src: Remember... Just follow the white trail leading to the cave!
Star Thief#021.dst: Recuerda... ¡Solo sigue el rastro blanco que lleva a la cueva!
Star Thief#021.speaker: Agent

Supply and Delivery#000.src: What? Don't look at me like that! We had a perfectly fair interaction which we both benefited from. I got the plant, and you... well. You gained experience?

Supply and Delivery#001.src: So either you run the supplies to {p}... or we both run away and start new lives, and we avoid the consequences of our actions!

Supply and Delivery#002.src: Howdy! Lookin' to hitch a ride off to {p}? Sorry to say, but the wagon's broken down.

Supply and Delivery#003.src: I reckon it won't be long 'till it's fixed up, but you'll have to make the journey yourself for now.

Supply and Delivery#004.src: This fast travel requires Supply and Delivery to use.

Supply and Delivery#005.src: I hope these emeralds will suffice. Additionally... we have recently fixed up one of our broken carts, which makes the trip to {p} and back.

Supply and Delivery#007.src: Oh, man... What am I going to do now...
Supply and Delivery#007.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#008.src: O-oh! H-hello soldier! Wow, what a coincidence that we're both here... in {p}... today...
Supply and Delivery#008.dst: ¡A-ah! ¡H-hola, soldado! Vaya, qué casualidad que los dos estemos aquí... en {p}... hoy...
Supply and Delivery#008.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#009.src: What? Don't look at me like that! We had a perfectly fair interaction which we both benefitted from. I got the plant, and you... well. You gained experience?
Supply and Delivery#009.dst: ¿Qué? ¡No me mires así! Fue un trato del todo justo del que ambos salimos ganando. Yo conseguí la planta y tú... bueno. ¿Ganaste experiencia?
Supply and Delivery#009.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#010.src: Look, alright, I get it! But I can't pay you back either way. The mayor sent me here to pick up a crate of supplies for the village.
Supply and Delivery#010.dst: Mira, ¡vale, lo pillo! Pero de todas formas no puedo devolvértelo. El alcalde me mandó aquí a recoger una caja de suministros para el pueblo.
Supply and Delivery#010.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#011.src: The issue is... I've already run out of money on- uh, unrelated purchases. And even if I had the money, I couldn't buy the supply crate anyway...
Supply and Delivery#011.dst: El problema es que... ya me he quedado sin dinero por... eh, compras que no vienen al caso. Y aunque lo tuviera, tampoco podría comprar la caja...
Supply and Delivery#011.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#012.src: Those two over there who run the market banned me from ever using it after I tried to buy out the world's supplies of magical powders.
Supply and Delivery#012.dst: Esos dos de ahí que llevan el Mercado me vetaron para siempre después de que intentara comprar todo el polvo mágico del mundo.
Supply and Delivery#012.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#013.src: Look, it's not my fault I'm making big market moves. I'm just, you know- smarter than all these other folks!
Supply and Delivery#013.dst: Oye, no es culpa mía mover el mercado a lo grande. Es solo que, ya sabes, ¡soy más listo que toda esta gente!
Supply and Delivery#013.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#014.src: ... The point is. I could really use your help right now! I- I promise, I'll pay you back for it this time.
Supply and Delivery#014.dst: ... La cuestión es. ¡Me vendría genial tu ayuda ahora mismo! T-te prometo que esta vez te lo devuelvo.
Supply and Delivery#014.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#015.src: All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. Please?
Supply and Delivery#015.dst: Solo tienes que acercarte al Mercado y comprarme la caja de suministros. ¿Porfa?
Supply and Delivery#015.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#016.src: Oh, man... What am I going to do now...
Supply and Delivery#016.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#017.src: O-oh! H-hello soldier! Wow, what a coincidence that we're both here... in {p}... today...
Supply and Delivery#017.dst: ¡A-ah! ¡H-hola, soldado! Vaya, qué casualidad que los dos estemos aquí... en {p}... hoy...
Supply and Delivery#017.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#018.src: What? Don't look at me like that! We had a perfectly fair interaction which we both benefitted from. I got the plant, and you... well. You gained experience?
Supply and Delivery#018.dst: ¿Qué? ¡No me mires así! Fue un trato del todo justo del que ambos salimos ganando. Yo conseguí la planta y tú... bueno. ¿Ganaste experiencia?
Supply and Delivery#018.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#019.src: Look, alright, I get it! But I can't pay you back either way. The mayor sent me here to pick up a crate of supplies for the village.
Supply and Delivery#019.dst: Mira, ¡vale, lo pillo! Pero de todas formas no puedo devolvértelo. El alcalde me mandó aquí a recoger una caja de suministros para el pueblo.
Supply and Delivery#019.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#020.src: The issue is... I've already run out of money on- uh, unrelated purchases. And even if I had the money, I couldn't buy the supply crate anyway...
Supply and Delivery#020.dst: El problema es que... ya me he quedado sin dinero por... eh, compras que no vienen al caso. Y aunque lo tuviera, tampoco podría comprar la caja...
Supply and Delivery#020.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#021.src: Those two over there who run the market banned me from ever using it after I tried to buy out the world's supplies of magical powders.
Supply and Delivery#021.dst: Esos dos de ahí que llevan el Mercado me vetaron para siempre después de que intentara comprar todo el polvo mágico del mundo.
Supply and Delivery#021.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#022.src: Look, it's not my fault I'm making big market moves. I'm just, you know- smarter than all these other folks!
Supply and Delivery#022.dst: Oye, no es culpa mía mover el mercado a lo grande. Es solo que, ya sabes, ¡soy más listo que toda esta gente!
Supply and Delivery#022.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#023.src: ... What? They also banned you from the market?! Well, great. What are we supposed to do now?
Supply and Delivery#023.dst: ... ¿Qué? ¡¿A ti también te han vetado del Mercado?! Genial. ¿Y ahora qué hacemos?
Supply and Delivery#023.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#024.src: Well, do you have any other friends we could get involved? There was... that other soldier guy, right? His name was... Tim. Or something.
Supply and Delivery#024.dst: Bueno, ¿tienes otros amigos a los que meter en esto? Estaba... ese otro soldado, ¿no? Se llamaba... Tim. O algo así.
Supply and Delivery#024.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#025.src: Look- alright, I get it, I'm a jerk who doesn't remember peoples' names! Could you just ask him to buy the supplies for us?? He's our last hope... probably.
Supply and Delivery#025.dst: Mira, vale, lo pillo, ¡soy un cretino que no se acuerda de los nombres! ¿Puedes pedirle que nos compre los suministros? Es nuestra última esperanza... creo.
Supply and Delivery#025.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#026.src: Purchase the supply crate from the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#026.dst: Compra la caja de suministros en el Mercado, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Supply and Delivery#027.src: Hey, good work! Now you'll need to pick up the supply crate.
Supply and Delivery#027.dst: ¡Eh, buen trabajo! Ahora tienes que recoger la caja de suministros.
Supply and Delivery#027.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#028.src: Find Tasim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and convince him to buy the supply crate for you.
Supply and Delivery#028.dst: Encuentra a Tasim en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] y convéncelo de que te compre la caja de suministros.

Supply and Delivery#029.src: Oh, hey {u}! Are you just here to hang out? Or- that look on your face tells me you're here for something else.
Supply and Delivery#029.dst: ¡Ah, hola {u}! ¿Vienes solo a pasar el rato? O... esa cara me dice que vienes por otra cosa.
Supply and Delivery#029.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#030.src: [{~}] Can you buy something from the Trade Market for me?

Supply and Delivery#031.src: I... guess so? Is there a reason you can't do it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#031.dst: Supongo... que sí. ¿Hay algún motivo por el que no puedas tú?
Supply and Delivery#031.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#032.src: ...You're banned from the market? How did you even manage that? We haven't even been in {p} for that long!
Supply and Delivery#032.dst: ...¿Te han vetado del Mercado? ¿Cómo lo has conseguido siquiera? ¡Si no llevamos tanto tiempo en {p}!
Supply and Delivery#032.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#033.src: You- what!? Nevermind, I don't actually want to know. Come on, lead the way. I'll buy... whatever it is you need.
Supply and Delivery#033.dst: Tú... ¡¿qué?! Da igual, mejor no saberlo. Venga, tú primero. Compraré... lo que sea que necesites.
Supply and Delivery#033.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#034.src: ...Oh. Well, that explains that. Though- is there a reason you can't get it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#034.dst: ...Ah. Bueno, eso lo explica. Aunque... ¿hay algún motivo por el que no puedas recogerla tú?
Supply and Delivery#034.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#035.src: ...You're banned from the market? How did you even manage that? We haven't even been in {p} for that long!
Supply and Delivery#035.dst: ...¿Te han vetado del Mercado? ¿Cómo lo has conseguido siquiera? ¡Si no llevamos tanto tiempo en {p}!
Supply and Delivery#035.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#036.src: You- what!? Nevermind, I don't actually want to know. Come on, lead the way. I'll buy whatever it is Ope needs.
Supply and Delivery#036.dst: Tú... ¡¿qué?! Da igual, mejor no saberlo. Venga, tú primero. Compraré lo que sea que necesite Ope.
Supply and Delivery#036.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#037.src: Oh, hello . Are you here for training as well? Or- that look on your face tells me you're here for something else.
Supply and Delivery#037.dst: Ah, hola . ¿Tú también vienes a entrenar? O... esa cara me dice que vienes por otra cosa.
Supply and Delivery#037.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#038.src: I... guess so? Is there a reason you can't do it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#038.dst: Supongo... que sí. ¿Hay algún motivo por el que no puedas tú?
Supply and Delivery#038.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#039.dst: ...¿Te han vetado del Mercado? ¿Cómo lo has conseguido siquiera? ¡Si no llevamos tanto tiempo en {p}!
Supply and Delivery#039.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#040.dst: Tú... ¡¿qué?! Da igual, mejor no saberlo. Venga, tú primero. Compraré... lo que sea que necesites.
Supply and Delivery#040.speaker: Tasim
