Supply and Delivery#041.dst: ...Ah. Bueno, eso lo explica. Aunque... ¿hay algún motivo por el que no puedas recogerla tú?
Supply and Delivery#041.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#042.src: ...You're banned from the market? How did you even manage that? We haven't even been in {p} for that long!
Supply and Delivery#042.dst: ...¿Te han vetado del Mercado? ¿Cómo lo has conseguido siquiera? ¡Si no llevamos tanto tiempo en {p}!
Supply and Delivery#042.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#043.src: You- what!? Nevermind, I don't actually want to know. Come on, lead the way. I'll buy whatever it is Ope needs.
Supply and Delivery#043.dst: Tú... ¡¿qué?! Da igual, mejor no saberlo. Venga, tú primero. Compraré lo que sea que necesite Ope.
Supply and Delivery#043.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#044.src: Bring Tasim to the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#044.dst: Lleva a Tasim al Mercado, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Supply and Delivery#045.src: Alright. So I'm just buying a supply crate...
Supply and Delivery#045.dst: Vale. Entonces solo compro una caja de suministros...
Supply and Delivery#045.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#046.src: Here it is. I wish you luck with... whatever it is you're up to.
Supply and Delivery#046.dst: Aquí la tienes. Suerte con... lo que sea que estés tramando.
Supply and Delivery#046.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#047.src: Return to Ope with the supply crate at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Supply and Delivery#047.dst: Vuelve con Ope con la caja de suministros, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Supply and Delivery#048.src: Perfect! Now, quickly, come back over here, before those two realize you're working with me!
Supply and Delivery#048.dst: ¡Perfecto! Ahora, rápido, vuelve aquí, ¡antes de que esos dos vean que trabajas conmigo!
Supply and Delivery#048.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#049.src: You got the item? Good. Good, good good.
Supply and Delivery#049.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#050.src: Okay! Now, we're onto step two. So, you see, this package still needs to make it to {p}...
Supply and Delivery#050.dst: ¡Vale! Pasamos al paso dos. Verás, este paquete todavía tiene que llegar a {p}...
Supply and Delivery#050.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#051.src: And. Well. You're the one holding the crate, not me! So... you know!
Supply and Delivery#051.dst: Y. Bueno. ¡La caja la llevas tú, no yo! Así que... ¡ya sabes!
Supply and Delivery#051.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#052.src: Great! You know the way by now, surely! No need for me to, uh, get in your way!
Supply and Delivery#052.dst: ¡Genial! ¡Seguro que ya sabes el camino! No hace falta que yo, eh, estorbe.
Supply and Delivery#052.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#053.src: Just take those supplies to {p}, and. Well. Things will work out.
Supply and Delivery#053.dst: Tú lleva esos suministros a {p}, y. Bueno. Todo saldrá bien.
Supply and Delivery#053.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#055.src: Well, you see. I really don't want to do it. And I'm not going to!
Supply and Delivery#055.dst: Verás. Es que no quiero hacerlo de verdad. ¡Y no pienso hacerlo!
Supply and Delivery#055.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#056.src: So you either run the supplies to {p}... or we both run away and start new lives, and we avoid the consequences of our actions!
Supply and Delivery#056.dst: Así que o llevas tú los suministros a {p}... ¡o huimos los dos, empezamos una vida nueva y esquivamos las consecuencias de lo que hicimos!
Supply and Delivery#056.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#057.src: ...no? No. Okay. Worth a shot. Well, you know the way by now! No need for me to, uh, get in your way! Heh...
Supply and Delivery#057.dst: ...¿no? No. Vale. Había que intentarlo. ¡Bueno, ya sabes el camino! No hace falta que yo, eh, estorbe. Je...
Supply and Delivery#057.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#058.src: He bought you the item? Good. Good, good good. Okay! That was... harder than expected.
Supply and Delivery#058.dst: ¿Te lo ha comprado? Bien. Bien, bien bien. ¡Vale! Eso ha sido... más difícil de lo esperado.
Supply and Delivery#058.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#059.src: Okay! Now, we're onto step two. So, you see, this package still needs to make it to {p}...
Supply and Delivery#059.dst: ¡Vale! Pasamos al paso dos. Verás, este paquete todavía tiene que llegar a {p}...
Supply and Delivery#059.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#060.src: And. Well. You're the one holding the crate, not me! So... you know!
Supply and Delivery#060.dst: Y. Bueno. ¡La caja la llevas tú, no yo! Así que... ¡ya sabes!
Supply and Delivery#060.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#061.src: Great! You know the way by now, surely! No need for me to, uh, get in your way!
Supply and Delivery#061.dst: ¡Genial! ¡Seguro que ya sabes el camino! No hace falta que yo, eh, estorbe.
Supply and Delivery#061.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#062.src: Just take those supplies to {p}, and. Well. Things will work out.
Supply and Delivery#062.dst: Tú lleva esos suministros a {p}, y. Bueno. Todo saldrá bien.
Supply and Delivery#062.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#064.src: Well, you see. I really don't want to do it. And I'm not going to!
Supply and Delivery#064.dst: Verás. Es que no quiero hacerlo de verdad. ¡Y no pienso hacerlo!
Supply and Delivery#064.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#065.src: So you either run the supplies to {p}... or we both run away and start new lives, and we avoid the consequences of our actions!
Supply and Delivery#065.dst: Así que o llevas tú los suministros a {p}... ¡o huimos los dos, empezamos una vida nueva y esquivamos las consecuencias de lo que hicimos!
Supply and Delivery#065.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#066.src: ...no? No. Okay. Worth a shot. Well, you know the way by now! No need for me to, uh, get in your way! Heh...
Supply and Delivery#066.dst: ...¿no? No. Vale. Había que intentarlo. ¡Bueno, ya sabes el camino! No hace falta que yo, eh, estorbe. Je...
Supply and Delivery#066.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#067.src: Bring the supply crate to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#067.dst: Lleva la caja de suministros al alcalde Alvin en {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Supply and Delivery#068.src: Ah, hello! What can I do for you today?
Supply and Delivery#068.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#069.src: Ah... So you do. I thought I had sent Ope to pick that up...
Supply and Delivery#069.dst: Ah... Ya veo. Creía haber mandado a Ope a recogerla...
Supply and Delivery#069.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#070.src: More of his shenanigans, I suppose. I am sorry you have had to deal with him twice.
Supply and Delivery#070.dst: Otra de sus trastadas, supongo. Siento que haya tenido que lidiar con él dos veces.
Supply and Delivery#070.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#071.src: When he returns to the village, I'm going to need to have a word with him... Ah, but of course, I should pay you for your troubles.
Supply and Delivery#071.dst: Cuando vuelva al pueblo, tendré que hablar seriamente con él... Ah, pero claro, debería pagarle por las molestias.
Supply and Delivery#071.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#072.src: I hope these emeralds will suffice. Additionally... we recently fixed up one of our broken carts, which makes the trip to {p} and back.
Supply and Delivery#072.dst: Espero que estas esmeraldas basten. Además... hace poco arreglamos una de nuestras carretas averiadas, que hace el viaje a {p} y vuelta.
Supply and Delivery#072.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#073.src: You may feel free to use it whenever you like! As thanks for all you have done for us.
Supply and Delivery#073.dst: ¡Puede usarla siempre que quiera! Como agradecimiento por todo lo que ha hecho por nosotros.
Supply and Delivery#073.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#074.src: He's... difficult. He's the son of my sister, who was unfortunately killed by spiders some time ago.
Supply and Delivery#074.dst: Es... difícil. Es hijo de mi hermana, a la que por desgracia mataron unas arañas hace un tiempo.
Supply and Delivery#074.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#075.src: With his father out of the picture, I had to take him in. He's a grown man now, yes, but... I fear the loss has taken a toll on us both.
Supply and Delivery#075.dst: Sin su padre en escena, tuve que acogerlo. Ya es un hombre hecho y derecho, sí, pero... temo que la pérdida nos pasó factura a los dos.
Supply and Delivery#075.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#076.src: I truly hope he will cease with these ridiculous ploys sometime soon... but I can't bring myself to do more than give him a stern talking to.
Supply and Delivery#076.dst: Espero de veras que pronto deje estas artimañas ridículas... pero no soy capaz de hacer más que echarle una buena reprimenda.
Supply and Delivery#076.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#077.src: He's a good man, truly. I believe that with my whole heart. It's alright if you don't feel the same way, though. I will not force you to interact with him if you do not wish to.
Supply and Delivery#077.dst: Es un buen hombre, de verdad. Lo creo con todo mi corazón. Aunque no pasa nada si usted no opina lo mismo. No le obligaré a tratar con él si no lo desea.
Supply and Delivery#077.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#078.src: Oh, dear... I suppose it must have been fifteen years ago that I took the position, when the old mayor stepped down.
Supply and Delivery#078.dst: Ay, madre... Supongo que hará quince años que asumí el cargo, cuando el antiguo alcalde se retiró.
Supply and Delivery#078.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#079.src: He was a kind man, always looking out for the townsfolk. Though, by the time he retired, it was clear he was growing restless in our little town.
Supply and Delivery#079.dst: Era un hombre amable, siempre pendiente de los vecinos. Aunque, cuando se retiró, estaba claro que se impacientaba en nuestro pueblecito.
Supply and Delivery#079.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#080.src: Well, as soon as he passed down the position to me, he immediately traveled to {p} and enlisted in their army! I hear he's in the business of training soldiers these days.
Supply and Delivery#080.dst: Pues en cuanto me cedió el cargo, ¡se marchó de inmediato a {p} y se alistó en su ejército! Tengo entendido que ahora se dedica a entrenar soldados.
Supply and Delivery#080.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#081.src: Ah, but I've tried lived up to his legacy. I like to think I've done well in my time as mayor!
Supply and Delivery#081.dst: Ah, pero he intentado estar a la altura de su legado. ¡Me gusta pensar que lo he hecho bien como alcalde!
Supply and Delivery#081.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#082.src: A fine day for passing through! I hope you enjoy your stay.
Supply and Delivery#082.dst: ¡Buen día para estar de paso! Espero que disfrute de su estancia.
Supply and Delivery#082.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Taking the Tower#000.src: Oh, wait. There's a stop we've got to make first. Follow me to the Item Upgrader!

Taking the Tower#001.src: Apparently, the big bad at the top of the tower is weak to  Water damage!

Taking the Tower#002.src: You can apply various elemental powders to your weapons, which lets them deal types of damage they might not have been able to before.

Taking the Tower#003.src: In this case, you can apply a  Water powder, so that your weapon will be more effective against the corrupted enemies at the tower!

Taking the Tower#004.src: ...The point is- here. Take this elemental powder and Hold the powder, then Right Click on your weapon. Let me know when you're done!

Taking the Tower#006.src: You see this Item Upgrader? It can be used to upgrade powders to high tiers.

Taking the Tower#007.src: It can also remove powders from your items, if you need to- don't worry, you'll get your powders back!

Taking the Tower#008.src: ...Anyway, Lieutenant Van and the others are by that bunch of houses in the {p}- you probably saw it on your way in.

Taking the Tower#009.src: It doesn't much matter who does the job, so long as it gets done. If you see an opportunity- go for it!

Taking the Tower#010.src: If you need to retreat, or the corrupteds are slain, regroup here! Understood?

Taking the Tower#011.src: Hey, {u}, there you are! Come on, let's climb that tower!

Taking the Tower#012.src: They have, lieutenant! {u} and I reached the top and defeated the corrupted.

Taking the Tower#013.src: Speak to Aledar in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#013.dst: Habla con Aledar en los barracones de {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#014.src: Oh, {u}! Hey! It's good to see you and Tasim again. Hope you didn't have too many adventures without me!
Taking the Tower#014.dst: ¡Ah, {u}! ¡Hola! Qué bien volver a veros a ti y a Tasim. ¡Espero que no hayáis vivido muchas aventuras sin mí!
Taking the Tower#014.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#015.src: Tasim's gone off to the training room, if you were looking for him. He's really jumping straight into it, which... is good! We all need to get stronger so we can defend the province.
Taking the Tower#015.dst: Tasim se ha ido a la sala de entrenamiento, por si lo buscabas. Se ha metido de lleno, y eso... ¡está bien! Todos tenemos que hacernos más fuertes para defender la provincia.
Taking the Tower#015.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#016.src: Tasim told me all about the corrupted force you took out. I wish I could have been there to help!
Taking the Tower#016.dst: Tasim me lo contó todo sobre la fuerza corrupta que eliminasteis. ¡Ojalá hubiera estado allí para ayudar!
Taking the Tower#016.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#017.src: ...Oh! Since you're here- I was about to head out to join Lieutenant Van's squad to take back a tower overtaken by corrupteds. You should come with us, too!
Taking the Tower#017.dst: ...¡Ah! Ya que estás aquí, iba a salir a unirme al escuadrón del teniente Van para recuperar una torre tomada por corruptos. ¡Deberías venir con nosotros!
Taking the Tower#017.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#018.src: Well? What do you think? Want to get some real combat experience? It shouldn't take long.
Taking the Tower#018.dst: ¿Y bien? ¿Qué me dices? ¿Quieres algo de experiencia de combate real? No debería llevar mucho.
Taking the Tower#018.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#019.src: Perfect. Well, no time better than the present! Let's get going.
Taking the Tower#019.dst: Perfecto. ¡No hay mejor momento que ahora! En marcha.
Taking the Tower#019.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#020.src: Oh, wait. There's a stop we've got to make first. Follow me to the Powder Master!
Taking the Tower#020.dst: Ah, espera. Antes tenemos que parar en un sitio. ¡Sígueme hasta el Maestro de Polvos!
Taking the Tower#020.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#022.src: Well, I'll still be here for a while. If you change your mind, let me know!
Taking the Tower#022.dst: Bueno, seguiré aquí un rato. ¡Si cambias de idea, dímelo!
Taking the Tower#022.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#023.src: Hey, you're back! Have you changed you mind? Want to join a raid on a corrupted tower?
Taking the Tower#023.dst: ¡Eh, has vuelto! ¿Has cambiado de idea? ¿Te apuntas a un asalto a una torre corrupta?
Taking the Tower#023.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#024.src: Follow Aledar to the Powder Master at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#024.dst: Sigue a Aledar hasta el Maestro de Polvos, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#025.src: Alright, so. There's something I've been told about the tower we're going to be attacking which we can prepare for!
Taking the Tower#025.dst: Vale, verás. ¡Me han contado algo sobre la torre que vamos a atacar para lo que podemos prepararnos!
Taking the Tower#025.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#026.src: Apparently, the big bad at the top of the tower is weak to damage! And so, here we are at the Powder Master.
Taking the Tower#026.dst: Por lo visto, el jefazo de lo alto de la torre es débil al daño. Por eso estamos aquí, con el Maestro de Polvos.
Taking the Tower#026.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#027.src: You can apply various elemental powders to your weapons here, which lets them deal types of damage they might not have been able to before.
Taking the Tower#027.dst: Aquí puedes aplicar distintos polvos elementales a tus armas, lo que les permite infligir tipos de daño que antes no podían.
Taking the Tower#027.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#028.src: In this case, you can apply a powder, so that your weapon will be more effective against the corrupted enemies at the tower!
Taking the Tower#028.dst: ¡En este caso, puedes aplicar un polvo para que tu arma sea más eficaz contra los enemigos corruptos de la torre!
Taking the Tower#028.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#029.src: I, uh... don't remember the whole elemental speech off the top of my head. If you want to know more about those, you'll have to talk to Captain Ragon in the barracks. He has a whole course about it!
Taking the Tower#029.dst: Yo, eh... no me sé de memoria todo el discurso de los elementos. Si quieres saber más, tendrás que hablar con el capitán Ragon en los barracones. ¡Tiene un curso entero sobre eso!
Taking the Tower#029.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#030.src: ...The point is- here. Take this elemental powder and talk to the Powder Master to apply it. Let me know when you're done!
Taking the Tower#030.dst: ...La cuestión es: toma. Coge este polvo elemental y habla con el Maestro de Polvos para aplicarlo. ¡Avísame cuando termines!
Taking the Tower#030.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#031.src: Apply a Water Powder to your weapon, then let Aledar know at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#031.dst: Aplica un polvo de agua a tu arma y luego avisa a Aledar en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#032.src: Got the powder on your weapon? Good, that means we're ready.
Taking the Tower#032.dst: ¿Ya tienes el polvo en el arma? Bien, eso significa que estamos listos.
Taking the Tower#032.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#033.src: Lieutenant Van and the others are by that bunch of houses in the {p} Suburbs- you probably saw it on your way in.
Taking the Tower#033.dst: El teniente Van y los demás están junto a ese grupo de casas en las afueras de {p}; seguro que lo viste al venir.
Taking the Tower#033.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#034.src: Lead the way! I'll be right behind you.
Taking the Tower#034.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#035.src: Meet up with Lieutenant Van's squad near the Raging Tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#035.dst: Reúnete con el escuadrón del teniente Van cerca de la Torre Furiosa, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#036.src: Ah, Aledar! Good to see you here. Who's this with you?
Taking the Tower#036.dst: ¡Ah, Aledar! Me alegra verte. ¿Quién viene contigo?
Taking the Tower#036.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#037.src: This is {u}, sir. They're here to join our assault, if you'll allow it.
Taking the Tower#037.dst: Es {u}, señor. Quiere unirse al asalto, si usted lo permite.
Taking the Tower#037.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#038.src: Hm... Well, I don't see why not. The more the merrier, that's what I say.
Taking the Tower#038.dst: Hm... No veo por qué no. Cuantos más, mejor, digo yo.
Taking the Tower#038.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#039.src: If everyone's here, we can begin. Here's the plan! We'll need to fight off some of the forces near the base of the tower, so that someone can climb to the top.
Taking the Tower#039.dst: Si estamos todos, empecemos. ¡El plan es este! Habrá que rechazar parte de las fuerzas al pie de la torre para que alguien pueda subir a lo alto.
Taking the Tower#039.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#040.src: It doesn't matter who does the job, so long as it gets done. If you see an opportunity- go for it!
Taking the Tower#040.dst: Da igual quién lo haga, mientras se haga. Si veis una oportunidad, ¡aprovechadla!
Taking the Tower#040.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#041.src: If you need to retreat, or the corrupteds are slain, regroup here!| Understood?
Taking the Tower#041.dst: Si tenéis que retiraros, o los corruptos caen, ¡reagrupaos aquí!| ¿Entendido?
Taking the Tower#041.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#044.src: Good. Alright soldiers, let's take back that tower!
Taking the Tower#044.dst: Bien. ¡Vamos, soldados, a recuperar esa torre!
Taking the Tower#044.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#045.src: Go on, head for the tower! If we're lucky, we'll be able to clear out the corrupteds who have taken over it.
Taking the Tower#045.dst: ¡Vamos, id hacia la torre! Con suerte podremos limpiarla de los corruptos que la han tomado.
Taking the Tower#045.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#046.src: Assault the Raging Tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and defeat the monster at the top.
Taking the Tower#046.dst: Asalta la Torre Furiosa en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] y derrota al monstruo de lo alto.

Taking the Tower#047.src: Alright. It's time to take on the tower! We've got this, {u}.
Taking the Tower#047.dst: Muy bien. ¡Hora de atacar la torre! Podemos con esto, {u}.
Taking the Tower#047.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#048.src: Report back to Lieutenant Van about your success at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Taking the Tower#048.dst: Informa al teniente Van de tu éxito en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Taking the Tower#049.src: We did it, we killed the corrupted! Come on, let's get back to Lieutenant Van with the news!
Taking the Tower#049.dst: ¡Lo hemos hecho, hemos matado al corrupto! ¡Vamos, volvamos con el teniente Van a dar la noticia!
Taking the Tower#049.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#050.src: It seems everyone has returned. Well? Have the corrupted forces been vanquished?
Taking the Tower#050.dst: Parece que han vuelto todos. ¿Y bien? ¿Han sido derrotadas las fuerzas corruptas?
Taking the Tower#050.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#051.src: They have, lieutenant. {u} and I reached the top and defeated the corrupted.
Taking the Tower#051.dst: Así es, teniente. {u} y yo llegamos a lo alto y derrotamos al corrupto.
Taking the Tower#051.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#052.src: Fine work, soldiers! Another great victory for the {p} army. With the leader killed, it shouldn't be too difficult to clear out the rest of them.
Taking the Tower#052.dst: ¡Buen trabajo, soldados! Otra gran victoria para el ejército de {p}. Muerto el cabecilla, limpiar el resto no debería costar mucho.
Taking the Tower#052.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#053.src: I'll let the Admiral know of your victory today, soldiers. And- here, some payment for your work.
Taking the Tower#053.dst: Informaré al almirante de vuestra victoria de hoy, soldados. Y... toma, una paga por el trabajo.
Taking the Tower#053.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#054.src: The two of you have a promising future. I look forward to serving with you in the future!
Taking the Tower#054.dst: Los dos tenéis un futuro prometedor. ¡Espero volver a servir con vosotros!
Taking the Tower#054.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#056.src: We'll take care of the remaining stragglers, don't you worry. Thank you for your work today, soldier.
Taking the Tower#056.dst: Nosotros nos encargamos de los rezagados, no te preocupes. Gracias por tu trabajo de hoy, soldado.
Taking the Tower#056.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taproot#000.src: You should follow Lari. There has to be something you can do.
Taproot#000.dst: Deberías seguir a Lari. Tiene que haber algo que puedas hacer.

Taproot#002.src: ...oh. {u}, you're back. Ehm...I have to say, I'm...rather busy at the moment.
Taproot#002.dst: ...ah. {u}, has vuelto. Ehm... debo decir que estoy... bastante ocupada ahora mismo.
Taproot#002.speaker: Lari

Taproot#003.src: I have...important things to do. This accursed Decay...I have to end it. This all needs to stop.
Taproot#003.dst: Tengo... cosas importantes que hacer. Esta maldita Decadencia... tengo que acabar con ella. Todo esto debe parar.
Taproot#003.speaker: Lari

Taproot#004.src: I am thankful for your aid with the...the Grootslang, but I do not believe you will be able to help with this- Simply a matter of scale.
Taproot#004.dst: Te agradezco tu ayuda con el... el Grootslang, pero no creo que puedas ayudar con esto- Es simple cuestión de escala.
Taproot#004.speaker: Lari

Taproot#005.src: I apologize, but I need to focus on my task here. If, perhaps, you could come back another time? And, I do mean that sincerely...
Taproot#005.dst: Lo siento, pero necesito centrarme en mi tarea aquí. ¿Quizá podrías volver en otro momento? Y lo digo con toda sinceridad...
Taproot#005.speaker: Lari

Taproot#006.src: I can't even recall how many attempts this will make...but all my knowledge has gone into this. This must work.
Taproot#006.dst: Ya ni recuerdo cuántos intentos van... pero he volcado en esto todo mi saber. Tiene que funcionar.
Taproot#006.speaker: Lari

Taproot#007.src: Follow Lari to the black spot next to her camp.
Taproot#007.dst: Sigue a Lari hasta la mancha negra junto a su campamento.

Taproot#008.src: ...I suppose I can't fault you for being curious. You may have seen a large, dark-looking patch of ground on your way here- I am trying to tend to it once more.
Taproot#008.dst: ...Supongo que no puedo reprocharte la curiosidad. Puede que vieras un gran trozo de tierra oscura al venir- Estoy intentando curarlo una vez más.
Taproot#008.speaker: Lari

Taproot#009.src: It is...the most obvious stain of the decay, and very intense...if I can scrub this out, the rest should follow.
Taproot#009.dst: Es... la mancha más evidente de la Decadencia, y muy intensa... si logro borrarla, lo demás debería seguirla.
Taproot#009.speaker: Lari

Taproot#010.src: This concoction of mine should...do the trick!
Taproot#010.speaker: Lari

Taproot#011.src: It...it's working!! I can feel it, the land is reacting positively!
Taproot#011.dst: ¡¡Fun... funciona!! ¡Lo noto, la tierra reacciona bien!
Taproot#011.speaker: Lari

Taproot#012.src: I...I... It was...it was working, a-and... Agh, why can't I get this RIGHT?!
Taproot#012.dst: Yo... yo... Estaba... estaba funcionando, y-y... Agh, ¡¿por qué no me sale BIEN?!
Taproot#012.speaker: Lari

Taproot#013.src: How many decades have I been doing this? How much time have I wasted, just...flailing like this?!
Taproot#013.dst: ¿Cuántas décadas llevo con esto? ¡¿Cuánto tiempo he perdido, solo... dando palos de ciego?!
Taproot#013.speaker: Lari

Taproot#014.src: Look, {u}, I...I don't know what you expect to do against this. The Wyrm was one thing, but...this is beyond your comprehension.
Taproot#014.dst: Mira, {u}, yo... no sé qué esperas hacer contra esto. El Wyrm era una cosa, pero... esto supera tu comprensión.
Taproot#014.speaker: Lari

Taproot#015.src: I think you sh... Should...w-what is... Now, of all times? As I fail?!
Taproot#015.dst: Creo que deb... Deberías... q-qué es... ¿Ahora, justo ahora? ¡¿Cuando fracaso?!
Taproot#015.speaker: Lari

Taproot#016.src: The road, look! He's contacting me! A-are you finally giving me the answers I've asked for?
Taproot#016.dst: ¡El camino, mira! ¡Está contactando conmigo! ¿P-por fin me das las respuestas que te he pedido?
Taproot#016.speaker: Lari

Taproot#017.src: Follow the trail of magic leading from the black spot.
Taproot#017.dst: Sigue el rastro de magia que parte de la mancha negra.

Taproot#018.src: Talk to Lari outside the weird gate at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Taproot#018.dst: Habla con Lari fuera de la extraña puerta en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Taproot#019.src: ...I followed you seeking answers...and here, I am presented with more questions. Why did he bring us here?
Taproot#019.dst: ...Te seguí buscando respuestas... y aquí solo se me presentan más preguntas. ¿Por qué nos ha traído aquí?
Taproot#019.speaker: Lari

Taproot#020.src: This gate has appeared, immovable and impassable, since the moment that...that everything started.
Taproot#020.dst: Esta puerta apareció, inamovible e infranqueable, desde el momento en que... en que todo empezó.
Taproot#020.speaker: Lari

Taproot#021.src: I don't...is he trying to remind me of what's at stake? Did he want to show y- No, that's...he wouldn't know you...but then, what IS this about?!
Taproot#021.dst: No... ¿intenta recordarme lo que está en juego? ¿Quería enseñarte a t- No, eso... él no te conocería... entonces, ¡¿DE qué va esto?!
Taproot#021.speaker: Lari

Taproot#022.src: Rrgh... ANSWER ME! PLEASE! I've begged you for so long to answer!
Taproot#022.speaker: Lari

Taproot#023.src: You gave me my task and your light but never told me what to DO! I've tried everything I can think of!!
Taproot#023.dst: ¡Me diste mi tarea y tu luz, pero nunca me dijiste qué HACER! ¡¡He probado todo lo que se me ocurre!!
Taproot#023.speaker: Lari

Taproot#024.src: Tell me! Please, just t-tell me already!! I don't know how much longer I can stand this!!
Taproot#024.dst: ¡Dímelo! Por favor, ¡¡d-dímelo ya!! ¡¡No sé cuánto más podré soportarlo!!
Taproot#024.speaker: Lari

Taproot#025.src: I...a-another one? Where are you leading me now?
Taproot#025.speaker: Lari

Taproot#026.src: It...the gateway...? Are you...I can't understand! Why this, again?
Taproot#026.dst: Es... ¿el portal...? ¿Acaso... ¡No lo entiendo! ¿Por qué esto otra vez?
Taproot#026.speaker: Lari

Taproot#027.src: You showed me this before... At first, when you first contacted me. I made the choice...
Taproot#027.dst: Ya me mostraste esto antes... Al principio, cuando contactaste conmigo. Yo tomé la decisión...
Taproot#027.speaker: Lari

Taproot#028.src: Must I make it again? Is that it, do I need to prove myself to you once more?
Taproot#028.dst: ¿Debo tomarla otra vez? ¿Es eso, tengo que demostrarte mi valía de nuevo?
Taproot#028.speaker: Lari

Taproot#029.src: I...what? You...you present me with this, but refuse to let me do what you want?
Taproot#029.dst: Yo... ¿qué? Me... ¿me muestras esto y no me dejas hacer lo que quieres?
Taproot#029.speaker: Lari

Taproot#030.src: ...please, can you investigate the doorway? There must be something wrong that I don't understand.
Taproot#030.dst: ...por favor, ¿puedes examinar la entrada? Algo tiene que ir mal y yo no lo entiendo.
Taproot#030.speaker: Lari

Taproot#033.src: My pulse... Human. I must inquire to you. I present you a test. Guide your attention to those you see.
Taproot#033.dst: Mi pulso... Humano. Debo interrogarte. Te presento una prueba. Dirige tu atención a los que ves.

Taproot#034.src: I must see the rhythm your heart beats. Listen well.
Taproot#034.dst: Debo ver el ritmo que late tu corazón. Escucha bien.

Taproot#035.src: This has gone far enough. I can't do this anymore! I can't give you any more and I refuse to apologize for it!
Taproot#035.dst: Esto ya ha ido demasiado lejos. ¡No puedo seguir! ¡No puedo darle nada más y me niego a disculparme por ello!
Taproot#035.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#036.src: You know our deal. Remember what good you are doing by following the plans I've laid out for you.
Taproot#036.dst: Conoce usted nuestro trato. Recuerde cuánto bien hace siguiendo los planes que le he trazado.
Taproot#036.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#037.src: Are you going to let your emotions cloud your judgment? You're a smarter man than that, Mr. Mayor.
Taproot#037.dst: ¿Va a dejar que las emociones le nublen el juicio? Es usted más listo que eso, señor alcalde.
Taproot#037.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#038.src: You can't possibly believe that throwing away the lives of innocent people is right! I can't go on with this on my conscience!
Taproot#038.dst: ¡No puede creer de verdad que tirar las vidas de inocentes esté bien! ¡No puedo seguir con esto en la conciencia!
Taproot#038.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#039.src: Detective Hart WILL be hearing from me, and he'll be hearing everything. We can't keep sacrificing our own like this!
Taproot#039.dst: El detective Hart VA a saber de mí, y lo va a saber todo. ¡No podemos seguir sacrificando a los nuestros así!
Taproot#039.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#040.src: Our golems have single-handedly turned the tide of the Humans' corruption war. You would save ten here and sentence a thousand to die overseas?
Taproot#040.dst: Nuestros gólems han cambiado solos el rumbo de la guerra de la Corrupción humana. ¿Salvaría a diez aquí y condenaría a mil al otro lado del mar?
Taproot#040.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#041.src: You're a sick, twisted man, Urelix. I will not abide by this a moment longer.
Taproot#041.dst: Es usted un enfermo retorcido, Urelix. No lo toleraré ni un instante más.
Taproot#041.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#042.src: My pulse, you must decide. Three paths diverge upon your road.
Taproot#042.dst: Mi pulso, debes decidir. Tres sendas se abren en tu camino.

Taproot#043.src: You may leave. The rays of fate will see to destiny unfolding.
Taproot#043.dst: Puedes marcharte. Los rayos del sino velarán por que el destino se cumpla.

Taproot#044.src: You may end this "Mayor's" life. Blood upon your hands in many ways.
Taproot#044.dst: Puedes segar la vida de este «alcalde». Sangre en tus manos de mil modos.

Taproot#046.src: You may end the life of Urelix. Heartbeats ceased by a bleeding heart.
Taproot#046.dst: Puedes segar la vida de Urelix. Latidos detenidos por un corazón que sangra.

Taproot#047.src: Which way does your heart beat? How will you cast your light? Can you see?
Taproot#047.dst: ¿Hacia dónde late tu corazón? ¿Cómo proyectarás tu luz? ¿Puedes verlo?

Taproot#049.src: My pulse... The blood of a bleeding heart has poisoned me. Even if you believe the sun should shine elsewhere, you must direct it yourself.
Taproot#049.dst: Mi pulso... La sangre de un corazón que sangra me ha envenenado. Aunque creas que el sol debe brillar en otra parte, has de dirigirlo tú mismo.

Taproot#050.src: You must realize what is needed. You must see light through my lens.
Taproot#050.dst: Has de comprender lo necesario. Has de ver la luz por mi lente.

Taproot#051.src: To leave... As destiny unfolds, the sun shall set.
Taproot#051.dst: Marcharte... Al cumplirse el destino, el sol se pondrá.

Taproot#052.src: To end this Mayor's life... To snuff out one whose heart aches is painful.
Taproot#052.dst: Acabar con la vida de este alcalde... Apagar a quien sufre en el corazón duele.

Taproot#053.src: To end the life of Urelix... The shadows of war shall engulf all.
Taproot#053.dst: Acabar con la vida de Urelix... Las sombras de la guerra lo engullirán todo.

Taproot#054.src: My pulse, there is only one choice. You must do what is required, I beg of you.
Taproot#054.dst: Mi pulso, solo hay una elección. Haz lo que se requiere, te lo ruego.

Taproot#055.src: Ah, you recognize necessity. That couldn't have been pleasant...but what's needed isn't pleasant, in the end.
Taproot#055.dst: Ah, reconoce usted la necesidad. No habrá sido agradable... pero lo necesario, al final, no lo es.
Taproot#055.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#058.src: ...I didn't think you would be able to help, but I had to ask. So...was this for nothing?
Taproot#058.dst: ...No creía que pudieras ayudar, pero tenía que pedirlo. Entonces... ¿todo ha sido en vano?
Taproot#058.speaker: Lari

Taproot#059.src: Wait...y-you...had a choice? He gave you the choice too?! A-Already?!
Taproot#059.dst: Espera... ¿t-tú... pudiste elegir? ¡¿A ti también te dio a elegir?! ¡¿Y-ya?!
Taproot#059.speaker: Lari

Taproot#060.src: Wh- I don't understand! You...you just arrived to Gavel! You haven't seen its decline! Felt its pain!
Taproot#060.dst: Qu- ¡No lo entiendo! ¡Tú... acabas de llegar a Gavel! ¡No has visto su declive! ¡Ni sentido su dolor!
Taproot#060.speaker: Lari

Taproot#061.src: What did you do?! The gate is opening? YOU did this?! I know your heart is in the right place, but you're a stranger to this land!
Taproot#061.dst: ¡¿Qué has hecho?! ¿La puerta se abre? ¡¿Esto lo has hecho TÚ?! Sé que tienes buen corazón, ¡pero eres un extraño en esta tierra!
Taproot#061.speaker: Lari

Taproot#062.src: I...I...rrrgh... AAAAGH!! This isn't fair!! I've worked for decades and the light just...throws me to the wayside?!
Taproot#062.dst: Yo... yo... rrrgh... ¡¡AAAAGH!! ¡¡No es justo!! ¡¿Llevo décadas trabajando y la luz simplemente... me aparta a un lado?!
Taproot#062.speaker: Lari

Taproot#063.src:
Lari
PLEASE! Just let me in!
Taproot#063.speaker: Lari

Taproot#064.src: My pulse, you must leave her be. Her heart's emotions have overpowered her mind's judgement. She must learn to separate them as you have.
Taproot#064.dst: Mi pulso, debes dejarla en paz. Las emociones de su corazón han vencido al juicio de su mente. Debe aprender a separarlos como tú.

Taproot#065.src: Please... You can't DO this to me!!
Taproot#065.speaker: Lari

Taproot#066.src: Why do you want this human to enter the Taproot?! What's special about them, what's their connection? What have they done that I haven't?! Tell me, please! Let me be useful!!
Taproot#066.dst: ¡¿Por qué quieres que este humano entre en el Taproot?! ¿Qué tiene de especial, qué vínculo tiene? ¡¿Qué ha hecho que yo no haya hecho?! ¡Dímelo, por favor! ¡¡Déjame ser útil!!
Taproot#066.speaker: Lari

Taproot#069.src: Your heartbeat beats in time with mine. Your mind is unclouded, despite the fury you have been steeped in. My pulse, you are needed.
Taproot#069.dst: Tu latido late al compás del mío. Tu mente está despejada pese a la furia en que te has visto sumido. Mi pulso, se te necesita.

Taproot#070.src: Your eyes cannot see the scope of the realms. You must allow me to shed light upon them- You must see the connections.
Taproot#070.dst: Tus ojos no alcanzan a ver la amplitud de los reinos. Debes permitirme arrojar luz sobre ellos- Debes ver las conexiones.

Taproot#071.src: Light... Dark... We oppose. I am light. It is dark. Our places reflect this land...and it is plain- The sun is setting. Light is fading
Taproot#071.dst: Luz... Oscuridad... Nos oponemos. Yo soy luz. Ello es oscuridad. Nuestros lugares reflejan esta tierra... y está claro- El sol se pone. La luz se apaga

Taproot#072.src: The land you visit warps with the slow siphoning of my light, my blood. It becomes outlandish and strange- Oppressive and alien.
Taproot#072.dst: La tierra que pisas se deforma mientras drenan lentamente mi luz, mi sangre. Se vuelve insólita y extraña- Opresiva y ajena.

Taproot#073.src: Perhaps you should try interacting with this thing?
Taproot#073.dst: ¿Quizá deberías probar a interactuar con esto?

Taproot#074.src: As dusk approaches- As darkness spreads- My heart slows and stops. My pulse, you are needed. You shall be as one with me, and you shall see.
Taproot#074.dst: Al acercarse el ocaso- Al extenderse la oscuridad- Mi corazón se aletarga y se detiene. Mi pulso, se te necesita. Serás uno conmigo, y verás.

Taproot#075.src: {p} needs life anew- A new pulse. It need you.
Taproot#075.dst: {p} necesita vida nueva- Un nuevo pulso. Te necesita.

Taproot#077.src: Our light is synchronous! You may see what I must have you see...
Taproot#077.dst: ¡Nuestra luz es una! Ya puedes ver lo que he de mostrarte...

Taproot#078.src: Follow the road. You must witness the reason behind my trial.
Taproot#078.dst: Sigue el camino. Debes presenciar la razón de mi prueba.

Taproot#079.src: See my memories. The memories of the realm. See...and be enlightened.
Taproot#079.dst: Mira mis recuerdos. Los recuerdos del reino. Mira... y sé iluminado.

Taproot#080.src: Witness it... The Equinox. Learn why you are needed, my pulse.
Taproot#080.dst: Contémplalo... The Equinox. Aprende por qué se te necesita, mi pulso.

Taproot#082.dst: Contempla el inicio de la Decadencia.

Taproot#083.src: My light...I won't let you down!
Taproot#083.speaker: Lari

Taproot#085.src: Wah! Back away, I don't want to hurt you!
Taproot#085.speaker: Lari

Taproot#086.src: I can do this... Orphion, lend me your voice!
Taproot#086.speaker: Lari

Taproot#087.src: Return to your realm in peace!
Taproot#087.speaker: Lari

Taproot#088.src: Your power is blinded by light. You cannot win!
Taproot#088.dst: Tu poder está cegado por la luz. ¡No puedes ganar!
Taproot#088.speaker: Lari

Taproot#089.src: Peace, strange creature! You must be peaceful!
Taproot#089.speaker: Lari

Taproot#090.src: Why isn't this working? Even Orphion's voice...
Taproot#090.dst: ¿Por qué no funciona? Ni siquiera la voz de Orphion...
Taproot#090.speaker: Lari

Taproot#091.src: It's scarring the land... I need to end this, quickly...
Taproot#091.dst: Está dejando cicatrices en la tierra... Debo acabar con esto, rápido...
Taproot#091.speaker: Lari

Taproot#092.src: His light... This power... I can do this!
Taproot#092.speaker: Lari

Taproot#093.src: The embodiment of light supports me!
Taproot#093.dst: ¡La encarnación de la luz me apoya!
Taproot#093.speaker: Lari

Taproot#094.src: You cannot fight the focus of pure light!
Taproot#094.dst: ¡No puedes luchar contra la luz pura!
Taproot#094.speaker: Lari

Taproot#095.src: Be done! I bind you with Orphion's light!
Taproot#095.dst: ¡Se acabó! ¡Te ato con la luz de Orphion!
Taproot#095.speaker: Lari

Taproot#097.src: Lari... A conflicted heart failed to channel my light. She refused to battle.
Taproot#097.dst: Lari... Un corazón dividido no supo canalizar mi luz. Se negó a luchar.

Taproot#098.src: The vile intruder was weak... But every opportunity to strike, exchanged for words to the deaf.
Taproot#098.dst: El vil intruso era débil... Mas cada ocasión de golpear la cambió por palabras a los sordos.

Taproot#099.src: My pulse... It pains me. Her light simply fails to shine where it is needed, and so we are here.
Taproot#099.dst: Mi pulso... Me duele. Su luz sencillamente no brilla donde hace falta, y por eso estamos aquí.

Taproot#100.src: The Realm of Light needs life anew- A new pulse. It needs you.
Taproot#100.dst: El Reino de la Luz necesita vida nueva- Un nuevo pulso. Te necesita a ti.

Taproot#101.src: Talk to Lari outside the Taproot gate.
Taproot#101.dst: Habla con Lari fuera de la puerta del Taproot.

Taproot#102.src: I... I...hope you'll forgive me, {u}. My anger wasn't with you. I...j-just...
Taproot#102.dst: Yo... yo... espero que me perdones, {u}. Mi enfado no era contigo. Yo... s-solo...
Taproot#102.speaker: Lari

Taproot#103.src: I work for untold years, trying to save this province, to save a Realm... All to so little avail. To the sound of silence from the one I'm trying to help.
Taproot#103.dst: Llevo años incontables intentando salvar esta provincia, salvar un Reino... Con tan poco fruto. Y solo silencio de aquel a quien intento ayudar.
Taproot#103.speaker: Lari

Taproot#104.src: And then, you appear, and... I still haven't ever been in there. I'd...I'd ask what it was like, but it's...probably private, right?
Taproot#104.dst: Y entonces apareces tú, y... Yo aún no he entrado nunca ahí. Te... te preguntaría cómo era, pero eso... será algo privado, ¿no?
Taproot#104.speaker: Lari

Taproot#105.src: At...at least I have an ally now, r-right? But...I'm afraid that... N-no, it's silly, you don't need to hear me fretting.
Taproot#105.dst: Al... al menos ahora tengo un aliado, ¿v-verdad? Pero... me temo que... N-no, es una tontería, no hace falta que oigas mis agobios.
Taproot#105.speaker: Lari

Taproot#106.src: I... I promise I can still be useful. I'll... I'll find a way. I promise you. I'll...get out of your way, for now.
Taproot#106.dst: Yo... prometo que aún puedo ser útil. Ya... ya hallaré la manera. Te lo prometo. Me... me apartaré por ahora.
Taproot#106.speaker: Lari

Taproot#107.src:
Lari
Please... You can't DO this to me!!
Taproot#107.dst:
Lari
Por favor... ¡¡No me hagas esto!!
Taproot#107.speaker: Lari

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#000.src: Talk to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends, close to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#000.dst: Habla con Kelight en la entrada del Templo de las leyendas, cerca de {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.src: I see you want to enter this mighty temple! Do not deny it, I see it in your eyes.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.dst: ¡Veo que quieres entrar en este poderoso templo! No lo niegues, lo veo en tus ojos.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.src: It is only natural, after all, to want to join the esteemed ranks of the Legends, such as myself!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.dst: Es lo natural, al fin y al cabo: ¡querer unirse a las ilustres filas de las Leyendas, como yo!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.src: You will need to prove yourself by fighting a powerful beast, hidden deep in this cave beside me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.dst: Tendrás que demostrar tu valía luchando contra una bestia poderosa, oculta en el fondo de esta cueva.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#004.src: However, as a Legend, I am very busy, autographs and the sort, and that's not to mention my guard duty! Let me see if you are even worth my time.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#004.dst: Sin embargo, como Leyenda estoy muy ocupado: autógrafos y demás, ¡por no hablar de mi guardia! Veamos si mereces siquiera mi tiempo.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#004.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.src: Hm... At a glance, you don't look anything special! Why, you may as well be a common soldier, for all I can imagine!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.dst: Hm... ¡A simple vista no tienes nada de especial! ¡Por lo que veo, bien podrías ser un soldado raso!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.src: Tell me, why should I bother giving you this chance? Because thus far, I'm not impressed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.dst: Dime, ¿por qué habría de darte esta oportunidad? Porque hasta ahora no me impresionas.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#007.src: You're stubborn? Hah! Don't make me laugh. Do you think you are the first to attempt entry without anything great to show for it?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#007.dst: ¿Que eres tozudo? ¡Ja! No me hagas reír. ¿Crees que eres el primero que intenta entrar sin nada grande que mostrar?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#007.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.src: Of course you aren't. Run along, now. Return when you have something truly impressive to show for yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.dst: Claro que no. Anda, largo. Vuelve cuando tengas algo verdaderamente impresionante que mostrar.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.src: ...And? Surely you do not hope to bribe me, do you? What use would I have for whatever meager wealth you have?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.dst: ...¿Y? No esperarás sobornarme, ¿verdad? ¿De qué me serviría tu escasa fortuna?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#010.src: I'm a Legend! I have everything I could possibly need for the rest of my life! Now, run along. Return when you have something concrete to show me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#010.dst: ¡Soy una Leyenda! ¡Tengo todo lo que podría necesitar el resto de mi vida! Anda, largo. Vuelve cuando tengas algo concreto que enseñarme.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#010.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.src: Ha! You? A Legend?! What a joke. You aren't the first to have tried that, by the way. I know each and every member of our ranks, and you are not one of them.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.dst: ¡Ja! ¿Tú? ¡¿Una Leyenda?! Qué chiste. Por cierto, no eres el primero que lo intenta. Conozco a todos y cada uno de nuestras filas, y tú no eres uno de ellos.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.src: Ah, truly, being a gatekeeper of the Temple is an entertaining position. Run along, now. Return when you have something real to show me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.dst: Ah, de verdad que ser guardián de la puerta del Templo es un puesto entretenido. Anda, largo. Vuelve cuando tengas algo real que enseñarme.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#013.src: Hmph. Ridiculous. I don't need you to convince me of anything! Clearly, you are nothing but a pretender.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#013.dst: Hmpf. Ridículo. ¡No necesito que me convenzas de nada! Está claro que no eres más que un farsante.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#013.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#014.src: Run along, now. If you don't have anything to show for yourself, don't waste my time!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#014.dst: Anda, largo. Si no tienes nada que mostrar, ¡no me hagas perder el tiempo!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#014.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.src: ...But- ah. Since you are still here. Perhaps- no, no, don't be ridiculous, Kelight.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.dst: ...Pero- ah. Ya que sigues aquí. Quizá- no, no, no seas ridículo, Kelight.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#019.src: Come on, Kelight, don't do this, you can't just let them get you with the silent treatment...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#019.dst: Vamos, Kelight, no hagas esto, no puedes dejar que te ganen con la ley del hielo...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#019.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.src: Oh, fine. You've got me interested. What is special about you? You look like a common soldier, and yet...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.dst: Ay, está bien. Has despertado mi interés. ¿Qué tienes de especial? Pareces un soldado raso, y aun así...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.src: Very well. I will allow you to attempt the trial. Perhaps, then, you will be able to prove yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.dst: Muy bien. Te permitiré intentar la prueba. Quizá entonces logres demostrar tu valía.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.src: Hidden deep within a nearby cave is a beast beyond compare. Corrupted, yes, but nothing like the foes you may have faced before.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.dst: En lo hondo de una cueva cercana se oculta una bestia sin igual. Corrupta, sí, pero nada que ver con los enemigos que hayas enfrentado.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#024.src: Rumor has it this creature was one of the miners which first ventured into the Nether Portal... Of course, as a Legend, I would usually disregard such things.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#024.dst: Se rumorea que esa criatura fue uno de los mineros que primero se adentraron en el Portal del Nether... Claro que, como Leyenda, suelo desdeñar esas cosas.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#024.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#025.src: In any case, its power cannot be underestimated. Simply entering its cave will greatly weaken you, even with the best equipment!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#025.dst: En todo caso, su poder no debe subestimarse. ¡Solo con entrar en su cueva te debilitarás muchísimo, aunque lleves el mejor equipo!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#025.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#026.src: Getting close to it would quickly corrupt you, which is why you will need protection. Only a light which is from the same realm from which the beast arrived will do the trick.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#026.dst: Acercarte a ella te corrompería enseguida, por eso necesitarás protección. Solo servirá una luz del mismo reino del que llegó la bestia.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#026.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#027.src: As such, your very first step on your journey to become a Legend will be... to visit a friend of mine who studies the Nether.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#027.dst: Así pues, tu primer paso en el camino para ser una Leyenda será... visitar a un amigo mío que estudia el Nether.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#027.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.src: His name is Jorkin, and he knows more about that realm than anyone else I know. Find him near the {p}, in {p}, and request his aid. Tell him I sent you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.dst: Se llama Jorkin y sabe más de ese reino que nadie que yo conozca. Búscalo cerca de {p}, en {p}, y pídele ayuda. Dile que te envío yo.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#029.src: Find a way to get Kelight to allow you entry into the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#029.dst: Encuentra la forma de que Kelight te deje entrar en el Templo de las leyendas, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.src: So you return! Very interesting. That certainly puts you a level beyond any others who have tried... But it is not enough.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.dst: ¡Así que vuelves! Muy interesante. Eso te pone un nivel por encima de todos los que lo han intentado... Pero no basta.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#031.src: So? Tell me, why should I bother giving you this chance? Because thus far, I'm not impressed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#031.dst: ¿Y bien? Dime, ¿por qué habría de darte esta oportunidad? Porque hasta ahora no me impresionas.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#031.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#032.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.src: Of course you aren't. Run along, now. Return when you have something truly impressive to show for yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.dst: Claro que no. Anda, largo. Vuelve cuando tengas algo verdaderamente impresionante que mostrar.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.src: So you are! And so am I. You will not get past me that easily, I'm afraid.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.dst: ¡Ya lo veo! Yo también. Me temo que no me pasarás tan fácil.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.src: Off you go, then. Don't come back unless you have something to show!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.dst: Pues largo. ¡No vuelvas sin algo que mostrar!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.src: Yes, I'm starting to get that impression. You are such a headache, you know that?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.dst: Sí, empiezo a tener esa impresión. Vaya dolor de cabeza eres, ¿lo sabías?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.src: Fine! Fine. I'll give you a chance. I'm certain you won't succeed, but anything to get you to stop bothering me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.dst: ¡Está bien! Vale. Te daré una oportunidad. Seguro que fracasas, pero lo que sea con tal de que dejes de molestarme.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#039.src: Ahem. Hidden deep within a nearby cave is a beast beyond compare. Corrupted, yes, but nothing like the foes you may have faced before.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#039.dst: Ejem. En lo hondo de una cueva cercana se oculta una bestia sin igual. Corrupta, sí, pero nada que ver con los enemigos que hayas enfrentado.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#039.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#065.src: Talk to Jorkin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] about Light Dust.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#065.dst: Habla con Jorkin en {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], sobre el Light Dust.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.src: Ah, hello soldier. What brings you to my humble abode today?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.dst: Ah, hola, soldado. ¿Qué te trae hoy a mi humilde morada?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.src: Oh my. You...you want to attack HIM? Th-that horrid beast! Are you mad?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.dst: Madre mía. ¿Quieres... atacarle a ÉL? ¡E-esa bestia horrible! ¡¿Estás loco?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.src: Urgh, Kelight keeps sending adventurers like you to their deaths with his asinine tasks!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.dst: Urgh, ¡Kelight no para de mandar aventureros como tú a la muerte con sus tareas absurdas!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.src: Fine. If you're really so determined to walk to your death, I can tell you where to go.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.dst: Está bien. Si de verdad estás tan decidido a caminar hacia tu muerte, puedo decirte adónde ir.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.src: Down in the Roots, there is a cave full of the Light Dust you'll need.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.dst: Abajo, en las Raíces, hay una cueva llena del Light Dust que necesitas.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.src: Powerful corrupteds live in that cave, so be very careful retrieving it, and bring it back to me once you find it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.dst: En esa cueva viven corruptos poderosos, así que ten mucho cuidado al cogerlo, y tráemelo en cuanto lo encuentres.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#072.src: Find the lightdust cavern located near the Portal at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#072.dst: Encuentra la caverna de Light Dust que hay cerca del Portal, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#073.src: Retrieve [{~} Light Dust] from the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring it back to Jorkin at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#073.dst: Consigue [{~} Light Dust] en la cueva de [{~}, {~}, -{~}] y llévaselo a Jorkin, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.src: You have the Light Dust, then? Hand it here, I want to see something.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.dst: ¿Tienes el Light Dust? Dámelo, quiero comprobar algo.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.src: Ah, just as I thought. Even this light has been tainted by Corruption. Sorry, looks like you can't fight him, go home.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.dst: Ah, justo lo que pensaba. Hasta esta luz la ha manchado la Corrupción. No puedes luchar con él, lo siento; vete a casa.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.src: ...urgh, there's no fooling you, is there? You really are committed to trying to fight him.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.dst: ...urgh, no hay quien te engañe, ¿eh? De verdad estás decidido a intentar luchar contra él.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.src: Well, I wasn't lying when I said the Light Dust was corrupted, but there is a way to purify it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.dst: Bueno, no mentía al decir que el Light Dust estaba corrompido, pero hay una forma de purificarlo.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.src: An old acquaintance of mine, Rayshyroth, has a method. He lives on {p}.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.dst: Un viejo conocido mío, Rayshyroth, tiene un método. Vive en {p}.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.src: He knows even more about that...thing, than I do in my years of studying the Nether. Maybe he'll be able to talk you out of this.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.dst: Sabe aún más sobre esa... cosa que yo tras años estudiando el Nether. Quizá él consiga quitarte la idea de la cabeza.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#081.src: Visit Rayshyroth on {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to purify the dust
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#081.dst: Visita a Rayshyroth en {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}], para purificar el polvo

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.src: Oh? Well, greetings. What brings you to our quiet lonely island, let alone all the way up here?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.dst: ¿Oh? Pues saludos. ¿Qué te trae a nuestra isla tranquila y solitaria, y además hasta aquí arriba?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#083.src: ...I see. Yes, the corruption of the blasted Nether Portal is rather potent. I'm not surprised this would need purification.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#083.dst: ...Ya veo. Sí, la corrupción del maldito Portal del Nether es bastante potente. No me extraña que esto necesite purificación.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#083.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.src: Well, I can certainly do it, but I'll need the materials to do so. Shouldn't be anything you can't handle by now, right?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.dst: Puedo hacerlo, desde luego, pero necesitaré materiales. A estas alturas nada que no puedas conseguir, ¿verdad?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.src: You see, below my house here, there is a wellspring from which a powerful magic flux generates.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.dst: Verás, debajo de mi casa hay un manantial del que brota un poderoso flujo mágico.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.src: It creates a unique magic vapor if disrupted, which I can use to purify the dust for you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.dst: Si se altera, genera un vapor mágico único que puedo usar para purificarte el polvo.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.src: I would say, given how badly corrupted this is, I will need at least [{~} Sky Vapor] for the task.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.dst: Diría que, con lo corrompido que está esto, necesitaré al menos [{~} Sky Vapor] para la tarea.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#088.src: Find the cave on {p} where the Sky Flux gathers at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#088.dst: Encuentra la cueva de {p} donde se acumula el Sky Flux, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#089.src: Give [{~} Sky Vapor] to Rayshyroth at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#089.dst: Dale [{~} Sky Vapor] a Rayshyroth en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.src: Aha, you're back with the Sky Vapor! Sorry about the climb, even I find it rather inconvenient at times.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.dst: ¡Ajá, vuelves con el Sky Vapor! Siento lo de la subida; hasta a mí me resulta incómoda a veces.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.src: While I perform the ritual to purify this, I'd like to ask you something. Do you know, exactly, what it is you'll be fighting?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.dst: Mientras hago el ritual para purificar esto, quisiera preguntarte algo. ¿Sabes exactamente contra qué vas a luchar?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#092.src: Don't look so surprised, I know exactly what you need Light Dust for. The corruption warding helmet...to allow you to fight the Corrupter of Worlds.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#092.dst: No pongas esa cara; sé perfectamente para qué quieres el Light Dust. El casco que protege de la corrupción... para poder luchar contra el Corrupter of Worlds.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#092.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#093.src: Yes, yes. I imagine that Kelight didn't bother telling you that was his title. I also surmise that you were given few details of how he came to be...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#093.dst: Sí, sí. Imagino que Kelight no se molestó en decirte que ese es su título. También supongo que apenas te contaron cómo llegó a ser lo que es...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#093.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#094.src: The beast now known as the Corrupter of Worlds used to be a simple mining captain, during the expeditions that uncovered the Nether Portal. He was the first to enter that wicked realm.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#094.dst: La bestia hoy conocida como el Corrupter of Worlds fue un simple capataz de minería, durante las expediciones que descubrieron el Portal del Nether. Fue el primero en entrar en aquel reino maligno.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#094.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.src: The poor man was never heard from again...well, that is until the corrupted hordes began to pour from the Nether, with him leading the pack. A bit ironic, isn't it? Led the miners in life, the corrupteds in death.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.dst: Nunca se volvió a saber del pobre hombre... hasta que las hordas corruptas empezaron a brotar del Nether, con él a la cabeza. Un poco irónico, ¿no? Guio a los mineros en vida y a los corruptos en la muerte.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.src: His mining crew there lasted hardly minutes. He personally slaughtered every single one of his original crew, and thousands more. The energies of the Nether have made him monstrously powerful.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.dst: Su cuadrilla de mineros no duró ni unos minutos allí. Él mismo masacró a cada uno de sus hombres, y a miles más. Las energías del Nether lo han vuelto monstruosamente poderoso.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.src: ...although, the stories differ. Some say that Bak'al was the first to enter the portal, and the Corrupter of Worlds was simply a beast from the Nether. But the unclear truth doesn't change his strength.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.dst: ...aunque las historias difieren. Algunos dicen que Bak'al fue el primero en entrar en el portal y que el Corrupter of Worlds era solo una bestia del Nether. Pero que la verdad sea confusa no cambia su fuerza.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#098.src: Just remember that no one, aside from that snooty Kelight, will think less of you should you choose not to fight him.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#098.dst: Recuerda solo que nadie, salvo el engreído de Kelight, te tendrá en menos si decides no luchar contra él.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#098.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#099.src: Show the [Purified Light Dust] to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#099.dst: Muéstrale el [Purified Light Dust] a Kelight en la entrada del Templo de las leyendas, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#100.src: Hah. Took you long enough. This is the light dust, I presume?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#100.dst: Ja. Ya era hora. Esto es el Light Dust, supongo.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#100.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#101.src: I'll hold onto this for now. While it is a vital ingredient for your protection, it is not enough on its own.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#101.dst: Me lo quedaré de momento. Aunque es un ingrediente vital para tu protección, no basta por sí solo.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#101.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#102.src: You'll need an item to focus the magic around yourself, preferably something you'd wear. Hm... How about a helmet? Certainly, it'd do wonders for your poor sense of style.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#102.dst: Necesitarás un objeto que concentre la magia a tu alrededor, mejor algo que puedas llevar puesto. Hm... ¿Qué tal un casco? Desde luego, haría maravillas con tu pobre sentido del estilo.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#102.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#103.src: Ahem. As for creating it... I know only one man capable of crafting a piece of armor good enough to ensure your safety.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#103.dst: Ejem. En cuanto a hacerlo... solo conozco a un hombre capaz de forjar una armadura que garantice tu seguridad.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#103.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#104.src: Unfortunately, he will be hard to reach. His name was Garull, and he was the finest craftsman I'd ever met! A bit on the eccentric side, though.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#104.dst: Por desgracia, será difícil dar con él. Se llamaba Garull, ¡y era el mejor artesano que he conocido! Un poco excéntrico, eso sí.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#104.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#105.src: He was always ranting and raving about Creepers... he really thought they were real, can you imagine? What complete and utter nonsense.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#105.dst: Siempre despotricaba sobre los creepers... creía de verdad que existían, ¿te lo imaginas? Menuda sarta de tonterías.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#105.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#106.src: When I suggested the notion to be absurd, he seemed upset by my comments, and stopped visiting. Truly, I did not know what I did wrong. What a ridiculous man.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#106.dst: Cuando insinué que la idea era absurda, pareció ofenderse y dejó de visitarme. De verdad que no sé qué hice mal. Qué hombre más ridículo.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#106.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#107.src: As it stands, I have no idea where you could find him. He spoke of wanting to research the Pigman Ravines several times, though none of our rank had ever seen him there.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#107.dst: Tal como están las cosas, no tengo ni idea de dónde encontrarlo. Habló varias veces de querer investigar las Pigman Ravines, aunque ninguno de los nuestros lo vio nunca allí.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#107.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#108.src: In any case, it is somewhere to begin your search! Should you manage to find him, and convince him to craft you the helmet, return here and we can proceed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#108.dst: En cualquier caso, ¡por algún sitio hay que empezar! Si logras encontrarlo y convencerlo de que te haga el casco, vuelve aquí y seguiremos.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#108.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#109.src: Find Garull, the Creeper obsessed craftsman, somewhere in the {p} located around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#109.dst: Encuentra a Garull, el artesano obsesionado con los creepers, en algún lugar de {p}, por [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#110.src: GWUH! Oh god, don't scare me like that! Who... Who even are you?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#110.dst: ¡GUAH! ¡Dios, no me des esos sustos! ¿Quién...? ¡¿Quién eres tú?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#110.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#111.src: Ah, you were sent from Kelight for a protection helmet? I can do that, sure, but there's a few complications.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#111.dst: Ah, ¿te manda Kelight a por un casco de protección? Puedo hacerlo, claro, pero hay unas cuantas complicaciones.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#111.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#112.src: See, I usually use something called Touroto Hide to make my armor. It's extremely resilient, magic resistant and tough to break.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#112.dst: Verás, para mis armaduras suelo usar algo llamado Touroto Hide. Es resistentísima, aguanta la magia y cuesta mucho romperla.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#112.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#113.src: But, this also makes the Touroto themselves almost impossible to kill. Getting Touroto Hide is extremely difficult. I do know of a black market for it in {p}, but...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#113.dst: Pero eso también hace que matar a los propios Touroto sea casi imposible. Conseguir Touroto Hide es dificilísimo. Sé que hay un mercado negro en {p}, pero...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#113.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.src: They only sell useless Old Touroto Hide, gotten from ones that died of old age. It's almost no better than just plain leather.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.dst: Solo venden la inútil Old Touroto Hide, sacada de los que murieron de viejos. Apenas es mejor que el cuero corriente.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.src: So, for me to craft you this helmet, I'll need you to bring me not just the [Old Touroto Hide], but also the means to restore it to its previous power. Do listen up, there's a lot to tell you!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.dst: Así que, para forjarte este casco, necesito que me traigas no solo la [Old Touroto Hide], sino también con qué devolverle su antiguo poder. ¡Atiende, que hay mucho que contar!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.src: There's the [Aseado Leaf], grown someplace in the {p}... it has powerful medicinal qualities, supposedly able to reverse aging.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.dst: Está la [Aseado Leaf], que crece en algún punto de {p}... tiene propiedades medicinales potentes, dicen que revierte el envejecimiento.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.src: Then, a [Maro's Eye Jewel], which is an amazing magical focus from...well, where else, the {p}. Using its dust, I'll be able to return its magical resilience manually.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.dst: Luego, una [Maro's Eye Jewel], un foco mágico asombroso de... bueno, de dónde si no, de {p}. Con su polvo podré devolverle a mano la resistencia mágica.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#118.src: Finally, I'll need a [Coral of Nelfors], which can be found in the {p}. This is what I need to use to enchant the hide to be magically resistant.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#118.dst: Por último, necesito un [Coral of Nelfors], que se encuentra en {p}. Con eso encantaré la piel para que resista la magia.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#118.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.src: I wrote all that down in your content book. If you can get it all, come back to see me, but don't be so sneaky about coming up to me please!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.dst: Lo he apuntado todo en tu libro de contenido. Si lo consigues todo, vuelve a verme, ¡pero no te me acerques tan a hurtadillas, por favor!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#120.src: Bring the [Old Touroto Hide], [Aseado Leaf], [Maro's Eye Jewel], and [Coral of Nelfors] to Garull in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#120.dst: Lleva la [Old Touroto Hide], la [Aseado Leaf], la [Maro's Eye Jewel] y el [Coral of Nelfors] a Garull, en la cueva de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.src: Thank you for listening to me about not being so quiet coming over here. I'm guessing you've got everything?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.dst: Gracias por hacerme caso y no venir tan sigiloso esta vez. ¿Supongo que lo tienes todo?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.src: Alright, this should go quickly. For however pompous Kelight is, he's right in sending you to me to craft this.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.dst: Bien, esto será rápido. Por muy pomposo que sea Kelight, acertó al enviarte a mí para forjar esto.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.src: Now, I want to warn you about something. I've heard stories about the enemy you need this helmet to face, none of them good.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.dst: Ahora quiero advertirte de algo. He oído historias sobre el enemigo al que necesitas enfrentarte con este casco, y ninguna es buena.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.src: While I have seen people return from killing the "beast" he talks about, it isn't often. Be very careful, should you choose to fight it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.dst: He visto a gente volver tras matar a la "bestia" de la que habla, pero no es frecuente. Ten mucho cuidado si decides luchar contra ella.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#125.src: Bring the [Helmet of the Legends] to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#125.dst: Lleva el [Helmet of the Legends] a Kelight, en la entrada del Templo de las leyendas, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#126.src: ...Hm? Oh, it's you again. Did you actually manage to find the blighter? Good to know he isn't dead, at least.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#126.dst: ...¿Hm? Ah, otra vez tú. ¿De verdad lograste encontrar a ese tipo? Al menos es bueno saber que no está muerto.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#126.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.src: You have the helmet, I presume? Hand it over, here. I'll quickly apply the light dust. Then, you'll be able to enter the cave.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.dst: Tienes el casco, supongo. Dámelo, aquí. Aplicaré el Light Dust en un momento. Luego podrás entrar en la cueva.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#128.src: Hopefully you'll do better than that last group that tried to fight him. Six fighters strong... never came back.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#128.dst: Espero que te vaya mejor que al último grupo que intentó luchar contra él. Seis guerreros... nunca volvieron.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#128.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.src: ...Well, good luck! I'm certain you'll either succeed, or you'll fail spectacularly. Either or, really.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.dst: ...¡Bueno, suerte! Estoy seguro de que triunfarás o fracasarás espectacularmente. Una de dos, la verdad.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.src: Bring me concrete proof of your triumph over the beast, and I will grant you passage into the Temple of the Legends! Do be quick, would you?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.dst: ¡Tráeme una prueba concreta de tu triunfo sobre la bestia y te concederé el paso al Templo de las leyendas! Date prisa, ¿quieres?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#131.src: Kill the Corrupter of Worlds in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring proof of its death to Kelight at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#131.dst: Mata al Corrupter of Worlds en la cueva de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y lleva la prueba de su muerte a Kelight, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.src: Even one so brave and powerful as myself could not possibly survive against-
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.dst: Ni siquiera alguien tan valiente y poderoso como yo podría sobrevivir contra-
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#134.src: Er... I mean, of course you were able to defeat the beast! I believed in you from the very start!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#134.dst: Eh... Quiero decir, ¡claro que podías derrotar a la bestia! ¡Creí en ti desde el primer momento!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#134.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#135.src: ...Ehm. I suppose you are welcome in the Temple of the Legends, now! You have... certainly proven yourself. My apologies for misjudging you. Feel proud of your accomplishment!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#135.dst: ...Ejem. ¡Supongo que ahora eres bienvenido en el Templo de las leyendas! Sin duda... has demostrado tu valía. Disculpa que te juzgara mal. ¡Siéntete orgulloso de tu logro!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#135.speaker: Kelight
