The Corrupted Village#019.src: I see, you were sent to aid the public. Perfect.
The Corrupted Village#019.dst: Ya veo, te han enviado a ayudar a la gente. Perfecto.
The Corrupted Village#019.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#020.src: I am Orikal, I'm trying to stop everyone here from killing each other.
The Corrupted Village#020.dst: Soy Orikal, intento evitar que todos los de aquí se maten entre sí.
The Corrupted Village#020.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#021.src: Do you see all these spikes? I believe they are the thing spreading corruption.
The Corrupted Village#021.dst: ¿Ves todas estas púas? Creo que son ellas las que propagan la Corrupción.
The Corrupted Village#021.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#022.src: Corruption does not affect humans like other beings. It’s much much slower, more like an infection of the mind to us.
The Corrupted Village#022.dst: La Corrupción no afecta a los humanos como al resto. Es mucho más lenta; para nosotros es una infección mental.
The Corrupted Village#022.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#023.src: Could you inspect the peak of the spike in the village for me? It might give me valuable insight. Thanks!
The Corrupted Village#023.dst: ¿Podrías examinar la punta de la púa de la aldea por mí? Quizá me dé alguna pista valiosa. ¡Gracias!
The Corrupted Village#023.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#024.src: Examine the nearby corrupted spike to the northeast at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Corrupted Village#024.dst: Examina la púa corrupta cercana al noreste, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Corrupted Village#025.src: Climb the spike to see if you can find anything useful about it's existance.
The Corrupted Village#025.dst: Sube por la púa a ver si encuentras algo útil sobre su existencia.

The Corrupted Village#026.src: Report back to Orikal about your observations.
The Corrupted Village#026.dst: Informa a Orikal de lo que has observado.

The Corrupted Village#027.src: That was quick... did you find anything?
The Corrupted Village#027.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#028.src: Really, nothing? You didn't even feel anything?
The Corrupted Village#028.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#029.src: How can it be just a spike? It must be spreading corruption somehow.
The Corrupted Village#029.dst: ¿Cómo va a ser solo una púa? De algún modo estará propagando la Corrupción.
The Corrupted Village#029.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#030.src: Then perhaps my second theory was correct. I will have to send you underground.
The Corrupted Village#030.dst: Entonces quizá mi segunda teoría era la correcta. Tendré que enviarte bajo tierra.
The Corrupted Village#030.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#031.src: There are old cave systems around here from the mining days. I sent two men down to excavate the spike, can you go down and help?
The Corrupted Village#031.dst: Por aquí hay cuevas antiguas de la época de las minas. Mandé a dos hombres a excavar la púa, ¿puedes bajar a echar una mano?
The Corrupted Village#031.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#032.src: The entrance is a little to the northeast. In fact, you should have passed it on your way to the spike.
The Corrupted Village#032.dst: La entrada está un poco al noreste. De hecho, debiste pasar por delante camino de la púa.
The Corrupted Village#032.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#033.src: Find the excavators inside the nearby cave to the northeast at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Corrupted Village#033.dst: Encuentra a los excavadores en la cueva cercana al noreste, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Corrupted Village#034.src: Find the excavators inside the cave.
The Corrupted Village#034.dst: Encuentra a los excavadores dentro de la cueva.

The Corrupted Village#035.src: This is insane, why are we here?! We're looking for corruption you know that right?
The Corrupted Village#035.dst: Esto es de locos, ¡¿qué hacemos aquí?! Estamos buscando Corrupción, lo sabes, ¿verdad?
The Corrupted Village#035.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#036.src: Calm down. All we have to do is keep digging. Besides, he did say he'd pay us a lot, so stop being mad.
The Corrupted Village#036.dst: Tranquilo. Solo tenemos que seguir cavando. Además, dijo que nos pagaría mucho, así que deja de enfadarte.
The Corrupted Village#036.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#037.src: Forget it, I don't care anymore, just prime the explosive and get clear of the blast!
The Corrupted Village#037.dst: Olvídalo, ya me da igual, ¡tú activa el explosivo y apártate de la explosión!
The Corrupted Village#037.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#038.src: Well, that did the trick. Let's take a look.
The Corrupted Village#038.dst: Bueno, eso ha funcionado. Vamos a echar un vistazo.
The Corrupted Village#038.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#040.src: It almost looks like a giant spike... Woah. How deep does this thing go?
The Corrupted Village#040.dst: Parece casi una púa gigante... Vaya. ¿Hasta qué hondura llega esto?
The Corrupted Village#040.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#041.src: Well, you know what? We did our job, so honestly I don't care. Let's get out of he-
The Corrupted Village#041.dst: ¿Sabes qué? Hemos hecho nuestro trabajo, así que sinceramente me da igual. Salgamos de aqu-
The Corrupted Village#041.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#042.src: Orikal? We're done! Pay up! I want out. This place is getting to me.
The Corrupted Village#042.dst: ¿Orikal? ¡Hemos terminado! ¡Paga! Quiero largarme. Este sitio me está afectando.
The Corrupted Village#042.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#043.src: I came when I heard the explosion. I thought you'd hurt yourselves.
The Corrupted Village#043.dst: Vine al oír la explosión. Pensé que os habíais hecho daño.
The Corrupted Village#043.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#044.src: Well, I'll be darned. The spike goes this far down? And it looks like it goes even deeper than this!
The Corrupted Village#044.dst: Que me aspen. ¿La púa llega tan abajo? ¡Y parece que sigue aún más hondo!
The Corrupted Village#044.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#045.src: Well, I don't know about you, but I say we blow it to shreds! That oughta get rid of this spike!
The Corrupted Village#045.dst: No sé vosotros, pero yo digo que la volemos en pedazos. ¡Eso acabará con esta púa!
The Corrupted Village#045.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#046.src: For once, I agree. I'll do it, you guys just get clear.
The Corrupted Village#046.dst: Por una vez, estoy de acuerdo. Lo haré yo, vosotros apartaos.
The Corrupted Village#046.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#047.src: ...Wow, that did nothing. We're going to need something MUCH more powerful than TNT...
The Corrupted Village#047.dst: ...Vaya, no ha servido de nada. Vamos a necesitar algo MUCHO más potente que la TNT...
The Corrupted Village#047.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#048.src: Oh yeah? And just what would you have in mind?
The Corrupted Village#048.dst: ¿Ah, sí? ¿Y qué tienes en mente exactamente?
The Corrupted Village#048.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#049.src: Well, it's sorta complicated. That's why I've decided to give our new friend here the job of acquiring this explosive.
The Corrupted Village#049.dst: Bueno, es algo complicado. Por eso he decidido encargar a nuestro nuevo amigo la tarea de conseguir ese explosivo.
The Corrupted Village#049.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#050.src: Oh yeah, we were so busy with this spike, we forgot to address you! Sorry about that.
The Corrupted Village#050.dst: ¡Ah, sí, con tanta púa se nos olvidó saludarte! Perdona.
The Corrupted Village#050.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#051.src: Well if you don't need us anymore then we'll just be on our way... WITH our money! So hand it over please.
The Corrupted Village#051.dst: Bueno, si ya no nos necesitáis, nos vamos... ¡CON nuestro dinero! Así que suéltalo, por favor.
The Corrupted Village#051.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#052.src: Alright, fine. Here's your pay. Thank you for your help.
The Corrupted Village#052.dst: Está bien. Aquí tenéis vuestra paga. Gracias por la ayuda.
The Corrupted Village#052.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#053.src: Gah! That's hardly anything! I'm not even surprised. Let's just go.
The Corrupted Village#053.dst: ¡Agh! ¡Si esto no es nada! Ni me sorprende. Venga, vámonos.
The Corrupted Village#053.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#054.src: Anyway, come meet me back at my tent, friend. We will discuss what to do then.
The Corrupted Village#054.dst: En fin, ven a verme a mi tienda, amigo. Allí decidiremos qué hacer.
The Corrupted Village#054.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#055.src: Exit the cave and speak to Orikal in his tent about his plan for destroying the spike.
The Corrupted Village#055.dst: Sal de la cueva y habla con Orikal en su tienda sobre su plan para destruir la púa.

The Corrupted Village#056.src: Okay. I happen to know a recipe for creating an extremely lethal magical explosive.
The Corrupted Village#056.dst: Bien. Resulta que conozco una receta para crear un explosivo mágico extremadamente letal.
The Corrupted Village#056.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#057.src: There are {~} main ingredients you will need to get me: [Stabilized Corrupted Ore], [Incendiary Fluid], and a [Switch Fuse] to activate it.
The Corrupted Village#057.dst: Hay {~} ingredientes principales que debes traerme: [Stabilized Corrupted Ore], [Incendiary Fluid] y un [Switch Fuse] para activarlo.
The Corrupted Village#057.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#058.src: There used to be a small mining camp a little east of this town. It's abandoned now, but you should still be able to find what you need there.
The Corrupted Village#058.dst: Al este de este pueblo había un pequeño campamento minero. Ahora está abandonado, pero aún deberías encontrar allí lo que necesitas.
The Corrupted Village#058.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#059.src: It's not the big ol' abandoned mines, mind you. It's a smaller camp, in fact you should be able to see it from this village.
The Corrupted Village#059.dst: Ojo, no son las grandes minas abandonadas. Es un campamento más pequeño; de hecho, deberías verlo desde esta aldea.
The Corrupted Village#059.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#060.src: Best of luck! Oh, and also, try not to die please. These ingredients do indeed promote environmental hazards.
The Corrupted Village#060.dst: ¡Mucha suerte! Ah, y por favor, intenta no morir. Estos ingredientes sí que provocan peligros en el entorno.
The Corrupted Village#060.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#061.src: Find [Stabilized Corrupted Ore], [Incendiary Fluid], and [Switch Fuse] for the TNT at the mining camp at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Corrupted Village#061.dst: Encuentra [Stabilized Corrupted Ore], [Incendiary Fluid] y [Switch Fuse] para la TNT en el campamento minero en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Corrupted Village#062.src: You got 'em all! Excellent, this is exactly what we need.
The Corrupted Village#062.dst: ¡Los tienes todos! Excelente, es justo lo que necesitamos.
The Corrupted Village#062.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#063.src: Alright, stand back. I have actually never made this before, so let's hope I don't cause a disaster.
The Corrupted Village#063.dst: Bien, apártate. La verdad es que nunca había hecho esto, así que esperemos que no provoque un desastre.
The Corrupted Village#063.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#064.src: Phew, glad nothing tragic happened there. This should be it, now go take it back down to the spike and destroy it once and for all!
The Corrupted Village#064.dst: Uf, menos mal que no ha pasado nada trágico. Esto debería bastar; ¡ahora bájalo hasta la púa y destrúyela de una vez por todas!
The Corrupted Village#064.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#065.src: Bring the explosive to the spike in the cave and use it to destroy the spike.
The Corrupted Village#065.dst: Lleva el explosivo hasta la púa de la cueva y úsalo para destruirla.

The Corrupted Village#066.src: Report to Orikal about your success.
The Corrupted Village#066.dst: Informa a Orikal de tu éxito.

The Corrupted Village#067.src: Oh, do you feel that? It's like a buzzing in my ears I never knew about has just vanished.
The Corrupted Village#067.dst: Oh, ¿lo notas? Es como si un zumbido en los oídos que nunca supe que tenía acabara de desaparecer.
The Corrupted Village#067.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#068.src: I think that worked you know. It seems the power of the spike comes from the root...
The Corrupted Village#068.dst: Creo que ha funcionado, ¿sabes? Parece que el poder de la púa viene de la raíz...
The Corrupted Village#068.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#069.src: But what is it connected to? That's for another day. The main thing is the village is safe.
The Corrupted Village#069.dst: Pero ¿con qué está conectada? Eso queda para otro día. Lo importante es que la aldea está a salvo.
The Corrupted Village#069.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#070.src: Here, take this for your help. I found this potato in one of the houses around here, and I sure as heck don't want it!
The Corrupted Village#070.dst: Toma, esto por tu ayuda. Encontré esta patata en una de las casas de por aquí, ¡y desde luego yo no la quiero!
The Corrupted Village#070.speaker: Orikal

The Cursed One#000.src: For all that the festival revolves around the crown, I've always appreciated its representation of our culture.
The Cursed One#000.dst: Aunque el festival gire en torno a la Corona, siempre he apreciado cómo representa nuestra cultura.

The Cursed One#001.src: Good job friend! You showed those mudkins!
The Cursed One#001.dst: ¡Buen trabajo, amigo! ¡Les diste su merecido a esos Mudkin!

The Cursed One#002.src: As of late, I have felt a distinct lack of impact in our actions. Certainly- we've done good for the downtrodden and overlooked! But we have failed to make any real change.
The Cursed One#002.dst: Últimamente siento que nuestros actos apenas tienen impacto. Cierto- ¡hemos hecho el bien por los pisoteados y los olvidados! Pero no hemos logrado ningún cambio real.

The Cursed One#003.src: Yeah, curses, blessings - whatever. So, what, you think all of us could just... use "magic"? What would that even look like?
The Cursed One#003.dst: Sí, maldiciones, bendiciones - lo que sea. ¿Y qué, crees que todos podríamos simplemente... usar "magia"? ¿Y eso cómo sería?

The Cursed One#004.src: However, the traditional "cursed one" mythos has the afflicted wielding such power without the use of any blessed artifacts.
The Cursed One#004.dst: Sin embargo, en los mitos tradicionales del "maldito", el afligido esgrime ese poder sin usar ningún artefacto bendito.

The Cursed One#005.src: As an example- I learned that I have an affinity for the fire element, but I didn't know what form that would take until I actually received my blessing.
The Cursed One#005.dst: Por ejemplo- supe que tenía afinidad con el elemento Fuego, pero no supe qué forma tomaría hasta que recibí mi bendición.

The Cursed One#006.src: Return to the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#006.dst: Vuelve al campamento de la resistencia en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#007.src: {u}, it's good to see you. Have you been well?
The Cursed One#007.dst: {u}, me alegro de verte. ¿Has estado bien?
The Cursed One#007.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#008.src: ...no one has recognized you in {p}, have they?
The Cursed One#008.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#009.src: Good, good. Be sure to tell me if it does happen, and we'll figure out what to do from there.
The Cursed One#009.dst: Bien, bien. Avísame si llega a pasar y ya veremos qué hacer entonces.
The Cursed One#009.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#010.src: Anyway, since you're here, I'd like to follow up on our earlier discussion. About... magic.
The Cursed One#010.dst: En fin, ya que estás aquí, quiero retomar nuestra charla de antes. Sobre... la magia.
The Cursed One#010.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#011.src: I would like for you to describe what you know of it, how you use it, and how most people in your province can wield it.
The Cursed One#011.dst: Me gustaría que describieras qué sabes de ella, cómo la usas y cómo la maneja la mayoría de la gente de tu provincia.
The Cursed One#011.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#012.src: I've informed the Leaves about our plans, and those interested will join us. Though, I will not force anyone to attend if they do not wish to. Are you ready?
The Cursed One#012.dst: He informado a las Hojas de nuestros planes, y quien tenga interés vendrá. Aun así, no obligaré a nadie a asistir. ¿Estás listo?
The Cursed One#012.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#014.src: Teach the Leaves in the Wind magic.
The Cursed One#014.dst: Enseña magia a Hojas al Viento.

The Cursed One#015.src: Hello, everyone. Hm... has anyone seen Sui?
The Cursed One#015.dst: Hola a todos. Hm... ¿alguien ha visto a Sui?
The Cursed One#015.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#016.src: She told me she did not feel particularly comfortable listening in on this discussion, so I did not push her further.
The Cursed One#016.dst: Me dijo que no se sentía muy cómoda escuchando esta conversación, así que no insistí más.
The Cursed One#016.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#017.src: I see. I think it would be good for her to hear this, though. Could someone fetch her for me?
The Cursed One#017.dst: Entiendo. Aun así, creo que le vendría bien oír esto. ¿Alguien podría ir a buscarla?
The Cursed One#017.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#018.src: I can go find her, ma'am.
The Cursed One#018.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#020.src: It... isn't something you need to worry about. Not yet, at least.
The Cursed One#020.dst: No... no es algo de lo que debas preocuparte. Al menos, no todavía.
The Cursed One#020.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#021.src: Magic... or, rather, curses have a tendency to be associated with bad memories.
The Cursed One#021.dst: La magia... o más bien las maldiciones suelen ir asociadas a malos recuerdos.
The Cursed One#021.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#022.src: It's not my place to tell you why. Sui can share more if she wants to, later.
The Cursed One#022.dst: No me corresponde contarte por qué. Sui te dirá más luego, si quiere.
The Cursed One#022.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#024.src: I have my reasons for it. I believe it would be better for her to hear this now, rather than later.
The Cursed One#024.dst: Tengo mis motivos. Creo que le conviene más oír esto ahora que después.
The Cursed One#024.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#025.src: It's not my place to tell you why. Sui can share more if she wants to, later.
The Cursed One#025.dst: No me corresponde contarte por qué. Sui te dirá más luego, si quiere.
The Cursed One#025.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#026.src: Here we are! So, could we get started already? Some of us actually have responsibilities.
The Cursed One#026.dst: ¡Ya estamos! ¿Y bien, podemos empezar de una vez? Algunos sí tenemos obligaciones.
The Cursed One#026.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#027.src: Seeing as everyone is here, yes, Rex, we may. {u}, let us start with the basics.
The Cursed One#027.dst: Ya que estamos todos, sí, Rex, podemos. {u}, empecemos por lo básico.
The Cursed One#027.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#028.src: Ah, yes, such as the cursed... the stories do tell of the original evil lurking within us. It would follow that it exists in all things.
The Cursed One#028.dst: Ah, sí, como los malditos... las historias sí hablan del mal original que acecha en nuestro interior. Cabe deducir que existe en todas las cosas.
The Cursed One#028.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#029.src: Indeed. So {u}, how do you wield your magic?
The Cursed One#029.dst: En efecto. Y bien, {u}, ¿cómo manejas tu magia?
The Cursed One#029.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#030.src: Similar to the blessed implements of the crown's commanders, yes? I remember hearing of this from the military recruiters.
The Cursed One#030.dst: ¿Parecido a los útiles benditos de los comandantes de la Corona? Recuerdo habérselo oído a los reclutadores del ejército.
The Cursed One#030.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#031.src: Don't those usually only have one specific blessing attached to them? I don't remember them being as... uh, flexible, I guess.
The Cursed One#031.dst: ¿Esos no suelen llevar una sola bendición concreta? No recuerdo que fueran tan... eh, flexibles, supongo.
The Cursed One#031.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#032.src: You'd be correct, Rex, though the same principle applies. A blessed weapon is referred to as a "focus" by the crown. They allow the wielder to more easily access the blessing placed within.
The Cursed One#032.dst: Tienes razón, Rex, aunque el principio es el mismo. La Corona llama "foco" a un arma bendita. Permiten a quien las empuña acceder más fácilmente a la bendición que encierran.
The Cursed One#032.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#033.src: Ah, I do have experience with this. We call it mana. Once one receives a blessing, it takes time to learn how to draw from your own source of mana.
The Cursed One#033.dst: Ah, de eso sí tengo experiencia. Nosotros lo llamamos maná. Tras recibir una bendición, cuesta tiempo aprender a tirar de tu propia fuente de maná.
The Cursed One#033.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#034.src: This is where foci come into play they are crafted or forged from mana-dense materials, and so provide a more easily accessible source to power one's blessing.
The Cursed One#034.dst: Ahí es donde entran los focos: se elaboran o forjan con materiales densos en maná, y así ofrecen una fuente más accesible para alimentar la bendición.
The Cursed One#034.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#035.src: And, so... what? You think any of us could just... do it? That's hard to believe.
The Cursed One#035.dst: Y... ¿qué? ¿Crees que cualquiera de nosotros podría... hacerlo sin más? Cuesta creerlo.
The Cursed One#035.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#036.src: Ha! If it were truly the case, would there not be many, many more cursed ones running around? I concur with Rex, it seems outlandish.
The Cursed One#036.dst: ¡Ja! Si así fuera, ¿no habría muchísimos más malditos sueltos por ahí? Coincido con Rex, suena descabellado.
The Cursed One#036.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#037.src: I d- d- don't know... {u} doesn't seem like they're l- ly- like they're lying. What- wh- what if it is true?
The Cursed One#037.dst: N- n- no sé... {u} no parece que esté m- mi- que esté mintiendo. ¿Y- y- y si es verdad?
The Cursed One#037.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#038.src: It would explain certain aspects of the crown's response to cursed ones...
The Cursed One#038.dst: Explicaría parte de la reacción de la Corona ante los malditos...
The Cursed One#038.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#039.src: But... if you didn't receive a blessing, doesn't it still make you cursed?
The Cursed One#039.dst: Pero... si no recibiste una bendición, ¿no te convierte igualmente en maldito?
The Cursed One#039.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#040.src: Yes, precisely! My sister is correct. Any... "magic" not sourced from the crown is innately tainted, from my understanding.
The Cursed One#040.dst: ¡Sí, exacto! Mi hermana tiene razón. Toda... "magia" que no venga de la Corona es intrínsecamente impura, según tengo entendido.
The Cursed One#040.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#041.src: Yeah, curses, blessings whatever. So, what, you think all of us could just... use "magic"? What would that even look like?
The Cursed One#041.dst: Sí, maldiciones, bendiciones lo que sea. ¿Y qué, crees que todos podríamos simplemente... usar "magia"? ¿Y eso cómo sería?
The Cursed One#041.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#042.src: Ha. Right, sure. "Belief." So if I think hard enough, I can just start calling down lightning strikes?
The Cursed One#042.dst: Ja. Ya, claro. "Creer." ¿Así que si me concentro lo bastante puedo ponerme a invocar rayos?
The Cursed One#042.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#043.src: Ugh. This was a waste of time.
The Cursed One#043.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#044.src: Now, now, Rex. Don't be so hasty in writing it off entirely. You have seen with your own eyes what {u} can do!
The Cursed One#044.dst: Vamos, vamos, Rex. No lo descartes todo tan deprisa. ¡Has visto con tus propios ojos lo que {u} puede hacer!
The Cursed One#044.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#045.src: Belief... I- I- I can do that.
The Cursed One#045.dst: Creer... e- e- eso sí puedo.
The Cursed One#045.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#046.src: Oh, come on Zeph, really? You can't seriously
The Cursed One#046.dst: Ah, venga ya, Zeph, ¿en serio? No estarás pensando de verdad
The Cursed One#046.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#047.src: We're getting off track. {u}, what else is there?
The Cursed One#047.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#048.src: So... s- so you don't even know what your m- ma- magic will look like?
The Cursed One#048.dst: Entonces... ¿n- ni siquiera sabes qué forma tendrá tu m- ma- magia?
The Cursed One#048.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#049.src: Correct. There are aptitude tests which the crown uses before giving out blessings, but those only provide an idea of the general typing.
The Cursed One#049.dst: Correcto. La Corona hace pruebas de aptitud antes de conceder bendiciones, pero solo dan una idea del tipo general.
The Cursed One#049.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#050.src: As an example I learned that I have an affinity for the fire element, but I didn't know what form that would take until I actually received my blessing.
The Cursed One#050.dst: Por ejemplo, supe que tenía afinidad con el elemento Fuego, pero no supe qué forma tomaría hasta que recibí mi bendición.
The Cursed One#050.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#051.src: Oh! S- s- so, what type of magic do you think I w- would- I would have?
The Cursed One#051.dst: ¡Oh! E- e- entonces, ¿qué tipo de magia crees que t- ten- tendría yo?
The Cursed One#051.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#052.src: Something with wind, probably. You have that sort of... feel to you. Hey we'll be the Leaves, and you can be the Wind!
The Cursed One#052.dst: Algo de viento, seguramente. Tienes ese... aire. ¡Eh, nosotros seremos las Hojas y tú puedes ser el Viento!
The Cursed One#052.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#053.src: He- hey! That... oh, that would be c- c- cool, actually...
The Cursed One#053.dst: ¡E- eh! Eso... ah, eso sería g- g- genial, la verdad...
The Cursed One#053.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#054.src: If I may interrupt thus far, you have spoken at length on casting through the use of a focus.
The Cursed One#054.dst: Si me permites interrumpir, hasta ahora has hablado largo y tendido de lanzar hechizos mediante un foco.
The Cursed One#054.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#055.src: However, the traditional "cursed one" mythos has afflicted wielding such power without the use of any blessed artifacts.
The Cursed One#055.dst: Sin embargo, en los mitos tradicionales del "maldito", el afligido esgrime ese poder sin usar ningún artefacto bendito.
The Cursed One#055.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#056.src: Aha. Of course, then those must be the dangerous ones.
The Cursed One#056.dst: Ajá. Entonces esos deben de ser, claro, los peligrosos.
The Cursed One#056.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#058.src: Uncommon, but still common enough to maintain the reputation the cursed have... It would make sense.
The Cursed One#058.dst: Poco frecuente, pero bastante como para mantener la fama de los malditos... Tendría sentido.
The Cursed One#058.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#059.src: Well, thank you for your time, {u}. I think we'll call it there. You're all dismissed.
The Cursed One#059.dst: Bien, gracias por tu tiempo, {u}. Creo que lo dejaremos aquí. Podéis retiraros.
The Cursed One#059.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#060.src: ...So what, is- is that it? We talk about th- th- theory for a while, and th- a- and then do nothing?
The Cursed One#060.dst: ...¿Y ya está? ¿E- eso es todo? ¿Hablamos un rato de te- te- teoría y- y- y luego no hacemos nada?
The Cursed One#060.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#061.src: Zeph, even if {u}'s information is true, it doesn't mean it's immediately applicable.
The Cursed One#061.dst: Zeph, aunque lo que cuenta {u} sea cierto, no significa que se pueda aplicar ya.
The Cursed One#061.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#062.src: If I could be certain that experimenting with cur... magic... would be safe, maybe there could be an opportunity here. As it stands... it's too risky.
The Cursed One#062.dst: Si supiera que experimentar con las mal... con la magia... es seguro, quizá habría una ocasión aquí. Pero así... es demasiado arriesgado.
The Cursed One#062.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#063.src: R- ris- risky... maybe the reason we've been stuck is because we d- d- we don't take risks!
The Cursed One#063.dst: A- arr- arriesgado... ¡quizá seguimos atascados porque n- n- no corremos riesgos!
The Cursed One#063.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#064.src: The per- perfect opportunity to be a- a- able to hold our own against the c- cr- crown, a- and- and we're gonna do n- no- nothing? Are you h- hear- hearing yourself?
The Cursed One#064.dst: La oc- ocasión perfecta para p- p- poder plantar cara a la C- Co- Corona, ¿y- y- y no vamos a hacer n- na- nada? ¿Te e- es- estás oyendo?
The Cursed One#064.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#066.src: No, I- I'm gonna ta- take the chance. Even- e- even if no- nobody else will. Come- c- come on, {u}, let's go.
The Cursed One#066.dst: No, y- yo voy a a- arriesgarme. Aun- a- aunque n- nadie más lo haga. V- v- vamos, {u}, en marcha.
The Cursed One#066.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#068.src: Sigh. I suppose I should have expected something like this. Of all the children, he's the one with the most to prove...
The Cursed One#068.dst: Suspiro. Supongo que debí esperarme algo así. De todos los chicos, es el que más necesita demostrar algo...
The Cursed One#068.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#069.src: You may as well go with him, {u}. Maybe you'll be able to prove my worries wrong.
The Cursed One#069.dst: Más vale que vayas con él, {u}. Quizá demuestres que mis temores son infundados.
The Cursed One#069.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#070.src: Hum... I suppose the pieces fit together, yet...
The Cursed One#070.dst: Hum... supongo que las piezas encajan, y aun así...
The Cursed One#070.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#072.src: I... I may have gotten a bit h- he- heated there...
The Cursed One#072.dst: Yo... puede que me haya a- ac- acalorado un poco...
The Cursed One#072.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#073.src: It's just... all so- s- so frustrating! So often, people are h- hur- hurt by the crown, and- and th- there's nothing we can do about it! If we had m- m- if we had m- magic, we'd be able to- to sta- stand up to them!
The Cursed One#073.dst: Es que... ¡todo es t- t- tan frustrante! La Corona h- hie- hiere a gente sin parar, ¡y- y n- no podemos hacer nada! Si tuviéramos m- m- si tuviéramos m- magia, ¡podríamos p- pl- plantarles cara!
The Cursed One#073.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#074.src: But they don't... eugh. What- wh- whatever. We can just
The Cursed One#074.dst: Pero no lo hacen... puaj. D- d- da igual. Podemos simplemente
The Cursed One#074.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#077.src: Well, I can't just let you go off and do this on your own. Even if I think it's stupid and reckless.
The Cursed One#077.dst: Bueno, no voy a dejar que hagas esto tú solo. Aunque me parezca una estupidez y una temeridad.
The Cursed One#077.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#078.src: So, what's the plan? You didn't just run off without one, right?
The Cursed One#078.dst: ¿Y cuál es el plan? No habrás salido corriendo sin uno, ¿no?
The Cursed One#078.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#081.src: Hey! I know that I- I need a f- fo- focus, right? We just need to find some... s- some magical materials to ma- make it out of. Even if I- I- I don't know where to... look.
The Cursed One#081.dst: ¡Eh! Sé que n- necesito un f- fo- foco, ¿no? Solo hay que encontrar... a- algún material mágico para h- hacerlo. Aunque y- y- yo no sepa dónde... buscar.
The Cursed One#081.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#082.src: Sigh. Okay. Well, luckily for you, I know a spot. Remember that cave to the west of the festival grounds? Soldiers were swarming the place a week or two ago. Blocked it off 'cause of... cursed activity, or something.
The Cursed One#082.dst: Suspiro. Vale. Por suerte para ti, conozco un sitio. ¿Recuerdas la cueva al oeste del recinto del festival? Hace una o dos semanas aquello estaba plagado de soldados. La cerraron por... actividad de malditos o algo así.
The Cursed One#082.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#083.src: And... y- you- you think there might be s- some- something there?
The Cursed One#083.dst: Y... ¿c- cre- crees que puede haber a- a- algo ahí?
The Cursed One#083.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#084.src: Yep! Why else would they prevent people from going there for so long? There's gotta be something.
The Cursed One#084.dst: ¡Claro! ¿Si no, por qué llevan tanto tiempo sin dejar entrar a nadie? Algo tiene que haber.
The Cursed One#084.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#085.src: Okay. It's w- worth a shot... Thanks for the help, Rex.
The Cursed One#085.dst: Vale. M- merece la pena probar... Gracias por la ayuda, Rex.
The Cursed One#085.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#086.src: Don't mention it. We'll just have to follow those blue flowers, they'll lead us right to the cave. I'll stand guard outside while you two search it.
The Cursed One#086.dst: No hay de qué. Solo hay que seguir esas flores azules, nos llevarán directos a la cueva. Yo vigilo fuera mientras vosotros dos la registráis.
The Cursed One#086.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#088.src: Head to the blocked off cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#088.dst: Dirígete a la cueva cerrada en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#089.src: ...Hm? What? I'm not here for you, just to be clear.
The Cursed One#089.dst: ...¿Hm? ¿Qué? Que quede claro: no estoy aquí por ti.
The Cursed One#089.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#090.src: You should stop wasting time talking to me, and hurry up after Zeph already.
The Cursed One#090.dst: Deja de perder el tiempo hablando conmigo y ve ya tras Zeph.
The Cursed One#090.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#091.src: He's probably trying to compete with you to see who can get to the end fastest, and every second you spend here is not doing you any favors in beating him.
The Cursed One#091.dst: Seguro que quiere competir contigo por ver quién llega antes al fondo, y cada segundo que pasas aquí juega en tu contra para ganarle.
The Cursed One#091.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#092.src: Heh. Not that you'd win anyway!
The Cursed One#092.dst: Je. ¡Tampoco es que fueras a ganar!
The Cursed One#092.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#093.src: Hah! Too s- sl- slow! I guess I probably sh- should- should've warned you about the r- roly-bugs...
The Cursed One#093.dst: ¡Ja! ¡D- de- demasiado lento! Supongo que d- deb- debí avisarte de los b- bichos Roly...
The Cursed One#093.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#094.src: If you're quiet en- enough, they usually don't bother you. I th- th- I think you even woke up the lea- leader of the colony!
The Cursed One#094.dst: Si vas lo bastante c- callado, no suelen molestarte. ¡C- c- creo que hasta despertaste al lí- líder de la colonia!
The Cursed One#094.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#095.src: Anyway... I think Rex was right. Lo- look at these crystals! If- if a- any- anything's magical, it's got to be them!
The Cursed One#095.dst: En fin... creo que Rex tenía razón. ¡M- mi- mira estos cristales! Si a- a- algo es mágico, ¡tienen que ser ellos!
The Cursed One#095.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#096.src: Let's grab some and g- get- get out of here. We don't want to get c- cau- caught in a res- restricted area.
The Cursed One#096.dst: Cojamos unos cuantos y s- sal- salgamos de aquí. No queremos que nos p- pi- pillen en una zona res- restringida.
The Cursed One#096.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#097.src: I'll take one... M- may- maybe we should take some more? In ca- c- in case anyone else wants to- y- you know. Co- coming back here again later would be da- dangerous.
The Cursed One#097.dst: Yo cojo uno... ¿Q- qui- quizá deberíamos coger más? P- p- por si alguien más quiere- y- ya sabes. V- volver aquí más tarde sería p- peligroso.
The Cursed One#097.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#098.src: Grab a crystal before you leave.
The Cursed One#098.dst: Coge un cristal antes de irte.

The Cursed One#099.src: Took you long enough! So, who won the race?
The Cursed One#099.dst: ¡Ya era hora! ¿Y bien, quién ganó la carrera?
The Cursed One#099.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#100.src: You say that like you don't a- al- already know, Rex!
The Cursed One#100.dst: ¡Lo dices como si no lo s- su- supieras ya, Rex!
The Cursed One#100.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#101.src: Excuses, excuses. You should always have your guard up around Zeph. You never know when he'll strike with a surprise race.
The Cursed One#101.dst: Excusas, excusas. Con Zeph hay que estar siempre en guardia. Nunca sabes cuándo te saldrá con una carrera sorpresa.
The Cursed One#101.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#105.src: Sure, Zeph. Well, what'd you find? I haven't seen anybody out here, so I think we're in the clear to go if we're done here.
The Cursed One#105.dst: Ya, Zeph. Bueno, ¿qué habéis encontrado? Por aquí no he visto a nadie, así que creo que podemos irnos tranquilos si ya está.
The Cursed One#105.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#106.src: We fou- found some crystals growing at the end of the cave. They f- fe- feel magical to me, so... they should w- wor- work. Let's get going back.
The Cursed One#106.dst: En- encontramos unos cristales al fondo de la cueva. A mí me p- pa- parecen mágicos, así que... deberían s- ser- servir. Volvamos ya.
The Cursed One#106.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#107.src: Return to the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#107.dst: Vuelve al campamento de la resistencia en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#108.src: Come on. Just because we're in the clear now doesn't mean we can dilly-dally. Let's go.
The Cursed One#108.dst: Venga. Que ahora estemos a salvo no significa que podamos entretenernos. Vamos.
The Cursed One#108.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#109.src: Let's get going back. I r- really hope these crystals w- wor- work.
The Cursed One#109.dst: Volvamos ya. E- espero de verdad que estos cristales f- fun- funcionen.
The Cursed One#109.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#110.src: ...Ah! You return! I'd best inform miss Syndra of your arrival.
The Cursed One#110.dst: ...¡Ah! ¡Habéis vuelto! Será mejor que avise a la señorita Syndra.
The Cursed One#110.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#111.src: You were wai- waiting for us? Why?
The Cursed One#111.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#112.src: Hrm... I suppose your words resonated with me, in the end. Having taken some time to mull it over while you were gone... I must admit, you make a solid point.
The Cursed One#112.dst: Hum... supongo que al final tus palabras me calaron. He tenido tiempo de darle vueltas mientras no estabais... y debo admitir que tienes razón.
The Cursed One#112.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#113.src: As of late, I have felt a distinct lack of impact in our actions. Certainly we've done good for the downtrodden and overlooked! But we have failed to make any real change.
The Cursed One#113.dst: Últimamente siento que nuestros actos apenas tienen impacto. Cierto, ¡hemos hecho el bien por los pisoteados y los olvidados! Pero no hemos logrado ningún cambio real.
The Cursed One#113.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#114.src: Well, you're not the only one feeling that way, if it makes you feel any better. I think Syndra's the same.
The Cursed One#114.dst: Bueno, no eres el único que lo siente así, si te sirve de consuelo. Creo que a Syndra le pasa igual.
The Cursed One#114.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#115.src: Even more reason to try something new, then! This... magic, as you call it- if indeed it is what you have described, though I still have my doubts-
The Cursed One#115.dst: ¡Razón de más para probar algo nuevo, entonces! Esta... magia, como la llamas- si de verdad es lo que has descrito, aunque sigo teniendo mis dudas-
The Cursed One#115.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#117.src: Yes, Rex, I appreciate the encouragement as I was saying, it could be just what we need to truly make a difference.
The Cursed One#117.dst: Sí, Rex, gracias por el ánimo como decía, podría ser justo lo que necesitamos para cambiar algo de verdad.
The Cursed One#117.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#118.src: ...I h- ho- hope so. Um... you were g- go- going to tell Syndra we were back?
The Cursed One#118.dst: ...E- eso espero. Eh... ¿no ibas a d- decirle a Syndra que volvimos?
The Cursed One#118.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#119.src: So I was! Allow me one moment, please.
The Cursed One#119.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#120.src: ...You're really sure you want to go through with this, Zeph?
The Cursed One#120.dst: ...¿Seguro que quieres seguir adelante con esto, Zeph?
The Cursed One#120.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#121.src: I- I am. I w- wa- I want to try it! Maybe then, I could...
The Cursed One#121.dst: S- sí. ¡Q- qui- quiero intentarlo! Quizá entonces podría...
The Cursed One#121.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#122.src: Okay! Okay. It's your choice. I just worry sometimes!
The Cursed One#122.dst: ¡Vale! Vale. Es tu decisión. ¡Es que a veces me preocupo!
The Cursed One#122.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#123.src: I... I ne- need to get into the r- r- right mood for it, I thi- I- I think. I'm... kind of ner- nervous, actually.
The Cursed One#123.dst: Yo... ne- necesito ponerme en el e- e- estado de ánimo justo, c- cr- creo. La verdad... estoy un poco ner- nervioso.
The Cursed One#123.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#124.src: ...Hey, {u}, could you... do- d- do some magic. As a- a d- dem- demonstration!
The Cursed One#124.dst: ...Oye, {u}, ¿podrías... h- h- hacer algo de magia? ¡C- co- como demostración!
The Cursed One#124.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#126.src: N- no, she- she's just paranoid. It'll be f- f- fine! You were casting sp- spells in the cave a- and- and nothing bad happened!
The Cursed One#126.dst: N- no, e- ella es una paranoica. ¡No p- p- pasará nada! ¡Lanzaste he- hechizos en la cueva y- y- y no ocurrió nada malo!
The Cursed One#126.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#127.src: Sigh. If you insist, Zeph. Whatever you do had better be cool though, {u}.
The Cursed One#127.dst: Suspiro. Si insistes, Zeph. Pero lo que hagas más te vale que mole, {u}.
The Cursed One#127.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#128.src: Hm, I don't quite like the sound of "probably".
The Cursed One#128.dst: Hm, no me gusta nada cómo suena eso de "probablemente".
The Cursed One#128.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#129.src: Good- g- good enough for me! Come on, {u}, sh- show- show me a spell!
The Cursed One#129.dst: ¡Me v- vale! ¡Venga, {u}, en- enséñame un hechizo!
The Cursed One#129.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#130.src: Showcase magic by casting spells in the resistance camp.
The Cursed One#130.dst: Muestra tu magia lanzando hechizos en el campamento de la resistencia.

The Cursed One#131.src: Woah! That w- was cool! Can you d- do- do it again?
The Cursed One#131.dst: ¡Hala! ¡Q- qué pasada! ¿Puedes h- ha- hacerlo otra vez?
The Cursed One#131.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#133.src: What's going on out here? I heard
The Cursed One#133.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#134.src: {u} is show- sh- showing me some magic!
The Cursed One#134.dst: ¡{u} me está en- ens- enseñando magia!
The Cursed One#134.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#135.src: ... I take it you found what you were looking for then?
The Cursed One#135.dst: ... Deduzco que encontrasteis lo que buscabais, ¿no?
The Cursed One#135.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#136.src: Yup. Cursed crystals from the roly-nest.
The Cursed One#136.dst: Sí. Cristales malditos del nido Roly.
The Cursed One#136.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#137.src: The... of all places, you went to the roly-nest?! Did you even consider the risk?!
The Cursed One#137.dst: El... ¡¿precisamente al nido de los Roly?! ¡¿Pensasteis siquiera en el riesgo?!
The Cursed One#137.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#138.src: What if you were caught? We are only able to operate here because we avoid drawing attention to ourselves. If you had been seen
The Cursed One#138.dst: ¿Y si os hubieran pillado? Si podemos operar aquí es porque evitamos llamar la atención. Si os hubieran visto
The Cursed One#138.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#139.src: But we weren't. I know the shift schedule of the guards, nobody was going to stop by while we were there.
The Cursed One#139.dst: Pero no nos vieron. Me sé los turnos de los guardias, nadie iba a pasar por allí mientras estábamos.
The Cursed One#139.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#140.src: ...sigh. You children, you'll be the death of me. Fine. You found the crystals, and you weren't spotted good.
The Cursed One#140.dst: ...suspiro. Estos críos van a acabar conmigo. Está bien. Encontrasteis los cristales y nadie os vio, bien.
The Cursed One#140.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#141.src: Um... not to interrupt, or, anything, but... I missed the c- magic. Could you... show us some more?
The Cursed One#141.dst: Eh... no quiero interrumpir, ni, nada, pero... me perdí la mal- la magia. ¿Podrías... enseñarnos un poco más?
The Cursed One#141.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#143.src: Indeed. Thank you for the demonstration, {u}. Now, we should
The Cursed One#143.dst: En efecto. Gracias por la demostración, {u}. Ahora deberíamos
The Cursed One#143.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#144.src: Oh! Syndra, do- d- do you think you could show us something t- t- too? You're b- bl- blessed, so maybe it'd be
The Cursed One#144.dst: ¡Oh! Syndra, ¿c- c- crees que podrías enseñarnos algo t- t- tú también? Estás b- ben- bendecida, así que quizá sería
The Cursed One#144.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#146.src: ... O- o- okay! If- if you s- say- say so...
The Cursed One#146.dst: ... ¡V- v- vale! S- si tú lo d- di- dices...
The Cursed One#146.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#147.src: If we're done with the demonstrations, we should discuss
The Cursed One#147.dst: Si ya hemos acabado con las demostraciones, deberíamos hablar de
The Cursed One#147.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#148.src: But- b- but I want to tr- try now! I have a- a fo- focus, so I sh- should- I should be able to do... something.
The Cursed One#148.dst: ¡P- p- pero quiero p- probar ya! Tengo un f- fo- foco, así que d- deb- debería poder hacer... algo.
The Cursed One#148.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#149.src: Sigh. Yes, alright, Zeph. But let me guide you through it, would you?
The Cursed One#149.dst: Suspiro. Sí, está bien, Zeph. Pero deja que te guíe, ¿quieres?
The Cursed One#149.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#150.dst: Observa a Zeph intentar usar magia.

The Cursed One#151.src: Take your position, Zeph. Everyone else, let's move out of the way.
The Cursed One#151.dst: Ponte en posición, Zeph. Los demás, apartémonos.
The Cursed One#151.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#152.src: Yes, indeed, it would not do well for us to be injured, unintentionally or otherwise. Come on, Sui!
The Cursed One#152.dst: Sí, en efecto, no nos conviene salir heridos, sea sin querer o no. ¡Vamos, Sui!
The Cursed One#152.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#153.src: And we're sure this is safe?
The Cursed One#153.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#154.src: We have all seen {u} in action, and they appear to be unharmed, no?
The Cursed One#154.dst: Todos hemos visto a {u} en acción, y parece estar ileso, ¿no?
The Cursed One#154.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#155.src: Okay, sure, but what if someone sees? It's not like we're especially hidden here.
The Cursed One#155.dst: Vale, ya, ¿y si alguien lo ve? No es que estemos muy escondidos.
The Cursed One#155.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#156.src: You know as well as I that the only ones showing up in these parts are outcasts and drunks!
The Cursed One#156.dst: ¡Sabes tan bien como yo que por estos lares solo aparecen parias y borrachos!
The Cursed One#156.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#157.src: In any case, we can make it quick. Zeph, are you ready?
The Cursed One#157.dst: En cualquier caso, será rápido. Zeph, ¿estás listo?
The Cursed One#157.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#159.src: Close your eyes, and hold the crystal close to your chest. Concentrate on the points of contact. Your hands, your chest. Do you feel anything?
The Cursed One#159.dst: Cierra los ojos y sujeta el cristal contra el pecho. Concéntrate en los puntos de contacto. Tus manos, tu pecho. ¿Sientes algo?
The Cursed One#159.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#160.src: ...oh! I- I do! It's l- l- like... st- static electricity, li- little sparks bouncing around...
The Cursed One#160.dst: ...¡oh! ¡S- sí! Es c- c- como... e- electricidad estática, ch- chi- chispitas rebotando...
The Cursed One#160.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#161.src: Good. Now, you'll try to draw your focus inwards. Imagine the sparks being pulled towards the center of your body. Feel them gathering together.
The Cursed One#161.dst: Bien. Ahora dirige tu atención hacia dentro. Imagina que las chispas son atraídas al centro de tu cuerpo. Siente cómo se juntan.
The Cursed One#161.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#163.src: Now, finally, try releasing that energy. Concentrate on the crystal again, the points of contact. Imagine pushing the sparks back into it, and then further, sending them out through the crystal
The Cursed One#163.dst: Por último, trata de liberar esa energía. Concéntrate otra vez en el cristal, en los puntos de contacto. Imagina que empujas las chispas dentro de él y más allá, lanzándolas fuera por el cristal
The Cursed One#163.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#165.src: Hey! Are you okay? Not hurt? I don't see anything visible, but
The Cursed One#165.dst: ¡Eh! ¿Estás bien? ¿No te has hecho daño? No veo nada, pero
The Cursed One#165.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#166.src: W- would you s- st- stop, already? I'm fine!
The Cursed One#166.dst: ¿Q- quieres p- pa- parar ya? ¡Estoy bien!
The Cursed One#166.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#167.src: Ow! What- wh- what was that for?!
The Cursed One#167.dst: ¡Ay! ¡¿P- p- por qué ha sido eso?!
The Cursed One#167.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#169.src: Well done, Zeph. You've done just as well as any of the soldiers I've seen receive blessings. Just... as well...
The Cursed One#169.dst: Bien hecho, Zeph. Lo has hecho tan bien como cualquier soldado que he visto recibir una bendición. Igual... de bien...
The Cursed One#169.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#170.src: ...was it really that easy all this time?
The Cursed One#170.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#172.src: Yes... yes, I'm alright. {u}, I apologize for doubting you. It would seem... you were right all along.
The Cursed One#172.dst: Sí... sí, estoy bien. {u}, perdona por dudar de ti. Parece que... tenías razón desde el principio.
The Cursed One#172.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#173.dst: O igual Zeph ya era maldito...
The Cursed One#173.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#175.src: Sorry! Sorry. No, you're right. It was... cool, I guess. It's just... weird.
The Cursed One#175.dst: ¡Perdón! Perdón. No, tienes razón. Ha estado... bien, supongo. Es solo... raro.
The Cursed One#175.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#176.src: A- a little, I guess. But if f- f- felt right. Like- l- like I always co- could have done it. Even if it was just sp- spark- sparkles.
The Cursed One#176.dst: U- un poco, supongo. Pero s- s- se sintió bien. C- c- como si siempre hu- hubiera podido. Aunque solo fueran ch- chis- chispitas.
The Cursed One#176.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#177.src: That's part of the process. You'll need a proper focus to do more... specially-forged weapons have always done the trick, in my experience.
The Cursed One#177.dst: Eso es parte del proceso. Necesitarás un foco de verdad para más... por mi experiencia, las armas forjadas a medida siempre han servido.
The Cursed One#177.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#178.src: Specially-forged weapons, you say? Miss, is there anything in particular one would need to create one? With the right materials, I'm certain I could forge Zeph what he needs.
The Cursed One#178.dst: ¿Armas forjadas a medida, dices? Señorita, ¿hace falta algo en particular para crear una? Con los materiales adecuados, seguro que puedo forjarle a Zeph lo que necesita.
The Cursed One#178.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#179.src: A- a new weapon? That I ca- can cast ma- magic with?
The Cursed One#179.dst: ¿U- un arma nueva? ¿Con la que p- pueda usar m- magia?
The Cursed One#179.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#180.src: I could see it coming in use. We'll want more sturdy materials than usual- preferably something that is magical in and of itself... Zeph, do you think you could-
The Cursed One#180.dst: Podría resultar útil. Necesitaremos materiales más resistentes de lo normal- mejor algo que sea mágico por sí mismo... Zeph, ¿crees que podrías-
The Cursed One#180.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#181.src: Yes!!! I- I mean, uh, y- yes, I can do that.
The Cursed One#181.dst: ¡¡¡Sí!!! Q- quiero decir, eh, s- sí, puedo hacerlo.
The Cursed One#181.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#182.src: ...Okay! {u}, I kn- I- I know where to start! Me- meet me by the big tree to the n- nor- northeast! The one for the riddle!
The Cursed One#182.dst: ...¡Vale! {u}, ¡y- y- ya sé por dónde empezar! ¡N- nos vemos junto al árbol grande del n- nor- noreste! ¡El del acertijo!
The Cursed One#182.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#183.src: Head to the big tree and find Zeph at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#183.dst: Ve al árbol grande y encuentra a Zeph en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#184.src: I suppose I should get around to firing up the forge... Sui, will you need me for anything?
The Cursed One#184.dst: Supongo que debería ir encendiendo la fragua... Sui, ¿me vas a necesitar para algo?
The Cursed One#184.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#185.src: Um... n-no, I don't think so.
The Cursed One#185.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#186.src: He's taken to it remarkably well, hasn't he? Better than I could have hoped.
The Cursed One#186.dst: Se le ha dado asombrosamente bien, ¿verdad? Mejor de lo que esperaba.
The Cursed One#186.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#187.src: {u}... you have opened a path for me that I never could have imagined. Thank you.
The Cursed One#187.dst: {u}... me has abierto un camino que jamás habría imaginado. Gracias.
The Cursed One#187.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#192.src: Never in my life did I expect to have my whole world view challenged, hoh!
The Cursed One#192.dst: ¡Jamás en mi vida pensé que se pondría en duda toda mi visión del mundo, joh!
The Cursed One#192.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#193.src: Admittedly, this information will take some time to progress...
The Cursed One#193.dst: Reconozco que me llevará un tiempo digerir esta información...
The Cursed One#193.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#194.src: I'll most likely seek you out later with some follow up questions.
The Cursed One#194.dst: Lo más seguro es que te busque luego con más preguntas.
The Cursed One#194.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#195.src: ...well, Synny, don't suppose any of this changes your usual approach?
The Cursed One#195.dst: ...bueno, Synny, supongo que nada de esto cambia tu método, ¿no?
The Cursed One#195.speaker: Kaio

The Cursed One#196.src: Sigh... You know it does, Kaio. If there's a possibility more of our members could wield magic, then...
The Cursed One#196.dst: Suspiro... Sabes que sí, Kaio. Si cabe la posibilidad de que más de los nuestros usen magia, entonces...
The Cursed One#196.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#198.src: ... I don't know. I don't know if it'll work, yet.
The Cursed One#198.dst: ... No lo sé. Aún no sé si funcionará.
The Cursed One#198.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#201.src: Yes, well, I especially don't like this. Don't like the ideas you're gettin' all up there in your head. It's a risk.
The Cursed One#201.dst: Ya, bueno, pues esto me gusta menos aún. No me gustan las ideas que se te están metiendo en la cabeza. Es un riesgo.
The Cursed One#201.speaker: Kaio

The Cursed One#202.src: Everything is a risk. But it doesn't matter yet. It'll depend on what Quill has to tell me during the festival.
The Cursed One#202.dst: Todo es un riesgo. Pero aún da igual. Dependerá de lo que Quill tenga que contarme durante el festival.
The Cursed One#202.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#204.src: When I m- ma- when I make my weapon... do you think I'll be a- a- able to cast real spells? And not just... poofs of sp- s- sparkles?
The Cursed One#204.dst: Cuando h- ha- cuando haga mi arma... ¿crees que p- p- podré lanzar hechizos de verdad? ¿Y no solo... puf, ch- ch- chispitas?
The Cursed One#204.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#207.src: Sigh... I was h- h- hoping that- that- that I could do... I- I don't know! Something! A- any- anything to help. But... you're right.
The Cursed One#207.dst: Suspiro... E- e- esperaba que- que- que pudiera hacer... ¡y- yo qué sé! ¡Algo! C- cual- cualquier cosa para ayudar. Pero... tienes razón.
The Cursed One#207.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#208.src: Oh. O- okay! That means it- it m- might help me, too. Thank you.
The Cursed One#208.dst: Ah. ¡V- vale! Entonces a- a mí t- también podría ayudarme. Gracias.
The Cursed One#208.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#209.src: Oh! R- ri- right! Well, Syndra said we sh- should find something magical, right? Well, I- I don't know for- f- for sure if it's magical or not, but...
The Cursed One#209.dst: ¡Oh! ¡C- cl- claro! Syndra dijo que d- debíamos buscar algo mágico, ¿no? Bueno, n- no sé s- s- seguro si es mágico o no, pero...
The Cursed One#209.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#210.src: A long, long time ago, th- this- this tree was more than just a stump! It had long arms st- str- stretching out over the whole forest, watching over th- the people and w- wi- wildlife.
The Cursed One#210.dst: ¡Hace mucho, mucho tiempo, e- es- este árbol era más que un tocón! Tenía brazos largos que se e- ex- extendían sobre todo el bosque, velando por l- la gente y los a- an- animales.
The Cursed One#210.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#211.src: When anyone was hurt, o- or- or unwell, the tree would reach out with its br- branches and grow fruit- fruit that was said to he- h- heal all injuries and illnesses.
The Cursed One#211.dst: Cuando alguien se hería, o- o- o enfermaba, el árbol tendía sus r- ramas y daba un fruto- un fruto que, según dicen, c- c- curaba toda herida y enfermedad.
The Cursed One#211.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#212.src: It took care of the people, and the p- people took care of the tree. But then- then the c- cur- curse took hold of the people.
The Cursed One#212.dst: Cuidaba de la gente, y la g- gente cuidaba del árbol. Pero entonces- entonces la m- mal- maldición se apoderó de la gente.
The Cursed One#212.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#213.src: In the chaos and d- des- destruction caused by the cursed ones, the tree was hurt. It stopped gr- grow- growing its gifts, and went to sleep... f- forever.
The Cursed One#213.dst: En el caos y la d- des- destrucción que causaron los malditos, el árbol quedó herido. Dejó de d- d- dar sus regalos y se durmió... p- para siempre.
The Cursed One#213.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#214.src: Even after the Queen arrived a- and blessed the people, the tree di- didn't- didn't wake up. Its trust had been broken...
The Cursed One#214.dst: Aunque llegó la Reina y- y bendijo a la gente, el árbol no se d- des- despertó. Su confianza se había roto...
The Cursed One#214.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#215.src: Ev- even though it's just a story... I hope s- some- someday the tree can trust us again. We could- c- could- we could really use its help, these days...
The Cursed One#215.dst: A- aunque solo sea un cuento... espero que a- al- algún día el árbol vuelva a confiar en nosotros. N- nos- nos vendría muy bien su ayuda, hoy en día...
The Cursed One#215.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#216.src: ... A- a- anyway! The cavern you met Syndra in is also said to be s- sa- sacred. And the feel of the crystals reminds me of h- how I feel there.
The Cursed One#216.dst: ... ¡E- e- en fin! De la cueva donde conociste a Syndra también dicen que es s- sa- sagrada. Y los cristales me recuerdan a l- lo que siento allí.
The Cursed One#216.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#217.src: So- s- so if we can find our way into the tree... we co- could find some m- ma- s- some magical wood. Follow me!
The Cursed One#217.dst: A- a- así que si logramos entrar en el árbol... p- podríamos encontrar m- ma- m- madera mágica. ¡Sígueme!
The Cursed One#217.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#218.src: Head to the top of the giant tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#218.dst: Sube a la copa del árbol gigante en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#219.src: Hey! F- faster than last time! Keep up the im- im- improvement, and maybe soon I'll have to put in mo- more than {~}!
The Cursed One#219.dst: ¡Eh! ¡M- más rápido que la última vez! ¡Sigue m- me- mejorando y quizá pronto tenga que darte m- más de {~}!
The Cursed One#219.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#220.src: Ha... yeah... Um, earlier you m- me- mentioned that magic can be found in- in everything.
The Cursed One#220.dst: Ja... ya... Eh, antes m- me- mencionaste que la magia está e- en todo.
The Cursed One#220.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#221.src: So... so ma- maybe we didn't need to come to- to- to this old tree... But- b- but it feels right to me.
The Cursed One#221.dst: Así que... q- quizá no hacía falta venir a- a- a este viejo árbol... P- p- pero a mí me parece lo correcto.
The Cursed One#221.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#222.src: ... Thank you for c- c- coming along.
The Cursed One#222.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#223.src: It's a breath of fresh air, having someone n- n- new around! I don't know, having you around just f- fe- feels... good! Like- like anything is possible!
The Cursed One#223.dst: ¡Es un soplo de aire fresco tener a alguien n- n- nuevo cerca! No sé, tenerte aquí s- se- se siente... ¡bien! ¡C- como si todo fuera posible!
The Cursed One#223.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#224.src: ... Oh, I- I- I'm getting too sappy. Sorry, sorry!
The Cursed One#224.dst: ... Ay, m- m- me estoy poniendo muy cursi. ¡Perdón, perdón!
The Cursed One#224.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#225.src: Well... my h- h- my heart is telling me that this wood is what I w- w- what I want!
The Cursed One#225.dst: Bueno... ¡m- m- mi corazón me dice que esta madera es lo que q- q- lo que quiero!
The Cursed One#225.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#226.src: That old tale... it's one of the o- o- only things I still remember from my childhood.
The Cursed One#226.dst: Ese viejo cuento... es de las p- p- pocas cosas que aún recuerdo de mi infancia.
The Cursed One#226.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#227.src: So, s- so this is definitely what I want my w- we- weapon to be made out of.
The Cursed One#227.dst: A- así que mi a- ar- arma va a ser de esto, seguro.
The Cursed One#227.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#228.src: Oh... y- y- yeah. Maybe you're right...
The Cursed One#228.dst: Ah... y- y- ya. Quizá tengas razón...
The Cursed One#228.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#229.src: I just thought... choosing s- some- something special to me would- would be b- best.
The Cursed One#229.dst: Solo pensé... que elegir a- al- algo especial para mí s- sería lo m- mejor.
The Cursed One#229.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#230.src: B- but we're here now any- a- anyway, aren't we? So we can just use the- the- the wood here...
The Cursed One#230.dst: P- pero ya estamos aquí de t- t- todos modos, ¿no? Así que podemos usar l- l- la madera de aquí...
The Cursed One#230.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#231.src: So, we've gotta find a way into the tr- the tree...
The Cursed One#231.dst: Bueno, hay que encontrar la forma de entrar en el á- el árbol...
The Cursed One#231.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#232.src: Ha, I- I'm not exactly a wood- woodcutting expert... maybe it'd have been smart to ask Mora t- to- to join us?
The Cursed One#232.dst: Ja, n- no soy un experto en tal- talar árboles... ¿quizá habría sido listo pedirle a Mora que v- vi- viniera?
The Cursed One#232.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#233.src: ... Do- do you have any ideas? May- maybe you could break through with a sp- spe- spell?
The Cursed One#233.dst: ... ¿S- se te ocurre algo? ¿Q- qui- quizá podrías abrirlo con un h- he- hechizo?
The Cursed One#233.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#234.src: Cast a spell ontop of the tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#234.dst: Lanza un hechizo en lo alto del árbol en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#235.src: Maybe you could break through with a sp- spe- spell?
The Cursed One#235.dst: ¿Q- qui- quizá podrías abrirlo con un h- he- hechizo?
The Cursed One#235.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#237.src: ... Do- do you think the t- tr- the tree heard me earlier? Is it...
The Cursed One#237.dst: ... ¿C- crees que el á- ár- el árbol me oyó antes? ¿Será que...
The Cursed One#237.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#238.src: This- th- this has to be a sign! Come on, let's go in!
The Cursed One#238.dst: ¡E- e- esto tiene que ser una señal! ¡Vamos, entremos!
The Cursed One#238.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#239.src: Find the wood Zeph wants at the end of the root system.
The Cursed One#239.dst: Encuentra la madera que Zeph quiere al final de las raíces.

The Cursed One#240.src: Th- th- there! That should- sh- should be a big enough chunk for Mora... right?
The Cursed One#240.dst: ¡A- a- ahí! Ese trozo d- de- debería bastarle a Mora... ¿no?
The Cursed One#240.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#241.src: A- and- you're still not fast enough to beat me to th- th- to the end!
The Cursed One#241.dst: Y- y- ¡sigues sin ser tan rápido como para llegar al f- f- final antes que yo!
The Cursed One#241.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#242.src: Okay, next... We- weapons are usually made of m- me- metal, right? That's why Mora has a f- fo- a forge.
The Cursed One#242.dst: Vale, ahora... L- las armas suelen ser de m- me- metal, ¿no? Por eso Mora tiene una f- fr- una fragua.
The Cursed One#242.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#243.src: ...I have a- an- an idea! Let's meet up near {p}, wh- where we first met.
The Cursed One#243.dst: ...¡T- te- tengo una idea! Veámonos cerca de {p}, d- donde nos conocimos.
The Cursed One#243.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#245.src: O- okay, so. The crown usually uses t- ti- titanium for their equipment. Th- that's what Mora says, at least.
The Cursed One#245.dst: V- vale, mira. La Corona suele usar t- ti- titanio para su equipo. E- eso dice Mora, al menos.
The Cursed One#245.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#246.src: But- b- but, it can be hard to come by, b- be- because the crown keeps most of it for themselves.
The Cursed One#246.dst: P- p- pero cuesta conseguirlo, p- por- porque la Corona se queda casi todo.
The Cursed One#246.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#247.src: Luckily, it's F- F- Festival time, so a bunch of m- merchants are in town! And they're fr- from all over the p- pr- province, not just here!
The Cursed One#247.dst: Por suerte es época de F- F- Festival, ¡así que hay un montón de m- mercaderes en la ciudad! ¡Y vienen d- de toda la p- pro- provincia, no solo de aquí!
The Cursed One#247.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#248.src: So someone m- must have titanium, somewhere... we'll j- just- just have to look around.
The Cursed One#248.dst: Así que alguien t- tiene que tener titanio, en algún sitio... s- so- solo hay que buscar.
The Cursed One#248.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#249.src: Ah! Th- that- that's the Sovereign!
The Cursed One#249.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#250.src: ...and alongside that, does she really think it's safe to hold the festival right now, sir? That opens up a really big risk!
The Cursed One#250.dst: ...y aparte de eso, ¿de verdad cree ella que es seguro celebrar el festival ahora, señor? ¡Eso abre un riesgo enorme!
The Cursed One#250.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#251.src: What do you th- th- think they're t- talking about? Come on, let- l- let's shadow them.
The Cursed One#251.dst: ¿De qué c- c- crees que e- están hablando? Venga, v- v- vamos a seguirlos.
The Cursed One#251.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#252.src: If the cursed thinks they can get past both myself and Her Majesty, they're out of their vector. You don't need to worry about the people.
The Cursed One#252.dst: Si el maldito cree que puede pasar por encima de mí y de Su Majestad, se le ha ido el vector. No tienes que preocuparte por el pueblo.
The Cursed One#252.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#253.src: I was more worried about... ...um... W-well, never mind that! If you think we'll all be safe, sir, I'll take you at your word!
The Cursed One#253.dst: A mí me preocupaba más... ...eh... ¡B-bueno, da igual! Si usted cree que estaremos a salvo, señor, ¡le tomo la palabra!
The Cursed One#253.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#254.src: Let me rephrase- you don't need to worry about anyone. ...heh. Any- wait. What's that noise?
The Cursed One#254.dst: Reformulo- no tienes que preocuparte por nadie. ...je. Por na- espera. ¿Qué es ese ruido?
The Cursed One#254.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#255.src: Just someone out on a random walk? Back to the point is everything for the festival shaping up according to schedule?
The Cursed One#255.dst: ¿Alguien dando un paseo aleatorio? Volviendo al tema: ¿todo lo del festival va según lo previsto?
The Cursed One#255.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#256.src: Oh yes! Yes it is, sir! The vendors have all been assigned, the game stands have all been constructed, we've commissioned a local band... The one you liked last year!
The Cursed One#256.dst: ¡Ah, sí! ¡Así es, señor! Los puestos están todos asignados, las casetas de juegos ya están montadas, hemos contratado a una banda local... ¡La que le gustó el año pasado!
The Cursed One#256.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#257.src: Golden. That rendition of "CHASE" is what really sold me on them.
The Cursed One#257.dst: Áureo. Su versión de "CHASE" fue lo que me convenció.
The Cursed One#257.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#258.src: That just leaves your speech, sir! Have you Oh, who am I kidding, you already have it memorized.
The Cursed One#258.dst: ¡Solo queda su discurso, señor! ¿Ya lo Ah, a quién quiero engañar, si ya se lo sabe de memoria.
The Cursed One#258.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#259.src: Naturally, Xao. We have the whole festival set down to the last point, it looks like. Any more business to factor out?
The Cursed One#259.dst: Naturalmente, Xao. Parece que tenemos el festival definido hasta el último punto. ¿Algún otro asunto que factorizar?
The Cursed One#259.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#260.src: Yes, sir! I've received word that Inquisitor Renn will be arriving tonight, as you sent me to request for!
The Cursed One#260.dst: ¡Sí, señor! ¡Me han comunicado que el Inquisidor Renn llegará esta noche, tal como me mandó solicitar!
The Cursed One#260.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#261.src: Fantastic job. I have to remember that the Inquisitors aren't like me. When they're busy they can't just go triple-time... Still, good to have that problem solved.
The Cursed One#261.dst: Trabajo excelente. Debo recordar que los Inquisidores no son como yo. Cuando están ocupados no pueden ir al triple de velocidad... Aun así, me alegra tener ese problema resuelto.
The Cursed One#261.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#262.src: You know, they should check your work. This is proof positive they can keep pace with me like you can.
The Cursed One#262.dst: ¿Sabes? Deberían revisar tu trabajo. Es prueba fehaciente de que pueden seguirme el ritmo como tú.
The Cursed One#262.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#263.src: Well! Sir! You know I've had to insist you stop and rest sometimes, and Inquisitors do serve the whole of the province, so...
The Cursed One#263.dst: ¡Bueno! ¡Señor! Ya sabe que a veces he tenido que insistirle en que pare y descanse, y los Inquisidores sirven a toda la provincia, así que...
The Cursed One#263.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#264.src: Hmm... ev- even with us r- r- raiding Nixeph, he isn't concerned...
The Cursed One#264.dst: Hmm... n- ni con nuestro a- a- asalto a Nixeph se preocupa...
The Cursed One#264.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#265.src: A- and- an Inquisitor! Th- that- that's not good. We need to tell the others to be c- ca- careful...
The Cursed One#265.dst: Y- y- ¡un Inquisidor! E- e- eso no es bueno. Hay que decirles a los demás que tengan c- cu- cuidado...
The Cursed One#265.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#266.src: Oh! R- r- right! You're not from here. They're, uh, b- b- bad news. They're sent to d- d- deal with... um, c- cursed ones, and other s- si- similar stuff.
The Cursed One#266.dst: ¡Oh! ¡C- c- claro! Tú no eres de aquí. Son, eh, m- m- mala noticia. Los mandan a o- o- ocuparse de... eh, m- malditos y otras c- co- cosas parecidas.
The Cursed One#266.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#267.src: If one's a- around... we have to b- be careful. But, since w- we- since we're here, we should still find the t- ti- titanium.
The Cursed One#267.dst: Si hay uno c- cerca... hay que tener c- cuidado. Pero, ya que e- es- ya que estamos aquí, deberíamos buscar el t- ti- titanio igual.
The Cursed One#267.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#268.src: There's a b- b- bazaar in the tunnel... if anyone wi- will have it, they'll be there.
The Cursed One#268.dst: Hay un b- b- bazar en el túnel... si alguien lo t- tiene, estará allí.
The Cursed One#268.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#269.dst: Encuentra al mercader de metales en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#270.src: Fine quality metals, fine quality metals for- Ah, hello, hello! Might you be interested in my stock, friends?
The Cursed One#270.dst: Metales de primera, metales de primera para- ¡Ah, hola, hola! ¿Os interesa mi género, amigos?
The Cursed One#270.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#271.src: I've got all sorts for sale. Ingots, pre-made bangles and bracelets and trinkets I've got hold of this lovely iron leaf, in fact. Quite fine decor, I might think!
The Cursed One#271.dst: Vendo de todo. Lingotes, aros y pulseras ya hechos, baratijas de hecho, me hice con esta preciosa hoja de hierro. ¡Un adorno bien fino, diría yo!
The Cursed One#271.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#272.src: Hello! We're a- ac- actually looking for titanium! Would you h- ha- happen to have any in stock?
The Cursed One#272.dst: ¡Hola! ¡En r- re- realidad buscamos titanio! ¿T- te- tendría por casualidad?
The Cursed One#272.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#273.src: Aha, you're in luck then! I've managed to obtain some from a passing {p} merchant! Straight from the {p} and so I'm told, quite good quality!
The Cursed One#273.dst: ¡Ajá, entonces estáis de suerte! ¡Conseguí algo de un mercader de {p} que pasaba por aquí! Directo de {p} y, según me dicen, ¡de muy buena calidad!
The Cursed One#273.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#274.src: I think the man was struck dumb by the offer of leaves I handed in return, he left with such a bewildered face- but I digress! Would you like ingots, or anything pre-hewn?
The Cursed One#274.dst: Creo que al hombre se le fue el habla con las hojas que le ofrecí a cambio, se marchó con una cara de desconcierto- ¡pero divago! ¿Queréis lingotes o algo ya labrado?
The Cursed One#274.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#275.src: Uh... just- j- just some ingots would be fine.
The Cursed One#275.dst: Eh... con- c- con unos lingotes nos vale.
The Cursed One#275.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#276.src: Indeed, then! It is always fine to see those interested in the crafting trades. For this, I might say ten Liff Leaves would be an agreeable price, yes?
The Cursed One#276.dst: ¡Pues hecho! Siempre gusta ver a quien se interesa por los oficios artesanos. Por esto, diría que diez hojas de Liff es un precio razonable, ¿sí?
The Cursed One#276.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#277.src: Ten!? Oh, f- fine... you said it's h- high- high quality? It's pr- probably worth the price. Here.
The Cursed One#277.dst: ¡¿Diez?! Ay, v- vale... ¿decía que es de a- al- alta calidad? P- probablemente valga el precio. Tome.
The Cursed One#277.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#278.src: Indeed, friend, so I have been assured! May you have fine fortune in your endeavors!
The Cursed One#278.dst: ¡Así es, amigo, eso me aseguraron! ¡Que la fortuna acompañe vuestros empeños!
The Cursed One#278.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#280.src: Hm... I d- don't- I don't think titanium is meant to have th- these purple streaks...
The Cursed One#280.dst: Hm... n- no- no creo que el titanio deba tener e- estas vetas moradas...
The Cursed One#280.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#281.src: But I- I- I'm not the blacksmith, so... a- a- and it's not like anyone else is s- se- selling titanium, so.
The Cursed One#281.dst: Pero y- y- yo no soy el herrero, así que... y- y- y tampoco es que nadie más v- ve- venda titanio, así que.
The Cursed One#281.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#282.src: Huh? Oh, r- r- right, I keep forgetting you don't know e- ev- everything around here.
The Cursed One#282.dst: ¿Eh? Ah, c- c- claro, se me olvida que no lo sabes t- to- todo de por aquí.
The Cursed One#282.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#283.src: The Auburn F- Fo- Forest may be a poorer area, so we d- do- don't have many emeralds...
The Cursed One#283.dst: El b- bo- bosque de Auburn será una zona pobre, así que n- no- no tenemos muchas esmeraldas...
The Cursed One#283.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#284.src: But we make up for it by u- u- using all the varied m- materials from the forest! People here v- val- value things from the wild more than e- em- emeralds.
The Cursed One#284.dst: ¡Pero lo compensamos u- u- usando todos los m- materiales del bosque! Aquí la gente v- va- valora lo del monte más que las e- es- esmeraldas.
The Cursed One#284.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#285.src: Liff Leaves especially are in high d- d- demand due to their versatility.
The Cursed One#285.dst: Las hojas de Liff tienen mucha d- d- demanda por su versatilidad.
The Cursed One#285.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#286.src: You don't need a- an- anything else? Then I'm r- ready to go.
The Cursed One#286.dst: ¿No necesitas n- na- nada más? Entonces y- ya puedo irme.
The Cursed One#286.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#287.src: Want to tr- travel back with me?
The Cursed One#287.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#289.src: Okay! I'll m- m- meet you later, then.
The Cursed One#289.dst: ¡Vale! Pues n- n- nos vemos luego.
The Cursed One#289.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#290.src: Return to the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#290.dst: Vuelve al campamento de la resistencia en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#292.src: Ah! Good, you're just in time.
The Cursed One#292.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#293.src: Uh... in time for wh- what? A- and- and where is everybody?
The Cursed One#293.dst: Eh... ¿a tiempo p- para qué? Y- y- ¿y dónde está todo el mundo?
The Cursed One#293.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#294.src: Have you forgotten? The Festival of the Queen is about to start!
The Cursed One#294.dst: ¿Te has olvidado? ¡El Festival de la Reina está a punto de empezar!
The Cursed One#294.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#295.src: Wh- th- that was today?! Oh, man, I g- g- got so excited about the m- m- the ma- magic... I forgot!
The Cursed One#295.dst: ¡¿Q- e- era hoy?! Ay, m- m- me emocioné tanto con l- l- la m- magia... ¡se me olvidó!
The Cursed One#295.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#296.src: Wait... w- wait, before I go Syndra, we o- ov- overheard something in town. The S- S- Sovereign said an In- Inquisitor would be arriving t- t- tonight!
The Cursed One#296.dst: Espera... e- espera, antes de irme Syndra, o- oí- oímos algo en la ciudad. ¡El S- S- Soberano dijo que un In- Inquisidor llegaría e- e- esta noche!
The Cursed One#296.speaker: Zeph
