The Cursed One#297.src: ...ah. Well, that pushes ahead our timeline significantly...
The Cursed One#297.dst: ...ah. Bueno, eso adelanta bastante nuestros plazos...
The Cursed One#297.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#298.src: Hopefully, they're just here to clear out that cave you found the crystals in, but... better to be safe than sorry.
The Cursed One#298.dst: Ojalá solo vengan a despejar esa cueva donde encontrasteis los cristales, pero... más vale prevenir que curar.
The Cursed One#298.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#299.src: That can wait until after the festival, though. You should go on ahead an enjoy yourself.
The Cursed One#299.dst: Aun así, eso puede esperar al final del festival. Adelántate y pásatelo bien.
The Cursed One#299.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#300.src: ...if you s- s- say so, Syndra. {u}, you should c- come to the festival too! See you there!
The Cursed One#300.dst: ...si tú lo d- d- dices, Syndra. {u}, ¡tú también deberías v- venir al festival! ¡Nos vemos allí!
The Cursed One#300.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#301.src: Ah... there he goes. Well, what do you say? Will you join us for the festival?
The Cursed One#301.dst: Ah... ahí va. Bueno, ¿qué dices? ¿Nos acompañas al festival?
The Cursed One#301.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#302.src: It is a celebration of the crown... but you have a limited time here, and it is still a part of our culture. You wouldn't want to miss it.
The Cursed One#302.dst: Es una celebración de la Corona... pero tu tiempo aquí es limitado, y no deja de ser parte de nuestra cultura. No querrás perdértelo.
The Cursed One#302.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#303.src: It's a day for everyone to relax and enjoy themselves. The children certainly do... it's good for them, I think, to have some normalcy.
The Cursed One#303.dst: Es un día para que todos se relajen y disfruten. Los críos desde luego lo hacen... creo que les viene bien un poco de normalidad.
The Cursed One#303.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#304.src: I'll finish packing some things here, then I'll head on over. You should meet me there. If you head south, the river will lead you right to it.
The Cursed One#304.dst: Termino de recoger unas cosas aquí y voy para allá. Reúnete conmigo allí. Si vas al sur, el río te llevará justo hasta él.
The Cursed One#304.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#305.src: Join Syndra at the festival at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#305.dst: Reúnete con Syndra en el festival en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#306.src: I'll head on over soon. I just need to take care of some things before I leave.
The Cursed One#306.dst: Iré enseguida. Solo tengo que resolver unas cosas antes de salir.
The Cursed One#306.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#307.src: You're here! Allow me to welcome you to the annual Festival of the Crown.
The Cursed One#307.dst: ¡Ya estás aquí! Bienvenido al Festival de la Corona anual.
The Cursed One#307.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#308.src: I have some business to attend to, so Zeph, would you be able to show {u} around?
The Cursed One#308.dst: Tengo unos asuntos que atender, así que Zeph, ¿podrías enseñarle esto a {u}?
The Cursed One#308.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#310.src: So there's some g- games over there... and right here is the f- foo- food and beverages s- s- stand!
The Cursed One#310.dst: Ahí hay unos j- juegos... ¡y justo aquí está el p- pu- puesto de c- c- comida y bebida!
The Cursed One#310.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#311.src: They sell re- r- regional food and drinks. And, a- ac- according to Rex... they've even im- im- imported some fancy alcohol from the h- high- highlands!
The Cursed One#311.dst: Venden comida y bebida de la r- r- región. Y, s- se- según Rex... ¡hasta han i- im- importado alcohol fino de las T- Tie- Tierras Altas!
The Cursed One#311.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#312.src: Here are some at- attractions, and an animal exhibit! I, uh, d- d- don't- I don't like the Mudkins game very much...
The Cursed One#312.dst: Aquí hay a- atracciones, ¡y una muestra de animales! A mí, eh, n- n- no me gusta mucho el juego de los Mudkin...
The Cursed One#312.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#313.src: I th- think I saw Sui back there, so... I'm gonna go h- ha- hang out with her. You sh- should check out some of the stalls!
The Cursed One#313.dst: C- creo que he visto a Sui por allí, así que... voy a e- es- estar un rato con ella. ¡T- tú deberías mirar los puestos!
The Cursed One#313.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#315.src: ...thank you, Jiro. It's always good to hear from
The Cursed One#315.dst: ...gracias, Jiro. Siempre viene bien tener noticias de
The Cursed One#315.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#317.src: Hm? Oh, that's just {u} they're who I was hoping to write to Quill about. {u}, this is Jiro, my contact from the Roughworks.
The Cursed One#317.dst: ¿Hm? Ah, es solo {u}, justo de quien quería escribirle a Quill. {u}, este es Jiro, mi contacto en Roughworks.
The Cursed One#317.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#318.src: Ah. Well, it's good to meet you then.
The Cursed One#318.speaker: Jiro

The Cursed One#319.src: Quill is... an old friend. It can be hard for us to stay in contact... discretely... so we often send messages this way.
The Cursed One#319.dst: Quill es... un viejo amigo. Nos cuesta mantener el contacto... con discreción... así que solemos mandarnos mensajes así.
The Cursed One#319.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#320.src: Wasn't going to use my yearly rail pass for anything anyway, so might as well.
The Cursed One#320.dst: Total, no iba a usar mi abono anual de tren para nada, así que por qué no.
The Cursed One#320.speaker: Jiro

The Cursed One#321.src: Well, it's more than I'm able to do, so I appreciate it. In any case, Quill runs his own... organization, shall we say.
The Cursed One#321.dst: Bueno, es más de lo que puedo hacer yo, así que te lo agradezco. En fin, Quill dirige su propia... organización, digamos.
The Cursed One#321.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#323.src: The Roughworks is the region directly to the south of here, just past the wall. Officially, it's known as the {p}.
The Cursed One#323.dst: Roughworks es la región justo al sur de aquí, pasada la muralla. Oficialmente se la conoce como {p}.
The Cursed One#323.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#324.src: I can fill you in on it later. This isn't the place for it.
The Cursed One#324.dst: Ya te pondré al día más tarde. Este no es el sitio.
The Cursed One#324.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#325.src: ...ahem. Should we get back to it then?
The Cursed One#325.speaker: Jiro

The Cursed One#326.src: We should. {u}, take a look around the stalls and come back later.
The Cursed One#326.dst: Sí. {u}, echa un vistazo a los puestos y vuelve luego.
The Cursed One#326.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#327.src: {u}, take a look around the stalls and come back later.
The Cursed One#327.dst: {u}, echa un vistazo a los puestos y vuelve luego.
The Cursed One#327.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#329.src: You're here visiting too I see!
The Cursed One#329.dst: ¡Veo que tú también estás de visita!
The Cursed One#329.speaker: Highlands Tourist

The Cursed One#330.src: I plan on touring the whole festival this year around. Next up for me is the {p}!
The Cursed One#330.dst: Este año pienso recorrer todos los festivales. ¡Mi próxima parada es {p}!
The Cursed One#330.speaker: Highlands Tourist

The Cursed One#331.src: But the Auburn festival is known for the best food and beverages around the province. Trust me! Those rumours are true.
The Cursed One#331.dst: Pero el festival de Auburn es famoso por la mejor comida y bebida de la provincia. ¡Créeme! Esos rumores son ciertos.
The Cursed One#331.speaker: Highlands Tourist

The Cursed One#332.src: Will that be enough boar meat, ma'am?
The Cursed One#332.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#333.src: Yes, dear. Thank you for always being so kind-hearted, helping us out each and every year.
The Cursed One#333.dst: Sí, cielo. Gracias por ser siempre tan buena y echarnos una mano todos los años.
The Cursed One#333.speaker: Food Merchant

The Cursed One#334.src: No worries, Oya! Hope you sell... oh. It's you.
The Cursed One#334.dst: ¡De nada, Oya! Espero que vendas... ah. Eres tú.
The Cursed One#334.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#337.src: Huh? I'm just here with a delivery. Nothing much.
The Cursed One#337.dst: ¿Eh? Solo he venido a traer un pedido. Nada más.
The Cursed One#337.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#339.src: Just cause you've got everyone else wrapped around your finger, doesn't mean I have to be fine with you!
The Cursed One#339.dst: ¡Que tengas a todos los demás comiendo de tu mano no significa que yo tenga que tragarte!
The Cursed One#339.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#340.src: Everything was fine until you showed up. I- I- I'd gotten over it! I made a home here, and now- and now, you
The Cursed One#340.dst: Todo iba bien hasta que apareciste. ¡Y- y- ya lo había superado! Me hice un hogar aquí, y ahora- y ahora, tú
The Cursed One#340.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#341.src: And- and sure, I'm happy for Zeph, but your- your- your everything, it's got Syndra plotting, and- and we were safe, and you've ruined that.
The Cursed One#341.dst: Y- y vale, me alegro por Zeph, pero tú- tú- todo lo tuyo tiene a Syndra tramando cosas, y- y estábamos a salvo, y tú lo has arruinado.
The Cursed One#341.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#342.src: So... so, no, I don't have to be okay with you. I don't trust you, I don't trust where you're from, and I definitely don't trust your... your c
The Cursed One#342.dst: Así que... así que no, no tengo por qué tragarte. No me fío de ti, no me fío de dónde vienes, y desde luego no me fío de tu... tu mal
The Cursed One#342.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#345.src: Have you seen an- any- anyone else yet?
The Cursed One#345.dst: ¿Has visto ya a a- al- alguien más?
The Cursed One#345.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#346.src: I was, um, looking for Mora... earlier. I, ah, didn't find him.
The Cursed One#346.dst: Estaba, eh, buscando a Mora... antes. No, ah, no lo encontré.
The Cursed One#346.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#347.src: We, uh, s- saw Rex run past just a bit ago. Did s- so- something happen?
The Cursed One#347.dst: Hace nada, eh, v- vimos pasar a Rex corriendo. ¿P- pa- pasó algo?
The Cursed One#347.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#348.src: I can... um, take a guess.
The Cursed One#348.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#349.src: An- anyway, how are you liking the f- fes- festival?
The Cursed One#349.dst: E- en fin, ¿qué te está pareciendo el f- fes- festival?
The Cursed One#349.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#350.src: Hey, th- that's good to hear!
The Cursed One#350.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#351.src: Have you, um, had the chance to, to taste any of the food? From the... food stall?
The Cursed One#351.dst: ¿Has, eh, has tenido ocasión de, de probar la comida? Del... ¿del puesto de comida?
The Cursed One#351.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#352.src: Hahaha, as if th- th- there's any left after y- you- you ate so much!
The Cursed One#352.dst: Jajaja, ¡como si q- q- quedara algo después de lo que c- co- comiste!
The Cursed One#352.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#353.src: Okay... well, I, I was hungry! That's... not my fault.
The Cursed One#353.dst: Vale... bueno, ¡es que, es que tenía hambre! Eso... no es culpa mía.
The Cursed One#353.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#354.src: Oh... finally, someone else who, um, who gets it.
The Cursed One#354.dst: Ah... por fin, alguien más que, eh, que lo entiende.
The Cursed One#354.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#355.src: Wh- wh- what?! Sui, you don't like the f- fes- festival?
The Cursed One#355.dst: ¡¿Q- q- qué?! Sui, ¿no te gusta el f- fes- festival?
The Cursed One#355.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#356.src: I- I didn't, say that. It's just... a little boring. There's, um, not much to do.
The Cursed One#356.dst: N- no he, dicho eso. Es solo que... es un poco aburrido. No hay, eh, mucho que hacer.
The Cursed One#356.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#357.src: There's good f- food, fun rides a- and- and games... okay, m- maybe except the Mudkin g- game...
The Cursed One#357.dst: Hay buena c- comida, atracciones divertidas y- y- y juegos... vale, q- quizá menos el j- juego de los Mudkin...
The Cursed One#357.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#358.src: Why don't you, um, like the Mudkins? I... I think they're fun.
The Cursed One#358.dst: ¿Por qué no te, eh, gustan los Mudkin? A mí... a mí me parecen divertidos.
The Cursed One#358.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#359.src: They're s- s- so- there's no strategy! You j- just pick a random one, and- a- and sometimes you win!
The Cursed One#359.dst: ¡Son t- t- tan- no hay ninguna estrategia! S- solo eliges uno al azar, ¡y- y- y a veces ganas!
The Cursed One#359.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#361.src: Unbelievable. {u}, a- a- are you hearing this?
The Cursed One#361.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#362.src: Okay, wh- whatever... Sui, let's go t- try out the zipline. I wonder if th- th- they changed it this year.
The Cursed One#362.dst: Vale, d- da igual... Sui, vamos a p- probar la tirolina. No sé si l- l- la habrán cambiado este año.
The Cursed One#362.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#363.src: ...could we, um, get food first? I'm hungry.
The Cursed One#363.dst: ...¿podemos, eh, comer algo primero? Tengo hambre.
The Cursed One#363.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#364.src: A- ag- again?! No, we should do the z- z- zipline first. I don't want you th- thr- throwing up all over me.
The Cursed One#364.dst: ¡¿O- o- otra vez?! No, primero la t- t- tirolina. No quiero que me v- vo- vomites encima.
The Cursed One#364.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#366.src: You kn- know I'm right! Oh, uh, {u}, you can j- j- join us if you want! It's fun, I pr- promise.
The Cursed One#366.dst: ¡S- sabes que tengo razón! Ah, {u}, ¡p- p- puedes venir si quieres! Es divertido, te lo pr- prometo.
The Cursed One#366.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#368.src: The {p} orchestra is definitely the best in all of Fruma! Well, not that I've heard any other orchestras.
The Cursed One#368.dst: ¡La orquesta de {p} es sin duda la mejor de toda Fruma! Bueno, tampoco es que haya oído otras orquestas.
The Cursed One#368.speaker: Festival Goer

The Cursed One#369.src: Aha! Hello there, {u}! Enjoying our festival, are you?
The Cursed One#369.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#370.src: I trust you and Zeph have acquired all the necessary materials in the time since we last spoke?
The Cursed One#370.dst: ¿Zeph y tú habéis conseguido ya todos los materiales necesarios desde la última vez?
The Cursed One#370.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#371.src: As soon as the festival concludes, I shall get right to smithing. I have a good feeling about this one!
The Cursed One#371.dst: En cuanto acabe el festival, me pondré a forjar de inmediato. ¡Tengo un buen presentimiento con esta!
The Cursed One#371.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#372.src: I, ah... am still learning. But I have greatly improved since I started, worry not!
The Cursed One#372.dst: Yo, ah... aún estoy aprendiendo. Pero he mejorado muchísimo desde que empecé, ¡descuida!
The Cursed One#372.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#373.src: ...ehm. I suppose I should return to my report...
The Cursed One#373.dst: ...ejem. Supongo que debería volver a mi informe...
The Cursed One#373.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#374.src: Hm? Ah, yes, I forget this is your first year. First week, even.
The Cursed One#374.dst: ¿Hm? Ah, sí, olvido que es tu primer año. Tu primera semana, incluso.
The Cursed One#374.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#375.src: I am... gathering data. Recording the changes since last year's festival guard positioning and numbers, types of stands, amount of attendees and so on.
The Cursed One#375.dst: Estoy... reuniendo datos. Anoto los cambios desde el festival del año pasado: posición y número de guardias, tipos de puestos, cantidad de asistentes y demás.
The Cursed One#375.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#376.src: It is... perhaps unnecessarily thorough. Much of this data has not proven to be useful thus far... but it is something for me to do, and I do it well.
The Cursed One#376.dst: Es... quizá innecesariamente minucioso. Gran parte de estos datos no ha servido de nada hasta ahora... pero es algo que puedo hacer, y lo hago bien.
The Cursed One#376.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#377.src: These festivals... I suppose our discomfort is something Syndra and I share. It can be hard for us to enjoy ourselves, knowing what we do.
The Cursed One#377.dst: Estos festivales... supongo que esa incomodidad la compartimos Syndra y yo. Nos cuesta disfrutar, sabiendo lo que sabemos.
The Cursed One#377.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#378.src: I am grateful that the younger Leaves can still find joy here. Perhaps you might as well, given your... relative lack of history.
The Cursed One#378.dst: Agradezco que las Hojas más jóvenes aún encuentren alegría aquí. Quizá tú también puedas, dada tu... relativa falta de historia.
The Cursed One#378.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#379.src: Ah, but I am rambling. If you will excuse me, I need to get back to... counting all the new food items... hm.
The Cursed One#379.dst: Ah, pero divago. Si me disculpas, debo volver a... contar todos los platos nuevos... hm.
The Cursed One#379.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#380.src: Welcome. Can I interest you in buying anything?
The Cursed One#380.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#381.src: Perhaps you would like to hear what we have to offer?
The Cursed One#381.dst: ¿Quizá le gustaría oír lo que ofrecemos?
The Cursed One#381.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#383.src: We are selling both the raw ingredients and some freshly brewed tea.
The Cursed One#383.dst: Vendemos tanto los ingredientes en crudo como té recién hecho.
The Cursed One#383.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#384.src: Let me bring you on a history lesson to learn about the finest ingredients the forest has to offer.
The Cursed One#384.dst: Permítame darle una lección de historia sobre los mejores ingredientes que ofrece el bosque.
The Cursed One#384.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#385.src: Tea is very popular in Auburn and the people have managed to make tea out of almost any plant you can find! Some are... more tasty than others.
The Cursed One#385.dst: En Auburn el té es muy popular, ¡y la gente ha logrado hacer té con casi cualquier planta que encuentre! Algunos son... más sabrosos que otros.
The Cursed One#385.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#386.src: The Reishi Mushroom for example! Brewing tea of the mushroom alone often turns... bitter. With the help of herbs and spices it goes from a bitter to a rich spicy flavour!
The Cursed One#386.dst: ¡La seta reishi, por ejemplo! Preparar té solo con la seta suele salir... amargo. Con ayuda de hierbas y especias, ¡el amargor se convierte en un sabor rico y especiado!
The Cursed One#386.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#387.src: The mushroom itself is said to keep you healthy. It is also said to boost your resistances!
The Cursed One#387.dst: Se dice que la seta en sí te mantiene sano. ¡También dicen que aumenta tus resistencias!
The Cursed One#387.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#388.src: The Tea Tree Mushroom on the other hand is perfect for a good tea blend. The mushroom alone gives it a sweet and earthy flavour.
The Cursed One#388.dst: La seta del árbol del té, en cambio, es perfecta para una buena mezcla. Ella sola aporta un sabor dulce y terroso.
The Cursed One#388.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#389.src: The mushroom is also said to regenerate you back to health and alleviate the feeling of tiredness! How amazing.
The Cursed One#389.dst: ¡También dicen que esta seta te devuelve la salud y alivia la sensación de cansancio! Qué maravilla.
The Cursed One#389.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#390.src: If you feel like buying something, please talk to my assistant.
The Cursed One#390.dst: Si le apetece comprar algo, hable con mi ayudante, por favor.
The Cursed One#390.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#393.src: It's festival time! *hic* that means... drinking time!!!
The Cursed One#393.dst: ¡Es hora de festival! *hip* o sea que... ¡¡¡hora de beber!!!
The Cursed One#393.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#394.src: Inteeeerested in any of our mouth-watering beverages?
The Cursed One#394.dst: ¿Te inteeeeresa alguna de nuestras bebidas de rechupete?
The Cursed One#394.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#396.src: *Hic* Todaaaay, we have a couple of imported drinks as well as our classic Autumn Amaretto.
The Cursed One#396.dst: *Hip* Hooooy tenemos un par de bebidas importadas y nuestro clásico Autumn Amaretto.
The Cursed One#396.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#397.src: Seen them blue fruits in the trees around here? Most of 'em are inedible Liffberries, buuut, some of 'em are actually a more edible fruit called Autumn Fruit, which carry a high value!
The Cursed One#397.dst: ¿Has visto esos frutos azules de los árboles de por aquí? La mayoría son Liffberries incomibles, peeero algunos son en realidad un fruto más comestible llamado Autumn Fruit, ¡que vale mucho!
The Cursed One#397.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#398.src: The Amaretto is made from Autumn Fruit kernels! We have aaaalso mixed in some Liff Leaves which *hic* gives it its warm colour and slightly bitter and metallic taste.
The Cursed One#398.dst: ¡El Amaretto se hace con las pepitas del Autumn Fruit! Taaaambién le hemos mezclado hojas de Liff, que *hip* le dan ese color cálido y ese sabor algo amargo y metálico.
The Cursed One#398.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#400.src: We have also imported the faaaamed Heather Beer from the rich highlands.
The Cursed One#400.dst: También hemos importado la famoooosa Heather Beer de las ricas Tierras Altas.
The Cursed One#400.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#401.src: A beer infused with the most beautiful heather grown across the highlands. *hic* You can almost taste the richness of the aristocrats.
The Cursed One#401.dst: Una cerveza infusionada con el brezo más hermoso de las Tierras Altas. *hip* Casi se saborea la opulencia de los aristócratas.
The Cursed One#401.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#402.src: *hic* If I were you, I would deeefinitely try this drink. Stuff like this doesn't come to Auburn often.
The Cursed One#402.dst: *hip* Yo en tu lugar la probaría siiin duda. Cosas así no llegan a Auburn muy a menudo.
The Cursed One#402.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#403.src: If you feel like blessing your taste buds, talk to my brother over there. *hic*
The Cursed One#403.dst: Si te apetece bendecir tus papilas, habla con mi hermano de ahí. *hip*
The Cursed One#403.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#406.src: We have freshly cooked and baked regional goods.
The Cursed One#406.dst: Tenemos productos de la zona recién cocinados y horneados.
The Cursed One#406.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#407.src: Would you like to hear about our menu, dear?
The Cursed One#407.dst: ¿Quieres que te cuente nuestro menú, cielo?
The Cursed One#407.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#408.src: Just perfect! Auburn is famous for their bold, earthy and cosy flavours!
The Cursed One#408.dst: ¡Perfecto! ¡Auburn es famosa por sus sabores intensos, terrosos y acogedores!
The Cursed One#408.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#409.src: We also love to cook using our wild animals and resources, but I'm sure you already know all of this, haha.
The Cursed One#409.dst: También nos encanta cocinar con nuestros animales salvajes y recursos, pero seguro que ya lo sabes todo, jaja.
The Cursed One#409.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#410.src: Let me go over some of our special dishes for today, dear.
The Cursed One#410.dst: Déjame repasar algunos de los platos especiales de hoy, cielo.
The Cursed One#410.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#411.src: The most important dish in Auburn, is of course the "Gift of the Forest". A wonderful meat and fruit mixture inside a steamed leaf wrap.
The Cursed One#411.dst: El plato más importante de Auburn es, por supuesto, el "Regalo del Bosque". Una mezcla maravillosa de carne y fruta envuelta en una hoja al vapor.
The Cursed One#411.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#412.src: We have hand wrapped all of our gifts this morning and they are steamed to go!
The Cursed One#412.dst: Esta mañana envolvimos a mano todos los regalos, ¡y salen al vapor para llevar!
The Cursed One#412.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#413.src: If that doesn't interest you, we also have the classic "Forest Feast". A grilled piece of boar meat with a mud-kin salad.
The Cursed One#413.dst: Si eso no te interesa, también tenemos el clásico "Festín del Bosque". Un trozo de carne de jabalí a la parrilla con ensalada de mudkin.
The Cursed One#413.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#414.src: I'm afraid we have run out of ingredients at the moment. Please come back later!
The Cursed One#414.dst: Me temo que ahora nos hemos quedado sin ingredientes. ¡Vuelve más tarde!
The Cursed One#414.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#416.src: Hey! You look like a tourist to me!
The Cursed One#416.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#417.src: I'm glad you decided to check out my little exhibition here.
The Cursed One#417.dst: Me alegra que hayas decidido ver mi pequeña exposición.
The Cursed One#417.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#418.src: Is it your first time in this part of the region? Would you perhaps want to hear some fun facts about our animals?
The Cursed One#418.dst: ¿Es tu primera vez por esta parte de la región? ¿Te apetece oír algunas curiosidades sobre nuestros animales?
The Cursed One#418.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#420.src: First we have our Roly-bugs here! These little buggers are a pest to the people here.
The Cursed One#420.dst: ¡Primero tenemos nuestros bichos Roly! Estos pequeñajos son una plaga para la gente de aquí.
The Cursed One#420.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#421.src: They love gnawing on our houses. Luckily, we built most of our structures on stilts aaaand those bugs can't climb.
The Cursed One#421.dst: Les encanta roer las casas. Por suerte, casi todo se construye sobre pilotes yyyy esos bichos no trepan.
The Cursed One#421.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#422.src: Now! Frogs! The north-western bog is the best place for frog-watching. Just be careful of the bog monster.
The Cursed One#422.dst: ¡Y ahora! ¡Ranas! La ciénaga del noroeste es el mejor sitio para verlas. Solo ten cuidado con el monstruo de la ciénaga.
The Cursed One#422.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#423.src: Frogs might be a good source of food but we like to see them more as... pets!
The Cursed One#423.dst: Las ranas pueden ser buen alimento, ¡pero preferimos verlas como... mascotas!
The Cursed One#423.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#424.src: Lastly, we have foxes! These little cuties are very shy in nature. But beware, there are bigger versions of them, known as Foxhounds.
The Cursed One#424.dst: ¡Por último, los zorros! Estos pequeñajos son muy tímidos por naturaleza. Pero cuidado, hay versiones más grandes, conocidas como Foxhounds.
The Cursed One#424.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#425.src: Those are not as shy... or peaceful, as their smaller cousins. They are just as cute though!
The Cursed One#425.dst: Esos no son tan tímidos... ni tan pacíficos como sus primos pequeños. ¡Pero son igual de monos!
The Cursed One#425.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#426.src: Please have a looksie around! You can also pet them.
The Cursed One#426.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#428.src: Howdy and welcome to a mudkin farm!
The Cursed One#428.dst: ¡Güenas! Esto es una granja de Mudkin.
The Cursed One#428.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#429.src: Mudkins are popular vegetables in food around here. They grow underground and you have to yoikn em' out!
The Cursed One#429.dst: Los Mudkin son una verdura mu popular en la comida de por aquí. Crecen bajo tierra, ¡y hay que sacarlos de un tirón!
The Cursed One#429.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#430.src: Are ya interested in a game of Mudkin Picking?
The Cursed One#430.dst: ¿Te interesa una partida de Recogida de Mudkin?
The Cursed One#430.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#431.src: Basically, ye goal is to get as many points as possible before the time runs out.
The Cursed One#431.dst: Básicamente, tu meta es sacar todos los puntos que puedas antes de que se acabe el tiempo.
The Cursed One#431.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#432.src: There are three sizes of Mudkins, each size gives a set of points. However! There are two ginger roots that give negative points.
The Cursed One#432.dst: Hay tres tamaños de Mudkin, y cada tamaño da unos puntos. ¡Pero ojo! Hay dos raíces de jengibre que dan puntos negativos.
The Cursed One#432.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#433.src: Simply click on the dirt particles appearing in the field. There are five spots for ya to pick.
The Cursed One#433.dst: Solo tienes que hacer clic en las partículas de tierra que salgan en el campo. Hay cinco sitios pa recoger.
The Cursed One#433.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#436.src: Return to Syndra at or keep exploring the festival.
The Cursed One#436.dst: Vuelve con Syndra o sigue explorando el festival.

The Cursed One#437.src: Ah. There you are. Have you been enjoying yourself?
The Cursed One#437.dst: Ah. Ahí estás. ¿Te lo has pasado bien?
The Cursed One#437.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#439.src: For all that the festival revolves around the crown, I've always appreciated its representation of our culture.**
The Cursed One#439.dst: Aunque el festival gire en torno a la Corona, siempre he apreciado cómo representa nuestra cultura.**
The Cursed One#439.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#440.src: I hope your experience with the crown has not ruined your perception of our province... there are still many things to celebrate.
The Cursed One#440.dst: Espero que tu experiencia con la Corona no haya arruinado tu idea de nuestra provincia... aún hay mucho que celebrar.
The Cursed One#440.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#441.src: Sometimes, it can be nice to set aside your woes, and... take things as they are. Breathe, a little.
The Cursed One#441.dst: A veces está bien dejar a un lado las penas y... tomar las cosas como son. Respirar un poco.
The Cursed One#441.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#443.src: It's hard to enjoy yourself with your experiences with the crown weighing you down, isn't it? I know the feeling.
The Cursed One#443.dst: Cuesta disfrutar con lo que has vivido con la Corona pesándote, ¿verdad? Conozco esa sensación.
The Cursed One#443.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#444.src: Mmn. I'd suggest to take what you can get. Happy moments like this can be fleeting, in my experience.
The Cursed One#444.dst: Mmn. Yo te aconsejaría aprovechar lo que puedas. Por mi experiencia, los momentos felices así son fugaces.
The Cursed One#444.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#445.src: If there's even the smallest spark of joy... take hold of it before it's gone. Cherish it while you still can. Try not to grow old and jaded like I have, would you?
The Cursed One#445.dst: Si hay aunque sea la chispa más pequeña de alegría... agárrala antes de que se apague. Valórala mientras puedas. Intenta no hacerte viejo y cínico como yo, ¿quieres?
The Cursed One#445.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#446.src: Ha! It's alright. Neither have I.
The Cursed One#446.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#447.src: Every year... every single year, the crown hosts these festivals. Starting here, and moving around in a ring around the province.
The Cursed One#447.dst: Cada año... todos y cada uno de los años, la Corona organiza estos festivales. Empiezan aquí y van dando la vuelta a la provincia.
The Cursed One#447.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#448.src: The festival's a holiday, a day of rest, of celebration. What a gift it is, not needing to work for a time! How generous.
The Cursed One#448.dst: El festival es fiesta, un día de descanso, de celebración. ¡Qué regalo, no tener que trabajar un rato! Qué generosidad.
The Cursed One#448.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#449.src: I can't stand it here... Every year, I convince myself I can bear it. The reminder it brings, of memories long passed. Every year, I'm proven wrong.
The Cursed One#449.dst: No soporto estar aquí... Cada año me convenzo de que podré aguantarlo. Lo que me recuerda, memorias de hace mucho. Y cada año me equivoco.
The Cursed One#449.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#450.src: ...Ah. It's time. The main event is about to begin.
The Cursed One#450.dst: ...Ah. Es la hora. El acto principal está a punto de empezar.
The Cursed One#450.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#451.src: Why, Her Majesty's annual speech, of course! It wouldn't be a Festival of the Crown if she didn't make an appearance, would it?
The Cursed One#451.dst: ¡El discurso anual de Su Majestad, por supuesto! No sería un Festival de la Corona si ella no apareciera, ¿verdad?
The Cursed One#451.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#452.src: Ha! No, no. Of course not. It wouldn't be a Festival of the Crown without a speech from Her Majesty herself, would it?
The Cursed One#452.dst: ¡Ja! No, no. Claro que no. No sería un Festival de la Corona sin un discurso de la propia Su Majestad, ¿verdad?
The Cursed One#452.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#453.src: Now... observe. Behold our enemy, take note of how she presents herself, what she says, what she doesn't say.
The Cursed One#453.dst: Ahora... observa. Contempla a nuestra enemiga, fíjate en cómo se presenta, en lo que dice y en lo que calla.
The Cursed One#453.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#454.src: Ah... beloved people of the {p}! What a joy, what an honor it is to stand amongst you once again.
The Cursed One#454.dst: Ah... ¡amado pueblo de {p}! Qué alegría, qué honor es estar de nuevo entre vosotros.
The Cursed One#454.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#455.src: Some will claim the stunning {p} to be our most beautiful region, with its vibrant blossoming trees and grand historic castles...
The Cursed One#455.dst: Algunos dirán que {p}, con sus árboles en flor y sus grandiosos castillos históricos, es nuestra región más hermosa...
The Cursed One#455.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#456.src: But I've always held a special regard for this place. The leaves and their warm shades, blowing in the soft breeze... all the woes of the world would be worth this sight.
The Cursed One#456.dst: Pero yo siempre he sentido un aprecio especial por este lugar. Las hojas y sus tonos cálidos, mecidas por la brisa suave... todas las penas del mundo valdrían por esta vista.
The Cursed One#456.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#457.src: If I were able, perhaps I could stay here year-round! Ah, but alas... work in the Citadel keeps us all occupied!
The Cursed One#457.dst: ¡Si pudiera, quizá me quedaría aquí todo el año! Ah, pero ay... ¡el trabajo en la Ciudadela nos mantiene a todos ocupados!
The Cursed One#457.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#458.src: We have many plans for the coming year. Increased imports from the other regions, easier access to travel for all, and additional openings in military positions!
The Cursed One#458.dst: Tenemos muchos planes para el año que viene. Más importaciones de las otras regiones, viajes más accesibles para todos, ¡y nuevas plazas en el ejército!
The Cursed One#458.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#459.src: More will be revealed soon. Now, some words from your beloved Sovereign.
The Cursed One#459.dst: Pronto se revelará más. Ahora, unas palabras de vuestro amado Soberano.
The Cursed One#459.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#460.src: ...ah. The one thing I miscalculated. The mic height. Oh well- Testing, testing, one two three...
The Cursed One#460.dst: ...ah. Lo único que calculé mal. La altura del micro. En fin- Probando, probando, uno dos tres...
The Cursed One#460.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#461.src: Welcome one and all! I'm your Sovereign, Zhiraok. It's an honor to be here before you all again today.
The Cursed One#461.dst: ¡Bienvenidos todos! Soy vuestro Soberano, Zhiraok. Es un honor estar hoy de nuevo ante vosotros.
The Cursed One#461.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#462.src: Two decades of work in the {p}. Twenty years. It feels like I've been here for so much longer this place, these people, really have become my home.
The Cursed One#462.dst: Dos décadas de trabajo en {p}. Veinte años. Se me hace mucho más largo: este lugar, esta gente, se han convertido de verdad en mi hogar.
The Cursed One#462.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#463.src: My duty is not just to serve the Crown, but also to serve you. To make your lives better, to raise this region we live in to new heights.
The Cursed One#463.dst: Mi deber no es solo servir a la Corona, sino también serviros a vosotros. Mejorar vuestras vidas y elevar esta región a nuevas cotas.
The Cursed One#463.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#464.src: Whether that's by increasing production of Liff Leaves to share our resources and knowledge the province over, which we owe to your hard work...
The Cursed One#464.dst: Ya sea aumentando la producción de hojas de Liff para compartir nuestros recursos y saberes con toda la provincia, lo cual debemos a vuestro esfuerzo...
The Cursed One#464.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#465.src: ...or through sharpening our infrastructure to exponentiate your quality of life, in thanks for what you do!
The Cursed One#465.dst: ...o afinando nuestras infraestructuras para exponenciar vuestra calidad de vida, ¡en agradecimiento por lo que hacéis!
The Cursed One#465.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#466.src: I'd be here all day listing the improvements over the last year, but I'll summarize Multiple major road improvements, countless new job opportunities, multiplying guard patrols to keep you safe...
The Cursed One#466.dst: Pasaría el día entero enumerando las mejoras del último año, así que resumiré: varias mejoras en carreteras principales, incontables empleos nuevos, patrullas de guardia multiplicadas para manteneros a salvo...
The Cursed One#466.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#467.src: The place we came from twenty years ago is unrecognizable now. My vow is that twenty years ahead, I can say the same thing for how much more we, together, improve our home.
The Cursed One#467.dst: El lugar del que partimos hace veinte años hoy es irreconocible. Mi promesa es que dentro de veinte años pueda decir lo mismo de cuánto habremos mejorado juntos nuestro hogar.
The Cursed One#467.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#468.src: 'til the day we sum up to the grandeur of {p}- Thank you all! Enjoy the festivities!
The Cursed One#468.dst: ...hasta el día en que sumemos la grandeza de {p}- ¡Gracias a todos! ¡Disfrutad de las fiestas!
The Cursed One#468.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#469.src: What fine work Sovereign Zhiraok has done for our province! Truly, there could have been no better choice to fill that role!
The Cursed One#469.dst: ¡Qué gran labor ha hecho el Soberano Zhiraok por nuestra provincia! ¡En verdad, no podría haber mejor elección para ese cargo!
The Cursed One#469.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#470.src: The {p} flourishes under his governance, and I could not be more pleased by the progress he has made.
The Cursed One#470.dst: {p} florece bajo su gobierno, y no podría estar más satisfecha con los avances que ha logrado.
The Cursed One#470.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#471.src: One final message before we conclude. These past years, we have seen fewer and fewer reports of the cursed - a sign of our strength as a people.
The Cursed One#471.dst: Un último mensaje antes de concluir. Estos últimos años hemos visto cada vez menos informes sobre los malditos - señal de nuestra fuerza como pueblo.
The Cursed One#471.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#472.src: And it is all thanks to you! Your diligent reporting of suspicious activity makes all the difference in keeping our province safe.
The Cursed One#472.dst: ¡Y todo gracias a vosotros! Vuestras diligentes denuncias de actividades sospechosas son decisivas para mantener segura nuestra provincia.
The Cursed One#472.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#473.src: We must stand strong, together! We will not allow this evil its victory, we will not let our province fall like so many others have beyond our walls!
The Cursed One#473.dst: ¡Debemos mantenernos firmes, juntos! ¡No le concederemos la victoria a ese mal, no dejaremos caer nuestra provincia como han caído tantas más allá de nuestros muros!
The Cursed One#473.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#474.src: With that, let the celebrations begin!
The Cursed One#474.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#476.src: Did anything stand out to you?
The Cursed One#476.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#477.src: Indeed, it is. It's quite puzzling, isn't it? It's a sort of reverence she never displays elsewhere.
The Cursed One#477.dst: Así es. Resulta bastante desconcertante, ¿verdad? Es una especie de reverencia que nunca muestra en otra parte.
The Cursed One#477.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#478.src: And if there's one thing I'm certain she's being truthful about, it's this. Which only makes it all the stranger.
The Cursed One#478.dst: Y si hay algo en lo que estoy segura de que dice la verdad, es esto. Lo cual lo hace aún más extraño.
The Cursed One#478.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#479.src: Yes, yes... improvements. Life has improved since he ascended to that position. I'll give him that. He's invested in Auburn.
The Cursed One#479.dst: Sí, sí... mejoras. La vida ha mejorado desde que ascendió a ese cargo. Eso se lo concedo. Se ha volcado en Auburn.
The Cursed One#479.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#480.src: But he is still working under the crown. Don't forget that. For every improvement he has made, there's another he has left ignored.
The Cursed One#480.dst: Pero sigue trabajando bajo la Corona. No lo olvides. Por cada mejora que ha hecho, hay otra que ha dejado desatendida.
The Cursed One#480.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#481.src: No, I suppose they wouldn't. Better to leave the public unaware of such failures.
The Cursed One#481.dst: No, supongo que no lo dirían. Mejor que el pueblo no sepa de esos fracasos.
The Cursed One#481.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#482.src: But rest assured that internally, they have not forgotten. They will keep searching for you.
The Cursed One#482.dst: Pero ten por seguro que, de puertas adentro, no lo han olvidado. Seguirán buscándote.
The Cursed One#482.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#483.src: Yes... the cursed. The crown needs to keep the people afraid. If there's another enemy out there that the crown supposedly protects them from...
The Cursed One#483.dst: Sí... los malditos. La Corona necesita mantener al pueblo con miedo. Si hay otro enemigo ahí fuera del que la Corona supuestamente los protege...
The Cursed One#483.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#484.src: There's a reason they want people to believe the outside world is destroyed. Any contact could break the illusion.
The Cursed One#484.dst: Por algo quieren que la gente crea que el mundo exterior está destruido. Cualquier contacto podría romper la ilusión.
The Cursed One#484.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#485.src: They'll be closing out the festival soon... so, our work here is done. We should be leaving before the crowd thins enough for us to be spotted.
The Cursed One#485.dst: Pronto cerrarán el festival... así que aquí hemos terminado. Deberíamos irnos antes de que la multitud se disperse y nos vean.
The Cursed One#485.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#486.src: I've scheduled a meeting for tomorrow I'd like for you to attend. It'll be about our next steps, now that the crown has moved on. I'll see you there.
The Cursed One#486.dst: He convocado una reunión para mañana y me gustaría que asistieras. Trataremos los próximos pasos, ahora que la Corona ha seguido su camino. Nos vemos allí.
The Cursed One#486.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#488.src: I think I've had just about enough of people sneaking into my office. Care to knock next time?
The Cursed One#488.dst: Creo que ya me he hartado de que la gente se cuele en mi despacho. ¿Te importaría llamar la próxima vez?
The Cursed One#488.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#489.src: Mmn. It's more interesting this way. I have news from the capital - your request for additional troops has been granted. Reassignments should come through by the end of the week.
The Cursed One#489.dst: Mmn. Así resulta más interesante. Traigo noticias de la capital - se ha aprobado tu petición de tropas adicionales. Los traslados deberían llegar a final de semana.

The Cursed One#490.src: Well, that'll solve some problems. But that's not the whole message, is it? What obtuse remark has he got for me this time?
The Cursed One#490.dst: Bueno, eso resolverá algunos problemas. Pero ese no es todo el mensaje, ¿verdad? ¿Qué comentario obtuso me manda esta vez?
The Cursed One#490.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#491.src: Merely a reminder to... "get your act together," as it were.
The Cursed One#491.dst: Solo un recordatorio de que... "te pongas las pilas", por así decirlo.

The Cursed One#492.src: Get my act toge That floundering fractal's developed less in his quadrant in a hundred-fifty years than I've done in two, in the last ten!
The Cursed One#492.dst: Que me ponga las pi ¡Ese fractal a la deriva ha desarrollado menos en su cuadrante en ciento cincuenta años que yo en dos de los últimos diez!
The Cursed One#492.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#493.src: I Ugh, focus, Z... He's not even here, don't let him get under your skin...
The Cursed One#493.dst: Yo Uf, céntrate, Z... Si ni siquiera está aquí, no dejes que te saque de quicio...
The Cursed One#493.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#494.src: I'll get off that tangent. If that was all you had to say, it'd be a waste of your time. What do you need to say that a courier can't send in a letter?
The Cursed One#494.dst: Me bajo de esa tangente. Si eso fuera todo lo que tienes que decir, sería perder tu tiempo. ¿Qué tienes que decir que un mensajero no pueda mandar por carta?
The Cursed One#494.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#495.src: The intruder. Does your administration believe it can get the situation under control?
The Cursed One#495.dst: El intruso. ¿Tu administración cree que puede controlar la situación?

The Cursed One#496.src: There it is. Listen, I've got their number, alright? There's no way in or out of the district where they won't be detected. We'll track them down.
The Cursed One#496.dst: Ahí está. Escucha, ya le tengo el número, ¿vale? No hay forma de entrar ni salir del distrito sin ser detectado. Lo rastrearemos.
The Cursed One#496.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#497.src: Though unlike some people, my ego isn't so massive I can't recognize when an ally can be of use. Your types have an expertise here, so if you could spare a set or two of eyes it'd be much appreciated.
The Cursed One#497.dst: Aunque, a diferencia de otros, mi ego no es tan enorme como para no ver cuándo un aliado puede servir. Los tuyos sois expertos en esto, así que si pudieras prestarme un par de ojos, te lo agradecería mucho.
The Cursed One#497.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#498.src: I'll see what I can do. There happens to be an ongoing operation in the area already, we can discuss redirecting the agent once it's concluded.
The Cursed One#498.dst: Veré qué puedo hacer. Da la casualidad de que ya hay una operación en marcha en la zona; cuando concluya, podemos hablar de reasignar al agente.

The Cursed One#499.src: One last thing- the identity of the intruder has been made clear to you already, yes?
The Cursed One#499.dst: Una última cosa- ya te han dejado clara la identidad del intruso, ¿no?

The Cursed One#500.src: Mhm. Like I said, I've got their number.
The Cursed One#500.dst: Ajá. Ya te dije, le tengo el número.
The Cursed One#500.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#501.src: Then you will understand Her Majesty's order not to speak of this ordeal to our newest. Ascension is a difficult process, and it would be... unwise to add additional distractions to it.
The Cursed One#501.dst: Entonces entenderás la orden de Su Majestad de no hablar de este asunto con el más nuevo de los nuestros. La ascensión es un proceso difícil, y sería... imprudente añadirle más distracciones.

The Cursed One#502.src: Wouldn't want to distract a hard worker like him, right. But if that's everything, Spymaster? My to-do list is getting more added by the minute.
The Cursed One#502.dst: No querríamos distraer a un trabajador tan aplicado, claro. Pero ¿eso es todo, Jefa de Espías? Mi lista de tareas crece por minutos.
The Cursed One#502.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Dark Descent#000.src: Hello there, chap! I must say, I didn't expect to see a part of the old {p} regiment over 'ere.

The Dark Descent#001.src: I... there... too many... th-thousands, at... at least...

The Dark Descent#003.src: Please, stop this! Whoever you are, leave me and my family in peace!

The Dark Descent#004.src: Ah, but if you had only said so sooner! I'm afraid they have already joined me, down below.

The Dark Descent#005.src: Y-you... I thought they... oh, gods, no...

The Dark Descent#006.src: Hush, now. You and your family will make fine additions to my legion.

The Dark Descent#007.src: Wha... you mean... N-no, please! I don't want to hurt anyone!

The Dark Descent#008.src: How naive. Fear not. You will rise again, and then you will serve my purpose.

The Dark Descent#010.src: How easily this place fell? How quickly I became its master?

The Dark Descent#011.src: You can barely keep them at bay on the surface, and yet you think to enter my own domain, to challenge me in the Underworld?

The Dark Descent#012.src: So enter the mouth of my skull, soldier, make your way below the ground. I look forward to our next meeting, keheheh...

The Dark Descent#013.src: Looks like the only way to go is into the skull...

The Dark Descent#014.src: You were stumbling about like a senile biddy, eyes blank as cream, and you kept muttering something about a Charon.

The Dark Descent#015.src: I'm supposing he was the one who took you for a spin there? Well, you certainly haven't carked it, so I might call this operation a success!

The Dark Descent#016.src: When you're ready, I'd be chuffed to have you along in the expedition down into the depths, old bean!

The Dark Descent#017.src: How foolish. You might think you are strong, adventurer, but you have no idea what you are about to face...

The Dark Descent#018.src: Simply marvellous work, chap! You've made it this far, so no time to fill your boots. Be prepared, we are about to fight Charon's undead army.

The Dark Descent#019.src: We've lost a lot of good men on the way here, but I believe we can still throw a heavy punch.

The Dark Descent#020.src: You've earned a lot of respect from the boys this fight, better than all of us I'd say. For this fight, I'll let you direct the army.

The Dark Descent#021.src: Don't take it as a promotion though, old bean. It's only for this fight, although you'll be getting a medal of valor if I can wangle it! Charon's army is remarkably strong, we need as much help as we can get.

The Dark Descent#022.src: Aey- careful now, {u}, the cretin must be lurking around here somewhere.

The Dark Descent#023.src: I see you've brought aid, you aren't as foolish as I thought.

The Dark Descent#024.src: Tell me, how do you plan to defeat an army that cannot die!?

The Dark Descent#026.src: Aha, chap! Wonderful, the {p} regiment's gotten its representative down 'ere. All rested up, I suppose, so let me give you an earful.

The Dark Descent#027.src: Those blighting zombies are all over the place. I tell ya, this skull's been giving the folk in {p} the collywobbles. Just as I thought, they're all coming from here.

The Dark Descent#028.src: Now, I don't wish to alarm you old bean, but I believe we are in front of the literal gates to hell.

The Dark Descent#029.src: Not to worry chuck! Don't look so glum, I've called for aid from the nearby towns. Once they get here we'll give them a good kicking, and you've already gotten out of there before, ain't ya?

The Dark Descent#030.src: Now is finally our chance to take down his army... It will be a jolly difficult battle, knowing our opponent and what he's managed, even away from his lair.

The Dark Descent#031.src: Still, early days to say what he could be like in person! I'll take another route, but we'll meet in front of his door, right after crossing the river. Good luck, old bean!

The Dark Descent#033.src: I have an entire undead army at my service. Do you really think you stand a chance?
The Dark Descent#033.dst: Tengo todo un ejército de no muertos a mi servicio. ¿De verdad crees que tienes alguna posibilidad?

The Dark Descent#034.dst: Habla con el General Graken en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Dark Descent#035.src: Ah, hello there chap! I must say, I didn't expect to see a part of the old {p} regiment over 'ere.
The Dark Descent#035.dst: ¡Ah, hola, amigo! Debo decir que no esperaba ver por aquí a nadie del viejo regimiento de {p}.
The Dark Descent#035.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#036.src: I am General Graken, leader of the {p} militia. Charmed to meet you!
The Dark Descent#036.dst: Soy el General Graken, jefe de la milicia de {p}. ¡Un placer conocerte!
The Dark Descent#036.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#037.src: You've seen all the bloody zombies faffing about everywhere, yes? They're all seeming to come from this massive skull.
The Dark Descent#037.dst: Habrás visto a los malditos zombis que pululan por todas partes, ¿no? Parece que todos salen de esa calavera enorme.
The Dark Descent#037.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#038.src: I'm putting together a crack team for an expedition inside, but we haven't got any bleedin' idea what's down there!
The Dark Descent#038.dst: Estoy formando un equipo de élite para una expedición ahí dentro, ¡pero no tenemos ni idea de lo que hay abajo!
The Dark Descent#038.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#039.src: If you're up for it, chap, we could absolutely do with some recon 'round the old town, look for clues and the like.
The Dark Descent#039.dst: Si te apetece, amigo, nos vendría de perlas que husmearas por el viejo pueblo, en busca de pistas y demás.
The Dark Descent#039.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#040.src: I took a gander earlier, and one of the ol' houses caught my eye - it had a bloomin' great skull right over the door!
The Dark Descent#040.dst: Antes eché un vistazo y una de las casas viejas me llamó la atención: ¡tenía un calaverón enorme sobre la puerta!
The Dark Descent#040.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#041.src: I didn't have time to look in proper, but I'd start the investigation there, chap.
The Dark Descent#041.dst: No tuve tiempo de mirar bien, pero yo empezaría por ahí, amigo.
The Dark Descent#041.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#042.src: It's just south of here. The house still had solid wood boarding in it, despite the age, so look lively, chum!
The Dark Descent#042.dst: Está justo al sur. Pese a los años, la casa aún tiene tablones firmes, ¡así que ojo avizor, compañero!
The Dark Descent#042.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#044.src: Oh, sod it, I knew I was forgetting something! Steady there, chum! I'm on my way!
The Dark Descent#044.dst: ¡Ay, maldita sea, sabía que se me olvidaba algo! ¡Aguanta, compañero! ¡Voy para allá!
The Dark Descent#044.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#045.src: Drat! Too late, it seems. Yes, I forgot to mention the floor was in poor condition. Up here! You took quite the tumble, are you alright?
The Dark Descent#045.dst: ¡Rayos! Llego tarde, por lo que veo. Sí, olvidé mencionar que el suelo estaba fatal. ¡Aquí arriba! Vaya costalazo, ¿estás bien?
The Dark Descent#045.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#046.src: Well, there's some good news, I suppose. Still though, seems I sent you a ticket to a bit of a sticky wicket! Do you see a way out anywhere down there?
The Dark Descent#046.dst: Bueno, hay buenas noticias, supongo. Aun así, ¡parece que te he mandado de cabeza a un buen embrollo! ¿Ves alguna salida ahí abajo?
The Dark Descent#046.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#047.src: There's a tunnel? Aha, spiffing! I suggest you take it immediately. I'll have to return to my post now, post-haste!
The Dark Descent#047.dst: ¿Hay un túnel? ¡Ajá, estupendo! Te sugiero que lo tomes de inmediato. ¡Yo debo volver a mi puesto ahora mismo, a la carrera!
The Dark Descent#047.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#048.src: Good luck, chum! Now, back, you cads! Back I say!
The Dark Descent#048.dst: ¡Suerte, compañero! ¡Y ahora atrás, canallas! ¡Atrás, he dicho!
The Dark Descent#048.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#049.src: Keheh... Come further, little human... Step into the shadows...
The Dark Descent#049.dst: Je, je... Acércate más, humanito... Entra en las sombras...

The Dark Descent#050.src: Explore the tunnel in the basement of the house.
The Dark Descent#050.dst: Explora el túnel del sótano de la casa.

The Dark Descent#051.dst: Investiga el extraño reino de oscuridad.

The Dark Descent#053.src: Scout! Report your findings, immediately! How many corrupteds are coming?
The Dark Descent#053.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#054.dst: Yo... ahí... demasiados... m-miles, por... por lo menos...
The Dark Descent#054.speaker: Scout

The Dark Descent#055.src: Thousands...? This is far worse than I expected. Men! Prepare for-
The Dark Descent#055.dst: ¿Miles...? Esto es mucho peor de lo que esperaba. ¡Soldados! Preparaos para-
The Dark Descent#055.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#056.dst: No sirve de nada... estamos... perdidos...
The Dark Descent#056.speaker: Scout

The Dark Descent#057.src: Wait, w-what's going on? What's happening to you?!
The Dark Descent#057.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#058.src: Please, stop this! Whoever you are, leave me and my family in peace! What did we ever do to deserve this?!
The Dark Descent#058.dst: ¡Por favor, basta ya! ¡Quienquiera que seas, déjanos en paz a mí y a mi familia! ¡¿Qué hemos hecho para merecer esto?!
The Dark Descent#058.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#059.src: Ah, but if you had only said so sooner! They have already left this mortal coil...oh, what a shame.
The Dark Descent#059.dst: Ay, ¡si lo hubieras dicho antes! Ya han abandonado este mundo mortal... oh, qué lástima.

The Dark Descent#060.dst: T-tú... creía que ellos... dios mío, no...
The Dark Descent#060.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#061.src: Hush now. I will ensure that you and your family are reunited. You will even be able to partake in...keheh...family outings, under my watchful eye...
The Dark Descent#061.dst: Calla ya. Me encargaré de que te reúnas con tu familia. Incluso podréis dar... je, je... paseos familiares, bajo mi atenta mirada...

The Dark Descent#062.src: Wha...you mean... N-no, please! I don't want to hurt anyone! I don't want to die!!
The Dark Descent#062.dst: Qué... quieres decir que... N-no, ¡por favor! ¡No quiero hacer daño a nadie! ¡¡No quiero morir!!
The Dark Descent#062.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#063.src: Aha, naive girl. How cute, you believe you have a choice in the matter. What you want, is not what I need.
The Dark Descent#063.dst: Ajá, niña ingenua. Qué tierno, crees que puedes elegir. Lo que tú quieras no es lo que yo necesito.

The Dark Descent#065.src: Do you see how easily this place fell? How quickly I became its master? And how I could simply dispose of you without a second thought?
The Dark Descent#065.dst: ¿Ves con qué facilidad cayó este lugar? ¿Qué pronto me convertí en su amo? ¿Y que podría deshacerme de ti sin pensarlo dos veces?

The Dark Descent#066.src: Hundreds slaughtered in mere moments... only to rise again as my soldiers in infinite amounts.
The Dark Descent#066.dst: Cientos degollados en un instante... solo para alzarse de nuevo como mis soldados, en número infinito.

The Dark Descent#067.src: You can barely keep them at bay on the surface, and yet you think you can enter my own domain, to challenge me in the Underworld?
The Dark Descent#067.dst: Apenas los contenéis en la superficie, ¿y aun así crees que puedes entrar en mis dominios y retarme en el Inframundo?

The Dark Descent#068.src: You will fail, and I will be free to string your body up like a puppet and make you dance for me.
The Dark Descent#068.dst: Fracasarás, y yo podré colgar tu cuerpo como una marioneta y hacerte bailar para mí.

The Dark Descent#069.src: So enter the mouth of the skull, soldier, make your way below the ground. I look forward to our next meeting, keheheh...
The Dark Descent#069.dst: Así que entra en la boca de la calavera, soldado, desciende bajo tierra. Ansío nuestro próximo encuentro, je, je, je...

The Dark Descent#070.dst: Abandona el extraño reino de oscuridad.

The Dark Descent#071.src: Return the ruby to Graken at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Dark Descent#071.dst: Devuelve el rubí a Graken en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Dark Descent#072.src: Return to your world, now. And if you still want to challenge me... I'll be waiting.
The Dark Descent#072.dst: Vuelve a tu mundo, ya. Y si aún quieres retarme... estaré esperando.

The Dark Descent#073.src: Hey! Come on, come over here! Quit milling about with the zombies, chap!
The Dark Descent#073.dst: ¡Eh! ¡Vamos, ven aquí! ¡Deja de deambular con los zombis, amigo!
The Dark Descent#073.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#074.src: Oi! Hallo?! Chum? Why're you wandering round all bog-eyed? Come back to me now!
The Dark Descent#074.dst: ¡Oye! ¿¡Hola!? ¿Compañero? ¿Por qué vagas por ahí con esa mirada perdida? ¡Vuelve en ti!
The Dark Descent#074.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#075.src: Come on, pip pip! Let's see a bit more colour in your eyes- There we are! Back now, chap?
The Dark Descent#075.dst: ¡Vamos, ánimo! A ver si te vuelve algo de color a los ojos- ¡Eso es! ¿Ya estás de vuelta, amigo?
The Dark Descent#075.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#076.src: Capital! You had me quite worried for a spot, there. Do bubble about just what went on down there, mm?
The Dark Descent#076.dst: ¡Magnífico! Me has tenido bastante preocupado un rato. Anda, cuéntame qué demonios pasó ahí abajo, ¿eh?
The Dark Descent#076.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#077.src: But, you were stumbling about like a senile biddy, eyes blank as cream, and you kept muttering something about a Charon.
The Dark Descent#077.dst: Pero ibas dando tumbos como una vieja chocha, con los ojos en blanco, y no parabas de murmurar algo sobre un tal Charon.
The Dark Descent#077.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#078.src: I'm supposing he was the one who took you for a spin there? Well, you certainly haven't carked it, so I might call this operation a jolly good success!
The Dark Descent#078.dst: Supongo que fue él quien te llevó de paseo, ¿no? Bueno, desde luego no has estirado la pata, ¡así que doy la operación por todo un éxito!
The Dark Descent#078.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#079.src: Your discoveries fit in jolly-well with what we already know - and I'm convinced. To stop all these bleedin' zombos, we're going to have to go down under.
The Dark Descent#079.dst: Tus hallazgos encajan de maravilla con lo que ya sabemos, y me has convencido. Para frenar a esos malditos zombis, tendremos que bajar ahí.
The Dark Descent#079.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#080.src: Preliminary expeditions have brought back some real nasty bits, brains and such - but also some fancy-as-you-like jewellery!
The Dark Descent#080.dst: Las expediciones preliminares han traído cosas bien asquerosas, sesos y demás, ¡pero también joyas de lo más elegantes!
The Dark Descent#080.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#081.src: Take some with you, remind you what we're up against. But keep your eyes on the prize!
The Dark Descent#081.dst: Llévate algunas, que te recuerden a qué nos enfrentamos. ¡Pero no pierdas de vista lo importante!
The Dark Descent#081.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#082.src: When you're ready, I'd be chuffed to have you along again in the expedition down into the depths, old bean!
The Dark Descent#082.dst: Cuando estés listo, me encantaría contar contigo otra vez en la expedición hacia las profundidades, ¡amigo mío!
The Dark Descent#082.speaker: General Graken

The Envoy Part I#000.src: It's an independant island to the west. In fact... If you want to go...
The Envoy Part I#000.dst: Es una isla independiente al oeste. De hecho... Si quiere ir...

The Envoy Part I#001.src: The boat is down at the dock.
The Envoy Part I#001.dst: El barco está abajo, en el muelle.

The Envoy Part I#002.src: It's really hard to miss. Just hop on!
The Envoy Part I#002.dst: Es difícil no verlo. ¡Suba a bordo!

The Envoy Part I#003.src: And don't get me sterted on our architectur'!
The Envoy Part I#003.dst: ¡Y no me hagas hablar de nuestra arquitectura!

The Envoy Part I#004.src: Mo'in, Wynn traveller! Come speak to me.
The Envoy Part I#004.dst: ¡Mo'in, viajero de Wynn! Ven a hablar conmigo.

The Envoy Part I#005.src: North, you can buy weapons and potions. If you continue through the gate you will find the native Avos.
The Envoy Part I#005.dst: Al norte puede comprar armas y pociones. Si cruza la puerta, encontrará a los Avos nativos.

The Envoy Part I#006.src: West, you can buy armour, and there is another entrance to the potion shop.
The Envoy Part I#006.dst: Al oeste hay armaduras y otra entrada a la tienda de pociones.

The Envoy Part I#007.src: Something is going on at the diner, you should hurry.
The Envoy Part I#007.dst: Algo pasa en el restaurante, deberías darte prisa.

The Envoy Part I#008.src: Psst! You! Over here, behind the logs!

The Envoy Part I#009.src: Mo'in, Wynnian. Thank goodness I stopped you!
The Envoy Part I#009.dst: Mo'in, wynniano. ¡Menos mal que te he parado!

The Envoy Part I#010.src: The diner is being raided by mechs...

The Envoy Part I#011.src: You don't know, huh? Of course you don't. Let me explain.
The Envoy Part I#011.dst: ¿No lo sabes? Claro que no. Te lo explico.

The Envoy Part I#012.src: The name's Maxie by the way. Nice to meet you.
The Envoy Part I#012.dst: Por cierto, me llamo Maxie. Encantado.

The Envoy Part I#013.src: This town is usually full of life...

The Envoy Part I#014.src: Look... I know you're a stranger, but... If you want to help, talk to me.
The Envoy Part I#014.dst: Mira... sé que no eres de aquí, pero... Si quieres ayudar, habla conmigo.

The Envoy Part I#015.src: Alright, I'll open the door with electromagic...
The Envoy Part I#015.dst: Vale, abriré la puerta con electromagia...

The Envoy Part I#018.src: Look, I-I'm sorry for slowing you down. It's just...
The Envoy Part I#018.dst: Oye, s-siento retrasarte. Es solo que...

The Envoy Part I#019.src: Oh, two paths. Well, I'm not sure which way it is, so let's split up. I'll go to the right.
The Envoy Part I#019.dst: Ah, dos caminos. No sé cuál es, así que separémonos. Yo iré por la derecha.

The Envoy Part I#020.src: Mo'in. Sorry, had a problem with the-
The Envoy Part I#020.dst: Mo'in. Perdona, tuve un problema con-

The Envoy Part I#022.src: Don't worry about the guards, they're disabled for now. Follow me!
The Envoy Part I#022.dst: No te preocupes por los guardias, están desactivados. ¡Sígueme!

The Envoy Part I#023.src: We saw a mech… A new mech! It looked different like it was made in-
The Envoy Part I#023.dst: Vimos un mech... ¡Un mech nuevo! Parecía distinto, como hecho en-

The Envoy Part I#024.src: Our guest... just killed several despermechs by themselves.
The Envoy Part I#024.dst: Nuestro invitado... ha acabado con varios despermechs sin ayuda.

The Envoy Part I#025.src: Come to my house when you reach level {~}, here's a key so you get in. We must prepare to break into the factory.
The Envoy Part I#025.dst: Ven a mi casa al llegar al nivel {~}; toma una llave para entrar. Debemos preparar el asalto a la fábrica.

The Envoy Part I#031.src: I'm not from around here. In fact I am from Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#031.dst: No soy de por aquí. De hecho, soy de Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#031.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#032.src: It's an independent island to the west. In fact.. If you want to go...
The Envoy Part I#032.dst: Es una isla independiente al oeste. De hecho.. Si quiere ir...
The Envoy Part I#032.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#033.src: We're looking for Wynn representatives. Head to the C.S.S Wavebreaker down at the dock if you want to experience Corkus. Enjoy Corkus if you go!
The Envoy Part I#033.dst: Buscamos representantes de Wynn. Si quiere conocer Corkus, vaya al C.S.S Wavebreaker, abajo en el muelle. ¡Disfrute de Corkus si va!
The Envoy Part I#033.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#034.src: Speak to C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain at the {p} docks.
The Envoy Part I#034.dst: Habla con el capitán del C.S.S Wavebreaker en los muelles de {p}.

The Envoy Part I#036.src: The only boat that'll take ye directly to {p}.
The Envoy Part I#036.dst: El único barco que te lleva derecho a {p}.
The Envoy Part I#036.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#037.src: Just hop aboard and make yerself comfy.
The Envoy Part I#037.dst: Sube a bordo y ponte cómodo.
The Envoy Part I#037.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#039.src: Welcam aboard me ship, I'll bring ye directly to Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#039.dst: Bienvenido a mi barco, te llevo derecho a Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#039.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#040.src: Trust me, it is fa' more amazin than Gavel and Wynn. We even 'ave machines!
The Envoy Part I#040.dst: Créeme, es mucho más asombroso que Gavel y Wynn. ¡Hasta tenemos máquinas!
The Envoy Part I#040.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#041.src: And don't get me started on our architectur'!
The Envoy Part I#041.dst: ¡Y no me hagas hablar de nuestra arquitectura!
The Envoy Part I#041.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#042.src: Trust me, you will enjoy yer stay.
The Envoy Part I#042.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#044.dst: Habla con el delegado de Corkus

The Envoy Part I#045.src: It's such an honour to have a Wynn soldier visit our island.
The Envoy Part I#045.dst: Es un gran honor recibir a un soldado de Wynn en nuestra isla.
The Envoy Part I#045.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#046.src: We were hoping for a true envoy, but you will do.
The Envoy Part I#046.dst: Esperábamos un enviado de verdad, pero usted servirá.
The Envoy Part I#046.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#047.src: If you follow me, I'll give you a tour of the city.
The Envoy Part I#047.dst: Si me sigue, le daré una vuelta por la ciudad.
The Envoy Part I#047.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#048.src: We first arrived on Corkus {~} years ago.
The Envoy Part I#048.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#049.src: The Corkians, like you, are from Fruma originally...
The Envoy Part I#049.dst: Los corkianos, como usted, venimos de Fruma...
The Envoy Part I#049.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#051.src: Coming from Fruma, we of course knew no magic at all.
The Envoy Part I#051.dst: Al venir de Fruma, claro está, no sabíamos nada de magia.
The Envoy Part I#051.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#052.src: We soon developed our own. The rare power of Electromagic.
The Envoy Part I#052.dst: Pronto creamos la nuestra: el raro poder de la electromagia.
The Envoy Part I#052.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#053.src: It's a difficult modern branch of magic that allows us to create machines.
The Envoy Part I#053.dst: Es una rama moderna y difícil que nos permite crear máquinas.
The Envoy Part I#053.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#054.src: Ah, here already. Welcome to {p}, Capital of our island.
The Envoy Part I#054.dst: Ah, ya hemos llegado. Bienvenido a {p}, capital de nuestra isla.
The Envoy Part I#054.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#055.src: We've come a long way in a short time.
The Envoy Part I#055.dst: Hemos avanzado mucho en poco tiempo.
The Envoy Part I#055.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#056.src: Let me point out where the shops are.
The Envoy Part I#056.dst: Le indico dónde están las tiendas.
The Envoy Part I#056.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#057.src: North, you can buy weapons and potions. If you will continue through the gate you will find the native Avos.
The Envoy Part I#057.dst: Al norte puede comprar armas y pociones. Si cruza la puerta, encontrará a los Avos nativos.
The Envoy Part I#057.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#058.src: West, you can buy armor, and another entrance to the potion shop.
The Envoy Part I#058.dst: Al oeste hay armaduras y otra entrada a la tienda de pociones.
The Envoy Part I#058.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#059.src: To the south is our bank, powder shop, scrolls, and our exclusive powder exchange!
The Envoy Part I#059.dst: ¡Al sur están el banco, la tienda de polvos, los pergaminos y nuestro exclusivo intercambio de polvos!
The Envoy Part I#059.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#060.src: Oh! And speaking of the powder exchange, I'll start you off with some of these.
The Envoy Part I#060.dst: ¡Ah! Y hablando del intercambio, le doy algunos para empezar.
The Envoy Part I#060.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#061.src: Moving on... The south gate leads to {p}. On your way there, you might pass by the-
The Envoy Part I#061.dst: Sigamos... La puerta sur lleva a {p}. De camino quizá pase junto al-
The Envoy Part I#061.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#062.src: Uhm, nevermind. In fact, we have a gift for you.
The Envoy Part I#062.dst: Eh, olvídelo. De hecho, tenemos un regalo para usted.
The Envoy Part I#062.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#063.src: The Five Gears Diner is hosting any guests of the island.
The Envoy Part I#063.dst: The Five Gears Diner recibe a todos los visitantes de la isla.
The Envoy Part I#063.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#064.src: Go through the western gate and head to the diner for your free feast. Enjoy!
The Envoy Part I#064.dst: Cruce la puerta oeste y vaya al restaurante. ¡El banquete es gratis!
The Envoy Part I#064.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#065.src: Walk towards The Five Gears Diner.
The Envoy Part I#065.dst: Dirígete a The Five Gears Diner.

The Envoy Part I#069.src: Mo'in, Wynnian. Thank goodness I stopped you.
The Envoy Part I#069.dst: Mo'in, wynniano. Menos mal que te he parado.
The Envoy Part I#069.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#070.src: The diner is being raided by mechs..
The Envoy Part I#070.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#071.src: Before we do anything, I have to explain what's happening here...
The Envoy Part I#071.dst: Antes de nada, tengo que explicarte qué pasa aquí...
The Envoy Part I#071.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#072.src: My name is Maxie by the way. Nice to meet you.
The Envoy Part I#072.dst: Por cierto, me llamo Maxie. Encantado de conocerte.
The Envoy Part I#072.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#073.src: This town is usually full of life.
The Envoy Part I#073.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#075.src: Our creations have rebelled against us.
The Envoy Part I#075.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#076.src: They now raid towns for parts.
The Envoy Part I#076.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#077.src: Mechs are getting increasingly more desperate.
The Envoy Part I#077.dst: Los mechs están cada vez más desesperados.
The Envoy Part I#077.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#078.src: Even in rust, they are still powerful.
The Envoy Part I#078.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#079.src: We have tried to remove them but the factory always makes more.
The Envoy Part I#079.dst: Hemos intentado eliminarlos, pero la fábrica siempre hace más.
The Envoy Part I#079.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#080.src: It is Corkus' greatest failure. It must be stopped.
The Envoy Part I#080.dst: Es el mayor fracaso de Corkus. Hay que detenerlo.
The Envoy Part I#080.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#082.src: I can try to open the vent to sneak in.
The Envoy Part I#082.dst: Puedo abrir la rejilla y colarnos.
The Envoy Part I#082.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#083.src: I know you are a stranger, but talk to me if you want to help.
The Envoy Part I#083.dst: Sé que no eres de aquí, pero habla conmigo si quieres ayudar.
The Envoy Part I#083.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#086.src: Alright, I'll open the door with electromagic.
The Envoy Part I#086.dst: Vale, abriré la puerta con electromagia.
The Envoy Part I#086.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#088.src: Gah! I can't even do the most basic spell!
The Envoy Part I#088.dst: ¡Agh! ¡No me sale ni el hechizo más básico!
The Envoy Part I#088.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#091.src: I'm sorry for being useless in front of you...
The Envoy Part I#091.dst: Siento ser un inútil delante de ti...
The Envoy Part I#091.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#092.src: Electromagic is different from your magic.. I'm not very good at it...
The Envoy Part I#092.dst: La electromagia no es como vuestra magia.. No se me da bien...
The Envoy Part I#092.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#095.src: Open the door and exit the ducts.
The Envoy Part I#095.dst: Abre la puerta y sal de los conductos.

The Envoy Part I#100.src: Mo'in. Sorry had a problem with the-
The Envoy Part I#100.dst: Mo'in. Perdona, tuve un problema con-
The Envoy Part I#100.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#101.src: ...What in the world is that mech on top of the pile of scrap over there?!
The Envoy Part I#101.dst: ...¿¡Qué demonios es ese mech de ahí, sobre la chatarra!?
The Envoy Part I#101.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#102.src: That is definitely not a regular despermech... It looks brand new!
The Envoy Part I#102.dst: Ese no es un despermech normal... ¡Parece nuevecito!
The Envoy Part I#102.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#103.src: One of those hasn't been seen since the factory was running...
The Envoy Part I#103.dst: No se ve uno de esos desde que la fábrica funcionaba...
The Envoy Part I#103.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#104.src: We need to do something! I'll clear the path for you. That's the only thing I can do, I... hurt my... leg.
The Envoy Part I#104.dst: ¡Hay que hacer algo! Yo te abro camino. Es lo único que puedo hacer, me... hice daño... en la pierna.
The Envoy Part I#104.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#108.src: Are you okay? Good. Meet me at the entrance where we met. We need to report to {p}!
The Envoy Part I#108.dst: ¿Estás bien? Bien. Nos vemos en la entrada donde nos conocimos. ¡Hay que informar a {p}!
The Envoy Part I#108.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#109.src: Talk to Maxie at the entrance to The Five Gears Diner.
The Envoy Part I#109.dst: Habla con Maxie en la entrada de The Five Gears Diner.

The Envoy Part I#110.src: Don't worry about the guards, they are disabled for now. Follow me.
The Envoy Part I#110.dst: No te preocupes por los guardias, están desactivados. Sígueme.
The Envoy Part I#110.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#111.src: I know a shortcut, we'll be in {p} in no time.
The Envoy Part I#111.dst: Conozco un atajo, llegaremos a {p} enseguida.
The Envoy Part I#111.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#112.src: Talk to Maxie and Corkus Delegate in {p}.
The Envoy Part I#112.dst: Habla con Maxie y el delegado de Corkus en {p}.

The Envoy Part I#114.src: Beltrude, we have a problem! The factory is running!
