The Feathers Fly Part II#415.src: Maybe you can help whoever lost their invitation. Maybe you can steal it. I'm not the boss of you! Now, shoo! Don't step on my plants!
The Feathers Fly Part II#415.dst: A lo mejor puedes ayudar a quien perdió su invitación. O robarla. ¡Yo no soy tu jefe! ¡Y ahora, largo! ¡No pises mis plantas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#415.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#417.src: I mean, yeah, anyone can try getting one...
The Feathers Fly Part II#417.dst: O sea, sí, cualquiera puede intentarlo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#417.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#418.src: You have to be real impressive though. Like, I don't wanna be mean, but you ain't gonna cut it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#418.dst: Pero hay que ser impresionante de verdad. No quiero ser borde, pero no vas a dar la talla.
The Feathers Fly Part II#418.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#419.src: If you really want to, the receptionist is in the castle. Just go east and don't stop.
The Feathers Fly Part II#419.dst: Si de verdad quieres, la recepcionista está en el castillo. Ve al este y no pares.
The Feathers Fly Part II#419.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#420.src: Lemme tell ya though, with all the crazy lads goin' in, she's never in a good mood.
The Feathers Fly Part II#420.dst: Eso sí, te aviso: con la de locos que entran, nunca está de buen humor.
The Feathers Fly Part II#420.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#421.src: Oh, hi there. Whatcha lookin' for? ...An audience? What?
The Feathers Fly Part II#421.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#422.src: Urgh... Let me guess what your machine is. Is it a weapon? What does it shoot? Sand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#422.dst: Uf... Déjame adivinar qué es tu máquina. ¿Un arma? ¿Qué dispara? ¿Arena?
The Feathers Fly Part II#422.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#423.src: Sorry, it's just a li'l annoying. If you really want an audience, there is a receptionist for that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#423.dst: Perdona, es que cansa un poco. Si de verdad quieres una audiencia, hay una recepcionista para eso.
The Feathers Fly Part II#423.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#424.src: Ask others. I ain't the one for that kind of stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part II#424.dst: Pregunta a otros. Yo no llevo ese tipo de cosas.
The Feathers Fly Part II#424.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#425.src: Oh, are you interested in getting an audience too?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#425.dst: ¡¿Ah, tú también quieres conseguir una audiencia?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#425.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#426.src: I've been forgin' away the greatest robotized swords the world shall ever see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#426.dst: ¡Llevo forjando las mejores espadas robotizadas que verá el mundo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#426.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#427.src: Look, ya gotta go up to the receptionist and impress her like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#427.dst: ¡Mira, tienes que ir a ver a la recepcionista y dejarla flipando!
The Feathers Fly Part II#427.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#428.src: It's great! Worst-case scenario, you die, but with enough luck only your arm gets broken!
The Feathers Fly Part II#428.dst: ¡Es genial! En el peor caso mueres, ¡pero con suerte solo te rompes un brazo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#428.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#429.src: She's inside the castle to the east, just go through and keep walkin', you'll get there eventually!
The Feathers Fly Part II#429.dst: ¡Está dentro del castillo del este! Cruza y sigue andando, ¡al final llegas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#429.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#430.src: Hey, what's up? I do have somethin'!
The Feathers Fly Part II#430.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#431.src: Hmm... So we can go see a receptionist and they just might grant us an audience. Got it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#431.dst: Mmm... Así que podemos ir a ver a una recepcionista y quizá nos conceda una audiencia. ¡Entendido!
The Feathers Fly Part II#431.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#432.src: So we go in, show her how cool we are, and I guess that'd work, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#432.dst: Entramos, le enseñamos lo molones que somos y con eso bastará, ¿no?
The Feathers Fly Part II#432.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#433.src: That's fine, I'm sure you just have to show her your resolve or something.
The Feathers Fly Part II#433.dst: No pasa nada, seguro que solo hay que demostrarle tu determinación o algo así.
The Feathers Fly Part II#433.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#434.src: Oh, right, I had something too!
The Feathers Fly Part II#434.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#435.src: There's apparently some sort of shady dude selling audience invitations!
The Feathers Fly Part II#435.dst: ¡Por lo visto hay un tipo turbio que vende invitaciones a audiencias!
The Feathers Fly Part II#435.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#436.src: I believe it's in the castle to the east, on the first left? Though...
The Feathers Fly Part II#436.dst: Creo que está en el castillo del este, ¿primera a la izquierda? Aunque...
The Feathers Fly Part II#436.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#437.src: I'm sure there are other ways to go about this. Like that receptionist, for one! So she's in the last room of the castle, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#437.dst: Seguro que hay otras formas de lograrlo. ¡La recepcionista, por ejemplo! Está en la última sala del castillo, ¿no?
The Feathers Fly Part II#437.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#438.src: In fact, if you want me to follow you there, I can do that! Just tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#438.dst: De hecho, ¡si quieres que te acompañe, puedo! ¡Solo dímelo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#438.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#440.src: Hey kid. An audience, huh? Eheheh... I do have an idea...
The Feathers Fly Part II#440.dst: Eh, chaval. Una audiencia, ¿eh? Je je je... Se me ocurre algo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#440.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#441.src: Y'know, it's hard to get one... Reeeaaal hard... But I know a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#441.dst: ¿Sabes? Es difícil conseguir una... Muuuuy difícil... Pero sé cómo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#441.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#442.src: It's really, really simple... Ya just gotta hand me [{~} Emerald Blocks] and I'll work it out!
The Feathers Fly Part II#442.dst: Es muy, muy sencillo... ¡Solo tienes que darme [{~} bloques de esmeralda] y yo me encargo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#442.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#443.src: ...eheheh... Well, you know where to find me if you're up to it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#443.dst: ...je je je... ¡Bueno, ya sabes dónde encontrarme si te animas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#443.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#444.src: So you found that weird dealer? Surely you're not thinking of...
The Feathers Fly Part II#444.dst: ¿Así que has encontrado a ese vendedor raro? No estarás pensando en...
The Feathers Fly Part II#444.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#445.src: I mean... Actually, that'd be a way to get an audience, for sure. What does he want?
The Feathers Fly Part II#445.dst: O sea... la verdad es que sí sería una forma de conseguir una audiencia. ¿Qué quiere?
The Feathers Fly Part II#445.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#446.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks]? Is that a lot? I'm not human, y'know! Well, anyway!
The Feathers Fly Part II#446.dst: ¿[{~} bloques de esmeralda]? ¿Es mucho? ¡No soy humana! ¡En fin!
The Feathers Fly Part II#446.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#447.src: Buy that if you want, but I'm certain there are other ways to obtain an audience. You don't really have to buy that.

The Feathers Fly Part II#447.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#448.src: Well, I'll just... Keep looking then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#448.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#449.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#449.dst: ¡Muchas gracias! Un placer hacer negocios contigo, je je... ¡Suerte!
The Feathers Fly Part II#449.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#451.src: Seriously what is it with you people! Can't I be left alone for FIVE MINUTES?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#451.dst: ¡¿Pero qué os pasa a todos?! ¡¿No puedo estar tranquila CINCO MINUTOS?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#451.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#452.src: Oh excuuuuse me, did someone tell you to come here? Are you going to "impress" me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#452.dst: Ay, perdoooona, ¿te ha dicho alguien que vengas? ¿Vas a «impresionarme»?
The Feathers Fly Part II#452.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#453.src: Well, let me tell ya', you FAILED.
The Feathers Fly Part II#453.dst: Pues te lo digo ya: has FALLADO.
The Feathers Fly Part II#453.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#454.src: Come back when you actually have something of interest. Goodbye.
The Feathers Fly Part II#454.dst: Vuelve cuando tengas algo de interés de verdad. Adiós.
The Feathers Fly Part II#454.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#455.src: Oh? You found the dealer as well as one other way to get an audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#455.dst: ¿Ah? ¿Has encontrado al vendedor y otra forma de conseguir audiencia?
The Feathers Fly Part II#455.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#456.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks], huh? No clue if that's a lot. I'd say we should try your other way! What is it?
The Feathers Fly Part II#456.dst: ¿[{~} bloques de esmeralda], eh? Ni idea de si es mucho. ¡Yo digo que probemos tu otra opción! ¿Cuál es?
The Feathers Fly Part II#456.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#457.src: There's a receptionist for audiences? How convenient! We should go talk to her then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#457.dst: ¿Hay una recepcionista para las audiencias? ¡Qué cómodo! ¡Pues vamos a hablar con ella!
The Feathers Fly Part II#457.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#458.src: It's... Apparently really hard? Oh... Well, that's not helpful. Maybe we can still give it a go?
The Feathers Fly Part II#458.dst: Y... ¿parece que es muy difícil? Oh... Pues eso no ayuda. ¿Podemos intentarlo igualmente?
The Feathers Fly Part II#458.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#459.dst: Cómprale a ese vendedor raro si quieres, pero también deberíamos ir a ver a la recepcionista. Dime si quieres que te acompañe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#459.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#460.src: Alright, let's go then. I'd say we should avoid the dealer, I definitely don't want to get on the bad side of the law!
The Feathers Fly Part II#460.dst: Vale, pues vamos. Yo diría que evitemos al vendedor, ¡no quiero problemas con la ley!
The Feathers Fly Part II#460.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#461.src: So, that dealer is in there, huh? Let's make sure to keep going. And avoid that place.
The Feathers Fly Part II#461.dst: Así que el vendedor está ahí dentro, ¿eh? Sigamos adelante. Y evitemos ese sitio.
The Feathers Fly Part II#461.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#462.src: Wait wait wait what did I just tell yo- I'll just make myself small...
The Feathers Fly Part II#462.dst: Espera espera espera qué acabo de dec- Me haré pequeñita...
The Feathers Fly Part II#462.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#463.src: 'ey, it's [{~} Emerald Blocks] or nothin'! Don't worry, I can get you two an audience! Your lady's quite shy I see! Believe me, I understand your struggle!
The Feathers Fly Part II#463.dst: ¡Eh, son [{~} bloques de esmeralda] o nada! ¡Tranquilo, os consigo audiencia a los dos! ¡Tu chica es tímida, ya veo! ¡Créeme, te entiendo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#463.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#464.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#464.dst: ¡Muchas gracias! Un placer hacer negocios contigo, je je... ¡Suerte!
The Feathers Fly Part II#464.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#467.dst: Vaya. No puedo dejar de mirarte... Qué armadura tan magnífica.
The Feathers Fly Part II#467.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#468.src: Well sir, or miss, if you tried to impress me, you certainly succeeded.
The Feathers Fly Part II#468.dst: Pues señor, o señorita, si quería impresionarme, desde luego lo ha logrado.
The Feathers Fly Part II#468.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#469.src: Why thank you! I reckon you will search for an available time regarding an audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#469.dst: ¡Pues gracias! ¿Supongo que buscará un hueco libre para una audiencia?
The Feathers Fly Part II#469.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#470.src: Well, you two seem very lucky, there's an available slot soon!
The Feathers Fly Part II#470.dst: ¡Pues parece que tienen mucha suerte, hay un hueco libre pronto!
The Feathers Fly Part II#470.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#471.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's available at that time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#471.dst: Espero que mañana por la mañana les venga bien, porque el Consejo está libre a esa hora.
The Feathers Fly Part II#471.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#472.dst: ¿Les parece bien? Se lo merecen, ust
The Feathers Fly Part II#472.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#473.src: Oh, please don't mention the word "audience" to me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#473.dst: ¡Ay, por favor, no me menciones la palabra «audiencia»!
The Feathers Fly Part II#473.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#474.src: I-I just got my invitation stolen! I can't believe this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#474.dst: ¡M-me acaban de robar la invitación! ¡No me lo puedo creer!
The Feathers Fly Part II#474.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#475.src: I asked around, obviously no one knows anything! I'm trying to look for it...
The Feathers Fly Part II#475.dst: He preguntado por ahí y nadie sabe nada, ¡claro! Sigo buscándola...
The Feathers Fly Part II#475.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#476.src: This inn has been under renovation for a while now... It's quite the spot to hide a stolen item!
The Feathers Fly Part II#476.dst: Esta posada lleva un tiempo en obras... ¡Menudo sitio para esconder algo robado!
The Feathers Fly Part II#476.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#477.src: But nooo, of course it's locked! Though it looks like we can access it from the back...
The Feathers Fly Part II#477.dst: ¡Pero nooo, claro, está cerrada! Aunque parece que se puede entrar por detrás...
The Feathers Fly Part II#477.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#478.src: It looks like there's some shady alleyway over there... Maybe...
The Feathers Fly Part II#478.dst: Parece que ahí hay un callejón oscuro... Quizá...
The Feathers Fly Part II#478.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#479.dst: Uf, perdona por quejarme tanto. Ni siquiera te conozco. Seguro que por ahí hay un pasadizo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#479.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#480.dst: Espera espera espera, seguro que algo has pillado, pero prefiero no hacer nada turbio en el pueblo. Haz lo que quieras, yo me quedo por el centro.

The Feathers Fly Part II#481.src: Let's hope we don't get rejected this time around.
The Feathers Fly Part II#481.dst: Esperemos que esta vez no nos echen.
The Feathers Fly Part II#481.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#482.dst: Así que el vendedor está ahí dentro, ¿eh? Sigamos adelante. Y evitemos ese sitio.
The Feathers Fly Part II#482.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#483.dst: ¡No me creo que estemos avanzando de verdad! ¡Qué emoción!
The Feathers Fly Part II#483.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#484.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#485.dst: Nos vemos cerca de la entrada norte si quieres que te lleve. O si prefieres andar, ¡vete directo al Taller!
The Feathers Fly Part II#485.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#486.src: Help Ava operate the machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#486.dst: Ayuda a Ava a manejar la máquina en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#487.src: Hey! I'm back in my original clothes. It feels so much better...
The Feathers Fly Part II#487.dst: ¡Eh! Ya llevo mi ropa de siempre. Se está mucho mejor así...
The Feathers Fly Part II#487.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#488.src: Remember that hill next to the Workshop? We'll work there again. Tell me when you're ready for the lift.
The Feathers Fly Part II#488.dst: ¿Te acuerdas de la colina junto al Taller? Volvemos a trabajar allí. Dime cuando quieras que te lleve.
The Feathers Fly Part II#488.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#490.src: There we are! Talk to me and I'll tell you all about the changes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#490.dst: ¡Ya estamos! ¡Háblame y te cuento todos los cambios!
The Feathers Fly Part II#490.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#491.src: Do you remember how it worked last time? Don't worry, it's still fairly similar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#491.dst: ¿Recuerdas cómo iba la última vez? Tranquilo, es bastante parecido.
The Feathers Fly Part II#491.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#492.src: Once again, you'll have a remote. Simply click in the right orders. However!
The Feathers Fly Part II#492.dst: Otra vez tendrás un mando. Pulsa en el orden correcto. ¡Pero ojo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#492.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#493.src: Now, the machine requires a bit more... Dexterity.
The Feathers Fly Part II#493.dst: Ahora la máquina exige un poco más de... destreza.
The Feathers Fly Part II#493.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#494.src: If you're really quick, the machine will charge up real fast!
The Feathers Fly Part II#494.dst: ¡Si eres muy rápido, la máquina se cargará superrápido!
The Feathers Fly Part II#494.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#495.src: If you're too slow however, it'd take a bit of time to charge up...
The Feathers Fly Part II#495.dst: Pero si vas muy lento, tardará un rato en cargarse...
The Feathers Fly Part II#495.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#496.src: Time is still limited too. Don't worry, this is practice for the Council! Tell me once you're ready!
The Feathers Fly Part II#496.dst: El tiempo también es limitado. ¡Tranquilo, esto es práctica para el Consejo! ¡Avísame cuando estés listo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#496.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#503.src: You gotta admit, this has to be revolutionary!
The Feathers Fly Part II#503.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#504.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#505.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#506.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#507.src: I'll drop you off around the city outskirts. See ya!

The Feathers Fly Part II#507.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#509.src: Meet Ava to start the audience with the Corkian council at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#509.dst: Reúnete con Ava para empezar la audiencia con el Consejo corkiano en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#510.src: This is it, then. {u}, I'm... scared.

The Feathers Fly Part II#510.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#965.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#966.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#967.src: You know, your kind has always been...
The Feathers Fly Part II#967.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#968.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#969.src: And you, you're fiddling not only with nature, but also with OUR things.

The Feathers Fly Part II#969.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#970.src: Somehow, you're able to control electromagic? I guess it's not exclusive to humans, then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#970.dst: ¿Y resulta que puedes controlar la electromagia? Pues no será exclusiva de los humanos.
The Feathers Fly Part II#970.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#971.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#972.src: I think... I finally get it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#972.dst: Creo que... por fin lo entiendo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#972.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#973.src: I do, really. The truth is...
The Feathers Fly Part II#973.dst: De verdad. La verdad es que...
The Feathers Fly Part II#973.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#975.dst: Todos. Y cada. Uno de vosotros.
The Feathers Fly Part II#975.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#976.src: I come up to you with an incredible breakthrough, and you can't even see past my feathers.
The Feathers Fly Part II#976.dst: Vengo a vosotros con un avance increíble y no sois capaces de ver más allá de mis plumas.
The Feathers Fly Part II#976.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#977.src: Alright, I've heard enough. That's it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#977.dst: Vale, ya he oído bastante. Se acabó.
The Feathers Fly Part II#977.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#979.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#980.src: What just... Everyone! Dismissed! What is that girl doing?! I'll go after her! Nodise, Maxie, you go and help Sybil!
The Feathers Fly Part II#980.dst: Pero qué... ¡Se levanta la sesión! ¡¿Qué hace esa chica?! ¡Voy tras ella! ¡Nodise, Maxie, ayudad a Sybil!
The Feathers Fly Part II#980.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#982.src: Well... Mo'in, {u}. I was thinking about catching up with you and all after the audience, but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#982.dst: Pues... Buenas, {u}. Pensaba ponerme al día contigo después de la audiencia, pero...
The Feathers Fly Part II#982.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#983.src: I guess we don't really have time for that now, do we?
The Feathers Fly Part II#983.dst: Supongo que ahora no tenemos tiempo para eso, ¿no?
The Feathers Fly Part II#983.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#984.src: Wow, Maxie, great time management you got there!
The Feathers Fly Part II#984.dst: Vaya, Maxie, ¡qué bien gestionas el tiempo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#984.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#985.src: Sybil... This is no time to quarrel.
The Feathers Fly Part II#985.dst: Sybil... No es momento de discutir.
The Feathers Fly Part II#985.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#986.src: Have you seen what just happened? I'm sure even now he'll keep defending the Avos!
The Feathers Fly Part II#986.dst: ¿Has visto lo que acaba de pasar? ¡Seguro que hasta ahora sigue defendiendo a los Avos!
The Feathers Fly Part II#986.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#987.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#988.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#989.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#990.src: Prevent Ava from making a mistake at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#991.src: Well look who decided to show up. I thought you would've fled by now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#991.dst: Vaya, mira quién ha aparecido. Creía que ya habrías huido.
The Feathers Fly Part II#991.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#992.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1075.dst: Quiero, pero... ¿viste cómo estaba durante la audiencia?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1075.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1076.src: I can't trust you, {u}. There's no way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1076.dst: No puedo fiarme de ti, {u}. Ni hablar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1076.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1077.src: I regret this... I shouldn't have acted this way, this wasn't supposed to happen, I...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1077.dst: Me arrepiento... No debí actuar así, esto no tenía que pasar, yo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1077.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1078.src: I can't stay, {u}. The president's one thing, but the others...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1078.dst: No puedo quedarme, {u}. La presidenta es una cosa, pero los demás...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1078.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1079.src: {u}!! I'm sure Efena told you already, no time to talk!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1079.dst: ¡¡{u}!! Seguro que Efena ya te lo ha dicho, ¡no hay tiempo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1079.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1080.src: Apparently, there's something up there! Try to reach the top! There are strange plants around, see if that helps!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1080.dst: ¡Por lo visto hay algo ahí arriba! ¡Intenta llegar a la cima! Hay plantas raras por ahí, ¡a ver si sirven!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1080.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1081.src: ...You're here. Here to fix my own mistakes, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1081.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1082.src: And then, here to take me, I suppose. Right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1082.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1083.src: Y'know, I noticed you always were one to follow orders. Well, what you're lookin' for is on top of the plant.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1083.dst: ¿Sabes? Siempre me pareciste de los que siguen órdenes. Bueno, lo que buscas está en lo alto de la planta.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1083.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1084.src: No point fighting back, even though I could totally manage. I feel bad for that other girl now. Go, then... Stop my machine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1084.dst: No tiene sentido resistirse, aunque podría de sobra. Ahora me da pena esa otra chica. Ve, entonces... Para mi máquina.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1084.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1085.src: Woah! You did something! You should try that again!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1085.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1086.src: I - I really didn't want this. I wanted to help people, {u}! Not... not...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1086.dst: Yo- yo no quería esto. ¡Quería ayudar a la gente, {u}! No... no...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1086.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1087.src: I sure have impressed everyone. So I guess not all's lost, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1087.dst: Desde luego he impresionado a todos. Así que no está todo perdido, ¿eh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1087.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1088.src: I'll be the talk of an entire nation!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1088.dst: ¡Seré la comidilla de todo un país!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1088.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1089.src: Gosh, I really am going crazy aren't I?...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1089.dst: Madre mía, me estoy volviendo loca, ¿verdad?...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1089.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1090.src: I just... I don't know what to do... I reached rock bottom...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1090.dst: Es que... no sé qué hacer... He tocado fondo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1090.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1091.src: I screwed up with my people, then with the humans, then...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1091.dst: La fastidié con los míos, luego con los humanos, y luego...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1091.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1094.src: Could you tell her something for me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1094.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1095.src: Tell her that... I'm not that mad.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1095.dst: Dile que... no estoy tan enfadada.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1095.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1096.src: This... While destructive, it's impressive, and...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1096.dst: Esto... aunque destructivo, es impresionante, y...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1096.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1097.src: Whatever, just tell her! People will think I lost my mind, it's fine!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1097.dst: Da igual, ¡tú díselo! Pensarán que he perdido la cabeza, ¡me da igual!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1097.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1098.src: I'd like to talk to her. I assume she'll just flee, but... You should try!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1098.dst: Me gustaría hablar con ella. Supongo que huirá, pero... ¡inténtalo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1098.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1099.src: ...What? Do you have anythin' to tell me before I leave?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1099.dst: ...¿Qué? ¿Tienes algo que decirme antes de que me vaya?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1099.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1100.src: Huh?! The president herself isn't too mad at me? What??
The Feathers Fly Part II#1100.dst: ¡¿Eh?! ¿La presidenta en persona no está muy enfadada conmigo? ¿¿Qué??
The Feathers Fly Part II#1100.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1101.src: Are you trying to make me get down and get arrested? You know I... I can't believe you...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1101.dst: ¿Intentas que baje para que me detengan? Sabes que yo... No me puedo creer que tú...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1101.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1102.dst: Quiero, pero... ¿viste cómo estaba durante la audiencia?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1102.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1105.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1108.src: Hmpf. Did take that thing down?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1108.speaker: Grant

The Feathers Fly Part II#1111.src: Oh she better be around here!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1111.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1112.src: Wait, under the rubble, I see something!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1112.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1116.src: Look, I'll give you a mission. Find Ava with {u}, and tell her this...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1116.dst: Mira, te doy una misión. Encuentra a Ava con {u} y dile esto...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1116.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1118.src: Mo'in, {u}! You're fine! I'm so glad!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1118.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1119.src: You're something of a hero, y'know?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1119.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1120.src: That was some really nice job back there! But now...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1120.dst: ¡Menudo trabajazo el de antes! Pero ahora...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1120.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1121.src: Well, the town's fine, but... I got tasked to find Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1121.dst: Bueno, el pueblo está bien, pero... me han encargado encontrar a Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1121.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1122.src: From what I've gathered, you worked with her and know where to go, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1122.dst: Por lo que sé, trabajaste con ella y sabes adónde ir, ¿verdad?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1122.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1123.src: Oh, you told Ava about Efena? And she... she fled. Right. Well, I'm not surprised!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1123.dst: ¿Le contaste a Ava lo de Efena? Y ella... huyó. Ya. ¡Bueno, no me sorprende!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1123.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1124.src: Trust me, we want to help that poor Avo. Let's just find her, alright?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1124.dst: Créeme, queremos ayudar a esa pobre Avo. Vamos a encontrarla, ¿vale?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1124.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1125.src: Tell me whenever you're ready, and we'll go.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1125.dst: Avísame cuando estés listo y nos vamos.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1125.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1128.src: Find Ava at the Workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#1128.dst: Encuentra a Ava en el Taller en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#1130.src: The Avos chief did mention her once, but this place is crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1130.dst: El jefe Avos la mencionó una vez, ¡pero este sitio es una locura!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1130.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1131.src: You... I assume you're here to take me.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1131.dst: Vosotros... Venís a por mí, supongo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1131.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1132.src: Go ahead, then. Do it. I don't have anything to lose anymore. I've already lost everything.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1132.dst: Pues adelante. Hacedlo. Ya no tengo nada que perder. Ya lo he perdido todo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1132.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1134.src: I don't want your pity. I have no one. You're making this harder for yourself.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1134.dst: No quiero tu lástima. No tengo a nadie. Solo te lo pones más difícil.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1134.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1135.src: The president didn't sentence you to death or anything... Quite the opposite, actually.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1135.dst: La presidenta no te ha condenado a muerte ni nada... Más bien todo lo contrario.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1135.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1136.src: What do you mean? Why should I trust you?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1136.dst: ¿Qué quieres decir? ¿Por qué debería fiarme de ti?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1136.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1138.src: Don't bother, Maxie. I'll explain myself.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1138.dst: Déjalo, Maxie. Ya me explico yo.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1139.src: Nice place. I can clearly see how our culture got to you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1139.dst: Bonito sitio. Se nota bien cuánto te ha calado nuestra cultura.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1139.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1140.src: So you're here. Are you... Forgiving me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1140.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1141.src: Oh, "forgive" is a really strong word, Ava. Look.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1141.dst: Ay, «perdonar» es una palabra muy fuerte, Ava. Mira.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1141.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1142.src: I do believe we can all learn a thing or two about this. Ava...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1142.dst: Creo que todos podemos aprender algo de esto. Ava...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1142.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1143.src: You broke the law, and as such, you're not allowed in town. Ya understand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1143.dst: Has infringido la ley, así que no puedes entrar en el pueblo. ¿Entendido?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1143.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1144.src: First the Avos, then you, huh. So it's come full circle.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1144.dst: Primero los Avos, ahora vosotros. Vaya, el círculo se cierra.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1144.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1145.src: Look, that machine of yours is impressive. I'm not lying. You're talented.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1145.dst: Mira, esa máquina tuya es impresionante. No miento. Tienes talento.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1145.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1146.src: But you've definitely made quite the mistake. I did too.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1146.dst: Pero desde luego has cometido un buen error. Yo también.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1146.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1147.src: I guess you and I really learnt what acting in the heat of the moment means, huh.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1147.dst: Supongo que tú y yo hemos aprendido de verdad lo que es actuar en caliente, ¿eh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1147.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1148.src: I have some sort of... Compromise. For us. Maxie?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1148.dst: Tengo una especie de... acuerdo. Para las dos. ¿Maxie?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1148.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1149.src: Yeah, I'm... interested in working with you. Learning from you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1149.dst: Sí, me... interesa trabajar contigo. Aprender de ti.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1149.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1150.src: You're clearly better at Electromagic than I, so...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1150.dst: Está claro que se te da mejor la electromagia que a mí, así que...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1150.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1151.src: I'm willing to provide you with what you need. Help you out from time to time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1151.dst: Estoy dispuesto a darte lo que necesites. Echarte una mano de vez en cuando.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1151.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1152.src: You've been alone for so long, Ava. I'm lending you Maxie!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1152.dst: Has estado sola mucho tiempo, Ava. ¡Te presto a Maxie!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1152.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1153.src: Hey, don't say it like that!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1153.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1154.src: *chuckles* I'm kidding. The rest of the council isn't aware yet.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1154.dst: *se ríe* Es broma. El resto del Consejo aún no lo sabe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1154.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1155.src: They're not gonna like this, but I'll handle it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1155.dst: No les va a gustar, pero yo me encargo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1155.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1156.src: You know I can't kill you. Can you imagine how the Avos would take it? Even though you're banished...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1156.dst: Sabes que no puedo matarte. ¿Te imaginas cómo se lo tomarían los Avos? Aunque estés desterrada...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1156.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1157.src: But I don't want to either. As for you, {u}...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1157.dst: Pero tampoco quiero. Y en cuanto a ti, {u}...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1157.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1158.src: I'll give you some stuff. I can't imagine how things would've gone if it weren't for you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1158.dst: Te voy a dar unas cosas. No me imagino cómo habría acabado esto de no ser por ti.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1158.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1159.src: Now, you're banished from everyone Ava. I know that's no happy ending.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1159.dst: Bueno, Ava, quedas desterrada de todo. Sé que no es un final feliz.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1159.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1160.src: But that would've been too easy, don't ya think?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1160.dst: Pero eso habría sido demasiado fácil, ¿no crees?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1160.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1161.src: Maybe later, you'll get your happy ending. But you can settle with not being alone anymore, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1161.dst: Quizá más adelante tengas tu final feliz. Pero de momento te vale con no estar sola, ¿verdad?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1161.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, maybe I'll stop by sometimes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.dst: Adiós, Ava. Quién sabe, quizá me pase por aquí de vez en cuando.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.src: ...? If you stop by the Workshop later, maybe I'll have some things for you as well.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.dst: ...? Si te pasas luego por el Taller, quizá tenga algunas cosas para ti también.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1194.dst: Te voy a dar unas cosas. No me imagino cómo habría acabado esto de no ser por ti.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1194.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1195.src: Now, you're banished from everyone Ava. I know that's no happy ending.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1195.dst: Bueno, Ava, quedas desterrada de todo. Sé que no es un final feliz.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1195.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1196.src: But that would've been too easy, don't ya think?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1196.dst: Pero eso habría sido demasiado fácil, ¿no crees?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1196.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1197.src: Maybe later, you'll get your happy ending. But you can settle with not being alone anymore, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1197.dst: Quizá más adelante tengas tu final feliz. Pero de momento te vale con no estar sola, ¿verdad?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1197.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1198.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, maybe I'll stop by sometimes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1198.dst: Adiós, Ava. Quién sabe, quizá me pase por aquí de vez en cuando.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1198.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1199.src: ...? If you stop by the Workshop later, maybe I'll have some things for you as well.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1199.dst: ...? Si te pasas luego por el Taller, quizá tenga algunas cosas para ti también.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1199.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1202.src: The Avos chief did mention her once, but this place is crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1202.dst: El jefe Avos la mencionó una vez, ¡pero este sitio es una locura!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1202.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1203.src: You... I assume you're here to take me.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1203.dst: Vosotros... Venís a por mí, supongo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1203.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1204.src: Go ahead, then. Do it. I don't have anything to lose anymore. I've already lost everything.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1204.dst: Pues adelante. Hacedlo. Ya no tengo nada que perder. Ya lo he perdido todo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1204.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1206.src: I don't want your pity. I have no one. You're making this harder for yourself.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1206.dst: No quiero tu lástima. No tengo a nadie. Solo te lo pones más difícil.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1206.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1207.src: The president didn't sentence you to death or anything... Quite the opposite, actually.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1207.dst: La presidenta no te ha condenado a muerte ni nada... Más bien todo lo contrario.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1207.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1208.src: What do you mean? Why should I trust you?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1208.dst: ¿Qué quieres decir? ¿Por qué debería fiarme de ti?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1208.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1210.src: Don't bother, Maxie. I'll explain myself.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1210.dst: Déjalo, Maxie. Ya me explico yo.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1211.src: Nice place. I can clearly see how our culture got to you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1211.dst: Bonito sitio. Se nota bien cuánto te ha calado nuestra cultura.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1211.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1212.src: So you're here. Are you... Forgiving me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1212.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1213.src: Oh, "forgive" is a really strong word, Ava. Look.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1213.dst: Ay, «perdonar» es una palabra muy fuerte, Ava. Mira.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1213.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1214.src: I do believe we can all learn a thing or two about this. Ava...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1214.dst: Creo que todos podemos aprender algo de esto. Ava...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1214.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1215.src: You broke the law, and as such, you're not allowed in town. Ya understand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1215.dst: Has infringido la ley, así que no puedes entrar en el pueblo. ¿Entendido?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1215.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1216.src: First the Avos, then you, huh. So it's come full circle.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1216.dst: Primero los Avos, ahora vosotros. Vaya, el círculo se cierra.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1216.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1217.src: Look, that machine of yours is impressive. I'm not lying. You're talented.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1217.dst: Mira, esa máquina tuya es impresionante. No miento. Tienes talento.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1217.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1218.src: But you've definitely made quite the mistake. I did too.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1218.dst: Pero desde luego has cometido un buen error. Yo también.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1218.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1219.src: I guess you and I really learnt what acting in the heat of the moment means, huh.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1219.dst: Supongo que tú y yo hemos aprendido de verdad lo que es actuar en caliente, ¿eh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1219.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1220.src: I have some sort of... Compromise. For us. Maxie?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1220.dst: Tengo una especie de... acuerdo. Para las dos. ¿Maxie?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1220.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1221.src: Yeah, I'm... interested in working with you. Learning from you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1221.dst: Sí, me... interesa trabajar contigo. Aprender de ti.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1221.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1222.src: You're clearly better at Electromagic than I, so...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1222.dst: Está claro que se te da mejor la electromagia que a mí, así que...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1222.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1223.src: I'm willing to provide you with what you need. Help you out from time to time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1223.dst: Estoy dispuesto a darte lo que necesites. Echarte una mano de vez en cuando.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1223.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1224.src: You've been alone for so long, Ava. I'm lending you Maxie!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1224.dst: Has estado sola mucho tiempo, Ava. ¡Te presto a Maxie!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1224.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1225.src: Hey, don't say it like that!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1225.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1226.src: *chuckles* I'm kidding. The rest of the council isn't aware yet.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1226.dst: *se ríe* Es broma. El resto del Consejo aún no lo sabe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1226.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1227.src: They're not gonna like this, but I'll handle it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1227.dst: No les va a gustar, pero yo me encargo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1227.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1228.src: You know I can't kill you. Can you imagine how the Avos would take it? Even though you're banished...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1228.dst: Sabes que no puedo matarte. ¿Te imaginas cómo se lo tomarían los Avos? Aunque estés desterrada...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1228.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1229.src: But I don't want to either. As for you, {u}...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1229.dst: Pero tampoco quiero. Y en cuanto a ti, {u}...

The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.speaker: Robot Sentry

The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.src: If you have any questions, know that I am definitely not the right machine to ask.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.dst: Si tiene alguna pregunta, sepa que no soy en absoluto la máquina adecuada para responderla.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.speaker: Robot Sentry

The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.src: Hey, it's alright. We'll be fine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.src: You know, that Workshop of yours is way nicer than I expected.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.dst: ¿Sabes? Ese Taller tuyo es mucho mejor de lo que esperaba.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.src: {u}, thanks for the help. You've introduced me to quite the talent!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.dst: {u}, gracias por la ayuda. ¡Me has presentado a todo un talento!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.src: Believe me, I know how rejection feels like. I guess everyone does, in their own ways.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.dst: Créeme, sé lo que es el rechazo. Supongo que todos lo sabemos, cada uno a su manera.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.src: Efena... She's nicer than Chief, that's for sure...

The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.src: This is all... Very hard to believe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.dst: Todo esto es... muy difícil de creer.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.src: {u}, once you come back here, you'll be able to get some of my gadgets.
