The Mercenary#040.src: Hmph. I suppose this is as many soldiers as we'll be able to get. Very well!
The Mercenary#040.dst: Hmpf. Supongo que no reuniremos más soldados. ¡En fin, adelante!
The Mercenary#040.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#041.src: To begin with - the situation. Commander Takan of {p} has abandoned his post, and has taken the lead of a group of local bandits.
The Mercenary#041.dst: Primero, la situación. El comandante Takan de {p} ha abandonado su puesto y se ha puesto al frente de unos bandidos locales.
The Mercenary#041.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#042.src: Under his command, they were able to strike our forces in the dead of night, and have taken over the barracks to the northeast.
The Mercenary#042.dst: Bajo su mando atacaron a nuestras tropas en plena noche y se han hecho con los barracones del noreste.
The Mercenary#042.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#043.src: Our entire military force, captured or killed! What a disgrace. We've sent messengers to {p}, and they have promised their support...
The Mercenary#043.dst: ¡Toda nuestra fuerza militar, capturada o muerta! Qué deshonra. Hemos enviado mensajeros a {p} y nos han prometido apoyo...
The Mercenary#043.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#044.src: But I would like this dealt with quickly and quietly. That's where you five come in.
The Mercenary#044.dst: Pero quiero zanjarlo rápido y en silencio. Ahí entráis vosotros cinco.
The Mercenary#044.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#045.src: You will attack and infiltrate the barracks, and assassinate our treasonous commander. I will leave the strategizing to you, as there is much I still must handle here.
The Mercenary#045.dst: Asaltaréis los barracones, os infiltraréis y asesinaréis al comandante traidor. La estrategia la dejo en vuestras manos; aquí aún tengo mucho que atender.
The Mercenary#045.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#046.src: A question, if I may. Do we know the commander's reasoning for this attack? It seems out of character.
The Mercenary#046.dst: Una pregunta, si me permite. ¿Sabemos por qué atacó el comandante? No parece propio de él.
The Mercenary#046.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#047.src: ...No. There is nothing that I can recall that would motivate such an attack. Will that be all?
The Mercenary#047.dst: ...No. No recuerdo nada que justifique semejante ataque. ¿Eso es todo?
The Mercenary#047.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#049.src: Then I must be off! Good luck, soldiers. I hope for a swift end to this disaster.
The Mercenary#049.dst: ¡Pues me voy! Suerte, soldados. Ojalá este desastre acabe pronto.
The Mercenary#049.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#050.src: ...Well, darn. Bandits sound like trouble. Do we know what sort?
The Mercenary#050.dst: ...Caray. Los bandidos suenan a problemas. ¿Sabemos de qué clase?
The Mercenary#050.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#051.src: Does it matter? We'll probably be fighting them no matter what kind they are.
The Mercenary#051.dst: ¿Y qué más da? Sean de la clase que sean, acabaremos peleando con ellos.
The Mercenary#051.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#052.src: It might, actually... Some bandit groups are stronger than others. If we know which group we're dealing with ahead of time, it might-
The Mercenary#052.dst: Pues sí importa... Unas bandas son más fuertes que otras. Si sabemos de antemano con cuál tratamos, quizá-
The Mercenary#052.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#053.src: We've been standing around here for too long. Come on, let's make our way closer to the barracks. We can come up with a plan there.
The Mercenary#053.dst: Llevamos demasiado rato aquí parados. Venga, acerquémonos a los barracones. Allí podemos trazar un plan.
The Mercenary#053.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#057.dst: Reúnete cerca de los barracones en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Mercenary#058.src: Well, darn. The place is swarming with bandits...
The Mercenary#058.dst: Caray. El sitio está plagado de bandidos...
The Mercenary#058.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#059.src: I don't see how that's a problem! We can just launch explosives into the crowd, and boom, problem solved.
The Mercenary#059.dst: ¡No veo el problema! Lanzamos explosivos al montón y, pum, asunto resuelto.
The Mercenary#059.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#061.src: We can't do that. You'd almost certainly damage the structure in the process!
The Mercenary#061.dst: No podemos. ¡Casi seguro que dañarías el edificio!
The Mercenary#061.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#062.src: Ah, true. Can't forget about the historical value. Good catch.
The Mercenary#062.dst: Ah, cierto. No olvidemos el valor histórico. Bien visto.
The Mercenary#062.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#063.src: ...Right. Well, anyway, I don't think we can get through those bandits with brute force. We'll have to try to find a way around them...
The Mercenary#063.dst: ...Ya. En fin, no creo que podamos pasar a esos bandidos por la fuerza. Habrá que buscar la forma de rodearlos...
The Mercenary#063.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#064.src: Well, if I may interject- I reckon I won't be of much use in proper combat! Injured leg, 'n all. Makes moving a little hard!
The Mercenary#064.dst: Si me dejáis meter baza- ¡en un combate de verdad no os serviré de mucho! Tengo la pierna herida, ¿sabéis? ¡Me cuesta moverme!
The Mercenary#064.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#065.src: So, if we think goin' right in won't work, I could try to create a distraction? I've got the magic for it, and I'd be of much more use out here.
The Mercenary#065.dst: Así que, si entrar de frente no va a colar, ¿y si monto una distracción? Tengo magia para eso y aquí fuera os serviré mucho más.
The Mercenary#065.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#066.src: It could work... if I join you, we'd be able to draw attention towards us while the others sneak in from a different angle.
The Mercenary#066.dst: Podría funcionar... Si voy contigo, atraeremos su atención mientras los demás se cuelan por otro lado.
The Mercenary#066.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#067.src: Good idea. But, how do we get in? I don't think there is another entrance, other than that one in front.
The Mercenary#067.dst: Buena idea. ¿Pero cómo entramos? No creo que haya más entrada que la de delante.
The Mercenary#067.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#069.src: This had better not be going where I think it is, Linton.
The Mercenary#069.dst: Más te vale que no vaya por donde creo, Linton.
The Mercenary#069.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#070.src: Okay, maybe it is. But, listen! We don't have any entrances, right? What if we made our own... by blowing a hole through a wall?
The Mercenary#070.dst: Vale, puede que sí. ¡Pero escucha! No hay entradas, ¿no? ¿Y si hacemos una nuestra... abriendo un boquete en el muro?
The Mercenary#070.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#071.src: ...Alright, fine. That sounds like it could work.
The Mercenary#071.dst: ...Está bien, vale. Suena a que podría funcionar.
The Mercenary#071.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#073.src: Exactly! You need to have more faith in the experts, Aledar.
The Mercenary#073.dst: ¡Exacto! Ten más fe en los expertos, Aledar.
The Mercenary#073.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#074.src: We all need to make sacrifices, Lanu.
The Mercenary#074.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#075.src: Hm. No, I don't think I do. Either way, that sounds like a plan. {u}, Linton, and I will break into the barracks then.
The Mercenary#075.dst: Hm. No, no creo. En fin, ya tenemos plan. {u}, Linton y yo entraremos en los barracones.
The Mercenary#075.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#077.src: And Lanu and I can distract 'em while you do so. Sounds like a plan! Let's get goin'.
The Mercenary#077.dst: Lanu y yo los distraemos mientras tanto. ¡Buen plan! ¡En marcha!
The Mercenary#077.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#079.src: Well, well. This looks like a good place to break our way in, wouldn't you say, Aledar?
The Mercenary#079.dst: Vaya, vaya. Buen sitio para abrirnos paso, ¿no te parece, Aledar?
The Mercenary#079.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#080.src: Yes, Linton, it looks fine. {u}, we'll be looking for Takan. I think the two of us could take him out.
The Mercenary#080.dst: Sí, Linton, sirve. {u}, buscaremos a Takan. Creo que entre los dos podemos con él.
The Mercenary#080.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#081.src: And I'll be looking for the captured soldiers! I stole a map of the barracks from Amerigo's desk, so I'll be able to find them easily enough!
The Mercenary#081.dst: ¡Y yo buscaré a los soldados presos! Le mangué a Amerigo un plano de los barracones, ¡así que los encontraré fácil!
The Mercenary#081.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#082.src: You-... nevermind, I don't care. Just do your job, please?
The Mercenary#082.dst: Tú-... da igual, me da lo mismo. Haz tu trabajo, ¿vale?
The Mercenary#082.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#084.src: See you two on the other side!
The Mercenary#084.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#087.src: Damn it... damn it, damn it, damn it ALL! Couldn't give me a MOMENT of peace, could he, that rat Amerigo...
The Mercenary#087.dst: Maldita sea... ¡maldita, maldita, maldito TODO! Ni un MOMENTO de paz, ¿eh?, esa rata de Amerigo...
The Mercenary#087.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#088.src: ...do I really need to do everything myself?! It's almost as though-
The Mercenary#088.dst: ...¡¿de verdad tengo que hacerlo todo yo?! Es casi como si-
The Mercenary#088.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#089.src: Oh, I see. I see what's going on. More of Amerigo's dogs, here to take care of his business, huh?! Get out here where I can see you.
The Mercenary#089.dst: Vaya, ya veo. Ya veo de qué va esto. ¡¿Más perros de Amerigo a hacerle el trabajo sucio?! Salid donde pueda veros.
The Mercenary#089.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#090.src: You look new... haven't been around long enough to really see the face of War up close and personal yet, have you?
The Mercenary#090.dst: Caras nuevas... aún no habéis visto la cara de la Guerra de cerca, ¿verdad?
The Mercenary#090.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#091.src: You think this is right? You think it's right that those DAMNED admirals get all the wealth and fame, when WE'RE the ones out fighting in the trenches?!
The Mercenary#091.dst: ¿Te parece justo? ¿Te parece justo que esos MALDITOS almirantes se lleven riqueza y fama mientras NOSOTROS peleamos en las trincheras?
The Mercenary#091.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#092.src: I've seen soldiers fall and fall and fall, then rise back up again. I've lived through the chaos and death of battle more times than I could count.
The Mercenary#092.dst: He visto caer a soldados una y otra vez, y volver a levantarse. He vivido el caos y la muerte del combate más veces de las que puedo contar.
The Mercenary#092.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#093.src: And these IDIOTS think they deserve their power? Their authority?!
The Mercenary#093.dst: ¿Y esos IDIOTAS creen merecer su poder? ¡¿Su autoridad?!
The Mercenary#093.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#094.src: ...You've killed dozens, and you're keeping dozens more captured.
The Mercenary#094.dst: ...Has matado a decenas y tienes presas a decenas más.
The Mercenary#094.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#095.src: And I'd do all that and more, just to prove my point! They think they hold power?! I'll show them power...
The Mercenary#095.dst: ¡Y haría eso y más con tal de demostrarlo! ¡¿Creen que tienen poder?! Ya les enseñaré yo poder...
The Mercenary#095.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#096.src: I suppose I'll start with you. What are two more compared to dozens?
The Mercenary#096.dst: Empezaré por vosotros. ¿Qué son dos más frente a decenas?
The Mercenary#096.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#097.src: Step aside, Shadow Spears. I'd like to deal with these dogs myself.
The Mercenary#097.dst: Apartaos, Shadow Spears. De estos perros me encargo yo.
The Mercenary#097.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#098.src: ...We won't make it easy for you.
The Mercenary#098.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#103.src: This tower can only go up... Come on, we need to chase after him! We can't let him get away!
The Mercenary#103.dst: Esta torre solo sube... ¡Vamos, hay que perseguirlo! ¡No podemos dejarlo escapar!
The Mercenary#103.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#104.src: Continue up the stairs in the barracks.
The Mercenary#104.dst: Sigue subiendo las escaleras de los barracones.

The Mercenary#107.src: Look, it's obvious we've lost here. Even if that idiot escapes, you military folk will find him.
The Mercenary#107.dst: Mirad, está claro que hemos perdido. Aunque ese idiota escape, los militares lo encontraréis.
The Mercenary#107.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#108.src: So, I surrender! Don't see the point in fightin' a pointless battle. Not like we're gonna be paid after this mess, anyhow.
The Mercenary#108.dst: ¡Así que me rindo! No le veo sentido a pelear una batalla sin sentido. Total, con este lío no nos van a pagar.
The Mercenary#108.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#109.src: Here, take the key to the tower. A sign of good faith. Do what you will with him, I really don't care.
The Mercenary#109.dst: Toma, la llave de la torre. Un gesto de buena fe. Haced con él lo que queráis, me da igual.
The Mercenary#109.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#110.src: I always preferred his brother anyway. Much quieter.
The Mercenary#110.dst: Siempre preferí a su hermano. Mucho más callado.
The Mercenary#110.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#111.src: Ugh, more bandits... I'll hold them off here.
The Mercenary#111.dst: Uf, más bandidos... Yo los entretengo aquí.
The Mercenary#111.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#112.src: Keep going after Takan! I'll be fine!
The Mercenary#112.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#113.src: Head up the tower and take out Takan.
The Mercenary#113.dst: Sube a la torre y acaba con Takan.

The Mercenary#114.src: Urgh... Why did I even come up here?! There's nowhere for me to-
The Mercenary#114.dst: Urgh... ¡¿Por qué habré subido aquí?! No tengo por dónde-
The Mercenary#114.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#115.src: ...Oh. L-listen. We can talk this out-
The Mercenary#115.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#118.src: ...and so then, I had to free them somehow! So I shouted at them to brace for it, and-
The Mercenary#118.dst: ...¡y entonces tenía que liberarlos como fuera! Les grité que se prepararan y-
The Mercenary#118.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#119.src: {u}! There you are! I'm glad you made it out safely. It looks like the bandits are dispersing.
The Mercenary#119.dst: ¡{u}! ¡Ahí estás! Me alegra que salieras sin un rasguño. Parece que los bandidos se dispersan.
The Mercenary#119.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#120.src: And so is my train of thought for my story. So! Did you get him?
The Mercenary#120.dst: Y mi hilo también se ha dispersado. ¡Bueno! ¿Lo pillasteis?
The Mercenary#120.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#121.src: That's good to hear. At least something good came of this whole situation...
The Mercenary#121.dst: Me alegra oírlo. Algo bueno salió de todo esto...
The Mercenary#121.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#122.src: I'm glad we managed to take him out after all. The things he was saying... he seemed like a dangerous man.
The Mercenary#122.dst: Me alegro de que al final pudiéramos acabar con él. Lo que decía... parecía un hombre peligroso.
The Mercenary#122.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#123.src: Oh, not this again. You're still on that?
The Mercenary#123.dst: Ay, otra vez no. ¿Sigues con eso?
The Mercenary#123.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#124.src: I caught a few of the things he was shoutin' from outside. It didn't sound very pleasant.
The Mercenary#124.dst: Desde fuera pillé algunas cosas de las que gritaba. No sonaban nada agradables.
The Mercenary#124.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#125.src:
Lanu:
Some of us care about history, Mel.
The Mercenary#125.dst:
Lanu:
Algunos valoramos la historia, Mel.
The Mercenary#125.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#126.src: Well, I didn't hear a thing. Probably on account of the ringing in my ears. It seems to me we're done here, though, right?
The Mercenary#126.dst: Pues yo no oí nada. Será por el pitido en los oídos. Pero a mí me parece que aquí ya hemos terminado, ¿no?
The Mercenary#126.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#127.src: It looks like it, yes. I think I'll stay behind to help the soldiers clear out the remaining bandits.
The Mercenary#127.dst: Eso parece, sí. Creo que me quedaré a ayudar a los soldados con los bandidos que queden.
The Mercenary#127.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#128.src: I figure I'll stick around too. Don't got anythin' better to do right now, anyway!
The Mercenary#128.dst: Yo también me quedo. ¡Total, ahora no tengo nada mejor!
The Mercenary#128.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#129.src: Well, I'm out of here. I've got places to be! Things to do! Explosives to return! Goodbye!
The Mercenary#129.dst: Bueno, yo me largo. ¡Tengo sitios a los que ir! ¡Cosas que hacer! ¡Explosivos que devolver! ¡Adiós!
The Mercenary#129.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#130.src: {u}, I guess that leaves the two of us to return to {p} with the news! Let's get going.
The Mercenary#130.dst: {u}, ¡pues nos toca a los dos volver a {p} con la noticia! Vamos allá.
The Mercenary#130.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#131.src: Bring Takan's badge to Amerigo at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Mercenary#131.dst: Lleva la insignia de Takan a Amerigo en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Mercenary#132.src: Soldiers! Report! Don't tell me you're the only two survivors, damn it all...
The Mercenary#132.dst: ¡Soldados! ¡Informad! No me digáis que solo quedáis vosotros dos...
The Mercenary#132.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#133.src: No, sir, the mission was a success. Takan is dead.
The Mercenary#133.dst: No, señor, la misión fue un éxito. Takan ha muerto.
The Mercenary#133.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#134.src: You're certain of this? You have his badge, surely...?
The Mercenary#134.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#135.src: I see... satisfactory work, soldiers. You two, and the others, have {p}'s gratitude.
The Mercenary#135.dst: Ya veo... trabajo satisfactorio, soldados. Vosotros dos y los demás tenéis la gratitud de {p}.
The Mercenary#135.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#136.src: Admiral, sir. Some of what Takan is saying, it was-
The Mercenary#136.dst: Almirante, señor. Parte de lo que decía Takan-
The Mercenary#136.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#137.src: I wouldn't put too much stock in those traitor's words. People like him, who spit vitriol with no merit, riling up the masses against the order we hold.
The Mercenary#137.dst: Yo no daría crédito a las palabras de ese traidor. Gente así escupe veneno sin fundamento y azuza a las masas contra nuestro orden.
The Mercenary#137.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#138.src: He is an angry man holding a grudge for an imagined wrongdoing. There is nothing more to it than that. I would suggest putting it out of your mind.
The Mercenary#138.dst: Es un hombre rencoroso que guarda odio por un agravio imaginado. No hay nada más. Os sugiero que lo quitéis de la cabeza.
The Mercenary#138.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#139.src: You will all be well-compensated for your work today. Now, run along. I have to collect my honorary badge for taking out Ex-Commander Takan.
The Mercenary#139.dst: Se os recompensará bien por lo de hoy. Ahora, marchaos. Debo recoger mi insignia honorífica por acabar con el excomandante Takan.
The Mercenary#139.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#141.src: I'm starting to see why Takan hated him so much.
The Mercenary#141.dst: Empiezo a ver por qué Takan lo odiaba tanto.
The Mercenary#141.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#142.src: I'll... probably try to speak to Admiral Aegis about that the next time I'm in {p}.
The Mercenary#142.dst: Creo que... hablaré con el almirante Aegis de esto la próxima vez que esté en {p}.
The Mercenary#142.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#143.src: Anyway! What an adventure, right? I can't wait to tell Tasim about it.
The Mercenary#143.dst: ¡En fin! Menuda aventura, ¿eh? Me muero por contárselo a Tasim.
The Mercenary#143.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#144.src: ...Speaking of. Have you heard from him recently? I can't seem to get ahold of him at all.
The Mercenary#144.dst: ...Por cierto. ¿Has sabido algo de él últimamente? No consigo localizarlo de ninguna manera.
The Mercenary#144.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#145.src: It's weird. Last I heard, he was at {p}, but he's not there anymore.
The Mercenary#145.dst: Qué raro. Lo último que supe es que estaba en {p}, pero ya no.
The Mercenary#145.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#146.src: He- what? Really? And he didn't even tell me...
The Mercenary#146.dst: Él- ¿qué? ¿En serio? Y ni me lo dijo...
The Mercenary#146.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#147.src: ...I guess it must have slipped his mind. That's alright. We're all busy around here, right?
The Mercenary#147.dst: ...Se le habrá olvidado, supongo. No pasa nada. Aquí todos andamos liados, ¿no?
The Mercenary#147.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#148.src: A general location is useful, though. I'll see if I can get any letters to him. Thanks for telling me.
The Mercenary#148.dst: Aun así, saber más o menos dónde ayuda. Probaré a mandarle alguna carta. Gracias por decírmelo.
The Mercenary#148.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#149.src: Yeah, that makes two of us...
The Mercenary#149.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#150.src: Well, it's probably fine. I'm sure he'll pop up eventually! We just need to wait.
The Mercenary#150.dst: Bueno, seguro que no es nada. ¡Ya aparecerá! Solo hay que esperar.
The Mercenary#150.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#151.src: I wonder where he's gone off to? Some kind of assignment in {p}, maybe? Or could he have gone off to Gavel...?
The Mercenary#151.dst: ¿Adónde habrá ido? ¿Alguna misión en {p}, quizá? ¿O se habrá marchado a Gavel...?
The Mercenary#151.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#152.src: Well, whatever. It was good to see you again! Even if... well. Even if it was strange.
The Mercenary#152.dst: En fin, da igual. ¡Me alegró volver a verte! Aunque... bueno. Aunque fuera raro.
The Mercenary#152.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#154.src: Well, I guess I'm going to head off. I'll see you around, {u}!
The Mercenary#154.dst: Bueno, creo que me voy yendo. ¡Nos vemos, {u}!
The Mercenary#154.speaker: Aledar

The Missing Piece#000.src: It says it's for 'the woman on the hill'.
The Missing Piece#000.dst: Es para 'la mujer de la colina'.

The Missing Piece#003.src: I have some letters that are addressed to you.
The Missing Piece#003.dst: Tengo unas cartas dirigidas a ti.

The Missing Piece#004.src: Move and rotate the selected beam using the directional buttons.
The Missing Piece#004.dst: Mueve y gira la viga seleccionada con los botones de dirección.

The Missing Piece#005.src: You could either confront them or talk to Elise about what to do.
The Missing Piece#005.dst: Puedes encararlos o preguntar a Elise qué hacer.

The Missing Piece#007.src: It would be best to get the bread and get out of this place quickly.
The Missing Piece#007.dst: Mejor coger el pan y salir de aquí cuanto antes.

The Missing Piece#008.src: You are already carrying a bottle.

The Missing Piece#009.src: The handwriting seems familiar. But, it doesn't say much...
The Missing Piece#009.dst: La letra te suena. Pero no dice gran cosa...

The Missing Piece#010.src: Throw a Bottle by  RIGHT-CLICKING to aim and then  RIGHT-CLICKING again to throw.
The Missing Piece#010.dst: Lanza una botella con  CLIC DERECHO para apuntar y otro  CLIC DERECHO para lanzarla.

The Missing Piece#012.src: After knocking them out,  RIGHT-CLICK to search workers.
The Missing Piece#012.dst: Tras noquearlos,  CLIC DERECHO para registrar a los obreros.

The Missing Piece#013.src: Now, how to get up from here...
The Missing Piece#013.dst: A ver, cómo subo desde aquí...

The Missing Piece#014.src: This must be the pipe Bush was talking about...
The Missing Piece#014.dst: Esta debe de ser la tubería de la que hablaba Bush...

The Missing Piece#015.src: Hm... There's no sender... Are these all from the same person?
The Missing Piece#015.dst: Hm... No hay remitente... ¿Son todas de la misma persona?

The Missing Piece#016.src: Pick up your post in the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#016.dst: Recoge tu correo en la oficina de correos en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#018.src: Don't you see I'm busy!? Take a ticket and wait in line as you're supposed to! I don't care if no one else is here, follow protocol!
The Missing Piece#018.dst: ¿¡No ves que estoy ocupado!? ¡Coge un ticket y espera en la cola como es debido! ¡Me da igual que no haya nadie más, sigue el protocolo!
The Missing Piece#018.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#019.src: You could get across this gap by arranging the suspended beams into a path.
The Missing Piece#019.dst: Puedes cruzar este hueco ordenando las vigas suspendidas en un camino.

The Missing Piece#020.src: Oh, yes! The letters. Silly me, I almost forgot.
The Missing Piece#020.dst: ¡Ah, sí! Las cartas. Qué cabeza la mía, casi se me olvida.

The Missing Piece#022.src: Take a ticket from the Ticket Machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#022.dst: Coge un ticket en la máquina de tickets de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#023.src: You have to take a ticket, just like everyone else!
The Missing Piece#023.dst: ¡Tienes que coger un ticket, como todo el mundo!
The Missing Piece#023.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#024.src: Return to the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#024.dst: Vuelve a la oficina de correos en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#027.src: I'll be with you in one second! Gosh, so impatient these days...
The Missing Piece#027.dst: ¡Ahora te atiendo! Madre mía, qué impaciente es la gente hoy...
The Missing Piece#027.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#028.src: Tired of waiting already? Well, someone decided to leave this place a mess for when I returned!
The Missing Piece#028.dst: ¿Ya te has cansado de esperar? ¡Pues alguien decidió dejarme esto hecho un desastre para cuando volviera!
The Missing Piece#028.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#029.src: I come back to the office yesterday from a well-deserved, brief, eighteen week, vacation. And this is how I'm thanked?!
The Missing Piece#029.dst: Ayer vuelvo a la oficina tras unas merecidas y breves vacaciones de dieciocho semanas. ¿¡Y así me lo pagan!?
The Missing Piece#029.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#030.src: Do you see the mess my substitute left this place in? And now I have to clean it up, or the Royal Inspector will have my head!
The Missing Piece#030.dst: ¿Ves el desastre que dejó mi sustituto? ¡Y ahora me toca limpiarlo a mí, o el Inspector Real me cortará la cabeza!
The Missing Piece#030.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#031.src: I'll have you know I graduated with honours from the Royal University of Aelumia.
The Missing Piece#031.dst: Para que lo sepas, me gradué con honores en la Universidad Real de Aelumia.
The Missing Piece#031.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#032.src: Frankly, it's demeaning they stuck me out here with the... ugh... peasants! Oh, and don't even get me started on the smell!
The Missing Piece#032.dst: Francamente, es humillante que me destinaran aquí con los... puaj... ¡campesinos! ¡Ah, y no me hagas hablar del olor!
The Missing Piece#032.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#033.src: But anyway, that is all besides the point. What did you want again?
The Missing Piece#033.dst: En fin, eso no viene al caso. ¿Qué querías?
The Missing Piece#033.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#034.src: It's you! You're the one I left in charge over my vacation, you scoundrel!
The Missing Piece#034.dst: ¡Eres tú! ¡Te dejé al mando en mis vacaciones, bribón!
The Missing Piece#034.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#035.src: I knew it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
The Missing Piece#035.dst: ¡Lo sabía! ¡Un universitario como yo no puede equivocarse!
The Missing Piece#035.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#036.src: Don't try to weasel your way out of it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
The Missing Piece#036.dst: ¡No intentes escaquearte! ¡Un universitario como yo no puede equivocarse!
The Missing Piece#036.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#039.src: It's not just me who's going to be in trouble when the inspection comes, surely you realize that?
The Missing Piece#039.dst: No solo yo tendré problemas cuando llegue la inspección, ¿te das cuenta?
The Missing Piece#039.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#041.src: If you fix this mess you made... Then no one ever has to hear a word of what happened.
The Missing Piece#041.dst: Si arreglas este desastre que has montado... nadie tendrá por qué enterarse.
The Missing Piece#041.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#042.src: You don't get in trouble, the Royal Inspector is happy, I'm happy. Everyone is happy!
The Missing Piece#042.dst: Tú te libras, el Inspector Real contento, yo contento. ¡Todos contentos!
The Missing Piece#042.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#045.src: Then I'll have you sorting post like your life depends on it, scoundrel!
The Missing Piece#045.dst: ¡Pues vas a clasificar correo como si te fuera la vida, bribón!
The Missing Piece#045.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#048.dst: Sigue al jefe de correos hasta [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#049.src: Sorting is so easy even someone like you should be able to do it.
The Missing Piece#049.dst: Clasificar es tan fácil que hasta tú deberías poder.
The Missing Piece#049.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#050.src: All you do is take the packages from the conveyor over there.
The Missing Piece#050.dst: Solo tienes que coger los paquetes de esa cinta.
The Missing Piece#050.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#051.src: And put them where they're supposed to go over there.
The Missing Piece#051.dst: Y ponerlos ahí, donde les corresponde.
The Missing Piece#051.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#052.src: {p} packages to the {p}, Auburn packages to the {p}, and so on.
The Missing Piece#052.dst: Paquetes de {p} para {p}, de Auburn para {p}, y así.
The Missing Piece#052.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#054.src: Fantastic! Just don't make a mess of it, okay?
The Missing Piece#054.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#058.src: Well, that was just the warmup! There's more to come, so don't go slacking off now!
The Missing Piece#058.dst: ¡Pues eso era solo el calentamiento! ¡Queda más, así que no te relajes!
The Missing Piece#058.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#059.src: Hmm... You did fine this time, but watch out, because these last packages come fast!
The Missing Piece#059.dst: Hmm... Esta vez bien, pero ojo, ¡que estos últimos paquetes vienen rápido!
The Missing Piece#059.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#060.src: Don't think you're somebody just because you can sort some packages!
The Missing Piece#060.dst: ¡No te creas nadie por saber clasificar paquetes!
The Missing Piece#060.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#061.src: What are you doing over there!?
The Missing Piece#061.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#062.src: Agh! Try again, but you better do it right this time!
The Missing Piece#062.dst: ¡Agh! Otra vez, ¡y esta vez hazlo bien!
The Missing Piece#062.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#063.src: Agh! Try again, but you better do it right this time!
The Missing Piece#063.dst: ¡Agh! Otra vez, ¡y esta vez hazlo bien!
The Missing Piece#063.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#064.src: Don't bother me while I'm working! I didn't go to university just to slack off with people like you!
The Missing Piece#064.dst: ¡No me molestes mientras trabajo! ¡No fui a la universidad para perder el tiempo con gente como tú!
The Missing Piece#064.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#065.dst: Escucha las indicaciones del jefe de correos.

The Missing Piece#066.src: Ah, perfect! You sorted the packages!
The Missing Piece#066.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#067.src: But wait, what's this then? Why are there so many packages to the {p}?
The Missing Piece#067.dst: Pero espera, ¿y esto? ¿Por qué hay tantos paquetes para {p}?
The Missing Piece#067.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#068.src: Did you mess up the sorting, you fool!?
The Missing Piece#068.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#069.src: What's up with these packages! They're filled with letters?
The Missing Piece#069.dst: ¿Qué pasa con estos paquetes? ¿Están llenos de cartas?
The Missing Piece#069.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#070.src: Hmph... all of them to the woman on the hill... Whatever that means!
The Missing Piece#070.dst: Hmf... todos para la mujer de la colina... ¡Vete a saber qué significa!
The Missing Piece#070.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#071.src: Hey you, scoundrel. This is part of your duty too, you know!
The Missing Piece#071.dst: Oye, bribón. ¡Esto también es tu obligación!
The Missing Piece#071.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#072.src: Go deliver these letters! Or... or I'll tell the Royal Inspector about what you did! That's right, don't mess with me!
The Missing Piece#072.dst: ¡Ve a repartir estas cartas! ¡O le contaré al Inspector Real lo que hiciste! ¡Eso es, conmigo no se juega!
The Missing Piece#072.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#073.src: How should I know! That's your job to figure out. See, it says here 'to the woman on the hill', that should be enough shouldn't it?
The Missing Piece#073.dst: ¡Y yo qué sé! Es tu trabajo averiguarlo. Mira, aquí pone 'a la mujer de la colina', con eso basta, ¿no?
The Missing Piece#073.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#074.src: Oh, but you are! I have very many friends, in very high places! Met them in university, makes sure to remember that!
The Missing Piece#074.dst: ¡Ya lo creo que sí! ¡Tengo muchísimos amigos, y muy bien colocados! Los conocí en la universidad, ¡que no se te olvide!
The Missing Piece#074.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#075.src: Great! Now with that settled I can finally go back to my very important work.
The Missing Piece#075.dst: ¡Genial! Con eso resuelto, por fin puedo volver a mi importantísimo trabajo.
The Missing Piece#075.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#076.src: Oh, yes. Very important. University graduate, did I mention that?
The Missing Piece#076.dst: Ah, sí. Importantísimo. Licenciado universitario, ¿lo había dicho?
The Missing Piece#076.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#077.src: Now now, off you go. And don't come back crying if you can't find this mysterious woman!
The Missing Piece#077.dst: Venga, venga, largo. ¡Y no vuelvas llorando si no encuentras a esa misteriosa mujer!
The Missing Piece#077.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#078.src: But if you lose the letter I can always give you another, they seem to be practically infinite anyhow!
The Missing Piece#078.dst: Pero si pierdes la carta siempre puedo darte otra, ¡parecen prácticamente infinitas!
The Missing Piece#078.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#079.src: Find out about the woman on the hill around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#079.dst: Averigua sobre la mujer de la colina cerca de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#080.src: Are you trying to slack off? You still have the letter on you, go deliver it!
The Missing Piece#080.dst: ¿Intentas escaquearte? Aún llevas la carta, ¡ve a entregarla!
The Missing Piece#080.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#082.src: Hmm, you lost the letter? Already!?
The Missing Piece#082.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#083.src: Don't think you're getting out of this! I have spares!
The Missing Piece#083.dst: ¡No creas que te libras! ¡Tengo de sobra!
The Missing Piece#083.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#084.src: Now go on and sort this out for me, won't you? I have enough to worry about as is without you bungling about!
The Missing Piece#084.dst: Anda, ve y arréglame esto, ¿quieres? ¡Ya tengo bastantes preocupaciones sin que tú lo enredes todo!
The Missing Piece#084.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#086.src: Looking for someone, huh? 'round these parts it's usually the tin cans who do that.
The Missing Piece#086.dst: ¿Buscando a alguien, eh? Por aquí los que hacen eso suelen ser las latas de hojalata.
The Missing Piece#086.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#087.src: A visit from one of those and you get an all-expenses-paid vacation on the Crown, if you catch my drift.
The Missing Piece#087.dst: Que te visite una de esas y te llevas unas vacaciones pagadas por la Corona, ya me entiendes.
The Missing Piece#087.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#088.src: Safe to say, if it were Lars you were looking for I'd be happy to rat him out, but you haven't told me who it is yet.
The Missing Piece#088.dst: Si buscaras a Lars, te lo delataba encantado, pero aún no me has dicho a quién buscas.
The Missing Piece#088.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#089.src: PLenty of hills 'round these parts, women too. But they're in the factories, slaving away, not on any hills 'sfar as I'm aware.
The Missing Piece#089.dst: Colinas por aquí hay de sobra, y mujeres también. Pero están en las fábricas, deslomándose, no en ninguna colina que yo sepa.
The Missing Piece#089.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#090.src: Sorry bud, don't think I can help you with this one. Try asking Lars, he's usually hogging the fire in the alley here behind me. Hate that guy...
The Missing Piece#090.dst: Lo siento, colega, con esta no te ayudo. Pregunta a Lars, suele acaparar la hoguera del callejón de aquí detrás. Odio a ese tipo...
The Missing Piece#090.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#092.src: Already told you everythin', didn't I? Go harass Lars instead, I have nothing more to say.
The Missing Piece#092.dst: Ya te lo he contado todo, ¿no? Ve a dar la lata a Lars, no tengo nada más que decir.
The Missing Piece#092.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#094.src: I'm looking for someone called 'the woman on the hill'. I have a letter I need to deliver to her.
The Missing Piece#094.dst: Busco a alguien llamada 'la mujer de la colina'. Tengo una carta que entregarle.
The Missing Piece#094.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#095.src: A letter? Don't know nuthin' about no woman on the hill, but maybe Bush over there would know.
The Missing Piece#095.dst: ¿Una carta? De ninguna mujer de la colina sé nada, pero quizá Bush, el de ahí, sepa.
The Missing Piece#095.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#096.src: He usually knows things... He's a knower.
The Missing Piece#096.dst: Suele saber cosas... Es un sabedor.
The Missing Piece#096.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#097.src: Don't talk to him for too long though, or he'll start putting strange ideas in your head...
The Missing Piece#097.dst: Pero no hables mucho rato con él, o empezará a meterte ideas raras en la cabeza...
The Missing Piece#097.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#099.src: Ask Bush. I told you I don't know nuthin'.
The Missing Piece#099.dst: Pregunta a Bush. Te dije que no sé nada.
The Missing Piece#099.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#100.src: I'm Bush, nice to meet you. Is there something you wish to know?
The Missing Piece#100.dst: Soy Bush, encantado. ¿Hay algo que desees saber?
The Missing Piece#100.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#101.src: Oh, yes, her... This bush knows her all too well!
The Missing Piece#101.dst: Ah, sí, ella... ¡Este arbusto la conoce de sobra!
The Missing Piece#101.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#102.src: Without her this bush would wilt! Yes, a bush requires water to grow. I know, I know!
The Missing Piece#102.dst: ¡Sin ella este arbusto se marchitaría! Sí, un arbusto necesita agua para crecer. ¡Lo sé, lo sé!
The Missing Piece#102.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#103.src: But first, I must know why you must know! Do you know?
The Missing Piece#103.dst: ¡Pero antes debo saber por qué debes saberlo! ¿Lo sabes?
The Missing Piece#103.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#104.src: A letter! If only this Bush could know its contents... Alas, it would be rude to know...
The Missing Piece#104.dst: ¡Una carta! Si este Bush pudiera saber qué dice... Ay, saberlo sería una grosería...
The Missing Piece#104.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#105.src: The mail-deliverer, truly a noble profession. I will share with you her location, but in exchange you must tell her: her friend is back in town.
The Missing Piece#105.dst: Repartir el correo es sin duda un oficio noble. Te diré dónde está, pero a cambio debes decirle: su amigo ha vuelto a la ciudad.
The Missing Piece#105.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#106.src: Here, let me write it down for you!
The Missing Piece#106.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#107.src: Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#107.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#108.src: To know why I must know? Not even I know... All I know is that I must know!
The Missing Piece#108.dst: ¿Por qué debo saberlo? Ni yo lo sé... ¡Solo sé que debo saberlo!
The Missing Piece#108.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#109.src: Again, tell me why you must know.
The Missing Piece#109.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#110.src: Nothing? That such people existed, I did not know! Now I know, now I know!
The Missing Piece#110.dst: ¿Por nada? ¡No sabía que hubiera gente así! ¡Ahora lo sé, ahora lo sé!
The Missing Piece#110.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#112.src: Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#112.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#114.src: Post? You must be at the wrong house, dear.
The Missing Piece#114.dst: ¿Correo? Te habrás equivocado de casa, cielo.
The Missing Piece#114.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#115.src: No one is sending me any of that...
The Missing Piece#115.dst: Nadie me manda nada de eso...
The Missing Piece#115.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#116.src: Well, if it says so on the letter...
The Missing Piece#116.dst: Bueno, si lo pone en la carta...
The Missing Piece#116.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#117.src: Come in and we'll talk about it.
The Missing Piece#117.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#118.dst: Entra en la casa de la mujer.

The Missing Piece#119.src: I don't usually get a lot of visitors up on the hill.
The Missing Piece#119.dst: No suelo tener muchas visitas aquí en la colina.
The Missing Piece#119.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#122.dst: Sigue a la mujer dentro hasta [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#124.src: Place the letters on the table at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#124.dst: Deja las cartas en la mesa en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#127.src: I think I'll need a closer look at this.
The Missing Piece#127.dst: Necesito mirar esto más de cerca.
The Missing Piece#127.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#128.src: Please, have a seat. I'll make you something to drink.
The Missing Piece#128.dst: Por favor, siéntate. Te prepararé algo de beber.
The Missing Piece#128.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#130.src: You don't look like you're from around these parts, do you?
The Missing Piece#130.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#131.src: Hmm? Well, I shouldn't pry into my guest's secrets. Better to let the unexplained rest, ha. Wouldn't you agree?
The Missing Piece#131.dst: ¿Hmm? En fin, no debería husmear en los secretos de mis invitados. Mejor dejar lo inexplicable en paz, ja. ¿No crees?
The Missing Piece#131.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#132.src: Here in the Roughworks, we don't have any secrets. At least that's what Her Majesty wants to believe, ha.
The Missing Piece#132.dst: Aquí en Roughworks no tenemos secretos. Al menos eso quiere creer Su Majestad, ja.
The Missing Piece#132.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#133.src: That's why I chose to live here. In the neighborhoods, the walls are thinner than paper. Nothing goes unheard.
The Missing Piece#133.dst: Por eso elegí vivir aquí. En los barrios las paredes son más finas que el papel. Todo se oye.
The Missing Piece#133.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#134.src: Up here on the hill, it's much more peaceful. As long as the Water Authority doesn't come knocking, ha.
The Missing Piece#134.dst: Aquí arriba, en la colina, se está mucho más tranquilo. Mientras no llame la Autoridad del Agua, ja.
The Missing Piece#134.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#135.src: Well, if you're already here, why don't we have a little chat? Not a lot of people to talk to up here!
The Missing Piece#135.dst: Bueno, ya que estás aquí, ¿por qué no charlamos un rato? ¡Aquí arriba no hay mucha gente con quien hablar!
The Missing Piece#135.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#136.src: Pick up the Watering Can outside at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#136.dst: Coge la regadera de fuera en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#137.src: The watering can is just outside in the garden. There are three plants inside and three plants outside.
The Missing Piece#137.dst: La regadera está ahí fuera, en el jardín. Hay tres plantas dentro y tres fuera.
The Missing Piece#137.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#138.src: Water Elise's plants while she reads the letters.
The Missing Piece#138.dst: Riega las plantas de Elise mientras ella lee las cartas.

The Missing Piece#140.src: Oh, what a mess... trying to make sense of this is making my head hurt.
The Missing Piece#140.dst: Ay, qué lío... intentar entender esto me está dando dolor de cabeza.
The Missing Piece#140.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#141.src: So many letters, over so many years... who would possibly be so insistent on reaching me?
The Missing Piece#141.dst: Tantas cartas, durante tantos años... ¿quién insistiría tanto en llegar hasta mí?
The Missing Piece#141.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#142.src: Hm? Oh, you finished watering the plants already? That was quick!
The Missing Piece#142.dst: ¿Hm? Ah, ¿ya has terminado de regar? ¡Qué rápido!
The Missing Piece#142.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#143.src: Well, I certainly won't make any progress like this, and it seems we both are in need of a break.
The Missing Piece#143.dst: Bueno, así no voy a avanzar nada, y parece que a los dos nos vendría bien un descanso.
The Missing Piece#143.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#144.src: Oh, it's such a lovely day today... Why don't we go outside and enjoy the garden for a bit?
The Missing Piece#144.dst: Ay, qué día tan bonito hace hoy... ¿Y si salimos a disfrutar un rato del jardín?
The Missing Piece#144.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#145.src: Follow Elise outside and take a seat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#145.dst: Sigue a Elise fuera y siéntate en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#147.src: It really is beautiful today, isn't it?
The Missing Piece#147.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#148.src: Ah... freshly watered flowers. Nothing beats that smell.
The Missing Piece#148.dst: Ah... flores recién regadas. No hay olor que lo supere.
The Missing Piece#148.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#149.src: Hm. Do you see that tree over there?
The Missing Piece#149.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#150.src: It's the only one of its kind in the whole of the Roughworks. Isn't it beautiful?
The Missing Piece#150.dst: Es el único de su especie en todo Roughworks. ¿A que es precioso?
The Missing Piece#150.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#151.src: It was a gift, but from who... It's another thing I've forgotten.
The Missing Piece#151.dst: Fue un regalo, pero de quién... Otra cosa que he olvidado.
The Missing Piece#151.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#152.src: It's frustrating, so frustrating... All these precious memories...
The Missing Piece#152.dst: Es frustrante, tan frustrante... Todos esos recuerdos preciados...
The Missing Piece#152.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#154.src: It isn't much now, that is for certain.
The Missing Piece#154.dst: Ahora no es gran cosa, desde luego.

The Missing Piece#155.src: Well. It's beautiful already, don't you think?
The Missing Piece#155.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#157.src: Ha! Of course it will, it's a tree!
The Missing Piece#157.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#158.src: Oh, you know I didn't mean it like that.
The Missing Piece#158.dst: Ay, sabes que no lo decía por eso.

The Missing Piece#159.src: For each year that passes... this tree will grow taller, and ever more beautiful.
The Missing Piece#159.dst: Con cada año que pase... este árbol será más alto y aún más hermoso.

The Missing Piece#160.src: It'll have to weather many storms, and on some days it might even have to go without water. And still, it will continue growing.
The Missing Piece#160.dst: Tendrá que aguantar muchas tormentas, y algunos días incluso quedarse sin agua. Y aun así, seguirá creciendo.

The Missing Piece#162.src: And then in ten, fifteen, maybe even twenty-five years... we'll finally be able to rest in its shade.
The Missing Piece#162.dst: Y dentro de diez, quince, quizá veinticinco años... por fin podremos descansar a su sombra.

The Missing Piece#163.src: Twenty-five years!? We'll be old by then!
The Missing Piece#163.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#164.src: Oh, I know! We could have a picnic underneath its canopy Doesn't that sound nice, {u}?
The Missing Piece#164.dst: ¡Ah, ya sé! Podríamos merendar bajo su copa ¿A que suena bien, {u}?
The Missing Piece#164.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#165.src: ... It does. It does sound nice, Elise. Perhaps we could.
The Missing Piece#165.dst: ... Sí. Suena bien de verdad, Elise. Quizá podamos.

The Missing Piece#166.src: Go on, give it some more water. Or it'll never grow an inch!
The Missing Piece#166.dst: Venga, dale un poco más de agua. ¡O no crecerá ni un dedo!

The Missing Piece#171.src: I was just thinking... If I were to die some day, I'd like to be buried here, under the tree.
The Missing Piece#171.dst: Solo pensaba... Si algún día muero, me gustaría que me enterraran aquí, bajo el árbol.

The Missing Piece#172.src: Huh? What could possibly make you think about such silly things? We still have a long life left ahead of us, don't we?
The Missing Piece#172.dst: ¿Eh? ¿Qué te hace pensar en esas tonterías? Aún nos queda mucha vida por delante, ¿no?
The Missing Piece#172.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#173.src: Of course, you're right. I'm sorry, I'm just not used to this...
The Missing Piece#173.dst: Claro, tienes razón. Perdona, es que no estoy acostumbrada a esto...

The Missing Piece#176.src: Let's just enjoy the sun, for a bit. There's still work tomorrow.
The Missing Piece#176.dst: Disfrutemos del sol un rato. Mañana toca trabajar otra vez.
The Missing Piece#176.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#179.src: Hm. I shall leave the worrying for another day, I think. Today is a good day... not a day for worrying.
The Missing Piece#179.dst: Hm. Creo que dejaré las preocupaciones para otro día. Hoy es un buen día... no un día para preocuparse.
The Missing Piece#179.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#180.src: In fact, today is too nice a day to waste it... by not going anywhere, that is. Wouldn't you agree?
The Missing Piece#180.dst: Además, hoy hace un día demasiado bueno para desperdiciarlo... quedándonos aquí, quiero decir. ¿No crees?
The Missing Piece#180.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#182.src: Follow Elise to the roof at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#182.dst: Sigue a Elise hasta el tejado en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#183.src: Ah... Do you see that factory off that way? I used to work there, back when I was younger...
The Missing Piece#183.dst: Ah... ¿Ves esa fábrica de allá? Yo trabajaba ahí, cuando era más joven...
The Missing Piece#183.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#184.src: We mass-produced bread for the higher regions... Tedious work, and thankless too.
The Missing Piece#184.dst: Producíamos pan en masa para las regiones altas... Un trabajo tedioso, y encima ingrato.
The Missing Piece#184.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#185.src: I'm sure you have noticed, but things around here aren't too easy. Some people even go as far as stealing when times are tough...
The Missing Piece#185.dst: Seguro que ya lo has notado, pero aquí las cosas no son fáciles. Cuando vienen mal dadas, algunos hasta llegan a robar...
The Missing Piece#185.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#186.src: Fortunately... I never had to. They would let us take some home, every once in a while.
The Missing Piece#186.dst: Por suerte... yo nunca tuve que hacerlo. De vez en cuando nos dejaban llevarnos algo a casa.
The Missing Piece#186.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#187.src: Those were good days. On those occasions, we'd go and have ourselves a picnic, me and- hm. Just me, I suppose.
The Missing Piece#187.dst: Eran buenos tiempos. En esas ocasiones nos íbamos de pícnic, yo y- hm. Solo yo, supongo.
The Missing Piece#187.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#188.src: A shame it's so hard to come by... the thefts became a real problem, you know. The Crown ended up building a vault down under the factory to keep it all secure!
The Missing Piece#188.dst: Lástima que cueste tanto conseguirlo... los robos se volvieron un problema serio. ¡La Corona acabó haciendo una cámara bajo la fábrica para guardarlo todo!
The Missing Piece#188.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#189.src: A shame it's so hard to come by... the thefts became a real problem, you know. The Crown ended up building a vault down under the factory to keep it all secure.
The Missing Piece#189.dst: Lástima que cueste tanto conseguirlo... los robos se volvieron un problema serio. La Corona acabó haciendo una cámara bajo la fábrica para guardarlo todo.
The Missing Piece#189.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#190.src: The door is locked. A note is plastered on the front.
The Missing Piece#190.dst: La puerta está cerrada. Hay una nota pegada delante.

The Missing Piece#191.src: Now to find a way inside without being caught...
The Missing Piece#191.dst: Ahora, a buscar la forma de entrar sin que me pillen...

The Missing Piece#192.src: How long, since I last had some? Years, surely... not like any of that bread ever makes it to us poor folk, ha!
The Missing Piece#192.dst: ¿Cuánto hace que no como? Años, seguro... ese pan nunca llega a los pobres como nosotros, ¡ja!
The Missing Piece#192.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#193.src: But it'd be nice to have some again, I suppose... reminisce on old times.
The Missing Piece#193.dst: Pero estaría bien volver a probarlo, supongo... recordar viejos tiempos.
The Missing Piece#193.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#194.src: Well, if you're running errands for me already... mind seeing if you can get your hands on a loaf or two?
The Missing Piece#194.dst: Bueno, ya que estás haciéndome recados... ¿te importaría ver si consigues una hogaza o dos?
The Missing Piece#194.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#195.src: It's expensive, but for the right price... I'm sure you could get ahold of some. You don't seem the sort to struggle with that kind of thing, do you, letter carrier?
The Missing Piece#195.dst: Es caro, pero por el precio adecuado... seguro que consigues alguna. No pareces de los que sufren con estas cosas, ¿verdad, cartero?
The Missing Piece#195.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#196.src: Ha! Well, do your best, either way. Once you come back, I have a plan for what we can do today. How's that sound?
The Missing Piece#196.dst: ¡Ja! Bueno, haz lo que puedas. Cuando vuelvas, tengo un plan para hoy. ¿Qué te parece?
The Missing Piece#196.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#197.src: Try to enter the Bread Factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#197.dst: Intenta entrar en la Fábrica de Pan en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#198.src: Oh, no... You know! You know! Speak to that constable first, and perhaps, I'll tell you more.
The Missing Piece#198.dst: Oh, no... ¡Lo sabes! ¡Lo sabes! Habla primero con ese alguacil y quizá te cuente más.
The Missing Piece#198.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#199.src: If you've come to beg, you might as well leave.
The Missing Piece#199.dst: Si vienes a mendigar, ya puedes largarte.
The Missing Piece#199.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#200.src: Huh? Alright, bud. We all do.
The Missing Piece#200.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#202.src: Do I look like a vending machine to you? Go find somewhere else. We just make bread here, we don't sell it.
The Missing Piece#202.dst: ¿Te parezco una máquina expendedora? Búscalo en otro sitio. Aquí solo hacemos pan, no lo vendemos.
The Missing Piece#202.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#203.src: Get out of here pal, you shouldn't be loitering around under a Constable's watch.
The Missing Piece#203.dst: Lárgate, colega, no deberías merodear por aquí con un alguacil vigilando.
The Missing Piece#203.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#204.src: But, but, but! No buts. Don't make me have to do something! The paperwork is always such a hassle...
The Missing Piece#204.dst: ¡Pero, pero, pero! Nada de peros. ¡No me obligues a actuar! El papeleo siempre es un fastidio...
The Missing Piece#204.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#206.src: Obviously not... We have enough problems as it is, what with that stolen barrel last week... And the production quotas...
The Missing Piece#206.dst: Obviamente no... Problemas ya tenemos de sobra, con el barril robado la semana pasada... Y las cuotas...
The Missing Piece#206.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#207.src: Don't you have something better to do anyway?
The Missing Piece#207.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#209.src: Over here, friend of a friend!

The Missing Piece#211.src: Did you know? Did you know? There is more than one way to enter any building.
The Missing Piece#211.dst: ¿Lo sabías? ¿Lo sabías? Hay más de una forma de entrar en un edificio.
The Missing Piece#211.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#212.src: I'll tell you! But, stealing is unethical, you must know!
The Missing Piece#212.dst: ¡Te lo diré! Pero robar no es ético, ¡eso debes saberlo!
The Missing Piece#212.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#213.src: As long as she doesn't know! She won't know! Do you understand?
The Missing Piece#213.dst: ¡Mientras ella no lo sepa! ¡No lo sabrá! ¿Lo entiendes?
The Missing Piece#213.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#214.src: It's just around the corner, you see. A pipe! Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#214.dst: Está a la vuelta de la esquina. ¡Una tubería! ¡Ya lo sabes! ¡Ya lo sabes!
The Missing Piece#214.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#215.src: Enter the Bread Factory through the pipe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#215.dst: Entra en la Fábrica de Pan por la tubería en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#216.src: It's just around the corner, you see. A pipe! Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#216.dst: Está a la vuelta de la esquina. ¡Una tubería! ¡Ya lo sabes! ¡Ya lo sabes!
The Missing Piece#216.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#217.dst: Vuelve a entrar en la Fábrica de Pan en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#218.src: Find a way to enter the Bread Vault through the elevator at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#218.dst: Busca la forma de entrar en la Cámara del Pan por el ascensor en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#221.src: Uhh? That's not an answer! Now, tell me who you are or I'll have a look for myself! And I never forget faces, keep that in mind!
The Missing Piece#221.dst: ¿Eh? ¡Eso no es una respuesta! Dime quién eres o iré a mirar yo mismo. ¡Y nunca olvido una cara, tenlo en cuenta!
The Missing Piece#221.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#222.src: What's a worker doing in my office!? Now, tell me who you are or I'll have a look for myself! And I never forget faces, keep that in mind!
The Missing Piece#222.dst: ¿¡Qué hace un obrero en mi despacho!? Dime quién eres o iré a mirar yo mismo. ¡Y nunca olvido una cara, tenlo en cuenta!
The Missing Piece#222.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#224.src: Well, thank you for bringing this to my attention! I will investigate the matter immediately!
The Missing Piece#224.dst: ¡Gracias por avisarme! ¡Investigaré el asunto de inmediato!
The Missing Piece#224.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#226.src: Make your way through the Bread Vault to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#226.dst: Cruza la Cámara del Pan hasta [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#227.dst: Busca la forma de subir a [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#228.src: Hit the bottles at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with a Bottle.
The Missing Piece#228.dst: Dale a las botellas de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] con una botella.

The Missing Piece#229.src: Continue through the Bread Vault to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#229.dst: Sigue por la Cámara del Pan hasta [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#230.src: Use the beams to make it across to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#230.dst: Usa las vigas para cruzar hasta [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#231.dst: Escucha a escondidas la reunión en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#232.src: ...and in accordance with our protocols, we will require a detailed record of this former employee. Years of employment, known associates, work performance... all of it.
The Missing Piece#232.dst: ...y conforme a nuestros protocolos, necesitaremos un expediente detallado de esta antigua empleada. Años de servicio, contactos conocidos, rendimiento laboral... todo.
The Missing Piece#232.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#233.src: Naturally, I will comply to the best of my ability, blessed be Her Grace. But to think that the mere theft of one crate would reach this high a level...
The Missing Piece#233.dst: Por supuesto, colaboraré en todo lo posible, bendita sea Su Gracia. Pero pensar que el simple robo de una caja llegue a este nivel...
The Missing Piece#233.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#234.src: The crate is not relevant. It is the employee who is of interest. Further measures may be necessary, but the records will do well to begin with.
The Missing Piece#234.dst: La caja es irrelevante. Es la empleada lo que nos interesa. Puede que hagan falta más medidas, pero para empezar bastarán los expedientes.
The Missing Piece#234.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#235.src: ...only the employee? Pardon my questions, but I do not understand why she is of interest to you.
The Missing Piece#235.dst: ...¿solo la empleada? Perdone mis preguntas, pero no entiendo por qué le interesa ella.
The Missing Piece#235.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#236.src: That is for us to know, and for you to comply. But it pertains to a potential security breach which we are investigating.
The Missing Piece#236.dst: Eso lo sabemos nosotros; usted solo obedezca. Pero atañe a una posible brecha de seguridad que estamos investigando.
The Missing Piece#236.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#237.src: At my factory? What are you implying!?
The Missing Piece#237.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#238.src: I imply nothing. Must you be reminded of your position? It is by Her Majesty's will that I am here today. Do you truly wish to stand against it?
The Missing Piece#238.dst: No insinúo nada. ¿He de recordarle su posición? Estoy aquí por voluntad de Su Majestad. ¿De veras desea oponerse?
The Missing Piece#238.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#239.src: I... I humbly apologize... I didn't mean-
The Missing Piece#239.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#241.src: Y-yes, of course. But, still, I had thought that matter was settled years ago! What connection could it possibly have to-
The Missing Piece#241.dst: S-sí, claro. Pero ¡yo creía que ese asunto se cerró hace años! ¿Qué relación puede tener con-
The Missing Piece#241.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#242.src: Enough aimless rambling. My time is limited. Pull up those records on this Elise, immediately.
The Missing Piece#242.dst: Basta de divagaciones. Mi tiempo es limitado. Saque ya el expediente de esa tal Elise.
The Missing Piece#242.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#243.src: U-understood, ma'am... I'll get them right away.
The Missing Piece#243.dst: E-entendido, señora... Los traigo ahora mismo.
The Missing Piece#243.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#244.src: Use the beams to make it across to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#244.dst: Usa las vigas para cruzar hasta [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#245.src: Acquire the bread from the barrel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#245.dst: Consigue el pan del barril en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#246.src: Continue through the Bread Vault to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#246.dst: Sigue por la Cámara del Pan hasta [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#247.src: Find the way out of the Bread Vault at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#247.dst: Encuentra la salida de la Cámara del Pan en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#248.src: Well, well, well... it would seem the rats aren't the only plague to infest this place.
The Missing Piece#248.dst: Vaya, vaya, vaya... parece que las ratas no son la única plaga de este sitio.
The Missing Piece#248.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#249.src: And here I had thought this particular lead was dead end! Only years-old records which tell us nothing we did not already know... always a risk, but worth checking regardless.
The Missing Piece#249.dst: ¡Y yo que creía que esta pista no llevaba a nada! Solo papeles viejos que no dicen nada nuevo... siempre hay riesgo, pero valía la pena comprobarlo.
The Missing Piece#249.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#250.src: But here you are. One of the province's most wanted criminals. What a strange coincidence, finding you here.
The Missing Piece#250.dst: Y aquí estás. En busca y captura en toda la provincia. Qué extraña casualidad, encontrarte aquí.
The Missing Piece#250.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#251.src: I must wonder... for what reason are you here?
The Missing Piece#251.dst: Me pregunto... ¿por qué razón estás aquí?
The Missing Piece#251.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#252.src: I know better than to expect an answer. But it does not matter, in the end. We will get it out of you eventually.
The Missing Piece#252.dst: Sé que no debo esperar respuesta. Pero da igual, al final. Acabaremos sacándotelo.
The Missing Piece#252.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#256.src: Return to the Roughworks through the pipe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#256.dst: Vuelve a Roughworks por la tubería en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#258.src: Confront the inspection or talk to Elise at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#258.dst: Enfréntate a la inspección o habla con Elise en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#259.src: Oh, it's the Water Authority! I don't know why they're here... but it can't be for any good reason.
The Missing Piece#259.dst: ¡Ay, es la Autoridad del Agua! No sé por qué han venido... pero seguro que no es por nada bueno.
The Missing Piece#259.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#260.src: Open up already! We know you're in there!
The Missing Piece#260.dst: ¡Abre de una vez! ¡Sabemos que estás ahí dentro!
The Missing Piece#260.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#261.src: Really, you should hide. It's okay, I've dealt with their type before. I'll send them away.
The Missing Piece#261.dst: En serio, deberías esconderte. No pasa nada, ya he tratado con esa gente antes. Los despacharé.
The Missing Piece#261.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#263.src: Good. Quick, find somewhere to hide!
The Missing Piece#263.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#264.src: Wait one second! I'll hide behind the plant!
The Missing Piece#264.dst: ¡Un segundo! ¡Me esconderé detrás de la planta!
The Missing Piece#264.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#268.src: A friend, you say? Then you should be able to tell me why she's not answering the door!
The Missing Piece#268.dst: ¿Un amigo, dices? ¡Entonces sabrás decirme por qué no abre la puerta!
The Missing Piece#268.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#270.src: Someone like me!? What's that supposed to mean?
The Missing Piece#270.dst: ¿¡Alguien como yo!? ¿Qué se supone que significa eso?
The Missing Piece#270.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#271.src: Oh, you'll pay for this insult! We have authority to enforce our orders with force, you know! We can do anything we want!
The Missing Piece#271.dst: ¡Ah, pagarás por este insulto! ¡Tenemos autoridad para imponer nuestras órdenes por la fuerza! ¡Podemos hacer lo que queramos!
The Missing Piece#271.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#272.src: Not at home, you say? How convenient. Just as the inspection comes around they're not at home to greet us!
The Missing Piece#272.dst: ¿Que no está en casa? Qué oportuno. ¡Justo cuando llega la inspección no está para recibirnos!
The Missing Piece#272.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#273.src: It's almost like someone tipped them off, don't you think?
The Missing Piece#273.dst: Es casi como si alguien la hubiera avisado, ¿no crees?
The Missing Piece#273.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#274.src: Say friend, did you tip off the subject that we were coming?
The Missing Piece#274.dst: Dime, amigo, ¿avisaste tú a la interesada de que veníamos?
The Missing Piece#274.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#275.src: Very well, then. But we will still need to get in to conduct the search.
The Missing Piece#275.dst: Muy bien, entonces. Pero aun así tendremos que entrar a registrar.
The Missing Piece#275.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#276.src: If you won't be of any use, then you better get out of our way!
The Missing Piece#276.dst: Si no vas a ser de ayuda, ¡más te vale apartarte!
The Missing Piece#276.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#277.src: At the bread factory? That's none of our concern, we're the Water Authority, not the Bread Authority!
The Missing Piece#277.dst: ¿En la fábrica de pan? Eso no es asunto nuestro, ¡somos la Autoridad del Agua, no la del Pan!
The Missing Piece#277.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#278.src: A massive water spillage, you say!?
The Missing Piece#278.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#279.src: And you're not making this up? We don't take easily to liars, you should know.
The Missing Piece#279.dst: ¿Y no te lo inventas? No toleramos a los mentirosos, que lo sepas.
The Missing Piece#279.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#280.src: Inspector, there seems to be some commotion coming from the Bread Factory.
The Missing Piece#280.dst: Inspectora, parece que hay alboroto en la Fábrica de Pan.
The Missing Piece#280.speaker: Sentinel

The Missing Piece#281.src: Hmm... Well, in that case, we'll have to check it out. Thank you for the information, citizen.
The Missing Piece#281.dst: Hmm... En ese caso, tendremos que ir a comprobarlo. Gracias por la información.
The Missing Piece#281.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#282.src: Passing by! As if! Did you really think I would believe that story?
The Missing Piece#282.dst: ¿De paso? ¡Ya! ¿De verdad creías que me tragaría ese cuento?
The Missing Piece#282.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#283.src: Oh, you'll pay for this insult! We have authority to enforce our orders with force, you know! We can do anything we want!
The Missing Piece#283.dst: ¡Ah, pagarás por este insulto! ¡Tenemos autoridad para imponer nuestras órdenes por la fuerza! ¡Podemos hacer lo que queramos!
The Missing Piece#283.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#284.src: We are here to execute a search. Your water usage levels have exceeded your authorized allotment.
The Missing Piece#284.dst: Venimos a realizar un registro. Tu consumo de agua ha superado la cuota autorizada.
The Missing Piece#284.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#287.src: Very well. We will now conduct an inspection of your property. Step out of the way, subject.
The Missing Piece#287.dst: Muy bien. Ahora inspeccionaremos tu vivienda. Apártate, súbdita.
The Missing Piece#287.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#288.src: What's this? No wonder you're exceeding your water limit when you've been keeping illicit plants!
The Missing Piece#288.dst: ¿Qué es esto? ¡Con razón superas tu límite de agua, si tienes plantas ilícitas!
The Missing Piece#288.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#289.src: Wait a second... There's someone hiding behind there! You said you were alone!
The Missing Piece#289.dst: Un momento... ¡Ahí detrás se esconde alguien! ¡Dijiste que estabas sola!
The Missing Piece#289.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#290.src: Oh, you'll pay for this insult! We have authority to enforce our orders with force, you know! We can do anything we want!
The Missing Piece#290.dst: ¡Ah, pagarás por este insulto! ¡Tenemos autoridad para imponer nuestras órdenes por la fuerza! ¡Podemos hacer lo que queramos!
The Missing Piece#290.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#294.src: Noooooooo, Alphonse! How... How could you do this!?
The Missing Piece#294.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#295.src: You'll pay for this, you rat! In the name of Her Majesty!
The Missing Piece#295.dst: ¡Pagarás por esto, rata! ¡En nombre de Su Majestad!
The Missing Piece#295.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#296.src: Are you alright!? I heard a commotion, and
The Missing Piece#296.dst: ¿¡Estás bien!? He oído un alboroto, y
The Missing Piece#296.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#298.src: You may as well come inside, dearie.
The Missing Piece#298.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#300.src: But how strange... The authorities have never bothered me before... Oh, let's just get inside for now.
The Missing Piece#300.dst: Pero qué raro... Las autoridades nunca me habían molestado... En fin, entremos de momento.
The Missing Piece#300.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#301.src: Find somewhere to hide in Elise's house!
The Missing Piece#301.dst: ¡Busca dónde esconderte en casa de Elise!

The Missing Piece#304.src: There you go. Now, what business could Her Majesty's authorities possibly have with little old me?
The Missing Piece#304.dst: Ya está. Bueno, ¿qué asunto pueden tener las autoridades de Su Majestad con esta vieja?
The Missing Piece#304.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#305.src: We are here to execute a search. You water usage levels have exceeded you authorized allotment.
The Missing Piece#305.dst: Venimos a realizar un registro. Tu consumo de agua ha superado la cuota autorizada.
The Missing Piece#305.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#310.src: We'll be done here after we've finished our inspection.
The Missing Piece#310.dst: Nos iremos cuando terminemos la inspección.
The Missing Piece#310.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#311.src: Say, would you prefer us searching the lower or upper floor first?
The Missing Piece#311.dst: Dime, ¿registramos primero la planta baja o la de arriba?
The Missing Piece#311.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#312.src: How kind of you to ask... but as there is nothing of interest anywhere, I would suggest you start by finding a reason to get out of my home.
The Missing Piece#312.dst: Qué amable por preguntar... pero como aquí no hay nada de interés, os sugiero empezar por buscar un motivo para salir de mi casa.
The Missing Piece#312.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#313.src: I wouldn't want to waste your time, is all.
The Missing Piece#313.dst: No quiero haceros perder el tiempo, nada más.
The Missing Piece#313.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#314.src: The lower floor then. Thank you for your cooperation.
The Missing Piece#314.dst: La planta baja, entonces. Gracias por tu cooperación.
The Missing Piece#314.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#317.src: What's this? No wonder you're exceeding your water limit when you've been keeping illicit plants!
The Missing Piece#317.dst: ¿Qué es esto? ¡Con razón superas tu límite de agua, si tienes plantas ilícitas!
The Missing Piece#317.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#318.src: Oh what's the matter with you!?
The Missing Piece#318.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#319.src: I've worked my whole life in the factories! Can't I have some flowers to keep me company in my old age?
The Missing Piece#319.dst: ¡He trabajado toda mi vida en las fábricas! ¿No puedo tener unas flores que me acompañen en la vejez?
The Missing Piece#319.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#320.src: Inspector. A message from the Authority.
The Missing Piece#320.speaker: Sentinel

The Missing Piece#324.src: There you go. Now, what business could Her Majesty's authorities possibly have with little old me?
The Missing Piece#324.dst: Ya está. Bueno, ¿qué asunto pueden tener las autoridades de Su Majestad con esta vieja?
The Missing Piece#324.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#325.src: We are here to execute a search. You water usage levels have exceeded you authorized allotment.
The Missing Piece#325.dst: Venimos a realizar un registro. Tu consumo de agua ha superado la cuota autorizada.
The Missing Piece#325.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#330.src: We'll be done here after we've finished our inspection.
The Missing Piece#330.dst: Nos iremos cuando terminemos la inspección.
The Missing Piece#330.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#331.src: Say, would you prefer us searching the lower or upper floor first?
The Missing Piece#331.dst: Dime, ¿registramos primero la planta baja o la de arriba?
The Missing Piece#331.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#332.src: How kind of you to ask... but as the upper floor is my bedroom, I would prefer it if you didn't inspect my bedsheets.
The Missing Piece#332.dst: Qué amable por preguntar... pero arriba está mi dormitorio, y preferiría que no inspeccionarais mis sábanas.
The Missing Piece#332.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#333.src: The upper floor then. Thank you for your cooperation.
The Missing Piece#333.dst: La planta de arriba, entonces. Gracias por tu cooperación.
The Missing Piece#333.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#336.src: What's this? No wonder you're exceeding your water limit when you've been keeping illicit plants!
The Missing Piece#336.dst: ¿Qué es esto? ¡Con razón superas tu límite de agua, si tienes plantas ilícitas!
The Missing Piece#336.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#337.src: Oh what's the matter with you!?
The Missing Piece#337.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#338.src: I've worked my whole life in the factories! Can't I have some flowers to keep me company in my old age?
The Missing Piece#338.dst: ¡He trabajado toda mi vida en las fábricas! ¿No puedo tener unas flores que me acompañen en la vejez?
The Missing Piece#338.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#339.src: How quaint. Doesn't it get lonely, living up here all by your lonesome?
The Missing Piece#339.dst: Qué pintoresco. ¿No se hace solitario, viviendo aquí arriba tan sola?
The Missing Piece#339.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#341.src: Anyhow, I am required to inform you that you are in breach of the ordinance on water usage and will have to-
The Missing Piece#341.dst: En fin, estoy obligado a informarte de que has infringido la ordenanza del agua y tendrás que-
The Missing Piece#341.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#342.src: Inspector. A message from the Authority.
The Missing Piece#342.speaker: Sentinel

The Missing Piece#346.src: There you go. Now, what business could Her Majesty's authorities possibly have with little old me?
The Missing Piece#346.dst: Ya está. Bueno, ¿qué asunto pueden tener las autoridades de Su Majestad con esta vieja?
The Missing Piece#346.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#347.src: We are here to execute a search. You water usage levels have exceeded you authorized allotment.
The Missing Piece#347.dst: Venimos a realizar un registro. Tu consumo de agua ha superado la cuota autorizada.
The Missing Piece#347.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#352.src: We'll be done here after we've finished our inspection.
The Missing Piece#352.dst: Nos iremos cuando terminemos la inspección.
The Missing Piece#352.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#353.src: Say, would you prefer us searching the lower or upper floor first?
The Missing Piece#353.dst: Dime, ¿registramos primero la planta baja o la de arriba?
The Missing Piece#353.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#355.src: Well, seems you're in luck this time, subject.
