The Missing Piece#355.dst: Bueno, parece que esta vez tienes suerte, súbdita.
The Missing Piece#355.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#356.src: Some higher authority has overruled our command... we're being recalled.
The Missing Piece#356.dst: Una autoridad superior ha anulado nuestra orden... nos retiran.
The Missing Piece#356.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#357.src: But don't be mistaken. We'll be back!
The Missing Piece#357.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#358.src: Well, you won't be welcome next time!
The Missing Piece#358.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#359.src: Nuisances, all of them... Well, it worked out in the end, didn't it?
The Missing Piece#359.dst: Unos pesados, todos ellos... En fin, al final salió bien, ¿no?
The Missing Piece#359.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#360.src: They're gone, you can come out now.
The Missing Piece#360.dst: Se han ido, ya puedes salir.
The Missing Piece#360.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#361.src: Come, let's sit down and have a talk.
The Missing Piece#361.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#364.src: Right! The bread! So forgetful these days...
The Missing Piece#364.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#365.src: Well? How did it go? Did you get any? I hope it wasn't too much trouble...
The Missing Piece#365.dst: ¿Y bien? ¿Cómo ha ido? ¿Lo conseguiste? Espero que no fuera mucho lío...
The Missing Piece#365.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#366.src: Oh, wonderful. Thank you. That should be everything we need...
The Missing Piece#366.dst: Ah, maravilloso. Gracias. Con esto tenemos todo lo que hace falta...
The Missing Piece#366.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#367.src: Well, if there was no other way... If the Authority is going to stomp in here looking for plants, taking a loaf of bread in return seems like a fair deal!
The Missing Piece#367.dst: En fin, si no había otra forma... ¡Si la Autoridad puede entrar aquí a buscar plantas, llevarse una hogaza a cambio parece un trato justo!
The Missing Piece#367.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#369.src: Ah... How nostalgic. It really does bring me back to those good old days.
The Missing Piece#369.dst: Ah... Qué nostalgia. De verdad me devuelve a aquellos buenos tiempos.
The Missing Piece#369.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#370.src: There was one time though... We... No, I bought it... Argh, why can't I remember!
The Missing Piece#370.dst: Aunque una vez... Fuimos... No, lo compré yo... ¡Agh, no me acuerdo!
The Missing Piece#370.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#371.src: How strange... Again, this feeling... As if- as if there's something I should be remembering... but can't.
The Missing Piece#371.dst: Qué extraño... Otra vez esta sensación... Como si- como si hubiera algo que debería recordar... y no puedo.
The Missing Piece#371.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#373.src: Do you remember how we first met? All those years ago?
The Missing Piece#373.dst: ¿Recuerdas cómo nos conocimos? Hace ya tantos años.

The Missing Piece#374.src: Of course I do! But... thinking about it now, maybe I was a bit... cold.
The Missing Piece#374.dst: ¡Claro que sí! Aunque... pensándolo ahora, quizá fui un poco... fría.
The Missing Piece#374.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#375.src: You were fine! You were the only one who...

The Missing Piece#377.src: You were the only one who even noticed I was there.
The Missing Piece#377.dst: Eras la única que se daba cuenta de que yo estaba ahí.

The Missing Piece#378.src: Ah- hello. I'm {u}, I'm new here. Nice to meet you.
The Missing Piece#378.dst: Ah- hola. Soy {u}, acabo de empezar aquí. Un placer.

The Missing Piece#379.src: The name's Elise, do a good job and I'm sure we'll get along.
The Missing Piece#379.dst: Me llamo Elise. Trabaja bien y seguro que nos llevamos bien.
The Missing Piece#379.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#380.src: Right, yes. Of course... I'll try my best!
The Missing Piece#380.dst: Sí, claro. Por supuesto... ¡Haré lo que pueda!

The Missing Piece#381.src: ... You know what, have this. It'll help you get through the day.
The Missing Piece#381.dst: ... ¿Sabes qué? Toma esto. Te ayudará a aguantar el día.
The Missing Piece#381.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#385.src: Really? I was only working there for a month!
The Missing Piece#385.dst: ¿En serio? ¡Si solo estuve allí un mes!

The Missing Piece#386.src: Oh, sure... but it was a good month, wasn't it?
The Missing Piece#386.dst: Ya, claro... pero fue un buen mes, ¿verdad?
The Missing Piece#386.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#387.src: And even after you were transferred away... I had something to look forward to at the end of my shifts.
The Missing Piece#387.dst: E incluso después de que te trasladaran... tenía algo que esperar al acabar el turno.
The Missing Piece#387.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#388.src: Ah... well... now you have something to look forward to when you come home, as well.
The Missing Piece#388.dst: Ah... bueno... ahora tú también tienes algo que esperar al volver a casa.

The Missing Piece#389.src: Ha! I guess I do, don't I...
The Missing Piece#389.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#390.src: But it all seems so small from up here... doesn't it? Just look at the view!
The Missing Piece#390.dst: Pero desde aquí todo parece tan pequeño... ¿verdad? ¡Mira qué vistas!
The Missing Piece#390.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#391.src: It really is beautiful... up here, it's like nothing else matters except for us.
The Missing Piece#391.dst: Es precioso de verdad... aquí arriba es como si nada más importara.

The Missing Piece#392.src: ...I wish we could stay like this forever...
The Missing Piece#392.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#393.src: ...oh. So do I, Elise... so do I...

The Missing Piece#394.src: Ha, but why do you sound so sad?
The Missing Piece#394.dst: Ja, ¿y por qué suenas tan triste?
The Missing Piece#394.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#396.src: It's nothing... we'll stay like this... forever. I promise.
The Missing Piece#396.dst: No es nada... nos quedaremos así... para siempre. Lo prometo.

The Missing Piece#397.src: Her, again... Who is she? Why am I remembering these things?
The Missing Piece#397.dst: Otra vez ella... ¿Quién es? ¿Por qué recuerdo estas cosas?
The Missing Piece#397.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#399.src: Well, there's nothing that can be done about it now, is there? Say, why don't we head out?
The Missing Piece#399.dst: En fin, ya no hay nada que hacer, ¿verdad? Oye, ¿y si salimos a dar una vuelta?
The Missing Piece#399.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#400.src: Oh, dear. Did I forget to tell you? The bread is for a picnic!
The Missing Piece#400.dst: Ay, cielo. ¿Se me olvidó decírtelo? ¡El pan es para un pícnic!
The Missing Piece#400.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#401.src: I know the perfect place... in fact, you reminded me of it. It has a view over the entire Roughworks, can you believe that?
The Missing Piece#401.dst: Conozco el sitio perfecto... de hecho, me lo has recordado tú. Desde allí se ve todo Roughworks, ¿te lo puedes creer?
The Missing Piece#401.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#402.src: Although... Thinking about it, it's a bit far... I don't know if my old legs will carry me all the way there, ha!
The Missing Piece#402.dst: Aunque... pensándolo bien, está un poco lejos... No sé si mis viejas piernas llegarán hasta allí, ¡ja!
The Missing Piece#402.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#403.src: Someone around here has to have the code to this...
The Missing Piece#403.dst: Alguien por aquí tiene que saber el código de esto...

The Missing Piece#404.src: Now all you have to do is get out of this place somehow...
The Missing Piece#404.dst: Ahora solo tienes que salir de este sitio de algún modo...

The Missing Piece#405.src: Maybe if you hit those bottles, it will move the beam.
The Missing Piece#405.dst: Quizá si le das a esas botellas, la viga se mueva.

The Missing Piece#409.src: Well, what do you say, then? Just talk to me when you want to head out.
The Missing Piece#409.dst: ¿Y bien, qué me dices? Habla conmigo cuando quieras salir.
The Missing Piece#409.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#411.src: Well, what do you say? Shall we head out?
The Missing Piece#411.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#414.src: Oh, you can really see a lot from up here... Let's go!
The Missing Piece#414.dst: Oh, desde aquí arriba se ve muchísimo... ¡Vamos!
The Missing Piece#414.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#415.src: Where to? I know just the place for this! Let's see, it's...
The Missing Piece#415.dst: ¿Hacia dónde? ¡Conozco el sitio ideal para esto! A ver, está...
The Missing Piece#415.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#416.src: Hm... I think... Forward! Yes, I think it was straight forward from here. Although, my memory might be a little hazy...
The Missing Piece#416.dst: Hm... Creo que... ¡Adelante! Sí, creo que era todo recto desde aquí. Aunque mi memoria no es lo que era...
The Missing Piece#416.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#418.src: Ah, hm... I think we turn left here...
The Missing Piece#418.dst: Ah, hm... Creo que es a la izquierda...
The Missing Piece#418.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#419.src: No, wait... It's right, we definitely have to turn right!
The Missing Piece#419.dst: No, espera... Es a la derecha, ¡seguro que hay que girar a la derecha!
The Missing Piece#419.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#421.src: That house feels familiar... I think... yes, turn right here!
The Missing Piece#421.dst: Esa casa me suena... Creo que... ¡sí, aquí a la derecha!
The Missing Piece#421.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#423.src: Stop! Hmm... I don't think it's across this bridge, at least. Then that must mean...
The Missing Piece#423.dst: ¡Para! Hmm... Al menos no creo que sea cruzando este puente. Entonces eso significa...
The Missing Piece#423.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#424.src: Oh, what's the matter! We'll find it eventually, right? I'm pretty sure it's to the left!
The Missing Piece#424.dst: ¡Ay, qué más da! Ya lo encontraremos, ¿no? ¡Estoy bastante segura de que es a la izquierda!
The Missing Piece#424.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#426.src: Yes, this is it! It's just around this corner, I'm sure of it!
The Missing Piece#426.dst: ¡Sí, es aquí! ¡Está justo a la vuelta de la esquina, estoy segura!
The Missing Piece#426.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#428.src: Here! I remember now... it's in here!
The Missing Piece#428.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#429.src: I don't remember it being so overgrown, though...
The Missing Piece#429.dst: Aunque no recuerdo que estuviera tan cubierto de maleza...
The Missing Piece#429.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#430.src: How long has it been? I can't recall the last time I was here...
The Missing Piece#430.dst: ¿Cuánto tiempo ha pasado? No recuerdo la última vez que estuve aquí...
The Missing Piece#430.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#432.src: Ah, it's blocked... Well. I didn't want to bring it up, but it seems we're out of options.
The Missing Piece#432.dst: Ah, está bloqueado... En fin. No quería sacar el tema, pero parece que no nos quedan opciones.
The Missing Piece#432.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#433.src: Oh, there's no need to pretend anymore. I know what you are. You're one of them, aren't you?
The Missing Piece#433.dst: Ah, ya no hace falta fingir. Sé lo que eres. Eres de los suyos, ¿verdad?
The Missing Piece#433.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#434.src: The cursed, as the Crown calls them. Not that I care!
The Missing Piece#434.dst: Los malditos, como los llama la Corona. ¡No es que a mí me importe!
The Missing Piece#434.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#435.src: Why should I? I'm old! I have enough to worry about as is...
The Missing Piece#435.dst: ¿Y por qué? ¡Soy vieja! Ya tengo bastantes preocupaciones...
The Missing Piece#435.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#436.src: Besides, it's certainly useful in situations like this, isn't it? Be a dearie and do one of your little tricks, won't you?
The Missing Piece#436.dst: Además, en situaciones así viene muy bien, ¿no? Anda, cielo, haz uno de tus truquitos, ¿quieres?
The Missing Piece#436.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#438.src: That's it... Let me down now, I can walk the rest of the way myself.
The Missing Piece#438.dst: Eso es... Ya puedes bajarme, el resto del camino lo hago yo sola.
The Missing Piece#438.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#440.src: It's a little more... well, deserted, than I remember. But that's fine.
The Missing Piece#440.dst: Está un poco más... bueno, desierto de lo que recuerdo. Pero no importa.
The Missing Piece#440.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#441.src: We can take this elevator to the top. You'll have to find a way into the control room though... It shouldn't be too hard to reach!
The Missing Piece#441.dst: Podemos subir con este ascensor. Aunque tendrás que encontrar la forma de entrar en la sala de control... ¡No debería costar llegar!
The Missing Piece#441.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#442.src: It's that thing up over there. The tunnel on the right will get you to it.
The Missing Piece#442.dst: Es esa cosa de ahí arriba. El túnel de la derecha te lleva hasta ella.
The Missing Piece#442.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#445.dst: Llega al panel de control en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#446.src: Can you hear me? I'm down here!
The Missing Piece#446.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#447.src: Use the controls to get me up! You know how it works, right?
The Missing Piece#447.dst: ¡Usa los controles para subirme! Sabes cómo funciona, ¿no?
The Missing Piece#447.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#448.src: Use the controls at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to bring Elise up.
The Missing Piece#448.dst: Usa los controles de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para subir a Elise.

The Missing Piece#451.src: Maybe if... oh, I know. Put something on the up button, then you can clear the blockage... and we'll go up.
The Missing Piece#451.dst: Quizá si... ah, ya sé. Pon algo encima del botón de subir, luego quitas lo atascado... y subimos.
The Missing Piece#451.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#452.src: Perfect! Now it will move, if only we can get it unstuck...
The Missing Piece#452.dst: ¡Perfecto! Ahora se moverá, si conseguimos desatascarlo...
The Missing Piece#452.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#453.src: If you could get up there, somehow...
The Missing Piece#453.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#455.src: Oh well, this place seems abandoned anyhow! Who cares about a little destruction?
The Missing Piece#455.dst: ¡Bah, este sitio parece abandonado igualmente! ¿A quién le importa un poco de destrozo?
The Missing Piece#455.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#456.src: Go up there and see if you can find a way to get this thing going again.
The Missing Piece#456.dst: Sube ahí y mira si encuentras la forma de poner esto en marcha otra vez.
The Missing Piece#456.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#458.src: Throw a brick at the blockage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#458.dst: Lanza un ladrillo al atasco en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#459.src: How's it going? Can you see anything?
The Missing Piece#459.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#466.src: Follow Elise to the cliff at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#466.dst: Sigue a Elise hasta el acantilado en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#467.src: Ah, isn't this place nice. The breeze, the view, everything.
The Missing Piece#467.dst: Ah, qué sitio tan bonito. La brisa, las vistas, todo.
The Missing Piece#467.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#468.src: You can even see the trees of the {p} swaying from up here...
The Missing Piece#468.dst: Desde aquí arriba hasta se ven mecerse los árboles de {p}...
The Missing Piece#468.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#469.src: And finally! A place to sit! I'm sorely in need of some relaxation after this eventful day.
The Missing Piece#469.dst: ¡Y por fin! ¡Un sitio donde sentarse! Después de un día tan movido me hace mucha falta relajarme.
The Missing Piece#469.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#470.src: Please, let's sit down and enjoy the view for a bit.
The Missing Piece#470.dst: Venga, sentémonos a disfrutar un rato de las vistas.
The Missing Piece#470.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#472.src: Hm. It's strange. All day, I've been... reminiscing, I suppose. And now, seeing this view... it fills me with that same, nostalgic feeling.
The Missing Piece#472.dst: Hm. Qué raro. Todo el día he estado... recordando, supongo. Y ahora, al ver estas vistas... me invade esa misma nostalgia.
The Missing Piece#472.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#476.src: You should probably take your place at the front of the line.
The Missing Piece#476.dst: Deberías ponerte al principio de la cola.

The Missing Piece#477.src: All day, I've been having these... visions of the past. Of these things I can't recall ever happening.
The Missing Piece#477.dst: Todo el día he tenido estas... visiones del pasado. De cosas que no recuerdo que ocurrieran.
The Missing Piece#477.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#478.src: And I... well, truthfully, I'm not sure how to feel about it...
The Missing Piece#478.dst: Y yo... bueno, la verdad, no sé qué sentir al respecto...
The Missing Piece#478.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#479.src: But I know- I know in my heart, that there's something missing... a piece that would make it all fit.
The Missing Piece#479.dst: Pero sé- sé en mi corazón que falta algo... una pieza que lo encajaría todo.
The Missing Piece#479.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#481.src: In every dream she's there beside me... but I don't even remember her name. I can't even recall her face...
The Missing Piece#481.dst: En cada sueño está a mi lado... pero ni siquiera recuerdo su nombre. Ni su cara...
The Missing Piece#481.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#482.src: If she was this important to me... then how could I forget?
The Missing Piece#482.dst: Si era tan importante para mí... ¿cómo pude olvidarla?
The Missing Piece#482.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#485.src: Hurgh... hurgh... One second, I need to catch my breath.
The Missing Piece#485.dst: Uf... uf... Un segundo, que recupere el aliento.
The Missing Piece#485.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#486.src: Hm... Do you know this person? They're not an inspector... are they?
The Missing Piece#486.dst: Hm... ¿Conoces a esta persona? No será un inspector... ¿verdad?
The Missing Piece#486.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#487.src: So, as I was going to say-
The Missing Piece#487.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#488.src: Okay, fine! I'll get straight to the point.
The Missing Piece#488.dst: ¡Vale, está bien! Iré directo al grano.
The Missing Piece#488.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#489.src: I found more letters to deliver, and I was on my way to deliver them when I saw you two running out! Can you imagine how shocked I was?
The Missing Piece#489.dst: ¡Encontré más cartas que repartir, e iba a entregarlas cuando os vi salir corriendo a los dos! ¿Os imagináis mi sorpresa?
The Missing Piece#489.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#490.src: That being that, I naturally decided to follow you, the good postmaster that I am. You sure didn't make it easy though! I barely managed to make it up here... It's a nice spot, by the way.
The Missing Piece#490.dst: Siendo así, naturalmente decidí seguiros, buen jefe de correos que soy. ¡Desde luego no me lo pusisteis fácil! Apenas conseguí llegar hasta aquí... Bonito sitio, por cierto.
The Missing Piece#490.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#491.src: But... how could you have possibly made it up here...?
The Missing Piece#491.dst: Pero... ¿cómo ha conseguido usted subir hasta aquí...?
The Missing Piece#491.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#492.src: Getting up here is nothing to a university graduate like me!
The Missing Piece#492.dst: ¡Subir aquí no es nada para un licenciado universitario como yo!
The Missing Piece#492.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#495.src: Well, that was all that I came for I suppose. So...
The Missing Piece#495.dst: Bueno, supongo que a eso venía. Así que...
The Missing Piece#495.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#496.src: You came all this way just for that!? At least have a piece of bread, or something...!
The Missing Piece#496.dst: ¿¡Ha hecho todo este camino solo por eso!? ¡Al menos coja un trozo de pan...!
The Missing Piece#496.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#497.src: No, no. I couldn't possibly! Duty calls, the post isn't going to sort itself, and all that... Oh, by Her Majesty, the backlog...
The Missing Piece#497.dst: No, no. ¡De ninguna manera! El deber llama, el correo no se clasifica solo y todo eso... Ay, por Su Majestad, el atraso...
The Missing Piece#497.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#498.src: Right! You! I hate to admit it, but it seems you've done your job well enough.
The Missing Piece#498.dst: ¡Ah, tú! Me cuesta admitirlo, pero parece que has hecho bien tu trabajo.
The Missing Piece#498.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#499.src: I happened to double check the records and it seems like my substitute, well, may have been someone else entirely!
The Missing Piece#499.dst: Resulta que revisé los registros otra vez y parece que mi sustituto, bueno, ¡podría haber sido otra persona!
The Missing Piece#499.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#500.src: No harm, no foul, right? The work's already done! No takesies-backsies! Okay?
The Missing Piece#500.dst: Sin daño no hay falta, ¿no? ¡El trabajo ya está hecho! ¡Y no vale arrepentirse! ¿Vale?
The Missing Piece#500.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#502.src: Huh, what was that? I couldn't hear you! Okay, bye!
The Missing Piece#502.dst: ¿Eh, qué has dicho? ¡No te oigo! ¡Vale, adiós!
The Missing Piece#502.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#504.src: But it was certainly nice of them to deliver this letter. Let me take a look.
The Missing Piece#504.dst: Pero desde luego fue amable al traer esta carta. Déjame ver.
The Missing Piece#504.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#506.src: Oh, I don't understand... What would she have to apologize for?
The Missing Piece#506.dst: Ay, no lo entiendo... ¿De qué tendría que disculparse ella?
The Missing Piece#506.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#507.src: Please... {u}, take a breath. You're shaking.
The Missing Piece#507.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#509.src: Getting caught in a storm like that... really, I could have waited a few hours! You didn't need to push yourself to get here.
The Missing Piece#509.dst: Meterte en una tormenta así... ¡de verdad, podría haber esperado unas horas! No hacía falta que te forzaras para llegar.
The Missing Piece#509.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#511.src: Yes, I know the weather's bad now... but eventually, it'll get better again. The clouds will clear and the sun will shine again. Right?
The Missing Piece#511.dst: Sí, ya sé que ahora hace mal tiempo... pero al final mejorará. Las nubes se irán y volverá a brillar el sol. ¿Verdad?
The Missing Piece#511.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#513.src: You know, it's not so bad with rain once in a while. Means we don't have to water the flowers, at least! And nothing beats the smell of wet grass after rain, don't you agree?
The Missing Piece#513.dst: ¿Sabes? De vez en cuando la lluvia no viene mal. ¡Al menos no hay que regar las flores! Y no hay nada como el olor a hierba mojada después de llover, ¿no crees?
The Missing Piece#513.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#514.src: We could do something after it clears up. It's been a while since you visited, so why not go to our spot? I should still have some leftover bread lying around...
The Missing Piece#514.dst: Cuando escampe podríamos hacer algo. Hace tiempo que no vienes, ¿por qué no vamos a nuestro sitio? Creo que aún me queda pan por ahí...
The Missing Piece#514.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#515.src: Elise. You're- please, forgive me- you're in danger. I-
The Missing Piece#515.dst: Elise. Estás- por favor, perdóname- estás en peligro. Yo-

The Missing Piece#516.src: I'm in danger? I'm just an ordinary worker, what reason would anyone have to harm me? I'll be fine.
The Missing Piece#516.dst: ¿En peligro? Soy una obrera normal y corriente, ¿qué motivo tendría nadie para hacerme daño? Estaré bien.
The Missing Piece#516.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#517.src: {u}, you're the one pushing herself through this weather, clearly panicking...
The Missing Piece#517.dst: {u}, eres tú la que se fuerza con este tiempo, claramente presa del pánico...
The Missing Piece#517.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#518.src: I barely get to see you anymore. And now, out of nowhere, you're here in this state... What's going on? Please, just talk to me.
The Missing Piece#518.dst: Ya casi no puedo verte. Y ahora, de repente, apareces en ese estado... ¿Qué ocurre? Por favor, háblame.
The Missing Piece#518.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#519.src: ...ha. I- I haven't been truthful with you, Elise, and- I can explain later. We need to get out of here, before they-
The Missing Piece#519.dst: ...ja. No- no he sido sincera contigo, Elise, y- luego te lo explico. Hay que salir de aquí, antes de que-

The Missing Piece#522.src: Why would they... no, this doesn't make any sense...
The Missing Piece#522.dst: ¿Por qué iban a... no, esto no tiene ningún sentido...

The Missing Piece#523.src: Hm. Well, then maybe it's nothing. I'll go see who it is.
The Missing Piece#523.dst: Hm. Bueno, entonces quizá no sea nada. Iré a ver quién es.
The Missing Piece#523.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#524.src: As if one wasn't enough... who could possibly be foolish enough to brave a storm just to come visit this little place? Whatever it is, it can wait.
The Missing Piece#524.dst: Como si con una no bastara... ¿quién sería tan tonto como para desafiar una tormenta solo por venir a este rincón? Sea lo que sea, puede esperar.
The Missing Piece#524.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#527.src: No... No... What are you... Why are you-
The Missing Piece#527.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#528.src: Apologies for the disturbance, madam. But I'm afraid we have business to attend to.
The Missing Piece#528.dst: Disculpe la molestia, señora. Pero me temo que tenemos un asunto que atender.
The Missing Piece#528.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#530.src: {u}, {u}, why are they here? Why... why won't you answer me...?
The Missing Piece#530.dst: {u}, {u}, ¿por qué están aquí? Por qué... ¿por qué no me respondes...?
The Missing Piece#530.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#531.src: What have you done? I... Please, just explain... I- I...
The Missing Piece#531.dst: ¿Qué has hecho? Yo... Por favor, explícamelo... Yo- yo...
The Missing Piece#531.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#532.src: I... how did I overlook this...?

The Missing Piece#533.src: Seems you're not quite the strategic mastermind you though yourself, Lioness.
The Missing Piece#533.dst: Parece que no eres la gran estratega que creías, Leona.
The Missing Piece#533.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#535.src: Elise... if you... if you just cooperate...
The Missing Piece#535.dst: Elise... si tú... si simplemente cooperas...

The Missing Piece#536.src: Then... everything will be fine. It... it will.
The Missing Piece#536.dst: Entonces... todo irá bien. Irá... irá bien.

The Missing Piece#539.src: She... What did she do? Why did she wrap me up in it?
The Missing Piece#539.dst: Ella... ¿Qué hizo? ¿Por qué me metió en esto?
The Missing Piece#539.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#540.src: Everything I remember... it just leaves me with more questions than answers. Why can't I remember her...? Why!?
The Missing Piece#540.dst: Todo lo que recuerdo... solo me deja más preguntas que respuestas. ¿Por qué no la recuerdo...? ¿¡Por qué!?
The Missing Piece#540.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#541.src: I- I'm just an ordinary factory worker! I woke up early, worked late, slept late... then did it all over again the next day.
The Missing Piece#541.dst: ¡Yo- yo solo soy una obrera corriente! Madrugaba, trabajaba hasta tarde, dormía poco... y vuelta a empezar.
The Missing Piece#541.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#542.src: I've never said a word about the Crown! Why would they possibly care about... me...?
The Missing Piece#542.dst: ¡Nunca he dicho ni una palabra contra la Corona! ¿Por qué iban a interesarse por... mí...?
The Missing Piece#542.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#543.src: They... they took everything from me. My youth, my body, my time, and... and I never demanded anything in return.
The Missing Piece#543.dst: Ellos... me lo quitaron todo. Mi juventud, mi cuerpo, mi tiempo, y... y yo nunca pedí nada a cambio.
The Missing Piece#543.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#544.src: So, why... why can't I just have this? This one little thing? Why can't I remember her...?
The Missing Piece#544.dst: Entonces, por qué... ¿por qué no puedo tener esto? ¿Esta pequeñez? ¿Por qué no puedo recordarla...?
The Missing Piece#544.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#545.src: ...oh, it might sound sad... but, looking back at it all like this...
The Missing Piece#545.dst: ...ay, quizá suene triste... pero, mirando todo esto en retrospectiva...
The Missing Piece#545.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#546.src: My life doesn't seem all that great, does it? Ha. Toiling away in a factory for someone else's bread...
The Missing Piece#546.dst: Mi vida no parece gran cosa, ¿verdad? Ja. Deslomándome en una fábrica por el pan de otros...
The Missing Piece#546.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#547.src: But I can feel her. Even if... even if I can't remember her face, or her name, or her touch... I still feel her. Lingering in my heart. Shining.
The Missing Piece#547.dst: Pero la siento. Aunque... aunque no recuerde su cara, ni su nombre, ni su tacto... la sigo sintiendo. Latiendo en mi corazón. Brillando.
The Missing Piece#547.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#548.src: ...it's all some sort of sick joke, isn't it?
The Missing Piece#548.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#549.src: They weren't content with all I sacrificed... they had to take even my memories? Is that it...?
The Missing Piece#549.dst: No les bastó con todo lo que sacrifiqué... ¿tenían que llevarse hasta mis recuerdos? ¿Es eso...?
The Missing Piece#549.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#551.src: Wherever you are now... whatever you did... whatever secrets you kept... I hope it was worth it.
The Missing Piece#551.dst: Estés donde estés... hicieras lo que hicieras... con los secretos que guardaras... espero que valiera la pena.
The Missing Piece#551.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#552.src: I hope you burn this entire place to the ground.
The Missing Piece#552.dst: Espero que reduzcas este lugar entero a cenizas.
The Missing Piece#552.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#554.src: I just wish... we could have spent more time together.
The Missing Piece#554.dst: Solo desearía... que hubiéramos pasado más tiempo juntas.
The Missing Piece#554.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#555.src: For a long time, I went along the path that had been laid before me. I did what was right.
The Missing Piece#555.dst: Durante mucho tiempo seguí el camino que habían trazado para mí. Hacía lo que era correcto.

The Missing Piece#556.src: But then... I met you, Elise.

The Missing Piece#557.src: I... I don't know what to say, {u}...
The Missing Piece#557.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#560.src: I see... a bird. A pigeon, it's old and gray. Its wings no longer work like they used to...
The Missing Piece#560.dst: Veo... un pájaro. Una paloma, vieja y gris. Sus alas ya no funcionan como antes...
The Missing Piece#560.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#561.src: It wants to fly, but it can't... It's struggling...
The Missing Piece#561.dst: Quiere volar, pero no puede... Se esfuerza...
The Missing Piece#561.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#563.src: No, I can't! It's too sad...
The Missing Piece#563.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#565.src: It's sitting beneath the shade of a canopy, singing. Like a cry, almost, mourning.
The Missing Piece#565.dst: Está posada a la sombra de una copa, cantando. Casi como un llanto, un lamento.
The Missing Piece#565.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#566.src: The clouds, dark clouds are gathering. A storm is coming. The bird is looking around, frantically searching. It's scared.
The Missing Piece#566.dst: Las nubes, unas nubes oscuras se acumulan. Se acerca una tormenta. El pájaro mira a su alrededor, buscando frenético. Tiene miedo.
The Missing Piece#566.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#567.src: It... It calls out, for something... or someone...
The Missing Piece#567.dst: Está... Está llamando a algo... o a alguien...
The Missing Piece#567.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#568.src: Who is it calling for, Elise?

The Missing Piece#573.src: I won't forget! I won't forget! I won't! I promised! I promised I'd never forget you!
The Missing Piece#573.dst: ¡No lo olvidaré! ¡No lo olvidaré! ¡No! ¡Lo prometí! ¡Prometí que nunca te olvidaría!
The Missing Piece#573.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#576.src: You are an ordinary worker from the Roughworks. You work an ordinary job, and lead an ordinary but solitary life.
The Missing Piece#576.dst: Eres una obrera corriente de Roughworks. Tienes un trabajo corriente y una vida corriente pero solitaria.
The Missing Piece#576.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#578.src: She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her.
The Missing Piece#578.dst: Ella no es nada para ti. Nunca la has conocido. Nunca la conocerás.
The Missing Piece#578.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#581.src: You are nothing to her! She is nothing to you! Soon you'll forget she ever existed.
The Missing Piece#581.dst: ¡Tú no eres nada para ella! ¡Ella no es nada para ti! Pronto olvidarás que existió.
The Missing Piece#581.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#582.src: No, I will never forget! She was everything to me! She is everything to me! I will never forget her!
The Missing Piece#582.dst: ¡No, nunca lo olvidaré! ¡Ella lo era todo para mí! ¡Ella lo es todo para mí! ¡Nunca la olvidaré!
The Missing Piece#582.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#583.src: She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her.
The Missing Piece#583.dst: Ella no es nada para ti. Nunca la has conocido. Nunca la conocerás.
The Missing Piece#583.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#584.src: You do not know her face, nor her voice, nor her touch.
The Missing Piece#584.dst: No conoces su cara, ni su voz, ni su tacto.
The Missing Piece#584.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#586.src: She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her. You have always been ordinary, you will always be ordinary.
The Missing Piece#586.dst: Ella no es nada para ti. Nunca la has conocido. Nunca la conocerás. Siempre has sido corriente, y siempre lo serás.
The Missing Piece#586.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#589.src: I will ask once more. Is your directive understood?
The Missing Piece#589.dst: Preguntaré una vez más. ¿Has entendido tu directriz?
The Missing Piece#589.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#599.dst: Me he acordado de que te quiero.
The Missing Piece#599.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#600.src: And I'll never forget it, Elise.
The Missing Piece#600.speaker: Syndra

The Missing Piece#603.src: My legs... feel funny... I think... I think I'm in need of some rest. A long, long rest... I deserve that... don't I?
The Missing Piece#603.dst: Las piernas... me fallan... Creo... creo que necesito descansar. Un descanso largo, muy largo... Me lo merezco... ¿no?
The Missing Piece#603.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#604.src: You'll take me home... won't you? I want to see it, at least once more... The tree.
The Missing Piece#604.dst: Me llevarás a casa... ¿verdad? Quiero verlo, al menos una vez más... El árbol.
The Missing Piece#604.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#606.dst: Lleva a Elise a casa, a [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#608.src: It's grown so tall... and so beautiful. Hasn't it, Syndra...?
The Missing Piece#608.dst: Qué alto se ha hecho... y qué bonito. ¿Verdad, Syndra...?
The Missing Piece#608.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#609.src: If... If only... you could have seen it... like this...
The Missing Piece#609.dst: Si... Si al menos... hubieras podido verlo... así...
The Missing Piece#609.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#612.src: Pick some of Elise's flowers around her house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#612.dst: Recoge algunas flores de Elise alrededor de su casa en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Olmic Rune#000.src: It has no fuel left, maybe you can start it again?
The Olmic Rune#000.dst: No le queda combustible, ¿quizá puedas volver a arrancarla?

The Olmic Rune#001.src: The crystalized magic on the floor seems unstable. Maybe something can shatter it...
The Olmic Rune#001.dst: La magia cristalizada del suelo parece inestable. Quizá algo pueda hacerla añicos...

The Olmic Rune#003.src: The strange shard is reacting to the floor...
The Olmic Rune#003.dst: El extraño fragmento reacciona al suelo...

The Olmic Rune#007.src: The loud noise is bound to attract creatures of the expanse.
The Olmic Rune#007.dst: Semejante estruendo atraerá sin duda a las criaturas del Expanse.

The Olmic Rune#008.src: It looks like the machine is about to break through!
The Olmic Rune#008.dst: ¡Parece que la máquina está a punto de atravesarlo!

The Olmic Rune#010.src: Find some sort of fuel in the Ruined City.
The Olmic Rune#010.dst: Encuentra algún tipo de combustible en Ruined City.

The Olmic Rune#011.src: Explore the cave for the fuel
The Olmic Rune#011.dst: Explora la cueva en busca del combustible

The Olmic Rune#012.src: Collect [{~} Fuel Sprites] and bring it back to the machine.
The Olmic Rune#012.dst: Reúne [{~} Espíritus de combustible] y llévalos de vuelta a la máquina.

The Olmic Rune#013.src: Head back to the machine at [{~},-{~}]

The Olmic Rune#014.src: Defend the machine from the incoming attackers.
The Olmic Rune#014.dst: Defiende la máquina de los atacantes que llegan.

The Order of the Grook#000.src: Talk to Seasum in a tower on {p}.
The Order of the Grook#000.dst: Habla con Seasum en una torre de {p}.

The Order of the Grook#001.src: Ugh... I really, really, reeeeally don't want to go...
The Order of the Grook#001.dst: Puf... No quiero ir, de verdad, de verdaaaad que no...
The Order of the Grook#001.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#003.src: Do you... not have manners at all?! Just running into my parents' house like that! Jeez!
The Order of the Grook#003.dst: ¿Tú... no tienes modales ni por asomo? ¡Entrar así en casa de mis padres! ¡Jopé!
The Order of the Grook#003.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#005.src: Oh, I know! Here, go to my room real fast, and grab the letter in there
The Order of the Grook#005.dst: ¡Ah, ya sé! Corre a mi cuarto y coge la carta que hay allí
The Order of the Grook#005.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#006.src: Bring it back to me when you do, I wanna make sure it's the right one.
The Order of the Grook#006.dst: Tráemela cuando la tengas, quiero ver si es la correcta.
The Order of the Grook#006.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#007.src: Get the school invitation from Seasum room and bring it to Seasum.
The Order of the Grook#007.dst: Coge la invitación del colegio en el cuarto de Seasum y llévasela.

The Order of the Grook#008.src: Yep, that's the right letter. I hope you like school!
The Order of the Grook#008.dst: Sí, esa es la carta. ¡Espero que te guste el cole!
The Order of the Grook#008.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#009.src: My parents were super exited when that letter flew into my room, but magical school sounds so boring...
The Order of the Grook#009.dst: Mis padres flipaban cuando la carta entró volando, pero un colegio de magia suena aburridísimo...
The Order of the Grook#009.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#010.src: I don't even want to learn magic! I just want to write my stories and play games. You can go instead.
The Order of the Grook#010.dst: ¡Ni siquiera quiero aprender magia! Solo quiero escribir mis historias y jugar. Ve tú en mi lugar.
The Order of the Grook#010.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#011.src: I know the picture on the letter is of me, but you can, um...
The Order of the Grook#011.dst: Ya sé que la foto de la carta soy yo, pero puedes, eh...
The Order of the Grook#011.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#012.src: You can say you had a growth spurt! Uh, that should work, i think!
The Order of the Grook#012.dst: ¡Di que has pegado un estirón! Eh, ¡creo que colará!
The Order of the Grook#012.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#013.src: Now go on, you should get out before my parents see you. I don't want them to find out I gave that letter away...
The Order of the Grook#013.dst: Venga, sal antes de que te vean mis padres. No quiero que sepan que regalé esa carta...
The Order of the Grook#013.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#014.src: Talk to the School Ship Captain on the pier next to the Seaskipper Captain.
The Order of the Grook#014.dst: Habla con el capitán del barco escolar en el muelle, junto al capitán del Seaskipper.

The Order of the Grook#015.src: Hey! What are you doing all the way over here? This dock's broken.
The Order of the Grook#015.dst: ¡Eh! ¿Qué haces tan lejos por aquí? Este muelle está roto.
The Order of the Grook#015.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#016.src: Oh, a student, you say. Aren't you a little old to be learning fundamental magical knowledge?
The Order of the Grook#016.dst: Ah, estudiante, dices. ¿No eres un poco mayor para aprender magia básica?
The Order of the Grook#016.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#017.src: Well, if I could see your invitation letter, then?
The Order of the Grook#017.dst: Bueno, ¿me dejas ver tu carta de invitación?
The Order of the Grook#017.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#018.src: ...Hm. This...wow, you really look quite different than the picture. Did you get a new haircut?
The Order of the Grook#018.dst: ...Hm. Esto... vaya, no te pareces nada a la foto. ¿Te has cortado el pelo?
The Order of the Grook#018.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#019.src: Well, no judging from me! Keep walking to the end of the dock. Have faith!
The Order of the Grook#019.dst: ¡Yo no juzgo a nadie! Sigue hasta el final del muelle. ¡Ten fe!
The Order of the Grook#019.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#021.src: Alright everyone. Ready for a magical experience?
The Order of the Grook#021.dst: Muy bien, chicos. ¿Listos para una experiencia mágica?
The Order of the Grook#021.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#022.src: We're headed to the Nexus. You've been told where to go. If you've forgotten, ask your fellow students!
The Order of the Grook#022.dst: Vamos al Nexo. Ya os han dicho adónde ir. Si se os ha olvidado, ¡preguntad a vuestros compañeros!
The Order of the Grook#022.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#023.src: If you ever need to come back here, just walk out onto the dock again. Good luck, now!
The Order of the Grook#023.dst: Si alguna vez necesitas volver, sal otra vez al muelle. ¡Mucha suerte!
The Order of the Grook#023.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#024.src: Follow the children to the school.
The Order of the Grook#024.dst: Sigue a los niños hasta el colegio.

The Order of the Grook#025.src: Through the wall, right? I hope my uniform doesn't get dirty.
The Order of the Grook#025.dst: Por la pared, ¿no? Espero no mancharme el uniforme.
The Order of the Grook#025.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#026.src: Talk to Cidre on the school island.
The Order of the Grook#026.dst: Habla con Cidre en la isla del colegio.

The Order of the Grook#028.src: Welcome to the island of Grookwarts! I will be guiding and helping all the new students.
The Order of the Grook#028.dst: ¡Bienvenidos a la isla de Grookwarts! Yo guiaré y ayudaré a todos los novatos.
The Order of the Grook#028.speaker: Cidre

The Order of the Grook#029.src: So all of you will be getting two vouchers each, and with them you will need to buy one wand and a book or tome.
The Order of the Grook#029.dst: Cada uno recibirá dos vales, y con ellos tendréis que comprar una varita y un libro o tomo.
The Order of the Grook#029.speaker: Cidre

The Order of the Grook#030.src: You can find everything here around the docks. Choosing your materials is very important, so buy the ones that speak to you!
The Order of the Grook#030.dst: Aquí, junto a los muelles, lo encontraréis todo. Elegir el material es importantísimo, ¡así que comprad el que os hable!
The Order of the Grook#030.speaker: Cidre

The Order of the Grook#031.src: When you're done, meet with Miss Una at the front gates!
The Order of the Grook#031.dst: Cuando acabéis, ¡id con la señorita Una a la entrada!
The Order of the Grook#031.speaker: Cidre

The Order of the Grook#032.src: Purchase a wand from the Wand Merchant and a book from the Magical Book Merchant, then talk to Una.
The Order of the Grook#032.dst: Compra una varita al mercader de varitas y un libro al mercader de libros mágicos, y luego habla con Una.

The Order of the Grook#034.src: Seems like you all have your materials in order. You are now free to enter Grookwarts and begin your lessons.
The Order of the Grook#034.dst: Parece que lo tenéis todo en orden. Ya podéis entrar en Grookwarts y empezar las clases.
The Order of the Grook#034.speaker: Una

The Order of the Grook#035.src: The door is just behind me. Walk on in!
The Order of the Grook#035.dst: La puerta está detrás de mí. ¡Pasad!
The Order of the Grook#035.speaker: Una

The Order of the Grook#036.src: Attend the welcoming dinner at Grookwarts.
The Order of the Grook#036.dst: Asiste a la cena de bienvenida de Grookwarts.

The Order of the Grook#037.src: Hush, hush! The speech will be soon!
The Order of the Grook#037.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#038.src: Hurry, take a seat! The banquet will be starting any second now!
The Order of the Grook#038.dst: ¡Corre, siéntate! ¡El banquete empieza de un momento a otro!
The Order of the Grook#038.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#039.src: Magical children of Wynn and Gavel alike... We welcome you here, to our fair academy.
The Order of the Grook#039.dst: Hijos mágicos de Wynn y de Gavel... Os damos la bienvenida a nuestra bella academia.

The Order of the Grook#040.src: Oh lordy, the headmaster! I didn't even see him come in!
The Order of the Grook#040.dst: ¡Madre mía, el director! ¡Ni lo he visto entrar!
The Order of the Grook#040.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#041.src: Uhm... I don't see him at all, actually...
The Order of the Grook#041.dst: Eh... Yo no lo veo, la verdad...
The Order of the Grook#041.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#042.src: Well, I should hope you can see me now, all of you. Oh, what a splendid turnout this year!
The Order of the Grook#042.dst: Bueno, espero que ahora sí me veáis todos. ¡Ah, qué espléndida asistencia este año!
The Order of the Grook#042.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#043.src: Apologies, I simply can't resist a bit of theatrics. But now, it is time to listen and learn, fledgeling Grooks.
The Order of the Grook#043.dst: Disculpad, no me resisto a un poco de teatro. Pero ahora toca escuchar y aprender, polluelos de Grook.
The Order of the Grook#043.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#044.src: We knowledged mages and scholars, the Order of the Grook, are pleased to see each of you here. Whether you be a young mind aching with curiosity...
The Order of the Grook#044.dst: Los magos y eruditos de la orden del Grook nos alegramos de veros aquí a todos. Ya seáis una mente joven que arde de curiosidad...
The Order of the Grook#044.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#045.src: ...or an old hat looking to refine their knowledge, all seeking to learn magic are welcomed here. We expect great things of you.
The Order of the Grook#045.dst: ...o un veterano que busca pulir su saber, aquí es bienvenido todo el que quiera aprender magia. Esperamos grandes cosas de vosotros.
The Order of the Grook#045.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#046.src: Now, to business. You will write your schedules for the semester. Look down on your paper and write in what classes you wish to participate in.
The Order of the Grook#046.dst: Y ahora, al grano. Vais a componer vuestro horario del semestre. Mirad vuestro papel y anotad las clases a las que queráis asistir.
The Order of the Grook#046.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#047.src: You will need to choose four classes, one from each category. The categories are: Elemental Magic, Practical Magic, Magical Creatures, and Types of magic.
The Order of the Grook#047.dst: Debéis elegir cuatro clases, una de cada categoría. Las categorías son: Magia Elemental, Magia Práctica, Criaturas Mágicas y Tipos de magia.
The Order of the Grook#047.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#048.src: The schedule book is at the end of the table. Worry not, there is no limit on class size. If you wish to take it, you may take it.
The Order of the Grook#048.dst: El libro de horarios está al final de la mesa. Tranquilos, no hay límite de plazas. Si queréis una clase, podéis cogerla.
The Order of the Grook#048.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#050.src: Talk to the Ghost Guide and attend your chosen classes (The Ghost Guide will lead you to each class):
The Order of the Grook#050.dst: Habla con el Guía Fantasma y asiste a las clases elegidas (el Guía Fantasma te llevará a cada una):

The Order of the Grook#051.src: I'll be leading you to your classes, everyone! Talk to me when you're ready to go.
The Order of the Grook#051.dst: ¡Yo os llevaré a vuestras clases! Habladme cuando estéis listos para salir.
The Order of the Grook#051.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#052.src: Alright, fledgeling Grooks! Your first class is starting in just a minute. Follow me!
The Order of the Grook#052.dst: ¡Muy bien, polluelos de Grook! Vuestra primera clase empieza en un minuto. ¡Seguidme!
The Order of the Grook#052.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#053.src: Here are the elemental classes. Step on in. Your magical journey truly begins here!
The Order of the Grook#053.dst: Aquí están las clases elementales. Pasad. ¡Vuestro viaje mágico empieza aquí de verdad!
The Order of the Grook#053.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#054.src: Now, all of you. Sit. Listen.
The Order of the Grook#054.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#055.src: Earth is an element of great power. Versatile and everpresent, nearly as the air.
The Order of the Grook#055.dst: La Tierra es un elemento de gran poder. Versátil y omnipresente, casi como el aire.
The Order of the Grook#055.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#056.src: Thunder provides force... Earth provides sheer power. The difference... Force choose its own path. Power is force, directed.
The Order of the Grook#056.dst: El Trueno da empuje... La Tierra da poder puro. La diferencia... El empuje elige su camino. El poder es empuje dirigido.
The Order of the Grook#056.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#057.src: Earth is also the earth itself. Stone, metal, trees and soil. Trees sway in the wind, but do not break. And the mountains do not crumble.
The Order of the Grook#057.dst: La Tierra es también la tierra misma. Piedra, metal, árboles y suelo. Los árboles se mecen al viento, pero no se rompen. Y los montes no caen.
The Order of the Grook#057.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#058.src: The Touroto, stepped in earthly magic, are nearly invincible to all but themselves. It is proof of the earth's strength.
The Order of the Grook#058.dst: Los Touroto, empapados de magia terrestre, son casi invencibles salvo entre ellos. Es prueba de la fuerza de la tierra.
The Order of the Grook#058.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#059.src: The Doguns... They were masters of the earth, and fire alike, shaping caverns to their will... And now, nearly extinct. A terrible crime...
The Order of the Grook#059.dst: Los Doguns... Fueron maestros de la tierra y del fuego, moldeando cavernas a su antojo... Y ahora, casi extintos. Un crimen atroz...
The Order of the Grook#059.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#060.src: But we shall honor them, and move forwards. We shall strike the earth and claim it to be our own.
The Order of the Grook#060.dst: Pero los honraremos y seguiremos adelante. Golpearemos la tierra y la haremos nuestra.
The Order of the Grook#060.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#061.src: The tome directs the earth's force. Take it and utilize it to shatter the stones I summon.
The Order of the Grook#061.dst: El tomo dirige la fuerza de la tierra. Cógelo y úsalo para destrozar las piedras que invoque.
The Order of the Grook#061.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#062.src: The darkest parts of the stones are weak points. Find them, and learn the power of the earth.
The Order of the Grook#062.dst: Las partes más oscuras de las piedras son sus puntos débiles. Encuéntralos y conoce el poder de la tierra.
The Order of the Grook#062.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#063.src: You know the earth's power, fledgeling. There is nothing more for you here. Go.
The Order of the Grook#063.dst: Ya conoces el poder de la tierra, polluelo. Nada más hay aquí para ti. Ve.
The Order of the Grook#063.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#064.src: Hee hee, take your seats, take your seats, TAKE. YOUR. SEATS. A marvelous batch of eager students today!!
The Order of the Grook#064.dst: Ji ji, sentaos, sentaos, SEN. TA. OS. ¡¡Qué tanda tan maravillosa de alumnos ansiosos hoy!!
The Order of the Grook#064.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#065.src: Almost as marvelous as the powers of Thunder! Energy! Pure, unfocused energy! Devastation, desolation, industrialization all alike!
The Order of the Grook#065.dst: ¡Casi tan maravillosa como los poderes del Trueno! ¡Energía! ¡Energía pura y sin enfocar! ¡Devastación, desolación e industrialización por igual!
The Order of the Grook#065.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#066.src: Yes, yes! Thunder is technical and versatile! Unreliable to all those who don't know how to rely on it, to those dexterous of hand and mind!
The Order of the Grook#066.dst: ¡Sí, sí! ¡El Trueno es técnico y versátil! ¡Poco fiable para quien no sabe fiarse de él, fiel a los diestros de mano y de mente!
The Order of the Grook#066.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#067.src: But woe, woe, Thunder is reviled, reviled! Pure energy has no morality! If used for good, yes yes, ho hum, but if used for evil, oh, burn the witch! Burn, burn! Evil, they say! Pah!!
The Order of the Grook#067.dst: ¡Pero ay, ay, al Trueno lo vilipendian! ¡La energía pura no tiene moral! Para el bien, sí, sí, bah; para el mal, ¡ay, a la hoguera con la bruja! ¡Quemadla, quemadla! ¡Malvada, dicen! ¡¡Bah!!
The Order of the Grook#067.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#068.src: All magicks are unaligned with silly concepts such as morality. They are pure chaos! But Thunder, the element of energy and force, it seems ever so EASY to use for evil...
The Order of the Grook#068.dst: Ninguna magia se alinea con tonterías como la moral. ¡Son puro caos! Pero el Trueno, el elemento de la energía y el empuje, ¡parece tan FÁCIL de usar para el mal...!
The Order of the Grook#068.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#069.src: And evil has found it, found it! CORRUPTION!! DEMONS!! Forces anathema to us, but knowleged in the ways of force and thus, thunder! So terrible, terrible, and thunder mages feared, feared...
The Order of the Grook#069.dst: ¡Y el mal lo ha encontrado, lo ha encontrado! ¡¡LA CORRUPCIÓN!! ¡¡LOS DEMONIOS!! ¡Fuerzas que nos son anatema, pero versadas en las vías del empuje y, por tanto, del trueno! ¡Qué terrible, y los magos del trueno temidos, temidos...!
The Order of the Grook#069.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#070.src: And then, then! Joyous day, the Corkians arrived with their marvelous machines, and their electromagic! Thunder controlled, thunder tamed! The wonder of it all!
The Order of the Grook#070.dst: ¡Y entonces, entonces! Día feliz: llegaron los corkianos con sus máquinas maravillosas y su electromagia. ¡Trueno controlado, trueno domado! ¡Qué maravilla!
The Order of the Grook#070.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#071.src: Electromagic makes handles crank, gears spin, metal move, gives sheer stones the power to THINK, and to PLAN! A Corkian original, and a splendid, splendid development reintroduced!
The Order of the Grook#071.dst: ¡La electromagia gira manivelas, hace rodar engranajes, mueve metal y da a la piedra el poder de PENSAR y de TRAMAR! ¡Invento corkiano y un avance espléndido, espléndido, recuperado!
The Order of the Grook#071.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#072.src: And so, you shall see for yourselves! Electromagic at work! You will control thunder and electricity, and make the machines bend to your world today, today, this shocking day!
The Order of the Grook#072.dst: ¡Y ahora lo veréis vosotros mismos! ¡Electromagia en acción! Hoy controlaréis el trueno y la electricidad y doblegaréis las máquinas a vuestra voluntad, ¡hoy, en este día electrizante!
The Order of the Grook#072.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#073.src: The mechanism is behind me now! Come up, come up! See the power of thunder, shackled by our whims, won't you, {u}?
The Order of the Grook#073.dst: ¡El mecanismo está detrás de mí! ¡Subid, subid! Mira el poder del trueno, encadenado a nuestro capricho, ¿quieres, {u}?
The Order of the Grook#073.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#074.src: Whee hee hee! Thunder tamed, thunder shackled, and your magical wings unbound by such petty concepts, {u}! What a show!
The Order of the Grook#074.dst: ¡Ji ji ji! ¡Trueno domado, trueno encadenado, y tus alas mágicas libres de conceptos tan mezquinos, {u}! ¡Menudo espectáculo!
The Order of the Grook#074.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#075.src: Expand your knowledge ever further, further! Your task is complete, complete, and your next awaits!
The Order of the Grook#075.dst: ¡Amplía tu saber más y más! ¡Tu tarea está lista, lista, y la siguiente te espera!
The Order of the Grook#075.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#076.src: Aah, wow! Everyone s-sure got here quick...
The Order of the Grook#076.dst: A-ah, ¡vaya! Q-qué rápido habéis llegado todos...
The Order of the Grook#076.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#077.src: Welcome, w-welcome. The Water element class is...certainly an interesting one, I-I'd hope... Because water doesn't j-just pertain to, well, w-water...
The Order of the Grook#077.dst: Bienvenidos, b-bienvenidos. La clase de Agua es... interesante, e-eso espero... Porque el agua no solo t-tiene que ver con, bueno, el a-agua...
The Order of the Grook#077.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#078.src: It also the element o-of knowledge, and pure magicality. Water i-is sort of magical default, If you w-will. If it isn't focused on on o-one element or another, magic ends up being water-based
The Order of the Grook#078.dst: Es también el elemento d-del saber y de la magicidad pura. El agua e-es como el estado por defecto, s-si queréis. Si no se enfoca en u-un elemento u otro, la magia acaba siendo de agua
The Order of the Grook#078.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#079.src: Learning a-about the water element and e-expanding your horizons can allow you to cast spells easier... C-control the flow of magic better, you see.
The Order of the Grook#079.dst: Aprender s-sobre el elemento agua y a-ampliar horizontes ayuda a lanzar hechizos más fácil... C-controlar mejor el flujo de la magia, ya veis.
The Order of the Grook#079.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#080.src: Most aquatic creatures are t-tied to water, though creatures that live in icy or snowy environments are, t-too...often, they are also connected to air, but not always.
The Order of the Grook#080.dst: Casi todas las criaturas acuáticas están l-ligadas al agua, y las que viven en entornos de hielo o nieve t-también... a menudo se ligan al aire además, pero no siempre.
The Order of the Grook#080.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#081.src: In a-addition, many holy artifacts are enchanted with water magic... S-something about how it's a pure type of energy, I believe.
The Order of the Grook#081.dst: A-además, muchos artefactos sagrados están encantados con magia de agua... A-algo sobre que es una energía pura, creo.
The Order of the Grook#081.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#082.src: Lastly, healing abilities are b-bolstered by water magic. Just knowing magic well d-doesn't help, but actually having artifacts charged w-with water magic can increase healing capabilities.
The Order of the Grook#082.dst: Por último, la magia de agua r-refuerza las capacidades curativas. Saber mucha magia n-no basta, pero llevar artefactos cargados c-con magia de agua sí aumenta lo que puedes curar.
The Order of the Grook#082.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#083.src: N-now, for your test, I have...um, a...a test. Anyone who wants to try it f-first, just go up and start.
The Order of the Grook#083.dst: A-ahora, para el examen tengo... eh, un... un examen. Quien quiera probar p-primero, que suba y empiece.
The Order of the Grook#083.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#084.src: Good w-work there! I h-hope it wasn't too boring with my talking... You can go now.
The Order of the Grook#084.dst: ¡B-buen trabajo! E-espero no haberos aburrido hablando tanto... Ya puedes irte.
The Order of the Grook#084.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#085.src: N-now, who's n-next? And... i-is it really cold in here for all of you, too? Or, is it j-just me?
The Order of the Grook#085.dst: ¿A-ahora quién s-sigue? Y... ¿a vosotros t-también os da frío aquí? ¿O s-soy solo yo?
The Order of the Grook#085.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#086.src: Good to see a decent turnout this year for my class. Too dangerous, pah! You can take this just fine.
The Order of the Grook#086.dst: Me alegra ver buena asistencia este año en mi clase. Demasiado peligrosa, ¡bah! Podéis con esto de sobra.
The Order of the Grook#086.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#087.src: Anyways. The fire element class. Many misunderstand just what fire stands for... but after today, you will leave with courage in your hearts.
The Order of the Grook#087.dst: En fin. La clase del elemento Fuego. Muchos malinterpretan lo que representa el fuego... pero hoy saldréis de aquí con valor en el pecho.
The Order of the Grook#087.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#088.src: Fire is, of course, related to physical fire, magma, etcetera. A burning torch is a source of fire magic, but that is not the only source of it.
The Order of the Grook#088.dst: El Fuego se relaciona, claro, con el fuego físico, el magma, etcétera. Una antorcha encendida es fuente de magia de fuego, pero no la única.
The Order of the Grook#088.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#089.src: Courage, bravery, and defensiveness are also tied to the fire element. Those stalwart and selfless, willing to sacrifice themselves for others.
The Order of the Grook#089.dst: El valor, la valentía y el afán protector también se ligan al fuego. Los firmes y generosos, dispuestos a sacrificarse por los demás.
The Order of the Grook#089.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#090.src: In addition, water is tied to healing magic, fire is tied to self-healing. Regenerative capacity if you will. Many fire-based artifacts heal the user passively.
The Order of the Grook#090.dst: Además, si el agua se liga a la magia curativa, el fuego se liga a la autocuración. Capacidad regenerativa, si queréis. Muchos artefactos de fuego curan de forma pasiva a quien los lleva.
The Order of the Grook#090.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#091.src: And while they are on the verge of extinction after the war in the {p}, the Dogun species used to embody fire and earth magic alike. It is a shame what happened to them.
The Order of the Grook#091.dst: Y aunque están al borde de la extinción tras la guerra de {p}, los Dogun encarnaban por igual la magia de fuego y la de tierra. Es una pena lo que les pasó.
The Order of the Grook#091.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#092.src: Unfortunately, it is also notable that corrupted creatures are often connected to fire, by nature of the corruption seeming to bring heat wherever it goes...
The Order of the Grook#092.dst: Por desgracia, cabe señalar que las criaturas corruptas suelen ligarse al fuego, pues la corrupción parece traer calor allá donde va...
The Order of the Grook#092.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#093.src: But aside from that, onto our practical test. You will all come up to me, starting with {u}, and hone courage. I will be casting balls of fire at you.
The Order of the Grook#093.dst: Dejando eso aparte, vamos con la prueba práctica. Subiréis de uno en uno, empezando por {u}, a templar el valor. Os lanzaré bolas de fuego.
The Order of the Grook#093.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#094.src: You will need to dodge these fire charges. If you are hit, it counts as a failure. Now. Let's get started, {u}.
The Order of the Grook#094.dst: Tendréis que esquivarlas. Si os dan, es un suspenso. Bien. Empecemos, {u}.
The Order of the Grook#094.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#095.src: Are you ready? Summon your bravery.
The Order of the Grook#095.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#096.src: Well done {u}, fledgeling Grook! Continue to sharpen your instincts. You'll be a fine hero someday, I am sure of it.
The Order of the Grook#096.dst: ¡Bien hecho, {u}, polluelo de Grook! Sigue afilando tus instintos. Algún día serás un gran héroe, no me cabe duda.
The Order of the Grook#096.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#097.src: Dismissed, {u}. You may leave. Now do I have any volunteers for the next round...?
The Order of the Grook#097.dst: Puedes retirarte, {u}. Ya está. ¿Hay voluntarios para la siguiente ronda...?
The Order of the Grook#097.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#098.src: Arright class, the sooner we start, the sooner we finish, so everyone, take your seats! You'll be getting up soon enough anyways!
The Order of the Grook#098.dst: Bueno, clase, cuanto antes empecemos, antes acabamos, así que ¡todos a sentarse! ¡De todas formas os levantaréis enseguida!
The Order of the Grook#098.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#099.src: Movin' right along. Air! You're breathing it, we're surrounded by it, but ain'tcha know what it's all about yet, so pay attention.
The Order of the Grook#099.dst: Seguimos. ¡El Aire! Lo estáis respirando, nos rodea, pero aún no sabéis de qué va la cosa, así que atentos.
The Order of the Grook#099.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#100.src: Air is an element of freedom! speed, wind and agility. if you're trained well with agility, attacks'll seem like they just phase through ya!
The Order of the Grook#100.dst: ¡El Aire es el elemento de la libertad! Velocidad, viento y agilidad. Si entrenas bien la Agilidad, ¡los ataques parecerán atravesarte sin más!
The Order of the Grook#100.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#101.src: But over and above that, 'cause of air's ever-presence, it's one of the most versatile kinda magic in existence. People use it in all sorts of ways.
The Order of the Grook#101.dst: Y por encima de eso, como el aire está en todas partes, es de las magias más versátiles que hay. La gente la usa de mil maneras.
The Order of the Grook#101.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#102.src: Over in Gavel, the Bantisu Air Monks have managed to extend their sight by the wind! They use it to help guide folks who get lost in that canyon over there.
The Order of the Grook#102.dst: Allá en Gavel, ¡los Monjes del Aire de Bantisu han logrado extender su vista con el viento! Lo usan para guiar a los que se pierden en aquel cañón.
The Order of the Grook#102.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#103.src: Many winged sorts a'creatures are tied to air, but not all of them. Some magic users just straight-out float! Now wouldn't that be nice, eh?
The Order of the Grook#103.dst: Muchos bichos con alas están ligados al aire, pero no todos. ¡Hay magos que directamente flotan! ¿No estaría bien, eh?
The Order of the Grook#103.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#104.src: Due to their tenuous physicality, souls and spirits are also often related to air magic. Make ya wonder if you could just blow ghost out of the window!
The Order of the Grook#104.dst: Por lo tenue de su cuerpo, las almas y los espíritus también se ligan al aire. ¡Te hace pensar si podrías echar a un fantasma de un soplido!
The Order of the Grook#104.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#105.src: And finally, some old, old tales tell of a woman who crossed the sea before it was calmed using air magic to fly. 's just an old legend, but an interesting one.
The Order of the Grook#105.dst: Y por último, unos relatos muy, muy viejos hablan de una mujer que cruzó el mar antes de que se calmara volando con magia de aire. Es solo una vieja leyenda, pero curiosa.
The Order of the Grook#105.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#106.src: Now onto the practical test! It's time to get those bones a-shakin'! You'll be running an obstacle course I have set up, but with a twist.
The Order of the Grook#106.dst: ¡Y ahora, la prueba práctica! ¡Toca mover el esqueleto! Correréis un circuito de obstáculos que he montado, pero con truco.
The Order of the Grook#106.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#107.src: Everyone up to the table! You'll need this feather with ya to get through.It'll help you jump higher!
The Order of the Grook#107.dst: ¡Todos a la mesa! Necesitaréis esta pluma para pasar.¡Os ayudará a saltar más alto!
The Order of the Grook#107.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#108.src: The goal is to grab three crystal balls I put in the obstacle course. once you found 'em, bring 'em back to me.
The Order of the Grook#108.dst: El objetivo es coger tres bolas de cristal que he puesto en el circuito. cuando las tengas, tráemelas.
The Order of the Grook#108.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#109.src: The course is behind me. Shake a leg now!
The Order of the Grook#109.dst: El circuito está detrás de mí. ¡Venga, rápido!
The Order of the Grook#109.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#110.src: Lessee here, one, two, three, yes indeedy! You got through that pretty quick!
The Order of the Grook#110.dst: A ver, una, dos, tres, ¡pues sí señor! ¡Has pasado bastante rápido!
The Order of the Grook#110.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#111.src: Now, if you'll just hand me back that feather ya got there...
The Order of the Grook#111.dst: Ahora, si me devuelves esa pluma que llevas ahí...
The Order of the Grook#111.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#112.src: ...then you'll be all done! Congrats, little fledge, you've finished this class! Now get on along to your next one!
The Order of the Grook#112.dst: ...¡y listo! ¡Enhorabuena, polluelo, has terminado esta clase! ¡Venga, a la siguiente!
The Order of the Grook#112.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#113.src: Moving swiftly on, the next class is just across the way. Follow me!
The Order of the Grook#113.dst: Sin perder tiempo: la siguiente clase está enfrente. ¡Seguidme!
The Order of the Grook#113.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#114.src: Alright everyone. Take a seat but don't get comfy. You'll be getting up soon. Hope you brought your reading glasses
The Order of the Grook#114.dst: Muy bien. Sentaos, pero no os acomodéis. Pronto os levantaréis. Espero que hayáis traído las gafas de leer
The Order of the Grook#114.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#115.src: See, I'll just be giving you short primer, then sending you out for the practical exercise, Since I have all this written down already.
The Order of the Grook#115.dst: Veréis, os daré una introducción breve y luego os mandaré al ejercicio práctico, ya que todo esto lo tengo ya escrito.
The Order of the Grook#115.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#116.src: The basis of this class is that many materials, whether you know it or not, are inherently magical in some way or another. If you want to be artificer, you need to know how each one works.
The Order of the Grook#116.dst: La base de esta clase es que muchos materiales, lo sepáis o no, son mágicos de un modo u otro por naturaleza. Si queréis ser artífices, debéis saber cómo funciona cada uno.
The Order of the Grook#116.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#117.src: Thankfully, the field of artifice is very popular one, so there's a wealth of knowledge out there on magical materials and how to use them efficiently.
The Order of the Grook#117.dst: Por suerte, la artificería está muy de moda, así que hay muchísimo escrito sobre materiales mágicos y cómo usarlos bien.
The Order of the Grook#117.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#118.src: Heck, Wynn soldiers are cobbling together rings out of copper and old spider silk, so you know this sort of thing is easy to get to. Tough to master, though!
The Order of the Grook#118.dst: Caramba, los soldados de Wynn se apañan anillos con cobre y seda vieja de araña, o sea que esto está al alcance de cualquiera. ¡Dominarlo ya es otra cosa!
The Order of the Grook#118.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#119.src: For those intimidated, you don't need much crafting knowledge for this class; you'll be reading up on everything you need to know in the back.
The Order of the Grook#119.dst: Si os impone, esta clase no exige mucha fabricación; al fondo leeréis todo lo que hace falta saber.
The Order of the Grook#119.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#120.src: You all be crafting a magical amulet using different items. I've stockpiled in the back; everyone will be crafting a different kind of necklace.
The Order of the Grook#120.dst: Vais a fabricar un amuleto mágico con distintos objetos. Los tengo apilados al fondo; cada uno hará un collar diferente.
The Order of the Grook#120.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#121.src: Here's a note on what you should craft. Once you have the materials you think you need, come to the crafting table. It's enchanted, and will craft the item for you if you have what you need.
The Order of the Grook#121.dst: Aquí tienes una nota con lo que debes fabricar. Cuando reúnas los materiales que creas necesarios, ve a la mesa de fabricación. Está encantada y hará el objeto por ti si lo tienes todo.
The Order of the Grook#121.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#122.src: Mhm, that's the ticket, {u}. If you're interested in learning more, you can probably find my books in most of the libraries.
The Order of the Grook#122.dst: Ajá, eso es, {u}. Si quieres saber más, encontrarás mis libros en casi todas las bibliotecas.
The Order of the Grook#122.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#123.src: Your feathers are coming out just nicely, fledgeling. You can scoot off to your next class now
The Order of the Grook#123.dst: Te están saliendo unas plumas estupendas, polluelo. Ya puedes largarte a tu siguiente clase
The Order of the Grook#123.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#124.src: Okay class, everyone take your seats, and listen up. This class is going to be interesting.
The Order of the Grook#124.dst: Muy bien, clase, sentaos todos y atended. Esta clase va a ser interesante.
The Order of the Grook#124.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#125.src: As you know, this class is all about magical effects, specifically those tied to various materials, and how they'll affect you!
The Order of the Grook#125.dst: Como sabéis, esta clase trata de los efectos mágicos, en concreto los ligados a distintos materiales, ¡y de cómo os afectarán!
The Order of the Grook#125.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#126.src: This is going to be a hands-on learning experience, so those of you with weak constitutions may request to skip the demonstration if you're concerned for your health.
The Order of the Grook#126.dst: Será una clase muy práctica, así que quien tenga una constitución débil puede pedir saltarse la demostración si teme por su salud.
The Order of the Grook#126.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#127.src: If you've read my books, you know about Quartz, and how dangerous it can be if overcharged. So, of course, we have overcharged sample so you can feel the signs of it.
The Order of the Grook#127.dst: Si habéis leído mis libros, conocéis el cuarzo y lo peligroso que es si se sobrecarga. Así que, cómo no, tenemos una muestra sobrecargada para que notéis las señales.
The Order of the Grook#127.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#128.src: It may be explosive, but it will be in a controlled manner. The worst that'll happen to you is your face will get a bit dusty, or your glasses will fall off.
The Order of the Grook#128.dst: Explotará, sí, pero de forma controlada. Lo peor que os pasará es acabar con la cara llena de polvo o que se os caigan las gafas.
The Order of the Grook#128.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#129.src: Magical crystals, as we have to my left here, can be charged with all kinds of different effects. This is an incredibly valuable aspect for artificers.
The Order of the Grook#129.dst: Los cristales mágicos, como estos de mi izquierda, pueden cargarse con toda clase de efectos. Es algo valiosísimo para un artífice.
The Order of the Grook#129.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#130.src: Depending on the formation, they can have natural effects as well. These crystals were found in Gavel's flouting islands, and...well, let's say it's difficult to keep it in its case.
The Order of the Grook#130.dst: Según cómo se formen, pueden tener efectos naturales. Estos se hallaron en las islas flotantes de Gavel y... bueno, digamos que cuesta mantenerlos en su vitrina.
The Order of the Grook#130.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#131.src: Our last sample is of cosmic material, and if you're sickened easily, then don't examine it. Its effects are mostly unknown, but one thing's certain...
The Order of the Grook#131.dst: La última muestra es material cósmico; si os mareáis con facilidad, no la examinéis. Sus efectos son casi todos desconocidos, pero algo es seguro...
The Order of the Grook#131.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#132.src: ...it's dangerous to be exposed for long periods. Now, each of you will go back behind me, and examine and interact with each of the three samples provided.
The Order of the Grook#132.dst: ...exponerse mucho tiempo es peligroso. Ahora pasad todos detrás de mí y examinad e interactuad con cada una de las tres muestras.
The Order of the Grook#132.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#133.src: Once you've done so, then you can leave. Hands-on training is the best way to learn, after all.
The Order of the Grook#133.dst: Cuando lo hagáis, podréis iros. Al fin y al cabo, la práctica es la mejor manera de aprender.
The Order of the Grook#133.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#134.src: Well done. How did that feel?
The Order of the Grook#134.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#135.src: Personally, the void sample is the most interesting to me. You may now leave the classroom.
The Order of the Grook#135.dst: A mí la muestra del Vacío es la que más me interesa. Ya puedes salir del aula.
The Order of the Grook#135.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#136.src: There's a bit of a walk to your next class. Follow me.
The Order of the Grook#136.dst: Hay un buen paseo hasta la siguiente clase. Seguidme.
The Order of the Grook#136.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#137.src: These staircases were supposed to move, but... That was too much work to put together, apparently. They're a pain to navigate, aren't they?
