The Order of the Grook#137.dst: Estas escaleras tenían que moverse, pero... por lo visto era demasiado trabajo. Son un lío, ¿verdad?
The Order of the Grook#137.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#138.src: Alright, fledgeling grooks. Time to hit you all with the info you're really here for!
The Order of the Grook#138.dst: Muy bien, polluelos de grook. ¡Toca soltaros la información por la que venís de verdad!
The Order of the Grook#138.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#139.src: Wybels! Pronounced like nibble, they're a rather popular pet nowadays. But you all knew that, you want to know where they came from.
The Order of the Grook#139.dst: ¡Los Wybels! Se pronuncia "güíbel", y hoy son mascotas muy populares. Pero eso ya lo sabíais; queréis saber de dónde salieron.
The Order of the Grook#139.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#140.src: The explanation we got was that they lived in the Ahms region, and when it split open, they eventually burrowed into the surface of the {p}.
The Order of the Grook#140.dst: La explicación que nos dieron es que vivían en la región de Ahms y, cuando esta se abrió, acabaron excavando hasta la superficie de {p}.
The Order of the Grook#140.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#141.src: But no one actually KNOWS for sure. That means they. Could. Be. ANYTHING! What could lie beneath that veneer of fluff and playful demeanor?!
The Order of the Grook#141.dst: Pero nadie lo SABE de verdad. O sea que. Podrían. Ser. ¡CUALQUIER COSA! ¡¿Qué se esconderá bajo esa capa de pelusa y esos aires juguetones?!
The Order of the Grook#141.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#142.src: Oh, speaking of fluff. The wooly fur never actually stops growing, ever, and neither do their hooves, their horns, or their teeth. They shed often.
The Order of the Grook#142.dst: Ah, hablando de pelusa. Ese pelo lanudo no deja nunca de crecer, jamás, ni tampoco sus pezuñas, sus cuernos o sus dientes. Mudan a menudo.
The Order of the Grook#142.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#143.src: These materials have innate magical energy to them. Stable like lodestone and reliable like quartz, but not as powerful as either. Interesting, that a fluffball has that potential!!
The Order of the Grook#143.dst: Esos materiales tienen energía mágica innata. Estables como la magnetita y fiables como el cuarzo, aunque menos potentes que ambos. ¡¡Curioso que una bola de pelusa tenga ese potencial!!
The Order of the Grook#143.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#144.src: Wybel fluff is also able to be boiled, and it turns into sticky molasses-like substance. It's used for candy, and its very popular...but it's all POISON!!
The Order of the Grook#144.dst: La pelusa de Wybel también se hierve y se vuelve una pasta pegajosa como la melaza. Se usa para golosinas y gusta mucho... ¡¡pero es VENENO!!
The Order of the Grook#144.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#145.src: It's POISON, I tell you! Wyble meat is horrendously inedible! It'll give you the worst stomachache of your life! The candymakers are feeding us DEATH!
The Order of the Grook#145.dst: ¡Es VENENO, os lo digo! ¡La carne de Wybel es incomible! ¡Os dará el peor dolor de barriga de vuestra vida! ¡Los confiteros nos dan de comer MUERTE!
The Order of the Grook#145.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#146.src: And the worst part is, if too much fluff gathers up in one spot, ANOTHER WYBEL APPEARS! They reproduce by budding!! Growing out of lint and dust! It's a no-win game they're makin' us play!
The Order of the Grook#146.dst: ¡Y lo peor es que, si se junta demasiada pelusa en un sitio, APARECE OTRO WYBEL! ¡¡Se reproducen por gemación!! ¡Brotan de la borra y el polvo! ¡Es un juego amañado al que nos obligan!
The Order of the Grook#146.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#147.src: Wybels do have some good use though...they can sniff out sources of cosmic magic, like a pig sniffs out truffles. Sometimes they even try to take it home.
The Order of the Grook#147.dst: Aunque algo bueno tienen... olfatean fuentes de magia cósmica como un cerdo olfatea trufas. A veces hasta intentan llevárselas a casa.
The Order of the Grook#147.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#148.src: It's almost like they miss it, somehow. It's almost like they might be FROM outer space! It's ALMOST like they bringing insanity-inducing things into our houses ON PURPOSE!
The Order of the Grook#148.dst: Es casi como si la echaran de menos. ¡Es casi como si vinieran DEL espacio exterior! ¡Es CASI como si metieran cosas que vuelven loco a uno en nuestras casas A PROPÓSITO!
The Order of the Grook#148.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#149.src: They're here to kill us all, I swear it! How else would you explain a wybel VAPORIZING a group of poachers? Ten colors of wybel, every one of them rotten evil!
The Order of the Grook#149.dst: ¡Están aquí para matarnos a todos, lo juro! ¿Si no, cómo explicáis que un wybel VAPORIZARA a unos furtivos? ¡Diez colores de wybel, y todos malvados hasta la médula!
The Order of the Grook#149.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#150.src: Everyone says there's only nine, but WE know the truth! There's a tenth out there, an ultimately powerful one that want us all gone. Pray you never see it, kids.
The Order of the Grook#150.dst: Todos dicen que solo hay nueve, ¡pero NOSOTROS sabemos la verdad! Hay un décimo por ahí, poderosísimo, que nos quiere a todos fuera. Rezad por no verlo nunca, chavales.
The Order of the Grook#150.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#151.src: Anyways, my lesson's safe from all that. All you have to do is to re-order these plush Wybel toys on the stand. You'll figure out once you're up here.
The Order of the Grook#151.dst: En fin, mi clase está a salvo de todo eso. Solo tenéis que reordenar estos peluches de Wybel del expositor. Ya lo entenderéis al subir.
The Order of the Grook#151.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#152.src: Alrighty, fledgeling, good job. You're armed with the REAL truth now! Go on to your next class.
The Order of the Grook#152.dst: Muy bien, polluelo, buen trabajo. ¡Ya vas armado con la VERDADERA verdad! A la siguiente clase.
The Order of the Grook#152.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#153.src: Hello, students. This is the magical creatures class, and I will be your instructor.
The Order of the Grook#153.dst: Hola, alumnos. Esta es la clase de criaturas mágicas y yo os la impartiré.
The Order of the Grook#153.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#154.src: Different species have different levels of innate magicality. This is often an invisible aspect of the species. You must never assume.
The Order of the Grook#154.dst: Cada especie tiene un nivel distinto de magicidad innata. Suele ser un rasgo invisible de la especie. Nunca deis nada por hecho.
The Order of the Grook#154.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#155.src: To begin with, Doguns. They are ancient creatures, artificial-seeming at first. Despite this, they are highly adept at earth and fire-based magic.
The Order of the Grook#155.dst: Empecemos por los Doguns. Son criaturas antiguas, de aspecto artificial al principio. Aun así, dominan la magia de tierra y de fuego.
The Order of the Grook#155.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#156.src: Able to quite literally move mountains, it is theorized that they were the one who carve out the inside of the {p} into the caves we know today.
The Order of the Grook#156.dst: Capaces de mover montañas literalmente, se teoriza que fueron ellos quienes excavaron el interior de {p} formando las cuevas de hoy.
The Order of the Grook#156.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#157.src: Tales also tell of their utilizing demonic energy for various purposes. However, we are only able to assume their magical energy from Dwarven tales, as they are nigh-extinct
The Order of the Grook#157.dst: También se cuenta que usaban energía demoníaca para diversos fines. Pero, como están casi extintos, solo podemos suponer su energía mágica por los relatos de los enanos
The Order of the Grook#157.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#158.src: Moving on. The term "Greenskins" is a catch-all for Trolls, Goblins, Orcs, Ogres and Hobgoblins. Some include Gerts into this definition, though by technicality they are separate.
The Order of the Grook#158.dst: Sigamos. El término "pielverdes" engloba a trolls, goblins, orcos, ogros y hobgoblins. Algunos incluyen a los Gerts, aunque técnicamente son aparte.
The Order of the Grook#158.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#159.src: Though many Greenskins societies with mystical particles, the only known way for them to utilize magic is through magical artifacts. They've little magic potential.
The Order of the Grook#159.dst: Aunque muchas sociedades pielverdes tratan con partículas místicas, el único modo conocido de usar magia que tienen es mediante artefactos mágicos. Su potencial mágico es escaso.
The Order of the Grook#159.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#160.src: Meanwhile, Villagers are the opposite persuasion. High magical potential, often unrealized out of laziness.
The Order of the Grook#160.dst: Los aldeanos, en cambio, son lo contrario. Gran potencial mágico, casi siempre sin desarrollar por pereza.
The Order of the Grook#160.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#161.src: Humans are often thought of as magical then Villagers, due to Fruman soldiers seeming to know some magic innate, but this is untrue.
The Order of the Grook#161.dst: Suele creerse que los humanos son más mágicos que los aldeanos, porque los soldados de Fruma parecen tener magia innata, pero no es cierto.
The Order of the Grook#161.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#162.src: Dwarves have a similar level of magicality to Humans, but like the Villagers, it often go unrealized. Their culture values physical strength more.
The Order of the Grook#162.dst: Los enanos tienen una magicidad similar a la humana, pero, como los aldeanos, suelen dejarla sin desarrollar. Su cultura valora más la fuerza física.
The Order of the Grook#162.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#163.src: It is theorized that the reason for this is due to their distance for demonic energies of the Doguns. They reject their magic potential often, such that it is lessening over time.
The Order of the Grook#163.dst: Se teoriza que se debe a su distancia con las energías demoníacas de los Doguns. Rechazan a menudo su potencial mágico, hasta el punto de que este mengua con el tiempo.
The Order of the Grook#163.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#164.src: Inversely, Elves have a deep connection to their magicality. Despite their reclusiveness, they are known for their open share of magicality energy within their own society.
The Order of the Grook#164.dst: A la inversa, los elfos tienen un vínculo profundo con su magicidad. Pese a su aislamiento, se los conoce por compartir abiertamente esa energía dentro de su sociedad.
The Order of the Grook#164.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#165.src: The outcast Elves of {p} have shared their connection to what we refers to as "The Light". This connection is supposedly unfathomable, but guides them and protects them.
The Order of the Grook#165.dst: Los elfos desterrados de {p} han compartido su vínculo con lo que llamamos "la Luz". Se dice que ese vínculo es insondable, pero los guía y los protege.
The Order of the Grook#165.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#166.src: Now, we see if you were paying attention. You will come here and order the societies I have referred to in the class from least magical, to the most.
The Order of the Grook#166.dst: Veamos ahora si atendíais. Vendréis aquí y ordenaréis las sociedades que he mencionado en clase, de la menos mágica a la más mágica.
The Order of the Grook#166.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#167.src: Well done, you got it right!
The Order of the Grook#167.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#168.src: Correct. {u}, thank you for paying attention. No one ever seems to in this class. You may go.
The Order of the Grook#168.dst: Correcto. Gracias por atender, {u}. Nadie parece hacerlo en esta clase. Puedes irte.
The Order of the Grook#168.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#169.src: Next class is actually rather close!
The Order of the Grook#169.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#171.src: ...I was hoping for a smaller class size.
The Order of the Grook#171.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#172.src: Corruption is incredibly dangerous...it'll be tough to keep so many students safe. If anyone wishes to leave, you may.
The Order of the Grook#172.dst: La Corrupción es peligrosísima... costará mantener a salvo a tantos alumnos. Quien quiera irse, puede hacerlo.
The Order of the Grook#172.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#173.src: Now... Corruption is a force of nature of...some description. Yes, you heard me right. We don't actually know much about it.
The Order of the Grook#173.dst: Veamos... La Corrupción es una fuerza de la naturaleza de... algún tipo. Sí, habéis oído bien. En realidad sabemos poco de ella.
The Order of the Grook#173.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#174.src: Even though it's plagued the Wynn province for a thousand years, the way it behaves is so incredibly alien in nature that it's nigh-impossible to study.
The Order of the Grook#174.dst: Aunque lleva mil años asolando la provincia de Wynn, se comporta de un modo tan ajeno a todo que es casi imposible de estudiar.
The Order of the Grook#174.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#175.src: We know it raises undead bodies... The working theory is that the more heavily injured a target is, the more susceptible they are to being corrupted.
The Order of the Grook#175.dst: Sabemos que levanta cuerpos no muertos... La hipótesis de trabajo es que cuanto más herido está un objetivo, más fácil es corromperlo.
The Order of the Grook#175.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#176.src: And...well, you can't exactly get more injured than "dead". Hence, the growth of zombies and skeletons and all, over in Wynn.
The Order of the Grook#176.dst: Y... bueno, no se puede estar más herido que "muerto". De ahí el auge de zombis, esqueletos y demás allá en Wynn.
The Order of the Grook#176.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#177.src: It appears to spread by a complex "root" system. A scientist from {p}, Orikal, has studied this. The corruption spikes appear to spread it in greater concentration.
The Order of the Grook#177.dst: Parece extenderse por un complejo sistema de "raíces". Lo ha estudiado Orikal, una autoridad científica de {p}. Las púas de corrupción parecen propagarla en mayor concentración.
The Order of the Grook#177.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#178.src: As for the effects on your person, most often paranoia and anger are seen. And that's about the only consistent thing with it; it affect everyone slightly differently.
The Order of the Grook#178.dst: En cuanto a los efectos sobre la persona, lo más común es paranoia e ira. Y eso es casi lo único constante; a cada cual le afecta de forma algo distinta.
The Order of the Grook#178.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#179.src: The worst part is that practically everything single thing we've touched on here is conjecture and theorycrafting! The force of corruption is terrifying.
The Order of the Grook#179.dst: ¡Lo peor es que casi todo lo que hemos visto aquí son conjeturas y teoría pura! La fuerza de la corrupción es aterradora.
The Order of the Grook#179.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#180.src: The only thing we know for certain is that powerful ice-based magic can halt corruption, as seen in the {p} region.
The Order of the Grook#180.dst: Lo único seguro es que una magia de hielo potente puede frenar la corrupción, como se ve en la región de {p}.
The Order of the Grook#180.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#181.src: Now, the dangerous part. Everyone, come up past my desk here. We'll examine a corrupted creature in a controlled environment.
The Order of the Grook#181.dst: Y ahora, la parte peligrosa. Pasad todos al otro lado de mi mesa. Examinaremos a una criatura corrupta en un entorno controlado.
The Order of the Grook#181.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#182.src: We have one in captivity, and its cage is reinforced with the strongest metals we have...so dear god let it be enough.
The Order of the Grook#182.dst: Tenemos una en cautividad y su jaula está reforzada con los metales más fuertes que hay... ojalá baste.
The Order of the Grook#182.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#183.src: Bringing it out now...be sure to back up. We don't want anyone caught in the crossfire here.
The Order of the Grook#183.dst: La saco ya... echaos atrás, por favor. No queremos que nadie salga salpicado.
The Order of the Grook#183.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#184.src: One thing to note about undead corrupteds...they can't be cured. You can weaken them, but that's about it. ...wait...
The Order of the Grook#184.dst: Algo que notar sobre los corruptos no muertos... no se los puede curar. Puedes debilitarlos, y poco más. ...un momento...
The Order of the Grook#184.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#185.src: Wait, why's it spreading here? It's never done this before! E-everyone, back up, now!
The Order of the Grook#185.dst: Un momento, ¿por qué se extiende aquí? ¡Nunca había hecho esto! ¡T-todos atrás, ya!
The Order of the Grook#185.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#186.src: A-as you can see, corruption is very powerful, eheheh, c-can someone go get another teacher or something?!
The Order of the Grook#186.dst: C-como veis, la corrupción es muy poderosa, ejeje, ¡¿p-puede alguien ir a buscar a otro profesor o algo?!
The Order of the Grook#186.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#187.src: Wait, no! It's corroding the bars! Everyone, RUN! NOW! GET OUT OF HERE, CLASS DISMISSED!!!
The Order of the Grook#187.dst: ¡Espera, no! ¡Está corroyendo los barrotes! ¡Todos, CORRED! ¡YA! ¡FUERA DE AQUÍ, SE ACABÓ LA CLASE!!!
The Order of the Grook#187.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#188.src: GAACK! No, {u}, I said RUN! Don't fight that thing, get OUT!
The Order of the Grook#188.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#189.src: Dear lord...that was awful. {u}, I can't believe you were able to kill that thing!
The Order of the Grook#189.dst: Madre mía... qué horror. {u}, ¡no me creo que hayas matado a esa cosa!
The Order of the Grook#189.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#190.src: Class absolutely dismissed. We've got to cancel this class...it's far too dangerous for the students...
The Order of the Grook#190.dst: Clase terminada, sin más. Hay que cancelar esta asignatura... es demasiado peligrosa para los alumnos...
The Order of the Grook#190.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#191.src: Welcome in, guys and gals... we're learnin' about nature magic today!
The Order of the Grook#191.dst: Pasad, chicos y chicas... ¡hoy toca magia de la naturaleza!
The Order of the Grook#191.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#192.src: There's two main ways of usin' nature magic... Shamanism and druidism. Two sides of the same coin, man.
The Order of the Grook#192.dst: Hay dos formas de usarla... el chamanismo y el druidismo. Dos caras de la misma moneda, tío.
The Order of the Grook#192.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#193.src: Druidic Practices tend to deal with healing more, and nurturing. When life's created, it gives off energy... and Druids use that energy for their magic.
The Order of the Grook#193.dst: Lo druídico va más de curar y de cuidar. Cuando se crea vida, esta desprende energía... y los druidas usan esa energía para su magia.
The Order of the Grook#193.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#194.src: Shamanic skills are a lot more direct, man. They take the life from other things and use that to do their stuffs. It's way more varied than Druidic magic.
The Order of the Grook#194.dst: Lo chamánico es mucho más directo, tío. Toman la vida de otras cosas y con eso hacen lo suyo. Es mucho más variado que la magia druídica.
The Order of the Grook#194.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#195.src: Each has its ups and downs, man. Druidism is chill and helpful... but you can really expand your mind with Shamanism, buddies.
The Order of the Grook#195.dst: Cada uno tiene lo suyo, tío. El druidismo es tranqui y útil... pero con el chamanismo se te abre la mente de verdad, colegas.
The Order of the Grook#195.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#196.src: Either way, it's all about equivalent exchange, y'see? You can't get somethin' from nothin', man. Either make life or take life.
The Order of the Grook#196.dst: En cualquier caso, todo va de intercambio equivalente, ¿ves? De la nada no sale nada, tío. O creas vida o la quitas.
The Order of the Grook#196.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#197.src: But! It's not peaky about what life you take, man! A good shaman takes from plants and animals, not people!
The Order of the Grook#197.dst: ¡Pero! No es tiquismiquis con qué vida quitas, tío. ¡Un buen chamán la toma de plantas y animales, no de personas!
The Order of the Grook#197.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#198.src: Don't be a Slykaar, kiddos. He asked for human sacrifices, but he lived in a jungle, man! Like, what the hey! He coulda done anything alse!
The Order of the Grook#198.dst: No seáis como Slykaar, chavales. ¡Pedía sacrificios humanos y vivía en plena jungla, tío! ¡Pero bueno! ¡Podría haber hecho otra cosa!
The Order of the Grook#198.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#199.src: Anyways, our test today, little buds, is to practice some shamanic skills. We got a sick cow in the back, and you're gonna nurse it back to health.
The Order of the Grook#199.dst: En fin, el examen de hoy, brotecitos, es practicar algo de chamanismo. Hay una vaca enferma al fondo y vais a devolverle la salud.
The Order of the Grook#199.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#200.src: You'll need to sacrifice some old grooks, but it has to be just the right amount, man! The practice is through the door behind me.
The Order of the Grook#200.dst: Tendréis que sacrificar unos cuantos grooks viejos, ¡pero la cantidad tiene que ser justa, tío! La práctica es por la puerta de detrás de mí.
The Order of the Grook#200.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#201.src: Groovy work, man! You're at one with nature!
The Order of the Grook#201.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#202.src: Your feathers are all grown out, man! Time to head out!
The Order of the Grook#202.dst: ¡Ya tienes las plumas crecidas, tío! ¡Toca largarse!
The Order of the Grook#202.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#204.src: That's all four classes! I hope you found them magically enriching! Now, off to the graduation hall!
The Order of the Grook#204.dst: ¡Ya son las cuatro clases! ¡Espero que te hayan enriquecido mágicamente! ¡Y ahora, al salón de graduación!
The Order of the Grook#204.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#205.src: It's the room all the way at the bottom of the stairs. Hurry, don't hold up the ceremony! It won't start until everyone's there.
The Order of the Grook#205.dst: Es la sala del todo al final de las escaleras. ¡Corre, no retrases la ceremonia! No empezará hasta que estemos todos.
The Order of the Grook#205.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#206.src: Go to the ceremony room for the Headmaster's closing speech.
The Order of the Grook#206.dst: Ve a la sala de ceremonias para el discurso de clausura del director.

The Order of the Grook#207.src: Take a seat. The ceremony is starting.
The Order of the Grook#207.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#208.src: And so, your teachings, or at least their basics, have ended. Your magical feathers have started to grow!
The Order of the Grook#208.dst: Y así concluyen vuestras lecciones, o al menos lo básico de ellas. ¡Vuestras plumas mágicas han empezado a crecer!
The Order of the Grook#208.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#209.src: You have all been performing very well during your classes today. I've heard quite a bit of praise from the teachers being passed around.
The Order of the Grook#209.dst: Hoy os habéis desenvuelto todos muy bien en clase. He oído no pocos elogios circulando entre el profesorado.
The Order of the Grook#209.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#210.src: But now, for your efforts, you shall not go unrewarded. You will leave here with more than simply knowledge.
The Order of the Grook#210.dst: Y vuestro esfuerzo no quedará sin recompensa. Saldréis de aquí con algo más que conocimiento.
The Order of the Grook#210.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#211.src: Your tools have shaped your minds, subtly but inexorably. And so with that, what you leave with today, both in mind and in treasure, shall be different for each of you.
The Order of the Grook#211.dst: Vuestros útiles han moldeado vuestra mente, sutil pero inexorablemente. Por eso, lo que os llevéis hoy, tanto en mente como en tesoro, será distinto para cada uno.
The Order of the Grook#211.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#212.src: Let us start with . Please come up to the stage!
The Order of the Grook#212.dst: Empecemos por . ¡Sube al escenario, por favor!
The Order of the Grook#212.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#213.src: There is a reason I've called you up first, you know. Recall what I said about old hats earlier? Don't think we didn't notice the armor, or the weapon, or the grim countenance.
The Order of the Grook#213.dst: Por algo te he llamado primero, ¿sabes? ¿Recuerdas lo que dije antes de los veteranos? No creas que no hemos visto la armadura, ni el arma, ni ese semblante sombrío.
The Order of the Grook#213.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#214.src: But no need to worry. Those who truly have the drive to become learned in the ways of magic, no matter who they are, will always find their way here, and be accepted.
The Order of the Grook#214.dst: Pero no te preocupes. Quien de verdad tenga el impulso de instruirse en las vías de la magia, sea quien sea, siempre acabará encontrando este lugar y será aceptado.
The Order of the Grook#214.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#215.src: A shame about Seasum, but not to worry. Now, hand over your materials, and you'll receive your rewards.
The Order of the Grook#215.dst: Lo de Seasum es una lástima, pero tranquilo. Ahora entrega tus materiales y recibirás tus recompensas.
The Order of the Grook#215.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#216.src: And there you have it. Your feathers are grown, and you can spread your magical wings! Good luck on your adventures, Wynn soldier.
The Order of the Grook#216.dst: Y ahí lo tienes. ¡Tus plumas ya han crecido y puedes desplegar tus alas mágicas! Suerte en tus aventuras, soldado de Wynn.
The Order of the Grook#216.speaker: Headmaster

The Passage (Quest)#002.src: My dad said I can't let any strangers through this passage!
The Passage (Quest)#002.dst: ¡Mi padre dijo que no deje pasar a ningún desconocido por aquí!
The Passage (Quest)#002.speaker: Wirt

The Passage (Quest)#003.src: If you want access, talk to him, he's the recruiter of the town! His name is Ildan. He's just southwest of here.
The Passage (Quest)#003.dst: Si quieres pasar, habla con él, ¡es el reclutador del pueblo! Se llama Ildan y está al suroeste de aquí.
The Passage (Quest)#003.speaker: Wirt

The Passage (Quest)#004.src: Find Ildan in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and ask to be a member of the town
The Passage (Quest)#004.dst: Encuentra a Ildan en {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], y pide ser miembro del pueblo

The Passage (Quest)#005.src: Oh! So you want to become a member of this town?
The Passage (Quest)#005.dst: ¡Ah! ¿Así que quieres ser miembro de este pueblo?
The Passage (Quest)#005.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#006.src: You will have to help us first, of course!
The Passage (Quest)#006.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#007.src: I'm sure you've noticed, but there is a tribe camp not too far from here.
The Passage (Quest)#007.dst: Seguro que lo has visto: hay un campamento tribal no muy lejos.
The Passage (Quest)#007.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#008.src: They used to have a powerful chief, but he eventually died in battle.
The Passage (Quest)#008.dst: Tenían un jefe poderoso, pero acabó muriendo en combate.
The Passage (Quest)#008.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#009.src: The tribe couldn't bear the fact that he was dead. They performed some unethical necromancy spell on him.
The Passage (Quest)#009.dst: La tribu no soportó su muerte. Le lanzaron cierto hechizo de nigromancia poco ético.
The Passage (Quest)#009.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#010.src: They quickly realized that is was a bad idea, so they locked him in a tomb.
The Passage (Quest)#010.dst: Pronto vieron que era mala idea, así que lo encerraron en una tumba.
The Passage (Quest)#010.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#011.src: He keeps reviving his minions and it's causing quite some problems to our army.
The Passage (Quest)#011.dst: No para de revivir a sus siervos y eso da problemas a nuestro ejército.
The Passage (Quest)#011.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#012.src: You can access the tomb from a sacrificial shrine, I've heard, but I'm not sure how. There are probably hints nearby the shrine.
The Passage (Quest)#012.dst: He oído que se entra a la tumba desde un santuario de sacrificios, pero no sé cómo. Seguramente haya pistas cerca del santuario.
The Passage (Quest)#012.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#013.src: Bring me back [{~} Antic Bead] as a proof of its death, and I will let you become a citizen.
The Passage (Quest)#013.dst: Tráeme [{~} Antic Bead] como prueba de su muerte y te dejaré ser ciudadano.
The Passage (Quest)#013.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#014.src: I've marked the direction to the shrine in your book. Remember, there should be hints right nearby the shrine. Good luck.
The Passage (Quest)#014.dst: Te he marcado la dirección del santuario en tu libro. Recuerda: debería haber pistas justo al lado. Suerte.
The Passage (Quest)#014.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#015.src: Search for clues near [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring back [{~} Antic Bead] to Ildan.
The Passage (Quest)#015.dst: Busca pistas cerca de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y llévale a Ildan [{~} Antic Bead].

The Passage (Quest)#017.src: Well, welcome to this town, adventurer! You are now officially a citizen.
The Passage (Quest)#017.dst: ¡Bienvenido a este pueblo, aventurero! Ya eres ciudadano oficialmente.
The Passage (Quest)#017.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#018.src: Oh, but before you go! I do have a few things to say. First, about the beads here.
The Passage (Quest)#018.dst: ¡Ah, pero antes de que te vayas! Tengo un par de cosas que decir. Primero, sobre las cuentas de por aquí.
The Passage (Quest)#018.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#019.src: The tribesmen accept these as currency, so if you collect enough, I've heard they can offer you powerful masks.
The Passage (Quest)#019.dst: Los de la tribu las aceptan como moneda; si juntas suficientes, dicen que te dan máscaras poderosas.
The Passage (Quest)#019.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#020.src: Second, about the shrine. Now, this is just a rumor, but apparently that tomb is not unique.
The Passage (Quest)#020.dst: Segundo, sobre el santuario. Es solo un rumor, pero por lo visto esa tumba no es la única.
The Passage (Quest)#020.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#021.src: There are supposed to be a bunch of these altars scattered around the province, even in Gavel too!
The Passage (Quest)#021.dst: Dicen que hay un montón de estos altares repartidos por la provincia, ¡y hasta en Gavel!
The Passage (Quest)#021.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#022.src: If true, you should look for them. While the fights will be tough, I would imagine great rewards could be gotten from them!
The Passage (Quest)#022.dst: Si es cierto, deberías buscarlos. Las peleas serán duras, ¡pero me imagino que las recompensas serán enormes!
The Passage (Quest)#022.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#023.src: Anyway, I've talked enough. I'm proud to have such a powerful fighter join our town! I wish you luck, friend!
The Passage (Quest)#023.dst: En fin, ya he hablado bastante. ¡Me enorgullece que un luchador tan fuerte entre en nuestro pueblo! ¡Suerte, amigo!
The Passage (Quest)#023.speaker: Ildan

The Price of Ingenuity#002.src: Previously implemented locomotive models employ an engine with relatively low efficiency.
The Price of Ingenuity#002.dst: Los modelos de locomotora empleados hasta ahora montan un motor de eficiencia relativamente baja.

The Price of Ingenuity#003.src: Rest for the night in you room in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#003.dst: Descansa durante la noche en tu habitación de la Pluma de Acero en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#004.src: ...what. Where is it? W-where is it?!
The Price of Ingenuity#004.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#006.src: My bow, Yuman! Where is it? WHERE did you put it?!
The Price of Ingenuity#006.dst: ¡Mi arco, Yuman! ¿Dónde está? ¡¿DÓNDE lo has puesto?!
The Price of Ingenuity#006.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#007.src: Hey, hey, relax, jeez! It's over here, on the meeting table! It fell off your bed in the early morning, so I figured I'd put it somewhere safe!
The Price of Ingenuity#007.dst: ¡Eh, eh, tranqui, jolín! ¡Está aquí, en la mesa de reuniones! Se te cayó de la cama de madrugada, ¡así que lo puse a buen recaudo!
The Price of Ingenuity#007.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#008.src: I didn't, like, snatch it off ya or anything! Sorry, man! My bad. I forgot you got like this.
The Price of Ingenuity#008.dst: ¡Que no te lo quité ni nada, tío! ¡Perdona! Culpa mía. Olvidé que te pones así.
The Price of Ingenuity#008.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#010.src: Sorry. For shouting at you. I... don't know what came over me.
The Price of Ingenuity#010.dst: Perdona. Por gritarte. No... no sé qué me ha pasado.
The Price of Ingenuity#010.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#011.src: Hey, it's all good! I get grouchy too when one of my bros moves my stuff without tellin' me! 'Kay, well, maybe not that grouchy, but- I sorta get it, is what I mean.
The Price of Ingenuity#011.dst: ¡Eh, no pasa nada! ¡Yo también me mosqueo cuando uno de mis hermanos me toca las cosas sin avisar! Bueno, vale, quizá no tanto, pero- lo pillo, más o menos, eso quiero decir.
The Price of Ingenuity#011.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#012.src: Mmh. Did I ever tell you about it back when I was staying here?
The Price of Ingenuity#012.dst: Mmh. ¿Te hablé de él alguna vez, cuando vivía aquí?
The Price of Ingenuity#012.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#013.src: Nah, don't think you ever did. You were still keepin' everyone an arm's length away back then, so I didn't want to push my luck.
The Price of Ingenuity#013.dst: Nah, creo que nunca. Por entonces aún mantenías a todo el mundo a distancia, así que no quise tentar a la suerte.
The Price of Ingenuity#013.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#014.src: Right... right. It's not even that big of a deal. My bow's just... important to me.
The Price of Ingenuity#014.dst: Ya... ya. Tampoco es para tanto. Es que mi arco es... importante para mí.
The Price of Ingenuity#014.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#015.src: Yes, I know I look silly walking around with the bulky thing all day! But I can't afford to lose it. I need it. I can't explain why, but I do.
The Price of Ingenuity#015.dst: ¡Sí, ya sé que hago el tonto paseándome todo el día con este trasto! Pero no puedo perderlo. Lo necesito. No sé explicar por qué, pero lo necesito.
The Price of Ingenuity#015.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#016.src: Nah that's cool, man! If we're talkin' silly, just take a look at me! I fight using my GUITAR! How d'you get sillier than that?
The Price of Ingenuity#016.dst: ¡Nah, si no pasa nada, tío! ¡Si hablamos de hacer el tonto, mírame a mí! ¡Yo peleo con mi GUITARRA! ¿Hay algo más tonto?
The Price of Ingenuity#016.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#017.src: Pff, ha! What, do you just play bad music until your enemies give up? "Please, stop, I can't bear it! The melody's too discordant!"
The Price of Ingenuity#017.dst: ¡Pff, ja! ¿Qué, tocas mal hasta que tus enemigos se rinden? "¡Para, por favor, no lo soporto! ¡La melodía desafina demasiado!"
The Price of Ingenuity#017.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#018.src: Hahahah! That'd be fun, I should try that! But nah, I just club 'em with it. Yus stuck some metal plates in, so it hurts more and doesn't break!
The Price of Ingenuity#018.dst: ¡Jajaja! Sería divertido, ¡tengo que probarlo! Pero no, solo les atizo con ella. Yus le metió unas placas de metal: duele más y no se rompe.
The Price of Ingenuity#018.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#019.src: Wow. You're right, that's way sillier than what I do. I've got to tell Zeph about this.
The Price of Ingenuity#019.dst: Vaya. Tienes razón, eso es mucho más tonto que lo mío. Tengo que contárselo a Zeph.
The Price of Ingenuity#019.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#020.src: Woah, hey! You don't gotta do that, let him think I'm cool! But, uh, jokes aside. Feeling better?
The Price of Ingenuity#020.dst: ¡Uy, eh! ¡No hace falta, deja que me vea guay! Pero, eh, bromas aparte. ¿Estás mejor?
The Price of Ingenuity#020.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#022.src: Good! Cool, then you should wake up the rest of your gang. Quill said he'd be over soon, wanted to talk to you about something.
The Price of Ingenuity#022.dst: ¡Bien! Guay, pues despierta al resto de tu pandilla. Quill dijo que vendría pronto, quería hablaros de algo.
The Price of Ingenuity#022.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#023.src: Wake up the other three members at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#023.dst: Despierta a los otros tres miembros en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#026.src: Morning, Sui! She's not exactly a... morning person. Guess I forgot to warn you!
The Price of Ingenuity#026.dst: ¡Buenos días, Sui! No es precisamente... madrugadora. ¡Creo que olvidé avisarte!
The Price of Ingenuity#026.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#030.src: Why'd you wake me up? Um, this early.
The Price of Ingenuity#030.dst: ¿Por qué me despiertas? Eh, tan pronto.
The Price of Ingenuity#030.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#033.src: Um... is he... expecting me to, ha, prepare, breakfast? Oh, no...
The Price of Ingenuity#033.dst: Eh... ¿es que... espera que yo, ja, prepare, el desayuno? Ay, no...
The Price of Ingenuity#033.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#035.src: And there she goes. Well, no stopping her anxieties now! Might as well just let her get it out of her system.
The Price of Ingenuity#035.dst: Y ahí va otra vez. ¡Ya no hay quien pare su ansiedad! Mejor dejar que lo suelte todo.
The Price of Ingenuity#035.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#038.src: Ah, yes, I had overheard! I assume he has some work for us then.
The Price of Ingenuity#038.dst: ¡Ah, sí, lo había oído! Supongo que tiene trabajo para nosotros.
The Price of Ingenuity#038.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#039.src: Allow me to go freshen up, and then I will join you.
The Price of Ingenuity#039.dst: Dejadme asearme un momento y enseguida me uno a vosotros.
The Price of Ingenuity#039.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#040.src: Surprisingly so, yes! These beds were much more comfortable than I had anticipated...
The Price of Ingenuity#040.dst: ¡Sorprendentemente, sí! Estas camas eran mucho más cómodas de lo que esperaba...
The Price of Ingenuity#040.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#041.src: However... hm. I appear to have been afflicted with repeating night terrors.
The Price of Ingenuity#041.dst: Aunque... hm. Parece que me aquejan terrores nocturnos recurrentes.
The Price of Ingenuity#041.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#042.src: Reality is setting in, in a sense. Returning to the {p} now is out of the question. We cannot come home until the deed is done.
The Price of Ingenuity#042.dst: La realidad se impone, en cierto modo. Volver a {p} ahora es impensable. No podemos regresar a casa hasta que el asunto esté resuelto.
The Price of Ingenuity#042.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#043.src: It does weigh on me a little. We have made new friends and allies here, but this is the furthest away I have ever been from home.
The Price of Ingenuity#043.dst: Sí que me pesa un poco. Aquí hemos hecho nuevos amigos y aliados, pero nunca había estado tan lejos de casa.
The Price of Ingenuity#043.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#044.src: Hm. I know the feeling, Mora. If it helps, it never really goes away, but it becomes... lighter. Easier to deal with.
The Price of Ingenuity#044.dst: Hm. Conozco esa sensación, Mora. Si te sirve: nunca se va del todo, pero se vuelve... más ligera. Más llevadera.
The Price of Ingenuity#044.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#045.src: Hoho! It does not especially, no. But I appreciate the sentiment. I am glad to have my family here with me.
The Price of Ingenuity#045.dst: ¡Jojo! No especialmente, no. Pero te agradezco el gesto. Me alegra tener aquí a mi familia.
The Price of Ingenuity#045.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#046.src: But enough of that! I heard Quill was coming over? I had best freshen up before he arrives. I will join the rest of you later.
The Price of Ingenuity#046.dst: ¡Pero basta de eso! ¿He oído que venía Quill? Será mejor que me asee antes de que llegue. Me uniré a vosotros más tarde.
The Price of Ingenuity#046.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#048.src: Hrrk..... f-f-five more minutes, m- s- Synd- Zzzzzzzzz.....
The Price of Ingenuity#048.dst: Hrrk..... c-c-cinco minutos más, m- S- Synd- Zzzzzzzzz.....
The Price of Ingenuity#048.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#050.src: Okay, he's slept enough. What do you think, should I shoot him?
The Price of Ingenuity#050.dst: Vale, ya ha dormido bastante. ¿Tú qué dices, le disparo?
The Price of Ingenuity#050.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#051.src: Pfft! Ha, kidding. It wouldn't work anyway, he's stubborn enough to just roll over and keep sleeping.
The Price of Ingenuity#051.dst: ¡Pfft! Ja, es broma. Tampoco funcionaría: es tan cabezota que se daría la vuelta y seguiría durmiendo.
The Price of Ingenuity#051.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#052.src: Hm, what can we try... oh, I know.
The Price of Ingenuity#052.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#053.src: Oh, wow, these sure are some nice shiny and rare trinkets! Gosh, if only Zeph were awake, he'd love these. What a shame!
The Price of Ingenuity#053.dst: Oh, vaya, ¡qué baratijas más brillantes y raras! Jo, si Zeph estuviera despierto le encantarían. ¡Qué pena!
The Price of Ingenuity#053.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#054.src: This is a fun one! It's a passion project, inspired by one of my favorite books, an intriguing story of a girl and her friends saving the world.
The Price of Ingenuity#054.dst: ¡Esta es divertida! Un proyecto personal inspirado en uno de mis libros favoritos: la intrigante historia de una chica y sus amigos que salvan el mundo.

The Price of Ingenuity#055.src: Oh, wow, these sure are some nice and shiny and rare trinkets! Gosh, if only Zeph were awake, he'd love these. What a shame!
The Price of Ingenuity#055.dst: Oh, vaya, ¡qué baratijas más bonitas, brillantes y raras! Jo, si Zeph estuviera despierto le encantarían. ¡Qué pena!
The Price of Ingenuity#055.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#056.src: HUH! N-no, wait, I- I- I'm awake, where are- sh-sh-show me the t-trinkets, I want to see-
The Price of Ingenuity#056.dst: ¡¿EH?! N-no, espera, y- y- ya estoy despierto, ¿dónde-? E-e-enséñame las b-baratijas, quiero verlas-
The Price of Ingenuity#056.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#059.src: There aren't an-any tr-trinkets, are there.
The Price of Ingenuity#059.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#060.src: Nope! But I like the enthusiasm.
The Price of Ingenuity#060.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#061.src: Ugh... wh-why are you w-waking everyone up, anyway? I d-didn't think we had an-anything planned today..
The Price of Ingenuity#061.dst: Uf... ¿p-por qué despiertas a t-todos, en serio? N-no creía que tuviéramos n-nada planeado hoy...
The Price of Ingenuity#061.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#062.src: O-oh! Uh... I- I- I- I slept... fine. G-g-good, even! Yeah!
The Price of Ingenuity#062.dst: ¡A-ah! Eh... y- y- y- yo dormí... bien. ¡M-m-muy bien, incluso! ¡Sí!
The Price of Ingenuity#062.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#064.src: H-hey! What's that s-s-supposed to mean!?
The Price of Ingenuity#064.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#065.src: You got in bed super late! And you know how I know that? Because your snoring only started waking me up after that!
The Price of Ingenuity#065.dst: ¡Te acostaste tardísimo! ¿Y sabes cómo lo sé? ¡Porque tus ronquidos empezaron a despertarme justo después!
The Price of Ingenuity#065.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#066.src: I kept waking up thinking it was thundering outside, that's how loud it was!
The Price of Ingenuity#066.dst: ¡Me despertaba pensando que había tormenta fuera, así de fuerte era!
The Price of Ingenuity#066.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#067.src: Wh-what?! N-n-no, that's not- {u}, b-back me up here! I- I wasn't sn-snoring loudly, right?
The Price of Ingenuity#067.dst: ¡¿Q-qué?! N-n-no, eso no es- {u}, ¡a-apóyame! Yo- yo no r-roncaba tan fuerte, ¿verdad?
The Price of Ingenuity#067.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#068.src: S-see! It couldn't have been th-that bad.
The Price of Ingenuity#068.dst: ¡L-lo ves! No pudo ser t-tan grave.
The Price of Ingenuity#068.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#069.src: Or maybe {u} needs to sleep lighter! Next thing you know, an enemy's gonna sneak up on you at night, and you're not gonna hear it because you're too used to Zeph's loud snoring!
The Price of Ingenuity#069.dst: ¡O quizá {u} tenga que dormir con menos sueño! Cualquier noche se te acerca un enemigo y no lo oyes, ¡porque estás demasiado acostumbrado a los ronquidos de Zeph!
The Price of Ingenuity#069.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#070.src: Oh my g-gods... the whole station m-must have heard me!
The Price of Ingenuity#070.dst: Por los d-dioses... ¡toda la estación m-me habrá oído!
The Price of Ingenuity#070.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#071.src: It better have been just the station! Next thing you know, the crown's going to raid this hideout, and they would've only found it because your snoring echoes around {p} every night!
The Price of Ingenuity#071.dst: ¡Ojalá solo la estación! Cualquier día la Corona asalta este escondite, ¡y lo habrán encontrado solo porque tus ronquidos resuenan por {p} cada noche!
The Price of Ingenuity#071.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#073.src: Oh! W-wonder what it's about. Do you-
The Price of Ingenuity#073.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#074.src: Do you think h-he's mad about my mistake?
The Price of Ingenuity#074.dst: ¿Creéis que está enfadado por mi e-error?
The Price of Ingenuity#074.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#075.src: You heard him yourself, stupid. He wasn't mad! He thinks you did the right thing!
The Price of Ingenuity#075.dst: Lo oíste tú mismo, tonto. ¡No estaba enfadado! ¡Cree que hiciste lo correcto!
The Price of Ingenuity#075.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#076.src: B-but... Still! Ugh. I'll have to go freshen up b-before he's here then!
The Price of Ingenuity#076.dst: P-pero... ¡Aun así! Uf. ¡Entonces tendré que asearme a-antes de que llegue!
The Price of Ingenuity#076.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#077.src: And that leaves one more. Hm...
The Price of Ingenuity#077.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#078.src: {u}, you should let me wake her.
The Price of Ingenuity#078.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#079.src: She's... kind of like Sui, but more intense? In the way she's, y'know. Military trained.
The Price of Ingenuity#079.dst: Es... como Sui, pero más intensa. Ya sabes, por lo de... la instrucción militar.
The Price of Ingenuity#079.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#080.src: So it's probably better if I do it since I know what I'm dealing with!
The Price of Ingenuity#080.dst: ¡Así que mejor lo hago yo, que sé a lo que me enfrento!
The Price of Ingenuity#080.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#082.src: You know, you'd think she'd wake up at the crack of dawn with her military background... but nope.
The Price of Ingenuity#082.dst: Con su pasado militar pensarías que se levanta al amanecer... pues no.
The Price of Ingenuity#082.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#086.src: I thought I'd be prepared for it, but nope...
The Price of Ingenuity#086.dst: Creía que estaba preparada, pero no...
The Price of Ingenuity#086.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#087.src: We thought you were asleep, Syndra! I was coming up to wake you!
The Price of Ingenuity#087.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#088.src: Well... I'm awake. Quill is stopping by, right?
The Price of Ingenuity#088.dst: Bueno... estoy despierta. Quill va a pasarse, ¿no?
The Price of Ingenuity#088.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#090.src: I've been awake for a while, Rex. I heard you talking about it downstairs!
The Price of Ingenuity#090.dst: Llevo un rato despierta, Rex. ¡Os he oído hablarlo abajo!
The Price of Ingenuity#090.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#091.src: And here I thought I was a morning person...
The Price of Ingenuity#091.dst: Y yo que me creía madrugadora...
The Price of Ingenuity#091.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#093.src: Ah, hello! Good morning to you all.
The Price of Ingenuity#093.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#095.src: Oh, dear. What is with all the formality this morning?
The Price of Ingenuity#095.dst: Vaya por dios. ¿A qué viene tanta formalidad esta mañana?
The Price of Ingenuity#095.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#096.src: Well, Yuman told us to be up and ready since you were coming-
The Price of Ingenuity#096.dst: Bueno, Yuman nos dijo que estuviéramos listos porque venía usted-
The Price of Ingenuity#096.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#097.src: -so, naturally, the assumption was made that you had a mission for us-
The Price of Ingenuity#097.dst: -así que, naturalmente, supusimos que tenía una misión para nosotros-
The Price of Ingenuity#097.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#098.src: -o-o-or that w-we had done something wrong...
The Price of Ingenuity#098.dst: -o- o- o que h-habíamos hecho algo mal...
The Price of Ingenuity#098.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#101.src: Pahaha! Goodness, that was a lot all at once. Syndra, are they typically like this?
The Price of Ingenuity#101.dst: ¡Pajaja! Madre mía, todo de golpe. Syndra, ¿siempre son así?
The Price of Ingenuity#101.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#102.src: They're not usually this snappy, no. But between meeting the brothers and experiencing the Roughworks, they're probably getting swept up in their emotions.
The Price of Ingenuity#102.dst: No suelen estar tan alterados, no. Pero entre conocer a los hermanos y vivir lo de Roughworks, se estarán dejando llevar por las emociones.
The Price of Ingenuity#102.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#103.src: Ah... I understand, don't worry. But no, I'm not here to assign you all a mission, nor to scold you, or anything else of the sort.
The Price of Ingenuity#103.dst: Ah... lo entiendo, no os preocupéis. Pero no, no vengo a encargaros una misión, ni a regañaros, ni nada por el estilo.
The Price of Ingenuity#103.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#104.src: I simply wanted to offer you all a starting sum of tickets for the shops. I'd meant to give them yesterday, but in the chaos I forgot to.
The Price of Ingenuity#104.dst: Solo quería daros una suma inicial de vales para las tiendas. Pensaba dároslos ayer, pero con el caos se me olvidó.
The Price of Ingenuity#104.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#105.src: The ticket system is used to ration out food and other items to people that need it. You'll receive a weekly allowance of tickets to spend on whatever you'd like, in addition to this starting sum.
The Price of Ingenuity#105.dst: El sistema de vales sirve para racionar comida y otros artículos entre quienes los necesitan. Además de esta suma inicial, recibiréis vales cada semana para gastarlos en lo que queráis.
The Price of Ingenuity#105.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#106.src: Of course, basic amenities are free of charge if you're part of our community. Wouldn't want any of our members to sleep on the tracks, after all!
The Price of Ingenuity#106.dst: Claro que los servicios básicos son gratuitos si formas parte de nuestra comunidad. ¡No querríamos que ningún miembro durmiera en las vías!
The Price of Ingenuity#106.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#107.src: So... I baked bread for, um, no reason?
The Price of Ingenuity#107.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#108.src: I fear so, haha! Do not worry, you will not be forced to do work here.
The Price of Ingenuity#108.dst: ¡Me temo que sí, jaja! Tranquila, aquí nadie te obligará a trabajar.
The Price of Ingenuity#108.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#109.src: And, besides, if I wanted you to cook for us, I would have let you know well in advance.
The Price of Ingenuity#109.dst: Y, además, si quisiera que cocinaras para nosotros, te lo habría dicho con mucha antelación.
The Price of Ingenuity#109.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#110.src: I mean... I w-wouldn't mind some fr-fresh bread...
The Price of Ingenuity#110.dst: Bueno... a mí no me i-importaría un poco de pan r-recién hecho...
The Price of Ingenuity#110.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#112.src: Ah, one more thing. I wanted to point you all towards the training yard- Zeph, I believe you have been there already?
The Price of Ingenuity#112.dst: Ah, una cosa más. Quería indicaros el patio de entrenamiento- Zeph, ¿tú ya has estado allí?
The Price of Ingenuity#112.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#114.src: I believe the brothers should be there right now. If you're to be working with us, it would be best to get used to each other's fighting styles.
The Price of Ingenuity#114.dst: Creo que los hermanos estarán allí ahora mismo. Si vais a trabajar con nosotros, conviene acostumbrarse al estilo de lucha de cada uno.
The Price of Ingenuity#114.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#115.src: Why don't you go join them there, while Syndra and I discuss further matters?
The Price of Ingenuity#115.dst: ¿Por qué no os unís a ellos mientras Syndra y yo hablamos de otros asuntos?
The Price of Ingenuity#115.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#116.src: Find the brothers at the training yard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#116.dst: Busca a los hermanos en el patio de entrenamiento en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#117.src: ...do you really gotta head out there again?
The Price of Ingenuity#117.dst: ...¿de verdad tienes que salir otra vez?
The Price of Ingenuity#117.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#118.src: You know contracts are rare, man. I have to take what I can get.
The Price of Ingenuity#118.dst: Los contratos escasean, tío. Tengo que coger lo que salga.
The Price of Ingenuity#118.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#119.src: Why's it always gotta be you and Yus heading out?! For once- for once, man, take care of yourself!
The Price of Ingenuity#119.dst: ¡¿Por qué siempre tenéis que ir tú y Yus?! ¡Por una vez- por una vez, tío, cuídate tú!
The Price of Ingenuity#119.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#123.src: No, this can wait. Did Quill send you over?
The Price of Ingenuity#123.dst: No, esto puede esperar. ¿Os manda Quill?
The Price of Ingenuity#123.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#124.src: Indeed he did. He suggested we get to know each other's fighting styles!
The Price of Ingenuity#124.dst: Así es. ¡Nos sugirió conocer el estilo de lucha de cada uno!
The Price of Ingenuity#124.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#125.src: Not a bad idea. Yuman and I would be happy to show off what we can do, right?
The Price of Ingenuity#125.dst: No es mala idea. Yuman y yo estaremos encantados de enseñar lo que sabemos hacer, ¿verdad?
The Price of Ingenuity#125.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#127.src: Well, Zeph, {u}, and I've already been through it! Some cool moves from you both! Man, getting to see a cursed one in action was awesome...
The Price of Ingenuity#127.dst: ¡Bueno, Zeph, {u} y yo ya hemos pasado por eso! ¡Buenos movimientos los de los dos! Tío, ver a un maldito en acción fue increíble...
The Price of Ingenuity#127.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#129.src: Yeah! Like, I'd hear all the stories, and think... man, having those kinds of powers sounds so cool. Sometimes I wished I could have em! Without, uh, being evil, of course.
The Price of Ingenuity#129.dst: ¡Sí! O sea, oía todas esas historias y pensaba... tío, tener esos poderes suena genial. ¡A veces deseaba tenerlos! Sin, eh, ser malvado, claro.
The Price of Ingenuity#129.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#130.src: You'd be even harder to deal with if you did, bro. But on that subject- Quill said something about you all practicing... what was the word he used... "magic?"
The Price of Ingenuity#130.dst: Si los tuvieras serías aún más insoportable, hermano. Pero a eso iba- Quill dijo algo de que practicáis... ¿cómo era la palabra...? ¿"magia"?
The Price of Ingenuity#130.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#131.src: What?! Ey, princess, why didn't you show anything off the other day?
The Price of Ingenuity#131.dst: ¡¿Qué?! Eh, princesa, ¿por qué no enseñaste nada el otro día?
The Price of Ingenuity#131.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#133.src: Don't be insensitive, Yuman. It isn't something people just... pick up.
The Price of Ingenuity#133.dst: No seas insensible, Yuman. No es algo que la gente... aprenda sin más.
The Price of Ingenuity#133.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#134.src: From what little I've heard from Quill, it can take years of study to master a blessing... so I wouldn't be surprised if they couldn't even make a spark! Uh, no offense.
The Price of Ingenuity#134.dst: Por lo poco que le he oído a Quill, dominar una bendición puede llevar años de estudio... ¡así que no me sorprendería que no sacaran ni una chispa! Eh, sin ofender.
The Price of Ingenuity#134.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#135.src: W- well... maybe we'll s- sur- surprise you!
The Price of Ingenuity#135.dst: B- bueno... ¡a lo mejor os s- sor- sorprendemos!
The Price of Ingenuity#135.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#136.src: Ha, think you're the only ones with hidden talents? I've got a trick or two up my sleeve too!
The Price of Ingenuity#136.dst: Ja, ¿creéis que solo vosotros tenéis talentos ocultos? ¡Yo también me guardo algún truco en la manga!
The Price of Ingenuity#136.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#138.src: It's an expression, dumbass. Like you're one to talk. Why are you half-naked?
The Price of Ingenuity#138.dst: Es una expresión, idiota. Mira quién habla. ¿Por qué vas medio desnudo?
The Price of Ingenuity#138.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#139.src: To show off my abs? Obviously. Anyway, {u}, why don't you decide who goes first?
The Price of Ingenuity#139.dst: ¿Para lucir abdominales? Obvio. En fin, {u}, ¿por qué no decides tú quién va primero?
The Price of Ingenuity#139.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#141.src: Who, me? Sorry, but I'll sit this one out until you're all done.
The Price of Ingenuity#141.dst: ¿Quién, yo? Lo siento, yo me quedo fuera hasta que acabéis todos.
The Price of Ingenuity#141.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#142.src: Got to save the best for last, right? Heh.
The Price of Ingenuity#142.dst: Lo mejor se guarda para el final, ¿no? Je.
The Price of Ingenuity#142.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#143.src: I'll have to add arrows until my bowstring runs out of space next time...
The Price of Ingenuity#143.dst: La próxima vez tendré que poner flechas hasta llenar la cuerda...
The Price of Ingenuity#143.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#144.src: I'll h-have to come back here a-again tonight!
The Price of Ingenuity#144.dst: ¡T-tendré que volver aquí o-otra vez esta noche!
The Price of Ingenuity#144.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#145.src: It's like there's ripples gently spreading within me...
The Price of Ingenuity#145.dst: Es como si dentro de mí se extendieran ondas suaves...
The Price of Ingenuity#145.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#146.src: To see my powers growing this clearly...
The Price of Ingenuity#146.dst: Ver mi poder crecer con tanta claridad...
The Price of Ingenuity#146.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#148.src: Dang, I think I overloaded it. I'll have to put it through a charge cycle...
The Price of Ingenuity#148.dst: Vaya, creo que lo he sobrecargado. Tendré que darle un ciclo de carga...
The Price of Ingenuity#148.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#150.src: So. Magic, curses, blessings... whatever you want to call it, it hasn't worked for me. It just doesn't... click.
The Price of Ingenuity#150.dst: Bueno. Magia, maldiciones, bendiciones... llámalo como quieras, conmigo no ha funcionado. Simplemente no... encaja.
The Price of Ingenuity#150.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#151.src: Ah, not to worry, Rex! Even without it, none in the province could match your accuracy with a bow.
The Price of Ingenuity#151.dst: ¡Ah, no te preocupes, Rex! Aun sin ella, nadie en la provincia igualaría tu puntería con el arco.
The Price of Ingenuity#151.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#152.src: Y- yeah! And if you d- did get magic, it'd j- jus- just be unfair for the rest of us!
The Price of Ingenuity#152.dst: ¡S- sí! Y si t- tuvieras magia, s- se- ¡sería injusto para los demás!
The Price of Ingenuity#152.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#153.src: Yeah, yeah, sure. Either way, I've been practicing a new technique... let's see if I can pull it off.
The Price of Ingenuity#153.dst: Ya, ya, claro. Sea como sea, llevo practicando una técnica nueva... a ver si me sale.
The Price of Ingenuity#153.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#155.src: Yep! I just place every arrow on the string at once, which lets me shoot at a much larger area!
The Price of Ingenuity#155.dst: ¡Sip! ¡Solo pongo todas las flechas en la cuerda a la vez, y así cubro un área mucho mayor!
The Price of Ingenuity#155.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#156.src: But... how'd you manage to hit each arrow right on target?! That's... insane!
The Price of Ingenuity#156.dst: Pero... ¡¿cómo has clavado cada flecha en el blanco?! Eso es... ¡una locura!
The Price of Ingenuity#156.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#157.src: Ha. Go on, keep praising my skill. That was actually the first time I tried that many arrows at once... glad it worked out!
The Price of Ingenuity#157.dst: Ja. Venga, sigue alabando mi técnica. En realidad era la primera vez que probaba con tantas flechas a la vez... ¡menos mal que salió bien!
The Price of Ingenuity#157.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#158.src: The... first... You said you'd practiced it, man! What do you mean that was the first time?!
The Price of Ingenuity#158.dst: La... primera... ¡Dijiste que la habías practicado, tía! ¡¿Cómo que era la primera vez?!
The Price of Ingenuity#158.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#159.src: Yeah? I practiced theoretically. In my head. Keep up, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#159.dst: ¿Sí? La practiqué en teoría. En mi cabeza. Sigue el ritmo, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#159.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#161.src: Couldn't even make a spark, eh?
The Price of Ingenuity#161.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#162.src: Alright, alright! I've been proven wrong.
The Price of Ingenuity#162.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#164.src: So... I w-want to first say that I've been c-coming here every night.
The Price of Ingenuity#164.dst: Bueno... p-primero quiero decir que he estado v-viniendo aquí cada noche.
The Price of Ingenuity#164.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#165.src: I was e-embarrassed that I just didn't g-get it.
The Price of Ingenuity#165.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#166.src: I mean, j-just look at how fast your m-magic developed, Mora!
The Price of Ingenuity#166.dst: O sea, ¡m-mira lo rápido que creció tu m-magia, Mora!
The Price of Ingenuity#166.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#167.src: And you, S-sui! You are a natural, a-after all.
The Price of Ingenuity#167.dst: ¡Y tú, S-sui! Si eres un t-talento natural.
The Price of Ingenuity#167.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#168.src: I still don't know any form of magic. Why feel so embarassed?
The Price of Ingenuity#168.dst: Yo sigo sin saber ninguna clase de magia. ¿Por qué avergonzarse?
The Price of Ingenuity#168.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#169.src: Rex, you don't even n-need magic to be a valuable asset! You're the best archer in the w-world!
The Price of Ingenuity#169.dst: Rex, ¡tú no n-necesitas magia para ser valiosa! ¡Eres la mejor arquera del m-mundo!
The Price of Ingenuity#169.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#170.src: I don't h-have that skill! My blade skills a-aren't good enough! You've h-had to save me time and time a-again.
The Price of Ingenuity#170.dst: ¡Yo no t-tengo ese talento! ¡Mi manejo de la espada no es s-suficiente! Has t-tenido que salvarme una y otra v-vez.
The Price of Ingenuity#170.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#171.src: And {u}, I felt like I had l-let you down after all the k-knowledge you had given me.
The Price of Ingenuity#171.dst: Y {u}, sentía que te había f-fallado después de todo lo que me has e-enseñado.
The Price of Ingenuity#171.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#172.src: I may not have talked to you a lot, Zeph. But from what I know of the science behind magic, you don't have to blame yourself for not getting it.
The Price of Ingenuity#172.dst: No hemos hablado mucho, Zeph. Pero por lo que sé de la ciencia que hay tras la magia, no tienes que culparte por no pillarlo.
The Price of Ingenuity#172.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#173.src: A lot of people study magic their whole lives. I'm sure you'll get there eventually.
The Price of Ingenuity#173.dst: Mucha gente estudia magia toda su vida. Seguro que acabas llegando.
The Price of Ingenuity#173.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#174.src: Thank y-you, Yusanu. However, I think I f-finally figured it out...
The Price of Ingenuity#174.dst: G-gracias, Yusanu. Aunque creo que p-por fin lo he entendido...
The Price of Ingenuity#174.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#176.src: I think I'm finally g-getting this magic thing somewhat down!
The Price of Ingenuity#176.dst: ¡Creo que por fin le voy c-cogiendo el truco a esto de la magia!
The Price of Ingenuity#176.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#177.src: I will n-not stop practicing! N-not until I can m-m-match you all!
The Price of Ingenuity#177.dst: ¡N-no pienso dejar de practicar! ¡N-no hasta que pueda i-i-igualaros!
The Price of Ingenuity#177.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#179.src: Come on, man! Show us what you've got!
The Price of Ingenuity#179.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#180.src: ...okay. I've tried to, um, practice a bit, now that I'm... yeah.
The Price of Ingenuity#180.dst: ...vale. He intentado, eh, practicar un poco, ahora que soy... sí.
The Price of Ingenuity#180.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#181.src: I haven't fully developed it, but, I have this new skill...
The Price of Ingenuity#181.dst: No lo tengo del todo desarrollado, pero tengo esta habilidad nueva...
The Price of Ingenuity#181.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#182.src: Okay! I'm going to try it!
The Price of Ingenuity#182.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#183.src: W- woah! It's like you ma- made that out of n- n- nothing!
The Price of Ingenuity#183.dst: ¡A- anda! ¡Es como si lo hu- hubieras hecho de la n- n- nada!
The Price of Ingenuity#183.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#184.src: ...ugh! It takes so much concentration... even a word makes me fail...
The Price of Ingenuity#184.dst: ...¡uf! Requiere muchísima concentración... una palabra y ya fallo...
The Price of Ingenuity#184.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#185.src: Also. It's not, um, out of nothing.
The Price of Ingenuity#185.dst: Y además. No es, eh, de la nada.
The Price of Ingenuity#185.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#186.src: It's like... there's an ocean of swirling energy, all around me. If I can get a bit, in, like... a bucket, I can use it. But... I don't know how to get it without, um, falling into it and getting overwhelmed.
The Price of Ingenuity#186.dst: Es como... hay un océano de energía en remolino a mi alrededor. Si logro coger un poco, como en... un cubo, puedo usarla. Pero... no sé cómo cogerla sin, eh, caerme dentro y quedar desbordada.
The Price of Ingenuity#186.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#188.src: Uh... n- not- not really, but-
The Price of Ingenuity#188.dst: Eh... n- no- no mucho, pero-
The Price of Ingenuity#188.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#193.src: I... I'm fine. No, even... more than that...
The Price of Ingenuity#193.dst: Yo... estoy bien. No, incluso... más que eso...
The Price of Ingenuity#193.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#194.src: It's like... I finally felt this power's ebb and flow, not just... it pouring out, I...
The Price of Ingenuity#194.dst: Es como... por fin he sentido el flujo y reflujo de este poder, no solo... cómo se derrama, yo...
The Price of Ingenuity#194.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#195.src: ...ah! Is everyone fine? You... you all seem fine. Okay...
The Price of Ingenuity#195.dst: ...¡ah! ¿Estáis todos bien? Parecéis... parecéis estar bien. Vale...
The Price of Ingenuity#195.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#196.src: I think... I think that's all from me.
The Price of Ingenuity#196.dst: Creo... creo que ya está todo.
The Price of Ingenuity#196.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#197.src: Very well! This is as good an opportunity as any to show off my progress!
The Price of Ingenuity#197.dst: ¡Muy bien! ¡No hay mejor ocasión para lucir mis progresos!
The Price of Ingenuity#197.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#198.src: Although I am proficient in combat with my hammer, that is... standard. So, allow me to show my magic instead, as that is what I have been training!
The Price of Ingenuity#198.dst: Aunque manejo el martillo con soltura, eso es... lo habitual. ¡Así que permitidme mostrar mi magia, que es lo que he estado entrenando!
The Price of Ingenuity#198.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#199.src: ...oh, dear. I did not expect it to have become so powerful! It seems I must still master control over it...
The Price of Ingenuity#199.dst: ...ay, madre. ¡No esperaba que se hubiera vuelto tan poderosa! Parece que aún debo dominar su control...
The Price of Ingenuity#199.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#200.src: I apologize for the damage I have caused. If you would ask for compensation, I would gladly provide it.
The Price of Ingenuity#200.dst: Pido disculpas por los daños que he causado. Si pedís una compensación, la pagaré con gusto.
The Price of Ingenuity#200.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#201.src: Eh, don't worry about it. It's just a training room. Besides, all this junk in here doesn't even work anymore.
The Price of Ingenuity#201.dst: Bah, no te preocupes. Es solo una sala de entrenamiento. Además, todos estos trastos ya no funcionaban.
The Price of Ingenuity#201.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#203.src: Yo, that was badass, man! Your curse is awesome.
The Price of Ingenuity#203.dst: ¡Yo, eso ha sido brutal, tío! Tu maldición es increíble.
The Price of Ingenuity#203.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#204.src: Is it! I suppose it is, haha! I am glad to have had the oppurtunity to learn to use it.
The Price of Ingenuity#204.dst: ¿Lo es? Supongo que sí, ¡jaja! Me alegra haber tenido la oportunidad de aprender a usarla.
The Price of Ingenuity#204.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#205.src: That is all, then. Who will go next?
The Price of Ingenuity#205.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#206.src: Lemme show you just what I can really do, man.
The Price of Ingenuity#206.dst: Deja que te enseñe lo que sé hacer de verdad, tío.
The Price of Ingenuity#206.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#207.src: Watch and learn, princess. Not every day you get to see me shred.
The Price of Ingenuity#207.dst: Mira y aprende, princesa. No todos los días me ves darle caña.
The Price of Ingenuity#207.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#209.src: Yuman But wait! That's not all!
The Price of Ingenuity#209.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#210.src: My Sonic Boomer can help out with defense too! I'm no one trick pony - I can cover every genre of combat!
The Price of Ingenuity#210.dst: ¡Mi Estruendo Sónico también ayuda en defensa! No soy de un solo truco: ¡domino todos los géneros del combate!
The Price of Ingenuity#210.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#211.src: And bam! That's it from me and Sonic Boomer for today.
The Price of Ingenuity#211.dst: ¡Y pam! Eso es todo por hoy de mí y del Estruendo Sónico.
The Price of Ingenuity#211.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#214.src: I'll say, I'm not as... direct... as Yuman. But I can hold my own in a fight.
The Price of Ingenuity#214.dst: La verdad, no soy tan... directo... como Yuman. Pero me defiendo bien peleando.
The Price of Ingenuity#214.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#216.src: I mean... yeah? Yusanu made this thing for me, and he calls it the Electric Blaster.
The Price of Ingenuity#216.dst: Pues... ¿sí? Me lo hizo Yusanu, y lo llama el Bláster Eléctrico.
The Price of Ingenuity#216.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#217.src: It's also able to fire a much larger blast with way more power, but that does make it less... precise.
The Price of Ingenuity#217.dst: También puede disparar una descarga mucho más grande y potente, pero entonces es menos... preciso.
The Price of Ingenuity#217.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#218.src: That's all from me. Next one!
The Price of Ingenuity#218.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#219.src: Alrighty! Let's see... where to start...
The Price of Ingenuity#219.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#220.src: Oh, you have gotta be... again?! Really?! Ugh!
The Price of Ingenuity#220.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#221.src: Yulie, Yuman, can you check the tunnels for any intruders?
The Price of Ingenuity#221.dst: Yulie, Yuman, ¿podéis revisar los túneles por si hay intrusos?
The Price of Ingenuity#221.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#222.src: If you need us to. Keep us updated, would you?
The Price of Ingenuity#222.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#223.src: Sure. Get the others to help you, I gotta run and check on things!
The Price of Ingenuity#223.dst: Claro. Que los demás os ayuden, ¡tengo que ir corriendo a ver una cosa!
The Price of Ingenuity#223.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#224.src: Of course we can help, just tell us what to do!
The Price of Ingenuity#224.dst: ¡Claro que podemos ayudar, solo dinos qué hacer!
The Price of Ingenuity#224.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#225.src: {u} and I actually have some important tasks Syndra needed done!! Will you be okay without us?
The Price of Ingenuity#225.dst: ¡¡{u} y yo tenemos unas tareas importantes que Syndra nos encargó!! ¿Os las apañáis sin nosotros?
The Price of Ingenuity#225.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#226.src: We will. It shouldn't be too hard for us, anyway- just routine check ups.
The Price of Ingenuity#226.dst: Sí. Tampoco será difícil para nosotros- solo comprobaciones rutinarias.
The Price of Ingenuity#226.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#227.src: Yep, yep! Alright guys, follow papa!
The Price of Ingenuity#227.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#228.src: Wh- what? Ugh... put some c- cl- clothes on, a- at- at least.
The Price of Ingenuity#228.dst: ¿Q- qué? Uf... p- po- ponte algo de r- ropa, al m- menos.
The Price of Ingenuity#228.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#232.src: I needed a way to get everyone else out of here so we could talk!
The Price of Ingenuity#232.dst: ¡Necesitaba sacar a todos de aquí para que pudiéramos hablar!
The Price of Ingenuity#232.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#233.src: Yeah, obviously! It was the best excuse I could come up with in the moment.
The Price of Ingenuity#233.dst: ¡Sí, evidentemente! Fue la mejor excusa que se me ocurrió en el momento.
The Price of Ingenuity#233.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#234.src: So, look. Yusanu's been really hard to get a read of! He's barely ever around- I'm honestly surprised he even showed up today!
The Price of Ingenuity#234.dst: Mira. ¡A Yusanu cuesta muchísimo calarlo! Casi nunca está aquí- ¡sinceramente, me sorprende que hoy apareciera!
The Price of Ingenuity#234.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#235.src: But anyway, when you and Zeph headed out with Yuman during the last alarm, I wanted to check in with Yusanu and see what he was up to.
The Price of Ingenuity#235.dst: En fin, cuando tú y Zeph salisteis con Yuman durante la última alarma, quise pasarme por donde Yusanu a ver qué se traía entre manos.
The Price of Ingenuity#235.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#236.src: But guess what? He was gone! Walked into his workshop and never walked out. Isn't that weird?
The Price of Ingenuity#236.dst: ¿Y sabes qué? ¡No estaba! Entró en su taller y no volvió a salir. ¿No es raro?
The Price of Ingenuity#236.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#237.src: I don't know what it means, and I don't know if he's a risk to us or not. But what I do know is that he's suspicious!
The Price of Ingenuity#237.dst: No sé qué significa, ni sé si es un peligro para nosotros. ¡Pero lo que sí sé es que es sospechoso!
The Price of Ingenuity#237.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#238.src: Because they'd all probably tell me not to do anything impulsive right now. Which isn't even true, I've thought this plan out extensively!
The Price of Ingenuity#238.dst: Porque seguramente todos me dirían que no hiciera nada impulsivo ahora mismo. Lo cual ni siquiera es cierto, ¡me he pensado este plan a fondo!
The Price of Ingenuity#238.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#239.src: Come on, meet me outside his workshop! I just want to look. If it's nothing, then it's nothing! But I don't think it's nothing.
The Price of Ingenuity#239.dst: ¡Venga, nos vemos fuera de su taller! Solo quiero mirar. Si no es nada, ¡pues no es nada! Pero no creo que no sea nada.
The Price of Ingenuity#239.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#241.src: I'll meet up with you at the workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#241.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#244.src: See? I told you! He's just... gone.
The Price of Ingenuity#244.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#245.src: Not even a trace... Seems like I wasn't distrustful for nothing. But how?
The Price of Ingenuity#245.dst: Ni rastro... Parece que no desconfiaba en balde. Pero ¿cómo?
The Price of Ingenuity#245.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#246.src: He has to have gone somewhere! He couldn't have just... vanished.
The Price of Ingenuity#246.dst: ¡Tiene que haber ido a alguna parte! No puede haberse... esfumado.
The Price of Ingenuity#246.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#247.src: There has to be something else going on here! Do you see why I suspect him now?
The Price of Ingenuity#247.dst: ¡Aquí pasa algo más! ¿Ahora entiendes por qué sospecho de él?
The Price of Ingenuity#247.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#248.src: Let's snoop around a bit and make sure he's not posing a threat to us.
