The Price of Ingenuity#592.src: Restarting the Resonance Weaver project... it cannot be done. That artifact I entrusted you with... that magic is a lost art. It cannot be replicated.
The Price of Ingenuity#592.dst: Reiniciar el proyecto del Tejedor de Resonancia... no se puede. Ese artefacto que te confié... esa magia es un arte perdido. No se puede replicar.
The Price of Ingenuity#592.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#593.src: N- no, I have the notes, I- I know how it works, I can do it, just- just give me a chance! I can fix this!
The Price of Ingenuity#593.dst: N- no, tengo las notas, s- sé cómo funciona, puedo hacerlo, solo- ¡solo deme una oportunidad! ¡Puedo arreglarlo!
The Price of Ingenuity#593.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#594.src: I must prepare for the festival. I will expect your presence there, as usual. Please... clean yourself up before that.
The Price of Ingenuity#594.dst: Debo prepararme para el festival. Espero tu presencia allí, como siempre. Por favor... aséate antes.
The Price of Ingenuity#594.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#597.src: Consider our agreement null. You have failed me. You will continue your service as Sovereign indefinitely... with your blessing intact.
The Price of Ingenuity#597.dst: Considera nuestro acuerdo nulo. Me has fallado. Seguirás sirviendo como Soberana indefinidamente... con tu bendición intacta.
The Price of Ingenuity#597.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#598.src: ...what? No- no, no no no, you- you can't, you can't, you can't!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#598.dst: ...¿qué? No- no, no no no, ¡¡¡¡no puedes, no puedes, no puedes!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#598.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Qira Hive (Quest)#000.src: I see another lost soul has found their way to The {p}!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#000.dst: ¡Veo que otra alma perdida ha encontrado el camino a {p}!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#000.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#001.src: I can't say I am overwhelmed by your appearance. Here, the birth of many powerful and magical monsters take place.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#001.dst: No puedo decir que tu aspecto me impresione. Aquí nacen muchos monstruos poderosos y mágicos.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#001.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#002.src: Gavel's governments can not stop Mistress Qira. I doubt you can either.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#002.dst: Los gobiernos de Gavel no detienen a la Señora Qira. Dudo que tú sí.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#002.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#003.src: If you want to meet her, you will have to defeat each division of her army.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#003.dst: Si quieres verla, tendrás que derrotar a cada división de su ejército.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#003.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#004.src: Although powerful, she is not without honour. After every floor you complete, you will receive a token for a reward from the shop. Good luck, adventurer-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#004.dst: Aunque poderosa, no carece de honor. Por cada planta que superes recibirás una ficha para un premio de la tienda. Suerte, aventurer-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#004.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#005.src: Wh- Oh, Mistress, am I? My apologies...
The Qira Hive (Quest)#005.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#006.src: Begin, the Thunder Division! Strike quickly and move on, for those within will warp your very mind should you stray for too long!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#006.dst: ¡Que comience la División de Trueno! ¡Golpea rápido y avanza: si te demoras, los de dentro te retorcerán la mente!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#006.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#007.src: Heeheehahaaah! I see you! You humans have such easily influenced minds, but I'll settle for beating you within an inch of your life! Come through, come through!!!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#007.dst: ¡Jiji jajaaa! ¡Te veo! Los humanos tenéis mentes muy fáciles de manipular, pero me conformo con darte una paliza casi mortal. ¡Pasa, pasa!!!

The Qira Hive (Quest)#008.src: Feh, you're no fun, you little cheater! I was supposed to beat you, not the other way around!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#008.dst: ¡Bah, qué aburrido eres, tramposillo! ¡Era yo quien debía ganarte, no al revés!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#008.speaker: Psychomancer

The Qira Hive (Quest)#009.src: I hate you so much. Just get out and talk to that idiot servant already!!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#009.dst: Te odio muchísimo. ¡Largo, ve a hablar con ese siervo idiota ya!!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#009.speaker: Psychomancer

The Qira Hive (Quest)#010.src: You have completed the Thunder floor? How surprising. They were some of Mistress Qira's earliest successes.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#010.dst: ¿Has superado la planta de Trueno? Qué sorpresa. Eran de los primeros éxitos de la Señora Qira.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#010.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#011.src: I agree, Mistress. As promised, here is a Thunder Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#011.dst: De acuerdo, Señora. Como se prometió, aquí tienes un Thunder Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#011.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#012.src: Take it to the shop to claim your prize. It is located at the base of the Hive. The servant there will have important information for you regarding your prizes.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#012.dst: Llévalo a la tienda para reclamar tu premio. Está en la base de la Colmena. El siervo de allí tiene información importante sobre tus premios.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#012.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#013.src: I doubt you are still worth Mistress's time, however. She has much to tend to here, as you might guess.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#013.dst: Aun así, dudo que merezcas el tiempo de la Señora. Como imaginarás, aquí tiene mucho que atender.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#013.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#014.src: She made a deal with Gavel's people long ago, after they foolishly attempted to lay siege to our Hive.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#014.dst: Hace mucho hizo un trato con la gente de Gavel, tras su necio intento de asediar nuestra Colmena.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#014.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#015.src: She could continue her unethical and possibly evil work...and in return, she would allow the people of Gavel to remain undisturbed by her.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#015.dst: Ella podría seguir su labor poco ética, quizá malvada... y a cambio, no molestaría al pueblo de Gavel.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#015.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#016.src: Next you must tackle the Air division, featuring some of her tougher creations.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#016.dst: Ahora te toca la división de Aire, con sus creaciones más duras.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#016.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#017.src: Begin, the Air Division! Fight freely with the wind, for the coming storm shall claim you for my own if you cannot spread your wings here!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#017.dst: ¡Que comience la División de Aire! Lucha libre con el viento: si no despliegas aquí tus alas, ¡la tormenta que llega te hará mía!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#017.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#018.src: Well, nice work getting this far! Don't tell anyone, but I'm gonna pull my punches here, okay? I'm rooting for you, so let's have fun with this! Come on through!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#018.dst: ¡Vaya, bien hecho por llegar hasta aquí! No se lo digas a nadie, pero aquí voy a contenerme, ¿vale? Estoy de tu parte, ¡así que divirtámonos! ¡Pasa, pasa!

The Qira Hive (Quest)#019.src: Heehee, maybe I didn't need to hold back after all? You did really well, really well!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#019.dst: Jiji, ¿al final no hacía falta contenerse? ¡Lo has hecho muy bien, muy bien!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#019.speaker: Gale

The Qira Hive (Quest)#020.src: A lot of people say I'm the roughest we have to offer, so you've got this! I'm sorry you have to go talk to Yansur of all people now, though.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#020.dst: Muchos dicen que soy la más dura de todas, ¡así que lo tienes hecho! Eso sí, siento que ahora te toque hablar con Yansur, nada menos.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#020.speaker: Gale

The Qira Hive (Quest)#021.src: Hrm, perhaps we have underestimated you. The creations of Air have defeated thousands, particularly-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#021.dst: Hum, quizá te hayamos subestimado. Las creaciones de Aire han derrotado a miles, en especial-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#021.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#022.src: ...yes. Here is the promised Air Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#022.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#023.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#023.dst: La tienda tiene tu recompensa lista. Si aún no has hablado con el siervo de la tienda, hazlo la próxima vez.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#023.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#024.src: You still have a long way to go. It is not easy to gain an audience with Mistress Qira.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#024.dst: Aún te queda mucho camino. No es fácil lograr una audiencia con la Señora Qira.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#024.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#025.src: Your next objective is to clear the Earth division. Some of the most powerful, raw creatures ever hatched.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#025.dst: Tu siguiente objetivo: limpiar la división de Tierra. De las criaturas más brutas y poderosas jamás nacidas.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#025.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#026.src: Begin, the Earth Division! You must withstand both sheer force and deadly toxins! Be quick on your feet, or you will return to the dust of the earth!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#026.dst: ¡Que comience la División de Tierra! ¡Resiste la fuerza bruta y las toxinas mortales! ¡Muévete rápido o volverás al polvo de la tierra!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#026.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#027.src: Creatures of the earth were not enough for you... Mistress's most rawly powerful... Destroyed.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#027.dst: Las criaturas de la tierra no te bastaron... Las más brutas y poderosas de la Señora... Destruidas.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#027.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#028.src: Well, here is your Earth Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#028.dst: Bueno, aquí tienes tu Earth Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#028.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#029.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#029.dst: La tienda tiene tu recompensa lista. Si aún no has hablado con el siervo de la tienda, hazlo la próxima vez.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#029.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#030.src: It is impressive to see how far you have come. Many have failed at this point.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#030.dst: Impresiona ver lo lejos que has llegado. Muchos han fallado aquí.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#030.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#031.src: It is of no consequence, however, for the Water division is your next challenge. I am sure you will not succeed.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#031.dst: Da igual, de todos modos: tu siguiente reto es la división de Agua. Seguro que no lo logras.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#031.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#032.src: Begin, the Water Division! If you will not withstand the crashing waves, the creatures that lurk within shall ensure you never emerge from the abyss!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#032.dst: ¡Que comience la División de Agua! Si no resistes el embate de las olas, las criaturas que acechan harán que jamás salgas del abismo.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#032.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#033.src: You have been judged worthy enough to face me in combat. However, I know your strength, and I do not believe it enough to defeat me. Come forth now. Make your attempt to prove me wrong.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#033.dst: Se te ha juzgado digno de enfrentarme en combate. Aun así, conozco tu fuerza y no la creo suficiente para vencerme. Adelante. Intenta demostrar que me equivoco.

The Qira Hive (Quest)#034.src: Seems my judgment was incorrect. In this case, however, it is refreshing to see.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#034.dst: Parece que mi juicio erró. En este caso, sin embargo, resulta grato.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#034.speaker: Oceanic Judge

The Qira Hive (Quest)#035.src: Continue forwards, honourable human. Perhaps your intellect and respect will rub off on that insufferable Yansur.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#035.dst: Sigue adelante, humano honorable. Quizá tu ingenio y tu respeto se le peguen al insufrible Yansur.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#035.speaker: Oceanic Judge

The Qira Hive (Quest)#036.src: Impossible. Not even the most tactically advanced monsters could defeat you.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#036.dst: Imposible. Ni los monstruos más tácticos pudieron vencerte.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#036.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#037.dst: ...Aquí tienes el Water Voucher que esperas.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#037.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#038.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#038.dst: La tienda tiene tu recompensa lista. Si aún no has hablado con el siervo de la tienda, hazlo la próxima vez.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#038.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#039.src: We are intrigued by your determination... But we are not worried. We do not expect you to make it past the next floor.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#039.dst: Tu determinación nos intriga... Pero no nos preocupa. No esperamos que pases de la siguiente planta.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#039.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#040.src: Now you must face some of the toughest creatures of Mistress Qira's imagination!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#040.dst: ¡Ahora te enfrentarás a lo más duro que ha imaginado la Señora Qira!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#040.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#041.src: You must now face the division of Fire, and it will be sure to burn you.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#041.dst: Ahora te toca la división de Fuego, y te quemará sin duda.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#041.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#042.src: Begin, the Fire Division! Summon your courage, and brave the heat of the volcanoes and blow away in the breeze!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#042.dst: ¡Que comience la División de Fuego! Reúne valor y afronta el calor de los volcanes, o te llevará la brisa.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#042.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#043.src: Impressive, making it this far. I am your final test. Let us fight fairly, then. An honourable end to your challenge is only fitting, whether that be triumph or defeat. Come forward and face me.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#043.dst: Impresiona que hayas llegado hasta aquí. Soy tu última prueba. Luchemos con honor, pues. Tu desafío merece un final honorable, sea victoria o derrota. Ven y enfréntame.

The Qira Hive (Quest)#044.src: Defeat feels strange, after so long. You fought valiantly, and with great zeal, however. It would be a lie to say I am disappointed. Impart these traits onto Mistress's servant, if you would, and claim your final prize.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#044.dst: La derrota resulta extraña tras tanto tiempo. Aun así, luchaste con valor y gran ardor. Mentiría si dijera que estoy decepcionado. Contagia esas virtudes al siervo de la Señora y reclama tu último premio.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#044.speaker: Solar Vanguard

The Qira Hive (Quest)#045.src: All that is left is to talk to Mistress's servant, and claim your final prize. Surely he will not be as great an obstacle as I was.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#045.dst: Solo queda hablar con el siervo de la Señora y reclamar tu último premio. Seguro que él no será tan gran obstáculo como yo.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#045.speaker: Solar Vanguard

The Qira Hive (Quest)#046.src: This is unprecedented. You have defeated some of the most recent and powerful creations.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#046.dst: Esto no tiene precedentes. Has derrotado a algunas de las creaciones más recientes y poderosas.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#046.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#047.src: Here you are then, the Fire Voucher!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#047.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#048.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#048.dst: La tienda tiene tu recompensa lista. Si aún no has hablado con el siervo de la tienda, hazlo la próxima vez.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#048.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#049.src: This is unorthodox, as no one has made it this far. But I suppose this means that you have earned an audience with-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#049.dst: Esto es insólito, nadie había llegado tan lejos. Supongo que significa que te has ganado una audiencia con-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#049.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#050.src: Hah! Incredible! Mistress wishes to battle you herself! You astound me.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#050.dst: ¡Ja! ¡Increíble! ¡La Señora quiere luchar contigo! Me asombras.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#050.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#051.src: Be warned, however. This will be your toughest battle yet. Mistress Qira is the most feared being in Gavel.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#051.dst: Pero quedas advertido. Será tu batalla más dura. La Señora Qira es el ser más temido de Gavel.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#051.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#052.src: You will die...but consider it the greatest honour to die by her hand.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#052.dst: Morirás... pero morir a su mano es el mayor honor.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#052.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#053.src: How cowardly! After defeating so many in the Hive, and receiving such praise, you've the gall to upstand Mistress's request?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#053.dst: ¡Qué cobardía! Tras vencer a tantos en la Colmena y recibir tales elogios, ¿tienes el descaro de rechazar la petición de la Señora?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#053.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#054.src: I had begun to think highly of you, but after such a disgusting display-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#054.dst: Empezaba a tenerte en alta estima, pero tras tal bochorno-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#054.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#055.src: Wha...that- No, that can't possibly be correct, you are-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#055.dst: Qué...eso- No, no puede ser cierto, tú eres-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#055.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#056.src: ...Masterful...Have we been cooped up in this Hive so long that our army is outdated?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#056.dst: ...Magistral...¿Tanto llevamos encerrados en esta Colmena que nuestro ejército quedó anticuado?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#056.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#057.src: To be defeated by a human of Wynn... I am not sure whether to be disappointed or amazed. Our ultimate challenge has been bested.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#057.dst: Ser derrotados por un humano de Wynn... No sé si decepcionarme o asombrarme. Nuestro desafío final ha sido superado.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#057.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#058.src: Here is your voucher, then. The back room in the shop will have your rewards. If you still have not talked to the servant at the shop...well. You should know by now.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#058.dst: Aquí tienes tu vale, pues. Tus recompensas están en la trastienda. Si aún no has hablado con el siervo de la tienda...en fin. A estas alturas ya deberías saberlo.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#058.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#059.src: Mistress...if I may tell the tale? She was once called upon to help stop the decay of the forest.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#059.dst: Señora...¿me permite contarlo? Una vez la llamaron para ayudar a detener la Decadencia del bosque.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#059.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#060.src: With her boundless knowledge and magic, she surely could have cured it. But she declined.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#060.dst: Con su saber y su magia sin límites, sin duda podría haberlo curado. Pero se negó.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#060.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#061.src: She instead chose to create, obsessed with preparing for some sort of war.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#061.dst: Prefirió crear, obsesionada con preparar no sé qué guerra.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#061.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#062.src: Mistress never elaborated, but it seems like she knows something we don't.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#062.dst: La Señora nunca lo explicó, pero parece saber algo que nosotros no.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#062.speaker: Yansur

The Realm of Light (Quest)#002.src: ... Achara... I do not believe I can ever atone for what I have done to you. An apology simply isn't enough.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#002.dst: ... Achara... No creo que pueda expiar jamás lo que te hice. Una disculpa no basta.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#002.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#003.src: As infuriating as what you did was, you were following orders... I had every right to be angry, but to try and take your life was ten steps too far.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#003.dst: Por mucho que me enfureciera lo que hiciste, seguías órdenes... Tenía derecho a enfadarme, pero intentar matarte fue pasarme diez pueblos.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#003.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#004.src: Even though it is not enough, I will say I am sorry for the pain I caused you. The Guardian was right, in the end.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#004.dst: Aunque no baste, quiero decirte que siento el dolor que te causé. Al final, el Guardián tenía razón.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#004.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#005.src: Without you carrying out Orphion's will, we would not be here. You truly are necessary in this, and I believe I have finally made peace with that.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#005.dst: Sin ti cumpliendo la voluntad de Orphion, no estaríamos aquí. Tu papel aquí es imprescindible, y creo que por fin lo he aceptado.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#005.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#006.src: It has been a long time since I had a partner willing to help me in this way. I was unused to it, I suppose... Still.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#006.dst: Hacía mucho que no tenía a alguien dispuesto a ayudarme así. Supongo que no estaba acostumbrada... Aun así.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#006.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#007.src: If you'll be willing to aid me, it would be a great relief. It has been a thousand years since I entered the Realm of Light...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#007.dst: Si quieres ayudarme, sería un gran alivio. Hace mil años que no entro en el Reino de la Luz...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#007.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#008.src: I can only hope things have not changed much. I remember how it was, right down to the last petal...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#008.dst: Solo espero que no haya cambiado mucho. Recuerdo cómo era, hasta el último pétalo...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#008.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#009.src: Walk towards the portal with Lari.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#009.dst: Camina hacia el portal con Lari.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#010.src: Wait a moment, {u}. I have one more thing I would like to say before we enter.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#010.dst: Espera un momento, {u}. Quiero decirte una cosa más antes de entrar.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#010.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#011.src: I... I need to thank you. For helping, as you have. For staying by me as you have. There was one other before you like that...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#011.dst: Yo... tengo que darte las gracias. Por ayudarme como lo has hecho. Por quedarte a mi lado. Antes de ti solo hubo otro así...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#011.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#012.src: I promise that you will not meet the same fate as him. I will fight with you to the bitter end, achara.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#012.dst: Te prometo que no correrás su misma suerte. Lucharé contigo hasta el amargo final, achara.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#012.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#013.src: It's time, then. To visit Orphion.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#013.dst: Es la hora, pues. A ver a Orphion.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#013.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#014.src: Jump into the portal after Lari.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#014.dst: Salta al portal detrás de Lari.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#015.src: Talk to Lari at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] in the Realm of Light.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#015.dst: Habla con Lari en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], en el Reino de la Luz.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#016.src: Welcome to the Realm of Light then, {u}. Once you've re-oriented yourself, come over here.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#016.dst: Te doy la bienvenida al Reino de la Luz, {u}. Cuando te orientes, ven aquí.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#016.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#017.src: It's so much smaller than it used to be! There used to be many more landmasses, all connected to each other...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#017.dst: ¡Es mucho más pequeño que antes! Había muchas más tierras, todas conectadas entre sí...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#017.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#018.src: I feel... I feel everything in here. With Orphion's light, I can tap into the very core of the realm.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#018.dst: Siento... Lo siento todo aquí dentro. Con la luz de Orphion puedo llegar al núcleo mismo del reino.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#018.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#019.src: And I can feel disturbances. There are dark creatures here, where there should be none!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#019.dst: Y siento perturbaciones. ¡Hay criaturas oscuras aquí, donde no debería haber ninguna!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#019.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#020.src: I mean, even look at this creature. The light emanating from it is-
The Realm of Light (Quest)#020.dst: Mira esta criatura, sin ir más lejos. La luz que emana de ella es-
The Realm of Light (Quest)#020.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#021.src: Wait. Wh... Why is it attacking you!?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#021.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#022.src: Its mind was addled by darkness. Poor thing was terrified... Nothing for it though.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#022.dst: La oscuridad le nubló la mente. Pobrecilla, estaba aterrada... Pero no había otra.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#022.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#023.src: I suppose your more ruthless nature is a good thing, in this case. We each will need to fight, if this is as widespread as it feels.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#023.dst: Supongo que tu carácter más despiadado viene bien esta vez. Si esto está tan extendido como parece, tendremos que luchar los dos.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#023.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#024.src: I'll have to prepare myself for that... Being willing to take action will not make it any easier on my conscience.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#024.dst: Tendré que prepararme para eso... Estar dispuesta a actuar no le facilitará las cosas a mi conciencia.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#024.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#025.src: But I will set that aside, until the day this all becomes a memory. We'll both need to seek the Nexus of Light, Orphion's home. Follow me!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#025.dst: Pero lo dejaré a un lado hasta que todo esto sea un recuerdo. Debemos buscar el Nexo de luz, el hogar de Orphion. ¡Sígueme!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#025.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#026.src: Follow Lari to Orphion's Nexus of Light at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Realm of Light (Quest)#026.dst: Sigue a Lari hasta el Nexo de luz de Orphion en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Realm of Light (Quest)#027.src: I should have expected this. With the connections severed, of course the bridge to the Nexus would be gone.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#027.dst: Debí esperarlo. Si las conexiones están cortadas, claro que el puente al Nexo ha desaparecido.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#027.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#028.src: This must be because of that horrid parasite... The Guardian of the Forest informed me of the situation afterwards.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#028.dst: Esto será por ese parásito horrible... El Guardián del Bosque me contó la situación después.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#028.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#029.src: The gap may be too far for me to carry you over... Is there a way I can bypass this, I wonder?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#029.dst: Quizá el vacío sea demasiado ancho para llevarte en brazos... ¿Habrá forma de rodearlo?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#029.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#030.src: Perhaps I can try to bridge the gap myself. Let's see if this will work.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#030.dst: Quizá pueda tender yo el puente. Veamos si funciona.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#030.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#032.src: ...hm. That ought to have worked! Is the Nexus too far to reach?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#032.dst: ...hum. ¡Debería haber funcionado! ¿El Nexo queda demasiado lejos?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#032.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#033.src: There has to be some way over... Maybe the direct method is- Hm? Another creature?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#033.dst: Tiene que haber algún modo de cruzar... Quizá lo directo sea- ¿Hm? ¿Otra criatura?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#033.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#034.src: This one doesn't seem hostile, {u}... I'll try and talk with it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#034.dst: Esta no parece hostil, {u}... Voy a hablar con ella.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#034.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#035.src: Its mind is whole, but it's wary of your presence. You should stay back, just in case.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#035.dst: Tiene la mente intacta, pero desconfía de ti. Mejor quédate atrás, por si acaso.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#035.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#036.src: So tell me, achara. What is it you sought me for?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#036.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#037.src: Ahh, I see. You wish to see your master once more as well...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#037.dst: Ahh, entiendo. Tú también quieres ver a tu amo otra vez...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#037.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#038.src: The monoliths? Are they what's severed the connections?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#038.dst: ¿Los monolitos? ¿Son ellos los que cortaron las conexiones?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#038.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#039.src: Ahh, I understand. I assure you, we will fix this!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#039.dst: Ahh, comprendo. ¡Te aseguro que lo arreglaremos!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#039.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#040.src: It said that the connections to the rest of the realm were severed intentionally by Orphion, in order to protect them.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#040.dst: Dice que Orphion cortó a propósito las conexiones con el resto del reino, para protegerlo.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#040.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#041.src: Two monoliths on this landmass controlled the connections, and they are being drained of their light- As such, they closed the bridges.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#041.dst: Dos monolitos de esta tierra controlaban las conexiones, y les están drenando la luz- Por eso cerraron los puentes.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#041.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#042.src: The light is still there- But it must be drawn back out. We have our task ahead of us now, achara. We need to go to the first monolith. Follow me!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#042.dst: La luz sigue ahí- Pero hay que volver a sacarla. Ya sabemos qué hacer, achara. Vamos al primer monolito. ¡Sígueme!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#042.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#043.src: Search for the monolith Lari was talking about at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Realm of Light (Quest)#043.dst: Busca el monolito del que hablaba Lari en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Realm of Light (Quest)#044.src: I never knew the monoliths kept the realm together as they did. You can see that it is inactive, yes?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#044.dst: No sabía que los monolitos sostenían así el reino. Ves que está inactivo, ¿verdad?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#044.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#045.src: There should be bright bands of color going along it, and light pouring from it. This is where we play our roles, {u}!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#045.dst: Debería tener franjas de color brillante y derramar luz. ¡Aquí entramos nosotros, {u}!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#045.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#046.src: It may be getting drained, but there is certainly still light within it, and if that parasite is battling Orphion we should be able to recharge it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#046.dst: Lo estarán drenando, pero seguro que aún guarda luz, y si ese parásito pelea con Orphion, podremos recargarlo.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#046.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#047.src: I'll tap into the monolith... You'll need to enter it, and find its core. I'll send a part of Orphion's light with you to activate it once you do.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#047.dst: Yo me conectaré al monolito... Tú entra y busca su núcleo. Te mandaré parte de la luz de Orphion para activarlo.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#047.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#049.src: The damage here is minor- Nothing that can't be fixed, thankfully.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#049.dst: El daño aquí es leve- Nada que no tenga arreglo, por suerte.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#049.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#050.src: Its aura is lowered- Now your soul must enter. I will keep you safe, {u}.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#050.dst: Su aura ha bajado- Ahora debe entrar tu alma. Yo te protegeré, {u}.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#050.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#051.src: Allow my magic to open your senses... Good luck, achara.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#051.dst: Deja que mi magia te abra los sentidos... Suerte, achara.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#051.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#053.src: Find a way to fill the monolith with light.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#053.dst: Encuentra la forma de llenar el monolito de luz.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#054.src: Follow Lari to the next monolith at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Realm of Light (Quest)#054.dst: Sigue a Lari hasta el siguiente monolito en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Realm of Light (Quest)#055.src: Welcome back, {u}. I had few troubles dealing with the creatures trying to get close. Did you have issues inside?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#055.dst: Ya estás de vuelta, {u}. Apenas me costó apartar a las criaturas que se acercaban. ¿Tuviste problemas dentro?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#055.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#056.src: The light is starting to pulse out from the monolith again, so I would say you've succeeded. I suppose we do make a decent team?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#056.dst: La luz vuelve a latir desde el monolito, así que diría que lo lograste. Parece que hacemos buen equipo, ¿eh?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#056.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#057.src: Look! The colours are returning to the monolith! It's definitely reactivated. I'll run ahead and get to the other monolith.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#057.dst: ¡Mira! ¡Los colores vuelven al monolito! Está reactivado, sin duda. Me adelanto hacia el otro monolito.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#057.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#058.src: Follow the path! The way there is up the big cliff where we first entered the Realm.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#058.dst: ¡Sigue el camino! Se sube por el gran acantilado por donde entramos al Reino.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#058.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#059.src: I'm unsure if you can feel the light returning from the monolith, but I can. I almost feel reborn, with all this energy!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#059.dst: No sé si tú notas la luz que regresa del monolito, pero yo sí. ¡Con esta energía casi me siento renacida!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#059.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#060.src: The rift ahead ought to take us to the second monolith, but it doesn't seem to be working, and I'm unsure why.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#060.dst: La grieta de ahí delante debería llevarnos al segundo monolito, pero no parece funcionar y no sé por qué.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#060.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#061.src: See? It's inert, which is... Odd. These aren't connected to the energy of the monolith.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#061.dst: ¿Ves? Está inerte, y eso es... Raro. Estas no se conectan con la energía del monolito.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#061.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#062.src: It shouldn't be inactive as it is. There's some dark influence around here, but I can't seem to place it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#062.dst: No debería estar inactiva así. Hay alguna influencia oscura por aquí, pero no consigo localizarla.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#062.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#063.src: My only guess is that it's interfering with the rift's energy. I've already scoured the hill though- No dark patches to be seen.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#063.dst: Mi única idea es que interfiere con la energía de la grieta. Pero ya he peinado la colina- Ni rastro de manchas oscuras.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#063.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#064.src: Do you think you could take a second look-
The Realm of Light (Quest)#064.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#065.src: ...maybe you won't need to, after all. That was...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#065.dst: ...quizá no haga falta, después de todo. Eso ha sido...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#065.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#068.src: We've found the disturbance... Even beyond this, I'll need to charge the rift with energy to activate it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#068.dst: Ya tenemos la perturbación... Aun así, tendré que cargar la grieta de energía para activarla.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#068.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#069.src: Go in peace, tortured ones! Be at one with the light!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#069.dst: ¡Id en paz, almas torturadas! ¡Uníos a la luz!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#069.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#070.src: Get the rest of them, {u}! I'll charge the rift!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#070.dst: ¡Acaba con el resto, {u}! ¡Yo cargo la grieta!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#070.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#071.src: Defeat the darkened creatures and progress to the monolith.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#071.dst: Derrota a las criaturas oscurecidas y avanza hasta el monolito.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#072.src: Thank you, achara. The rift is charged again- Just walk into it!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#072.dst: Gracias, achara. La grieta ya está cargada- ¡Solo tienes que entrar!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#072.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#073.dst: Entra en el segundo monolito en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Realm of Light (Quest)#074.src: The process here should be roughly the same. I bring down the barrier, you enter and charge it with the light I provide.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#074.dst: Aquí el proceso será casi igual. Yo bajo la barrera, tú entras y lo cargas con la luz que te dé.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#074.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#075.src: I'll need to focus the energies of the monoliths to reconnect the Nexus of Light to the mainland here, so you'll be alone.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#075.dst: Tendré que concentrar la energía de los monolitos para reconectar el Nexo de luz con esta tierra, así que irás sin mí.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#075.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#076.src: I'll leave a barrier around you. Few creatures live on these cliffs, but best to be certain, of course.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#076.dst: Te dejaré una barrera alrededor. En estos acantilados hay pocas criaturas, pero más vale asegurarse.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#076.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#077.src: Once you're done, meet me at the cliff near the Nexus. If we're to free Orphion from the parasite, having you along would be a great help.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#077.dst: Cuando acabes, búscame en el acantilado junto al Nexo. Si queremos liberar a Orphion del parásito, tu ayuda será valiosa.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#077.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#078.src: Good luck, achara. I will see you soon.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#078.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#081.src: There. The connection to the Nexus is established, and so we'll cross.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#081.dst: Listo. La conexión con el Nexo está hecha, así que crucemos.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#081.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#082.src: Wait! Something... Something's not quite right...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#082.dst: ¡Espera! Algo... Algo no va del todo bien...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#082.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#084.src: Interfere?! You're one of the dark!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#084.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#085.src: You're the one trespassing in realms not your own!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#085.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#086.src:
Lari:
{u}. I think. I found someone.
Who deserves to be killed. Help me out?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#086.dst:
Lari:
{u}. Creo. Que he encontrado a alguien.
Que merece morir. ¿Me ayudas?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#086.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#087.src: Continue up the road towards Orphion's Nexus of Light.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#087.dst: Sigue el camino hacia el Nexo de luz de Orphion.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#088.src: {u}!! Stay back! I'm keeping up but he'll destroy you if you get close!!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#088.dst: ¡¡{u}!! ¡Atrás! ¡Yo aguanto, pero te matará si te acercas!!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#088.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#089.src: AGH, ENOUGH OF THIS! You aren't allowed here, foul thing!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#089.dst: ¡AGH, BASTA YA! ¡Aquí no tienes sitio, cosa inmunda!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#089.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#091.src: No! You won't run- I'll kill you before that!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#091.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#092.src: New Quest Started: Realm of Light V - The Realm of Light
The Realm of Light (Quest)#092.dst: Nueva misión iniciada: Reino de la Luz V - El reino de la luz

The Realm of Light (Quest)#094.src: Or something that another person wants you to see?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#094.dst: ¿O algo que otra persona quiere que veas?

The Realm of Light (Quest)#096.src: You. Elf girl. You are to be eliminated.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#097.src: Fool. The Beast quakes with our influence. This land is ours.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#097.dst: Necio. La Bestia tiembla por nuestro influjo. Esta tierra es nuestra.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#098.src: I will not waste my time with that specimen. Now. Face death.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#098.dst: No perderé el tiempo con ese espécimen. Ahora. Enfréntate a la muerte.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#100.src: You shall not. Surely your god will smile seeing me leave.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#100.dst: No lo harás. Tu dios sonreirá al verme partir.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#101.src: YOU DON'T GET TO TALK ABOUT ORPHION LIKE THAT!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#101.dst: ¡NO TIENES DERECHO A HABLAR ASÍ DE ORPHION!

The Realm of Light (Quest)#102.src: We have already won. Your peon is outmatched.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#102.dst: Ya hemos ganado. Tu peón no está a la altura.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#103.src: It's not over... IT CAN'T BE, DON'T YOU- TAKE THIS!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#103.dst: No ha terminado... NO PUEDE SER, NO TE- ¡TOMA ESTO!

The Realm of Light (Quest)#104.src: There's a faint buzzing in your ears...

The Realm of Light (Quest)#105.src: I have a slight idea of where I'm headed, but... If I'm able to handle him, then maybe I'm powerful enough for this.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#105.dst: Más o menos sé adónde voy, pero... Si puedo con él, quizá tenga fuerza para esto.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#106.src: I've never been one to say goodbyes, but thank you for everything. I know you'll find people just as strong as you are to rescue Orphion in my place.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#106.dst: Nunca se me dieron bien las despedidas, pero gracias por todo. Sé que hallarás gente tan fuerte como tú para rescatar a Orphion en mi lugar.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#107.src: I- I see the end of this... Tunnel. There's- Wait...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#107.dst: Veo- Veo el final de este... Túnel. Hay- Espera...

The Realm of Light (Quest)#109.src: {u}... Achara... I do not believe I can ever atone for what I have done to you. An apology simply isn't enough.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#109.dst: {u}... Achara... No creo que pueda expiar jamás lo que te hice. Una disculpa no basta.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#110.src: You need to defeat the mob before you can progress!

The Scarred Springs#000.src: Talk to Maripe at Pishlas at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#000.dst: Habla con Maripe en Pishlas, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#001.src: Oh! Well, hello there, tourist! I have to assume you're a tourist, anyways. That doesn't look like local dress, anyways. I suppose you've heard about the hot springs!
The Scarred Springs#001.dst: ¡Oh! ¡Hola, turista! Bueno, supongo que eres turista. Esa ropa no parece de por aquí. ¡Imagino que has oído hablar de las aguas termales!
The Scarred Springs#001.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#002.src: Well, ah...unfortunately, Pishlas is closed for renovations. You see, it's been closed for a long time... My family has run it for generations, but trouble started.
The Scarred Springs#002.dst: Pues, ah... por desgracia, Pishlas está cerrado por obras. Lleva cerrado mucho tiempo... Mi familia lo ha llevado durante generaciones, pero surgieron problemas.
The Scarred Springs#002.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#003.src: With my mother having been stricken ill for so long, my father and all our family, we've had to abandon this place to care for her. It's fallen into disrepair.
The Scarred Springs#003.dst: Con mi madre enferma tanto tiempo, mi padre y toda la familia tuvimos que dejar este sitio para cuidarla. Se vino abajo.
The Scarred Springs#003.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#004.src: She's well enough now that she doesn't need someone looking after her every hour, so I'm taking it on myself to return this place to its former glory!
The Scarred Springs#004.dst: Ya está mejor y no necesita a alguien encima a todas horas, así que me he propuesto devolverle a este sitio su antiguo esplendor.
The Scarred Springs#004.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#005.src: It's been hard work...and it should be opening soon- but I'm not quite done. Again, I'm so sorry you came all this way for nothing.
The Scarred Springs#005.dst: Ha sido mucho trabajo... y debería abrir pronto- pero aún no he terminado. De verdad, siento que hayas venido para nada.
The Scarred Springs#005.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#006.src: I- excuse me? You want to...
The Scarred Springs#006.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#007.src: That'd... That'd be absolutely fantastic!! I've been working alone on this for months now!! I'm NEARLY done, but-
The Scarred Springs#007.dst: Eso... ¡¡Eso sería fantástico!! ¡¡Llevo meses con esto yo solo!! Ya CASI está, pero-
The Scarred Springs#007.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#008.src: Come on, come on! I'll show you around! Let's go, let's go!!
The Scarred Springs#008.dst: ¡Vamos, vamos! ¡Te enseño esto! ¡¡En marcha, en marcha!!
The Scarred Springs#008.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#009.src: Hopefully you'll be able to visit before you have to go home then!
The Scarred Springs#009.dst: ¡Ojalá puedas darte un baño antes de volver a casa!
The Scarred Springs#009.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#010.src: Okay, okay, what's next on the list... C'mon, think like Sovereign Zhiraok!
The Scarred Springs#010.dst: Vale, vale, ¿qué toca ahora?... ¡Piensa como el Soberano Zhiraok!
The Scarred Springs#010.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#011.src: Let Maripe show you around at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#011.dst: Deja que Maripe te enseñe el lugar en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#012.src: Okay, so! These are the main pools- Frankly, I have no idea how all these frogs got here, given the bog is clear across the whole forest...
The Scarred Springs#012.dst: ¡Bueno, pues! Estas son las pozas principales- La verdad, no sé cómo llegaron tantas ranas, con el pantano al otro lado del bosque...
The Scarred Springs#012.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#013.src: But they've got to go. Sure, they're cute, but no one's going to want to take a soak with them... Or with all these fallen leaves in the pools.
The Scarred Springs#013.dst: Pero tienen que irse. Son monas, sí, pero nadie querrá bañarse con ellas... Ni con todas estas hojas caídas en el agua.
The Scarred Springs#013.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#014.src: The side pool over here is just as important to clean out. Need to have clear pools for the guests! And maybe even for the Sovereign!
The Scarred Springs#014.dst: La poza lateral de aquí hay que limpiarla igual. ¡El agua tiene que estar clara para los clientes! ¡Y quizá hasta para el Soberano!
The Scarred Springs#014.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#015.src: I've already put a lot of time into fixing up these huts. I do carpentry work. These used to be in so much worse shape... I'm a little glad my grandparents didn't end up seeing it like this.
The Scarred Springs#015.dst: Ya le he dedicado mucho tiempo a arreglar estas cabañas. Yo hago trabajos de carpintería. Antes estaban mucho peor... Casi me alegra que mis abuelos no llegaran a verlo así.
The Scarred Springs#015.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#016.src: I have such fond memories of playing around here when I was younger... What would they think, seeing it fall apart? That thought has been giving me motivation this whole time.
The Scarred Springs#016.dst: Tengo recuerdos preciosos de jugar por aquí de pequeño... ¿Qué pensarían al verlo caerse a trozos? Esa idea me ha dado fuerzas todo este tiempo.
The Scarred Springs#016.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#017.src: It'd be a disgrace to let Pishlas fall completely apart. Even Sovereign Zhiraok agreed! Did you know he dropped by, when I was first starting- Oh, wait! There's one other place!
The Scarred Springs#017.dst: Sería una vergüenza dejar que Pishlas se hundiera. ¡Hasta el Soberano Zhiraok lo dijo! ¿Sabías que se pasó por aquí cuando empezaba- ¡Ah, espera! ¡Falta un sitio!
The Scarred Springs#017.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#018.src: The teahouse! Refreshments, hot drinks, a place to sit out of the water... This is one of the big remaining projects. I'll take care of this- but, back about the Sovereign?
The Scarred Springs#018.dst: ¡La casa de té! Tentempiés, bebidas calientes, un sitio donde sentarse fuera del agua... Es de lo poco grande que queda. De esto me encargo yo- ¿y lo del Soberano?
The Scarred Springs#018.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#019.src: He visited one day, while I was starting on fixing the place, and he told me this would be a fantastic community service! Since it's been so long since Pishlas has been usable, I mean.
The Scarred Springs#019.dst: Vino un día, cuando empezaba a arreglar esto, y me dijo que sería un servicio estupendo para la comunidad. Digo, porque hace muchísimo que Pishlas no se puede usar.
The Scarred Springs#019.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#020.src: This used to be a big community center. Losing it was a blow to all Auburn residents... He's promised some great things if I can clean this all up! So let's get to it!
The Scarred Springs#020.dst: Esto era un gran centro para el pueblo. Perderlo fue un golpe para todos en Auburn... ¡Me prometió cosas muy buenas si lo dejo todo listo! ¡Manos a la obra!
The Scarred Springs#020.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#021.src: You go gather up the frogs! There's a pond to the you can drop them off at. Then...the leaves! Pick them out of the pools. Then...then come back and we'll see where we're at!
The Scarred Springs#021.dst: ¡Tú recoge las ranas! Hay un estanque donde puedes soltarlas. Luego... ¡las hojas! Sácalas de las pozas. Y luego... ¡luego vuelve y vemos cómo vamos!
The Scarred Springs#021.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#023.src: How's it coming? Still working on this. Will be for a bit, but I'm energized! Maybe I can get this done today, even! Uh...right, right! Frogs!
The Scarred Springs#023.dst: ¿Cómo va eso? Yo sigo con lo mío. Me queda un rato, ¡pero estoy que no paro! ¡Igual lo acabo hoy mismo! Eh... ¡ah, sí, sí! ¡Las ranas!
The Scarred Springs#023.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#024.src: Okay, there were five, and you're holding... Alright, so there's left to get!
The Scarred Springs#024.dst: Vale, había cinco y llevas... ¡Pues aún quedan por pillar!
The Scarred Springs#024.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#025.src: Release the frogs at the pond in the back at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#025.dst: Suelta las ranas en el estanque de atrás, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#026.src: Woah! That...that's sure a way to carry the frogs, haha! Y- Pfffkhhhaaahahahaa!! You look- Wahaha, that's fantastic!! Oh, Ohhkay, okay, right!
The Scarred Springs#026.dst: ¡Uala! Eso... es una forma de llevar ranas, ¡ja ja! T- ¡¡Pfffjjjajajaja!! Estás- ¡¡Jajaja, genial!! Ay, va-vale, vale, ¡ya!
The Scarred Springs#026.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#027.src: There's a pond to the of Pishlas here you can drop them off at! Now, g-get out of here, eheheh! I gotta concentrate, and there's frogs on y- heehehahahahaaah!!
The Scarred Springs#027.dst: ¡Hay un estanque junto a Pishlas donde puedes soltarlas! Y ahora, v-vete, ¡ejeje! Tengo que concentrarme, y llevas ranas encima- ¡¡jijijajajajaa!!
The Scarred Springs#027.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#028.src: Pick up all the leaf piles around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#028.dst: Recoge todos los montones de hojas por [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#029.src: Okay, frogs are dealt with, now the leaves! There were ten big patches out there I saw. Get in there and scoop them up- Uh, lemme see. ...
The Scarred Springs#029.dst: Vale, ranas resueltas, ¡ahora las hojas! Vi diez montones grandes ahí fuera. Métete y sácalas- Eh, déjame ver. ...
The Scarred Springs#029.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#030.src: Okay, you got left! Hopefully once you do, I'll be all done over here, and we'll go from there!
The Scarred Springs#030.dst: ¡Vale, aún te quedan! Espero acabar aquí para cuando termines, ¡y seguimos desde ahí!
The Scarred Springs#030.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#032.src: Okay, there! And STAY in, you darn board... So, how's the work going?
The Scarred Springs#032.dst: Vale, ¡ahí! Y QUÉDATE, maldita tabla... ¿Qué tal va la cosa?
The Scarred Springs#032.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#033.src: Frogs dealt with, check...and leaves out of the water, check! Which, ah...well, that means now I need you to get some leaves...to put IN the water, eheh!
The Scarred Springs#033.dst: Ranas resueltas, hecho... ¡y hojas fuera del agua, hecho! Lo que, ah... significa que ahora necesito hojas... ¡para meterlas EN el agua, ejej!
The Scarred Springs#033.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#034.src: What I mean by that, is that I need fresh tea for the teahouse! I've already got some food stowed away for refreshments, but I'll need some drinks to go along with that.
The Scarred Springs#034.dst: O sea, ¡que necesito té fresco para la casa de té! Ya tengo comida guardada para los tentempiés, pero hace falta algo de beber para acompañar.
The Scarred Springs#034.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#035.src: I might be done in this building, but there's still plenty of things for me to take care of, so I've got to stay behind and really...really focus in on this!
The Scarred Springs#035.dst: Con este edificio quizá haya acabado, pero aún me quedan mil cosas, así que tengo que quedarme y concentrarme de verdad... ¡de verdad!
The Scarred Springs#035.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#036.src: It's just that...a lot of this isn't heavy work, but there's just so many tasks on the list that I don't know where to start, so I just can't get it going. You taking care of the other things is helping with that!
The Scarred Springs#036.dst: Es que... mucho de esto no es trabajo duro, pero hay tantas tareas en la lista que no sé por dónde empezar y no arranco. ¡Que tú te ocupes de lo demás me ayuda un montón!
The Scarred Springs#036.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#037.src: So, uh, anyway! There's a teahouse off to the northwest, up on a ridge. I know the owner- her name's Marseled, and she makes the best tea in the whole forest!
The Scarred Springs#037.dst: En fin, ¡eh! Al noroeste, en una loma, hay una casa de té. Conozco a la dueña- se llama Marseled y hace el mejor té del bosque.
The Scarred Springs#037.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#038.src: So, your job is to head there for a big bulk order, and then bring it back! I'll ask her about paying it off later, since we trade favors a lot. Tell her I sent you!
The Scarred Springs#038.dst: Tu tarea es ir allí a por un pedido grande y traerlo, ¡venga! Ya hablaré yo del pago luego, nos hacemos favores a menudo. ¡Dile que te envío yo!
The Scarred Springs#038.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#040.src: Okay, dust busted, cobwebs cleared, lanterns in the middle of being lit- Oh, hey! Did you get the tea?
The Scarred Springs#040.dst: Vale, polvo fuera, telarañas fuera, faroles a medio encender- ¡Ah, hola! ¿Traes el té?
The Scarred Springs#040.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#041.src: Marseled's teahouse is off to the northwest, up on the ridge. If you need the exact spot, look in your !
The Scarred Springs#041.dst: La casa de té de Marseled está al noroeste, en la loma. ¿Necesitas el punto exacto? ¡Míralo!
The Scarred Springs#041.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#042.src: Welcome, traveler, to my humble teahouse. My name is Marseled. It is always a pleasure to see a new customer.
The Scarred Springs#042.dst: Bienvenido a mi humilde casa de té, viajero. Soy Marseled. Siempre es un placer ver a un cliente nuevo.
The Scarred Springs#042.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#043.src: So, what can I do for you?
The Scarred Springs#043.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#044.src: Oh, is that so? Why, that's wonderful! He's spoken with me a few times about working on old Pishlas there. If he wants fresh stock for drinks, he must be confident that it's nearly finished!
The Scarred Springs#044.dst: ¿Ah, sí? ¡Vaya, qué maravilla! Me ha hablado varias veces de arreglar el viejo Pishlas. Si quiere género fresco para las bebidas, ¡seguro que lo ve casi terminado!
The Scarred Springs#044.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#045.src: Admittedly, though, I'm facing some...difficulties. I've not got quite enough to fill up an order like he'll need. You see, ah...there's...
The Scarred Springs#045.dst: Aunque, lo admito, tengo algunas... dificultades. No me llega para un pedido tan grande como el suyo. Verá, ah... es que...
The Scarred Springs#045.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#046.src: It's COCKROACHES! Filthy, ugly, disgusting COCKROACHES!! They keep getting all over the mushrooms and on the tea leaves and I CAN'T touch them, I can't I can't I CAN'T!!
The Scarred Springs#046.dst: ¡Son CUCARACHAS! ¡¡Sucias, feas, asquerosas CUCARACHAS!! Se meten por las setas y por las hojas de té y NO puedo tocarlas, no puedo no puedo ¡¡NO PUEDO!!
The Scarred Springs#046.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#047.src: They aren't even harming the plants or anything, but I go out to harvest them and they race up to me and crawl all over my feet and up my leggings and aahghguhgughuguhhhh!!!
The Scarred Springs#047.dst: Ni siquiera dañan las plantas, pero salgo a cosechar y corren hacia mí y me trepan por los pies y por las mallas y ¡¡¡aaghgughugughhh!!!
The Scarred Springs#047.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#048.src: I hate them I hate them I hate them, I hate them so much! I- Er. Um. S-sorry. I...shouldn't act so ill-mannered in front of my customers.
The Scarred Springs#048.dst: Las odio las odio las odio, ¡las odio muchísimo! Yo- Eh. Ejem. P-perdón. No... debería comportarme así delante de mis clientes.
The Scarred Springs#048.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#049.src: The musrooms are right out front and the leaves are down the side of the hill. and should be enough to get me started again.
The Scarred Springs#049.dst: Las setas están justo delante y las hojas, ladera abajo. Con eso debería bastar para empezar otra vez.
The Scarred Springs#049.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#050.src: I do hate to ask, but...if you could go out and harvest some of the ingredients for me? And deal with the pests? I've tried, but every time I just...panic.
The Scarred Springs#050.dst: Me sabe mal pedirlo, pero... ¿podría salir a recoger algunos ingredientes por mí? ¿Y ocuparse de las plagas? Lo he intentado, pero siempre me... entra el pánico.
The Scarred Springs#050.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#051.src: If you could take care of that problem for me, I'll be able to fill out the order for Maripe... And, hopefully, I won't wake the whole of {p} shrieking over a roach in my pants.
The Scarred Springs#051.dst: Si me resuelve ese problema, podré completar el pedido de Maripe... Y, con suerte, no despertaré a todo {p} chillando por una cucaracha en los pantalones.
The Scarred Springs#051.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#052.src: The mushrooms are just out front, and the leaves are down the side of the hill. and should be enough to fill the order.
The Scarred Springs#052.dst: Las setas están justo delante y las hojas, ladera abajo. Con eso bastará para el pedido.
The Scarred Springs#052.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#053.src: Collect {~} mushrooms and {~} leaf batches from the tea farm at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#053.dst: Recoge {~} setas y {~} manojos de hojas en la granja de té de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#054.src: Oh, hey! Did you get the tea yet? I'm trying to get everything in ship-shape here, but I'm running in circles a little...
The Scarred Springs#054.dst: ¡Ah, hola! ¿Ya tienes el té? Intento dejarlo todo impecable aquí, pero doy un poco de vueltas en círculo...
The Scarred Springs#054.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#055.src: Oh, ew. She's got roaches in the farm? Yeah, that's rough. Anyways, go get 'em! I'll be, uh... Well, hopefully I'll have this done by the time you deal with that!
The Scarred Springs#055.dst: Puaj. ¿Tiene cucarachas en la granja? Ya, qué mal rollo. En fin, ¡a por ellas! Yo estaré, eh... Bueno, ¡espero tener esto listo para cuando acabes!
The Scarred Springs#055.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#056.src: Bring the tea you collected back to Marseled at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#056.dst: Lleva el té recogido a Marseled, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#057.src: So, what can I do for you?
The Scarred Springs#057.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#059.src: YES!! Take THAT, you dirty things! No more cockroooaches, no more cockroooaches, yeah, yeah- Er!
The Scarred Springs#059.dst: ¡¡SÍ!! ¡Tomad ESO, bichos sucios! Adiós cucaraaachas, adiós cucaraaachas, sí, sí- ¡Ejem!
The Scarred Springs#059.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#060.src: ...if you could. Um. Not tell anyone I was...doing that happy dance. Please. I don't think I've done that since I was a child.
The Scarred Springs#060.dst: ...si pudiera. Ejem. No contarle a nadie que... hacía ese bailecito de alegría. Por favor. Creo que no lo hacía desde niña.
The Scarred Springs#060.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#061.src: A-anyway, I'll pack up that order and bring it down to Pishlas on my own time. I know where it is. Perhaps I can be there for the opening celebrations, too!
The Scarred Springs#061.dst: E-en fin, prepararé el pedido y lo llevaré a Pishlas cuando pueda. Sé dónde está. ¡Quizá asista también a la apertura!
The Scarred Springs#061.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#062.src: I'll be sure to let my customers know. An entire generation has missed out on those hot springs, if my parents speak truly, so this will be an event to cherish, I think!
The Scarred Springs#062.dst: Se lo diré a mis clientes, por supuesto. Si mis padres dicen la verdad, toda una generación se ha perdido esas termas, así que será un acontecimiento memorable.
The Scarred Springs#062.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#063.src: Okay, that's that now, so now- Oh, you're back! Did you get the order all filled out?
The Scarred Springs#063.dst: Vale, eso ya está, así que ahora- ¡Ah, has vuelto! ¿Te han completado el pedido?
The Scarred Springs#063.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#064.src: ...oops. You got confused, didn't you. Nah, those ingredients need to go to Marseled, and THEN come here. Good hustle, though! Get those to Marseled for processing!
The Scarred Springs#064.dst: ...vaya. Te has hecho un lío, ¿verdad? No, esos ingredientes van a Marseled y LUEGO vienen aquí. ¡Pero qué rapidez! ¡Llévaselos a Marseled para que los prepare!
The Scarred Springs#064.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#065.src: Bring the tea back to Maripe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#065.dst: Lleva el té a Maripe, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#066.src: Oh my gosh, oh my gosh...L-Look! We have visitors!! Um, I know I'm not setting a great example, but...be quiet, okay? Don't disturb them!
The Scarred Springs#066.dst: Madre mía, madre mía... ¡M-mira! ¡¡Tenemos visita!! Ya sé que no doy buen ejemplo, pero... no hagas ruido, ¿vale? ¡No las molestes!
The Scarred Springs#066.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#067.src: See? The foxes...! I haven't seen them around here since I was a kid! I- well, if you're a tourist you wouldn't know, I suppose, but this is exciting!
The Scarred Springs#067.dst: ¿Ves? ¡Los zorros...! ¡No los veía por aquí desde que era crío! Yo- bueno, si eres turista no lo sabrás, pero ¡esto es emocionante!
The Scarred Springs#067.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#068.src: There's a really common tale about foxes here- That they're the reincarnation of our ancestors, that their spirits inhabit them. I know it's...well, it's supposed to be just a tall tale, but...
The Scarred Springs#068.dst: Aquí se cuenta mucho que los zorros son la reencarnación de nuestros antepasados, que sus espíritus viven en ellos. Ya sé que... bueno, que solo es una leyenda, pero...
The Scarred Springs#068.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#069.src: I really can't help but feel like seeing them here is a good omen! It's like my grandparents are back again- Er, wait! The tea! I completely forgot, did you get the order placed?
The Scarred Springs#069.dst: ¡No puedo evitar sentir que verlos aquí es buena señal! Es como si mis abuelos hubieran vuelto- ¡Eh, espera! ¡El té! Se me había olvidado, ¿hiciste el pedido?
The Scarred Springs#069.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#070.src: Oh, Marseled said she'd bring it by herself? Alright, fantastic! And she said she'd invite folks to the opening too... Funny she did, since that's what I was just about to ask you to do!
The Scarred Springs#070.dst: ¿Marseled dijo que lo traería ella misma? ¡Vale, genial! Y también dijo que invitaría a gente a la apertura... Qué curioso, ¡justo iba a pedirte eso a ti!
The Scarred Springs#070.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#071.src: Pishlas is almost back to the way I remember it being when I was younger. I've still got a bit of decorating to do, so I want you to spread the word!
The Scarred Springs#071.dst: Pishlas está casi como lo recuerdo de pequeño. Aún me falta algo de decoración, así que ¡quiero que corras la voz!
The Scarred Springs#071.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#072.src: I've got some notes here on where you could find folks I know in {p}. You tell them, put some notices up...
The Scarred Springs#072.dst: Tengo aquí unas notas con dónde encontrar a conocidos míos en {p}. Tú se lo cuentas y pones algún cartel...
The Scarred Springs#072.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#073.src: ...and then after the big celebration re-opening, they'll tell their families, and then word will spread from there! Is it odd to say I'm looking forward to the work of maintaining the place?
The Scarred Springs#073.dst: ...y luego, tras la gran fiesta de reapertura, se lo contarán a sus familias, ¡y de ahí correrá la voz! ¿Es raro decir que me hace ilusión el trabajo de mantener esto?
The Scarred Springs#073.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#074.src: Anyways, head off and start getting the word out! If you don't know where to look, just ! If you lose my notes you can come back and I'll copy them down again for you.
The Scarred Springs#074.dst: En fin, ¡sal ahí fuera y empieza a correr la voz! Si no sabes dónde buscar, ¡echa un vistazo! Si pierdes mis notas, vuelve y te las copio otra vez.
The Scarred Springs#074.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#075.src: Invite citizens of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to join the opening celebrations.
The Scarred Springs#075.dst: Invita a los ciudadanos de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] a la fiesta de apertura.

The Scarred Springs#076.src: Whew, okay... Whew. Gotta remember, I'm not the Sovereign. Can't be everywhere at once. Need to slow down...it's nearly done, no need to stress out- Oh, hey!
The Scarred Springs#076.dst: Uf, vale... Uf. Recuerda, no soy el Soberano. No puedo estar en todas partes. Calma... ya casi está, no hay por qué agobiarse- ¡Ah, hola!
The Scarred Springs#076.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#077.src: Have you spread the word yet? to see where the people usually are, and get the news out! You're invited to the grand re-opening too, of course.
The Scarred Springs#077.dst: ¿Ya has corrido la voz? Mira dónde suele estar la gente y ¡lleva la noticia! Tú también estás invitado a la gran reapertura, claro.
The Scarred Springs#077.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#078.src: Whew, okay... Whew. Gotta remember, I'm not the Sovereign. Can't be everywhere at once. Need to slow down...it's nearly done, no need to stress out- Oh, hey!
The Scarred Springs#078.dst: Uf, vale... Uf. Recuerda, no soy el Soberano. No puedo estar en todas partes. Calma... ya casi está, no hay por qué agobiarse- ¡Ah, hola!
The Scarred Springs#078.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#079.src: Oh, you lost my notes. Don't worry, it happens. Do you think you can find the spots on your own, or do you want me to write a new copy down for you?
The Scarred Springs#079.dst: Ah, has perdido mis notas. Tranquilo, pasa. ¿Crees que encontrarás los sitios tú solo o quieres que te escriba otra copia?
The Scarred Springs#079.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#080.src: Okay, one sec...and...here! Remember to for where to go!
The Scarred Springs#080.dst: Vale, un segundo... y... ¡toma! ¡No olvides mirar adónde ir!
The Scarred Springs#080.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#081.src: All the spots I listed are {u}, but if you're having trouble, I'll write you up a new set if you ask!
The Scarred Springs#081.dst: Todos los sitios que anoté son {u}, pero si te cuesta, ¡pídemelo y te escribo otra lista!
The Scarred Springs#081.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#082.src: Oh, hello there. I certainly haven't seen you around here before.
The Scarred Springs#082.dst: Vaya, hola. Desde luego no le había visto por aquí.
The Scarred Springs#082.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#083.src: Is there something you wanted to speak with me about?
The Scarred Springs#083.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#085.src: Oh, OH! Pishlas? The hot springs? Sorry, it's been so long that I nearly forgot the name.
The Scarred Springs#085.dst: ¡Ah, AH! ¿Pishlas? ¿Las termas? Perdone, hacía tanto que casi olvido el nombre.
The Scarred Springs#085.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#086.src: I have such vague memories of going there as a child, but I couldn't imagine them after seeing how the place was abandoned.
The Scarred Springs#086.dst: Tengo recuerdos vagos de ir allí de niño, pero tras ver el lugar abandonado ya no conseguía imaginarlos.
The Scarred Springs#086.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#087.src: Maripe did tell me some time ago he would be working on renovating it. I'm to suppose his work has paid off, then! I'd intended to visit him again soon, but this provides a nice excuse, as well.
The Scarred Springs#087.dst: Maripe me dijo hace tiempo que iba a reformarlo. ¡Supongo, pues, que su esfuerzo ha dado fruto! Pensaba visitarlo pronto, y esto me da una buena excusa.
The Scarred Springs#087.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#088.src: ...I might have to spread the word to his family for him. Even if Maripe's father is too busy looking after his wife, I'm sure he'll be delighted to hear about this.
The Scarred Springs#088.dst: ...quizá deba dar yo la noticia a su familia. Aunque el padre de Maripe esté ocupado cuidando de su mujer, seguro que le encantará saberlo.
The Scarred Springs#088.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#089.src: Well, I hope to see you there, stranger!
The Scarred Springs#089.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#090.src: Well, this is a sight, for sure! What can we do for you, fella?
The Scarred Springs#090.dst: ¡Vaya estampa, desde luego! ¿Qué se te ofrece, muchacho?
The Scarred Springs#090.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#092.src: It's been ages, right...? That place, it's been in a state of disrepair for as long as I can recall...
The Scarred Springs#092.dst: Hace siglos, ¿no...? Ese sitio lleva en ruinas desde que tengo memoria...
The Scarred Springs#092.speaker: Nerod

The Scarred Springs#093.src: They're finally going to be open again? And fully renovated? Sounds-
The Scarred Springs#093.dst: ¿Por fin vuelven a abrir? ¿Y reformadas del todo? Suena-
The Scarred Springs#093.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#094.src: Sounds tempting. It's been ages since I've been able to bathe in hot water or relax properly...
The Scarred Springs#094.dst: Suena tentador. Hace siglos que no me doy un baño caliente ni descanso en condiciones...
The Scarred Springs#094.speaker: Feri

The Scarred Springs#095.src: We'll surely all be there! These old bones could use a nice, long soak, I think!
The Scarred Springs#095.dst: ¡Seguro que vamos todos! ¡A estos huesos viejos les vendría bien un buen remojón largo!
The Scarred Springs#095.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#096.src: The tourist returns! Anything else you wanted to talk about?
The Scarred Springs#096.dst: ¡Vuelve el turista! ¿Querías hablar de algo más?
The Scarred Springs#096.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#097.src: Head back to Pishlas to participate in the celebrations at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#097.dst: Vuelve a Pishlas para participar en la fiesta, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#098.src: Okay. Phew. Wow. Okay. Alright, alright, it's...
The Scarred Springs#098.dst: Vale. Uf. Guau. Vale. Bien, bien, esto...
The Scarred Springs#098.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#099.src: It's...it's done. It's all... It's all done, wow, I... There's. There's people... And they're here, and they're enjoying it, and, and...
The Scarred Springs#099.dst: Está... está hecho. Está todo... Está todo hecho, guau, yo... Hay. Hay gente... Y están aquí, y lo están disfrutando, y, y...
The Scarred Springs#099.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#100.src: And I don't have to think about this anymore, and my parents can relax about having let the place go, and...
The Scarred Springs#100.dst: Y ya no tengo que pensar en esto, y mis padres pueden dejar de culparse por haberlo abandonado, y...
The Scarred Springs#100.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#101.src: And, and, and, the, the Sovereign, he'll, Ill get to tell him I'm done, and I'll get that, and... Ohhh my stars I'm done but I'm even more anxious now that it's done than I was before, aaah-
The Scarred Springs#101.dst: Y, y, y, el, el Soberano, él, podré decirle que he terminado, y me darán eso, y... Ay, madre, he terminado pero ahora estoy más nervioso que antes, aaah-
The Scarred Springs#101.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#102.src: Okay, come on, keep your head on straight, Maripe! Now's the time to relax a bit... Deep breaths now- Oh, hey!
The Scarred Springs#102.dst: Vale, venga, ¡mantén la cabeza fría, Maripe! Ahora toca relajarse un poco... Respira hondo- ¡Ah, hola!
The Scarred Springs#102.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#103.src: Uh, I...I need a minute, eheh. How about...you, uh, talk to everyone else, first, and just...yeah?
The Scarred Springs#103.dst: Eh, yo... necesito un minuto, ejej. ¿Y si... tú, eh, hablas antes con los demás y ya... sí?
The Scarred Springs#103.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#104.src: I'd say I barely recognize the place after all the renovations...but honestly, it feels like I'm right at home, like I'm that little fox kit I used to be.
The Scarred Springs#104.dst: Diría que casi no reconozco el sitio tras las reformas... pero, sinceramente, me siento como en casa, como aquel zorrito que fui.
The Scarred Springs#104.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#105.src: Maripe tried to talk you up like you did all the work! I practically had to pry a confession out of him that you just came in at the end to help with the finishing touches.
The Scarred Springs#105.dst: ¡Maripe intentó presentarle como si hubiera hecho todo el trabajo! Casi tuve que arrancarle la confesión de que llegó al final, para los últimos retoques.
The Scarred Springs#105.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#106.src: He's always been a humble sort, but I think that just shows his gratitude. And believe me, I'm grateful to you as well! I think you gave him the kick he needed.
The Scarred Springs#106.dst: Siempre ha sido humilde, pero creo que así muestra su gratitud. Y créame, ¡yo también se lo agradezco! Le dio el empujón que necesitaba.
The Scarred Springs#106.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#107.src: Ohhhohoho that's the spot. Man...I never knew what I was missing. Sort of an old style name, Pishlas, but...
The Scarred Springs#107.dst: Ooohohoho, justo ahí. Tío... no sabía lo que me perdía. Pishlas es un nombre algo antiguo, pero...
The Scarred Springs#107.speaker: Denis

The Scarred Springs#108.src: Phew, I'm definitely going to be coming back here again. A long day of Liff hunting, then a long night's soak... Oh, that sounds like a satisfying routine...
The Scarred Springs#108.dst: Uf, voy a volver aquí seguro. Un día largo cazando Liff y luego una noche larga en remojo... Ay, qué rutina más satisfactoria...
The Scarred Springs#108.speaker: Denis

The Scarred Springs#109.src: Maripe, hm. That boy has done good. Certainly couldn't have done better myself, at my age. He's got an eye for carpentry, for decoration, for the respect of his ancestors...
The Scarred Springs#109.dst: Maripe, hum. Ese chico lo ha hecho bien. A mi edad yo no lo habría hecho mejor, desde luego. Tiene ojo para la carpintería, la decoración y el respeto a sus antepasados...
The Scarred Springs#109.speaker: Feri

The Scarred Springs#110.src: And heck, he's even got free towels provided! I'll be a regular from now on, that's for sure! Hope he's prepared for daily business!
The Scarred Springs#110.dst: ¡Y encima pone toallas gratis! A partir de ahora seré clienta fija, ¡eso seguro! ¡Espero que esté listo para el trajín diario!
The Scarred Springs#110.speaker: Feri
