The Strong Survive#466.dst: Bueno, no exactamente. El reclutador Strumon solo acepta reclutas. Si quieres que te asciendan a la división de las Alas siendo soldado de Aelumia, tendrías que impresionar a un comandante de las Alas, o al Soberano Majin...
The Strong Survive#466.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#467.src: Darn... That sounds harder than I thought it'd be...
The Strong Survive#467.dst: Vaya... Suena más difícil de lo que pensaba...
The Strong Survive#467.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#468.src: Did you speak to Recruiter Ollisy about your ranking from yesterday's training, what did she say?
The Strong Survive#468.dst: ¿Hablaste con la reclutadora Ollisy sobre tu puesto en el entrenamiento de ayer? ¿Qué te dijo?
The Strong Survive#468.speaker: Madelen

The Strong Survive#469.src: She assured me that it was not that big of a deal, and I have lots of time to improve. I suppose I was being a bit overdramatic...
The Strong Survive#469.dst: Me aseguró que no era para tanto y que tengo mucho tiempo para mejorar. Supongo que estaba siendo algo dramática...
The Strong Survive#469.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#470.src: In the Fruman military's eyes, we already passed the test. We're all going to be soldiers after the training, the ranking just encourages us to constantly improve.
The Strong Survive#470.dst: A ojos del ejército de Fruma ya hemos pasado la prueba. Todas seremos soldados tras el entrenamiento; la clasificación solo nos anima a mejorar constantemente.
The Strong Survive#470.speaker: Madelen

The Strong Survive#471.src: That's true, I will use my poor ranking as a reminder that I have much to improve on. I will make sure that today, my ranking will be higher!
The Strong Survive#471.dst: Es verdad, usaré mi mal puesto como recordatorio de que me queda mucho por mejorar. ¡Hoy me aseguraré de subir en la clasificación!
The Strong Survive#471.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#473.src: I've seen you and Arnol together a lot. I am confused with what you see in him. Is it because of his family name?
The Strong Survive#473.dst: Te he visto mucho con Arnol. No entiendo qué le ves. ¿Es por su apellido?
The Strong Survive#473.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#474.src: If that is the case, I can assure you there are better options. Ones that will not hold you back.
The Strong Survive#474.dst: Si es así, te aseguro que hay opciones mejores. Opciones que no te frenarán.
The Strong Survive#474.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#475.src: So... This is how it feels to eat alone at lunch... I hate it...
The Strong Survive#475.dst: Así que... así se siente comer solo... Lo odio...
The Strong Survive#475.speaker: Dogi

The Strong Survive#476.src: These challenges have been so difficult... I wonder if my performance will end up on my record, I hope not...
The Strong Survive#476.dst: Estos desafíos han sido durísimos... No sé si mi rendimiento acabará en mi expediente, espero que no...
The Strong Survive#476.speaker: Matilda

The Strong Survive#477.src: Ha! What am I worried about, this is only the second day of a month of training! I'm sure I will get better before then.
The Strong Survive#477.dst: ¡Ja! ¿De qué me preocupo? ¡Solo es el segundo día de un mes de entrenamiento! Seguro que para entonces habré mejorado.
The Strong Survive#477.speaker: Matilda

The Strong Survive#478.src: This is my third serving, you really ought to take advantage of this buffet! Oh... I hope I don't get a cramp...
The Strong Survive#478.dst: Esta es mi tercera ración, ¡deberíais aprovechar este bufé! Oh... Espero que no me dé un retortijón...
The Strong Survive#478.speaker: Holger

The Strong Survive#479.src: Hey, wasn't there someone else in your group, what happened to them?
The Strong Survive#479.dst: Oye, ¿no había alguien más en vuestro grupo? ¿Qué le pasó?
The Strong Survive#479.speaker: Kerry

The Strong Survive#480.src: Eh? I'm not sure, they seemed really jumpy, my guess is they couldn't handle the pressure and wanted to go home.
The Strong Survive#480.dst: ¿Eh? No lo sé, parecía muy nervioso; supongo que no aguantó la presión y quiso irse a casa.
The Strong Survive#480.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#481.src: Maybe you should take their example sis. I can tell already that you're struggling to keep up with everyone else!
The Strong Survive#481.dst: Quizá deberías seguir su ejemplo, hermanita. ¡Ya se nota que te cuesta seguir el ritmo de los demás!
The Strong Survive#481.speaker: Robin

The Strong Survive#482.src: It seems like things are starting to look better for me in these challenges! Maybe if I keep this up, I can manage a spot in the top five!
The Strong Survive#482.dst: ¡Parece que las cosas empiezan a irme mejor en estos desafíos! ¡Quizá, si sigo así, consiga un puesto entre los cinco primeros!
The Strong Survive#482.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#483.src: Ah, you're here, {u}, come on, let's go ask Adder about how his duel went yesterday...
The Strong Survive#483.dst: Ah, ya estás aquí, {u}, vamos, preguntemos a Adder cómo le fue ayer en su duelo...
The Strong Survive#483.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#484.src: Hey there, you're Adder right? I saw that you were first on the ranking yesterday, great job!
The Strong Survive#484.dst: Hola, eres Adder, ¿verdad? Vi que ayer quedaste primero en la clasificación, ¡muy bien!
The Strong Survive#484.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#485.src: and I were wondering how the duel went for you yesterday. We erm... Both did poorly on it and wanted to know how you won yours, just tell us what happened during the fight.
The Strong Survive#485.dst: y yo queríamos saber cómo te fue ayer el duelo. A nosotros, ejem... nos salió fatal a los dos y queremos saber cómo ganaste el tuyo; cuéntanos qué pasó en el combate.
The Strong Survive#485.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#486.src: You want to know how my duel went yesterday? Well, when it started I didn't engage immediately, I wanted to gauge the strength of my opponent.
The Strong Survive#486.dst: ¿Queréis saber cómo fue mi duelo de ayer? Pues cuando empezó no ataqué de inmediato: quería medir la fuerza de mi rival.
The Strong Survive#486.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#487.src: Despite leaving myself open for attack many times, my opponent couldn't even land a single hit on me. When I grew tired of that farse, I brutally retaliated...
The Strong Survive#487.dst: Aunque me descubrí muchas veces, mi rival no logró acertarme ni un solo golpe. Cuando me cansé de esa farsa, respondí con brutalidad...
The Strong Survive#487.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#488.src: Even after he was yelling for me to stop, yelling "I yield!" at the top of his lungs, I continued. People like that should not become soldiers.
The Strong Survive#488.dst: Incluso cuando me gritaba que parara, aullando "¡me rindo!" a pleno pulmón, seguí. Gente así no debe ser soldado.
The Strong Survive#488.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#489.src: I stopped after he finally finished yelling, he had to be carried out by two guards. Commander Ferreo was watching the whole time, and did not intervene.
The Strong Survive#489.dst: Paré cuando por fin dejó de gritar; tuvieron que sacarlo dos guardias. El comandante Ferreo lo vio todo y no intervino.
The Strong Survive#489.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#490.src: You wanted to know how the duel went, that is how. He never should have been here in the first place, and I did the Fruman military a favour by making sure he will never come back.
The Strong Survive#490.dst: Queríais saber cómo fue el duelo: así fue. Nunca debió estar aquí y, al asegurarme de que no vuelva, le hice un favor al ejército de Fruma.
The Strong Survive#490.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#491.src: You monster... He wanted to dedicate his life to serving the Queen and the people he loved, and you took that all away from him...
The Strong Survive#491.dst: Monstruo... Él quería dedicar su vida a servir a la Reina y a los suyos, y tú se lo has quitado todo...
The Strong Survive#491.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#492.src: The will to do something means nothing, no matter how strong it is, if you do not have the ability to do it.
The Strong Survive#492.dst: La voluntad de hacer algo no vale nada, por fuerte que sea, si no tienes la capacidad de hacerlo.
The Strong Survive#492.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#493.src: He would have just gotten himself killed, or worse, gotten others killed. What I did was serve Fruma to the best of my ability, I am no monster.
The Strong Survive#493.dst: Solo habría acabado muerto o, peor, habría matado a otros. Yo serví a Fruma lo mejor que supe; no soy ningún monstruo.
The Strong Survive#493.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#494.src: No true soldier would ever intentionally injure an ally... Let's go, this conversation is over.
The Strong Survive#494.dst: Ningún soldado de verdad heriría a un aliado a propósito... Vámonos, esta conversación se acabó.
The Strong Survive#494.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#496.src: Are you the one who told him to ask me about that? Who are you exactly?
The Strong Survive#496.dst: ¿Le dijiste tú que me preguntara eso? ¿Quién eres?
The Strong Survive#496.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#497.src: Come sit next to me, I want to discuss what just happened.
The Strong Survive#497.dst: Ven a sentarte a mi lado, quiero hablar de lo que acaba de pasar.
The Strong Survive#497.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#498.src: I expected the worst yet was still surprised by that... That fiend really did it on purpose, and Commander Ferreo let it happen...
The Strong Survive#498.dst: Me esperaba lo peor y aun así me ha sorprendido... Ese malnacido lo hizo a propósito, y el comandante Ferreo lo permitió...
The Strong Survive#498.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#499.src: I suppose we should talk about how the shield challenge went. That might end up making me angrier, but I should tell you...
The Strong Survive#499.dst: Supongo que deberíamos hablar de cómo fue el desafío del escudo. Puede que eso me enfade más, pero debería contártelo...
The Strong Survive#499.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#500.src: I started the test, confident, ready to make that instructor eat his words, show him that I am not a failure. And I still couldn't block a single arrow.
The Strong Survive#500.dst: Empecé la prueba confiado, listo para hacerle tragar sus palabras a ese instructor y demostrarle que no soy un fracaso. Y aun así no paré ni una flecha.
The Strong Survive#500.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#501.src: He wouldn't even let me retry it, just told me to leave the room. I protested, I said that wasn't fair, but he insisted...
The Strong Survive#501.dst: Ni siquiera me dejó repetirlo, solo me mandó salir de la sala. Protesté, dije que no era justo, pero insistió...
The Strong Survive#501.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#502.src: And what about you, how did the shield challenge go?
The Strong Survive#502.dst: ¿Y tú? ¿Cómo te fue el desafío del escudo?
The Strong Survive#502.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#503.src: That's great to hear, maybe you can show me how you did it sometime-
The Strong Survive#503.dst: Me alegra oírlo, quizá algún día puedas enseñarme cómo lo hiciste-
The Strong Survive#503.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#504.src: I'm sorry to hear about that, we're in this together-
The Strong Survive#504.dst: Siento oír eso, estamos juntos en esto-
The Strong Survive#504.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#505.src: I-I was just wondering... No need to get-
The Strong Survive#505.dst: S-solo lo preguntaba... No hace falta que-
The Strong Survive#505.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#506.src: Ah, you again... I've decided that I won't be going with you, I have done nothing to deserve such punishment, and will not stand to be treated like this.
The Strong Survive#506.dst: Ah, tú otra vez... He decidido que no pienso ir contigo; no he hecho nada que merezca ese castigo y no voy a tolerar que me traten así.
The Strong Survive#506.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#507.src: Don't talk to him like he's one of your servants, Arnol. Your family name means nothing here, if he asks you to go with him, you must go!
The Strong Survive#507.dst: No le hables como si fuera uno de tus criados, Arnol. Tu apellido aquí no vale nada; ¡si te pide que vayas con él, vas!
The Strong Survive#507.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#508.src: This childish tantrum of yours will be noted. Now come with me before you start a scene. You are here to serve us, not the other way around.
The Strong Survive#508.dst: Esta rabieta infantil quedará anotada. Ahora ven conmigo antes de que montes una escena. Estás aquí para servirnos, no al revés.
The Strong Survive#508.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#509.src: Wow, I didn't think Arnol had it in him to talk back to someone like that... Anyway, are you ready for dueling? Follow me.
The Strong Survive#509.dst: Vaya, no creía que Arnol tuviera agallas para responderle así a alguien... En fin, ¿listo para los duelos? Sígueme.
The Strong Survive#509.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#510.src: Poor Arnol, he's going to become a soldier and yet he still can't control his temper tantrums.
The Strong Survive#510.dst: Pobre Arnol, va a ser soldado y aún no controla sus rabietas.
The Strong Survive#510.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#511.src: What's next? Is he going to ask Commander Ferreo if he can change his diaper for him?
The Strong Survive#511.dst: ¿Qué será lo siguiente? ¿Pedirle al comandante Ferreo que le cambie el pañal?
The Strong Survive#511.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#512.src: Head to the challenge room and recieve instructions for the final challenge of the day at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#512.dst: Ve a la sala de desafíos y recibe las instrucciones del último desafío del día en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

The Strong Survive#513.src: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
The Strong Survive#513.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#514.src: If you're done with your lunch then wait for Recruiter Effal to pick you up for the next challenge in the cafeteria.
The Strong Survive#514.dst: Si ya has terminado de comer, espera en el comedor a que el reclutador Effal te lleve al siguiente desafío.
The Strong Survive#514.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#515.src: And if Recruiter Effal already came to pick you and your group up then... you should be with him in the dueling room.
The Strong Survive#515.dst: Y si el reclutador Effal ya ha venido a por tu grupo, entonces... deberías estar con él en la sala de duelos.
The Strong Survive#515.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#516.src: This will be the last of your training for today. Singular melee combat against another recruit.
The Strong Survive#516.dst: Este será el último entrenamiento de hoy. Combate singular cuerpo a cuerpo contra otro recluta.
The Strong Survive#516.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#517.src: The rules are the same as the day prior. Grab a training sword if you have not from the table and enter the large door when you are ready.
The Strong Survive#517.dst: Las reglas son las mismas que ayer. Quien no tenga espada de entrenamiento, que coja una de la mesa, y entrad por la puerta grande cuando estéis listos.
The Strong Survive#517.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#518.src: I will be unable to oversee your challenges today as there is somthing I must attend to. I have asked another instructor to do so, they are waiting in the dueling rooms.
The Strong Survive#518.dst: Hoy no podré supervisar vuestros desafíos, tengo un asunto que atender. He pedido a otro instructor que lo haga; os espera en las salas de duelo.
The Strong Survive#518.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#519.src: Now go start the duels, good luck recruits.
The Strong Survive#519.dst: Id a empezar los duelos, suerte, reclutas.
The Strong Survive#519.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#520.src: Enter the next room and complete the final challenge of the day.
The Strong Survive#520.dst: Entra en la siguiente sala y completa el último desafío del día.

The Strong Survive#521.src: Remember not to take things too seriously here. Being a good soldier is not always about winning.
The Strong Survive#521.dst: Recuerda no tomarte esto demasiado en serio. Ser buen soldado no siempre consiste en ganar.
The Strong Survive#521.speaker: Recruiter Alena

The Strong Survive#522.src: Commander Ferreo wants to speak with you, don't keep him waiting.
The Strong Survive#522.dst: El comandante Ferreo quiere hablar contigo, no le hagas esperar.
The Strong Survive#522.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#523.src: Don't tell him I said this, but my brother, Robin, has the advantage over me in this challenge.
The Strong Survive#523.dst: No le digas que lo he dicho, pero mi hermano Robin me lleva ventaja en este desafío.
The Strong Survive#523.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#524.src: As long as I never go up against him though, he won't realize that, that's why I am letting him go on ahead without me.
The Strong Survive#524.dst: Pero mientras no me enfrente a él, no se dará cuenta; por eso le dejo pasar delante sin mí.
The Strong Survive#524.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#525.src: Maybe if I win against my opponent and he loses, he might be convinced that I am stronger!
The Strong Survive#525.dst: ¡Quizá, si yo gano a mi rival y él pierde, se convenza de que soy más fuerte!
The Strong Survive#525.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#527.src: I don't want you to start the duel yet, your opponent has yet to arrive. Let's wait together for him.
The Strong Survive#527.dst: Todavía no quiero que empieces el duelo, tu rival aún no ha llegado. Esperémoslo juntos.
The Strong Survive#527.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#528.src: There you are, Arnol. I was told that you had an outburst during lunch. You will come to know that such things are unacceptable here.
The Strong Survive#528.dst: Ahí estás, Arnol. Me han dicho que tuviste un arrebato durante la comida. Aprenderás que aquí eso es inaceptable.
The Strong Survive#528.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#529.src: This is who you'll be dueling against Arnol. You two are friends, yes? Well this duel will surely teach both of you a valuable lesson.
The Strong Survive#529.dst: Este es tu rival en el duelo, Arnol. Sois amigos, ¿verdad? Pues este duelo os dará sin duda una valiosa lección a los dos.
The Strong Survive#529.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#530.src: Valuable lesson? What is that supposed to mean Commander? Is this a trick? What is the point of me dueling my friend?
The Strong Survive#530.dst: ¿Una valiosa lección? ¿Qué quiere decir con eso, comandante? ¿Es una trampa? ¿Qué sentido tiene que luche contra mi amigo?
The Strong Survive#530.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#531.src: You should know better than to question the orders of your superior, Arnol. Now both of you, into the dueling room.
The Strong Survive#531.dst: Deberías saber que no se cuestionan las órdenes de un superior, Arnol. Ahora, los dos, a la sala de duelos.
The Strong Survive#531.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#532.dst: Dale una lección a ese crío.
The Strong Survive#532.speaker: Millitary Guard

The Strong Survive#533.src: Step up, and the duel may begin. If either of you hold back, I will make you start the duel again, as many times as is needed.
The Strong Survive#533.dst: Adelante, que empiece el duelo. Si alguno se contiene, os haré repetirlo tantas veces como haga falta.
The Strong Survive#533.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#534.src: You did better than expected Arnol. Yet the result was still what I imagined it would be.
The Strong Survive#534.dst: Lo has hecho mejor de lo que esperaba, Arnol. Aun así, el resultado ha sido el que imaginaba.
The Strong Survive#534.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#535.src: Then what was the point of this duel, if you knew I would lose! Were you trying to humiliate me further? Haven't you done that enough already?!
The Strong Survive#535.dst: Entonces, ¿qué sentido tenía este duelo, si sabía que iba a perder? ¿Quería humillarme aún más? ¿¡No lo ha hecho ya bastante!?
The Strong Survive#535.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#536.src: Your arrogance truly has no bounds. How many punishments will I have to give you until you start to take things here seriously?
The Strong Survive#536.dst: Tu arrogancia no tiene límites. ¿Cuántos castigos tendré que imponerte para que empieces a tomarte esto en serio?
The Strong Survive#536.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#537.src: You're becoming a lost cause, Arnol. Now go, there is something I would like to discuss with in private.
The Strong Survive#537.dst: Te estás volviendo un caso perdido, Arnol. Ahora vete, tengo algo que tratar en privado.
The Strong Survive#537.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#538.src: Your kindness towards him is doing him no favour. Arnol must know what pain is like before he can become stronger, and your friendship is preventing that.
The Strong Survive#538.dst: Tu amabilidad con él no le hace ningún favor. Arnol tiene que conocer el dolor antes de poder hacerse fuerte, y vuestra amistad lo impide.
The Strong Survive#538.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#539.src: For both of your sakes, I insist you sever your bond with him.
The Strong Survive#539.dst: Por el bien de los dos, insisto en que rompas tu vínculo con él.
The Strong Survive#539.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#540.src: Leave the dueling room, then go to the barracks to sleep at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#540.dst: Sal de la sala de duelos y ve al barracón a dormir en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

The Strong Survive#541.src: Do not take my advice for granted.
The Strong Survive#541.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#542.src: Am I the only one who is unimpressed with these challenges? They don't seem that related to being a soldier.
The Strong Survive#542.dst: ¿Solo a mí no me impresionan estos desafíos? Poco tienen que ver con ser soldado.
The Strong Survive#542.speaker: Kerry

The Strong Survive#543.src: Eh, oh well. At least they're kind of fun, I'll give them that. I just wish the other recruits took them less seriously.
The Strong Survive#543.dst: Bah, da igual. Al menos son divertidos, eso lo admito. Ojalá los demás se los tomaran menos en serio.
The Strong Survive#543.speaker: Kerry

The Strong Survive#544.src: Well done, you kept your promise to get a better ranking! I am sure Commander Ferreo and Recruiter Olissy are proud.
The Strong Survive#544.dst: ¡Bien hecho, cumpliste tu promesa de subir puestos! Seguro que Ferreo y la reclutadora Olissy están orgullosos.
The Strong Survive#544.speaker: Madelen

The Strong Survive#545.src: I used my shame from my first ranking as a driver to try harder on today's challenges. I am happy that I did poorly initially, because now I know must be constantly trying to improve!
The Strong Survive#545.dst: Usé la vergüenza de mi primer puesto como impulso para esforzarme más hoy. ¡Me alegro de haber empezado mal, porque ahora sé que hay que mejorar constantemente!
The Strong Survive#545.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#546.src: I will set the same promise now, tomorrow my ranking will be higher than it is now!
The Strong Survive#546.dst: Hago ahora la misma promesa: ¡mañana mi puesto será mejor que el de hoy!
The Strong Survive#546.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#547.src: I've failed... Now I'll never be able to become a Wings soldier...
The Strong Survive#547.dst: He fracasado... Ya nunca podré ser soldado de las Alas...
The Strong Survive#547.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#548.src: Don't you think you're being a bit over dramatic? I think you did great, it's not like you're at the bottom of the ranking.
The Strong Survive#548.dst: ¿No crees que dramatizas un poco? A mí me parece genial tu resultado, no estás al final de la clasificación.
The Strong Survive#548.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#549.src: Easy for you to say... You're already in the Wings group, you didn't have to work for anything, you were just born good! You'll never know what it's like to be a failure!
The Strong Survive#549.dst: Qué fácil es decirlo... ¡Tú ya estás en el grupo de las Alas, no has tenido que ganarte nada, naciste bueno! ¡Nunca sabrás lo que es ser un fracaso!
The Strong Survive#549.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#550.src: I can't believe we're done with the second day already. Enjoy being a recruit while it lasts, it won't get any easier from here.
The Strong Survive#550.dst: No me creo que ya hayamos acabado el segundo día. Disfruta de ser recluta mientras dure, porque de aquí en adelante no será más fácil.
The Strong Survive#550.speaker: Holger

The Strong Survive#551.src: You're on thin ice, Priscilla... You didn't improve at all from yesterday! What will people think if I let a weakling follow me around?
The Strong Survive#551.dst: Estás pisando hielo fino, Priscilla... ¡No has mejorado nada desde ayer! ¿Qué pensará la gente si dejo que me siga una debilucha?
The Strong Survive#551.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#552.src: Please Lynn! Just give me a second chance! I promise I will get into the top {~} tomorrow!
The Strong Survive#552.dst: ¡Por favor, Lynn! ¡Dame una segunda oportunidad! ¡Prometo que mañana entro en el top {~}!
The Strong Survive#552.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#553.src: Make it top {~}! And if you fail... I'll never speak to you again!
The Strong Survive#553.dst: ¡Que sea el top {~}! Y si fallas... ¡no volveré a hablarte!
The Strong Survive#553.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#554.src: Top {~}!? That's... Eh... Fine, I will make it into the top {~} tomorrow, I promise!
The Strong Survive#554.dst: ¿¡Top {~}!? Eso es... Eh... Vale, mañana entraré en el top {~}, ¡lo prometo!
The Strong Survive#554.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#555.src: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
The Strong Survive#555.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#556.src: You're done for the day, there are no challenges left.
The Strong Survive#556.dst: Por hoy has terminado, no quedan desafíos.
The Strong Survive#556.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#557.src: Now go get a well deserved rest. Head to the room straight across as soon as you enter the next room, and from there, enter the room to the left.
The Strong Survive#557.dst: Ahora ve a descansar, te lo has ganado. Nada más entrar en la siguiente sala, cruza a la de enfrente y desde ahí entra en la de la izquierda.
The Strong Survive#557.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#559.src: You're not worth my time. Do me a favour and buzz off.
The Strong Survive#559.dst: No mereces mi tiempo. Hazme un favor y lárgate.
The Strong Survive#559.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#560.src: I am willing to put the incident at lunch today aside. You just need to tell me how you or Arnol discovered what happened in my duel on the first day.
The Strong Survive#560.dst: Estoy dispuesto a dejar de lado lo de hoy en la comida. Solo tienes que decirme cómo descubristeis Arnol o tú lo que pasó en mi duelo del primer día.
The Strong Survive#560.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#561.src: I'm not easily fooled, I don't buy the made up story that you two were looking for advice.
The Strong Survive#561.dst: No me engañan fácilmente; no me creo el cuento de que los dos buscabais consejo.
The Strong Survive#561.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#562.src: You should take this proposition seriously. I am not the type of person you would want as your enemy.
The Strong Survive#562.dst: Deberías tomarte en serio esta propuesta. No soy de los que querrías tener por enemigo.
The Strong Survive#562.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#563.src: It was a fluke, that's the only explanation of how you were able to beat me by one singular point! It means nothing!
The Strong Survive#563.dst: Fue chiripa, ¡es la única explicación de que me ganaras por un solo punto! ¡No significa nada!
The Strong Survive#563.speaker: Robin

The Strong Survive#564.src: Right... Keep telling yourself that, but in the back of your mind you know that I beat you. I'll never make you forget that fact!
The Strong Survive#564.dst: Ya... Sigue diciéndotelo, pero en el fondo sabes que te gané. ¡Nunca dejaré que lo olvides!
The Strong Survive#564.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#565.src: They've been at it for a while now. Which one do you think will beat the other tomorrow?
The Strong Survive#565.dst: Llevan así un buen rato. ¿Cuál de los dos crees que ganará mañana al otro?
The Strong Survive#565.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#566.src: I'm not sure... What do you think will happen if they tie?
The Strong Survive#566.dst: No lo sé... ¿Qué crees que pasará si empatan?
The Strong Survive#566.speaker: Matilda

The Strong Survive#567.src: I hope that doesn't happen, they would probably be up all night arguing about who's better.
The Strong Survive#567.dst: Espero que no ocurra, seguramente se pasarían la noche discutiendo quién es mejor.
The Strong Survive#567.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#568.src: Could this day have gone any worse?
The Strong Survive#568.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#569.src: The honourable Commander Ferreo did nothing as Adder beat a fellow recruit to a pulp...
The Strong Survive#569.dst: El honorable comandante Ferreo no hizo nada mientras Adder molía a palos a un compañero...
The Strong Survive#569.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#570.src: The instructors of the esteemed {p} recruit program seem to have no interest in actually training us...
The Strong Survive#570.dst: Los instructores del famoso programa de reclutas de {p} no parecen tener interés en entrenarnos...
The Strong Survive#570.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#571.src: And I am starting to doubt the idea of bringing honour to my house...
The Strong Survive#571.dst: Y empiezo a dudar de eso de dar honor a mi casa...
The Strong Survive#571.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#572.src: At least I'm not alone though...
The Strong Survive#572.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#573.src: Sneak around to find more information on Commander Ferreo's plans.
The Strong Survive#573.dst: Muévete a escondidas para averiguar más sobre los planes del comandante Ferreo.

The Strong Survive#574.src: You found all of my diary entries, well done.
The Strong Survive#574.dst: Has encontrado todas las entradas de mi diario, bien hecho.
The Strong Survive#574.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#575.src: It's been so long since I've hid them, I was beginning to forget about them ever existing.
The Strong Survive#575.dst: Hace tanto que las escondí que empezaba a olvidar que existían.
The Strong Survive#575.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#576.src: Don't expect a medal or anything, I can answer some questions that you may have about them though.
The Strong Survive#576.dst: No esperes una medalla ni nada, pero puedo responder algunas preguntas que tengas sobre ellas.
The Strong Survive#576.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#577.src: It was Commander Ferreo's final insult. That's the reason I am here, as a guard in {p}.
The Strong Survive#577.dst: Fue el último insulto del comandante Ferreo. Por eso estoy aquí, como guardia en {p}.
The Strong Survive#577.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#578.src: After I graduated from the recruit program, my average rankings were seen as too low to join a field Captain or Commander's service.
The Strong Survive#578.dst: Al terminar el programa de reclutas, mi puesto medio se consideró demasiado bajo para servir a un capitán o comandante de campo.
The Strong Survive#578.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#579.src: So Ferreo himself stepped up and took me in, stationing me here to waste away. I think it's some form of punishment...
The Strong Survive#579.dst: Así que el propio Ferreo me acogió y me destinó aquí a pudrirme. Creo que es una especie de castigo...
The Strong Survive#579.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#580.src: I'm not sure to be quite honest. Maybe I was hoping for a sly recruit like yourself to find them, and not make the same mistakes I did.
The Strong Survive#580.dst: La verdad, no estoy seguro. Quizá esperaba que un recluta astuto como tú las encontrara y no cometiera mis errores.
The Strong Survive#580.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#581.src: It may have just been out of boredom though. I can't remember what thoughts were going through my head back when I hid them, after I became a soldier.
The Strong Survive#581.dst: Aunque puede que solo fuera por aburrimiento. No recuerdo qué se me pasaba por la cabeza cuando las escondí, ya siendo soldado.
The Strong Survive#581.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#582.src: Deep down... Maybe I wanted Commander Ferreo to find those notes. I wonder what he would have though after reading them...
The Strong Survive#582.dst: En el fondo... Quizá quería que el comandante Ferreo encontrara esas notas. Me pregunto qué habría pensado al leerlas...
The Strong Survive#582.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#583.src: I had a feeling you'd ask me that. And surprisingly, yes, I did discover the truth about Commander Ferreo's success. There is no secret. He did it all through a fierce determination to become greater.
The Strong Survive#583.dst: Sabía que me lo preguntarías. Y, sorprendentemente, sí, descubrí la verdad sobre el éxito del comandante Ferreo. No hay ningún secreto. Todo lo logró con una feroz determinación de ser más grande.
The Strong Survive#583.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#584.src: When Commander Ferreo was young, he had nothing, he was a vagabond in {p}. Not living, just, surviving.
The Strong Survive#584.dst: De joven, el comandante Ferreo no tenía nada; era un vagabundo en {p}. No vivía, solo sobrevivía.
The Strong Survive#584.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#585.src: Sometimes the Fruman Military would come to visit, and everyone in the town gathered together to see them. Ferreo saw how everyone loved and praised them for their valiance.
The Strong Survive#585.dst: A veces el ejército de Fruma venía de visita y todo el pueblo se reunía para verlo. Ferreo vio cómo todos los querían y alababan por su valor.
The Strong Survive#585.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#586.src: He desperately wanted to be praised and loved like that too. So he made it his goal to reach that position, overcoming the countless obstacles in his way.
The Strong Survive#586.dst: Él también ansiaba ser alabado y querido así. Se propuso llegar a ese puesto, superando los incontables obstáculos del camino.
The Strong Survive#586.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#587.src: Through sheer strength and expertise, he quickly became a Wings Commander, breaking military records in the process.
The Strong Survive#587.dst: Con pura fuerza y destreza, pronto llegó a comandante de las Alas, batiendo récords militares por el camino.
The Strong Survive#587.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#588.src: There were rumours that he would push further and attempt to become a Sovereign, even though all the positions were full at the time...
The Strong Survive#588.dst: Se rumoreaba que iría más allá e intentaría convertirse en Soberano, aunque entonces todos los puestos estaban ocupados...
The Strong Survive#588.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#589.src: He had finally reached the level of fame and admiration that he had set out for. But I imagine the potential for even greater heights tormented him.
The Strong Survive#589.dst: Por fin había alcanzado la fama y la admiración que buscaba. Pero imagino que la posibilidad de llegar aún más alto lo atormentaba.
The Strong Survive#589.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#590.src: Not many know this, but just before he was given his current position, Commander Ferreo had a meeting with Sovereign Majin and The Queen.
The Strong Survive#590.dst: Pocos lo saben, pero justo antes de recibir su puesto actual, el comandante Ferreo se reunió con el Soberano Majin y la Reina.
The Strong Survive#590.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#591.src: We can only speculate at what the discussed, but quickly after said meeting, Majin appointed Commander Ferreo as head of {p}. My guess is that he was punished for his ambition...
The Strong Survive#591.dst: Solo podemos especular sobre lo que hablaron, pero poco después de esa reunión, Majin nombró al comandante Ferreo jefe de {p}. Supongo que lo castigaron por su ambición...
The Strong Survive#591.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#592.src: Good luck on your training recruit. I recommend you take it more seriously than I did.
The Strong Survive#592.dst: Suerte con el entrenamiento, recluta. Te recomiendo que te lo tomes más en serio que yo.
The Strong Survive#592.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#593.src: Sorry, but I still can't let you enter.
The Strong Survive#593.dst: Lo siento, aún no puedo dejarte pasar.
The Strong Survive#593.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#595.src: I grew suspicious of you when I heard you get up in the middle of the night yesterday to sneak around.
The Strong Survive#595.dst: Empecé a sospechar de ti cuando anoche te oí levantarte a medianoche para merodear a escondidas.
The Strong Survive#595.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#596.src: And somehow you were able to discover the results of my first duel... The only conclusion I can come to is that you have been spying on Commander Ferreo.
The Strong Survive#596.dst: Y de algún modo descubriste el resultado de mi primer duelo... La única conclusión posible es que has estado espiando al comandante Ferreo.
The Strong Survive#596.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#597.src: For this, you deserve to be exiled, executed, or imprisoned.
The Strong Survive#597.dst: Por esto mereces el destierro, la ejecución o la cárcel.
The Strong Survive#597.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#598.src: But... I have been looking to challenge myself, so far the training has been underwhelming. I would like to see what a resistance spy is capable of.
The Strong Survive#598.dst: Pero... buscaba un reto, y hasta ahora el entrenamiento ha sido decepcionante. Quiero ver de qué es capaz un espía de la resistencia.
The Strong Survive#598.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#599.src: If you can best me in a duel, I won't report you to Commander Ferreo. The first person to land {~} hits on the other shall be declared the victor.
The Strong Survive#599.dst: Si me vences en un duelo, no te denunciaré ante el comandante Ferreo. El primero que acierte {~} golpes al otro será el vencedor.
The Strong Survive#599.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#600.src: As a show of good faith, I will let you land the first hit on me.
The Strong Survive#600.dst: Como muestra de buena fe, te dejaré asestarme el primer golpe.
The Strong Survive#600.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#601.src: Telegraphed by a grunt and angry particles, Adder will swipe his estoc at you. Perfect blocking this attack will stun him, allowing you to counterattack.
The Strong Survive#601.dst: Anunciado por un gruñido y partículas de ira, Adder te lanzará un tajo con su estoque. Un bloqueo perfecto lo aturdirá y podrás contraatacar.
The Strong Survive#601.speaker: Swipe

The Strong Survive#602.src: Telegraphed by a grunt without angry particles, Adder will hop to the side.
The Strong Survive#602.dst: Anunciado por un gruñido sin partículas de ira, Adder saltará hacia un lado.
The Strong Survive#602.speaker: Sidestep

The Strong Survive#603.src: Telegraphed by a grunt and angry and blue particles, Adder will lunge forward and charge with his estoc. This attack deals damage twice, once at the start and once at the peak of the lunge. Perfect blocking the last hit will stun him.
The Strong Survive#603.dst: Anunciado por un gruñido y partículas de ira y azules, Adder se lanzará hacia delante y cargará con su estoque. Este ataque hace daño dos veces: al inicio y en el punto álgido de la estocada. Un bloqueo perfecto del último golpe lo aturdirá.
The Strong Survive#603.speaker: Lunge

The Strong Survive#604.src: Telegraphed by angry and green particles, Adder will continuously swipe his estoc in front of him while running towards the {u} for several seconds. Perfect blocking the last hit will stun him.
The Strong Survive#604.dst: Anunciado por partículas de ira y verdes, Adder lanzará tajos sin parar con su estoque mientras corre hacia {u} durante varios segundos. Un bloqueo perfecto del último golpe lo aturdirá.
The Strong Survive#604.speaker: Swipe Chain

The Strong Survive#605.src: Absurd... Even after everything I have been through, I still am not strong enough...
The Strong Survive#605.dst: Absurdo... Incluso después de todo lo que he pasado, sigo sin ser lo bastante fuerte...
The Strong Survive#605.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#607.src: Make your way through the vents.
The Strong Survive#607.dst: Avanza por los conductos de ventilación.

The Strong Survive#608.src: We've found ourselves in a terribly difficult situation, Strumon...
The Strong Survive#608.dst: Nos encontramos en una situación terriblemente difícil, Strumon...
The Strong Survive#608.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#609.src: We have a spy amongst our recruits and know who they are, yet that messenger expects us to not do anything about it until Sovereign Majin gets here!?
The Strong Survive#609.dst: Tenemos un espía entre los reclutas y sabemos quién es, ¡¿y ese mensajero espera que no hagamos nada hasta que llegue el Soberano Majin?!
The Strong Survive#609.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#610.src: I think it is important to be cautious here Commander, if this spy is as powerful as the messenger implied... This could spell the end for all of us...
The Strong Survive#610.dst: Creo que aquí conviene ser prudentes, comandante. Si ese espía es tan poderoso como insinuó el mensajero... podría ser el fin de todos nosotros...
The Strong Survive#610.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#611.src: Yes, you're probably right. Nevertheless, once Sovereign Majin arrives and sees that I let a spy into the recruit program... I fear that all that I have worked for will be lost...
The Strong Survive#611.dst: Sí, seguramente tienes razón. Aun así, cuando llegue el Soberano Majin y vea que dejé entrar a un espía en el programa de reclutas... temo perder todo aquello por lo que he trabajado...
The Strong Survive#611.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#612.src: I will not give up so easily, nor will I do nothing while we wait for Sovereign Majin to arrive...
The Strong Survive#612.dst: No me rendiré tan fácilmente, ni me quedaré de brazos cruzados mientras esperamos al Soberano Majin...
The Strong Survive#612.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#613.src: I want Effal to be exiled to Wynn immediately for treason. He let the spy in, and must be punished for that. Find a guard to replace his position as Recruiter, anyone would be more competent than him.
The Strong Survive#613.dst: Quiero que Effal sea desterrado a Wynn de inmediato por traición. Él dejó entrar al espía y debe pagar por ello. Busca a un guardia que lo sustituya como reclutador; cualquiera será más competente que él.
The Strong Survive#613.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#614.src: Relay this to the other guards and recruiters. Effal should be out of Fruma by tomorrow!
The Strong Survive#614.dst: Transmite esto a los demás guardias y reclutadores. ¡Effal debe estar fuera de Fruma mañana!
The Strong Survive#614.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#615.src: Now, Commander, there is another issue I would like to bring up with you, the reason why I came to your office this late into the night in the first place.
The Strong Survive#615.dst: Ahora, comandante, hay otro asunto que querría tratar con usted, el motivo por el que vine a su despacho a estas horas de la noche.
The Strong Survive#615.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#616.src: Your plan yesterday went along perfectly. I checked in with the doctor and he told me Katze will need to be sent home.
The Strong Survive#616.dst: Su plan de ayer salió a la perfección. Hablé con el médico y me dijo que habrá que enviar a Katze a casa.
The Strong Survive#616.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#617.src: Excellent, tomorrow Adder will duel against Arnol. His family name can no longer make up for his weakness!
The Strong Survive#617.dst: Excelente. Mañana Adder se batirá en duelo con Arnol. ¡Su apellido ya no podrá compensar su debilidad!
The Strong Survive#617.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#618.src: Commander... Is this really the best option? The spy seems to have grown a liking towards Arnol. I fear doing this could trigger a retaliation from them...
The Strong Survive#618.dst: Comandante... ¿De verdad es la mejor opción? El espía parece haberle cogido cariño a Arnol. Temo que esto provoque una represalia...
The Strong Survive#618.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#619.src: Does upsetting a single cursed one really frighten you that much, Strumon? Besides, I expect Sovereign Majin will have arrived by then, your concerns are unfounded.
The Strong Survive#619.dst: ¿De verdad te asusta tanto molestar a un solo maldito, Strumon? Además, espero que el Soberano Majin haya llegado para entonces; tus temores son infundados.
The Strong Survive#619.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#620.src: Commander, Recruiter, there is an urgent matter that requires attending to. Please, follow me!
The Strong Survive#620.dst: Comandante, reclutador, hay un asunto urgente que requiere su atención. ¡Síganme, por favor!
The Strong Survive#620.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#621.src: Unscrew the vent, then head back to the barracks to wake Arnol at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#621.dst: Desatornilla la rejilla y vuelve al barracón para despertar a Arnol en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

The Strong Survive#623.src: What is this about, {u}? Why are you waking me up so early in the morning?
The Strong Survive#623.dst: ¿Qué pasa, {u}? ¿Por qué me despiertas tan temprano?
The Strong Survive#623.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#624.src: What!? I'd stand no chance against Adder! He might even end up killing me if I face him! I guess I should have expected Commander Ferreo would do something like this though...
The Strong Survive#624.dst: ¡¿Qué?! ¡No tengo ninguna posibilidad contra Adder! ¡Hasta podría matarme si me enfrento a él! Aunque supongo que debí imaginar que el comandante Ferreo haría algo así...
The Strong Survive#624.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#625.src: If you're telling me this now, you must have some idea on how to help me with this mess. What is your plan, {u}?
The Strong Survive#625.dst: Si me lo cuentas ahora, será que tienes alguna idea para sacarme de este lío. ¿Cuál es tu plan, {u}?
The Strong Survive#625.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#626.src: Hmmm... Ok, I trust you. Let's go before anyone wakes up.
The Strong Survive#626.dst: Hmmm... Vale, confío en ti. Vámonos antes de que alguien se despierte.
The Strong Survive#626.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#627.src: Hmmm... Ok, I'll go with you.
The Strong Survive#627.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#629.src: Escape through the Tericen entrance at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Strong Survive#629.dst: Escapa por la entrada de Tericen en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Strong Survive#630.src: We're leaving through the main entrance? What if a guard spots us?
The Strong Survive#630.dst: ¿Salimos por la entrada principal? ¿Y si nos ve un guardia?
The Strong Survive#630.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#631.src: Alright, I'll try to stay close.
The Strong Survive#631.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#633.src: Weird... There seems to be no guards on duty...
The Strong Survive#633.dst: Qué raro... Parece que no hay ningún guardia de servicio...
The Strong Survive#633.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#637.src: Where are you off to? I don't remember dismissing either of you.
The Strong Survive#637.dst: ¿Adónde vais? No recuerdo haberos dado permiso para iros.
The Strong Survive#637.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#638.src: I would have thought that by now you'd both know insubordination isn't tolerated here. Neither is treason...
The Strong Survive#638.dst: Creía que a estas alturas ya sabríais que aquí no se tolera la insubordinación. Ni la traición...
The Strong Survive#638.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#639.src: Does Arnol know you're a spy? Imagine what his family would think, if they found out he's conspiring with the resistance.
The Strong Survive#639.dst: ¿Sabe Arnol que eres un espía? Imagina lo que pensaría su familia si supiera que conspira con la resistencia.
The Strong Survive#639.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#641.src: I'll let them deal with him. But you... the responsibility of prosecuting you has been lended to me.
The Strong Survive#641.dst: Dejaré que ellos se ocupen de él. Pero tú... a mí se me ha encomendado juzgarte.
The Strong Survive#641.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#643.src: There is no hope for you or your kind in Fruma!
The Strong Survive#643.dst: ¡No hay esperanza para ti ni para los tuyos en Fruma!
The Strong Survive#643.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#644.src: I've never lost a duel, don't fool yourself into thinking I'd let you change that!
The Strong Survive#644.dst: Nunca he perdido un duelo, ¡no te engañes creyendo que dejaré que eso cambie!
The Strong Survive#644.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#645.src: I won't die here! Not to the likes of you!
The Strong Survive#645.dst: ¡No moriré aquí! ¡Y menos a manos de alguien como tú!
The Strong Survive#645.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#647.src: That's enough Commander, you're clearly outmatched.
The Strong Survive#647.dst: Basta, comandante. Está claro que ha perdido.
The Strong Survive#647.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#648.src: Thank you... For looking out for me after everything, even though you had no reason to...
The Strong Survive#648.dst: Gracias... Por cuidar de mí después de todo, aunque no tenías ningún motivo...
The Strong Survive#648.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#649.src: I've spent my whole life drifting, aimless... But now I know what my purpose is, thanks to you...
The Strong Survive#649.dst: Me he pasado la vida a la deriva, sin rumbo... Pero ahora sé cuál es mi propósito, gracias a ti...
The Strong Survive#649.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#650.src: My purpose is to make sure that tyrants like Commander Ferreo meet their just end. It seems like this may be your goal as well.
The Strong Survive#650.dst: Mi propósito es asegurarme de que los tiranos como el comandante Ferreo tengan el final que merecen. Parece que ese también es tu objetivo.
The Strong Survive#650.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#651.src: I must go out on my own now, I hope that one day we meet again. I promise you I'll be stronger by then!
The Strong Survive#651.dst: Ahora debo seguir solo. Ojalá volvamos a vernos algún día. ¡Te prometo que para entonces seré más fuerte!
The Strong Survive#651.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#652.src: I was raised to believe that the cursed ones were wicked, yet you've been nothing but helpful. Seems like that was just another lie...
The Strong Survive#652.dst: Me educaron para creer que los malditos eran malvados, pero tú no has hecho más que ayudarme. Parece que era otra mentira más...
The Strong Survive#652.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#653.src: Are you a recruit as well? You certainly look strong. I imagine you must have a lot of experience.
The Strong Survive#653.dst: ¿Tú también eres recluta? Desde luego pareces fuerte. Supongo que tendrás mucha experiencia.
The Strong Survive#653.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#654.src: I am a bit newer to this than you, but I may still be able to offer you some insights if you're curious.
The Strong Survive#654.dst: Yo soy algo más nuevo en esto que tú, pero si tienes curiosidad, quizá pueda darte algunos consejos.
The Strong Survive#654.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#655.src: Well... A carriage rode me halfway to {p}, then it broke down and I had to walk the rest of the way. When I finally arrived the King himself was there to greet me and made me a recruit.
The Strong Survive#655.dst: Pues... Un carruaje me llevó hasta medio camino de {p}, luego se averió y tuve que ir andando el resto. Cuando por fin llegué, el mismísimo Rey me recibió y me hizo recluta.
The Strong Survive#655.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#656.src: I can't seem to remember anything before that though... It probably wasn't too important, what's important is my new job as a recruit!
The Strong Survive#656.dst: Aunque no consigo recordar nada de antes de eso... Seguramente no era importante. ¡Lo importante es mi nuevo trabajo de recluta!
The Strong Survive#656.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#657.src: I wonder if the King will give me a promotion soon...
The Strong Survive#657.dst: Me pregunto si el Rey me ascenderá pronto...
The Strong Survive#657.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#658.src: No... I can't say I have ever seen you before... Are you a fan or something?
The Strong Survive#658.dst: No... No recuerdo haberte visto nunca... ¿Eres un admirador o algo así?
The Strong Survive#658.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#659.src: I didn't imagine having fans already but that's great! I'm already on the path of becoming the most famous person in Wynn!
The Strong Survive#659.dst: ¡No imaginaba tener admiradores ya, pero es genial! ¡Ya voy camino de ser la persona más famosa de Wynn!
The Strong Survive#659.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#660.src: Waiting? I'm not waiting for anything! I'm just resting... That's all!
The Strong Survive#660.dst: ¿Esperando? ¡No estoy esperando nada! Solo estoy descansando... ¡Nada más!
The Strong Survive#660.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#661.src: It's tiring doing so much work out there. Plus I need to give the other recruits and guards a chance to prove themselves, I shouldn't hog all of the glory!
The Strong Survive#661.dst: Trabajar tanto ahí fuera cansa. Además, debo dar a los demás reclutas y guardias ocasión de lucirse, ¡no puedo acaparar toda la gloria!
The Strong Survive#661.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#662.src: You don't need to worry about me, I'll be fine out there. Just because you look stronger doesn't mean I'm weak!
The Strong Survive#662.dst: No te preocupes por mí, estaré bien ahí fuera. ¡Que parezcas más fuerte no significa que yo sea débil!
The Strong Survive#662.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#663.src: You're the one who should be worried... Worried about me surpassing you of course!
The Strong Survive#663.dst: Eres tú quien debería preocuparse... ¡Preocuparse de que te supere, claro!
The Strong Survive#663.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#664.src: But hey, we're on the same side, so let's both keep fighting out there! For the King!
The Strong Survive#664.dst: Pero bueno, estamos en el mismo bando, ¡así que sigamos luchando ahí fuera! ¡Por el Rey!
The Strong Survive#664.speaker: Effal

The Thanos Depository#000.src: Thank you again...soldier. For helping us make peace...
The Thanos Depository#000.dst: Gracias otra vez...soldado. Por ayudarnos a lograr la paz...

The Thanos Depository#002.src: Please take a track controller before entering the rail line.
The Thanos Depository#002.dst: Coge un control de vías antes de entrar en la vía férrea.

The Thanos Depository#004.src: This is just a disaster... I pray nothing goes awry with the recovery team.
The Thanos Depository#004.dst: Esto es un desastre... Ruego que al equipo de rescate no le pase nada.
The Thanos Depository#004.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#005.src: I'd never be able to live it off if I'm responsible for more deaths.
The Thanos Depository#005.dst: No me lo perdonaría nunca si muere más gente por mi culpa.
The Thanos Depository#005.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#006.src: But I must do what it takes to prevent {p} from any more disaster.
The Thanos Depository#006.dst: Pero haré lo que haga falta para evitar más desastres en {p}.
The Thanos Depository#006.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#008.src: Atila, you're back! Give it to me straight, did they succeed? We can't afford any more losses.
The Thanos Depository#008.dst: ¡Atila, has vuelto! Dímelo claro, ¿lo consiguieron? No podemos permitirnos más pérdidas.
The Thanos Depository#008.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#009.dst: No, señor... Me temo que no.
The Thanos Depository#009.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#010.src: The elevator leads right in to where the dragon lays. Without knowing when it's asleep, it's a gamble.
The Thanos Depository#010.dst: El ascensor lleva justo adonde yace la dragona. Sin saber cuándo duerme, es una apuesta.
The Thanos Depository#010.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#011.src: The elevator leads right in to where the dragon lays. Without knowing when it's asleep, it's a gamble...
The Thanos Depository#011.dst: El ascensor lleva justo adonde yace la dragona. Sin saber cuándo duerme, es una apuesta...
The Thanos Depository#011.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#012.src: It's a great feat what you've accomplished. The dwarven defense system was thought to be impeccable. We'll need to rethink our security!
The Thanos Depository#012.dst: Es una gran hazaña lo que has logrado. La defensa de los enanos se creía impecable. ¡Tendremos que replantearnos nuestra seguridad!

The Thanos Depository#013.src: So we truly do need to go through the vault. But with the defense systems gone haywire...
The Thanos Depository#013.dst: Así que de verdad hay que pasar por la cámara. Pero con los sistemas de defensa enloquecidos...
The Thanos Depository#013.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#015.src: Think nothing of it, let's get back to the drawing board.
The Thanos Depository#015.dst: No le des importancia, volvamos a empezar de cero.
The Thanos Depository#015.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#016.src: Yes, I'll get to it immediately.
The Thanos Depository#016.dst: Sí, me pongo a ello enseguida.
The Thanos Depository#016.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#017.src: You there, human! What's your business here? Come speak to me.
The Thanos Depository#017.dst: ¡Eh, tú, humano! ¿Qué haces aquí? Ven a hablar conmigo.
The Thanos Depository#017.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#018.src: What's your business here? This place is off limits, the vault is very dangerous right now.
The Thanos Depository#018.dst: ¿Qué haces aquí? Está prohibido el paso, la cámara es muy peligrosa ahora mismo.
The Thanos Depository#018.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#019.src: Now that I look, say, that gear of yours is pretty high-quality, yeah? What's your name?
The Thanos Depository#019.dst: Ahora que te miro, oye, ese equipo tuyo es de buena calidad, ¿eh? ¿Cómo te llamas?
The Thanos Depository#019.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#020.src: Now that I look, say, that gear of yours is pretty high quality, yeah? What's your name?
The Thanos Depository#020.dst: Ahora que te miro, oye, ese equipo tuyo es de buena calidad, ¿eh? ¿Cómo te llamas?
The Thanos Depository#020.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#021.src: ... where have I heard that name before... Oh, I remember! You're that guy who defeated that Qira woman, yeah?
The Thanos Depository#021.dst: ...¿de qué me suena ese nombre?... ¡Ah, ya recuerdo! Eres el que venció a esa mujer, Qira, ¿verdad?
The Thanos Depository#021.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#022.src: ... where have I heard that name before... Oh, I remember! You're the one who helped resolve the whole Dogun thing, right?
The Thanos Depository#022.dst: ...¿de qué me suena ese nombre?... ¡Ah, ya recuerdo! Eres quien ayudó a resolver todo el asunto de Dogun, ¿verdad?
The Thanos Depository#022.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#023.src: I see, I haven't seen you around before.
The Thanos Depository#023.dst: Ya veo, no te había visto por aquí.
The Thanos Depository#023.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#024.src: Nevertheless, {p} is in danger. To put it simply, a dragon is living uninvited in our depository.
The Thanos Depository#024.dst: Aun así, {p} está en peligro. En pocas palabras: una dragona vive sin permiso en nuestro depósito.
The Thanos Depository#024.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#025.src: Perhaps, you've seen its lair above our city. Normally she leaves us unharmed, but one day she suddenly made her way in to this vault.
The Thanos Depository#025.dst: Quizá hayas visto su guarida sobre la ciudad. Normalmente no nos hace daño, pero un día entró de golpe en esta cámara.
The Thanos Depository#025.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#026.src: My great friend Atila has been leading a recon squad, he's discerned that she's nesting an egg.
The Thanos Depository#026.dst: Mi buen amigo Atila dirige una patrulla de reconocimiento; ha deducido que está incubando un huevo.
The Thanos Depository#026.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#027.src: We've tried at our greatest expenses to steal the egg, and bring it back to her nest, so that maybe she would leave... But, as you've heard, it's not going well.
The Thanos Depository#027.dst: Hemos hecho enormes esfuerzos por robar el huevo y devolverlo a su nido, por si así se marchaba... Pero, como has oído, no va nada bien.
The Thanos Depository#027.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#028.src: I don't normally ask this of strangers, but we've run ourselves thin. Do you think you're up to help? I'll make sure it's all worth your trouble.
The Thanos Depository#028.dst: No suelo pedir esto a desconocidos, pero estamos al límite. ¿Te ves capaz de ayudarnos? Haré que te merezca la pena.
The Thanos Depository#028.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#029.src: So you'll help!? Thank you so much! I'll make sure it's worth every moment!
The Thanos Depository#029.dst: ¿¡Vas a ayudarnos!? ¡Muchísimas gracias! ¡Haré que valga cada segundo!
The Thanos Depository#029.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#030.src: You'll have to go through this chamber behind me to reach the depository. Our only other way in is right where the dragon is...
The Thanos Depository#030.dst: Tendrás que cruzar esta sala que hay detrás de mí para llegar al depósito. La otra entrada está justo donde está la dragona...
The Thanos Depository#030.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#031.src: You have to go through this chamber behind me to reach the depository. Our only other way in is right where the dragon is...
The Thanos Depository#031.dst: Tienes que cruzar esta sala que hay detrás de mí para llegar al depósito. La otra entrada está justo donde está la dragona...
The Thanos Depository#031.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#032.src: The people of {p} have everlasting gratitude, soldier.
The Thanos Depository#032.dst: La gente de {p} te estará eternamente agradecida, soldado.

The Thanos Depository#034.src: Atila knows some of the inner workings of the vault. I bid you good luck and will be praying for your success. Your courage will inspire {p}.
The Thanos Depository#034.dst: Atila conoce parte del funcionamiento interno de la cámara. Te deseo suerte y rezaré por tu éxito. Tu valor inspirará a {p}.
The Thanos Depository#034.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#035.src: Oh, so it wasn't meant to be I suppose...
The Thanos Depository#035.dst: Vaya, supongo que no tenía que ser...
The Thanos Depository#035.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#036.src: Well, if we cross paths again, I'll always much appreciate your help... Back to the drawing board...
The Thanos Depository#036.dst: Bueno, si volvemos a coincidir, siempre agradeceré tu ayuda... A empezar de cero otra vez...
The Thanos Depository#036.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#039.src: Find a way through the depository.
The Thanos Depository#039.dst: Encuentra un camino a través del depósito.

The Thanos Depository#040.src: Ride the minecarts to get further in to the depository
The Thanos Depository#040.dst: Monta en las vagonetas para adentrarte en el depósito

The Thanos Depository#041.src: Steal Ozoth's egg and escape the depository.
The Thanos Depository#041.dst: Roba el huevo de Ozoth y escapa del depósito.

The Thanos Depository#043.src: Oh-oh my gosh!! I took you for dead, and thought the dragon was sending me up a corpse!
The Thanos Depository#043.dst: ¡M-madre mía! ¡Te daba por muerto y creía que la dragona me enviaba un cadáver!
The Thanos Depository#043.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#044.src: You really got it!? Hurry, then, the nest is up through this cave! Maybe {p} can finally be rid of its woes...
The Thanos Depository#044.dst: ¿¡De verdad lo tienes!? ¡Rápido, el nido está subiendo por esta cueva! Quizá {p} por fin se libre de sus penas...
The Thanos Depository#044.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#045.src: Place Ozoth's egg back in her nest at [{~},-{~}].
The Thanos Depository#045.dst: Devuelve el huevo de Ozoth a su nido en [{~},-{~}].

The Thanos Depository#047.src: She's a beauty, isn't she? A monster though, nevertheless.
The Thanos Depository#047.dst: Es preciosa, ¿verdad? Aunque no deja de ser un monstruo.
The Thanos Depository#047.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#048.src: {u}! Over here... Atila told me the news, I came as fast as I could!
The Thanos Depository#048.dst: ¡{u}! Por aquí... Atila me contó la noticia, ¡vine lo más rápido que pude!
The Thanos Depository#048.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#049.src: You're a hero, lad! With the dragon out of our city, {p} no longer has to live in fear.
The Thanos Depository#049.dst: ¡Eres un héroe, muchacho! Sin la dragona en la ciudad, {p} ya no tiene que vivir con miedo.
The Thanos Depository#049.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#050.src: I've prepared your reward. The people of {p} will remember your contribution for years to come.
The Thanos Depository#050.dst: He preparado tu recompensa. La gente de {p} recordará tu contribución durante muchos años.
The Thanos Depository#050.speaker: Coulmis

The Ultimate Weapon#001.src: I'm glad you came along, I could do with a little help if you're not too busy.
The Ultimate Weapon#001.dst: Me alegra que vengas; me vendría bien algo de ayuda si no estás ocupado.
The Ultimate Weapon#001.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#002.src: I'm Dodegar Bandysnoot, the world famous Hobbit swordsmith! Perhaps you've heard of me?
The Ultimate Weapon#002.dst: ¡Soy Dodegar Bandysnoot, el espadero hobbit más famoso del mundo! ¿Habías oído hablar de mí?
The Ultimate Weapon#002.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#003.src: No? Oh... Well, I've had an idea about how I could make the best weapon that the world has ever seen!
The Ultimate Weapon#003.dst: ¿No? Ah... Bueno, ¡se me ha ocurrido cómo crear la mejor arma que el mundo haya visto jamás!
The Ultimate Weapon#003.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#004.src: But, I need some help getting the special resources to make it.
The Ultimate Weapon#004.dst: Pero necesito ayuda para conseguir los materiales especiales.
The Ultimate Weapon#004.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#005.src: You'll help?! Excellent! We shall gather enough resources to make one for each of us!
The Ultimate Weapon#005.dst: ¿¡Me ayudas!? ¡Excelente! ¡Reuniremos materiales suficientes para hacer una para cada uno!
The Ultimate Weapon#005.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#006.src: So firstly, I need some living wood for the handle, [{~} Enchanted Stick] should be enough.
The Ultimate Weapon#006.dst: Primero necesito madera viva para la empuñadura; con [{~} Enchanted Stick] bastaría.
The Ultimate Weapon#006.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#007.src: The wood sprites located across the river to the west, in a big tree trunk, have magical properties! The handle can then mold to the user's hand! One shouldn't be too hard to come across!
The Ultimate Weapon#007.dst: ¡Los duendes de madera del otro lado del río, al oeste, en un gran tronco, tienen propiedades mágicas! ¡Así la empuñadura se amoldará a la mano del que la use! ¡No costará encontrar uno!
The Ultimate Weapon#007.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#008.src: I hope you are prepared, this will be your best quest yet!
The Ultimate Weapon#008.dst: ¡Espero que estés preparado, será la mejor misión que hayas hecho!
The Ultimate Weapon#008.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#009.src: Collect [{~} Enchanted Stick] from Wood Sprites at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and return them to Dodegar
The Ultimate Weapon#009.dst: Consigue [{~} Enchanted Stick] de los duendes de madera en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y llévaselos a Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#010.src: Wow! You got the wood I needed, thanks!
The Ultimate Weapon#010.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#011.src: While I'm making the handle, could you help me with the blade?
The Ultimate Weapon#011.dst: Mientras hago la empuñadura, ¿me echas una mano con la hoja?
The Ultimate Weapon#011.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#012.src: Since we want this weapon to be as good as possible we need to find some sacred Hobbit metal!
The Ultimate Weapon#012.dst: ¡Ya que queremos que esta arma sea lo mejor posible, necesitamos metal sagrado hobbit!
The Ultimate Weapon#012.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#013.src: The hobbit village, The Shiar, is really close! Follow the southern road. My brother Gogedar should be there!
The Ultimate Weapon#013.dst: ¡La aldea hobbit, el Shiar, está muy cerca! Sigue el camino del sur. ¡Mi hermano Gogedar debería estar allí!
The Ultimate Weapon#013.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#014.src: Dodegar needs [{~} Sacred Hobbit Metal] from the Shiar at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Ultimate Weapon#014.dst: Dodegar necesita [{~} Sacred Hobbit Metal] del Shiar en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Ultimate Weapon#015.src: My brother you say... Trying to create a weapon...
The Ultimate Weapon#015.dst: Mi hermano, dices... Que quiere forjar un arma...
The Ultimate Weapon#015.speaker: Gogedar

The Ultimate Weapon#017.src: Oh he needs Sacred Hobbit Metal!?
The Ultimate Weapon#017.speaker: Gogedar

The Ultimate Weapon#019.src: Sorry can't help you. I don't really know what that is.
The Ultimate Weapon#019.dst: Lo siento, no puedo ayudarte. No sé muy bien qué es eso.
The Ultimate Weapon#019.speaker: Gogedar

The Ultimate Weapon#020.dst: ¿Y si preguntas a nuestro primo Togedar?
The Ultimate Weapon#020.speaker: Gogedar

The Ultimate Weapon#021.dst: Encuentra a Togedar en el Shiar.

The Ultimate Weapon#022.src: Dodegar? Does not really ring a bell I'm afraid.
The Ultimate Weapon#022.dst: ¿Dodegar? Me temo que no me suena de nada.
The Ultimate Weapon#022.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#023.src: Oh! Gogedar's brother, why didn't you tell me that.
The Ultimate Weapon#023.dst: ¡Ah! El hermano de Gogedar, ¿por qué no lo dijiste antes?
The Ultimate Weapon#023.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#024.src: Sacred Hobbit Metal... This is a metal forged by master blacksmith hobbits within our village. It is a bit expensive to get by but holds great potential, if used properly.
The Ultimate Weapon#024.dst: Metal sagrado hobbit... Es un metal forjado por los maestros herreros hobbits de nuestra aldea. Sale algo caro conseguirlo, pero tiene un gran potencial si se usa bien.
The Ultimate Weapon#024.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#026.src: I don't have any. Maybe ask my nephew's brother Alegdar?
The Ultimate Weapon#026.dst: No tengo ninguno. ¿Y si preguntas al hermano de mi sobrino, Alegdar?
The Ultimate Weapon#026.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#027.dst: Encuentra a Alegdar en el Shiar.

The Ultimate Weapon#029.src: I actually don't know much about... anything.
The Ultimate Weapon#029.dst: La verdad es que no sé mucho de... nada.
The Ultimate Weapon#029.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#030.src: I kind of just... stand around here.
The Ultimate Weapon#030.dst: Yo solo... estoy aquí de pie.
The Ultimate Weapon#030.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#031.src: Everyone I have ever met just calls me annoying and useless. So I decided to stop trying.
The Ultimate Weapon#031.dst: Todos los que he conocido me llaman pesado e inútil. Así que dejé de intentarlo.
The Ultimate Weapon#031.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#032.src: You know, life is hard. We all just have to fight through, and then eventually, we might become happy.
The Ultimate Weapon#032.dst: ¿Sabes? La vida es dura. Solo hay que resistir y, con el tiempo, quizá seamos felices.
The Ultimate Weapon#032.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#033.src: Right sorry... Ask Balegar for any information. He is way smarter.
The Ultimate Weapon#033.dst: Ah, perdona... Pregúntale a Balegar. Él es mucho más listo.
The Ultimate Weapon#033.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#034.dst: Encuentra a Balegar en el Shiar.

The Ultimate Weapon#035.src: My cousin's nephew's dad has had a rough year... I feel bad for him.
The Ultimate Weapon#035.dst: El padre del sobrino de mi primo ha tenido un año duro... Me da pena.
The Ultimate Weapon#035.speaker: Balegar

The Ultimate Weapon#037.src: I have nooooo clue about that metal. I heard it was just a valuable as a normal rock.
The Ultimate Weapon#037.dst: No tengo niiiinguna idea sobre ese metal. He oído que vale lo mismo que una piedra normal.
The Ultimate Weapon#037.speaker: Balegar

The Ultimate Weapon#038.src: Maybe my cousin Reyoretrsed knows anything about it.
The Ultimate Weapon#038.dst: Quizá mi primo Reyoretrsed sepa algo del tema.
The Ultimate Weapon#038.speaker: Balegar

The Ultimate Weapon#039.dst: Encuentra a Reyoretrsed en el Shiar.

The Ultimate Weapon#041.src: You are wondering how my name is pronounced? What a rude question.
The Ultimate Weapon#041.dst: ¿Te preguntas cómo se pronuncia mi nombre? Qué pregunta tan grosera.
The Ultimate Weapon#041.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#042.src: Ray-ore-tree-sed, obviously. What is a human doing here?
The Ultimate Weapon#042.dst: Rei-or-tri-sed, obviamente. ¿Qué hace un humano aquí?
The Ultimate Weapon#042.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#043.src: You are wondering if I have Sacred whatever metal?
The Ultimate Weapon#043.dst: ¿Que si tengo metal sagrado no sé qué?
The Ultimate Weapon#043.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#044.src: I'm {~}. Now if you excuse me, I am busy standing still. Go bother Richard or something.
The Ultimate Weapon#044.dst: Tengo {~} años. Y ahora, si me disculpas, estoy ocupado quedándome quieto. Ve a molestar a Richard o algo.
The Ultimate Weapon#044.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#045.dst: Encuentra a Richard en el Shiar.

The Ultimate Weapon#046.src: I've been trying to tell you that I have what you need.
The Ultimate Weapon#046.dst: Llevo un rato intentando decirte que tengo lo que necesitas.
The Ultimate Weapon#046.speaker: Richard

The Ultimate Weapon#047.src: You humans really need to practice your communication skills, please.
The Ultimate Weapon#047.dst: Los humanos deberíais practicar vuestras dotes de comunicación, por favor.
The Ultimate Weapon#047.speaker: Richard

The Ultimate Weapon#048.src: Anyway, here. Take it! This metal is just a scam anyway, nothing special with it.
The Ultimate Weapon#048.dst: En fin, toma. ¡Cógelo! De todas formas este metal es un timo, no tiene nada de especial.
The Ultimate Weapon#048.speaker: Richard

The Ultimate Weapon#049.src: Return to Dodegar with the metal.
The Ultimate Weapon#049.dst: Vuelve con Dodegar con el metal.

The Ultimate Weapon#050.src: I hope it wasn't too much of an issue to get!
The Ultimate Weapon#050.dst: ¡Espero que no te costara demasiado conseguirlo!
The Ultimate Weapon#050.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#051.src: ... I forgot a step. I can't attach a blade without a binder material.
The Ultimate Weapon#051.dst: ... Olvidé un paso. No puedo fijar la hoja sin un aglutinante.
The Ultimate Weapon#051.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#052.src: I need the nectar of a native flower of the forest to attach it. [{~} Diplacus Aurantiacus] would do the trick.
The Ultimate Weapon#052.dst: Necesito el néctar de una flor autóctona del bosque para fijarla. [{~} Diplacus Aurantiacus] serviría.
The Ultimate Weapon#052.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#053.src: Finding the flower can be rather difficult, here's a riddle on how to find it.
The Ultimate Weapon#053.dst: Encontrar la flor puede ser bastante difícil; aquí tienes un acertijo para dar con ella.
The Ultimate Weapon#053.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#054.src: On the side of a hut, hidden inside a hole. Resting in a forest of light, without plight. Whatever that would mean.
The Ultimate Weapon#054.dst: Al lado de una choza, escondida en un agujero. Descansa en un bosque de luz, sin pesar alguno. Sea lo que sea que eso signifique.
The Ultimate Weapon#054.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#055.src: Find the Diplacus Aurantiacus by following the riddle to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Ultimate Weapon#055.dst: Encuentra la Diplacus Aurantiacus siguiendo el acertijo hasta [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Ultimate Weapon#056.src: Hold up! This feels waaay, toooo easy.
The Ultimate Weapon#056.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#057.src: If I'm going to give you this amazingly, incredible, showstopping, crazy item particulary for free, you need to at least work for it!
The Ultimate Weapon#057.dst: ¡Si te voy a dar este objeto asombroso, increíble, espectacular y alucinante prácticamente gratis, al menos tendrás que currártelo!
The Ultimate Weapon#057.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#060.src: This looks so much better! Anyway, bring me that flower now!
The Ultimate Weapon#060.dst: ¡Así se ve mucho mejor! En fin, ¡ahora tráeme esa flor!
The Ultimate Weapon#060.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#061.src: Talk to Dodegar with the Diplacus Aurantiacus.
The Ultimate Weapon#061.dst: Habla con Dodegar llevando la Diplacus Aurantiacus.

The Ultimate Weapon#062.src: Took you a while, did it not?
The Ultimate Weapon#062.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#063.src: It's starting to look pretty amazing! Just like it's supposed to I'm sure!
The Ultimate Weapon#063.dst: ¡Empieza a tener una pinta asombrosa! ¡Seguro que es justo como debe ser!
The Ultimate Weapon#063.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#064.src: Maybe this will actually work out. Either way, last ingredient we need!
The Ultimate Weapon#064.dst: Quizá esto salga bien de verdad. En cualquier caso, ¡el último ingrediente!
The Ultimate Weapon#064.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#065.src: So to finalize and apply some magical properties to this uniquely amazing item we need something known as Luster Blood.
The Ultimate Weapon#065.dst: Para rematar este objeto único y asombroso y darle propiedades mágicas, necesitamos algo llamado sangre lustrosa.
The Ultimate Weapon#065.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#066.src: The only known creature in the west, probably in the whole world, if I'm being frank, is known as the Glow Dust Leaf Beetle of the Underworld, not sure where the name comes from.
The Ultimate Weapon#066.dst: La única criatura conocida del oeste, y probablemente del mundo entero, si te soy sincero, es el Glow Dust Leaf Beetle of the Underworld; no sé de dónde sale ese nombre.
The Ultimate Weapon#066.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#067.src: I happen to know that this beetle lives in a cave in the eastern ravine thingy! If you walk straight east, you should stumble upon it, I promise!
The Ultimate Weapon#067.dst: ¡Resulta que sé que ese escarabajo vive en una cueva del barranco ese del este! Si vas recto hacia el este, darás con ella, ¡te lo prometo!
The Ultimate Weapon#067.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#068.src: Oh! Almost forgot to mention, about {~} Luster Blood is probably enough.
The Ultimate Weapon#068.dst: ¡Ah! Casi olvido decírtelo: con {~} de sangre lustrosa seguramente baste.
