The Ultimate Weapon#068.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#069.src: Find the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring back [{~} Luster Blood] and bring it back to Dodegar.
The Ultimate Weapon#069.dst: Encuentra la cueva en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], consigue [{~} Luster Blood] y llévaselo a Dodegar.

The Ultimate Weapon#070.src: Do not step any closer... Or I will be forced to obliterate you!
The Ultimate Weapon#070.dst: No des un paso más... ¡O me veré obligado a aniquilarte!

The Ultimate Weapon#071.src: The final component! It is finally here!
The Ultimate Weapon#071.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#073.src: Do you see how it's glowing, sparkling and... and radiating!
The Ultimate Weapon#073.dst: ¿Ves cómo brilla, cómo destella y... y cómo irradia?
The Ultimate Weapon#073.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#074.src: You don't? Uhm... maybe you need glasses humie.
The Ultimate Weapon#074.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#075.src: As promised! Here you go! Always happy to practice the art of weapon creation.
The Ultimate Weapon#075.dst: ¡Como prometí! ¡Aquí tienes! Siempre me alegra practicar el arte de crear armas.
The Ultimate Weapon#075.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#000~1.src: The metal is rather rare so I don't know if you can even find it...
The Ultimate Weapon#000~1.dst: El metal es bastante raro, así que no sé si podrás encontrarlo siquiera...

The Worm Holes#000.src: New Questline Started: The Realm of Light
The Worm Holes#000.dst: Nueva línea de misiones iniciada: El Reino de la Luz

The Worm Holes#001.src: Find out what's going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Worm Holes#002.src: Arrighty fellers, let's get this wrapped up now! 'ere's plenty more holes where this one came from!
The Worm Holes#002.dst: ¡Venga, chicos, vamos a rematar esto ya! ¡Que agujeros como este quedan un montón más!
The Worm Holes#002.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#004.src: The scaffolds are crackin'! Everyone, get offa there, now!!
The Worm Holes#004.dst: ¡Los andamios se están rajando! ¡¡Todos fuera de ahí, ya!!
The Worm Holes#004.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#006.src: Aw, hell... I knew this project was a bust from the start...there goes Willam and Clint cause a' this!
The Worm Holes#006.dst: Ay, maldita sea... Sabía que esto estaba perdido desde el principio...¡y por su culpa se nos van Willam y Clint!
The Worm Holes#006.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#007.src: I gotta get someone tough enough to get down there...hm? Hey, a human! Git on over here!
The Worm Holes#007.dst: Necesito a alguien duro que baje ahí...¿eh? ¡Oye, un humano! ¡Ven p'acá!
The Worm Holes#007.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#008.src: I gotta ask, how much 'a that didja see, Wynn feller? Wasn't pretty, and I'm in charge a' them folks, so I gotta take responsibility fer that.
The Worm Holes#008.dst: A ver, ¿cuánto has visto de eso, amigo de Wynn? No fue bonito, y yo mando a esa gente, así que la responsabilidad es mía.
The Worm Holes#008.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#009.src: Th' mayor of {p} there saw these holes poppin' up, and hired us out to cover 'em up. Thing is, the ground's too unstable to build.
The Worm Holes#009.dst: El alcalde de {p} vio salir estos agujeros y nos contrató para taparlos. La cosa es que el suelo es demasiado inestable para construir.
The Worm Holes#009.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#010.src: It's gettin' real worrying round here. They only started openin' up recently, and there've been quakes too. Feels like the place is gonna collapse!
The Worm Holes#010.dst: Esto se está poniendo feo de verdad. Empezaron a abrirse hace poco, y encima ha habido temblores. ¡Parece que esto se va a venir abajo!
The Worm Holes#010.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#011.src: I think we oughta head down there and figure out what 'n heck's goin' on, and you're the best armed outta any of us, being human 'n all.
The Worm Holes#011.dst: Creo que deberíamos bajar ahí y averiguar qué diantres pasa, y tú eres el mejor armado de todos, siendo humano y tal.
The Worm Holes#011.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#012.src: Think y'all could head down 'n see if you can rustle up any leads? There's a path down just to the left of the hole.
The Worm Holes#012.dst: ¿Te ves capaz de bajar a ver si sacas alguna pista? Hay un camino que baja justo a la izquierda del agujero.
The Worm Holes#012.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#013.src: Go down the hole and look for what's causing this and return to Malo at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with proof.
The Worm Holes#013.dst: Baja al agujero, busca la causa de esto y vuelve con Malo a [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] con una prueba.

The Worm Holes#014.src: What in tarnation...? The heck did you find down there, soldier?
The Worm Holes#014.dst: ¿Pero qué demonios...? ¿Qué has encontrado ahí abajo, soldado?
The Worm Holes#014.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#015.src: Oh, it was just the skin, huh? Dang...was hopin' you'd've seen what it was, cause I got no clue 'bout this.
The Worm Holes#015.dst: Ah, ¿solo era la piel, eh? Vaya...esperaba que hubieras visto qué era, porque yo no tengo ni idea.
The Worm Holes#015.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#016.src: Urgh. Only gal I know who might have an idea 'bout this is that durn elf lady...
The Worm Holes#016.dst: Uf. La única tía que igual sabe algo de esto es esa maldita elfa...
The Worm Holes#016.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#017.src: She's got purple hair and's been wanderin' round like she knows everything. Yeah, she's a bright penny but she ain't gotta be so uppity ta all of us 'bout it.
The Worm Holes#017.dst: Tiene el pelo morado y anda por ahí como si lo supiera todo. Sí, es lista, pero no hace falta que sea tan altiva con todos nosotros.
The Worm Holes#017.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#018.src: She put up a camp just east of here. She'll prob'ly react better to you than me, so I'll go to the authorities and see if they have any leads.
The Worm Holes#018.dst: Ha montado un campamento justo al este de aquí. Seguro que contigo reacciona mejor que conmigo, así que yo iré a las autoridades a ver si tienen alguna pista.
The Worm Holes#018.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#019.src: Look for Lari and ask what is going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Worm Holes#019.dst: Busca a Lari y pregunta qué ocurre en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Worm Holes#020.src: ...Haven’t we met? I have witnessed your presence in Gavel more than once.
The Worm Holes#020.dst: ...¿No nos hemos visto ya? He notado tu presencia en Gavel más de una vez.
The Worm Holes#020.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#021.src: I am Lari. I might have greeted you properly before if I were not so busy, which reminds me. You have a reason to be here, yes?
The Worm Holes#021.dst: Soy Lari. Te habría saludado como es debido si no estuviera tan ocupada, lo que me recuerda... Tienes un motivo para estar aquí, ¿verdad?
The Worm Holes#021.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#022.src: Hm...I believe I know what you have found, by your description. That dead skin too, is proof enough, I would say.
The Worm Holes#022.dst: Hm...creo que sé lo que has encontrado, por tu descripción. Esa piel mudada también es prueba suficiente, diría yo.
The Worm Holes#022.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#023.src: The creature which shed that skin is known as a Grootslang. Though large, they are rather peaceful. Gentle giants, I believe the saying is?
The Worm Holes#023.dst: La criatura que mudó esa piel se conoce como Grootslang. Aunque son enormes, resultan bastante pacíficos. Gigantes amables, creo que se dice así, ¿no?
The Worm Holes#023.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#024.src: This horrid Decay...it affects their habitats underground. They are seeking shelter closer to the surface. I have been trying to scrub the Decay without success...
The Worm Holes#024.dst: Esta horrible Decadencia...afecta a sus hábitats bajo tierra. Buscan refugio más cerca de la superficie. He intentado limpiar la Decadencia, pero sin éxito...
The Worm Holes#024.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#025.src: Wait... More holes appeared just today? There...there were deaths?! W-where, when?!
The Worm Holes#025.dst: Espera... ¿Hoy han aparecido más agujeros? Y... ¡¿ha habido muertos?! ¡¿D-dónde, cuándo?!
The Worm Holes#025.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#026.src: No, no...! I refuse to be responsible for any more deaths... Human, tell me your name, please.
The Worm Holes#026.dst: ¡No, no...! Me niego a ser responsable de más muertes... Humano, dime tu nombre, por favor.
The Worm Holes#026.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#027.src: {u}, then... Let us head to the site. {u}. I need to fix this... Please, help me get to the root of this problem so I may soothe the land's pain.
The Worm Holes#027.dst: {u}, entonces... Vayamos al lugar. {u}. Debo arreglarlo... Ayúdame a hallar la raíz del problema y calmar el dolor de esta tierra.
The Worm Holes#027.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#029.src: So this is the site... [Gavellian Spell]...
The Worm Holes#029.dst: Así que este es el lugar... [Gavellian Spell]...
The Worm Holes#029.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#030.src: Here. Allow me to provide at least one person safe passage into the pit.
The Worm Holes#030.dst: Toma. Déjame al menos dar a una persona paso seguro hasta el pozo.
The Worm Holes#030.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#031.src: Have faith- Jump in. I will carry you down slowly.
The Worm Holes#031.dst: Ten fe- Salta. Te bajaré despacio.
The Worm Holes#031.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#032.src: Take the lead. If we can find any further evidence of the Grootslangs around here, it will aid in my understanding.
The Worm Holes#032.dst: Ve tú delante. Si encontramos más pruebas de los Grootslang por aquí, me ayudará a comprenderlo.
The Worm Holes#032.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#033.src: Hm? This wall looks like it's been disturbed recently...
The Worm Holes#033.dst: ¿Hm? Esta pared parece removida hace poco...
The Worm Holes#033.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#034.src: I can hear it...but where is it crawling...?
The Worm Holes#034.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#035.src: That's the mother Wyrm! She must be what is making the holes. We need to follow her!
The Worm Holes#035.dst: ¡Es la madre Wyrm! Ella debe de ser quien abre los agujeros. ¡Tenemos que seguirla!
The Worm Holes#035.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#036.src: Never mind the spiders, we need to keep following the Wyrm!
The Worm Holes#036.dst: Olvida las arañas, ¡hay que seguir a la madre Wyrm!
The Worm Holes#036.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#037.src: Ah...ehm, {u}? I've... Um, this is...a bit difficult to say, but...
The Worm Holes#037.dst: Ah...ehm, ¿{u}? Yo... Um, esto es...un poco difícil de decir, pero...
The Worm Holes#037.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#038.src: I...do not believe we need to fight, or to kill, here? The creatures are native to here, we are invading their space.
The Worm Holes#038.dst: Yo...no creo que aquí haga falta luchar, ni matar. Estas criaturas son de aquí; los invasores somos nosotros.
The Worm Holes#038.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#039.src: Why should they be attacked for merely existing in their territory? Even if they are animals, I believe that you can solve these problems without killing.
The Worm Holes#039.dst: ¿Por qué atacarlas por el mero hecho de existir en su territorio? Aunque sean animales, creo que puedes resolver estos problemas sin matar.
The Worm Holes#039.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#040.src: I...understand you may not have the same powers as myself... And I, ah...am not free of guilt, either. But I think you could stand to take a peaceful stance.
The Worm Holes#040.dst: Yo...entiendo que quizá no tengas mis poderes... Y yo, ah...tampoco estoy libre de culpa. Pero creo que bien podrías adoptar una postura pacífica.
The Worm Holes#040.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#041.src: Even if I am alone on that front...though I understand you are taught differently where you come from. I do not envy you, though I still thank you for your aid thusfar.
The Worm Holes#041.dst: Aunque en eso esté sola...aunque entiendo que de donde vienes os enseñan otra cosa. No te envidio, pero aun así te agradezco tu ayuda hasta ahora.
The Worm Holes#041.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#042.src: Your methods are...disagreeable, but you still have a sense of right to you, I feel... Well, the tunnel diverges here. We'll need to split apart.
The Worm Holes#042.dst: Tus métodos son...desagradables, pero siento que aún tienes un sentido de lo correcto... Bueno, el túnel se bifurca aquí. Tendremos que separarnos.
The Worm Holes#042.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#043.src: I'll go to the right, so you ought to continue to the left here. I will meet up with you again soon, hopefully.
The Worm Holes#043.dst: Yo iré a la derecha, así que tú sigue a la izquierda. Espero que volvamos a encontrarnos pronto.
The Worm Holes#043.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#045.dst: Investiga los túneles de los gusanos.

The Worm Holes#046.src: Aah! {u}! Don't...don't make any sudden movements.
The Worm Holes#046.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#047.src: This Grootslang is uncharacteristically aggressive... She's scared, being so close to the surface. Stay behind me, please.
The Worm Holes#047.dst: Este Grootslang está inusualmente agresivo... Tiene miedo por estar tan cerca de la superficie. Quédate detrás de mí, por favor.
The Worm Holes#047.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#049.src: Do not approach it! The power of the Wyrm is far too much for you!
The Worm Holes#049.dst: ¡No te acerques! ¡El poder del Wyrm es demasiado para ti!
The Worm Holes#049.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#051.src: {u}!! You're unharmed, yes? She's scared and in pain!
The Worm Holes#051.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#052.src: I have to get it right this time... I'm going to talk her down, stay there!
The Worm Holes#052.dst: Esta vez tengo que hacerlo bien... Voy a calmarla, ¡quédate ahí!
The Worm Holes#052.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#053.src: You must be calm, I beg you. Retreat to the earth- You harm those above!
The Worm Holes#053.dst: Debes calmarte, te lo ruego. Vuelve a la tierra- ¡Estás dañando a los de arriba!
The Worm Holes#053.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#054.src: The earth rotting... I take full responsibility, but does the grass above not rot also?
The Worm Holes#054.dst: La tierra se pudre... Asumo toda la responsabilidad, pero ¿no se pudre también la hierba de arriba?
The Worm Holes#054.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#055.src: I wish to soothe your pain, but you must allow me to aid you- You must listen!
The Worm Holes#055.dst: Quiero aliviar tu dolor, pero déjame ayudarte- ¡Tienes que escuchar!
The Worm Holes#055.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#056.src: What does this violence solve? Be calm, please!
The Worm Holes#056.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#057.src: {u}, it won't budge... There's something in its mind rejecting me. Distract it- but don't approach! It will kill you if you get close. Just...be loud!
The Worm Holes#057.dst: {u}, no cede... Hay algo en su mente que me rechaza. Distráela- ¡pero no te acerques! Si te acercas te matará. Solo... ¡haz ruido!
The Worm Holes#057.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#058.dst: Lucha contra el Grootslang junto a Lari

The Worm Holes#060.src: Can you hear me?! I'll get her to...to...s-something! Spit you up, I don't know! Just...please, d-don't die!
The Worm Holes#060.dst: ¡¿Me oyes?! ¡Voy a hacer que...que...h-haga algo! ¡Que te escupa, no sé! Solo... por favor, ¡n-no te mueras!
The Worm Holes#060.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#061.src: W-We have... We have not laid a blow against you! It is not right for you to do the same!
The Worm Holes#061.dst: N-nosotros... ¡No te hemos asestado ni un golpe! ¡No está bien que tú sí lo hagas!
The Worm Holes#061.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#062.src: You would wound and consume everything in your rage? Even knowing the consequences?
The Worm Holes#062.dst: ¿Vas a herir y devorar todo en tu ira? ¿Aun sabiendo las consecuencias?
The Worm Holes#062.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#063.src: Your hunger cannot be sated with this fruitless destruction! I beg of you, let them out!
The Worm Holes#063.dst: ¡Tu hambre no se saciará con esta destrucción inútil! ¡Te lo suplico, déjalos salir!
The Worm Holes#063.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#064.src: You know th- W-wait...where did you... AAAH!
The Worm Holes#064.dst: Tú sabes q- E-espera...¿de dónde has...? ¡AAAH!
The Worm Holes#064.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#066.src: I tried...w-why does no one listen to me? Why won't a-anything change for me?
The Worm Holes#066.dst: Lo intenté...¿p-por qué nadie me escucha? ¿Por qué n-nada cambia para mí?
The Worm Holes#066.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#067.src: She...she's been eating dark parasites. They're wracking her insides and h-hurting her head...
The Worm Holes#067.dst: Ella...ha estado comiendo parásitos oscuros. Le destrozan las entrañas y le d-duele la cabeza...
The Worm Holes#067.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#068.src: I...i-it's so d-dark... I c-can't breathe... This...th-this can't be the end...
The Worm Holes#068.dst: Yo...t-todo está tan oscuro... No puedo respirar... No...no puede ser el final...
The Worm Holes#068.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#069.src: I...n-no, I can't die in here... I-I'm needed still... You're n-needed still! I... I...
The Worm Holes#069.dst: Yo...n-no, no puedo morir aquí... M-me necesitan todavía... ¡A ti t-también te necesitan! Yo... Yo...
The Worm Holes#069.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#070.src: I n-need... Or... O-Or... C-Concentrate, Lari... You can do this...
The Worm Holes#070.dst: N-necesito... O... O-o... C-concéntrate, Lari... Tú puedes...
The Worm Holes#070.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#072.src: LET US OUT! LET US OUT OF HERE! DON'T LET US DIE LIKE THIS! I'M BEGGING YOU, PLEASE!!
The Worm Holes#072.dst: ¡DÉJANOS SALIR! ¡DÉJANOS SALIR DE AQUÍ! ¡NO DEJES QUE MURAMOS ASÍ! ¡¡TE LO SUPLICO, POR FAVOR!!
The Worm Holes#072.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#073.src: ...I...oh no... It's...d-d... I... I j-just... I just w-wanted out... Ohhh...n-no...
The Worm Holes#073.dst: ...Yo...oh, no... Está...m-mue... Yo s-solo... solo quería salir... Ohhh...no...
The Worm Holes#073.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#074.src: ...w-we're...leaving. I...I c-can't look at this any more...
The Worm Holes#074.dst: ...n-nos...vamos. Yo...y-ya no puedo seguir mirando esto...
The Worm Holes#074.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#076.src: I'm...I'm so sorry, {u}. If I'd...I don't... I don't even know what else I could have d-done...
The Worm Holes#076.dst: Lo...lo siento mucho, {u}. Si hubiera...no sé... Ni siquiera sé qué más podría haber h-hecho...
The Worm Holes#076.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#077.src: There...it didn’t feel like there was...anything left to it... But, if I’d just been quicker, then... Would it...would it even have made a difference?
The Worm Holes#077.dst: Allí...no parecía que quedara...nada de ella... Pero, si hubiera sido más rápida, entonces... ¿Habría...habría cambiado algo siquiera?
The Worm Holes#077.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#078.src: ...some savior I am... I need to be better, but what else even is there that...ugh, I'm going in circles...
The Worm Holes#078.dst: ...vaya salvadora estoy hecha... Tengo que ser mejor, pero qué más hay que...uf, estoy dando vueltas en círculo...
The Worm Holes#078.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#080.src: ...I...I can't believe this. This is...does destiny just hate me? What have I done to deserve this?!
The Worm Holes#080.dst: ...Yo...no me lo puedo creer. Esto es...¿es que el destino me odia? ¡¿Qué he hecho para merecer esto?!
The Worm Holes#080.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#081.src: The Mother Wyrm laid eggs... Eggs infested with parasites! Every single one is going to be born berserk!!
The Worm Holes#081.dst: La madre Wyrm había puesto huevos... ¡Huevos infestados de parásitos! ¡¡Todos van a nacer enloquecidos!!
The Worm Holes#081.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#082.src: You saw how strong the mother was...an infestation like this could cause the entire region of Gavel to collapse in a quake...
The Worm Holes#082.dst: Has visto lo fuerte que era la madre...una plaga así podría hundir toda la región de Gavel en un terremoto...
The Worm Holes#082.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#083.src: They...they need to be stopped, but...I can't do it. I c-can't kill... I'm sorry, I just can't!
The Worm Holes#083.dst: Hay...hay que detenerlos, pero...yo no puedo. N-no puedo matar... Lo siento, ¡simplemente no puedo!
The Worm Holes#083.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#084.src: Bring a group... Even Whelps can be a terror if they're enraged. Just...p-please, take care of this quickly.
The Worm Holes#084.dst: Trae a un grupo... Hasta las crías pueden ser un terror si están enfurecidas. Solo...p-por favor, ocúpate de esto rápido.
The Worm Holes#084.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#085.src: You deserve the best... But that's more than I can give...so here. Take these. I'll move along.
The Worm Holes#085.dst: Mereces lo mejor... Pero es más de lo que puedo dar...así que toma. Quédate esto. Yo seguiré mi camino.
The Worm Holes#085.speaker: Lari

Through the Pipes#001.src: You're a lifesaver, {u}. I cannot thank you enough!
Through the Pipes#001.dst: Me has salvado la vida, {u}. ¡No sé cómo agradecértelo!

Through the Pipes#002.src: WAIT! MY ART BAG IS MISSING! Did I accidentally drop it somewhere?
Through the Pipes#002.dst: ¡ESPERA! ¡MI BOLSA DE PINTURAS NO ESTÁ! ¿La habré dejado caer por ahí?

Through the Pipes#003.src: Do you want us to sink?!

similar.text: So you want us to sneak in?

Through the Pipes#004.src: What's your name... {u}? Great, I will resume searching for that fool as well. Best of luck to you!
Through the Pipes#004.dst: ¿Cómo te llamas... {u}? Genial, yo también seguiré buscando a ese bobo. ¡Mucha suerte!

Through the Pipes#006.src: Maybe it's best to continue forward...

Through the Pipes#008.src: You hear someone in the distance.
Through the Pipes#008.dst: Oyes a alguien a lo lejos.

Through the Pipes#009.src: I'm so glad you found it! I don't know what I would do if I lost Soosu's gift and my bag!
Through the Pipes#009.dst: ¡Cuánto me alegro de que la encontraras! ¡No sé qué haría si perdiera el regalo de Soosu y mi bolsa!

Through the Pipes#010.src: You are? Excellent! Let's see what you've created.

Through the Pipes#012.src: Are you sure you want to leave the dock?

Through the Pipes#014.dst: El generador cobra vida con un zumbido.

Through the Pipes#015.src: You pull the hook off of the grapple. It might be useful later.
Through the Pipes#015.dst: Arrancas el gancho del garfio. Quizá sirva más adelante.

Through the Pipes#017.src: You must be on your raft to use this.
Through the Pipes#017.dst: Debes estar en tu balsa para usar esto.

Through the Pipes#018.src: Find a way to open that gate. I don't want to be on this raft for any longer!
Through the Pipes#018.dst: Abre esa compuerta como sea. ¡No quiero seguir más en esta balsa!

Through the Pipes#020.src: Huh, this isn't- really what I expected.
Through the Pipes#020.dst: Vaya, esto no es- lo que esperaba.

Through the Pipes#021.src: Are you sure you want to reset your raft?

Through the Pipes#022.src: Maybe there's something you could build to get across...
Through the Pipes#022.dst: Quizá puedas construir algo para cruzar...

Through the Pipes#023.src: That looks like enough leaf litter. You should return to the generator to fuel it now.
Through the Pipes#023.dst: Parece hojarasca suficiente. Vuelve al generador para echársela de combustible.

Through the Pipes#025.src: Especially considering how rarely Soosu shows up in public, this festival might be my only opportunity this year...
Through the Pipes#025.dst: Y más teniendo en cuenta lo poco que Soosu aparece en público; esta fiesta puede ser mi única ocasión este año...

Through the Pipes#026.src: You should let Fichu know you're done.
Through the Pipes#026.dst: Avisa a Fichu de que has terminado.

Through the Pipes#027.src: The board crumbles under your step. Maybe there's another way to the other side.
Through the Pipes#027.dst: La tabla se deshace bajo tu pie. Quizá haya otro camino al otro lado.

Through the Pipes#028.src: Talk with the citizen in despair at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Through the Pipes#028.dst: Habla con el ciudadano desesperado en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Through the Pipes#029.src: H-Hey, you! Have you seen a raccoon anywhere?
Through the Pipes#029.dst: ¡E-eh, tú! ¿Has visto un mapache por aquí?
Through the Pipes#029.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#030.src: I spent all my free time making a gift for Soosu, and that devil snatched it from me! It would be a shame if I never got the chance to give it to her...
Through the Pipes#030.dst: ¡Dediqué todo mi tiempo libre a hacer un regalo para Soosu, y ese demonio me lo arrebató! Sería una pena no llegar a dárselo nunca...
Through the Pipes#030.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#031.src: This might be a big ask, but- do you think you could help me?
Through the Pipes#031.dst: Quizá sea mucho pedir, pero- ¿crees que podrías ayudarme?
Through the Pipes#031.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#032.src: Y-You will? I knew there was still some good left in this world!
Through the Pipes#032.dst: ¿D-de verdad? ¡Sabía que aún quedaba algo de bondad en el mundo!
Through the Pipes#032.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#033.src: Right! Last time I saw that raccoon, it was running into an alleyway south of the town center. It can't have gone too far!
Through the Pipes#033.dst: ¡Bien! La última vez que vi al mapache, se metía en un callejón al sur del centro del pueblo. ¡No puede haber ido muy lejos!
Through the Pipes#033.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#034.src: I will resume searching for that fool as well. Best of luck to you!
Through the Pipes#034.dst: Yo también seguiré buscando a ese bobo. ¡Mucha suerte!
Through the Pipes#034.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#035.src: ...I get it. If you change your mind, come and talk with me again.
Through the Pipes#035.dst: ...Lo entiendo. Si cambias de idea, vuelve a hablar conmigo.
Through the Pipes#035.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#036.src: Yes! A raccoon! You've seen them before- surely? They're rampant around here!
Through the Pipes#036.dst: ¡Sí! ¡Un mapache! Los habrás visto antes- ¿no? ¡Aquí están por todas partes!
Through the Pipes#036.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#038.src: You know, those furry gray creatures with the weird striped tails?
Through the Pipes#038.dst: Ya sabes, esos bichos grises y peludos con esa cola a rayas tan rara, ¿no?
Through the Pipes#038.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#039.src: ...I hope you know what a raccoon is.
Through the Pipes#039.dst: ...Espero que sepas qué es un mapache.
Through the Pipes#039.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#041.src: Oh- you're back! Are you able to help me now?
Through the Pipes#041.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#043.src: I really think it would be better if we split up to search, don't you agree?
Through the Pipes#043.dst: Creo de verdad que es mejor buscar por separado, ¿no te parece?
Through the Pipes#043.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#044.src: If you forgot, you should try searching south of the town center. But you do you, I suppose...
Through the Pipes#044.dst: Por si lo has olvidado, busca al sur del centro del pueblo. Pero allá tú, supongo...
Through the Pipes#044.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#047.src: Enter the drainage hole at to continue the search.
Through the Pipes#047.dst: Entra en el desagüe para continuar la búsqueda.

Through the Pipes#048.src: Dive deeper into the sewer network.
Through the Pipes#048.dst: Adéntrate más en la red de alcantarillado.

Through the Pipes#049.dst: Explora más allá de la compuerta.

Through the Pipes#050.src: Find a way to get across the flooded section of the sewer.
Through the Pipes#050.dst: Encuentra la forma de cruzar el tramo inundado de la alcantarilla.

Through the Pipes#051.src: Huh, is there someone down there?

Through the Pipes#053.src: Continue chasing the raccoon through the sewers.
Through the Pipes#053.dst: Sigue persiguiendo al mapache por las alcantarillas.

Through the Pipes#054.src: You aren't getting away from me now!

Through the Pipes#055.src: Encounter a familiar face in the sewers.
Through the Pipes#055.dst: Encuentra una cara conocida en las alcantarillas.

Through the Pipes#056.src: Ah ha! I've got you now, thief!

Through the Pipes#060.src: {u}! You're here! I was wondering where you went!
Through the Pipes#060.dst: ¡{u}! ¡Estás aquí! ¡Me preguntaba dónde te habías metido!
Through the Pipes#060.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#061.src: I've been chasing that raccoon the whole time! What in the world have you been up to?
Through the Pipes#061.dst: ¡Yo llevo todo el rato persiguiendo al mapache! ¿Y tú qué demonios has estado haciendo?
Through the Pipes#061.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#062.src: Whatever. I'm struggling to keep up the chase at this rate. But fortunately, I have just the thing that'll help you!
Through the Pipes#062.dst: Da igual. A este paso no aguanto la persecución. ¡Pero, por suerte, tengo justo lo que te hará falta!
Through the Pipes#062.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#064.src: It's broken! How will I ever catch up with that crook at this rate?
Through the Pipes#064.dst: ¡Está roto! ¿Cómo voy a alcanzar a ese granuja así?
Through the Pipes#064.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#065.src: ...Maybe this is all a lost cause. You can try fixing it, I guess, but it's not worth it.
Through the Pipes#065.dst: ...Puede que todo esto sea una causa perdida. Supongo que puedes intentar arreglarlo, pero no merece la pena.
Through the Pipes#065.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#066.src: I'm going that direction to see if I can catch that pest. You go the other way, we'll meet again soon.
Through the Pipes#066.dst: Yo voy hacia allí, a ver si atrapo a ese bicho. Tú ve por el otro lado; nos veremos pronto.
Through the Pipes#066.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#067.src: Encounter the stranger in the sewers.
Through the Pipes#067.dst: Encuentra al desconocido en las alcantarillas.

Through the Pipes#068.src: Ah ha! I've got you now, thief!

Through the Pipes#073.src: Who are you? What are you doing here?
Through the Pipes#073.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#074.src: Ah, exploring the sewers? That's fun! I've basically been to every corner of {p}'s sewers.
Through the Pipes#074.dst: Ah, ¿explorando las alcantarillas? ¡Qué divertido! Yo he estado en casi cada rincón de las alcantarillas de {p}.
Through the Pipes#074.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#075.src: Say, is there any chance you stumbled upon that raccoon earlier? That pest snatched something of value from me!
Through the Pipes#075.dst: Oye, ¿no te habrás cruzado antes con un mapache? ¡Ese bicho me robó algo muy valioso!
Through the Pipes#075.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#076.src: I was making a gift for Sovereign Soosu, but then that fiend just ran off with it! Horrible, isn't it?
Through the Pipes#076.dst: Estaba haciendo un regalo para la Soberana Soosu, ¡y ese granuja salió corriendo con él! Horrible, ¿verdad?
Through the Pipes#076.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#077.src: Especially with how soon the festival is... I wouldn't want to miss my only opportunity this year!
Through the Pipes#077.dst: Y más con lo cerca que está la fiesta... ¡No quiero perder mi única ocasión de este año!
Through the Pipes#077.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#078.src: I could really use your help, and hey I have just the tool you'll want for exploring the sewers!
Through the Pipes#078.dst: Me vendría muy bien tu ayuda y, oye, ¡tengo justo la herramienta que querrás para explorar las alcantarillas!
Through the Pipes#078.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#080.src: It's broken! How will I ever catch up with that crook at this rate?
Through the Pipes#080.dst: ¡Está roto! ¿Cómo voy a alcanzar a ese granuja así?
Through the Pipes#080.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#081.src: ...Maybe this is all a lost cause. You can try fixing it, I guess, but it's not worth it.
Through the Pipes#081.dst: ...Puede que todo esto sea una causa perdida. Supongo que puedes intentar arreglarlo, pero no merece la pena.
Through the Pipes#081.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#082.src: I'm going that direction to see if I can catch that pest. What's your name... {u}? You go the other way, we'll meet again soon.
Through the Pipes#082.dst: Yo voy hacia allí, a ver si atrapo a ese bicho. ¿Cómo te llamas... {u}? Tú ve por el otro lado; nos veremos pronto.
Through the Pipes#082.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#083.src: Find a safe way past the flooded rail tunnels.
Through the Pipes#083.dst: Encuentra un modo seguro de pasar los túneles ferroviarios inundados.

Through the Pipes#084.src: Whew! I didn't mean to let go-
Through the Pipes#084.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#086.src: Perfect, I know where we are, and there isn't much further that foolish raccoon can run. We could corner it!
Through the Pipes#086.dst: Perfecto, sé dónde estamos, y a ese mapache bobo no le queda mucho por donde huir. ¡Podemos acorralarlo!
Through the Pipes#086.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#087.src: Now, the problem is, I have no idea how to traverse this next area. It's heavily flooded if I can recall.
Through the Pipes#087.dst: El problema es que no tengo ni idea de cómo cruzar la siguiente zona. Si no recuerdo mal, está muy inundada.
Through the Pipes#087.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#088.src: {u}! OH NO! I didn't mean to drop that on you
Through the Pipes#088.dst: ¡{u}! ¡AY, NO! No quería tirarte eso encima
Through the Pipes#088.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#089.src: W-why were you standing there? Out of all places?
Through the Pipes#089.dst: ¿P-por qué estabas justo ahí? ¿De todos los sitios?
Through the Pipes#089.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#090.src: ...Okay. You seem to be alright. Sorry, I didn't realize you were standing right there!
Through the Pipes#090.dst: ...Vale. Pareces estar bien. ¡Perdona, no me di cuenta de que estabas justo ahí!
Through the Pipes#090.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#091.src: Alright, at least we're regrouped now. Try not to stand under any more heavy objects, alright?
Through the Pipes#091.dst: Bueno, al menos ya volvemos a estar juntos. Intenta no ponerte debajo de más objetos pesados, ¿vale?
Through the Pipes#091.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#092.src: Moving forward, the problem is, I have no idea how to traverse this next area. It's heavily flooded if I can recall.
Through the Pipes#092.dst: De cara a seguir, el problema es que no sé cómo cruzar la siguiente zona. Si no recuerdo mal, está muy inundada.
Through the Pipes#092.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#093.src: You'll need to find some way for us to cross. Too many people have gotten the worst of diseases by wading through that water- eugh.
Through the Pipes#093.dst: Tendrás que buscar la forma de que crucemos. Demasiada gente ha pillado enfermedades horribles vadeando esa agua- puaj.
Through the Pipes#093.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#094.src: Right! Let me know when you figure something out. I'll scout around, never had an excuse to explore this area before!
Through the Pipes#094.dst: ¡Bien! Avísame cuando se te ocurra algo. Yo exploraré por aquí; ¡nunca había tenido una excusa para ver esta zona!
Through the Pipes#094.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#095.src: Huh? What's all this stuff? Did someone forget their construction equipment?
Through the Pipes#095.dst: ¿Eh? ¿Y todo esto? ¿Alguien se ha dejado el material de obra?
Through the Pipes#095.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#096.src: I guess the maintenance crews never bother to pack up their equipment. Maybe you can use this stuff for something.
Through the Pipes#096.dst: Se ve que las cuadrillas de mantenimiento nunca recogen su material. Quizá puedas usar esto para algo.
Through the Pipes#096.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#097.src: Check back in with me when you're done!
Through the Pipes#097.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#098.src: Navigate through the end of the sewer network with Fichu.
Through the Pipes#098.dst: Recorre el final de la red de alcantarillado con Fichu.

Through the Pipes#101.src: I'd appreciate it if you added a seat for me.
Through the Pipes#101.dst: Te agradecería que me pusieras un asiento.
Through the Pipes#101.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#105.src: Bet no one's been here for a while.
Through the Pipes#105.dst: Aquí no viene nadie hace tiempo.
Through the Pipes#105.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#106.src: Wonder where that raccoon is now...
Through the Pipes#106.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#107.src: Soosu needs to see that state of this place...
Through the Pipes#107.dst: Soosu tendría que ver cómo está este sitio...
Through the Pipes#107.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#109.src: What else do you think we'll find?
Through the Pipes#109.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#110.src: I've heard a few stories about this place. Mostly bad ones...
Through the Pipes#110.dst: He oído algunas historias de este sitio. Casi todas malas...
Through the Pipes#110.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#111.src: I hope that raccoon hasn't gone too far...
Through the Pipes#111.dst: Espero que ese mapache no se haya alejado mucho...
Through the Pipes#111.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#114.src: This raft looks fragile, be careful!
Through the Pipes#114.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#116.dst: Creo que has chocado con algo.
Through the Pipes#116.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#119.src: You know what you're doing, right?
Through the Pipes#119.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#121.src: Ah! I almost fell out of my seat.
Through the Pipes#121.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#123.src: Are you even capable of not hitting something?
Through the Pipes#123.dst: ¿Eres capaz de no chocar con nada?
Through the Pipes#123.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#124.src: One more hit and I'm taking over!
Through the Pipes#124.dst: ¡Un golpe más y tomo el mando!
Through the Pipes#124.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#125.src: I don't trust you sailing this thing!
Through the Pipes#125.dst: ¡No me fío de ti al timón!
Through the Pipes#125.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#127.src: It can't possibly be that hard!
Through the Pipes#127.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#128.src: Make sure to be careful, okay?
Through the Pipes#128.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#129.src: No wonder everyone avoids this place...
Through the Pipes#129.dst: Con razón todos evitan este sitio...
Through the Pipes#129.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#131.src: You know where you're going, right?
Through the Pipes#131.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#132.src: When I get that raccoon, oh man...
Through the Pipes#132.dst: Cuando pille a ese mapache, madre mía...
Through the Pipes#132.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#133.src: How long have I even spent chasing that fool...
Through the Pipes#133.dst: ¿Cuánto tiempo llevo ya persiguiendo a ese bobo...?
Through the Pipes#133.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#135.src: Keep an eye out for dangers!
Through the Pipes#135.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#136.src: Make sure we're staying on track.
Through the Pipes#136.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#137.src: Maybe rats are better than raccoons after all.
Through the Pipes#137.dst: Quizá las ratas sean mejores que los mapaches, después de todo.
Through the Pipes#137.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#138.src: I regret getting on this raft.
Through the Pipes#138.dst: Me arrepiento de subir a esta balsa.
Through the Pipes#138.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#139.dst: Por favor, no hagas ninguna tontería...
Through the Pipes#139.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#142.src: I cannot wait to get off...
Through the Pipes#142.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#144.src: I really don't want to insult you, but-
Through the Pipes#144.dst: No quiero ofenderte, de verdad, pero-
Through the Pipes#144.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#147.dst: La peor decisión de mi vida...
Through the Pipes#147.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#150.src: Ah! What will we do now?!
Through the Pipes#150.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#152.src: Hmm, is the raft broken? We haven't moved for a while.
Through the Pipes#152.dst: Mmm, ¿se ha roto la balsa? Llevamos un rato sin movernos.
Through the Pipes#152.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#153.src: Are you... going to have us move?
Through the Pipes#153.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#156.src: I'm not sure why you think this place is interesting enough to stop at.
Through the Pipes#156.dst: No sé por qué te parece que este sitio merezca una parada.
Through the Pipes#156.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#160.src: The raccoon is probably long gone at this point, thanks to your delay.
Through the Pipes#160.dst: A estas alturas el mapache ya estará lejísimos, gracias a tu tardanza.
Through the Pipes#160.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#161.dst: Genial, ya nos movemos otra vez.
Through the Pipes#161.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#163.src: How long were we waiting for?
Through the Pipes#163.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#164.src: Huh? What are you doing with that?!
Through the Pipes#164.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#165.src: You're going to sink us with that!
Through the Pipes#165.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#167.src: IS THAT AN EXPLOSIVE?! ARE YOU MAD!
Through the Pipes#167.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#168.src: HELP US! WE'RE GOING TO DROWN!
Through the Pipes#168.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#169.src: OH NO! GET ME OFF OF HERE!
Through the Pipes#169.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#172.src: Why did you think this was a good idea?!
Through the Pipes#172.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#173.src: I gotta get off of this thing!
Through the Pipes#173.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#174.src: That's the exit! Go past this gate, then I never want to board anything sailed by you again!
Through the Pipes#174.dst: ¡Esa es la salida! ¡Cruza esta compuerta y no vuelvo a subirme a nada que pilotes tú!

Through the Pipes#175.src: I gotta get off this thing!
Through the Pipes#175.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#176.src: Hey- maybe we should've been a bit further away from that train?
Through the Pipes#176.dst: Oye- ¿no deberíamos habernos apartado un poco más de ese tren?
Through the Pipes#176.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#179.src: Agh! Sorry, just got scared by that.
Through the Pipes#179.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#180.src: AHHHHH! THIS WAS A HORRIBLE IDEA!
Through the Pipes#180.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#181.src: OUT OF ALL ROUTES YOU TOOK, ONE OF THEM INCLUDED A TRAIN!
Through the Pipes#181.dst: ¡DE TODAS LAS RUTAS, HAS COGIDO LA QUE TIENE UN TREN!
Through the Pipes#181.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#183.src: Huh? AH! THERE'S A TRAIN! GET OUT OF HERE!
Through the Pipes#183.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#186.src: YOU REALLY THINK THIS FLIMSY RAFT IS GOING TO SURVIVE A TRAIN?!
Through the Pipes#186.dst: ¡¿DE VERDAD CREES QUE ESTA BALSA CUTRE AGUANTA UN TREN?!
Through the Pipes#186.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#187.src: YOU FOOL! We barely missed being hit!
Through the Pipes#187.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#188.src: Oh my- we survived! YOU ARE AN IDIOT! DON'T DO THAT AGAIN!
Through the Pipes#188.dst: Madre mía- ¡seguimos vivos! ¡ERES UN IDIOTA! ¡NO LO VUELVAS A HACER!
Through the Pipes#188.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#189.src: This looks like the halfway point!
Through the Pipes#189.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#190.src: You'll need to find a way to open that gate, since I don't see any other way past.
Through the Pipes#190.dst: Tendrás que buscar cómo abrir esa compuerta, porque no veo otra forma de pasar.
Through the Pipes#190.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#191.src: If I'm remembering correctly, just past this gate should be our destination!
Through the Pipes#191.dst: Si no recuerdo mal, ¡justo pasada esta compuerta está nuestro destino!
Through the Pipes#191.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#192.src: Phew, we survived. That was a bit rough, but at least we made it.
Through the Pipes#192.dst: Uf, hemos sobrevivido. Ha sido un poco duro, pero al menos llegamos.
Through the Pipes#192.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#193.src: However, I think I'll definitely be avoiding boats for now...
Through the Pipes#193.dst: Eso sí, creo que voy a evitar los barcos por una temporada...
Through the Pipes#193.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#194.src: We made it! You did a pretty good job navigating, I knew I could trust you!
Through the Pipes#194.dst: ¡Lo logramos! Has pilotado bastante bien, ¡sabía que podía confiar en ti!
Through the Pipes#194.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#195.src: Alright, let's chase down that raccoon once and for all!
Through the Pipes#195.dst: ¡Vamos, a por ese mapache de una vez por todas!
Through the Pipes#195.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#196.src: I hope my prediction is right, and there really is no further it can run from here.
Through the Pipes#196.dst: Espero acertar y que de aquí en adelante no tenga adónde huir.
Through the Pipes#196.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#198.src: Huh?! LOOK! It's the raccoon, that's it!
Through the Pipes#198.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#201.src: Ah ha! Now you're cornered, you little imp!
Through the Pipes#201.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#202.src: Before you do anything, we need a way to take the gift back!
Through the Pipes#202.dst: Antes de hacer nada, ¡necesitamos la forma de recuperar el regalo!
Through the Pipes#202.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#204.src: And look! We finally got the gift back! I knew we could do it.
Through the Pipes#204.dst: ¡Y mira! ¡Por fin recuperamos el regalo! Sabía que podíamos.
Through the Pipes#204.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#205.src: Hopefully this is still intact after all of that...
Through the Pipes#205.dst: Ojalá siga de una pieza después de todo eso...
Through the Pipes#205.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#206.src: It survived! Thank the queen! I don't know what I would do otherwise...
Through the Pipes#206.dst: ¡Ha sobrevivido! ¡Gracias a la reina! No sé qué habría hecho si no...
Through the Pipes#206.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#207.src: {u}, from the very start, you have been a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#207.dst: {u}, desde el principio has sido una ayuda enorme. ¡No sé cómo agradecerte tu esfuerzo!
Through the Pipes#207.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#208.src: ...You don't think that was a little too brutal, do you?
Through the Pipes#208.dst: ...No te parecerá que eso ha sido un poco bestia, ¿no?

Through the Pipes#209.src: {u}, from the very start, you were a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#209.dst: {u}, desde el principio fuiste una ayuda enorme. ¡No sé cómo agradecerte tu esfuerzo!
Through the Pipes#209.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#210.src: Without your help, I don't even know if I could have caught that raccoon on my own!
Through the Pipes#210.dst: ¡Sin tu ayuda ni sé si habría podido atrapar a ese mapache yo solo!
Through the Pipes#210.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#211.src: As a reward, I have an extra gift just for you! Thank you again for your incredible help!
Through the Pipes#211.dst: ¡Como recompensa, tengo un regalo extra solo para ti! ¡Gracias otra vez por tu increíble ayuda!
Through the Pipes#211.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#212.src: And look! We finally got the gift back! I knew we could do it.
Through the Pipes#212.dst: ¡Y mira! ¡Por fin recuperamos el regalo! Sabía que podíamos.
Through the Pipes#212.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#213.src: Hopefully this is still intact after all of that...
Through the Pipes#213.dst: Ojalá siga de una pieza después de todo eso...
Through the Pipes#213.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#214.src: It survived! Thank the queen! I don't know what I would do otherwise...
Through the Pipes#214.dst: ¡Ha sobrevivido! ¡Gracias a la reina! No sé qué habría hecho si no...
Through the Pipes#214.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#215.src: {u}, from the very start, you were a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#215.dst: {u}, desde el principio fuiste una ayuda enorme. ¡No sé cómo agradecerte tu esfuerzo!
Through the Pipes#215.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#216.src: Not only did you safely get us through a flooded tunnel with that creation of yours, but you came more prepared than I could have expected!
Through the Pipes#216.dst: No solo nos cruzaste sanos y salvos un túnel inundado con ese invento tuyo, ¡es que venías mejor preparado de lo que imaginaba!
Through the Pipes#216.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#217.src: A cage... a ring to use as a distraction... and even a firecracker. Where did you even find all this stuff?
Through the Pipes#217.dst: Una jaula... un anillo para distraerlo... y hasta un petardo. ¿De dónde has sacado todo esto?
Through the Pipes#217.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#218.src: And on top of all of that, you found my art supplies bag! That bag itself is more important to me than the gift we were chasing after!
Through the Pipes#218.dst: ¡Y encima encontraste mi bolsa de material de pintura! ¡Esa bolsa me importa más que el regalo que perseguíamos!
Through the Pipes#218.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#219.src: Speaking of that, I would like to give you Soosu's gift as a token of appreciation. I believe you're more deserving of it.
Through the Pipes#219.dst: Y hablando de eso, quiero darte el regalo de Soosu en señal de agradecimiento. Creo que tú lo mereces más.
Through the Pipes#219.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#220.src: Don't worry, I've already brainstormed a better design. I think Soosu will like this next one even more!
Through the Pipes#220.dst: Tranquilo, ya tengo pensado un diseño mejor. ¡Creo que a Soosu le gustará aún más el siguiente!
Through the Pipes#220.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#221.src: Don't go so close! You might scare it off again!
Through the Pipes#221.dst: ¡No te acerques tanto! ¡Podrías espantarlo otra vez!
Through the Pipes#221.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#222.src: Thank you again for the help! I couldn't have done it without you.
Through the Pipes#222.dst: ¡Gracias de nuevo por la ayuda! Sin ti no habría podido.
Through the Pipes#222.speaker: Fichu

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#002.src: I challenge you to reach the final floor!
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#002.dst: ¡Te reto a llegar al último piso!
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#002.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#003.src: Have you got what it takes to conquer it?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#003.dst: ¿Tienes lo que hace falta para conquistarla?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#003.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#004.src: Perhaps you would like to know the layout of the tower first? Hehehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#004.dst: ¿Quizá quieras conocer antes cómo es la torre? Jejejeje...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#004.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#005.src: There are {~} floors in this tower, each with ten levels.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#005.dst: Esta torre tiene {~} pisos, cada uno con diez niveles.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#005.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#006.src: Each floor has nine regular levels and one boss level.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#006.dst: Cada piso tiene nueve niveles normales y uno de jefe.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#006.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#007.src: To pass a regular level, you must collect five tokens from the challenge on that level, and one token from boss levels.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#007.dst: Para superar un nivel normal, reúne cinco fichas en su desafío; en los niveles de jefe, basta con una.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#007.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#008.src: After you beat a whole floor, you will return here and you can begin the next one...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#008.dst: Cuando superes un piso entero, volverás aquí y podrás empezar el siguiente...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#008.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#009.src: So, what do you say? Hehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#009.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#010.src: Turn left and head to the first floor...if you dare...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#010.dst: Gira a la izquierda y ve al primer piso... si te atreves...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#010.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#011.src: Well done, adventurer, you have successfully completed this floor! You may proceed.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#011.dst: Bien hecho, aventurero, ¡has completado este piso! Puedes continuar.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#011.speaker: Floormaster

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#012.src: You have completed my tower, I see...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#012.dst: Veo que has completado mi torre...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#012.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#013.src: Did you enjoy Death? Many challengers certainly did. Her power is... unmatched, hehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#013.dst: ¿Has disfrutado de Death? Muchos aspirantes, sin duda. Su poder es... incomparable, jejeje...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#013.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#014.src: And you... You are unlike all of them, yes? Few have managed to ascend these floors.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#014.dst: Y tú... No eres como ellos, ¿verdad? Pocos han logrado subir estos pisos.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#014.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#015.src: A tower of madness, fueled by Death herself... Quite a challenge, yes?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#015.dst: Una torre de locura, alimentada por la propia Death... Todo un reto, ¿verdad?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#015.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#016.src: You have joined us now, champion... Few can claim this victory as their own. Fewer still have held their mind.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#016.dst: Ya eres uno de los nuestros, campeón... Pocos pueden decir que es suya esta victoria. Menos aún conservan la cordura.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#016.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#017.src: For this honor... A reward, for you. You have truly earned it... Hehehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#017.dst: Por este honor... Una recompensa para ti. Te la has ganado de verdad... Jejejeje...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#017.speaker: Ankou

Tribal Aggression#000.src: My tribe worries our own business, stranger.

Tribal Aggression#001.src: I'm sure they hid the totem, but if you are able to find it, I await your return!

Tribal Aggression#002.src: Hopefully, we two camps will never set foot on another's land in an attempt to steal back the totems, and live in peace.

Tribal Aggression#003.src: I-Is that, the totem? My, it has been a long time since the owl has been with me. Though I wonder if the Eagle and Owl totem possess the same mystic powers.

Tribal Aggression#004.src: Have you gotten our totem back yet? The Eagle camp is across the river, on the other side of the canyon.
Tribal Aggression#004.dst: ¿Ya has recuperado nuestro tótem? El campamento Águila está al otro lado del río, pasado el cañón.

Tribal Aggression#006.src: My tribes worries our own business, stranger.
Tribal Aggression#006.dst: Mi tribu se ocupa de sus asuntos, forastero.
Tribal Aggression#006.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#007.src: Oh, my apologies, I did not realize you are a warrior of the province! We would be grateful of your help.
Tribal Aggression#007.dst: Oh, disculpa, ¡no sabía que eras un guerrero de la Provincia! Te agradeceríamos tu ayuda.
Tribal Aggression#007.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#008.src: Our sacred owl totem that we worship was stolen by the cunning Eagle Tribe many years ago. Its magical properties used to bring prosperity to our camp.
Tribal Aggression#008.dst: La astuta tribu Águila robó hace muchos años el sagrado tótem del búho que adoramos. Su magia traía prosperidad a nuestro campamento.
Tribal Aggression#008.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#009.src: However, the Eagle tribe are not victorious, we possess their mystic eagle totem, but alas, I do not know who was the original thief.
Tribal Aggression#009.dst: Pero la tribu Águila tampoco ha ganado: tenemos su místico tótem del águila, aunque, por desgracia, no sé quién fue el primer ladrón.
Tribal Aggression#009.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#010.src: We have been at war for years now, despite being neighbors. Without our totem, our rivalry will continue for ages and peace will never again be felt in our hearts.
Tribal Aggression#010.dst: Llevamos años en guerra, aunque seamos vecinos. Sin nuestro tótem, esta rivalidad durará siglos y la paz nunca volverá a nuestros corazones.
Tribal Aggression#010.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#011.src: Retrieve our totem, and the blessing of the Owl spirit will be with you.
Tribal Aggression#011.dst: Recupera nuestro tótem y la bendición del espíritu del Búho te acompañará.
Tribal Aggression#011.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#012.src: Now, enter the Eagle Camp across the river, you may have to search the camp, I'm sure they have hidden our totem!
Tribal Aggression#012.dst: Ve al campamento Águila, cruzando el río, y regístralo; ¡seguro que han escondido nuestro tótem!
Tribal Aggression#012.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#013.src: Enter the Eagle Camp and talk to Favian
Tribal Aggression#013.dst: Entra en el campamento Águila y habla con Favian

Tribal Aggression#014.src: Greetings, what brings you to the noble Eagle tribe?
Tribal Aggression#014.dst: Saludos, ¿qué te trae a la noble tribu Águila?
Tribal Aggression#014.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#015.src: You seek the Owl totem? The cursed Owl tribe trying to retain their lost dignity again.
Tribal Aggression#015.dst: ¿Buscas el tótem del búho? La maldita tribu Búho intentando otra vez recuperar su dignidad perdida.
Tribal Aggression#015.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#016.src: Why should we give you their totem back? They stole our source of enlightenment all those years ago.
Tribal Aggression#016.dst: ¿Por qué íbamos a devolverte su tótem? Hace años nos robaron a nosotros nuestra fuente de iluminación.
Tribal Aggression#016.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#017.src: Tell you what, if you can retrieve our Eagle Totem, I will allow you to go return the Owl totem.
Tribal Aggression#017.dst: Te propongo algo: si recuperas nuestro tótem del águila, te dejaré llevar el tótem del búho de vuelta.
Tribal Aggression#017.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#018.src: I'm sure they hid the totem, but if you are able to find, I await your return!
Tribal Aggression#018.dst: Seguro que escondieron el tótem, pero si lo encuentras, ¡espero tu regreso!
Tribal Aggression#018.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#019.src: Bring back the Eagle Totem from the Owl Camp
Tribal Aggression#019.dst: Trae el tótem del águila desde el campamento Búho

Tribal Aggression#020.src: Wonderful! You may now enter the cave to retrieve the blasted Owl totem.
Tribal Aggression#020.dst: ¡Magnífico! Ya puedes entrar en la cueva a por el dichoso tótem del búho.
Tribal Aggression#020.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#021.src: Be careful, there are Eagle guardians in the cave, be prepared traveller.
Tribal Aggression#021.dst: Cuidado, hay guardianes águila en la cueva. Ve preparado, viajero.
Tribal Aggression#021.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#022.src: Once you get the totem, you may return it to its original tribe.
Tribal Aggression#022.dst: Cuando tengas el tótem, podrás devolverlo a su tribu original.
Tribal Aggression#022.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#023.src: Hopefully, we two camps will never set foot on another's land in an attempt steal back the totems, and live in peace.
Tribal Aggression#023.dst: Ojalá nuestros campamentos nunca vuelvan a pisar la tierra del otro para robar los tótems, y vivamos en paz.
Tribal Aggression#023.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#024.src: Anyways, hurry up, even the thought of the two totems sharing the same space makes me sick.
Tribal Aggression#024.dst: En fin, date prisa; solo de pensar en los dos tótems en el mismo sitio me pongo enfermo.
Tribal Aggression#024.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#025.src: Retrieve the Owl Totem and return it to the Owl Camp
Tribal Aggression#025.dst: Recupera el tótem del búho y devuélvelo al campamento Búho

Tribal Aggression#026.src: I-Is that, the totem? My, it has been a long time since the owl has been with me. Though I wonder if the Eagle and the Owl totem possess the same mystic powers.
Tribal Aggression#026.dst: ¿E-es ese el tótem? Vaya, cuánto tiempo sin tener el búho conmigo. Aunque me pregunto si los tótems del Águila y del Búho tienen el mismo poder místico.
Tribal Aggression#026.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#027.src: To think, such a long war could end so quickly and by the help of a single person.
Tribal Aggression#027.dst: Quién lo diría: una guerra tan larga, terminada tan deprisa y con la ayuda de una sola persona.
Tribal Aggression#027.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#028.src: Many thanks to you! I shall keep my promise, please accept this reward, and may the Owl be forever with you.
Tribal Aggression#028.dst: ¡Muchísimas gracias! Cumpliré mi promesa; acepta esta recompensa, y que el Búho te acompañe siempre.
Tribal Aggression#028.speaker: Caras

Troubled Tribesmen#002.src: Hey! Aren't these people fascinating? They sure smell bad, though! What? That Tribesman said my name?! Amazing! I've been trying to communicate with them for weeks.
Troubled Tribesmen#002.dst: ¡Eh! ¿A que esta gente es fascinante? ¡Aunque huelen fatal! ¿Qué? ¡¿Ese miembro de la tribu ha dicho mi nombre?! ¡Increíble! Llevo semanas intentando comunicarme con ellos.
Troubled Tribesmen#002.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#003.src: He sure seems like a distressed little fellow. He keeps pointing to that huge tree right there. A {p} keeper once told me it's possible to speak with them.
Troubled Tribesmen#003.dst: Se le ve muy angustiado al pobre. No para de señalar ese árbol enorme de ahí. Un guardián de {p} me dijo una vez que se puede hablar con ellos.
Troubled Tribesmen#003.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#004.src: He told me that within the woods there is a Shaman who will grant certain people permission to speak their language. I did some traveling through the jungle and actually found him!
Troubled Tribesmen#004.dst: Me dijo que en el bosque hay un chamán que concede a ciertas personas el permiso para hablar su idioma. Recorrí un poco la jungla, ¡y de verdad lo encontré!
Troubled Tribesmen#004.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#005.src: But despite my efforts, he just sat in silence with his eyes closed. He must of known I wasn't a threat because he was totally exposed. He had no interest in speaking with me, though.
Troubled Tribesmen#005.dst: Pero por mucho que lo intenté, se quedó sentado en silencio con los ojos cerrados. Sabría que yo no era una amenaza, porque estaba totalmente expuesto. Pero no quiso hablar conmigo.
Troubled Tribesmen#005.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#006.src: Say, who knows, maybe the Shaman will talk to you. It would greatly assist my research if you could help me talk to them. So why don't you give it a shot?
Troubled Tribesmen#006.dst: Oye, quién sabe, igual el chamán sí te habla a ti. Si me ayudas a hablar con ellos, sería de gran ayuda para mi investigación. ¿Por qué no lo intentas?
Troubled Tribesmen#006.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#007.src: Follow this path to the north. Keep going past the pond and the path will split to the West and to the East. Take the West path, and you will see the Shaman.
Troubled Tribesmen#007.dst: Sigue este camino hacia el norte. Pasado el estanque, el camino se divide al oeste y al este. Toma el del oeste y verás al chamán.
Troubled Tribesmen#007.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#009.src: Oui ryja y bufanvim vaam ypuid oui, cdnyhkan. So baubma yna eh tyhkan. Bmayca, dyga drec yht ramb bas.
Troubled Tribesmen#009.dst: Oui ryja y bufanvim vaam ypuid oui, cdnyhkan. So baubma yna eh tyhkan. Bmayca, dyga drec yht ramb bas.
Troubled Tribesmen#009.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#010.src: I have cast a spell on you. If you can understand me, you are pure of heart.
Troubled Tribesmen#010.dst: Te he lanzado un hechizo. Si me entiendes, eres puro de corazón.
Troubled Tribesmen#010.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#011.src: This spell will allow those of true spirit to speak and comprehend our language. I have entrusted you with this because of my connection with our sacred tree, who we call Entamis.
Troubled Tribesmen#011.dst: Este hechizo permite a los de espíritu sincero hablar y entender nuestro idioma. Te lo he confiado por mi vínculo con nuestro árbol sagrado, al que llamamos Entamis.
Troubled Tribesmen#011.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#012.src: I am the shaman of my tribe. I sit here every day with my eyes closed and carefully monitor Entamis' wavelengths. She has not been responding to my calls as of late...
Troubled Tribesmen#012.dst: Soy el chamán de mi tribu. Me siento aquí cada día con los ojos cerrados y vigilo con cuidado las ondas de Entamis. Últimamente no responde a mis llamadas...
Troubled Tribesmen#012.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#013.src: Dear human, your presence emits warmth and trust. Please go speak with my apprentice, Ka L'argwit. He is to take my place as shaman when I pass from this life.
Troubled Tribesmen#013.dst: Querido humano, tu presencia transmite calidez y confianza. Ve a hablar con mi aprendiz, Ka L'argwit. Él ocupará mi lugar como chamán cuando yo deje esta vida.
Troubled Tribesmen#013.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#014.src: He would know if anything is causing our beautiful tree discomfort. The spell I have cast on you will allow you to speak with him.
Troubled Tribesmen#014.dst: Él sabría si algo está haciendo sufrir a nuestro hermoso árbol. El hechizo que te lancé te permitirá hablar con él.
Troubled Tribesmen#014.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#015.src: Now, please go seek out Ka L'argwit.
Troubled Tribesmen#015.dst: Ahora, ve a buscar a Ka L'argwit.
Troubled Tribesmen#015.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#018.src: Thank you for coming. We haven't but moments. The monster's name is Aenara. He's a fiendish monster of corruption.
Troubled Tribesmen#018.dst: Gracias por venir. Apenas nos queda tiempo. El monstruo se llama Aenara. Es un monstruo diabólico de la Corrupción.
Troubled Tribesmen#018.speaker: Entamis

Troubled Tribesmen#019.src: He unleashed egg pods that host a variety of magic draining insects. They are eating me alive and replacing my magic with evil magic. Soon I will die.
Troubled Tribesmen#019.dst: Liberó vainas de huevos llenas de insectos que absorben magia. Me están devorando viva y cambian mi magia por magia maligna. Pronto moriré.
Troubled Tribesmen#019.speaker: Entamis

Troubled Tribesmen#020.src: You mustn't let me be reborn a creature of evil...
Troubled Tribesmen#020.dst: No dejes que renazca como una criatura del mal...
Troubled Tribesmen#020.speaker: Entamis

Troubled Tribesmen#021.src: Kill Aenara and bring an Insect of Corruption to Shaman Inrekei.
Troubled Tribesmen#021.dst: Mata a Aenara y lleva un Insecto de la Corrupción al chamán Inrekei.

Troubled Tribesmen#022.src: Hello again. I am grateful you returned. You don't need to say anything, though. I can no longer sense Entamis. I know she has died..
Troubled Tribesmen#022.dst: Hola de nuevo. Te agradezco que hayas vuelto. Pero no hace falta que digas nada. Ya no siento a Entamis. Sé que ha muerto...
Troubled Tribesmen#022.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#023.src: You still have managed to prevent her corrupted magic to spread any further. And for that, my people are forever in your debt.
Troubled Tribesmen#023.dst: Aun así, has logrado impedir que su magia corrupta se siga extendiendo. Por eso, mi pueblo estará siempre en deuda contigo.
Troubled Tribesmen#023.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#024.src: This insect appears to be the queen. I'll need to perform a ritual to kill it permanently. But never mind that, I can do that in my own time.
Troubled Tribesmen#024.dst: Este insecto parece ser la reina. Tendré que hacer un ritual para matarla para siempre. Pero no te preocupes, ya lo haré a su debido tiempo.
Troubled Tribesmen#024.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#025.src: Please take this. It is but a small gift. Your currency means nothing to us. In times of peril, few step forward and risk their lives to save those they do not know.
Troubled Tribesmen#025.dst: Toma esto, por favor. Es solo un pequeño regalo. Tu dinero no significa nada para nosotros. En tiempos de peligro, pocos arriesgan su vida por salvar a desconocidos.
Troubled Tribesmen#025.speaker: Inrekei

True Colours#000.dst: - Sujeto #{~}. Robó comida de la cafetería.

True Colours#001.src: - Subjects require sustenance based on the form they are currently using.
True Colours#001.dst: - Los sujetos necesitan alimento según la forma que usen.

True Colours#002.src: - Leave no gaps in the cell. Subjects may transform into small creatures in order to escape.
True Colours#002.dst: - No dejar huecos en la celda. Los sujetos pueden transformarse en criaturas pequeñas para escapar.

True Colours#005.src: The cabinet is locked. A label reads: Project Hallowground.
True Colours#005.dst: El armario está cerrado. Una etiqueta dice: Proyecto Hallowground.

True Colours#009.src: Feel free to take the zipline up to the canopy.
True Colours#009.dst: Puedes subir en tirolina hasta las copas.

True Colours#012.src: Alright, enough games. Now, dance for me! Hehehahehah!
True Colours#012.dst: Bien, basta de juegos. ¡Ahora baila para mí! ¡Jejejajejá!

True Colours#014.src: Changelings are a great asset to any army. They are proven excellent spies.
True Colours#014.dst: Los cambiaformas son un gran activo militar. Son espías excelentes.

True Colours#015.src: - Provide subjects with daily stimulus. Enquire with instructors on current curriculum.
True Colours#015.dst: - Dar estímulos diarios a los sujetos. Consultar el plan actual con los instructores.

True Colours#017.src: - Yusanu. Wanted. Will be held until Sovereign Majin arrives.
True Colours#017.dst: - Yusanu. En busca y captura. Retenido hasta que llegue el Soberano Majin.

True Colours#018.src: ...and she needed help. Needed someone powerful - someone from Fruma, but who had also seen... well, all of it. The world, and their impact on it.
True Colours#018.dst: ...y necesitaba ayuda. Necesitaba a alguien poderoso - alguien de Fruma, pero que además hubiera visto... bueno, todo. El mundo y el efecto que tienen en él.

True Colours#020.src: Their biology makes them easily adaptable to any situation, they can easily become heat resistant or cold resistant.
True Colours#020.dst: Su biología los hace adaptarse con facilidad a cualquier situación; pueden volverse resistentes al calor o al frío sin problema.

True Colours#022.src: ...there has to be a key around here somewhere.
True Colours#022.dst: ...tiene que haber una llave por aquí en alguna parte.

True Colours#023.src: Meet up with The Canopy at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#024.src: {u}! Did you hear? They- they finished, um, sorting through the reports!
True Colours#024.dst: ¡{u}! ¿Sabes qué? ¡Han- han terminado, eh, de revisar los informes!
True Colours#024.speaker: Sui

True Colours#025.src: Azael says he has news about everyone from the Roughworks!
True Colours#025.dst: ¡Azael dice que tiene noticias de todos los de Roughworks!
True Colours#025.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#026.src: Indeed... indeed. Ehm... where to begin...
True Colours#026.speaker: Azael

True Colours#027.src: Outsiders, I would... temper your expectations.
True Colours#027.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#029.src: I am afraid we are sorely lacking in good news. The Owls have returned with reports of a rather sudden influx of prisoners taken to Deraj Prison following the festival.
True Colours#029.dst: Me temo que andamos muy escasos de buenas noticias. Los Búhos han vuelto con informes de una entrada repentina y masiva de presos en la prisión de Deraj tras el festival.
True Colours#029.speaker: Azael

True Colours#031.src: No... no, no, it- it can't be, there- there has to be another explanation...
True Colours#031.dst: No... no, no, no- no puede ser, tiene- tiene que haber otra explicación...
True Colours#031.speaker: Sui

True Colours#032.src: Ah, Gravity's Monolith... it truly is a sight to behold, dark carved stone and burning crimson lights shining deep in the southern wastes...
True Colours#032.dst: Ah, el Monolito de la Gravedad... es todo un espectáculo: piedra oscura tallada y luces carmesí ardiendo en lo hondo de los yermos del sur...
True Colours#032.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#033.src: A shame it's inescapable, or I'd love to pay a visit. It's true, what they say- there is no escaping its pull once it gets a hold of you!
True Colours#033.dst: Lástima que no se pueda escapar de él, o me encantaría hacerle una visita. Es verdad lo que dicen- ¡una vez te agarra, no hay quien escape de su tirón!
True Colours#033.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#034.src: I... I've, I've heard the rumors... are- are they really true?
True Colours#034.dst: Yo... he, he oído los rumores... ¿son- son verdad?
True Colours#034.speaker: Sui

True Colours#035.src: As far as we can tell. We don't have a single record of a successful escape attempt. Supposedly, the Warden's blessing keeps the prisoners in line.
True Colours#035.dst: Por lo que sabemos. No tenemos ni un solo registro de una fuga con éxito. Al parecer, la bendición del alcaide mantiene a raya a los presos.
True Colours#035.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#037.src: Cileon, goodness! There's no need for the dramatics! What they mean to say, dear friends, is that none who enter are ever heard from again!
True Colours#037.dst: ¡Cileon, por favor! ¡No hace falta tanto dramatismo! Lo que quiere decir, queridos amigos, es que de los que entran nunca se vuelve a saber nada.
True Colours#037.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#038.src: Gravity's Monolith, they call it... an inescapable pull, drawing you deeper and deeper into its clutches the more you try to break free!
True Colours#038.dst: El Monolito de la Gravedad, lo llaman... un tirón del que no se escapa, ¡que te arrastra más y más hondo cuanto más intentas soltarte!
True Colours#038.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#039.src: Oh, you're one to talk about dramatics. But he's right. I wouldn't get your hopes up.
True Colours#039.dst: Ay, mira quién habla de dramatismo. Pero tiene razón. Yo no me haría ilusiones.
True Colours#039.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#040.src: Unfortunately, it would seem we also lack the details on who specifically has been sent there.
True Colours#040.dst: Por desgracia, parece que tampoco sabemos a quién han enviado allí exactamente.
True Colours#040.speaker: Azael

True Colours#041.src: Sigh. Azael, sir, it's cruel to leave them in the dark. You need to tell them.
True Colours#041.dst: Ay. Azael, señor, es cruel dejarlos a oscuras. Tiene que decírselo.
True Colours#041.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#043.src: I suppose you are right, captain. It is regarding the older woman among your party... Syndra, was it?
True Colours#043.dst: Supongo que tienes razón, capitana. Es sobre la mujer mayor de vuestro grupo... Syndra, ¿verdad?
True Colours#043.speaker: Azael

True Colours#044.src: It would seem that Her Majesty has made her into a statement.
True Colours#044.dst: Parece que Su Majestad ha hecho de ella un escarmiento.
True Colours#044.speaker: Azael

True Colours#046.src: She was publicly executed during the festival, as a way to send a message.
True Colours#046.dst: La ejecutaron en público durante el festival, para enviar un mensaje.
True Colours#046.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#047.src: Subtle as a brick, aren't you?
True Colours#047.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#048.src: I apologize. This must be a shock. It is my understanding she was something of a leader to you all.
True Colours#048.dst: Lo siento. Debe de ser un golpe duro. Tengo entendido que era una especie de líder para todos vosotros.
True Colours#048.speaker: Azael

True Colours#049.src: So it would seem. My, it has been an age since Her Majesty last performed such an act... how interesting, that she would deem it necessary.
True Colours#049.dst: Eso parece. Vaya, hacía una eternidad que Su Majestad no hacía algo así... qué interesante que lo haya creído necesario.
True Colours#049.speaker: Azael

True Colours#050.src: But rest assured that her death will not be for nought. She fought like a true warrior, to the bitter end.
True Colours#050.dst: Pero tened por seguro que su muerte no será en vano. Luchó como una auténtica guerrera hasta el amargo final.
True Colours#050.speaker: Azael

True Colours#051.dst: Yo....... n- no, yo.... ella... no p- puede.... yo.... yo-
True Colours#051.speaker: Sui

True Colours#053.src: Yes, a fine idea, Cileon. Space - that we certainly can provide!
True Colours#053.dst: Sí, buena idea, Cileon. Espacio - ¡eso desde luego podemos darlo!
True Colours#053.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#054.src: Ugh. Fine. Captains, let's talk plans. Come on.
True Colours#054.dst: Uf. Está bien. Capitanes, hablemos de planes. Vamos.
True Colours#054.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#055.src: Talk to Sui and Yusanu at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#055.dst: Habla con Sui y Yusanu en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#057.src: I... I didn't think she could... how...?
True Colours#057.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#058.src: She... she d-died, and we... w-we all got separated. She died and... she's d-dead. D-dead dead... dead. She's... dead.
True Colours#058.dst: Ella... m-murió, y a nosotros... n-nos separaron. Murió y... está m-muerta. M-muerta muerta... muerta. Está... muerta.
True Colours#058.speaker: Sui

True Colours#059.src: And the others... to Deraj? What... what are we going to do now?
True Colours#059.dst: Y los demás... ¿a Deraj? ¿Qué... qué vamos a hacer ahora?
True Colours#059.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#060.src: N-no, we... we can't. You... you heard Rurie. There's no escaping once they take you there...
True Colours#060.dst: N-no, no... no podemos. Ya... ya has oído a Rurie. Una vez te llevan allí, no hay salida...
True Colours#060.speaker: Sui

True Colours#061.src: I... I've lost too many people to th-that place. So many friends, c-captured and... and taken...
True Colours#061.dst: Yo... he perdido a demasiada gente por c-culpa de ese sitio. Tantos amigos, c-capturados y... y llevados allí...
True Colours#061.speaker: Sui

True Colours#063.src: {u}, are you really considering this?! You can't just- just- throw yourself into a suicide mission!
True Colours#063.dst: {u}, ¡¿de verdad te lo estás planteando?! ¡No puedes- no puedes- lanzarte a una misión suicida!
True Colours#063.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#064.src: ...fine. Fine! Just... make sure you c-come back. The three of us, we... we're all that's, ha, left.
True Colours#064.dst: ...está bien. ¡Está bien! Solo... asegúrate de v-volver. Nosotros tres somos... ja, lo único que queda.
True Colours#064.speaker: Sui

True Colours#066.src: I need to get back to work. Keep trying to align the resonances... maybe if I get it to work, it'll actually help us...
True Colours#066.dst: Tengo que volver al trabajo. Seguiré intentando alinear las resonancias... quizá, si lo consigo, nos sirva de algo...
True Colours#066.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#067.src: ...{u}, um. You should... tell Master Azael what you're doing. Before you... go.
True Colours#067.dst: ...{u}, eh. Deberías... contarle al maestro Azael lo que vas a hacer. Antes de... irte.
True Colours#067.speaker: Sui

True Colours#068.src: Say good bye to Master Azael before heading to the Deraj Prison at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#068.dst: Despídete del maestro Azael antes de ir a la prisión de Deraj en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#069.src: Stupid... resonance core. Pink, green, blue, white, gold... what am I supposed to even do with this?!
