True Colours#452.src: Find your weapon before you proceed further. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#452.dst: Encuentra tu arma antes de seguir. Si necesitas volver al campamento, ve a [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#453.src: Hey! We can't leave without our belongings.
True Colours#453.dst: ¡Eh! No podemos irnos sin nuestras cosas.
True Colours#453.speaker: Sui

True Colours#456.src: I... I hope so, but... I'm not sure. The ocean still feels... off. Like, like a step to the left.
True Colours#456.dst: Yo... eso espero, pero... no estoy segura. El océano aún se siente... raro. Como, como un paso a la izquierda.
True Colours#456.speaker: Sui

True Colours#457.src: I... don't really, I don't have anything worth grabbing, here...
True Colours#457.dst: Yo... no, no tengo nada que valga la pena coger aquí...
True Colours#457.speaker: Sui

True Colours#458.src: Uh, I found this map... come here.
True Colours#458.dst: Eh, he encontrado este mapa... ven.
True Colours#458.speaker: Sui

True Colours#460.src: "{p}, Changeling Facility." So... this whole place is, um, probably crawling with them.
True Colours#460.dst: "{p}, Instalación de cambiaformas." Así que... todo esto está, eh, probablemente plagado de ellos.
True Colours#460.speaker: Sui

True Colours#461.src: This... this m-might be, um, harder than I thought it might be. B-but! I can't give up. They're so close... where are they...?
True Colours#461.dst: Esto... esto p-podría ser, eh, más difícil de lo que pensaba. ¡P-pero! No puedo rendirme. Están muy cerca... ¿dónde están...?
True Colours#461.speaker: Sui

True Colours#463.src: And the Sovereign's office looks like it's at the very back of the building...
True Colours#463.dst: Y el despacho del Soberano parece estar al fondo del todo del edificio...
True Colours#463.speaker: Sui

True Colours#464.src: There's a, another block of cells right outside. If we're careful enough... maybe we can avoid a confrontation with the Sovereign.
True Colours#464.dst: Hay un, otro bloque de celdas justo fuera. Si tenemos cuidado... quizá evitemos enfrentarnos al Soberano.
True Colours#464.speaker: Sui

True Colours#465.src: ...th-thanks for being here, {u}. I... I would've given up a long time ago if you weren't.
True Colours#465.dst: ...g-gracias por estar aquí, {u}. Yo... me habría rendido hace mucho si no fuera por ti.
True Colours#465.speaker: Sui

True Colours#466.src: Continue exploring the Changeling Camp and look for your friends. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#466.dst: Sigue explorando el campamento de cambiaformas y busca a tus amigos. Si necesitas volver al campamento, ve a [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#467.src: Continue to the Officer's Quarters in the southern wing. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#467.dst: Sigue hasta los aposentos de oficiales del ala sur. Si necesitas volver al campamento, ve a [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#468.src: Here for a duel?! I love duels?! I love fighting?! I love life?!
True Colours#468.dst: ¡¿A batirte en duelo?! ¡¿Amo los duelos?! ¡¿Amo luchar?! ¡¿Amo la vida?!

True Colours#469.src: C-careful! That's... Sovereign Gikyo's office up ahead. Let's, um, try and avoid them.
True Colours#469.dst: ¡C-cuidado! Ahí delante está... el despacho del Soberano Gikyo. Intentemos, eh, no cruzarnos con Gikyo.
True Colours#469.speaker: Sui

True Colours#471.src: No... n-no, no no no, no- no...
True Colours#471.dst: No... n-no, no no no, no- no...
True Colours#471.speaker: Sui

True Colours#472.src: It's... it's a ticket. From the... Steel Feather... the ones... Quill gave us...
True Colours#472.dst: Es... es un billete. De la... Pluma de Acero... los que... nos dio Quill...
True Colours#472.speaker: Sui

True Colours#474.src: There- ha, there, th-there's no way s-some-someone could, ha, survive... this...
True Colours#474.dst: No- ja, no, n-no hay forma de que al- alguien pudiera, ja, sobrevivir a... esto...
True Colours#474.speaker: Sui

True Colours#475.src: How... h-how dare they... how DARE they?! Th-they have to pay for this, {u}, they- they have to!!
True Colours#475.dst: ¿Cómo... c-cómo se atreven...? ¡¿Cómo SE ATREVEN?! T-tienen que pagarlo, {u}, ¡¡tie- tienen que pagarlo!!
True Colours#475.speaker: Sui

True Colours#476.src: Come on... come on, come on, we- we need to confront Gikyo, we- come on!!
True Colours#476.dst: Vamos... vamos, vamos, te- tenemos que enfrentarnos a Gikyo, nos- ¡¡vamos!!
True Colours#476.speaker: Sui

True Colours#477.src: Head to Sovereign Gikyo's office to confront them. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#477.dst: Ve al despacho del Soberano Gikyo para plantarle cara. Si necesitas volver al campamento, ve a [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#480.src: Well well, look who has stumbled on in! If it is not the crown's number one wanted and the silly weak sister! Were you not locked up?
True Colours#480.dst: ¡Vaya, vaya, mira quién ha entrado a trompicones! ¡Si es el más buscado de la Corona y la hermanita tonta y débil! ¿No estabais encerrados?
True Colours#480.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#481.src: No... you... wh- what did you... what did you DO?!
True Colours#481.dst: No... tú... ¿q- qué has...? ¡¿Qué le has HECHO?!
True Colours#481.speaker: Sui

True Colours#482.src: Hehehehahaha! Oh, this? Why it's the prodigal son of course! Go on, say hello to your little sister, big brother!!
True Colours#482.dst: ¡Jejejejajaja! ¿Oh, esto? ¡Pues el hijo pródigo, claro! ¡¡Vamos, saluda a tu hermanita, hermano mayor!!
True Colours#482.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#483.src: You should know I did offer the opportunity to speak, yes yes indeed! If only he would have spat up all those deep deep secrets on your group... could his pain have been avoided?
True Colours#483.dst: Que sepas que sí le ofrecí la oportunidad de hablar, ¡sí sí, desde luego! Si tan solo hubiera escupido todos esos secretos tan tan hondos de tu grupo... ¿se habría ahorrado el dolor?
True Colours#483.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#484.src: But but but but but sad as it is, he refused to say a word! What a shame indeed, indeed. A long deep dark painful agonizing death it was!
True Colours#484.dst: ¡Pero pero pero pero pero, qué pena, no quiso decir ni una palabra! Qué lástima, de verdad, de verdad. ¡Fue una muerte larga, honda, oscura, dolorosa y agónica!
True Colours#484.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#485.src: Well since you are here and the rest are taken it would seem it was for naught! I have every little dove just where I want them, yes yes I do.
True Colours#485.dst: Bueno, ya que estás aquí y los demás están atrapados, ¡parece que fue en vano! Tengo a cada pequeña paloma justo donde quiero, sí sí, así es.
True Colours#485.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#486.src: Yes! Shooty girl and wind boy! Rex and Zeph I believe it was?
True Colours#486.dst: ¡Sí! ¡La chica que dispara y el chico del viento! Rex y Zeph, ¿no se llamaban?
True Colours#486.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#487.src: Wind boy was always crying and screaming... how pathetic. But shooty girl... yes shooty girl was a delight.
True Colours#487.dst: El chico del viento no paraba de llorar y chillar... qué patético. Pero la chica que dispara... sí, esa era una delicia.
True Colours#487.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#488.src: Never let out a word no matter the pain! The ones like her are always the most most most fun to crack, yes they are.
True Colours#488.dst: ¡Ni una palabra, por mucho que le doliera! Las como ella son siempre las más más más divertidas de quebrar, sí señor.
True Colours#488.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#489.src: Alas... all good things must come to an end it would seem! The killjoy Sovereign {p}, swooping in and ruining ALL my fun...
True Colours#489.dst: Ay... ¡parece que todo lo bueno se acaba! El aguafiestas del Soberano de {p}, que llegó en picado y me arruinó TODA la diversión...
True Colours#489.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#490.src: Noooo Gikyo you cannot keep your prisoners no matter how much you wish, no no no, the people {p} demand their girl returned and well who am I to stand against them?
True Colours#490.dst: Noooo, Gikyo, no puedes quedarte con tus prisioneros por mucho que quieras, no no no, el pueblo de {p} exige que le devuelvan a su chica, y bueno, ¿quién soy yo para oponerme?
True Colours#490.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#491.src: And so ended the fun that was being had! But I had the last laugh, ehehehaha. The Athassa girl could take one and not both of the companions! A choice? A choice!
True Colours#491.dst: ¡Y así se acabó la diversión! Pero reí el último, ejejejajá. ¡La chica Athassa podía llevarse a uno de los compañeros, no a los dos! ¿Una elección? ¡Una elección!
True Colours#491.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#492.src: Oh the noble hero that he was, he chose to stay! What a bore. But what a joy! What a joy joy joy joy joy!
True Colours#492.dst: ¡Oh, el noble héroe eligió quedarse! Qué aburrimiento. ¡Pero qué alegría! ¡Qué alegría alegría alegría alegría alegría!
True Colours#492.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#493.src: And now where is he? Bleeding out, dying, fading, vanishing with each and every passing moment! And it would seem perhaps he is the lucky one!
True Colours#493.dst: ¿Y dónde está ahora? ¡Desangrándose, muriendo, apagándose, desvaneciéndose con cada instante que pasa! ¡Y quizá él sea el afortunado!
True Colours#493.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#494.src: Well then! Would you care to join him in this dance? To the end of days - yours end HERE and NOW!
True Colours#494.dst: ¡Pues bien! ¿Te apetece unirte a él en este baile? Hasta el fin de los días - ¡los tuyos acaban AQUÍ y AHORA!
True Colours#494.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#495.src: Defeat Sovereign Gikyo. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#495.dst: Derrota al Soberano Gikyo. Si necesitas volver al campamento, ve a [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#496.src: Check up on Sui. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#496.dst: Ve a ver cómo está Sui. Si necesitas volver al campamento, ve a [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#497.src: He's... he's my brother... give... give him... back...
True Colours#497.dst: Es... es mi hermano... devuélve... devuélvemelo...
True Colours#497.speaker: Sui

True Colours#500.src: He's dead. He's... dead he's dead he's dead, but so is that BASTARD!!!
True Colours#500.dst: Está muerto. Está... muerto muerto muerto, ¡¡¡pero ese CABRÓN también!!!
True Colours#500.speaker: Sui

True Colours#501.src: And it... it... it doesn't even matter. I killed them, and... and... and what now? M- Mora, he's- he's still...
True Colours#501.dst: Y eso... eso... ni siquiera importa. Acabé con Gikyo, y... y... ¿y ahora qué? M- Mora, él- él sigue...
True Colours#501.speaker: Sui

True Colours#504.src: No?? Then what do you CALL this?! Rex and Zeph are gone and Mora is- h-he's... he... he's...
True Colours#504.dst: ¿¿No?? ¡¿Entonces cómo LLAMAS a esto?! Rex y Zeph no están y Mora está- e-él está... él... está...
True Colours#504.speaker: Sui

True Colours#505.src: We... we weren't fast enough... we took too long to get here, a-and now... and now...
True Colours#505.dst: No... no fuimos lo bastante rápidos... tardamos demasiado en llegar, y-y ahora... y ahora...
True Colours#505.speaker: Sui

True Colours#506.src: I already GOT revenge, {u}!! I didn't... I didn't know I... it- it happened so fast, and... and... I killed them. I got revenge and... and I still feel hollow.
True Colours#506.dst: ¡¡Ya me he VENGADO, {u}!! No... no sabía que... p- pasó tan rápido, y... y... acabé con Gikyo. Me he vengado y... y sigo sintiéndome vacía.
True Colours#506.speaker: Sui

True Colours#507.src: He's... gone. He's gone, and- a-and I can't... I can't get him back...
True Colours#507.dst: Se ha... ido. Se ha ido, y- y-y no puedo... no puedo recuperarlo...
True Colours#507.speaker: Sui

True Colours#509.src: We- we need to g-get out of here, I- I- I can't... I can't be here. I can't... I c-can't look at him.
True Colours#509.dst: Te- tenemos que s-salir de aquí, no- no- no puedo... no puedo estar aquí. No puedo... no p-puedo mirarlo.
True Colours#509.speaker: Sui

True Colours#511.src: ...this is all my fault, isn't it?
True Colours#511.speaker: Sui

True Colours#512.src: I- I- all I've been DOING this whole time has been crying, worrying, and- and- and being USELESS!
True Colours#512.dst: Yo- yo- ¡lo único que he HECHO todo este tiempo es llorar, preocuparme y- y- y ser una INÚTIL!
True Colours#512.speaker: Sui

True Colours#513.src: I was so afraid of my cur-... why, why, WHY can't I break that habit?! Magic. Magic magic magic magic MAGIC!!
True Colours#513.dst: Tenía tanto miedo de mi maldi-... ¡¿por qué, POR QUÉ no me quito esa manía?! Magia. ¡¡Magia magia magia MAGIA!!
True Colours#513.speaker: Sui

True Colours#514.src: I was so afraid that I never even tried!! If I had, if I- I- if I'd have learned more, been stronger...
True Colours#514.dst: ¡¡Tenía tanto miedo que ni lo intenté!! Si lo hubiera hecho, si- si- si hubiera aprendido más, si fuera más fuerte...
True Colours#514.speaker: Sui

True Colours#515.src: I... I could have... I could have saved him. I could have protected him, I could have healed him, I could have-
True Colours#515.dst: Yo... podría haber... podría haberlo salvado. Podría haberlo protegido, podría haberlo curado, podría haber-
True Colours#515.speaker: Sui

True Colours#516.src: But no, of COURSE NOT!! Because I'm worthless and useless and can't help ANYONE!!
True Colours#516.dst: Pero no, ¡¡CLARO QUE NO!! ¡¡Porque no valgo nada, soy una inútil y no puedo ayudar a NADIE!!
True Colours#516.speaker: Sui

True Colours#518.src: Rex and Zeph are- they're still out there. {u}, {u}, we can still save them. We- we know where they are!!
True Colours#518.dst: Rex y Zeph están- siguen ahí fuera. {u}, {u}, aún podemos salvarlos. ¡¡Sa- sabemos dónde están!!
True Colours#518.speaker: Sui

True Colours#519.src: We just... we just need to find the {p} Sovereign. He has them, he- he has to. He... he has to.
True Colours#519.dst: Solo... solo hay que encontrar al Soberano de {p}. Él los tiene, él- tiene que tenerlos. Tiene que tenerlos.
True Colours#519.speaker: Sui

True Colours#520.src: ...let's go. We can't- we can't let this happen again.
True Colours#520.dst: ...vamos. No podemos- no podemos dejar que vuelva a pasar.
True Colours#520.speaker: Sui

True Colours#521.src: Meet up with Yusanu and Captain Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#521.dst: Reúnete con Yusanu y el capitán Rurie en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#523.src: Hello, dear friends! I see you have returned to us safe and sound!
True Colours#523.dst: ¡Hola, queridos amigos! ¡Veo que habéis vuelto sanos y salvos!
True Colours#523.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#524.src: We found everything we were looking for, and- and more!! Plans, Sui, plans!! Of Deraj prison!!
True Colours#524.dst: ¡¡Encontramos todo lo que buscábamos, y- y más!! ¡¡Planos, Sui, planos!! ¡¡De la prisión de Deraj!!
True Colours#524.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#525.src: It would seem our dear Changeling Sovereign worked closely with the prison's warden... for what purpose remains unclear, though I imagine something changeling-adjacent?
True Colours#525.dst: Parece que nuestro querido Soberano de los cambiaformas colaboraba de cerca con el alcaide de la prisión... con qué fin, no se sabe, aunque ¿imagino que algo de cambiaformas?
True Colours#525.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#526.src: Sui, with- with these plans, we could... we could stand a chance of breaking everyone out! We could- we could get them all back!
True Colours#526.dst: Sui, con- con estos planos, podríamos... ¡podríamos tener una oportunidad de sacar a todos! ¡Podríamos- podríamos recuperarlos a todos!
True Colours#526.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#532.src: They're gone, Yusanu! Mora's- Mora's dead.
True Colours#532.dst: ¡Ya no están, Yusanu! Mora está- Mora está muerto.
True Colours#532.speaker: Sui

True Colours#533.src: The Sovereign, they... they killed him.
True Colours#533.speaker: Sui

True Colours#535.src: Just... gone. Taken to the {p}. But, Mora is- he's-
True Colours#535.dst: Ya... no están. Se los llevaron a {p}. Pero Mora está- está-
True Colours#535.speaker: Sui

True Colours#536.src: So. So, I- I'm glad you have hope! For... for getting your people back! Good for you!!
True Colours#536.dst: Así que. Así que me- ¡me alegro de que tengas esperanza! De... ¡de recuperar a los tuyos! ¡¡Bien por ti!!
True Colours#536.speaker: Sui

True Colours#537.src: Emotions are... certainly running high right now, aren't they! Why don't we, ah, regroup with the rest of the Canopy, and... take some time?
True Colours#537.dst: Los ánimos están... bastante caldeados ahora mismo, ¿verdad? ¿Por qué no, eh, nos reunimos con el resto del Dosel y... nos tomamos un tiempo?
True Colours#537.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#538.src: Take. Some Time? No. No, I'm done taking time. I'm done crying, I'm done worrying! I'm so... so... angry! At the Crown, at myself, at- at Mora!!!!
True Colours#538.dst: ¿Tomarnos. Un tiempo? No. Se acabó. ¡Se acabó llorar, se acabó preocuparme! Estoy tan... tan... ¡furiosa! ¡Con la Corona, conmigo, con- con Mora!!!!
True Colours#538.speaker: Sui

True Colours#539.src: At all of you for treating me like I can't handle anything myself!!!
True Colours#539.dst: ¡¡¡Con todos vosotros por tratarme como si no pudiera hacer nada sola!!!
True Colours#539.speaker: Sui

True Colours#540.src: S-Sui, please, I- I understand, but-
True Colours#540.dst: S-Sui, por favor, lo- lo entiendo, pero-
True Colours#540.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#541.src: DO YOU?! Do you understand?! Because it SOUNDS like everything's all just fine for you! Your brothers are still alive! You even have a plan to get them back!!
True Colours#541.dst: ¡¿DE VERDAD?! ¡¿Lo entiendes?! ¡Porque PARECE que para ti todo va bien! ¡Tus hermanos siguen vivos! ¡¡Hasta tienes un plan para recuperarlos!!
True Colours#541.speaker: Sui

True Colours#542.src: Rex and Zeph, they... they need me. Need us! And... and I'm not letting anyone else get hurt, or- or- or d-die, not if I can stop it!!
True Colours#542.dst: Rex y Zeph... me necesitan. ¡Nos necesitan! Y... y no voy a dejar que nadie más salga herido, o- o- o m-muera, ¡¡no si puedo impedirlo!!
True Colours#542.speaker: Sui

True Colours#543.src: The Crown... the Sovereigns... the Queen... they'll pay. They'll pay for everything they've done to me, and my- m-my... my family...
True Colours#543.dst: La Corona... los Soberanos... la Reina... pagarán. Pagarán por todo lo que nos han hecho a mí y a mi- m-mi... mi familia...
True Colours#543.speaker: Sui

True Colours#545.src: And how exactly do you expect to be able to take vengeance in your current state, Sui? I beg of you, please rest before doing something so extreme!
True Colours#545.dst: ¿Y cómo pretendes exactamente vengarte en tu estado actual, Sui? ¡Te lo ruego, descansa antes de hacer algo tan extremo!
True Colours#545.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#546.src: Every minute I waste is another chance for something to go wrong!!! "Fading with each and every passing moment..."
True Colours#546.dst: ¡¡¡Cada minuto perdido es otra ocasión de que algo salga mal!!! "Desvaneciéndose con cada instante..."
True Colours#546.speaker: Sui

True Colours#547.src: If- if only we were there sooner, then- th-then... so- so, no. No, I can't rest! I will be getting my family back!
True Colours#547.dst: Si- si hubiéramos llegado antes, en- en-entonces... así- así que no. ¡No puedo descansar! ¡Voy a recuperar a mi familia!
True Colours#547.speaker: Sui

True Colours#548.src: Sui, we... we can't just storm off into a new district without a plan! The Canopy, they- they can help us! And Soosu's device, I'm so close to a breakthrough, I just need-
True Colours#548.dst: Sui, no... ¡no podemos lanzarnos a un distrito nuevo sin un plan! El Dosel, ellos- ¡ellos pueden ayudarnos! Y el aparato de Soosu, estoy a punto de lograrlo, solo necesito-
True Colours#548.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#549.src: Then stay behind, Yusanu. I... I don't need you, anyway.
True Colours#549.dst: Pues quédate, Yusanu. Yo... de todos modos no te necesito.
True Colours#549.speaker: Sui

True Colours#551.src: I said, I don't NEED you, Yusanu! What have you even done this whole time we've been in the {p}?! Taken as hostage, tinkering with- with- with that STUPID device!
True Colours#551.dst: ¡He dicho que no te NECESITO, Yusanu! ¡¿Qué has hecho siquiera en todo el tiempo que llevamos en {p}?! ¡Dejarte tomar como rehén, trastear con- con- con ese ESTÚPIDO aparato!
True Colours#551.speaker: Sui

True Colours#552.src: YOU haven't had to do any of the work! YOU didn't have to- to run random tasks without explanation! YOU didn't have to- to f-fight and k- k- kill a Sovereign! You... you...
True Colours#552.dst: ¡TÚ no has tenido que hacer nada! ¡TÚ no has tenido que- que hacer recados sin explicación! ¡TÚ no has tenido que- que l-luchar y m- m- matar a un Soberano! Tú... tú...
True Colours#552.speaker: Sui

True Colours#555.src: Is... is there nothing I can say to convince you not to go?
True Colours#555.dst: ¿No... no hay nada que pueda decirte para convencerte de que no vayas?
True Colours#555.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#557.src: Fine. I... I can't follow you, Sui, I can't. I'm going to stay with the Canopy... I'm going to save everyone from Deraj... and I'm going to keep working.
True Colours#557.dst: Vale. No... no puedo seguirte, Sui, no puedo. Me quedaré con el Dosel... voy a sacar a todos de Deraj... y seguiré trabajando.
True Colours#557.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#558.src: ...well, this doesn't have to be goodbye for good, does it? We shall go our separate paths, for a time, then link back together further down the line!
True Colours#558.dst: ...bueno, esto no tiene por qué ser un adiós definitivo, ¿verdad? ¡Seguiremos caminos separados un tiempo y luego volveremos a juntarnos más adelante!
True Colours#558.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#560.src: Hm. If you're set on this path, you'll surely be dealing with the {p} Sovereign. Ah, Majin of House Thalas... what a delightfully horrible man he is.
True Colours#560.dst: Mm. Si estás decidida, seguro que tendrás que vértelas con el Soberano de {p}. Ah, Majin de la Casa Thalas... qué hombre tan deliciosamente horrible.
True Colours#560.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#561.src: Experience? Ha! Hahahaha! Yes, I suppose you could say that! Goodness. Experience.
True Colours#561.dst: ¿Experiencia? ¡Ja! ¡Jajajaja! Sí, ¡supongo que podría decirse así! Cielos. Experiencia.
True Colours#561.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#562.src: A word of warning... he's an easy man to underestimate. All confidence, bluster, so insufferable you could hardly believe there's anything beneath it all!
True Colours#562.dst: Un aviso... es fácil subestimarlo. Todo confianza y fanfarronería, tan insufrible que cuesta creer que haya algo debajo.
True Colours#562.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#563.src: But his self-proclaimed "number one" position amongst the Sovereigns isn't just for show! His confidence, his demeanour... all of it is earned. As much as one may wish otherwise!
True Colours#563.dst: ¡Pero su autoproclamado puesto de "número uno" entre los Soberanos no es solo fachada! Su confianza, su porte... todo es merecido. ¡Por mucho que uno quisiera lo contrario!
True Colours#563.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#564.src: And there's nothing he loves more than to exert his influence over those beneath him. Which would be, ah... everybody?
True Colours#564.dst: Y nada le gusta más que imponer su influencia sobre los que están por debajo. Que serían, eh... ¿todos?
True Colours#564.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#565.src: ... If he has my family, then... it doesn't matter. I won't let him get in my way.
True Colours#565.dst: ... Si tiene a mi familia, entonces... da igual. No dejaré que se interponga en mi camino.
True Colours#565.speaker: Sui

True Colours#566.src: Ooh, frightening. Well, I've said my piece. The rest shall be up to you!
True Colours#566.dst: Uy, qué miedo. Bueno, ya he dicho lo mío. ¡El resto depende de vosotros!
True Colours#566.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#567.src: If you ever have need of us again, we'll have set up camp in the cave we first met. You remember the one, yes? Where I-
True Colours#567.dst: Si alguna vez volvéis a necesitarnos, habremos acampado en la cueva donde nos conocimos. Os acordáis, ¿verdad? Donde yo-
True Colours#567.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#568.src: Sui, I... I'm sorry for Mora. I hope you can... I hope you can save the others. I really do. Please... don't get yourself killed.
True Colours#568.dst: Sui, yo... siento lo de Mora. Espero que puedas... espero que puedas salvar a los demás. De verdad. Por favor... no dejes que te maten.
True Colours#568.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#569.src: ...I- I'm not planning on it. Bye, Yusanu.
True Colours#569.dst: ...no- no tengo pensado hacerlo. Adiós, Yusanu.
True Colours#569.speaker: Sui

Tunnel Trouble#000.src: Talk to Captain Fenor in front of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Tunnel Trouble#000.dst: Habla con el capitán Fenor delante de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Tunnel Trouble#001.src: Ah! You must be a new recruit! Well, I've got a mission for you.
Tunnel Trouble#001.dst: ¡Ah! Debes de ser el nuevo recluta. Bueno, tengo una misión para ti.
Tunnel Trouble#001.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#002.src: There's an old cave behind me. It was used in the Corruption Wars...
Tunnel Trouble#002.dst: Detrás de mí hay una cueva vieja. Se usó en las Guerras de la Corrupción...
Tunnel Trouble#002.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#003.src: We used it for quick and easy travel between {p} and {p}. It’s been abandoned for years.
Tunnel Trouble#003.dst: La usábamos para ir rápido entre {p} y {p}. Lleva años abandonada.
Tunnel Trouble#003.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#004.src: This cave could prove to be very useful for future recruits who need to travel between {p} and {p}.
Tunnel Trouble#004.dst: Esta cueva podría ser muy útil para los futuros reclutas que tengan que viajar entre {p} y {p}.
Tunnel Trouble#004.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#005.src: Now, here's where you come in - I need you to clear out that cave route so we can use it once more! Good luck, soldier!
Tunnel Trouble#005.dst: Y aquí entras tú: necesito que despejes esa ruta para poder usarla otra vez. ¡Suerte, soldado!
Tunnel Trouble#005.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#006.src: Enter the cave behind Captain Fenor at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Tunnel Trouble#006.dst: Entra en la cueva detrás del capitán Fenor en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Tunnel Trouble#007.src: ...Oh! Shoot, is it time to get to work already?
Tunnel Trouble#007.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#009.src: Uh... well, to start, we'll need to clear that debris. Just... give it a shove, or something. That'll probably do it.
Tunnel Trouble#009.dst: Eh... bueno, para empezar hay que quitar esos escombros. Solo... dales un empujón o algo. Seguro que basta.
Tunnel Trouble#009.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#010.src: Help Miner Linton remove the debris blocking the path.
Tunnel Trouble#010.dst: Ayuda al minero Linton a quitar los escombros que bloquean el paso.

Tunnel Trouble#011.src: Pretty easy, huh? Hey, maybe you can just go on ahead, and do the rest yourself?
Tunnel Trouble#011.dst: Fácil, ¿eh? Oye, ¿y si sigues tú solo y haces el resto por tu cuenta?
Tunnel Trouble#011.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#012.src: ...Yeah, no, I should probably do my job. Let me grab my pickaxe, and we can keep going forward.
Tunnel Trouble#012.dst: ...Ya, no, mejor hago mi trabajo. Déjame coger el pico y seguimos adelante.
Tunnel Trouble#012.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#013.src: Clear the cave of possible roadblocks.
Tunnel Trouble#013.dst: Despeja la cueva de posibles obstáculos.

Tunnel Trouble#014.src: Oh, come on... Hey, soldier, do your job! Get rid of those monsters, would you?
Tunnel Trouble#014.dst: Oh, venga... ¡Eh, soldado, haz tu trabajo! ¿Quitas a esos monstruos?
Tunnel Trouble#014.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#016.src: A cave-in? Really? More work for me... I'll make us a way through, just keep fighting those corrupteds!
Tunnel Trouble#016.dst: ¿Un derrumbe? ¿En serio? Más trabajo para mí... Yo abro paso, ¡tú sigue con los corruptos!
Tunnel Trouble#016.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#017.src: Halfway there... Ugh, I knew I should have brought explosives...
Tunnel Trouble#017.dst: A mitad de camino... Uf, sabía que debí traer explosivos...
Tunnel Trouble#017.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#018.src: I can see the other side! Just a little more...
Tunnel Trouble#018.dst: ¡Ya veo el otro lado! Un poco más...
Tunnel Trouble#018.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#019.src: There we go, I've made us a hole! Get over here, quickly!
Tunnel Trouble#019.dst: ¡Listo, ya hay un hueco! ¡Ven aquí, rápido!
Tunnel Trouble#019.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#020.src: ...Oh, come on. You've got to be kidding me. Another cave-in? Really?
Tunnel Trouble#020.dst: ...Oh, venga ya. Es broma, ¿no? ¿Otro derrumbe? ¿En serio?
Tunnel Trouble#020.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#021.src: And of course it's bigger than the last one. What's my pickaxe going to do against this thing?!
Tunnel Trouble#021.dst: Y claro, más grande que el anterior. ¡¿Qué va a hacer mi pico contra esto?!
Tunnel Trouble#021.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#022.src: Really should have thought to bring explosives. Well, soldier, we tried our best! Nobody'll blame us if we give up now.
Tunnel Trouble#022.dst: Debí pensar en traer explosivos. ¡Bueno, soldado, lo intentamos! Nadie nos culpará si lo dejamos ya.
Tunnel Trouble#022.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#023.src: ...What? Don't look at me like that. Fine, we can- huh? Do you hear that? Over there, to the right.
Tunnel Trouble#023.dst: ...¿Qué? No me mires así. Vale, podemos- ¿eh? ¿Oyes eso? Ahí, a la derecha.
Tunnel Trouble#023.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#024.src: Oh, uh... Hi... Well, this is a little awkward... I'll just... Go.
Tunnel Trouble#024.dst: Ah, eh... Hola... Esto es un poco incómodo... Mejor... me voy.

Tunnel Trouble#025.src: ...You know what? I'm not going to ask. As far as I'm concerned, that didn't happen.
Tunnel Trouble#025.dst: ...¿Sabes qué? No voy a preguntar. Para mí, eso no ha pasado.
Tunnel Trouble#025.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#026.src: Right, of course you want to check it out. Fine! Go ahead. I'll just... sit here and twiddle my thumbs 'till you're back.
Tunnel Trouble#026.dst: Ya, claro que quieres ir a mirar. ¡Vale! Ve. Yo me quedo aquí sentado sin hacer nada hasta que vuelvas.
Tunnel Trouble#026.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#027.src: Investigate the small hole to the right of the large pile of debris.
Tunnel Trouble#027.dst: Investiga el pequeño agujero a la derecha del gran montón de escombros.

Tunnel Trouble#028.src: Oh... Didn't expect you to follow me... Well, um... Hi! This will sound mad but...
Tunnel Trouble#028.dst: Oh... No esperaba que me siguieras... Bueno, em... ¡Hola! Sonará de locos, pero...
Tunnel Trouble#028.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#029.src: I'm Drale, and I'm on a mission to free these cows from the enslavement of {p}.
Tunnel Trouble#029.dst: Soy Drale, y mi misión es liberar a estas vacas de la esclavitud de {p}.
Tunnel Trouble#029.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#030.src: Those farmers stole those cows. They are sacred animals. Now they're about to turn them into steak! If you were to help me, maybe I could help you...
Tunnel Trouble#030.dst: Esos granjeros robaron las vacas. Son animales sagrados. ¡Y ahora van a convertirlas en filetes! Si me ayudaras, quizá yo podría ayudarte a ti...
Tunnel Trouble#030.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#031.src: Go free those innocent cows from enslavement! Qu-quickly! Before that farmer gets back...
Tunnel Trouble#031.dst: ¡Ve y libera a esas vacas inocentes de la esclavitud! ¡R-rápido! Antes de que vuelva ese granjero...
Tunnel Trouble#031.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#032.src: Where are you going? Come here and talk to me first.
Tunnel Trouble#032.dst: ¿Adónde vas? Ven aquí y habla conmigo primero.
Tunnel Trouble#032.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#033.src: Free the cows without being seen by the farmer.
Tunnel Trouble#033.dst: Libera a las vacas sin que te vea el granjero.

Tunnel Trouble#034.src: Go free the cows from the farmers before they're taken to the slaughterhouse! Oh man, the slaughterhouse...
Tunnel Trouble#034.dst: ¡Libera a las vacas de los granjeros antes de que las lleven al matadero! Ay, madre, el matadero...
Tunnel Trouble#034.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#035.src: Ah, good to see my cows are all in tip-top shape! Welp, time to- gah!
Tunnel Trouble#035.dst: ¡Ah, qué bien ver a mis vacas en plena forma! Bueno, hora de- ¡agh!
Tunnel Trouble#035.speaker: Bylvis

Tunnel Trouble#036.src: An intruder! What are you doing with my cows!? Guard golem, attack!
Tunnel Trouble#036.dst: ¡Un intruso! ¡¿Qué haces con mis vacas?! ¡Gólem guardián, al ataque!
Tunnel Trouble#036.speaker: Bylvis

Tunnel Trouble#037.dst: Derrota al gólem guardián del granjero.

Tunnel Trouble#038.src: Golem! No! That cost me thousands of emeralds!
Tunnel Trouble#038.speaker: Bylvis

Tunnel Trouble#039.src: Return to Drale about your success.
Tunnel Trouble#039.dst: Vuelve con Drale a contarle tu éxito.

Tunnel Trouble#040.src: Thank you so much, but we're not done yet. We need to get these cows out the province.
Tunnel Trouble#040.dst: Muchísimas gracias, pero aún no hemos terminado. Hay que sacar a estas vacas de la provincia.
Tunnel Trouble#040.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#041.src: There's a small opening behind me. Go through it and help me get these cows on a raft to Gavel!
Tunnel Trouble#041.dst: Detrás de mí hay una abertura pequeña. ¡Pasa por ahí y ayúdame a subir estas vacas a una balsa rumbo a Gavel!
Tunnel Trouble#041.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#042.src: Help Drale push the raft with the cows out to sea.
Tunnel Trouble#042.dst: Ayuda a Drale a empujar la balsa con las vacas hacia el mar.

Tunnel Trouble#043.src: There's the raft! Help me push it for the cows!
Tunnel Trouble#043.dst: ¡Ahí está la balsa! ¡Ayúdame a empujarla por las vacas!
Tunnel Trouble#043.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#044.src: And, that should do it! Be free, my friends! A new life awaits!
Tunnel Trouble#044.dst: ¡Y listo! ¡Sed libres, amigas! ¡Os espera una vida nueva!
Tunnel Trouble#044.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#045.src: Again, thank you so much for what you have done this day. These cows deserve a better life than being farm animals.
Tunnel Trouble#045.dst: De nuevo, muchísimas gracias por lo que has hecho hoy. Estas vacas merecen algo mejor que ser animales de granja.
Tunnel Trouble#045.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#046.src: ...Oh! Right! You were busy with something before you came to help me, weren't you? Hm... I think I might be able to help you with that as well! Let's go back to the tunnel!
Tunnel Trouble#046.dst: ...¡Oh! ¡Claro! Antes de venir a ayudarme estabas ocupado con algo, ¿no? Mmm... ¡Creo que con eso también puedo echarte una mano! ¡Volvamos al túnel!
Tunnel Trouble#046.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#047.src: Return to Miner Linton back in the abandoned cave.
Tunnel Trouble#047.dst: Vuelve con el minero Linton a la cueva abandonada.

Tunnel Trouble#048.src: Oh, good, you're back. It's been, like, an hour! What were you even doing for that long!
Tunnel Trouble#048.dst: Oh, bien, ya estás de vuelta. ¡Ha pasado como una hora! ¡¿Qué has estado haciendo tanto rato?!
Tunnel Trouble#048.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#049.src: ...You helped some crazy cow-obsessed lunatic steal some cows? I don't think you're allowed to do that. There's a law against that, or something.
Tunnel Trouble#049.dst: ...¿Has ayudado a un chiflado obsesionado con las vacas a robar vacas? No creo que eso se pueda hacer. Habrá alguna ley en contra, digo yo.
Tunnel Trouble#049.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#050.src: Eh. Not that I really care, either way. I've certainly done worse.
Tunnel Trouble#050.dst: Bah. Tampoco es que me importe mucho. Yo he hecho cosas peores.
Tunnel Trouble#050.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#051.src: Well then! Ready to call it quits? We're definitely not going to make any progress, so we might as we-
Tunnel Trouble#051.dst: ¡Pues nada! ¿Listo para dejarlo? No vamos a avanzar nada, así que más vale que-
Tunnel Trouble#051.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#052.src: Hello again, friend! I'm here with help! Cows, to me!
Tunnel Trouble#052.dst: ¡Hola otra vez, amigo! ¡Traigo ayuda! ¡Vacas, a mí!
Tunnel Trouble#052.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#054.src: Since you helped me with my problem, I thought I should repay that favor by helping you!
Tunnel Trouble#054.dst: Como me ayudaste con mi problema, ¡he pensado en devolverte el favor ayudándote a ti!
Tunnel Trouble#054.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#055.src: Welp, see ya! Oh, and nice to meet you, miner! Now, let's get going my cows!
Tunnel Trouble#055.dst: ¡Bueno, hasta luego! ¡Ah, y encantado, minero! ¡Vamos allá, vacas mías!
Tunnel Trouble#055.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#056.src: ...I- huh. You saw that too, right? I didn't just imagine that?
Tunnel Trouble#056.dst: ...Yo- vaya. Tú también lo has visto, ¿verdad? No me lo he imaginado, ¿no?
Tunnel Trouble#056.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#057.src: You know what? I think I quit. I think this has finally pushed me to my limit! I didn't know that I had one, but apparently I do!
Tunnel Trouble#057.dst: ¿Sabes qué? Creo que lo dejo. ¡Esto por fin me ha llevado al límite! ¡No sabía que tenía uno, pero por lo visto sí!
Tunnel Trouble#057.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#058.src: You can... go on ahead. Tell whoever's on the other end that we succeeded. And while we do that, I'll be searching for a better career.
Tunnel Trouble#058.dst: Tú... sigue adelante. Diles a los del otro lado que lo hemos conseguido. Y mientras, yo buscaré una carrera mejor.
Tunnel Trouble#058.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#060.src: Speak to Sergeant Klafson next to the {p} entrance of the cave.
Tunnel Trouble#060.dst: Habla con el sargento Klafson junto a la salida de la cueva del lado de {p}.

Tunnel Trouble#061.src: Recruit, Captain Fenor told me to meet you here, said if you came out on this side of that tunnel then you completed your mission!
Tunnel Trouble#061.dst: ¡Recluta! El capitán Fenor me dijo que te esperara aquí: si salías por este lado del túnel, ¡es que habías cumplido la misión!
Tunnel Trouble#061.speaker: Sergeant Klafson

Tunnel Trouble#062.src: You did a great deed today, soldier! We can now use this cave to travel easily between {p} and {p}! Great job!
Tunnel Trouble#062.dst: ¡Gran labor la de hoy, soldado! ¡Ya podemos usar la cueva para ir entre {p} y {p} sin problemas! ¡Bien hecho!
Tunnel Trouble#062.speaker: Sergeant Klafson

Underice#001.src: I'm having trouble with the fish in our lake recently and I am sure the problem lies within the lake itself.
Underice#001.dst: Últimamente tengo problemas con los peces de nuestro lago y estoy seguro de que el problema está en el lago mismo.
Underice#001.speaker: Fredris

Underice#002.src: I would like to commission you to investigate, but since it's freezing cold in our lake you need something to protect you. I heard the people in {p} on the coast of Wynn have something that can help you.
Underice#002.dst: Quisiera encargarte que lo investigues, pero nuestro lago está helado y necesitas algo que te proteja. He oído que la gente de {p}, en la costa de Wynn, tiene algo que puede ayudarte.
Underice#002.speaker: Fredris

Underice#003.src: Would you mind coming back with a [Breathing Helmet I]? I think that should be everything you need.
Underice#003.dst: ¿Te importaría volver con un [Breathing Helmet I]? Creo que con eso tendrás todo lo que necesitas.
Underice#003.speaker: Fredris

Underice#004.src: Return to {p} and bring Fredris a [Breathing Helmet I]
Underice#004.dst: Vuelve a {p} y tráele a Fredris un [Breathing Helmet I]

Underice#005.src: What is this thing supposed to be? You know, I would really appreciate your help, but this [Breathing Helmet I] does not look like it's going to keep you protected.
Underice#005.dst: ¿Y esto qué se supone que es? Mira, te agradezco mucho la ayuda, pero este [Breathing Helmet I] no parece que vaya a protegerte.
Underice#005.speaker: Fredris

Underice#006.src: Would you mind heading to our local armour merchant and buying one of our [Breathing Helmet II]? I don't want you to drown. Just come back with the helmet and I will tell you about my problem.
Underice#006.dst: ¿Te importaría ir a nuestro mercader de armaduras y comprar un [Breathing Helmet II]? No quiero que te ahogues. Vuelve con el casco y te contaré mi problema.
Underice#006.speaker: Fredris

Underice#007.src: Buy a [Breathing Helmet II] and find the underwater cave
Underice#007.dst: Compra un [Breathing Helmet II] y encuentra la cueva submarina

Underice#008.src: Explore the cave underneath the frozen lake in {p}
Underice#008.dst: Explora la cueva que hay bajo el lago helado de {p}

Underice#009.src: Who are you? You don't look like one of those villagers we stole the fi... Wait, they didn't send you to retrieve "their" fish, did they?
Underice#009.dst: ¿Quién eres tú? No pareces uno de esos aldeanos a los que robamos el pes... Un momento, ¿no te habrán mandado a recuperar «su» pescado?
Underice#009.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#010.src: For years we let them share the lake with us, the actual inhabitants of it, we were modest and took what we needed, we let them catch the rest. But then they went too far, they caught too much.
Underice#010.dst: Durante años les dejamos compartir el lago con nosotros, sus verdaderos habitantes. Éramos modestos, tomábamos lo justo y el resto lo pescaban ellos. Pero se pasaron: pescaban demasiado.
Underice#010.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#011.src: We didn't have enough to eat, we were forced to steal their fish, we would have starved otherwise. And now they want their fish, our fish back? We can't do that, I hope you understand.
Underice#011.dst: No teníamos qué comer, nos vimos obligados a robarles el pescado; si no, habríamos muerto de hambre. ¿Y ahora quieren su pescado, nuestro pescado? No podemos, espero que lo entiendas.
Underice#011.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#012.src: However, we don't have to fight over the fish in the lake, we just need a [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish], that would be enough, nothing else. We never wanted to steal the fish.
Underice#012.dst: Aun así, no hace falta pelear por los peces del lago: solo necesitamos un [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish], con eso basta, nada más. Nunca quisimos robar el pescado.
Underice#012.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#013.src: If you want to help us and the villagers, just follow the stream that flows into this lake to the south, you will find the best fishing ground there. The pufferfish should be around there too.
Underice#013.dst: Si quieres ayudarnos a nosotros y a los aldeanos, sigue hacia el sur el arroyo que desemboca en este lago; allí está el mejor caladero. El pez globo debería andar por ahí.
Underice#013.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#014.src: Follow the river south to find the fishing dock
Underice#014.dst: Sigue el río hacia el sur para encontrar el muelle de pesca

Underice#015.src: Oh you look a bit lost, let me help you, I've lived here for a long time, I know every corner and every snowflake.
Underice#015.dst: Oh, pareces un poco perdido. Deja que te ayude: llevo mucho aquí y conozco cada rincón y cada copo de nieve.
Underice#015.speaker: Gernald

Underice#016.src: You're searching for a [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish]? Hmm I heard that name before, my friend, Strato, told me about it years ago. If I remember correctly it is infinite, you can feed every single person in all the provinces from this single fish.
Underice#016.dst: ¿Buscas un [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish]? Hmm, ese nombre ya lo había oído: mi amigo Strato me habló de él hace años. Si mal no recuerdo, es infinito, con ese solo pez podrías dar de comer a todo el mundo en todas las provincias.
Underice#016.speaker: Gernald

Underice#017.src: Sadly Strato is no longer alive. He used to work and live at the woodcutting camp northwest of {p}. We always met here, caught fish and told each other stories. I really miss those times...
Underice#017.dst: Por desgracia, Strato ya murió. Vivía en el campamento de leñadores al noroeste de {p}. Quedábamos aquí a pescar y contarnos historias. Cómo echo de menos esos días...
Underice#017.speaker: Gernald

Underice#018.src: Maybe you can find some sort of bait there, he had some of the best bait I have ever seen. You should be able to acquire some and throw it in water, maybe that will attract the pufferfish.
Underice#018.dst: Quizá encuentres allí algún cebo; él tenía el mejor cebo que he visto nunca. Deberías poder conseguir algo y echarlo al agua; puede que así atraigas al pez globo.
Underice#018.speaker: Gernald

Underice#019.src: Can I ask you something? As you might see I'm not the richest guy, or the youngest. If you manage to catch that fish, could you hand it over? I know we just met but you seem like somebody who would help an old man.
Underice#019.dst: ¿Puedo pedirte algo? Como ves, no soy el más rico, ni el más joven. Si consigues pescar ese pez, ¿me lo darías? Sé que acabamos de conocernos, pero pareces de los que ayudan a un viejo.
Underice#019.speaker: Gernald

Underice#020.src: Obtain the bait at the woodcutting camp northwest of {p}, use it to catch the fish and then give it to Calamaro or Gernald
Underice#020.dst: Consigue el cebo en el campamento de leñadores al noroeste de {p}, úsalo para pescar el pez y luego dáselo a Calamaro o a Gernald

Underice#021.src: Just look at those fish, I told you they love this bait.
Underice#021.dst: Mira cómo vienen los peces, ya te dije que adoran este cebo.
Underice#021.speaker: Gernald

Underice#022.src: There it comes, the [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish], I can't believe it!
Underice#022.dst: ¡Ahí llega, el [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish], no me lo puedo creer!
Underice#022.speaker: Gernald

Underice#023.src: You decided to give me the fish? I wish Strato was still around, he would be so amazed. I can't show you how much this means to me, but take this little gift, please, promise me to never change.
Underice#023.dst: ¿Has decidido darme el pez? Ojalá Strato siguiera aquí, se quedaría de piedra. No sé cómo explicarte lo que esto significa para mí, pero acepta este regalito y prométeme que nunca cambiarás.
Underice#023.speaker: Gernald

Underice#024.src: You found a pufferfish! Who would have thought such a small thing could solve our problem. I will start bringing back the fish immediately, but first we will have a nice hot soup. Please take this as payback for your services.
Underice#024.dst: ¡Has encontrado un pez globo! Quién diría que algo tan pequeño resolvería nuestro problema. Empezaré a devolver el pescado ahora mismo, pero antes nos haremos una buena sopa caliente. Toma esto en pago por tus servicios.
Underice#024.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#025.src: You can trade it at the shop right over there, it's hard to miss. I will give you a last advise, you don't want to eat that slimy fish.
Underice#025.dst: Puedes cambiarlo en la tienda de ahí mismo, no tiene pérdida. Y un último consejo: no te comas ese pez baboso.
Underice#025.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#026.src: Meet up with Fredris in {p} and claim your reward
Underice#026.dst: Reúnete con Fredris en {p} y reclama tu recompensa

Underice#027.src: Oh you are done with whatever you were doing? I heard you ran around the whole place, I don't know if you were the right person to ask for help...
Underice#027.dst: Oh, ¿ya has terminado con lo tuyo? Dicen que has estado dando vueltas por todas partes; no sé si eras la persona indicada para esto...
Underice#027.speaker: Fredris

Underice#028.src: I will just ask the next one who comes around, no need to have you run around all day. Take this, I appreciate your effort.
Underice#028.dst: Mejor se lo pido al siguiente que pase, no hace falta que andes corriendo todo el día. Toma esto, agradezco tu esfuerzo.
Underice#028.speaker: Fredris

Underice#029.src: A real disaster! I can't believe this is happening to me!
Underice#029.dst: ¡Un auténtico desastre! ¡No me puedo creer que me pase esto a mí!
Underice#029.speaker: Fredris

Underice#030.src: I've been fishing for the last few days and I caught nothing! Zilch! This isn't normal!
Underice#030.dst: ¡Llevo días pescando y no he pescado nada! ¡Ni uno! ¡Esto no es normal!
Underice#030.speaker: Fredris

Underice#031.src: I spent my entire life fishing in this area! I wish I could dive under this ice to fix the problem myself...
Underice#031.dst: ¡Me he pasado la vida pescando por esta zona! Ojalá pudiera bucear bajo el hielo y arreglarlo yo mismo...
Underice#031.speaker: Fredris

Underice#032.src: Do you think you could help me? You might actually be exactly what I need!
Underice#032.dst: ¿Crees que podrías ayudarme? ¡Puede que seas justo lo que necesito!
Underice#032.speaker: Fredris

Underice#033.src: Enter my shack, there you will find the entrance... Good luck!
Underice#033.dst: Entra en mi cabaña, allí encontrarás la entrada... ¡Suerte!
Underice#033.speaker: Fredris

Underice#034.src: Explore under the ice to find a cause to the fish problem. You'll need the Breathing Helmet for this.
Underice#034.dst: Explora bajo el hielo para hallar la causa del problema con los peces. Necesitarás el Breathing Helmet.

Underice#035.src: Talk to Squidward in the Squid Village.
Underice#035.dst: Habla con Squidward en la Aldea de los Calamares.

Underice#036.src: Have I seen any fish? No, of course not! I don't even know what a fish looks like!
Underice#036.dst: ¿Que si he visto peces? ¡No, claro que no! ¡Ni siquiera sé cómo es un pez!
Underice#036.speaker: Squidward

Underice#037.src: Who could be stealing all those fish? I wonder! Actually...
Underice#037.dst: ¿Quién estará robando todos esos peces? ¡Qué misterio! Aunque...
Underice#037.speaker: Squidward

Underice#038.src: I'm sure Calamaro did it! He's just that kind of guy. He lives in that house down there.
Underice#038.dst: ¡Seguro que fue Calamaro! Es de esa clase de tipos. Vive en esa casa de ahí abajo.
Underice#038.speaker: Squidward

Underice#039.src: Find Calamaro in the Squid Village.
Underice#039.dst: Encuentra a Calamaro en la Aldea de los Calamares.

Underice#040.src: Me? Stealing fish? You are out of your mind! It's obviously Kroken who is stealing them!
Underice#040.dst: ¿Yo? ¿Robando peces? ¡Tú estás mal de la cabeza! ¡Está claro que es Kroken quien los roba!
Underice#040.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#041.src: He lives right on top of that waterfall right there, if you want to go talk to him.
Underice#041.dst: Vive justo encima de esa cascada de ahí, por si quieres ir a hablar con él.
Underice#041.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#042.src: Find Kroken in the Squid Village.
Underice#042.dst: Encuentra a Kroken en la Aldea de los Calamares.

Underice#043.src: Do I look like someone who steals fish?
Underice#043.speaker: Kroken

Underice#044.src: It's obvious that Squidward did it, he has tons of crates full of fish!
Underice#044.dst: Está claro que fue Squidward, ¡tiene montones de cajas llenas de peces!
Underice#044.speaker: Kroken

Underice#046.src: Okay, okay, fine! It was me all along... I know, what a shock, right?
Underice#046.dst: ¡Vale, vale, está bien! He sido yo todo este tiempo... Ya, menuda sorpresa, ¿no?
Underice#046.speaker: Squidward

Underice#047.src: Okay, I got a proposition for you. Bring me [{~} Raw Fish] and I will stop, deal?
Underice#047.dst: Vale, te hago una propuesta. Tráeme [{~} Raw Fish] y lo dejo, ¿trato hecho?
Underice#047.speaker: Squidward

Underice#049.src: Bring back {~} Raw Fish to Squidward.

Underice#051.src: You can trust me, I won't touch the fish in the frozen lake anymore!
Underice#051.dst: ¡Puedes fiarte de mí, no volveré a tocar los peces del lago helado!
Underice#051.speaker: Squidward

Underice#052.src: Talk to Fredris to collect your reward.
Underice#052.dst: Habla con Fredris para recoger tu recompensa.

Underice#053.src: Your story really doesn't make sense. Villagers living in a squid village under the lake? Pff!
Underice#053.dst: Tu historia no tiene ningún sentido. ¿Aldeanos viviendo en una aldea de calamares bajo el lago? ¡Bah!
Underice#053.speaker: Fredris

Underice#054.src: However, if you can garantee me that my problem is gone, I'll trust you.
Underice#054.dst: Aun así, si me garantizas que mi problema se ha acabado, me fiaré de ti.
Underice#054.speaker: Fredris

Underice#055.src: Thank you for your help. Here, take these...
Underice#055.dst: Gracias por tu ayuda. Toma, quédate con esto...
Underice#055.speaker: Fredris

Undersupply#000.src: Investigate the river settlement's water troubles at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Undersupply#000.dst: Investiga los problemas de agua del poblado del río en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Undersupply#001.src: Oho, now that's some dress I've not seen in many a moon! You're one of those {p} folk, aren't ya? Quite some luxury ya must've lived with.
Undersupply#001.dst: ¡Ojo, hacía lunas que no veía un atuendo así! Eres de esa gente de {p}, ¿a que sí? Menudos lujos habrás tenido.
Undersupply#001.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#002.src: 's a bit more humble down here in the shadow of the dam. Surprised someone like you would take the trip, but it ain't a complaint. Getting about to see the world is a fine endeavor!
Undersupply#002.dst: Aquí abajo, a la sombra de la presa, todo es más humilde. Me extraña que alguien como tú haga el viaje, pero no me quejo. ¡Recorrer el mundo es una buena empresa!
Undersupply#002.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#003.src: Unfortunately, the bar here's dry. Sure, I got alcohol, but you drink that, and you'll be passing more water than ya took in. Dries you right out, and right now we haven't got any water to spare. Dangerous, y'know?
Undersupply#003.dst: Por desgracia, el bar está seco. Alcohol tengo, pero si lo bebes, echarás más agua de la que metes. Te deja seco, y ahora mismo no nos sobra ni una gota. Es peligroso, ¿sabes?
Undersupply#003.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#004.src: The dam opens up every month or so to let out some water for us, but is passes through a noble manor, past the hill, rationed out to the rest of the forest.
Undersupply#004.dst: La presa se abre cada mes más o menos para soltarnos algo de agua, pero pasa por una mansión noble tras la colina y la reparten al resto del bosque.
Undersupply#004.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#005.src: It's so little though, nowadays. The children are going thirsty. The muck in the riverbeds is more mud than water- so even if ya boil it out like I do, what you get is foul trifles.
Undersupply#005.dst: Pero hoy en día es tan poca... Los niños pasan sed. Los cauces tienen más barro que agua: aunque la hiervas, como hago yo, lo que sale es una porquería.
Undersupply#005.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#006.src: Didn't used to be like this, though. Ain't sure what's changed, but I'm just an old geezer. I've lived my life enough- it's what it's doing to the kids that has me worried. ...say, stranger.
Undersupply#006.dst: Antes no era así, ¿eh? No sé qué ha cambiado, pero solo soy un viejo cascarrabias. Yo ya he vivido bastante; lo que me preocupa es lo que les hace a los críos. ...oye, forastero.
Undersupply#006.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#007.src: If you're touring about here, you'll probably see the manor soon enough. If ya could get them to spare us some more water a while, I'll give ya a discount! How's about it?
Undersupply#007.dst: Si andas de visita por aquí, pronto verás la mansión. Si consigues que nos den algo más de agua durante un tiempo, ¡te haré un descuento! ¿Qué me dices?
Undersupply#007.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#008.src: Ain't quite sure how you would go about convincing the nobles to let out more water for us, I admit. If I did, I'd take the trek up the hill myself- even in spite of my creaky ol' back.
Undersupply#008.dst: No sé muy bien cómo convencerías a los nobles para que nos suelten más agua, lo admito. Si lo supiera, subiría yo mismo la colina, aunque me cruja la espalda.
Undersupply#008.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#009.src: Even if it's just getting them to put a word in to the Sovereign. I imagine that come-lately Zhiraok would do something about it all. I swear that man doesn't know what sleep is...
Undersupply#009.dst: Aunque solo sea que hablen con el Soberano. Me imagino que ese recién llegado de Zhiraok haría algo al respecto. Te juro que ese hombre no sabe lo que es dormir...
Undersupply#009.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#010.src: I can appreciate a young'un with some spark in their eyes, but he needs to learn to slow down! What's that saying about the brightest candle burning twice as fast?
Undersupply#010.dst: Me gustan los jóvenes con chispa en los ojos, ¡pero tiene que frenar un poco! ¿Cómo era eso de que la vela que más brilla se consume el doble de rápido?
Undersupply#010.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#011.src: Oh, my! Who are you? In such fantastical equipment! Certainly not a guard- I've never seen anything like it! Oh me, oh my...
Undersupply#011.dst: ¡Ay, madre! ¿Quién es usted? ¡Con un equipo tan fantástico! No es un guardia, desde luego: ¡nunca había visto algo así! Ay, ay, ay...
Undersupply#011.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#012.src: Unless... Are you, perhaps...I have heard whispers on the wind of a new Sovereign? I have seen our Sovereign dress rather differently, so maybe-
Undersupply#012.dst: A no ser que... ¿Será usted...? El viento susurra que hay un nuevo Soberano. Nuestro Soberano viste de otra manera, así que quizá-
Undersupply#012.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#013.src: No? You aren't? Hm! Well, be that as it may, I do wish I could welcome you more hospitably, stranger, but we are in the lean time of the month- the leanest I have seen.
Undersupply#013.dst: ¿No? ¿No lo es? ¡Hm! Bueno, sea como sea, ojalá pudiera recibirle con más hospitalidad, forastero, pero estamos en la época escasa del mes, la más escasa que he visto.
Undersupply#013.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#014.src: *cough* Oh dear, excuse me. My throat is simply so dry... My children need the water more than I, but I would darn a dozen robes for but a glass now.
Undersupply#014.dst: *cof* Ay, disculpe. Tengo la garganta tan seca... Mis hijos necesitan el agua más que yo, pero ahora zurciría una docena de túnicas por un vaso.
Undersupply#014.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#015.src: The dam opens every month or so- I assume you wouldn't know, stranger. The water is rationed to us by the nobles in a manor over the hill.
Undersupply#015.dst: La presa se abre cada mes más o menos; supongo que usted no lo sabe, forastero. Los nobles de la mansión tras la colina nos racionan el agua.
Undersupply#015.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#016.src: This time of year is usually dry, but the amount of water we have received lately has been less and less. I wonder what is happening...
Undersupply#016.dst: En esta época del año suele hacer seco, pero el agua que nos llega es cada vez menos. Me pregunto qué pasará...
Undersupply#016.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#017.src: This kind lumberer has been visiting and passing out bottles, and without him I am certain my children wouldn't have made it. I'm unsure how much longer I can keep my family healthy...
Undersupply#017.dst: Un leñador muy amable viene a repartir botellas, y sin él estoy segura de que mis hijos no lo habrían superado. No sé cuánto más podré mantener sana a mi familia...
Undersupply#017.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#018.src: Oh, if only those nobles could spare more for us... Perhaps I could speak with them- but then, who would watch over my children here?
Undersupply#018.dst: Ay, si esos nobles pudieran darnos algo más... Quizá podría hablar con ellos, pero entonces, ¿quién cuidaría de mis hijos?
Undersupply#018.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#019.src: So...as much as I would like to welcome you with a meal and a hot cup of tea... I simply can't. I am just so sorry for this, stranger.
Undersupply#019.dst: Así que... por mucho que quisiera recibirle con una comida y una taza de té caliente... simplemente no puedo. Lo siento muchísimo, forastero.
Undersupply#019.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#020.src: I beg your pardon for it. I cannot spare the hospitality. Even my gardens I've had to abandon... My great-grandmother's flowers have wilted.
Undersupply#020.dst: Le ruego que me perdone. No puedo permitirme ser hospitalaria. Hasta el jardín he tenido que abandonar... Las flores de mi bisabuela se han marchitado.
Undersupply#020.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#021.src: My son had the idea to press the flowers so they would not be gone forever...But as it is, the risk of losing the rest of my family for the drought... I can't bear it!
Undersupply#021.dst: A mi hijo se le ocurrió prensar las flores para que no se perdieran para siempre... Pero tal como están las cosas, arriesgarme a perder al resto de mi familia por la sequía... ¡No lo soporto!
Undersupply#021.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#022.src: ...it may be rude to ask, but...could you ask the nobles of the manor, perhaps? To spare a drop or two extra? I'd be forever indebted to you...
Undersupply#022.dst: ...quizá sea grosero pedirlo, pero... ¿podría hablar con los nobles de la mansión? ¿Que nos den una gota o dos más? Le estaría siempre en deuda...
Undersupply#022.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#023.src: Whoa. That is positively outlandish dress. You...couldn't be a crown guard, can you be? That's simply so far out of uniform...so are you from the {p}, maybe?
Undersupply#023.dst: Vaya. Qué atuendo tan estrafalario. Usted... no será un guardia de la Corona, ¿verdad? Eso no se parece al uniforme... ¿Viene de {p}, quizá?
Undersupply#023.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#024.src: But then, why would you be here? The Festival...isn't that soon over in {p}? Why come all the way over here? I've hardly anything to trade, even.
Undersupply#024.dst: Pero entonces, ¿qué hace aquí? El Festival... ¿no es pronto en {p}? ¿Para qué venir hasta aquí? Si apenas tengo nada que vender.
Undersupply#024.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#025.src: It's the dry season, you know. End of the month, I'm sure you- ehm, wait. Perhaps, since you live atop the dam, that isn't the case? Oh, what I would do for that luxury!
Undersupply#025.dst: Es la estación seca, ¿sabe? Fin de mes, seguro que usted... ehm, un momento. Quizá, viviendo encima de la presa, ¿no le pase? ¡Ay, lo que daría yo por ese lujo!
Undersupply#025.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#026.src: Well, to the point- I've nothing to sell but dry herbs. A sad state for our village, when the apothecary cannot even make medicine, but every bit of water has to go towards necessities.
Undersupply#026.dst: En fin, al grano: no tengo nada que vender salvo hierbas secas. Triste situación para el pueblo, que el boticario no pueda hacer medicinas, pero cada gota va a lo imprescindible.
Undersupply#026.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#027.src: We've been receiving less and less. Some generous folks have been sharing, but that does only so far. A glass here and there cannot revitalize my poor garden.
Undersupply#027.dst: Cada vez recibimos menos. Hay gente generosa que comparte, pero eso no llega muy lejos. Un vaso aquí y otro allá no reviven mi pobre jardín.
Undersupply#027.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#028.src: If you want to find something more suited to the luxuries you might be used to, perhaps visit the manor over the hill? They do ration out the water to us, as well.
Undersupply#028.dst: Si busca algo más acorde con los lujos que conoce, ¿por qué no visita la mansión tras la colina? Ellos también nos racionan el agua.
Undersupply#028.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#029.src: ...far be it from me to make demands of a visitor, but... Should you visit, could you put in a word with them? A kindness begets a kindness, after all.
Undersupply#029.dst: ...lejos de mí exigirle nada a un visitante, pero... si va a visitarlos, ¿podría hablar con ellos? Al fin y al cabo, favor con favor se paga.
Undersupply#029.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#030.src: I've lived here all my life, I have. And I've always been learned to make everything stretch, to be diligent and frugal, but with things as they are, those skills fail me.
Undersupply#030.dst: He vivido aquí toda mi vida, sí. Siempre me enseñaron a estirar las cosas, a ser diligente y ahorrador, pero tal como están las cosas, esas habilidades no me sirven.
Undersupply#030.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#031.src: People could fall ill without my services, could die, and I would hate to see our families broken apart, but I may have no choice but to leave if this keeps up.
Undersupply#031.dst: Sin mí la gente podría enfermar, incluso morir, y odiaría ver familias rotas, pero si esto sigue así quizá no me quede otra que irme.
Undersupply#031.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#032.src: Oh, but I'm sure a sightseer like yourself doesn't want to hear the qualms of a man such as myself. Do enjoy the sights of our humble forest, would you?
Undersupply#032.dst: Ay, pero seguro que a un turista como usted no le interesan las penas de un hombre como yo. Disfrute de las vistas de nuestro humilde bosque, ¿quiere?
Undersupply#032.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#033.src: Oho, now that's some dress I've not seen in many a moon! You're one of those {p} folk, aren't ya? Quite some luxury ya must've lived with.
Undersupply#033.dst: ¡Ojo, hacía lunas que no veía un atuendo así! Eres de esa gente de {p}, ¿a que sí? Menudos lujos habrás tenido.
Undersupply#033.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#034.src: 's a bit more humble down here in the shadow of the dam. Surprised someone like you would take the trip, but it ain't a complaint. Getting about to see the world is a fine endeavor!
Undersupply#034.dst: Aquí abajo, a la sombra de la presa, todo es más humilde. Me extraña que alguien como tú haga el viaje, pero no me quejo. ¡Recorrer el mundo es una buena empresa!
Undersupply#034.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#035.src: Unfortunately, the bar here's dry. Sure, I got alcohol, but you drink that, and you'll be passing more water than ya took in. Dries you right out, and right now we haven't got any water to spare. Dangerous, y'know?
Undersupply#035.dst: Por desgracia, el bar está seco. Alcohol tengo, pero si lo bebes, echarás más agua de la que metes. Te deja seco, y ahora mismo no nos sobra ni una gota. Es peligroso, ¿sabes?
Undersupply#035.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#036.src: With the manor over the hill there barely letting out water for us anymore, it's all getting so much tougher. Kills me to see the children struggling like this...
Undersupply#036.dst: Con la mansión de tras la colina apenas soltándonos agua, todo se pone mucho más difícil. Me mata ver a los críos pasarlo tan mal...
Undersupply#036.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#037.src: Oh, my! Who are you? In such fantastical equipment! Certainly not a guard- I've never seen anything like it! Oh me, oh my...
Undersupply#037.dst: ¡Ay, madre! ¿Quién es usted? ¡Con un equipo tan fantástico! No es un guardia, desde luego: ¡nunca había visto algo así! Ay, ay, ay...
Undersupply#037.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#038.src: Unless... Are you, perhaps...I have heard whispers on the wind of a new Sovereign? I have seen our Sovereign dress rather differently, so maybe-
Undersupply#038.dst: A no ser que... ¿Será usted...? El viento susurra que hay un nuevo Soberano. Nuestro Soberano viste de otra manera, así que quizá-
Undersupply#038.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#039.src: No? You aren't? Hm! Well, be that as it may, I do wish I could welcome you more hospitably, stranger, but we are in the lean time of the month- the leanest I have seen.
Undersupply#039.dst: ¿No? ¿No lo es? ¡Hm! Bueno, sea como sea, ojalá pudiera recibirle con más hospitalidad, forastero, pero estamos en la época escasa del mes, la más escasa que he visto.
Undersupply#039.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#040.src: So...as much as I would like to welcome you with a meal and a hot cup of tea... I simply can't. I am just so sorry for this, stranger- there is barely enough water for my own family to drink.
Undersupply#040.dst: Así que... por mucho que quisiera recibirle con una comida y una taza de té caliente... no puedo. Lo siento muchísimo, forastero: apenas hay agua para que beba mi familia.
Undersupply#040.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#041.src: Oh, if only those nobles could spare more for us... Perhaps I could speak with them- but then, who would watch over my children here?
Undersupply#041.dst: Ay, si esos nobles pudieran darnos algo más... Quizá podría hablar con ellos, pero entonces, ¿quién cuidaría de mis hijos?
Undersupply#041.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#042.src: Whoa. That is positively outlandish dress. You...couldn't be a crown guard, can you be? That's simply so far out of uniform...so are you from the {p}, maybe?
Undersupply#042.dst: Vaya. Qué atuendo tan estrafalario. Usted... no será un guardia de la Corona, ¿verdad? Eso no se parece al uniforme... ¿Viene de {p}, quizá?
Undersupply#042.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#043.src: But then, why would you be here? The Festival...isn't that soon over in {p}? Why come all the way over here? I've hardly anything to trade, even.
Undersupply#043.dst: Pero entonces, ¿qué hace aquí? El Festival... ¿no es pronto en {p}? ¿Para qué venir hasta aquí? Si apenas tengo nada que vender.
Undersupply#043.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#044.src: It's the dry season, you know. End of the month, I'm sure you- ehm, wait. Perhaps, since you live atop the dam, that isn't the case? Oh, what I would do for that luxury!
Undersupply#044.dst: Es la estación seca, ¿sabe? Fin de mes, seguro que usted... ehm, un momento. Quizá, viviendo encima de la presa, ¿no le pase? ¡Ay, lo que daría yo por ese lujo!
Undersupply#044.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#045.src: Either way... It is difficult here. Perhaps I ought petition the Sovereeign to increase the rations. I'm sure he would listen, given how much he has helped in the past twenty years, or so.
Undersupply#045.dst: Sea como sea... Aquí las cosas están difíciles. Quizá debería pedir al Soberano que aumente las raciones. Seguro que escucharía, con lo mucho que ha ayudado en estos veinte años.
Undersupply#045.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#046.src: Hrm. Can't even wash my clothes with the streams this claggy and slow... What a dilemma.
Undersupply#046.dst: Hrm. Ni siquiera puedo lavar la ropa con los arroyos tan turbios y lentos... Qué dilema.
Undersupply#046.speaker: Duress

Undersupply#047.src: I'm telling you, the guards in the dam are putting something in the water to turn the frogs gigantic!
Undersupply#047.dst: ¡Te lo digo yo: los guardias de la presa le echan algo al agua para que las ranas se vuelvan gigantes!
Undersupply#047.speaker: Doyel

Undersupply#048.src: I've seen one with my own eyes, wandering about! Soon enough they'll send them to eat us!
Undersupply#048.dst: ¡He visto una con mis propios ojos, rondando por aquí! ¡Pronto las mandarán a comernos!
Undersupply#048.speaker: Doyel

Undersupply#049.src: What? Selling the house? What do you- Oh, that!
Undersupply#049.speaker: Ryde

Undersupply#050.src: No, no, a salesman sold me a 'For Sale' sign, in case I wanted to sell something. I wasn't sure where else to put it, is all.
Undersupply#050.dst: No, no, un vendedor me vendió un cartel de «Se vende», por si quería vender algo. Es que no sabía dónde más ponerlo, nada más.
Undersupply#050.speaker: Ryde

Undersupply#051.src: It's dry enough here that I have considered it, though...
Undersupply#051.dst: Aunque aquí está todo tan seco que me lo he planteado...
Undersupply#051.speaker: Ryde

Undersupply#052.src: Make your way to the manor and question them. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Undersupply#052.dst: Ve a la mansión y pregunta a sus dueños. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Undersupply#053.src: Welcome to the manor. Have the townspeople sent you?
Undersupply#053.dst: Le doy la bienvenida a la mansión. ¿Le envía la gente del pueblo?
Undersupply#053.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#054.src: As I had expected. In that case, let me walk you to the masters.
Undersupply#054.dst: Lo que me esperaba. En ese caso, le acompañaré ante los señores.
Undersupply#054.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#055.src: Still- allow me to lead you to the masters.
Undersupply#055.dst: Aun así, permítame llevarle ante los señores.
Undersupply#055.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#056.src: Ah, haha! Hayn, who might this be? Ostentatious dress, I must declare! Is this a tourist come to tour the manor, mayhaps?
Undersupply#056.dst: ¡Ah, jaja! Hayn, ¿a quién tenemos aquí? ¡Un atuendo ostentoso, he de declarar! ¿Será acaso un turista que viene a visitar la mansión?
Undersupply#056.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#057.src: Ohh... I see! The locals sent you. Then, allow me to enlighten you on the matter. You see, the Crown has entrusted us to manage the water supplied from the dam.
Undersupply#057.dst: Ooh... ¡Ya veo! Le envían los lugareños. Entonces, permítame que le ilustre. Verá, la Corona nos ha confiado gestionar el agua que sale de la presa.
Undersupply#057.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#058.src: All potable water in the forest comes through us- it is our responsibility to ensure the rations we are given are spread to where it is most needed.
Undersupply#058.dst: Toda el agua potable del bosque pasa por nosotros: es nuestra responsabilidad que las raciones lleguen a donde más se necesitan.
Undersupply#058.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#059.src: With the Crown Festival in {p} being about this time, the water must go there! Additionally, with all the new construction recently, there have been more places to ration out to.
Undersupply#059.dst: Con el Festival de la Corona en {p} por estas fechas, ¡el agua tiene que ir allí! Además, con tanta construcción nueva, hay más sitios entre los que repartirla.
Undersupply#059.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#060.src: We, too, have taken a smaller share than normal. The village down there, unfortunately, has been the lowest priority for some months now. I have petitioned the Sovereign for more water...
Undersupply#060.dst: Nosotros también nos quedamos con menos de lo normal. El pueblo de abajo, por desgracia, lleva meses siendo la última prioridad. He pedido al Soberano más agua...
Undersupply#060.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#061.src: ...but that will not solve the problem here and now. Neither would a gulp here, or a bottle there. It does break my heart, it truly does! But we must take our responsibilities seriously.
Undersupply#061.dst: ...pero eso no resuelve el problema aquí y ahora. Tampoco un trago aquí o una botella allá. ¡Me parte el corazón, de verdad! Pero debemos tomarnos en serio nuestras responsabilidades.
Undersupply#061.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#062.src: ...Hm. Hm, hm, hm... But perhaps...what if...
Undersupply#062.dst: ...Hm. Hm, hm, hm... Pero quizá... ¿y si...?
Undersupply#062.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#063.src: Oh, do speak up! I hear you turning over an idea in your head, good Sir!
Undersupply#063.dst: ¡Ah, hable, hable! ¡Le oigo darle vueltas a una idea, buen señor!
Undersupply#063.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#064.src: Well, perhaps it is a foolish thought. But, if they were to tinker with the dam's systems and let out more water for all of us earlier than the next month? Tide us over 'til the Nasin gets his head on straight?
Undersupply#064.dst: Bueno, quizá sea una idea tonta. Pero ¿y si alguien manipulara la presa y soltara más agua para todos antes del mes que viene? ¿Aguantar hasta que el Nasin siente la cabeza?
Undersupply#064.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#065.src: Hm! Foolish indeed! Quite unlike you, I must say- only us and the highest ranks of the military have access to the dam! Why, we would be suspects number one, two, and three!
Undersupply#065.dst: ¡Hm! ¡Tonta, sin duda! Nada propio de usted, he de decir: ¡solo nosotros y los altos mandos del ejército tenemos acceso a la presa! ¡Seríamos los sospechosos uno, dos y tres!
Undersupply#065.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#066.src: And what if we were to...have some scofflaw break into the mansion, and lift the key, good Master? Why, we would be helpless bystanders, free of responsibility and suspicion.
Undersupply#066.dst: ¿Y si... algún maleante entrara en la mansión y se llevara la llave, buen señor? Vaya, seríamos simples testigos indefensos, libres de culpa y sospecha.
Undersupply#066.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#067.src: ...you mean, to have this traveler pose as a thief, and steal the key to the dam?
Undersupply#067.dst: ...¿quiere decir que este viajero se haga pasar por ladrón y robe la llave de la presa?
Undersupply#067.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#068.src: Hahaha!! There is wisdom I have known from you for so long! What a magnificient idea! It would not be without risk for you, traveler, but we all stand to gain!
Undersupply#068.dst: ¡¡Jajaja!! ¡Esa es la sabiduría que le conozco desde hace tanto! ¡Qué idea tan magnífica! No será sin riesgo para usted, viajero, ¡pero todos saldremos ganando!
Undersupply#068.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#069.src: The dam is guarded heavily, and assuredly the Crown's military would pursue you...but if you were to succeed, we could have more than enough water 'til the Sovereign receives our petition!
Undersupply#069.dst: La presa está muy vigilada, y seguro que el ejército de la Corona le perseguiría... pero si lo logra, ¡tendríamos agua de sobra hasta que el Soberano reciba nuestra petición!
Undersupply#069.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#070.src: That being said, should you take it upon yourself to do this, we must pretend to have never met! To keep suspicion away from us, you know. Still, our gratitude will abound!
Undersupply#070.dst: Dicho esto, si decide hacerlo, ¡debemos fingir que nunca nos conocimos! Para alejar las sospechas, ya sabe. Aun así, ¡nuestra gratitud será inmensa!
Undersupply#070.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#071.src: Hayn! Please bring the stranger to the rose, under which we have hidden the key. And good tidings to you!
Undersupply#071.dst: ¡Hayn! Lleve al forastero hasta la rosa bajo la que escondimos la llave. ¡Y buena suerte!
Undersupply#071.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#072.src: Take the key to the dam from under the rose. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Undersupply#072.dst: Coge la llave de la presa de debajo de la rosa. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Undersupply#073.src: Now, away with you, 'scofflaw!' Ah, haha! I shall be looking forward to sharing a veritable tidal wave of water with the forest!
Undersupply#073.dst: ¡Y ahora fuera de aquí, «maleante»! ¡Ah, jaja! ¡Estoy deseando compartir con el bosque un verdadero maremoto de agua!
Undersupply#073.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#074.src: We shall call for the guards only after you are well out of sight. Be sure to leave a scene- it may delay them for longer.
Undersupply#074.dst: Llamaremos a los guardias solo cuando esté bien lejos. Asegúrese de dejar un buen desorden: puede retrasarlos más.
Undersupply#074.speaker: Sir Hurlay
