Undersupply#075.src: Do make a mess, please. The masters will want a convincing scene.
Undersupply#075.dst: Haga un buen desorden, por favor. Los señores querrán una escena convincente.
Undersupply#075.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#076.src: If you've taken the key, take it to the entrance east of here.
Undersupply#076.dst: Si ya tiene la llave, llévela a la entrada al este de aquí.
Undersupply#076.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#077.src: Enter the Fruma Dam and find a way to make the water flow. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Undersupply#077.dst: Entra en la presa de Fruma y busca la forma de que el agua fluya. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Undersupply#078.src: Hm... Then, once you have entered the dam, you should avoid returning here. I would hate to see you escape, but be caught returning to the scene of the crime.
Undersupply#078.dst: Hm... Entonces, una vez que entre en la presa, no vuelva por aquí. Sería una pena que escapara y le atraparan al volver a la escena del crimen.
Undersupply#078.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#079.src: So this is the scene of the robbery, then. And you say they took the key to the dam?
Undersupply#079.dst: Así que esta es la escena del robo. ¿Y dice que se llevaron la llave de la presa?
Undersupply#079.speaker: Commander Balsura

Undersupply#081.src: This room is too open to guard effectively. Reverse psychology doesn't work on thieves- they'll check the obvious spots to cover their bases.
Undersupply#081.dst: Esta sala es demasiado abierta para vigilarla bien. La psicología inversa no funciona con ladrones: miran en los sitios obvios por si acaso.
Undersupply#081.speaker: Commander Balsura

Undersupply#082.src: By this point...they likely will have gone into the dam. I'll have to mobilize the forces and deal with them.
Undersupply#082.dst: A estas alturas... seguramente ya habrán entrado en la presa. Tendré que movilizar a las tropas y ocuparme.
Undersupply#082.speaker: Commander Balsura

Undersupply#083.src: I'll be reporting this. You'll get a replacement key, but lose it again and you'll be relieved of your responsibilities. Consider this your one chance.
Undersupply#083.dst: Informaré de esto. Recibirán una llave de repuesto, pero si la vuelven a perder, les relevarán de sus funciones. Considérenlo su única oportunidad.
Undersupply#083.speaker: Commander Balsura

Undersupply#085.src: So this was your plan! Here to sabotage the game... trying to steal water for yourself? Or did you mean to bring destruction? Cause a flood?
Undersupply#085.dst: ¡Así que este era tu plan! Venir a sabotear... ¿Robar agua para ti? ¿O querías sembrar la destrucción? ¿Provocar una inundación?
Undersupply#085.speaker: Commander Balsura

Undersupply#086.src: I'll not be letting you get away with such heinous crimes. Lay down your weapons!
Undersupply#086.dst: No voy a dejar que te salgas con la tuya con crímenes tan atroces. ¡Suelta las armas!
Undersupply#086.speaker: Commander Balsura

Undersupply#087.src: Return to the settlement and tell them about your success. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Undersupply#087.dst: Vuelve al poblado y cuéntales tu éxito. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Undersupply#088.src: The water seems to be flowing! Isn't it too early this month? I have to get back and tell the others.
Undersupply#088.dst: ¡Parece que el agua fluye! ¿No es muy pronto este mes? Tengo que volver y avisar a los demás.
Undersupply#088.speaker: Duress

Undersupply#089.src: Wonderful, wonderful! I've sent Hayn with your payment to the village. Now hurry, hurry, 'scofflaw!' You wouldn't want to be caught, after all that trouble!
Undersupply#089.dst: ¡Maravilloso, maravilloso! He enviado a Hayn al pueblo con su pago. ¡Y ahora deprisa, deprisa, «maleante»! ¡No querrá que le atrapen después de tanto esfuerzo!
Undersupply#089.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#090.src: Hm! You'd best be going, else the guards may catch you. Our butler has gone away to the village with a dividend of payment. Do hurry there, would you?
Undersupply#090.dst: ¡Hm! Más vale que se vaya, o los guardias podrían atraparle. Nuestro mayordomo ha ido al pueblo con una parte del pago. Dese prisa en ir allí, ¿quiere?
Undersupply#090.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#091.src: My... My land! The well!! Everyone, the well is filling!! My children- They'll have their water!!
Undersupply#091.dst: ¡Dios... Dios mío! ¡El pozo! ¡Todos, el pozo se está llenando! ¡Mis hijos... tendrán agua!
Undersupply#091.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#092.src: The river flows, as well! It certainly is not yet the time of the month for another ration... But I will not complain of good fortune!
Undersupply#092.dst: ¡El río también fluye! Desde luego, aún no toca otra ración este mes... ¡Pero no me quejaré de la buena suerte!
Undersupply#092.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#093.src: Seems like the stranger with that spark in their eyes did it! Have to give 'em that discount I mentioned. I'll get to open up the bar proper again! What a fine day this is.
Undersupply#093.dst: ¡Parece que el forastero con chispa en los ojos lo ha logrado! Tendré que hacerle ese descuento que dije. ¡Podré volver a abrir el bar como es debido! Qué buen día.
Undersupply#093.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#094.src: My... My land! The well!! Everyone, the well is filling!! Was this... That strange fellow in the Sovereign-like dress... Did they...?! They must have!! My children- They'll have their water!!
Undersupply#094.dst: ¡Dios... Dios mío! ¡El pozo! ¡Todos, el pozo se está llenando! ¿Ha sido... ese extraño forastero con ropa de Soberano...? ¡Seguro que sí! ¡Mis hijos... tendrán agua!
Undersupply#094.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#095.src: The river flows, as well! It certainly is not yet the time of the month for another ration... But I will not complain of good fortune!
Undersupply#095.dst: ¡El río también fluye! Desde luego, aún no toca otra ración este mes... ¡Pero no me quejaré de la buena suerte!
Undersupply#095.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#096.src: I'll get to open up the bar proper again! What a fine day this is. Say, stranger...
Undersupply#096.dst: ¡Podré volver a abrir el bar como es debido! Qué buen día. Oye, forastero...
Undersupply#096.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#097.src: My... My land! The well!! Everyone, the well is filling!! My children- They'll have their water!!
Undersupply#097.dst: ¡Dios... Dios mío! ¡El pozo! ¡Todos, el pozo se está llenando! ¡Mis hijos... tendrán agua!
Undersupply#097.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#098.src: The river flows, as well! It certainly is not yet the time of the month for another ration... Oh! It must have been that tourist! Perhaps they asked the manor to release some extra?
Undersupply#098.dst: ¡El río también fluye! Aún no toca otra ración este mes... ¡Oh! ¡Seguro que fue ese turista! ¿Quizá pidió a la mansión que soltaran algo más?
Undersupply#098.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#099.src: I'll get to open up the bar proper again! What a fine day this is. Say, stranger...
Undersupply#099.dst: ¡Podré volver a abrir el bar como es debido! Qué buen día. Oye, forastero...
Undersupply#099.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#100.src: So then! I have to figure this was you! Got the manor to let out a little extra, did you?
Undersupply#100.dst: ¡Vaya, vaya! ¡Me da que esto ha sido cosa tuya! Conseguiste que la mansión soltara algo más, ¿eh?
Undersupply#100.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#101.src: They have risked life and limb to enter the dam and allow the water to flow freely. Show your thanks, and do not report them.
Undersupply#101.dst: Ha arriesgado la vida para entrar en la presa y dejar que el agua fluya libremente. Denle las gracias y no le denuncien.
Undersupply#101.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#102.src: The masters have sent me to hand out compensation for your dangerous actions.
Undersupply#102.dst: Los señores me envían a repartir una compensación por sus peligrosos actos.
Undersupply#102.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#103.src: Wait, the ro- Why did you jump off th- The masters, wh- Are you from the manor?! Why did-
Undersupply#103.dst: Espere, el te- ¿Por qué ha saltado del te-? Los señores, qu- ¿Es usted de la mansión? ¿Por qué-
Undersupply#103.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#104.src: There was no more water for the masters to give. They have fixed the problem for all of us.
Undersupply#104.dst: Los señores ya no tenían más agua que dar. Han resuelto el problema para todos.
Undersupply#104.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#105.src: Even you were short? Gracious. Still...our gardens may now grow, our children may now drink... We can only give you our utmost thanks, stranger!
Undersupply#105.dst: ¿Ni ustedes tenían bastante? Madre mía. Aun así... crecerán los jardines, beberán los niños... ¡Solo podemos darle las gracias de corazón, forastero!
Undersupply#105.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#106.src: Thank ye traveler. I gotta get myself back to the bar. See ye around and stay safe!
Undersupply#106.dst: Gracias, viajero. Tengo que volver al bar. ¡Nos vemos, y cuídate!
Undersupply#106.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#107.src: Did the butler just jump off the roof!? W-whatever, I have to get home! Thank you!
Undersupply#107.dst: ¿¡El mayordomo acaba de saltar del tejado!? B-bueno, ¡tengo que irme a casa! ¡Gracias!
Undersupply#107.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#108.src: The water helps out the manor too, eh? It can't be helped, atleast they deliver it around the whole forest.
Undersupply#108.dst: El agua también le hace falta a la mansión, ¿eh? Qué se le va a hacer, al menos la reparten por todo el bosque.
Undersupply#108.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#109.src: They're pretty smart businessmen, I can understand the hustle. Maybe I'll ask them for advice some time soon!
Undersupply#109.dst: Son unos negociantes muy listos, entiendo el trajín. ¡Quizá pronto les pida algún consejo!
Undersupply#109.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#110.src: I must be going now. The guards won't forgive you for slaying Balsura, but hopefully you can keep from being caught. Good luck.
Undersupply#110.dst: Debo irme ya. Los guardias no le perdonarán que matara a Balsura, pero ojalá consiga que no le atrapen. Buena suerte.
Undersupply#110.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#111.src: Hey traveler, remember my promise? Discounted water for life! What do ye say? Want some?
Undersupply#111.dst: Oye, viajero, ¿recuerdas mi promesa? ¡Agua con descuento de por vida! ¿Qué me dices? ¿Quieres?
Undersupply#111.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#113.src: Pleasure doing business with ye! Jokes aside, thanks for all you've done.
Undersupply#113.dst: ¡Un placer hacer negocios contigo! Bromas aparte, gracias por todo.
Undersupply#113.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#114.src: Guh, you must be pulling my leg...! ...Thanks for all you've done, traveler.
Undersupply#114.dst: Uf, ¡me estás tomando el pelo...! ...Gracias por todo, viajero.
Undersupply#114.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#115.src: Hey traveler, good work out there. Whenever the heat's off ye, come visit me!
Undersupply#115.dst: Oye, viajero, buen trabajo. ¡Cuando dejen de buscarte, ven a verme!
Undersupply#115.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#116.src: You're still around, traveler! Stay safe, please! I don't know what I would do if you were caught!
Undersupply#116.dst: ¡Sigue por aquí, viajero! ¡Cuídese, por favor! ¡No sé qué haría si le atraparan!
Undersupply#116.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#117.src: Although, if you ever need some water, feel free to stop by!
Undersupply#117.dst: Aunque, si alguna vez necesita agua, ¡pase cuando quiera!
Undersupply#117.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#118.src: The water helps out the manor too, eh? It can't be helped, atleast they deliver it around the whole forest.
Undersupply#118.dst: El agua también le hace falta a la mansión, ¿eh? Qué se le va a hacer, al menos la reparten por todo el bosque.
Undersupply#118.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#119.src: They're pretty smart businessmen, I can understand the hustle. Maybe I'll ask them for advice some time soon!
Undersupply#119.dst: Son unos negociantes muy listos, entiendo el trajín. ¡Quizá pronto les pida algún consejo!
Undersupply#119.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#120.src: Hrm. I got so used to the stream being slow that I lost my last robe to the water flow. What a dilemma.
Undersupply#120.dst: Hrm. Me acostumbré tanto a que el arroyo fuera lento que la corriente se llevó mi última túnica. Qué dilema.
Undersupply#120.speaker: Duress

Undersupply#121.src: I really ought to put away that 'For Sale' sign so no one else gets confused...
Undersupply#121.dst: Debería quitar ese cartel de «Se vende» para que nadie más se confunda...
Undersupply#121.speaker: Ryde

Undersupply#122.src: Fine work, indeed! I might welcome you with a cup of tea, but I cannot abide by 'scofflaws' such as yourself- wink, wink! Now away with you! Ah, haha!
Undersupply#122.dst: ¡Un trabajo espléndido, sin duda! Le invitaría a una taza de té, pero no tolero a «maleantes» como usted, ¡guiño, guiño! ¡Y ahora fuera de aquí! ¡Ah, jaja!
Undersupply#122.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#123.src: Hm. Hm, hm, hm... I should keep better track of the ledgers. If I had noticed earlier, petitioned earlier... But of course, a Nasin wouldn't have thought ahead... Hm...
Undersupply#123.dst: Hm. Hm, hm, hm... Debería llevar mejor las cuentas. Si lo hubiera notado antes, si hubiera pedido antes... Pero claro, un Nasin no habría previsto nada... Hm...
Undersupply#123.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#124.src: Stay out of trouble from now on. The beginning of strife is as when one lets out water.
Undersupply#124.dst: De ahora en adelante, no se meta en líos. El principio de la discordia es como quien suelta las aguas.
Undersupply#124.speaker: Butler Hayn

Underwater#000.src: But recently, a small hole has opened in the shipwreck here. It is believed that our fortune is hidden within it.

Underwater#001.src: Talk to Omango located at the North of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Underwater#001.dst: Habla con Omango, al norte de {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Underwater#002.src: Hi, my name is Omango. I am a resident of the {p} village, on top of the hill.
Underwater#002.dst: Hola, me llamo Omango. Vivo en el pueblo de {p}, en lo alto de la colina.
Underwater#002.speaker: Omango

Underwater#003.src: As you may know, our people came to your land years ago, and this is the ship they used.
Underwater#003.dst: Como sabrás, mi pueblo llegó a tus tierras hace años, y este es el barco que usaron.
Underwater#003.speaker: Omango

Underwater#004.src: They brought lots of luxurious goods with them. Most of them got lost in the wreck.
Underwater#004.dst: Trajeron muchos bienes de lujo. La mayoría se perdieron en el naufragio.
Underwater#004.speaker: Omango

Underwater#005.src: But recently, a small hole has opened in the shipwreck here. It is believed that fortune is hidden within it.
Underwater#005.dst: Pero hace poco se abrió un pequeño agujero en el pecio. Se cree que dentro hay una fortuna escondida.
Underwater#005.speaker: Omango

Underwater#006.src: Unfortunately, nobody has been able to explore it. It is too deep, no creature can survive underwater that long!
Underwater#006.dst: Por desgracia, nadie ha podido explorarlo. ¡Está demasiado hondo, nadie aguanta tanto bajo el agua!
Underwater#006.speaker: Omango

Underwater#007.src: However, my old friend Sayrr is a fisherman, and I know that he has a very special helmet...
Underwater#007.dst: Pero mi viejo amigo Sayrr es pescador, y sé que tiene un casco muy especial...
Underwater#007.speaker: Omango

Underwater#008.src: If you convince him to give you this helmet, and find the treasure, I'll give you a part of it!
Underwater#008.dst: Si lo convences de que te dé ese casco y encuentras el tesoro, ¡te daré una parte!
Underwater#008.speaker: Omango

Underwater#009.src: Sayrr is out on his boat, but the cave next to me is a quick way over to where he does his fishing. Be careful on the way, though.
Underwater#009.dst: Sayrr está en su barca, pero la cueva de al lado es un atajo hasta donde pesca. Eso sí, ten cuidado por el camino.
Underwater#009.speaker: Omango

Underwater#010.src: When you finally have the helmet, explore the ship and bring me back [{~} Ancient Treasure]. Good luck.
Underwater#010.dst: Cuando tengas el casco, explora el barco y tráeme [{~} Ancient Treasure]. Buena suerte.
Underwater#010.speaker: Omango

Underwater#011.src: Go through the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find Sayrr on his boat on the other side
Underwater#011.dst: Cruza la cueva en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para encontrar a Sayrr en su barca al otro lado

Underwater#012.src: Why ya looking at me like that? Is it cause I'm small, eh? I'll have you know that I caught fish that were twice your size!
Underwater#012.dst: ¿Por qué me miras así? Porque soy pequeño, ¿eh? ¡Que sepas que he pescado peces que te doblaban en tamaño!
Underwater#012.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#013.src: ...or, well, I used to be able to. Nothing's biting recently- wait a sec, why'd you hop on my boat anyways, stranger?
Underwater#013.dst: ...o bueno, antes podía. Últimamente no pica nada. Espera, ¿por qué te subiste a mi barca, forastero?
Underwater#013.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#014.src: Ahah! Yes, I still have that old breathing helmet. You want it? You'll have to do something for me first.
Underwater#014.dst: ¡Ajá! Sí, aún tengo ese viejo casco de respiración. ¿Lo quieres? Primero tendrás que hacer algo por mí.
Underwater#014.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#015.src: I'm sure you heard me, but the fish just aren't biting around here anymore! I need to make a living somehow! There's some fish in that cave, but...
Underwater#015.dst: Ya me has oído: ¡aquí los peces ya no pican! ¡Y de algo tengo que vivir! En esa cueva hay algunos peces, pero...
Underwater#015.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#016.src: ...it's a bit dangerous. Tell ya what, I'll give you my fishing rod, and you can go catch me, say, [{~} Gudgeon Meat] down there.
Underwater#016.dst: ...es algo peligrosa. Mira, te doy mi caña de pescar y tú me pescas ahí abajo, digamos, [{~} Gudgeon Meat].
Underwater#016.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#017.src: The helmet will be all yours after that.
Underwater#017.dst: Después, el casco será todo tuyo.
Underwater#017.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#018.src: Bring back [{~} Gudgeon Meat] found in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to Sayrr
Underwater#018.dst: Lleva a Sayrr [{~} Gudgeon Meat] de la cueva en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Underwater#019.src: Ah! Welcome back! Any luck with the fish?
Underwater#019.dst: ¡Ah! ¡Ya has vuelto! ¿Qué tal con los peces?
Underwater#019.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#020.src: Great, and I'll thank you kindly. Here's your helmet, have fun with that.
Underwater#020.dst: Genial, te lo agradezco mucho. Aquí tienes tu casco, que lo disfrutes.
Underwater#020.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#021.src: Explore the crashed ship for a lost treasure at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Underwater#021.dst: Explora el barco naufragado en busca de un tesoro perdido en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Underwater#022.src: Break the crate and bring [{~} Old Treasure] to Omango at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Underwater#022.dst: Rompe la caja y lleva [{~} Old Treasure] a Omango en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Underwater#023.src: You got it! You found the treasure!
Underwater#023.speaker: Omango

Underwater#024.src: As promised, here's your part of the loot.
Underwater#024.dst: Como te prometí, aquí tienes tu parte del botín.
Underwater#024.speaker: Omango

Wrath of the Mummy#000.src: Do I know anything about Mummies? Of course! I've spent my entire life studying them!

Wrath of the Mummy#001.src: Mummies aren't known to be weak, especially that one. It's demonic... pure evil. It's easily one of the most powerful specimens I've encountered.

Wrath of the Mummy#002.src: Unless... look. I've been waiting to get my hands on some pink wool, and the only shop that sells it has just restocked.

Wrath of the Mummy#003.src: Or better yet, if you happen to have some of that pink wool on you. If you give it to me, well... the tomb is all yours.

Wrath of the Mummy#004.src: Either way, you can take my wagon over there to {p}, but you'll have to make your own way back. Give me [{~} Pink Wool] and I'll let you through.

Wrath of the Mummy#005.src: Have you got me [{~} Pink Wool] yet!? You can get it from the shop in {p}.

Wrath of the Mummy#006.src: I don't know you, and you don't know me. Got it?

Wrath of the Mummy#007.src: Talk to Ormrod in the desert of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Wrath of the Mummy#007.dst: Habla con Ormrod en el desierto de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Wrath of the Mummy#009.src: I live in this camp by choice. A curse follows me... and now trouble starts wherever I go. I left civilization and made camp in the desert, where I could do no more harm.
Wrath of the Mummy#009.dst: Vivo en este campamento por elección. Me persigue una maldición... y los problemas surgen allá donde voy. Dejé la civilización y acampé en el desierto, donde no hiciera más daño.
Wrath of the Mummy#009.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#010.src: I do miss the comforts of {p} some days, though... you look like a learned adventurer. If I asked you to investigate this curse, perhaps you could help me rid myself of it?
Wrath of the Mummy#010.dst: Aunque algunos días echo de menos las comodidades de {p}... Pareces un aventurero instruido. Si te pidiera investigar esta maldición, ¿quizá podrías ayudarme a librarme de ella?
Wrath of the Mummy#010.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#011.src: It all started when I discovered an old tomb in the North of the desert. Upon entering it, the ground started shaking and I heard inhuman screams coming from deeper within.
Wrath of the Mummy#011.dst: Todo empezó cuando descubrí una vieja tumba en el norte del desierto. Al entrar, el suelo empezó a temblar y oí gritos inhumanos que venían de lo más hondo.
Wrath of the Mummy#011.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#012.src: I ran as fast as I could, learning later the tomb housed the remains of an ancient Mummy... which I accidentally awoke. If the Mummy could be put back to rest, perhaps the curse would go away.
Wrath of the Mummy#012.dst: Corrí todo lo que pude, y más tarde supe que la tumba guardaba los restos de una antigua momia... que desperté sin querer. Si la momia volviera a descansar, quizá la maldición desaparecería.
Wrath of the Mummy#012.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#013.src: I have heard of a scholar in {p}, Achper, who may know more about the tomb. I am reluctant to return to the city, in case my presence hurts anyone else.
Wrath of the Mummy#013.dst: He oído que en {p} hay un erudito, Achper, que quizá sepa más de la tumba. No quiero volver a la ciudad, por si mi presencia hace daño a alguien más.
Wrath of the Mummy#013.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#014.src: If you would truly like to help, you should start by talking to him.
Wrath of the Mummy#014.dst: Si de verdad quieres ayudar, deberías empezar por hablar con él.
Wrath of the Mummy#014.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#015.src: Talk to Achper in {p} about the curse at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Wrath of the Mummy#015.dst: Habla con Achper en {p} sobre la maldición en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Wrath of the Mummy#016.src: If I know about mummies? Of course! I've spent my entire life studying them!
Wrath of the Mummy#016.dst: ¿Que si sé de momias? ¡Pues claro! ¡Me he pasado la vida estudiándolas!
Wrath of the Mummy#016.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#017.src: They usually are very hard to reach, hidden in their tomb... and they don't like being disturbed.
Wrath of the Mummy#017.dst: Suelen ser muy difíciles de alcanzar, escondidas en sus tumbas... y no les gusta que las molesten.
Wrath of the Mummy#017.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#018.src: I have heard of the curse that follows Ormrod, and the only way to remove its effects would be to kill the mummy.
Wrath of the Mummy#018.dst: He oído hablar de la maldición que persigue a Ormrod, y la única forma de quitársela sería matar a la momia.
Wrath of the Mummy#018.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#019.src: The tomb lies in the North of the desert, but be very careful!
Wrath of the Mummy#019.dst: La tumba está en el norte del desierto, ¡pero ten mucho cuidado!
Wrath of the Mummy#019.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#020.src: Mummies aren't known to be weak... especially that one. It's demonic... pure evil, It's easily one of the most powerful specimens I've encountered.
Wrath of the Mummy#020.dst: Las momias no tienen fama de débiles... sobre todo esa. Es demoníaca... el mal en estado puro. Es fácilmente uno de los especímenes más poderosos que he visto.
Wrath of the Mummy#020.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#021.src: On top of that, the Creden Tibus bandit clan have been ransacking the tombs around the desert. You might run into trouble with them, so be prepared.
Wrath of the Mummy#021.dst: Además, el clan de bandidos Creden Tibus lleva tiempo saqueando las tumbas del desierto. Puede que tengas problemas con ellos, así que prepárate.
Wrath of the Mummy#021.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#022.src: Attempt to enter the Mummy's tomb at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Wrath of the Mummy#022.dst: Intenta entrar en la tumba de la momia en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Wrath of the Mummy#023.src: Stop! If you're thinking about looting the tomb, you're too late. The Creden Tibus have laid claim here, and you're not getting past.
Wrath of the Mummy#023.dst: ¡Alto! Si piensas saquear la tumba, llegas tarde. Los Creden Tibus la han reclamado, y no vas a pasar.
Wrath of the Mummy#023.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#024.src: Mummy? Curse? I don't know anything about that, but I can't let you in - how do I know you won't just grab the gold?
Wrath of the Mummy#024.dst: ¿Momia? ¿Maldición? No sé nada de eso, pero no puedo dejarte entrar: ¿cómo sé que no te llevarás el oro?
Wrath of the Mummy#024.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#025.src: Unless... look. I've been waiting to get my hands on some pink wool, and the only shop that sells it has just been restocked.
Wrath of the Mummy#025.dst: A no ser que... mira. Llevo tiempo queriendo hacerme con lana rosa, y la única tienda que la vende acaba de reponer.
Wrath of the Mummy#025.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#026.src: Trouble is, the shop's over in {p} and I'm stuck guarding this tomb. If you go and grab me some before it sells out, I can look the other way.
Wrath of the Mummy#026.dst: El problema es que la tienda está en {p} y yo estoy atrapado vigilando esta tumba. Si vas y me traes un poco antes de que se agote, haré la vista gorda.
Wrath of the Mummy#026.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#027.src: You can take my wagon over there, but you'll have to make your own way back. Give me [{~} Pink Wool] and I'll let you through.
Wrath of the Mummy#027.dst: Puedes ir en mi carreta, pero la vuelta te la buscas tú. Dame [{~} Pink Wool] y te dejaré pasar.
Wrath of the Mummy#027.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#028.src: Use the bandit's wagon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to get to {p}.
Wrath of the Mummy#028.dst: Usa la carreta del bandido en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para llegar a {p}.

Wrath of the Mummy#029.src: Bring back [{~} Pink Wool] to the bandit at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Wrath of the Mummy#029.dst: Lleva [{~} Pink Wool] al bandido en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Wrath of the Mummy#030.src: Well, whaddya know? You got some Pink Wool! Okay, hand it here and I'll look the other way and let you into the tomb.
Wrath of the Mummy#030.dst: Vaya, ¿quién lo iba a decir? ¡Tienes lana rosa! Vale, dámela y haré la vista gorda para que entres en la tumba.
Wrath of the Mummy#030.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#031.src: Just don't touch any of the gold, hmm? And if I were you, I wouldn't go in too deep.
Wrath of the Mummy#031.dst: Pero no toques nada del oro, ¿eh? Y yo en tu lugar, no me adentraría demasiado.
Wrath of the Mummy#031.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#032.src: The clan was going to explore further inside, but the sounds...
Wrath of the Mummy#032.dst: El clan iba a explorar más adentro, pero esos ruidos...
Wrath of the Mummy#032.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#033.src: Anyway, I'll still let you inside if you want. Just remember, if anyone asks, this conversation never happened.
Wrath of the Mummy#033.dst: En fin, si quieres te sigo dejando entrar. Pero recuerda: si alguien pregunta, esta conversación nunca ocurrió.
Wrath of the Mummy#033.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#034.src: Enter the tomb at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and kill the Mummy.
Wrath of the Mummy#034.dst: Entra en la tumba en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] y mata a la momia.

Wrath of the Mummy#035.src: Bring [{~} Mummy's Bandage] to Ormrod at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Wrath of the Mummy#035.dst: Lleva [{~} Mummy's Bandage] a Ormrod en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Wrath of the Mummy#036.src: Hello, again... have you had any luck?
Wrath of the Mummy#036.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#037.src: Those are the Mummy's bandages?! You did it? My curse is finally lifted!
Wrath of the Mummy#037.dst: ¿¡Las vendas de la momia!? ¿Lo lograste? ¡Por fin se rompió mi maldición!
Wrath of the Mummy#037.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#038.src: I can't thank you enough! As a reward, take this rag I got from the Mummy when I entered the tomb.
Wrath of the Mummy#038.dst: ¡No sé cómo agradecértelo! Como premio, toma este harapo que le quité a la momia en la tumba.
Wrath of the Mummy#038.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#039.src: I am not strong enough to wear it, but I'm sure you are! Take these emeralds too, that's the least I can do!
Wrath of the Mummy#039.dst: Yo no tengo fuerza para llevarlo, ¡pero tú seguro que sí! Toma también estas esmeraldas, ¡es lo mínimo!
Wrath of the Mummy#039.speaker: Ormrod

WynnExcavation Site A#000.dst: Habla con el excavador Vade en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

WynnExcavation Site A#001.src: Oh, hey kid. Wanna make some money?
WynnExcavation Site A#001.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#002.src: I need you to translate this ancient text.
WynnExcavation Site A#002.dst: Necesito que traduzcas este texto antiguo.
WynnExcavation Site A#002.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#003.src: Just run it down to the lab assistant, Tesha.
WynnExcavation Site A#003.dst: Llévaselo a la ayudante de laboratorio, Tesha.
WynnExcavation Site A#003.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#004.src: I'd take it myself, but I'm far too important for grunt work! The lab is up there in the tent, and don't you dare damage the translation!
WynnExcavation Site A#004.dst: Lo llevaría yo, ¡pero soy demasiado importante para el trabajo sucio! El laboratorio está ahí arriba, en la tienda, ¡y ni se te ocurra dañar la traducción!
WynnExcavation Site A#004.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#005.src: Bring the Ancient Writing to Tesha in the tents at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
WynnExcavation Site A#005.dst: Lleva el escrito antiguo a Tesha, en las tiendas de [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

WynnExcavation Site A#008.src: Oh yes, the tablet I was waiting for!
WynnExcavation Site A#008.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#010.src: Oh my! This is quite interesting..
WynnExcavation Site A#010.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#011.src: Here, let me finish this up...
WynnExcavation Site A#011.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#013.src: One tablet complete! Return it to Vade. Oh and don't read it!
WynnExcavation Site A#013.dst: ¡Tablilla terminada! Devuélvesela a Vade. ¡Ah, y no la leas!
WynnExcavation Site A#013.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#014.src: Return to Excavator Vade with the translated writing
WynnExcavation Site A#014.dst: Vuelve con el excavador Vade con el escrito traducido

WynnExcavation Site A#016.src: Oh right, you're that kid I sent out!
WynnExcavation Site A#016.dst: ¡Ah, claro, eres el chaval que mandé!
WynnExcavation Site A#016.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#017.src: Well do you have the translated text or not?
WynnExcavation Site A#017.dst: Bueno, ¿tienes el texto traducido o no?
WynnExcavation Site A#017.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#018.src: You do! Brilliant! Let's take a look at that...
WynnExcavation Site A#018.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#019.src: "Throw tribute an item to the wood that stands out, the right angle will open the way"
WynnExcavation Site A#019.dst: "Arroja en tributo un objeto a la madera que destaca; el ángulo correcto abrirá el camino"
WynnExcavation Site A#019.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#020.src: I wonder if it is talking about inside the temple... Oh, uh, I forgot you were here. Stay out of this kid, it's grown up business!
WynnExcavation Site A#020.dst: Me pregunto si habla del interior del templo... Oh, eh, olvidé que estabas aquí. No te metas en esto, chaval, ¡son cosas de mayores!
WynnExcavation Site A#020.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#021.src: Solve this riddle in the tomb: "Throw tribute an item to the wood that stands out, the right angle will open the way"
WynnExcavation Site A#021.dst: Resuelve este acertijo en la tumba: "Arroja en tributo un objeto a la madera que destaca; el ángulo correcto abrirá el camino"

WynnExcavation Site A#023.src: Return and talk to Excavator Vade
WynnExcavation Site A#023.dst: Vuelve y habla con el excavador Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#024.src: Hey kid, did you just come from the tomb?
WynnExcavation Site A#024.dst: Eh, chaval, ¿acabas de salir de la tumba?
WynnExcavation Site A#024.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#025.src: I knew I shouldn't have been so lazy and got someone else to do the leg work!
WynnExcavation Site A#025.dst: ¡Sabía que no debí ser tan vago y mandar a otro a hacer el trabajo!
WynnExcavation Site A#025.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#026.src: Gosh, I can't tell my boss about this, he'll have my head! Literally! Wynn Excavation is not a group you want to betray, they are more powerful than you will ever know.
WynnExcavation Site A#026.dst: Madre mía, no puedo contarle esto a mi jefe, ¡me cortará la cabeza! ¡Literalmente! WynnExcavation no es un grupo al que quieras traicionar, son más poderosos de lo que imaginas.
WynnExcavation Site A#026.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#027.src: YOU'D BETTER NOT HAVE TAKEN ANYTHING! THAT IS OFFICIAL WYNNEXCAVATION PROPERTY!
WynnExcavation Site A#027.dst: ¡MÁS TE VALE NO HABERTE LLEVADO NADA! ¡ES PROPIEDAD OFICIAL DE WYNNEXCAVATION!
WynnExcavation Site A#027.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site B#000.src: Bring the Yellow Crystal Shard to Excavator Lykron at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] The entrance to the cave is at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
WynnExcavation Site B#000.dst: Lleva el fragmento de cristal amarillo al excavador Lykron en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]. La entrada a la cueva está en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

WynnExcavation Site B#001.src: Good day! You're the person that helped us out in the desert aren't you? Excellent! Just the person I need! Can you help me out with a problem I have?
WynnExcavation Site B#001.dst: ¡Buenos días! Tú eres quien nos ayudó en el desierto, ¿verdad? ¡Excelente! ¡Justo a quien necesito! ¿Me ayudas con un problema que tengo?
WynnExcavation Site B#001.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#002.src: Perfect! You see, we are supposed to be searching for some of the... uhhh... long lost ruins of ancient Wynn, just like in the desert!
WynnExcavation Site B#002.dst: ¡Perfecto! Verás, se supone que buscamos unas... eeh... ruinas perdidas hace mucho de la antigua Wynn, ¡igual que en el desierto!
WynnExcavation Site B#002.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#003.src: However, it seems no progress has been made recently; my workers have stopped working!
WynnExcavation Site B#003.dst: Pero parece que últimamente no se avanza nada: ¡mis trabajadores han dejado de trabajar!
WynnExcavation Site B#003.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#004.src: The problem is, there are strange creatures down at the bottom of the cave disturbing them.
WynnExcavation Site B#004.dst: El problema es que en el fondo de la cueva hay criaturas extrañas que los molestan.
WynnExcavation Site B#004.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#005.src: I need you to go and kill them, but first you should go talk to one of my colleagues, he has more information for you.
WynnExcavation Site B#005.dst: Necesito que vayas a matarlas, pero antes habla con uno de mis colegas, él tiene más información para ti.
WynnExcavation Site B#005.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#006.src: He is located directly at the bottom of this cave, go speak to him, go on now! Off you go!
WynnExcavation Site B#006.dst: Está justo en el fondo de esta cueva, ve a hablar con él, ¡venga! ¡En marcha!
WynnExcavation Site B#006.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#007.src: Investigate the depths of the cave
WynnExcavation Site B#007.dst: Investiga las profundidades de la cueva

WynnExcavation Site B#008.src: We know what you stole from us in the desert! Take THIS! You won't be escaping this dead end any time soon!
WynnExcavation Site B#008.dst: ¡Sabemos lo que nos robaste en el desierto! ¡Toma ESTO! ¡No saldrás de este callejón sin salida tan pronto!
WynnExcavation Site B#008.speaker: Flendar

WynnExcavation Site B#012.src: This door is closed; the mine entrance behind it isn't open at this time.
WynnExcavation Site B#012.dst: Esta puerta está cerrada; la entrada a la mina de detrás no está abierta.
WynnExcavation Site B#012.speaker: WynnExcavation Guard

WynnExcavation Site B#013.src: I'm here to make sure no one uses the passage while the archaeologist works.
WynnExcavation Site B#013.dst: Estoy aquí para que nadie use el pasadizo mientras trabaja el arqueólogo.
WynnExcavation Site B#013.speaker: WynnExcavation Guard

WynnExcavation Site B#014.src: You will have to find another exit if you want to get out!
WynnExcavation Site B#014.dst: ¡Si quieres salir, tendrás que buscar otra salida!
WynnExcavation Site B#014.speaker: WynnExcavation Guard

WynnExcavation Site B#015.src: Baffling... What a puzzling situation I am in...
WynnExcavation Site B#015.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#016.src: I cannot open this door for some reason...
WynnExcavation Site B#016.dst: Por algún motivo no puedo abrir esta puerta...
WynnExcavation Site B#016.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#017.src: We suspect the purple crystal is behind this door, but the descriptions in the scriptures don't match this door.
WynnExcavation Site B#017.dst: Sospechamos que el cristal morado está tras esta puerta, pero las descripciones de las escrituras no encajan con ella.
WynnExcavation Site B#017.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#018.src: They seem to describe another door, but all our evidence says otherwise.
WynnExcavation Site B#018.dst: Parecen describir otra puerta, pero todas nuestras pruebas dicen lo contrario.
WynnExcavation Site B#018.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#019.src: The scriptures also say something about hidden within the rocks... But we removed them all!
WynnExcavation Site B#019.dst: Las escrituras también hablan de algo oculto entre las rocas... ¡Pero las quitamos todas!
WynnExcavation Site B#019.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#020.src: Well, the writing isn't actually all that clear. It could mean virtually anything, I think one of these words means hippo! Guess we'll have to find out!
WynnExcavation Site B#020.dst: Bueno, el escrito no está tan claro. Podría significar casi cualquier cosa, ¡creo que una de estas palabras significa hipopótamo! ¡Habrá que averiguarlo!
WynnExcavation Site B#020.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#021.src: Anyway, back to figuring out what needs to be done here... Wait, who are you, you're not an employee of WynnExcavation!
WynnExcavation Site B#021.dst: En fin, volvamos a averiguar qué hay que hacer aquí... Espera, ¿quién eres? ¡No trabajas para WynnExcavation!
WynnExcavation Site B#021.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#023.src: I have to admit, I'm impressed. I genuinely thought our plan would be successful. Who knew that dead end had a secret exit.
WynnExcavation Site B#023.dst: He de admitirlo, estoy impresionado. De verdad creía que nuestro plan funcionaría. Quién iba a saber que ese callejón tenía una salida secreta.
WynnExcavation Site B#023.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#024.src: Not me apparently. We know what you took in the desert, you were just some kid expected to do a delivery job, who knew you'd take a shard of the crystal.
WynnExcavation Site B#024.dst: Yo no, por lo visto. Sabemos lo que te llevaste en el desierto; eras un simple recadero, ¿quién iba a pensar que te quedarías un fragmento del cristal?
WynnExcavation Site B#024.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#025.src: Don't pretend like you don't know what it is, you know as well as I do combining the four crystal shards is told to bring unlimited power!
WynnExcavation Site B#025.dst: No finjas que no sabes qué es; sabes tan bien como yo que, según dicen, unir los cuatro fragmentos de cristal otorga un poder ilimitado.
WynnExcavation Site B#025.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#026.src: You will not interfere any longer. The location of the remaining crystals are known only to us; the fire and leaf crystals are safe.
WynnExcavation Site B#026.dst: No volverás a interferir. Solo nosotros sabemos dónde están los demás cristales; los cristales de fuego y de hoja están a salvo.
WynnExcavation Site B#026.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#027.src: I see that tricking you isn't the way to defeating you. If we ever meet again, we'll be using force and upping our security. Now I never want to see you again. Our socie- I mean company, will not tolerate your interference again.
WynnExcavation Site B#027.dst: Ya veo que engañarte no es la forma de derrotarte. Si volvemos a vernos, usaremos la fuerza y reforzaremos la seguridad. Y ahora no quiero volver a verte. Nuestra socie- digo, empresa, no tolerará otra interferencia tuya.
WynnExcavation Site B#027.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site C#000.src: I hope all of our troubles have been settled. Now if you'll excuse me, I have a meeting to attend.
WynnExcavation Site C#000.dst: Espero que todos nuestros problemas se hayan resuelto. Y ahora, si me disculpas, tengo una reunión.

WynnExcavation Site C#001.src: Talk to Excavator Placardus at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Requires shard from Site B)
WynnExcavation Site C#001.dst: Habla con el excavador Placardus en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (requiere el fragmento del yacimiento B)

WynnExcavation Site C#002.src: All operations functional... Transportation on schedule... Oh. It's you. We've been looking for you.
WynnExcavation Site C#002.dst: Todo operativo... Transporte según lo previsto... Oh. Eres tú. Te estábamos buscando.
WynnExcavation Site C#002.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#003.src: Locating you was far harder than we thought, but here you are, having come right to us.
WynnExcavation Site C#003.dst: Dar contigo fue mucho más difícil de lo que pensábamos, pero aquí estás, has venido tú solito.
WynnExcavation Site C#003.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#004.src: Now you're here, I'm not sure what to say. But I feel I must explain, we at WynnExcavation apologise for all our previous encounters.
WynnExcavation Site C#004.dst: Ahora que estás aquí, no sé muy bien qué decir. Pero debo explicarme: en WynnExcavation te pedimos disculpas por todos nuestros encuentros.
WynnExcavation Site C#004.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#005.src: We completely got off on the wrong foot. We are a company from Gavel which specialises in historic artifacts of great mystical importance.
WynnExcavation Site C#005.dst: Empezamos con muy mal pie. Somos una empresa de Gavel especializada en artefactos históricos de gran importancia mística.
WynnExcavation Site C#005.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#006.src: After our encounter in {p}, we naturally thought you were a black market salesperson trying to steal pieces of the artifact for monetary gain.
WynnExcavation Site C#006.dst: Tras nuestro encuentro en {p}, dimos por hecho que vendías en el mercado negro y querías robar piezas del artefacto para lucrarte.
WynnExcavation Site C#006.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#007.src: So we instructed all of our employees in all of our sites to thwart you at any cost. Historical loss is a very important issue, especially with something so powerful.
WynnExcavation Site C#007.dst: Así que ordenamos a todos los empleados de todos nuestros yacimientos que te frenaran a toda costa. La pérdida histórica es un asunto muy serio, más aún con algo tan poderoso.
WynnExcavation Site C#007.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#008.src: But after hearing the stories of your travels in the province, we realised what had happened, and you mistook us for the enemy. This is obviously not the case.
WynnExcavation Site C#008.dst: Pero al oír las historias de tus viajes por la provincia, entendimos lo que había pasado: nos tomaste por el enemigo. Y está claro que no es así.
WynnExcavation Site C#008.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#009.src: I hope this clears everything up between us and we can both move our separate ways, now if you'll excuse me, I have a meeting to attend.
WynnExcavation Site C#009.dst: Espero que esto lo aclare todo entre nosotros y que cada uno siga su camino. Y ahora, si me disculpas, tengo una reunión.
WynnExcavation Site C#009.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#010.src: Infiltrate the Excavation Meeting. The meeting is held in a diamond-pickaxe room, the portal being located to the left of the entrance to a large lava cave.
WynnExcavation Site C#010.dst: Infíltrate en la reunión de la excavación. Se celebra en una sala con un pico de diamante; el portal está a la izquierda de la entrada a una gran cueva de lava.

WynnExcavation Site C#011.src: I'm sorry. This is a private meeting.
WynnExcavation Site C#011.dst: Lo siento. Es una reunión privada.
WynnExcavation Site C#011.speaker: Guard Klerodor

WynnExcavation Site C#012.src: It is only my first day on the job, so I can't let you in without a pass. Sorry.
WynnExcavation Site C#012.dst: Es mi primer día, así que sin pase no puedo dejarte pasar. Lo siento.
WynnExcavation Site C#012.speaker: Guard Klerodor

WynnExcavation Site C#013.src: The door will be locked shortly.
WynnExcavation Site C#013.dst: La puerta se cerrará en breve.
WynnExcavation Site C#013.speaker: Guard Klerodor

WynnExcavation Site C#015.src: Hello and welcome, senior members of Wynn Excavation Site C. May the dark's gaze forever watch over us. I want to update you on our progress thus far. The fire relic crystal has been largely intact in the heart of the volcano for many years.
WynnExcavation Site C#015.dst: Hola y bienvenidos, miembros veteranos del yacimiento C de Wynn Excavation. Que la mirada de la oscuridad vele siempre por nosotros. Quiero informaros de nuestros avances. El cristal reliquia de fuego lleva muchos años casi intacto en el corazón del volcán.
WynnExcavation Site C#015.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#016.src: Removing it will most likely cause a chain reaction and make things difficult. Fortunately, a mage from the other side of the ocean is here to counter that. We can expect to have it moved and be shipped over to the undisclosed location any day now.
WynnExcavation Site C#016.dst: Extraerlo provocará casi seguro una reacción en cadena y complicará las cosas. Por suerte, ha venido un mago del otro lado del océano para contrarrestarlo. Podemos esperar que lo trasladen y lo envíen al lugar secreto cualquier día de estos.
WynnExcavation Site C#016.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#017.src: I would also like to inform you that the crystals removed from our possession from sites B and A have not been retrieved. However, the culprit should no longer be interested in our operations. The lost crystals did not harness any raw magic, thus are not essential to the overall scheme.
WynnExcavation Site C#017.dst: También quiero informaros de que los cristales que nos arrebataron en los yacimientos B y A no se han recuperado. Sin embargo, al culpable ya no deberían interesarle nuestras operaciones. Los cristales perdidos no contenían magia pura, así que no son esenciales para el plan general.
WynnExcavation Site C#017.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#018.src: Now, our short term goals are to move our equipment out of the heart of the volcano and start moving the fire stone for assimilation at the concealed location. All senior officers are responsible for their quadrants. Let's get this done efficiently and discreetly.
WynnExcavation Site C#018.dst: Nuestros objetivos a corto plazo son sacar el equipo del corazón del volcán y empezar a trasladar la piedra de fuego al lugar oculto para su asimilación. Cada oficial veterano responde de su cuadrante. Hagámoslo con eficacia y discreción.
WynnExcavation Site C#018.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#020.src: The alarm has been set off! There is an unauthorized guest! Guards, seize them!
WynnExcavation Site C#020.dst: ¡Ha saltado la alarma! ¡Hay un intruso! ¡Guardias, atrapadlo!
WynnExcavation Site C#020.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#021.dst: Escapa de los guardias de WynnExcavation

WynnExcavation Site C#022.src: Explore the area and search for the traitor
WynnExcavation Site C#022.dst: Explora la zona y busca al traidor

WynnExcavation Site C#023.src: You. You are the one they are worried about.
WynnExcavation Site C#023.dst: Tú. Tú eres quien les tiene tan preocupados.

WynnExcavation Site C#024.src: I am Amadel, leader of the rebellion.
WynnExcavation Site C#024.dst: Soy Amadel, líder de la rebelión.

WynnExcavation Site C#025.src: I know this is all a bit sudden, but I have some information you must hear.
WynnExcavation Site C#025.dst: Sé que todo esto es algo repentino, pero tengo información que debes oír.
WynnExcavation Site C#025.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#026.src: Everything you have been told is a lie. The Wynn Excavation “company” are not what they appear to be.
WynnExcavation Site C#026.dst: Todo lo que te han contado es mentira. La «empresa» Wynn Excavation no es lo que parece.
WynnExcavation Site C#026.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#027.src: They are using that as a front and their reach stretches further than I even know.
WynnExcavation Site C#027.dst: La usan como tapadera y su alcance llega más lejos de lo que incluso yo sé.
WynnExcavation Site C#027.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#028.src: There is no higher authority than them, not even the kings. And their intentions are not good.
WynnExcavation Site C#028.dst: No hay autoridad por encima de ellos, ni siquiera los reyes. Y sus intenciones no son buenas.
WynnExcavation Site C#028.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#029.src: They seek the ultimate power, a power hidden across Wynn by various civilizations over hundreds of years.
WynnExcavation Site C#029.dst: Buscan el poder supremo, un poder que varias civilizaciones escondieron por todo Wynn durante cientos de años.
WynnExcavation Site C#029.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#030.src: They heard about it, and of course, began to gather the ingredients to create something that would lead them to total domination of the province.
WynnExcavation Site C#030.dst: Se enteraron y, por supuesto, empezaron a reunir los ingredientes para crear algo que les diera el dominio total de la provincia.
WynnExcavation Site C#030.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#031.src: They've been on to me for some time. I can't tell you everything here, but first, you must gather parts of the crystal, like you did with the others. It is essential.
WynnExcavation Site C#031.dst: Hace tiempo que me siguen la pista. Aquí no puedo contártelo todo, pero primero debes reunir partes del cristal, como hiciste con los otros. Es esencial.
WynnExcavation Site C#031.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#032.src: The crystal is in the cave just inside the volcano past the base. Hurry, they are all off duty at the moment, the cave to the heart of the volcano is clear. Act swiftly, and good luck.
WynnExcavation Site C#032.dst: El cristal está en la cueva justo dentro del volcán, pasada la base. Date prisa, ahora están todos fuera de servicio y la cueva al corazón del volcán está despejada. Actúa rápido, y suerte.
WynnExcavation Site C#032.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#033.src: Explore the depths of the volcano

WynnExcavation Site C#034.src: Escape the volcano with the crystal shard
WynnExcavation Site C#034.dst: Escapa del volcán con el fragmento de cristal

WynnExcavation Site C#035.src: Report back to Excavator Placardus with a [Red Crystal Shard]
WynnExcavation Site C#035.dst: Vuelve con el excavador Placardus con un [Red Crystal Shard]

WynnExcavation Site C#036.src: You couldn't just take my polite word and leave it at that, could you?
WynnExcavation Site C#036.dst: No podías aceptar mi palabra educada y dejarlo estar, ¿verdad?
WynnExcavation Site C#036.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#037.src: You had to go snooping around, meddle in things that are far beyond your comprehension. No matter. Something did come out of this, it would appear.
WynnExcavation Site C#037.dst: Tenías que ir husmeando, meterte en asuntos que escapan con mucho a tu comprensión. No importa. Parece que algo bueno ha salido de todo esto.
WynnExcavation Site C#037.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#038.src: You were caught, conversing with Amadel, who we now know to be a traitor, thanks to you. There are eyes everywhere, young hero.
WynnExcavation Site C#038.dst: Te pillaron hablando con Amadel, que ahora sabemos que es un traidor, gracias a ti. Hay ojos por todas partes, joven héroe.
WynnExcavation Site C#038.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#039.src: I'm willing to bet he's already been... taken care of by senior staff.
WynnExcavation Site C#039.dst: Apuesto a que los altos cargos ya se han... ocupado de él.
WynnExcavation Site C#039.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#040.src: We also now know you are operating in the dark. You know nothing of the crystals or their power, and you know not that even the crystals you possess are inconsequential to our plans.
WynnExcavation Site C#040.dst: Ahora también sabemos que vas a ciegas. No sabes nada de los cristales ni de su poder, y ni siquiera sabes que los cristales que tienes son irrelevantes para nuestros planes.
WynnExcavation Site C#040.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#041.src: You're lucky you aren't dead. How you infiltrated us this far has shown nothing but beginner's luck for the province's new hero.
WynnExcavation Site C#041.dst: Tienes suerte de seguir con vida. Haber llegado hasta aquí no demuestra más que la suerte del principiante del nuevo héroe de la provincia.
WynnExcavation Site C#041.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#042.src: I suggest you leave, before the guards get here and you meet the same fate as Amadel. Our power is limitless; armies, resources, even royalty are on our side. Our gaze is everpresent. Now, get out of my sight!
WynnExcavation Site C#042.dst: Te sugiero que te vayas antes de que lleguen los guardias y acabes como Amadel. Nuestro poder es ilimitado: ejércitos, recursos, hasta la realeza está con nosotros. Nuestra mirada lo ve todo. ¡Y ahora, fuera de mi vista!
WynnExcavation Site C#042.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site D#000.src: I remember being told something by my adoptive father, and he was a king of {p} himself!
WynnExcavation Site D#000.dst: Recuerdo algo que me contó mi padre adoptivo, ¡y él mismo era rey de {p}!

WynnExcavation Site D#001.src: Talk to Royal Advisor Carlos in {p} Castle at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Requires shard from Site C)
WynnExcavation Site D#001.dst: Habla con el consejero real Carlos en el castillo de {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (requiere el fragmento del yacimiento C)

WynnExcavation Site D#002.src: His majesty Lord King of {p} is indisposed at this moment.
WynnExcavation Site D#002.dst: Su Majestad el rey de {p} no puede recibir a nadie en este momento.
WynnExcavation Site D#002.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#003.src: He recieved a message and made his way frantically down to the panic room, which is somewhere inside of this throne room.
WynnExcavation Site D#003.dst: Recibió un mensaje y bajó a toda prisa a la cámara de seguridad, que está en algún lugar de este salón del trono.
WynnExcavation Site D#003.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#004.src: He hasn't been seen since. Only the King knows how to get into the panic room, but I've had my suspicions about it for a while now.
WynnExcavation Site D#004.dst: Desde entonces nadie lo ha visto. Solo el rey sabe cómo entrar en la cámara de seguridad, pero hace tiempo que tengo mis sospechas.
WynnExcavation Site D#004.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#005.src: He seemed to be expecting someone, but I'm fed up of waiting.
WynnExcavation Site D#005.dst: Parecía estar esperando a alguien, pero estoy harto de esperar.
WynnExcavation Site D#005.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#006.src: I managed to hear a few things he was muttering to himself just before he disappeared, though.
WynnExcavation Site D#006.dst: Aun así, logré oír algunas cosas que murmuraba justo antes de desaparecer.
WynnExcavation Site D#006.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#007.src: He mentioned something about a fourth crystal... a green one.
WynnExcavation Site D#007.dst: Mencionó algo sobre un cuarto cristal... uno verde.
WynnExcavation Site D#007.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#008.src: And then he said "The order of the crystals will open the way".Maybe it's a clue as to how to find him?
WynnExcavation Site D#008.dst: Y luego dijo: «El orden de los cristales abrirá el camino». ¿Quizá sea una pista para encontrarlo?
WynnExcavation Site D#008.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#009.src: Please, we need to find him, I'm sick of telling everyone he's indisposed!
WynnExcavation Site D#009.dst: ¡Por favor, hay que encontrarlo, estoy harto de decir que no recibe a nadie!
WynnExcavation Site D#009.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#010.src: Find the secret passageway inside of the throne room
WynnExcavation Site D#010.dst: Encuentra el pasadizo secreto del salón del trono

WynnExcavation Site D#011.src: Oh my, a secret passage has opened up beneath the throne! Quickly, head inside!
WynnExcavation Site D#011.dst: ¡Madre mía, se ha abierto un pasadizo secreto bajo el trono! ¡Rápido, entre!
WynnExcavation Site D#011.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#012.dst: Explora los secretos bajo el castillo de {p}

WynnExcavation Site D#014.src: I am impressed you managed to find me. Someone of my intellect is not normally found when he hasn't the intention of being so.
WynnExcavation Site D#014.dst: Me impresiona que hayas logrado encontrarme. A alguien de mi intelecto no se le suele encontrar cuando no tiene intención de ser encontrado.
WynnExcavation Site D#014.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#015.src: I suppose I at least owe you the truth for getting this far, not that it matters.
WynnExcavation Site D#015.dst: Supongo que, por haber llegado hasta aquí, al menos te debo la verdad, aunque ya no importe.
WynnExcavation Site D#015.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#016.src: WynnExcavation, the Gavel company is a fake, a facade. It's not real....
WynnExcavation Site D#016.dst: WynnExcavation, la empresa de Gavel, es un engaño, una fachada. No es real....
WynnExcavation Site D#016.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#017.src: It's actually a secret society run by the high and mighty of Gavel.
WynnExcavation Site D#017.dst: En realidad es una sociedad secreta dirigida por los poderosos de Gavel.
WynnExcavation Site D#017.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#018.src: They have one goal, complete control.
WynnExcavation Site D#018.dst: Su único fin: el control total.
WynnExcavation Site D#018.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#019.src: You can't compete with them, kid. I tried to at first, but they had turned my inner circle before getting to me.
WynnExcavation Site D#019.dst: No puedes con ellos, chaval. Yo lo intenté al principio, pero se ganaron a mi círculo íntimo antes de llegar a mí.
WynnExcavation Site D#019.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#020.src: Though I cannot admit I fought hard, their ideals are admirable.
WynnExcavation Site D#020.dst: Aunque no puedo decir que luchara mucho, sus ideales son admirables.
WynnExcavation Site D#020.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#021.src: So I hope you will forgive me, I act only for the greater good of the world.
WynnExcavation Site D#021.dst: Así que espero que me perdones: solo actúo por el bien mayor del mundo.
WynnExcavation Site D#021.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#022.src: As you will not be leaving the city, I wish you a fond farewell. When you leave, you will be accused of treason and will be hunted. It is the only way...
WynnExcavation Site D#022.dst: Como no vas a salir de la ciudad, te deseo una afectuosa despedida. Cuando salgas, te acusarán de traición y te darán caza. Es la única manera...
WynnExcavation Site D#022.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#023.dst: Sal de la estancia del rey

WynnExcavation Site D#024.src: Time is short, so I'll have to spare you the details, but let's just say I'm on your side.
WynnExcavation Site D#024.dst: Hay poco tiempo, así que me ahorraré los detalles, pero digamos que estoy de tu parte.
WynnExcavation Site D#024.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#025.src: The King just placed you under arrest for treason. They've locked down the entire city.
WynnExcavation Site D#025.dst: El rey acaba de ordenar tu arresto por traición. Han cerrado toda la ciudad.
WynnExcavation Site D#025.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#026.src: Both the front gate and the Passage are closed down. So we've created another exit for you.
WynnExcavation Site D#026.dst: Tanto la puerta principal como el Pasaje están cerrados. Así que te hemos abierto otra salida.
WynnExcavation Site D#026.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#027.src: Just follow the path to your left around the city. Keep going until you see a villager next to a tunnel. We'll clear your name once you've escaped.
WynnExcavation Site D#027.dst: Sigue el camino de tu izquierda rodeando la ciudad. Continúa hasta ver a un aldeano junto a un túnel. Limpiaremos tu nombre cuando hayas escapado.
WynnExcavation Site D#027.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#028.src: You'll pass through the army headquarters on your way, so be prepared for a fight. I'm the only guard here to help you.
WynnExcavation Site D#028.dst: Pasarás por el cuartel del ejército, así que prepárate para luchar. Soy el único guardia aquí que puede ayudarte.
WynnExcavation Site D#028.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#029.src: Now run! We don't have another moment to waste!
WynnExcavation Site D#029.dst: ¡Ahora corre! ¡No hay ni un segundo que perder!
WynnExcavation Site D#029.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#032.src: Take this, and run! You need to get out!

WynnExcavation Site D#033.src: Head to those coordinates, there is no time to explain, now go! I'll close the tunnel behind you.
WynnExcavation Site D#033.dst: Ve a esas coordenadas, no hay tiempo para explicaciones, ¡vamos! Cerraré el túnel detrás de ti.

WynnExcavation Site D#034.src: I'VE FOUND THE TRAITOR! THEY'RE OVER HERE!

WynnExcavation Site D#035.src: Head to the location on the note
WynnExcavation Site D#035.dst: Ve al lugar indicado en la nota

WynnExcavation Site D#037.src: I'm sorry, I can't let you in there.
WynnExcavation Site D#037.dst: Lo siento, no puedo dejarte entrar ahí.
WynnExcavation Site D#037.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#038.src: I can't let you in there, not until you have proven you are truly on our side.
WynnExcavation Site D#038.dst: No puedo dejarte entrar hasta que demuestres que estás de nuestro lado.
WynnExcavation Site D#038.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#039.src: We never know who to believe anymore. Unfortunately there is no way for you to prove your loyalty.
WynnExcavation Site D#039.dst: Ya no sabemos en quién confiar. Por desgracia, no tienes forma de demostrar tu lealtad.
WynnExcavation Site D#039.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#040.src: Now if you would excuse me, I have to hunt for the lost map fragments of Dernel. I'm sure these eyes have something to do with it...
WynnExcavation Site D#040.dst: Y ahora, si me disculpas, tengo que buscar los fragmentos perdidos del mapa de Dernel. Seguro que estos ojos tienen algo que ver...
WynnExcavation Site D#040.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#041.src: Find the three map fragments by following the eyes and return to Thomas.
WynnExcavation Site D#041.dst: Encuentra los tres fragmentos del mapa siguiendo los ojos y vuelve con Thomas.

WynnExcavation Site D#042.src: I can't let you in, we're busy looking for an important document, I'm sure these eyes have something to do with it...
WynnExcavation Site D#042.dst: No puedo dejarte entrar, estamos buscando un documento importante. Seguro que estos ojos tienen algo que ver...
WynnExcavation Site D#042.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#043.src: Is that... The map fragments? You found them!
WynnExcavation Site D#043.dst: ¿Eso son... los fragmentos del mapa? ¡Los has encontrado!
WynnExcavation Site D#043.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#044.src: Oh my, you better come in.
WynnExcavation Site D#044.dst: Madre mía, será mejor que entres.
WynnExcavation Site D#044.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#045.src: There's not enough time! We need to combine those fragments with ours!
WynnExcavation Site D#045.dst: ¡No hay tiempo! ¡Tenemos que juntar esos fragmentos con los nuestros!
WynnExcavation Site D#045.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#047.dst: Entra en el campamento de los traidores

WynnExcavation Site D#048.dst: Habla con el líder rebelde Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#049.src: Welcome, friend. I knew you would figure it all out.
WynnExcavation Site D#049.dst: Bienvenido, amigo. Sabía que lo descubrirías todo.
WynnExcavation Site D#049.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#050.src: You must be surprised to see me. The excavation crew at site C tried very hard to kill me.
WynnExcavation Site D#050.dst: Te sorprenderá verme. Los excavadores del yacimiento C se esforzaron mucho por matarme.
WynnExcavation Site D#050.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#051.src: They didn't succeed though. I got away, and I swiped a fragment of a map, and I found out what it's for.
WynnExcavation Site D#051.dst: Pero no lo lograron. Escapé, me llevé un fragmento de un mapa y descubrí para qué sirve.
WynnExcavation Site D#051.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#052.src: If you made it this far, you know Wynn Excavation are not what they seem. They want to harness Wynn's ancient power.
WynnExcavation Site D#052.dst: Si has llegado hasta aquí, sabes que Wynn Excavation no es lo que parece. Quieren el antiguo poder de Wynn.
WynnExcavation Site D#052.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#053.src: They control our governments, authorities and seem to be {~} steps ahead of any of us that oppose them.
WynnExcavation Site D#053.dst: Controlan nuestros gobiernos y autoridades, y parecen ir {~} pasos por delante de todos los que se les oponen.
WynnExcavation Site D#053.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#054.src: That is, unless we're able to beat the excavationists to the last crystal.
WynnExcavation Site D#054.dst: A menos que logremos llegar al último cristal antes que los excavadores.
WynnExcavation Site D#054.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#055.src: They cannot use a single shard of power without combining them all.
WynnExcavation Site D#055.dst: No pueden usar ni un solo fragmento de poder sin reunirlos todos.
WynnExcavation Site D#055.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#056.src: Here, I've combined the map fragments behind me. It looks it's deep in the jungle, I wonder where...
WynnExcavation Site D#056.dst: Mira, he unido los fragmentos del mapa que hay detrás de mí. Parece que está en plena jungla, pero ¿dónde...?
WynnExcavation Site D#056.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#057.src: WynnExcavation have done really horrible things, and I used to help...
WynnExcavation Site D#057.dst: WynnExcavation ha hecho cosas horribles, y yo antes les ayudaba...
WynnExcavation Site D#057.speaker: Traitor Buice

WynnExcavation Site D#058.src: WynnExcavation will be destroyed, no matter what!
WynnExcavation Site D#058.dst: ¡WynnExcavation será destruida, cueste lo que cueste!
WynnExcavation Site D#058.speaker: Traitor Jaynar

WynnExcavation Site D#062.dst: Habla con el administrador excavador Uci.

WynnExcavation Site D#063.src: Oh my. It's you. I can't say I'm surprised to see you, we thought you might be stupid enough to come here.
WynnExcavation Site D#063.dst: Vaya. Eres tú. No puedo decir que me sorprenda, ya pensábamos que tendrías tan poco juicio como para venir.
WynnExcavation Site D#063.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#064.src: Stupid enough to come here, yet, smart enough to make it.
WynnExcavation Site D#064.dst: Con tan poco juicio como para venir, pero con cabeza para llegar.
WynnExcavation Site D#064.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#065.src: You were at every site, taking shards and attempting to thwart us.
WynnExcavation Site D#065.dst: Estuviste en cada yacimiento, llevándote fragmentos y estorbándonos.
WynnExcavation Site D#065.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#066.src: This time we won, and you lost.
WynnExcavation Site D#066.dst: Esta vez ganamos nosotros y perdiste tú.
WynnExcavation Site D#066.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#067.src: What do your shards mean to us when we have all four crystals?
WynnExcavation Site D#067.dst: ¿Qué nos importan tus fragmentos si tenemos los cuatro cristales?
WynnExcavation Site D#067.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#068.dst: Nada, eso es lo que importan.
WynnExcavation Site D#068.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#069.src: The boss wants to speak to you, I don't recommend keeping him waiting, he's not a patient man.
WynnExcavation Site D#069.dst: El jefe quiere hablar contigo. No te recomiendo hacerle esperar, no es un hombre paciente.
WynnExcavation Site D#069.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#070.src: He'll be waiting for you, head through that door.
WynnExcavation Site D#070.dst: Te estará esperando, cruza esa puerta.
WynnExcavation Site D#070.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#071.src: My boss Uci is a bit of a mean guy, but hey the perks of minionship aren't bad!
WynnExcavation Site D#071.dst: Mi jefe Uci es algo borde, pero oye, ¡ser secuaz tiene sus ventajas!
WynnExcavation Site D#071.speaker: Excavator Sean

WynnExcavation Site D#072.src: This leads deeper into this dungeon, but it seems like it has to be activated from the other side.
WynnExcavation Site D#072.dst: Esto lleva más adentro de esta mazmorra, pero parece que hay que activarlo desde el otro lado.
WynnExcavation Site D#072.speaker: WynnExcavation Scientist Azure

WynnExcavation Site D#080.src: Well, well. Looks like you've finally made it.
WynnExcavation Site D#080.dst: Vaya, vaya. Parece que por fin has llegado.
WynnExcavation Site D#080.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#081.src: You might be a little shocked to see me here...
WynnExcavation Site D#081.dst: Quizá te sorprenda un poco verme aquí...
WynnExcavation Site D#081.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#083.src: You finding that old fool in the desert, you surviving that fall.
WynnExcavation Site D#083.dst: Que encontraras a ese viejo loco en el desierto, que sobrevivieras a esa caída.
WynnExcavation Site D#083.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#084.src: You finding that notebook, and eventually meeting me.
WynnExcavation Site D#084.dst: Que encontraras ese cuaderno y que, al final, dieras conmigo.
WynnExcavation Site D#084.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#085.src: Everything that you have done has been planned by the mastermind behind this organisation, me.
WynnExcavation Site D#085.dst: Todo lo que has hecho lo ha planeado el cerebro de esta organización: yo.
WynnExcavation Site D#085.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#086.src: You don't get it, do you? We needed you. The otherworldly crystals are a powerful magic, but a dangerous one at that.
WynnExcavation Site D#086.dst: No lo entiendes, ¿verdad? Te necesitábamos. Los cristales de otro mundo son una magia poderosa, pero también peligrosa.
WynnExcavation Site D#086.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#087.src: We needed you, an unaware human with some form of pure intent to bring empowered shards here. Anyone else would have ran off with the shards, and turned against us. It's just how it all works. I don't expect you to understand.. Now. Enough talking.
WynnExcavation Site D#087.dst: Necesitábamos a un humano ignorante con cierta pureza de intención para traer aquí los fragmentos potenciados. Cualquier otro habría huido con ellos y se habría vuelto contra nosotros. Así funciona todo. No espero que lo entiendas.. Y ahora, basta de charla.
WynnExcavation Site D#087.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#090.dst: Habla con el ayudante de Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#092.src: The crystals combine the power of the stars themselves.. an ultimate power... the power to reign over the entire WORLD!
WynnExcavation Site D#092.dst: Los cristales combinan el poder de las mismísimas estrellas.. un poder supremo... ¡el poder de reinar sobre el MUNDO entero!
WynnExcavation Site D#092.speaker: Corrupted Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#094.src: I- I- I feel... unstoppable.. this power... will not aļ͢͠͠͡l̶̀͜͏͏ów me to lớ̀͠͝se..!!!
WynnExcavation Site D#094.dst: Me- me- me siento... imparable.. este poder... no me d-d-dejará p-perder..!!!
WynnExcavation Site D#094.speaker: Shadow Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#096.src: DID YOU REALLY THINK YOU COULD WIN?!?! YOU ARE NOTHING COMPARED TO ME! NOTHING!! I WILL EXTERMINATE ALL LIFE, STARTING WITH YOU!! NOW, PERISH!!!
WynnExcavation Site D#096.dst: ¡¿DE VERDAD CREÍAS QUE PODÍAS GANAR?!?! ¡NO ERES NADA COMPARADO CONMIGO! ¡¡NADA!! ¡¡EXTERMINARÉ TODA LA VIDA, EMPEZANDO POR TI!! ¡¡¡AHORA, PERECE!!!
WynnExcavation Site D#096.speaker: Amadel

Zhight Island (Quest)#001.src: Hello, esteemed tourist sir or madame! I see you have found my illustrious resort, {p}!
Zhight Island (Quest)#001.dst: ¡Saludos, distinguido turista, señor o señora! ¡Veo que ha encontrado mi ilustre complejo turístico, {p}!
Zhight Island (Quest)#001.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#002.src: Normally, you'd need a reservation to stay here, but our human visitors are ALWAYS welcome! Ehm...
Zhight Island (Quest)#002.dst: Normalmente haría falta reserva para alojarse aquí, ¡pero nuestros visitantes humanos SIEMPRE son bienvenidos! Ehm...
Zhight Island (Quest)#002.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#003.src: ...w-well, actually...wait, no, it's nothing, nothing, friend! I guarantee you'll enjoy your stay here!
Zhight Island (Quest)#003.dst: ...b-bueno, en realidad... espere, no, no es nada, ¡nada, amigo! ¡Le garantizo que disfrutará de su estancia!
Zhight Island (Quest)#003.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#004.src: Even if m-my usual supplies haven't arrived in weeks, I, um, I'm TOTALLY sure we can accommodate for you!
Zhight Island (Quest)#004.dst: Aunque m-mis suministros lleven semanas sin llegar, yo, eh, ¡estoy TOTALMENTE seguro de que podremos atenderle!
Zhight Island (Quest)#004.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#005.src: We can just...um...w-well, I won't impose on you, dearest most welcomest traveller, no sir! Or madame!
Zhight Island (Quest)#005.dst: Podemos... eh... b-bueno, no quiero molestarle, queridísimo y bienvenidísimo viajero, ¡no, señor! ¡O señora!
Zhight Island (Quest)#005.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#006.src: B-But, if, perchance, you were to, um...happen to find my supplier, Phief, who hasn't come around in weeks the bas-
Zhight Island (Quest)#006.dst: P-pero si, por casualidad, usted, eh... se topara con mi proveedor, Phief, que lleva semanas sin aparecer, el muy desgra-
Zhight Island (Quest)#006.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#007.src: I! I mean! Nothing, nothing! Just, ehm, our extra reliable supplier often stops by {p} for supplies...
Zhight Island (Quest)#007.dst: ¡Yo! ¡Quiero decir! ¡Nada, nada! Es que, ehm, nuestro fidelísimo proveedor suele pasar por {p} a por suministros...
Zhight Island (Quest)#007.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#008.src: S-So, if you just happen to stop by there after your lovely stay here, and tell him to get off his sorry butt and send me my supplies that'd be just peachy!
Zhight Island (Quest)#008.dst: A-así que, si pasa por allí después de su estupenda estancia y le dice que mueva el trasero y me mande los suministros, ¡sería de lo más maravilloso!
Zhight Island (Quest)#008.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#010.src: Hello there. I see Zhight has sent you, correct?
Zhight Island (Quest)#010.dst: Hola. Veo que te envía Zhight, ¿verdad?
Zhight Island (Quest)#010.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#011.src: I do hope he isn't mad at me. I fully intended to bring the supplies to him.
Zhight Island (Quest)#011.dst: Espero que no esté enfadado. De verdad pensaba llevarle los suministros.
Zhight Island (Quest)#011.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#012.src: But things took a turn for the worst quickly, and I no longer have access to my ship.
Zhight Island (Quest)#012.dst: Pero las cosas se torcieron enseguida y ya no tengo acceso a mi barco.
Zhight Island (Quest)#012.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#013.src: A madman jumped onto my ship, overpowered me, and held me hostage!
Zhight Island (Quest)#013.dst: ¡Un loco saltó a mi barco, me redujo y me tomó como rehén!
Zhight Island (Quest)#013.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#014.src: He was telling me how he wanted to "take back what was stolen from him", and it looked like he was heading to {p}.
Zhight Island (Quest)#014.dst: No paraba de decir que quería «recuperar lo que le robaron», y parecía que se dirigía a {p}.
Zhight Island (Quest)#014.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#015.src: I have no clue whether he was deranged, paranoid, or if someone really did take something from him.
Zhight Island (Quest)#015.dst: No tengo ni idea de si estaba trastornado, paranoico o si de verdad alguien le quitó algo.
Zhight Island (Quest)#015.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#016.src: I am certain of one thing. Nobody is going to sail my boat but me. I took my first chance to escape, broke the controls.
